title: The Murals of Venice
body:
![IMG_7611.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bobbyb58/244of7xgqcjQbrc7gTT2CHHTW9aCMMpiR7263oDeMcnQXDopvRGxaDduN1x9HAYWMx71e.jpeg)
I've been living in the Southern California community of Santa Monica while my house is being renovated. It's a premier coastal city with a popular entertainment-themed pier, beautiful beaches, plenty of boutique shops, and a laid back luxury feel. Tech companies can be found in old and new architecture, driverless cars intermingle with normal traffic, and small robots scurry along sidewalks to deliver goods. 
![IMG_8148.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bobbyb58/23u64kS3WbjVMiJFzd9qLMLZJw3gbdgHVQzAo2A2VHCGW2bCRxMyt6mstt7raMYgYdRnd.jpeg)
Santa Monica is polished and trendy.

My location is along its southern border, a mile from the ocean and within a few blocks of the quirky Los Angeles city segment known as Venice. Named for canals that were attempted here, Venice is as eclectic as it gets. Where Santa Monica is refined; Venice is randy. Santa Monica has architecture; Venice has a \

hodgepodge of homes and businesses.
![IMG_8039.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bobbyb58/243zNactXvQLQxV9jUb4oKoJAeMExrvm8hxUWLvCLyq9WU2Uxd2A8cJm91NUSMjonGmNB.jpeg)
The change happens quickly. Within a couple of blocks, you leave trendy wealth behind for edgy hip. People don't flaunt wealth in either town, but you can certainly feel it change from posh to pauper.

Venice also has murals. Loads of them. I suspect if I were to walk all of its streets, they would tally to over a hundred. Some on short property walls, and some covering multi-story businesses.
![IMG_7495.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bobbyb58/23zGgJ4qRMs6JdJGKiHHjJhUP5dwf27fERGvCwfcgqKW4eyGojCYYiHQobDbzaETkMUac.jpeg)
The mural painters of Venice take great pride in their art. While vast in their appearance, they generally share the unified theme of community.
![IMG_7615.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bobbyb58/24246az8ADJddaM4CsEKPJMGV5GtAjtbrh6AbCrYhgzCpiHit383Z9c582zpU2Rqhr5TP.jpeg)
A number celebrate the diverse cultural blend that the area founder, Abbott Kinney, believed in and instilled. While other parts of the greater Los Angeles basin were segregated, Venice was for everyone, and the murals honor that.
![IMG_7617.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bobbyb58/243qHDSNeyGUemLQUPY9ySh54G9Wkn1Hog6Ufir5V48LaDDVbUGH8bTJXx3mbiMkMpQuz.jpeg)
Other murals are purely for the joy of expression, meant to brighten up your day, and if so inclined, steer you towards a local business.
![IMG_7618.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bobbyb58/23z79UHJpXRGbzwC8UpzmatftzVkXE1HKU864sKCF5LuU849EyQ2ZFn84RhCZbaF3cYAx.jpeg)
And lastly, some harken to days gone by, and the stories of motorcycles and convertibles rolling along Highway 1, the road that rides the California coastline from Mexico to the state of Oregon and beyond.
![IMG_7494.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bobbyb58/EonjUdUpqVzpMWk8PHF3oH7nhqFEwnhA6r9BiwMnVHtouKDucdUsD5iBZD8tKjSpEYu.jpeg)
In all, the vibrant art makes you laugh, makes you think, and when stuck in ruch hour traffic, makes you forget your troubles for a while.

title: San Juan de Macarapana|| An agricultural zona in Sucre (Eng/Spa)
body:
> 

Happy Friday, dear bloggers, to this wonderful community of **Worldmappin**. I send my best wishes to all of you. It’s wonderful to share my visit to the **San Juan** River, located south of Cumaná in Sucre State, Venezuela—a town and the capital of the parish of the same name in the municipality of Sucre.

> Feliz viernes queridos bloggers  a esta   gran comunidad  de  **Worldmappin**,   deseándole mis mejores deseos a todos los usuarios.  Es maravilloso compartir mi visita al Rio \

** ubicada al sur de Cumaná - estado - Sucre - VENEZUELA**, una población y capital de la parroquia homónima en el municipio Sucre.
![1001670308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/245cUCB3T5fEU8tyBWhdX8YktBBcqqHSZ5YUbA6iSeDMArFxezZRumYhpNYXpE96KDFNA.jpg) ![1001670306.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/242rkw1VjE7NspaszkLqs1GW948NDoZbrQ9EhpfbjwtVTsqHUVfLobmosQjJqDuo9uebS.jpg) ![1001670307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/244e6MwpVuAi2FnbgserDVGH7gf8J7pE4fKVEKQWKZgp5ekMwiFwxxZ5WdLsMS5D7wCpv.jpg) ![1001670300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/242XyKQiUcEohn8NEuLNrd79SbLjfyJQWLc4wNbPRQHpk7q9qkkCLM4pTuu65QLgot23g.jpg) ![1001670295.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23yd3npDEqUjYeabU5kTp5H4nvTESVpiWA77YPMZ7o9r2a7diuYm3jaPJiQqK4rCed18H.jpg)

> 

**The San Juan de Macarapana River** is a beautiful tourist spot that’s very popular with locals and visitors alike. There, you can enjoy its stunning scenery and natural pools, surrounded by large rocks and farmland. It’s just a 20-minute drive away, and you can get there by car or by bus from the 4 Esquinas area in Cumaná. The fare is 200 Bfs /0.3$.     





> El río **\

** es un hermoso lugar turístico muy visitado por lugareños y turistas, en donde podemos disfrutar de sus hermosos paisajes y sus pozas, rodeado de grandes piedras y vegetación agrícola, que en escasos 20 minutos podremos llegar en vehículos propios y buses que salen desde el sector 4 esquinas en Cumaná. El pasaje cuesta 200 Bfs /0.3$ ![1001670315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/2432Dc3yQeqeKTazDyxm9ZhGzyZdz7pfaJLcuZU6U1q7XP2w1fx5zrpXofRcU3qLXE2eM.jpg) ![1001670333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23w2cudNJW9MdoaH1KMiJDLWf14a2ZGLiur9kBZgy8acQ4tAqpUiRr5MEGr7s5aVAuQ49.jpg) ![1001670319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/241tT8a9HurqGtoyHQ79x4yaDSQqM6W3RpC9g1HmX4GBgg8uNAG6qpY9EA1iw8ZVd9w5v.jpg) ![1001670324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/242Y1Edk9Q5ohEjz4GN7RLvy8jsAvdQ3y8sgQZ51436wyKzQw6by7oRsHZq3ha1oYfXuN.jpg)

> We drove there in our own car and it only took 20 minutes. The road is in good condition; we enjoyed the wooded area, breathing in the fresh air, as this region is considered the “lung” of Sucre state. There are several rest stops where you can park, as well as many concrete huts with blue-painted benches bearing the names of trees and fruits; you just need to contribute 2 bolivianos toward their upkeep. We stayed at the hut called **Mango**. In addition to having a fire pit made of concrete and stones, it has a grill and firewood for preparing your food; in this case, we had a barbecue. > Nos fuimos en carro propio y solo tardamos 20 minutos. La carretera está en buen estado; disfrutamos de esa zona boscosa, pues respiramos aire puro, pues este es considerado el pulmón de este estado, Sucre. Hay varios paradores turísticos en donde puedes estacionarte y muchas chozas de cemento con bancos pintados de azul, con nombres de árboles y frutas; solo tienes que colaborar con 2, para su mantenimiento. Nos alojamos en la choza llamada **Mango**, además de tener un fogón hecho de cemento y piedras, contiene una parrillera y leña,para preparar tu comida, en este caso hicimos una parrilla.
![1001670473.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23uFU4NNWThijdaonGhFcP8h6K3x1mFRua1hAUR25S5q1ctD1mfvz3porMMgfQzPP727P.jpg) ![1001670330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23u697rXdYbThTzNPHynbEZwD9repny2Zeaf11yAqHR5LAGdkXPritVdPeDEbAPHBvG6F.jpg) ![1001670332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23tmL9A91WpAzuCQLDgyve47eXT7J44Ejg998ZsGydT7qzCT6C1aGMdKxqd48Ahei9J2j.jpg) ![1001670325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23vsSpZurUy53AK2iXL3q7JatNUM5rwTyivLRMoZZUwjqrJ3SNw6rTsY7gaM8bpsCDVq7.jpg)

>

This area is an agricultural region and is home to many houses, as it is a town with approximately 20,000 residents. Many people work on their own land, which is very fertile and produces the foods we need for our basic diet, such as fruits, vegetables, beans, poultry, and beef, among others. Agriculture is an important economic activity for the local residents. > Este lugar es una zona agrícola y está poblado de muchas casas, ya que es una población con aproximadamente 20.000 habitantes. Muchos trabajan en su propia tierra, la cual es muy fértil para producir alimentos que necesitamos en nuestra dieta básica, como verduras,frutas, hortalizas, frijoles, aves de corral, carne de ganado, entre otros. La agricultura es una actividad económica importante para sus habitantes.

> The river is characterized by numerous rocks of various sizes; its waters are home to fish such as guaraguaras and shrimp. At this time of year, we can see that the river is dry; soon the rains will come and the water will rise, making it a great time to swim in the fresh waters of the San Juan River, which flows through the entire parish. >El río se caracteriza por tener varias piedras de diferentes tamaños; sus aguas poseen peces como guaraguaras y camarones. En esta época podemos notar que el río está seco; pronto llegarán las lluvias y el agua sube y es mejor poder bañarse en las dulces aguas del río San Juan que atraviesan toda la geografía de la parroquia.

> This town hosts many festivals, such as the Cruz de Mayo, and the region’s biggest festival takes place on June 24 in honor of Saint John the Baptist, its patron saint, and is considered one of the most significant traditions in all of Venezuela. In addition to having stores where you can shop using points-of-sale systems, it also has many educational institutions and a clinic. > En este pueblo se celebran muchas festividades como la cruz de mayo, y la gran fiesta de esta región se celebra el 24 de junio en honor a San Juan Bautista, su santo patrón, constituida como una de las mayores tradiciones en todo el territorio de Venezuela. Además de poseer abastos donde puedes comprar con puntos de ventas, tambien tiene muchas intituciones educativas y un ambulbulatorio.
![1001670473.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23uFU4NNWThijdaonGhFcP8h6K3x1mFRua1hAUR25S5q1ctD1mfvz3porMMgfQzPP727P.jpg) ![1001670338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/243q6HVGiEPn9Nit4PZzCY3w2mtbTV53G6Zye6AzWnCkKaCgmztDAFMcqK8VBUXVdgsoQ.jpg) ![1001670339.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/244KJfxgA4187QabFP4pW3fcQXgaedwZRGXQ8hhM5ccwZTShZF8SUUcXNMobQiR8SuBdS.jpg) ![1001670329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23wMYfDDLYP8MntH7Fz3gwrrXqcRBreMhWFncPokgBAqQLEzvJUpz9uBcxAeFc4SmUHQR.jpg)

> 


Many people enjoy cooking outdoors, such as a “sancocho a leña” or a “parrilla.” They can swim in the crystal-clear waters, which is why it is considered a popular spot for recreation and relaxation. 

> Muchas personas disfrutan preparando comidas al aire libre, como un \

. Podrán bañarse en las aguas cristalinas, por eso es considerado un sitio popular para la recreación y el descanso.
![1001670469.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23uFTrFV7shq4XdFqvvqwVJhwKAezMU986GHgRnZseEmH6gv3T68TYSNKqVVNteh4sABS.jpg) ![1001670462.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EpELHNQZ1tc78tDoS6mKX9Vmzz3VvMGYT7tWyakKbS2jRyBgZJr3SBkpiMJDYRs6xJd.jpg) ![1001670392.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoeGGfzekn7bdGVBVgvW4GFxTp9F7zoAkJqc4YcmsfoEtCqRmJqq4rqrYQPWGJ4DtnL.jpg)

After enjoying a wonderful day surrounded by nature and delicious food, we headed home as evening fell. A light rain began to fall, which made the atmosphere even more pleasant and refreshing. That’s all for now, my fellow adventurers. >Luego de disfrutar de un exclente dia en contacto con la naturaleza, delicosa comida, nos vinimos a nuestras casas al caer la tarde, comenzco a caer una pequeña lluvia, lo que hizo que el ambiente fuera mas agradable y fresco. Hasta aquí, mis aventureros.
![1001670507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23vsQTkv9GMejCbD549iaNvxvgkMhJ8eWLTaYai73KaFJcKUS2uqnkmQXhGFzjuMGjfNP.jpg) ![1001670398.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/2423o1MXdLo8Nen3CuN83NKVX24niizrWBKZ5cFgUbR8oUY2JsJ2mL8WRV3n3GmNbr3xG.jpg) ![1001670346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EpVA9bdgj4WYnKUgxqv7HtfCy3YhES5GG5EF3VRcfLvu7CmHvSKxAEvJLpt8ZrfqUFy.jpg)

body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![Delicioso almuerzo (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tvsFuC89WjLkW7hL1E7KjhQJmaRf9Hc7j6CFiKstjhBwPzrpN2yupquqZ7QcGbuKYwE.jpg)

>
 
Hola, amigos, nuevamente con otra receta saludable; se trata de unas arepas con semillas acompañadas de una revoltilla de huevo y queso. Les cuento, amigos, que desde que cambié mis hábitos alimenticios, busco la manera de preparar mi dieta lo más saludable posible. Esta vez preparé para mi desayuno sano arepas con 4 semillas que son muy nutritivas, ricas en fibra; además, tienen mucho beneficio para el organismo, ya que contienen grasas buenas, buena porción de proteínas, porque a través de estas semillas le inyectamos a estas arepas esa fibra que necesitamos para un nutritivo desayuno. Espero que les guste tanto como a mí. ¡Aquí les comparto el paso a paso!


> Hi, friends, I’m back with another healthy recipe: seed-filled arepas served with scrambled eggs and cheese. Let me tell you, friends, ever since I changed my eating habits, I’ve been looking for ways to prepare my meals as healthily as possible. This time, for my healthy breakfast, I made arepas with four types of seeds that are very nutritious and high in fiber; plus, they offer many health benefits, since they contain healthy fats and a good amount of protein. These seeds provide the fiber we need for a nutritious breakfast. I hope you like them as much as I do. Here’s the step-by-step guide!


---


![El texto del párrafo (32).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EouEzXFRam7Qu5Er4T5yaxbebYHDJJvGYKKJedtHFWxqE5sXNxmydEWFdjp6DLSkUTF.jpg)

<div class = \

> - 2 cucharadas de chía - 2 cucharadas de linaza - 2 cucharadas de ajonjolí - 3 cucharadas de afrecho - 1 taza de harina de maíz - 2 huevos - 1 cucharada de mantequilla - Aceite - 2 lajas de queso paisa - Sal

> - 2 tablespoons of chia seeds - 2 tablespoons of flaxseeds - 2 tablespoons of sesame seeds - 3 tablespoons of bran - 1 cup of cornmeal - 2 eggs - 1 tablespoon of butter - Oil - 2 slices of Paisa cheese - Salt

![1000464781.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uQxtKvPdW9z5g2ZyNy1KLTzGxs1FX2YP5U86tuYzuoh19eGtWiCegSnucuVJu8oTumT.jpg)
![El texto del párrafo (31).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EowNPiUud55yj2BkuDpKGUA8asqcUnP2g4hytTz9iUtwoeMREbopLjBeaQpT27KBKrK.jpg)
- Lo primero que hacemos es colocar en un recipiente las semillas de chía, luego las de linaza, seguidamente la de ajonjolí, el afrecho, la harina de maíz y sal al gusto. > - First, place the chia seeds in a bowl, followed by the flaxseeds, then the sesame seeds, the bran, the cornmeal, and salt to taste.
|![1000464782.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wC9oGfWymoWDqa3uLB9Sp2xds5mq7td4zR1nATvnDb8CyiVfSYH3qn4U7XKATQYe8vc.jpg)|![1000464784.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23zS7ksBPFPLutpWu292NmEnvcE8TGuhGZAy33aMqXex8FCoigok4SvmQCMR61Zc9VuYZ.jpg)|![1000464786.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMcPBPdmPuGA3ZxzdJ1Wd4fnw1mtR74nWLchbi4cRM3LZoe7rNLjWVkkUNE8x9pvYnn.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![1000464788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wWyQ67RMkLxY2pxp3BWEQkTpUf4K3ffufxLiCWgmPpNZ17pbdoV37LWGEbHQVfnYyGw.jpg)|![arepa1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsX3NSQbxPQPh51kaukdJVjVG96aeqhGZBw6VaiyTjos9N4oNPAqstBUGh5MAJwXzR1.jpg)|![arepa2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMeXxwwa8eXNim3D63sMWgrJt6ei9Ujo7vJeJp2yr9oUutuLyvJAdHYi9TnvABwThiB.jpg)|
- Ahora añadimos agua poco a poco y comenzamos a amasar hasta conseguir una masa suave. > - Now add water little by little and begin kneading until you have a smooth dough.
|![1000464793.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xp8dpawhvRRNLz1uSL6483Mh4ymRYEXGoEwoWnQixqeFhXj9boQmw5hNJ16m5MvDz8S.jpg)|![1000464795.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yJJHf8DGqwZtWHQEmsLyPihEmygtZhijUTziRRg3Ajc4roML4Be2LC8vQYvg23mXeCQ.jpg)| |-|-|
- Ahora hacemos una bola con la masa y aplastamos hasta formar una rueda. > - Now shape the dough into a ball and flatten it into a round disc.
|![1000464797.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xVP1vcrFjznc7Tgo9tF2hXPUezV3pAHMmoE5FhoMdeCAfcm6wcMkb5iMJkJF5F4FXbf.jpg)|![1000464798.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMh7P2DPXQdEN9kEStfak2tjzzqPAyMtuNYiHD1rhoeh4yyVhXBcKbwsdCdx94j3QXA.jpg)| |-|-|
- Luego tomamos un budare y lo colocamos en la cocina a fuego alto, untamos aceite y, cuando esté caliente, colocamos las arepas y dejamos cocinar por ambos lados. > - Next, take a budare and place it on the stove over high heat. Brush it with oil, and once it’s hot, place the arepas on it and cook them on both sides.
|![1000464800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xyQamzNLc5vwg79Y4CairGCLotPGaMruX8SYxqNGVv8KpaskRgA9Xp8iX2bty5GXKqr.jpg)|![1000464801.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsFeL3M8JkifEMvyckkveakBKb3ATe9xdZQoQ8JnprbFnr8oHZ6uALMkbnEM4q11e6Y.jpg)| |-|-| |![1000464804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23y8jM6T3BgxaEqjZnA2mPqkng7dtikBLCTf3yCHtJBjbKzBX9DK4ssFCtShoYkVTmbiJ.jpg)|![1000464805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xVEvt5A2AkM3CcMZwTvtqsoULLwzoJukrX3P5YKrAqr1VETX4HiVQu2oebf7A8FAcen.jpg)|
- Mientras se cocinan las arepas, tomamos una sartén, le colocamos aceite de oliva y, cuando esté caliente, añadimos los huevos y vamos batiendo con un tenedor y le añadimos el queso y dejamos cocinar. > - While the arepas are cooking, take a skillet, add some olive oil, and once it’s hot, add the eggs and beat them with a fork. Then add the cheese and let it cook.
|![1000464830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vi1f7aEAr5KG4CUKoRzTqAqRTzzDhzwWcF45ya9KqVr3s8FJmYPPtksSayNsZN9qaMR.jpg)|![1000464833.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23x1BQHRdHCct63i9imZBNBjQmRgxy9hPzcVXMDxeaSPd8EkmLXV3fSVRkppoUk5VboYQ.jpg)|![arepa3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tSYjdi6VMBExgxuhazzSC72xuWq18rfQE8BD5MRvypMnwqEf3bjbXsAG4CVfbS2LNFV.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Una vez listas las arepas, procedemos a rellenarlas; para eso tomamos la arepa, la abrimos por la mitad, le untamos mantequilla y luego agregamos el revoltillo y listo. > - Once the arepas are ready, we fill them; to do this, we take an arepa, split it in half, spread butter on it, add the mixture, and that’s it.
|![1000464834.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yJCN3EDrSCi9iHaUWLHHgWVGDrXdmVBKtjbsDQsYoa295ucFgiYmy3Weccuyw7GyRYG.jpg)|![1000464836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wquFLMvJgV99BpG6EZhNAX6Kmps1Pj3ha8j4K4Gw4ifM59efn1AKqBu75qK2qXF1sza.jpg)|![1000464838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMjGDHuhDhQSo5qvxTa4fGNA2PySG9EeU92TEdD9VynEDJEPi9SyAroKaFSR88WzW2H.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![1000464840.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xL2YHSPQfXX7mn2x6CofJci4FVJUQPb1Y6sGESAb43pVNoi4FQwRuSq1GJ8QzAonHtT.jpg)|![1000464841.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2wed9y8j2PwLCedeVjRzSYB5CF9AeC8VJdmoKeMJWn8Tn1CkKFsPf6jfwMTXYKwoB6.jpg)|![1000464842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uFefP8TAeHCy2NYLHNzAKXj4Fh84nrTPAH3b82n6RVzC8SAm3on9MwV6QYL2uRWcjVn.jpg)|
- Ahora a degustar este delicioso desayuno saludable. Buen apetito. > - Now let's enjoy this delicious, healthy breakfast. Bon appétit.
![1000464843.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uFXnHc1bJktDxAMuKF65YwqkVUf4f5HmT4nr3s2ZKd5UzscapfycWfABtRKnrzL3NZd.jpg) ![1000464847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vi7vYghJEVvJSc8isxPVZAubzX3pzV7Kp7yS7FAh1PLuQWKaHgSmGGeVS6csPidKJNE.jpg)

title: Busy days, big dreams 🚗❤️
body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmefscMvEMUdSVcqQn5q88TuWhs8drvDod41Uy1uDQdeQy/IMG_4985.jpg 

Running from one place to another has honestly become part of my routine lately. Some days feel exhausting, but at the same time, I know every little step is taking me closer to the life I want.

Today was full of errands, calls, messages, and random unexpected things… but I still tried to enjoy the moment instead of stressing over everything.

I’ve learned that confidence is not pretending to have life figured out. It’s continuing forward even when things feel messy sometimes.

And yes… music in the car always makes everything better 🎶✨

title: Un día caluroso, lleno de amor y primeras videollamadas / A Hot Day Filled with Love and Our First Video Call
body:
ESPANISH 🇪🇦

![IMG20260508135119.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23uFRcXfkgDDU6a9yG3nDt9V8azBaGerW8yWXgLh2qLB9vdL5ZgHJyfXq9cPLS3VBmVhw.jpg)

Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes mi día. La corriente eléctrica estaba programada de 6 a 9 de la mañana, pero yo me demoré un poco en la cama porque pasé mucho calor durante la noche y quería dormir con el ventilador. Me levanté a las 8:39, apenas quedaban 20 minutos para preparar el almuerzo, calentar agua para bañar a Lukas y hacer café y desayuno.
Me levanté corriendo, sin siquiera cambiarme, lavarme los dientes o la cara. Puse la cafetera, cociné unas pechuguitas de pollo en la olla y arroz en el fogón. En seguida Lukas se despertó y le di su yogur de desayuno. @valderalazaro me ayudó mucho con la preparación del almuerzo mientras yo cambiaba a Lukas y lo vestía. Luego me di una ducha rápida y nos arreglamos ambos para salir.
Fuimos al centro de Matanzas, a la calle del medio, que es como nuestro bulevar local. Visitamos algunas tiendas y traté de hacer gestiones con mi tarjeta para compras en dólares, pero la falta de corriente y otros problemas hicieron que no pudiéramos resolverlo todo. Después nos sentamos en la heladería del Hotel del Louvre para refrescarnos del sol y disfrutamos un helado de fresa que pudimos pagar por transferencia, aunque los trabajos nos pagan con tarjeta no siempre nos dejan pagar en transferencia en muchos lugares 
De vuelta caminando, compré unas galletitas de limón y gelatina para la merienda de Lukas. Al llegar a la casa, nos sentamos un rato en el teatro Sausto, y Lukas se quedó dormido en el coche. Llegamos a casa alrededor de las 3:15 p.m., seguimos preparando la comida, y cuando la luz se fue a las 6 p.m., nos fuimos a la bahía a tomar un poco de vino blanco. Lukas disfrutaba viendo el mar y no paraba de gritar  \

cuando vio el mar 
Lo más especial del día fue nuestra primera videollamada con nuestra amiga @cathyarrow  y su esposo @bradleyarrow , que viven en Canadá. Ver su alegría al conocernos fue muy emotivo. @cathyarrow  conoció a mi esposo @valderazaro en el hotel, pero nunca nos había visto a mí ni a Lukas. Fue hermoso sentir todo el amor y cariño que nos da, y doy gracias a Dios por poner personas tan sinceras y amorosas en nuestro camino.
Al volver a casa, Lukas comió, se bañó y ya está durmiendo. Ha sido un día lleno de calor, caminatas, pequeños retos con la electricidad, pero también de amor, encuentros especiales y momentos que recordaré con alegría.

ENGLISH 🇬🇧

Today I want to share my day with you. The electricity was scheduled from 6 to 9 a.m., but I stayed in bed a little longer because it was so hot during the night and I wanted to sleep with the fan. I got up at 8:39 a.m., leaving only 20 minutes to prepare lunch, heat water for Lukas’s bath, make coffee, and breakfast.
I got up in a rush, without even changing, brushing my teeth, or washing my face. I started the coffee, cooked some chicken breasts in the pot, and made rice on the stove. Lukas woke up right away, and I gave him his yogurt for breakfast. @valderalazaro helped me a lot with lunch while I changed Lukas and dressed him. Then I took a quick shower and we both got ready to go out.
We went to downtown Matanzas, to “Calle del Medio,” which is like our local boulevard. We visited some shops, and I tried to take care of an issue with my dollar card, but the power cuts and other obstacles made it difficult to solve. Afterward, we stopped at the ice cream shop at the Hotel del Louvre to cool off from the sun and enjoyed a strawberry ice cream, which we could pay for via transfer , Although our jobs pay us by card, many places don't always allow us to pay by bank transfer.
On our way back, I bought some lemon cookies and gelatin for Lukas’s snack. At home, we sat for a while at the Sausto Theater, and Lukas fell asleep in the stroller. We got home around 3:15 p.m., continued preparing food, and when the electricity went out at 6 p.m., we went to the bay to enjoy some white wine. Lukas loved the sea and 
He kept shouting \

when he saw the sea lol
The most special part of the day was our first video call with our friend @cathyarrow and her husband @bradleyarrow , who live in Canada. Seeing her so happy to meet us was very emotional. Cathy met Lázaro at the hotel, but she had never seen me or Lukas before. It was beautiful to feel all the love and affection she gave us, and I thank God for putting such sincere and loving people in our lives.
When we got back home, Lucas ate, took a bath, and is now sleeping. It has been a day full of heat, walks, small challenges with electricity, but also love, special moments, and memories I will cherish 
![IMG-20260508-WA0034.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23zkpmqQyYHSUGVv7YCSh6cb9wE8ja5NQLbhVYxr3hjG34bWK8FqeVodNQ183VvwznnQM.jpeg)

![IMG-20260508-WA0036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/244e5jp5dtkqKRjdwHfyBLmDwKTGmooNHerFPRzGReaYvYCavq949q9Bf4QmzepHrZPSe.jpg)



![IMG-20260508-WA0032.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23z79gJqnmxz5c3pLo8MoTuZXbsc5cqXSYhkQ4C98my6NC6zk1ENYruxdgfZVGrdY24VR.jpeg)

![IMG-20260508-WA0002.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/242Y9ZGNSYh3PbcocWPWbh3oJSDVkyBmd3p2YnBkMGdHipnrySn4q7awwPb7Wvw5vswhW.jpeg)


Gracias a mi esposo, @valderalazaro, por ser mi apoyo incondicional en cada etapa de mi vida, incluso en las más difíciles.
A @bradleyarrow y a su esposa @cathyarrow, por formar parte de mi familia y por ser personas tan maravillosas.
Y a todos los seguidores de BitD, gracias por estar, por leer y por acompañar cada historia. Los invito a seguir apoyando la comunidad BBH, para que juntos podamos seguir ayudando a quienes más lo necesitan.
Acknowledgements (English):
Thanks to my husband, @valderalazaro, for being my unconditional support through every stage of my life, even the hardest ones.
To @bradleyarrow and his wife @cathyarrow, for being part of my family and for being such wonderful people.
And to all the BitD followers, thank you for being there, for reading, and for supporting every story. I invite you all to continue supporting the BBH community, so together we can keep helping those in need.

title: El precio de vivir en el escenario
body:
Publicado en Español, Inglés y Portugués.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZMqdNsUu127H5ZFv8KgVxHVVERbz58LunTwdiprZnwj/1778292510558.jpg) *Editado en PhotoCollage*


[Fuente](https://www.aalavina.org/sites/default/files/p46-108591980.jpg) *de la imagen utilizada*.

---
---


Buenas noches y dulces sueños.

Vamos directo a lo que quiero reflexionar.

Hay una idea incómoda que casi nadie quiere aceptar y es que aparentar lo que no se es no es un truco social sin consecuencias. Se convierte en una condena voluntaria.

La mayoría de las personas creen que fingir un estatus, felicidad o seguridad solo les trae beneficios como la aceptación, envidia o validación. Pero eso es porque solo miran los primeros minutos de la obra. Nadie habla del último acto.

El castigo no es externo, va por dentro. Cuando construyes una versión de ti que no existe, ocurren tres cosas objetivas, una es que tu energía se agota en mantener la mentira. Cada interacción social se convierte en un examen. Y eso mismo pasa con cada like, saludo o comentario casual que siempre exige revisar el guion. ¿Dije que ganaba eso? ¿Publiqué aquella foto? ¿Recordaré no delatar mi realidad? El cerebro humano no está diseñado para sostener ficciones todo el tiempo. La fatiga mental que genera no es ansiedad clínica, es el desgaste lógico de un actor que nunca sale del escenario.

Otra cosa es que dejas de recibir referencias reales sobre tu vida.
La gente aplaude tu personaje, no a ti. Y ese aplauso es veneno pues valida algo falso. Cuando finalmente tropieces,y créeme que lo harás, porque todo ser humano tropieza, te darás cuenta de que nadie te conoce. Los que te admiraban admiraban una sombra e infelizmente no podrán ayudarte porque no saben quién eres. Y tú tampoco.

Ademas de lo que hemos hablado, hay algo muy importante, tu identidad real se atrofia por desuso.
Este es un daño irreversible. Un músculo que no se usa se encoge. La autenticidad es un músculo. Entonces pasas años preguntándote \

, y vas dejando de saber lo que realmente te gusta o te duele, lo que quieres. No es que te reprimas, es que literalmente pierdes el acceso a tu propia brújula emocional. Un día te miras al espejo y hay un extraño.\n\nY luego está el \
. La obsesión por la mirada ajena no es debilidad de carácter. Es un mecanismo de supervivencia social mal calibrado. Nuestros cerebros primitivos asocian \
. Por eso duele tanto. Pero les voy a presentar la verdad objetiva\n\nEl \

no es una fuerza externa. Es una cadena que tú mismo te pones. La mayoría de la gente no te está juzgando. Están demasiado ocupados fingiendo ellos también. El castigo final de aparentar es descubrir que viviste para una audiencia que ni siquiera prestaba atención.

Que triste todo, que triste esa escalera de las apariencias; cada peldaño que subes te aleja más del suelo firme

De pronto te convertiste en una foto cuidadosamente editada, un logro exagerado, una felicidad que no sientes o la opinión que no es tuya.

Y un día, cuando quieras bajar, descubres que no recordabas cómo se caminaba sin aplausos.

No hay un juicio divino contra los falsos. Solo hay consecuencias materiales, tales como: relaciones superficiales, fatiga crónica, vulnerabilidad extrema ante cualquier fracaso real, y un vacío que no se llena con likes.

La gente no te odia por ser auténtico. La gente, simplemente, no piensa en ti tanto como crees. No eres el ombligo del mundo.

Bajar de la escalera duele más que subir. Pero solo abajo hay descanso.

---
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

---
---

# *ENGLISH*

---
---

Good  evening, and sweet dreams.

Let's go straight to what I want to reflect on.

There's an uncomfortable idea that almost no one wants to accept: pretending to be what you are not is not a social trick without consequences. It becomes a self-imposed sentence.

Most people believe that faking status, happiness, or security only brings them benefits like acceptance, envy, or validation. But that's because they only watch the first few minutes of the play. No one talks about the final act.

The punishment is not external; it's internal. When you build a version of yourself that doesn't exist, three objective things happen. One is that your energy drains away maintaining the lie. Every social interaction becomes an exam. The same goes for every like, greeting, or casual comment that always requires checking the script. \

The human brain is not designed to sustain fictions all the time. The mental fatigue this generates is not clinical anxiety; it's the logical wear and tear of an actor who never leaves the stage.

Another thing is that you stop receiving real feedback about your life. People applaud your character, not you. And that applause is poison because it validates something false. When you finally stumble, and believe me, you will, because every human being stumbles ,you will realize that no one knows you. Those who admired you admired a shadow, and unfortunately they won't be able to help you because they don't know who you are. Neither do you.

Besides what we've discussed, there's something very important: your real identity atrophies from disuse. This is irreversible damage. A muscle that isn't used shrinks. Authenticity is a muscle. So you spend years asking yourself \

, and you gradually stop knowing what you really like or what hurts you, what you want. It's not that you repress yourself; it's that you literally lose access to your own emotional compass. One day you look in the mirror and there's a stranger.\n\nThen there's \
The obsession with others' gaze is not a character flaw. It's a poorly calibrated social survival mechanism. Our primitive brains associate \
That's why it hurts so much. But I'm going to present you with the objective truth: \

is not an external force. It's a chain you put on yourself. Most people aren't judging you. They're too busy pretending too. The final punishment of pretending is discovering that you lived for an audience that wasn't even paying attention.

How sad all of this is, how sad that ladder of appearances; every rung you climb takes you further from solid ground. Suddenly you've become a carefully edited photo, an exaggerated achievement, a happiness you don't feel, or an opinion that isn't yours. And one day, when you want to come down, you discover you couldn't remember how to walk without applause.

There is no divine judgment against fakes. There are only material consequences, such as: superficial relationships, chronic fatigue, extreme vulnerability to any real failure, and a void that likes cannot fill. People don't hate you for being authentic. People simply don't think about you as much as you think. You are not the center of the universe.

Climbing down the ladder hurts more than climbing up. But only at the bottom is there rest.

---
---

# *PORTUGUÉS*

---
---

Boa noite e doce sonhos.

Vamos direto ao que quero refletir.

Há uma ideia desconfortável que quase ninguém quer aceitar: fingir ser o que não se é não é um truque social sem consequências. Torna-se uma condenação voluntária.

A maioria das pessoas acredita que fingir status, felicidade ou segurança só lhes traz benefícios como aceitação, inveja ou validação. Mas isso é porque elas só assistem aos primeiros minutos da peça. Ninguém fala sobre o último ato.

O castigo não é externo, é interno. Quando você constrói uma versão de si mesmo que não existe, três coisas objetivas acontecem. Uma é que sua energia se esgota mantendo a mentira. Cada interação social se torna um exame. E o mesmo acontece com cada like, cada cumprimento ou comentário casual que sempre exige que você verifique o roteiro. \

O cérebro humano não foi projetado para sustentar ficções o tempo todo. O cansaço mental que isso gera não é ansiedade clínica; é o desgaste lógico de um ator que nunca sai do palco.

Outra coisa é que você deixa de receber referências reais sobre sua vida. As pessoas aplaudem seu personagem, não você. E esse aplauso é veneno porque valida algo falso. Quando você finalmente tropeçar, e acredite, você vai, porque todo ser humano tropeça , você perceberá que ninguém te conhece. Aqueles que te admiravam admiravam uma sombra e, infelizmente, não poderão te ajudar porque não sabem quem você é. Nem você sabe.

Além do que já falamos, há algo muito importante: sua identidade real atrofia por desuso. Isso é um dano irreversível. Um músculo que não é usado encolhe. A autenticidade é um músculo. Então você passa anos se perguntando \

, e vai deixando de saber o que realmente gosta, o que te machuca, o que você quer. Não é que você se reprima; é que você literalmente perde o acesso à sua própria bússola emocional. Um dia você se olha no espelho e há um estranho.\n\nE então há o \
A obsessão pelo olhar alheio não é uma fraqueza de caráter. É um mecanismo de sobrevivência social mal calibrado. Nossos cérebros primitivos associam \
. É por isso que dói tanto. Mas vou lhes apresentar a verdade objetiva: o \

não é uma força externa. É uma corrente que você mesmo coloca em si mesmo. A maioria das pessoas não está te julgando. Elas estão ocupadas demais fingindo também. O castigo final de fingir é descobrir que você viveu para uma plateia que nem sequer prestava atenção.

Que triste tudo isso, que triste essa escada das aparências; cada degrau que você sobe te afasta mais do chão firme. De repente você se tornou uma foto cuidadosamente editada, uma conquista exagerada, uma felicidade que não sente, ou uma opinião que não é sua. E um dia, quando quiser descer, descobre que não se lembrava como se caminhava sem aplausos.

Não há um julgamento divino contra os falsos. Há apenas consequências materiais, tais como: relacionamentos superficiais, fadiga crônica, vulnerabilidade extrema diante de qualquer fracasso real, e um vazio que os likes não preenchem. As pessoas não te odeiam por ser autêntico. As pessoas simplesmente não pensam em você tanto quanto você pensa. Você não é o centro do mundo.

Descer da escada dói mais do que subir. Mas só lá embaixo há descanso.

title: Mujer en la sociedad vikinga y europa Esp    /Women in Viking Society and Europe.  Eng
body:
Esp 🇪🇸
Antes de empezar a escribir sobre lo que tengo pensado para hoy en mi blog les cuento que el día de hoy se puede considerar único y si quiere saber mucho más de él tienen que revisar el blog de mi esposa @diazktty se sorprenderán de lo que sucedió creo que es una de las mejores cosas que me a pasado este mes 

![IMG_20260508_220928.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23z7L9cuyE6bnA2mmG9fiiBHeuXRDtH1s35uPZTeeDDT41ToUbGWoFLDuShuPtAwSifMD.png)

Hoy quiero hacer una comparación sobre la posición de las mujeres en la sociedad vikinga y en la Europa occidental entre los años 800 y 1100 después de Cristo, para ver las diferencias y similitudes de manera clara.
1. Poder político:
En la sociedad vikinga, la política era patriarcal: los hombres eran jefes de clan o caudillos. Las mujeres no gobernaban oficialmente, pero podían influir en decisiones familiares y locales, especialmente cuando los hombres estaban ausentes. En Europa continental, bajo el feudalismo temprano, la política estaba casi exclusivamente en manos de hombres nobles. Las mujeres nobles podían ser regentes si su marido o hijo eran menores, pero su autoridad era temporal y supervisada. En resumen, en Escandinavia las mujeres tenían algo más de autonomía práctica, especialmente en la gestión cotidiana de tierras y recursos.
2. Propiedad y herencia:
Las mujeres vikingas podían heredar tierras y propiedades si no tenían hermanos, y tenían derecho legal sobre la herencia y la gestión de sus bienes. En Europa continental, normalmente la herencia pasaba primero a los hijos varones; las mujeres solo heredaban si no había varones, y su control sobre la propiedad estaba limitado por esposos o tutores. Por lo tanto, las mujeres vikingas tenían más independencia legal sobre la propiedad.
3. Economía:
En la sociedad vikinga, las mujeres gestionaban granjas, recursos y comercio local durante la ausencia de los hombres, quienes a menudo estaban en expediciones o guerras. En Europa continental, las mujeres campesinas también trabajaban, pero la economía de la granja estaba subordinada al señor feudal o al esposo. Así, las mujeres vikingas tenían mayor autonomía económica, especialmente en comunidades rurales.
4. Religión y espiritualidad:
Las völvas (sacerdotisas) vikingas tenían gran respeto social e influían en decisiones y rituales importantes. En Europa continental, la Iglesia Católica estaba dominada por hombres; las mujeres podían ser monjas o abadisas, con autoridad limitada dentro del convento, pero sin influencia en la sociedad civil. Las völvas, entonces, tenían mayor influencia social y espiritual fuera del ámbito religioso cerrado.
5. Libertad personal:
Las mujeres vikingas podían divorciarse, manejar su vida y tomar decisiones sobre matrimonio y propiedad. En Europa continental, el divorcio era casi imposible, y la libertad de elección de las mujeres estaba muy limitada, ligada al linaje y la familia. Las mujeres vikingas, por tanto, gozaban de más derechos personales y legales que la mayoría de sus contemporáneas europeas.
Conclusión histórica:
La sociedad vikinga era patriarcal, pero ofrecía mayor autonomía femenina práctica. Las mujeres podían heredar, administrar propiedades, participar en la economía y tener influencia espiritual y social, mientras que en Europa continental estaban más restringidas legal y socialmente.
Aplicación a la sociedad actual:
Hoy más que nunca necesitamos aprender de las mujeres vikingas: independientes, fuertes y decisivas, capaces de dirigir su hogar y su comunidad sin perder respeto ni humanidad. Debemos empoderar a cada mujer, reconociendo su derecho a decidir sobre su vida, trabajo y propiedad. Al mismo tiempo, la familia sigue siendo el núcleo que nos sostiene: un espacio de cuidado, amor y colaboración entre generaciones. Que el ejemplo vikingo nos recuerde que igualdad y fortaleza femenina no están reñidas con la unidad familiar; juntas construyen hogares sólidos, comunidades más fuertes y una sociedad más libre.
  Para hoy ya no tengo más palabras como siempre agradezco a la comunidad BBH que más que una comunidad es mi nueva familia 
A @bradleyarrow y @cathyarrow la nana de Lukas gracias por estar presente aún de lejos aunque la distancia no significa nada cuando hay amor ❤️❤️❤️
Eng 🇬🇧
Before I start writing about what I have planned for today on my blog, I want to tell you that today can be considered unique. If you want to know more about it, you should check my wife @diazktty’s blog  You’ll be surprised by what happened—I think it’s one of the best things that has happened to me this month.
![IMG_20260508_220928.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23z7L9cuyE6bnA2mmG9fiiBHeuXRDtH1s35uPZTeeDDT41ToUbGWoFLDuShuPtAwSifMD.png)
A Today I want to make a comparison of the position of women in Viking society and in Western Europe between the years 800 and 1100 AD, to see the differences and similarities clearly.
1. Political power:
In Viking society, politics was patriarchal: men were clan leaders or chieftains. Women did not officially govern, but they could influence family and local decisions, especially when men were absent. In continental Europe, under early feudalism, politics was almost exclusively in the hands of male nobles. Noblewomen could act as regents if their husband or son was underage, but their authority was temporary and supervised. In summary, in Scandinavia, women had somewhat more practical autonomy, especially in the daily management of land and resources.
2. Property and inheritance:
Viking women could inherit land and property if they had no brothers, and they had legal rights over inheritance and the management of their assets. In continental Europe, inheritance typically passed first to male children; women could only inherit if there were no males, and their control over property was often limited by husbands or guardians. Therefore, Viking women had more legal independence over property.
3. Economy:
In Viking society, women managed farms, resources, and local trade during the absence of men, who were often on expeditions or at war. In continental Europe, peasant women also worked in the fields and tended animals, but the management of the farm economy was generally subordinated to the feudal lord or husband. Thus, Viking women had greater economic autonomy, especially in rural communities.
4. Religion and spirituality:
The völvas (Viking priestesses) commanded great social respect and influenced important decisions and rituals. In continental Europe, the Catholic Church was dominated by men; women could be nuns or abbesses, with limited authority within the convent, but no influence in civil society. The völvas, then, had greater social and spiritual influence outside a restricted religious setting.
5. Personal freedom:
Viking women could divorce, manage their lives, and make decisions about marriage and property. In continental Europe, divorce was almost impossible, and women’s freedom of choice was very limited, tied closely to family and lineage. Viking women, therefore, enjoyed more personal and legal rights than most of their European contemporaries.
Historical conclusion:
Viking society was patriarchal, but it offered greater practical female autonomy. Women could inherit, manage property, participate in the economy, and exert spiritual and social influence, whereas in continental Europe, women were more legally and socially restricted.
Application to modern society:
Now more than ever, we need to learn from Viking women: independent, strong, and decisive, capable of leading their home and community without losing respect or humanity. We must empower every woman, recognizing her right to make decisions about her life, work, and property. At the same time, the family remains the core that supports us: a space of care, love, and collaboration across generations. Let the Viking example remind us that equality and female strength are not at odds with family unity; together, they build solid homes, stronger communities, and a freer society.
For today, I have no more words. As always, I am grateful to the BBH community, which is more than a community—it’s my new family.
To @bradleyarrow and @cathyarrow, Lukas’s nanny, thank you for being present even from afar, because distance means nothing when there is love.❤️❤️

title: A Nightmare On Elm Street Is One Of The Smartest And Most Original Horror Films Of The Eighties. It Took A Simple Fear Everyone Understands—Sleep—and Turned It Into Pure Nightmare Fuel.
body:
Released in 1984 and written and directed by Wes Craven, A Nightmare on Elm Street changed horror in a major way. Slasher films already existed, but Craven brought something different by blending supernatural horror with the everyday terror of not being able to trust your own mind. The idea that if you die in your dreams, you die in real life, is still one of the best horror concepts ever created.

![IMG_1358.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbs4QbwXxe7FUghJvobekYg4QybMVRCjYeeYSrmCsQWUf/IMG_1358.webp)

The plot follows a group of teenagers in the quiet suburban town of Springwood who begin having terrifying nightmares about a burned man wearing a striped sweater, a fedora, and a glove with razor sharp blades. That man is Freddy Krueger, and once he enters their dreams, there is no easy escape.

Robert Englund created one of the most iconic horror villains of all time with Freddy. What makes him stand out is that he is not just a silent killer. Freddy talks, taunts, and enjoys the fear he creates. Englund gives him personality, making him far more memorable than many slasher villains of the era.

Heather Langenkamp plays Nancy Thompson, and she is one of the strongest final girls in horror history. Nancy is not just reacting to terror. She studies it, fights back, and refuses to accept helplessness. Langenkamp gives the role intelligence and determination, making her the emotional center of the film.

John Saxon and Ronee Blakley play Nancy’s parents, representing the adults who either do not understand or are hiding more than they admit. Their presence adds another layer because the story is also about the sins of the previous generation creating danger for the next.

A young Johnny Depp appears as Glen in one of his earliest film roles, and even in a smaller part, he is memorable. His famous bedroom scene remains one of the most shocking moments in the movie and one of the most iconic horror deaths ever filmed.

Wes Craven’s direction is what makes the movie special. He understands that horror works best when normal life feels unsafe. Elm Street looks like a typical suburban neighborhood, which makes the dream horror feel even more disturbing. The contrast between safe looking streets and terrifying nightmares is perfect.

The dream sequences are where the film really shines. Craven uses practical effects, surreal imagery, and unsettling transitions between reality and dreams to keep the audience off balance. You never fully know what is real, and that uncertainty creates real tension.

Charles Bernstein’s score also deserves praise because it adds a constant sense of dread without overwhelming the scenes. The music feels eerie and hypnotic, fitting perfectly with the dreamlike horror of the story.

What makes A Nightmare on Elm Street so strong is that the concept itself is universal. Everyone has had a nightmare. Everyone understands the fear of being trapped in sleep. Craven turned that into something cinematic and unforgettable.

The film also has a deeper theme about guilt and consequences. Freddy is not random. He is connected to the hidden actions of the adults in the town, and that history shapes everything. It gives the story more weight than just a body count.

Unlike many slashers that focus only on kills, this movie builds atmosphere and suspense first. The violence matters because the fear matters. That is why it still works decades later while many lesser imitators feel disposable.

Over time, Freddy became a massive pop culture figure, but the original film remains the strongest because it is genuinely frightening. Later sequels leaned more into humor, but here Freddy still feels dangerous and unpredictable.

In the end, A Nightmare on Elm Street is an excellent film because it combines a brilliant concept, strong characters, and unforgettable horror imagery. It is creative, tense, and far smarter than people sometimes give slasher films credit for.

It remains one of the defining horror films of the eighties and proof that the best monsters are often the ones waiting for you when you close your eyes.

Calling a bank is often the simplest option when your question has several moving parts. You may be trying to understand an account matter, clarify a card issue, ask about a payment, or check what steps are open to you. A clear, calm opening sentence can save time: say what has happened, what you need help with, and whether the matter feels urgent to you.

Readers searching for the Monzo customer service phone +442034451324 are usually trying to avoid being passed from one place to another. For example, you might say that you are calling about a payment you do not recognise, a card setting you want to understand, or a question about your account details. The point is not to give a long speech at the start, but to give enough context for the person on the phone to recognise the type of help you need.

It also helps to make notes during the conversation. Write down the main explanation you are given, any action you are asked to take, and anything you should check afterwards. title: Amigurumi personalizado con uniforme de voleibol
body:
> Saludos querida comunidad, hace unos días atrás un cliente me hizo un pedido muy especial, se trata de un amigurumi personalizado de su hija, la cual pertenece a un equipo de voleibol, me envió la foto de la chica con su uniforme y me encantó la idea y acordé hacerlo lo mas parecido posible, el resultado me encantó y por eso lo comparto con ustedes. > Greetings dear community, a few days ago a client placed a very special order with me: a personalized amigurumi of his daughter, who belongs to a volleyball team. He sent me a photo of the girl in her uniform, and I loved the idea and agreed to make it as similar as possible. I loved the result, and that's why I'm sharing it with you.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/Ep3iC21UDZkW97eqDEv7ApUa53muxLUuv73dhmw8oaUhSmUdXEYKP1W7xNpapF77mpF.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Estoy acostumbrada a hacer amigurumis más pequeños , pero ya tenía la experiencia de haber hecho recientemente a la pareja de la película UP, me sentí mucho mas confiada para realizar este encargo, lo hice con hebra doble de hilo acrílico y ganchillo de 2.5mm, comencé de pies a cabeza , primero con los zapatos con 6 cadenas de base, aumentos hasta llegar a un óvalo de 20, hice el zapato y las disminuciones para el tobillo, como la chica tenia un short por lo mostraba sus piernas no quise hacer las piernas rectas, sino que le hice curvas valiéndome de disminuciones y aumentos para hacer que se notaran las pantorrillas, la rodilla y los muslos mas anchos, del mismo modo también hice aumentos para los glúteos y luego disminuciones para la cintura, me encantó tanto el resultado que decidí también hacer aumentos para la parte del pecho aunque la camiseta la haría aparte, luego uní los brazos y continué hasta el cuello, decidí hacer las cabeza que se pudiera girar por lo cual hice el cuello largo para meter la cabeza después. > I'm used to making smaller amigurumi, but having recently made the couple from the movie UP, I felt much more confident taking on this commission. I made it with double strands of acrylic yarn and a 2.5mm crochet hook. I started from head to toe, beginning with the shoes. I chained 6 for the foundation, increasing until I reached an oval of 20. I made the shoe and the decreases for the ankle. Since the girl was wearing shorts and showing her legs, I didn't want to make them straight. Instead, I gave them curves using decreases and increases to make the calves, knees, and wider thighs stand out. I also increased stitches for the buttocks and then decreased stitches for the waist. I loved the result so much that I decided to also increase stitches for the chest area, although I would make the shirt separately. Then I joined the arms and continued to the neck. I decided to make the head turnable, so I made the neck long enough to insert the head later.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK3etUnocNFsAxgHpuuJ94V2gkuFJczK8LFSqB1P5HDRuakAmBnbdP6TSLFXxE9.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Para la camiseta hice y deshice varias veces, porque buscaba la mejor manera de hacerla, lo que al final me resultó más adecuado fue hacer el canesú de forma cuadrada, el color era morado pero en la parte de atrás tenia verde y un degradado hasta llegar al morado otra vez, esta parte la resolví tomando un hebra de cada color por una hilera, luego hice el cambio de color completo y me encantó. Luego hice el número nueve, lo cosí en la espalda y los demás detalles como el nombre y numero frontal los hice bordados. > For the t-shirt, I made and remade it several times because I was looking for the best way to do it. What worked best in the end was making the yoke square. The color was purple, but the back had green and a gradient that faded back to purple. I solved this by using one strand of each color for one row, then I did the complete color change, and I loved it. Then I made the number nine, sewed it on the back, and embroidered the other details like the name and number on the front.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJpkQrm4Su3Coub69AbKU4j9RTznPwV9BeT8eCvzHecsA8MQCBWLEwbHQiaorpF.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Coloqué la cabeza solo después de haberle puesto la camiseta al amigurumi. Otro reto fue hacer el cabello tal cual lo tenía la chica en la foto, este peinado era una cola de caballo pero en los lados tenia dos trenzas que se extendían hasta llegar a la coleta, por eso decidí hacer el cabello desde atrás hacia adelante haciendo los mechones para las trenzas muchos mas largos, de modo que después de haber cosido todo el cabello por alrededor de la cabeza, pudiera hacer las trenzas de delante hacia a atrás, crenado entonces la cola de caballo 😊, luego hice los detalles como la cinta del cabello y los detalles de los zapatos. Espero en un futuro recibir mas encargos personalizados como este, me parece un detalle espectacular para dar de regalo. > I attached the head only after putting the t-shirt on the amigurumi. Another challenge was making the hair exactly like the girl's in the photo. Her hairstyle was a ponytail, but on the sides, she had two braids that extended to the ponytail. So, I decided to work the hair from back to front, making the strands for the braids much longer. This way, after sewing all the hair around the head, I could braid from front to back, creating the ponytail 😊. Then I added the details like the hair ribbon and the shoe details. I hope to receive more custom orders like this in the future; I think it makes a spectacular gift.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJoKH2Lb4YEcf66sGZcHHNHBSFuzYmj5rDYQ9GwVUo4MDtPMnQ9Q359FsG9pLSj.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

title: Compartir del día de las madres [Esp/Eng]
body:
>  ![355101.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23x1HujhshH8RjAnh7aijB6eBURddqd8uQqx5VzPWZYdgKgd1Gx6QyA1MYKSbWxYt3XXF.png) Hola, ¿qué tal, amigos? ¿Cómo están? Feliz noche, que todos estén muy, muy bien y cierren su semana con las mejores vibras positivas, así como yo por esta parte, porque la verdad, a pesar de ser una semana bastante movida, fue una semana bastante interesante donde aprendí muchísimas cosas. El día de hoy les quería compartir un pequeño encuentro que tuvimos en la danza de mi sobrina. Como ustedes ya saben, en la danza donde se presenta mi sobrina, soy su representante y quien la inscribió y hace todo por ella en ese momento porque fue un deseo que ella me pidió pertenecer a una danza y yo solo cumplí, así que me comprometí a estar con ella en todo momento.
Hello, how are you all, friends? How are you? Have a lovely evening; I hope you’re all doing really, really well and ending the week on a high note, just like I am here, because to be honest, despite it being quite a hectic week, it was a really interesting one where I learnt so much. Today I wanted to share with you a little encounter we had at my niece’s dance class. As you already know, at the dance class where my niece performs, I’m her representative and the one who signed her up and does everything for her at the moment, because it was her wish to join a dance class and I simply fulfilled it, so I committed to being with her at all times.
![IMG-20260508-WA0030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uQtiQWck9b9LVBFunJ4KaJ4BbrVYw32McQmWf9NW8MoonQhYRkEvavhqfv5NPvis6KV.jpg) ![20260508_182300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23u5vRLEGtGfKynTgkD6B7ZuSfpkxUwNLiLkdodpc9k3HGRAhvvJbJSt5LUQXvCUw97Gx.jpg) ![20260508_180757.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/2423sCMqpLvMqecvD8ftAdztYD1j5h3rTUjjuFcamfdkkLtnVgqr1BbSKL49fYrm5aU9W.jpg) Después de haberle dicho todo esto y haberles explicado los motivos, resulta que su profesora, aparte de representantes, me considera que tengo mucho cariño con la niña y es como si fuera una mamá, así que me invitó al pequeño compartir, así también como su mamá. ¿Qué pasa? Su mamá no pudo ir porque en este momento está mi otro sobrino enfermo y solo pude asistir yo a compartir. Aunque para todas esas cosas siempre he dado el trato de involucrar a mi hermana para que ya también esté presente en las actividades de la niña, esta vez fue por otras cosas mayores. Después de haber pasado un megasusto en el momento en que nos dirigíamos, gracias a Dios llegamos y todo bien. Nos estaban esperando todas las madres junto con la profesora para hacer un pequeño compartir de dulces, así como también la profesora nos tenía un regalo sorpresa a cada una, incluyéndome a pesar de no ser madre.
After telling her all this and explaining my reasons, it turns out that her teacher, apart from the parents’ representatives, thinks I’m very fond of the little girl and that I’m like a mum to her, so she invited me to the little get-together, along with her mum. What happened? Her mum couldn’t go because my other nephew is ill at the moment, so I was the only one who could attend the get-together. Although I’ve always tried to involve my sister in all these things so that she’s also present at the girl’s activities, this time it was due to other, more pressing matters. After having a massive scare on the way there, thank God we arrived and everything was fine. All the mums were waiting for us along with the teacher to have a little treat, and the teacher also had a surprise gift for each of us, including me even though I’m not a mum.

The gifts were small bandanas, each personalised with the dancers’ names and the dance school’s logo. title: 上路不戴头盔会喜提‘警告/罚款’
body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![KLyJtYhiTPFmkHuc_IMG_20260506_185333.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/KLyJtYhiTPFmkHuc_IMG_20260506_185333/KLyJtYhiTPFmkHuc_IMG_20260506_185333.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

跟朋友约了去逛街，想着晚高峰太堵，不如骑电动车去。快到西单的十字路口，发现好几个交警在拦人，我当时心里还想:自己没逆行，速度也不快，没事儿……

结果被拦下来了，对方询问我知道五一后，北京都强制要求戴头盔吗？我一头雾水的说不知道，且上次骑行还是四月初。他又给我普及了一遍戴头盔的安全性，以及电动车上的遮风被也要拆下来，否则都影响安全

教育了我十分钟左右，又录入身份信息，给我开了个首次警告⚠️，下次就罚款20-50不等(离开前提醒我拿好开的条子，再遇到检查给对方看就行)，后面又遇到了一位检查大叔……

刚松一口气儿，等红绿灯时看到了一位北京土著，他说看见我被拦截了，还建议我走胡同，说胡同里安全，没人查(重点胡同我不认识路，导航会自动绕到大路😂

也感谢对方给我仔细描述了胡同路线嘿嘿(✿︶‿︶)，好些善良友好的人

**感谢阅读！祝你生活明媚，阖家安康！财源滚滚，好运连连🤑**

## Brawl Game Play
 

Brawl are one of my favorite game play and try to play all battles assigned to me by our Guild. The are like tournament only but here we play in teams and the final results are depends on the overall performance of the team. The another good part of the brawls is that you can submit the team anytime before the brawl ends, so no need to rush and play as per the convenient time. It is like anytime tournament submit the team and the battle results will come out when both the opponents submitted their teams for battle. So submit the team and your work is over if the opponent so not submit the team in time i.e before the brawl ends, you will be the winner. 
Lets have a look at the overall performance of our team, we secure the second position at the end of the Brawl with 300 points. The first positioned team was having 330 points. We completely won 100 battles and lost the 28 battles. The team on first position won 110 battles. I can say that overall performance of team was good.

I Played all the matches and submitted the team on time so I become the  fully participating member and also received the full share of winning i.e. 4800 Merits and 44.009 SPS.  ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhMwNrdURZskSNZ1LcsBMnZFwSLwZoLogvwezjPuKEko/image.png)

Second pack was even more exciting as I pulled two Legendries one from the life splinter and second from the dragon splinter. With more excitement I opened the third pack.

title: Decisions Left for Midnight
body: > Hello, midnight owls. Been a while here... We all know midnight comes with a different and calm feeling, as opposed to the day, hence calling the opportunity for some people like midnight owls to take advantage of and do some things that probably couldn't or won't be done during the day, or things that are perhaps best done during the night. Not many people though would have it this way, except it seems necessary, but I guess it's no big deal for those who have learnt to stay up at night. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeNkuLwXgpJP5WsZQSt5tewirMuMFQeavvDWxWZVWwjXm/pezibear-midnight-571595_1280.jpg [Image Source.](https://pixabay.com/photos/midnight-full-moon-moon-night-571595/) Midnight is just another time to do some things for such people. It could be finishing up a work or task, starting another or doing other things. Sometimes, it's about having some deep thoughts about life and making critical decisions. When midnight sets in and the majority of people are in bed, the place is quiet and void of noises that prevail during the day, with maybe calmer weather or atmosphere, some decisions are best left for midnight. Awake during such hours, my mind gets drawn to some life concerns that need some thought. While this might not be possible or rather not better done during the day because of the noise, engagements and distractions or disruptions, midnight offers a good period and atmosphere for free-flowing thoughts and imagination, as the case may be. Somehow, I find working at night kind of very productive or effective. For some of those decisions left for midnight, it could be about life; the plans towards the future and the aspirations. What are the plans, the necessities to achieve them and the current state of things? There seems to be more clarity in those hours and the necessary decisions to take seem to flow more easily, with more grounding in critical thinking and analysis, rather than probability or just doing. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYMDh6aG8FHkkxgamghD6oFjFNUNRVKF7beKnr6a1Ab8y/photo-1628105364240-de81cc89b054.jpeg [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/silhouette-of-man-standing-near-window-dxChoSz4A1c) The decisions could be the financial actions to take, what skills to have or the need to upgrade the ones acquired, the ways to make an impact and be a blessing to others, ways to possibly give back to the community already suffering and devastated even in a little way, and sometimes considering the state of the country and if it can become better in any way. Some might not be deep considerations, but not easy useless ones as well. Making these decisions seems better at midnight hours for some of the reasons aforementioned. Whether it's about making financial gain, affecting or impacting lives and community, or even fulfilling purpose, midnight leaves me sometimes thinking and making these decisions. They are necessary ones, so maybe I'm grateful for the night offering itself as a productive and effective period for doing that. Publishing this post at about 3 a.m. --- ###### Thank you for reading! Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@daverick/decisions-left-for-midnight-jfw)

title: Annie's Story, Between myths
body:
Good evening and warm greetings, dear friends. I'm eager to share my new story with you today. This one is about Annie, a singer with a somewhat complex reputation that limits her as an artist. You'll see why she earned that reputation and whether, for some reason, she manages to change others' opinions about music. I hope you enjoy it; with that said, let's begin.

> Buenas noches y saludos cordiales queridos amigos. Estoy deseando compartirles mi nueva historia de hoy, esta la he escrito sobre Annie, ella es una cantante con una reputación un poco compleja que la limita un poco como cantante. Ya verán por que se ganó esa reputación y si por alguna razón logra cambiar la opinión de los demás en la música. Espero que les guste, pues dicho esto entonces ya podemos arrancar.

<div class=\

> ![1778158286014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23y8qZb3tKYYHzXLnbo4LC56Bbe5ctLMjTULDDkuSMrs5yXTpdFN2T8K2ptAbazEKTZCd.jpg) Image created by me in canva The truth is, she's lost count; she doesn't have enough fingers to count them all. Annie has been in so many bands. She started singing in bars like many others, but quickly moved on to bigger groups. But for one reason or another, these groups would be blamed for tainting her future. Strange things happened with every band she was in, things many attribute to bad luck or perhaps superstitions. The first band she was in had already been enjoying success for some time and was well-known. But when she joined, the group began to experience misfortunes and later broke up. That's when the rumors started that she had brought bad luck to the group. But since it hadn't happened before because this was her first band, they were just rumors, and not even from the band members themselves; it was the fans making those comments. Annie wasn't worried about it at all; she simply saw it as a series of events that led to the band's downfall. There was no other logical explanation. He even found it a little funny that the fans were saying that. > La verdad ella ya ha perdido la cuenta, los dedos ya no le alcanzan para contarlas, son muchas las bandas por donde ha pasado Annie. Ella empezó cantando en los bares como muchos otros, pero enseguida pasó a la música en agrupaciones más grandes. Pero por una cosa o por otra estos grupos serían los culpables de manchar su futuro. Y es que por cada banda que ha ido pasando han sucedido cosas extrañas y que varios atribuyen a la mala suerte o quizás a supersticiones. En el primer grupo en el que estuvo la banda ya llevaba un tiempo con varios éxitos y eran conocidos. Pero cuando ella entró el grupo empezó a pasar por desgracias y más tarde se desintegró. > Ahí empezaron los comentarios de que ella le había traído mala suerte al grupo. Pero como no había pasado antes porque este era el primer grupo en donde ella había estado solo fueron comentarios, y ni siquiera de los miembros de la banda, eran los fans quienes hacían esos comentarios. Annie no se preocupó para nada por esto, solo lo vio como una serie de acontecimientos que llevaron al fracaso de la banda. No había otra explicación lógica. Hasta le dio un poco de gracia que los fans estuvieran diciendo eso.

> ![kelly-sikkema-Ocj_QoqxiHQ-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23tvaGy2D9VSAv5AUTQQtaYzaKuuW4yP9bqbLWEB76cYF6azmni3XjzcPrT8HG6ACTBXK.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) But when things happened in the second, third, and then fourth bands that destroyed them and their members, leaving many ruined or plagued by failures, people began to seriously wonder if perhaps she was to blame. Perhaps she was cursed and carried bad luck with her everywhere, causing the groups to fall apart. Despite all this, it remained just talk; no one in the music industry had spoken out about it. But Annie was starting to get uncomfortable with people saying these things without knowing the facts. In reality, each band had fallen due to various problems, but not because of her. After several bands and failures, the band Nara arrived. This band also failed, like many others, but this one was successful. Almost a few weeks after Annie joined, the band became a flop, and no one was buying their records or listening to their music. So the band broke up because the members couldn't tolerate it. In this case, something serious happened: she was directly accused by them of bringing bad luck to the group. > Pero cuando en la segunda banda, y en la tercera, y luego en la cuarta pasaron cosas que destruyeron a las bandas, a sus miembros y muchas quedaron arruinadas o llenas de fracasos la gente empezó a preguntarse de forma más sería si quizás ella tenía la culpa. Quizás ella tenía la mala suerte encima y la llevaba consigo a todas partes y por eso los grupos caían. A pesar de todo aún todo esto se quedaba en comentarios, nadie de la música se había pronunciado sobre esto. Pero ya Annie se empezaba a incomodar por la gente estar diciendo esto sin saber las cosas. En realidad cada banda había caído por varios problemas, pero no por ella. > Varias bandas y fracasos después llegó la banda Nara. Esta banda también fracasó de cómo muchas otras, pero esta si era exitosa, y casi unas semanas después de la llegada de Annie la banda se volvió un fracaso y nadie compraba las producciones que hacían, ni escuchaban la música. Así quela banda se rompió porque los miembros no toleraron esto. En este casi su pasó algo grave y es que fue acusada directamente por ellos de traer mala suerte al grupo.

> ![jametlene-reskp-XXMD5XzhzcA-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23tvW8b4S6iEcjS5S9oNWwJCNFtGpgFwz7QwLSxnxHztya36msMpyunBpPo7rPjxspLZX.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) With the comments from fans, this band's past and the example of its trajectory brought Annie a terrible reputation. People no longer just assumed she was cursed or something like that, but demanded an explanation. Campaigns were launched to boycott her joining any more groups, and others who were considering hiring her backed out for fear of bad luck and the pressure from fans. The effect on Annie's singing career was disastrous. She could no longer sing peacefully or join any group with confidence. Others treated her with contempt, and the pressure for her to leave music grew increasingly intense. She cried bitterly, both because of the way she was being treated and because she knew deep down that she was never to blame for those failures, but that remained between her and the bands. > Con los comentarios de los fans, de esta banda ahora y el ejemplo de su trayectoria le trajo una malísima mala reputación a Annie. La gente ya no suponía, afirmaban que ella estaba maldita o algo así, sino como se explicaba esto. Se hicieron campañas para boicotear su unión en más grupos y otros que estaban pensando en contratarla ya no lo hicieron por temor a la mala suerte y a la presión de los fans. El efecto en la carrera de Annie como cantante fue desastroso. > Ya no podía cantar tranquila ni unirse a ningún grupo con confianza. Los demás la trataban con desprecio y cada vez más la presión sobre que se fuera de la música era mayor. Ella lloró amargamente, por lo mal que estaba siendo tratada y por saber en el lo más profundo de su corazón que ella nunca tuvo la culpa de esos fracasos, pero eso se quedó entre ella y las bandas.

> ![eric-ward-akT1bnnuMMk-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23tbPF8cNzKh3gotoXBN5uVsJukoP4X1uxfFs7yDZpU3RxGY25x3HxSyfRphLrxqMaWo9.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) Being so sad, she was filled with rage and hatred. She hated herself, but for a different reason: for having given in to the pressure from others. She knew what they were saying wasn't true. She could sing. Who were they to tell her what she could or couldn't do in the industry? So she transformed her rage into determination to change everyone's minds. She joined a band that was always flopping. They had never done anything worthwhile. She chose them to show everyone that, thanks to her joining them, they would finally take off. With her talent and experience, she managed to pull the stagnant band back on track and take them to the top of the Buskeria scene, proving that she really did bring good luck and that what was said about her was false. Many of those who criticized her had to admit that she had always been right; perhaps it was all just a coincidence. Annie wouldn't stop for anything or anyone; it was all or nothing for the music. > Estando tan triste ella se llenó de rabia y de odio. Se odiaba a si misma pero por una cosa distinta, por haberse dejado llevar por la presión de la gente. Ella sabía que no era cierto lo que decían. Sabía cantar. Quienes eran los demás para decirle que o no podía hacer en la industria. Así que su rabia la transformó en determinación para hacer cambiar a todos de opinión. Se unió a una banda que siempre estaba de fracaso en fracaso. Nunca habían hecho nada que sirviera. Ella los escogió para demostrarle a todos que gracias a su unión con ellos iban a despegar de verdad. > Con su talento y experiencia logró sacar la banda estancada adelante y la llevó a lo más destacado de todo Buskeria, demostrando así que ella en realidad traía buena suerte y lo que se decía de ella era falso. Muchos de los que la criticaron tuvieron que reconocer que ella siempre tuvo razón, tal vez todo fue obra de la casualidad. Annie no parara por nada ni nadie, todo o nada por la música.

title: Prompt #45 - Memorable Meals You’ve Ever Had
body:
>Have a wonderful weekend filled with health, energy, amazing ideas, and magic. May it be a time for connection with your inner self and great enthusiasm in every activity you undertake.

\n\n

>This week's theme is about memorable meals that remind us of something special. In this case, I think I'm very traditional when it comes to food, and I really enjoy the dishes my grandmother and, consequently, my mother used to make—we grew up eating them.

\n\n

>Something like a palo a pique (Venezuelans will understand). Bayo beans and rice—what defines this dish is its flavor, made with simple ingredients that my mother used, and that was a feast. There are no pictures of this dish, really.

\n\n

>Other memorable meals that we enjoy year after year are Venezuelan hallacas. It's not so much the dish itself, but what goes into making them and what sustains the tradition. The family gathering, the sharing, the learning when the younger ones get involved, because not everyone enjoys these kinds of traditions. In this tradition, many families have developed other ways of sharing during the Christmas season, emphasizing family unity.

>Meals have so much to offer, from the quiet meals we prepare to indulge ourselves when we're alone, to those we share with a few family members when everyone can't be there. Like the photo I'm sharing, from my mother's last birthday, we were only able to gather a few of us for various reasons. The meal wasn't elaborate; it was a baked pasta dish I lovingly made to share with my mother. I didn't really know who would be joining us, but the memory remains, and this image shows the few attendees, all of whom were there with such heartfelt commitment. These moments truly become part of those memories that make it truly memorable.

\n\n
>A memorable meal means so much, regardless of the time, place, or occasion. That's what makes it memorable.

>

title: Un día de grandes momentos/ An amazing day 🥰💗
body:
> 

Hello gente de Hive! Qué tal su día? Por estos lados dándome cuenta que debo retomar mi rutina y volver a mi ritmo de siempre en la plataforma porque siento que estoy un poco desorganizada, tanto así que tengo cositas que siguen esperando a ser publicadas como mi salida del fin de semana pasado a un torneo de ajedrez con mi amiga Claudimar donde nos encontramos con Jesy que ya saben que junto con su esposo son los dueños de la academia que organiza los torneos.

Como saben,  ya Mati no practica la disciplina, pero cada vez que puedo voy a los torneos, y esto es por varias razones, y la principal de ellas es que es ahí donde coincidimos las tres, además la verdad es que después de tantos años compartiendo con los chicos del ajedrez y sus familias realmente los extraño, así que los días en los que puedo ir son días felices, llenos de risa y buenos momentos.

Nuestro último encuentro fue el domingo pasado, que fue el día de cierre de un torneo que duró tres días, y aunque los amo a todos, ir tres días seguidos sería *\

too much**, so one day is enough, and to be honest, I had a brilliant time. Hablamos un montón, me encontré con Ulises, uno de mis chicos de Hive que por motivos de trabajo y estudio no pudo continuar en la plataforma, pero por dicha puedo verlo en los torneos y siempre la pasamos súper bien, y el domingo no fue la excepción, y es que comimos súper rico y hasta merendamos en el supermercado Más x Menos. La verdad es que son momentos para mí muy valiosos, pero sobre todo es un tiempo de soltar las preocupaciones y recargar baterías.
We had a right good chat. I bumped into Ulises, one of my mates from Hive who, due to work and study commitments, couldn’t stay on the platform, but luckily I get to see him at tournaments and we always have a brilliant time together – and Sunday was no exception. We had a lovely meal and even picked up a snack at the Más x Menos supermarket. The truth is that these are very precious moments for me, but above all, it’s a time to let go of my worries and recharge my batteries.

日子像水一样流过，一不小心，五月又走了三分之一
半个月没写日记了，一个是太忙了，月底我老妈罢工我要接孩子+下雨+期末考试
然后就是五一，本以为五天假很长不知道干啥，没想到挂啦一下子就过完了，说实话，还没有周末在家休息的舒服
前两天又被小儿子老师批评，又紧急调整小家伙的学习状态
这一天天的，感觉自己到处扑火
还有一个原因就是最近网站好像不稳定，登了几次没登上我就放弃了，还好今天登上了
继续写我的感恩日记：
最近可是发生了一些好事：
1 大儿子成绩越来越好了，第九第六第四，我的天哪，平时没看他怎么学习的，都不知道怎么越来越好了
2 给大儿子找了英语补习，既然孩子愿意学家长也得加油支持，还好不贵，跟朋友聊天别人告诉我的。
3 最大的喜事，突然得了一笔钱，解决了我很多的烦恼。
幸运的五月，继续加油
