title: YaninFresita: Mi Introducción en Hive |(ESP -ENG)
body:
> ¡Hola! 😊 Me llamo Yanin, tengo 24 años y soy Doctora. 🩺 Es increíble poder decir eso en presente, porque hubo días en los que creí que nunca llegaría. Agradezco a #ecency la posibilidad de publicar en sus páginas y darme a conocer el mundo. 🌍 También quiero agradecerle a @marabuzal quien me habló de #hive y me va guiando con paciencia en este nuevo territorio virtual. La medicina es una profesión que me apasiona con toda el alma ❤️‍🩹, pero debo confesar que no es un camino de color de rosa. Lo más difícil para mí, sin duda, es esa sensación de impotencia cuando, a pesar de dar todo de mí, no puedo ayudar a todos mis pacientes. 😔 Esos momentos se me clavan en el corazón y me llevan a casa una tristeza silenciosa que a veces cuesta procesar. Lloro en privado, me cuestiono, pero luego recuerdo por qué estoy aquí. 💪 Porque por cada momento difícil, hay días de pura luz. ✨ La satisfacción de ver a un paciente recuperarse, de devolverle la sonrisa a una familia, de saber que mis manos y mi conocimiento aliviaron un dolor o curaron una enfermedad… eso es lo que me impulsa a ponerme la bata blanca cada día con renovada energía. 🥼 Es un honor inmenso poder ser ese apoyo en los momentos más vulnerables de las personas. Eso es lo que me apasiona y lo que me hace seguir, incluso en los días más agotadores. ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMhCNHfbKZSBd2nTm1Co7THfEDgh5i1MJBoseE9ru4mB/1778290310571.jpg)
***

>

Cuando salgo del hospital, necesito desconectar y reconectar con la vida simple. 🏥➡️☕ Disfruto muchísimo pasar tiempo con mis amigos; sus risas son mi mejor terapia. 😂 Soy una fanática del café, mi debilidad, y cualquier excusa es buena para ir a una cafetería nueva o a nuestra favorita a ponernos al día. En casa, me encanta ver series, pero no me limito a un solo género. 📺 Me gusta explorar de todo: desde un drama intenso hasta una comedia absurda. Creo que ampliar mis horizontes en el entretenimiento me ayuda a tener una mente más abierta, algo que también aplico en mi profesión.

Soy, por naturaleza, una persona muy alegre, carismática y risueña. 🎉 Me gusta pensar que transmito calor. Y tengo un pequeño secreto: ¡soy fanática de los peluches! 🧸 Mi habitación tiene una colección modesta pero muy querida. Mi niña interior los adora, y para mí representan ternura, inocencia y un consuelo simple. No pienso dejarlos jamás.

Mi motor principal en la vida son mis padres. 👨‍👩‍👧 Durante toda mi carrera, ellos han sido mi red de seguridad. En la universidad, en las largas noches de estudio, en las prácticas agotadoras… hubo tantas veces que quise rendirme. 😢 Pero ellos siempre estaban ahí, con una palabra de aliento, con un \

, con un plato de comida caliente a cualquier hora. Gracias a ellos, y solo a ellos, soy la Doctora que soy hoy. Su fe en mí fue más fuerte que mi propia duda. 🙏 En los detalles simples también me defino: mi color preferido es el azul 💙, me transmite paz y serenidad, que a veces tanto necesito. Y aunque los espaguetis son mi plato favorito (¡una buena ensalada es mi felicidad! 🥗), en realidad como de todo. No soy nada quisquillosa. ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQwfBD1tcbQaR3VUWsKpoZDxDg9L5W1HXBnVddzJzVA7g/1778290310631.jpg)
***
>\n\n¡Espero con el corazón abierto encontrar aquí muchos amigos! 🤗 Esta red me llama especialmente porque siento que valora la conexión real, la conversación de tú a tú, no solo los \

vacíos.

Después de jornadas intensas en el hospital, donde la conexión humana es tan profunda pero a veces tan fugaz, anhelo un espacio donde pueda compartir no solo lo profesional, sino esos pedacitos de mi que me hacen quien soy: mi amor por el café de las tardes, mi debilidad por los finales inesperados en las series, y esa risa que siempre intento que salga, incluso después de un día difícil. 😅

Espero conocer personas que, desde detrás de sus pantallas, también busquen algo más que scroll infinito. 👥 Gente con la que poder debatir una idea, celebrar un logro pequeño, recomendar un libro o simplemente intercambiar una palabra amable en un comentario. 💬 Sueño con construir esa especie de \
donde, al llegar, sepas que hay caras conocidas que te saludan, que preguntan \

y realmente escuchan la respuesta. 🎧

Sé que puede sonar un poco idealista, pero si algo me ha enseñado la medicina es que el deseo de conectar, de ser visto y de acompañar, es una de las fuerzas más curativas que existen. 🌈 Y tengo la esperanza genuina de que aquí, en Hive, pueda florecer ese tipo de conexiones cálidas y duraderas. No busco miles de seguidores; busco unos cuantos amigos de verdad con los que pueda crecer, aprender y, por supuesto, reír mucho en el proceso. 🤝

Al fin y al cabo, ¿qué es la vida sin personas con quienes compartirla? Aquí estoy, con mi taza de café virtual en la mano ☕ y una sonrisa lista, esperando conocerles. 😃

Al final del día, trato de vivir con una filosofía simple pero poderosa: \

. 😁 Yo procuro regalarla a diario, a mis pacientes, a mis colegas, a la señora de la cafetería. He aprendido que, junto al conocimiento médico, un poco de luz humana es a veces la mejor medicina. 💖 --- 💓Mi Post es original y obviamente no he utilizado IA. 💓Las imágenes empleadas son de mi propiedad. 💓Mi lengua materna es el español. La traducción al inglés la realicé con el servicio gratuito de Google. *** [En inglés] ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTC131dgoDYXZCazNYTKUbQrgYXYgoCBtMWbWaqDUubjY/1778290310487.jpg)
***

> Hi! 😊 My name is Yanin, I'm 24 years old, and I'm a doctor. 🩺 It's incredible to be able to say that now, because there were days when I thought I'd never get there. I'm grateful to #ecency for the opportunity to publish on their pages and introduce myself to the world. 🌍 I also want to thank @marabuzal, who told me about #hive and is patiently guiding me through this new virtual world. Medicine is a profession I'm passionate about with all my heart ❤️‍🩹, but I must confess it's not a bed of roses. The hardest thing for me, without a doubt, is that feeling of helplessness when, despite giving it my all, I can't help all my patients. 😔 Those moments pierce my heart and bring home a silent sadness that's sometimes hard to process. I cry in private, I question myself, but then I remember why I'm here. 💪 Because for every difficult moment, there are days of pure light. ✨ The satisfaction of seeing a patient recover, of bringing a smile back to a family, of knowing that my hands and my knowledge have eased pain or cured an illness… that's what drives me to put on my white coat every day with renewed energy. 🥼 It's an immense honor to be able to be that support in people's most vulnerable moments. That's what I'm passionate about and what keeps me going, even on the most exhausting days. ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMhCNHfbKZSBd2nTm1Co7THfEDgh5i1MJBoseE9ru4mB/1778290310571.jpg)
***

>

When I leave the hospital, I need to disconnect and reconnect with the simple life. 🏥➡️☕ I really enjoy spending time with my friends; their laughter is my best therapy. 😂 I'm a coffee fanatic, it's my weakness, and any excuse is a good one to go to a new coffee shop or our favorite to catch up. At home, I love watching series, but I don't limit myself to just one genre.  📺 I love exploring all kinds of entertainment: from intense dramas to absurd comedies. I believe that broadening my horizons in entertainment helps me be more open-minded, something I also apply to my profession.

I'm naturally a very cheerful, charismatic, and smiley person. 🎉 I like to think I radiate warmth. And I have a little secret: I'm a huge fan of stuffed animals! 🧸 My room has a modest but much-loved collection. My inner child adores them, and for me, they represent tenderness, innocence, and simple comfort. I never plan on parting with them.

My parents are my main source of motivation in life. 👨‍👩‍👧 Throughout my career, they've been my safety net. In college, during long nights of studying, during exhausting internships… there were so many times I wanted to give up.  😢 But they were always there, with a word of encouragement, with a \

with a hot meal at any time. Thanks to them, and only to them, I am the doctor I am today. Their faith in me was stronger than my own doubt. 🙏 I also define myself in the simple details: my favorite color is blue 💙, it brings me peace and serenity, which I sometimes so desperately need. And although spaghetti is my favorite dish (a good salad is my happiness! 🥗), I actually eat everything. I'm not picky at all. ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQwfBD1tcbQaR3VUWsKpoZDxDg9L5W1HXBnVddzJzVA7g/1778290310631.jpg)
***
>\n\nI sincerely hope to find many friends here! 🤗 This network appeals to me especially because I feel it values genuine connection, one-on-one conversation, not just empty \

After intense days at the hospital, where human connection is so profound yet sometimes so fleeting, I long for a space where I can share not only my professional life, but also those little pieces of myself that make me who I am: my love for afternoon coffee, my weakness for unexpected endings in TV series, and that laugh I always try to force out, even after a tough day. 😅

I hope to meet people who, from behind their screens, are also looking for more than just endless scrolling. 👥 People with whom I can discuss an idea, celebrate a small achievement, recommend a book, or simply exchange a kind word in a comment. 💬 I dream of building that kind of \
where, upon arriving, you know there are familiar faces greeting you, asking, \

And they actually listen to the response. 🎧

I know it might sound a little idealistic, but if medicine has taught me anything, it's that the desire to connect, to be seen, and to be there for others is one of the most healing forces there is. 🌈 And I genuinely hope that here on Hive, those kinds of warm and lasting connections can flourish. I'm not looking for thousands of followers; I'm looking for a few real friends with whom I can grow, learn, and, of course, laugh a lot in the process. 🤝

After all, what is life without people to share it with? Here I am, with my virtual coffee mug in hand ☕ and a smile ready, waiting to meet you. 😃

At the end of the day, I try to live by a simple but powerful philosophy: \

😁 I try to give it away every day—to my patients, my colleagues, the lady at the coffee shop. I've learned that, alongside medical knowledge, a little human warmth is sometimes the best medicine. 💖 --- 💓My post is original, and I obviously haven't used AI. 💓The images used are my own. 💓My native language is Spanish. I used Google Translate for the English translation. ***

title: The false easy wealth
body:
A few years ago, a “friend” proposed an illegal business deal to me—a very illegal one; a dangerous one—a very dangerous one; and a harmful one—a very harmful one. I thought about it, weighed it, and pictured it… If everything went well, I’d have a brand-new car from that year—that’s what they offered me.

![20260508_211356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/verdesmeralda/EpEMDyQ9BTb3YoQ6fy4iGfYSfXRb1nsKC2WNCA7HgFThRapbd6pC5LyuMqfepY675TH.jpg)

\
was about pretending; I would have to act and behave as if \

was my partner, showering him with affection, distracting him to divert others as well, and above all, making sure he didn't consume any food or drink, making excuses so that others wouldn't suspect.

After all, he would be carrying illegal substances in his stomach and would be in greater danger than I was; my job was to play the role of the lovey-dovey girlfriend so that he would appear happy and above suspicion.

It was a tempting offer at the time; I thought I could sell the car I’d win and use the money to buy a house, or who knows, maybe even settle a good portion of my financial problems.

“My friend” kept insisting, he was a high-performance athlete and told me they’d barely check him at the airport and that, with his credentials, they’d treat him like royalty.

He told me that if things went wrong, only he would be caught since he’d be the one carrying the substances in his stomach; according to him, I wasn’t taking any risks.

I trusted him a lot; he seemed like a very respectful and cultured guy. I could spend hours and hours talking to him, and in the few months I’d known him, he’d never made any inappropriate advances until he proposed that deal to me.

Even though I thought about it, my answer was a resounding no. I don’t think I ever fully trust anyone, and besides, I didn’t want to be complicit in that activity.

We remained friends, seemingly, until I entrusted him with some money because he was supposedly going to receive some laptops at a good price and I needed one. He disappeared with the money and never returned, not even to the gym where he worked out.

A few years later—quite a few, about fifteen. We ran into each other on a bus; he apologized to me, barely able to look me in the eye, and then walked away. 

That was a proposal that seemed tempting at that point in my life, but I’m glad I finally said no—I probably would have ended up in prison. Those people have no scruples; they would surely have planted illegal substances in my luggage. Besides, if things had gone “well,” I’d have the guilt today of having contributed to the trafficking of harmful substances; in that sense, I’m in the clear. 

Peace of mind is priceless to me; it’s what I value most and what’s most important in my life. Even if they offered me a lot of gold and “easy” material wealth, I’d rather be at peace with myself, calm, without any trouble with the law, and without having to hide. And being at peace with myself also means acting in a way that doesn’t harm others.

title: 🌊 Learning to Keep My Balance
body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmahquUGGYcN1qNGwKp1xmyKTWGK2LsQgVJ1XkVHpJrs9L/IMG_6645.png 

Life lately feels a little like this picture.

Trying to stay balanced while walking over something uncertain.

Some days I feel confident and motivated, like I can really make my dreams happen. Other days I overthink everything — money, the future, whether I’ll actually be able to study law someday or if life will keep getting in the way.

But I think growing up means learning how to keep moving even when things feel unstable.

I don’t have a perfect plan yet. I’m still figuring things out one step at a time. Social media, photos, trying to grow an audience… maybe it seems small to some people, but for me it feels like I’m at least doing *something* instead of standing still.

And honestly, I’d rather move forward slowly than never try at all.

So here I am… still balancing, still dreaming, still hoping that one day this path leads me exactly where I’m meant to be.

body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcGySkAz2KvXz1GC2xYD7U2bq9CKZP7A7RAMGDDTLTg82/1000182088.jpg 
[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-ai-image/men-cartoon-characters-together_94961468.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=3&uuid=1b05f3da-d7b0-4813-8ebc-b90b997b701f&query=Team+Leading+AI+generated) 
I guess our in office activities next [week](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-week) might be much bulkier than expected. The earlier I get the going going, the better. Managing a [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business) goes beyond individual or self thinking and entrepreneurship is not [storytelling](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-storytelling). You need to be up to the task of solving problems. While others shy away, you will keep raising the needed question of ‘how can I?’.   

A worker may not really understand but if I am to run something big, bring in more workers and pay them well, I will have to [leverage](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-leverage) every [opportunity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-opportunity) centering on these sectors. A good [entrepreneur](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-entrepreneur) must know how to bait.  

One thing leading to another, and another and before you know it, you have made a valuable amount off a transacted services or products. You just can't allow opportunities pass you by with the idea that you are trying to focus on a single thing. Most [times](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) it is self underestimation regarding capacity [building](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-building-structure). How do individuals own and manage global brands with hundreds of outlet [offices](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-office-) and thousands of workers.  

If you can't coordinate people to get things done for you, how are you planning to scale?. I talked about something relating to this yesterday concerning my experience at a pharmacy. They are really doing big business there and the first thing to consider is how to manage or coordinate people.   

There has been so much incoming recently from [customers](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-customer) and my [contract](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-contract-real-estate) worker is trying to shy away from some [jobs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-job). His idea was the fact that we need to focus more on men’s wear. That's just an idea if I should say; the [company](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-company-business) is aiming to influence the entire unisex industry in the long run.  

I have really been making many adverts on [female](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-female) clothes yet some people have picked the earlier ones I had done and are [NOW](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-negotiable-order-of-withdrawal-account-now) patronizing. So what do we do from here, shy away? Of course not, this will be a big disappointment to our brand.   

This is where the entrepreneurial mindset has to kick in, where and where can I touch and see the needed results? I have had to go though my [contract](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-contract) workers archives to [check](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-check-cheque) for female clothes [professionals](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-professional) working with us. Another thing to consider is [price](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-price) comparisons.   

A decent job sells itself faster, especially under the roof of a brand. Personally, I will want to monitor the entire process to learn, correct and add knowledge. I may not be able to do the entire sewing but I know how to be very creative. I have on several occasions given our workers creative ideas that when applied, turned out to be a stunner.  

To conclude, let me add, an entrepreneur is a leader. You must be able to coordinate your entire workforce and available system to drive service and product [delivery](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-delivery). The take [home](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-home) here is; refuse to think small, the explosion you need might just be some bold steps away. But how can you come close if you chose to settle for less?.

body.title: Making the grade in the world
body.body:
#
How do you leave your mark?

It is kind of funny that in the world people try to leave their mark but in school everything is about getting good marks. Totally different meanings but the same words. Which brings up the question about marks.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/terganftp/23uFK5i8Gmxw46o2ms4xj9hTeZWywdoFKEQzsQP7hpatAb2e1U8UA9dPqGrMtuT1LgtKi.png)
### Going back in time.
Hard for me to believe that it has been over 50 years since I started going to school. I remember that my first class was in a tiny little school where we had Kindergarten, Grade 1, Grade 2, and Grade 3 all in one room. I remember almost nothing of going to that school. I vaguely remember a class with tables and I remember the teacher allowing us to go outside and dig for worms. We got a penny for every worm we collected. Past that? Nothing. Except that my mom said I was doing Grade 3 math in the class. I'll take her word for it as I certainly don't remember a report card. But I actually have report cards from later years. At that time there were no percentages, no letter grades, no competition to be the best. Report cards were simple: * How hard did you try? * Did you learn what you were supposed to. The grading scale was simple. U - Unsatisfactory S - Satisfactory G - Good VG - Very good. Those words meant something. You either learned it or you didn't. \

or better was good enough for me on the mark. My mom was far more interested in the how hard did I try. The effort mark was more important to her than the achievement part.

#
Then times changed

Fast forward a decade (plus or minus a little) and letter grades became important. I entered the world of: * A = Excellent * B = Good * C = Average * D = Below Average * E/F = Fail. And there were percentages attached. I actively competed with other students in class. Who would be the best? Who would be on the honor roll with a \
average?  Who would be top honors with an \

average? There absolutely was competition to be the top. Who would get the scholarships? Who would get the medals? Who would get the trophies? Marks became a measure of success. Which reminds me of a bad joke... ... But I'll tell it to you anyway. ### Did you hear about the kid with a parent who was obsessed with grades?
##### ***The child went for a blood test and it came back as B negative. The parent told the child \

***
Of course that is absurd but there is a real culture of striving to be nothing but the best. To excel and get perfect grades. I've had Korean students who study late at night to get those marks. Students who go to school and then go to cram school after school. Students who sacrifice weekends to keep studying. *To pass the test. To make the grade. To be the best*
### But is that useful?
When my children started going to school there were originally letter grades that I was familiar with. Of course I wanted them to do well and I looked for the A's and B's as much as possible. I read with them. I hired tutors for them. I helped them with their homework. I *want* them to succeed. But the funny thing is that the learning that paid off the most was the learning that had no grade associated with it. It was the money talks we had around their allowance. It was the time I spent with them assembling their own computers rather than just buying a prebuilt. It was the YouTube video's we made together. Time spent hiking or camping in the woods together. Even time spent at the park learning to ride a bike, at the rec center learning how to swim, or at the ice rink learning to skate. There was no letter grade, no final exam and no competition... just skills to be learned to last a lifetime. And when my students entered the second half of their schooling the teacher told us they were doing away with the letter grades and percentages. Students wouldn't be taking tests like they used to. No more stratification of students based on test scores. Instead students would be \

. The idea was simple: * Competition can make lower grade students feel inadequate * Reciting facts and knowing how to take tests isn't a good equivalent of knowledge * In a digital world where information is available in seconds knowing the answer isn't nearly as important as evaluating it and figuring out why its important. In a way there were right and in a way they were not.

#
The \

education system
For High School I actually think that the schools had a point. They changed their grading system to: * Exceeding expectations * Meeting expectations * Minimally meeting expectations * On the path to learning expectations More or less VG, G, S, U ... that I had decades earlier. As a parent who lived in the competition system I had a hard time accepting the new grades. I knew how much better I did in school *because* I was competing with friends and other students. Without the competition I never would have strived as hard. However, for students who aren't top of the class? Not having to compete and knowing that you are at the level you should be at is \

without hurting ego

Looking at my children now?  Both of them had contempt for their teachers in high school because they felt they were being lumped in with a bunch of students who didn't care for subjects that didn't matter.  As such their grades weren't bad, but they certainly didn't indicate how intelligent they were.  

For high school students who just need to be competent and have a baseline education the \
system works just fine.  Having High School students who are competent is good enough.  I do get a little upset when children are just passed along when they are obviously \
expectations though.  A high school graduate who doesn't know 7 x 11 = 77 or that 100 - 10 = 90 is unacceptable.  When at my work I have a high school graduate ask me \

body.title: The right reason to stay.
body.body: <center>[Work Life Psych](https://www.worklifepsych.news/finding-a-coach/)</center>\nUnderstanding the scope of a project like **Hive**, I wonder what the right reason would be for each user to remain active in the development of this ecosystem. What really keeps them \

here, choosing to stay, choosing to go further into a field of still unknown total potential? I know that the categorical answers to these questions are too broad to be cataloged... So, I myself consider them rhetorical questions.\nHowever, this does not prevent me from discussing some possible aspects. For example: the longevity of this project, as well as its functionality within the construction of **WEB 3.0** and the monetary aspect that certainly remains one of the main attractions of this ecosystem on a global scale. There is nothing similar that is so functional, so revolutionary. We are in the right place, at the right time, and doing the right thing (despite the drawbacks).\nHave you ever wondered what the right reason is for staying here? Perhaps, by better understanding your own motivations, there is likely to be more fun and more rewards on this journey, which can easily become very \

when things are not properly clear. It all depends on each user's particular perspective, but I think it's a fact that self-knowledge leads us to places that put us in quite comfortable situations.\nAt this level, emotional intelligence opens doors that other \

cannot. Within this game, the moves change frequently. Therefore, being aware of one's own motivations helps to define a better path to follow. Since the work is collective, we need to deal with other people besides ourselves, and for many users this is not a very easy \

(so to speak). The right reason defines what we are looking for.
---
<center>**La razón correcta para quedarse.**</center>
Comprendiendo el alcance de un proyecto como **Hive**, me pregunto cuál sería la razón correcta para que cada usuario permanezca activo en el desarrollo de este ecosistema. ¿Qué es lo que realmente los mantiene \

aquí, eligiendo quedarse, eligiendo adentrarse en un campo con un potencial total aún desconocido? Sé que las respuestas categóricas a estas preguntas son demasiado amplias para catalogarlas... Así que, personalmente, las considero preguntas retóricas.
Sin embargo, esto no me impide analizar algunos aspectos posibles. Por ejemplo: la longevidad de este proyecto, así como su funcionalidad en la construcción de la **WEB 3.0** y el aspecto económico, que sin duda sigue siendo uno de los principales atractivos de este ecosistema a escala global. No existe nada similar que sea tan funcional, tan revolucionario. Estamos en el lugar correcto, en el momento correcto y haciendo lo correcto (a pesar de los inconvenientes).
¿Te has preguntado alguna vez cuál es la verdadera razón para quedarte aquí? Quizás, al comprender mejor tus propias motivaciones, este viaje te resulte más gratificante y te brinde mayores recompensas, ya que puede volverse “frustrante” cuando las cosas no están del todo claras. Todo depende de la perspectiva de cada usuario, pero creo que el autoconocimiento nos lleva a situaciones bastante cómodas.
En este nivel, la inteligencia emocional abre puertas que otros \

no pueden. En este juego, los movimientos cambian con frecuencia. Por lo tanto, ser consciente de las propias motivaciones ayuda a definir un mejor camino a seguir. Dado que el trabajo es colectivo, debemos interactuar con otras personas, y para muchos usuarios esto no es una “tarea” muy fácil. La verdadera razón define lo que buscamos. ---
**A razão certa para ficar.**
Entendendo a dimensão de um projeto como a **Hive**, eu me pergunto qual seria a razão certa para que cada usuário se mantenha ativo no desenvolvimento desse ecossistema. O que realmente os mantém “presos” aqui, optando por ficar, escolhendo ir mais além em um campo de potencial total ainda desconhecido. Eu sei que as respostas categóricas para essas perguntas são amplas demais para serem catalogadas... Então, eu mesmo as considero como perguntas retóricas. No entanto, isso não me impede de colocar em discussão alguns possíveis aspectos. Por exemplo: a longevidade desse projeto, assim como à sua funcionalidade dentro da construção da **WEB 3.0** e o aspecto monetário que certamente se mantém como um dos principais atrativos desse ecossistema numa escala global. Por aí não há nada parecido que seja tão funcional, tão revolucionário. Nós estamos no lugar certo, na hora certa e fazendo a coisa certa (apesar de pesares). Você já se perguntou a razão certa para ficar aqui? Talvez, entendendo melhor as suas próprias motivações, é provável que haja mais diversão e mais recompensas nessa jornada, que pode facilmente se tornar em algo muito “frustrante” quando as coisas não estão devidamente claras. Tudo depende da perspectiva particular de cada usuário, mas eu penso que seja um fato dizer que o autoconhecimento nos leva a lugares que nos colocam em situações bastante confortáveis. Nessa camada, a inteligência emocional abre portas que outros “truques mentais” não conseguem. Dentro desse jogo, os movimentos mudam frequentemente. Sendo assim, estar ciente das próprias motivações ajuda a definir um melhor caminho a ser seguido. Uma vez que o trabalho é coletivo, precisamos lidar com outras pessoas além de nós mesmos, e para muitos usuários essa não é uma “tarefa” muito fácil (por assim dizer). A razão certa define o que nós buscamos. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/the-right-reason-to-stay-l1o)

body.title: The Lilac Mystery of the Neighbor's Garden [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmesG34tEuHYcaCigcXTSiH4kThFdfhBq1KZEeKiYJdi5C/1778288820657.jpg)


***
***
In my neighbor's garden grows a shrub that I remember seeing there since I was a little girl, and that's saying something given how much time has passed. Many afternoons of my childhood I spent leaning on the fence just to look at it, and I never knew why it caught my attention so much, though I think it was perhaps because its flowers didn't look like any others I knew.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ9rvq8JhkWsXhHGCmRQN9wybkKgqnowZtdi5xd1C6dsw/1778289777157.jpg)


***
A few years ago, tired of calling it \
I looked up its name and searched online until I found it: Calotropis gigantea. I've heard it called \

and the name fits like a glove because the flowers feel somewhat fluffy, unreal, as if someone had woven them with very fine thread.

***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY4BGXeSSTxBqvVCEMznp6kL2zVKSoeNcjzg3H9DkE5CF/1778289777347.jpg)


***

The flowers are a pale, soft lilac, almost powdery, and they have a strange shape, like a closed star that can't quite decide to fully open. They aren't showy or attention-grabbing from a distance, but when you get closer... then the magic happens, because they look like wax, like silk, like a material that shouldn't exist on a shrub that withstands sun and cold without flinching.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbE6NG12apPN7NsFDCaxL2RWZQuf8qNcZGWnaES1ARQGf/1778289776604.jpg)



***
What truly fascinates me is not just their beauty, but their duration. Most flowering plants have their moment of glory and then fade, but not this shrub. Its lilac flowers last so long that my neighbor's garden stays beautiful almost all year round. Whether it's spring, summer, or autumn, it remains there, steady, giving color.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ8s8TqYgZzTe5ZHBm97MnkMMLUnycthsSS4YjaC8ni2U/1778289777816.jpg)


***
My neighbor barely takes care of it, to be honest. I never see her with pruning shears or special fertilizers. The shrub grows on its own, as if it decided to take root there forever and ask for nothing in return. I confess I love thinking that there are plants like this, so strong that they don't need constant pampering to give you beauty back.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcEZzVQiZE8RgEBYzrNQ6aH3TNyFkPEcZaqjTGUWdH8bC/1778289775931.jpg)


***
Sometimes, when I walk past her gate, I reach out and touch a flower with my fingertips, and it seems incredible to me that something so delicate to the eye can endure for so long.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKw8UgqHE8SaNNVW2oZDfTn46TnZyeeBnC7FkhAjUGXp/1778290034463.jpg)



***
Maybe that's why it fascinates me so much, because it's a living reminder that beautiful things can also be strong, and that there are things that, just by existing, beautify the passage of time. That lilac shrub has spent its whole life teaching me that without saying a single word, while I keep stopping to look at it, just like when I was a child. And the truth is, some fascinations never go away; they just stay, like it does, steady and in bloom.

## <center>El misterio lila del jardín de al lado </center>



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWT6i3C51zWBQ9a8pEJZ6vAJQNDV1k8K6GdJJ4FU8EB8J/1778288821340.jpg)



***
***

En el jardín de mi vecina crece un arbusto que recuerdo verlo allí desde que yo era pequeña, y mira que ha pasado tiempo. Muchas tardes de infancia me pasé asomada a la reja solo para verlo y nunca supe por qué me llamaba tanto la atención, aunque creo que era quizá porque sus flores no se parecían a ninguna otra de las que conocía.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ9rvq8JhkWsXhHGCmRQN9wybkKgqnowZtdi5xd1C6dsw/1778289777157.jpg)


***
Hace unos años, cansada de llamarlo \
, busqué su nombre e indagué en internet, hasta que di con él: Calotropis gigantea. He escuchado que le dicen \

, y el nombre le sienta como anillo al dedo porque las flores tienen algo de mullidas, de irreales, como si alguien las hubiera tejido con un hilo muy fino.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY4BGXeSSTxBqvVCEMznp6kL2zVKSoeNcjzg3H9DkE5CF/1778289777347.jpg)


***
Las flores son de un lila pálido, suave, casi polvoriento, y tienen una forma extraña, como de estrella cerrada que no termina de decidirse a abrirse del todo. No son estridentes ni llaman la atención desde lejos, pero cuando te acercas… entonces ocurre la magia, porque parecen de cera, de seda, de una materia que no debería existir en un arbusto que aguanta el sol y el frío sin inmutarse.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbE6NG12apPN7NsFDCaxL2RWZQuf8qNcZGWnaES1ARQGf/1778289776604.jpg)


***
Lo que de verdad me fascina no es solo su belleza, sino su duración, porque la mayoría de las plantas con flor tienen su momento de gloria y luego se apagan, pero este arbusto no. Sus flores lilas duran tanto que el jardín de mi vecina se mantiene hermoso prácticamente todo el año. Da igual si es primavera, verano u otoño, él sigue ahí, firme, regalando color.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ8s8TqYgZzTe5ZHBm97MnkMMLUnycthsSS4YjaC8ni2U/1778289777816.jpg)


***
Mi vecina lo cuida poco, la verdad, y no la veo con tijeras de poda ni con abonos especiales. El arbusto crece solo, como si hubiera decidido echar raíces allí para siempre y no pedir nada a cambio. Confieso que me encanta pensar que hay plantas así, tan fuertes que no necesitan mimos constantes para devolverte belleza.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcEZzVQiZE8RgEBYzrNQ6aH3TNyFkPEcZaqjTGUWdH8bC/1778289775931.jpg)


***
A veces, cuando paso por delante de su verja, alargo la mano y toco una flor con la punta de los dedos, y me parece increíble que algo tan delicado a la vista sea capaz de perdurar tanto tiempo.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKw8UgqHE8SaNNVW2oZDfTn46TnZyeeBnC7FkhAjUGXp/1778290034463.jpg)


***
Quizá por eso me fascina tanto, porque es un recordatorio vivo de que lo bello puede ser también fuerte, y de que hay cosas que, con solo existir, embellecen el paso del tiempo. Ese arbusto lila lleva toda una vida enseñándome eso sin decir una sola palabra, mientras yo sigo parándome a mirarlo, como cuando era niña, y es que algunas fascinaciones nunca se van, solo se quedan, como él, firmes y en flor.

body.title: holoz0r's A-Z of Steam - Gyromancer
body.body: <center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holoz0r/23uQjgyqHjtpn4xt6nC679RSeuATmi8Mhfv5XFCbfgkoWoDtbEztvV6bwG2sSypUXrYxz.png</center>\n\nIf you've followed me for years, I am so sorry for all the words you've read, and even more sorry for the words that you may ignore. For a long time, an insurmountable task has confounded me. The only reason I am typing this is because Gyromancer crashed, and that was enough for me to call the game \

, because I tell you - it had me in its juvenile grasp, ready to snap my neck.

*Gyromancer* is crack. I've never done drugs, but I imagine that this is what they're like. It's a match 3 game in the style of Puzzle Quest and Candy Crush and others, except instead of swiping to match three or more things of the same colour or style, you rotate them clockwise.

![Traverse](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holoz0r/EokahvfLXAGsSV3SVcwmDtNMKnVvgYpdUXkG7GHVbmx7Y6simLuVs7LxKcurQm7MoC2.png)

Depending on the monster you choose, this powers up abilities, and then off you go, killing other monsters. The monsters don't have personalities, and the *resolution*, tactical depth, plot, and visuals of the game aren't anything to write home about, but there is something endlessly (until the game crashes) satisfying about organising imaginary mystical rocks and orbs into order and watching number go up, and number go down in concert with one another.

Number go up? Experience. Number go down? Amount of life left to live in the ontological construct our conciousness paints as reality. Also, the number of hit points enemy monster has until you engage once more in the gameplay loop, which has the potential to wipe productivity from the face of the Earth.

![This is battle](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holoz0r/23tm9d5Jzzni2bjesfFdrnGipGC2uRvqSZ86pZ1tRkYH5y88x3GZDRMqF68p32uzPrmJ2.png)


It is guilty pleasure gaming on offer here. Nothing special, just an addictive formula without micro-transactions, an easy difficulty curve, addictive game play, passable music, and a few tried and tested ideas all slapped together into one neat package. I am glad it doesn't work on the Steam deck. I'd never sleep again at night.


![Enemy number go down](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holoz0r/EoGxTTKMLZvDw4TVMkN7TzDftwFbuZAdysux3RqwCsXumN6T4hyuf44Xq9XZyP7e4vE.png)


I played the game for about 8? hours and I could see myself playing it for many more to kill the time. Only, I do very much believe that I have much better things to do with my time, like, struggle with the stressful notion that I have approximately another 400 games in my Steam library to experience.

This experience may not be a memorable one, but it is one that will not merely go into the \
pile, but instead go into a lofty pedestal of \

, which is a list of games that I would very much like to revisit again - if it doesn't crash. It will remain installed on my desktop for the time being, its icon tempting me away from other tasks.

Don't expect challenging puzzles and mind-bending revelations or story. Just expect a game that is a game, and does well at being a game. For the price it is on Steam, I feel like this is worth while use of funds in order to maximise your escape from the increasingly hellish capitalistic landscape that continues to rapidly rise (and simultaneously crumble) around us all. 

That said, there's probably better options, but are there better options at this price?

今天放假，我看天气还好没下雨🌧️，就叫老公带我去妈妈家！我买好菜带上我的礼物和菜菜一起过去做饭！本来还想走路过去的，老公不让我太辛苦哈！昨晚问她了，她说在家的！

我们早上收拾好东西就出发了，开着小毛驴很快到了！见到她，我就说母亲节快乐😆，给你的！我把礼物放到桌子上亮起来了，她爱不释手，还臭美的拍照！

妈妈好看到我的礼物中意啊，好开心，果然中意花花，她话比真花好，我又帮她拍照，三个美颜，三个没美颜的[捂脸]！

到十二点我去厨房煮潮汕牛肉丸粿条，她问我有没有买牛肉丸，我说买了哈哈！看来妈妈很喜欢吃，我把瘦肉切薄放适合调味料混合，还有香菇也切片！提早把有机水果甘蓝切好，泡十几分钟！也把牛肉丸切开两份备用，还有切了点儿香葱！

水开了，我放了点儿花生油，姜片进去，然后把青菜🥬放进去，几分钟后再放肉丸和瘦肉片，七分熟的时候放粿条进去，还有香菇！最后给点盐和香菜葱花就好了！

朋友说我这样哄妈妈开心挺好的，我就是有办法哈哈哈哈！

#


MADRE DE ENSUEÑOS 

Madre De Ensueño
​Para ti, mi verso
se ha convertido en flor
y en cada pétalo
la ternura de tus manos
llevan el bálsamo
que curan la ansiedad
y el insomnio que sufro
lo sumerges con tus besos.

​Tus tibias manos de fogón
amasan la vida
en un redondel de esperanza
que tutelas en tu corazón
como cofrecito carmesí
que late sin cesar, madre mía.

​De las tantas rosas del jardín
la tuya no se marchita
se alza erguida al sol
en el áureo amanecer
que besa el rocío
al nacer el beso dorado
entre cortinas verdes.

​Mi ensueño se queda contigo
en la dulce mirada
en tu risa fresca
en tus manos de palomas
que vuelan al cielo
mientras me abrazas, madre mía.

#

![IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531 (3).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXDhyWeu8nnDqWG2gRSVjPh2nUaPZu9hjNCWa5zK4TF8a/IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531%20(3).png)

#

MOTHER OF DREAMS

Dream Mother
For you, my verse
has become a flower,
and in each petal
the tenderness of your hands
carries the balm
that heals the anxiety
and insomnia I suffer; you immerse it with your kisses.

Your warm, hearth-like hands
knead life
in a circle of hope
that you guard in your heart
like a crimson little chest
that beats without ceasing, my mother.

Of the many roses in the garden,
yours does not wither; it stands erect in the sun
in the golden dawn
that kisses the dew
as the golden kiss is born
among green curtains.

My dream remains with you
in your sweet gaze,
in your fresh laughter,
in your dove-like hands
that fly to the sky
while you embrace me, my mother.

#

body.title: The weather stayed with me
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778202870-200bfed8605b.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/feardragon/seed-feardragon-2026-05-08/main-1-1778202870-200bfed8605b.png)
![main-2-1778202880-08416be67c9c.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/feardragon/seed-feardragon-2026-05-08/main-2-1778202880-08416be67c9c.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

I've been sitting by this window for three days now, and the mountains haven't changed their mood once. The mist hangs low over the valley, the same thickness each morning when I wake, the same weight when I make tea at dusk. There's something about weather like this that doesn't feel temporary. It feels like it could stay forever.

This place has that effect on time. The room is simple, old wood and stone, the kind of shelter you find high up where the forest thickens. I brought a book I've been meaning to finish, but mostly I just watch the green slopes disappear into white, then reappear when the light shifts. The cat found me on the second day, orange and deliberate, and now she's part of the routine. She understands stillness.

I've noticed how the weather seeps into everything when you're not moving. It's not just something outside the window anymore. It becomes the rhythm of the tea, the sound of the curtains, the way light falls across the table at certain hours. The mist carries the smell of wet earth and something like smoke from distant fires. My hands are always slightly damp.

There's no hurry here. The mountains don't suggest urgency. They suggest patience, the kind that builds over seasons. I think that's what drew me to this place in the first place, before I even arrived. Some part of me knew I needed to sit still long enough for the weather to become familiar, to stop being weather and start being home.

I completely agree that user retention has been abysmal on Hive, and anyone that wants to know why I think that is can look at my posting history, or ask any of the biggest downvoters, because I discussed it with all of them at least once.

One of the most successful user retention programs was called the 'Stewards of Gondor', and it required only modest delegations (~5k Hive IIRC) to trusted curators, which they then used to upvote good posts from new authors.  When the curators proved to be unworthy of trust and started self-voting or circle-jerking to profit from their delegations, all that was necessary to end their scamming was withdrawing the delegation.  No actual DHF or fund expenditures were required, simply a sponsor with a phat sack.  

This was a great success, so of course the sponsor was flagged off the platform.

Anyway, that's really all it takes to create a formal program to recognize new creators that create quality posts.

body.title: Freewrite || The Constant Movement of Life in a Market Corner
body.body:
![PSX_20260509_081131.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWrirUDVJSdG21rkkzXVHLhmpUpcSGRrnyBQ7LFs77Nch/PSX_20260509_081131.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
That morning, the small streets surrounding the market were bustling with activity. Motorized pedicabs (becaks) passed by carrying merchandise, while vendors busily set up their stalls one by one. This atmosphere always presented a simple story about the ongoing struggles of life.

I enjoyed a few moments standing on the side of the road, observing the people's activities. Some were carrying fresh vegetables, others were selling fruit, and still others were simply sitting and chatting with old friends. Although the market building looked old and simple, it remained a center of life for many.

The morning sky was overcast, but that didn't dampen the enthusiasm of those seeking sustenance. The sound of vehicles mixed with the sounds of people greeting each other created a lively atmosphere. It was in places like these that I often witnessed the strength of the people's spirit in living each day.

Sometimes we get so caught up in pursuing something grand that we forget that simple life also has its own beauty. The bustling market streets, the fading wooden buildings, and the daily activities of the people actually hold many lessons about hard work and perseverance.

I believe every corner of the city has a story. It's not about luxury, but about people moving forward for the sake of their families and their futures. And that morning, I was reminded again that simplicity is often the most valuable part of life.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdrZ3MBZ7Spkdr6qrfd4DdKe31wdYfgKUgaxpNKag4vC/1778289512107.jpg)

EPL Round 36 ပွဲစဉ်များ ဒီတပတ်မှာ ကစားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ ဘာလိုလိုနဲ့ ရာသီ သိမ်းဖို့တောင် ၂ ပွဲသာ လိုတော့၏။ စနေနေ့၏ အဖွင့်ပွဲစဉ်က ပွဲ‌ကြီး ပွဲကောင်းနဲ့ ဖွင့်လှစ်ထား၏။ Liverpool vs Chelsea ပွဲစဉ် ဖြစ်၏။ UCL ဝင်ခွင့်ရဖို့ သေချာသလောက် ဖြစ်နေသည့် Liverpool အနေဖြင့် Europa သို့မဟုတ် Conference League ဝင်ခွင့်ရဖို့ ရုန်းကန်နေရသည့် Chelsea နဲ့ ယှဉ်ပြိုင် ကစားရမည် ဖြစ်၏။ Liverpool အနေဖြင့် ရှုံးနိမ့်ခဲ့ရင်လည်း UCL ဝင်ခွင့် ဆုံးရှုံးဖို့ မရှိလှပေမဲ့ အိမ်ကွင်းဆိုတော့ အရှုံးခံမည် မဟုတ်ပေ။ ပြီးခဲ့သော တပတ်က United ကိုရှုံးထားသည်မို့ ဒီတပတ်မှာ ရလဒ်ကောင်း ရယူနိုင်ဖို့ လို၏။

Chelsea အနေဖြင့် UCL ဝင်ခွင့်နေရာကနေ တဖြည်းဖြည်း လျော့ကျလာခဲ့ရာ ခုဆို Europa, Conference League ဝင်ခွင့်တို့နဲ့ ဝေးရာ နေရာအထိကိုပါ ရောက်သွားခဲ့လေ၏။ Chelsea အနေဖြင့် လက်ကျန် ပွဲစဉ် အားလုံး အနိုင်ရခဲ့ရင်တောင် ကိုယ့်ရှေ့က အသင်းတွေ ခြေချော်မှသာ ဥရောပလိဂ်ပြိုင်ပွဲတွေ ဝင်ရောက်ခွင့်ရမည် ဖြစ်၏။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtJCBGu1c5PG9qEztHMRjGaGDYXYcVYPxiZrYLYF2f2A/1778289512129.jpg)


ညနေ ၈ နာရီခွဲမှာတော့ Sunderland vs Man United ပွဲစဉ် ကစားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ UCL ဝင်ခွင့်သေချာသွားခဲ့ပြီ ဖြစ်ပေမဲ့ အဆင့် ၃ နေရာကို ကာကွယ်ဖို့ အတွက် လက်ကျန် ပွဲစဉ်တွေကို United တို့ အာရုံစိုက်ဖို့ လိုမည် ဖြစ်၏။ နှစ်သင်းလုံး အတွက် အမှတ်ပေးဇယား ရပ်တည်မှု အပြောင်းအလဲ ကြီးကြီးမားမား မရှိနိုင်သည့် ပွဲစဉ်ပေမဲ့ EPL ပွဲစဉ်တို့၏ ထုံးစံအတိုင်း အကြိတ်အနယ် ရှိနေဦးမှာ အသေအချာပင်။

ည ၁၁ နာရီမှာတော့ Man City vs Brentford ပွဲစဉ် ကစားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ ချန်ပီယံ အိပ်မက်လေး မမှေးမှိန်ရေးအတွက် ယခုပွဲစဉ်ကို City တို့ အနိုင်ကစားဖို့ လိုမည် ဖြစ်၏။ သရေ သို့မဟုတ် ရှုံးနိမ့်သွားခဲ့ရင် City ၏ ချန်ပီယံ အိပ်မက်က ရေစုန်မြောပြီ။ Brentford အနေဖြင့် Europa League ‌ဝင်ခွင့် မျှော်မှန်းလို့ရနေတာကလည်း City ကို အခက်တွေ့စေနိုင်၏။ ဇာတ်လမ်း အားလုံးတို့၏ အစက Chelsea ဖြစ်၏။

ဇယားထိပ်ပိုင်းကနေ ဆင်းလာလိုက်တာ သူက ပြန်မတက်နိုင်တော့ အခြားအသင်းတွေက ကျော်တက်လာကြ၏။ Bournemouth, Brentford & Brighton တို့ အနေဖြင့် မျှော်မှန်းချက်တွေ မျှော်လင့်ချက်တွေ ဖြစ်ပေါ်လို့ လာခဲ့၏။ လာမယ့်နှစ် ဥရောပပြိုင်ပွဲတွေမှာ မျက်နှာသစ် အသင်းတွေ တွေ့မြင်ရလာနိုင်၏။ ဒီနှစ်ဆိုလည်း UCL, Europa & Conference League ဗိုလ်လုပွဲတွေမှာ EPL က အသင်း ၃ သင်း ကိုယ်စီ တက်ရောက်ထားသည် မဟုတ်ပါလား။

body.body:
QUESTION: What country offers the best quality of life for the least amount of money?


![AI.jpg](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/world-travel-pro/79a827ac5d6f5b3b311c7d961b70dd08e8aa7ba8.jpg)


ANSWER: Finding the best \

depends on whether you value safety and infrastructure (typical in Europe) or extreme affordability and natural beauty (typical in Southeast Asia or Latin America).
Based on 2026 data and indices, the following countries offer the highest quality of life relative to their costs:
## 1. [Portugal](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/05r4w)
[Portugal](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/05r4w) is widely considered the top \

choice in Europe for its high safety standards and lower costs compared to the UK or the US. 

* Quality Indicators: Ranked highly for its healthcare system, stability, and safety.
* Cost: Expats can live comfortably on approximately $1,500–$2,000 per month; rent in cities like Porto or Lisbon is significantly cheaper than in major Western hubs.

## 2. [Malaysia](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/09pmkv)
[Malaysia](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/09pmkv) offers one of the best balances in Asia, providing modern infrastructure and high-quality healthcare at a low cost.

* Quality Indicators: Known for excellent private healthcare, a high level of English proficiency, and stable infrastructure.
* Cost: A single person can live a high-end lifestyle for roughly $1,000–$1,500 per month; it is frequently cited as one of the most affordable countries with a high quality of life.

## 3. [Thailand](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/07f1x)
Known as a top destination for value, [Thailand](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/07f1x) combines low living costs with robust healthcare systems and diverse lifestyle options, from Bangkok's urban energy to Chiang Mai's tranquility.

* Quality Indicators: Strong healthcare network and well-developed public transport.
* Cost: Monthly expenses often range between $800 and $1,500, depending on the city.

## 4. [Oman](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/05l8y)
[Oman](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/05l8y) is a notable high-performer in Quality of Life indices (ranking #4 globally in 2026), yet it maintains a lower cost profile than other high-scoring nations like Switzerland or the Netherlands.

* Quality Indicators: Extremely high safety scores and significant recent investment in healthcare and infrastructure.
* Cost: While not \

in the way Vietnam is, it offers high purchasing power and stability at a fraction of European prices.

## Comparison at a Glance (2026 Estimates)

| Country [1, 6, 11, 15, 19, 22] | Quality of Life Index (Rank) | Cost of Living Index | Best For |
|---|---|---|---|
| Portugal[](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/05r4w) | High (~28th) | Moderate (Lower for Europe) | Safety & Healthcare |
| Malaysia[](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/09pmkv) | Moderate (~51st) | Low | Infrastructure & English |

body.title: A beautiful yellow flower I saw on a cactus immediately caught my attention
body.body: > Happy weekend and grateful to share a new post here in the #hivegarden community, where, as always, nature never ceases to amaze us, especially in the most unexpected plants. This morning, I was watering my plants since the sun has been strong, and I do it early in the morning as well as in the afternoon. After finishing, I went for a walk on the nearby hill and saw a cactus with what looked like a flower. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQkz2R3gzecfXMZbsthoyJQtVBdj68zJUhqRxyQqK6vb/1778288970319.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmULCJxpLAWNQcDYAqeUT1rzaqR93Gzm8b7Sc5eyhUHSG1/1778288970550.jpg) As I slowly approached, it was indeed a beautiful yellow flower with many petals. Inside, I could see some white antennae, which I imagine serve a specific function, but unfortunately, I don't know much about them. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNPZwdpTxcZsTpJonbBWX3AmztEQyi6y1XZarKyUsV63Z/1778289019700.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUfQ5DxXCBmbQhfLwYZDe9gXWRkPicj88pXCJMEhokZZP/1778289019943.jpg) I took several photos, but very carefully, because, as you can see, the cactus had a large number of spines. There was also another plant nearby that seemed to surround it, also with what appeared to be other spines, a bit longer and thicker compared to those of the cactus. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCRJEbDLe7AnMSmikiTGULyAgMWNG6i6243xYruFbfjf/1778289059508.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYc9y5cwRoFxryZ7ZoEgEfFjaZeQiJCgbiChiQwJC7pYv/1778289059762.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVYdpbL27MMGSrHLVYt9TM4BPE1FWRzFrkqAQHkYosZoE/1778289060081.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma3kEhFyuZVgUVvMRnBEAiM5WrjVp9to19zHebtrJuuEy/1778289060418.jpg) One detail that caught my attention was seeing other flowers developing at the ends of the cactus's limbs. I've seen them in other colors, but not like this, which is what made it so surprising. And, as usual, I always have my phone nearby because I never know when the perfect moment might be to capture one of the incredible images that nature has to offer. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQSLVXpZinYst3pLCFoMBc3G32fkoeEntf4MB6CPoofEB/1778289104348.jpg) There are truly beautiful flowers that we can find growing wild in nature, perhaps because of that very element of surprise—seeing them on a cactus with practically no special care, which makes it even more amazing.

body.title: Red poppies and the light that finds you
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778265288-9bd9cfd0db57.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/landem/seed-landem-2026-05-08/main-1-1778265288-9bd9cfd0db57.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

I drove out to this field because I'd heard the poppies were good this year, and honestly, I needed to be somewhere that wasn't a city for a while. The kind of somewhere you can sit without thinking about rent or how many followers noticed your last post. Budget travel means I end up in these quiet places a lot, and I've stopped pretending it's accidental.

The light was doing something strange when I arrived, all soft and diffused through the clouds. I had some daisies and a red poppy in my bag from earlier, so I twisted them into my hair the way I always do. It's become such a habit now that people expect it, which is funny because I started doing it just because flowers were free and my hair needed something. Now it's the thing people remember.

I sat there for maybe twenty minutes, not even thinking about the shot at first. Just watching the field stretch toward that distant cottage, the way the poppies seemed to glow even under grey sky. There's something about being alone in a place like this that makes you realize how little you actually need. I came with almost nothing, and the field gave me everything.

The light was fading by the time I turned around to frame it properly. That's when I saw it, the way the path caught the last warmth of the day, how it led somewhere but nowhere in particular. Sometimes the best photos aren't about being clever. They're just about noticing where the light decided to land and sitting still long enough to let it find you.

body.title: ¿Dónde estoy? Capítulo IV (esp-eng)
body.body:
***Prólogo…*** ***​Un susurro, una señal, un cuento de niños, una pesadilla... todas son señales que un niño grita; las mismas que los padres silencian porque, para la mayoría, los niños muchas veces solo dicen «mentiras».*** ***
![1000026074.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xyQagwR2SefX2YBZVz7ER6KXzJuGFC8PeCoueyZaf4brmCnyvfpu613Jp78eTYnM14x.jpg)

¿Dónde estoy? Capítulo IV

​Sentía la luz en mis ojos. Los abrí poniendo una mano por delante, queriendo tapar un poco de ese resplandor para ver mejor; de pronto, escuché los gritos de mi mami y mi abuela. ​Miré a todos lados: estaba en el cobertizo del patio, ese que, desde que recuerdo, ha estado cerrado con un candado enorme, el mismo al que le metía piedritas cuando era más pequeña. ​Las tablas, algo separadas, me dejaban ver difusamente dos siluetas. Desesperadas, iban de un lado a otro gritando con angustia: «¡Lina! Responde», pero por más que quería hablar, no podía. ​La garganta me ardía como cuando tuve faringitis el invierno pasado y mami me daba té de limón y miel para calmar el dolor. Pero esta vez, ese dolor quemante venía desde atrás, cerca del lado donde esa cosa me había tocado. ​Caminé descalza por ese cobertizo. Había cosas extrañas y es que, la verdad, yo jamás había entrado aquí; siendo realista, ni mamá ni la abuela habían entrado. ​El sitio estaba lleno de cajas, pero no había polvo, como si alguien hubiera limpiado. La curiosidad me ganó y empecé a mirar. Dentro de algunas cajas había ropa; parecían disfraces, zapatos de niñas... de todo había dos, como si no fuera una sola niña en realidad. ​Más al fondo, dos triciclos de ruedas grandes y extrañas, como los que nos había enseñado la señorita Jiménez en la escuela. Las campanillas tenían nombres: Luna y Lina. Mi asombro se hizo más fuerte: ¿por qué la campanilla tenía mi nombre?
![1000026071.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/2423sUEAbeutNRKTYzzCVZyKT5RYE1miZbwrriW17SfwR7ZHpEC9wNUwT58j5DXCj9KsM.jpg)
​Empecé a sentir agobio; era como si se me fuera la respiración y, sin darme cuenta, caí de rodillas sobre un saco. Estaba duro, con un aroma extraño pero conocido, aunque no podía recordar dónde lo había sentido. ​Abrí una parte del saco y muchos cabellos salieron de él. Cabello negro, suave... era como el de mi abuela, pero sin canas. Lo seguí tocando mientras los gritos afuera no paraban y aumentaban de intensidad.
![1000026072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23zRrwpU3dcTUKKVojSGjjab6fUjB9VcBmfmYHbskotkxJnwk6wnG6BNScD84MdqrnVds.jpg)
​Seguí descubriendo el borde del saco y, de pronto, frente a mí estaba esa cosa de mi habitación. Sus ojos encendidos, la piel negra pegada a sus huesos, sus dedos largos o, más bien, sus uñas. Sus pies tenían llagas con manchas rojas pero resecas, como cuando se le caía el vino al abuelo Pedro y dejaba la alfombra manchada.
![1000026073.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23zGTk3qEpajnm3n3kaqL4pmPc4kybzQJxwyqH8Pz1ERoyzTUrHqx5tDYZfdYMH9ieFq3.jpg)
​De repente, sentí una voz salir de mi boca, pero no era mía. «Espera», resonó, mientras aquella cosa me indicaba con la mano quemada que no siguiera buscando en ese saco. *** ###
English
*** ***Foreword…*** ***A whisper, a sign, a children’s story, a nightmare… these are all cries for help from a child; the very ones that parents silence because, for most, children often just tell ‘lies’.*** ***
![1000026074.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xyQagwR2SefX2YBZVz7ER6KXzJuGFC8PeCoueyZaf4brmCnyvfpu613Jp78eTYnM14x.jpg)

Where am I? Chapter IV

​I felt the light in my eyes. I opened them, holding a hand up in front of them, trying to block out some of that glare so I could see better; suddenly, I heard my mum and my grandma shouting. ​I looked all around: I was in the shed in the garden, the one that, for as long as I can remember, has been locked with a huge padlock—the very one I used to put little stones into when I was younger. The planks, slightly apart, allowed me to make out two vague silhouettes. Desperate, they were running back and forth, shouting in anguish: ‘Lina! Answer us,’ but no matter how much I wanted to speak, I couldn’t. My throat was burning, just like when I had pharyngitis last winter and Mum gave me lemon and honey tea to soothe the pain. But this time, that burning pain was coming from behind, near the side where that thing had touched me. I walked barefoot through that shed. There were strange things there, and the truth is, I’d never been in here before; to be honest, neither Mum nor Grandma had ever been in here either. The place was full of boxes, but there was no dust, as if someone had cleaned it. Curiosity got the better of me and I started looking around. Inside some of the boxes were clothes; they looked like fancy dress costumes, girls’ shoes... there were two of everything, as if there wasn’t really just one girl. Further back, two tricycles with big, strange wheels, like the ones Miss Jiménez had shown us at school. The bells had names: Luna and Lina. My astonishment grew: why did the bell have my name on it?
![1000026071.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/2423sUEAbeutNRKTYzzCVZyKT5RYE1miZbwrriW17SfwR7ZHpEC9wNUwT58j5DXCj9KsM.jpg)
I began to feel overwhelmed; it was as if I couldn’t breathe, and without realising it, I fell to my knees on a sack. It was hard, with a strange yet familiar scent, though I couldn’t remember where I’d smelled it before. I opened a part of the sack and a lot of hair spilled out. Black, soft hair... it was like my grandmother’s, but without any grey. I kept touching it whilst the screams outside didn’t stop and grew louder.
![1000026072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23zRrwpU3dcTUKKVojSGjjab6fUjB9VcBmfmYHbskotkxJnwk6wnG6BNScD84MdqrnVds.jpg)
I kept pulling back the edge of the sack and, suddenly, there in front of me was that thing from my bedroom. Its eyes glowing, its black skin clinging to its bones, its long fingers—or rather, its nails. Its feet were covered in sores with red but dried-out patches, like when Grandad Pedro spilled wine and left a stain on the carpet.
![1000026073.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23zGTk3qEpajnm3n3kaqL4pmPc4kybzQJxwyqH8Pz1ERoyzTUrHqx5tDYZfdYMH9ieFq3.jpg)
Suddenly, I felt a voice come out of my mouth, but it wasn’t mine. ‘Wait,’ it echoed, whilst that thing gestured with its burnt hand for me not to keep searching in that coat. *** Si gustas leer las partes anteriores te las dejo a continuación. body.title: Lo necesario debe decirse en el momento oportuno./  The necessary things have to be said at the right time.[Spa -Eng]
body.body:
> 

  


https://images.pexels.com/photos/8923975/pexels-photo-8923975.jpeg




[source ](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-man-and-a-woman-protesting-8923975/  )
 







***


Hablar es fundamental en nuestra vida. A través de la palabra, podemos expresar nuestros pensamientos y explicar a los demás nuestras necesidades, gustos y disgustos. Por eso, es tan importante hablar. Sin embargo, hay un momento y un lugar para hablar. No podemos decir cualquier cosa en cualquier lugar ni a cualquier hora. Si no decimos lo correcto según el lugar y el momento, y hablamos de forma inapropiada, se nos considerará insensatos y, a menudo, se pensará que no sabemos hablar o que no somos aptos para hacerlo. Y este pensamiento no es inapropiado en absoluto, porque hablar siempre debe hacerse con comprensión. La situación se desarrolla de una manera, y si empezamos a hablar de forma diferente, seremos mal vistos. Por lo tanto, siempre debemos hablar teniendo en cuenta el contexto.

En un momento de felicidad o alegría, donde todos celebran y disfrutan, si hablamos de la muerte y lamentamos nuestras penas, la gente nos considerará inapropiados para la situación. Intentarán mantenerse alejados de nosotros. Y debido a nuestras contradicciones, nadie querrá relacionarse con nosotros. De igual manera, si vemos a alguien trabajando y nos acercamos y le decimos: \

, seguramente se sentirá muy molesto por nuestras palabras. Porque ya está trabajando y si seguimos insistiendo en que lo haga mientras lo está haciendo, entonces nuestras palabras se volverán completamente inútiles y molestas.

Es importante pensar con detenimiento al hablar. Debemos considerar si lo que decimos es apropiado en ese momento. A la gente no le gustan las palabras innecesarias en momentos inoportunos. Este rechazo no es exclusivo de los demás; si lo piensas, entenderás que si alguien nos lo dijera a nosotros, tampoco nos gustaría. Por lo tanto, al hablar, debemos pensar con cuidado y considerar el contexto de la situación. Así, nuestras palabras serán mucho más valiosas y útiles. Siempre debemos hablar de una manera que agrade a los demás y que les beneficie en momentos difíciles, además de ayudarnos a mejorar nuestro estado de ánimo cuando estamos molestos. Si nuestras palabras no son valiosas ni benefician a los demás, es mucho mejor no decirlas. Porque si hablamos innecesariamente, la gente puede irritarse y, con el tiempo, comportarse mal con nosotros, alejarse de nuestra compañía e ignorarnos.

Si hablamos innecesariamente sin pensar en el momento adecuado, nuestros familiares se irritarán, su amor y afecto disminuirán, y nuestro valor en la sociedad se verá afectado, sintiéndonos inferiores. Por lo tanto, siempre debemos hablar con criterio y comprender si es necesario hablar en cada situación y en ese momento. Es mucho más importante y efectivo guardar silencio que hablar en exceso o hablar sin pensar. Debemos reflexionar cuidadosamente sobre qué es apropiado y qué se puede decir en cada momento. Debemos abstenernos de hablar innecesariamente, hablar sin importancia y hablar sin comprender el momento adecuado. Necesitamos saber cuándo hablar y cuándo callar; así nuestras palabras tendrán importancia y serán valoradas. Si no se valoran y nunca sabemos si debemos hablar o no, es mejor guardar silencio.


***

***


https://images.pexels.com/photos/8923975/pexels-photo-8923975.jpeg




[source ](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-man-and-a-woman-protesting-8923975/  )

***


\

is a very important thing in our life. Through this speech, we can express our thoughts. We can explain to others our needs, dislikes, likes and dislikes. So it is understood how necessary and important it is to speak this word in our life. But there is a time and place for speaking. We cannot say anything at any place or at any time. If we do not speak the right thing according to the place and time and keep talking wrongly, then we are considered crazy and many times everyone thinks that we cannot speak or are not suitable for speaking. And this thought is not inappropriate in any way because speech is something that needs to be said with understanding at all times. The situation is going on in one way and if we start talking differently there, then we will be considered bad there. So we need to always speak keeping the environment in mind.\n\nAt a time of happiness or joy where everyone is celebrating and enjoying, if we talk about death and keep discussing the sorrows of our life, people will consider us unsuitable for that situation. Will try to maintain distance from us. And because of our contradictory talk, no one will want to mix with us. Similarly, if a person is seen working but we go to him and say, \

, then the person doing the work will definitely feel very annoyed by our words. Because that person is already doing that work and if we keep advising him to do that work while doing that work, then at that time our words will become completely worthless and annoying. It is understood that while we are talking, we should definitely think carefully. That whether that word can be said at that time or not. Because people do not like unnecessary words at the wrong time. This dislike is not only for others, if you think about it, you will understand that if someone says this to us, we will not like it at all. So when we talk, we should definitely think carefully and speak considering everything in the context of the situation. So that our words are much more valuable and useful. We should always speak in a way that people will like to hear and will benefit people in times of trouble and will help to improve our mood when we are upset. If our words are not valuable and do not benefit others, it is much better not to say them. Because if we keep talking unnecessarily, people may get annoyed by our words and eventually misbehave with us and leave our company and ignore us. If we keep talking unnecessarily without seeing the right time, then our family members will get annoyed and their love and affection for us will decrease, as well as our value in society will decrease and we will become much more inferior. Therefore, we should always speak with an understanding of the importance and we should also understand whether we need to speak in that situation and at that time. It is much more important and effective to remain silent than talking excessively or talking. We should think carefully about what is appropriate and what can be said at the time. We must refrain from talking unnecessarily, talking unimportantly, and talking without understanding the right time. We need to understand when to speak and when to speak, then our words will have importance and everyone will value our words. If our words are not valued and if we never understand whether we should speak at this time or not, then it is better for us to remain silent at that time. *** *** > Translated by Google Translate. Tu reflexión me parece muy valiosa y honesta. Coincido contigo en que la adultez es ese momento en el que uno empieza a tomar las riendas de su vida, con todo lo que implica asumir decisiones y responsabilidades. Eso no significa dejar de lado el apoyo de la familia y los amigos —al contrario, esa red es un recurso fundamental—, pero es importante que ese acompañamiento no se convierta en apego ni dependencia, porque entonces se pierde la oportunidad de crecer en autonomía.  

Lo que compartes sobre agradecer la ayuda recibida y, al mismo tiempo, reconocer que hay pasos que debes dar sola, refleja una madurez que se construye poco a poco. La vida, como bien dices, no es lineal ni una carrera con metas fijas; es un proceso en el que cada experiencia, incluso las que no esperábamos, nos enseña algo sobre quiénes somos y hacia dónde queremos ir.  

Me parece muy significativo que estés entrando a una nueva etapa de tu vida con esa conciencia: valorar lo que has recibido, pero también atreverte a caminar con tus propias fuerzas. Esa combinación de gratitud y autonomía es una base sólida para el futuro que estás construyendo.

Good day folks 😄, Day 1 always sounds bigger in your head than it actually is. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/39be1aae-5dc7-4b33-8ff5-5a7bdc1b7dbd.jpg) After a few lazy weeks and step counts slowly dropping, I finally decided to stop talking about getting consistent again and just start. Went out early this morning with no big plan—just walk, jog a little, stretch when needed, and keep moving. Started with a calm walk while the roads were still quiet, then mixed in light jogging once the body warmed up. Took a short pause for stretching halfway through because my legs felt tighter than expected. Funny thing is, once I got into the rhythm, the whole thing felt easier than the excuses I made yesterday 😄 Ended up finishing the morning with around 13,000 steps. I’m realizing consistency probably comes from lowering the drama around starting. Just show up and let the routine rebuild itself. If you’ve been waiting for the “perfect Monday” or the perfect mood… this is your reminder to just begin.

body.title: Crónica del último turno ( ESP / ENG )
body.body:
Un abrazo a toda la comunidad, he pasado unas semanas de mucha tensión y algo triste, tal vez por eso me había alejado un poco de esta puerta inmensa de #ecency pero aunque no me siento recuperada del todo he querido regresar y dejarles estos versos como breve saludo. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXEHi6buGdF3SJwBVirCRs4AScum3ibxcdZdN1kDrmX1H/img_20260508_122805.jpg)

​Yo pude amarte una mañana
mientras la gente se acumulaba en las esquinas,
en las colas inmensas.
No, no lo pensamos;
dimos vuelta a la página
y surgió la caricia y el beso.
Tus brazos me guardaron,
entre sudor y sábanas nos alcanzó la tarde.
​Esa mañana descubrí que el tiempo
es una lágrima.
Las horas no fueron ni cortas ni largas,
nos concedieron la caricia íntima,
el juego de no pensar en nada.
​A veces te invento mientras la gente pasa,
me atrevo a extrañarte y luego,
luego nada.
Pido el último y me quedo
esperando que el tiempo vuelva sobre mis mejillas
y me dibuje
otra vez tus manos
como lágrimas.


Gracias por recibirme siempre. 

***

A hug to the entire community, I have spent a few weeks of great tension and a little sad, perhaps that is why I had distanced myself a little from this immense door of #ecency but although I still do not feel completely recovered, I wanted to return and leave you these verses as a brief greeting. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVpCLpLP9q67N52GquXcdyYLtWQKV9TqEWG4HQvJkmoe8/img_20260508_123033.jpg)











I could love you one morning
while people gathered on the corners,
in the huge queues. 
No, we don't think about it;
we turned the page
and the caress and the kiss emerged. 
Your arms kept me,
between sweat and sheets the afternoon caught up with us. 
That morning I discovered that time
It's a tear. 
The hours were neither short nor long,
They granted us the intimate caress,
the game of not thinking about anything. 
Sometimes I invent you while people pass by,
I dare to miss you and then,
then nothing. 
I order the last one and stay
waiting for time to return on my cheeks
and I drew myself
your hands again
like tears


Thank you for always having me.
