body.title: Me fui a la cake picnic de Valencia [ES][EN]
body.body: >\n\nEn el país está agarrando un auge hacer este tipo de eventos. Independientemente de las razones detrás, algunos \

están imitando esta tendencia de otros países. Particularmente, me gusta asistir a estos eventos para conocer sobre las marcas patrocinantes, poder probar sus productos y, de alguna u otra forma, poder ahorrarme un poco. Si has leído algunas de mis entradas de cocina, sabrás que me gusta probar diferentes marcas para descubrir cuál se adapta mejor a mis gustos, pero eso lleva un gasto. Este tipo de eventos me permite poder degustar diferentes productos y sacar algunas primeras conclusiones. > This type of event is really taking off in the country. Regardless of the reasons behind it, some “influencers” are following this trend from other countries. Personally, I like attending these events to learn about the sponsoring brands, try their products, and, in one way or another, save a little money. If you’ve read some of my cooking posts, you’ll know that I like to try different brands to find out which one suits my tastes best, but that comes at a cost. These kinds of events let me sample different products and form some initial conclusions. ![IMG20260503161337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/Eou9kEbTXJr2oP8iyBfvGdJ5FoSpfUnovPooa35YXvc897frkJc7JYVrEuCpvMpNpKJ.jpg) Por supuesto que me gusta también ir a comer torta, porque no tendría ciencia ir a estos eventos si no es por torta. En el lugar había un total de 450 emprendimientos y cada uno llevó 2 o 3 propuestas de dulces. La entrada cubría 6 porciones de pastel, entonces te podrás imaginar que me tomó tiempo elegir. Duré aproximadamente 2 horas caminando el lugar, buscando esas 6 porciones de pastel que me gustaran y que no fueran más de lo mismo. > Of course, I also love going to eat cake—after all, there’d be no point in going to these events if it weren’t for the cake. There were a total of 450 vendors at the event, and each one brought two or three different types of sweets. The ticket covered six slices of cake, so you can imagine it took me a while to choose. I spent about two hours walking around the venue, looking for those six slices of cake that I liked and that weren’t just more of the same. ![IMG20260503150836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EqBd6ncbX87SyXBh7HrMi4C6YBoRkpEeS9znYsG6DRDHu3YUegeNwuTawiETrUcivzU.jpg) ![IMG20260503151110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EoiWhfaQPdQnUzuZzu6NVbYVjJMCs1RFhWJfCScDMkgXRD2nnukQc4V8mi7C5VvYwii.jpg) Voy a ser sincero, me fue bastante difícil encontrar esas 6 pociones. No porque todo estuviera malo, porque sí había pasteles que no tenían buena técnica, pero no encontraba ese factor diferenciador más allá de tortas de chocolate con crema chantillí. Incluso estaba pensando que los emprendimientos, asumiendo que estudiaron en academias de pastelería, se quedaban con lo básico y no salían de su zona de confort. Hay tantos sabores que se pueden combinar y las personas parecían que solo iban por el chocolate. > I’ll be honest, I had a pretty hard time finding those six standout items. Not because everything was bad—there were indeed some cakes that weren’t made with great technique—but I couldn’t find that unique selling point beyond chocolate cakes with whipped cream. I even started to think that these entrepreneurs, assuming they’d studied at pastry schools, were sticking to the basics and not stepping outside their comfort zone. There are so many flavors that can be combined, and people seemed to be going only for chocolate. ![IMG20260503170041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/Eonn1sh94vAuX3zevoXtm2styLf26q4dxZ66P5xTySGnMaQkM5jtDh662qVNXWf1ktP.jpg) ![IMG20260503165817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23vi82rwyHSRFS1SxKtHcVBxnAKpYwHjssDMf9sj8V4eEM27kw2aVCb5BAbuvNKixPcus.jpg) Al final sí logré encontrar esos postres que, para mi criterio, destacaron. Me encontré con una chef amiga que llevó una propuesta totalmente diferente y que resaltaba el sabor de la vainilla sarrapia, una especia típica de las orillas del río Orinoco. Ver tantas preparaciones también me sirvió de fuente de inspiración. Poder escuchar cómo cada emprendedor vendía su preparación, la inspiración que tenían para hacerlos, sirve de motivación también para crear. > In the end, I did manage to find those desserts that, in my opinion, stood out. I ran into a chef friend who presented a completely different concept that highlighted the flavor of sarrapia vanilla, a spice native to the banks of the Orinoco River. Seeing so many different creations also served as a source of inspiration for me. Hearing how each entrepreneur pitched their creation and the inspiration behind them also serves as motivation to create. ![IMG20260503163725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EoChZjdnZoAxJsCJphDprgGvHUtSyM15J1S4e6u3ACMWcgyqBsk7c59d8pXR9RZFvSR.jpg) ![IMG20260503170021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EoCifHtV2gtakSmDiVFo4PED1W8Gpm6MM2Ewc66mbC1ayRPT94AvZ1Buq2NpwYLM6Sj.jpg) Podría hablar muchas cosas negativas de la organización del evento, que fue un total desastre. Pero soy de las personas a las que les gusta enfocarse más en lo positivo, aprender de lo negativo y continuar. Esta salida la organizaron mis amigas por motivo de mi cumpleaños y, a pesar de los contratiempos, la pasamos bien, nos reímos bastante, criticamos jajaja, aprendimos y nos encontramos con colegas que la estaban dando todo. > I could say a lot of negative things about how the event was organized—it was a total disaster. But I’m the kind of person who likes to focus on the positive, learn from the negative, and move on. My friends organized this outing for my birthday, and despite the setbacks, we had a good time, laughed a lot, complained a bit (hahaha), learned some lessons, and ran into some friends who were really giving it their all. ![IMG20260503161417.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EpNpSPXsuMXSGYzkZDTi8GtADvwD8FwJXdP1F3jbmoZBonrRM8UfXo49gCDdo8Q4Kh3.jpg) ![IMG20260503163944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23tmHi3iJAjsK3URWMj2Wkaeo1C6LgFcYeFH38gHaUGHC111H5sEm2ptPLYciGMfqsisJ.jpg) Si tienen la oportunidad de asistir a estos eventos, háganlo. Sacando las cosas malas, es una oportunidad de conocer diferentes emprendimientos, el trabajo que están realizando otras personas y salir de la zona de confort de siempre comprar los dulces en el mismo lugar. La vida hay que disfrutarla y no podemos quedarnos comiendo siempre lo mismo; hay que probar cosas nuevas. > If you have the chance to attend these events, go for it. Setting aside the downsides, it’s a chance to discover different businesses, see the work other people are doing, and step outside your comfort zone of always buying sweets from the same place. Life is meant to be enjoyed, and we can’t just keep eating the same things all the time; we have to try new things. ![IMG20260503162612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EoGxQR3fs3vU5KCVUcgbChFseva527JbHnPoamgMfMgdyVH6uYnHeKPRQwud3bTfW5P.jpg) ![IMG20260503162659.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EogMoXcWjYetu5hcjNdHASwBnAFq1VuDAn8ToYA2NVm6FzmsCkRnzuqFU1K5GRsopjt.jpg) --- ---
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23w2oCU1jrMQb87xKWpLidyqDisfwQEZG5j58s8WspTg4md9pgUiYR7uBSLzFaqhMa5c1.png
Todas las fotografías fueron tomadas por mí con un Realme 7 pro. No autorizo a nadie reutilizarlas. Esta publicación fue escrita en español y luego traducida al inglés. > All photographs were taken by me with a Realme 7 pro. I do not authorize anyone to reuse them. This publication was written in Spanish and then translated into English.

body.body:
**Selva** funciona muy bien para “jungle”, aunque en español también se usa mucho para **bosque tropical** o **selva tropical**, según el contexto.

Tu frase está correcta:

**Hay muchos árboles en la selva.**  
“There are many trees in the jungle.”

Un matiz útil para estudiantes:

- **Selva** = jungle / rainforest, normalmente vegetación densa y tropical.
- **Bosque** = forest, más general.
- **Selva tropical** = tropical rainforest.
- **La selva amazónica** = the Amazon rainforest.

Buen ejemplo visual también: la imagen ayuda a distinguir “selva” de un simple “bosque”. No toda selva es Amazonas, pero si hay humedad, vegetación densa y uno siente que un mono te está juzgando desde un árbol, probablemente vamos por buen camino.

body.title: Muchos quieren el fruto pero pocos aguantarían el clima necesario para que crezca [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Muchos quieren el fruto pero pocos aguantarían el clima necesario para que crezca [ESPENG].jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/243M2veNPkC7ymkHQTBs6YTAqLKmXUG2RxPSiko5GqBknPRsLBbn7g7L9wxBQQqctqyrj.jpg)


<div class=\

>

En Español

Saludos a la comunidad de @womentribe, me uno a la iniciativa de nuestra estimada @syllem , en su columna de Letras inspiradoras, con el tema a reflexionar sobre: \

en donde nos indica que muchas veces queremos dinero y reconocimiento y pensar si estamos preparados para eso. Nos deja algunas preguntas: ¿Hay algo que hayas tenido que guardarte últimamente para evitar un conflicto? ¿Qué reflexiones te dejó ese momento?, a continuación mi participación: Existen acontecimientos a lo largo de nuestras vidas que eluden los sentimientos que nunca supimos que estaban ahí y que pensábamos que nosotras éramos completamente incapaces de tener, solo cuando puedo ver la realidad, es normal tener esta clase de sentimientos.

Aprender algo nuevo de mí misma

Cuando tengo este tipo de sentimientos, tengo otra oportunidad de aprender algo nuevo de mí misma. Entonces pienso en estar agradecida por dejarlos salir, porque no es sano proyectarlos sobre los demás o reprimirlos pues se cocerían dentro de mi interior. Como lo señala nuestra estimada @syllem, a veces queremos dinero y reconocimiento, sin pensar si estamos preparados para eso. Un ejemplo es cuando alguien cercano me pregunta \

, en realidad no me está cuestionando a mí, sino que se está cuestionando a sí mismo. ![Muchos quieren el fruto pero pocos aguantarían el clima necesario para que crezca [ESPENG] (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23u673stzHYQXQabh4oLFuo9kXaiEoBULYi4nSoY4ccW62VBmxznAA9SHtsewsWGJWMvf.jpg)

La gente suele enamorarse del resultado, pero desprecia el proceso

Hay una mezcla amarga entre el afecto familiar y el resentimiento que nace de la comparación, ya que es un fenómeno psicológico y social muy real, porque la gente suele enamorarse del resultado, pero desprecia el proceso. Muchas veces ven el donde estoy ahora como un destino al que se llega por suerte o por decreto, ignorando la preparación, los sacrificios y la resistencia mental que me han permitido sostener ese estilo de vida. Aquí hay algunas verdades incómodas que he leído en internet, pero necesarias sobre esa dinámica: **-El éxito como espejo** Tu progreso actúa como un espejo que les devuelve la imagen de su propio estancamiento. Para no enfrentar la falta de disciplina o de riesgo personal, es más fácil invalidar tu logro sugiriendo que es un privilegio injusto. **-Capacidad vs. Deseo**, muchos quieren el fruto, pero pocos aguantarían el **clima** necesario para que crezca. **-El dinero** sin educación financiera se convierte en deuda. **-El reconocimiento** sin madurez emocional se convierte en ego destructivo o ansiedad. **-La \
**Es ese impulso inconsciente de algunos grupos (especialmente familias) de intentar bajar al que está sobresaliendo para que el resto no se sienta \

. No es que no te quieran, es que tu ascenso altera el equilibrio de poder y comodidad al que estaban acostumbrados. ![Muchos quieren el fruto pero pocos aguantarían el clima necesario para que crezca [ESPENG] (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23tm6tTke9EWtFeNVLX4KowySLpyvQabGed7GiHicTxDt3QwLF2xhKeRhrv8DaDUMuUCm.jpg)

Devolver la responsabilidad suavemente

Solo cuando me permito manejar este tipo de cosas sin desgastarme, es porque no tengo que pedir permiso para brillar, no necesito disculparme por los frutos de mi esfuerzo. Tratar de hacerme pequeña, para que ellos no se sientan mal, solo me traerá resentimiento hacia mi propia persona. De todos modos, cuando surjan esos comentarios, puedo devolver la responsabilidad suavemente, cuando les digo: “ya que todos tenemos derecho a buscar lo mejor, pero los caminos de cada quien requieren sacrificios distintos”. Yo estoy feliz de ver que es posible lograrlo. Es agotador sentir que tengo que pagar una fianza emocional por haber salido adelante. Pero la realidad es que estar preparada para lo que tengo, es lo que me permite mantenerlo. Ellos ven la meta, pero solo yo conozco el peso de la mochila que he cargado, siempre con la fe puesta en nuestro creador. Si desean unirse a la iniciativa, deben hacer [Haga clic aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-lo-mejor-de). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeZeEupfP2Ys5Yin2yB3q4qodjysvQmFQzzqVuENLu9c4LfDp9pEG4suGmVQVhofzs.jpg) Los diseños y las imágenes en Canva. Las fotografías en mi galería tomadas de mi teléfono Honor Magic6 y editadas en Canva Traducido con www.DeepL.com/Translator (versión gratuita) ![Muchos quieren el fruto pero pocos aguantarían el clima necesario para que crezca [ESPENG] (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/243WRTDHicyEp4Qo8pGSt3Z28NtcextgWC4JXaTzbG9mfxKUGkodW3MEB491vN9niv9ND.jpg)

In English

Greetings to the @womentribe community! I'm joining our esteemed @syllem's initiative in her \
column, with the theme for reflection: \

She points out that we often crave money and recognition and ask ourselves if we're truly prepared for it. She poses a few questions: Is there anything you've had to keep to yourself lately to avoid conflict? What reflections did that moment bring to your mind? Here's my contribution: There are events throughout our lives that unleash feelings we never knew existed, feelings we thought we were completely incapable of experiencing. Only when I see reality do I realize it's normal to have these kinds of feelings.

Learning something new about myself

When I have these kinds of feelings, I have another opportunity to learn something new about myself. Then I think about being grateful for letting them out, because it's not healthy to project them onto others or repress them, as they would fester inside me. As our esteemed @syllem points out, sometimes we want money and recognition without considering whether we're ready for it. An example is when someone close to me asks, \

They're not really questioning me, but rather questioning themselves. ![Muchos quieren el fruto pero pocos aguantarían el clima necesario para que crezca [ESPENG] (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23u673stzHYQXQabh4oLFuo9kXaiEoBULYi4nSoY4ccW62VBmxznAA9SHtsewsWGJWMvf.jpg)

People often fall in love with the result, but despise the process

There's a bitter mix of familial affection and resentment born from comparison, as it's a very real psychological and social phenomenon: people often fall in love with the result, but despise the process. Many times they see where I am now as a destination reached by luck or by decree, ignoring the preparation, sacrifices, and mental resilience that have allowed me to sustain this lifestyle. Here are some uncomfortable but necessary truths I've read online about this dynamic: **-Success as a Mirror** Your progress acts as a mirror, reflecting back their own stagnation. To avoid confronting their lack of discipline or personal risk, it's easier to invalidate your achievement by suggesting it's an unfair privilege. **-Ability vs. Desire** Many want the fruit, but few would endure the necessary **climate** for it to grow. **-Money** without financial education becomes debt. **-Recognition** without emotional maturity becomes destructive ego or anxiety. **-The \
** This is the unconscious impulse in some groups (especially families) to try to bring down the one who is excelling so that the rest don't feel \

It's not that they don't like you; it's that your rise disrupts the balance of power and comfort they were accustomed to. ![Muchos quieren el fruto pero pocos aguantarían el clima necesario para que crezca [ESPENG] (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23tm6tTke9EWtFeNVLX4KowySLpyvQabGed7GiHicTxDt3QwLF2xhKeRhrv8DaDUMuUCm.jpg)

Gently Returning Responsibility

Only when I allow myself to handle these kinds of things without getting burned out is it because I don't have to ask permission to shine, I don't need to apologize for the fruits of my labor. Trying to shrink myself so they don't feel bad will only bring me resentment towards myself. Anyway, when those comments come up, I can gently return the responsibility by saying, \

I'm happy to see that it's possible to achieve it. It's exhausting to feel like I have to pay an emotional price for having succeeded. But the reality is that being prepared for what I have is what allows me to maintain it. They see the goal, but only I know the weight of the backpack I've carried, always with faith in our Creator. If you wish to join the initiative, you must do [Click here](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-lo-mejor-de). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeZeEupfP2Ys5Yin2yB3q4qodjysvQmFQzzqVuENLu9c4LfDp9pEG4suGmVQVhofzs.jpg) The designs and images in canva The pictures in my gallery taken from my Honor Magic6 phone and edited in canva Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version) ![@cautiva30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/48GiQXHFXuLXhcZXkK5D2agffwMe5xE3nu6XSwbDyvaimGxptw98DKqiE6TD4LkNoE.jpg)

body.title: Letter grading vs pass/fail method
body.body:
Most schools now grade students by A,B,C,D and F, this determines their performance in class if they are to promoted to another class or offered a scholarship. But what if this method is scrapped and it will be replaced with pass/fail method, where by someone that an A+ will be given a pass and some that had a grade like F will be graded fail instead. Will that be kind for the students morale?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTWMv1p1t3mRPa3hEVBNtvnJJAoxGjBAqYEDVUpYNJqAT/1778288259573.png)

In the case of passing/fail using will reduce the anxiety and energy to pursue to get a high point, for when a student got 59 it feels like he or she has failed after studying and the other where a student got  85 he discourage or disappointed in himself after seeing a fellow student getting an 100. This now looks like a competition instead means of growth.

Inputting fail/pass method it will reduce tension, it reduces the competition between students, they will be more concerned to know if they are doing well to be able to move on. For a student who doesn't have confidence will be more and when pass/fail school system it reduces the fear of making mistakes, that's where learning occur.

But there is negative side of pass/fail. First its kills motivation; what makes A and B to be different is when a student pushes harder to reach on highest top. Wherby every student result looks the same on the script and some that 50% is the same as someone that has 90%. Most of the students will just at 51% and stop and will not be motivated to do more. They are just learning for learning sake, maybe just  to pass a subject they don't like.

Using a pass/fail, does not encourage feedback. For instance when a sthad an A in a course, it makes the students to have confidence that he has done well and known the subject well and when a student have a C on a student, it makes you realise that you didn't did when and that you put more effort in your study for you score an A next time. But using\

to pass to grade the students, they won't know when they scaled through or improved in their studies.

Now the question is will pass/fail good for morale? The answer will be yes. When you remove grades like A,B, C ,D, or F it will reduce and make the students from comparing each other, it will reduce lack of self confidence and shame. If the reason why the students study its only for them to have a grade, then using pass/fail grade them will make them not to study hard or that will make them not feel challenged.

The best option is to use the two to grade students, use the pass/fail for the basic courses, the aim is for the students to master the course and the feedback will be recorded through comments and while A or F grade will be use for specialised courses

In concluson, removing letter grade for pass/fail  grading students academic performance will not help in education system itself. Grading is not just a aim rather it's a tool. If the aim is to reduce lack of confidence, shame and anxiety then pass/fail will definitely be helpful. If the aim is to encourage students better performance and to get a good feedback then letter grades will be in the right thing to use. When student feels capable and observed progress and not always compared with each other that's when students morale comes in and improves.

body.title: Animal Spirit Guide: The Kangaroo
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYUUNRZRsgesrqKz4g6az9s8MrwicfKnH4eAFFwtFLyEP/1778280039667.jpg)

The kangaroo as a spirit animal carries rich and layered symbolism, drawing on both Indigenous Australian traditions and broader shamanic/totemic interpretations. Here’s what it typically signifies:

**Forward Movement & Progress**
The kangaroo’s most iconic quality — it can only move forward, never backward — makes it a powerful symbol of momentum, purpose, and refusing to dwell in the past. As a spirit animal, it encourages you to keep pressing ahead even when the path is uncertain.

**Strength & Agility**
Kangaroos are deceptively powerful. Their spirit energy speaks to inner resilience, the ability to navigate difficult terrain, and finding balance between strength and grace under pressure.

**Protection & Nurturing**
The pouch is central to kangaroo symbolism. It represents a deep instinct to protect those you love, carrying them through vulnerable stages until they’re ready to stand on their own. It’s strongly associated with maternal energy, family bonds, and creating safe spaces for others.

**Adaptability**
Kangaroos thrive in harsh, unpredictable environments. Their spirit invites you to be resourceful, flexible, and at ease with change rather than resisting it.

**Community & Collective Living**
Kangaroos travel in “mobs” — social creatures who look out for one another. Their spirit energy can point to the importance of your tribe, chosen family, or community ties, and your role within that group.

**Leaping Into the Unknown**
Their great leaping ability is often read as a call to take bold, courageous jumps — in career, relationships, or spiritual growth — trusting that you have the strength to land well.

**Balance of Action & Stillness**
Despite their bursts of powerful energy, kangaroos can also be remarkably still and watchful. Their spirit teaches discernment: knowing *when* to leap and when to simply observe.

**In Indigenous Australian tradition**, the kangaroo holds a sacred place as a totem animal connected to land, family lineage, and the Dreamtime — representing abundance, survival, and a deep relationship with the earth.

If the kangaroo has been showing up for you — in dreams, meditations, or repeated sightings — it may be nudging you toward bold forward movement, a reminder to protect what matters, or an invitation to trust the leap you've been hesitating to take.

We lost our 2 Huskies, Nikkita & Frosty, They were 14 yrs old, Our 2 cats Shadow & Squeekers, sister cats of 17 years, 2 Ferrets Harley & Harlett, And our beloved Mother Pamela Schultz Bach, Samantha Jo was Born on or very near to the Date that Kelly's Mom Pam was Born, September 5th, Sammi Jo Rescued Us Both, I had Lost my Wife & Best friend to depression. And Kelly needed a reason to pick herself up and live again. No matter what your beliefs are, and I am not a spiritual person at all. Kelly & I believe in a higher power now. Not the make believe ones that live-in the clouds. But there has to be something more to all this madness... Thank You Pam for sending Samantha Jo our way. This amazing little @krazzy-kitty helped us heal and when we look at her we also think of you. Pamela Schultz Bach a wonderful Wife, Mother & Friend, R.I.P. Pam Bach. Sept, 5th 1951 to May 10th 2010. We Will Always Love & Miss You..!! A few more photos of Pam Bach. Forever in our Hearts. My Best Friend & Life Partner Kelly (@pooky-jax) and Mom.

body.title: [ENG - ESP 🛣️🏙️] Moments Over Plans
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdGEdocHJq8eUn5vV9AUkqn1sL42TsfGqNXFgCZRu1mWW/1778265565994.jpg)

🛣️ What a whirlwind of a day! It was intense, emotional, and anything but routine. My morning started at the neurologist’s office for my migraine treatment, and by the afternoon, I was already packed and on my way to visit my soulmate-friend after 5 long years.

🏙️ *Hoy fue un día intenso, cargado de emociones y mucho ajetreo. Totalmente fuera de la rutina, totalmente aventurero. Por la mañana tocó cita con el neurólogo para aplicarme el tratamiento para la migraña, por la tarde estaba cogiendo mi maleta y mi mochila para encaminarme hacia un lugar nuevo, el hogar de mi amiga del alma a quien o veía desde hace 5 años.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWSDUvjxHvtaN9jq8yJGHirJCMAoEN9vQH73LosJhRU5W/1778208198103.jpg)

🛣️We really need to stop overanalyzing and planning every second of our lives. Every once in a while, you have to embrace the adventure, leave your comfort zone, and just go for it. Let your instincts and that spark of adrenaline lead the way. If you think about it too much, you’ll just end up paralyzed. You have to dive in to actually live the experience.

🏙️*A veces hay que dejar de pensar y calcular y planificar tanto las cosas. A veces hay que lanzarse a la aventura, salir de la zona de confort, atreverse a dar el paso, dejarse llevar un poco por los instintos y el impulso (un poquito, de vez en cuando), dejarse llevar por la adrenalina y la emoción. Sí te pones a pensarlo simplemente te congelarás y no lo harás, no vivirás la experiencia.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWHqg6ySx7zHPhFbrgjzYsqyZ4rUt7xYH3jhPoPHTjWqN/1778208198157.jpg)

🛣️Adult life is filled with problems to solve, priorities, and endless details. There are things that always end up at the bottom of our never-ending to-do list because time or money just isn't enough. We work to earn money, but then we have no time because we’re working. It’s a vicious cycle that, if we don’t break it when an opportunity or an impulse arises—no matter how small—keeps pulling at us, absorbing us completely.

🏙️*La vida adulta está llena de problemas que resolver, prioridades, pormenores. Hay cosas que se dejan de último en la lista interminable de quehaceres porque el tiempo o el dinero no alcanzan. Trabajamos para tener dinero y luego no tenemos tiempo porque trabajamos. Es un círculo vicioso que si no rompemos cuando hay alguna oportunidad o impulso por pequeño que sea, va tirando de nosotros, absorbiéndonos.* 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDxGfrvpeJHCA7u2yYnCkaoMBhgB9k1sn54nZeiaSdQS/1778208071505.jpg)

🛣️It’s often said that to truly enjoy life, you have to feel it with the same sense of adventure as a child. Shifting all those 'priorities' and important matters to the back burner every once in a while is healthy; it’s necessary.

🏙️ *Bien dicen que para disfrutar de la vida hay que sentirla con la misma emoción de aventura que un niño. Desplazar de vez en cuando todas esas \

y asuntos importantes a un segundo lugar es sano, es necesario.* 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR7v6KfMkMuhrkt9sJJbo7ZDGBJMKFWdneM4kji26qYXy/1778208071606.jpg)

🛣️And well, here I am—improvising, making plans out of thin air. My friend and I feel like little girls again. Because the opportunity presented itself and here we are, living in the moment. So grateful to life for bringing us back together 💕.

🏙️*Y bueno, aquí me encuentro, improvisando, armando planes de la nada y al momento. Mi amiga y yo nos sentimos como unas niñas. Porque la oportunidad se dio y aquí estamos, viviendo el momento. Agradecidas con la vida por habernos reencontrado* 💕.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6zD8KpzeoeYdNpu2nx8DyZUczw1rvy9Go2fsBp9Mqb2/1778208071686.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkEL8VbniComePdDoW7ba4CLoYzsfMcDRyBhW17b2FR9/1778208071782.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmboNHNzeGPvgNcSFiZirv7EkCe4WdvidnTbZaPdCz24WA/1778208071872.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnLVWByDYjzEmyJELYoiq6EcbgX1Xkcz8HNAEzmdGTdp/1778208250507.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQz3BYuSPRb5R6bHG8jFuherfkTrwo6nJsdPrb4XXvHmP/1778208250577.jpg)

🛣️And as for me, I’m getting to know—and falling in love with—a brand new city.

🏙️*Y yo, conociendo y enamorándome de una ciudad nueva para mí.* 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYrmRxq47p6fo8FRyiR98vzZYRazgQMYf3GHQv5w7tBJN/1778208250652.jpg)

🛣️Thank you for reading and for all your support 💖. I hope this weekend brings you opportunities to hit pause, breathe, and enjoy the small details that often go unnoticed or that we take for granted 🌸.

🏙️*Gracias por leerme y darme su apoyo* 💖 *espero que el fin de semana les brinde oportunidades de dar una pausa, respirar, y disfrutar de los pequeños detalles que a veces nos pasan desapercibidos o damos por sentado* 🌸.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdJjdvRFCUSfGZKHkXez85MjovhSZBEVddvRnAnvLhYe/1778208296237.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeYvNiubB2tTvbTa5faN8t7sreMHHj8JsLnTEBj3tPGzD/1778208296353.jpg)

I wasn't planning to go to this event because it was so far away… but a friend of mine was competing and he got me excited because he lent me a lens I've always wanted to use: the Canon 70-200 f/2.8 with a 1.4x extender. Anyway. For those who don't know, triathlon is a sport that combines three disciplines: swimming, cycling, and running. This particular one was a sprint distance (750m swim + 20km bike + 5km run), although there are longer distances depending on the category.

body.title: The joy of opening a guild pack and getting cards
body.body:
Today very special day for me. I finally got open a guild pack after waiting for a time. You know how exciting it is open a guild pack when you play the game regularly. Nobody knows when they will get a card. Today was same for me. I was really shocked when I saw cards I got. It felt like I was very lucky today.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQGrkArr1GWcmMrP8X6iVTvcmeYK4LGTc9SDc2zSXYT4g/1778287649189.png)

I love collecting cards when I play the game. It is especially fun when I get an rare card. I had been collecting guild packs for a time hoping to get some good cards. I thought I would get some cards but what I got was much better than I expected. I was a little nervous when I opened pack. Because you never know what, will get.. As the cards came out I could not believe my eyes.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcDCSJFx1pfkLcQcXRuX56jcJgpA4GsUj4rwQESMohzt7/1778287649614.jpg)

I was most surprised when I saw the valuable cards. Especially the Legendary and Epic cards were amazing. Usually it is not easy to get these cards. Sometimes players do not get them after opening many packs.. Today I was very lucky. I got some cards in a short time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcn95YgDtCQ3y6oyN5Co9yjPq7RA8N9Gc23pxPrfDFQHt/1778287649484.jpg)

The cards looked very beautiful and attractive. The people who made the game did a job with the artwork. I really liked the Larissa Kerato card. It looked amazing. Had great power and abilities. Cards like this are not good for my collection but they can also help me a lot during battles. I am already thinking about how I will use this card in the future.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYPts5vJBySQ9Yj1RYawbk79icEkqG8gQA7og5nFP4qDL/1778287649431.jpg)

I was also very happy to get the Quora Towershead card. I had heard a lot of things about this card. I saw how well it worked in battles. It felt like I got a strength for my gaming journey.

The Alva The Crusher card seemed interesting to me. A good tank card can make a difference in a battle. So getting this card felt like an achievement.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcevY53VH36eYXtkgp1yMVjvpRZKa9jfuRJcxbVTw7RJf/1778287649335.jpg)

When I saw the Whistling Damon and Witch of Warwick cards I knew I was very lucky today. It is rare to get many good cards at once. I do not usually expect much when I open a pack because if I expect much I might be disappointed.. What I got today was better than I could have imagined.

When I play games I want to make my deck stronger. The better my cards are, the stronger my team will be. Opening the guild pack today made me more confident. Now I feel like I can compete better and build a team.

The best thing is that this joy is not about getting cards. It is the result of waiting and working hard for a time. Sometimes I play the game for a time and do not get what I want. It can be disappointing.. Then there are moments that make me forget all the hard work. Today was one of those moments.

I think that in the gaming world it is these joys that motivate us. Getting cards making new strategies and building a strong team make the game more fun. Now I am excited to try combinations with these cards. I want to see how they work in guild battles and ranked matches.

I am also happy about the potential these cards. They will help me now and in future. I plan level them up. When a powerful card gets to a level it becomes even more powerful. So now I have a goal.

Todays experience reminded me that luck and patience are important in the game. Sometimes one pack can change everything. I am happy and grateful that I got beautiful cards.

Finally I want to say that todays Guild Pack Open was one of the moments of my gaming life. It was not about getting  cards but also  excitement and joy  that moment. I hope have more moments like this in future. Playing battles with these new cards is what I am most excited, about now.

Hive powers economic survival in Cuba by providing a **decentralized, censorship-resistant infrastructure** that allows citizens to bypass traditional financial barriers and international sanctions. In a country where traditional banking bridges often collapse or are inaccessible, Hive is utilized as a trusted blockchain to maintain financial activity.

### **Resistance to Financial Censorship**

Because major international exchanges and custodial wallets frequently block Cuban users due to **OFAC sanctions**, Hive’s decentralized nature offers a critical alternative. By emphasizing **self-custody**—the principle of \

(not your keys, not your coins)—the Hive community ensures that Cubans can manage their own funds without the risk of third-party seizures or account freezes.

### **Protecting Value via HBD**

The **Hive Backed Dollar (HBD)** is used as a digital reserve to protect the value of Cuban labor from the severe **devaluation of the Cuban peso (CUP)** and high inflation.

*   **HBD-Mint:** This solution allows local communities to create their own **digital reserves**, fostering a circular economy where values are protected from the volatility of local fiat currency.
    
*   **Economic Stability:** Entrepreneurs and content creators use HBD as a **stablecoin** (pegged to the USD) to save and trade without the risks associated with the fluctuating prices of non-stable cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin.
    

### **Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Exchange and Remittances**

Hive facilitates the flow of capital through direct person-to-person channels, which is vital given the limited credit system in Cuba.

*   **HiveCuBaP2P\_Bot:** This Telegram-based tool enables secure and decentralized P2P exchanges, allowing users to trade assets directly within the community.
    
*   **Remittance Services:** Platforms like **canje**, **hiveremesas**, and **PaCubba** allow Cubans to convert their rewards from Web3 content creation into local currency (MLC or CUP) quickly and safely.
    

### **Adaptation to Local Infrastructure**

Survival in Cuba requires technology that accounts for unstable internet connectivity.

*   **HiveCash:** This is an **\

wallet** developed specifically for the Cuban context, allowing users to handle HBD transactions even when a constant internet connection is not available.
    
*   **Low Friction:** The community promotes tools like **LNbits** and the **V4V app**, which act as gateways between Hive and the Bitcoin Lightning Network, allowing for fast, low-fee, and nearly instant cross-border payments.
    

### **Educational and Academic Support**

The Hive ecosystem in Cuba is not just about financial tools; it is a movement supported by **knowledge and literacy**.

*   **Academic Collaboration:** The community works with the **University of Havana** to study blockchain from a scientific perspective, training a new generation of developers and specialists in **Web3 and smart contracts**.
    
*   **Entrepreneurial Growth:** Hive acts as an incubator for startups, providing the programmability (via Layer 2 solutions like VSC) needed to build payment processors that do not rely on traditional, high-cost intermediaries.

body.title: Lindas y letales - Bailarinas asesinas | Pretty and Deadly – Killer Dancers
body.body:
> >! [English Version] > Dance, like any artistic pursuit, demands effort and dedication. In ballet, although the audience sees glamour and grace in every movement on stage, behind the scenes there is pain and countless hours of rehearsal. Few people are willing to pay the price to achieve perfection. > > It is with this behind-the-scenes effort that Pretty and Deadly begins, an action, horror and suspense film based on the experiences of a group of dancers who travelled from North America to Budapest, Hungary, to take part in a competition, never imagining they would have to fight for their survival. > >
![1001647188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/23tbK6aNXb1CSeSE9mkXsSHokJR7iCcztXn7Qgd7c2ugm9cdhqcZJUe7NhQBsfBGBtDUW.jpg)
> > Being a dancer is not synonymous with fragility, for this film shows quite the opposite: first, the rivalry that can exist among the dancers in a group because the soloist steals the limelight, and then the injuries and the training they endure through physical pain; this forges a strong character capable of facing the worst situations. > > This group of dancers is made up of very different characters: there is the wealthy girl who has everything handed to her; the spoilt one; the one who works, lives alone and has a scholarship; and there is even a deaf-mute character in the group. If you look more closely at the physical features of these dancers, you’ll realise there’s an Asian girl, an Indian girl, a white girl and a black girl. It’s a diverse group that complements one another. > >
![1001647187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/23tGyM5HLiszF59toR32dLBrP7T6cGjnE8UTNiWB3kyjVcKQ9QpsWYBkr366qCqtj3tgK.jpg)
> > In the first part there are no signs of horror; everything happens as normal, but in the second part there is an unexpected twist when the bus crashes and they have to walk through the woods until they find shelter; that is when the cinematography and atmosphere change, and from then on all the scenes take place in a dark and eerie bar, a place curiously decorated with dancers’ dresses and ballet photos. This place is full of men dressed in a way that suggests they are gangsters. > > To the girls’ relief—and my own as a viewer, heh heh heh—the bar’s owner and manager is a woman who used to be a famous dancer, but… well, rather than being a positive thing, this didn’t help them get out of their predicament. The dancers just wanted to leave and get to the audition on time, yet they were kidnapped and had to face all those men, becoming killers just to survive. > > That’s when the blood starts to stain everything; the dancers used every resource at their disposal to fight and defend themselves; there were cruel, action-packed scenes that left me feeling desperate, as well as some scenes of black humour full of sarcasm that had me laughing out loud, such as the scene where a man starts torturing the protagonist with the intention of pulling out her toenails, which causes the young woman to burst into laughter; the man doesn’t understand her reaction and, amidst laughter, anger and irony, the dancer explains that her nails break constantly and that she pulls them out herself and dances with a smile. Implying that for her, that wasn’t torture. This scene was my favourite 😁😆, I loved it. > >
![1001647186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/23tRxii2ANp3cwGpRNd3Pu5esWMVgVy8GEQ7xh9EmbwJHeGcmk4bYhcYaZkggKSvjh24f.jpg)
> > I enjoyed the mix of genres, the costumes and the impeccable make-up; the only thing that disappointed me a little was the ending—I didn’t like how it ended; however, it kept me entertained throughout the film; if I had to give it a score, it would be an 8 out of 10.
La danza como cualquier actividad artística requiere de esfuerzo y dedicación. En la danza clásica aunque en escena el espectador vea glamour y sutileza en cada gesto detrás de eso, hay dolor y muchas horas de ensayo. Son pocas las personas que están dispuestas a pagar el precio para lograr la perfección. Con ese esfuerzo detrás de escena es que inicia lindas y letales, una película del género de acción, terror y thriller basada en las experiencias de un grupo de bailarinas que viajaron desde su país Norte América a Budapest, Hungría para participar en un concurso sin imaginar que tendrían que luchar para sobrevivir.
![1001647188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/23tbK6aNXb1CSeSE9mkXsSHokJR7iCcztXn7Qgd7c2ugm9cdhqcZJUe7NhQBsfBGBtDUW.jpg)
Ser bailarina no es sinónimo de fragilidad, pues en esta película se muestra todo lo contrario, primero la rivalidad que puede existir entre las bailarinas de un grupo porque la solista se roba todas las miradas y luego las lesiones y prácticas que realizan con dolor físico, eso construye un carácter fuerte capaz de enfrentar las peores situaciones. Este grupo de bailarinas son personajes muy diferentes, está la chica que es adinerada que todo se lo dan; la consentida; la que trabaja, vive sola y es becada, incluso en el grupo hay un personaje que es sorda-muda, y si observas mejor los rasgos físicos de estas bailarinas te darás cuenta que hay una asiática, india, blanca y raza negra. Es un grupo diverso que se complementa.
![1001647187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/23tGyM5HLiszF59toR32dLBrP7T6cGjnE8UTNiWB3kyjVcKQ9QpsWYBkr366qCqtj3tgK.jpg)
En la primera parte no hay indicios de terror todo sucede de forma normal, pero en la segunda parte hay un giro inesperado cuando el bus se accidenta y tienen que caminar por el bosque hasta encontrar refugio, entonces es cuando la fotografía y ambiente cambia, a partir de allí todas las escenas ocurren en un oscuro y tenebroso bar, lugar que está curiosamente decorado con vestidos de bailarinas y fotos de ballet. Este lugar está lleno de hombres con un vestuario que hace pensar que son mafiosos. Para la tranquilidad de las chicas y mía propia como espectadora je, je, je, la dueña y jefa del bar es una mujer que llegó a ser una famosa bailarina, pero... eso en vez de ser algo positivo no les ayudó a salir de apuros. Las bailarinas solo querían irse y llegar a tiempo a la audición, sin embargo las secuestraron teniendo que enfrentarse a todos esos hombres convirtiéndose en asesinas para sobrevivir. Es cuando la sangre comienza a pintar todo, las bailarinas usaron todos sus recursos para pelear y defenderse, hubo escenas crueles y llenas de acción que me desesperaron también algunas escenas de humor negro llenas de sarcasmo, que me sacaron una carcajada, como la escena donde un hombre empieza a torturar a la protagonista su intención es arrancarle las uñas de los pies esto a la joven le da un ataque de risa, el hombre no entiende su reacción y entre risas, rabia e ironía la bailarina le explica que todo el tiempo se le parten las uñas y ella misma se las arranca y baila con una sonrisa. Dando a entender que para ella eso no era tortura. Esta escena fue mi favorita 😁😆, me encantó.
![1001647186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/23tRxii2ANp3cwGpRNd3Pu5esWMVgVy8GEQ7xh9EmbwJHeGcmk4bYhcYaZkggKSvjh24f.jpg)
Disfruté la mezcla de los géneros, el vestuario, el maquillaje impecable lo único que me decepcionó un poco fue su parte final, no me gustó el cierre, sin embargo, me mantuvo entretenida toda la película, si tuviera que darle un puntaje sería 8 de 10. * * *

这是假期第三次出来去逛街了。昨天去了这家串串香自助火锅店。可能假期已经结束了，没有前几天的客流量了但傍晚的时间还是不少人。姑娘吃饭快哈，吃的差不多了，人家竟然给我丟下自己出去买东西了。丢就丢吧，我可不着急自己在这慢慢吃，还给自己开了一瓶宏宝莱结果喝不完呵，跟着临桌小情侣学的喝饮料，还挺浪漫的😂，一个人的浪漫。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbV78DuwevjkV7msMcpexD31YC4wurZLpob6KMUUz9dbn/1778287030650.jpg)

吃不回来，我连红薯地瓜都吃了😂
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRE9EHffAeMYxmbXHrmz8H4dphBzu481SK2mqrVL6KNjN/1778287082045.jpg)衣服放这筐里。记得螺蛳粉家也是这样的。

昨晚公园运动的人不少，跳广场舞的有好几波。有两波因为占地盘还吵起来了哈哈，这又何必呢，影响了出来运动的核心那。

This is one of the hardest aquatic animals that I've tried keeping. I have tried keeping four, and most of them could not make it. I am not sure why. Hi hi.. How are you? I hope that you are great. Have a great Saturday. A happy crayfish greets you good morning.
/> These are quite huge in size already.
/> So many different types of aquatic animals in the fish tank here. There are some Neon Tetras and what I have been looking for is some of the gold fish here.

/> A cute little stingray. This is one of those aquatic animals that I've not yet tried and raised before. But, it looks like a colourful addition to any aquarium tank. One of the things I look for when buying any fishes or aquarium mates is to look at the health of most of the fish to see if they are all healthy or not.

/> My favourite The black gold fish or Oranda goldfish. They look like these little swimming lions. I have a dozen of these in different colours in my own aquarium at home. They are the most greediest bunch. They constantly come for food most of the time.
/> The platinum and gold short-body koi. I had one of this in my aquarium and it lived quite happily for a couple of months till one day , all of the sudden, it just went to heaven.
/> The Pacu That fish has special human looking teeth.
/> The most beautiful fish in Asia. The red arowana.
/> So many fish here in this aquarium shop. The tanks look like they have been well maintained which is great to look at. The owner has done a good job keeping this place clean.

links.title: Maryland | Divided State (and a history of MD during the war)
links.body:
![Maryland.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ds-tech/23tvkjsxLPWmzcpj2c4z173zDfRHV6CJbXAByofRu12BJo9b9BguHzqkLTNksNemsw2GD.jpg)


This is mixed media on canvas paper.

Acrylics
Decocolor paint markers
Primsacolor markers
Pastels
Charcoal

This is pretty old, but I felt like uploading it.
This is the outline of the state of Maryland, and the state flag within the borders. MD is known for it's flag, and often considered the best looking of the state flags.

The flag has an interesting story that goes all the way back the US Civil War. The flag represents that MD was split Confederate & Union.

 Maryland shared a border with the US capital of Washington DC which was formerly Rome, Maryland before becoming the District of Colombia long before the Civil War. The rest of the border was Virginia(and today West-Virginia as well).

MD was the southern-most Union state in the war, and is below the Mason-Dixon line which technically makes it a \

state.
But the war was divisive for the people & politics of MD.

Much of MD wanted to secede and join the Confederacy, but Abraham Lincoln suspended voting and Constitutional rights of Habeas Corpus to prevent the voting that would make this happen.
The reason being because DC would be literally surrounded by enemy territory.

What's left out of history is the fact that Baltimore was where the first shots in the war were fired.
The Union army was travelling south by train, and the line ended in Baltimore where they'd have to march through the city to board the next train. 
On the streets the locals of Baltimore started to throw bricks at the Union army as they marched which resulted in them opening fire, and the civilians returning fire.

But the state was divided during the war with secessionists attempting to fight for the Confederacy.

The top left & bottom right quarters of yellow/black are the Union side of MD's flag during the war, and red/white cross sections top-right/bottom-left are the Confederate MD flag.

links.title: Lo que aprendí leyendo Crear Desde Cero de Platzi /ESP-ENG
links.body: # Resumen del libro *Crear Desde Cero* de Platzi 🚀 Hola comunidad de emprendedores. Hoy vengo a traerles un resumen del libro que estoy leyendo, llamado *Crear Desde Cero* de Platzi. He estado leyendo este libro junto a mi amiga Sakura, una chica a la que le gusta aprender todo lo relacionado con la ciberseguridad y con quien también realizo charlas en X. Bueno, ahora vayamos a mis aprendizajes sobre esta lectura. 👇 --- En el libro de Platzi he aprendido que las culturas de los países son muy diferentes. Una persona de México y una de Colombia pueden tener distintas maneras de entender palabras o expresiones. Leyendo este libro entendí que debo aprender a comunicarme mejor con personas de otros países y, al menos, comprender parte de su jerga. Ahora imaginen esto: si eres emprendedor y estás en una sala con personas de diferentes culturas, debes pensar muy bien qué vas a decir y cómo lo dirás. Incluso el lenguaje corporal influye mucho en cómo se interpreta un mensaje. Por ejemplo, para algunas personas la expresión “lo voy a hacer ahorita” significa que lo harán inmediatamente, mientras que para otras puede significar que lo harán más tarde.

> --- También he podido entender que en una startup como Platzi, tener personas de diferentes nacionalidades permite construir equipos con opiniones muy diversas y perspectivas distintas. Además, aprendí que una buena manera de conectar con otras personas es durante esos pequeños momentos del café. Ahí pueden surgir conversaciones interesantes, especialmente cuando existe un interés genuino por conocer a la otra persona. Otro aprendizaje importante es que en países como Holanda es común dar feedback de manera muy directa, comenzando primero por lo negativo. Imagínense estar en una reunión y escuchar comentarios muy fuertes. Los latinos normalmente no estamos acostumbrados a ese estilo de retroalimentación; solemos preferir un feedback más personal y cuidadoso cuando se trata de aspectos que debemos mejorar. Todo esto me hizo entender que el mundo y las costumbres son muchísimo más amplios de lo que imaginamos. Lo que para mí es normal o común puede tener un significado completamente distinto para personas de otros países. También me gustó aprender que muchos sistemas o metodologías creadas en Europa u otros continentes necesitan adaptarse para trabajar en América Latina. No todo funciona exactamente igual aquí, por lo que muchas estrategias deben personalizarse para que las startups puedan trabajar de forma más ágil y eficiente.

> --- Otro punto importante que aprendí es que en una startup el aprendizaje debe ser rápido. Muchas veces existe el temor de tomar decisiones equivocadas o de no tener toda la información correcta. Sin embargo, también aprendí que nunca tendremos una certeza absoluta sobre todo. Uno no puede quedarse quieto por miedo a equivocarse. Muchas veces avanzar imperfectamente es mejor que quedarse paralizado. También entendí que no siempre es necesario tener todo solucionado para continuar avanzando. Lo importante es seguir construyendo y aprendiendo poco a poco. Como dice el lema de Platzi: **“Nunca parar de aprender”**. Estoy seguro de que mientras uno siga trabajando y construyendo, las oportunidades correctas llegarán en el momento adecuado. 💡

> --- También aprendí que uno puede cambiar un plan si no está funcionando. Muchas veces, por el temor a no terminar algo que comenzamos, terminamos gastando demasiada energía en algo que quizá ya no tiene sentido continuar de la misma manera. En lugar de verlo como un fracaso, debemos pensar en todo lo que aprendimos durante el proceso, incluso si el plan original no funcionó. Tener siempre el pensamiento de “nunca rendirse” también puede ser desgastante si no somos capaces de analizar las cosas desde otro ángulo. A veces, el mismo proyecto puede retomarse desde una nueva perspectiva, aplicando lo aprendido y haciendo las cosas de manera diferente para obtener mejores resultados.

> Gracias por leer este pequeño resumen de mis aprendizajes. 📚✨ Si también estás leyendo este libro o te interesa el mundo de las startups, el emprendimiento y la tecnología, me encantaría leer tu opinión.

>
Read the English version here

# Summary of the Book *Crear Desde Cero* by Platzi 🚀 Hello entrepreneur community. Today I want to share a summary of the book I’m currently reading, called *Crear Desde Cero* by Platzi. I’ve been reading this book together with my friend Sakura, a girl who loves learning everything related to cybersecurity and with whom I also host talks on X. Now, let’s get into some of the lessons I learned from this reading. 👇 --- In Platzi’s book, I learned that cultures around the world are very different. A person from Mexico and a person from Colombia may understand certain words or expressions in completely different ways. Reading this book made me realize that I need to improve the way I communicate with people from other countries and at least understand part of their slang and cultural context. Now imagine this: if you are an entrepreneur sitting in a room with people from different cultures, you really have to think carefully about what you say and how you say it. Even body language can strongly influence how a message is interpreted. For example, for some people the expression “I’ll do it right now” means they will do it immediately, while for others it could mean they will do it later.

> --- I also understood that in a startup like Platzi, having people from different nationalities allows teams to be built with diverse opinions and perspectives. Another interesting lesson was that one of the best ways to connect with people is during simple coffee moments. Interesting conversations, friendships, and even opportunities can emerge there, especially when there is genuine interest in getting to know the other person. I also learned that in countries like the Netherlands, it is common to give feedback in a very direct way, often starting with the negative points first. Imagine being in a meeting and hearing very strong comments. Latinos are usually not used to that style of feedback; we tend to prefer more personal and careful ways of pointing out areas for improvement. All of this helped me understand that the world and its customs are much broader than we imagine. What feels normal or common to me may have a completely different meaning for someone from another country. I also liked learning that many systems or methodologies created in Europe or other continents need to be adapted when implemented in Latin America. Not everything works exactly the same here, so strategies often need to be customized for startups to work in a more agile and efficient way.

> --- Another important point I learned is that in a startup, learning must happen quickly. Many times, there is fear of making wrong decisions or not having the correct information. However, I also learned that we will never have absolute certainty about everything. You cannot stay frozen because of the fear of making mistakes. Many times, moving forward imperfectly is better than standing still. I also understood that it is not always necessary to have everything solved before continuing to move forward. The important thing is to keep building and learning step by step. As Platzi’s motto says: **“Never stop learning.”** I’m sure that as long as we continue working and building, the right opportunities will arrive at the right moment. 💡

> --- I also learned that it is okay to change a plan if it is not working. Many times, because of the fear of not finishing something we started, we end up wasting too much energy on something that may no longer make sense to continue in the same way. Instead of seeing it as a failure, we should think about everything we learned during the process, even if the original plan did not work out. Always having the mindset of “never give up” can also become exhausting if we are not able to analyze things from another perspective. Sometimes, the same project can be approached again from a different angle, applying what we learned and doing things differently to achieve better results.

> --- Thank you for reading this small summary of my learnings. 📚✨ If you are also reading this book or are interested in startups, entrepreneurship, and technology, I would love to hear your opinion.

>

El escrito es original, basado en mis aprendizajes del libro Crear Desde Acá de Nicole Chapaval. Las fotos fueron tomadas del libro que compré en Kindle. Traducido con DeepL.

links.title: Vivir nuestra vida adulta con menos dudas y más confianza en lo que queremos | To live our adult lives with fewer doubts and more confidence in what we want 🫀  [ESP/ENG]
links.body:
![398b8e9c-b513-4675-a9c4-b194510fc364-1_all_556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EpvjGTRotZLQme96vSspi1yLuvRz7sNfrHzBEu1ggtWs1N3qGDss2EEyJvD4CPRtkpB.jpg)


Hola amigas de la comunidad de Womentribe, espero que se encuentren muy bien el día de hoy. La vida está siendo bastante retadora estos últimos días que he llevado con paciencia y algo de miedo. Estuve leyendo [la iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@eldiariodelys/conectate-contigo-y-la-adultez-oror-connect-with-yourself-and-adulthood) de nuestra amiga @eldiariodelys en la que habla de llegar a la adultez y todo lo que conlleva ser un adulto responsable. Reflexione sobre este tema y quise compartir que pienso sobre lo que ella habla en su post y también, sobre lo difícil que puede ser llenar las expectativas, sobre todo las que nos ponemos a nosotros mismos. 

En unos días estaré de cumpleaños, mi último cumpleaños dentro de los veintes. Se siente como que ha pasado un largo tiempo en pocos meses, mi vida no ha sido lo que esperaba que fuese a esta edad, mucho menos me esperaba todo lo que tendría que vivir para aprender a ser más madura y más leal a quién soy y las cosas que me hacen sentir bien. Soy adulta pero tengo mucha ayuda de mis padres todavía y además, vivo aún en casa de mi mamá. Ella siempre está dispuesta a ayudarme, pero se que hay pasos que tengo que dar sola porque de eso se trata la adultez. 

Estoy a punto de entrar en un ciclo de mi vida que había estado esperando durante mucho tiempo, no en las condiciones que quisiera pero si con una mentalidad de agradecimiento por esa oportunidad tan grande de poder volver a estudiar la carrera que tenía siempre en mente. Siento que todos los pasos que di desde unos cinco años atrás hasta ahora, me han permitido apreciar este momento desde otra mirada. Ahora se que es el momento de aprovechar esta oportunidad, que no sucede dos veces en la vida y que, no estoy dispuesta a dejar ir tan fácilmente. 

Creía que a esta edad ya estaría graduada y hasta casada 😂, pero la vida no es lineal ni tampoco una carrera donde tenemos algo que puede ser fijo dentro de nuestra historia. Hasta ahora es que empiezo a saber apreciar los momentos en los que puedo hacer las cosas por mi misma porque en algún momento no podía y recibí mucha ayuda, lo cual agradezco, pero se que el camino que se avecina es difícil pero no imposible de transitar. De alguna manera es la muestra de que los tiempos de Dios son perfectos y que sin importar cuántas veces nos desviemos, al final terminaremos encontrando nuestro lugar en el mundo. 


![398b8e9c-b513-4675-a9c4-b194510fc364-1_all_802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vsLEQQ356qcpugjLMHXffPgBYrqejBoByoxSgdmwpkXMeJLgXZMC5aUgTGZwJLuB3zJ.jpg)


Estudiar puede ser desafiante pero se que voy a aprender mucho sobre todo de las personas con las que me voy a rodear, algunas mayores que yo y otras mucho más jóvenes, pero todos con el mismo objetivo y poniéndole el corazón a ese sueño que tanto esperamos. Aun me siento como si tuviera 20 años porque como dice @eldiariodelys, me gustan muchas cosas que para mi edad supuestamente ya no están \

. Pero tener a esa niña que fui presente, me hace sentir mucho más feliz y me llena poder saber apreciar esas pequeñas cosas de la vida como si estuviese en mi adolescencia o en la niñez. 

La vida adulta puede ser para algunos lograr múltiples objetivos, metas, tareas, pero para todos hay un tiempo diferente y un momento en el cuál podemos llegar a aprender mejor de las lecciones de la vida. Considero que aunque hay cosas que no he vivido, me siento afortunada de aún poder tener una visión de la vida mucho más empática, eso me permite siempre recordar que sin importar lo que pase, el corazón debe seguir intacto sin llegar a endurecerse por las heridas que nos hagamos en el camino. La edad es realmente solo un número cuando verdaderamente sabemos que el tiempo es finito, que las oportunidades pasan, y que no siempre tendremos esta edad y la misma fuerza para seguir apostando por lo que nos llene el alma. Así que debemos siempre vivir en el ahora. 💛

![1000013988.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uRN2p2M1BfYb3qDs64wHhPoPYSVCJYDQeutpgdwd1BKRi4Na3efKTtjPs9VvivchkJo.png)

![398b8e9c-b513-4675-a9c4-b194510fc364-1_all_556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EpvjGTRotZLQme96vSspi1yLuvRz7sNfrHzBEu1ggtWs1N3qGDss2EEyJvD4CPRtkpB.jpg)

Hello, friends of the Womentribe community! I hope you are all doing very well today. Life has been quite challenging these past few days, and I’ve been navigating them with patience and a bit of fear. I was reading [the initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@eldiariodelys/conectate-contigo-y-la-adultez-oror-connect-with-yourself-and-adulthood) by our friend @eldiariodelys, where she talks about reaching adulthood and everything that comes with being a responsible adult. I reflected on this topic and wanted to share my thoughts on what she discusses in her post, as well as how difficult it can be to meet expectations—especially the ones we set for ourselves.


In a few days, it will be my birthday—my last birthday in my twenties. It feels like a long time has passed in just a few months. My life hasn't turned out to be what I expected at this age; much less did I expect everything I would have to go through to learn how to be more mature and more loyal to who I am and the things that make me feel good. I am an adult, but I still receive a lot of help from my parents, and I still live at my mom's house. She is always willing to help me, but I know there are steps I have to take on my own because that’s what adulthood is all about.


I am about to enter a cycle of my life that I’ve been waiting for for a long time. It’s not under the conditions I would have wanted, but I’m entering it with a mindset of gratitude for the huge opportunity to study the career I’ve always had in mind again. I feel that all the steps I’ve taken from five years ago until now have allowed me to appreciate this moment from a different perspective. Now I know it’s time to make the most of this opportunity—it doesn’t happen twice in a lifetime, and I’m not willing to let it go so easily.


I thought that by this age I’d already be graduated and even married 😂, but life isn't linear, nor is it a race where things are fixed in our story. It’s only now that I’m beginning to appreciate the moments when I can do things for myself; at one point I couldn't and I received a lot of help, which I’m grateful for, but I know the path ahead is difficult but not impossible to walk. In a way, it’s proof that God's timing is perfect and that no matter how many times we drift off course, in the end, we will find our place in the world.

![398b8e9c-b513-4675-a9c4-b194510fc364-1_all_802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vsLEQQ356qcpugjLMHXffPgBYrqejBoByoxSgdmwpkXMeJLgXZMC5aUgTGZwJLuB3zJ.jpg)

Studying can be challenging, but I know I’m going to learn a lot, especially from the people I’ll be surrounded by—some older than me and others much younger, but all with the same goal and putting their hearts into that dream we’ve waited for so long. I still feel like I’m 20 because, as @eldiariodelys says, I like many things that are supposedly no longer \

at my age. But keeping the girl I used to be present makes me feel much happier; it fulfills me to be able to appreciate the little things in life as if I were in my adolescence or childhood.


For some, adult life may mean achieving multiple objectives, goals, and tasks, but everyone has a different timeline and a specific moment to best learn life's lessons. I believe that even though there are things I haven't experienced yet, I feel lucky to still have a much more empathetic vision of life. This allows me to always remember that no matter what happens, the heart must remain intact without hardening from the wounds we sustain along the way. Age is truly just a number when we truly understand that time is finite, that opportunities pass, and that we won't always be this age or have the same strength to keep betting on what fills our souls. So, we must always live in the now. 💛


![1000013988.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uRN2p2M1BfYb3qDs64wHhPoPYSVCJYDQeutpgdwd1BKRi4Na3efKTtjPs9VvivchkJo.png)

links.body:
>

What is said about consumerism, is a very serious and interesting thing...because we human beings were not born being consumerists, that is, we were not born for that, that is, we have all been preparing and inducing consumption precisely because it is the means of subsidence of many companies, ideas, whose policies have to do with the human being consuming and that incidentally consumes in excess. We combine to want to be, to want to be and to do, to be at the level or to be at the height of creating an image and that speaks of wanting to consume, and that what it does is *put our own criteria to sleep*, and that's not at all easy because obviously, what I'm writing about is not happening to me or to you, this consumerism thing is happening to all of us and comes from the times when the *convenience* of groups doing things in favor of those who wanted to somehow have a power or influence over the masses began to exist. And this is not my fault, nor of you who read me, it is of all of us who are immersed in it, because we all live in a consumer society. When one raises this we start thinking about these things and we say to each other *\

*, and every time I want something, I can make the decision to want to have something maybe because I really need it or that other person is planting ideas in me,... for example: I would like to do this, which is not the same as \

. >Rather, we can do without everything, now the one who can't do without is the EGO, hahahaha. To whom, we have to confront it permanently because of course we are not any fools, no stupid people who are not going to like the good things, obviously yes, but when that turns into a loss, or a feeling of grief because we don't have it, there things change, I mean it's not that I want a watch that allows me to see the time, be on time, fulfill my activities, and also that I want to have it just for having it on my wrist showing it because it has two shiny, or it's gold or it has a special brand, anyway, how many things we see with all the globalization. And the same, it happens to consume food, music, novels, books, movies, even the brands of whatever, one sees the product and if we don't see the pretty colors and it doesn't get in our eyes, we don't buy it, it's complicated because we, the human being, are often self-destructive. By the way, this morning I went to do the market for the consmo of the week ahead... Janitze 💃

links.title: A's smoke the Phillies 12-1 in series finale | Team in Baltimore tonight vs Orioles
links.body:
![584d48ce0a44bd1070d5d46f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJg3BnVxoiM2NuNHqgzjQovf9NYMeSJ4EYmngpiJMp61Su8EWJJbQuCKSGUjh45.png)
[Src](https://www.stickpng.com/img/sports/baseball/major-league-baseball-mlb/oakland-athletics/oakland-athletics-a-logo)

The A's may have lost their series vs the Phillies, but they competed well and ended with a bang, as they dominate the Phillies in the final contest, really teeing off on Phillies' starting pitcher Andrew Painter. The A's hit ***four*** two-run homers in their 12-1 victory. Shea Langeliers hit his 11th, Brent Rooker hit his 4th, Jacob Wilson hit his 3rd, and Zack Gelof hit his 3rd. I mean talk about spreading the power! This A's offense is a problem sometimes. 

Of course what can't be forgotten is **J.T. Ginn's mega gem!** He pitched eight innings and allowed just four hits and one run! Incredible! The most he's pitched in a game prior to yesterday was 5 2/3 which he did twice, against the Rangers and Mariners. I didn't see that coming from Ginn, awesome stuff. 

The Athletics stay in the northeast/mid-Atlantic as they travel a bit south to Baltimore to face the Orioles, my dad's favorite team. 

The Orioles are a team I'm not too aware of. But they have Gunnar Henderson and Pete Alonso so that's always a team to respect. Weston Wilson is also a former Phillie who I always thought was pretty good. Based on looking at the O's probable pitchers, their pitching looks a little weak so let's see if this explosive A's offense can take advantage of the seemingly not-too-great O's starting pitching. 

![5526 - 5726_20260508_191001_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJmqzaN8ytcruvueoqL8dDZpokrRMw8PCSNDRtUQqFWHRpe1bAD7SVujqiDRQXD.png)
[Src](https://www.stickpng.com/img/sports/baseball/major-league-baseball-mlb/oakland-athletics/oakland-athletics-a-logo) [Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/baltimore-orioles/mlb-baltimore-orioles-logo/)

The A's still hold a 1.5 game lead in the AL West. They were already in New York not too long ago, so maybe the schedule is getting rid of their east coast games early we shall see, maybe I'll glance at the schedule later.

Let's see if Jacob Lopez can bounce back on the mound tonight!

links.title: Birdwatching sessions
links.body:
I try to walk in nature as much as I can, especially when I visit my grandparent's village; and bringing binoculars and camera here is a must, since birdwatching is nomally rewarding: some species are almost warranted, and apart from the usual suspects, sometimes a rarity comes along.
![IMG_0005.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/EoAZnNFFoCMSh598kyJ2MPneYA6Tn6RG9p8es7h48FJvVFvWargC7doeEDQgdi3EBSB.JPG)
European stonechat - *Saxicola rubicola*, female
Stonechats belong to the *warranted* category, obviously. And I'm glad they do, because they're every birdwatchers dream: clear plummage difference between sexes, not shy, and always perching in easy to spot locations, normally at the very top of something.
![IMG_0033.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/EppMCW5avNzhavnQBsMUmn8BWyEBRVQRM45PWaqpqs3jDT4oTGiWepab29SnFiYPYPB.JPG)
European stonechat - *Saxicola rubicola*, male
![IMG_0029.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/EpVD4DNMxH9rxtAkehgecTXcCdYLkoEBqozYBxzBzoiKt8BeCYSuR65Dg73NxYyrsaR.JPG)
See how easy it is to tell sexes apart? And in this time of the year, with Spring arriving in full bloom, they're even more active and noisy.
![IMG_0007.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/EoK9gswoDwk8wN6EWYbmpnCb4dTzikDpdizepxXAWaJVtS3v7DPuErYVFmyYrFHDCeN.JPG)
This time though, what made my day wasn't the usual suspects, but a rarity. Birds of prey are a normal sighting here as well, and not long after starting my walk, the booted eagle soared over me.
![IMG_0024.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/23wgcbTbjddSAzpDTBWB5A447WhFeBzFiCyYHX7iMHQouFQHvwgLJhdVdhyVWViv4Jk9Y.JPG)
Booted eagle - *Hieraaetus pennatus*
These cuties come in different plummages, one lighter and one darker, and although it's not easy to see it here since it was against the light, this is the paler version. It's the plummage type I see here the most, and also the one that makes it easier to identify them. She flew away, minding her business, and some time after I spotted another bird of prey far away, flying in my direction. I though it was the same eagle coming back... but I quickly noticed this one was way bigger. I grabbed my binoculars and it was clear what was coming: a species I hadn't seen for a long time! Not only that, but she got close enough for me to get a decentish photo!
![IMG_0027.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/23uR14AeGC3xUo8puXeGAguvgm647aES9swmU5qUiYA2YumTJHHng7NdAWjuQPh22GMaK.JPG)
Short-toed snake eagle - *Circaetus gallicus*
A snake eagle! They're stunning, and also easy to identify, with their pale barred underparts, dark head and the bar on the tail. It was likely the closest I had one of them flying near me. Unfortunately she didn't stayed for long, but this sighting alone made the whole walk even more worthwhile. On the way back, another species Im really fond of, but one I hardly get on camera. They're one of the most colourful birds of our fauna, but also a shy species, and I can hear and see them easily, but it's not that easy to get near when they're perched.
![IMG_0037.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/EoK6r11Mse7UX5G6gMdzKuwigtzeYZhFM4TuyR55Qnn46rqh7ctA78nNWAfJDxHfBzL.JPG)
European bee-eater - *Merops apiaster*
So this is the kind of crappy photo that I manage to take, the slightly blurry-far away-perched bee-eater. Oh well, at least I get the chance to see them, right? ;)
![rgazlbwpwi.png](https://img.esteem.ws/rgazlbwpwi.png)

links.title: The quiet geometry of staying still
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778214098-8cab854a1c21.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/mara.rowe/seed-mara.rowe-2026-05-08/main-1-1778214098-8cab854a1c21.png)
![main-2-1778214109-e13d8d21fd3c.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/mara.rowe/seed-mara.rowe-2026-05-08/main-2-1778214109-e13d8d21fd3c.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

I spent the afternoon in one of the college passages, the kind where light moves slowly across stone and you lose track of time without trying. There's a particular quality to these spaces, the way centuries of footsteps have worn the cobbles into something almost sculptural. I wasn't there to study or to tick anything off. I was there because the architecture itself is a kind of argument, and I wanted to sit with it.

The archway frames everything differently. From inside looking out, the courtyard becomes a painting. The grass, the bench, the distant chapel spire, all arranged as if someone had composed it deliberately. But that's not really what happened. It just accumulated over time, stones placed by people solving practical problems, grass growing in the spaces they left, light falling where it falls. There's something about that accident that feels more honest than intention.

I brought a book and tea. The mug was chipped, which somehow made it easier to hold, less precious. The pages were dense with ideas I'd circled in the margins weeks ago, arguments I wanted to return to. There's a philosophy to rereading, to coming back to the same sentences and finding different meaning in them depending on what you've lived through since. The glasses resting on the open pages, the dried flowers in the vase by the window, the courtyard visible through the leaded glass, all of it felt like evidence of something. Not a conclusion, just evidence.

I think art happens in these moments when you're not performing for anyone. When you're simply present with what's in front of you, letting the geometry and the light and your own thoughts arrange themselves without forcing them into a shape. The archway doesn't know it's beautiful. The path doesn't know it's been walked a thousand times. They just are, and that's enough.
