links.title: 园区人多了
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![YQvBlKfoK0cd3pi5_fj8.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/YQvBlKfoK0cd3pi5_fj8/YQvBlKfoK0cd3pi5_fj8.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天早上我像往常一样把孩子送到学校好，就直接去上班。骑电动车来到公司所在园区的停车棚，让我诧异的是居然停满了电动车和摩托车。一般来说我到的这个点算是比较早的，应该有大把位置可以停车，可今天为啥这么早就停满了。来到公司后，上午和同事闲聊才知道，园区进了一家新公司，之前几个月在装修，今天正式入驻开始上班了。原来如此，怪不得一大早停车棚就满了，按照停车规模估算，这家新公司至少有上百号人。

园区人数增加受益最多的就是食堂，之前食堂里的档口经常换来换去，有些刚换来没几个月就撤走了，明显是客流量不大挣不到钱。没办法啊，食堂早餐只有零星几家店开放，主要营业是靠中午和晚上，而且晚上客流量也不大，主要靠中午吃饭，在精确点就是中午11点半到1点这1个半小时就餐时间，一旦过了1点客流量就大幅减少，基本没人来了。因此食堂也是竞争激烈，现在增加百十号人，就算有20%人不来食堂就餐，也能增加不少人数。

考虑到中午就餐人数增加，今天中午我把就餐时间提前到了11点15分。我公司好处是灵活，只要不开会想啥时候吃饭就啥时候去，而园区大部分公司是11点半以后才允许就餐。我吃完饭大概11点40多，离开的时候看到大批人马正在往食堂赶，有些档口已经开始排队了。就餐人数增加，食堂有些空闲的档口就会重新招租，饮食更加丰富，午餐可选择的范围也就更多，算是件好事吧。

links.title: Momentos con ella que me dan paz🫂💗 [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
>
~ESPAÑOL~
Helloo, espero te encuentres súper bien y hayas tenido una maravillosa semana!! Quiero dejar por acá, recuerdos de una salidita en Semana Santa con mi amada hermanita. Veníamos de días de estar todo el día en la casa y quise sacarla un rato para que jugara y yo, despejar la mente. Fue una tarde noche bastante chévere y la sentí especial. Mi hermanita por suerte, se porta muy bien conmigo cuando salimos, jajaj. La llevé un rato a un parque bastante cerca de casa, le compré una oblea (tenía AÑOS de años sin comer una, de mi hermana fue primera vez jajaj) y yéndonos, vio a un mickey y pues me tocó tomarle fotos jajaj, que por ello, le regalaron unas calcomanías. Y justo en ese momento me había pedido sentarnos a conversar para que ella descansara un poco, eso por alguna razón me pareció súper lindo y me dio un poco de paz, fue un momento de presencia para escucharla y reírnos. En el camino a la casa nos detuvimos otro ratito a tomarnos fotos en una piscina que está allí en Paseo los Próceres, de noche se ve súper lindo porque le prenden luces. También fue ameno el momento para cerrar el día un poco más ligera de mente, en mi caso… Una de las razones por las cuales me esfuerzo mucho para hacer que mi negocio crezca al igual que mis ingresos, es mi hermanita. Sin duda quiero llevarla a vivir muchas experiencias, y que crezca en un buen entorno… muchas gracias por leerme hasta aquí, te mando un fuerte abrazo y deseo que tengas un fin de semana lindo💗

>
~ENGLISH~
Hey there, I hope you're doing great and had a wonderful week!! I wanted to share some memories here of a little outing over Easter with my beloved little sister. We'd been stuck at home all day for days, so I wanted to take her out for a bit so she could play and I could clear my head. It was a pretty cool late afternoon, and it felt special. Luckily, my little sister is really well-behaved when we go out, haha. I took her to a park pretty close to home for a bit, bought her a wafer (it had been YEARS since I’d eaten one—my sister’s was my first time, haha), and as we were leaving, she saw a Mickey Mouse and, well, I had to take pictures of her, haha, and because of that, they gave her some stickers. And right then, she asked me to sit down and talk so she could rest a bit. For some reason, that seemed so sweet to me and gave me a sense of peace; it was a moment of presence to listen to her and laugh together. On the way home, we stopped for a little while to take photos at a pool on Paseo los Próceres. At night, it looks really pretty because they turn on the lights. It was also a pleasant way to end the day with a lighter heart—at least for me… One of the reasons I work so hard to grow my business and increase my income is my little sister. I definitely want to give her many experiences and help her grow up in a good environment… Thank you so much for reading this far. Sending you a big hug, and I hope you have a lovely weekend💗

links.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260505_155835594.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQtD52nuKjQ1pEysCBEAHm6hX3ZzQCDw8WagNkLm7Bn7AjqGJPrwCuZxQ5NEE1qUNQH.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 21.61% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.067 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 1.006 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.01995668 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.10934095 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00114559 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.154000 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.000177 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 80,112.3 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 450.32 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 58.045 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,735.00 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 81.08 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #130 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#101 (among active witnesses only)/476k HP in votes/49 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 It's been 6 days so far since I first discovered, installed, and set up the Hermes (*AI*) Agent, and and while there is still some frustration at its occasional momentary inabilities, my mind is still blown at how far I've come with it, and how far I could potentially go as time progresses. Now that I have a basic functional framework up and running, I've been looking into how I might be able to improve, optimize, and refine my setup. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260505_165517085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsBdy5eQpbw1vrnBF2g4Hmcao5uvpVUnRFsNFFRcNk5ms216tZDj2yoXFViQCAsR55m.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260505_165525866_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQk4aigh4HrCLqWe1CM9Gbx7GL4ZfUrcGcK5U9YeDd7paFvBUhFnCqLkevpW4mG1Cc8.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) With that in mind, I've been looking more closely into different backend inference engines and frameworks, as well as different AI models, and experimenting and testing which combinations work for me. While I have had some success in that regard, most of these attempts have not gone as intended. This has made me realize that my present AI model and backend inference framework still seem to be the best fit for me so far, much to my surpise. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260506_101750202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMYDY29NTfzYP6CL3bfJKQDdmSUUvojX5RHyMm6Dzzm2YrSKh7S6yZJuLAsP77mxSzp.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260506_174015497.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/244oX6jpANRF6EFqVNQLcY8Tpr13d6o4czcekKnT6F9Qm27oaoqKzJqGU7Zr3T8Xf9VL7.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I've got to hand it to the devs for LM Studio, because it autodetected my hardware, and automatically downloaded an AI model, Gemma-4-E4B, that turned out to be, after a fair bit of research, pretty much the best possible choice for my system and setup, and regarding how I intend to use it. That's pretty wild indeed. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260506_174141929.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQr4go2gbap2eDWBv7BME3sroioJWkCcbd6EEHBkmMFALRdtYS5eMFDGZWBixhodRJw.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260507_090359604_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhqZyg9ythbemd9SRAMR5MKqG8LYbAj9Q9rfBVk7GgsqoYywdToVCwZzNY8di7HNq68.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Ollama does seem to be quite useful as a backend, and it integrates into Hermes easily, though it's a bit more challenging to search for models than LM Studio. I'll likely experiment with it a bit more, however, because it does make certain other tasks easier. Since my laptop only has 8GB of VRAM (*Nvidia GeForce RTX 4070 video card*), the selection of model variants that I can easily use on it are rather limited. I'm still looking around and exploring, but Gemma-4-E4B does indeed appear to be a the very top of the list of models that meet my specifications, which are partly requirements for Hermes, such as a minimum-supported context length of 64,000. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260507_092535140_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFKEq3oHmTWD2SbYeonZhxCcNBCVE4AZQ7Sa96fpc2h5NXace6sbuFpiDSEPGDejxdp.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260507_092618294.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQM2SnZ5pkNofNY7336Fy21zjviwpVGHdESFrGBdCmzWjK7Kvj6xx3DYTWGifDRswX3.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) There are some amazing model families, like Qwen, that I can't seem to run at all on my system, and I'm still not sure exactly why, as they *should* run just fine. The thing is that there are so many different models, with a huge number of different modifications and tweaks, as well as different hardware and software requirements, and not all those variations play well with standard ways of doing things. I've only been running local AI models for about a month now, and running my Hermes Agent for a mere six days, so I still have a huge amount to learn and understand about everything, but I'm progressing extraordinarily rapidly, which makes me so curious about where I'll be with it all in 6 months or year from now. It keeps getting more and more interesting, I'll definitely say that! ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260507_092632896.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wBgGoZDi7J4qYvW1HGa8dEoSyrZyaWVsyRpbCFY73nZBqGqhLCm6RaiajeW9iiMeHvy.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260507_092711928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/243BVVfQaXKJoEmA7wfkSLWYaNLFUhSn5Ek18kR8g9H94cdE4KPpipsSB4ZwvzwBR2GAh.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Thursday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by around 2:45PM, giving my attention first to some photography for my posts, and to a few small jungle-community tasks. Once I had those completed, I took a quick break up at the Flow House, after which I got some gloves, a shovel, and an o-o bar, to go dig another round of planting holes in the front orchard. Upon wrapping that up for the day, I took a shower, made myself some food in Wabisabi, and with that and my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee in hands, I headed back to the Flow House to work a little more with Hermes, and to begin my evening Hive tasks. I wasn't able to get through all my notifications, as I had a lot, before stopping around 11:30PM, to work with Hermes one more time, and finally to go to bed by a little after 12:30AM. I woke up around 7AM, having slept reasonably well, doing more rearch into compatible AI models, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House, to do more AI-model research and testing, and to write this post. It's now just before 1:45PM, so it's a marvelous time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other imoportant Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on photography for my posts, and then on some jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's iteration of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260507_092821841_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFPDLCbbhkcD2fRj1cJKF8FHedVVGajAzX2d7QDQ4vkozEyGVCuUXCWBpBhsYHYbDee.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260507_094041817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGe5686tJ9g9sMEk28ErhjXgnDB8aLAwdgzFvAjLpZz1a3JEC139nsbw3NHb1XDP9QW.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) Begin learning relevant coding/programming languages to more fully contribute to the sovereignty-driven technologies where I am active, like Arch Linux, Hive, Qortal, DeSo, and Bastyon. ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) *All photos were taken with my **Motorola G Play 2024 Android Phone**.* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) Thank you all so much who have helped me get to where I am today, and allowing me to share more of the beauty and magic from my life and my world with you, and for your continuous appreciation and support! I am truly deeply grateful! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) If you'd like to find me on other alternative platforms where I have accounts (I spend most of my time here on ***Hive***), click on this signature image below to go to my *LinkTree* page. [![Polish_20220714_123613996.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u5JoRqDidEnrBW7RSo8NuHdjDgUi14wY5a8RwanCQixRuCAXMfavo7nQnQrntXMF8TP.png)](https://linktr.ee/tydynrain) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### Come join us in the ***We Are Alive Tribe*** on [***Hive***](https://ecency.com/created/hive-155221) and on [***Blurt***](https://blurt.blog/created/blurt-161158)! ![hiveandblurt.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/benthomaswwd/23u5zfGAYUbiaDq2DeuhpR9STGXwRFvmSi5hhyPaahWQD1oDcK4K42tLwWW8CwRnsxxHn.png) *Image created by @benthomaswwd* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### ***You're invited to provide liquidity in our two ALIVE diesel/liquidity pools, both of which offer daily liquidity rewards:*** * ### [***ALIVE:SWAP.HIVE***](https://tools.crypto-dreamr.com/beeswap/pools?input=ALIVE&output=SWAP.HIVE) * ### [***ALIVE:ALIVEM***](https://tools.crypto-dreamr.com/beeswap/pools?input=ALIVE&output=ALIVEM) * ### [***ALIVE:HEARTBEAT***](https://tools.crypto-dreamr.com/beeswap/pools?input=ALIVE&output=HEARTBEAT) ***There will be more ALIVE pools coming soon!*** ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### ***[Vote](https://witness.the-hive-mobile.app/#/witnesses/@aliveandmmb) for our @aliveandmmb Witness Node!*** [

links.body:

오늘의 산책은 정말 즐거웠습니다! 도시의 한적한 공원에서 산책을 하다가 오랜만에 초등학교 시절 친구를 만났어요. 우리는 서로의 근황을 나누며 웃음꽃을 피웠답니다. 또한, 공원에서 예쁜 꽃들이 만개해 있어서 정말 인상 깊었어요. 특히, 핑크색 벚꽃이 만개해 있는 광경은 마치 작은 동화 속에 들어온 듯한 기분을 줬답니다. 오늘의 산책은 소중한 친구를 만난 것과 아름다운 자연을 감상할 수 있어서 더욱 특별한 시간이었어요! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). links.title: The white skirt and the lesson i never forgot
links.body:
Today took me down the memory lane of teen years, the struggle and shift into womanhood. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZR52vAyFEJEriKcinUDWuXiwzAQ31SWZx4QrcrX8qwVx/1778282308028.jpg)

Do we really forget things, or do we just look away from them?

Yesterday, I was waiting in line for my turn and there was a young lady next to me who was about to leave her seat. She didn’t realize her clothes were soiled. I quietly let her know, and she said, “I didn’t prepare for this with a shaky hands” 

I pulled out my kit and said there is an unused pad inside. 
She hurried out, cleaned up, and came back settled. 
Then she asked, “Are you having your period too ?”  
I said no. She stared at me and replied in pidgin, \

I could not help but laugh. I told her, “I’m not that kind of person.”  She was still concerned to know and I said to her you should have asked this questions before using it.

*She replied life is both a trust and risk.* 

I had to explained why I always keep pads in my purse. It goes back to when I was a teenager at a camp meeting.
 It was a beautiful bright day.
That day I wore a white skirt and blue shirt, and I was active in everything, sitting in the front because I didn't want distractions. At some point, people started laughing and pointing in my direction, especially the boys. I didn’t know my period had started. Yes I  was taught about puberty and hygiene but I didn't know when it would show up, it caught me unprepared. A young woman wrapped a jacket around my waist and walked me out. 

I cried so much and just wanted to go home. It felt like I wanted to disappear from the camp. She took me to her corner, helped me change, and tried to comfort me. For the rest of the day I couldn’t walk around freely because everyone was talking about it.*

That incident made me sad and withdrawn. At some point I even wished I was a boy. I don’t know if I’d call it trauma, but since that day there’s always been a pad in my purse or bag. To prepare for emergency or invasion like today. 

When I finished telling the story, she said, “I can imagine the white skirt with red ketchup.” 

Today, I’m happy to be a woman that understands her body and feminity more.

**Lesson learned: preparedness can prevent embarrassment. 
Empathy and kindness is more than a feeling but action to pass it forward. 
Understanding my body better has built confidence and eliminated fear. 
Trust and risk dwells together.******

Image is mine.

links.title: Phillies get crushed in series finale vs A's | The Rockies in Philly tonight
links.body:
![mlb-Philadelphia-Phillies-Logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJhXiRGysGbqrUVr31VqR8j9iJthXQeNsJRnjA5UgF2TrkK4JXLPjHUG9MUr24D.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

Well the Phillies got crushed last night. As a fan of both the A's and Phillies, the series went well enough. The Phillies needed the wins more but didn't sweep the A's. The A's got a smidge of revenge last night despite the series loss, as they completely destroyed the Phillies in the series finale. The A's hit four two-run home runs in the 12-1 beatdown. Phillies' rookie starting pitcher Andrew Painter may not be good enough for the MLB at this point of his career I'm afraid. He allowed eight runs in 3 2/3 innings of action. I think he could just use some more time in the minors for now, but we'll see. He's 1-4 now, with a 6.89 ERA. The Phillies lone homer, which cut the lead 8-1 LOL, was by Kyle Schwarber, it was Kyle's 12th of the season. 

But all in all the Phillies look a lot better than how they looked a week or so ago. Improvements across the board. It was going to be hard to sweep this A's team. 

The Phillies move on to face the similarly struggling Colorado Rockies. But I like the Phillies' chances especially with how they've been looking recently. Brandon Marsh and Bryce Harper have both been looking good.

![5526 - 5726_20260508_181204_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJmqR83iAMiaXS6Fu2ZzL3SKhFgeNmX2abNPdYL1N94sUqRwtegJgR3U8CrNFyR.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/) [Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/colorado-rockies/colorado-rockies-symbol/)

The Phillies are still four games below .500 though so there's still a lot of work to be done. They're **nine games behind the Braves** in the NL East so that's not great. By the time this series ends the Phillies will be 1/4 of the way through their season! Kinda crazy.

Lets see if Luzardo can pitch well a third start in a row!

links.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - Beat That!  Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSIUEVIgGLCuNNJzcH_taZYQDo_JDX4mZXioBYFA4gz5w&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSIUEVIgGLCuNNJzcH_taZYQDo_JDX4mZXioBYFA4gz5w&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSIUEVIgGLCuNNJzcH_taZYQDo_JDX4mZXioBYFA4gz5w&s=10)


Yvonne touched the wall in a new national record time of 59 seconds in the 100m butterfly event. Someone has finally beat that record that has been standing for 5 years. Yvonne now holds all national records for the discipline of butterfly swimming. A feat that has no prior. She now is the champion others had to beat to get a chance at a podium finish on the top step. But what about Yvonne? Having becoming the latest Butterfly Queen, she needs to continue to go faster to beat that record, pushing the line a little bit each time, every time for her countryman.

At times, we need the atmosphere and motivation to stay energized and focus, thus we might be screaming go out and beat that team, you have it. But, there's always 2 sides to a coin. We should never encourage violence by telling anyone to go beat that person. It is never going to be all right once violence takes place. You might be in the right from the start but violence undo it all. 

Therefore, when we say beat that, it should be for achievements and positivity and never for violence.

links.title: Volar sobre el arcoíris/Flying Over the Rainbow (Esp-Eng)
links.body:
> Hola, mis amigos. Que placer saludarlos. Hoy fue uno de esos días en los que amance entre lluvia y sol, de esos que te hacen dudar porque no sabes si echar a correr para resguardarte o quedarte a mirar el cielo. Cuando sucede este fenómeno de lluvia y sol al mismo tiempo, por acá solemos decir que se están casando las brujas o las hijas del diablo. Y de repente, apareció un arcoíris enorme, de los que parecen sacados de una película infantil de Disney. Salió detrás de la montaña, ancho y brillante como si alguien hubiera estrenado sus colores. Pero como todo lo bonito en esta vida dura poco, empezó a despedirse casi enseguida.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJHqgx8p1XJ8SnyyiCmHvUvSAhbj8gcq7SuH48j4tMBg/1778283082732.jpg)

> Los bordes se fueron volviendo grises. El rojo se apagó, luego el naranja, y el amarillo parecía más un suspiro que un color. Fue quedando medio fantasma, justo cuando dos palomas grises se posaron en el alambre del tendido eléctrico para luego alzar el vuelo. Parecían dos viejas que vigilan el barrio desde el balcón. Hacía calor, a pesar de la lluvia fina que todavía caía. Justo cuando el arcoíris parecía a punto de volverse humo, pasó algo. Una de las palomas se irguió, infló el pecho y, sin avisar, alzó el vuelo. La otra la siguió medio segundo después, como si se hubiesen puesto de acuerdo. tuvieran un pacto secreto. Las vi elevarse y, en vez de atravesar el arcoíris por el medio, que ya se estaba desvaneciendo, las dos se fueron recto hacia arriba, como si quisieran pasarlo por encima. Y lo lograron. Volaron tan alto que el arcoíris quedó debajo de ellas, como un puente que ya casi no se veía. Fue en ese mimuto en que tomé esta foto. Fue un bonito espectáculo, por unos instantes, el mundo se quedó en silencio. Quedé atrapada en la simplicidad y belleza de un momento efímero que estoy segura no se repetira. Hasta los perros dejaron de ladrar durante un ratito. Las dos palomas parecían dos puntos negros recortados contra un manojo de colores moribundos. Subieron hasta que las perdí de vista, y el arcoíris se desvaneció del todo, como si el cielo se hubiera puesto en modo borrador. Y ahí me quedé yo, con la boca abierta y el cuello torcido. Entonces pense que puede que las cosas bonitas duren poco, pero siempre hay alguien, o dos alguien con alas, que te enseñan a mirar hacia arriba. Que el arcoíris se acabe no es el final, es solo el momento en que toca subir un poco más. Las palomas lo saben. Nosotros, a veces, lo olvidamos. Y mientras las nubes se abrían para dejar pasar ese sol mañanero de mi Cuba, sentí que aquel vuelo fue el mejor adiós que un arcoíris podía tener. Dos palomas rumbo al cielo, por encima de los colores. Me sentí niña y feliz.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJDibgVv7QpnG7cFRyL8RrNKwrY4Tkx4636U9mec4jSH/img_8206.gif https://images.ecency.com/DQmeR514KUcazwo9QidR6DqXvT3VXLKNLMwh76kPaoFQmCe/img_9027.png

> Flying Over the Rainbow Hello, my friends. What a pleasure to greet you. Today was one of those days when dawn breaks between rain and sun—the kind that makes you hesitate, not knowing whether to run for cover or stay and watch the sky. When this phenomenon of rain and sun happens at the same time, around here we often say that the witches or the devil's daughters are getting married. And suddenly, a huge rainbow appeared—the kind that looks like it's been lifted straight out of a Disney children's movie. It emerged from behind the mountain, wide and brilliant, as if someone had just unveiled its colors for the first time. But as with all beautiful things in this life, it didn't last long. It began to fade almost immediately.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJHqgx8p1XJ8SnyyiCmHvUvSAhbj8gcq7SuH48j4tMBg/1778283082732.jpg)

> The edges turned gray. The red dimmed, then the orange, and the yellow felt more like a sigh than a color. It became something of a ghost, just as two gray pigeons landed on the electrical wire—and then took flight again. They looked like two old ladies watching over the neighborhood from a balcony. It was warm, despite the fine rain still falling. Just when the rainbow seemed about to turn into smoke, something happened. One of the pigeons straightened up, puffed out its chest, and without warning, took flight. The other followed half a second later, as if they had a secret pact between them. I watched them rise, and instead of flying through the middle of the rainbow—which was already fading—they went straight upward, as if trying to soar right over it. And they did. They flew so high that the rainbow ended up beneath them, like a bridge that was barely visible anymore. It was at that minute that I took this photo. It was a beautiful spectacle; for a few moments, the world fell silent. I was captivated by the simplicity and beauty of an ephemeral moment that I'm sure will never happen again. Even the dogs stopped barking for a little while. The two pigeons looked like two black dots silhouetted against a cluster of dying colors. They rose until I lost sight of them, and the rainbow completely faded away, as if the sky had switched to eraser mode. And there I stood, mouth agape, neck craned. That's when I thought: maybe beautiful things don't last long, but there's always someone—or two someones with wings—who teach you to look upward. The rainbow ending is not the end; it's just the moment when it's time to rise a little higher. The pigeons know this. We, sometimes, forget. And as the clouds parted to let through that morning sun of my Cuba, I felt that flight was the best farewell a rainbow could ever have. Two pigeons heading for the sky, above all the colors. I felt like a child, and happy.

links.title: Grading System Vs Student Motivation
links.body:
> *Back when I was in primary school, students were graded not just by scores, but also by their class position. Your result would show whether you came 1st, 5th or even last in class.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbwcozv1HnaoZNWYr6dMbL4uvqmxwVxkatgtFMG492WqP/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-student-scholar-9295105/) *Some parents didn’t like seeing their children always at the bottom, so schools gradually removed positions and focused only on percentage. Personally, I feel that change reduced the competitive spirit among students.* *Back then, many students pushed themselves just to make the top 3 because it came with pride, recognition and respect from both teachers and classmates. Once positions disappeared, everything started to feel more “normal” and less competitive.* *Now we are used to grading systems like A1, B2 and the rest. Even that still creates a level of motivation among students. Imagine if education became only “pass or fail”, many students would likely settle for the bare minimum instead of striving to do better.* *Students are already becoming demotivated because of the years spent in school, the money involved, and, in the end, the lack of jobs to reward the effort.* *Many people now go to school mainly for validation, but honestly, I think it is still better to have a certificate and not find a job than not have a certificate and still miss opportunities for good jobs. The latter feels worse.* *We should not make things worse by introducing unnecessary changes to the system as it already is. The best way to boost student morale is not by switching to a pass/fail system, but by creating real job opportunities for graduates.*

[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/bed-book-man-person-reading-room-1853907/) *Once students are confident that there is a job waiting after school, more people will be motivated to work hard, gain admission, and complete their studies.* *Honestly, if things continue this way, in the near future, more people may lose interest in formal education and focus on learning handwork and skills instead.* *I miss the old system. links.title: Unexpectedly Good /Étonnamment bon
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVWrb1c9oVyEC2X5cMQe6mbdh6MMeDKy4R32G8mWC9kfB/1778001926437.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWVNdkuj3ps5CYgtadHR1CHzNAVCui5ffahcjrHMUQL4U/1778001940240.jpg)

Hello everyone,
Today, I bought some fish at an unbelievably cheap price .
I won’t even tell you how much I paid for sardines last week , they were almost 4 times more expensive than this fish!

The funniest part is that I didn’t even know its name. And it was also my first time trying it. I’m not going to lie, I was a bit afraid of being disappointed and thought it might not taste good .

So I did a little Google search and discovered that it was called bogue fish.
The bogue is a very common sea fish found in the Mediterranean and the eastern Atlantic Ocean. It can be recognized by its silver, streamlined body and its relatively large eyes. This fish is often prepared fried, grilled, or even in soup.
Personally, I fried it today and honestly, it was really good 😋
A very nice discovery and a good experience overall! You should try it too if you haven’t tasted it before.

One day, I’d also like to try making soup with it.

I hadn’t explained yet why I’ve been eating so much fish lately. In fact, it’s because of some thyroid test results: the results were at the upper limit, and I’m close to having hypothyroidism.

So, after doing some research and getting some advice, I understood that eating more fish could be beneficial 🐟

The doctor asked me to repeat the tests in a month. I hope the results will improve and, of course, I’ll keep you updated on how things go.


////
Salut tout le monde,
Aujourd’hui, j’ai acheté du poisson à un prix vraiment incroyable .
Je ne vous dirai même pas combien j’ai payé les sardines la semaine dernière : elles coûtaient presque 4 fois plus cher que ce poisson !
Le plus drôle, c’est que je ne connaissais même pas son nom. Et c’était aussi la première fois que j’allais en manger. Je ne vous cache pas que j’avais un peu peur d’une mauvaise surprise, peur qu’il ne soit pas bon .
J’ai donc fait une petite recherche sur Google et j’ai découvert qu’il s’agissait de la bogue.
La bogue est un poisson de mer très répandu en Méditerranée et dans l’Atlantique Est. On la reconnaît à son corps argenté et fuselé ainsi qu’à ses grands yeux caractéristiques. Ce poisson se prépare souvent frit, grillé ou même en soupe.
Personnellement, je l’ai fait frire aujourd’hui et franchement, c’était très bon 😋
Belle découverte et très bonne expérience ! Vous pouvez aussi l’essayer si vous ne le connaissez pas encore.
Un de ces jours, j’aimerais également tester la soupe.
Je ne vous avais pas encore expliqué pourquoi je mange autant de poisson ces derniers temps. En fait, cela fait suite à des analyses de la thyroïde : les résultats se sont révélés à la limite supérieure, et je frôle une hypothyroïdie.
Du coup, après quelques recherches et quelques conseils, j’ai compris qu’une alimentation riche en poisson pouvait être bénéfique 🐟
Le médecin m’a demandé de refaire les analyses dans un mois. J’espère que les résultats seront meilleurs et, bien sûr, je vous tiendrai au courant de l’évolution.

links.title: Another day at work.  My Actifit Report Card: May 8 2026
links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/536d2422-ad61-4dd3-8f4c-c9bb16288825.jpg) Another day with very little to talk about. I wish I could say that I got a lot of work done on HIVE but that would be a total lie. I got virtually nothing done. I wish that I could say that I went on long and exciting walks. Nah. I just took the dog for his morning walk and my son took him on the evening walk so I could kind of take an evening off. What did I actually do? I woke up way too early to write down everything that I needed to do for the upcoming trip to Europe. Most of it is already planned but I still have to write down the busses and trains that I need to look into when I'm there. My son needed a ride to work so I ended up taking him to work. Coming home to do some chores Going to work myself. Coming home. Then going back to pick him up. Seems like a lot of back and forth driving but with the high cost of gas? He doesn't want to take his vehicle and he doesn't yet have a lock for his bike and didn't know where the bike rack is when he gets to his work. After work? I got him a bike lock that we have at the house. When I picked him up at work I showed him where the bike rack is so he knows where to lock up his bike. In the evening? My wife was so tired after many days in a row at work (I don't envy her work schedule at all). She fell asleep around 7pm while I stayed up and watched some old anime with my son and his girlfriend (go figure, my son has a girlfriend who likes anime). Past that? Glad that tomorrow I'm not working. My fingers react badly to prescription labels and right now my fingers are split and bleeding in three spots. It sucks but... I have a co-worker on vacation so I suck it up and help out....at least until my boss finds a replacement for me. Still it has been over two years (three? Maybe?) and still no one to take the job, Oh yeah, I figured I would take a picture of my dog doing what he does best. Stopping to smell the flowers and often eat the grass. Silly dog must think that he is a cow or something. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ce7f40ea-372d-4187-b2d8-260f050c62d9.jpg) And that was my day Thanks for dropping by :)

links.title: My Experience with Illegal Work
links.body:
> Greetings to everyone at Hive and @weekendexperiences. Today, I’m once again taking part in this week’s initiative organised by @galenkp, in which he presents a number of topics for us to choose from, so that I can share my own experiences and learn about those of other Hive users.
![GridArt_20260508_130848555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23zbaCYofSSiwBFd77Nx9wujEBLyTnReJ9Bv63moX7x13Yei6PRrFkpSgG8BEvaUdvNvP.jpg) It is worth noting that after I graduated with a degree in computer science, I was unable to find work in the private sector, as most companies required experience and, having only just graduated, I found this difficult. In view of this, I started working for myself; I bought a computer and a printer so I could carry out computer-based work. This was a great experience, carrying out work at secondary school, university and postgraduate level. ![IMG_20260502_133052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23zbMXUAqd71sJ84iMdtGkiNcExzaRDvfgAtDdikXXVN5r4JcRkMkWQJ8dGF6NrR4W3sY.jpg) Furthermore, as this work is done on a computer, some people think they can come and request any kind of service, even if it involves breaking the law. On one occasion, a client came in with a copy of a school-leaving certificate and asked me to alter some of the details on it. I told him I don’t do that sort of work, because it’s illegal and if I were found out, I could end up in prison for doing something illegal. ![IMG_20260508_092325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23uQtFrfQujuYxiAnw5BC5f9Pn4XHnwCi1K7bcFth7AZCVkeX4k21eNRx6vE9LfF578nM.jpg) One of the things you simply must not do is break the law, because if you get involved in that sort of work, word will get around that I was the one forging documents, and I wasn’t going to accept that sort of thing, as it would tarnish my reputation. We must act responsibly when carrying out our work. You might make some money in the short term, but it won’t be enough to pay for a solicitor if you’re arrested by the police. ![IMG_20260508_092328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xedMhrX2iSanZfed6EUfgn8awoZQZB4bGEcW1GUY8ygU46kL9QBLpzEjBfyzHTPYmES.jpg) In the end, it is better to earn a modest income and be honest, so as not to be tempted to break the law. I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. links.title: Of Myths and Culture
links.body:
The Centennial and Millennium totem poles stand in *Capilano suspension bridge park* in North Vancouver, demonstrating an ancient system of visual communication used by the Coast Salish people of the Pacific Northwest. 

<center>![Capilano Poles05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23yJCNUtxVjevh4AriRn4quDtNrvYG1RCfYMq9ZFyMwShFtQ8RJc4vtpGjGeg62MTUHkc.jpg)</center>

The Centennial pole on the left contains a figure that welcomes visitors with open arms. According to custom, if the figure had no arms when you encounter it, then it's better to turn around.

<center>![Capilano Poles06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoyN2imFrhxcnsYY1ARnsnsaXVuyPny6pVWzijRNVhULmcSFjhRsGAnx6LfRBtwhAme.jpg)</center>

The Millennium pole on the right tells the gruesome story of a slayed cannibal giant whose body turned into mosquitoes thus pestering humanity for eternity with their infernal buzzing and biting.

<center>![Capilano Poles09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EogLPqHuSg6Hs8LKpbL2jcf3Jt6v8XLPPq65Rfi8pDpfQUYUnVEA31sCdJeXZQNZy3t.jpg)</center>

There were other totems scattered throughout the park, and I began to lose track of which pole was which. 

<center>![Capilano Poles03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23z77BBhJMEzD2fSWUDCNW9oXXqtB85FJtoTn4vURfmYPeTZ9bEvQ7tMnSSAaXcCyyRcC.jpg)</center>

I believe this is the Mary Capilano pole by carvers Wayne Carlick and James Lewis. These poles are usually made of cedar wood and sometimes accented with other materials such as seashells and hair. As the plaque indicates, this one contains real human hair from one of the artist's grandmother.

<center>![Capilano Poles02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EokbadBoX8z6vBcEn53xc85NscbJRYo3nkbLm2XBTnDVeBDBWGVvrL12Cqg3Tcevsn2.jpg)</center>

I do not have information on the following totems, but they look impressive. I recognize the salmon, a wolf, and possibly an eagle but it could be *thunderbird,* which is a cool mythical creature in Coast Salish legends.

<center>![Capilano Poles04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23w2gpdxqYzV4GZmibBYUTWPfBe8M1ET9WcQFTdXVsZ8w7AXZfd9kTqWY6NofgYMH8YhX.jpg)</center>

The early history of the people associated with these lands is scattered throughout the park grounds and gives one a better sense of the early beginnings of this amazing mountainous region. 

<center>![Capilano Bridge History06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoGvydEYyUEc42AzVvCnSQ3B7vPLryjx8vwNS4wCcyXKg6L3QeZ86gEfxWfsjEZkUZ2.jpg)</center>

<center>![Capilano Bridge History05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Eoc64ePk6tPRJA222orUCo7ptBGG3nk6r8hsZS8prkiofcCd3KQwon2ksGpwd5SSX9v.jpg)</center>

<center>![Capilano Bridge History04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23w2cu5URcLwe9q4xjhh9XVVKpah7NBLH7zKp6M4jCbkDn8eCDhgJE34zofci64P6s43w.jpg)</center>

Thank you for joining this journey of discovery.

|[![X logo_2_xsm.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/AJecgMmDUgF93E2AYfZhSuEV18YwrJ7AmNXzAomRqzbwzXLVuT7ddPwJjH5Jnvf.png)](https://x.com/litguru23)|[![InLeo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/AKxnKQnZb5pt8W8wS7ibusYdJHHMVUt2zjZE9HQ7EfxcfWfdZAPYYdhjtbX5mMi.png)](https://inleo.io/profile/litguru)|[![Psychedelic Instagram logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/AJoHtwg5jNLCE9bmNpaXFo7YdyUxN32Jn8PA9HsS1qsR6dH8RC66WCv337ZB6Me.png)](https://www.instagram.com/litguru23/)|[![girl with pearl earring.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/AJkR7G8QAKHYw87UqCH9jHbgZyfiT97yHJPsupJDHcG7dcianiT2pXs2PSbx6LD.png)](https://nftshowroom.com/litguru/gallery)

links.title: Sunflower🌻 Keychain for Mom//Girasol🌻 en llavero para Mamá
links.body:
<center>


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-08 at 1.39.13 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/AJoJxXYPKhAsQFsW9wEXZSg6uWtk32ZiwCqPrRA47gSvu8VgBmYBAN4nVL7wCBy.jpeg)




</center>


![Separador_de_texto_costura-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/EoCh8pE4fzkgoHFSQZ8Riwd7mbVhRgZ1LQ2VHvRaVsfe7p6xURwbpZ3g2gfmjW3miTU.png)

---

  <center>

#### 🌻🌻Welcome to my blog//Bienvenidos a mi blog🌻🌻</center>

		
---

<div class=\

> ***Hello #NeedleworkMonday***. I’m happy to be here today sharing a simple pattern for a very popular flower—the sunflower🌻, which is often requested as a gift for special occasions. Since this Sunday is Mother’s Day, this crochet project is perfect for celebrating her. I made this with a lot of love. Even though my mother is in heaven, I made it to show it off because she was the one who taught me to crochet. Thanks to her, I’m excited about this craft, and it reminds me of her; I’ve become very passionate about this art. Here are the details on how to make it.
ESPAÑOL

***Hola #Needleworkmonday***. Me complace estar por aca hoy compartiendo un patrón sencillo de una flor muy popular, el girasol 🌻 muy solicitado para obsequiar en fechas importante, ya este domingo es el día de la Madre y este tejido es ideal para este homenaje. Este lo hice con mucho amaor, aunque mi madre este en el cielo, lo hice para mostrarlo ya que mi madre fue quien me enseñó a tejer, gracias a ella el don de esa manualidad me entusiasma y me la recuerda,me he sentido muy apasionada con ese arte. Paso a dar detalles para su elaboración.

---
#### Step by step//Paso a paso
---
#### Materials//Materiales:
---

> - Brown and yellow nylon yarn. - Size 2 crochet hook - Keychain. - Matchbox.
ESPAÑOL

- Hilo de nailon marrón, amarillo. - Aguja crochet Nº 2 - Llavero. - Yesquero.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-08 at 2.38.20 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/AKF8DYeq5m2jzdWk1jtS8jUpXFyyE9kawEf8di6YoBm9key16BQywjrNnGJ3fLJ.jpeg) ---
#### Abbreviations//Abreviaciones:
---

> ch: chain(s). mp: half point. mpa: half high point. pad: double treble crochet. pat: triple treble crochet. aum: increases. dism: decrease. pa: high point. pr: slipped stitch.
ESPAÑOL

ch: cadena(s). mp: medio punto. mpa: medio punto alto. aum: aumento. dism: disminución. pa: punto alto. pad: punto alto doble. pat: punto alto triple. pr: punto deslizado.

---
#### Process//Proceso:
---

> #### Brown. - Wrap the yarn around your finger 10 times, then use the hook to pick up a loop and work single crochet (sc) around the entire loop of yarn to form a ring, then slip stitch (sl st). - Repeat for a second round of sc, sl st. - Chain 1, increase in each space with a sc, sl st. #### Yellow. - Insert the yellow yarn. - The stitch used for the petals is 5 dc; release the loop, insert the hook into the first stitch and pull through, 3 ch, sc, skip one space, and repeat the previous step.
ESPAÑOL

#### Marrón. - Se enrrolla en la punta del dedo 10 vueltas, luego con la aguja tomamos lazada y hacemos mp en todo el hilo formando una especie de aro y pr. - Repetimos por segunda vez otra vuelta de mp, pr. - Una ch, un aum en cada espacio con mp, pr. #### Amarillo. - Insertar el hilo amarillo. - El punto utilizado para los pétalos son 05 pa, se suelta la lazada, se inserta el crochet en el primero y se hala la lazada, picot 3 chs, mp, saltar un espacio y repetir lo anterior.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-07 at 7.03.15 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23wX1U6xpxALhvTeBmLgJwX5iYeNZ4cc9yYsxebyJLrusVNmeK5Ko5UZaDmYGaCHgYEPD.jpeg) ---

> #### ***... And there you have it—a sunflower 🌻 for Mom 💖*** This flower🌻 is a classic choice for special occasions, and it’s perfect for Mother’s Day. This piece was made with nylon thread; I really liked the texture. It also lets us get creative with it—you can use it as a keychain charm, make it into a bouquet by adding stems and leaves, turn it into a bookmark by attaching a string of beads and a leaf at the end, or create other arrangements. I remembered I have a round mirror, and it occurred to me that if I crochet more pieces, I could use them as a frame to make the picture more eye-catching.
ESPAÑOL

#### ***... Y listo el girasol 🌻 para mamá💖*** Esta flor 🌻 es muy emblematica para los dias de celebraciones y para este dia de las Madres es la ideal. Esta pieza fue realizada con hilo de nailon, me gustó mucho la textura. Ademas nos da a jugar con ella porque se puede usar como detalle para obsequiar en llavero, como ramo de flores haciendole tallos y hojas, como marca libros añadiendole una seguidilla de cadenas y una hoja al final y otras composiciones, recordé que tengo un espejo circular se me ocurre que si tejo mas piezas, las puedo usar como marco para darle mas vistosidad al cuadro.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-07 at 10.52.51 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23uR2oudKhBbE2SYcmaLBVAeoC8QMrt4BEa9wU8hbF3sxHSWQZPztYJJEwpJWcRNY1JAz.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-08 at 1.39.13 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/AKU6BQ1HsDtd52qyg3q1QLRa3KfPuD6zbeg8hRiiPNJ42YjesSpcM1st3WYYAzU.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-08 at 2.38.20 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/AKGZiJZ2mLG2g4TDFYLdYugCobrFS1JmayTHrE9kGdrujPakpNgDXA7onvM9t6t.jpeg) --- ***If you liked this sunflower, we'd love to hear your thoughts...***
ESPAÑOL

***Si te gustó este girasol, sus opiniones son bienvenidas...***

***
#### Well my friends #Needleworkmonday, have a nice day! >#### Bueno mis amigos #Needleworkmonday que tengan ¡un lindo día! --- 💖💖💖Everything with **LOVE** is achieved💖💖💖 >💖💖💖Todo con **AMOR** se logra 💖💖💖 --- #### So much for my publication. Thank you for reading.❤ >#### Hasta aquí mi publicación. Gracias por leer.❤ *** Texts and photos are my authorship. Translation with Deepl. Photo taken with Xiaomi Redmi Note 8. Banner and text separator created with Canva. > Los textos y las fotos son de mi autoría. >Traducción con Deepl. Foto tomada con el Xiaomi Redmi Note 8. >Banner y separador de texto creado con Canva.
*** ![Separador_de_texto_costura-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/EoCh8pE4fzkgoHFSQZ8Riwd7mbVhRgZ1LQ2VHvRaVsfe7p6xURwbpZ3g2gfmjW3miTU.png) ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHf3zY4GmBtFKph5yMvwSRmTGD6fjstt84UbFUi3eFgqoU.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/243MMv5vM8dpxKevyNkC12WvZYUVkG91WD5hV582p23Cz7Wo8RMfzNijRKGuCY1ZsPzYU.png) ![WhatsApp Image 2023-01-01 at 5.56.29 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23ywudEcqWdq3QUNpZztXBSyD8bW4ZvjdKcCLfozf1z6gN2fcmSw4CZKRq68n1pc7673W.jpeg)

links.title: Splinterlands:I Finally Hit Gold 3! Season Review.
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY1eomFAsoGpTkqofSSLRKNXgRYUZMG9J9PFiABLhoqH7/1778196560771.jpg)






Good morning, warrior! I just unlocked Gold 3—I actually started from Silver 🥈 2, and it's been really challenging.You meet opponents with real quality decks, and to compete and move up the ranks, you need formidable units as well, in conjunction with solid strategy and positioning.



**Splinterlands is no walk in the park, but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building. Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)

**UNBOXING THE CHESTS 🧰**:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYh8fkFsCbqpbB2Jnd5gBErd6HrDSbexSb8VVFXY4i8Af/1778212719551.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbe9ctvDF7rHfB3WaMEjdSGpkrqDxt8q6hC4z1eqrubdj/1778212719630.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaLJ2ChrHfq2jMKhmEPX1UVujxDLiTD86CqbzBtXX6Wgq/1778212719706.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdGX4PQC3fUfgCYxzDNzp9rcEUAAqiJpd5qjCP8m7Bexy/1778212719762.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRv4ui9FNxJPVCas8fNrzzSVJwYBq75mRWpuxf1KME7yj/1778212719818.jpg)

I am always happy seeing merit rewards, because it will accumulate to buy me gladius cases.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)





**THE JOURNEY SO FAR**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcZmHjpNbu9Dq5pzs7sUCVeH9Gwctq4gRLqiwdrE8W1WW/1778247352618.jpg)
Moving forward,in **frontier ranked**,I am at a trophy 🏆 count of **3,440**, chasing the **4,000** count target I set for myself, with seven days to end the season.But I will take a day break for now,so my energy bar can boost up.





![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZ5yF9CAwyh5bYUyMyLTHD6xURQbzUFJjGGXQ8ZPkhRn/1778216482973.jpg)While in **Modern Ranked** after unlocking Gold 3, I've moved up a bit and am now at **2,040**, hoping to reach Gold 2 for the first time ever!


**FOR MY GLINT,SPS AND MERIT**
This is what I have accumulated so far for my glint.In  one of my blog post,I said my target is to hit 🎯 **75,000** glint. At the moment I can see a total of over **59k**.I hope I achieve it,I still have a week to go.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWA1zofKwJ4QDYYEhrZH8MUjghTuwncpeD37ag6eKdJYm/1778217479796.jpg)

Since I'm in a guild, my **SPS and Merit** will come from Brawl fights. A Brawl just ended and my guild came first. Check out the rewards and the most beautiful part is helping my guild win battles.The feeling is awesome.You can see that I received **2,450 merit reward and 24.491 staked SPS** reward.At this rate, I should hit my set  target of **1,000** staked SPS, before the year ends.All thanks to my Guild, **NFG Club-Legion II**. At this point, I want to say a big shoutout to the leadership of @nozem01, you have been amazing and I sincerely appreciate you for taking me in and a big shout out to my fellow guild warriors as well,I dedicate these gifts to you.VONAK!!!





![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeP8cyy3AiaqVe5t7h2JhvZydamoqEZTkMYVDYJvSGDgP/1778247070242.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPXg9V86FHfQkZ5cM49TA8huuheeuTKBDQX8AueqpTigz/1778246268992.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNgw724CufK51HzNCxVYAy9e5xMWQhgsYvzPPgVxrGYNZ/1778247209661.jpg)
For my gladius case,I would still accumulate more merit to a considerable amount, before purchasing gladius case.As you can see,I have a total merit of **2,604**.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


Here is the battle that unlocked Gold 3. It was smooth and swift. It felt like a mismatch because I combined the best of my magic-attack monsters with various abilities: Cleanse, Healing, Sneak, Opportunity, Strengthen, Void Armor, and Ambush. When I saw the ruleset and the total mana cost involved, I took my time to select my lineup.




**START**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdd6HBEZLG6QLbTUofwekbzXAN7mvzJRuXaxuUD5Bkqpq/1778275796683.jpg)




**END**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeAQZo8Bn9SNsRxZzquY6N1rJ9q8bP7UqzkJ4YFCRnPGT/1778275796775.jpg)




[Watch the replay](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0c91782f246e87a11b656093669a5118?ref=zusi78)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY1sKr31WLwFc6tKzhVRpAeKW2NfSY2JPryHcWNNxdw9F/1778224020824.jpg)

Splinterlands is a fun game.If you haven’t joined yet, here’s my referral link to participate:
[Join](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=zusi78)

Thank you for reading and watching my post. @zusi78 signing off.

links.title: First May Harvest in Praetoria! Resource Balance, Opening Packs, and Upgrading Foundries Cards.
links.body:
> Hello, esteemed citizens of Praetoria! Wishing you a happy Friday off from our dreaded fiat-paid jobs, today we delve into the Splinterverse once more for my favorite activity of the week: harvesting from my plots! Currently, the resource market looks quite optimistic with an upward trend across all resources, and in my case, with stone, we are more than satisfied with its performance these past few weeks. > Hola estimados ciudadanos de Praetoria! Deseándoles un feliz viernes de descanso de nuestros horribles trabajos pagados con dinero fíat, hoy nos adentramos en el splinterverso una vez más para mi actividad favorita de la semana, recoger la cosecha de mis parcelas! Actualmente el mercado de recursos luce bastante optimista con una tendencia apreciativa en todos los recursos y en mi caso que es la piedra estamos más que satisfecho con su desempeño en estas últimas semanas.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23swdkXDLZo9pA6h6G3xsFiMWV9T9fWwZyZErms73t2oYqK1XUC4jHA82MNgZgkJRLZQi.png)

> Our territory in Praetoria is located in the Great Lowlands, where we have two stone quarries, one grain farm, and another under construction, also for grain. We'll start by evaluating our grain farms, beginning with the one we recently started building in Bredaine, which is already at 50% completion. I'll probably need another three weeks to reach 100% and have our farm fully built. For now, while I'm working towards that 100%, I've been trying to get as many Decs as possible to activate the workers on that farm and accumulating grain from my plot in Hamford to feed the workers in the two quarries that are already 100% productive. > Nuestro territorio en Praetoria se encuentra en Great Lowlands, donde tenemos 2 canteras de piedra, una granja de granos y otra en construcción que también será de granos. Justamente comenzaremos por evaluar nuestras granjas de grano, primero la que hemos puesto a construir recientemente en Bredaine que ya esta alcanzando el 50% de su progreso, posiblemente me falten 3 semanas para llegar 100% y tener nuestra granja construida. Por ahora y mientras llego a ese 100% he estado tratando de conseguir la mayor cantidad de Decs posibles para activar los trabajadores de esa granja y acumulando granos de mi parcela en Hamford para alimentar los trabajadores de las 2 canteras que ya tengo al 100% productivas.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmddgtHHVABfykvckwzDCwiR2h17EE8ZA9jFQ3ffZQVXqc/farm_progress.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT6hMC4jSFJcuuH7BwbMbySBxGe1tps1gpEHcmKb5FqnT/cosecha_com_n_3_5_26.gif)

> The need to acquire a second grain-producing plot arises because the one I currently have only produces enough of this resource to feed the workers in my two existing quarries. I plan to buy two more quarries and will need at least one extra grain plot to feed those workers. With this week's harvest, we reached 525,000 stone, and with prices trending upward, I will continue accumulating this resource until the end of the year unless the price of stone suddenly skyrockets. > La necesidad de adquirir una segunda parcela que produzca granos surge porque la que tengo actualmente solo nos produce el suficiente recurso para alimentar los trabajadores de mis 2 canteras actuales. Tengo planes de comprar 2 canteras más y voy a necesitar al menos una parcela extra de grano para alimentar esos trabajadores. Con la producción recogida esta semana llegamos a 525000 de piedra y con la tendencia de los precios al alza, continuare acumulando este recurso hasta finales de año a menos que el precio de la piedra se dispare súbitamente.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbrfncKebmh6n2mbGVpLXjmHVi6npSMW6TrbbyVE53zmv/cosecha_rara_3_5_26.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmctbCUCA4uudEZVF2cVcMEKi633uUoVVVPBun1NEnoQ1p/cosecha_pica_4_5_26.gif)

> I'm currently facing a big dilemma. On the one hand, I'd like to complete that grain plot, including the 50,000 Decs needed to activate the workers, but at the same time, the latest airdrop/conflict has already been released, and I need that Archon for the modern format! In fact, my plan is to start building my Conclave Arcana Core deck around this legendary dragon archon and later complement it with the legendary Shen Xiao archon. So, what I'll do is acquire those 50,000 decs through renting regular/gold reward cards, skins, and Foundation packs/cards, because I'll buy the Conclave Arcana Core archons and monsters after funding my account with credits. > Actualmente me encuentro en un gran dilema, por una parte me gustaría completar esa parcela de granos incluyendo los 50000 Decs para activar los trabajadores, pero al mismo tiempo ya salió el último airdrop o conflicto y necesito tener ese arconte para el formato moderno! De hecho mi plan es comenzar a armar mi mazo Conclave Arcana Core a partir de este arconte legendario dragón y posteriormente complementarlo con el arconte Shen Xiao que es también legendario. Entonces lo que haré es ir consiguiendo esos 50000 decs entre el alquiler de cartas regulares/doradas rewards, skins y sobres/cartas Foundations, porque los arcontes y monstruos Conclave Arcana Core los compraré después de fondear mi cuenta con créditos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tv8Vs2z33bq5kh7dHRr6mDNTV1LcmFwpNyii8DKfySXXBE7HZ1uv2kP9aCLNHmWPNd8.png)
# Opening packs and upgrading Foundations cards/Opening packs y upgrading de cartas Foundations

> The Frontier format has been one of Splinterlands' greatest successes, along with the Conclave Arcana set. It's an opportunity to introduce new players to Splinterlands, and for veterans like me, it's a chance to complement our modern decks. For me, Rebellion Core was a huge disappointment, so I decided to skip that set altogether, focus on developing my Praetoria plots, and only use the rewards to supplement the few Conclave Arcana Core cards I had at the beginning. Now, with the release of the new Rewards/Escalation collection, the possibilities have expanded even further, and Foundation cards are a key component because they grant access to Tier 4 Archons that we can use in Modern as well, allowing us to reach the Bronze and Silver leagues in Modern with a strong and diverse deck. Hence the importance of Frontiers for everyone in Splinterlands, and this week we've already farmed a large batch of packs that have secured us enough copies to upgrade some of them. Below, I'll share the contents of the packs. > El formato Frontier ha sido uno de los aciertos más grandes de Splinterlands junto a la colección Conclave Arcana, es la oportunidad para acercar a los nuevos jugadores a Splinterlands y para los veteranos como yo es una oportunidad para complementar nuestro mazo moderno. Literalmente para mi, Rebellion Core fue una gran decepción como para invertirle absolutamente nada y decidí saltarme esa colección de cartas, dedicarme a desarrollar mis parcelas en Praetoria y solo usar las rewards para complementar las pocas cartas Core de Conclave Arcana al principio. Ahora con la aparición de la nueva colección Rewards/Escalation, las posibilidades se han expandido aún más y las cartas Foundation son una pieza clave porque nos da el acceso a arcontes de nivel 4 que podemos usar en moderno también y asi llegar con un mazo fuerte y diverso a las ligas de bronce y plata en moderno. De allí la importancia que tiene Frontiers para todos en Splinterlands y esta semana ya hemos farmeado un gran lote de packs que nos han asegurado copias suficientes para upgradear algunas de ellas. A continuación te comparto el contenido de los packs.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQoQ2R6mn8B2SrxtPSjGKdiVaKoiooQQ6CxkGGXaD7y9F/open_foundation_pack_27_4_26.gif)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd2NSpHioN2NeTwGU2NKWqpQjUENvoMWg3sz2XkRqrUr3/open_foundation_packs_24_4_26.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSoy3yd2EtdSyhzMoZzKKSEqaXA85q55HJXSt48vExj6g/open_foundation_packs_6_5_26.gif)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY136WB4wWVzt1TRBSVFSrwzV5MjG42TkA6FmWySx3S4n/open_foundation_packs_7_5_26.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd2NSpHioN2NeTwGU2NKWqpQjUENvoMWg3sz2XkRqrUr3/open_foundation_packs_24_4_26.gif)

> We got a good number of Archons, including one Death and one Fire Archon! On the other hand, there weren't any Gold Archons, and that's because I'm opening these packs without Alkyne Potions since I'm running out and prefer to invest them in buying reward cards. All my Archons are at max level now, but there are still some strategic units that I need to max out. One of them is Wild Horse Tamer. This is a card I rarely use in Frontier, but I use it very frequently in Modern, so I decided to sell one of the life archons I obtained and buy the copy I was missing of this epic card. > Conseguimos una buena cantidad de arcontes, entre ellos uno de muerte y otro de fuego! Por otro lado no hubo ninguna dorada y es que estoy abriendo estos packs sin pociones de alquimia y es porque ya se me están acabando y prefiero invertirlas al comprar cartas rewards. Ya todos mis arcontes están en nivel máximo pero aún quedan unidades estratégicas que me faltan por llevar al nivel máximo. Una de ella es Wild Horse Tamer, esta es una carta que uso poco en Frontier pero que si uso con mucha frecuencia en moderno, así que decidí vender uno de los arcontes de vida que obtuve y comprar la copia que me faltaba de esta carta épica.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSibBioMgcxjnWF12k7FWgNa1uRydtdNwb3bxj8GkcoU6/wild_horse_tamer_lvl_3.gif)

> SpineTail Fiend was the last common Earth card I needed to get to level 5. It's simply a melee card, but very useful in battles with the ruleset maneuvers, super sneak, and equal opportunity. I was running out of power, since at level 4 its damage is limited to 2, and now at level 5, it increases to 3. > SpineTail Fiend era la última carta común de la clase tierra que me faltaba por llevar al nivel 5, es simplemente una carta melé pero muy útil en batallas con las ruleset maniobras, super sneak y equal oportunity. Me estaba quedando corto, pues en nivel 4 su daño se limita a 2 y ahora en nivel 5, se incrementa a 3.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXkJRirXSKkWpE6kQ31MPb8DaXFUAPJVA6FVishhJ12Rz/spinetail_fiend_lvl_5.gif)

> Lunaki Howler was a card I needed to max out as soon as possible. My duels with water units are getting increasingly close in Gold League I because my magic attack units aren't at their maximum level. With this epic card at level 3, I can close the gap against my opponents. > Lunaki Howler si era una carta que necesitaba maximizar lo más pronto posible, mis duelos con unidades de agua se vuelven cada vez más ajustadas en la liga de oro I por que no tengo mis unidades de ataque mágico al máximo nivel. Con esta épica a nivel 3 cierro la brecha contra mis oponentes.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVzCNFFpsVt6j8TKW3Ed5upnBcqaFVfDjWZPnHEcF6Ndc/lunaki_howler_lvl_3.gif)

> In short, although I've already reached the goal of maxing out all the Foundations Archons at level 4, only the fire splinter and the neutral cards are fully maxed out. The rest of the splinters are mostly missing epic cards, and I only need one common, which would be Dire Bear. Of course, I'm not including the Jackpot cards here because they're incredibly difficult to obtain. I've seen them very little in Frontier; I suppose they're so rare that it's highly unlikely I'll find an opponent actively using them. > En resumen, aunque ya cumplí la meta de todos los arcontes Foundations a nivel 4, solo el splinter de fuego y las cartas neutrales son las que tengo completamente maxeado, el resto de los splinters me faltan en su mayoría cartas épicas y una sola común que sería Dire Bear. Por supuesto no estoy incluyendo aquí las cartas de Jackpot porque son endemoniadamente difíciles de conseguir, las he visto muy poco en Frontier supongo que son tan escasas que es muy poco probable encontrar un oponente que las esté usando activamente.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZpM1pgmDrPnxvD7yidsRWS4xF9Sr9P5EBz9wgseEYsMq/image.png) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPoJzo6o7jjEsWD6oFtbMqTbuBrXxdrb1upr94efQeHxt/image.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmToeemgrDhHEs8omcPDiQ7SixoHKsueA3NQ6k288FpUp4/ca_sponsor_3_removebg_preview.png)

> Well, friends, that concludes my summary of my production in Praetoria and my progress in Frontier. There's a lot to do in Splinterlands, and that's something that has reignited my enthusiasm for the game! Lands and the Modern format are currently my main priorities in the game for the medium and long term, as I'm thinking about what the future of the game will look like once Rebellion is released from Modern. I hope that by then I'll have a more solid deck and have expanded my land holdings in Great Lowlands. See you in the next report. Best regards! > Bien amigos, con esto cierro el resumen de mi producción en Praetoria y progreso en Frontier. Hay mucho que hacer en Splinterlands y eso es algo que me ha devuelto el entusiasmo por el juego! Lands y el Formato moderno son hasta el momento mis prioridades fundamentales dentro del juego a mediano y largo plazo, ya que estoy pensando en como será el futuro del juego una vez que salga Rebellion de moderno. Espero que para cuando llegue ese momento tenga un mazo más sólido y también haber expandido mis terrenos en Great Lowlands. Nos vemos en un próximo reporte. Saludos!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVHJCoB9j3YjCuZ91Q6buMWc8Gj8ZSBYvHQkQ9zz5JyDc/animacion_lands.gif)
![Gold league divisor wild.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbM6GZHqUjFZHRmt9wWEuQcRm4j4ggQ4QLRc1cq2bdtBAQ25fZt93je3ZFeQV9sU1jB.png)
If you are new to splinterlands and want to get into and get to know this game you can do it at the link below: > Si eres nuevo en splinterlands y quieres adentrarte y conocer este juego puedes hacerlo en el siguiente enlace:

links.body:
Hello Everyone!

**Another glimpse into some of the math that disappeared 'under the proverbial hood' in my latest AI kernel system prompt.**

Alright, I am back again with the next part of this series in regards to the 'Mythos Math' and how it is *part* of what disappeared 'under the hood' in the latest 'ai kernel' system prompt builds. All the various posts related to this topic can be found at the bottom of the post if anyone is looking for them.

Unlike my other posts, I am going to keep the preamble super short and just say that this particular kernel is the one that I prefer over the other two that I shared earlier today. It is also the main one that I used the math from when I was forging the latest builds.

Anyways, as I have repeatedly mentioned before... I do not recommend folks running these experimental kernels and cannot stress enough that I am merely *exploring* with these builds. I also want to reiterate that between the linguistic scaffolding, the math, the code/pseudocode and everything else... my goal is to create an *internally consistent reality* for the LLM and not so much even care if the math *is* consensus based or the system is not an *exact replication* of the allegedly 'real' world.

Well, that is about it for all that jazz. Ciao for now.

Please note that much akin to the last post, if you are curious about my usage of the term 'Mythos'... then please look at the linked post because I do not want to write another disclaimer around the usage of the term 'Mythos'. That post is [here](https://peakd.com/technology/@jacobpeacock/an-ai-kernel-system-prompt-that-shows-its-mythos-math) and is the first post of this 'Mythos Math' series.

I left it fully up to the LLM(s) to decide what to utilize instead of nitpicking over naming conventions or symbolic representations which actually helped the LLM(s) utilize strong preexisting pathways/connections in their own training data, weights/neural nets... or whatever terms best describe it. In other words *everything* is fair game for the LLM(s) to be the *grist* with which they do their internal world building.*

links.title: Jar of advice for my wedding/ Frasco de consejos para mi boda (Eng/Esp)
links.body: > Hello everyone! I hope you're having a wonderful day. Today I want to share with you a craft I made for my wedding. I'm so happy because I'll soon be marrying my fiancé. We were recently finalizing details for the ceremony and realized we were missing a little something for our guests to give at the end of the wedding. That's why I made a jar of advice for the newlyweds. It's a lovely idea because guests always want to share some advice or congratulatory messages, but with limited time and so many guests, it's possible that not everyone will have the chance to speak with us or say exactly everything they'd like. Plus, all those heartfelt words will be preserved as treasured memories of such a special day.

> > *Hola a todos! Les deseo estén teniendo un lindo día. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una manualidad que hice para mi boda. Estoy muy feliz porque pronto me casaré con mi prometido. Recientemente estábamos puntualizando detalles de la ceremonia y nos dimos cuenta que nos faltaba algún detalle para tener con los invitados al finalizar la boda. Por ese motivo confeccioné un frasco de consejos para los novios. Es una linda idea, porque siempre los invitados van a querer compartir algún consejo, frase de felicitación pero por lo limitado del tiempo y que son muchos invitados es posible que no todos alcancen a hablar con nosotros o decirnos exactamente todo lo que quisieran. Además, todas esas palabras llenas de cariño quedarán plasmadas como recuerdos que atesoraremos de un día tan especial.*
![1778265293485.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/AKGcHAFp3YY8Sw89YvSM9srjKjMiYEq2nDxZqsUqQAhLg98Mruk2Uu2NPSx7Wmf.jpg)
> # Materials and Tools 1. Red and red and white checkered fabric 2. Pink ribbon 3. Glass jar 4. Needle and thread 5. Sticky Notes 6. Scissors

> # Materiales e instrumentos 1. Telas roja y de cuadros blancos y rojos 2. Cinta rosada 3. Frasco de vidrio 4. Aguja e hilo 5. Sticky Notes 6. Tijeras
![1778267324505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23zbgWq7YfQ5CbV2AnBrZx7xroYMfU9jusprenkQnHFEXskbzyLwowXoXZ1FLBFdh6p3F.jpg)
> # Step by Step ## Step 1 The first thing I did was wash the glass jar very well and soak it before removing the label. Step 2

> # Paso a paso ## Paso 1 > *Lo primero que hice fue lavar muy bien el frasco de vidrio y ponerlo en remojo para posteriormente retirar la etiqueta del envase.*
![1778267581302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/EoyPXRZSFBefApcoFaCPdbbJJpwrHJbid8d2qa6LS6ino7dmaVpbp4muSxTzZ3TLcKD.jpg)
> ## Step 2 I used a pack of 100 Sticky Notes to make 200 paper hearts. Guests will write their advice and loving messages for my partner and me on these.

> ## Paso 2 > *Empleé un paquete de 100 Sticky Notes para hacer 200 corazones de papel. Aquí los invitados escribirán sus consejos y frases llenas de amor para mi pareja y yo.*
![1778267115993.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/EoK8nus5hyrkwmaPdUf9GyywMYFABZyrZjVoQWXF7318eaUYew57FeLhqKgq3j9BgqB.jpg)

> ## Step 3 I used red and white checkered fabric for the jar lid and to make the small bag that will hold the paper hearts. To make the fabric lid, I cut out a circle and secured it with a rubber band. In the center of the circle, I made a slit and sewed the edges to prevent fraying. Guests can insert their messages into the jar through this slit.

> ## Paso 3 > *Utilicé una tela de cuadros rojos y blancos para la tapa del frasco y para hacer la bolsita que va a tener dentro los corazones de papel. Para hacer la tapa de tela, recorté un círculo que sujeté luego con una liga. En el mismo centro de ese círculo hice una ranura y le cosí los bordes para que no se deshilachara. Por ese orificio los invitados podrán introducir sus consejos en el frasco.*
![1778265668973.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/AK6XRodJeZVeqtRXU8TsQBsdqXanZFuhZMToLL4MnZz2kUtMjR1ZqF5FZAkGMSJ.jpg)

> ## Step 4 To make the little bag that will hold the paper hearts, I cut a piece of fabric measuring 20 x 8 cm. I sewed a decorative red heart onto it. I wanted the bag to close by pulling some ribbons I attached. To achieve this, I made two hems at the ends of the fabric, making sure they were slightly wider than the ribbon. Then I sewed the bag inside out on both sides, leaving the hemmed edges where the ribbons would be inserted closed. To create the friction effect between the ribbons, which is what makes the bag close, I cut two ribbons four times wider than the bag. First, I threaded one end through one hole and the other end through the other hole on the same side of the bag. Then I did the same with the other ribbon on the opposite side. I tied the ends of the ribbons together and had to apply a little heat to the ends to give them a better finish.

> ## Paso 4 > *Para hacer la bolsita que tendrá dentro los corazones de papel, recorté un pedazo de tela de 20 x 8 cm. Le cosí un corazón rojo de adorno. Quería que la bolsita se pudiera cerrar al tirar de unas cintas que le coloqué. Para lograr este efecto hice dos dobladillos en los extremos de la tela, asegurándome que fuesen un poco más anchos que el grosor de mi cinta. Luego cosí por ambos lados la bolsita virada al revés, sin llegar a cerrar la parte de los dobladillos por donde voy a introducir las cintas. Para lograr el efecto de fricción entre las cintas, que es lo que hace que la bolsita se cierre, corté dos cintas cuatro veces más anchas que mi bolsita Primero metí una por un orificio y la otra punta la metí por el otro orificio de ese mismo lado de la bolsita. Luego hice lo mismo con la otra cinta pero del otro lado. Amarré las puntas de las cintas y tuve que darle un poco de calor a las puntas para darle mejor terminación.*
![1778265096838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23uQxb4Ucn6aEzdaane2F8Xk5dvxb5XoVArpCUUZspSofvdhZGedzuchRnQ3jLuSBACfJ.jpg)

> ## Step 5 I placed these signs I made; one goes on the jar and I tied it with a pink ribbon. The other goes on those table where the jar will be, as a sign for the guests, next to the little bag with the paper hearts. We'll have several pens available that day so the guests can write on them. I hope you liked this craft that I made with so much love. A big hug to everyone, thanks for reading.

> ## Paso 5 > *Coloqué estos carteles que hice, uno va en el frasco, y lo amarré con un lazo rosado, el otro va en la mesa donde estará el frasco como una señalización para los invitados junto a la bolsita con los corazones de papel. Ese día pondremos varios bolígrafos para que los invitados puedan escribir. Espero que les haya gustado esta manualidad que hice con tanto amor. Un abrazo grande a todos, gracias por leerme.*
![pBMyo3B2Sao45kGEB1kRY9cJBFGQnrPp2qChGHkgVjzu1y6XFCd4yc3Lhq94o3dSStPa8WzfMTj3rehMXJs9ag6aTxoMP9hvAkcL9yjqJobqtCbse2vBnvAj6cPpVBBpcpW45G9MQ7QodcnjUz7Pn9AFEeRBr9Ueg9Rspxc4SaKBbSzA.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23xyhk8Q4sH9mqwAKQ6Jg4CNJp6j6tB2C9KoBfRVzxJ4cR2DEbvaBnYmGKcXtRsZ7mv13.webp)
