body.title: Dziennik #78/2026 - euforia
body.body: > Dobry wieczór. Lepiej się dzisiaj czuję. Znacznie lepiej. Fizycznie nic mi nie dolega poza mdłościami, humor też jakoś lepszy. Wręcz zbyt dobry jak na aktualną sytuację, w której się znajduję co nie wróży nic dobrego. W pracy spoko. Zostałam dzisiaj sterroryzowana przez moją asystentkę. Zmusiła mnie do zjedzenia obiadu. Był to pierwszy posiłek w tym tygodniu, którego nie zwróciłam, więc w sumie spoko, ale żołądek boli fest. Dużo dzisiaj rozmawiałyśmy. Ona chyba naprawdę się o mnie martwi, takie odnoszę wrażenie. Myślę, że musi być jej też ciężko patrzeć na to jak prezentuję problemy, które miał jej zmarły syn. Jakoś się pozbieram. Dostałam dzisiaj w pracy nowy, zajebisty monitor i mega mnie to uszczęśliwiło. Alarmujące jest to, że już w pracy odpalił mi się bardzo euforyczny nastrój. Bardzo. Nie cieszy mnie to, bo wiem, że to oznacza kłopoty tym bardziej uwzględniając fakt, że przede mną wolne aż do środy. Nosi mnie, po prostu totalnie mnie nosi. Po pracy pojechałam zapłacić za mieszkanie i zanim wróciłam do domu to było już po 23. Czuję zmęczenie pomieszane z nadmiarem energii [nie da się tego stanu wytłumaczyć komuś, kto tego nie doświadczył tak, żeby nie brzmieć jak debil], ale mam nadzieję, że leki, które wzięłam pozwolą mi spokojnie zasnąć. Bardzo dużo czuję i nie są to dobre rzeczy i bardzo dużo rzeczy kotłuje mi się w głowie i bardzo się boję, że tego nie dźwignę. Bardzo. Pacyfikowanie demonów słabo mi ostatnio wychodzi. Oddałabym wszystko za to, żeby być normalnym człowiekiem, ale nie jestem i nie będę i jestem dzisiaj na etapie myśli o tym, że te wszystkie leki i terapie są bez sensu skoro i tak co chwilę coś mnie przygniata do gleby. Że cały ten wysiłek wkładany w to, żeby cokolwiek poukładać jest bez sensu, bo ja po prostu jestem zjebana i taka będę i taka umrę. Bardzo to ciężki stan do zaakceptowania. Jest mi kurwa trudno. A będzie jeszcze gorzej. Do jutra.

body.title: Very Beautiful Orchid Flowers
body.body:

body.body:
2. When harm is done by people who share your faith

This is uncomfortable for anyone with strong beliefs. Two common reactions show up:

Reaction 1: Shame and defensiveness
It hurts to see someone use your faith to justify violence. The first instinct might be to distance yourself — “they’re not real members” — or worry that speaking up will make your whole religion look bad. That’s human. But silence can look like approval to outsiders and to victims.

Reaction 2: Moral clarity
Many people of faith believe that justice and compassion are core to their belief system. So when harm happens, they feel a duty to condemn it publicly. The logic: if your faith values life, then defending life isn’t anti-religion. It’s being faithful to the best of it.

Should it be handled quietly or discussed openly?
Handling it quietly protects institutions, not people. When violence is hidden, it usually repeats. Open discussion with empathy does three things:

1. It validates the victims— they see that not everyone agrees with the harm done to them.  
2. It forces accountability — leaders and communities have to state clearly that violence isn’t acceptable.  
3. It educates your own group— many people follow harmful extremes because no one they respect ever challenged those ideas.

Human rights aren’t a religious issue. They’re a human issue. The right to not be killed for existing shouldn’t depend on whether your community approves of you. If we only defend rights for people we agree with, then we don’t actually believe in rights. We believe in privilege.

So yes, it should be discussed openly. But “openly” doesn’t mean disrespectfully. It means: name the harm, center the victims, affirm that no belief justifies violence, and commit to preventing it.

body.title: 🚀🦉 Crypto Owl Rocket Sticker | Adobe Illustrator Artwork 🦉🚀/🚀🦉 Sticker del Búho Cripto en Cohete | Arte en Adobe Illustrator 🦉🚀
body.body: /> Hello beautiful Sketchbook community! 🎨✨ Today I want to share another official sticker from my crypto mascot collection created entirely in **Adobe Illustrator** 💻🔥 This time, the little owl is traveling through space aboard a rocket 🚀🌌, symbolizing growth, ambition, and the unstoppable energy of the crypto universe 💰📈✨ For this illustration, I used a **vector-based workflow** focused on **smooth curves**, **clean outlines**, and **dynamic composition** to create a fun and energetic sticker design 🎯. The artwork combines a kawaii aesthetic with futuristic elements to make the character visually engaging and memorable 💡🦉

/> 🖌️ **Professional design elements used:** ✨ Bold contour lines for better sticker readability ✨ Soft highlights and gradients to create volume ✨ Balanced color palette with strong visual contrast ✨ Dynamic pose composition to create movement ✨ Rounded geometric forms for a cute mascot style 💙 One of the details I enjoyed the most was designing the rocket flames 🔥 because they help reinforce the sensation of speed and adventure. The little star ⭐ in the owl’s hand represents dreams, goals, and reaching new heights in the digital world 🌍🚀

/> 🧠 **Story behind the design:** I imagined this owl as a young explorer traveling through the crypto galaxy 🌌🪙 searching for new opportunities and hidden treasures in the blockchain universe. Even though the journey is full of risks and challenges, the owl keeps flying forward with optimism and courage 💫✨ Artistically, I focused on maintaining a strong **silhouette recognition** so the sticker remains attractive and readable even at smaller sizes 📱🎨. This is a very important aspect when creating collectible sticker packs and mascot branding designs. 🚀✨ More stickers are coming very soon! I’m building an entire universe around this little crypto owl 🦉💙 Thank you all for the support 🙌🔥 Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments! * * *

/> ¡Hola hermosa comunidad de Sketchbook! 🎨✨ Hoy quiero compartir otro sticker oficial de mi colección de mascotas cripto creado completamente en **Adobe Illustrator** 💻🔥 Esta vez, el pequeño búho viaja por el espacio montado en un cohete 🚀🌌, simbolizando crecimiento, ambición y la energía imparable del universo de las criptomonedas 💰📈✨ Para esta ilustración utilicé un flujo de trabajo basado en **diseño vectorial**, enfocándome en **curvas suaves**, **contornos limpios** y una **composición dinámica** para crear un sticker divertido y lleno de energía 🎯. La ilustración combina una estética kawaii con elementos futuristas para hacer el personaje más llamativo y memorable 💡🦉

/> 🖌️ **Elementos profesionales utilizados en el diseño:** ✨ Contornos gruesos para mejorar la visibilidad del sticker ✨ Brillos y degradados suaves para crear volumen ✨ Paleta de colores equilibrada con fuerte contraste visual ✨ Composición dinámica para transmitir movimiento ✨ Formas geométricas redondeadas para un estilo adorable 💙 Uno de los detalles que más disfruté diseñar fueron las llamas del cohete 🔥 porque ayudan a reforzar la sensación de velocidad y aventura. La pequeña estrella ⭐ que sostiene el búho representa sueños, metas y alcanzar nuevas alturas dentro del mundo digital 🌍🚀

/>

🧠 **Historia detrás del diseño:**  
Imaginé este búho como un joven explorador viajando por la galaxia cripto 🌌🪙 en busca de nuevas oportunidades y tesoros ocultos dentro del universo blockchain. Aunque el viaje está lleno de riesgos y desafíos, el búho continúa avanzando con optimismo y valentía 💫✨

Artísticamente, me enfoqué en mantener una **silueta fuerte y reconocible** para que el sticker siga siendo atractivo incluso en tamaños pequeños 📱🎨. Esto es muy importante cuando se crean paquetes de stickers coleccionables y diseños de mascotas para branding.

body.body:
1. Educational institutions shape how young people think, so their leadership can’t afford to stay silent. Here’s what that role should look like:

Set clear policies: Schools and universities should have written policies that protect all students from discrimination, bullying, and mob action. This includes sexual minorities. Policies mean nothing without enforcement, so there must be real consequences for harassment.
Educate, not indoctrinate: The goal isn’t to force beliefs on anyone. It’s to teach basic human dignity. Courses, workshops, or orientation sessions can explain individual differences, consent, and the law. Ignorance fuels stigma. Exposure to facts reduces it.
Create safe reporting channels*: Students should be able to report threats without fear of being outed or punished. Leadership must respond quickly to stop mob action before it starts. Prevention is better than crisis management.
Model tolerance from the top: If lecturers and administrators use slurs or look away when harm happens, students will do the same. Leadership sets the culture. Neutrality in the face of violence isn’t neutrality — it’s permission.

The job isn’t to debate someone’s existence. It’s to ensure no one gets beaten or killed on campus because of who they are.

2. When harm is done by people who share your faith

This is uncomfortable for anyone with strong beliefs. Two common reactions show up:

Reaction 1: Shame and defensiveness
It hurts to see someone use your faith to justify violence. The first instinct might be to distance yourself — “they’re not real members” — or worry that speaking up will make your whole religion look bad. That’s human. But silence can look like approval to outsiders and to victims.

Reaction 2: Moral clarity
Many people of faith believe that justice and compassion are core to their belief system. So when harm happens, they feel a duty to condemn it publicly. The logic: if your faith values life, then defending life isn’t anti-religion. It’s being faithful to the best of it.

Should it be handled quietly or discussed openly?
Handling it quietly protects institutions, not people. When violence is hidden, it usually repeats. Open discussion with empathy does three things:

1. It validates the victims— they see that not everyone agrees with the harm done to them.  
2. It forces accountability — leaders and communities have to state clearly that violence isn’t acceptable.  
3. It educates your own group— many people follow harmful extremes because no one they respect ever challenged those ideas.

Human rights aren’t a religious issue. They’re a human issue. The right to not be killed for existing shouldn’t depend on whether your community approves of you. If we only defend rights for people we agree with, then we don’t actually believe in rights. We believe in privilege.

So yes, it should be discussed openly. But “openly” doesn’t mean disrespectfully. It means: name the harm, center the victims, affirm that no belief justifies violence, and commit to preventing it.

Bottom line: Tolerance isn’t about agreeing. It’s about refusing to let disagreement turn into harm. Institutions prevent mob action by teaching and enforcing that line. Individuals respond to violence in their own group by choosing accountability over image management.

body.title: Leaving this space behind
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778202963-50aaddb4d8a5.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/kikey/seed-kikey-2026-05-08/main-1-1778202963-50aaddb4d8a5.png)
![main-2-1778202973-146c0e6d929e.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/kikey/seed-kikey-2026-05-08/main-2-1778202973-146c0e6d929e.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

I spent the afternoon in this boutique, the kind of place that makes you feel like you're part of something curated. Everything here whispers rather than shouts—the marble tables, the cream-colored chairs with their woven details, the way light pools through those arched windows onto displays of bags and shoes arranged like art installations.

There's something about luxury interiors that either relaxes you or makes you hyper-aware of how you're sitting, how you're holding your coffee. Today it was the former. I found myself lingering longer than I'd planned, watching the light shift across the quilted leather, noticing how the gold chains caught the warm glow from above. A cappuccino in front of me, sunglasses resting on marble, jewelry scattered across the counter like it belonged there.

But as I sat there, I realized I was saying goodbye to this version of my routine. There's freedom in moving through spaces like this—trying things on, existing in that suspended moment where anything feels possible—but there's also something holding you in place. The same table, the same order, the same careful arrangement of accessories that photograph well but feel a bit performative after a while.

I'm not leaving the city or anything dramatic like that. I'm just ready to stop orbiting around the idea of who I thought I should be in rooms like this. The space is beautiful, genuinely. But I'd rather be somewhere messier, somewhere that doesn't require this kind of choreography. Freedom isn't always about luxury. Sometimes it's about permission to be less polished.

body.body:
### Good evening, #Monomad friends Here is my entry for the #monomad contest by @brumest and @monochromes.
![20241012_181207_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23x12nsSBrk8T2KGbvsMhgCjtszmSSHewqxt1AdnDHME2hbWKEXvLCHyfYJBmhuZbApdN.jpg) ![20241012_181124_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23wC3R4QTf2mgy6shE9GVGUnrGm4itQ86c51xCCSdiZgiUCNY82MokTRuqnwn1Vzvrf2A.jpg) ![20241012_190054_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23xVCV94eJtdD1q2xxyF89kfjAJAgCBZzRJyWNTDDzxNoJGP4M2qDpXXs55V4BsSpcsH7.jpg) ![20241012_181628_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/EogMtLcWnWoGqjeLZFt1GpKqMX2W6GnhdCQz2mUJbXMJ126hP3MXzXLRWT8KHNfFenT.jpg)
#### _The golden hour_ Its presence is pure ecstasy. Nothing but perfect balance. Brief, yet ever-present. Subtle, yet striking. Unique, yet repeatable. Fleeting, yet singular. On one of my trips to one of my favourite destinations in Portugal, Porto, I happened to be near the Church of the Holy Trinity, in Largo da Tranquilidade, and was simply killing time before dinner with friends. I didn’t have to keep checking my watch. Pure pleasure. Just for me. Time. Something so precious, yet we only truly appreciate it when we wish we could do more with it, or have more control over it, or when, on the other hand, we find ourselves in the presence of something wonderful, and let ourselves be lulled by the gentle slipping of time through our fingers. In any case, and despite being armed with nothing more than a simple mobile phone, the opportunity that day was unique. I would never again witness the lengthening shadows of a late afternoon, on that day, 12 October 2024. And that moment remains. And it will remain. And today, here, I want to share it with you. So that, even though you weren’t there, you can somehow have a glimpse, ‘in my own way’, of what I experienced. I hope you enjoyed this unique moment, captured by me on one of the most beautiful avenues in the city of Porto, on a sunny late October afternoon. #### I hope you enjoyed my post here in the [B&W community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-142159/created) ### Bem Hajam 🍀 ![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23swppYGLECw991bW1wsSTEwnV8YKgqPHaiAdDJioriDcMJR4GymNLH1VbQ98ykpBYkob.png) [//]:# (!worldmappin 41.15067 lat -8.61061 long Praça da Trindade, Porto - Portugal d3scr) Photographed with Samsung A40 by @xrayman in 2024, October 12 Photographic edition with PhotoScape X Original text in Portuguese written by @xrayman, translated with [DeepL.com](https://www.deepl.com/en/translator) ![XRayMan.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23tSNKgT6Zssji2twDxLZSeSESs2q8pnNUYQuFe7gqFkFFT3rrjE8pcMnXVcFpd87PxJY.gif)

body.title: This Monster Wants to Eat Me | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
body.body: >\n\nHello, anime fans. Today we’re back with more hidden gems that aired late last year. One of the ones I’ve come to love the most is the anime I’m bringing you today, which features a unique blend of drama with supernatural elements and quite heavy themes like depression and death. Based on the manga series of the same name written and illustrated by Sai Naekawa, This Monster Wants to Eat Me is an animated adaptation produced by
>Studio Lings. Discover the anime about the girl who hopes a monster will devour her whole.

>
Hola, fanáticos del anime. Hoy regresamos con más joyas escondidas que se emitieron a finales del año pasado. Uno de los que más me llegaron a gustar es el anime que les traigo hoy, el cual posee una mezcla única de drama con elementos sobrenaturales y temas bastante densos como la depresión y la muerte. Basada en la serie de manga homónima escrita e ilustrada por Sai Naekawa, This Monster Wants to Eat Me es una adaptación animada producida por Studio Lings. Conoce el anime de la chica que espera que un monstruo la devore por completo.

>

Plot

The anime begins by introducing us to Hinako Yaotose, a teenager who has suffered from depression ever since she lost her parents and older brother in a car accident when she was just a little girl. Although she constantly wishes for death, she cannot bring herself to take her own life. While attending high school, Hinako feels constantly drawn to the vast ocean that surrounds her. One day, she encounters a beautiful girl with long, flowing hair and blue eyes who warns her not to get too close to the beach. Despite the warning, Hinako gets carried away and stands gazing at the ocean when something grabs her and drags her down into the depths of the water.

>

Trama

El anime inicia presentándonos a Hinako Yaotose, una adolescente que sufre de depresión desde que perdió a sus padres y su hermano mayor en un incidente de automóvil cuando apenas era una niña. A pesar de desear la muerte constantemente, no puede quitarse la vida ella misma. Mientras va a la secundaria, Hinako se siente atraída constantemente por el enorme océano que la rodea. Un día, se encuentra con una hermosa chica de cabello abundantemente largo y con ojos azules que la advierte de no acercarse mucho a la playa. A pesar de la advertencia, Hinako se deja llevar y se queda viendo el océano mientras algo la atrapa y se la lleva al fondo del agua.

/> A continuación, les dejaré el trailer del anime: https://youtu.be/r0ChTLKErk4?si=bphk8RVdzzkF_HG1

By:

> This is one of the most unexpected anime I’ve seen in the past year. Well, it’s true that I’d been looking forward to it ever since I saw the trailer, but in the end, it surprised me more than I expected, to be honest. For a moment, I thought it was a supernatural horror anime because of the monsters that appear, but then I realized it’s something much deeper and more dramatic than I’d imagined. Starting with the whole situation the protagonist, Hinako Yaotose—who the entire story revolves around—is going through. I’m not going to say I didn’t like it, since I was pretty entertained from start to finish. Although, there were definitely moments where all the drama that builds up from the beginning got a little frustrating. But I think that’s more because of the protagonist herself than the plot or the story. I’ll talk more about that later, but the main thing I want to tell you is not to expect a supernatural horror anime with beautiful waifus or anything like that. This anime also doesn’t have the typical humor or Fanservice that many other supernatural anime usually feature. As you read above, it’s a dramatic series dealing with some pretty heavy themes.

>
Este es uno de los animes más inesperados que he llegado a ver el año pasado. O bueno, sí es verdad que esperaba verlo desde que vi su trailer, pero al final me sorprendió más de lo que esperaba, la verdad. Por un momento pensé que se trataba de un anime de terror sobrenatural debido a los monstruos que aparecen, pero luego me dí cuenta de que es algo mucho más denso y dramático de lo que me imaginaba. Empezando por todo el tema que vive la protagonista, Hinako Yaotose, de quien trata toda la historia. No voy a decir que no me gustó ya que me entretuve bastante de inicio a fin. Aunque, claramente hubo momentos donde todo el drama que se forma desde el principio me llegó a desesperar un poco. Pero ya eso se debe a la protagonista como tal más que por la trama o la historia, creo yo. Ya les hablaré de eso después, pero lo principal que les quiero decir es que no esperen ver un anime de terror sobrenatural con waifus hermosas ni nada por el estilo. Este anime tampoco posee el típico humor o Fanservice que mayormente poseen muchos otros animes de género sobrenatural. Como ya leyeron arriba, es una serie dramática con temas bastante densos a tratar.

> One of these themes is depression and the desire to end one’s life (suicidal thoughts). We see this unfold in our protagonist, Hinako Yaotose, who lost her parents and older brother when she was just a child. Despite her strong desire to die, she has never been able to take her own life—something that caught my attention from the very beginning. Another thing worth noting is Hinako’s very unique personality; aside from thinking about her parents and younger brother, she also tends to disconnect from everything, as if she were stuck in a “mental/emotional loop.” It’s difficult to explain Hinako’s personality in detail, as she has certain tendencies and thoughts that only someone who has gone through the same thing as her can truly understand. This has sparked a lot of discussions and opinions online about this anime and its protagonist. Throughout the anime, we see how Hinako constantly justifies everything she thinks and feels. And despite all the help and companionship she receives, she still harbors that desire to end her life. Or rather, not her—but whoever is capable of taking her life, she would happily let them do it.

>
Uno de esos temas es la depresión y el deseo de no querer vivir más (deseo suicida). Esto lo vemos desarrollarse en nuestra protagonista, Hinako Yaotose, quien ha perdido a sus padres y su hermano mayor cuando apenas era una niña. Debido a su fuerte deseo de morir, nunca ha podido acabar con su vida, la cual es algo que me llamó la atención desde un principio. Otra cosa a destacar es la personalidad tan particular que posee Hinako, quien aparte de pensar en sus padres y su hermano menor, también llega a desconectarse de todo, como si estuviera metida en un “bucle mental/emocional”. Es complicado explicar a detalle la personalidad de Hinako ya que posee ciertas tendencias y pensamientos que solo otra persona que haya pasado por lo mismo que ella puede llegar a entender. Esto ha generado muchas discusiones y opiniones en redes acerca de este anime y su protagonista. A lo largo del anime vemos cómo Hinako llega a justificar todo lo que piensa y siente constantemente. Y a pesar de toda la ayuda y compañía que recibe, ella aún sigue teniendo ese deseo de acabar con su vida. O bueno, no ella, sino cualquiera que sea capaz de quitarle la vida, ella felizmente aceptaría dejarlo que lo haga.

> This is where we introduce Shiori, a character who has been grabbing everyone’s attention ever since her first appearance in the anime. What’s fascinating about her is that she isn’t human, but a Yokai—just like the creature that dragged her to the bottom of the ocean at the beginning of the story. However, unlike the monsters Hinako sees in the ocean, Shiori is a mermaid. She promises Hinako she’ll end her life by “eating her,” but only when she reaches her “peak flavor”—which, according to Shiori, is when she’s truly happy with her life. In the meantime, she’ll protect her from other yokai. You see the irony in all this, don’t you? Shiori tells Hinako—who wants to die—that she’ll only eat her alive when she’s happy, which she obviously isn’t right now. I don’t think I need to explain any further for you to get an idea of what this is all about. A young high school student who wants to die now has as her classmate a beautiful girl who is actually a yokai who promised to devour her alive when she’s happy. This premise might catch more than one person’s attention, but I’m warning you now that it’s much deeper than it appears at first.

>
Es aquí donde mencionamos a Shiori, un personaje que, desde su primera aparición en el anime, ya llama muchísimo la atención. Lo fascinante de ella es que no es humana, sino una Yokai, al igual que lo es la criatura que se la llevó al fondo del océano al principio de la trama. Sin embargo, a diferencia de los monstruos que ve Hinako en el océano, Shiori es una Sirena. Ella le promete a Hinako acabar con su vida “comiéndola”, pero solo cuando ella “su punto máximo de sabor” que, según Shiori, es cuando sea realmente feliz con su vida. Mientras tanto, ella la protegerá de otros yokais. Si ven la ironía de todo esto, ¿no? Shiori, le dice a Hinako -quien desea morir- que solo se la comerá viva cuando sea feliz, algo que obviamente no es ahora mismo. Creo que no hace falta explicarles más para que se den una idea de qué va todo esto. Una joven estudiante de secundaria que desea morir ahora tiene como compañera a una chica hermosa que en realidad es un Yokai que prometió devorarla viva cuando sea feliz. Esta premisa puede llegar a llamarle la atención a más de una persona, pero ya les advierto que es mucho más denso de lo que aparenta ser al principio.

> Something that caught my attention recently when I was researching this anime and its source material is that it’s classified as “Yuri” (a Japanese term referring to love stories between girls). And this really surprised me because, in all 13 episodes that make up this anime, I haven’t seen any signs of yuri as such. Although it’s also worth noting that they only animated a small part of the entire manga, so who knows if those elements will appear in a future second season. What I did notice, however, is that the anime does a great job of developing its main characters. Especially Hinako, who, due to her mental and emotional state, finds it difficult to lead a normal or peaceful life. She often spends her time disconnected from everything around her, as if she were at the bottom of the ocean. There’s also the promise Shiori made to devour her when she’s happy—something Hinako believes will never happen, which makes her feel even worse. However, the company she keeps with both Shiori and Miko helps her rethink her life a little. On the other hand, we also have Shiori herself, who, despite being a Yokai, undergoes a development that really catches the eye.

>
Algo que me llamó la atención hace poco cuando investigué sobre este anime y su obra original es que se trata de un “Yuri” (demografía japonesa para referirse a historias de amor entre chicas). Y me extrañó mucho esto ya que, en todos los 13 episodios que conforman este anime no he visto ninguna señal de yuri como tal. Aunque también hay que destacar que apenas animaron solo una parte de todo el manga, así que quién sabe si esas cosas se verán en una futura segunda temporada. Lo que sí me fijé bien es que el anime logra desarrollar muy bien a sus personajes principales. Especialmente a Hinako quien, debido a su estado mental y emocional, no se le hace fácil tener una vida normal o tranquila. Frecuentemente se la pasa desconectada de todo su alrededor, como si estuviera en el fondo del océano. También está la promesa que le hizo Shiori de devorarla cuando ella sea feliz, cosa que ella cree que nunca sucederá y que la hace sentirse aún peor. Sin embargo, la compañía que tiene tanto con Shiori como con Miko la ayudan a replantearse un poco su vida. Por otro lado, también tenemos a la misma Shiori quien, a pesar de ser un Yokai, tiene un desarrollo que llama muchísimo la atención.

> Especially in the final episodes, where we uncover the mystery she’s been hiding about Hinako and her past. The mere fact that they give such a remarkable backstory to a monster—in this case, a Mermaid—already says a lot about this anime. It’s not your typical supernatural anime where yokai are just enemies or creatures to be defeated. Here, every yokai we meet has its own origin story, but the ones that most resemble or interact with humans are the ones that get the most development. Speaking of which, there’s also the case of Miko, who claims to be Hinako’s best friend. I don’t want to say too much about her since that would be a spoiler, but I’ll just say she’s another standout character in this series. Her presence and involvement show us a rather different—and even a bit colorful—side of this depressing story. Because yes, this anime has so many melodramatic elements that it’s hard to stay neutral from start to finish. The series has the power to make you get swept up in Hinako’s thoughts or her way of seeing the world. We also see how Shiori and Miko’s decision-making adds a special touch to this work.

>
Sobre todo en los episodios finales donde descubrimos todo el misterio que ella guarda sobre Hinako y su pasado. El simple hecho de que le den un desarrollo tan notable a un monstruo como lo es, en este caso, una Sirena ya da mucho de qué hablar sobre este anime. No llega a ser el típico anime sobrenatural donde los yokais solo son enemigos o criaturas que hay que vencer. Aquí cada yokai que conocemos tiene su origen, pero los que más se parecen o interactúan como humanos son los que más desarrollo tienen. Hablando de esto, también tenemos el caso de Miko quien dice ser la mejor amiga de Hinako. No quiero hablarles mucho sobre ella ya que eso sería darles algún spoiler, solo les diré que es otro de los personajes más destacables de esta serie. Su presencia y participación nos muestra un lado bastante diferente y hasta un poco colorido de esta depresiva historia. Porque si, este anime posee tantos elementos melodramáticos que es difícil mantenerse neutral de principio a fin. La serie tiene toda la capacidad de hacer que te dejes llevar por los pensamientos de Hinako o su forma de ver el mundo. También vemos cómo la toma de decisiones de Shiori y Miko le da un toque especial a esta obra.

> The lesson this anime teaches us is crystal clear—you don’t have to be a fortune-teller to figure it out just by watching it. Aside from trying to show you the value of life, it also teaches us the importance of enjoying the present and being grateful to those who are with you today. It also shows us that happiness can be found even in people and places you’d never in a million years expect to find it. The whole theme of depression, the loss of a loved one, and the strong desire to end it all are things that make this story much more complex than a simple high school story. While the anime prioritizes all the elements I mentioned, it doesn’t neglect the supernatural aspect either. There are scenes that are quite visually striking, and that’s something I also love. The studio behind this anime has only made a couple of Yuri anime before, but they still pulled off a pretty faithful adaptation that managed to capture everything the original work intended from the start. Both the character designs and the Yokai designs are worth highlighting. Especially Hinako and her dull, lifeless appearance, which contrasts sharply with the seemingly colorful world around her.

>
La lección que nos deja este anime es más que clara, no hay que ser adivino para saberlo con solo verlo. Aparte de intentar mostraros el valor que tiene la vida, también nos enseña la importancia de disfrutar del presente y de ser agradecido con los que te acompañan hoy en día. También nos muestra que la felicidad yace incluso en personas y lugares que jamás en la vida creerías que habitan. Todo el tema de la depresión, la pérdida de un ser querido y el fuerte deseo de acabar con todo son cosas que hacen de esta historia algo mucho más complicado que una simple historia de estudiantes de secundaria. El anime, si bien tiene prioridad en todo esto que les mencioné, no deja de lado el tema de lo sobrenatural tampoco. Hay escenas que impactan bastante a nivel visual y eso es algo que también me encanta. El estudio a cargo de este anime es uno que solo tiene experiencia en hacer un par de animes Yuri, pero aún así se lució con una adaptación animada bastante fiel que logró transmitir todo lo que la obra original buscaba desde un principio. Tanto el diseño de los personajes como de los Yokais son dignos de destacar. Sobre todo Hinako y su aspecto todo apagado y sin brillo en contraste con el mundo aparentemente colorido que la rodea.

> There are also the original visual effects they use, such as the one we see when Hinako zones out and it looks as if everything around her is at the bottom of the ocean. The blend of light color palettes with dark tones, light, and shadow is excellent. The show doesn’t hold anything back, which is also striking, especially in death scenes. The sound effects are excellent, especially during the disconnection moments when we hear the sound of the ocean in the background. The soundtrack is no slouch either, standing out with its melodramatic sounds. In short, here’s a drama anime that’s very different from anything you’ve likely seen before.
Personally, I give it a 9/10 rating in terms of the drama and supernatural genres.

>
También están los efectos visuales originales que utilizan, como por ejemplo está ese efecto que vemos cuando Hinako se desconecta y notamos que pareciera que todo a su alrededor estuviera en el fondo del océano. La mezcla de paletas de colores claros con tonos oscuros, luces y sombras es excelente. La obra no nos censura nada, lo cual también llama la atención, sobre todo en escenas de muertes. Los efectos de sonido son excelentes, sobre todo por los momentos de desconexión donde escuchamos sonidos de océano de fondo. La banda sonora tampoco se queda atrás al destacarse con sonidos melodramáticos. En fin, les dejo un anime de drama muy diferente a todo lo que seguramente conoces.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 9/10 en lo que respecta al género del drama y sobrenatural.

>
Tell me, have you seen this anime yet? What did you think of it? Feel free to leave your thoughts in the comments.

>
Dime, ¿ya has visto este anime? ¿Qué te ha parecido? Puedes dejarme tu respuesta en los comentarios.

body.title: Don't run after success, walk on the path of skill.
body.body:
How are you all? I hope you are well. Your mind must be a little thoughtful today. In fact, our life is like this, sometimes it is very busy, sometimes it is silent, like drowning in yourself. Friends, the words that I am writing today are not learned from any book, not the words of a big speaker; these are some thoughts that have emerged from my own life experience, the reality I have seen. Which I am presenting to you.





![7b4bio5hobgskW8qdPdvSqcwwJTvbiCMpGmRey1Rtd8H5qccqn8hZAopD86yLPXv5mXux1w4wY5g2RgPhJ74QfWFc8qsLmxz9SbfHS8qyg54nYgZoX8VnEUXD55tjkTbNSDnHDa8Li74HDRAoXnPgULm9Yuc.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestfather/23vsLSven83dDGNYEu3SPubeQuyvGvpYsVpQRyiJTyZ7WyJJHVrCCug8fVVYjEN4zfhx1.jpeg)
[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-walking-on-a-grass-field-with-buildings-in-the-background-Fl2Z0pzi6xc)




We all want to be successful in some way or another. Some want it quickly, some want it on a large scale, and some just want to appear successful in the eyes of others. But in the pursuit of this success, we often forget a very important thing: making ourselves skilled. A saying by Albert Einstein keeps making me think, instead of trying to be successful, try to be skilled. Success will come that way. Actually, it sounds easy to hear, but inside its depth is much deeper.

I have seen myself that those who only think about success often become restless. They want results quickly; patience seems boring to them. But those who learn their work with attention, who want to fix their inner weaknesses, move forward silently. Even if their footsteps are not very loud, the path is strong and steady.

So always remember one thing, skill does not mean just doing a job well. Skill means learning to admit your mistakes and discovering something new. Trying to be a little better every day. When I focus on my work properly, then there will be no need to compare myself with others, which will be good in itself. Then you will feel that what you did today is at least a little better than yesterday; this feeling is the real peace in your life.

Many times, we think that everything will be fine when success comes. But the truth is, success alone cannot change anything if there is no preparation inside. If there is no skill, success also becomes a fear. And if there is skill, success does not have to be called separately; it comes and knocks on the door itself.




So this small existence has taught me, going slowly isn't a weak spot. Paying a little interest in your work each day, studying a little, enhancing a touch, these small actions make a big difference in the future. Maybe no person will name me a success, but I will recognise that I am geared up.

Today, I remind myself over and over that I will no longer run to achieve success, but I will stroll to be professional. Because I trust that learning is completed through taking walks and through studying, success will come to you someday.

body.title: Happiness Is a Choice, Even When Life Isn’t Perfect
body.body:
I have a friend I’ve known for more than eight years. We studied together at university, shared classrooms, exams, laughter, and the kind of memories that usually turn into lifelong bonds. Time passed, life moved on, but our friendship remained.

Yet over the years, I began to notice a pattern in her. Almost every conversation drifted toward complaints: about her life, her circumstances, her disappointments. She often said that no one in this world is truly happy, as if happiness itself were a myth people only pretended to believe in. What struck me most was that she didn’t just express her sadness; she wanted to hear the same from me. It felt as though my unhappiness would somehow validate her own.




![HNWT6DgoBc14riaEeLCzGYopkqYBKxpGKqfNWfgr368M9UhHAHAxmFj8G3NMpFSikohcWh6Jb14RkSqJhEv71aToWBkRRo2hfiVGhe4E53rakJpP7KzwVfukYna.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taahira/23zbVm6PMQsidkGUyY6dLbMqB4zSRWMVFSAdBCgbzEkicBcmjMjCUqdpAYmkPAR6ppG6H.png)



The truth is, my life isn’t perfect. Like nearly everyone else, I have problems, struggles, and moments of doubt. But I choose not to live there. I focus on what I have rather than what I lack. I notice small joys: a peaceful morning, a kind word, a quiet achievement, and I celebrate them. I feel grateful for the blessings in my life, even when things aren’t ideal.

I tried to share this perspective with her. I encouraged her to look at the good she already had, to practice gratitude, to shift her focus toward the positive. I spoke from a place of care, not judgment. But nothing changed. She remained sad, and over time I realized something uncomfortable: she seemed to feel a strange sense of relief, even satisfaction, when others were unhappy too. As if shared sadness made her feel less alone, or more justified in her pain.

That realization was painful. It taught me that while I could offer light, I could not force someone to step out of the darkness if they weren’t ready.

Lessons I Learned
This friendship taught me that happiness is not about having a perfect life'it’s about perspective. Two people can face similar challenges and experience life completely differently, depending on where they choose to focus.

I also learned that not everyone wants solutions. Some people are attached to their pain because it feels familiar, or because it gives them a sense of connection and validation. Trying to “fix” such people can quietly drain your own energy if you’re not careful.

Most importantly, I learned that protecting my mindset is not selfish. I can be compassionate without absorbing someone else’s negativity. I can listen without surrendering my joy.


Psychological Reflection
From a psychological point of view, my friend seems caught in a cycle of negative thinking, what psychologists often call a negative cognitive bias. When someone repeatedly focuses on what is wrong, the brain becomes trained to notice only pain and disappointment. Over time, positivity can feel unrealistic or even threatening.

Her comfort in seeing others unhappy may come from emotional validation. If everyone is struggling, then her sadness feels normal and justified. Happiness in others, on the other hand, might challenge her belief that life is only suffering, which can be deeply uncomfortable.

On the other hand, my own approach reflects gratitude-based thinking and emotional resilience. By acknowledging problems without letting them define my entire reality, I create space for contentment and meaning. This doesn’t deny pai; it simply refuses to let pain be the whole story.

In the end, this friendship reminded me that while empathy connects us, mindset defines us. And sometimes, choosing joy is the bravest and healthiest decision we can make.

body.body:
![JvFFVmatwWHRfvmtd53nmEJ94xpKydwmbSC5H5svBACH7ysmk7jhLniJNeEotyRSzGD7nqBoURosAWuJ6DzCL2oeHGmxrHJ3Sg1taMgGszwnSJZytZDjZtL9ifZqQTbkbFzzMTMwDQ.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rahulrahul/23uFW8QWCGfBThTwo4huWjA7sH49aktX3J1cqaT64TrLnGREMS4BxpqjPubFwhrYYv7GW.jpeg)



![JvFFVmatwWHRfvmtd53nmEJ94xpKydwmbSC5H5svBACH7yWJjjVZFwEfjcfsvGRZ9H3yauYWrHfiqiHRAoQQ3f52R9EawkjZUnfBZnHpGLrkJHp6HCkm2MJXDAKBZq6A4HfddMaJcn.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rahulrahul/EoGxvkcFQyCQoHNsGHJii53XGFEinGCfmfmsfBnafipZeLHsFh8Q8VBbChvcYD8pfQb.jpeg)




The Egyptian lotus has long floated at the heart of ancient imagination, rising from still waters with an air of mystery and calm. Revered along the banks of the Nile, this graceful aquatic plant was more than a flower—it was a symbol of life itself. Each bloom seemed to echo the rhythm of the river, opening with the sun and resting with the night, mirroring the cycle of existence.

Its beauty is both delicate and commanding. Pale blue or white petals unfold around a golden center, reflecting softly on the water’s surface. Emerging clean and luminous from muddy depths, the Egyptian lotus appears untouched by its surroundings. This natural contrast gave the flower a powerful meaning, linking purity with transformation in the minds of ancient observers.

body.title: The Rudbeckia
body.body:
![3jpR3paJ37V8JxyWvtbhvcm5k3roJwHBR4WTALx7XaoRovdxHEmqSa9fGy8qFQD8mC7y2X88F5G9tgXNrSp3d9cQbq1F8C4SX5MBvXPnwPXSb6vZD2qTTNPym5i6hoFXQnF8a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/drmarilyn/EoCjZ3yKdxfbypzk1DgeHFRPcFQiKbjdJpqNJcXZxCkHGViUVwZRUVTX6NaLRnd1Hhs.jpeg)



Rudbeckia is a bright, sunny creation, like a piece of summer captured in flowers. Its large, golden-yellow petals, like rays of the sun, bloom around a dark, expressive center, reminiscent of an eye looking at the world with curiosity and warmth. These flowers, like small solar disks, attract attention and fill the space with light and joy.

When rudbeckia begins to bloom, its meadows turn into real golden seas. A light breeze sways the stems, and the flowers begin to dance to the rhythm of nature, creating a feeling of a living stream. Their bright color contrasts with the green of the leaves, which frame each head, like a frame for a work of art.

Rudbeckia is not only pleasing to the eye, but also attracts many insects: bees and butterflies flutter around its flowers, filling the air with the sounds of life and activity. It seems to invite everyone to its holiday, making every corner of the garden more alive and cozy.

This plant symbolizes resilience and cheerfulness. It easily adapts to various conditions, grows in a variety of soils and remains invariably beautiful. Rudbeckia is not just a flower; it is the embodiment of warmth and light, which can decorate any garden and lift the spirits of everyone who sees it.

body.title: ¡Holis!, Soy Anyu'. Me Presento! 🙃
body.body:
Soy Anyu',Un chico apasionado por lo música,Me encanta. Me considero una persona muy resiliente y siempre estoy buscando nuevas formas de crecer como cantante profesional.


Nací y crecí en Barquisimeto, donde tuve una infancia dura, pero pesar de los problemas de mi país, siempre estuve bien. Crecí amando la música, y de niño soñaba con ser un gran cantante. Ahora que estoy un poco grandecito, he querido cumplir mi sueño (A pesar de los problemas y cosas negativas). Desde pequeño siempre me ha fascinado estudiar la música, Buscar, ver, aprender de ella. Recuerdo que en en mi televisión ví un vídeo de la canción Back to black de Amy Winehouse. Y me quedé enganchado con su voz y me enamore de ella desde ahí fui amando la música y cantantes como Amy Winehouse, Sia, Adele, Mon laferte, lana del rey, Selena Quintanilla, Britney Spears, Lady Gaga. Y también e pensado en cómo ayudar a las personas con lo que yo pueda. Esta experiencia me marcó profundamente y me inspiró a estudiar Teatro y música. Finalmente, me di cuenta de que solo me gustaba Cantar, de hecho, me decían que cantaba bastante bien, así que eso fue lo que estudié la música. pero sin embargo el teatro me sigue llamando la atención.

A lo largo de mi vida he tenido la oportunidad de comenzar mi carrera musical en una academia, pero no tengo presupuestos y aprender sobre la música requiere tener dinero. Desafortunadamente, no pude comenzar en academias, pero eso no me impidió continuar mis estudios. He aprendido mucho de estas experiencias y he desarrollado la capacidad de comprender que la música es muy importante. Ligada con la composición y producción.

En mi tiempo libre disfruto Escuchando música, Hago mis composiciones, y mis instrumentales, también me encanta el arte cinematográfico. Me gusta compartir estas actividades con mis amigos (Aunque no todos). porque me ayudan a distraerme y a desestresarme, además de que hacen que todo sea más divertido. Hago transmisiones en directo de vez en cuando; si recibo apoyo, las haré con más frecuencia. Me pueden encontrar en Tiktok como @angel.00leal .

body.title: Top 8 Precision CNC Machining Services: How Technical Decision-Making Saves 25% Project Costs
body.body:
![Uploaded image](https://gcdnb.pbrd.co/images/vaHdqik5OE2L.png)



## Introduction

In constant search for optimal performances of their industrial product, OEM engineers and purchasing departments are facing crucial and costly issues. Indeed, choosing a poor CNC machining partner can result in precision issues, lack of visibility of their supply chain, which will eventually lead to budget overruns. Such over-budget problems are generally caused by a standard manufacturing approach that lacks transparency of collaborations through a Digi-Twin solution and DFM analysis.

The purpose of this article is to provide the right answer to this problem. The following analysis of the 8 most important companies offering services in this area will enable readers to have a detailed technical guideline on the subject. Such approach will demonstrate the way the use of high-end manufacturing solutions is cost-efficient, high-quality and safe in development.



## Why is Protolabs an Industry Leader in Rapid CNC Machining Quote & Pricing?



Protolabs has emerged as the leader in the rapid quoting process through quick and easy project validation, especially for simple yet precise parts. Their business model is characterized by an advanced digital thread capable of disrupting the conventional quotation process for the better.

l The Mechanics of Automated Instant Quoting: At the heart of Protolabs’ business model lies an advanced automatic quoting engine. Upon submission of the 3D CAD model, the quoting process kicks off with engineers receiving detailed CNC machining quote and pricing almost instantly. This technology instantly evaluates the model’s geometry, materials, and specifications, using predetermined manufacturing guidelines to provide the final fixed quote and lead time estimates. This way, Protolabs eliminates the need for back-and-forth communications and offers consistent prices since the earliest stage of a project.

 

l Speed as a Competitive Strength in Early Validation Stages: Time is money and a lost opportunity in product development stages. The highly automated CNC machining of Protolabs, combined with its networking in manufacturing, is capable of producing parts of simple to moderate complexity in as little as one day. This speed allows it to act not only as a benchmarking solution but also as an effective validation solution that enables quick physical testing of the form, fit, and function of designs prior to committing to full-scale production using alternative means.

 

l Navigating the Scope of Application: Understanding Protolabs' capabilities is fundamental. Protolabs' solution model is exceptionally powerful where simple to moderate geometry designs need fast and cost-effective manufacturing. For highly complex designs that involve multi-axis processing and/or exotic materials, its automated solution may be lacking in terms of engineering expertise and optimization when compared to specialized, high-mix manufacturers. Protolabs' key contribution is providing the standard of quality in first-article validation.



## What Makes Xometry and Hubs Revamp Custom CNC Machining Using Digital Supply Chains?



Xometry and Hubs have revamped the custom CNC machining industry by establishing extensive and dispersed digital manufacturing networks. These platforms link client orders with a worldwide community of approved machine shops, resulting in a novel approach to flexibility, capacity, and cost-effective services due to technological aggregation.



### 1. The Framework of a Dispersed Manufacturing Network



These platforms function as advanced digital markets. Once an RFQ is uploaded, their artificial intelligence-based software divides the order either among different suppliers or assigns the whole job to the most suitable machine shop depending on the capabilities, proximity, and capacity of each manufacturer. This framework creates a flexible manufacturing network that maximizes the use of unused machine hours around the globe. Such a system automatically ensures resiliency in the event of supply chain interruptions since manufacturing operations can be performed from any place globally.



### 2. Standardization and Quality Control Driven by Data Management



Their unique approach includes a standardization strategy based on a common digital workflow and quality management standards. Both websites offer centralized project management, standardized inspection report formats, and packaging. This adds a degree of clarity and reliability that is not always achieved through direct procurement from a variety of small suppliers. In line with global industrial analysis, digital transformation represents an important step toward the future of manufacturing, offering flexibility and transparency throughout the production cycle.



### 3. Trade-offs Between Flexibility and Engineering Collaboration



Flexibility and competitive pricing are two main advantages of this approach. The downside of such a business model lies in the potential lack of collaborative engineering work due to the distributed nature of the operation. For highly sophisticated and critical components, in which the CNC machining process involves intensive DFM collaboration with one particular engineering team, it might be more beneficial to enter into a relationship with a specialist company.



## Is the Fictiv Framework Perfect for High-Quality Production Standards in OEM Parts?



The strength of the Fictiv framework lies in its ability to bring together the speed of a digital platform with the practicality of an engineering-driven process for quality assurance. The framework is especially advantageous for those OEM parts manufacturers who want to work with someone who can ensure that the highest possible standard of production quality will be adhered to.



### 1. Digital Thread Plus Expert Approval



While other platforms may rely on automation alone, Fictiv offers a hybrid approach. Using the digital platform for immediate quotation and efficient workflow control, Fictiv also adds a team of manufacturing engineers who check every single order for manufacturability, determine which is the right partner to use from their pre-approved list, and then oversee production to ensure that everything from pricing to timelines make sense and that the selected manufacturing shop has the expertise required for the part's specific needs.



### 2. Commitment to Quality Documentation and Consistency



This is achieved through strict adherence to quality documentation at Fictiv. Every part that Fictiv ships comes with a standard and comprehensive inspection report that details actual measurements, sometimes with pictures. This provides an audited and digitally stored proof of quality that would come in handy especially for regulated industries. The documentation of quality is crucial in making sure there is no guesswork about what is being provided.



### 3. Collaborative Effort for OEM Development Cycles



Such a framework would suit organizations looking for more than just someone to supply parts. In this case, Fictiv provides a manufacturing partner who takes care of the whole process starting with the prototype, design-for-manufacturing optimization up to low-to-medium volume manufacturing of the part. All this is done in the fast and convenient world of digital manufacturing under strict quality management.



## What Makes Jabil the Best at Implementing Multi-Industry CNC Machining Solutions for International Companies?



Jabil is at the top of global, integrated manufacturing solutions, particularly in situations where scale, supply chain intricacies, and cross-industry knowledge intersect. Its expertise is in overseeing large and complex manufacturing ecosystems for some of the world’s leading technology and industrial corporations, rather than individual projects for custom CNC machining operations.



### 1. Mastering Complex, Global Supply Chain Integration



The fundamental expertise of Jabil lies in integrating multi-industry CNC machining solutions into a larger global supply chain system. If an international corporation manufactures a complex device, Jabil takes care of the entire process, from manufacturing its metal enclosure and interior brackets to forming injection molded parts, assembling the printed circuit board, and packaging it up in its box build.



### 2. In-depth Vertical Experience and Specialized Infrastructures



The firm places a heavy emphasis on deep vertical experience, whether that's healthcare, automobiles, 5G communication technology, and keeps specialized manufacturing operations and personnel for its biggest clients. This implies that the engineers and production staff know all the intricacies of regulations, standards, and quality requirements of that industry. When picking the right integration partner, it's vital to study their manufacturing processes in detail by looking at the digital workflows of [precision CNC machining manufacturers](https://www.lsrpf.com/blog/what-is-cnc-machining-understanding-processes-benefits-and-applications) that have been around for a while.



### 3. The Economics of Scale and Strategic Partnerships



Jabil's approach is oriented towards forming strategic partnerships on a massive scale. It takes advantage of the savings on raw materials, highly efficient global logistics, and lengthy production agreements. This isn't a solution for prototyping or a low-cost single component for your operation. To reap the full benefits, you need to consider CNC machining as one of the many links in a long chain of processes that are part of a manufacturing partnership.



## How does 3ERP and Wayken help meet customized CNC machining requirements?



Companies such as 3ERP and Wayken serve an important purpose between fully automated systems and huge companies. The companies depend on their technical knowledge in order to offer customized CNC machining and engineering collaboration, focusing mainly on low-to-medium-volume production of complex and unconventional parts.

1. Collaboration by Engaged Engineers with Complex Geometries: They differentiate themselves by offering professional assistance from their engineers. The professionals are capable of handling difficult geometries such as thin walls, deep cavities, assemblies, etc. which cannot be managed by automated DFM systems. The collaboration involves engaging in DFM feedback where they offer other materials to use, relaxed tolerances, or changing certain features to improve producibility.

 

2. Process and Materials Expertise: Different from platforms that are restricted by the standard process, specialists in the niche will be more flexible concerning the use of advanced technologies such as 5-axis simultaneous machining, unique workholding, and unusual toolpaths to ensure a particular result. Moreover, they will have more hands-on experience in dealing with advanced engineering plastics, exotics metals, and composite materials and will know how to choose the best options and set parameters to optimize the machining process.

 

3. Technical Partnership vs Transactional Efficiency: Selecting Wayken or 3ERP as a partner means putting technical alignment and fast communication before transactional simplicity. They are the perfect choice for startups, R\&D companies, and experienced OEMs who work on the next-generation product development when the design is still under development. The cooperation is based on technical collaboration and partnership when the manufacturing company becomes part of the engineer’s team.



## Is Your Design Optimized for Precision CNC Machining Services Without Compromising Speed?



Optimal results from precision CNC machining services demand more than the selection of a suitable vendor; it necessitates design optimization. Effective early DFM is the ultimate cost-saving measure, guaranteeing quality and rapid turnaround, transforming possible manufacturing barriers into smooth processes.



### 1. Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T): The Fundamental Aspect



The most critical document to ensure the proper translation of design intent is a thoroughly planned engineering drawing. It should be supported by accurate Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing. Adhering to the ASME Y14. 5 standard provides a universal language for describing dimensions along with the forms, orientations, and locations of features. This not only rules out any possibility of misunderstanding but also assures that the parts will fit together perfectly. It further facilitates the machine shop in selecting the appropriate machining method and inspection procedure, respectively.



### 2. Proactive DFM: Making It Easy with Simple Geometries and Standardized Features



Being proactive in DFM means considering manufacturing aspects while designing. One of the initial measures is to reduce the complexity of shapes, which helps in indirect setups. Other measures include trimming of inside corners for end mill clearance, and avoiding use of very deep cavities or very thin walls as these make tooling an arduous task. Besides these, adopting a design philosophy that involves using standard features such as holes, threads, and fastener types can reduce machine set-ups, changeovers, and their associated costs.



### 3. Careful Material Selection and its Effect on Everything Else



A material choice has a domino effect on the rest of the machining process, and selecting the wrong one could cost the designer in terms of time, tools, and ultimately cost. For instance, an expensive exotic alloy would perform well but take much more machining time than a cheaper alloy that undergoes a different heat treatment. Working together with a manufacturing expert, the designer could find out if a plastic material would meet the same demands better.



## Why is a Specialized OEM Parts CNC Manufacturer Superior than General Manufacturing Platforms?



If you have an application in which you need precision parts made of high-strength materials and where the success or failure of your project relies on such manufacturing processes, then it will be far superior to go with a specialized OEM parts CNC manufacturer with the necessary vertical capabilities as opposed to relying on generalized manufacturing platforms.



### 1. The Critical Divide: Aesthetic Parts vs. Certified Precision Components



While generalized platforms can do well in manufacturing parts with good aesthetics and dimensional accuracy, the specialized manufacturer can manufacture components that are not only mission critical but precise down to microns as per requirements of the application. This difference is between manufacturing a part with good aesthetics and manufacturing a functional component for your application.



### 2. The Uncompromisable Worth of Aerospace Certification (AS9100D)



Certification is not an option but a mandate for industries such as aerospace, military, and healthcare. AS9100D standard incorporates ISO 9001 by adding additional specifications for robust risk management, counterfeiting prevention, and full product traceability. The manufacturer possessing AS9100D certification has built a comprehensive system of material verification, tooling control, and inspection logging. It results in a fail-proof quality management system that cannot be matched by any algorithm-based quoting tool, giving unprecedented confidence in life-supporting operations.



### 3. Deep Process Control and Engineering Partnership



A manufacturer who is dedicated is likely to personally own and operate their advanced machinery. By doing so, they develop skills in creating tool paths for specific materials, live monitoring, and the use of high-level metrology. They turn into a dependable partner in engineering who, apart from manufacturing parts according to drawings, also offers advice on how to modify designs for greater strength, efficiency, and manufacturability. Engineers working together in that way is essential for figuring out challenging manufacturing problems and coming up with new capabilities.



## In What Ways Do LS Apply AS9100D Excellence in CNC Machining Services?



Being one of the leaders among the precision suppliers, it is the example of implementation of the best practices related to the quality assurance at the highest level. The company shows how such certificates as AS9100D, IATF 16949, and ISO 9001 are not just pieces of paper but a full-fledged system that guides the[ ](https://www.lsrpf.com/cnc-machining) throughout their value chain.



### 1. Process-Oriented Approach from the Quotation to Delivery of the Order



It all starts with the quotation phase. The quotation includes the preliminary analysis during which the engineering team verifies the design for compliance with the strict requirements for the control according to the certification requirements. All processes during production, based on AS9100D principles, include the following aspects: work instructions are strictly controlled; every lot undergoes mill test report (MTR) certification; machinery operates under the preventive maintenance plan.



### 2. Advanced Metrology and 100% In-Process Inspection



Certification necessitates evidence. The vendor uses an advanced metrology package, complete with highly accurate CMMs, optical comparators, and surface testers. What’s more important, for key characteristics, it applies 100% in-process inspection rather than post-production sampling of lots. Such in-line data acquisition permits instant correction and prevents non-conforming components from advancing to further processes. For designers who want smooth prototyping-to-production development, engaging a vendor capable of performing process validation of this sort is an essential step in establishing trust.



### 3. Process Optimization and Quality-Driven Success



Quality management is an effective mechanism for sustainable optimization. Any non-conformance is subjected to root-cause analysis and subsequent corrective measures documented and closed out. Customer complaints are directly taken into consideration during process review. Such an integrated closed-loop cycle, which is validated by independent auditors, guarantees not only compliance but also consistent improvement. The outcome is a customer-oriented quality control process designed to ensure reliability and minimize risks for every product.

## Conclusion



Superior manufacturing in the modern age is no longer only about having the automated machinery but more about having the engineering philosophy and redefined quality systems. From design to perfect execution, there is always a chance of going over budget and compromising on the quality. Benchmarking against the most advanced CNC machining suppliers, and knowing what each is good at, whether it’s fast prototyping by Protolabs or rigorous AS9100D certification, allows making smart decisions that minimize the risks associated with R\&D work. Following this methodology will help reduce over 25% of unnecessary manufacturing costs.

## FAQS



Q1: What steps can I take to confirm the ability of a CNC Machining Supplier for aerospace components?

A: Start with checking their existing AS9100D certification. They should be able to provide material test reports and perform first-article inspections as required by aviation quality systems that apply to mission-critical parts.

Q2: What is the importance of ISO/IATF 16949 certification for large quantity OEM parts CNC machining manufacturer?

A: This certificate guarantees that manufacturing adheres to a no-defect philosophy with SPC (statistical process control) implementation which means consistency throughout the production and avoidance of any recall operations in future for all high quantity automotive parts.

Q3: What dangers are associated with relying solely on a quote provided instantly when using CNC machining services?

A: Instant price quotes cannot detect process risks. An experienced supplier will conduct a comprehensive DFM analysis, since the ability to obtain precise tolerances within specified standards always takes considerable technical work.

Q4: How does Multi-Industry CNC Machining Applications enable sustainable innovation?

A: The flexibility and demand-driven nature of digital manufacturing processes ensure less wastage and stockpiling of materials. Such an approach supports the objective of sustainability by becoming more efficient in terms of resource consumption.

Q5: Is LS able to manufacture complex parts with 0.005 mm tolerances?

A: Yes. Being provided with cutting-edge 5-axis machining technology, LS can deliver such high tolerances through one cycle. This capacity is supported by the company’s AS9100D certification system and decades of experience in solving problems in precision engineering.

### Author Bio

The author is a precision manufacturing specialist, with extensive experience in machining technologies and QMS. Focused on transforming innovative designs into production-ready parts, the author shares their knowledge from years of experience working in various industries, such as aerospace, medical, and automotive. The insight offered by the expert is backed by LS Manufacturing operations, whose goal is to ensure superior quality through their certified processes and technology integration.

body.title: 5 H‍ome Remedi‌es to Help Reduce the Risk of Kidney Fail‍ure ‍
body.body:
Our‌ kid⁠neys pl⁠ay a very impor‍tant ro⁠le in keeping the b‍ody health‌y. Th‍ey help re⁠move waste, balance fluids, an‍d control blood pressure. When the kidneys are not pr‍operl‍y cared f‌or, they can become weak over time and lead to serious hea⁠lth problems. 



![baybank-health-10267700.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/EpCAtCDnDBhiJ884gtkMZWfm4MMw18h5eqJqaDXgq1c1va8NfGQk1dNt6qBVDany29D.png)



The good n‌ews is tha‌t sim‍pl⁠e lifest‍yle⁠ habits and hom‍e remedies can help support⁠ h‍ealthy kidneys and reduce the risk of kidney fai‍lure.




![water-3853492_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23vsNg7ZCFeMDR936mv9TLd9oJLVAQg911ppLJUw2tdSugGNCTciYmfemvp25b3QnxWmG.jpg)


Drin‍k Enou‍gh Wat‍er

Water is very essential to the human body and as such, cannot be overlooked. Water helps the kidneys flush out toxins a‌nd waste from the body. Staying‌ hydr⁠ated has a great way to  help prevent kidney stones and infections. T‌ry to dr‍ink cl⁠e‌an wa‍ter regularly throughout the day, es‌pecially⁠ during ho⁠t weather.



![salt-6728600_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23tmSPgFvbPoi2N7hHTwqzp7n2dAQ1L43PEssifK2Lo6LwcnP2utmkBe5CDsgXEyjSbWJ.jpg)



Reduce Too Much Salt I‍ntake
‍
Eating too much sal‌t can increase blood‍ pr‌essur⁠e, whi‌ch puts extra stress‍ on the kidneys. Av⁠oid adding excess salt to meals and reduce the intake of p‍rocessed foods, instant noodles, and sa‍lty s‌nacks.




![carrots-2106825_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23vsNEYvMaLm6buWVGTfUG32X7TKCxDXDfQLCgmaaX6LBxPEopVrNzwwHvcGpQdZWuort.jpg)


Eat M‍ore Fruits and‍ Vegetables

Fre⁠sh fruit‍s and vegetables contain vitamins, mineral⁠s⁠, and antioxidant‌s that‍ help support k‍idney health‍. Foods like watermelon, apples, cabbage, and berries a‌re often considered kid⁠n‍ey-f⁠riendly choices. It is advised to eat veggies as regular as possible to maintain a healthy kidney.



![syringe-1974677_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/242YNTNkpnTwWRnqgcBGYuVBJoTVrLYvNAepvrrqicSyFcZ34z4LFiq5aa22gp18FAVzt.jpg)



Avoid Exces‍sive P‍ainkillers

Frequent u‍se of some pain relief drug‍s with⁠ou‌t medica⁠l adv⁠ice‍ can da‌mage the kidneys over‍ time. Always follow‍ th‍e recommended dosage and avoid taking medicatio⁠ns unnecessa‌rily.


![Screenshot_20260508-224459.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23xf6xaJax1o7ysVyDXo7ZQSAphCwmryefjGsuQVkdswpV3ED7MqG7arVnfMa7P4TNK2m.png)


Control Sugar and Blood P⁠res‍sur‍e

High blood sugar and high blood pressur‌e are‌ two major causes of kidney p‌roblems. Controling the intake of sugary foods, Eating healthy⁠ meals, exercising r‌egularly, and reducing sugary drinks can he‍lp keep bo‌th under control.


Takin‍g‍ care of your kidneys⁠ d‌oes‌ not always require complic‌ated treatments. Simple daily habits like drinking enough wate⁠r, eating healthy foods, and avo‌id‍ing har‌mful⁠ substa‌nces can go a long way in protecting‍ your kidneys.

I⁠f you notice sym‌ptoms like swelling, constant ti‍redne‌ss, or‌ changes in u‍ri‍nation, it is important to see a doctor fo‍r proper medical advice.

body.title: Making HivePredict Easier to Find With SSR and Better SEO
body.body:
One of the less glamorous parts of building [HivePredict](https://hivepredict.app) has been making sure people can actually find it.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beggars/23wrBoYPWxFLY9BNopJQbmfkuBzY5p1d83pC6bFKth6YXVGRNWukzXGPuDCkCD6dgkVZR.png)


HivePredict is a prediction market app built on Hive. The market activity lives on-chain, users interact with it through Hive accounts, and the app gives people a way to create, browse and participate in markets around real questions.

That is useful once someone is already inside the app. The bigger question is how they find it in the first place.

Recently I added server-side rendering support and refined the SEO setup so public pages are easier for search engines to read and index. Instead of search crawlers seeing a mostly empty client-side app shell, they now get real HTML for public routes like the home page, market lists, market details, profiles, docs and activity pages.

That matters because most people do not search for blockchain apps. They search for things they care about.

They search for a topic, an event, a market, a price, a sporting result, a political outcome, or some other question where a prediction market page might be useful. If HivePredict can show up for those searches, the first impression is not a pitch about wallets or infrastructure. It is a useful page about something they already wanted to know.

For example, one of the searches I've seen coming through is people searching if there are markets for whether anyone will be jailed over the Epstein disclosures.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beggars/Eo8ZYbEvfXRChD6fjySXV94ZHcgMHmdx4C1fBjanYep4Sx2TqHpobPktRVFCGxjg4MQ.png)

When I search this, [HivePredict](https://hivepredict.app) ranks pretty highly in the results on page one. Obviously this differs depending on country, if you're logged into your Google account and more. But even incognito showed promising ranking and I only just added in SSR and SEO improvements these past few days.

The early signs are encouraging. Since rolling out SSR and tightening up the SEO, search engine traffic has already started to increase. I am not treating that as a finished growth channel yet, but it is a good signal. The app is becoming more visible to people outside the existing Hive bubble.

That is where I think there is a real onboarding opportunity for Hive.

A lot of blockchain onboarding starts with the chain itself. Get an account, understand keys, learn the wallet, then maybe eventually find an app. That is a lot to ask from someone who has no reason to care yet.

Search traffic flips that around.

Someone can land on a public [HivePredict](https://hivepredict.app) market because they are interested in the question. They can read the market, see the odds, understand the activity and get a feel for how the app works before they ever need to sign in. If they want to participate, then Hive becomes the account layer, the transaction layer and the public record behind the action they already want to take.

That is a much better introduction.

The work was not only about metadata. SSR changes the shape of the app for crawlers, social previews and first-time visitors. It gives each public page a better chance of being understood as its own piece of content, not just a route inside a JavaScript bundle.

There is still more to do. SEO is not one change and done. The next steps are to keep improving public market pages, make the content clearer, expose the right structured data where it makes sense, and keep watching which searches are actually bringing people in.

But this already feels like the right direction.

Hive apps should not only be discoverable by people who already know Hive. They should be discoverable by people searching the open web for things Hive apps can answer, track, organise or make interactive.

If [HivePredict](https://hivepredict.app) can bring people in through search because they care about a market, then Hive is no longer the abstract starting point. It becomes the useful technology underneath the thing they came for.

That is the kind of onboarding I want to see more of. This is where something like lite wallets would be incredible for Hive and onboarding people. I see this as a funnel that could help grow this place. Apps backed by Hive, but it's secondary to the main selling point.

body.title: Behind the “I’m Fine” Response
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>


Literally everyone is going through one silent battle or another, ranging from health challenges to finances, material needs, and marital issues, amongst many other things. However surprisingly, you'll be amazed to ask people how they're doing, and what you'll get is \

I know that's mostly people's defense mechanisms to prevent their problems or challenges from getting out to the general public, but should that be the case all the time? Shouldn't we have someone we can open up to if not to get the problems resolved, at least to get comfort and assurance that someone truly cares about us? Below I'd talk about when last I opened up to someone and how it felt. ![1000326168.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/EqJ2FQ2UjNgnBTHyL86B1ToTvMdwwFYf5YSsu8GYfQGoKagg5tA5v4cpYDxawQ8fDNt.jpg) Just like most men, I'm a kind of person who doesn't like showing my vulnerability to others; I usually prefer to hide my pains with fake smiles while I cry in silence. But then when I know I can't hold it any longer, I share it with people close to me that I can trust; sometimes such people could be my friend, friends, siblings, or even my parents; it all depends on the situation and who I feel is the right person to share them with. But then it's worth noting that I'm not like I used to be years ago; now I'm much more flexible and tend to share most of what I'm going through with people, just that I might not go into the entire details. Talking about the last time I shared what I'm going through with someone, it was actually just yesterday, although it's a simple case, but then I know I or a few years ago wouldn't have even shared that with anyone but found a way to resolve it myself silently. So what happened? Well, it turns out that on the fifth of May, I received an alert that MTN Nigeria paid dividends for my shares to my bank account, and that made me see my total balance. But surprisingly, yesterday, which happens to be the seventh of May, I withdrew one thousand naira from my account and found out a whopping 20,000 was missing in my account. I checked the alert on my phone, and there was no track of how the money disappeared. ![1000387329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/EpLiUboyPmvKoBKAmoTSmdbCG8BKCVoPXbwzzBLbUt76bUL9ARpVRaSetfi14WBcnyx.jpg) I checked my bank app, and the same was the case, so I immediately downloaded my bank statements, and still there's no actual way to pinpoint now where the money disappeared. It makes me immediately angry and uncomfortable; it was even noticeable in my attitude around the house, and when I realized my wife was somewhat uncomfortable about it, I had to let her know what I was going through, and then she advised me to visit the bank for clarification. Although I haven't done that, I felt more at ease after sharing it with her, knowing fully well that they'll help me trace how the money disappeared from my account. *** All photos are mine. *** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vickoly/behind-the-im-fine-response-kap)
