body.title: Protocols of Freedom
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778276394833-22a74d162244e093.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=redx.chat/e29c597f)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=redx.chat/e29c597f)


---

I'll take crypto before TradFi any day but some perspective can go a long way. Decentralization is more than a node count.

### Parallel Money

Public cryptocurrencies do two things. First, they cement into code the rules of their financial being. Which is to say, every blockchain project is an island with it’s own tokens and rules. And secondly, they deeply minimize the trust needed for transacting with others.

In contrast, the legacy financial system depends on heavy regulation and data sharing to support it’s inefficiencies. This is to say, without regulation and data sharing, there would be fear of rampant abuse and wide-spread mistrust among themselves. Banks, MSBs, payment processors and card networks do not trust each other by default. And by extension, they do not trust their customers.

These same banking tools used to build trusted, human centric systems at scale also manifest problems of automation and over-compliance. Claims of protecting customers are, in reality, an insular act of protecting self. Customers are continuously surveilled and risk assessed. The net result to customers includes frequent debit card declines and account freezing.

And so it is. dinosaur banking; failing to be fast and efficient. Failing to be a store of value. Re-enforcing why crypto is so damn liberating and increasingly adopted.

### Rose Tinted Protocols

But let’s not get too ahead of ourselves. There are thousands of crypto projects out there - the free market in full swing - but many are destined to fail. Some are worthy of attention; technically brilliant, great teams, open source and good decentralization. Yet ***almost every single of them*** has a single implementation of the backend server with no viable alternatives. The specification and it’s reference model ***is also the product***. This means, no matter how good the project is and no matter how diversified the ecosystem is, the stage is set for a potential single point of failure or mismanagement.

Products change direction easier than protocols and a project’s governance may actually disincentivize alternatives. Product complexity may also discourage the development of co-existing alternatives.

True protocols do not survive on reference models alone. Diversification of the backend is the long game. It’s the difference between email - the SMTP protocol - and Gmail the product. Despite all it’s flaws, it persists. Protocol developers may be less interested in the spectacular and more inclined to work together.

Now, amazingly, there are only four blockchain projects with more than one implementation of the backend; Bitcoin, Ethereum, Bitcoin Cash and Zcash (albeit a temporary measure). There are some projects like Cosmos and Polkadot that sit somewhere in the middle; where blockchains are formed from building blocks and developers pick’n’mix the various parts, but this is still a shared codebase.

The key takeaway here is perspective. There are some great products out there, and there are some great investment opportunities, but to have both at the same time is rare.

---

Whether by subscription models, Freemium & Premium models, Per-Use strategies and any other new shenanigan they can think of.\n\nThe message is clear and has been clear for a long time. By 2030 you will own nothing and you will be happy. Although at the rate we're going, it's not surprising that they might brought forward that \

by a few years. They are the ones who create, produce, and distribute the drug, and you are already just the poor addicted consumer who can no longer function without it.

Yeah, these greedy digital traffickers learned well the lesson. They understood something that, in the early years of the internet, the established print media didn’t until it was almost too late: **you can’t simply give away something for free that stood as the economic foundation of your businesses for years and decades.**

When the Internet arrived, it was regarded as a totally open and ad-free place. Eventually, ads appeared along with the content of almost every media brand on the planet. No one charged a dime because ad views more than made up for **lost subscription revenue.** Until it didn’t. Display ads became white noise and the media companies watched profits plummet. Eventually, brands started erecting paywalls and found other forms of revenue like e-commerce and Freemium, Premium and Per-Use business models.

And of course, AI had the briefest honeymoon of being free for-all, but that’s changing quickly, and the future of AI access is clearly **pay-to-play** no matter how much you kick and scream. So once they've got you hooked to their numbing free crack, it's best if you get used to the fact that you won't own anything and you'll be happy forever.

body.title: The Negative impact I want to let go # Loh 287
body.body:
***What heavy feeling (guilt, resentment, or regret) are you carrying today that prevents you from enjoying your reality? What step are you willing to take to forgive yourself or forgive that situation?***

I have said it before and I'm still saying it again, I never liked the way I turned out to be as a adult.It's something I regret and in a way have resentment towards alot of person's and my environment. 

![1000381321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tehilah/23wgSRt53EGj5Fe9UoeicYijEcH3UVrWT8tEug6x7CPV7oMxVoBoU8zY6aM38jksicZMb.jpg)

Every single day, I feel like I am not living the life I am supposed to be living. Please tell me why I feel like am still a child growing up to be a teenager, at some point I end up acting older than my age.

I regret not experiencing life as a child, even worse not experiencing it as a teenager. I regret not accepting the advances I had from my close male friends while in the university because I was feeling awkward and had the mentality of a child, forgetting I am grown. 

I regret not going out with my friends as a teenager or experiencing a little bit of social life growing up, this has actually turned me to an over serious young lady in my late 20s. 

I always think my life would have been alot different from what it is today because I believe I would have been married by now with kids even. Right now I think about it a lot to the extent of crying, too much regrets I say.

But what can I do now it's already 2026, and the world is still moving, it's definitely hard but I still try to shake my head off of that mindset when I am going deeper into my thinking mood.

I know the people that raised me and those around my environment had good intentions towards me, not realizing that it will affect me as an adult, I am too shy for my liking and I dislike it so much but most times, this has save me from a whole lot of trouble and for that I am still grateful. 

I know my creator has perfect time for everything and myself is not an exception, I know I am going to achieve everything at the appointed time and so I don't fret.

Anyways ones in a while the thought \

come into my mind but I try to distract myself with movies and words of encouragement online and my sister, who tells me to always make myself available and be more open to good  people around me, for that I am extremely grateful. 

***Photo is mine***

Thank you for stopping by.

It’s is a very known colloquially as Chinese hibiscus, China rose, Hawaiian hibiscus, rose mallow & shoeblack plant which is a species of tropical hibiscus, a flowering plant in the Hibisceae tribe belonging to the family of Malvaceae. It’s widely cultivated as an ornamental plant in the tropics & subtropics, but its native range is Vanuatu.

Hibiscus is commonly consumed in teas made from its flowers, leaves, and roots. In addition to casual consumption, Hibiscus is also used as an herbal medicine to treat hypertension, cholesterol production & cancer progression.

It’s associated with love, passion, and feminine energy, often symbolizing beauty, fertility & the divine feminine. It is also linked to the heart chakra, promoting love, compassion & emotional healing.
Additionally, the flower is used in spiritual practices to enhance focus, clarity & to create a peaceful atmosphere for meditation and introspection.

body.title: Apex | Movie Review [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWAS8GsNNQ3pCwiqogDrQmRr1L5aDdKtUkG7YwN5sYpSe/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/bo/filmimages.php?movie_id=199096) New movie releases keep coming across various platforms, and we can enjoy a wide variety of films across different genres—some are perfect for all ages and full of meaningful messages, while others leave us feeling uneasy. That’s why APEX was recently released, combining both elements: the film takes a bold approach by creating a survival story where a human being faces off against a creature, which might seem a bit nonsensical at first glance. Nevertheless, the film has made a huge impact. >Los estrenos de película en las distintas plataformas siguen llegando y podemos ver una amplía variedad de ellas de distintos géneros y son perfectas para todas las edades cargas de mensajes y otras terminan dejando una sensación incómoda. Por eso hace poco se estrenó APEX que combina ambos elementos, donde el directo apostó en crear un juego de supervivencia donde un ser humano enfrenta, la cual puede llegar algo sin sentido, sin embargo, la película ha logrado un gran impacto. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaogZN1WxYqpCbUaAWUV5dErMkboh9riwZm7UJBqiPg6m/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/bo/filmimages.php?movie_id=199096) This is a production that goes beyond basic action, even though it still features chases, shootouts, falls, and mistakes; it also depicts the harm done to others, which makes the film feel very real—and here we ask ourselves: Is it worth risking your life? Each scene is meticulously crafted, brimming with color and tension, making the game far more engaging since there’s nowhere to hide. Furthermore, using nature as a game mechanic adds that sense of danger and that special touch needed every second, as a single misstep, a rock, or a simple fall can work against you. There are very few characters here, since it’s practically a two-player game. However, each one knows how to handle things—they react, run, improvise, and make mistakes, just like people do—even though there are moments where there’s no turning back and all that’s left is to run. In my case, I wouldn’t be prepared for something like that, much less put my life on the line. >Esta es una producción que va más allá de la acción básica, a pesar de que conserva persecuciones, disparos, caída, errores, además refleja el daño a otro, la cual la película puede llegar a sentirse muy real y aquí nos preguntamos ¿Valdrá la peña arriesgar la vida? # >Cada una de las escenas están muy bien trabajadas, llenas de color, tensión y así conseguir el juego sea mucho más interesante, ya que no hay dónde esconderse. Además, usar la naturaleza como recurso del juego le da ese peligro y ese toque especial que hace falta durante cada segundo, puesto que un mal movimiento, una roca o una simple caída jugara en contra. # >Aquí hay muy pocos personajes, puesto que prácticamente es un juego de dos. Sin embargo, cada uno sabe cómo llevar las cosas reacciona, corren, improvisan y se equivoca, como personas, a pesar de haber momentos donde no hay vuelta atrás y solo queda correr. La cual en mi caso no estaría preparado para algo como eso y muchos menos poner en juego mi vida. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTV3TYYetmtqxq5HxCg3GF8hep1JLMfQnSUknFi3pZW4Z/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/bo/filmimages.php?movie_id=199096) I really liked the film APEX—it dares to break the mold. It has a dense plot that builds tension and keeps you on the edge of your seat the entire time. It’s one of those movies that will probably go out of style quickly, but it leaves you with the feeling that someone is watching or stalking you in real life. >Me gusto mucho el resultado de la película APEX, ya que apuesta en salir de lo normal, es una trama densa que logra generar tensión y mantenerte atento durante cada segundo. Es una de esas películas que seguro pasará de moda rápida, pero te dejará esa sensación de que seguramente alguien te está observando o persiguiendo en tu vida.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb1YQAsu4GB81sVj4eS7YynfmSoXYhjpF5CvEkReLPj1r/image.png)

body.title: Between faith and fear. (Acrylic on canvas)
body.body:
<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaXMCoxut6LmtgVr7RQX9Kp7Lxo9EHPaxPKDj24hAwcTH/1778275438010.jpg)
</center>

The vulture rests peacefully on top of the church calmly and unbothered, In many Nigerian communities, such a sight would immediately be called a bad sign a symbol of death, darkness, or evil, and in most cases some will even curse the church. But the painting challenges that belief, the bird is not hunting, attacking, or causing harm. It simply resting in a place where people fear its presence.
This piece speaks about misunderstanding, judgment, and the fear humans place on things they do not fully understand. Like the vulture, many people are judged by appearance, reputation, or symbolism before their true nature is known.

Od kilku tygodni na lokalnych drogach wokół Mons trwają remonty – poprawianie nawierzchni i inne „wygibasy”, które w przyszłości mają poprawić komfort jazdy, ale obecnie komplikują nawet najkrótsze podróże. Rano miałem wizytę u stomatologa. Przez objazdy dotarłem z kilkuminutowym opóźnieniem, ale na szczęście lekarz zawsze ma poślizg w przyjmowaniu pacjentów, więc i tak spędziłem jeszcze pół godziny w poczekalni.

> ***[ENG] For a few weeks now, there’s been ongoing roadwork on the local roads around Mons—resurfacing and various \

intended to improve travel comfort in the future, but right now, they complicate even the shortest trips. I had a dentist appointment this morning. Because of the detours, I arrived a few minutes late, but fortunately, he’s always running behind schedule, so I still ended up spending another half hour in the waiting room.*** Dziś miały dotrzeć zamówione dętki, jednak przez to drogowe zamieszanie i trwające właśnie ferie w Walonii, dostawa również się opóźniła – ma dotrzeć dopiero w przyszłym tygodniu. Szkoda, bo liczyłem na to, że wieczorem pojadę do pracy rowerem, a trudno przecież jechać z przebitą dętką. > ***[ENG] The inner tubes I ordered were supposed to arrive today, but due to the road chaos and the current school holidays in Wallonia, the delivery has also been delayed and is now expected next week. It’s a shame because I was hoping to cycle to work tonight, and you can’t exactly ride with a flat tire.*** ![IMG_3483.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23sU6MkTiMoHwYV8DMCdbfZdqCmzKF6Fmee9bFge7HwFfDSFG7iSjRWA6yAh2tcFdmWm7.JPG) ---

body.title: ‎Respect Has a Body: The Uncomfortable Truth I Had to Accept
body.body:
For sometimes now, I actually used to think I used to believe that character alone should be enough and that being kind, intelligent, and hardworking would  earn respect naturally. But life has a way of confronting you with realities you can not ignore.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPxgEiNJj1KiZJQzE6BRjH2FUTEAGdHUWZe7iqYj3fgeN/geralt-handshake-442908_1920.jpg 

‎[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/handshake-shaking-hands-respect-awe-442908/)
‎
‎When you’re in great physical shape, people treat you differently 
‎
‎I didn’t realized it instantly. It happened gradually. The way people listened when I spoke. The way strangers made eye contact. The subtle shift in how seriously I was taken, even in rooms where no one knew my story. I told myself it was coincidence at first. But im the long run, the pattern became too clear to deny.
‎
‎When you physically look  strong and disciplined, people assume things about you. They assume you’re consistent. They assume you can handle pressure. They assume you respect yourself. And they extend a different kind of respect to you  because of that and sometimes before you have even said a word.
‎
‎It is uncomfortable because it challenges the idea that the world is purely fair. It is not. Perception also plays a huge role in how we’re judged. And one of the most visible signals of discipline physical fitness.
‎
‎I used to avoid that part of my life. I had excuses , no time, no energy, more “important” things to focus on. But the truth is, taking care of your body is not vanity, but it is communication. It tells the world that you have standards. And that you can commit to something difficult and stick with it.
‎
‎And here’s the deeper part  that it’s not just about how others see you. But it’s about how you see yourself. You carry yourself differently when you’re in shape. You walk with intention. You speak with more clarity and you feel more in control.
‎
‎People respond to that energy.
‎
‎This doesn’t mean muscles make you a better person automatically. But it does mean that discipline leaves visible evidence  and that the world reacts to evidence more than words.
‎
‎I had to accept this truth, not try to impress people, but to align my appearance with the level of respect I expect internally.
‎
‎Because whether we like it or not, respect is sometimes seen before it is earned.
‎‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎
‎

body.title: A Quiet Spring Day | My Entry for the #monomad Challenge
body.body:
Today was a very calm and peaceful day. Sometimes you don't need big plans to be happy. Good weather, a quiet cafe and even small moments are good for one's soul. This is my #monomad challenge post.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXBEpcWDKGDqa7oYxAJ4kXg9wXoCtztHL8ua3aJsytbW7/img_1990.jpg)

I took a little walk today. The weather was finally nice. The weather has been very cold for a long time, but today it really seemed like summer had come. It was sunny and it was very pleasant to walk outside.

tps://images.ecency.com/DQmQDFTXpaAck2y8n34wKvSefDQpARbSUquZZ6QNU96Myf3/img_1925.jpg)

Then I went to the stationery store because I had to study. I had an online class in the evening. I bought myself a few pens for motivation. One was red and the other was a black tip pen. Buying a new pen always makes me feel good.

![](ht
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbxZf2PLo3uzeShKKcdANyDGdsfAe76A2ViBefPZ7EFEo/img_1924.jpg)

Then I went to a cafe I always go to. It's called Siasra Cafe. It is very close to my house and a very quiet place. I usually go there to study or read books. I took my tea from home. I also bought a small snack there.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQe7ZdwQTfbWueGFibWVfbUdNUkmzSvtt1JWrSg8RTCcE/img_1985.jpg)
mg_1990.jpg)

I worked for about three hours. I'm tired but it went well. The atmosphere in the cafe was very calm. The sun was coming in through the windows. Everyone was silent.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPPZqCWvcymM2ejLiKwus1FXqeDxNtYUvBDpnWKW6715/img_1987.jpg)

Then I saw a very cute cat. He was sleeping on the chair. He was sleeping so well that I started to feel sleepy while watching him. His stomach was rising and going up as he breathed. He looked very peaceful. Actually, I also took the video, but I don't know how to share it here.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWnnkLRqcyEfQhavkL9ZaX6xWekajtqvBJQJVCvMbkJSE/img_1988.jpg)

The weather was hot, the cafe was quiet and the cat was sleeping soundly. It was a really good moment.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZRLowVTDLgNYUwvbU53voG6155FjGHBUCCGDrcXpCYLg/img_1991.jpg)


Then I went home and got ready for my evening class.

Maybe today wasn't a very big or special day, but it was very good for me. Sometimes quiet days are the best days.

Thank you for reading 🌸

body.title: Addiction Recovery and Career Rebuilding in New Jersey
body.body:
Addiction recovery is rarely limited to physical healing alone. For many individuals in New Jersey, recovery also involves restoring financial stability, rebuilding personal confidence, and returning to a meaningful career path. Employment can provide structure, accountability, and purpose—three elements that often play a significant role in maintaining long-term sobriety.

New Jersey has invested heavily in treatment accessibility, workforce development, and community health initiatives over the last decade. While recovery journeys differ from person to person, the connection between professional stability and substance use recovery has become increasingly clear. Individuals who regain steady employment often report improved self-esteem, stronger social support systems, and greater motivation to remain committed to recovery goals.

## Understanding the Connection Between Recovery and Employment

Substance use disorders can disrupt nearly every aspect of daily life, including career development. Missed work, damaged professional relationships, reduced productivity, and legal or financial problems may create barriers that continue even after treatment begins.

Employment, however, can become part of the healing process itself. Structured schedules help reduce idle time and improve consistency. Professional responsibilities also encourage accountability and long-term planning, which are valuable during recovery.

In New Jersey, many rehabilitation centers and support organizations now integrate vocational assistance into treatment planning. Career counseling, resume workshops, interview coaching, and employment referrals are increasingly recognized as essential recovery tools rather than optional services.

## Why New Jersey Faces Unique Recovery Challenges

New Jersey’s location between major metropolitan areas like New York City and Philadelphia creates both opportunities and challenges. Access to healthcare and employment is relatively strong, but high living costs and dense urban populations can intensify stress and increase exposure to substance-related environments.

### Economic Pressures and Urban Accessibility

Housing costs, transportation expenses, and competitive labor markets can place recovering individuals under significant pressure. Many people returning from treatment face gaps in employment history or concerns about criminal records, making reintegration more difficult.

At the same time, New Jersey offers one of the more developed healthcare infrastructures in the region. Residents often have access to outpatient treatment, counseling centers, peer recovery programs, and telehealth services within relatively short distances.

For individuals balancing work responsibilities and treatment schedules, access to flexible care options such as [suboxone doctors online that take insurance](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/online-suboxone-doctors/) can reduce logistical barriers and improve treatment consistency. Virtual appointments have become especially valuable for workers managing transportation issues, childcare obligations, or demanding schedules.

### The Role of Community-Based Recovery Programs

Community organizations throughout New Jersey continue to play a major role in supporting individuals after treatment. Recovery centers in cities like Newark, Jersey City, Camden, and Trenton frequently offer peer mentoring, housing assistance, and workforce development initiatives.

These programs matter because recovery rarely succeeds in isolation. Individuals who feel connected to supportive communities are often more likely to remain engaged in treatment and pursue long-term professional goals.

## The Importance of Stable Employment During Recovery

Research consistently shows that stable employment contributes positively to long-term recovery outcomes. A reliable income can reduce financial stress, improve housing stability, and restore a sense of independence.

Work also provides emotional benefits. Many individuals recovering from addiction describe employment as a source of identity restoration. Returning to work may help rebuild trust within families and communities while reinforcing a renewed sense of capability.

However, the transition is not always easy. Early recovery can involve fatigue, anxiety, concentration difficulties, and emotional fluctuations. Employers who understand these realities can make a meaningful difference by offering supportive workplace environments, flexible scheduling when possible, and access to mental health resources.

Some industries in New Jersey have become more proactive about second-chance hiring initiatives. Construction, logistics, manufacturing, healthcare support services, and certain trade professions increasingly recognize the value of providing opportunities to individuals in recovery.

## Modern Treatment Options Supporting Long-Term Recovery

Addiction treatment has evolved significantly over the past decade. Recovery is no longer viewed solely through the lens of abstinence; instead, many healthcare providers focus on sustainable, individualized care plans that support long-term stability.

### Telehealth and Flexible Recovery Support

Telehealth services expanded rapidly in response to changing healthcare demands and remain a valuable resource for many New Jersey residents. Virtual counseling, medication management, and peer support meetings can reduce transportation barriers and improve treatment continuity.

This flexibility is particularly important for individuals re-entering the workforce. Missing work repeatedly for appointments may create additional stress, especially during the early stages of rebuilding a career.

Healthcare accessibility also improves medication adherence. Questions about prescriptions, dosage instructions, and treatment safety often arise during recovery. Educational resources discussing medications, including topics like [970 orange pill how to take](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/suboxone-round-orange-pill-dosages-and-other-safety-protocols/), can help patients better understand treatment plans and reduce confusion around medication management.

### Medication-Assisted Treatment and Workplace Stability

Medication-assisted treatment (MAT) remains one of the most effective evidence-based approaches for opioid use disorder. Medications such as buprenorphine and methadone can help reduce cravings and withdrawal symptoms, making it easier for individuals to maintain employment and daily responsibilities.

Despite growing medical consensus, stigma around MAT still exists in some workplaces and communities. Education remains critical. Recovery supported by medication is still recovery, and many healthcare professionals consider MAT a life-saving intervention.

According to research from the National Institute on Drug Abuse, combining medication with counseling and behavioral therapies significantly improves recovery outcomes for opioid use disorder. External Reference Anchor: National Institute on Drug Abuse ([Link](https://nida.nih.gov/))

## Rebuilding Professional Confidence After Addiction

One of the biggest challenges many recovering individuals face is rebuilding confidence. Addiction can leave people feeling ashamed, uncertain, or disconnected from their previous ambitions.

Professional confidence rarely returns overnight. Small accomplishments often matter most in the beginning. Completing training programs, attending interviews, maintaining punctuality, or consistently meeting workplace expectations can gradually restore self-belief.

Mentorship also plays an important role. Recovery coaches, supportive supervisors, and peer mentors can provide guidance during difficult transitions. In many cases, individuals who once struggled with addiction later become strong leaders, counselors, or advocates because of the resilience developed through recovery.

New Jersey organizations focused on workforce reintegration increasingly emphasize strengths-based approaches. Instead of focusing solely on past mistakes, these programs encourage participants to identify transferable skills, personal growth, and long-term career potential.

## Career Paths and Workforce Programs in New Jersey

New Jersey offers several workforce development initiatives aimed at helping individuals return to stable employment after periods of hardship.

### Training Programs and Trade Opportunities

Trade programs have become particularly valuable for individuals seeking practical, accessible career pathways. Fields such as electrical work, plumbing, HVAC, transportation, and warehouse logistics often provide opportunities for individuals without traditional academic backgrounds.

Apprenticeship programs can also help recovering individuals rebuild structure and discipline while earning income. These programs typically combine hands-on experience with classroom instruction, creating a balanced learning environment.

Healthcare support roles are another growing area. Some individuals in recovery pursue certifications in peer counseling, behavioral health support, or community outreach after completing treatment. Their lived experiences can provide unique insight and empathy when helping others.

### Employer Perspectives on Hiring Individuals in Recovery

Employer attitudes toward addiction recovery have slowly evolved. Many businesses now recognize substance use disorder as a medical condition rather than a moral failing.

Companies that adopt recovery-friendly workplace policies often report positive outcomes, including improved employee loyalty and reduced turnover. Supportive workplaces may include employee assistance programs, mental health resources, and non-punitive approaches to seeking treatment.

Still, stigma remains a challenge. Some recovering individuals hesitate to disclose treatment histories due to fear of judgment. Others struggle with background checks or employment gaps.

Career counselors often advise focusing on honesty, accountability, and forward progress during interviews. Employers are generally more interested in current reliability and future potential than past mistakes when candidates demonstrate stability and professionalism.

## Managing Mental Health While Returning to Work

Recovery and mental health are closely connected. Anxiety, depression, trauma, and chronic stress frequently accompany substance use disorders, making emotional wellness a key component of career rebuilding.

Returning to work can trigger stressors that increase relapse risk if not properly managed. Long hours, workplace conflict, financial pressure, or unrealistic expectations may become overwhelming during early recovery.

Healthy coping strategies are essential. Therapy, exercise, structured routines, mindfulness practices, and peer support groups can help individuals manage emotional challenges more effectively.

Work-life balance also deserves attention. Some recovering individuals feel pressure to “make up for lost time” by overworking themselves. While ambition can be positive, burnout may undermine recovery progress if self-care is neglected.

## Long-Term Strategies for Sustainable Recovery and Career Growth

Sustainable recovery involves more than avoiding substances. It often requires creating a life that feels stable, purposeful, and rewarding over time.

Long-term success usually depends on consistency rather than dramatic transformation. Attending therapy regularly, maintaining healthy routines, strengthening professional skills, and building supportive relationships all contribute to lasting progress.

Financial planning can also become part of recovery growth. Budgeting, debt management, and savings goals help reinforce stability and reduce stress. Many individuals report that achieving financial independence becomes a powerful motivator for maintaining sobriety.

Career advancement should also be approached realistically. Starting with entry-level positions or transitional work does not mean future opportunities are limited. Recovery itself often develops resilience, emotional intelligence, adaptability, and problem-solving abilities that become valuable professional strengths over time.

## Conclusion

Addiction recovery and career rebuilding are deeply connected processes, particularly in a fast-paced and economically demanding state like New Jersey. While the path is rarely simple, access to modern treatment options, supportive employers, vocational programs, and community resources continues to improve outcomes for many individuals.

Employment alone cannot guarantee recovery, but meaningful work can provide stability, confidence, and renewed purpose. Likewise, successful recovery creates a stronger foundation for long-term professional growth.

As public understanding of addiction continues to evolve, New Jersey’s combination of healthcare accessibility, workforce initiatives, and community-based support may help more individuals transition from survival to long-term stability. Recovery is not merely about returning to a previous version of life—it is often about building something healthier, more sustainable, and more resilient than before.

>(WTF)


This is a semi-regular series that I will run on Fridays to hold discussions on a current topic from the week gone. The aim is to keep them light and conversational, though some might be heavier - regardless of the content topic itself though, just have some fun engaging and discussing with whoever happens to put in the effort in the comments section below. 

---



![31566.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23wWyP7Z5q1MU6zEDYSeEAA7eHmYU8k636Lv8vukhzamiEy9HYE4x2LMTAGTqHcMTLk6s.jpg)

# We Talk Friday Ep. 54: What a Cock

 # 1. You are an Illegal Alien 

>“While past administrations sought to discredit or dissuade the American people, President Trump is focused on providing maximum transparency to the public, who can ultimately make up their own minds about the information contained in these files.”

Nope - *not about Epstein* - No transparency on that.

The US government has released a so far *underwhelming* dump of files pertaining to alien interaction, or lack thereof, depending on what you believe. Most of it seems to have largely been *seen before,* but that doesn't stop the spin on how transparent the Trump government is - despite going to war without warning congress or allies. 

> Do you believe in Aliens?

Man, if they would abduct me and get me the fuck off this messed up world, I'd be pretty happy.  

 # 2. Turned Tides 

> \

This is from a poll in Finland and I think it is pretty clear from the results that at least from the perspective of the average Finn, the US can't be trusted in business or in security. And as I have said earlier, I have been in that camp for a while, believing that the EU should cut as many economic ties with the US as possible, start taxing US corporations locally and in full, and build its own security forces and defence systems. It might take time, but the sooner it starts, the faster it gets done. # 3. Have You Met Nipples? It was the Met Gala this week and lo and behold, it was another event where a slew of women went out in public naked, as if it is brave. Well, it would be brave to walk down a real street like that, but that is not the attention they are after. There is no political position, no greater cause - they just want to make it into pictures in the media. > I find it pathetic. I am not a prude and I am a huge fan of the human form, but it has just become so passé, so thoughtless, so mediocre, so lame. There is no art in fashion anymore, no fun. It is all falling into *just another average Instagram post by some rando who wants to monetize* category. Fashion used to have art, now it has no class. body.title: Learning Mushroom Photography: Dreamy Woodland Blewits
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeSjUkdbzmSCM1s3ZwUuLkbB5jQ6V8yPoWUfNugUWRXzi/ae482f31_87ac_4451_99d4_bf766c0be66f.jpg)



I’ve recently become interested in proper photography, so it took me a while to understand all the formats, settings, and terminology. Some of the Hivers here are incredibly skilled, and I thought I’d have a little go myself. I've been reading the manual and learning as I go. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcxDhPRW2E73Do3JpYA8a8DkHjDpGPgwWdr4ScZHRF1qm/imgp3126.png)

I was genuinely excited to put my new knowledge into practice today using my Pentax K10D.
I went to the woodland (along with my homemade cheat sheet), and as I walked in, I was really hoping to find some mushrooms to photograph.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7CeL7xcbFGZECneMdsZot3WKpXhQ4KbTWv2xJx4UCnw/imgp2996.png)

Just a few steps into the woods, I came across a pile of mown grass on the side of the path. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS8TdWV8gUjrq6fYF8wxdzhVSoQZUXY9egRpjwU7w6Kex/imgp3007.png)


In one sunlit patch, there was a beautiful little troop of mushrooms, like they had been set up just for me. Lol, nature was being nice! I felt so grateful and excited!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmezPNN7RdF7Ao1rofiE9ayMvwLsH5vH6pqsfyfRDRSmHu/imgp3021.png)

I set up my camera, composed the shot, and took the photos. And yes, I had my cheat sheet with me, lol.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUBRzyxC6o7BrLeT36QbWgToNR9gk8aUj56sJC4L2Ghup/imgp2956_1_.png)

These mushrooms were a stunning violet-purple, commonly known as the wood blewit (Lepista nuda).

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY4jpAhixggYAjNJCozjGtFWN5B4zb3wZtyXak64zfGF9/imgp2972.png)

There were two larger ones and several smaller ones underneath and more a bit further.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVLF2VCmhpkcjoiQtQW7MJ741kM94sB47MZT45NeWA1G5/imgp2951.png)

These were the smaller mushrooms from the troop

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZXtGG18kr6ZawML5s4XoCV9zWVeqYGgXQ1VVcPmA4CXH/imgp3031.png)

I noticed the baby mushrooms weren’t as vibrant yet, so I think I’ll come back in a couple of days for another shoot, if the deer don’t find them first. They usually get to them before I do!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRy2LWR2KTFrUDG6Ruw4ZrztiVWyYPXDpDPtKZw2mkvh1/imgp2985.png)

Look at those pretty gills!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZpeNhCLGE1vogGpkXZFMWiiRPU4yb79s3nsQrccyYP8b/imgp2991_1_.png)

The sun came and went, and I took the chance.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUtzrC3Ly85sJefAkST1kxVRHJwfL6jx4jp45ak2BA1Un/imgp3036.png)

As they are edible, I took a couple of the mature ones home and left the smaller ones to continue growing.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQEhyE2g2Wpd3H2sZxyebP6Pj4546nxT5qZnTSYxbZ1B/imgp3106.png)

Home with these beauties. I'll freeze these for now and wait for the rest to grow so I can whip up a nice recipe.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNmTfEq1yMMK3812fbUpGaZkDyKjB1XBN4yoDT3GakrES/imgp3100.png)

I’m really pleased I managed to do a bit of photography today for #fungifriday by @ewkaw 

One thing I noticed: this Pentax K10D camera produces dreamy results.

All photos were taken by me, with a 52mm lens, F 5.4 / ISO 100-400. I’m not sure if I did everything right, lol. Any suggestions are welcome! :)

Have a lovely day,
Mariah 💜

body.title: Luna 2
body.body:
# Luna 2

**Source:** https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luna_2

Luna 2 (Russian: Луна 2), originally named the Second Soviet Cosmic Rocket and nicknamed Lunik 2 in contemporaneous media, was the sixth of the Soviet Union's Luna programme spacecraft launched to the Moon, E-1 No.7. It was the first spacecraft to touch the surface of the Moon, and the first human-made object to make contact with another celestial body.
The spacecraft was launched on 12 September 1959 by the Luna 8K72 s/n I1-7B rocket. It followed a direct path to the Moon. In addition to the radio transmitters sending telemetry information back to Earth, the spacecraft released a sodium vapour cloud so the spacecraft's movement could be visually observed. On 13 September 1959, it impacted the Moon's surface east of Mare Imbrium near the craters Aristides, Archimedes, and Autolycus.
Prior to impact, two sphere-shaped pennants with USSR and the launch date engraved in Cyrillic were detonated, sending pentagonal shields in all directions. Luna 2 did not detect radiation or magnetic belts around the Moon.

Luna 1 and the three spacecraft of Luna programme before it were part of the Ye-1 series of spacecraft with a mass of 156 kilograms (344 lb).[8] Luna missions that failed to successfully launch or achieve good results remained unnamed and were not publicly acknowledged.[9][10] The first unnamed probe exploded on launch on 23 September 1958. Two more launches were unsuccessfully attempted on 11 October 1958 and 4 December 1958.[11] Luna 1 was the fourth launch attempt and the first partial success of the program.[12] It launched on 2 January 1959 and missed the Moon by 5,965 kilometres (3,706 mi).[13]
One mission separated Luna 1 and Luna 2, a launch failure that occurred with an unnamed probe on 18 June 1959.[14] Luna 2 would be the Soviet Union's sixth attempt to impact the Moon.[15] It was the second of the Ye-1a series, modified to carry a heavier payload of 156 kilograms (344 lb)[16] and had a combined mass of 390.2 kilograms (860 lb).[17] Luna 2 was similar in design to Luna 1,[18] a spherical space probe with protruding antennas and instrumentation.[19] The instrumentation was also similar to Luna 1,[18] which included a triaxial fluxgate magnetometer,[20] a piezoelectric detector, a scintillation counter, ion traps and two gas-discharge counters, while the Luna 2 included six gas-discharge counters.[21] There were no propulsion systems on Luna 2 itself.[22]

Upper stage of Luna rocket
Luna 2 carried five different types of instruments to conduct various tests while it was on its way to the Moon.[23] The scintillation counters were used to measure any ionizing radiation and the Cherenkov radiation detectors to measure electromagnetic radiation caused by charged particles.[24] The primary scientific purpose of the Geiger Counter carried on Luna 2 was to determine the electron spectrum of the Van Allen radiation belt. It consisted of three STS-5 gas-discharge counters mounted on the outside of an airtight container.[25] The last instrument on Luna 2 was a three component fluxgate magnetometer. It was similar to that used on Luna 1 but its dynamic range was reduced by a factor of 4 to ±750 gammas (nT) so that the quantisation uncertainty was ±12 gammas.[26] The probe's instrumentation was powered by silver-zinc and mercury-oxide batteries.[24][27]

A copy of the Soviet pennant sent on the Luna 2 probe to the Moon, at the Kansas Cosmosphere. This one has the date “January 1959” in Cyrillic.
The spacecraft also carried Soviet pennants which were located on the probe and on the Luna 2 rocket.[28] The two sphere-shaped pennants in the probe had surfaces covered by 72 pentagonal elements in a pattern similar to that later used by association footballs.[29][30] In the centre was an explosive charge designed to shatter the sphere, sending the pentagonal shields in all directions.[30] Each pentagonal element was made of titanium alloy; the centre regular pentagon had the State Emblem of the Soviet Union with the Cyrillic letters СССР (\
) engraved below and was surrounded by five non-regular pentagons which were each engraved with СССР СЕНТЯБРЬ 1959 (\

).[29][31] The third pennant was similar engravings on aluminium strips which were embossed on the last stage of the Luna 2 rocket.[28]
The scientists took extra, unspecified precautions in preventing biological contamination of the Moon.[32]

Launch and trajectory[edit]
There was difficulty getting Luna 2 ready for launch. The first attempt on September 6 failed due to a loose electrical connection. A second attempt two days later also went awry when the core stage LOX tank failed to pressurize properly due to ice formation in a pressure sensing line. The ice plug was broken but the launch had to be called off again. By this point the RP-1 had been sitting in the propellant tanks for almost four days and there was the risk that it could start to paraffin-ize. The next attempt was made on September 9. Core and strap-on ignition began but the engines only reached 75% thrust. The launch was aborted and the RP-1 finally drained from the tanks. The DP-2 electrical switch had failed to send the command to open the engine valves to full throttle.[33]The booster was removed from the pad and replaced with a different one, which was launched 12 September 1959, and Luna 2 lifted off at 06:39:42 GMT.[7][a]
Later in the month, Soviet premier Nikita Khrushchev was visiting the United States. The US space program had had several recent setbacks including an on-pad explosion of an Atlas-Able rocket and a Jupiter missile that exploded just after launch and killed several mice it was intended to fly on a biological mission. US President Dwight Eisenhower, while meeting with Khrushchev, remarked that there had been a few failures of American rockets lately and asked if there had been similar problems in the Soviet space programme. Alluding to the abortive Luna 2 attempt two weeks earlier, Khrushchev replied that \

[citation needed]
Once the vehicle reached Earth's escape velocity, the upper stage was detached, allowing the probe to travel on its path to the Moon. Luna 2 pirouetted slowly, making a full rotation every 14 minutes, while sending radio signals at 183.6, 19.993 and 39.986 MHz.[33] The probe started transmitting information back to Earth using three different transmitters. These transmitters provided precise information on its course, allowing scientists to calculate that Luna 2 would hit its mark on the Moon around 00:05 on 14 September (Moscow Time), which was announced on Radio Moscow.[33]
Because of claims[whose?] that information received from Luna 1 was fake, the Russian scientists sent a telex to astronomer Bernard Lovell at Jodrell Bank Observatory at the University of Manchester. Having received the intended time of impact, and the transmission and trajectory details, it was Bernard Lovell who confirmed the mission's success to outside observers. However, the American media were still skeptical of the data until Lovell was able to prove that the radio signal was coming from Luna 2 by showing the Doppler shift from its transmissions.[34][35]

Luna 2 site is near the right of the image, relatively close to the Apollo 15 landing site.
Luna 2 took a direct path to the Moon,[36] starting with an initial velocity from Earth of 11.2 kilometres per second (25,000 mph)[33] and impacting the Moon at about 3.3 kilometres per second (7,400 mph).[37] It hit the Moon about 0° west and 29.1° north of the centre of the visible disk at 00:02:24 (Moscow Time) on 14 September 1959.[17][38][a] The probe became the first human-made object to hit another celestial body.[39] To provide a display visible from Earth, on 13 September the spacecraft released a vapour cloud that expanded to a diameter of 650 kilometres (400 mi) that was seen by observatories in Alma Ata in Kazakhstan, Byurakan in Armenia, Abastumani and Tbilisi in Georgia, and Stalinabad in Tajikistan.[33] This cloud also acted as an experiment to see how the sodium gas would act in a vacuum and zero gravity.[22] The last stage of the rocket that propelled Luna 2 also hit the Moon's surface about 30 minutes after the spacecraft, but there was uncertainty about where it landed.[22]
Bernard Lovell began tracking the probe about five hours before it struck the Moon and also recorded the transmission from the probe, which ended abruptly. He played the recording during a phone call to reporters in New York to finally convince most media observers of the mission's authenticity.[38]

The radiation detectors and magnetometer were searching for lunar magnetic and radiation fields similar to the Van Allen radiation belt around Earth, sending information about once every minute[26] until its last transmission which came about 55 kilometres (34 mi) away from the lunar surface.[40] Although it did prove previous measurements of the Van Allen radiation belts that were taken from Luna 1 around the Earth,[40] it was not able to detect any type of radiation belts around the Moon[41] at or beyond the limits of its magnetometer's sensitivity (2–3×10−4 G).[42]
Luna 2 showed time variations in the electron flux and energy spectrum in the Van Allen radiation belt.[43] Using ion traps on board, the satellite made the first direct measurement of solar wind flux from outside the Earth's magnetosphere.[44] On its approach to the lunar surface, the probe did not detect any notable magnetic field to within 55 kilometres (34 mi) from the Moon.[23][40] It also did not detect a radiation belt around the Moon, but the four ion traps measured an increase in the ion particle flux at an altitude of 8,000 kilometres (5,000 mi), which suggested the presence of an ionosphere. The probe generated scientific data that was printed on 14 kilometres (8.7 mi) of teletype, which were analysed and published in the spring of 1960.[41]

![Image 1](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/9/94/Symbol_support_vote.svg/20px-Symbol_support_vote.svg.png)

Cultural significance[edit]
According to Donald William Cox, Americans were starting to believe that they were making progress in the Space Race and that although the Soviet Union might have had larger rockets, the United States had better guidance systems, but these beliefs were questioned when the Soviets were able to impact Luna 2 on the Moon.[45][46] At that time the closest Americans had come to the Moon was about 60,000 kilometres (37,000 mi) with Pioneer 4.[46] Soviet Premier Nikita Khrushchev, on his only visit to the United States, gave President Dwight D. Eisenhower a replica of the Soviet pennants that Luna 2 had just placed onto the lunar surface.[46][47]

In 1959, a Soviet exhibit of its economic achievements toured several countries. This exhibit included displays of Luna 2. CIA conducted a covert operation to access it to gain information. A team of CIA officers gained unrestricted access to the display for 24 hours, which turned out to be a fully-operational system comparable to the original and not a replica as expected. The team disassembled the object, photographed the parts without removing it from its crate and then put back in place, gaining intelligence regarding its design and capabilities. The Soviets did not find out, the CIA report being declassified in 2019, 28 years after the dissolution of the USSR.[48]

Luna 2 was a success for the Soviets, and was the first in a series of missions (lunar impactors) that were intentionally crashed on the Moon. The later U.S.-made Ranger missions ended in similar impacts. Such controlled crashes have remained useful even after the technique of soft landing was mastered.[49] NASA used hard spacecraft impacts to test whether shadowed Moon craters contain ice by analyzing the debris that was created on impact.[50]
The pennant presented to Eisenhower is kept at the Eisenhower Presidential Library and Museum in Abilene, Kansas, U.S.[51] A copy of the spherical pennant is located at the Kansas Cosmosphere in Hutchinson, Kansas.[52]
On 1 November 1959, the Soviet Union released two stamps commemorating the spacecraft. They depict the trajectory of the mission.[53]

body.title: The Day Pride Embarrassed Me
body.body:
One funny thing I have learned about competition is how quickly it can humble someone. I got to realize this during all these evenings' football matches that I usually played back then in one field not so far from my area. This particular evening, I was so full of myself in noise and confidence. I just scored the second goal for my set, and I started feeling like I just won the Ballon d'Or. I even looked at my friend and told him, “Beat that if you can.” Everyone around burst into laughter. I was feeling on top of the world. Just a few minutes into the second half, this same friend dribbled me so hard that those watching started shouting my name in mockery. Then he scored, and not long after, he scored again to equalize. Just a few minutes to the end of the match, he scored another goal. My set was eliminated. And I still remember how that evening felt for me and how blurry everything became. ![229601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/23tRxJ8Nr6iJSBFd5XrmMDPh2s6rVhatWZgKQnwSeZkjWfAdExBZj2FFX49dELQR2A2LB.jpg) I seemed not to forget that particular evening for a long time until it became the last thing that came to my mind. It felt so uncomfortable. And I have learned that one of the reasons why we challenged others is not because we are strong, but because we don't want to look small to them. Since then, I have become extremely careful of what I say. Because life can come at us so fast, in a way that it answers other people's prayers loudly when we boast too much. --- Thank you for reading. >

body.body:
## Happy almost weekend lovely hivers and my creative community 🥰💕.

![D5A7D4C4-70F5-4C3D-AEA6-B9753491579D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJpn7qjNz9e7R4JSfKMSH8eHeSdNyRDczsrFpx7v7LpGcchs2ibbBMKdR9Jx3rp.jpeg)

![AD89C0B7-774E-4B16-852F-B7354493E647.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x1NCxqtZosmmdHHJtANii2ghECPqDject9dpvbBuvXih8RL4XgkLRKUEUgjNWugq3bE.jpeg)

![2CB45429-E04C-49D0-904C-5522F452E883.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xL9KiTMHZ7EiPsQmqkJWV23JY7EGEkzhiushZLjedfLbru6UTGSxk42o36uLNnRfJ7b.jpeg)

Its already Friday here in my region and what can be better than a lovely weekend filled with good, healthy and enjoyable foods. Especially those new recipes we create through our imaginations running wild 😛 to bring them to our dinning tables 🍱.

Mangoes 🥭 are in season, calling on us to enjoy the best out of them in any way we could. And apart from eating them raw like other fruits 🍎 🥒🍉🍌, we can make smoothies, pairing them with either banana 🍌 or apple. Make desserts 🥭🍮 with them or even ice cream 🥭🍨 .

But in my today’s recipe, I have made a protein, fiber,  mango  🥭 brown beans side dish salad that can be paired with any food if you don’t want to serve it alone , because it very rich in protein, fiber and at the same time filling that you will feel so satisfied.

![3CDFEE81-E4E1-4F63-AC0F-8657A2B46434.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243ByFghyG8FUuGGPYeuzGtxTMaevyrhnwjNMMNA4JbYLWX8amTLGrxKiSj5PPj25juYY.jpeg)

This mangoes 🥭 brown bean side dish is bursting with sweet mangoes and creamy brown beans tossed with mayonnaise, red onions 🧅 and some fresh red peppers 🌶. Its a healthy , colorful and refreshing side salad 🥗 dish ready in just about 20 minutes since our beans has been previously boiled readily.

Below, I show you the simple steps you need to create this recipe in your home for a treat this weekend.

# INGREDIENTS:

![B52FB61D-375C-4BFE-AF6E-8ADD53925144.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMaCKGNMfiSrUn7qxthwNafLtT6csLJCGLKR4G5ui36dkWoHG7H2dcJ6edJwoCkAsuW.jpeg)

2 medium delicious not to soft mangoes 🥭 
1/4 cup of brown beans boiled readily 
1/4 teaspoon of salt 
1/4 medium size red onions 
1 tablespoon of mayonnaise 
2 fresh red peppers

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1.

![2A09C1B6-8620-4E7D-AD56-CF90B8094089.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245cqKMrKaZ1d5TFTMxDVkPBr1Nzkett8skRZuCKQDpcds4JeM3i3Bezat9qaCMT1sJw1.jpeg)

![82C52474-6931-4614-A61F-93F94F71C568.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALD9HJX8GmuK1PuzXA8Xu7rxkxnCRdz3Mt3uHQh8pdnubeGgBC4tZXJV6BDcdLY.jpeg)

We commence this recipe by peeling off the back of our already washed mangoes 🥭 to use the inner soft flash lights.

![031F79B6-8BF0-4691-991D-30F1925903FC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xen7og3sFufaCk8zmRrntG6pjd2RuTg4ZCaYL8RQY3VNpTh1FQVkn1PizRxoVkPYiaH.jpeg)

![0C4FD389-1D58-4B2C-A84B-3D677ED7294F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yTji5tKB8thUAGjofHAVR67f1xa3R3sVcHWFmLKG71hspWkV6Y9GW6cEJJvbAqfUtnp.jpeg)

![796F89AE-2CAD-4B22-8CF3-A232BC93FC75.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23s9kEctD6WPynXzgvNrTaHhm62j1TAWjyz9xxdWDvnMPSXhjnhd8oaGXf8mrQxJ48XDV.jpeg)

Then we cut the flash out from the seeds and dice them into thinly squares.

Step 2.

![5DF98F84-EB92-49BE-9062-276235AD91AF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgMmXhiBw9BTVmHnpA2S4Yjh9NVUNugyDN9i51cDr8fASqZDah96eWf1qAZRkbbXiyX.jpeg)

![9F2543D3-826D-46E1-9F76-650B5FB1A0BA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2kttYKdhi9gFxe7nBWZZcb4roJ5pg6dS4azExs1oJkVR5xxsj1G5dkXP2xXwoeFmig.jpeg)

![E7F50ACB-2D85-44DC-AB85-BD9FBEC309B2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245nBuEXcAua8z2uhP2ojy4bx2LfQhfDiS1fQvfJj67PdusECbXsbrMcR82TdepSgzbiU.jpeg)

We pour our boiled beans out into a plate readily 

Step 3.

![99A6E594-FAB5-4BC2-AA8D-518267076DB3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xAVtBAWN1CAGJhRA4msD5hFyReZFT7wf4Pmu2rsefTFoZMRVE6hXpLqobvhXSRCRBzs.jpeg)

![9D84CD90-07DA-48CB-8393-BF04AFE6F752.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALBi1XyHMMFvQg1y3ZxQWLxLV97EYjpvGLEFydxS1dyL9bFdp9i17wDjSAULnee.jpeg)

Cut our mayonnaise to measure a tablespoonful readily 

![E68917F1-5943-45B8-AA4B-F137C2DA9794.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL4YAQjH5gKpv3R6sNskXwrcAjUYQ87i7qS1wWAGwdqNG4EwVJ9X3gk18TQxEiJ.jpeg)

![C09B5462-72B7-4129-9896-D1ACB626C400.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23r1z2pgKUSEdHdPbKLc1uonJ3MJoiH8rtw8LdHmhNba3ox2qsyKz4tDKzkunWXCydE3X.jpeg)

Wash and slice the onions and fresh peppers.

Step 4.

![BC74E04A-C744-44F5-8FF1-4F16B8E39190.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uQtsabC8ZP1BgQGLuF9KEyAcLizZybaFgr7Uefe5Qb4CNPGia5YDf8jdTWg4717y8YJ.jpeg)

We now have our ingredients all ready above.

Step 5.

![548D3C89-A8C2-4827-84DB-578F8C8BCD9E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2CkPZdHCjoFBb8cuJ1ss8E8h6gcdP4ybDyhRMVJhRck4VBj6LNBFWNf5Ab4VF.jpeg)

Next, we add the mayonnaise in a heated frying pan 🍳 above.  And as it’s dissolving, we add our onions 🧅. Stir to incorporate them.

As above.

Step 6.

![49E862F0-6E35-4D2F-961B-243AE445E2C5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2ChJhdHrquWAZvk5ohh1BgLQ1jYb6F5y3vwTmPjLzSUGwrUd1a6u5Ad7SWJoJ.jpeg)

We lower heat, add our fresh chopped peppers and pinches  of salt . Stir to incorporate them.

Step 7.

![33F43B5E-5627-49A1-A0C0-4202AF848C77.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJpirqVMG1oG6hptAbc3G1TpVpVXhzRfERsH967iE1EhpfrZ76cGTMn7V6QSTnM.jpeg)

Add our brown beans to the mix, adding some drops of water 💦 to allow moist .
![76BF9305-076C-41A8-80E1-0A4E20C07DE5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uEua5CKvkiVFPxqGEX1bwbJem7PfGLcZXTDg993jn27WJuV6eWYa7NUmTc3CURZevD3.jpeg)

![DEACA058-2F87-4890-80F5-0EA3F7FC5E61.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242DNbbiwUKqKeq2Ta8Dar6bJn4UYGaqh2cuqcQoqPWuvtDPNCDcMoQnbwdjhMpvZVS32.jpeg)

We stir , allow for a minute and set it down.

Step 8.

![CBC9B0BF-DFC7-44F4-8D3A-D28025DF9DC8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xeg3NiAnD6gFphm9cR1WRmVy2E5QvRxTRWp8AqBhGKoT8WzxkFrtQagbGvtTpaeYhvz.jpeg)

![CDB98D0E-B3CE-4001-8FD4-B9D340931D3C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yd5n55AisECpZdX8PbNE6izQJ2U2QhByAGDk9ghE3Gf2j5wDUkyQ5nv8DEMTWD7cS1P.jpeg)

We add our chopped mangoes 🥭 into the seasoned brown beans, toss them together, incorporating finally.

![BC1F6D2E-8A1A-4B4D-AD60-93375413657A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xyZDYCYifVbVonSJ89YwwckLidg83eFeuwCj8NAzukRjgWvp3ZrwR12oxQYFWw4QfZ7.jpeg)

![AC9BC882-5EE0-4AE7-9497-95947E9C49D2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMeXwRTDYryFdvpvoZpnNcssBw2pdDRVBFk8b6U57RHwY1i4dU2VeyprxWRGRsba35o.jpeg)

![E89A5231-CADA-4BDC-BCE6-6C4DF06545D3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMeXwkvgqiwbQ9wmHaroFhMTPcPu9BvUDQwe9QiTrFviWo9XQi4YajJiTHw2EX7zcxD.jpeg)

Serve and garnish exquisitely for a unique mango 🥭 side you will always crave for .

![86E63E86-2019-4725-B2DB-0A497C579AF5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wqy3drfc1QoMiMQLa6sYXHP6e81Bixcjb1q2duzyYY3cjXRPkvwmAvgWeQnx8dDUjk4.jpeg)

Bursting with flavors with a delightful inviting colors, this recipe is a must try you need while mangoes 🥭 last in its season. Its simple, easy and will not take much of your time in the kitchen.

![0A06A948-17A5-413D-8A8F-8399113211E0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMo8rinHUBihJw2DhByjpq1riihqkb1w9zQ3XYMYrVBx7A255VNdrS4FXYq7MTVMyKV.jpeg)

Just make sure to shop for not too ripped mangoes 🥭 nor over ripped, but those still still famines for a satisfying crunch and deliciousness. And make it before hand to allow refrigeration for a chilled side dish everyone will enjoy.

### Espanol Version

### ¡Feliz casi fin de semana, queridos Hivers y mi comunidad creativa! 🥰💕.

![D5A7D4C4-70F5-4C3D-AEA6-B9753491579D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJpn7qjNz9e7R4JSfKMSH8eHeSdNyRDczsrFpx7v7LpGcchs2ibbBMKdR9Jx3rp.jpeg)

![AD89C0B7-774E-4B16-852F-B7354493E647.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x1NCxqtZosmmdHHJtANii2ghECPqDject9dpvbBuvXih8RL4XgkLRKUEUgjNWugq3bE.jpeg)

![2CB45429-E04C-49D0-904C-5522F452E883.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xL9KiTMHZ7EiPsQmqkJWV23JY7EGEkzhiushZLjedfLbru6UTGSxk42o36uLNnRfJ7b.jpeg)

Aquí en mi zona ya es viernes, y ¿qué mejor que un fin de semana estupendo lleno de comida buena, sana y sabrosa? Sobre todo esas nuevas recetas que creamos dejando volar nuestra imaginación 😛 para llevarlas a nuestras mesas 🍱.

Los mangos 🥭 están en temporada, invitándonos a disfrutar de lo mejor de ellos de todas las formas posibles. Y, además de comerlos crudos como otras frutas 🍎 🥒🍉🍌, podemos hacer batidos, combinándolos con plátano 🍌 o manzana. Preparar postres 🥭🍮 con ellos o incluso helado 🥭🍨.

Pero en la receta de hoy, he preparado una ensalada de guarnición de mango 🥭 y alubias marrones, rica en proteínas y fibra, que se puede combinar con cualquier plato si no quieres servirla sola, ya que es muy rica en proteínas y fibra y, al mismo tiempo, tan saciante que te sentirás muy satisfecho.

![3CDFEE81-E4E1-4F63-AC0F-8657A2B46434.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243ByFghyG8FUuGGPYeuzGtxTMaevyrhnwjNMMNA4JbYLWX8amTLGrxKiSj5PPj25juYY.jpeg)

Esta guarnición de mango 🥭 y alubias marrones rebosa de mango dulce y alubias marrones cremosas, aderezadas con mayonesa, cebolla roja 🧅 y pimiento rojo fresco 🌶. Es una ensalada 🥗 saludable, colorida y refrescante, lista en unos 20 minutos, ya que las alubias ya están cocidas.

A continuación, te muestro los sencillos pasos que necesitas seguir para preparar esta receta en casa y darte un capricho este fin de semana.

# INGREDIENTES:

![B52FB61D-375C-4BFE-AF6E-8ADD53925144.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMaCKGNMfiSrUn7qxthwNafLtT6csLJCGLKR4G5ui36dkWoHG7H2dcJ6edJwoCkAsuW.jpeg)

2 mangos medianos, sabrosos y no demasiado maduros 🥭 
1/4 de taza de alubias marrones ya cocidas 
1/4 de cucharadita de sal 
1/4 de cebolla roja mediana 
1 cucharada de mayonesa 
2 pimientos rojos frescos

# PASOS PARA LA PREPARACIÓN:

Paso 1.

![2A09C1B6-8620-4E7D-AD56-CF90B8094089.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245cqKMrKaZ1d5TFTMxDVkPBr1Nzkett8skRZuCKQDpcds4JeM3i3Bezat9qaCMT1sJw1.jpeg)

![82C52474-6931-4614-A61F-93F94F71C568.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALD9HJX8GmuK1PuzXA8Xu7rxkxnCRdz3Mt3uHQh8pdnubeGgBC4tZXJV6BDcdLY.jpeg)

Empezamos esta receta pelando la parte trasera de nuestros mangos ya lavados 🥭 para utilizar la pulpa blanda del interior.

![031F79B6-8BF0-4691-991D-30F1925903FC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xen7og3sFufaCk8zmRrntG6pjd2RuTg4ZCaYL8RQY3VNpTh1FQVkn1PizRxoVkPYiaH.jpeg)

![0C4FD389-1D58-4B2C-A84B-3D677ED7294F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yTji5tKB8thUAGjofHAVR67f1xa3R3sVcHWFmLKG71hspWkV6Y9GW6cEJJvbAqfUtnp.jpeg)

![796F89AE-2CAD-4B22-8CF3-A232BC93FC75.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23s9kEctD6WPynXzgvNrTaHhm62j1TAWjyz9xxdWDvnMPSXhjnhd8oaGXf8mrQxJ48XDV.jpeg)

A continuación, retiramos la parte blanca de las semillas y las cortamos en cuadraditos finos.

Paso 2.

![5DF98F84-EB92-49BE-9062-276235AD91AF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgMmXhiBw9BTVmHnpA2S4Yjh9NVUNugyDN9i51cDr8fASqZDah96eWf1qAZRkbbXiyX.jpeg)

![9F2543D3-826D-46E1-9F76-650B5FB1A0BA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2kttYKdhi9gFxe7nBWZZcb4roJ5pg6dS4azExs1oJkVR5xxsj1G5dkXP2xXwoeFmig.jpeg)

![E7F50ACB-2D85-44DC-AB85-BD9FBEC309B2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245nBuEXcAua8z2uhP2ojy4bx2LfQhfDiS1fQvfJj67PdusECbXsbrMcR82TdepSgzbiU.jpeg)

Vertemos rápidamente los frijoles hervidos en un plato 

Paso 3.

![99A6E594-FAB5-4BC2-AA8D-518267076DB3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xAVtBAWN1CAGJhRA4msD5hFyReZFT7wf4Pmu2rsefTFoZMRVE6hXpLqobvhXSRCRBzs.jpeg)

![9D84CD90-07DA-48CB-8393-BF04AFE6F752.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALBi1XyHMMFvQg1y3ZxQWLxLV97EYjpvGLEFydxS1dyL9bFdp9i17wDjSAULnee.jpeg)

Prepara nuestra mayonesa para tener siempre a mano una cucharada 

![E68917F1-5943-45B8-AA4B-F137C2DA9794.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL4YAQjH5gKpv3R6sNskXwrcAjUYQ87i7qS1wWAGwdqNG4EwVJ9X3gk18TQxEiJ.jpeg)

![C09B5462-72B7-4129-9896-D1ACB626C400.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23r1z2pgKUSEdHdPbKLc1uonJ3MJoiH8rtw8LdHmhNba3ox2qsyKz4tDKzkunWXCydE3X.jpeg)

Lava y corta en rodajas las cebollas y los pimientos frescos.

Paso 4.

![BC74E04A-C744-44F5-8FF1-4F16B8E39190.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uQtsabC8ZP1BgQGLuF9KEyAcLizZybaFgr7Uefe5Qb4CNPGia5YDf8jdTWg4717y8YJ.jpeg)

Ya tenemos todos los ingredientes preparados.

Paso 5.

![548D3C89-A8C2-4827-84DB-578F8C8BCD9E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2CkPZdHCjoFBb8cuJ1ss8E8h6gcdP4ybDyhRMVJhRck4VBj6LNBFWNf5Ab4VF.jpeg)

A continuación, echamos la mayonesa en la sartén caliente 🍳 que tenemos arriba.  Y, mientras se va derritiendo, añadimos la cebolla 🧅. Removemos para mezclarla bien.

![71E7B1AE-DFFC-4315-94EA-4B4FC3558E5B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tvAS8n9wALxMfK29Hd2Y8Zgnqe4UWxzC45sUWpRJ2hRbPfHJ1JXkfKT3dQuKYY394io.jpeg)

Lo mismo que arriba.

Paso 6.

![49E862F0-6E35-4D2F-961B-243AE445E2C5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2ChJhdHrquWAZvk5ohh1BgLQ1jYb6F5y3vwTmPjLzSUGwrUd1a6u5Ad7SWJoJ.jpeg)

Bajamos el fuego, añadimos los pimientos frescos picados y unas pizcas de sal. Removemos para mezclarlo todo bien.

Paso 7.

![33F43B5E-5627-49A1-A0C0-4202AF848C77.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJpirqVMG1oG6hptAbc3G1TpVpVXhzRfERsH967iE1EhpfrZ76cGTMn7V6QSTnM.jpeg)

Añade nuestras alubias marrones a la mezcla, echando unas gotas de agua 💦 para que se mantengan jugosas.

![76BF9305-076C-41A8-80E1-0A4E20C07DE5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uEua5CKvkiVFPxqGEX1bwbJem7PfGLcZXTDg993jn27WJuV6eWYa7NUmTc3CURZevD3.jpeg)

![DEACA058-2F87-4890-80F5-0EA3F7FC5E61.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242DNbbiwUKqKeq2Ta8Dar6bJn4UYGaqh2cuqcQoqPWuvtDPNCDcMoQnbwdjhMpvZVS32.jpeg)

Removemos, dejamos reposar un minuto y lo retiramos del fuego.

Paso 8.

![CBC9B0BF-DFC7-44F4-8D3A-D28025DF9DC8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xeg3NiAnD6gFphm9cR1WRmVy2E5QvRxTRWp8AqBhGKoT8WzxkFrtQagbGvtTpaeYhvz.jpeg)

![C55EF149-F71B-4541-BB69-776653EC8AE9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zbRuSe4cJzsLN4ALsA49TsNz9EWpRbQqq5t7AF7rVnBQyuQ9QzLdMZLxxYjdDHEf3wb.jpeg)

![CDB98D0E-B3CE-4001-8FD4-B9D340931D3C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yd5n55AisECpZdX8PbNE6izQJ2U2QhByAGDk9ghE3Gf2j5wDUkyQ5nv8DEMTWD7cS1P.jpeg)

Añadimos los trozos de mango 🥭 a las alubias marrones sazonadas, lo mezclamos todo y lo incorporamos bien.

![BC1F6D2E-8A1A-4B4D-AD60-93375413657A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xyZDYCYifVbVonSJ89YwwckLidg83eFeuwCj8NAzukRjgWvp3ZrwR12oxQYFWw4QfZ7.jpeg)

![AC9BC882-5EE0-4AE7-9497-95947E9C49D2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMeXwRTDYryFdvpvoZpnNcssBw2pdDRVBFk8b6U57RHwY1i4dU2VeyprxWRGRsba35o.jpeg)

![E89A5231-CADA-4BDC-BCE6-6C4DF06545D3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMeXwkvgqiwbQ9wmHaroFhMTPcPu9BvUDQwe9QiTrFviWo9XQi4YajJiTHw2EX7zcxD.jpeg)

Sírvelo y decóralo con esmero para conseguir una guarnición de mango 🥭 única que no podrás dejar de comer.

![86E63E86-2019-4725-B2DB-0A497C579AF5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wqy3drfc1QoMiMQLa6sYXHP6e81Bixcjb1q2duzyYY3cjXRPkvwmAvgWeQnx8dDUjk4.jpeg)

Rebosante de sabores y con unos colores deliciosos y apetecibles, esta receta es imprescindible mientras los mangos 🥭 siguen en temporada. Es sencilla, fácil de preparar y no te llevará mucho tiempo en la cocina.

![0A06A948-17A5-413D-8A8F-8399113211E0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMo8rinHUBihJw2DhByjpq1riihqkb1w9zQ3XYMYrVBx7A255VNdrS4FXYq7MTVMyKV.jpeg)

Solo asegúrate de elegir mangos que no estén ni demasiado verdes 🥭 ni demasiado maduros, sino que aún conserven ese crujido tan satisfactorio y ese sabor delicioso. Y prepáralos con antelación para que se enfríen en la nevera y así tener un acompañamiento fresquito que todos disfrutarán.

body.title: Two tables, two approaches to the same coast
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778204701-09093faeec2a.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/theobenn/seed-theobenn-2026-05-08/main-1-1778204701-09093faeec2a.png)
![main-2-1778204712-600ba8fc9914.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/theobenn/seed-theobenn-2026-05-08/main-2-1778204712-600ba8fc9914.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

Spent the evening moving between two establishments on the same stretch of water. The first was deliberate, the kind of place where you book months ahead and arrive in the suit you wore to the office. Terrace facing the hills, cars rolling past on the street below, wine that costs more than most people's weekly groceries. The meat was cut properly, the fries were hot, the whole setup functioned like clockwork.

Later, shifted to the harbor side. Different energy entirely. Seafood-focused, the kind of kitchen that specializes in oysters and langoustines stacked high on silver platters. The pasta came with lobster, real pieces, not shaved or minced. White tablecloth still, service still attentive, but the atmosphere felt less engineered. More relaxed. You could see the boats from the table, actual working vessels mixed in with the private yachts.

Both meals accomplished what they were supposed to. The first reminded me why these places charge what they do, the precision and the setting and the entire choreography of it. The second proved that sometimes the simpler option, the one focused on the ingredient rather than the theater, holds its own. The lobster was fresher than the steak was tender, if that makes sense.

Watches visible in both photos. Not intentional framing, just how the evening went. When you spend enough time at tables like these, the details become part of the background. The candles, the glassware, the weight of a good fork. It registers without announcement.

Will return to the first place next month. The second one I might visit more often.

Three office days in a row, and this one was the busiest of the three. A full, quite demanding day — the kind where the hours disappear into meetings and tasks and you look up and it's already evening.

Movement during the day was minimal. The step counter was patient.

## Evening detour — father's garden

Before the run, a small but meaningful stop: a visit to my father's garden to pick fresh lettuce. The kind of errand that doesn't feel like an errand at all. A doggy walk around the block rounded out the pre-run routine. By that point the counter already showed **6,200 steps**.

Out the door at 22:00. The route wound through **Črnuče** — past Gmajna, looping east towards Črnuški Bajer and back. Almost identical distance to yesterday, but the legs had more to say tonight.

**4.03 km** in **22:15** — average pace **5'31\

For once, the report goes up before the day is actually over. A small victory in itself.

I recently sat down with Iben Tranholm, and she said something that I haven't been able to shake since, that the West hasn't become more free, it has just become more fragile.

Could it be that we often try to fix what's broken around us with better laws and better politics, but the house keeps shaking because the foundation is gone? And Iben's answer is that it's not a political problem, it's a spiritual one.

body.title: Zehn Jahre
body.body:
Hallo Freunde,

ich habe die Tage etwas realisiert, ich habe vor zehn Jahren zum ersten mal von dieser Blockchain gehört, also von Steem damals noch, so lange ist es her. Ich weiß nicht mehr in welchen Forum es war, aber damals hat mir jemand von einem dezentralen Sozialen Netzwerk erzählt, bei dem man theoretisch Geld dafür bekommen kann um mit anderen zu interagieren. Manchmal denke ich mir, es ist spannend dass ich am Ende noch zwei Jahre gebraucht habe um hier aktiv zu werden. 

Effektiv bin ich dann durch @sempervideo hier gelandet, aber das hat dann nochmal gebraucht. Ich hatte schon einmal von Steem gehört, habe dann zwei Jahre später doch einen Account erstellt. Und das zeigt etwas was beim Marketing durchaus wichtig ist, meistens gewinnt man keine neuen Kunden beim ersten mal wenn man davon hört, das braucht und genau deshalb muss man dran bleiben. Irgendwann hat man von Sachen so oft gehört, dass man sich die Sache dann doch einmal näher anschaut. 

Und genau da ist unser Problem, wir sind nicht präsent. So dumm es klingt. Werbung im Alltag hilft dabei präsent zu werden und so im Hinterkopf der Menschen zu bleiben und wenn man nur Plakate an Kreuzungen mietet. Alleine dadurch kann man Leute gewinnen. Oder eben Radio Werbung oder Spotifywerbung. Aber das ist so eine Sache, man muss dafür Geld aufbringen und hat nur eine regionale Wirkung, aber ich glaube so kann man am ehesten eine Wirkung erzeugen. 

In dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl und welche Werbesprüche gehen euch noch durch den Kopf?

body.body:
![P1140413.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EokbEyKtv6KHogHcngjwYQm12FmHMcdwvqd32Tv4bD6Yn6mxjRZ8NPCPK6m85exPSF4.JPG)

As mysterious as the very origins of the Gothic style, about which historians still haven't reached a consensus, these supernatural, nightmarish beings, like functional ornamentation, occupy a prominent place in the highest parts of cathedrals, vying for dominance among the pinnacles and terrifying all those visitors who happen to look up to encounter them.

![P1140417.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23zRwBAZb2hZ45hMmq3mE2fHWbhwaU2gdBJevD3FY39WRkiPA4DtSXPoi9gMVemEkaf78.JPG)

They tend to be more acquiescent, perhaps following the romanticism implicit in the hermetic tradition, when they agree that the famous King Solomon—the same one who, in passing judgment, almost did the same as Alexander the Great, except that in a place where a Gordian knot was untied, the subject in question was a newborn infant fought over by two women—was one of the first to make use of similar demons, transformed into guardians of his famous Temple and subjected, through complicated magical spells, to his will.

![P1140454.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/244e3bLwjXNR2bt5apjLUfTojhiw7a96TTRVMmAH6KwimRzvpPbBxXesqmUh1oWMCcZpg.JPG)

Tan misteriosos como el propio misterio que envuelven los orígenes de un estilo, el Gótico, sobre el que los historiadores no terminan de ponerse de acuerdo, son también unos sobrenaturales seres de pesadilla, que, a la manera de funcional ornamentación, ocupan un lugar preeminente en los lugares más altos de las catedrales, rivalizando entre los pináculos y aterrorizando a todos aquellos visitantes que suelen levantar la mirada para encontrarse con ellos.

![P1140464.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EpEJHHm8Wt6u3THBAajH5FDFkfgCVudNaq3erDcC5kd8WWPB6naGVmh4uWLmLaLgiWy.JPG)

Sí suelen ser más aquiescentes cuando, quizás siguiendo el romanticismo implícito a la tradición hermética, suelen coincidir a la hora de ver en el famoso rey Salomón -el mismo que dictando sentencia estuvo a punto de hacer igual que Alejandro Magno, salvo que en un lugar de deshacer como éste un nudo gordiano, el sujeto en cuestión era un infante recién nacido que se disputaban dos mujeres- como uno de los primeros en valerse de demonios semejantes reconvertidos en guardianes de su famoso Templo y sujetos, por medio de complicados hechizos mágicos a su voluntad.

</center>
</liketuimages>

so i just got back from viña and honestly the transition is hitting different. like, you spend a few days just existing by the beach, sketching random stuff, having beers with no real schedule, and then suddenly you're back in santiago's chaos and your brain's still somewhere else entirely.

i hit up the market this morning just to ease back in, you know? needed that familiar grind of people and vendors and the whole vibe. grabbed some food, walked around like i was still on vacation mode. everyone's rushing, doing their thing, and i'm just there with my cap on, taking it slow, watching people move around me. the market's always been my reset button, even when i'm supposed to be productive or whatever.

the thing about coming back is that it's not instant. you don't just flip a switch and go back to normal life. part of you's still sitting at that beach bar with a sketchbook, cold beer sweating in your hand, the ocean doing its thing behind you. i was actually drawing while i waited for the sunset the other day—just doodling this weird cat character surrounded by stars. no real purpose, just felt right in the moment.

now i'm back and everyone wants to know what i did, if it was sick, all that. and yeah it was chill, but what they don't get is that the best part wasn't some landmark or anything. it was the slow hours. the sitting still part. the drinking and drawing and not thinking about what comes next.

still adjusting, but the market helped. maybe tomorrow i'll actually get stuff done.
