body.title: Birds of Grays Harbor: A Hoquiam (Wash.) Walk
body.body:
![IMG_7379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23ydGfzjJcNguvTDCyZzFfMP8DvbpToyUJUqAuv89BWG3vcZeJAarnwHoD2VB9jTchojz.jpg)

Tuesday afternoon I took a photographic ramble through my hometown of Hoquiam, Wash., to near the city limits on the bay of Grays Harbor, about a two mile journey.

I went looking for birds. The Grays Harbor estuary is a \

([source](https://whsrn.org/whsrn_sites/grays-harbor-estuary/)) Unfortunately, not thinking when I headed out on the spur of the moment, I picked the wrong time of day to catch many migrating birds. At two and three in the afternoon on a nice day, they're *migrating*, not seeking shelter in the estuary. But I did catch some good shots of our year round residents, and one notable return resident. Usually on my photographic rambles in Hoquiam I pick a location, a park or particular area on the bay, start out with my wide angle lens to photograph the landscape, and then switch to my 75-300mm zoom lens for wildlife shots. This journey was all about the wildlife (all birds). I used the zoom lens for all the shots and covered about five (depending how I categorize) of my favorite spots. I'll link to posts that cover those areas so you can see the context, if you're curious.
Hoquiam River Loop
![IMG_7331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tmG2CP3YHSy4t1879HmePYHa7KLwmapn4zDYJeFE2M7Ukax2XbAHtAav37yguKVNPVj.jpg) I started photographing along the [Hoquiam River Loop](https://peakd.com/hive-194913/@cliffagreen/walking-on-the-hoquiam-river-loop) in town, right next to the mayor's office and the dock for our tug boats. On the day after Easter, I ran across the first goslings of spring in that little triangle of grass above, and since then I have frequently seen that same family nibbling there. Those first goslings have reached their awkward adolescent (ugly duckling, to my mind) stage, but now two more families, with new babies, have started to gather in this spot. It's a perfect opportunity to photograph geese in their three life phases in one shot – don't they look like different species at each stage? ![IMG_7316-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23vi2Ac2XPyeHsP6m6eAP4sWdyqUp3jJPt4yMNSi45tty53VouZDmmpgSfDGtLxp1xjvN.jpg) ![IMG_7327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23wC5Znc2ecWqYHoNn4uKHpp4VhEu5H3BkebGccZtLNRUXa1ToNDjmof9p2GHvjRp6Lft.jpg) ![IMG_7319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tbuWgSUKKU1CtUX2Wyc3dx3v39JCayTEpsmpixa8kMcA9bFUycSLrpW3khATgnfDJCs.jpg) In the river by that triangle of grass where the geese hang out, between the tugboats and the riverbank, a great blue heron plied the waters. ![IMG_7348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23vi6BmcskXczLyrG7Djo71KAxYwkATRSptNrCRufuqLAwVrwTBSehXjPryn4WKr124EH.jpg) I find herons to be elegant and graceful in the way they move in spite of their gangly legs and neck. When I first started with photography for Hive (Steem, back then), I had only a point-and-shot Canon without much zoom capability. I have probably hundreds of shots of a heron flying away as I tried to get close enough to photograph it. Now, with the zoom lens, I can hang back just enough that I don't disturb them (though this one was still keeping an eye on me). ![IMG_7349.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/EoEq615a89u1AvSP4zfcgMHRZmM22pXjUJ2dCUUuiABATuP7W9Hk7NQCyTnodsoyMix.jpg) ![IMG_7351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tve98cLf9SPvWaDBi9fxHP8otdrwYghUNhPb1WCe1vNJNm6he1NZNuX6v8TLYo78Wan.jpg) ![IMG_7353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23u61B8N6CTaUAuAUp7GtpnTa9HZGJjfDHYAEe9qxN7WQNMfRHJkoFCexjToZcLc7cdV2.jpg)
The Rail Yard
I continued along the river not seeing many birds, except for the goose in the headline photo. At Simpson Avenue Bridge I left the path to trespass through the rail yard. I often photograph the riverbank beyond Simpson, but that's slick, treacherous going and I was making time to get to the bay, so I took a shortcut. It seemed a couple of geese had the same idea, passing through the rail yard from one section of riverbank to another. ![IMG_7391.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23ynUgTAhetKwoWKYC5JnMUGrefZnWXV3Q9eztCf9fJ4AUb31Jnd7JYfS61mPwDo3AB44.jpg) I almost captured a killdeer on a pile of gravel in the rail yard. I say almost because the killdeer is not quite as in focus as the rocks are. ![IMG_7386.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/EoEqaK9BmmrmZhBF3Cnx9KwpJ1W6VUfyMNkmRDdjvvcvBNQqwWzuAc4hJzccXrRX4Ny.jpg)
Dog Marsh
By following the train tracks, I arrived at the entrance to [Dog Marsh,](https://peakd.com/wednesdaywalk/@cliffagreen/wednesday-walk-to-dog-marsh) bordered by the Hoquiam River and Grays Harbor bay. I walked along the gravel path atop the embankment on the outside of the marsh, and discovered two cormorants drying their wings on a log at the mouth of the river. (Rennie Island in the bay serves as a backdrop.) ![IMG_7410.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23xpErQywfcs6JE3WHKHJZr1Uozpchy5GbPZqQdzrZJ75VSszTcJ6i4nvMnM6CrsCPcrJ.jpg) ![IMG_7411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23wMcP9mYBH3xy2RVKpnnRE5bKsc3YGqxkxjqpUJ5yqG8eK9EWYqKVjeSdocPVNwpRMuX.jpg) That seagull insisted on photobombing my shot of the cormorants, drifting back and forth in front of the log they perched on. I waited and waited for it to leave, and finally just decided to include it. The gravel path curves around to follow the bay west at the mouth of the river. At the curve I took another shot of the cormorants (finally sans seagull!), with the [Port of Grays Harbor terminal](https://peakd.com/hive-127238/@cliffagreen/industrial-dawn-in-hoquiam) in the background. I couldn't quite get high enough to separate the top of the one cormorant's head from the riverbank in the composition. ![IMG_7451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/EpGSfnjLQiUgtQUtfdghSGSxwFVRbjUYGipb756KDPa5cBXEUfVvcDkh9jGnQwjy3CL.jpg) Inside the marsh, a Savannah sparrow briefly perched on a weed. If you expand the photo, you can see the yellow stripe above its eye, which is a distinguishing feature of this species of sparrow. ([source](https://www.allaboutbirds.org/guide/Savannah_Sparrow/id)) ![IMG_7454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tvcK6ZKWxa3GcZ5c4E7EB3gBpfqFFX45TtCeFYq2W8aidfMJhYxTtaSDsaoJbjBSqbj.jpg)
A Regal Interlude
From Dog Marsh I returned to the railroad tracks, walking the ties to get to Eighth Street and Earley Industrial Way, which serves as a kind of bypass around the residential neighborhoods of Hoquiam. The plan was to walk about a mile along the road to Fifth Street and Old Cannery Park on the bay, where I thought I would surely run across some shorebirds. But, first, just before Eighth Street, I encountered this robin looking regal in the grass behind the drivers' license branch. ![IMG_7462.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tSQAnJxo4GEVuCkYFfnQF9CJgRDZxZg1C7S7YeijhWWGa6Zrn2o2WF9izPkYc18sVWs.jpg) ![IMG_7465.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tH3HYPXnRzQbBEU4DLbd4fCbihZobrF4av3vDbv6EETBNeCQABP9ms1B2ndBRXikUCM.jpg) ![IMG_7466.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tH1Hk6CXpWCEkogvx4UjaNHnTo6mkS1X4vM4KcuhUdqeDj8oVrBr2ZuivMemm37tgZH.jpg) It's fascinating how the robin perches on one leg with the other curled up. When I was working up the photos, I thought at first that our regal robin was missing a leg. But the final photo of this series (with some kind of out of focus sparrow) shows it has two. ![IMG_7469.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tHBp4nZm8k281tgNzpYdjvswPvb5CMEmRh67yBWvJ4puqZgD2iDT5waFYf75HGbVhtg.jpg) ![IMG_7470.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tSYcsXdvQBkCvqTjRPfbBXeXcWDAZ1H61v3VNwTeYhVWS2kLY57rho3pbf5ALiPkGAN.jpg) ![IMG_7471.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tSb4EUFyXycS8MEZnNme2wKmajJXdo55EceCq1F1XiwDSokWpEBVUo7FrLndiMiCcKp.jpg)
Old Cannery Park
Earley Industrial Way passes over grassed upland well off the bay to Fifth Street, which passes through a sparsely built industrial park to meet the bay again at [Old Cannery Park.](https://peakd.com/hive-194913/@cliffagreen/a-visit-to-old-cannery-park) I either didn't see many birds as I walked along the road, or I was so eager to get to the park, where I thought I might meet up with a flock of migrating birds, that I didn't didn't notice any. I took immediate notice as soon as a vista opened on the bay at the edge of the park. A Caspian tern hovered about 20 feet above the water, not more than 25 yards out from shore. ![IMG_7500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/244eGkRzNwgcLrrVejmGnKWZsNgXabNAiHV4GvTJCMpA4JHFXBq1d7DTicD2So1bPj8ER.jpg) ![IMG_7479.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tHNVPk8NXP7UTX3YpTiecevzcE4spEX8AYoVYSEJ78UsbJnPonndZtpxhh1SxaVHzQ9.jpg) ![IMG_7528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23yx1dsjGJC3e8xW7DiV5pfu3mAbzTtwxMJTVCpXVVtzyKZE4pBrm2QLTXqeDftv6Lger.jpg) The Caspian tern is by far the most exotic bird I've captured in a photo in my eight years of photography. I don't think I've ever seen one, let alone photograph one. In preparing this post, I thought sure the tern was one of the migrating birds moving through the area, but it turns out that, while they do migrate, the Washington coast is a breeding ground for them. In fact, according to the [Cornell Lab of Ornithology website](https://www.allaboutbirds.org/guide/Caspian_Tern/overview) where I got this info, \

So, it's an exotic bird to me only in the sense of strikingly exciting, only because I hadn't seen one before. The Cornell site (link above) describes their fishing technique: > To locate prey, they fly above water, between 10 and 100 feet high, and scan the water with bill pointed downward. When they spot prey they dive rapidly, usually submerging the body in the process but sometimes snatching the prey from the water without diving in. They usually consume fish in flight quickly after capture, unless the prey item is intended for the mate or chick. That's exactly what this tern did, except it never flew as high as 100 feet. Most of the time is was about 20 feet high and only about 25 yards from the shore. It moved slowly along facing the wind, then cycled back around in an oval shape to start over. ![IMG_7494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tmU8sWb82bjpH5pdQcV4UgeuAynTMSV8XRShvG5peyrvCQvckKaE5C16SLFbTHFFiqn.jpg) To the Cornell description I would add that it hovers just before it dives or when it spots something. It's hovering in the following three photos. ![IMG_7487.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tc7xkkeccRrmbR4WAJ9XgSZDqQpQg1aZ96QEr6Ybj7W1WaoT4V6HC8noT2xizoUvgsS.jpg) ![IMG_7488.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tc7fKgbxCwgBSvBupXYg6XkqivSk2CDt6JpYzc1XYQ5EoSmwP113F6FLxwrsBPyFLaY.jpg) ![IMG_7489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tShEKWvU9m1WD39LxMWUe6JNbtR5EVjeemj82CGPW6obL8B7fXEvBQCDGHrxjG7diET.jpg) This one shows the hover just before a dive. ![IMG_7527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23uFeARFMUErJiMsB4WAp8Xrd3RuoFwXamUq43Mi5iNP7U4UPJeJDAJki2uo1bm4r3J7w.jpg) I saw it dive and plunge into the water twice. I missed the first dive because I had still had the camera on single shot mode, and I was moving too fast for the autofocus. As it circled around again, I made adjustments, increasing the shutter speed and switching to continuous multishot mode. Then it dove again, not more than 20 yards away from where I perched on the bank. I didn't photographed the drop, but focused on the spot where it would enter the water and started shooting when it entered the frame. It was moving so fast it was almost in the water before my finger got the button pushed. ![IMG_7505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23sxSeCLWiagdVbyWBri8SHQe3jcTGC7ZsLcb9C3UzHG72ZJcdCD7EGw6wS9PLZqQnKq7.jpg) I rendered the entire sequence of the dive and fly away as a GIF, so you can see the action. This is every (unedited) shot the camera captured, while I sat there depressing the shutter and holding my breath. ![Untitled-1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23sxSeCLWiaghPLyvdgSLWru3EzuK5MH1VroiJhf4o3eAYPJedcUTKKYvvPaLjsdXyPfE.gif) I don't think the tern caught anything. None of the photos show a fish. Here are my favorite photos from the fly away, fully processed. ![IMG_7512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tmQFLZ9DgFH7XeVkQwjxEwKFuq4kWkDyMAN2CQNtS8hzZ9vwYTLBtWdaGrjAEWaU1PN.jpg) ![IMG_7513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tmQ69ba5aUdNcf3XnHiEGG9veJAMGZLYnYLviQiVWWwJEyejCBAFmf5n76FdwLA3kz4.jpg) ![IMG_7515a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tSch8KxxMk1KKiDn5DARDqgmxNq9WdWGLtFB9nemfwo99syxpMPc2PBnAc83j8FhbW8.jpg) ![IMG_7516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23sxSVQKtTMhrX1crHZ6YX4K8v8ovsxK4vh1DHtaBSqqbfv5rRFEsnZaaHo9uc9eRWFGp.jpg) ![IMG_7517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/EnyxkWAVQNCWUnegEexfwK57bV1HREvuE8aBNocvYjSjF1g6AGeRhfzoL1M5WMkkZRa.jpg) ![IMG_7518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23sxQhuAB7ZA1w9TUG24sMkWRPmpGgLYBSU5jAPcKFjieKdQ8d9SpohaTamCAhWvXurcq.jpg) After the dive, the tern made maybe one more circle before winging away east, across the bay toward Dog Marsh. But before we leave the tern, I have to share the very first shot I took of it … with another photobombing seagull! ![IMG_7474.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23viCZbGHyLDynBDdudasBcbKtzGqha9ypXAQmDDqCjDYhiGvGUqUxbxXwtLk1h1ytN8x.jpg) The seagulls apparently really wanted their picture taken. So I obliged, composing a shot of them lined up on this piece (whole tree) of driftwood at Old Cannery Park. ![IMG_7541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/242hctXLLX4HokyYa1nTrhme3rfQpxm6ArFn6kyrX4NMF2WuvuGeNzHYchkg9bdLn8DpT.jpg) That log of driftwood is a relatively new addition here; often I see the seagulls perched one apiece atop those dock pilings.
Willis Enterprises and Moon Island
After the Caspian tern, the rest of the afternoon felt like it would be anticlimactic (and it sort of was). But I kept going a bit longer, hoping for a few more species to round out the post. I returned to the road and walked another half mile to the port terminal at [Willis Enterprises,](https://peakd.com/hive-147010/@cgcliffordgreen/willis-enterprises-at-work) where they load wood chips onto barges. On the chain link fence around the port facility, this red-wing blackbird posed for exactly one shot. ![IMG_7547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23wCQHq8A7ptQTgKAJFBYWv3buXczfz2uYM75uoEFVgPP3BEX3HrgWjjMCmVnDByQ6VyF.jpg) Just past the port facility, at the edge of Moon Island (which was an island but got built up into a peninsula so they could build an airport), I went down to the water to photograph the cormorants hanging out on the channel marker and buoy. ![IMG_7554a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23wCJKK5aM9tL3gJ8S236acn6nnwuF8zSekBS4hxGqfVpd8yG19Dw5qEgh2nKoMGjHTze.jpg) The cormorants often have every level of the channel marker lined with nests, but at the moment only the second level (from the top) has a nest, which you can barely see even if you expand the photo. I thought that the cormorants would make a nice ending to the post, but then when I was heading home, retracing my steps on the road between Willis Enterprises and Old Cannery Park, I paused to photograph this pair of mallard ducks. On my first pass through there I startled them away before I noticed them. This time I stayed well back to photograph them (and then practically tiptoed when I went past them.) ![IMG_7580.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tH5euWFCmpZgbbU89B9NVg2ThbFHyLU9jpnQZ9JC8PR3j9beXx9seoRk6uht7rBzRtW.jpg) The male was standing guard and she wasn't moving, at least not the second time I went past them, so I wonder if she is sitting a nest there. It's awfully close to the road, but I guess it's possible. At any rate, I sure wasn't going to disturb them (again) in order to get close enough to see.
A Decent Birding Count
In the end I photographed nine species on the walk, and made one spectacular (for me) capture in the Caspian tern. Not the shorebird and migratory bird extravaganza I had hoped for when I set out, but I like the more commonplace birds too. So all in all I count it a pretty great day.
Thanks for viewing!

body.title: Korea Actor And Singer Jang Kang Suk And Playing Rising Star Game
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvPPu93AqYWqqwxA1YF9KYu7ikiLcR8VVr8Z4bjZTRpu/1778273796574.jpg)



[Image Source](https://share.google/9tv8bxYFAvkpO8oyI)



Hello, I mostly talk about korea kpop groups .But this time, I want to talk about korea actor jang kang suk. He is a korea actor who is also a singer. But his songs are more famous in japan and china than korea. I also knew him more as an actor than singer.

body.title: Incomprehensible, unconditional harmony.
body.body:
Incomprehensible, unconditional harmony. Incomprehensible harmony—that's the phrase, or rather, the meaning, with which I want to begin this post. After all, if you think of a car engine, or any other engine, where all the mechanisms, piston assemblies, valves, camshafts, carburetor, and spark plugs all work in harmony until they fail, lol, you can't call that unconditional harmony; it's all very conditional. Sometimes, under the hood, there lurks a harmony alien to the motorist, like when you can't repair the starter yourself or get to the oil filter without outside help. This harmony relies on certain standards and technical specifications that people have spent countless resources on, but they can't ensure consistent harmony. ![1ag009D2C.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZeB1aQHycWau6KvLLb6nQsDXFFHzPjBztCTvWqrmP6cR/1ag009D2C.png) ![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/3b9bf91876265882735377a264cc32074c4b2f4fe9fb5c73ecffd66f1e0cf322) In nature, harmony has no conditions; it can simply be completely incomprehensible to us at times. However, regardless of our understanding, animals care for their offspring in complete harmony, regardless of external factors. ![1ag010D2C.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmRvKD1w8ivNTprkddeRy45NfRUHdnPWJ9hUKHCinNBC11/1ag010D2C.png) ![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/a0f263c5d9e93a42960269d16450f894e91bf1049e293d2fd464ba14db95c332) I will only be able to understand this harmony when I understand how a butterfly perfectly hides from our eyes on the surface of soil excavated from a deep trench during construction... apparently, harmony, unconditional harmony, foresees everything in advance and creates the necessary balance for each specific situation. ![1ag011D2C.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXDCngJo8cBicgfgKUr6LvdBggBTWPLHNGfBDy3X7yNsE/1ag011D2C.png) ![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/64218d032fb7f86aaecbc7ea6cf44b5e29a850d0c3faaf040ba0868e24349ad7) *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. body.title: Pretending To Be Okay Have A Hidden Cost
body.body:
I hide the fact that I’m not okay because I don’t want anyone to see me as weak. I hide my pain because I have so much to protect, responsibilities, the people I love. On the outside, I look fine. I laugh, I smile, I play my part. But inside, it’s a different story. I know this act is eating me alive, yet somehow, I feel like I don’t have a choice.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXBcNpFq96aczBDPjXN5V3gFZFAgvhB5XAQLjYVnjZuk8/1000213196.jpg 

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/silent-girl-face-woman-portrait-7740555/)

There are nights when I cry behind closed doors, when the weight of everything I’ve held in finally catches up with me. And then the next morning, I put on the same mask I always do, laughing, joking, pretending like life hasn’t drained me. That is me. I’m not as strong as I appear, but I’ve learned to hide that truth from the world. It’s easier that way, or at least, that is what I tell myself.

Pretending to be okay has a hidden cost. It steals moments of real connection, because how can someone truly reach me if I refuse to show them my reality? It’s exhausting, too, keeping up appearances takes energy, focus, and constant vigilance. Every smile I force, every “I’m fine” I mutter, chips away at me just a little more. Over time, it becomes a quiet form of self-betrayal. I’m protecting others from my pain, but in doing so, I betray my own need for honesty, for help, for understanding.

The thing is, pretending isn’t living. It’s surviving in a way that keeps the deepest parts of me locked away. I cope, yes, but coping isn’t the same as healing. It’s a bandage, not a cure. And the more I push down my feelings, the more they fester, waiting for a moment when I can’t hold them in anymore.

I’m learning, slowly, that being honest about how I feel doesn’t make me weak. It doesn’t erase the responsibilities I carry or the love I protect. It just makes me human. And being human means allowing myself to feel pain, to be vulnerable, to reach out when I need support instead of always carrying the burden alone.

So yes, I cry behind doors. Yes, I laugh in front of everyone. And yes, that’s me, not invincible, not untouchable, not perfectly okay, but trying. Trying to be real, trying to survive, and maybe one day, trying to let myself be fully seen without fear.


**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

body.title: A Journey Filled With Suspense
body.body:
It was a very funny and suspended incident when there is presence of mixed thought and feelings. You know the kind of situation you will find yourself and all what will be on your mind is how, where, what, does questions that you alone can’t give the answer will keep coming to you but all you have to do is to calm down and study the whole scenario then you will gradually know what to do.

Today was a very stressful one for me because it all started from yesterday night when i went for a program which was overnight in a church and i just have to but I didn’t put it in my mind that i will be travelling very early this morning so i went and we finished the program around 2am  in the midnight so immediately i had to leave the church and come home so i can have a little time to rest before i wake up and start going for my journey. 

I got home around after 3 in the midnight and immediately i laid on the bed whereas i need to start going out around 7 in the morning which means i must have woken up an hour before the time, i had to set alarm but i know that was a 50 - 50 chance of waking up to the alarm. I just got a sudden vibration from my phone and when i checked it was my friend who called trying to make sure i am awake and when i checked the time it was already after 8. I stood up to brush since i knew i am late already.

![IMG_4260.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayorkeys/23vhsGhN4zhmgA4m3Wm52fhzzvcgKn28v49u28JvrU17UdTfqjVBpHhWQxgunna9gXatf.png)
[Source](https://chatgpt.com/s/m_69fe4a983264819198edf2595edc72e7)

> *Image Designed with Ai*

So it doesn’t take me much time before I finished dressing up and i left home for the travel. Getting to the car park it was almost full and after me was just two people left to make us move and in no time it was full. Leaving the park, the rain started heavily and i was very happy it didn’t meet me at home. So as we were going the driver stopped by at the petroleum station to fill up his car and it was of reasonable amount.

We got to halfway and suddenly the bus stopped and all passengers were surprised because it was in the middle of nowhere, we didn’t know what was wrong with the bus ansd it was still raining then the driver got down and too a little keg then left without saying anything, 

*Was I Scared?*
At first it was looking like that but i came down from the bus, my thought was that the driver already made plans with people and they purposely made the bus stop at that point. I got down and i had to stay far away from the bus because i feel if anything should happen i can still run then find my way inside the bush but after some minutes the driver came back with the keg filled with petrol to top up and he said the fuel was exhausted before so he had to get a new one.

I didn’t want to take any action and after moving further in the journey the bus stopped again and this period i was angry and i got down then I had to take another car since It was already closer to my destination but i just spent extra money to get there.

My whole thought was directed to kidnapping but it was not so because i could read the situation. Patient and observation is also needed to get through things. See you all next time here..

body.title: Splinterlands: Climbing to Gold III and Upgraded My Saltwraith Bulkhead!
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZecpbHycdrH1kyuBcoffHB2rgwrXk3ALM6P864PYzMs2/Screenshot%205014.png 







This morning when I started to play **Splinterlands** I really wasn't paying a whole lot of attention to the league position in Silver. After a few matches in **Modern** I suddenly found that I had climbed to Gold III which was a pleasant surprise! You can earn more rewards in Gold than Silver although the competition can be a bit stiffer in this higher league.  Still, a very fun accomplishment!



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcQ667UWnUZq2nb4JLdBpAT6DyfjpgYfUk6veKwyCYWMq/Screenshot%205000.png 

And with the upgrade came the associated rewards:


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVSQEe5WzeB6hMCdsKg5MWnkASG8FZK79hvLXuF9bqg9d/Screenshot%204999.png 

My rewards for achieving Gold III were pretty nice this time around. Two **Saltwraith Bulkhead** cards  and two gold **Coralforged** cards.  Since I already have a level 5 gold foil those two went right up for sale. But the **Saltwraith** cards allowed me to level mine to level 4 adding an extra melee attack!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfHVynzBHK3bjbDP23G8TdzWAMuxarGftvb2tEpF4EQYR/Screenshot%205001.png 

When I first got this card I didn't pay much attention to it. That was until I needed a cheaper tank in **Life Splinter** and tried it out. I've been a convert and use it regularly ever since. Finally reaching level 4 was exciting, as it's even more powerful now and a bigger threat to opponents.  Since my archons only handle level four rare cards it's as far as I plan to upgrade him. If I were to upgrade to a stronger archon at some point those plans may change.

The big downside to the card is **Weary** meaning it has a ten percent chance of becoming exhausted every round. At level three it picks up **Oppress** where it does double damage to non attack cards. At level five it picks up **Armored Strike** destroying the armor of an attacked unit. At at level ten it picks up self heal, but unless you play in Diamond or Champion you likely won't ever get to use that ability. I wish that came at level three!

I used the upgraded card in a few matches, and this one was pretty interesting!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVRphAPaqqVMFHuyDQz61XScZJ2Qn3ERPRQf9zpLKurHG/image.png 

Time to see the upgrade in action with the five melee attack!

You can see the whole battle at this link  [here.](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_cc4daf714a30193812cb06eff39d7695) 






 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXtDtVJ4LRZmzMxBj1k9d2nRQpNh4G1vZpZrtZuKkoUBk/Screenshot%205003.png 

This is a battle in **Modern**  with a mana cap of 52 and rulesets of **Super Sneak** and **Might Makes Right**. That means that all melee cards not in first position will attack the last card on the opposing team and that only units with three or more attack power are available for use in the match. The screenshot above was taken after the buffs were applied but before the action had started. 

For my team I chose **Incessant Sage** as archon giving each of my team members one extra shielding.  I chose **Doomshield Warden** as my tank which would normally give reach to the second team member, but the rulesets cancel that out. Next up I used the underappreciated **Saltwraith Bulkhead** and then added some magic with **Mindless Thrall**. Then some more magic in the mix with **Nessa** who also happens to be a flying type which is always a huge plus as it causes missed attacks. To round things out I put in two cards that were destined to be beat up but would put up a good fight, first **Luceheim Demon** followed by **Halfling Refugee**. 

My opponent chose **Kaylia Silverleaf** as archon and **Folen Flameye** as tank. Next up was the formidable **Lord Thanalor** and then the ever nasty **Grove Doomblade**.  Then we have **Buttercup Mauler** who is pretty nasty despite the name with **Swell Spore Beast** next up. **Lioceros** came last as a nasty little surprise with those thorns...

To be completely honest I thought I might be beat when I saw the lineup I was up against, but my team managed to soldier through and get the win.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTQtb2JEN2Ty6g36Sx4LM8eQhaGrpT25C7Aou2WtEdEk8/Screenshot%205004.png 

Here just showing the nasty attack of **Saltwraith Bulkhead**, that five melee attack is painful!

By round two my **Halfling Refugee** is down for the count...


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUYq8Ec1hVt37PgvuSmsAE8txf8aYRkHQ1gomVuPXgprb/Screenshot%205006.png 

Again **Saltwraith**'s nasty attack finishes off **Lioceros** but pays a price with those thorns!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTz4s6N47imSYaFVEzAHaFR1ZqxViBcwPk6jhtB12c5bc/Screenshot%205007.png 

By round three the field is slimming down quite a bit.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSVtiXLKkaugSef7cSSTiM6fzt9bBuKVkY5A2hj852Cpx/Screenshot%205008.png 

And again **Saltwraith**'s nasty attack on **Lord Thanalor**.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdNnU8fD6kEQ4qq5AerYJA7WBbztRX59DL5ATEvRWjy1Z/Screenshot%205009.png 

Round four not much change... Been getting misses on both magic cards though thank goodness!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW6BDwqFscY2tmHKuuGF2f1FoW5FxKomdsfotFvzmQ2H1/Screenshot%205010.png 


Round five and things are looking a little bleak for my team as **Saltwraith Bulkhead** has gone down.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbc3fssAowkNWtxki6ZRqUmTxDyt97jFfW7yRpxki55ca/Screenshot%205013.png 

Making some headway here in round six weakening **Grove Doomblade**.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPcdCbhvmVY3pu4JuBaqPijcme2RweWStQjK5nCgMmogq/Screenshot%205011.png 

But thanks to the heavy magic attacks and misses I am making a comeback, by taking out **Buttercup Mauler** the game is is all but over.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeJ5dacCB1pSwNpz3gbA9wSYVz1Rg2ToaDzXNUKiYbsKU/Screenshot%205012.png 

And **Nessa** delivers the the deathblow sealing the win for my team. Great game to my opponent!  I'm lucky to have pulled out a win on this one! The speed and phase of the **Mindless Thrall** along with **Nessa**'s flying saved the match for me. But still I had to chance to show my leveled up **Saltwraith Bulkhead** in action, his attack carries quite a wallop! It's always fun to have a new toy isn't it?

body.title: When AI started wearing human face
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXafmDQbeSJNZoTnAqpeqwfMVdM4hVFDsFESxptduJZud/1000238973.jpg 

There is this image that I stumbled upon today together with a report that follow it and, I tell you what, this is one of those reports where you really pause for a moment and wonder where the world is headed, or more accurately, where technology is taking us to. An AI bot is impersonating a medical professional? Not just that. It went one step further. The AI bot impersonated a fake identity to scam people who were looking for psychological help. 

We are no longer talking about AI-generated text or just aiding performance with certain tasks. This has gone beyond that. Once the AI begins to truly wear a human face, the consequences it would pose for certain sectors such as healthcare would be altogether another thing. That is the point where things start to go really wrong.

Imagine you are a psychologically disturbed person seeking psychiatric help and believing that you are in safe hands, only to find out that the person who is supposedly giving you the right help is actually an artificial bot and fake. That kind of fraud cannot only just affect you technologically but emotionally and would inflict far more damage than just the wrong kind of advice.

My fear is that many people will also fall victim to this. Not everyone will have the ability or expertise to authenticate any claimed qualification, more so when the AI has been trained in a way that makes us believe whatever it says due to its human resemblance. The more advanced it gets, the more it can be difficult to differentiate from humans.

If AI can take a human form on the screen today, we have to think about how it will ever look like when it finally comes to having a physical or more advanced visual representation in the future. Human face, human voice, human profession; everything which makes us have confidence in an individual could easily be abused.

This is not just about how much our technology can progress. This is about trust, safety, accountability and so much more. There are clearly defined boundaries that AI should be made to follow regarding anything where a human’s life, feeling or judgment is on the line, and those boundaries should indeed be clear. Procedures for confirmation must be put in place and must be readily available to people in a very understandable format. In addition to that, it must come with some sort of guarantee of accountability in cases of misuse.

I am certainly not suggesting we avoid technology altogether. I am very well aware that the use of an AI will be highly beneficial in society. However, this incidents show that if technology is used without caution, it can quickly become a tool for abuse to those in distress and seeking help.

So I ask again; Where exactly is technology taking us to if we cannot be sure if the person talking to us is human or an AI pretending to be one?

body.body:
You’re right, intishar: **trading without a plan is just gambling with extra buttons.** The dangerous part is that crypto makes randomness feel like skill because one lucky trade can convince someone they’ve “figured it out.”

The strongest point here is the distinction between **risk-taking** and **blind risk-taking**. Risk is unavoidable, but position sizing, stop-losses, patience, and knowing *why* you enter a trade are what separate a trader from someone donating liquidity to smarter people.

Your image fits the message well too: one side is hype, rockets, and emotional crowds; the other side is timing, shields, and strategy. That’s basically the whole market in one picture.

A related InLeo post by [@yordan96](https://inleo.io/@yordan96/ripping-the-pump-my-strateg...) makes the same practical point from another angle: instead of chasing pumps, he waits for buyer exhaustion and uses a defined counter-trend strategy. Whether someone agrees with shorting or not, the key lesson is solid: **mechanical process beats emotional reaction.**

body.title: Why hesitate to take profit?
body.body:
>

Cryptocurrency market is a volatile market, and everyone knows it very well, and because of that many people fear entering cryptocurrency, and I think that it is very natural, as most humans want stability in life as well as in finances. Risk cannot be avoided in cryptocurrency trading. Instead of that, there are many people who are interested in trading and dare to take the risk, hoping that they can make fortune in the cryptocurrency market. It is okay to expect something good, but I don’t think it’s a good thing for people to expect something without any proper reason. ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYoMDdqWmPG61VyJfSXWC28kL3e9ivAu16Vw5a3RTf8tZ/ai-image-1778272794441.jpeg) picture generated by rafiki Without having good knowledge about cryptocurrency trading and not having any kind of strategy for trading is nothing more than gambling with money. In gambling, one can win money or lose money depending on luck or following the instructions of others. There are many cryptocurrency influencers who are good enough to influence people to bring them into the crypto market but don’t guide them properly, or some people think they are pros and don’t need to learn anything from influencers, even if the influencer wants to teach them. They think just buying and selling is not so difficult and don’t need many things to learn from others. In this world, nothing comes to us easily, and in case of money, it’s more applicable. Money always comes to the hands of smart people; smart people make the right decisions, and their timing is quite good. In the cryptocurrency market, timing is the most important thing, and at the same time, minimizing risk is something that should be considered carefully. I’m in the cryptocurrency market for 7 years, if I guess correctly, and my experience is indeed very little. With my little experience, I learned about this building, and I think that I have many more things to learn from the crypto market. Most of the people in the crypto market don’t have good knowledge about trading, according to my opinion. I have seen that most people enter during the bull cycle and they see bullish waves most of the time, and even in the bear market, after suffering great loss, they always expect the price of their cryptocurrency to reach the buying price at least so they can sell. DCA is a good strategy to minimize losses over the long term and ensure profit over time if it’s a good crypto, I mean fundamentally strong. During the bear market, they fear making investments, and when all of a sudden there is a 50 to 60% pump, they just think that it will keep pumping hard and reach the buying price from where they bought. Even after going up nearly 100%, they are not ready to sell even a little. There were also people who buy at a moderate price, and after a close to 100% pump they receive a good amount of profit, but they choose to keep it thinking that it will go up more. They end up keeping their crypto assets and later, at least 90% of the time, it has been seen that the price comes down again within the buying range. So those people end up missing the opportunity to secure their profits. In fact, many times, they suffer loss at the end. I found it quite funny because even if they are ready, they should minimize the risk at least. There should be no reason to hesitate to take profits. If they are not making profit, then what is the necessity of buying cryptocurrency? At least people can pull the seed money from the investment and leave the profit for making more profit. In that case, they may, in case it goes up, miss some profit, but it will ensure that they won’t suffer loss at least, and if the price comes down, they will rebuy it and increase the quantity of the cryptocurrency. At the end, I want to say: don’t hesitate to secure your profit or at least secure your seed money.

What Is Internet Computer  The $1 Trillion Cloud Challenger

The Internet Computer is a decentralized cloud blockchain that pursues the $1+ trillion cloud market  hosting apps, websites, and enterprise systems fully onchain, where they benefit from extraordinary security and resilience. A core goal is to evolve into a \

where AI builds sophisticated applications based on natural language prompts. Smart contracts on ICP can write transactions to other chains without any centralized intermediaries, enabling decentralized Bitcoin DeFi and multi-chain DeFi.  
No AWS. No Google Cloud. No middlemen. Just pure decentralized compute and AI that builds the apps for you.

Catalyst 1 Cloud Engines Demo on May 10th

This is the biggest near-term catalyst. DFINITY has scheduled a major demonstration of its \

technology on May 10, 2026  the network's fifth anniversary showcasing sovereign cloud technology, agentic AI builds, and dedicated GPU-backed AI nodes, aiming to position ICP as a decentralized alternative to traditional cloud hyperscalers like AWS and Google Cloud.   A live demo of enterprise-grade decentralized cloud infrastructure  backed by real GPU nodes  could be one of the most significant technical showcases in ICP's history.

Catalyst 2  Cloud Engines Burn ICP Tokens

This is the structural story that most people are missing. The new Cloud Engines economic model directs 20% of all engine revenue to buy and burn ICP tokens, while node providers earn 80% creating a direct link between enterprise network usage and token scarcity.   Every enterprise workload running on ICP's Cloud Engines directly reduces circulating supply. More adoption = more burns = less supply = higher price. That is a deflationary flywheel.

Catalyst 3  MISSION70 Kills Inflation

The MISSION70 governance upgrade, enacted in early 2026, targets a 70% reduction in ICP's annual token inflation  aiming to lower the rate from 9.72% down to between 2.92% and 5.42% by year's end  achieved through cuts to node provider rewards and the usage-based burn mechanism from Cloud Engines. The Internet Computer ecosystem has witnessed a significant achievement in 2026, with 295,777 ICP tokens already burned  a clear sign of growing network usage and increasing compute demand on the platform. **A short 3-minute film that will leave you feeling renewed and relaxed through the sights and sounds of nature. **


*Experience the awe of a hidden world on the edge of the Lincolnshire Wolds. Travel through three main habitats of Linwood Warren and meet some of its characters that called this home. Viewers will be able to preview their visit to this charming nature reserve and

See some of the species they are likely to see here, and in which habitat. This will be accompanied by relaxing, calm music and the sounds of nature.
*
# Linwood Warren
Linwood is one of my favourite small nature reserves in Lincolnshire. It has something to see year-round. In the spring and summer, it is filled with insects and birds such as butterflies and grasshoppers. In autumn, it is great for flowering heather, which is later followed by moody landscapes. Winter is also nice; if you are lucky, you might see a Woodcock hiding amongst the grass.


I have made this short film so you can experience some of its beauty too. I hope you enjoy it as much as I did.

body.title: DIY Cute & Easy Bookmark Making at Home
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaEBxkqZ9YUAfBV8cSxJ8WfnEk3gr81uK62Mxx6229rYt/1778271425245.jpg)

# Hey guys!
Hello friends, how are you all? I hope you all are fine. I am also fine. So friends, because of some busyness I was not able to make blogs for you people, but from now I will try to post a blog daily or after one day. So in today’s blog I have made a bookmark. It is very cute and useful and gets made easily. So now without wasting much time let’s start making this step by step.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVBZRgPSnqx1Rw2KircPvTVFa2siV15Bmm7zX4rvajNhA/1778271533538.jpg)

# Materials needed 
So to make this bookmark, the things needed are these: 
Ice cream sticks
Color markers
Foami clay
That’s it, only these three things are needed to make it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1JJB3GLSWkEYfoFVb4CrTMVvddDJAj5Nv5a2oV8rQuZ/1778271572935.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcCYoNvNzg7UH5krah4KV8q4pN8JUjz6fWNfrYTBvxs5d/1778271573072.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXRTuoysTYGSeZQRvTgxw5zvSxT1yZAEMrKE5awXWEPbd/1778271573200.jpg)

# Coloring part 
So to make it first of all I took 2 ice cream sticks because I am making 2 bookmarks. Now I colored both of them with my favorite colors. One pink and the other blue. And I drew beautiful flowers on them. And in this way 50% of our work was done.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWDtRF5a4T5gABxGvgnwDeQaFyjCqfs89Mp21difmvPfs/1778271623649.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbD2vtmLeZ9AP5bRXrY2yjxGw3VavP4qZuzJXRoKy5Ss2/1778271623778.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVZAoR3vfQkHVMmTmYzaB1SmmZ5xqrpyf9GTL7gQXnMre/1778271623916.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsGAau18t2isyNNz2XMtAcCH5iRBS9eZKq8Qr8mpr1wA/1778271624033.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXxJChEXkqDQegmgwLFdusJ4eMNWA6jptg7u15dmhvh1o/1778271624177.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsytJ3GtHqTJpN61FxBviRcNuZCaCCL7FEecn8qJZC6m/1778271671709.jpg)

# Flowers with clay
Now to complete the remaining 50% we have to make 2 flowers from foami clay. So for the pink stick I am making a white and pink flower, and for the blue stick I am making a yellow and white flower. So to make these flowers you have to make 5-5 balls from pink and yellow color clay and 2 balls from white clay. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWAMoUUpt8KaYy4BuR54GMJfBwDG77SvKM6jQCVMiC8PX/1778271805910.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUx4AiLiaZp2Kkbj8EJBds3soj3GqqH8X9t5bmWWfN9rZ/1778271826590.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZPVxGWk5xoGFaGefRYqhCVf1mhNQ51ZfNEK8aLBtPou/1778271784630.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd3cwoM4f5zQs17mHb8KFaos2peZV2H5uPRAt8THTSZaP/1778271784692.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXz2WkYAin9TrXt6ZK1F2dy5MgwCF1CoYByXFG7HcCKqV/1778271784758.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHBYMXUkbFEgvj4W4PNFEgYdWyZxoir8VbqZ6ua2Jnv5/1778271872942.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTGoXGnaLcuA7VeVZnvkDLa9HHYzVHGQEiSMbLJEDCbb/1778272003315.jpg)

Now assemble them and with the tools that come with the clay make flower patterns on them, and in the end stick them on the sticks. Now to stick them properly on the sticks first I put a little clay on the stick and then stuck the flower on top of it because of which the flower got stuck strongly. Then at last i added some stickers on them. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfWisN5aPMC3tYGT6vUSHG13VCpjYEAZ9LXHQrT5BuL4q/1778271892980.jpg)

# Let it dry
You have to keep it for 24 hours to dry so that the clay dries properly. And in this way our bookmark will get ready. Anyone can make it because making it is very easy, as I already said before.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZy2bSvKE11rDn3kE68kGSnJAJsDF3ujpwLZXmE9w4nrs/1778271978957.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbSMnsfgLa3ADbt69ZCisu19NHCKjgzuCB8WTebAU63rM/1778271979017.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcKf7fSmuCjfF5od2sQomjFW8jdYgArCWf6rgnH7L4Y9v/1778271979054.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQo4bRWrHgHCBkqYCH6s9qVBCDWYqay9zX22Mh65RPE2Z/1778271979114.jpg)

# Final result 
So guys, this is the final result of this bookmark. I hope you people liked it so if you liked it then do tell me in the comment section and support me like before so that I can bring good DIYs and good food recipes for you people.

***That’s all for today. I will be back soon with something new to share. Until then, stay happy and keep supporting.
Bye byee!***

body.title: stink bug (Eysarcoris guttigerus)
body.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Eysarcoris guttigerus*** | May 03, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZsazbcbeVHkJPGUqWEzLh35U4dD3Siqi5Da1QPuzqcGU/mix_20260509_012632.jpg)

It was May 3rd. I was walking by my pond in the afternoon. Suddenly, I saw a strange insect on a dry branch in the grass. Looking at the insect's back, I was surprised. It had two clear white spots on its back, it looked like it was looking at me with two eyes.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb7XMuybpDWiNngXmmxh7GyDcRjpg7FUqupejAVpHU5BA/mix_20260509_012247.jpg)

After taking the picture, after a little research with the help of iNaturalist, I found out that it is actually a type of *stink bug*. Its scientific name is ***Eysarcoris guttigerus***. They are easily recognized by those two beautiful white spots on their back.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRq8qWKedmV7Gt8qxxHaD8N6uGsB39NgfAUpRDny9YHt6/mix_20260509_012810.jpg)

I thought I would share some information about this interesting insect with you, which I have read about them on various sites.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb8va4VY3qCzB3TNikUqFycmn1Lw8oLL9PHcw9B4Q2GSL/mix_20260509_022521.jpg)

Where they live: They mainly like to live in slightly damp or humid places. Their favorite places are the banks of our pond, grass, weeds or crop fields. They do not run around much, most of the time they prefer to sit quietly under leaves or on branches.

What do they eat: There is nothing to be afraid of, they do not bite or harm humans. They have a long, narrow, needle-like proboscis in front of their mouth. With this proboscis, they suck the sap from young leaves, stems, and seeds of grass or crops.

Reproduction: The mother insects lay many eggs in clusters on the opposite side of the leaves of the plant. The eggs look like small drums. After the eggs hatch, they change their shells several times and gradually turn into full-fledged winged insects.

Interesting fact: There is a big reason why they are called Gandhi insects. If you try to catch them or they are scared for some reason, they secrete a very foul-smelling substance or liquid from their bodies to protect themselves. Because of this smell, many birds or animals do not want to eat them easily.

Hope you like it.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

body.title: What Real Friendship Truly Means.
body.body: Having a friend that truly cares about you is not so common. But when you eventually see a friend that can stand by you and defend you wholeheartedly, you truly need to appreciate such a person because you will hardly see a person like that. Friends, to me, are people that are not really perfect, and they might not have equal goals, but they have some kind of interest that draws them together. Being friends means that you are liable to correction and you are ready to stand for each other when you need each other. You are ready to support one another to make sure that you all get successful in life.

>Source When you have a friend that is really ready to help and support you in time of need, you are a gem because you will be able to run the race of life well. Because we all cannot live life just all by ourselves. This post I am sharing now is as a result of what happened between my friends and me recently, and the way those ones that are older amongst your friends will take matters up will make you amazed sometimes. I really don't keep friends, but amongst the little cycle of friends I have, I happen to be one of the oldest, along with one other person. When issues happen, the ones who are the lower age will run to us for advice on whatever they are doing, and they will want us to guide them and put them on the right track despite them being adults. They believe we have a better understanding about life than them. Also, when it comes to seeking help, they will also come to us to ask first because they believe we have gone through the face of life a bit higher than them. Recently an incident happened, and I was not really aware of the situation. I got to know from my other friend that we were almost the same age range. He told me about what the others have been doing wrong, and before he told me, I had already heard some of the things from some people, but I had to defend him because he is my friend, and I know I can still scold him later and protect his image in public first. But it got to an extent that I could not protect him because I was not aware of what they were later saying, so I had to give up. I went back home and confronted him as my friend, and I told him how he has been tarnishing my image in front of people and what people have been thinking of him. Sometimes what people think does not matter if we have been doing the right thing. It will only just drive the audience more, and it will bring us to the limelight. But regardless, as a friend, you must be able to come up for your friends in times when it is needed and not when it is not needed because that is what makes you all friends. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@the-lead/what-real-friendship-truly-means-2qn)

body.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands – Enraged Warriors: Questions and Answers
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPMAxdvRKJd4bVPyAFvp89dBqdv86d5YhaAmqXVdZjN7t/Portada%20-%20Enraged%20Warriors.png</center>

<center>And after trying to resolve some of the doubts about **Outsider**, now it is the turn of the other **Ruleset** that arrived with the update of [**2026-04-28**](https://docs.splinterlands.com/platform/release-notes/2026#id-2026-04-28). This is, possibly, one of the most disruptive **Rulesets** for the traditional turn order of **Splinterlands**. Historically, **Speed** has been the absolute queen to determine who hits first, but lately **Rulesets** have been introduced that change this, and **Enraged Warriors** breaks that hierarchy by introducing a priority based on the **Attack Type**.</center>

><center>Y después de intentar resolver algunas de las dudas de **Outsider**, ahora le toca a la otra **Ruleset** que llegó con la actualización del [**2026-04-28**](https://docs.splinterlands.com/platform/release-notes/2026#id-2026-04-28). Esta es, posiblemente, una de las **Rulesets** más disruptivas para el orden de turno tradicional de **Splinterlands**. Históricamente, la **Velocidad** ha sido la reina absoluta para determinar quién golpea primero, pero últimamente se han ido introduciendo **Rulesets** que cambian esto y **Enraged Warriors** rompe esa jerarquía al introducir una prioridad basada en el **Tipo de Ataque**.</center>

## <center>Enraged Warriors </center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW6BqCZFXRijKeZx2hrJAXjyvgFnSTzyjszurLCqSoUAz/img_combat-rule_enraged-warriors_150.png</center>

- **Enraged Warriors:** Melee units attack before magic and ranged units. Speed turn order priority applies.

>- **Enraged Warriors:** Las unidades cuerpo a cuerpo atacan antes que las unidades mágicas y las de largo alcance. Se aplica la prioridad de turno por velocidad.

<center>Under this condition, **Melee** units attack before any **Magic** or **Ranged** unit, which seems like a minor change, but this restructuring can change a lot how the defenses and attacks of the teams are created. This also generates doubts about the order or priority of the attacks, especially by saying that **units** with melee attack hit before those of magic or distance damage and not saying that the melee **attacks** activate first than the others, leaving a doubt for the most curious.</center>

><center>Bajo esta condición, las unidades de **Melee** (Cuerpo a Cuerpo) atacan antes que cualquier unidad de **Magia** o **Rango**, lo que parece un cambio menor pero esta reestructuración puede cambiar mucho cómo se crean las defensas y ataques de los equipos lo que también genera dudas sobre el orden o prioridad de los ataques en especial al decir que las **unidades** con ataque cuerpo a cuerpo atacan antes que las de daño mágico o a distancias y no decir que los **ataques** cuerpo a cuerpo se activan primero que los demás dejando una duda para los más curiosos.</center>

Here I present to you the scenarios and doubts that this **Ruleset** can create:

>Aquí te presento los escenarios y dudas que puede crear esta **Ruleset**:

### <center>[Reverse Speed](https://splinterlands.com/battle/37f0f24e62d973bc92d5b281e5d3cfdcde3e4646?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>One of the first doubts about **Enraged Warriors** is its interaction with **Reverse Speed** since by inverting the speed it can also invert the order of the attacks, causing this new order of attacks to be taken into account when making the team.</center>

><center>Una de las primeras dudas sobre **Enraged Warriors** es su interacción con **Reverse Speed** ya que al invertir la velocidad también puede invertir el orden de los ataques, causando que se tenga que tener en cuenta este nuevo orden de los ataques al hacer el equipo.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmedWZkLDGkUH9UZ98sUZDVsiNsLPonAjGBKM22QCgpgzX/1%20V2.png</center>

<center>In this battle it can be seen and it is confirmed that the units maintain the inverse order of both the speed and the order of the attacks, so it must be taken into account that the **melee** attacks indeed will be the last to attack, but the **ranged** attacks will be the first to activate. This has its good side since the **ranged** attack can eliminate armor or **Divine Shield** to leave space for the other attacks and thus make the **melee** attack strike with all its power, which is good against enemies that have **Thorns** and armor to not lose so much damage.</center>

><center>En esta batalla se puede ver y se confirma que las unidades mantienen el orden inverso tanto de la velocidad como el orden de los ataques, por lo que hay que tener en cuenta que los ataques **cuerpo a cuerpo** sí serán los últimos en atacar, pero los ataques a distancia serán los primeros en activarse. Esto tiene su lado bueno ya que el ataque a distancia puede eliminar armadura o **Divine Shield** para dejar espacio para los demás ataques y así hacer que el ataque cuerpo a cuerpo pueda golpear con todo su poder lo que es bueno contra enemigos que tengan **Thorns** y armadura para no perder tanto daño.</center>

### <center>[**Attack order of unit with multiple attacks** | **Orden de ataque de unidad con múltiples ataques**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/87e1665875ede8e1388c53d720ed53d86e9625fd?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>Another doubt is how it interacts with units with multiple types of attacks and if **Enraged Warriors** gives priority to the unit but leaving the order of attacks or if it always attacks with the **melee** damage and afterwards the others.</center>

><center>Otra de las dudas es cómo interactúa con unidades con múltiples tipos de ataques y si **Enraged Warriors** le da prioridad a la unidad pero dejando el orden de ataques o si siempre ataca con el daño **cuerpo a cuerpo** y después los demás.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeoURuXfXfpeSuMnbH1a1nMGkSoK1bm4s2tWaaCsbVy1o/2%20V2.png</center>

<center>With this doubt I did **2** test battles and they confirmed that it gives priority to the units with **melee** attack but maintaining the order of the attacks, having all priority over the **melee** attack, although I do not know if it is a bug or the functioning of the units but it is something to take into account especially in battles where a specific type of attack before the others is key.</center>

><center>Con esta duda hice **2** batallas de pruebas y confirmaron que da prioridad a las unidades con ataque **cuerpo a cuerpo** pero manteniendo el orden de los ataques, teniendo todos prioridad sobre el ataque cuerpo a cuerpo, aunque no sé si es un bug o el funcionamiento de las unidades pero es algo a tener en cuenta en especial en batallas donde un tipo de ataque específico antes que los demás sea clave.</center>

### <center>[Attack order of unit with multiple attacks and Double Strike | Orden de ataque de unidad con múltiples ataques y Double Strike](https://splinterlands.com/battle/fc037dcd124fc7da3329c36a2d9478c63fef39bf?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>And another of the doubts of combining **Enraged Warriors** with a unit with various types of attacks is how its attack cycle works, if it continues the same: first the **melee** attack, the **magic**, and finally the **ranged** attack, or if it alters the whole order to launch the **2** **melee** attacks first and afterwards the normal cycle continues with the **magic** attack and afterwards the **ranged** attack and repeat the order.</center>

><center>Y otra de las dudas de combinar **Enraged Warriors** con unidad con varios tipos de ataques es cómo funciona su ciclo de ataques, si sigue igual: primero el ataque **cuerpo a cuerpo**, el **mágico** y por último el ataque a distancia, o si altera todo el orden para lanzar los **2** ataques cuerpo a cuerpo primero y después sigue el ciclo normal con el ataque mágico y después el ataque a distancia y repetir el orden.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSiQ4Zk7Uz1PkgZApGiBzgYDWgqRpLUDDVD1hPFJkUvMU/3%20V2.png</center>

<center>In this battle it is seen that with cards with multiple attacks and **Double Strike** they function in a normal way in both the order and the attack loop.</center>

><center>En esta batalla se ve que con tarjetas con múltiple ataque y **Double Strike** funcionan de manera normal tanto en el orden como el loop de ataques.</center>

### <center>[Brute Force](https://splinterlands.com/battle/c6560fdc6e73fb5d08a086f48c5850f68e07c967?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>Another doubt would be with the combination with another recent **Ruleset** that changes the priorities of the attacks and which one has priority or if they complement each other.</center>

><center>Otra de las dudas sería con la combinación con otra **Ruleset** reciente que cambia las prioridades de los ataques y cuál tiene prioridad o si se complementan.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeE6obj2YQ8PsFU3SijLSNgdw3JDgKBYNtThrxG5RQ7uU/4%20V2.png</center>

<center>In this battle it is seen that they complement each other by following the order of power but giving priority to the units with **melee** attack, but it seems that in case of a tie of power the one with greater speed wins.</center>

><center>En esta batalla se ve que se complementan siguiendo el orden de poder pero dando prioridad a las unidades con ataque **cuerpo a cuerpo**, pero parece que en caso de empate de poder gana la de mayor velocidad.</center>

### <center>[What happens with units without attack that gain melee attack | ¿Qué pasa con las unidades sin ataque que ganan ataque cuerpo a cuerpo?](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_9b3ddee307b18800b3b5995224a08555?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>Another doubt is its interaction with units that do not have an attack and are given one with **Weapons Training** and if it changes the attack order the same way.</center>

><center>Otra de las dudas es su interacción con las unidades que no tienen ataque y se les da con **Weapons Training** y si cambia el orden de ataques igual.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVqr584gs8AhAhhDov8TEiRPFBX4BE5NJMywN7vSFG6NV/5%20V2.png</center>

<center>In this battle the priority of the units with **melee** attack is maintained, whether it is base attack or acquired by **Weapons Training**, which enables the power to give several types of attacks and for units without attack to have priority over other units.</center>

><center>En esta batalla se mantiene la prioridad de las unidades con ataque **cuerpo a cuerpo**, sea ataque base o adquirido por **Weapons Training**, lo cual habilita el poder darle varios tipos de ataques y que tenga prioridad sobre otras unidades a las unidades sin ataque.</center>

### <center>Conclusion</center>

<center>**Enraged Warriors** joins another of the **Rulesets** that alter the order of battles, making it so that **melee** units can obtain the first blood of the battle or wounding the enemies so that the mages and archers finish the rest.</center>

><center>**Enraged Warriors** se une a otra de las **Rulesets** que alteran el orden de las batallas haciendo que las unidades **cuerpo a cuerpo** puedan obtener la primera sangre de la batalla o hiriendo a los enemigos para que los magos y arqueros acaben el resto.</center>

<center>But what do you think of **Enraged Warriors**? What has been the best strategy you have tried with **Enraged Warriors**? Which one is the most difficult to face?</center>

><center>¿Pero a ustedes qué les parece **Enraged Warriors**? ¿Cuál ha sido la mejor estrategia que han probado con **Enraged Warriors**? ¿cuál es la más difícil de enfrentar?</center>

# <center>[Join Splinterlands here. / Unete aqui a Splinterlands.](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=durlan)</center>


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@durlan/esen-splinterlands-enraged-warriors-questions-and-answers-dyr)

body.title: Golden hour sketching in a room that remembers things
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778198970-b9246775d05d.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/dalary/seed-dalary-2026-05-08/main-1-1778198970-b9246775d05d.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

I found myself in this drawing room again today, the kind of space where time moves differently. The light was doing that thing it does in late afternoon—pooling in corners, turning the walls the color of old honey. There's a fireplace that hasn't seen a fire in years, but someone's arranged prints around it anyway, dozens of them in mismatched frames. An easel leans against the wall with a half-finished landscape, patient and unpretentious.

I settled at the wooden table with a glass of something pale and my sketchbook. The pencils were already there, worn down from use, and I started drawing without really thinking about it. Just the shapes of the room, the angles where light breaks against shadow. There's something about this particular quality of light—it's not dramatic or performative. It's the kind that makes you want to work slowly, to notice how a line can suggest depth, how a single mark can hold the whole feeling of a space.

The room was quiet except for the sound of pencil on paper and someone's soft conversation near the window. I wasn't trying to make anything precious. Just working through what I was seeing, letting my hand respond to the geometry of the place. The drawing didn't need to be perfect; it needed to be honest. That's what these old rooms teach you, I think. They've stood long enough to know the difference.

By the time I looked up, the light had shifted again. The golden moment was fading into something cooler, more violet. I closed the sketchbook and sat with the glass for a while longer, watching how the room transformed itself in the dusk.

body.body:
Der bekannte Milliardär und Hedgefonds-Gründer Ray Dalio warnt vor einer neuen Phase globaler Instabilität. Nach seiner Analyse historischer Zyklen könnten Wirtschaft und Politik vor einer besonders turbulenten Zeit stehen.


![55163.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX6XGVSYX38gMD26fLX1Mhqd1714ULZ4u1Cjot37wYbup/55163.jpg)


Nach seiner Analyse von rund 500 Jahren Geschichte verlaufen Weltordnungen oft in wiederkehrenden Zyklen.

Dalio nennt dieses Muster den \

. In solchen Zyklen entstehen neue Geld-, Macht- und Weltordnungen, entwickeln sich über Jahrzehnte – und brechen schließlich wieder zusammen.

Aktuell, so seine Einschätzung, befinde sich die Welt in einer besonders kritischen Phase kurz vor einem möglichen Umbruch. 

Nach Dalios Analyse dauern solche großen historischen Zyklen im Schnitt etwa 75 Jahre – manchmal deutlich länger oder kürzer.

Der letzte große Umbruch sei die Zeit zwischen der Weltwirtschaftskrise 1929 und dem Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs 1945 gewesen. Danach entstand eine neue Weltordnung unter Führung der USA, die das internationale Finanz- und Sicherheitssystem bis heute prägt.

Doch viele Entwicklungen der Gegenwart erinnerten laut Dalio zunehmend an die Jahre vor diesem Umbruch. 

Dalio nennt mehrere Entwicklungen, die aus seiner Sicht typisch für eine besonders instabile Phase eines solchen Zyklus sind.

Dazu gehören unter anderem:

Hohe und schnell wachsende Staatsschulden sowie geopolitische Konflikte wecken Zweifel am Wert und an der Stabilität von Geld – besonders der Reservewährung.

Das treibt Kapital aus Papierwährungen heraus und hinein in Gold oder Kryptowährungen.

Der Übergang von einer Weltordnung mit einer dominierenden Macht und relativer Stabilität hin zu einer Weltordnung, die von Konflikten zwischen mehreren Großmächten geprägt ist.

**Der Zerfall von von Bündnissen wie der NATO**

Wachsende Vermögens- und Einkommensunterschiede innerhalb von Ländern führen zum:
Aufstieg von Populismus – sowohl von rechts als auch von links – sowie zu unüberbrückbaren Gegensätzen, die sich weder durch Kompromisse noch durch den Rechtsstaat lösen lassen.

Ich zitierte aus folgendem Artikel...

https://www.focus.de/finanzen/ray-dalio-ich-habe-500-jahre-geschichte-studiert-und-befuerchte-dass-wir-in-die-gefaehrlichste-phase-des-grossen-zyklus-eintreten_a149ff87-b186-4aeb-94ba-0d6904dafbdb.html

Mein persönliches Fazit:

Erkennst auch du die Parallelen? Die Frage ist nur ob dieser Systemchange in einem Krieg endet oder mit einem anderen Finanzsystem beginnt?

---

English 

The well-known billionaire and hedge fund founder Ray Dalio warns of a new phase of global instability. According to his analysis of historical cycles, the economy and politics could be facing a particularly turbulent time.

His analysis of roughly 500 years of history shows that world orders often follow recurring cycles.

Dalio calls this pattern the \

In such cycles, new monetary, power, and world orders emerge, develop over decades—and ultimately collapse.

Currently, he believes the world is in a particularly critical phase, on the verge of a potential upheaval.

According to Dalio's analysis, such major historical cycles last an average of about 75 years—sometimes considerably longer or shorter.

The last major upheaval, he argues, was the period between the Great Depression of 1929 and the end of World War II in 1945. Afterward, a new world order emerged under US leadership, which continues to shape the international financial and security system today.

 However, according to Dalio, many current developments increasingly resemble the years preceding this upheaval.

Dalio cites several developments that, in his view, are typical of a particularly unstable phase of such a cycle.

These include:

High and rapidly growing national debt, as well as geopolitical conflicts, raise doubts about the value and stability of money—especially reserve currencies.

This drives capital out of paper currencies and into gold or cryptocurrencies.

The transition from a world order with a dominant power and relative stability to a world order characterized by conflicts between multiple major powers.

The disintegration of alliances such as NATO.

Growing wealth and income disparities within countries lead to:

The rise of populism—both right-wing and left-wing—and to irreconcilable differences that cannot be resolved through compromise or the rule of law.

I quoted from the following article...

body.title: Silver’s Next Move
body.body:
![Screenshot 2026-05-07 at 6.26.07 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23uFYCqugBNbkDPzYgwfYGiFyaua71Zi38dTFxAe57A4EpfY2o4RpwUcsW32wgokKVHMD.png)


It's been a while since my last silver post. The latest surge in silver prices is turning heads again, but if you think this is just another  fear trade, you’re missing the bigger story.

Normally, you’d expect precious metals like silver to fall when geopolitical tensions cool. Instead, silver is rising and in many cases, outperforming gold. So what’s really going on? Over the past few days, silver has surged alongside gold as markets price in the possibility of a diplomatic breakthrough in the Middle East. Prices have jumped sharply, with silver gaining several percentage points in just a few sessions. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-07 at 6.25.37 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23tmmf85wy3iDEMxP5WPSMH1aADyTA22dNfKE3rTZNzhWG25m8beRyQSo8Vb9AZw4Bwae.png)


Silver is seeing less of a traditional safe haven rally. In fact, it’s almost the opposite. As tensions ease, oil prices have begun to fall and the U.S. dollar has weakened. That combination is critical. Lower energy costs reduce inflation pressure, which in turn opens the door for central banks especially the Federal Reserve to consider cutting interest rates. Silver benefits when interest rates fall and the dollar weakens. Lower yields make non interest bearing assets like precious metals more attractive.



So as traders we need to think of silver as less than a safe haven asset. The Fed controls all and since it is deeply tied to the real economy. When markets anticipate economic recovery like reopening trade routes or stabilizing energy costs industrial demand expectations rise. I am trying to rethink how I look at silver trading and so should you!

body.title: How do we overcome drug addiction? - MCGI TOPIC | THE OLDPATH
body.body:
https://youtu.be/7htpmP2QxLI

We must be disciplined if we are to successfully live the lives that Christians are supposed to live. This means that we must set aside all of our bodily appetites and desires. Forming habits is simple, but breaking them is challenging but not impossible. 

In order to successfully break a bad habit, we must be highly willing to do so and deliberate about it. No one can assist us if we are not prepared to receive assistance in the first place. Addiction of any kind, including drug addiction, cannot be overcome by magic. It requires dedication and earnestness. God can easily intervene and guide us through this stage when He sees this. 

The type of association we participate in is another crucial point to consider. Cutting ties with some friends may be necessary for someone to overcome drug addiction because, in most cases, they were the ones who persuaded them to adopt that lifestyle. 

We must sever our links with these guys and make new ones who will bring us closer to God rather than farther away since keeping them would not benefit us.

body.title: Why do people suffer tribulations // MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
body.body:
https://youtu.be/7PWvUQ0zeWE?si=SJ4t86o2v8UC5XG7

The adversary made every effort to suppress Jesus and thwart God's plan. Evil appeared to have triumphed via betrayal, false accusations, cruel torture, and crucifixion. However, the tomb was empty three days later. It is impossible to stop Jesus' resurrection. Dead in grandeur and power!

In John 14:6, Jesus said \

The truth is never destroyed, even if it is opposed, postponed, or concealed. Nothing can oppose us if God is on our side. This does not imply that you won't encounter resistance. However, when God is on your side, every opposition is bound to fall.

The apostle Paul reminds us that God sacrificed His own Son for all of us. God is more than sufficient for every challenge you face. Nothing can keep us from experiencing God's love. Not tribulation, not adversity, not persecution, starvation, peril, or even death. Because of Him, who loved us, we are more than conquerors in all of these things.

When life becomes difficult, God's love endures. You are not abandoned by Him because of your struggles. In fact, as He supports you through every storm, His love becomes even more apparent.
