body.title: Moralischer Bankrott: Die Ekpathischen
body.body:
>Das geschieht se recht, was fährtse mits Rad: So wie Vergewaltigungsopfer früher  beschuldigt wurden, einen zu kurzen Rock getragen zu haben, werden Mordopfer heute von der Linken zu den Schuldigen ihres Todes erklärt.

Jeder Mensch ist gleich, keinem darf seine Würde genommen werden. Wer ein einziges Leben rettet, rettet die ganze Welt, heißt es im Talmud. Und wer ein einziges Leben nimmt, tötet damit nicht nur sein Opfer, sondern zahllose Menschen. Die Mütter und Väter des Grundgesetzes haben aus dieser jüdisch-christlichen Erkenntnis die Lehre gezogen, dass selbst Mörder ein Recht auf Leben haben. Und der normal fühlende Bürger bräuchte nicht einmal diese Vorgabe: dass es sich verbietet, über Tote Schlechtes zu sagen oder sich gar über den Tod eines Menschen zu frohlocken, ist Teil der abendländischen Kultur.

>Auf dem absteigenden Ast 

Einer Kultur auf dem absteigenden Ast, einer Kultur, die von innen heraus zu verfaulen scheint. Nach dem Mord am US-Influencer Charlie Kirk flog der dünne Firnis von den Werten unserer Demokratie  wie von einer Schleifmaschine abgerissen. Die Freude darüber, dass es einen getroffen hat, der es wegen seiner politischen Auffassungen schon irgendwie verdient hat, war nicht mehr nur klammheimlich. Wer heute nicht Hetze, Hass und Hohn über dem politischen Konkurrenten ausschüttet, hat die Zeichen der Zeit nicht verstanden: Alles, was nicht im eigenen Lager und treu zur Sache steht, hat allenfalls Verachtung verdient. Entmenschlichung und die Unterstellung, selbst möglicherweise echtes Leid nur zu nutzen, um auf die Mitleidstour noch mehr Wählerinnen und Wähler widerrechtlich zu einem \

(Sebastian Krumbiegel) zu zwingen. Nur der grobe Klotz hat Aussichten, laut zu klingen.

Von

>El Hotzo, dem garstigen Fernsehclown, der in einem gerichtsfest als Witz anerkannten Post bei X schon Donald Trump vor den Bus Tod gewünscht hatte, bis zur revolutionären Linksjugend, die dem Opfer nachwies, dass er selbst schuld sei, wurde Klartext geschrieben. Mario Sixtus, ein Verbalextremist, der für das ZDF arbeitet und seine Hassblase bei Bluesky seit Jahren mit Hitlervergleichen und Holocaustverharmlosungen füttert, ließ wissen: \
applaudierte: Mit einem gezielten Schuss wurde das Ende seiner rechtsradikalen, menschenverachtenden und ausbeuterischen Politik besiegelt.\
starb an den Folgen einer Schussverletzung\
Tod des rechtskonservativen US-Aktivisten Charlie Kirk\
das ohnehin gespaltene Land noch stärker polarisieren\
Kirk die Lüge von der gestohlenen Wahl 2020\

vor Glück geweint, als Donald Trump 2024 erneut gewann  - nun ist der rechte Aktivist tot, erschossen im Alter von 31 Jahren. 

Elmar Theveßen, ein außerordentlich profunder Kenner
>der amerikanischen Verhältnisse, wie er sie sieht,  dichtete Charlie Kirk in der ARD an, er habe \

Im Unterschied zum Hoororschriftsteller Stephen King, der ungeprüft denselben Unsinn verbreitete hatte, sich später aber entschuldigte, rückte Theveßen nicht von seiner Erklärung ab, warum Kirk zwangsläuifg hatte streben müssen. Irgendwas wird schon hängenbleiben bei denen, die zugeschaut haben.

Das geschieht se recht, was fährtse mits Rad, sagen die Alten im ländlichen Ostdeutschland achselzuckend, wenn die Nachricht im Dorf die Runde macht, dass sich die 77-jährige Elsbeth bei einem Sturz mit dem Fahrrad bei Glatteis die Hüfte gebrochen hat. Immerhin aber bringen sie dann doch Blumen und gute Wünsche, sie fühlen mit und es tut ihnen leid. 

Kirk darf darauf nicht hoffen, jedenfalls nicht bei denen, für die weniger Mensch als - unbekannterweise - Feindbild ist. So wie Thilo Sarrazin sich einst als \

beschimpfen lassen musste, weil er zwar nicht lispelte, stotterte und zuckte, aber nicht davon abließ, anderer Meinung zu sein, liefert Charlie Kirk die perfekte Vorlage für korrekte Menschenfeindlichkeit.

(Spiegel) darf keine Gnade von denen erwarten, die ihre höhere Moral an gewöhnlichen Tagen wie eine Monstranz vor sich hertragen. Wenn so einer ermordet wird, eignet sich ein Affenbild am besten, die Genugtuung darüber auszudrücken, dass<span class=\
kommentierte der Sprecher der Linken-Fraktionschefin Heidi Reichinnek (37), Felix S. Schulz, den Tod des

>Vater von zwei Söhnen. Das hat er nun davon.

Abgründe tun sich auf, Abgründe, die schon lange zu erahnen sind. Sie sind randvoll mit dem Gegenteil von Empathie, einer Wesensart, die weniger bekannt, durchaus aber weit verbreitet ist. Die sogenannte Ekpathie ist die Fähigkeit, das dem Menschen eigentlich angeborene Einfühlungsvermögen in andere nicht zu besitzen oder aber bei Bedarf unterdrücken zu können.

>Aufstieg der Ekpathiker 

Jeder normale Mensch kennt das Gefühl, das aufsteigt, während er an einer auf dem kalten Boden einer innerstädtischen Einkaufsstraße hockenden Bettlerin vorübergeht, ohne ihr wenigstens einen Euro in ihren alten Kaffeebecher zu werfen. Obwohl der moderne Großstädter weiß, dass der Chef ihrer Bettlergang ihr am Abend ohnehin alles Geld wegnehmen wird, erscheint das sogenannte schlechte Gewissen automatisch. Man muss wegschauen. Und - wissenschaftliche Untersuchungen haben das bestätigt - im Durchschnitt gehen Passanten in der Nähe von Bettlern schneller.

Die, die das nicht tun, sind die Ekpathiker. Ihr Innenleben ist immun gegen Mitgefühl, ihr Anstand ist nur oberflächlich angelernt, sie können ihn in jedem beliebigen Moment ausschalten. Diese kalte, Nicht-Ekpathikern oft grausam erscheinende Gegenteil von Empathie ist vor allem im beruflichen Umfeld nützlich. Ekapthiker können rücksichtslos sein, ohne Reue zu empfinden. Sie können andere verletzen und dabei Freude empfinden. Wie sensible Empathiebegabte den Schnupfen eines Kätzchens in heißen Tränen beweinen können, sind sie in der Lage, die kleine Katze ohne Zögern vom Balkon eines Hochhauses zu werfen.

>Der nützliche Mangel 

Ekpathie ist ein Mangel, aber ein im Aufmerksamkeitsgeschäft sehr nützlicher. Ekpathie ist eine Gnade, die hilft, die Realität so zu verstehen, dass sie stets ins eigene Weltbild passt. Ein Terroranschlag auf eine Ostseepipeline ist eine gute Sache. Ein Terroranschlag auf ein Datenkabel in der Ostsee ein empörender Angriff auf die kritische Infrastruktur. Eine theaterreif inszeniertes Vertreibungstreffen in Potsdam raubt über Wochen den Schlaf. Ein Brandanschlag auf die kritische Infrastruktur, der Pflegeheimen für Tage den Strom abdreht, allenfalls ein bisschen ärgerlich. Nein, \

schreibt niemand. Aber gemeint ist es.

Empathie entwickelt sich im Kleinkindstadium. Ekpathie im harten Alltag des politischen und medialen Überlebenskampfes. Sieht ein kleines Kind ein anderes Kind weinen, kann es sich zunächst noch nicht in dessen Situation hineinversetzen, dann aber doch. Hat es erst selbst geweint und ist getröstet worden, weiß es, dass es hilft, die Traurigkeit oder den Schmerz eines anderen zu teilen. Der Ekpath lernt das Gegenteil.

>Regimenter an Relativierern 

Hotzo, Sixtus, die Regimenter an Relativierern, Opferbeschuldigern und Keinwunder-Erklärern - sie alle finden ihre mentale Stabilität darin, die Grundrechte nicht zu verteidigen, sondern sie wie auf dem Gnadenhof zu verteilen. Wer zu uns gehört, dem steht Menschenwürde zu. Wer nicht, dem nicht einmal das Recht auf Leben.

In der Pandemiezeit zeigte sich erstmals, dass die Gesellschaft nicht mehr in der Lage ist, den einfachen Anstand gegen die durchzusetzen, die ekpathisch agieren, sobald sie mit ihrem Weltbild auf Unerklärliches stoßen. Später zeigten sich das Phänomen immer wieder und immer öfter, zwei oder drei Maßstäbe anzulegen und Moral als Waffe zu benutzen, wurde in Politik und Medien zur Alltagsübung.

Mancher glaubte, es gehe nicht schlimmer, verdorbener, verkommener. Aber es war doch nur eine Zwischenstufe auf dem Weg zu moralischen Bankrott.

<center>

Una rosca de pan,
deja ver su mirar,
dos ojos aparecen sin afán
son grandes y de belleza sin igual. 

Cada uno quiere ir a un lado
como si estuvieran enfadados,
no logran un acuerdo bien logrado
y se molestan por lo que está pasando.

>A loaf of bread,
reveals its gaze,
two eyes appear without haste,
they are large and of unparalleled beauty.

>Each one wants to go its own way,
as if they were angry,
they can’t quite come to an agreement,
and they’re upset by what’s
happening.

![43787.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23yJNWUqiPZXmpauchQu6wPsvHy8mGYoB4rp2v8Wy3yyPb9AaPM8XsLF8GN37x3UrSCkN.gif)

La cuchara le propone a la rosquilla,
con precaución dividirla,
es así como tras un rato hay dos rosquillas
y cada una con una mirada bonita.

Una de ellas feliz se va
y la otra triste está,
se queda esperando en ese lugar 
hasta que llega una estrella fugaz. 

>The spoon suggests to the doughnut
that they split it carefully,
and so, after a while, there are two doughnuts,
each with a pretty face.

>One of them happily goes away,
while the other is sad,
it stays there waiting
until a shooting star appears.

![43788.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23yJP3oY8q5NfRe6T3DdAE4xXzvdYDdQG28sP3CPJ3pC8pHCJZzJTVAuASciL5ZdcHGgQ.gif)

La estrella le dice que la siga
y la media rosquilla la sigue con prisa
y cuando regresa la otra mitad comida,
se pone triste porque extraña a su amiga.

Y cuando mira el firmamento,
la media rosquilla está volando en el cielo 
va con la estrella de brillo intenso
disfrutando su nuevo aposento. 

>The star tells her to follow it,
and the half-bagel hurries after it.
And when the other half returns, half- eaten,
it feels sad because it misses its friend.

>And when it looks up at the sky,
the half-bagel is flying through the heavens,
following the brightly shining star,
enjoying its new home.

## A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words We all have heard this saying and have come across pictures that evoked all kinds of reactions in us. In this contest, we are presenting a photo/picture to write about.
# Prompt ![wal_172619-children-7899562_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freewritehouse/EpVE4XBsu81vR41q7MXTtXQsZ6LQ8VjzFCz1kr8F2yUKWC3qhPibdx1o6zocnYA4GvY.jpg) [](https://pixabay.com/photos/children-sea-to-bathe-fun-summer-7899562/)

> * Describe what you see * Describe what you feel * Write a story or poem or about what you think is going * Use #pic1000 * Leave the link to your entry in the comment section (preferably peakd this saves a lot of extra work) Of course, we expect original work. If the story that pours out of you after seeing the visual prompt is not obviously connected to the photo, please include a short paragraph how the prompt led you to the story. ## Length Write as much or as little to say what you want to say. You are invited to craft a longer story but we don't want to ask for a certain wordcount. ## Prizes For now, this is going to be a reward for participating this contest. body.title: Always something missing =/= So richtig passt es nie
body.body: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/244eEHpWhdRg6kcVmWAXMhVTHyNreuxVyfnHDhSXCmMCb9xaAzdKu7X2nZASkgRfBTJ5i.png) On a whim, I decided to ask AI to create me an image. I had just put the kids to bed and made up a fantasy scene to help them fall asleep and dream, and now I wanted a picture of it. I had told them about a mountain sea where pink dolphins swim, along with a whale on whose spout you can see two penguins. And even though I’d tweaked the prompt several times, I wasn’t really happy with the result. Well, I probably don’t even know what I was expecting, but somehow it just doesn’t quite fit. Which, of course, isn’t really a problem in the end. My final prompt was this one: _Please draw me a picture of a sea located high up in the mountains. Pink dolphins are jumping in the sea, and I see a blue whale with two penguins swimming on its water spout. I also see a few purple seagulls. The sun is setting in the background. Please make it as realistic as possible; it should look like a real photo_ I’ve brought three of the results with me: the first from ChatGPT, the second from Copilot, and the third from Gemini. But please see by yourself - I am sure you know what I mean. I am sure there is a way to get a bigger image, but well, I didn't get there. At least not today... ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23yThQV5ZNiYPfDZe52TEH66vXnuUiTnRK5KR4otKLGdRMRGqcjmgWF48qgV9kDgsc9Ri.png) DEUTSCH Aus spontaner Laune wollte ich mir ein Bild erstellen lassen. Ich hatte die Kleinen gerade zu Bett gebracht und ihnen zum Einschlafen und zum Träumen eine Fantasieszene erfunden, von der ich nun ein Bild haben wollte. Ich hatte ihnen von einem Bergmeer erzählt, in dem rosa Delphine schwimmen und auch ein Wal, auf dessen Fontäne zwei Pinguine zu sehen sind. Und obwohl ich den Prompt mehrmals angepasst hatte, war ich mit dem Ergebnis nicht wirklich zu frieden. Gut, ich weiß wahrscheinlich auch nicht, was ich erwartet hatte, aber irgendwie passt es eben nicht ganz. Was dann letztendlich natürlich auch kein Problem ist. Mein letzter Prompt war dieser hier: _bitte zeichne mir ein Bild im Querformat, von einem Meer das oben in den Bergen liegt. In dem meer springen rosa Delphine, und ich sehe einen Blauwal, auf dessen Wasserfontäne zwei Pinguine schwimmen. Außerdem sehe ich ein paar lila Möwen. Im hintergrund geht die sonne unter. Bitte so realistisch wie möglich; wie ein echtes foto soll das aussehen_ Ich habe drei der Ergebnisse mitgebracht, das erste von Chatgpt, das zweite von Copilot und das dritte von Gemini. Aber schaut mal selber, dann versteht ihr wahrscheinlich, was ich meine. Bestimmt gibt es ne Möglichkeit ein besseres Bild zu erstellen - aber zumindest mir ist das heute nicht gelungen.... ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23xyR81zJLb2txJqKe2Xm1bPtzVQeKc6GFqQrVNH1nr6fZtsJ91A45KxkP6bAbt5XqMHi.png) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | What is the purpose of our existence
body.body: > https://youtu.be/5syxe2GwVxU?si=rjWQGuFGcJrynEq3 What has always been a question that I have asked myself many times throughout my life is, why are we here? Sometimes life becomes hard, perplexing, painful, and I start to ask myself why do I have to live? But I have been granted knowledge through the word of God that there is no mistake in our being. We are created by God for a purpose: to know Him, to love Him, to obey Him, and to prepare for eternal life with Him. Ecclesiastes 12:13, “Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.” This scripture clearly says that our life is not about making money, building fame, achieving success in the world. All of that can make one feel happy for a while but it cannot fill their hearts completely. What is real fulfillment is when we live in accordance with God's will. I have personally been the times that I felt emptied even after I acquired what I wanted. It taught me that materialism cannot bring peace to my life. However, when I pray, read Bible and do good to others, my heart is lightened and it has a meaning. During that time, I learned that we are made for relationships with God and that we are made to show God's goodness in our lives. Yet another reason for our life is to love and to serve each other. The verse in Matthew 22:39 says, “Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.” God expects us to be kind, forgiving, patient and compassionate. Love is a powerful thing, even little pieces of love can impact a person's life. When we give to others sincerely, I think, we are doing a portion of God's work in us. The Bible also says in Jeremiah 29:11, “For I know the thoughts that I think toward you... thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.” This verse is comforting to me because it tells me that God has a beautiful plan for each person. No matter the struggles we face, our lives still have meaning in His eyes. In conclusion, our accountability is to serve God, live righteously, love others, and to be ready for an everlasting life. Life may not be easy, but with these truths in mind, we have hope, direction and peace in our souls.

body.title: Dark-haired man with flowers
body.body:
I show you this drawing from a couple of months ago that I made from a picture I saw that I liked a lot because of the warm tones and I liked it even more because the person's skin is brown. 

I was very excited when I did it, when I drew it and when I started coloring it because I liked the colors of the image, a very colorful and striking image. 

I drew it and when I started coloring it was a little confusing because I have no experience with brown skin tones are the most complex from my point of view as an artist and with all the experience I have because I have to find a balance between dark and light tones and not only that but I have to pay attention which are the skin tones that predominate more if the skin is more yellowish, more bluish, more pinkish or darker in this case brownish and it is something to be careful because if I do not pay the proper attention to the corresponding colors I can go from one skin tone to another just by making a mistake with a color.
 
In fact in the eyes and cheeks I got confused by the skin tones of the person because it is a person with light brown skin and I made it lighter than it really is but I still liked it because I took it as practice. 

I liked doing it even though I finished it in almost 3 months because of how difficult it was to do the skin, I still love it and it is one of the drawings that I enjoy the most to see.

In the background I put some spots and some flowers because I want to reach my own style and I didn't want it to look empty or common by just drawing an image from the Internet and it was a wonderful choice because I love how everything fits together and the background and the flowers are simple and make the drawing stand out and the realism of the face calls you to see it. 

I hope you enjoy the process of my work as much as I do:

body.title: Borago officinalis – Boraginaceae (ENG/ITA)
body.body:
>

### Borago officinalis – Boraginaceae (ENG)

Borage is an annual herbaceous plant belonging to the Boraginaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region and now naturalized throughout much of Europe. It features oval, rough, hairy leaves and deep blue, star-shaped flowers, highly recognizable and prized in traditional cuisine.

![borragine.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EqSXyHU6ADXc8gRGDZ4Dxpvy188wWDkgRHgLBDSwveaJur9AjwxNTVHdtwJasP5e2QG.png)

<sub> image created with canva.com </sub>

The plant grows well in well-drained, sunny soil and tolerates poor conditions, spreading easily by self-seeding. erbeofficinali.org

The minimum cultivation temperature is around 5°C, while the balsamic season for harvesting the aerial parts is June, when the concentration of mucilage and aromatic compounds is highest.

**Borage is now considered toxic due to the presence of pyrrolizidine alkaloids (PAs) in its leaves and flowers, which are hepatotoxic and genotoxic if consumed in significant quantities or over prolonged periods.**

**For this reason, the Ministry of Health prohibits its use in food supplements (aerial parts).**

The flowers are the most dangerous part, but the leaves also contain PAs. Ingestion can cause poisoning, especially in sensitive individuals or with repeated consumption.

**The seeds, however, do not contain PA and are considered safe: they yield borage oil, rich in essential fatty acids (particularly GLA), used to regulate cholesterol and promote skin health.**

Lycosamine, amabilin, and supinidine → toxic alkaloids responsible for the harmful effects of the aerial parts.
Mucilage → traditionally considered emollients.
Anthocyanins → pigments responsible for the blue color of the flowers.

**The only property recognized as safe today concerns the oil extracted from the seeds, used for:
lowering cholesterol, thanks to its polyunsaturated fatty acid content;
supporting skin function (eczema, dermatitis).**

The leaves and flowers, despite having a long popular tradition as diuretics, emollients, and purifiers, are no longer considered safe.

**Borage seed oil**: obtained by cold pressing; used to manage hypercholesterolemia and for skin health. It does not contain pyrrolizidine alkaloids.

In the past, the leaves were used in popular cuisine (stuffings, fritters), but the discovery of their genotoxicity is relatively recent.

The flowers were macerated in vinegar to flavor it and give it a bluish hue.

**In the Middle Ages, borage was called \
because it was believed to increase breast milk production.**\n\nPliny the Elder considered it a plant \

![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Borago officinalis – Boraginaceae (ITA) La borragine è una pianta erbacea annuale appartenente alle Boraginaceae, originaria dell’area mediterranea e oggi naturalizzata in gran parte d’Europa. Presenta foglie ovali, ruvide e pelose, e fiori stellati blu intenso, molto riconoscibili e apprezzati anche in cucina tradizionale. ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com La pianta cresce bene in terreni drenati, soleggiati, e tollera condizioni povere, diffondendosi facilmente per auto-semina. erbeofficinali.org La temperatura minima di coltivazione è intorno ai 5 °C, mentre il periodo balsamico per la raccolta delle parti aeree è giugno, quando la concentrazione di mucillagini e composti aromatici è massima. **La borragine è oggi considerata tossica a causa della presenza di alcaloidi pirrolizidinici (PA) nelle foglie e nei fiori, composti epatotossici e genotossici se assunti in quantità significative o per periodi prolungati. Per questo motivo, il Ministero della Salute ne vieta l’impiego negli integratori alimentari (parti aeree).** I fiori sono la parte più pericolosa, ma anche le foglie contengono PA. L’ingestione può provocare avvelenamento, soprattutto in soggetti sensibili o in caso di consumo ripetuto. **I semi, invece, non contengono PA e sono considerati sicuri: da essi si ricava l’olio di borragine, ricco di acidi grassi essenziali (in particolare GLA), utilizzato per la regolazione del colesterolo e per il benessere cutaneo.** Licosamina, amabilina, supinidina → alcaloidi tossici responsabili della pericolosità delle parti aeree. Mucillagini → tradizionalmente considerate emollienti. Antociani → pigmenti responsabili del colore blu dei fiori. **L’unica proprietà oggi riconosciuta come sicura riguarda l’olio estratto dai semi, utilizzato per: azione ipocolesterolemizzante, grazie al contenuto in acidi grassi polinsaturi; supporto alla funzione cutanea (eczemi, dermatiti).** Le foglie e i fiori, pur avendo una lunga tradizione popolare come diuretici, emollienti e depurativi, non sono più considerati sicuri. **Olio di semi di borragine:** ottenuto per spremitura a freddo; impiegato per la gestione dell’ipercolesterolemia e per il benessere della pelle. Non contiene alcaloidi pirrolizidinici. In passato le foglie erano usate nella cucina popolare (ripieni, frittelle), ma la scoperta della loro genotossicità è relativamente recente. I fiori venivano messi a macerare nell’aceto per aromatizzarlo e conferirgli una tonalità azzurrina. **Nel Medioevo la borragine era detta “erba delle balie”, poiché si credeva aumentasse la produzione di latte materno.** Plinio il Vecchio la considerava una pianta “che rallegra lo spirito” Sources - Fonti : https://www.erbecedario.it/it/borragine https://www.humanitas.it/enciclopedia/alimenti/erbe-aromatiche/borragine/ ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png)

body.title: Musical decisions - The Tale of Norville - ENG- SPA
body.body: > Norville, or as everyone knows him, The Nor, has been an excellent manager for many years. He has worked for various artists and singers, always making sure to take them as far as they can in their careers. He has also been a key part of several record labels and music studios. He's been involved in a little bit of everything. They've been good years, he can't deny it. It's true that there have always been trials, setbacks, and many times his opinions didn't coincide with those of his singer. But his perseverance and talent always helped him pull through. But now, after such a successful career as a manager, time is running out. It's not that he's running out of talent; it's that retirement is approaching. His current singer, whom he works for, is getting on in years and wants to retire soon. They are very good friends and have been together in the music industry for over 40 years. Norville had no plans to retire yet, but when he heard that his friend was about to do so, he wondered if he should do the same. Miguel, his singer friend, said that he had had a long and successful life. And he wanted people to remember him as he was now, at his peak, rather than leaving music when he could no longer even sing. This made Norville rethink things and start deciding if he should do the same.

> Norville o como todos lo conocen The Nor ha sido un excelente manager a lo largo de muchos años. Ha trabajado para varios artistas y cantantes y siempre se ha asegurado de llevarlos lo más lejos que puedan en sus carreras. También el ha sido parte clave ce varias discográficas y estudios musicales. Ha estado en de todo un poco. Han sido buenos años el no lo puede negar. Es cierto que siempre hubieron pruebas, contratiempos y muchas veces sus opiniones no coincidían con las de su cantante. Pero su perseverancia y talento siempre lo hicieron salir adelante. Pero ahora luego de esa carrera tan exitosa como manager se está acabando el tiempo. No es que se esté quedando sin talento, es que el tiempo del retiro está llegando. Su cantante actual para el que trabaja ya está muy mayor, y se quiere retirar pronto. Son muy buenos amigos ellos dos y llevan juntos más de 40 años en la música. Norville no tenía planes de retirarse aún pero cuando escuchó que su amigo ya estaba a punto de hacerlo se hizo la pregunta si debería hacer lo mismo. Miguel su amigo cantante decía que el había tenido una vida larga y llena de éxitos. Y quería que la gente lo recordara como estaba ahora en su mejor momento, que irse después de la música cuando ya no pudiera ni cantar. Esto a Norville le hizo replantearse las cosas, y empezar a decidir si el también debería hacer lo mismo.
![blackandwhite-7402145_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tvZzfU8t7Z6rMz1kF556tHMdVPpLhcr4Z7v8LJAf8CTEoeLfoN4TZVUSEQXknx6frzA.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> 

Many might see their working relationship as just that, a simple business. But theirs goes far beyond that; they are true friends. Norville has been by Miguel's side almost his entire life. He watched him grow, gradually becoming a great singer, and now he's reached old age with him. It certainly feels very uncomfortable to continue working without his great friend by his side. Starting over with another singer, facing a changing world where younger artists crave more emotion, more power, is very difficult. That's why, like Miguel, he came to think that the best thing was to retire with him.

Although he thought he knew it was the best course of action, his conscience bothered him a little. \
But, like good and evil, there was also the other side of his conscience that told him, \

It was a very complicated dilemma. While he was still deciding what to do, Miguel called him to tell him he was going to announce on his social media that it was time to retire and that he was going to do one last show, which Norville, by the way, was supposed to coordinate as his manager. That put The Nor in a difficult position; he still hadn't decided what to do. Should I retire or continue in this career? Miguel had often told him not to feel pressured by his retirement, that if he wanted to continue, he should; he was free to work with whomever he wanted. Those words calmed him a little, but they didn't ease his conscience.

> Puede que muchos que vean la relación de trabajo de ellos dos como eso, como un simple negocio. Pero lo de ellos va más allá, son verdaderos amigos. Y es que Norville lleva acompañando a Miguel casi toda su vida. Lo vio crecer, llegar a ser un gran cantante poco a poco y ahora llegó junto a el a la vejes. Ciertamente se siente muy incomodo seguir trabajando sin tener a su lado a su gran amigo. Empezar de nuevo con otro cantante, enfrentarse de nuevo a un mundo cambiante en el que los más jóvenes quieren más emoción, más potencia, es algo muy difícil. Por eso igual que Miguel llegó a pensar que lo mejor era irse junto con el. Aunque pensaba que sabía que era lo mejor, la conciencia le molestaba un poco, no quiero retirarme aún decía. Quizás pueda empezar de nuevo. Pero como el bien y el mal, también estaba la otra parte de la conciencia que le decía, no estás adaptado a los nuevos tiempos con cantantes jóvenes, lo que vas a hacer es manchar tu carrera llevando al fracaso a alguien. Era un dilema muy complicado. Mientras aún decidía lo que iba a hacer Miguel lo llamó para comunicarle que iba a anunciar en sus redes que era momento del retiro y que iba a hacer una última presentación, que por cierto Norville debía coordinar como manager. Eso puso a The Nor contra la espada y la pared, aún no había terminado de decidir que hacer. Me voy o sigo en esta carrera. Miguel muchas veces le dijo que no se sintiera presionado por su retiro, que si el quería continuar que lo hiciera, el era libre de trabajar con quien quisiera. Esas palabras lo tranquilizaban un poco, pero no calmaban la conciencia.
![man-1278713_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tGVUhhnucFETyDuijWwUvFbWMNTz1Bh4ZQp8c8JDGskTiJ4U6Hpp7NTTB3nqi9yHVhc.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> The day of the concert arrived sooner rather than later. Thousands of people attended, nearly 500,000. It was the biggest concert Miguel ever performed. Many people had experienced their best moments thanks to his music, and it had also accompanied their sorrows. It had been 40 years of struggle, in which everyone gained something through his music. After finishing his last song, Miguel took the microphone and publicly thanked The Nor for his help. He clearly stated that without him, without his guidance, his patience, and his talent for coordinating everything, he wouldn't have been able to go so far. He implied that they should thank him more than Miguel, because a great voice without direction goes nowhere, and The Nor gave him that; he was his guide throughout his career. Those last words reaffirmed Norville's final decision: he was going to retire alongside him. He still had talent and time, but what they had built was unique and couldn't be replicated by anyone else. They started together and they finished together. It was the most emotional concert ever. Now that their business relationship is over, they are closer friends than ever and will cherish every moment they spend together in their old age, knowing they have left behind a perfect legacy for future generations. They will be remembered forever.

> Ese día del concierto llegó más temprano que tarde. En ese concierto fueron miles de personas, casi llegó a 500 mil. Fue el concierto más grande que hizo Miguel. Muchas personas habían vivido sus mejores momentos gracias a su música, también habían acompañado sus penas con ella. Fueron 40 años de lucha en los que todos ganaron algo con su música. Al terminar su ultima canción, Miguel tomó la palabra y agradeció públicamente a The Nor por su ayuda. Dijo claramente que sin el, por su guía, por su paciencia y por su talento para coordinar todo no hubiera podido llegar tan lejos. Dio a entender que más que a el deberían agradecerle a el, porque una gran voz sin dirección no llega a ningún lugar, y The Nor le dio eso, fue su conductor en esta carrera. Esas últimas palabras acabaron de reafirmar la decisión final de Norville sobre el asunto, se iba a retirar junto a el. Aún tenía talento y tiempo, pero lo que habían construido era único y no se podía repetir con más nadie. Empezó juntos y terminaron juntos. Fue el concierto más emotivo que jamás haya habido nunca. Ahora que ya no hay una relación comercial de por medio son más amigos que antes, y disfrutaran de cada momento que puedan pasar juntos en su vejes. Sabiendo siempre que han dejado detrás un perfecto legado para las nuevas generaciones. Serán recordados por siempre.
![people-2596010_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23xe38Kz7c93RdKtU4iUekddFhCzda6eNqgw7LurKNLABm11KzeCLkLASAaduPW3XmZx2.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

Hace tres días, después de recorrer la galería de arte y dejarnos envolver por tantas emociones, colores y pensamientos, mi amiga Yessica y yo terminamos con algo mucho más terrenal: un hambre tremenda. Necesitábamos un lugar rico, acogedor y, sobre todo, donde pudiéramos pagar por transferencia, así que no lo pensé dos veces y la llevé a mi vieja confiable: Café Trovando.


Aunque al llegar tuvimos que sentarnos en la zona que menos me gusta porque estaba bastante lleno, honestamente eso pasó a segundo plano. Lo importante era estar allí, descansando después de una tarde diferente, compartiendo entre amigas.


Para comenzar, pedimos un café bombón, y debo decir que fue amor a primera vista. La presentación estaba preciosa, de esas que te hacen sonreír antes del primer sorbo. Y el sabor... simplemente perfecto. Tan delicioso que hasta me supo a poco. Definitivamente fue uno de esos pequeños placeres que salvan el día.


Animadas por la buena experiencia de la semana anterior, mi amiga pidió pizza, mientras yo me decidí por una ensalada césar que llevaba rato antojando. Además, acompañamos la comida con un frapuchino y una limonada frapé para combatir el calor sofocante.


Pero aquí llegó la parte triste de la visita.
La pizza fue una gran decepción: dura, con la salsa demasiado salada y un ligero sabor a quemado que arruinó por completo la experiencia. Mi ensalada césar tampoco logró conquistarme. No sabría explicar exactamente qué estaba mal, simplemente no tenía ese sabor fresco y delicioso que esperaba. Incluso Yessica, que adora las ensaladas, coincidió conmigo.


Por suerte, el frapuchino sí estuvo a la altura de mis expectativas: delicioso, refrescante y perfectamente preparado. En Café Trovando, el café, frío o caliente, sigue siendo una apuesta bastante segura.
Para cerrar, y debido al calor insoportable junto con la ausencia de helado, optamos por unas limonadas frapé. Lamentablemente, fueron otro tropiezo. Nada de limón natural; más bien un sabor artificial y excesivamente ácido que terminó siendo más castigo que alivio.


Aun así, entre platos fallidos y bebidas decepcionantes, nos quedamos con lo más valioso: ese exquisito café bombón y, sobre todo, la compañía. Porque al final, hay salidas que no se recuerdan por la perfección de la comida, sino por las conversaciones, las risas y el simple hecho de compartir un momento especial con alguien querido.





# English Version 





Y Three days ago, after exploring the art gallery and allowing ourselves to be carried away by so many emotions, colors, and reflections, my friend Yessica and I ended up facing something much more earthly: we were absolutely starving. We needed a place with delicious food, a cozy atmosphere, and most importantly, one where we could pay by transfer, so I didn’t hesitate to take her to my old reliable spot: Café Trovando.


Even though we had to sit in the area I like the least because the place was packed, that quickly became unimportant. What truly mattered was being there, relaxing after such a unique afternoon and enjoying each other’s company.


To start, we ordered a café bombón, and I have to admit, it was love at first sight. The presentation was beautiful, one of those little details that makes you smile before even taking the first sip. And the taste... simply perfect. It was so delicious that it actually felt like too little. Without a doubt, it was one of those small pleasures that can completely save your day.


Encouraged by our previous good experience, my friend ordered pizza while I chose a Caesar salad that I had really been craving. We also paired our meal with a frappuccino and a frozen lemonade to help us survive the intense heat.
But this is where the disappointment began.


The pizza was a huge letdown: hard, overly salty sauce, and a slight burnt flavor that completely ruined the experience. My Caesar salad wasn’t much better. I honestly couldn’t pinpoint exactly what was wrong, it simply lacked the fresh, delicious flavor I had expected. Even Yessica, who absolutely loves salads, agreed with me.


Thankfully, the frappuccino did not disappoint. It was delicious, refreshing, and perfectly made. At Café Trovando, coffee, whether hot or cold, continues to be one of the safest choices.


To finish, because of the unbearable heat and the fact that there was no ice cream available, we decided to try the frozen lemonades. Unfortunately, they became another disappointment. Instead of natural lemon, they tasted artificial and excessively acidic, making them feel more like punishment than refreshment.


Still, despite the failed dishes and disappointing drinks, we were left with the best part: that amazing café bombón and, above all, the joy of sharing the experience together. Because in the end, some outings are not remembered for perfect food, but for the conversations, the laughter, and the simple beauty of spending meaningful time with someone you care about.


Sometimes, even imperfect experiences carry their own special charm. They remind us that not everything has to go perfectly to become a beautiful memory. Because when genuine friendship is present, even a bad pizza can become part of a wonderful story.

body.body:
Thanks for this ! User retention is something I've been thinking hard about. While I appreciate it shouldn't be all about the money, I think that author and curator rewards is something that is new and exciting for those who (like me) come from legacy social media where you get nothing from a post except more adverts. So leveraging that is definitely worthwhile.

I didn't realise that the onboarding post thing was such a huge indicator. Perhaps what is needed (and I appreciate I'm suggesting something which creates a lot of work for other people !) is to try to persuade the main front-ends to have a kind of onboarding tutorial. Hivebuzz does something like this already, but of course you have to know it's there.

I'm thinking that for new users, there could be the kind of guided tutorial similar to the way video games do it. So once you click \

to the guided tutorial, it takes you straight to an onboarding post screen pre-populated with tags and with bubbles explaining what each thing is and with some suggestions on what to put. Once the onboarding post is done, it could move on to \
. Effectively, it would teach new users all the key functionality as well as pitfalls to avoid.\n\nPerhaps the front ends could even auto-join new users to a \

for a period of (say) 6 weeks, or highlight their names in green or something to make it easier for us all to spot them.\n\nUser retention is hard when there are so many things competing for our time !

body.title: Approved: Standardized results, sowing fragility [EN/PT]
body.body:
>

The educational system, in each country, state, and in some cases even cities, has its own particularities. Some are influenced by culture, others by economic circumstances, and many other variables. Even public, private, or state schools within the same city have, in a way, their own method, their own standard for delivering information, including test grades. Some use numbers, others use letters. But should the information being given really be limited to just “pass or fail”?

This may be an approach adopted by schools with the intention of preserving students’ morale. At the end of the day, that’s technically what it comes down to: you either passed or failed. But let’s be honest, what is the purpose of presenting a result with only two possibilities? Is it really about preserving morale? Sorry, but what morale? We need to stop thinking in such a victimized way and assuming we are so fragile that we cannot handle receiving news of a bad grade. We are creating increasingly fragile people, and shielding someone from unpleasant news is not the solution to the problem, but rather the root of other problems. Is the goal to create more equality? That doesn’t exist.

If we are raising citizens who cannot handle a bad grade due to their own incompetence, lack of dedication, lack of study, or whatever the reason may be, then what will happen when that same person is reprimanded by their boss? You cannot soften reality for those who do not achieve good results. Passed or failed, fine, but how far above the average was I, or how much was I lacking to pass? In many cases, grades are not only a determining factor for approval but also a way to identify the level of learning a student has reached. It is only fair for them to know whether it was merit or lack thereof.

Sorry, but I cannot accept this softened version of the world that people seem to want, and there is nothing worse than starting that process from an early age. Our grandparents fought wars, sparked revolutions, struggled, and built everything we have, and now we cannot give our children bad news about their grades? Do they need to feel more equal? Drop your notebooks and go work under the blazing sun. After that, you will realize that bad grades are just a piece of news that should motivate you to study harder for a better future.

I remember once studying at a state school in another city and how difficult it was to get there, since I lived in the countryside and walking for kilometers was simply my reality, both on the way there and back. I also remember that this school had a different way of grading. Everything was based on letters, and to be honest, to this day I still do not know exactly why, what they meant, or what the purpose was, when numbers can be far more efficient tools for measurement. But alright, it was a complete mess, and today I realize that this grading system seemed like a way to create a sense of equity among students. Strange, but understandable if the intention was to ease the discomfort and make everyone feel, in some way, intellectually similar.

Anyway, a huge absurdity. Sorry to those who believe that a binary response is the best solution, but if I performed poorly on a test, I want to know exactly how badly I did and how much I can improve, how much I have progressed. If I did well, I want to take pride in just how well I performed and how much my effort paid off. A, B, C, F… and whatever else, “pass or fail”… sorry, but that is a terrible way to measure performance. And perhaps tests themselves are too, but that is a conversation for another time.

O sistema educacional, em cada país, estado e, em alguns casos, até mesmo cidades, possui suas particularidades. Alguns são influenciados pela cultura, outros pelo momento econômico e por muitas outras variáveis. Até mesmo escolas públicas, particulares ou estaduais na mesma cidade possuem, de certa forma, uma maneira, um padrão de fornecer a informação, entre elas, as notas das provas. Alguns através de números, outros através de letras. Mas será que a informação a ser dada deveria ser apenas \

?

Essa pode ser uma atitude adotada pelas escolas com a finalidade de preservar a moral do estudante. No fim das contas, é realmente isso e nada além, você está aprovado ou reprovado. Mas vamos ser sinceros, qual a finalidade em trazer um resultado com apenas duas possibilidades? Realmente preservar a moral? Me desculpe, mas que moral? Precisamos parar de pensar de forma vitimista e achar que somos tão sensíveis assim ao ponto de não conseguirmos receber a notícia de uma nota ruim. Estamos criando pessoas cada vez mais frágeis, e poupar alguém de notícias desagradáveis não é a solução do problema, mas sim a raiz de outros problemas. Trazer mais igualdade seria uma das finalidades? Isso não existe.

Se estamos criando cidadãos que não conseguem receber uma nota ruim devido à sua incompetência, falta de dedicação, estudo ou seja lá o que for, o que vai ser quando esse mesmo ser humano for repreendido pelo chefe? Não dá para aliviar para quem não tem bons resultados. Aprovado ou reprovado, mas o quanto acima da média eu fiquei ou quanto faltou para que eu pudesse ser aprovado? Em muitos casos, as notas não são somente um fator determinante para aprovação, mas também uma forma de identificar o nível de aprendizado em que o aluno está. Nada mais justo do que ele saber se foi mérito ou demérito.

Me desculpe, mas eu não aceito a forma aliviada que as pessoas querem que o mundo se torne, e nada pior do que começar isso desde cedo. Nossos avós travaram guerras, criaram revoluções, lutaram e construíram tudo isso, e agora não podemos dar aos nossos filhos uma notícia ruim sobre suas notas? Eles precisam se sentir mais iguais? Largue os seus cadernos e vá capinar debaixo de um sol quente. Depois disso, verá que notas ruins são apenas uma notícia que vai te deixar mais disposto a estudar para ter um futuro melhor.

Eu me lembro de uma vez em que fui estudar em um colégio estadual, em outra cidade, e de como era difícil me deslocar, pois morava no interior e caminhar por quilômetros era a minha realidade, tanto na ida quanto na volta. Me lembro de essa escola ter uma forma diferente de dar as notas. Era tudo com letras e, para ser sincero, até hoje eu não sei exatamente o porquê, o que significavam ou qual era a finalidade de fazer dessa maneira, se os números podem ser ferramentas muito mais eficientes para medição. Mas ok, era uma verdadeira merda, e hoje eu percebo que essa forma de dar as notas parecia uma maneira de dar equidade aos alunos. Estranho, mas compreensível, se tratando de aliviar as dores e fazer com que todos se achassem, de certa forma, tão parecidos intelectualmente.

Enfim, uma grande idiotice. Me desculpe quem ache que apenas uma resposta binária é a melhor solução, mas se eu fui mal em uma prova, eu quero saber exatamente o quão ruim eu fui e o quanto posso melhorar, o quanto evoluí. Se fui bem, quero me vangloriar do quanto fui bem, do quanto meu esforço valeu a pena. A, B, C, F... e eu sei lá o que mais, \

... me desculpe, mas isso é uma péssima medição de desempenho. body.title: Dirty Old Town - Crime Fiction (Part 2) - Trigger Warning Descriptions of Violence
body.body:
>Unsplash ___
---WARNING - ADULT CONTENT---
___
Part two - King's Tunnel
“What d’you want for dinner then Terry?” asked the middle aged woman. Tired eyes looked down at him, shrill south London voice straining to be heard over the clattering of guns from the PlayStation. “I don’t know Shel’, whatever. Chicken usually does the trick. You want chicken, kids?” Terry boomed, tickling his youngest daughter Esme as he clucked chicken noises and she giggled uncontrollably. “Chicken, chicken, chicken,” chanted the children as Shelly shuffled back into the kitchen. “Can’t you switch that damn machine off for 10 minutes?” she shouted from the dingy, cigarette-stain walled kitchen as she opened the cupboard and pulled out the roasting pan. The stainless steel surface mirrored her face as she noticed the bags under her eyes had grown. Her panda eyes stared back at her. She snorted as she pulled the chicken from its plastic wrap. *No wonder with this mess of chaos to deal with.* Pale skin contrasted sharply with vivid blue eyes, like a sliver of sky slashed across an autumn panorama. Wheat coloured hair fell in waves to frame her face. She stared at her reflection and sighed. *Whatever happened to that bombshell that used to knock ‘em dead on a Saturday night?* The tin clattered down onto the kitchen worktop before she dropped the chicken in and grabbed the spice rub and the olive oil. *Right, its fuckin Jamie Oliver time. A tone of olive oil, luverly-jubbly.* She chopped the onions like a happy slasher in a psycho movie, quick and imprecise. A few bell peppers and garlic were sliced and thrown into the roasting pan and finally she sprinkled the spice rub on top and started to massage it in and under the skin of the chicken with her calloused hands. She wacked the oven on to high and walked to the kitchen doorway. This lot were oblivious to how little time it took to make ‘mums best spicy chicken’. They were always on that bleeding PlayStation. She stared at the scene in the living room and a smile slowly spread across her face. Her six year old son Bobby, jumped up and down on the couch chanting, “Kill him dad!” *A bunch of savages! But they’re my savages.* Esme was lying upside down with her head hanging off the end of the couch as she watched her brother and Terry with a look of intense concentration on her face. The woman's smile faded at the sight of Terry’s eyes and the way his lip curled up as he blasted down soldier after virtual soldier.
![divider-1024.png](https://steemitimages.com/DQmb9i2KiKpKHoj63jj482Z2HpRPSbx1UyAPXrRGYxXzhEj/divider-1024.png) Light flared as the torches’ switch clicked. The darkness blossomed into a halo of intensity, bright pain stinging the back of his eyes as a chin hove into view, upside-down mouth flapping with a worm of hair crawling disconcertingly across the lip-line. Dank dreary pillars swung from side to side as another slap landed on his face and sound returned from an unfathomable distance, slowly building from a hum into a patter like rain and then a screaming torrent of words, unintelligible. ###### SLAP!

Understanding… pain… clarity. “Lift him up quickly,” the voice barked an order, as vomit spewed out of his mouth. “Quickly, or he’ll choke. We need this prick alive, boys.” Rough hands grabbed at his arms. Pressure stung him like molten lava as they grasped his bruised muscles and righted him to an intense wrenching. Pain brought him back from the brink as everything swung right-side up. Mist hung in the air, the breath of the night and the smell of the river clogged his nostrils. Blood sputtered from his lips as he tried to speak and all that came forth was a weak croaking. Moustache stormed up to him out of the gloom, face looming large from the mist shroud. “What’s that you’re saying Carlos? I can’t hear you, son, perhaps you should speak up a bit.” “You fuckin… spllltdhtttt” blood ran over his lips, acrid copper choked out the words as Moustache cocked a hand to his ear theatrically and bent down towards his face. “Sorry nah, I didn’t get that either Carlos. You’re breaking up!” That high pitch fake laugh rattled around his ears as he spat a tooth and Moustache waved his arms in the air like a conductor at the royal philharmonic. “You’re falling apart here Carlos. You used to be one tough fucker. Look at you now, eh. Can’t even take a little slap”. “D’you know where we are? Just blink if you can hear me fella, no need to speak. Once for yes, twice for no.” Two blinks, eyes encrusted slow and heavy. “No! Well I’ll tell you then, Carlos. We’re in the King’s tunnels. See, back in the day they used to bring condemned prisoners down here. Traitors, you know, people they didn’t want to get away. This is back when we had a king, Carlos, not a queen. Long time ago. Before your lot had weaselled their way into London’s boroughs.” His voice echoed into silence. The arches marched in to the green distance, moss covered soldiers lining the depths of night. “There’s only one way in and one way out”, the high pitch laugh lanced through him again. “If you try to dig there’s nothing but the Thames to your left and sixty metres of solid rock to your right, so I ask you where… you… going to run to now… Carlos?” The voice whispered now, breath scalded the side of his face as moustache hairs tickled his ears brushing along his cheeks, those dead eyes stared baleful in the river bourne mist. “Traitors were kept here.” **To be continued...**

![main-1-1778204400-a22602892269.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/parthena/seed-parthena-2026-05-08/main-1-1778204400-a22602892269.png)

I've learned that the best parts of Athens aren't where everyone expects them to be. Today I took a left turn away from the main tourist trail and found myself in one of those quiet stone-lined neighborhoods where the light hits differently and people actually sit down to eat instead of rushing through.

There's something about choosing the smaller street. It forces you to slow down, to notice the way ivy grows up old walls, the temperature shift when you're in shade versus sun. I wore a white crop and linen skirt because the forecast promised heat, and I was right about that, but what I didn't expect was how much better the day felt when I wasn't surrounded by crowds.

I ordered a proper salad with feta, not the watered-down tourist version. Real olives, actual vegetables, the kind of meal that tastes like someone cared about making it. Cold coffee on the side because I'm particular about my caffeine, and the light was so clean and bright at that hour that I didn't need to think about angles or lighting. It just happened.

The thing about maintaining yourself the way I do is that you get picky about your surroundings too. You can't separate how you look from where you are and what you're eating. They're all the same conversation. So when I found this place, tucked away where the stone still smells like centuries, it felt like the right choice. Not performing for the background. Just existing in a place that matched the effort.

body.title: Mi cumpleaños #30 [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
> ## Español Hola a todos! como les contaba ayer, hoy es mi cumpleaños #30, sí, así como leen, ya estoy en el tercer piso, una edad que veía muy lejana cuando era una niña, pero que ahora es una realidad y para mí la nueva juventud jajaja, y como muchos de ustedes ya saben, tengo una hermana gemela @esthefanychacin quien también está de cumpleaños hoy y a la que extraño muchisimo y espero que algún día volvamos a celebrar nuestro cumpleaños juntas. Ahora bien, hoy no hicimos gran cosa, ya que el clima no fue muy bueno por aquí, aún así la pasé muy bien, rodeada de mucho amor y de mi pequeña familia, además me sentí muy afortunada y estoy agradecida con la vida por la salud, por mi familia y mis amigos (que son increíbles) y por todas las cosas que he vivido en todo este tiempo, además quiero agradecerles a todos los que se han tomado el tiempo de enviarme un mensaje para felicitarme, los quiero mucho. Mi esposo decidió hacerme la torta de cumpleaños, y la verdad es que me encantó, pues no solo quedó muy bonita, si no también muy deliciosa y lo más importante para mí es que se nota que la hizo con mucho esfuerzo y amor, lo cual valoro mucho. Una vez lista la torta, cantamos cumpleaños, y por supuesto que pedí mi deseo al soplar la vela, también mi esposo me consintió preparando una pizza para la cena y ahora que acabamos de comer y Olivia está dormida, mi esposo y yo vamos a disfrutar de una buena copa de vino viendo una serie, pues no todos los días se cumplen 30, pero antes quería compartirles estas lindas que estarán en mis sueños y en mis recuerdos cuando tenga 80 años, espero que les gusten. ## English Hi everyone! As I mentioned yesterday, today is my 30th birthday—yes, you read that right, I’m already in my thirties, an age that seemed so far away when I was a little girl, but that’s now a reality and, for me, a new kind of youth, ha ha ha, And as many of you already know, I have a twin sister, @esthefanychacin, who also has a birthday today. I miss her so much, and I hope that someday we’ll get to celebrate our birthdays together again. Well, we didn't do much today, since the weather wasn't very good around here, but I still had a great time, surrounded by so much love and my little family. I also felt very lucky and am grateful for my health, my family, and my friends (who are amazing), and for all the things I’ve experienced over the years. I also want to thank everyone who took the time to send me a message to congratulate me—I love you all so much. My husband decided to make me a birthday cake, and honestly, I loved it—not only did it look beautiful, but it was also delicious. Most importantly, you can tell he put a lot of effort and love into it, which I really appreciate. Once the cake was ready, we sang “Happy Birthday,” and of course I made a wish as I blew out the candle. My husband also spoiled me by making pizza for dinner, and now that we’ve just finished eating and Olivia is asleep, my husband and I are going to enjoy a nice glass of wine while watching a show, because it’s not every day you turn 30, but first I wanted to share these beautiful photos with you—they’ll be in my dreams and memories when I’m 80. I hope you like them.

Another Day, Another Step Difference 😅 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3a6d0a4d-649e-41a4-bd87-8c848f2ba266.jpg) Today the gap between my Huawei GT3 and Actifit showed up again. According to the watch I crossed over 13k steps, while Actifit stubbornly stopped much lower. The problem is simple — my phone often stays somewhere on a table while I keep running around like a tiny tornado all day long 😂 And honestly… today was one of those days. There was running around with the kids, an ophthalmologist visit with Oskar, moving between different places and appointments, shopping, and of course “just one quick stop” that somehow turned into another hour outside the house. But at least I came back with a new dress, so I guess the mission was successful 😎 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f07d85fd-c877-4e00-ae6c-e6252d1b7472.jpg) By the evening I could finally slow down a little. A short walk, fresh air, and a moment to breathe after another intense family day. Sometimes these ordinary chaotic days are the most exhausting, but also the most meaningful. Motherhood, work, errands, appointments, emotions, responsibilities… and somehow trying to find a tiny moment for yourself in between all of it. Now it’s time for some rest — or at least attempting to rest, because every parent knows that “quiet evening” is usually just a theory 😅 Still, over 13k steps says enough: today was active, busy, loud, and very real 💚 #actifit #walking #motherhood #family #lifestyle #health #busyday #polishgirl #hive #fitnessjourney Kolejny dzień i kolejna różnica w krokach 😅 Dziś tradycyjnie pojawiła się rozbieżność między moim Huawei GT3 a Actifitem. Według zegarka przekroczyłam 13 tysięcy kroków, podczas gdy Actifit uparcie pokazał dużo mniej. Powód jest prosty — telefon często leży gdzieś na stole, a ja dalej krążę jak małe tornado 😂 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/94ae1892-2cf3-4d0b-8e54-81f28b7ac0ac.jpg) I szczerze… dziś był właśnie jeden z tych dni. Było ganianie z dziećmi, wizyta z Oskarem u okulisty, rajd po różnych placówkach i sprawach do załatwienia, zakupy, a także „tylko szybkie wejście do sklepu”, które jak zwykle skończyło się dużo później niż planowałam. Ale przynajmniej wróciłam z nową kiecką, więc misję można uznać za udaną 😎 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/67006bc6-0ad4-4565-91eb-e98baadc1f0e.jpg) Wieczorem udało się w końcu trochę zwolnić. Krótki spacer, świeże powietrze i chwila oddechu po kolejnym intensywnym rodzinnym dniu. Czasem takie zwykłe, chaotyczne dni są najbardziej męczące, ale jednocześnie najbardziej wartościowe. Macierzyństwo, praca, obowiązki, wizyty, emocje… i próba znalezienia choć odrobiny czasu dla siebie gdzieś pomiędzy tym wszystkim. Teraz czas na odpoczynek — albo przynajmniej próbę odpoczynku, bo każdy rodzic wie, że „spokojny wieczór” to najczęściej tylko teoria 😅 Jedno jest pewne — ponad 13 tysięcy kroków mówi samo za siebie. Dziś było aktywnie, intensywnie, głośno i bardzo życiowo 💚 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/dc8eab8a-9934-4e96-8eda-bb9e830c96d2.jpg) #actifit #walking #motherhood #family #lifestyle #health #busyday #polishgirl #hive #fitnessjourney

body.title: When Respect Becomes Obedience
body.body:
A river flowed into my path yesterday and her waters uncovered something buried beneath the sand that I think needed to be spoken about.
A distinction that needs to be addressed that follows with what I have been writing on in [the previous post](https://peakd.com/authority/@muhshrooms/expertise-vs-authority?ref=muhshrooms).
This post will just expand further on those points while acknowledging the beautiful curves of the river.


![1000029580.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhshrooms/EoGrExyvjftLrpZfofnKaGYu5XtqTUkD1zT59HqBC7WKK5CGQwwm3t1CAoAW2MQZS16.png)



There’s a difference between guidance, coordination, and mutual respect versus the assumption that someone possesses a legitimate moral right to rule over another person simply because of position or institution.

What I want to explore is this:

How do people begin confusing competence and compassion with rightful authority?

I ask this because often enough I witness this occur in the relationship people have with each other as a client in an institution. This could be from the DMV, to schools, to religious institutions, etc. Because of the humble and kindness of human nature has, being nice and forming relationships, people sometimes quickly slip into  believing they have the right to rule even though it may not be so obvious at first. 

In other words, Good people working within institutions oftentimes dilute perception of power dynamics. The kindness that they show masks the coercive nature of the institute. Thus, through compassion, the \

is duped into believing their authority as legitimate. And this is why, in my opinion, institutions rely on good people to be at the forefront in their offices, such as in customer service or public relations jobs. Because they know people often comply more willingly with systems when the representatives are humane and compassionate.

So,
Why does wisdom and care so often become associated with rulership? When does earned respect become institutional authority?

The human mind is fascinating and it boggles my own when I think of these distinctive transfers in the psych. That doesn’t necessarily prove the system itself possesses moral legitimacy, but only that humans naturally respond to care, wisdom, and relationship.

As you read this I have one final question you could ask yourself dear reader.

Have you ever mistaken guidance and compassion for a moral right to rule?

body.title: Getting ready for the summer heat // Preparándome para el calor del verano.
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![1000246013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/EoyQXkkk78gX89nUc4dvfnTWdd6MZ2UAsDrHq8DYS5i382i2p5fAhfRuDTmaZqrgurZ.jpg)



Hello, Hive friends, and especially the @homesolutions community! As always, I hope you and your family and friends are doing well. It’s been a little while since I’ve stopped by here, but today I’m here to show you how I maintain my fan. As you all know, summer is just around the corner, and honestly, the heat is already unbearable, so I’m doing everything I can to make sure they’re ready and working properly by then. 


![1000246014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/242s3YaT9wBn3UrfFjSNZmcLU1f3PJn18136XzoiRqrBReutzQCQYX4NxZu7ZQE8TY4UG.jpg)



Normally, I’d take them to the mechanic, but after a short while I’d have to take them back, because they’d get stuck again right away. I think it was because they weren’t using the right oil to lubricate them—they actually looked pretty greasy to me. Since I’m a very observant person, the first two times I went to the mechanic, I learned how the job was done. 



![1000246015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23yx217Jzf377AQbLLRmRvKbp4sTrDwH6jSgxWjNNXsJSCAzFP9g2sYc2pStC7dV4cA8u.jpg)



A few days later, on one of those crazy days when I had the money, I bought the original oil used for maintenance, and SAS, ha ha ha. One fine day, I decided to take a chance and put what I’d learned into practice, ha ha ha. Well, I’ll tell you that every time my fans get jammed, I save over 1,000 pesos, because now I do that job myself. 


![1000246017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/242s3up3P6xS26tQhsqu5FwPwwAFDgwVoqF3FKX21z6LDzqYcFZjXs3KA8hReDEMSEeak.jpg)



The first thing I do is remove the covers, the blades, and the pin that holds the blade in place. Next, I take off the switch that lets you choose between stationary and rotating modes, the motor cover (both front and back), and loosen the screw that secures the base head so I can remove it and work more comfortably. Then, I take the motor out of the turntable and get to work, heh, heh, heh. I always keep a close eye on where each screw goes so that later I don’t end up missing any or having any left over, heh, heh, heh.




![1000246018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23xVVbdFoUvvcc5rHD1B9XBE2PthtNnFJMYGg3q7nXDUu7BWYEsbFkH9ibHY8o1kKEy36.jpg)



Once I have the motor in my hand and it’s easy to work with, I simply start taking it apart: I remove the screws that hold the motor together and take out the field and the shaft. And that’s where the real work begins. Using a damp cloth with kerosene or, if you don’t have any, a dry one—like I did because kerosene isn’t available here anymore—we clean everything thoroughly: the shaft and the bushings, making sure they’re completely clean with no dirt, because that’s what causes them to seize up. 




![1000246019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23ywyZLeHEo5Qe76z2fb2emKHXbfZtdApbvPX3U9QnWzJA9Q1GvDaTCQZBu5JN61F4AEM.jpg)



After everything is clean and smooth—if you want, you can use some very fine sandpaper—we proceed to apply oil and grease so everything is well-lubricated and the shaft runs smoothly through the bushings. We apply oil to both so they’re well-greased, but not too much so it doesn’t drip onto the field. Once we’ve done this, we reverse the process from back to front and start putting everything back together. Be careful with the field—it has to be in the same position it was in.



![1000246020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/243BpsKBuoMQuo2PxisL2kSCip4qosYZ9NjoWZG37FYPFc9TYMZho6et6BGi77FscGyJr.jpg)



Then, little by little, we put each part and each screw in its place until we finish assembling everything. We had to make sure the motor screws were properly positioned and securely tightened so that the motor would be centered and wouldn’t jam or get stuck due to friction. After assembly, I take a small stick and thoroughly clean the plastic parts to remove any dirt that might have gotten on them during the process. 




![1000246021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/242YEWxnU3BjrETA1CLcViC1s3BYKGUNP8K1J8FJ4LrUfAEQ98Tkw37b38hJF73wxCneN.jpg)




My friends, this is how I keep my fans running and ready for the hot summer. Honestly, it saves me a little money, and I’ll tell you—there’s nothing more rewarding than seeing the results of the work we’ve done. I really love fixing things, and this is a great way to do it, hee hee hee. Without further ado, I’ll say goodbye for now, and I’ll see you next time. Thousands of blessings. Have a great day.




<div class=\

The photos were edited using the mobile app [InShort](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.camerasideas.instashot). Texts translated into English by [DeepL Translate](https://www.deepl.com/mobile-apps/?utm_source=android&utm_medium=app&utm_campaign=share-with-friends). ‎
‎VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí!)

Hola amigos de Hive y en especial a la comunidad de @homesolutions como siempre espero que se encuentren bien al igual que sus familiares y amigos hace algún tiempito no pasaba por acá, pero hoy vengo para mostrarles como le doy mantenimiento a mi ventilador. Cómo todos saben se acerca la temporada de verano y la verdad ya los calores son irresistibles, así que trato por todos los medios que estén listos y funcionando bien para estas fechas. Normalmente, yo los llevaba al mecánico, pero al poquito tiempo tenía que volver con ellos para atrás, pues se volvían a trancar enseguida, creo que era que no usaban el aceite adecuado para engrasar porque la verdad los veía muy gordito. Cómo soy una persona muy observadora, pues en las primeras 2 veces que fui al mecánico aprendí como se hacía el trabajo. Días más tarde, me compré un día de esos locos y que tenía el dinero, pues el aceite original que se utiliza para dar mantenimiento, y SAS ja, ja, ja. Un buen día decidí arriesgarme y practicar lo aprendido ja, ja, ja. Bueno les cuento que cada vez que tengo los ventiladores trancados, me ahorro más de 1000 pesos, porque ese trabajo ahora lo hago yo misma. Lo primero que hago es quitarle las caretas, las paletas y el pasador que aguanta la paleta, seguidamente le quitó el botón de ponerlo fijo o a girar, la cubierta del motor, por detrás y por delante, y le aflojo el tornillo que aguanta la cabeza de la base para poder sacar y trabajar más cómoda. Seguidamente, saco el motor del giratorio y trabajar ji, ji, ji. Ojo siempre fijándome donde va cada tornillo para que después no me falte y me sobre ninguno ji, ji, ji. Después de tener el motor en la mano ya fácil para trabajar, pues sencillamente lo comiendo a desarmar, le saco los tornillos que cierran el motor y le saco el campo y el eje. Y ahí es donde está el kit de la cosa, con un pañito húmedo en luz brillante o keroseno si hay, si no seco, como lo hice yo porque aquí la luz brillante ya no se ve, limpiamos bien todo, el eje, los bujes que quede bien limpio sin nada de suciedad, pues está linda es la que los tranca. Después que todo quedó bien limpio y liso, si quieres te puedes ayudar de una lijita bien fina, pues procedemos a echar el aceite y a engrasar para que todo quede bien lubricado y corra bien el eje por los bujes, le echamos aceite a ambos para que quede bien engrasado, Pero sin excesos para que no caiga en el campo, y ya después que hacemos esto, pues revertimos el proceso de atrás para adelante y comenzamos a armar todo de nuevo. Ojo con el campo, tiene que quedar en la misma posición que estaba. Después ya poquito a poco vamos colocando cada pieza y cada tornillo donde va, hasta que terminamos de armar todo, la teníamos que tratar de que los tornillos del motor queden bien colocados y bien fijos para que el mismo quede bien encentrado y no choque y tranque por rozamiento. Luego de armado tomo un palito y le limpio bien los plásticos para quitar la suciedad que pudimos haberle transmitido en todo este proceso. Amigos míos y así es como mantengo mis ventiladores funcionando y listos para recibir el caluroso verano, la verdad me ahorro mi dinerito y les cuento que no hay nada más gratificante que ver el resultado del trabajo que realizamos. A mí la verdad me encanta arreglar cosas y esta es una buena forma de hacerlo ji, ji, ji. Sin más me despido de ustedes y nos vemos hasta la próxima. Bendiciones miles. Feliz día.

body.body:

No soy fan de que me festejen, pero si hay alguna celebración, estoy presente, tengo buen ánimo y agradezco el gesto. Ahora bien, si en la celebración hay comida: ¡Felicidades, estaré muy feliz! Y si además hay regalos, pues estaré muy contenta. Lo segundo puede faltar, pero ir a una celebración donde no haya comida, para mí es decepcionante 😆. Anoche fui invitada a una celebración por el día de las madres. Todo estuvo bellísimao, hasta ayudé un poco moviendo algunas mesas y colocando sillas que hacían falta (siempre me gusta ayudar). El ambiente tranquilo, bonito y yo era la encargada de tomar fotografías. Al saber que habían mesas, me imaginaba que servirían comida, pero no fue así y me fui tipo la canción del gatito (miau, miau, miau, miauuuu) a mi casi, super triste, porque yo había ido preparada era para comer, incluso evité colocarme ropa apretada jajajaja. De detalle, nos dieron una rosa eterna, super linda y una cajita muy bonita con dulces adentro. Gente, yo no soy fan del dulce, pero igual estaban buenos. ![1000953541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wqpWf7JrRN7EKeLZ1b7e5Q5eCDmANWVwwwLjLR9UxxpD3FxT9bzAid1NiyML1pJ2TGE.jpg)|![1000953544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23w2oQVrvB7EuJVik7znNnmuTU44jkok6p2HvSW25KKWhFNKfEvfpw6Q3NQMxK2chv4ze.jpg)| |-|-| --- Hoy les llegó el turno a Ammy y Joaquin, recordemos que Amelie aun no hace estas cosas por su condición. Amy llegó y me entregó una, carta tu que hacerla algo rápida para poder entregarla. Debo decir me dió mucha risa todo lo que dice y más aún porque los emoji estaban graciosos. Nos imaginábamos a la maestra leyendo esa carta. Realmente aprecio el tiene y además le quedó muy bonito y original. Por otra parte, Joaquin me regaló un espejito hecho en clases con la ayuda de la maestra. Al abrir el espejo se ve el dibujo que hizo de su mamá 🤭 y cuando llegó a casa le dijo a papá: mira papá, dibujé a mi mamá. |![1000954544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23u6J9LUNjABx8y1BvvDCMbiXtkzq28pn2DBphBFDygaYip7Zw4uemcXb1EUDPbuqZE7r.jpg)|![1000955047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/242Y3vpikKW9RnWZ6UgZneCVNhDTUTqY4CnmpAeUYh3w335WTGYna99wbpWzNJ3mGUZho.jpg)|![1000955048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/244y1hKE6HQfQUQcjxzoJNAXyqNBV6qtJzRE3EPgzBRcD4oYu5J4HKWe6wWqRvp6yFYu4.jpg)| |-|-|-| Cuando recibí los detalles, y luego de abrazarlos. Les conté que yo también llegaba de la escuela en estas fechas con un detalle para mi mamá y que ella aun conserva algunas de esas cosas en su casa en Venezuela. Realmente ser mamá es un privilegio y también trabajo duro y responsabilidad. Los niños se emocionan mucho con los regalos que ellos preparan con sus propias manos para uno y cada detallado cuenta, así como también nuestra actitud al recibirlos. Por ello, sonríe y agradece siempre.

I have no interest in attending but it is fascinating to see what is going on. I know how expensive World Cups are as I have attended three Rugby World Cups in the past. You do not know what expensive is until you start hunting for tickets and this evening I clicked on 3 stadiums hosting various games and the prices are rather eye watering.

/> [source](https://www.viagogo.com/) The above is the Scotland vs Brazil match being played on June 24th at the Hard Rock Stadium in Miami. The same venue where the Miami Grand Prix was being held using the car parks and outlying roads. Prices vary between $1661 and $11659 and the cheaper the seat the worse the viewing because you will most likely need binoculars to see any action. Some will say it is all about experiencing the atmosphere and in this case you are better off in some bar or at home.

/></center>
[source](https://www.viagogo.com/)

Scrolling through the various World Cup fixtures between the \

nations being South American and African countries the average ticket price is around the $1K price. As soon as a European team is involved then the prices tend to sky rocket due to fans willing to pay. The second semi final is already close to being 3 x more expensive than the first semi final being played the day before this particular match. Fans have already worked out a route to the semi finals and final and certain team fans have more money to spend than other poorer countries. I would stab at a guess this is hosting a possible European favorite and why the high prices. Sunday July 19th World Cup Final between two teams we do not know yet the prices are already that crazy. Who knows how much they will be closer to the time with desperate fans wanting to attend so these current day bargain prices are between $8600 and $58.2K each. We will revisit this in June and see how much these prices have changed by then.

/></center>

[source](https://www.viagogo.com/)

I would hate to know what it would cost fans to attend a quarter final, semi final and final along with flights, accommodation , food and spending money. A 3 week trip would be hard to see change from $50K depending on where you stay and how good the stadium seats are. Flight prices would have in some cases doubled due to demand over this 6 week period along with hotel bookings making the most all fueled by fans needing accommodation. When you have 80 000 fans attending they have to all stay and eat somewhere so nothing is priced normally.

When I went to my last Rugby World Cup back in 2015 I was paying $1K for seats then and I know the last 2023 Rugby World Cup in Paris seats were selling for $4K-$11K each. For these events you have to be first in line or you get screwed over by the various ticket agencies or ticketing touts.

We will hear of horror stories of the public buying counterfeit tickets or someone paying in excess of $100k for a ticket later this year which is the madness of any World Cup with football being the craziest of them all.
