body.title: From Plantain Chips to Fish Empire: How Chief Felix's Mentorship Changed My Life
body.body: Chief Felix had arrived before the visitors came. I, seated among my colleagues, watched how Mr. Felix, with a lot of pride and a sense of accomplishment, gave a speech on how he created not just an empire but a whole system where fishes are reared and sold at exorbitant prices. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmF87yW4UigmrKHU2mHUvo8vgdYVb7AEf6cCcjSp4NdV/ai_generated.webp) He said, “I remember those days when I was striving to be great. I would run as if I were in a marathon race just to sell plantain chips at any visible traffic congestion, which we normally call ‘hold up!’” After that, he smiled and glanced at our faces as if wanting something. Immediately, he added, “But today…” No sooner had he uttered such words than cheers and laughter could be heard from among the seated individuals. He then smiled while his hands were raised. “It is such a pity that my mum, whom I made a promise to buy a car and a house for, did not taste from the wealth that I have today.” He paused and altered these words in a Yoruba version: “Iya re re sun re,” which means “Good mother, sleep well.” Those words of his immediately struck a part of me, and I said to myself, “Not all promises made during hardship will be fulfilled, as time and all other determinants decide which promises get fulfilled.” Immediately, I stood up to see Chief Felix, also known as the Ghanaian Man because his dad was from Ghana and his mum was from Lagos. “Sir, I want to start a fish farming business near my house. Please, how do I begin? Please!” He smiled and said, “Yes! Like I have said, you do not need a 5-acre land to start. You can get some fingerlings at 50 naira from my company. What you really need is to have a goal. Make sure you set it and remove the obstacles. The goals could be yearly or monthly. Make sure the goal is about expanding the farming business.” I smiled. He promised to discount me 10 naira per fingerling. I was over the moon when he said that. Nothing pays really well than getting discounts for items purchased. The next morning, which was a Saturday, I zoomed off to his abode just to inquire about his office from his gate man. It had skipped my mind, as I failed to register the exact location of the farm. However, from the description he made—where he said that he bought a 5-acre land near his house—it told a lot. “Good morning, Mr. Suraju, I am an attendee of the Build Yourself Entrepreneurship class, and I need direction to Chief Felix’s farm.” Suraju said, “sir, mi o gbo yin ooo.” I immediately translated it to Yoruba just to pass the message across. After a long description, which I followed, I finally got to the Ghanaian Man’s farm. Thank God it was at a trekable distance. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUTdtxCUPeiQYPTDRTCrMXUy4ZjbqXfMqw1fLNAChBNnZ/ai_generated.webp) Mr Badmus came to welcome me. He said, “mister, what do you want to buy?” Immediately, I said, “Fingerlings for catfish.” He said, “Oh, you want to begin a farm?” I said yes. He said to me, “Would you need a technician or our service for a startup?” I also said yes, as I definitely knew that I couldn’t do all those installations alone. He began by telling me that I needed to make construction for a tank, and there should be availability of water. I said to him, “I have dug a borehole for tap water, but I can only afford a white tank of 1000 liters capacity.” “Well, that won’t float a standard pond, but it would do. You will need an additional one to separate the fishes, especially when they are of varying sizes, to prevent cannibalism. You would also need a pH meter, nylon, 5 rolls, feed in pellet form, and many more.” The list of what I saw almost sent me down the drain. It was as if the motivational speech of Mr. Felix was like a sugar-coated medicine. Mr. Badmus advised me to start buying the materials little by little, as they are the basic materials to start a small pond. Deep in thought, I closed my eyes and opened them. I saw a figure. It was Mr. Felix. “Mr. Felix!” I screamed. “Good morning, sir, I have been to your humble abode this morning to seek direction to your farm.” “Oh! That is good. Has Badmus attended to you?” “Em, em, yes he has, but…” I stopped, trying not to proceed, but a thought—should I pour out my challenges?—paved its way in. I didn’t know when I spilled the bucket by explaining all of my challenges in a murmuring fashion. Mr. Felix laughed when I told him that he had motivated me to start the process but did not tell me that the requirements were so many. He smiled as he told Badmus to send two tanks with fingerlings to me. He said that I could choose to return the tanks any time I am done with them, but it should not exceed a year. I was over the moon as I said, “Yes, sir.” Mr. Felix is a kind person, and in fact, he actually discounted the fingerlings that I bought. I was extremely joyful, and that was how I started my micro fish-rearing farm. --- All images were gennerated using ecency mobile app. ---

body.title: EntreNos [Esp-Eng]
body.body: >\n\nPresentamos la trayectoria de **EntreNos**, la agrupación que logró fusionar la experiencia de la tarima en vivo con un sonido de \
que conquistó las carteleras radiales y la televisión venezolana.
>\n\nWe present the trajectory of **EntreNos**, the group that managed to fuse live stage experience with a \

sound that conquered radio charts and Venezuelan television. -----
[English version below!](#contenido-english)
----- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AKtTskwZCSmHmLZXGKoDd8WRphTm5KyQovNLYX2vyKiYdku8xGF2vDYjxFoJrQL.png) # EntreNos: Rock suramericano con sello de exportación

>

El proyecto musical **EntreNos** surgió como el resultado de la madurez artística de cinco músicos de larga trayectoria en la escena nacional. Antes de consolidar esta agrupación, sus integrantes acumularon una experiencia invaluable formando parte de bandas emblemáticas como **Egos** y **Tártara**, recorriendo el país en festivales, eventos playeros y presentaciones corporativas. Esta etapa previa no solo les otorgó un récord incomparable de actuaciones en vivo, sino que sentó las bases para una preparación técnica y escénica que definió la identidad del grupo.

Con un norte bien definido, **EntreNos** se presentó ante el público con una propuesta sonora enmarcada en la estética del \

. Esta influencia, cargada de melodías pegajosas y una ejecución enérgica, les permitió conquistar rápidamente a un público exigente. Su ascenso en la industria musical venezolana se vio formalizado con el lanzamiento de su producción discográfica titulada **Once Cero Tres**, un álbum que reflejó la cohesión de la banda y su capacidad para facturar canciones con gran potencial de éxito masivo. El impacto de **EntreNos** trascendió las salas de concierto para posicionarse en las carteleras de medición radial. Gracias a su disco **Once Cero Tres**, la agrupación logró escalar hasta el primer lugar del **Record Report** venezolano, consolidándose como una de las bandas con mayor rotación en las emisoras del país. Asimismo, su música alcanzó una proyección nacional masiva al ser incluida en la banda sonora de la telenovela **Calle Luna, Calle Sol**, transmitida por **RCTV**, lo que permitió que sus temas se convirtieran en referencias cotidianas para la audiencia de la época. Aunque con el tiempo sus integrantes se dispersaron por el mundo para emprender proyectos individuales, el legado de **EntreNos** permanece como un testimonio de profesionalismo y visión clara del mercado musical. La combinación de influencias diversas y una sólida preparación dentro de la plataforma nacional convirtió a este proyecto en una referencia del pop-rock con proyección de exportación. Su historia recordó que el trabajo constante en la tarima es la mejor escuela para transformar un sueño en un éxito radial con identidad propia. -----

>

### EntreNos: South American Rock with Export Quality

The musical project **EntreNos** emerged as the result of the artistic maturity of five musicians with long careers in the national scene. Before consolidating this group, its members accumulated invaluable experience as part of emblematic bands such as **Egos** and **Tártara**, touring the country in festivals, beach events, and corporate presentations. This previous stage not only gave them an incomparable record of live performances but also laid the foundation for a technical and stage preparation that defined the group's identity.

With a well-defined direction, **EntreNos** presented themselves to the public with a sound proposal framed in the aesthetic of \

This influence, full of catchy melodies and energetic execution, allowed them to quickly conquer a demanding audience. Their rise in the Venezuelan music industry was formalized with the release of their record production titled **Once Cero Tres**, an album that reflected the band's cohesion and its ability to produce songs with great potential for mass success. The impact of **EntreNos** transcended concert halls to position itself on the radio measurement charts. Thanks to their album **Once Cero Tres**, the group managed to climb to the first place of the Venezuelan **Record Report**, establishing themselves as one of the bands with the highest rotation on the country's radio stations. Likewise, their music achieved massive national projection by being included in the soundtrack of the soap opera **Calle Luna, Calle Sol**, broadcast by **RCTV**, which allowed their songs to become daily references for the audience of that time. Although over time its members dispersed around the world to undertake individual projects, the legacy of **EntreNos** remains as a testimony of professionalism and a clear vision of the music market. The combination of diverse influences and solid preparation within the national platform turned this project into a reference of pop-rock with export projection. Their history served as a reminder that constant work on stage is the best school to transform a dream into a radio success with its own identity. #

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

> What a day! Making money is not easy haha. ![YpihifdXP4WNbGMdjw7e3DuhJWBvCw4SfuLZsrnJYHEpsqZFkiGGNCPw1nNtxP7YMEvCKoi2eX1evxLq4d4ZJuZV9Gkf8dr6V5FTyhmqHPeAk6vD8S2VJngKEpW47xkJbcngSFq9S7jzNJr7f4gHzZY6WMyk43taaHCXf6yCMkFY.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23xehjienebSK295c1WwS8uTtagJXNDT2V7m8iJLJVnra7sJHcYcmTdKnQTeHhQhi84aN.jpeg) I've been so busy with a lot of draft. I have a couple of clients to attend to and I thought of making my work so easy. I realized drafting, cutting nd sewing in a day is so draining, which was why I decided to split it. Today I drafted some of my clients outfit, I'll transfer them onto their respective fabric tomorrow. Drafting is a very tedious aspect of my job. All the beauty of an outfit begins from the draft, once there's an error on the pattern, there's obviously going to be a mishap on the outfit. My friend was way too kind to get me some popcorn when she saw how busy I was to even get a proper food. ![IMG_20260322_194158_324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23wqkdZppbaAUBxcmM4X4k4oFeoMzYKW7f7mD3zeDsam65nvM3tPZJuCXWPPqew75dcam.jpg) At least she was thoughtful that I could munch on something before I eventually finish drafting. ![IMG_20260507_180243_026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23tviGkfSuzMXw4hVuYnUwR9B37CVrxQa3Su2w8kCoqp6fKo3v1ubD3xca9aXFkmxGA1S.jpg) This draft is a half bodice which will have flare at the lower bodice. The neckline on this pattern, is called the built up asymmetric neckline. Not a regular neckline. It requires lot of attention and skill to achieve. ![IMG_20260507_180251_462.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23tSayoBP4JSyHTgrEgLjkoN6YzSydbNid9y4HiRK9Hf9fck1oPW5w8FHjGbVh91t7rPz.jpg) The back pattern is also technical, but not as the front pattern. <center>  <div class=text-justify>

_Nunca me he considerado como una seguidora de la moda pero comprar ropa linda es algo que me encanta y que hago siempre que tengo la oportunidad. Los vestidos son sin duda mis prendas favoritas y aunque no soy una experta en eso de combinaciones ni outfitd hago mi mejor intento en vestir lindo en ocasiones especiales._

>_I've never considered myself a fashion follower, but buying cute clothes is something I love and do whenever I have the chance. Dresses are definitely my favorite items, and although I'm not an expert at putting together outfits, I do my best to dress nicely for special occasions._

_En este caso para mí cumpleaños número 30 quise celebrarlo de manera diferente y una de las cosas que quería para ese día era un nuevo vestido para usar._

>_In this case, for my 30th birthday, I wanted to celebrate differently, and one of the things I wanted for that day was a new dress to wear._

_No tenía una idea muy clara de que tipo de vestido quería, por lo que tuve que ver varias opciones en internet para poder decidirme. Compré un lindo vestido/Braga de color negro y con un estilo bastante lindo y diferente a lo que acostumbro a usar._

>_I didn't have a very clear idea of what kind of dress I wanted, so I had to look at several options online to decide. I bought a cute black slip dress with a pretty style, quite different from what I usually wear._

<center>![1000263908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23zGceKbgbwNjBmuFStwLw43jNkhJS5hJ5gozwRbstohHEbmqRYSVubc7NKY7TXgQJzYq.jpg)</center>

_Este vestido/Braga tiene un estilo que considero como \
, es corto pero con mangas largas acampanadas._\n\n_>This dress/shorts has a style I consider \
; it's short but with long, flared sleeves._\n\n_El escote es de hombros caídos, o como también se conoce \
, lo que a mí me encantó porque amo las prendas con ese estilo._\n\n>_The neckline is off-the-shoulder, or as it's also known, \

which I loved because I adore clothes with that style._
![1000263910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23vsQcKvyYE3MxFVrntcMbWeWRHiGEGyKMo6G6sS4j3gJ9CDkMeQZVhBVCrEzvoEbnQfR.jpg)

_La parte baja (falda/pantalón) está compuesta de dos capas, quedando una superpuesta a la otra, dando un efecto al estilo de volantes._ >_The lower part (skirt/trousers) is made up of two layers, one overlapping the other, creating a ruffled effect._ _En cuanto a la tela no se exactamente qué tipo de tela sea, pero es realmente suave, ligera y fresca, pues, a pesar de la cantidad de tela que compone este vestido este es bastante fresco y cómodo, no genera calor ni ningún tipo de incomodidad en su uso._ >_As for the fabric, I'm not exactly sure what type it is, but it's really soft, lightweight, and cool. Despite the amount of fabric in this dress, it's quite cool and comfortable; it doesn't generate heat or any kind of discomfort when worn._
![1000263911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23wMaCLza7w7W2Vw88KPTTvgSHN4zn7xzWUpRknJRNyBVY9WpiokrvNqgULUfDw7NTzMC.jpg)
_Me pareció apropiado añadir un accesorio para acompañar el vestido y por su estilo lo combiné con un lindo cinturón dorado de cadena, con un diseño de medallones parecidos a monedas._ >_I thought it appropriate to add an accessory to complement the dress, and because of its style, I paired it with a pretty gold chain belt with a coin-like medallion design._ _Este cinturón sin duda fue el accesorio perfecto para acompañar el vestido, pues, le dio un toque bastante chick a mi outfit además de elevar por completo este look._ >_This belt was definitely the perfect accessory to go with the dress, as it gave my outfit a very chic touch and completely elevated the look._

body.title: The most ambitious video game in history - Star Citizen: Squadron 42 [ ENG - ESP ]
body.body:
Gracias por pasar, version en español abajo
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tbiiwxbnDkRFYQT42xE44AUiQfYviL1BGVE5QECMZpQyCaFQMg8GVAwhb5JWrAxrZYt.jpg)


I don't know why I'm more excited about this than about any other AAA title aside from GTA VI, that is. I suppose I just want to see how this saga finally ends, once and for all.

For over a decade, Star Citizen has stood as one of the most ambitious projects in the entire video game industry. What began as a crowdfunding campaign led by Chris Roberts eventually evolved into a colossal phenomenon, managing to raise over $927 million without having yet released its final version.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vsDrZTitSbQKoygYWLTW3TiPsatUwpseTguaZgeZm53T96FokF7aJvhy27fjuWb3Jre.png)



---

Now, just when many believed that the release of its highly anticipated single-player campaign was finally drawing near, a new obstacle has emerged: *Grand Theft Auto VI*.

According to recent statements made by Roberts on the *This Week in Videogames* podcast, the launch of *Squadron 42* could be impacted by the arrival of Rockstar's upcoming title. Although for months it was considered all but certain that the game would launch in late 2026, the director acknowledged that there is \

that compels every studio to sit up and take notice. That “thing,” evidently, is GTA 6. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uFHAUL9KZ9Ruanu4sqDXc68UqaH5PaRWZJuwRKvfX4RNNZPokWL9hv3uRz3FEVS119M.jpg) --- And for good reason. Rockstar’s upcoming title is poised to become the biggest entertainment launch of the decade, leading many companies to already avoid competing directly against it. The problem is that, in the case of *Star Citizen*, any further delays are starting to feel particularly precarious given its lengthy track record of broken promises. Development of the game officially began in 2012 with a crowdfunding campaign that initially aimed to raise just a few million dollars. Roberts himself even admitted years later that he had expected to raise only four million. The reality, however, turned out to be completely different. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xp47fFw2DAqbyKfNxMRvsPVjbWFTLZY1E6V7pWGya1jd9m92BiJX6gDk6SvsNUkmuVB.png) --- As the years went by, the project proceeded to break record after record. In 2015, it surpassed $100 million; by 2020, it had already crossed the $300 million mark; in 2022, it reached $500 million; and currently, it sits dangerously close to $1 billion in funding. However, the massive amount of money invested has not prevented *Star Citizen* from also becoming synonymous with eternal delays. For years, release dates shifted constantly. There were periods when the game seemed to be “just a few years away” from launch—only to be delayed once again. Many players already consider this situation to be almost a meme within the industry. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xUmbZP8FthQ3avn2pL21sZ778FkMEB8Wi6z9jLoexnkWg2CCsPqShtEzeuWXMcCmxA4.png) --- The community remains divided. Some fans continue to defend the project, arguing that a playable game *does* exist and that the level of technological ambition is enormous. Others believe that development has devolved into an endless cycle of new promises, sales of extremely expensive spaceships, and features that take years to materialize. On Reddit, for instance, comments abound from players who view the project as a “scam,” while others insist that—albeit slow—the progress is real. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wByQALKwWPPkyb5dDUijtd59LYGu3Pw5Si4XUffWcSxkBeg3j4zcTup3Wfx13izzMbR.png) Even so, *Squadron 42* remains the great hope for many followers. The single-player campaign promises a colossal cinematic experience, featuring renowned actors and a storyline focused on space combat and exploration. In fact, Cloud Imperium Games considers this release so significant that it prefers to avoid any direct clash with *GTA 6*. The big question now is how much longer players will be willing to wait. After 14 years of development—and a funding figure that seems straight out of a sci-fi movie—*Star Citizen* finds itself at a critical juncture: it must finally prove that all that ambition can be transformed into a finished product.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)






### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tbiiwxbnDkRFYQT42xE44AUiQfYviL1BGVE5QECMZpQyCaFQMg8GVAwhb5JWrAxrZYt.jpg) No se por que estoy mas emocionado por esto que por cualquier otro AAA aparte de GTA VI, supongo que quiero ver como termina la novela de una vez por todas Durante más de una década, Star Citizen ha sido uno de los proyectos más ambiciosos de toda la industria del videojuego. Lo que comenzó como una campaña de financiación colectiva liderada por Chris Roberts terminó convirtiéndose en un fenómeno gigantesco capaz de recaudar más de 927 millones de dólares sin haber lanzado todavía su versión definitiva. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vsDrZTitSbQKoygYWLTW3TiPsatUwpseTguaZgeZm53T96FokF7aJvhy27fjuWb3Jre.png) --- Ahora, cuando muchos pensaban que por fin se acercaba el estreno de su esperada campaña individual, surge un nuevo obstáculo: Grand Theft Auto VI. Según declaraciones recientes de Roberts en el pódcast This Week in Videogames, el lanzamiento de Squadron 42 podría verse afectado por la llegada del juego de Rockstar. Aunque durante meses se daba casi por hecho que el título aparecería a finales de 2026, el director reconoció que existe “algo en la industria” que obliga a todos los estudios a prestar atención. Esa “cosa”, evidentemente, es GTA 6. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uFHAUL9KZ9Ruanu4sqDXc68UqaH5PaRWZJuwRKvfX4RNNZPokWL9hv3uRz3FEVS119M.jpg) --- Y no es para menos. El próximo juego de Rockstar apunta a convertirse en el mayor lanzamiento de entretenimiento de la década, por lo que muchas compañías ya están evitando competir directamente contra él. El problema es que, en el caso de Star Citizen, cualquier retraso adicional empieza a sentirse especialmente delicado debido a su larguísimo historial de promesas incumplidas. El desarrollo del juego comenzó oficialmente en 2012 con una campaña de crowdfunding que inicialmente aspiraba a reunir apenas unos pocos millones de dólares. Incluso Roberts llegó a admitir años después que esperaba recaudar solo cuatro millones. La realidad terminó siendo completamente distinta. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xp47fFw2DAqbyKfNxMRvsPVjbWFTLZY1E6V7pWGya1jd9m92BiJX6gDk6SvsNUkmuVB.png) --- Con el paso de los años, el proyecto fue rompiendo récord tras récord. En 2015 superó los 100 millones de dólares; para 2020 ya había pasado la barrera de los 300 millones; en 2022 alcanzó los 500 millones; y actualmente se encuentra peligrosamente cerca de los mil millones de dólares en financiación. Sin embargo, la enorme cantidad de dinero invertida no ha evitado que Star Citizen se convierta también en sinónimo de retrasos eternos. Durante años, las fechas de lanzamiento cambiaron constantemente. Hubo épocas donde el juego parecía estar “a pocos años” de salir, solo para volver a retrasarse una vez más. Muchos jugadores ya consideran esta situación casi un meme dentro de la industria. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xUmbZP8FthQ3avn2pL21sZ778FkMEB8Wi6z9jLoexnkWg2CCsPqShtEzeuWXMcCmxA4.png) --- La comunidad se encuentra dividida. Algunos fans siguen defendiendo el proyecto argumentando que sí existe un juego jugable y que el nivel de ambición tecnológica es enorme. Otros creen que el desarrollo se ha convertido en un ciclo interminable de nuevas promesas, ventas de naves espaciales extremadamente caras y funciones que tardan años en llegar. En Reddit, por ejemplo, abundan comentarios de jugadores que consideran el proyecto una “estafa”, mientras otros aseguran que, aunque lento, el avance es real. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wByQALKwWPPkyb5dDUijtd59LYGu3Pw5Si4XUffWcSxkBeg3j4zcTup3Wfx13izzMbR.png) Aun así, Squadron 42 sigue siendo la gran esperanza de muchos seguidores. La campaña individual promete una experiencia cinematográfica gigantesca, con actores reconocidos y una historia enfocada en combates espaciales y exploración. De hecho, Cloud Imperium Games considera este lanzamiento tan importante que prefiere evitar cualquier choque directo con GTA 6. La gran pregunta ahora es cuánto tiempo más estarán dispuestos a esperar los jugadores. Después de 14 años de desarrollo y una cifra de financiación que parece salida de una película de ciencia ficción, Star Citizen se encuentra en un punto crítico: demostrar finalmente que toda esa ambición puede transformarse en un producto terminado
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)

body.title: Millmead lock  : My Actifit Report Card: May 8 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7cf359b7-f716-4de7-81fe-f2c438ebcd5d.jpg) So, I was back in Guildford again today. My @actifit step count is high because in fact I walked the two miles into town and back from the Royal Surrey Hospital. I was a nice dry day with a little sunshine at times. As I walked along the river towards Millmead lock I spotted a narrowboat approaching. That was a great opportunity to watch and take some pictures of them negotiating the lock. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cbab61ab-fa09-4d96-9d09-9c93a7357a15.jpg) Closing the gates behind the boat before releasing the water to lower the level. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/884a2a09-d15f-4844-9482-951526ef5844.jpg) Winching up the doors to release the water from the lock into the river. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2bce9f03-c40d-4093-896e-429df1a38a96.jpg) A picture of the boat entering the lock. I didn't get a picture of the boat exiting the lock but you get the picture! The two guys on the boat told me they have many of these locks to get through today on their journey. A lot of work and can take a while if there is a queue of boats! 😮 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f6400d98-5729-4fe7-9c6a-a4e656ab0204.jpg) Lastly, a picture of the wier. The reason for the lock so that boats can bypass this obstacle.

Me gustan todas las fotos, son momentos que compartimos y que, ya al tercer día después de haber pasado el estrés de las presentaciones, se disfrutaron de mucha mejor manera. El café del desayuno y la explanada, imprescindibles. Y la foto que me has hecho, encantadora, me has cogido justo antes de que todos los demás vinieran hasta ese lado de la embarcación, mientras me tomaba un momento para pensar en todo lo que había sucedido desde la primera BuzzParty a la que asistí, hasta este momento. Fueron las grúas de los buques cargueros las que me recordaron al puerto de Hamburg hace tres años ya. Gracias por compartir esta imagen, una fotaza que me has regalado! ❤️

Que alegría leer que te gustara tanto Tabarca como para considerar volver, la verdad es que gran parte de mi estaba atenta a si te había resultado lo suficientemente bueno todo, creo que alguien tan consciente e integrado en el ecosistema como tu, necesitaba de una vez por todas vivir una experiencia así de completa.

Me gustan mucho esos retratos que hiciste con los participantes del reto, las fotos de ratona, Livinguktaiwan y la familia están geniales!

Takový byl den.

Po ránu výšlap, ale žádný mimořádný výkon, procházka na devět kilometrů, na jelence pivko a polívka.

S tátou čtyři partie, tři vítězné, jedna po radě prohraná.

Shledal jsem Zvony ze včerejška přebasovanými, ale je to jistý druh specifické estetiky, jakési topení se.

Nepovažuju včerejší Sondu za nejlepší, ale k mé tvorbě patří, až na ní s Jirkou rozjedeme impro, bude mít nový rozměr.

Rozmýšlel jsem, co do toho hrát a asi vytvořím tónové prostředí z inharmonických řad.

[Jan Kotyk - Zvony (Sonda 7. 5. 2026)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KJJ8nIFtffQ)

Volali jsme si s Martičkou, chystá se do Rakouska a pak na dva roky na Nový Zéland.

Ksennia marodí a chybí mi.

Díra čeká, zkusím se prohrabat.

Zvony jsou docela vydařeným pokusem s revertovananým časovým vektorem, hodně materiálu běží pozpátku, jsou to stejné zvony, akorát v hustších harmoniích, ataky vládnou zvuku tím způsobem, že po skoro celý čas určují centrum na tínu c a poblíž,

Blíží se sedmileté výročí mého ztroskotání.

Do toho dodělávám orchestrálku pro Ostravu, měla by být super!

Jmenuje se 'Kila touhy'.

Kanastu jsme s babičkou proti našim prohráli, ale měli jsme cca 2700 bodů, takže ne extra propadák.

Dobrou!

body.title: Street Art #883 Wynwood Miami Part V : SKE, Ismo, Luke & Mwanel
body.body:
We're still in the **Wynwood neighborhood of Miami**. We haven't walked much since yesterday; we're still on Third Avenue, but at the corner of 25th Street, admiring the huge mural by [**SKE**](https://www.instagram.com/theamazingske/) on the **Moxy Hotel**. This impressive aquatic scene is visible from afar.

> *Nous sommes toujours dans le quartier de **Wynwood à Miami**. Nous n'avons pas beaucoup marché depuis hier, nous sommes toujours sur la troisième avenue mais au coin avec la 25ème rue pour admirer l'immense murale de [**SKE**](https://www.instagram.com/theamazingske/) sur l'hôtel Moxy. Cette scène aquatique impressionnante se remarque de loin.*

![Luke & Mwanel](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23ynL17tHh6j35toEkgD8WKzvtD3FFVjAQ39HYkKabCHH18frzovcSNTbskaYivcX1cyQ.JPG)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇʀᴇ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

This wall is located on 3rd Avenue at the corner of 25th in the Wynwood neighborhood of Miami, in the heart of the area's touristy section. On the map, I've listed all the posts about this neighborhood. The number in red corresponds to the relevant Street Art post. Example: 880 = [StreetArt #880](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-880-wynwood-miami-part-i--el-mac-dface-and-maxi-bagnasco).

![Wynwood.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tcJUxGJKqNSvEF5tvvSSNGCJvtM7WTptLDxaW5U1h9TLZPQeR7JWoGzMTpeZj87yfPJ.jpg)

> *Ce mur se trouve sur la 3ème avenue au coin de la 25ème dans le quartier de Wynwood à Miami, au coeur de la partie très touristique du quartier. Sur la carte, je liste tous les posts au sujet de ce quartier. Le numéro en rouge correspond au post StreetArt correspond. Exemple : 880 = [StreetArt #880](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-880-wynwood-miami-part-i--el-mac-dface-and-maxi-bagnasco).*

🗺️ Position on [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=17/25.800876/-80.199037)

[//]:# (!worldmappin 25.80075 lat -80.20101 long Murals by SKE & Ismo & Luke & Mwanel Summer 2025 d3scr)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴏ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

## SKE

![SKE](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23wqiHVstwuwj5NpMKaJVEGeeeknUKc4dkFhTKBMq6aQT381tcZEawQUgBJJbWPmHiAqm.JPG)

This huge mural was painted by [**SKE**](https://www.instagram.com/theamazingske/), an artist from Carolina in Puerto Rico, active since 1981. His talent and expertise are evident in his work for the **Moxi** hotel. He painted all three sides. However, I didn't see the wall on 25th Street because it's located at the very top of the hotel. I forgot to look up 😤.

> *Cette énorme murale a été peinte par [**SKE**](https://www.instagram.com/theamazingske/), un artiste de Carolina à Porto Rico, actif depuis 1981. On peut voir tout son talent et expertise dans son travail réalisé pour l'hôtel **Moxi**. Il y a fait les trois côtés. Mais je n'ai pas vu le mur sur la 25ème rue car situé tout en haut de l'hôtel. J'ai oublié de lever la tête.*

***

## Ismo

![Ismo](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23ywqPtDR9MaXcHhZnGxe2PEC3vuakAK9HmvGi9naoTLeqPWqCeSWqoYCsj9SDxgSq8cX.JPG)

It's because of that chrome crocodile that I didn't look up 😀. This is a mural done by [**Ismo**](https://www.instagram.com/bikismo/), another artist from Puerto Rico. His nickname is **The Chrome Master**, and he's been creating his work since 1993. The effect is truly stunning.

> *C'est à cause de ce crocodile chromé que je n'ai pas levé la tête* 😀. *Il s'agit d'une murale de [**Ismo**](https://www.instagram.com/bikismo/), un autre artiste provenant de Porto Rico. Son surnom est **The Chrome Master** réalisant ses oeuvres depuis 1993. L'effet est vraiment superbe.*

![Ismo](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23wMU59A8p38U6r8wKgaahxscELbpw6V73gaVejXRt9Zy8cYfmP2bFQ9D9fCXdWQmNYQj.JPG)

***

## Luke & Mwanel

![DSC09027.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23xVKSY294zoxk5JMBfoLwSnh1Ck1rCzr2bUiZxPutW1NFbKeU1aaBKugVXFPN7CrWQRF.JPG)

On the corner, on the walls of [The Art Of Hip Hop](https://www.instagram.com/the.art.of.hip.hop/), are the gloved hands done in 2025 by [**Luke**](https://www.instagram.com/lukek2s/). As you can see in the photo, it was hot. A girl was protecting herself from the sun with her umbrella. And on the other wall is **Mwanel Pierre-Louis** aka [**Mwanel**](https://www.instagram.com/mwanel1_l/), an artist from Miami. I really like his style, a mix of realistic portraiture and lettering.

> *Au coin de la rue, sur les murs de [The Art Of Hip Hop](https://www.instagram.com/the.art.of.hip.hop/), on a les mains gantées de [**Luke**](https://www.instagram.com/lukek2s/) réalisées en 2025. Comme vous pouvez le voir sur la photo, il faisait chaud. Une fille se protégeait du soleil avec son parapluie. Et sur l'autre mur, il s'agit de **Mwanel Pierre-Louis** aka [**Mwanel**](https://www.instagram.com/mwanel1_l/), artiste de Miami. J'aime bien son style, mélange de portrait réaliste et de lettrage.*

![Mwanel](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23ynSNTfCdSPiyQebAVbpJt4eNpZQVm4pvGN9TNqcJfJ64FREF8UcBefkQhZxW6cNH5vo.JPG)

We'll finish with a sticker. I thought I'd take more photos to do one post about it, but the murals completely captivated me 😀. 
**Do you have a favorite mural in this post?**

> *On termine avec un autocollant. Je pensais prendre plus de photos. Mais les murales ont pris toute mon attention* 😀. 
**Avez-vous une murale préférée dans ce post ?***

![DSC08943.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tmDZW8ysYZUDTP8H7oZmV47pnv5mY4sBpQiEjEtUcHFd4oUiSYpx9zaYbZ9v1iSTzBn.JPG)

body.body:
## Greetings 🤗 🤠 

## Learn the Art of Saying No: To Protect Your Peace

When I was scrolling Facebook last night an ad appears on my screen in which they were selling books \
. So, I go through their website I found a book named **THE ART OR SAYING NO* and it force me to think is ut really important to say No by some reasons, after deep thinkings my mind said \

to me. By that time I started writing about it and just finished the whole story.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZygLzKGSakHCnaRExHynPuBv1jabZwFQsseKjTHbRCQ/1778267888318.png)
[Image Generated with Using Google Gemini](gemini.google.com)

• Why is it important? 
• How to Say No?
• How to Get yourself Clear? 


We are living in a world where being \
is a badge of honor and many of us are owning the badge. We often say \
to things we hate, people who drain us, and tasks we don’t have time for, all because we are afraid of looking rude or to be judged badly. \n\nBut here’s the truth: **The art of saying \

is actually the art of soul-care.** Your attention is required 👇 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme464iDnPDknAnkpspAD9Y6pf1fBrprnw8XdSfHkE9mFd/1778267669549.png)
**This Photo was taken during my Facebook Scroll** 


### Why is it Important? 

Every time you say \
to someone else’s unimportant request, you are accidentally saying \

to your own goals, your family, or your rest (we mostly do that even after if we do not wanted). Your energy is a limited resource as we have limited resource credits here on Hive. If you fill it into everyone else's cup, your cup will stay empty until you start filling it with your efforts. Saying no isn't about being selfish, it's about being honest, sometimes all you need is just to say **NO** without any reasons. It allows you to give your best to the things that actually matter instead of giving a half-hearted effort to a hundred things you never wanted to do in the first place (I am also learning to say No because it is important, isn't it?).


### How to Say No Without Being Rude?

You don't have to be a hard-hearted person to set a boundary. Instead of a saying direct \

**
The key is to be straightforward no need to over-explain or nor to make up lies, lying it's isn't a good thing. When you will over explain anything you will give people chance to argue with your excuses. What to do? A simple, polite decline is much more respected than a fake promises, do it for your own sake.

### Clearing yourself of blame or responsibility..

The hardest part of saying no to someone whom you can't deny is the guilt you feel that the person will feel bad for you. Sometimes you feel like you have let that person down. But keep in mind, you are not responsible for someone else’s reaction to your boundary which you have set for yourself. If they get angry because you prioritized your mental health, they didn't value your time they just are looking for their own benefits.


#### As a beautiful reminder from Islamic tradition,  **Hazrat Ali (R.A) said:**
\

(Source: **Nahj al-Balagha**, Saying 74)

This serves as a powerful reference that the time is ticking away with every breath we're going close to our last breath. We shouldn't waste these precious moments on things that don't bring us closer to our purpose or peace. But we should keep doing some better things for ourselves. 


### Conclusion

Saying no isn't easy to say sometimes you need to be brave enough. Remember, the more you use it, the stronger it is going to be crucial for you. Start saying with small, value your time while doing work for your own self, and the world will start valuing it too, but it's you who have to start it. 

###### Keep in mind you aren't a robot; you're human.

body.title: Fotos desde mi ventana | Guacamayas de Caracas ESP - ENG
body.body:
Vivo en la ciudad de Caracas en Venezuela. Una de las particularidades más expectaculares de mi ciudad es la cantidad de guacamayas que hacen vida en los espacios urbanos de Caracas. Las guacamayas son como los perros callejeros del aire, van y comen donde quieren, visitan y se van. Son parte de la identidad de esta ciudad y espero que siempre lo sigan siendo.

Estas fotos las tomé con una cámara Cano 5D Mark III desde la ventana de mi habitación, me hace falta un mejor teleobjetivo para obtener mejores capturas, pero aún así logré sacar estas imágenes que me hacen valorar más a estas pequeñas y hermosas criaturas.



![_31A4145-Mejorado-NR2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/camiloferrua/23wgYHoz7h5xfpXUViHCMXTZPXHK489xiSnxS8iR6nWxj1DBeA83dgRVU8N56zxi4o4Mq.jpg)

![_31A4204-Mejorado-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/camiloferrua/23uFW1YmK1b9Lgyq4gsByTT3pACgWrpqhD7VWNqGrYnQk1AUUGghwusHCQMhKZpe9cBNx.jpg)

![_31A4167-Mejorado-NR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/camiloferrua/23wMepvJjHkU2T4GUKs7Ec45Mifivv67pE7EV96uqv7ojX2DUu3X8L2fXzKtLQqAsvQ89.jpg)


#### ENGLISH

I live in Caracas, Venezuela. One of the most spectacular things about my city is the number of macaws that call the urban spaces of Caracas home. Macaws are like the stray dogs of the sky—they go wherever they want, eat whatever they want, visit, and then fly away. They’re part of this city’s identity, and I hope they always will be.

I took these photos with a Canon 5D Mark III from my bedroom window. I need a better telephoto lens to get better shots, but even so, I managed to capture these images, which make me appreciate these small, beautiful creatures even more.

body.title: Bambu Labs X2D build and first thoughts.
body.body:
OK Hive buddies I’ve not been on Hive for about 6 months I guess once you get your of the habit it’s hard to get back in but here goes. 
I’ve been 3D printing for almost 10 years now I got my first Ender 3 back in 2006 and it’s still going strong much modified but still going.
![IMG_2077.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diveratt/23wMWWNup9Paf5zyXvY3DZptUq9K26QDZgpQLD6LNAzqB1WEzdu1MQ7hq6CVaHmGD2chX.jpeg)

When I retired to the Philippines I built another Ender even cheaper this time buying direct from China.
![IMG_0638.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diveratt/242hYf7mFBWPbyzT13mcy82Bi9gpN62nMkafCrmwHUDHBYLzq7bE9FfujYm9dRrJEBEKG.jpeg)

While there I ended up printing around 1,500 face mask frames and filter housings for local hospitals in Cebu during the Covid pandemic probably the useful my printer there had ever been.
![IMG_0639.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diveratt/244eEc1bH6Ad3N5vsdTttxVFDLHBNHvdd4msGQxVtrEorquVoiXh2y8oSzofAPvAfDiBJ.jpeg)

Anyway enough of the history lesson why this post? Bambu Labs that’s why.

So after years playing with Ender 3 printers I’ve finally bitten the bullet and upgraded far more professional Bambu Labs X2D an amazing printer at the price too, mostly for that heated chamber and ability to print filaments like PET CF the AMS multi filament feed is just a bonus.
![IMG_2050.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diveratt/23yToVNFWEcnoiA4BuFRcpGDAmQQ6qc4oLM6ZjiEoNByhqFjVDcNDGS2Mq4sHE1WUr92G.jpeg)

The setup today took even longer than building my first Ender considering it’s mostly preassembled and the Ender is really a kit build that was a surprise. 
![IMG_0637.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diveratt/EoeEtdq3eGkhTqkNYskg2FcYjYzR5UMx2AeFbUj5CihwJ8MrBvgwJiChPqc1HaQowLF.jpeg)

All I can really say is thank god for Bambu Labs YouTube setup video it’s defiantly a must watch if you buy the X2D. The amount of packing and supports and hidden lock screws is astounding.
![IMG_2070.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diveratt/23wC7qvd968sQUvQb5qFYRgFTNLgVW2XZJPTjEzuKJhgrTeDnopZJXD9wWgH1QmJcdY1S.jpeg)

I thought the box might come in handy but it too big and won’t fit though the loft hatch so I guess it will go in recycling along with all the other cardboard.
![IMG_2071.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diveratt/23xKonJXehcBqxPHJc3P7E2p6fwZjkjB2uZwi53t3FBoKgQV3rw5r5K4p4mckqjsArLxY.jpeg)

Once it’s all together with the AMS is fitted and you think it’s done, the calibration takes almost an hour but it’s all automatic.
![IMG_2073.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diveratt/23xVCz6GnuY4HjvquyQz9BqCB52FZLt2AyBtdEcTeZB5LPvW8vCd6Faa3J8qCz2KK77nS.jpeg)

The first test prints are already programmed in and it's fast really fade. The infamous Benchy only took about 15 minutes and came out perfect. At some stage I’ll have to a head to head against the Ender 3 and see how much quicker is.
![IMG_2078.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diveratt/23wqbyEdCt9ky99Z3cbTVnAUiWDWMGKdtJpWrmPmUpCnB7GRUJt73wyacbmZHiXR3gSVW.jpeg)

So you get a lot of printer for the price that is very capable and accurate 3D printer. The heated enclosure is capable of handling filaments such as PETG and ABS without issue. Where my Ender 3 will really struggle to produce good prints .

There is one down side however because of the speed and mass of the head it does move a fair bit and while the Ikea LACK table is just the right size and works fine with the Ender 3 but it’s no way sturdy enough and shakes about a bit when when it’s printing so I guess I’m going mean I need to invest in something a bit more substantial.  So I guess my mini print farm will look a bit different than  it does now.
![IMG_2069.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diveratt/23y8qVfZgC8P4HJ1ngZ6jGCJM8SS4VS819oxe3nSvT2ikYBEBKWHr7vtsp1jBYBQPqXJL.jpeg)

OK Hivers a quick update.two day later and a  trip up to Ikea in Exeter again today and picked up a system BROR work bench which was recommended for the Bambu Labs Printer and it’s much more sturdy than the LACK coffee table. Every thing is up a little higher but I can live with that, defiantly the right table for this job and I have some useful storage space under it.

body.body: 1/6 🧵 Noah Laba was supposed to be “promising.” Instead, he walked into Rangers camp, led the team in preseason scoring, grabbed the third-line center job, and basically refused to give it back. Not bad for a 22-year-old coming out of college.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/6 🧵 The surprise wasn’t just making Opening Night. It was staying. Laba played 74 games, only missing time due to two injury stints, and each time he returned there was still a lineup spot waiting for him. That says the coaching staff trusted him more than the usual “young guy getting a look” treatment.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/6 🧵 His calling card is already obvious: size, speed, and contact. At 6-foot-3, 214 pounds, Laba hit a max speed of 23.04 mph, faster than 86% of NHL players by NHL Edge tracking. His 14 bursts over 22 mph landed in the 94th percentile. Big centers who can skate like that are not exactly lying around.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/6 🧵 He also brought bite. Laba finished with 110 hits, sixth on the Rangers, and consistently won races while finishing checks. Mike Sullivan trusted him enough to give him penalty-kill time and a small role on the second power play. That’s how you turn “rookie energy” into actual NHL utility.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 5/6 🧵 The glaring question is offense. Laba had 9 goals and 15 assists in 74 games, which makes him more fourth-line than true third-line at current production. He knows it too: his summer focus is becoming a better shooter, improving stick skills, and producing more in the offensive zone.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
6/6 🧵 The Rangers may need him badly. With an $870K cap hit through next season and possible center-depth changes if Vincent Trocheck is moved, Laba could become a very useful cheap piece. The floor looks real. The next test is whether he can add enough offense to be more than just dependable. 📎 Source

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Roman Anthony’s wrist injury is the latest gut punch in a Red Sox season already wobbling badly. Boston put the 21-year-old outfielder on the 10-day IL with a sprained right wrist, and for a team sitting near the bottom of the AL East, the timing is brutal.

body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 The good news: Anthony says it’s “nothing serious” and plans to return as soon as the IL stint ends. The bad news: wrist and hand injuries are annoying little demons for hitters. Even when structurally minor, they can sap timing, grip strength, and power.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 Anthony’s sophomore season was already off to a slow start: .229 with one homer through 30 games. That’s a sharp contrast from his rookie year, when he hit .292/.396/.463 over 71 games and earned an eight-year, $130M deal. Boston needs that version back, not the compromised one.

body.title: How a Man’s Low Self-Esteem Destroys Marriages (And Why You Can't Fix It
body.body:
Marrying to a man is actually a deep thing. Untreated inferiority complex can actually affect someone in marriage if care is not taken. Low self-esteem has really destroyed a lot of men when it comes to marriage and it has left an indelible mark. 

Some of these men don't just feel small, they see themselves as always small. So small that anybody that is even within their league, they see themselves as smaller than the person. Men with inferiority complex often cope by criticizing and belittling their partners when so they feel less threatened.

They become easily superstitious and jealous. They want to control and they read betrayer easily and they see it as something that is normal. They easily blame everyone else for their unhappiness instead of taking responsibilities. 

Low self-esteem has a way of making you see less of what life is all about. In marriage, where you share your life, space and identity, this is not a flaw. It becomes the emotional climate that blankets the marriage total****
Reasons
﻿ReasonsYouCan'tFixIt﻿

There are some reasons why you can't fix a low self-esteem man who has entered marriage. Many women believe that if they love him enough, humble themselves enough or package their success well enough, they might actually feel secure but that is not the case and it has shown that that's not the case. A deep inferiority complex is an internal belief system, not a misunderstanding that you can explain away. 

There are also some reasons why you cannot fix it. Like I'm saying, self-image is built on comparison so your growth feels like an attack to him instead of inspiration. On a normal day in a marriage, when someone is actually wealthy than another person, they are supposed to see it as something complimentary, not supposed to be a tug of war.

Any feedback sounds like criticism which only deepens his shame and defensiveness. Then validation is into a bottomless pit. The more you give, the more he needs it.

Somebody needs to validate who he is and what he has done. Therapy, introspection and genuine desire to change can really help such a man but those who have been in this decision over a long period of time, there is a lot that needs to be done. For a woman, it erodes the human of the ability to be herself. 

Immediately you mention your friend, it becomes a shadow of what he is expecting. There are so many friends that have become a shadow of themselves because of these kinds of things. It has cost them their life and their health and their mental sanity. 


<center> https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeyaEasS5UrK9QuqFwrV9iXpWnXz44akgJdGYqyMCyHdQ/file_0000000004f071f4844da0c13917913c.png 
</center>


The tragedy is that the very thing that has made many of these women attractive to these men has been driven away. Low self-esteem has belittled the beauty, the love, compassion and the emotion, the drive, the confidence and the light of the marriage has been blanketed out. There is no limit to many of all these things. 

Before marriage, a man should pay attention, even a woman should pay attention to how he handles sex and how he reacts. When no is being said to him, there are some men that can't take responsibilities without collapsing into self-pity or exploding in blame. Probability to be in this kind of marriage is high because there are so many men who don't have anything at all but they are ready to marry the richest woman in town.

body.title: The Friend Who Came Through.
body.body:
So, while still in school I have this friend of mine who was doing well to some extent, as at the time he wasn't a student, but he was staying in the students area... Off campus, I was staying off campus too then. What happened was, after he finished his ND(National Diploma), he decided to stay back in school and hustle a little.



![1000718641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23y8vEvDG6aVZZk4fjv2B6pqSPtFWiUjwHoMZFFm6tvjACqAcCmNVXbZxf3u5FJtciqSL.jpg)



Around that time, he did his IT, and when he was supposed to put in for HND(Higher National Diploma), he didn't, he was trying to start up something for himself so he couldn't afford to merge it both with school. And to an extent, we are very close, we helped each other beiyh financially, idea wise and all.


So, there was a time school was draining and I was getting suffocated, he on the other hand hasn't put in yet, but his business was already doing well, so I asked him for help back then, and he couldn't help. I felt somehow, it was during my final year and I was trying to sort myself out so nothing will delay me in school, so help was all I needed back then.


I saw as my classmates were smiling and busy with their projects, some saying they are almost done, some in chapter 2 and all, and here I am, I haven't even started anything at all. Everything was just too much on me, even still I never let it show on my face, but then inside of me, I was the opposite... I was tired, sick and frustrated.


I never knew God will still use this friend of mine for me, when I thought all hope was lost. Omw Sunday morning, it was after our Sunday service, and in school fellowships, we always finish Sunday services early. I was an exco in church and we were preparing for some programs and handling over. Immediately after the meeting we had as excos that day, I saw him still sitting down at the back of the church, he beckoned to me and I went over to him.



He told me about how things were a little bit somehow for him and all and that he didn't forget me and such, I just smiled and told him, *\

* And we just laughed it off as I asked him when he will be putting in back to school and not allow work to derail him.


![1000718723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xenLLFYPvWHwkA5tQYEuHaEFiNsyXDhkTGm8tAD95yeYHKEYFLQxSmLow3gkfzgWrfS.jpg)


My phone was off for the most part of that day, immediately I switched it on that evening, I was welcomed by a credit alert from him. I wasn't expecting it at all. It wasn't that much, but it was the amount in needed to add to what I have on ground to get my project going and completed. We weren't staying in the same area anymore so I couldn't go to him, I just called to appreciate him and say my little word of prayers.

body.title: No Government formed yet in Tamilnadu
body.body:
We had our election results on the 4th of this month. Till today, we haven't had the government formed. Many people predicted that this is how it would be after the election, but one party had the majority, yet in spite of that, the Governor did not allow the party head to take the position as Chief Minister. It is likely that tomorrow this will come to an end, and Vijay will be taking up the position of Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4kqu9aEmwSkm4a7rwUdUM7iZnr6sdcBB6kFVa5wLzF8/image.png)

Source - Gemini

Vijay is not an experienced politician, but he used to be an experienced actor. We cannot say that his acting popularity gave him this opportunity. But instead, I would say that Tamil Nadu was desperately looking for a change, and he was a potential candidate for that change. Nobody knows how he will run the government, but there are hopes for him, and there are so many people who are ready to do anything for him. What is observed he has also done many good deeds, so it is expected that he might be a good leader to take Tamil Nadu to the next level. 

Anybody who is ruling Tamil Nadu should take the mindset of the people into consideration. They are used to getting free things from the past governments, and apart from that, they are not very supportive of the central government. So the expectation from the Tamil Nadu people is going to be totally different, and I'm very curious to understand how the newly formed government is going to take care of it. There will be lots of issues from the opposition party. They say that DMK is stronger as an opposition party than as a ruling party. So ultimately the next few years are going to be an interesting one where Mr Vijay should make a difference and prove it to people.

body.title: US - IRAN Circus
body.body:
It’s been a while since I posted about the Middle East. Not because things calmed down, but because fundamentally, nothing had really changed. The war was still going on, the ceasefire was barely holding, and the Strait of Hormuz was still effectively closed.

But over the last few days, a lot has happened. And when I say a lot, I mean that within 72 hours we saw a military operation, a pause in that operation, a 14-point memorandum, threats of bombings, oil dropping 8% in a single day, and gasoline in the U.S. hitting $4.50 per gallon.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbkh2dmzbGStJaBxJ6TH7X1TXmsoyaAmxj9P9Z9u2vND/image.png)


PROJECT FREEDOM

On Sunday night, Trump announced something called “Project Freedom.” In simple terms, it was a U.S. military operation designed to escort commercial ships out of the Strait of Hormuz.

And to understand the scale of this, we’re talking about 15,000 military personnel, more than 100 aircraft, guided missile destroyers, drones, basically everything. According to the Trump administration, around 23,000 sailors from 87 countries are trapped in the Persian Gulf because Iran shut down the strait.

Secretary of State Marco Rubio described them bluntly as “sitting ducks.” Isolated, vulnerable, running out of supplies. At least 10 sailors have reportedly already died.

So what happened next?

On Tuesday afternoon, barely 24 hours later, Trump announced that Project Freedom was being paused.

“There has been major progress toward a Full and Final Agreement with Iran,” he posted on Truth Social.

THE 14-POINT MEMORANDUM

And this is where things get even more interesting.

According to Axios, the White House believes it is close to finalizing a one-page, 14-point memorandum with Iran. The goal would be to end the war and establish a framework for broader nuclear negotiations.

What’s reportedly included?

Iran would agree to a moratorium on uranium enrichment, the U.S. would lift sanctions, and both sides would stop interfering with shipping traffic in Hormuz. In other words, the strait would reopen to everyone, including Iran itself.

The U.S. is reportedly expecting a response from Tehran within the next 48 hours through Pakistan, which is acting as an intermediary.

And here’s the important part. According to sources, this is the closest the two sides have come to a deal since the war began on February 28.

But on Wednesday, Trump added his usual twist.

“If they don’t agree, the bombings will begin, and they will be at a much higher level and intensity than before,” he wrote.

Yes, really.

On one hand he says a deal is close. On the other, he threatens even larger airstrikes. Classic Trump.

Iran’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson responded by saying that “negotiation” means a good faith effort to resolve differences, not “dictation,” “deception,” or “blackmail.”

HOW THE MARKETS REACTED

Now let’s get to the part that affects everyone. The markets.

On Wednesday, after reports about the memorandum surfaced, Brent crude fell nearly 8% in a single day, while U.S. WTI crude dropped around 7%.

But yesterday, as doubts emerged about whether the agreement would actually happen, stocks pulled back and oil prices climbed again.

At this point, literally every Trump post is moving billions of dollars.

And then there’s the most painful number of all.

Gasoline prices in the U.S. rose above $4.50 per gallon for the first time since July 2022, according to AAA. The average American now feels this every single time they fill up their car.

Warren Patterson from ING put it clearly: “Any agreement that normalizes oil flows through Hormuz is critical.”

Why?

Because around 13 million barrels per day of disrupted supply are currently being offset largely by inventories. And those inventories are shrinking fast. Every day this continues, the market becomes more vulnerable.

And even if Hormuz reopened tomorrow, Nicolo Bocchin from Azimut warned that it would still take “weeks and weeks” for trade flows to normalize.

LEBANON, CHINA, AND DOMESTIC PRESSURE

At the same time, the situation is not purely diplomatic.

Israel announced that it killed a Hezbollah commander in the southern suburbs of Beirut, marking the first strike on the city since last month’s ceasefire. In other words, the Lebanon ceasefire is also hanging by a thread.

Meanwhile, Iran’s Foreign Minister met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Beijing. China, one of the biggest buyers of Iranian oil, reportedly told Tehran that continuing the conflict would be “unwise.”

And this is where Saudi Arabia and Kuwait enter the picture. According to The Wall Street Journal, both countries have opened their bases to U.S. forces. Meaning that if negotiations collapse, Trump already has a Plan B.

But there’s also domestic pressure building in the United States.

Midterm elections are only six months away, and polls suggest Americans are growing tired of the war. With gasoline at $4.50 and energy costs eating into household budgets, the political pressure is becoming intense.

body.title: Hiking the ancient forest paths of the Vršac Hills
body.body: > Over the past few days, the weather was perfect for spending time in nature, so my wife and I decided to take the kids on a walk along a forest trail leading toward the Church of Saint Theodore in Vršac, located not far from the Cathedral of the Holy Cross. We found a small path—one that many might easily overlook—starting right from the asphalt road and leading straight into the forest, and so we set off on a new adventure.

> Aleksandar was thrilled with the idea, acting like a true little explorer, while our daughter Anja was cozily tucked into her mom’s ring sling, like in a kangaroo pouch, enjoying the cheerful chirping of birds.
> When we reached a nearby rock, Aleksandar climbed up and sat down, and we took a short break to drink some water and have a few snacks.
> We then continued climbing toward another rock and came across a small stream, which, unfortunately, had almost dried up.
> Our hike went on through the forest until we reached a large cluster of rocks, where we paused again for water. As I turned around, I caught a glimpse of the city panorama through the trees.

> Further along the way, we came upon an abandoned, partially ruined house. The kids curiously peeked through what used to be windows and doors, asking if a wicked witch lived there, just like in the story of Hansel and Gretel.

> Sunlight filtered through the branches of linden and oak trees, lighting up our messy hair. Soon after, we reached a set of old stairs leading to the road toward the Church of Saint Theodore in Vršac, which was now getting closer.

> By that point, the kids were already starting to feel tired, so we had to carry them. As we continued, we passed a large, luxurious weekend house with a swimming pool and white peacocks, which were unfortunately fenced in. The fence had electric wiring, so it wasn’t safe to get too close.
> From there, the path turned into an asphalt road with a few houses and a large mobile network antenna.
> On the left side, we finally spotted the well-known Vršac church, but unfortunately, we couldn’t go inside because it was closed.
> The kids soon found some puppies near a fence and happily started playing with them and petting them.

> Meanwhile, I noticed an interesting detail on the facade of a weekend house from the 1970s. Its mosaic design fascinated me with its authenticity, depicting hills and vineyards. I wondered how much time it must have taken the craftsman to carefully place each tiny decorative stone.
> At the end of our journey, we enjoyed walking down the steps at sunset. In the distance, on the horizon, we could see white wind turbines slowly turning and generating electricity.

>

Another successful day in nature—just one of many beautiful spots on the Vršac Hills, a place where you can always discover something new, but above all, truly enjoy the beauty of nature.

body.title: Nobody throws stones at a tree that has no fruit. [En-Es] Nadie tira piedras a un árbol que no da fruto.
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

I've never seen such an abrupt and prolonged drop as this one, and with it, the possibility of Hive disappearing altogether. But between readings, I find signs that give me hope of seeing our cryptocurrencies revalued.

I'm not referring to the price spikes of the last two or three days, which I consider part of the positive signs.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaxQmNwVme6NH7caj3Q1UyxhkfXmMZLCreqi74mWvfHDs/image.png)

Nor am I referring to the relaxed approach to publishing, which suggests a greater interest in sharing and connecting than in eagerly reaping rewards in votes that can be converted into income.
Those of us who continue publishing articles, photo essays, and audiovisual content are committed to the continuity of the communities, but we depend on technical support, which in turn depends on financial support. And what initially seems like bad news and a problem possibly originating from conventional social media, known as BOTS, is now appearing here in Hive, an unmistakable sign of our value.

# Nobody throws stones at a tree that bears no fruit.

Undoubtedly, this is a worrying issue that must be considered and controlled to prevent these tools and the abuse of AI from manipulating and draining resources that should be kept within the ecosystem.

Since I started, I've occasionally withdrawn funds for various purposes and even drained my power or HP before migrating. Since then, I've tried to increase it and even changed my HBD when I thought Hive would rise again.

I was wrong, and it continued to decline rapidly. Now it seems to be at rock bottom, and although it could continue to fall until it disappears, I don't think so.

Its extinction benefits no one.

From the bottom, the path of least resistance is upward, so I hope I don't make the same mistake again by choosing to stay and continue posting, commenting, and voting for the creators I like.

Some may not generate significant profits, but for me, feeling good is paramount, even if I don't make a substantial financial gain.

I hope the whales, witnets, and developers are working on this for the benefit of everyone.

If my thoughts resonate with you, feel free to comment as you wish or tag anyone who might have a positive influence on the matter.

>I write in Spanish; since I don't know English, I use Google Translate to share with those who write in that language.

>The image is a screenshot of Hive's value on the Binance page from a few days ago, not today.

# The same now in Spanish. 
# Lo mismo ahora en español.

Nunca vi una caída tan abrupta y prolongada en el tiempo como hasta ahora y con ella la posibilidad de ver desaparecer a Hive, pero entre lectura y lectura encuentro indicios para conservar la esperanza de ver nuestras criptomonedas revaluadas. 
No me refiero a los picos de incremento en los precios de los últimos dos o tres días, que considero parte de las señales positivas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaxQmNwVme6NH7caj3Q1UyxhkfXmMZLCreqi74mWvfHDs/image.png)

Tampoco me refiero al relajamiento en las formas y maneras de publicar, que denota un interés mayor en compartir y relacionarse que una ávida cosecha de recompensas en votos convertibles en ingresos.
Quienes continuamos publicando escritos, reportajes fotográficos y contenido audiovisual apostamos por la continuidad de las comunidades, pero dependemos del soporte técnico que a su vez depende del financiero. Y lo que en principio se ve como una mala noticia y un problema que posiblemente viene desde las redes sociales convencionales, conocidos como BOTS. Que estén haciendo su aparición aquí en Hive es señal inequívoca del valor que tenemos.

# Nadie le tira piedras al árbol que no tiene frutos.  

Sin duda, es un tema preocupante que se debe considerar y controlar para evitar que con estas herramientas y el abuso de la IA manipulen y drenen recursos que deben mantenerse dentro del ecosistema. 
Desde que me inicié, de vez en cuando he retirado fondos para distintos propósitos y hasta drené mi poder o HP antes de emigrar. Desde entonces he tratado de incrementarlo y hasta cambié mis HBD cuando pensé que el Hive volvería a subir. 
Me equivoqué y siguió bajando aceleradamente. Ahora parece estar en el fondo y, aunque pudiera seguir bajando hasta desaparecer, no lo creo. 
A nadie beneficia su extinción.
Desde el fondo, el camino de menor resistencia es hacia arriba, por lo que espero no volver a equivocarme apostando por permanecer y seguir publicando, comentando y votando a los creadores que me simpatizan. 
Algunos puede que no generen mayores beneficios, pero para mí es primordial sentirme bien, aunque no saque un beneficio económico sustancial.

Ojalá las ballenas, witnets y programadores estén trabajando el asunto en beneficio de todos.
Si mi reflexión tiene algún sentido para ti, siéntete en libertad de comentar a tu gusto o etiquetar a quien pueda tener una influencia positiva en el asunto.

>Escribo en español; como no sé inglés, empleo el traductor de Google para compartir con quienes lo hacen en esa lengua. 
>La imagen es una captura de pantalla del valor de Hive en la pagina de Binance de hace dias, no de hoy.

</div >

links.title: Beauty is not forever, let's not make a difference.
links.body:
>


Beauty is something that doesn't last forever. There is a definition of beauty, which is that whatever you find beautiful in your eyes is essentially beauty. But it is very difficult to find a match for beauty. Especially something that looks beautiful to one person may be ugly to another. Basically, the definition of beauty is different for each person because beauty is different for everyone. So what is beauty? That is what today's discussion will be about. 


![vuhoangno7-woman-8182795_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT6r3vt1sK5GMSkf42X1PNdGvHvGewnMcbfTc4m6fBGwS/vuhoangno7-woman-8182795_1920.jpg)[src](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-coffee-young-dress-8182795/)


People grow up with affection from childhood and gradually pass through childhood, adolescence, youth, and old age. From birth onwards, a person's beauty changes at every moment. People are very beautiful to people because of the beauty of each era. But the thing about imagination is that at some point, any beauty fades away. Beauty is constantly changing, think about it, do you recognize yourself when you come home sunburned? But when you take care of your appearance, maybe your heart will smile a little.

It's not a joyful smile, but this smile comes from the heart. But have you ever wondered if you might not be able to bring back this wonderful beauty one day, even with the best cosmetics in the world? It is an eternal truth that beauty will fade one day. No matter how hard you try, you cannot bring back the beauty of childhood or youth in old age. The beauty of childhood is very magical to people, but even if you want to, you won't be able to regain that childhood beauty when you're older. Because no human can change nature at will. 

![gromovataya-woman-3096664_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNs8GMtH3mkVyBcoskGfiU57715HAjDCBCjzqy55MDHp9/gromovataya-woman-3096664_1920.jpg)[src](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-portrait-face-skin-make-up-3096664/)


We pride ourselves on our facial features, but in a moment, the value of this appearance may become worthless. We don't imagine that our lives are so limited, but it is truly foolish to look for the existence of racism within this limited time. How brave we are with this beauty in our foolish times, yet our bravery may soon be extinguished. We judge people based on their skin color, but we don't know that ugly black people can contribute to the betterment of our society and state. Essentially, people are victims and slaves of racism. 


I harbor some deep hatred for such racist people. Because those who determine a person's future and title by looking at their color are complete fools. Because the only difference between a black person and a white person is color. Everyone is just colored. The poet said, \

That is, we cannot judge people by their outer beauty, because whether we are black or white, our inner flesh and blood are the same. There is no difference in color or religion here; everyone's flesh and blood are all human. And it is an eternal truth that there should be no distinction between white and black. Basically, humans are humans. Best Regards @kabirr Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@kabirr/beauty-is-not-forever-lets-not-make-a-difference-5ey)

links.title: Would Students Thrive Without Grades?
links.body: > Education they say is the key to success and education has grown over the years to become an integral part of our lives. Gone were they days when education wasn’t taken that seriously in my part of the world but today, everyone is educated to some extent no matter how little. It’s actually good to see how far we have come as a country and a continent at large in terms of education even thought I know there is still more to do. This at least is a step I towards the right direction. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMgSnNTLgC9YMLE5Gp6ceZ9Vcr7RpmuzjwKmYN3HpHcw/img_0454.jpg) I have been in the educational system from the very beginning. I started schooling even before the school age then because my parents were busy and so they decided to take me to school. I’d say it was a good call because I was able to get that solid foundation which has led me here today. Back then, primary school was very competitive because everyone wanted to top the class. Thanks to my inherited intelligence, I didn’t need to fight to be at the top of the food chain. I was always up there- I don’t mean to brag but I have to.😂 The grading system then was just basic math. I could single handlers grade my entire class because the grades were based on our exam score and continuous assessment. Honestly, the entire educational system is that way now. But the good thing is, this grading system helped us assess ourselves by knowing our strengths and weaknesses so as to know where we need to do something polishing. Fast forward to high school, it was equally ver competitive with the same grading system and a large number as compared to primary school. For me, I didn’t really care much about the grading in high school like I didn’t in primary. My goal in high school was to pass my final exams. I didn’t care much about class competition and all even though I knew it was something people were battling for but no on spoke about. University was more about real life and real world. There was nothing like fires in class or second in class. Your results are between you and your portal. When you don’t study and see the bad grades in your portal, you know to sit up and when you pass because you put in the work, you know it was worth it. When it comes to the grading system, I am of the view that the grading system during my primary school days was somehow a good thing then- but now things have changed. It’s still competitive in but these days anything can happen. In this era of technology, some students will go as far as cheating or even paying their way to the top of the class which will at the end of the day not even be worth it when they step into the outside world. The grading system for me is okay because we use both the A-F and also the actual marks so you can know you mark and the grade it corresponds to. What I think could be worked on is the result distribution. If there could be a portal for all students where they could asses their grades and have some privacy, it would be best because some students may have issues and might not be able to deal with the stereotype and all. The way, only the teachers know which students need to put in more effort and make sure to drive them to the right direction instead of making their fall backs general knowledge. This topic however is a subjective one and this are my thoughts on it. - - - image belongs to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)
