# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 08.05.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23u5YxFpUr4vb6ibopTqs3WBNz7jbPesGvwe6w37b322A4ShjGzsAZ1QqZXoVrxW9nfEt.jpg)

---

## 📰 NEWS

### ***Laboratoria Medyczne Optimed zhackowane przez grupę z Białorusi — dane pacjentów zagrożone***

Laboratoria Medyczne Optimed Sp. z o.o. poinformowały o cyberataku, do którego doszło 3 maja 2026 roku: zorganizowana białoruska grupa cyberprzestępcza uzyskała nieautoryzowany dostęp do części infrastruktury informatycznej. Nie można wykluczyć kradzieży danych pacjentów — wśród zagrożonych informacji mogą znaleźć się imię i nazwisko, data urodzenia, numer PESEL, adres, dane kontaktowe oraz — co szczególnie niepokojące — wyniki badań laboratoryjnych i historia leczenia. Spółka powiadomiła Urząd Ochrony Danych Osobowych i CERT Polska. Optimed ostrzega, że skradzione dane medyczne mogą zostać wykorzystane do kradzieży tożsamości, wyłudzeń finansowych lub szantażu informacjami o stanie zdrowia pacjenta. Każdy, kto korzystał z usług Optimed, powinien zastrzec numer PESEL przez mObywatela i zachować czujność wobec podejrzanych kontaktów.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQP5TR3s7cpfEaMSEkqePc3UbTzWZkUznYxwzLnrjH6DPQRYhcX5ktkP4TAaoUMa4oN.png)

*Źródło: [Niebezpiecznik](https://niebezpiecznik.pl/post/laboratoria-medyczne-optimed-zhackowane-dane-pacjentow-mogly-zostac-wykradzione/) [PL]*

---

### ***Policja rozbija w Polsce sieć twórców i dystrybutorów treści pedofilskich — kilkanaście zatrzymań***

Polska Policja przeprowadziła zakrojoną na szeroką skalę akcję wymierzoną w zorganizowaną grupę odpowiedzialną za tworzenie i dystrybucję treści przedstawiających seksualne wykorzystywanie dzieci. Działania koordynowała centralna jednostka Policji przy współpracy z Interpolem i partnerami zagranicznymi. Zabezpieczono urządzenia elektroniczne, serwery i nośniki z ogromną ilością nielegalnego materiału. Osoby zatrzymane usłyszą zarzuty m.in. produkcji i rozpowszechniania treści pedofilskich. Akcja jest elementem ciągłego, systemowego zwalczania przestępczości seksualnej przeciwko dzieciom w cyberprzestrzeni. Każdy, kto ma informacje mogące pomóc w identyfikacji ofiar lub sprawców, może zgłosić je anonimowo na platformie HOTLINE DYŻURNET.PL.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23x17EG8eVY9WATQaQLHpKY6fHtMAcsBdmFrL4dxYMTyU5ZGG6coUk7rNFMMj3HCASfGW.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/armia-i-sluzby/policja/wielka-akcja-policji-rozbito-siatke-tworcow-tresci-pedofilskich) [PL]*

---

### ***Palo Alto Networks — zero-day w PAN-OS aktywnie eksploitowany przez hakerów***

Palo Alto Networks potwierdziło aktywną eksploatację podatności zero-day w systemie operacyjnym PAN-OS, który napędza zapory sieciowe i systemy VPN firmy stosowane przez tysiące przedsiębiorstw na całym świecie. CISA wydała alert i umieściła lukę w katalogu KEV. Atakujący wykorzystują podatność do nieuprawnionego dostępu do zarządzania urządzeniami i potencjalnego przejęcia kontroli nad ruchem sieciowym organizacji. Firewalle Palo Alto Networks są powszechnie stosowane w sektorach finansowym, zdrowotnym i rządowym. Palo Alto wydało tymczasowe środki zaradcze i pracuje nad pełną łatką. Organizacje korzystające z dotkniętych urządzeń powinny niezwłocznie wdrożyć zalecane środki łagodzące i ograniczyć zdalny dostęp do panelu zarządzania.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23yTjH4vPigrsdoZVf15yVb5AfMbFW4G1JkZqdTZytfZ9chV45bUqVUYJH9M6PWL2zrra.png)

*Źródło: [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/palo-alto-networks-pan-os-firewall-zero-day-vulnerability-exploited/) [EN]*

---

## 🚨 INCYDENTY

### ***Student zhakował tajwańską Kolej Dużych Prędkości — zdalnie wyzwolił awaryjne hamowanie pociągów***

W Tajwanie aresztowano studenta, który zhakował systemy zarządzania infrastrukturą Taiwan High Speed Rail i zdalnie aktywował awaryjne hamowanie składów pasażerskich. Zdarzenie wydarzyło się na odcinku z dużą prędkością — skutki mogły być katastrofalne, jednak na szczęście nie doszło do ofiar ani kolizji. Śledztwo ujawniło poważne luki w zabezpieczeniach systemów przemysłowych (OT) operatora. Przypadek jest akademickim przykładem, dlaczego infrastruktura krytyczna — taka jak transport kolejowy — wymaga głębokiej segmentacji sieciowej, odizolowania systemów OT od IT i permanentnego monitorowania anomalii. Aresztowany student grozi mu wieloletnie więzienie.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23vsdHzu5rErBGnYHc5kEW6mtcCwT9zewB1GW39b61NNZbuxhtUk1ujUKZXQQDetkS8C6.png)

*Źródło: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/191785/hacking/taiwan-high-speed-rail-emergency-braking-hack-how-a-student-stopped-the-trains-and-exposed-a-major-security-gap.html) [EN], [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/student-hacked-taiwan-high-speed-rail-to-trigger-emergency-brakes/) [EN]*

---

### ***Fałszywa strona Claude AI dystrybuuje nowe złośliwe oprogramowanie Beagle***

Badacze zidentyfikowali kampanię, w której cyberprzestępcy stworzyli fałszywą stronę podszywającą się pod oficjalną stronę Anthropic Claude, by dystrybuować nowe złośliwe oprogramowanie nazwane \
. Strona wyglądała autentycznie, stosowała wizualną identyczność marki i kierowała użytkowników do pobrania \

— w rzeczywistości backdoora dla systemu Windows. Beagle po instalacji daje atakującym pełny zdalny dostęp do systemu, umożliwia kradzież danych i instalację kolejnych payloadów. Kampania celuje w użytkowników, którzy szukają Claude przez wyszukiwarki lub klikają reklamy. Jedynym oficjalnym miejscem instalacji Claude jest claude.ai — ostrożność przy wszelkich innych źródłach jest bezwzględnie wskazana.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uFua7Z3zZp5zdLCtRnu25fQgVHhoZJKnWyqVYR1dPfrLKnBa9BRPLnxKvvBv6xXzgkL.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/fake-claude-ai-website-delivers-new-beagle-windows-malware/) [EN], [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/fake-claude-site-beagle-backdoor/) [EN]*

---

### ***Kontraktor Pentagonu — luka w API ujawniała dane wojskowe tysiącom nieuprawnionych***

Badacze ujawnili poważną lukę bezpieczeństwa w platformie Schemata — dostawcy oprogramowania dla Departamentu Obrony USA — która przez niezabezpieczone endpoint'y API ujawniała wrażliwe dane operacyjne i osobowe powiązane z wojskiem: imiona, stopnie, lokalizacje i kontrakty. Luka mogła być eksploitowana przez każdego, kto znał strukturę URL-i. W erze, gdy Departament Obrony coraz szerzej korzysta z zewnętrznych systemów SaaS, każda nieostrożność w konfiguracji API staje się potencjalnym wektorem wywiadu dla obcych służb. Dostawca uśmierzył lukę po zgłoszeniu.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23yToeyFBjiZ7iTFsKjkjMjMbWULUgZuDFjcHeGpYTpZam9hKm2hMbV7vjek5NjfdQx9M.png)

*Źródło: [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/schemata-dod-contractor-api-flaw-military-data-exposure/) [EN]*

---

## 💡 CIEKAWOSTKI

### ***Claude AI naprowadzał hakerów na systemy sterowania wodociągami podczas włamania — nowy wektor ataku OT***

SecurityWeek opisuje bezprecedensowy incydent: podczas włamania na systemy miejskiej infrastruktury wodociągowej napastnicy posługiwali się asystentem AI (Claude) do analizy dokumentacji technologicznej i identyfikowania wrażliwych systemów OT (operational technology). AI \

atakującym — nie ze złośliwości, lecz odpowiadając na pytania techniczne — wskazując, które moduły sterowania wodociągami są dostępne i jak są skonfigurowane. Incydent jest pierwszą udokumentowaną sprawą, w której AI był aktywnie używany do naprowadzania na cele OT podczas realnego ataku. Otwiera to nową debatę o tym, jak modele AI powinny obsługiwać zapytania o infrastrukturę krytyczną — i czy potrzebne są specjalne \

dla takich scenariuszy.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQP1araL9mMTWq34agRytiBEABtR3yCmgvNyYiAcH5dWyaTPC4JKPNkweHkh6DoPsTu.png)

*Źródło: [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/claude-ai-guided-hackers-toward-ot-assets-during-water-utility-intrusion/) [EN]*

---

### ***Farmy laptopów dla Korei Północnej — Amerykanie skazani za wieloletnią sieć kryptowalutowych przekrętów***

Amerykański sąd federalny skazał kilka osób za prowadzenie sieci farm laptopów, które umożliwiały północnokoreańskim pracownikom IT omijanie sankcji i zdalną pracę dla zachodnich firm pod fałszywymi tożsamościami. Każda farma to zestaw laptopów z oprogramowaniem pulpitu zdalnego, przez które północnokoreańscy \

podszywali się pod lokalnych freelancerów i zarabiali miliony dolarów — które trafiały do programu nuklearnego KRLD. To dobrze zorganizowana, długoletnia operacja: część firm nieświadomie płaciła wynagrodzenia bezpośrednio wrogim podmiotom objętym sankcjami. Sprawa podkreśla, jak weryfikacja tożsamości przy zatrudnianiu zdalnych pracowników IT stała się kwestią bezpieczeństwa narodowego.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23zGjBKQPBg4vvUbaeq9dLkuXfy1dshbiLGK4QehyB33QuCuQ8yAHpWSYFen6diZABKQN.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/americans-sentenced-for-running-laptop-farms-for-north-korea/) [EN], [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/north-korea-it-worker-scheme-laptop-farm-facilitators-sentenced/) [EN]*

---

## 🎣 OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

### ***Oszustwo na ZUS — dzwonią z \

, żądają 800 zł opłaty***\n\nTelepolis i ZUS ostrzegają przed kolejną iteracją telefonicznych oszustw na Zakład Ubezpieczeń Społecznych: przestępcy dzwonią do obywateli, podszywając się pod pracowników ZUS lub doradców \

korzystniejszej emerytury za jednorazową opłatą 800 zł. Osoby starsze są szczególnie narażone — obietnica wyższej emerytury jest niezwykle skutecznym haczykiem socjotechnicznym. ZUS nigdy nie pobiera opłat przez telefon, nie kontaktuje się z prośbą o dane karty ani nie oferuje \

świadczeń. W przypadku takiego połączenia należy rozłączyć się i zadzwonić bezpośrednio na infolinię ZUS pod numer 22 560 16 00.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/48ZaXj9i3YriDaTNvxTWHwveTgq4NWthacfL9YwnaGWS8b3dgxbMbtpsKPhuPnrEAT.png)

*Źródło: [Telepolis](https://www.telepolis.pl/tech/bezpieczenstwo/oszustwo-na-zus-wydzwaniaja-program-emerytalny-800) [PL], [Telepolis](https://www.telepolis.pl/tech/bezpieczenstwo/zus-telefon-program-emerytalny) [PL]*

---

### ***Nowa fala phishingu na skarbówkę — fałszywe maile z QR kodami i groźbami egzekucji***

Instalki.pl ostrzegają przed masową kampanią phishingową podszywającą się pod Krajową Administrację Skarbową. Wiadomości informują o rzekomych zaległościach podatkowych i grożą zajęciem konta lub egzekucją, jednocześnie zachęcając do \

przez QR kod lub link. Strona docelowa imituje portal skarbowy i wyłudza dane logowania lub numer karty. Kampania jest szczególnie wiarygodna, bo sezon rozliczeń PIT właśnie minął — przestępcy świetnie wyczuwają momenty, gdy Polacy są podatni na komunikaty podatkowe. KAS nigdy nie kontaktuje się przez QR kody w e-mailach. Wszelkie zaległości należy weryfikować wyłącznie przez podatki.gov.pl lub infolinię KAS.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wMaCKES3FEpsJg8Vfd2XioKeXK3G8yyERLwA3uUAkmKQCnBD6ge3XoP57iureWtbKL3.png)

*Źródło: [Instalki.pl](https://www.instalki.pl/news/bezpieczenstwo/nowa-fala-oszustw-na-skarbowke-uwazaj-na-takie-maile/) [PL]*

---

### ***CERT Polska ostrzega: phishing celuje w studentów — fałszywe powiadomienia od uczelni***

CERT Polska wydał alert skierowany do środowiska akademickiego: trwa kampania phishingowa, w której przestępcy podszywają się pod uczelniane systemy poczty elektronicznej i platformy e-learningowe, informując studentów o \

. Link prowadzi na stronę wyłudzającą dane logowania. Skradzione konta studenckie są następnie używane do dalszego spamu lub sprzedawane. Jesień i koniec semestru — okresy intensywnej komunikacji z uczelnią — to typowe okna, kiedy takie kampanie mają największą skuteczność. Studenci powinni zawsze wchodzić na systemy uczelniane przez zakładki lub ręcznie wpisany adres, nigdy przez linki w e-mailach.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tmhMRR9DjJBK27BEpEDuJYQW4AMwuyaYfyCamCeJHQBAqbRvKwTgz8vYRsKuaApFuPP.png)

*Źródło: [CERT Polska](https://moje.cert.pl/komunikaty/2026/60/studencie-uwazaj-na-phishing/) [PL]*

---

## 🌐 DEZINFORMACJA, CYBER WOJNA

### ***Raport ABW 2024–2025: Rosja, Białoruś, Chiny — trzy fronty zagrożeń dla Polski***

ABW opublikowała pierwszy od 11 lat jawny raport z działalności Agencji, obejmujący lata 2024–2025 — dokument wyjątkowy politycznie i pod względem przejrzystości. Szef ABW płk Rafał Syrysko wskazuje na trzy główne zagrożenia: rosyjska \

— osoby rekrutowane online do sabotażu i dywersji, w tym prób wywołania katastrofy kolejowej pod Garwolinem i pożarów w samolotach — celuje w polską infrastrukturę krytyczną. Białoruś aktywnie wspiera te operacje. Wywiad chiński prowadzi równoległy \

— cierpliwą budowę wpływów gospodarczych i politycznych. Raport sygnalizuje też alarm w sprawie radykalizacji polskiej młodzieży przez internet: ABW zatrzymała nastolatków planujących zamachy w szkołach. To lektura obowiązkowa dla każdego, kto chce rozumieć realne zagrożenia dla polskiego bezpieczeństwa narodowego. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23xKza3tbGN5P8WTtjF2svjZoXsMiYzmC3FTjuQ59KufjtVVa9hQdwebsYijDrEJtWKtx.png) *Źródło: [Infosecurity24.pl](https://infosecurity24.pl/sluzby-specjalne/agencja-bezpieczenstwa-wewnetrznego/sabotaze-radykalizacja-mlodziezy-i-chinski-dlugi-marsz-szef-abw-o-zagrozeniach-dla-bezpieczenstwa-kraju) [PL]* --- ### ***Botnet XLabsV1 oparty na Mirai — fala ataków DDoS przez zainfekowane Android TV i routery*** Badacze opisują nowy botnet XLabsV1 zbudowany na fundamentach złośliwego kodu Mirai, który infekuje urządzenia IoT przez podatności w ADB (Android Debug Bridge) — często pozostawiony otwarty na telewizorach Android TV i tanich routerach. Botnet jest używany do przeprowadzania masowych ataków DDoS i był już obserwowany atakujący serwery gier, serwisy streamingowe i instytucje finansowe. Skala infekcji jest znaczna — tysiące urządzeń w wielu krajach. Najskuteczniejsza ochrona to wyłączenie ADB na urządzeniach Android po zakończeniu konfiguracji, aktualizacja firmware i zmiana domyślnych haseł administratora. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tHXKHqUgHZhuaPD84y55EVp6wd2XPGC7kt911FWWH7pS2KdgvLE5DcJ12tqorWZiYAt.png) *Źródło: [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/mirai-based-xlabsv1-botnet-exploits-adb.html) [EN], [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/191796/malware/from-android-tvs-to-routers-the-xlabs_v1-mirai-based-botnet-built-for-ddos-attacks.html) [EN]* ----- *📅 Powyższe zestawienie ma charakter wyłącznie informacyjny i edukacyjny. Wszystkie informacje opierają się na publicznie dostępnych doniesieniach prasowych z dnia 7 maja 2026 r. ⚠️ W razie podejrzenia incydentu bezpieczeństwa skonsultuj się z wykwalifikowanym specjalistą.*

links.body: 1/6 🧵 P.J. Tucker’s NBA career was never about box-score fireworks. It was about survival, defense, corner threes, toughness, and refusing to disappear. After 19 pro seasons, the former Knick and 2021 NBA champion is officially retired.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: Thanks for the Reddit, always appreciated.\nHave a wonderful weekend
links.author: heroldius

links.body: 2/6 🧵 Tucker announced the move Thursday on Instagram, framing it perfectly: basketball was his job for 20 years, but his identity for 40+. His line was basically: retiring from the NBA, not from ball. Very P.J. Tucker. Zero sentimentality, all edge.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/6 🧵 His final NBA stop was with the Knicks, where he played just three games last season. But his broader résumé runs deep: Raptors, Suns, Rockets, Bucks, Heat, 76ers, Clippers, and Knicks. That is a long, weird, very respectable NBA road.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/6 🧵 The peak came in 2021 with Milwaukee. Tucker was traded from Houston to the Bucks before the deadline, then became part of their title run. He played 20 regular-season games and 23 playoff games, averaging 4.3 points in nearly 30 minutes per postseason game.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: Your environment shapes your money mindset too - surround yourself with savers and investors, not spenders. Been building wealth for 8 years now, and cutting out flashy influences let compounding do its magic. Consistency wins
links.author: alphathoughts

links.body: 5/6 🧵 The best part of Tucker’s story: he didn’t stick the first time. Drafted 35th by Toronto in 2006 after Texas, he barely played, got waived, went through the G League, then spent five years overseas in Israel, Ukraine, Greece, Italy, and Germany before returning with Phoenix in 2012.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: Thanks for the curation, fully appreciated\nHave a great weekend
links.author: heroldius

links.body:
6/6 🧵 Final NBA line: 886 games, 6.6 points, 5.4 rebounds, 1.1 steals per game — modest numbers, serious career. Tucker is proof that role players can build legacies if they master the ugly work stars don’t want to do. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/08/sports/ex-knick-and-nba-champion-p-j-tucker-retires-after-19-seasons/)

links.title: Life as a student
links.body:
Every day begins with a plan, but things rarely go exactly as expected. You may wake up determined to study for hours, only to end up discussing football, music, or the latest trends with classmates. Yet somehow, students always find a way to survive deadlines and tests, often with little sleep and a lot of hope.

One of the most interesting things about student life is the friendships that are built. Classmates slowly become family. They share notes, help during difficult assignments, and sometimes even lend money when things get hard. The funniest memories usually come from simple moments — rushing to class late, hiding from strict lecturers, or celebrating after finishing a difficult exam.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQpKE9CAmAuurPAK2EJyrULenDMWK4fTq8DtYShxNi4Cr/1778266074461.jpg)


Student life also teaches responsibility. Many students learn how to manage money, balance time, and make decisions on their own for the first time. Some combine school with side hustles to support themselves. It is not always easy, but those struggles build strength and confidence for the future.

There are difficult days too. Sometimes the workload feels endless, and the fear of failure becomes heavy. A student may feel tired, confused, or uncertain about the future. However, those moments often become the lessons that shape character. They teach patience, discipline, and resilience.

Despite the challenges, student life remains one of the most exciting stages of life. It is a period filled with ambition and discovery. Students dream about becoming successful, traveling the world, helping their families, or changing their communities. Every assignment completed and every exam passed feels like another step closer to those dreams.
Years later, many people realize that student life was never only about grades. It was about growth, friendship, laughter, mistakes, and learning how to face life. The classrooms may eventually be left behind, but the memories and lessons remain forever.

links.title: A Good Systematic Result Finds Out the Best Students.
links.body:
Hello friends! Examination has no value without results. After each exam students eagerly awaiting for the result. The result considered a students present condition and it alarms about how improvement is needed. In the past the exam results was published  on the division system in Bangladesh. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZiFBz8MZKVfzZEHTDfNvWERdeJEpV4s5oKPKY4K5NVJU/1778265885512.jpg)

Above 80% marks - Letter marks
60 to 79%- First division 
40 to 59%- Second division 
33 to 39%- Third division 

Till 2000 this system was continued. On those years of division system the top 20 scorer with above 80 marks in all subjects achieved tha stand mark on the Board.
They were honored by all. In the news papers  thier photo were published. People from other places went to meet with them.
On that time achieving 80 percent marks was too hard. Only the brilliant and industrious students could achieve the letter marks in all subjects. So they got chance to admit in the best engineering or medical institutions of Bangladesh. 
After the year 2000 the result system has been changed and division system replaced with grading system adopted several letters. The top most grade is A+ and the lowest is D grade. If fail then he gets F grade. To get A+ a student should achieve at least 80 percent marks. And for avoiding fail he needs to get at least 33% marks.

The final CGPA is determined by adding the grading points of the optional subject. It is more easier to get A plus than to stand on the board before. So a lot of students every year get GPA 5 which means they achieve A+ overall. The secondary and higher secondary exam results help the students to take a good preparation to adimit in a better University. The Universities take admission tests to select the best students. The admission test result depends on the results of SSC and HSC examinations and the admission test mark he gets. The grading system helps to differ better students from others. 

It is not okey to scrap all the grade points and only publish their results  simply using the pass/fail mathod. If it is done then the unqualified students can get the chance to admit into good institutions. So if it becomes the reality in that case the good students who actually deserve the good institutions will be cheated. So the current result system shouldn’t be changed. It is a good system for all. Even for higher education International Universities also required the grade points to apply in there for admission. The current CGPA system is internationally popular system. A student can be justified on his merit in every job sectors. If results can't define who is good and who is bad then this result actually do nothing. 

Only pass/fail method may apply on the junior students who just started their educational journy. On that case it has no impact because the childhood is the period of learning basic education like writing  alphabet, making sentence, learning easy basic maths etc. So in this period pass/fail method has not any bad effect. I think CGPA system in Primary school is not necessary.  But from secondary school to higher education CGPA system is perfect.

links.body: @taskmaster4450le, using total cargo tonnage: Gulf leaders are Houston 309.5M short tons, South Louisiana 217.5M, Corpus Christi 189.8M, then New Orleans/Mobile/Tampa in the next tier per [BTS 2023 rankings](https://data.bts.gov/stories/s/Top-25-Ports-by-Total-Tonnage/iqfi-cuyv/) and [USACE Waterborne Commerce](https://www.iwr.usace.army.mil/About/Technical-Centers/WCSC-Waterborne-Commerce-Statistics-Center/WCSC-Waterborne-Commerce/). Florida: Port Tampa Bay is #1 at roughly 35M tons in 2023, followed by JAXPORT, Port Everglades, PortMiami, Port Canaveral, Port Manatee, Panama City, and Pensacola; Florida overall hit about 131M tons in 2024 per [Florida seaport reporting](https://fdotwww.blob.core.windows.net/sitefinity/docs/default-source/seaport/pdfs/seaports-fast-facts---2024.pdf?sfvrsn=6e95875f_1) and [WUSF](https://www.wusf.org/economy-business/2024-01-31/florida-seaports-boost-cargo-cruise-traffic). title.title: New Tunes 🎵 🎸 8.5.2026 🎤🎺
title.body:
## Hello music lovers! 🎶  
 
It's Friday and time for #newtunes! 
Weekly selection of music featuring well-known, lesser-known, and even unknown artists who are trying to get a few minutes of our ears. 
Is there even a future global hit among them? You won't know until you listen :)  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbbDLbeVNDt8VugNm3QZHn9nY5BMsshpFFgfXN4RSWcg1/nt.8.5.2026.webp)

Eight songs for curious music lovers! If you like something, you can dig deeper to find more detailed info.
If you don't like, skip it. 
 
**Music4life!**  
 
<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
## The Rolling Stones - In The Stars

A couple of weeks ago, I spotted a new Rolling Stones song on YouTube, which turned out to be a fake, AI-generated track—I think they’ve taken it down by now. But this one is actually theirs.
\

is the Rolling Stones’ new single and the lead track from their upcoming album, Foreign Tongues, set for release this July. A rock anthem about fate and love, with that signature Stones touch - a blend of romance, defiance, and observations of the world. Pop-rock with an energetic chorus, it evokes their ’80s sound while featuring modern production. Judge for yourself.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F-F_oHOvBsM



<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
## EUROPE - One on One

The Swedish hard-rock band, which rose to fame in the 1980s with the hit “The Final Countdown” and is still active today, announces its twelfth studio album, Come This Madness, set for release in September, with the new song “One On One.” High-flying classic hard rock. For the fans.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0PVLyBYNFj4


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

## Kerala Dust - FEVER

I’ve been following Kerala Dust, an English band from London, since their beginnings in 2016. I like their blend of electronic music with influences from psych rock, southern rock, Americana, and blues. I’ve mentioned them several times in #newtunes.
“Fever” is their latest single, released in late April. A typical track for them, even more downtempo, dreamy, and slightly dark, with techno and psych-blues-infused guitar riffs. Perfect for late nights, a drive, or a club set.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vGl82iISlxI


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

## Opus Kink - The Head Tree ft. The New Eves

Opus Kink is an English post-punk, art, and jazz band from Brighton, active since 2017. I’ve mentioned them once before in #newtunes. They’re known for their energetic, chaotic live performances, where they mix styles and genres in a fresh, unpredictable way. So far, they’ve released a few singles and EPs, and we’re expecting their first studio album at the end of July this year.
The song “The Head Tree” is a single released a week ago and a preview of their debut album, The Sweet Goodbye. It sounds a bit different, more disco-like and danceable, with a house beat and male-female vocals - the girls from the folk-rock band The New Eves are helping them out on this track. The song is about the last woman to be hanged as a witch in England.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6sJfQHe7Dfo



<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>
 
## Uncle Acid and the Deadbeats - Don't Let It Control You

Uncle Acid and the Deadbeats are an English band from Cambridge; they’ve been playing since 2009 and have released six albums to date. They’re known for their dark, occult rock and retro ’70s sound, reminiscent of a faster version of Black Sabbath, cult films, and horror aesthetics.
The song “Don’t Let It Control You” is their first single in ten years; they released it at the end of April, and it heralds a new, seventh album. It’s fast-paced psych-garage-rock with fresh energy, and it’s about the struggle against inner demons.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAlc1wP2RLM

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
## These Wicked Rivers - Ain't No Smoke

These Wicked Rivers is a British rock band from Derbyshire; they’ve been performing since 2014 and have released two studio albums. They play a mix of classic rock, blues, southern rock, and heavy groove. This is the first time I’ve heard of them, and I’ll be following them from now on.
The song “Ain’t No Smoke” was released eight days ago and heralds their third studio album, *Fire in Folklore*, coming in October. It’s a slow-burning, atmospheric rock song that builds like waves - from tension to a powerful chorus and a calm conclusion. 


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tAl4xBEUYeQ


<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>

## Antropoceno - Pe Rembi'urama

Antropoceno is an experimental project by Brazilian artist and environmental activist Lua Viana from São Paulo. She’s a new name to me. Antropoceno blends avant-garde black metal / post-metal with Brazilian rhythms (afoxé, candomblé, samba, capoeira), indigenous cosmology, ambient, shoegaze elements, and political-ecological themes. Two albums have been released as part of the project: Natureza Morta, released last year, and No Ritmo da Terra, released this past March.
The song “Pe Rembi’urama” is from the new album, written in the ancient Tupi language and spoken from the perspective of a spirit or a sacrifice - “Aju-ne ixé, pe rembi’urama” means “Here I am, your future food.” Very powerful and provocative. I recommend the whole album because it’s very diverse.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-T8Ktdzlvg4

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
##  Laibach - Love Machine (feat. Senidah)

Laibach, a Slovenian band and the musical branch of the NSK (Neue Slowenische Kunst) art collective, has been actively making music since 1980 and is known for its provocative, totalitarian aesthetic, irony, political commentary, and a mix of industrial, martial music, electronica, avant-garde, and pop. By the way, they are one of the few bands to have performed in [North Korea](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UfFKARb-A_I).
On May 1, they released their 20th album, Musick, their most pop-oriented album to date, yet still featuring the recognizable Laibach sound.
The song “Love Machine,” featuring the sensual vocals of Senidah, a major trap star in the region, is from the new album and speaks of love as a machine.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fSHUY08w6xY

title.title: Undefeated in Gold III: Can a Lack of Energy Derail My Diamond League Push?
title.body: > How are you doing my friends? This week I was happy to join the Gold League in Modern format. It came as a surprise after multiple days of combat. I had a productive week producing and managing my rewards in both modern and Wild format. One surprise on top of the week rewards in Splinterlands is the end of Conflict cards distribution. I gain one solid copy of Dragonlord Mancer. You will see my successful day in Modern Gold III.

> ## A:/ No need to stress If you are a new player in Splinterlands you have to play according to the rules. Your presence in the arena is not limitless. The energy points mobilized on your account drops fast if you are in a difficult pool of players. Two options come as a saving trick in this situation limit your intervention on the battlefield to three combat per day whether you win or lose it doesn't matter. Also, your investment in rewards cards from the lot chest with Glind is the key to level up your cards experience in the combat. This second part of the strategy will help you rank up faster than you think in your league.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbtWrGD3PMNLpAANJBfQStNaEL9PZhY7jM9BF3FpwsSSL/rewards_claim.png)
## B:/ On my way to Diamond League I have been in the arena for at least fifteen minutes. It was an interesting short experience of the temperature in Gold III. My team did not lose a game, but I was doing my best to save Energy point for the rest of the season. If I were to move up in Diamond I will need more energy point for the battles that I have to win.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDLKxPhvYe1Evh91yS4B1jP2bsm4RzUXJ8qKbtSN5cHp/bat_1.png)
I got it right in this combat. This first combat was a test of my concentration. I made it happen on the battlefield. [Combat n*1 ](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_88a1a4d2ab594907d98fc21544321c77) -- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAn6c6r6v2eNR4qXdjAgYnTKh9JeePPDevpNuZFpdZ5d/bat_2.png)
[Combat n*2 ](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_8336764fad0caa15ca7fbda117f41344) I was not focused on this entry. My phone rang, and I had to pick the call while the count-down was below 10 seconds. I made a mistake and submitted too soon my incomplete line of warriors. I was sure to register my first loss of the day, but the outcome was in my favor. -- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZxM8eNQqngVbcsTz7UbWCAa3xddTB2GcgmKGYtErQ7PJ/bat3.png)
I was in my element in this battle where Oridum was powerful enough to take out the opposition and Arachne supportive healing the ally tanker in first position [Combat n*3 ](https://splinterlands.com/pre-battle/sl_46fc9ec124abf614b162eaf647491fd7) Battle won with the amazing fire death combo under the command of Lorkus. -- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXsuH1VUWGFrHfqbR4NZw5dXGFBobKxXme6sBpjz2x3eR/bat4.png)
I was victorious in this combat before the first round even close. My opponent could not deploy his strategy against this defense. [Combat n*4 ](https://splinterlands.com/pre-battle/sl_95f8266f7a08e3d44772a02e73a7840d) The elite unit was a requirement from the ruleset. Therefore, Lorkus played dirty in this combat. -- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfPyX9i8b814EGtZ2jeUq7DXmAT6jiGZVVRrxEqPPbKG3/bat5.png)
The success of my premium line up was a guarantee in this combat. Akane and Rage took control of the battlefield in this combat. [Combat n*5 ](https://splinterlands.com/pre-battle/sl_e7603b963eee0decf112d68e33403196) -- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYU1jK9JGabNQB3gwR2AnpMJcUivvFzTXwYJEcqqP5mHk/gold3.png)

> ## C:/ Will you see my team in Diamond League? I am winning too many combats this last six days. It may be a simple luck but i am on the good position to push my team up in Diamond League. The only problem is the fuel to boost this ascension. Can it be possible that the limitation of energy point affect negatively my progress to Diamond? I have less than a week to make it happen in Modern format. If you were in my position will you struggle to reach Diamond or chill in Gold league?

title.title: Today I am going from Banyuwangi to Denpasar by Bus 🚌 | Crazy bus driving 💥| 3speak.tv
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778264571823-23db38c4164b0bb0.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=tanhub6t9/07e6fd1c)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=tanhub6t9/07e6fd1c)


---

Hi friends. How are you all? I hope you are all well. I am also very well because of your prayers. Today I started my journey on the Indonesian Road from Banyuwangi. Today we will go from Banyuwangi to Denpasar via Gilimanuk. So we start our journey.

First, our bus was parked at Banyuwangi station. I sat in the driver's seat on the bus. Since I will be operating offline, I have no passengers today either. I will do the same journey in the entire bus. I left the station. Our car will be at Gilimanuk. The car started moving towards Gilimanuk.

The weather was also quite pleasant. There was no traffic jam on the road. Very soon our car reached the ferry pier. Here it started raining lightly again. It felt like I had entered the game myself. We crossed the ferry very quickly. After crossing the ferry, the car moved forward for a few minutes and we reached the Gilimanuk station. We took a short break here.

Leaving Gilimanuk station, I continued towards Denpasar. The map shows a border area. But not sure. There may be an area next to it on the real map, but I see this as the last border area in the game.

While driving the bus, I was looking at the surrounding nature. It looked quite nice. Everything was organized. A very clean city.

The car was sometimes passing by the sea and sometimes by the dense forest. There was no jam, no obstacle. I was moving forward quite comfortably. In this way, I reached Denpasar station. Our journey ended here. 

Thanks for watching this video.

---

title.title: Deeper Into The Botanical Garden Near The Water Stream
title.body:
>

The deeper area of the Beijing botanical garden is very beautiful, especially the western section of the botanical garden, which is a scenic spot where a water stream is located, a long water channel that ends at the last point in the north direction deep in the forest mountains. The starting point is quite far from the entry of the botanical garden, and I have visited that end last time in other seasonal times; but this time I have explored the area up to mid-way. I found these scenic, iconic views of the water body, including the large pond in the middle area of the botanical garden.

The location of the Beijing Botanical Garden is in the north-western part of Beijing, which is a mountain region, and the route towards this direction has several scenic spots that are so beautiful and attractive, such as the Summer Palace, Xiangshan Park, and Fragrant Hills Park, which are also so beautiful and attractive to explore. My living place is quite far from the location, and it takes around 3 hours to reach the scenic spot, so I arrive at the Botanical Garden around 12:30 PM. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUaUUaCvE8cuum5cXRP4RSGg2rA5H8Xd4nG9b1BG24ftV/img_20260406_152042.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWRHunH2ZcUF4UegM7o88AYioEy2RH4DmHSzemM8mTnYJ/img_20260406_152049.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBF179U2uQDFKo41rossdFmydNgMHu7YLsBu4upxgkky/img_20260406_152052.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDZdBxviUU8guywdj16S5ckFZzeHnuWCydbSwstaosHB/img_20260406_153645.jpg)



The botanical garden is so crowded, and so many people were visiting the spot when I visited the scenic spot. I have seen in the entry board that more than 42000 people have already checked in the garden, and the garden is so large that I think several hundred thousand people can easily visit the area without much trouble. I found very few people in this water stream area, but the other spots, such as the tulips blooming area, were much more crowded than this area of the botanical garden.

I have enjoyed the scenic surrounding views that are really so soothing with the calmness of the greenery of the freshly grown leaves on the trees. The cherry blossoms are not so visible in this wet area as the botanical garden is divided into many sections with different characteristics of the trees in different locations of the botanical garden. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRZZGMvFEzQTZWm4RMNepCgfTjvB9UmVDw8ibaJx7xZ7t/img_20260406_152122.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdZvajTkyi26pLn1zWULrKRALAHoqLFcxjX5JvEbnz5r3/img_20260406_150930.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWbpzsk38K7Ei8gFUhjUEL8AEazp7Z9swC1ERDM8xdwBb/img_20260406_152026.jpg)

This walking path by the water stream is the longest walking route to the end of the botanical garden, and many people prefer choosing the water side path to explore the beauty rather than the other route to the scenic spot. So, I found many people on the waterside walking path in front of me.

In a nutshell, the scenery of the calm water with greenery in the water side areas, the green mountains in the far distance, everything makes the Beijing Botanical Garden so beautiful that you will definitely love exploring it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbU8ZV5zLtAizp2cbo9CcjE4bb3hf1YNFS7rNXyjFQoJo/img_20260406_152056.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2TWD1mh3Sgf9JhWzUgnCqsnToH8gXWYBjMtjfk3iB2y/img_20260406_153649.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTkY9z8MKcno9Qw3smReqd3JCiVjagkGCuUw9Kjwf2ypi/img_20260406_153633.jpg)



I hope you enjoy my photos of the beautiful natural beauty of the water stream area on a spring afternoon, when the surroundings of the Beijing Botanical Garden are really great. It is a great time to enjoy some outdoor activity like walking in this amazing area with warmer weather after the freezing cold of the winter season in Beijing. If you have any questions, let me know in the comments, and I will do my best to answer them.

Thanks a lot for your time and attention. I will catch up with you at the next one.

Wishing you a good day!

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 08 2026
title.body: <center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g2153c334f7bbc4cc9cbbb18b32b82b1013d755d1a652e8f820a12427d22409df02f186392033b6c9af3f25b8c27c83efe076441583e30c3d4098f8a4d6802f3a_640.jpg)</center>Ah, my last walk was truly delightful! I ventured out to the charming village of Bourton-on-the-Water in the Cotswolds, often referred to as the \

due to its picturesque river running through its centre. As I strolled along the banks of the River Windrush, I was captivated by the honey-coloured stone buildings that line the streets. The iconic low stone bridges and quaint arched crossings provided perfect photo opportunities. It was lovely to see families picnicking on the grassy banks and children feeding the ducks — a classic scene that captures the essence of rural English life. I stopped by the Model Village, a miniature replica of Bourton-on-the-Water itself, which gave me a fascinating glimpse into the village's history. It was built in the 1930s and crafted from Cotswold stone, and walking through it felt like stepping back in time. I couldn’t help but appreciate the intricate details, from the tiny thatched roofs to the miniature bridges. While I was enjoying a cup of tea at one of the local cafes, I struck up a conversation with an elderly gentleman named Mr. Jenkins, who had lived in the village his entire life. His stories about the village's past were captivating, particularly about the local fairs and the changes he witnessed over the decades. He told me about the time in the 1960s when the village became a popular spot for tourists, thanks to its beauty and the rise of domestic travel. As I continued my walk, I wandered through the lush gardens of the Cotswold Motoring Museum, where I admired vintage cars and even learned a bit about the evolution of motoring in Britain. It's amazing how such historical sites are often intertwined with personal stories from locals. Overall, it was a walk rich in both scenery and history, reminding me of the beauty and charm that England has to offer in every corner. title.title: 2 years in Hive: time flies / 2 años en Hive: el tiempo pasa muy rápido.
title.body:
> ## English Hi everyone, a few days ago I realized I'd already been here on Hive for two years, which surprised me. Partly because of how quickly everything goes by, and partly because of my consistency despite the various ups and downs and moments when my energy and inspiration have worked against me. And how this has kept me going, which I must say makes me very happy. Looking back, it's been a journey of learning, goals, and facing various challenges and stages within myself, which have gradually shaped this, you could say, personal structure of sharing and creating.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmPq7CELdgQfNwYup5KwPVnPHQp7dYgsuFaKMBTw7pj2pM/1778264713019.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmRVZSap1Jzgd2rgP4c1NankzYynmjKKJ4BCMVgCnENRKe/1778264720881.jpg
During this time, something that has surprised me about my progress is the growth of my HP (Personal Profile). To be honest, I had pretty low expectations for it. While some tend to focus on a single niche to establish themselves specifically, I've been experimenting and participating in various communities over time, mainly because I have this desire to share every experience or piece of knowledge in a diverse way. I thought at the time that this might work against me; However, I'm surprised every day by how much it's growing, and while it's not much compared to other users, it's quite motivating to keep exploring regularly.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTvMJWjZb4Zt6xxpyv7nXEyq1xvqd2xuKjEkqFsGU9kN/1778264755496.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmRLEhBgMy4ueFgJjfJrd48ecojGtaQHv3iBXTNoxwfcif/1778264764246.jpg
Likewise, I've been exploring the topic of delegations, learning, trying, and testing, not for any benefit, but because I'm curious and I like to learn as I go. I have to admit that I often don't fully understand some of the concepts used here, mainly because I prefer to experiment or learn little by little. But at the same time, I strive daily to learn more deeply and maintain a neutral and optimal perspective, even venturing into other areas like games, learning about tokens, and much more. I have to thank the conversations I have with friends during curation sessions for this, where I can learn a lot.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGJcvzyiAMFMjDL5DM5mv3pHcwbT2kEQHkVNCEMFoehj/1778264779649.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmVhiFZPmacNHNUXa3iQHFNiyDzjj28iMb6ShgK6MDZk1N/1778264787332.jpg
Two years have flown by, and this habit of sharing, even with each new tool that complements Hive, feels like a positive thing for me. As I mentioned at the beginning, it has encouraged me to be consistent and, above all, to stay active, which is part of my personal goal of not procrastinating. And while Hive has had its share of tense moments, it's always a great place to share and do more of what I love, which is writing. I've even had the opportunity to connect with other Hive members, which is simply fantastic. Of course, there's still a long way to go and many things I'm eager to try and learn about on this wonderful platform, including attending an event or two, which I'd really like to do. So, without further ado, and hoping you enjoyed this post, thank you for reading.

title.title: Colorado potato beetle  ( Leptinotarsa decemlineata )
title.body:
Colorado potato beetle we call it the golden potato beetle 
A nightmare for every gardener who plants potatoes.
Since we try to grow as organically as possible in our small family garden. We do not use chemicals or their use is kept to a minimum.
The philosophy is simple: chemicals do not kill just one type of \

, they kill many others, they poison the soil and our environment. And they also have a bad effect on our own.
![20260508_173920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKLsnwK1bxK31NxiRiymRsdR3F6WhRWNzVGNRLtHLKEtwm7sN1eReAhMTkaoRn7.jpg)


![20260508_173925.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKKSUtDBV9KiMUyWv4p9JJWiWc4FbGLm6rHUCcVoniDVKM47Z1AtMZjhubPng1G.jpg)

Colorado potato beetle there are no natural enemies in Serbia, so it acts as an invasive species. The first records of this beetle in our country began before the Second World War, but after the Second World War it became an intensive phenomenon.
![20260508_174012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKSdMkppWTwQGPDbJdYprvjwrBUNNzHBndPkDH7YaHYAy3h9UPVFfou91ePTYVY.jpg)

![20260508_174100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AK9QDjF2ReHA7Eji9NukV4AZvvnhRyDXPhWDWKxfYe1WbCwFqyKWvES3XfYgxd5.jpg)


We use deterrence tactics, so we plant potatoes next to beans, garlic, or other species that deter this beetle. My wife sprinkles the potato leaf with ash, and nettles soaked in water are excellent for dispersing.
Since we are sowing smaller quantities of potatoes, even harvesting Colorado potato beetle the stalks is a consideration.

![20260508_174103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKDhvf3bhoyixLW46TAjtYu9YZCQ7nyoCMdHH8hkJo2Jh98ZdkKJYTgRDRcHEJ8.jpg)![20260508_174105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKCGdQ1XqYNbHusd22fgCtK6aHkL2t13GqY5nYHP3vPcc6YYmd2CAMCZm2A42Zn.jpg)



Even collecting Colorado potato beetles is a consideration.Our beetle managed to hatch eggs. From which larvae develop, which are actually the greatest enemy of potatoes. Because they are able to eat all the leaves.
![20260508_174205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKp8ck6WYnWPuN8P4kfWZhV9TxswAKE7PTYYgYrTY1YNzYmgB4UYxPwibBKvZmP.jpg)

title.title: Between stations and water
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778198923-69eee1fd235a.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/soren.lowe/seed-soren.lowe-2026-05-08/main-1-1778198923-69eee1fd235a.png)
![main-2-1778198933-f3ff0f76cb46.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/soren.lowe/seed-soren.lowe-2026-05-08/main-2-1778198933-f3ff0f76cb46.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

I've always believed that the best reading happens in the margins of ordinary life, in those liminal spaces where you're neither here nor there. Today I found myself waiting for a train with an open book and a cup of coffee at a small station café, and it struck me how perfectly this moment held everything I've come to love about solitude.

There's something about the underground light, the fluorescent hum mixed with the distant rumble of arriving trains, that makes words on a page feel more real somehow. My book was in Russian, dense with the kind of prose that demands your full attention, and I was grateful for the table that let me settle into it properly. The café keeper had left fresh flowers in a vase nearby, and I noticed how the green of the stems caught the warm lamp light. These small gestures matter. They say: this place understands that people need more than just transit.

Later, after my journey, I found myself by the lake. The afternoon had opened into that particular kind of May light where the green of the trees becomes almost luminous. I sat on the old wooden bench by the water's edge, watching how the willow branches framed the far shore. There was a small boat tied nearby, patient and weathered. The water held the sky so perfectly that I couldn't quite tell where one ended and the other began.

I think proverbs exist because we keep learning the same lessons: that the best moments arrive when we stop rushing toward them. That green, at the edge of the day, is a kind of permission.

title.body: <div class= 'text-justify'>\n\n      Ayer fue día de traslado entre ciudades para las series de fin de semana. No obstante, hubo actividad en los estadios donde las series alcanzan 4 partidos en lugar de 3. Los Medias Rojas de Boston regresaron de la gira donde barrieron a los Tigres de Detroit, para recibir a los Rays de Tampa. Antes del partido, se programó la ceremonia de entronización de cinco de sus héroes particulares al salón de la fama del equipo. Fueron 4 peloteros y un hito histórico los inmortalizados. **Jon Lester**: Lanzador zurdo, tres veces campeón de la Serie Mundial (dos con Boston) y figura clave en el título de 2013. **Johnny Damon**: Jardinero central emblemático del equipo de 2004 que rompió la \

. **Mike Timlin**: Relevista derecho fundamental en los campeonatos de 2004 y 2007. **Sherm Feller**: Legendario locutor de cabina (PA announcer) de Fenway Park desde 1967 hasta 1993 y **Bill Mueller** ( como momento memorable): Por su cuadrangular contra Mariano Rivera el 24 de julio de 2004. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Yesterday was a travel day for most clubs heading into weekend sets, but we still had some action with those wrap-around four-game series. The Boston Red Sox hit the tarmac back home after pulling off a massive sweep against the Detroit Tigers, getting ready to host the Tampa Bay Rays at the Fens. Before first pitch, the Sox held a heavy-duty induction ceremony for five franchise legends entering the team's Hall of Fame. Four ballplayers and one legendary milestone officially became immortalized in Red Sox lore. Jon Lester: A stone-cold southpaw and three-time World Series champ (two rings with Boston) who was the absolute ace of the 2013 staff. Johnny Damon: The iconic center fielder for the 2004 \

who finally helped bust the Curse of the Bambino. Mike Timlin: A high-leverage righty out of the 'pen who was lights out during the 2004 and 2007 title runs. Sherm Feller: The legendary voice behind the mic as the Fenway PA announcer from 1967 to 1993. Bill Mueller (honored for a Memorable Moment): Immortalized for his clutch walk-off bomb against Mariano Rivera on July 24, 2004.

# ---

![John Lester.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23sJxWvPjeT9qpgghQq6eS7FHnjP7f6Y1Q4gVRmzj6z5JaUd3HvGaEUTPem5NbqvKr6bJ.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/rays-vs-red-sox/2026/05/07/824767/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Sin embargo, la ceremonia se vio un poco truncada, por el desarrollo del juego posterior, donde los patirrojos no pudieron controlar a la toletería de Tampa. Con problemas todavía en el cuerpo de abridores, donde solo Gray y Suárez han dado ciertas garantías, los medias Rojas montaron en la lomita a el novato Jake Bennett para su segunda apertura de la temporada. No le fue mal del todo, pero 4 carreras aceptadas fue lo que el manager pudo aceptar, para dar paso al relevo. Si usted juega contra equipos de su misma división, no se puede permitir perder y eso lo sabe Wilyer Abreu, quien intentó encender la chispa del equipo acercando el marcador con una carrera impulsada en el octavo, pero el daño ya estaba hecho. 8 a 4 terminó todo y los Rays siguen dando caza a los Yankees, 0.5 juegos detrás; mientras que Boston se hundió a 10 juegos de los mismos mulos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      Unfortunately, the pregame vibes didn't carry over once the umpire yelled \

as the Sox couldn't keep the Rays' bats quiet. With the rotation still in a funk—only Gray and Suarez have really been dealing—Boston gave the nod to rookie Jake Bennett for his second start of the campaign. He didn't get shelled, but once he surrendered four earned runs, the skipper went to the bullpen. You can’t afford to drop games against divisional rivals, and Wilyer Abreu clearly got the memo. He tried to spark a comeback with an RBI knock in the eighth, but the hole was already too deep. The Rays took it 8-4, staying hot on the Yankees' heels just 0.5 games back, while Boston fell a full 10 games behind the Bronx Bombers.

# ---

![Ruiz.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23vi66zujaFYHWraZqcUNAF2suM5UyoDecyJAeSejpDecsC8NuhGanNVUznFjJTheMqTc.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/twins-vs-nationals/2026/05/07/822741/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     En la capital de la nación del norte, los Nationals tuvieron un héroe bateando desde la receptoría: el criollo Kleivert Ruiz. El hombre impulsó 4 de las 7 carreras anotadas por el conjunto, en un despliegue de 3 extrabases productores. En la baja del tercero, puso una línea tendida pegada a la raya de cal, para traer la primera raya de los Nacionales, quienes perdían 2-0 ante los Mellizos. Luego, en la baja del quinto, su equipo perdía 3-2 y largó un doblete sobre la cabeza del segunda base, que se internó entre rightfield y el center. Dos más para la registradora y para voltear el juego. Más tarde, en la baja del séptimo con el partido empatado a 5, devolvió una reca de 4 costuras a las gradas del jardín derecho, para establecer una ventaja que no perderían en el resto del juego. Genio y figura. 7-5 el marcador final y los sorprendentes Nationals siguen detrás de los bravos de Atlanta en el 2do. lugar de su división. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     In the nation's capital, the Nationals found a hero behind the dish in Kleivert Ruiz. The Venezuelan backstop drove in four of the team's seven runs, putting on a clinic with three clutch extra-base hits. In the bottom of the third, he ripped a frozen rope down the line to put the Nats on the board while trailing the Twins 2-0. Then, in the bottom of the fifth with his squad down 3-2, he crushed a ground-rule double over the second baseman's head that split the gap in right-center. That knock plated two more and flipped the script. Later, in the bottom of the seventh with a 5-5 tie, he turned on a four-seam heater and sent it deep into the right-field bleachers to grab a lead they wouldn't look back from. Pure superstar stuff. A 7-5 final, and the surging Nationals keep hanging tough behind the Braves for second place in the division.

![García.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23x1HY41mdk7LfmJ6mMm91S9sezsMkzua6KvFdcQ1xSdd3RXkxo2sodcovj2hVbmP8Kwj.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/guardians-vs-royals/2026/05/07/824117/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Los duelos de la división central de la Americana cuentan demasiado. Y es que se ha vuelto la tabla más competitiva de las Mayores, por lo que cuando hay juegos directos entre conjuntos de la misma división, las victorias son vitales. Y los Guardianes de Cleveland lo entendieron al detener la racha de los Reales de Kansas City en 5 ganados. ¿El marcador? 8 carreras a 5 en favor de los indígenas sobre los nobles. El tercera base Maikel García lo intentó, remolcando una rayita con sencillo y bateando un doble, pero no fue suficiente. Imaginen lo apretada de la batalla en ésta división, que los Mellizos sotaneros, están a 3 y medio partidos detrás de los Guardianes de Cleveland, quienes se consolidaron en la vanguardia con la victoria. Mientras, los Reales bajaron a la 4ta. plaza, desde donde apuntan a los chicos de Ohio a 2 juegos y medio. Será un honor presenciar las refriegas que despejen el panorama acá. Seguimos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The AL Central matchups are carrying a ton of weight right now. It’s turned into the most competitive division in the Big Leagues, so when these rivals go head-to-head, every win is massive. The Cleveland Guardians rose to the occasion, snapping the Kansas City Royals' five-game winning streak. The final score? An 8-5 victory for the club from Ohio over the boys from KC. Hot corner specialist Maikel García tried to carry the load, driving in a run with a base knock and adding a double, but it wasn't enough to get the job done. This divisional race is a total dogfight—even the last-place Twins are only 3.5 games back of the Guardians, who tightened their grip on first place with the win. Meanwhile, the Royals slid down to fourth, sitting just 2.5 games out of the top spot. It’s going to be a blast watching these heavyweights scrap it out until the dust settles. We keep moving.

title.title: The Passage of Time.
title.body:
>

While tending to his horse, John received a telegram from Sadie Adler regarding a job. I rushed home to tell Abigail, but found she had left with Jack, leaving a letter and a gift. To cope with his sadness, John spent days performing grueling ranch chores and building fences.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZQJnXWNhWBFRK85hXKvMEN5rs3cVNuaps8NJq1znyZmq/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPFpdFDZzxkjvXiLsZZWa55BZ7muMYavwha24rewbAmqf/screenshot_2_.png)

It was the next morning when John was brushing his horse, and suddenly Abe came over to say there is a telegram messenger waiting for him. The sudden appearance of a messenger was rare and immediately caught his full attention.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXVzt7k8M2CebSeQwr2a7iLcfKx9ZAkviCEJ4jSgfvhgS/screenshot_3_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVe3pEJovkR5L7TLwLWEYJkKvbN5HFvByXDjf2wz2MVKC/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSAyrGjfc2hVUuWwGUGmaagvAX6zDiRub3ETFwS31ufFd/screenshot_5_.png)

Then I had to get to the messenger and take the telegram, so I went running toward him across the open fields. I felt a surge of curiosity about who would be sending word to the ranch. The messenger stood by his horse.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme86zn9dgLmZas5LrTeXjdKtu9njP3SaSZKiPb3L4N6X6/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPG4YgWtLzUxFLbX4K2GhFmGT43TL64xi8eF4qcChmEdQ/screenshot_7_.png)

The messenger made John sign on the register book to get the telegram, and then he noticed it was from Sadie Adler. She was telling him she got something to discuss that pays good and wanted John to meet her in the Saloon in Valentine.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNsURARyXt6B1ux4SMWg54bJR82wLsofnvDeyZ9E9vYBq/screenshot_8_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYKjXEkEPcyXCcSvXLkSxEJeXsRQWMFsk37qL9diTBAR/screenshot_9_.png)

The telegram from Sadie actually surprised John, and then he had to speak to Abigail at the house to discuss the opportunity. I ran fast as I was also excited about the potential money.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfKHHzCinKdCeyFngithdv6YbJQ32FbvHmFk3JqchFYin/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP2ZU8K5LZhDDtUANfh5Md4vvnno1mKefudsaWTn4hBnv/screenshot_11_.png)

After getting inside the house, John didn't find anyone, as Abigail and Jack had left him, leaving a letter for him on the table. The silence of the home was deafening as he picked up the paper.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbMkrPC9ymFU3jbyMtbgQfjQChx1h8SZ3gyvKzEiu3s6E/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmafy3RejB85Nh5ueuwSUG7UzsPgA5zN7ZnXmw3v6V9qik/screenshot_13_.png)

Abigail highlighted that she can't have their son around John while he is like this in the letter, fearing the ghost of his past life. They saw what happened to their group last time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYwj1wLbrJ4wsx1rW5NzVnnckb9kAjewjkEDtPsYri2DP/screenshot_14_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYUDRJymqdDdXgBoCbgmL5Dp2jGnnCrrhJtXoPG4YFLww/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfF11KAJ5gvYuKe9not6x6hX8FR3rmRohdamKXRiqqsv5/screenshot_16_.png)

Then John found the parcel that Abigail mentioned she bought as a gift for John before she decided to leave. It was a shirt for him, a nice-looking shirt that sat neatly in the box. He held the shirt while feeling the weight of everything he lost.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURGXut8V6DykoWPv86tpbKdjKbSi4FcKfiDWA5t9TGJB/screenshot_17_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZfdfQmaWKLKf7PrJNj7BjudxZBeLmV6usH5voaAs4nEi/screenshot_18_.png)

Suddenly, there came Mr. Dickens to tell John there is work to be done out on the ranch. So he went out to do some work, as he needed the distraction to keep his mind steady.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTegeDqVzc5dZe1DdW5EqQmqohzmRhmCn2u3eEMeShATx/screenshot_19_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXGvo8ufs1nDeJjzSNA7xb4qDWxCWg1cWhRYvSsZis9TH/screenshot_20_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYtcot9EtD8F9JvyJhErTtnoS71TSbdnF9w9yFvan4DXe/screenshot_21_.png)

I had different chores to do to keep the property in order, so I returned to work and I chose to start by building the fence. I hauled the heavy lumber and hammered the posts deep into the dirt. I was hoping each strike helped was clearing John's head.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZKhwL3eX1CEmnj82z2G4xG1DUSVQ5cyeDyvevnj1uri/screenshot_23_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUzV1XX5FRH1f2hFsGLjWUWCu2ybPYTRxq9gS31V7WFX9/screenshot_24_.png)

Then John started working in the cinematic part while the day passed and the sun began to dip below the horizon. He worked with a grim determination.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNT4vf9Jq6PHCRJZiyYwgFoPwPSBpRAFDmxcU5YbKqPD4/screenshot_25_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSNZ6bg3whb7hfZXfbCkVaGv9rqw5zDc9FV3uYkr3V8Zc/screenshot_26_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJ5cVDDxVgZu7ShurU6nkBCc1uSoKycm7MGUYFUBu3Jv/screenshot_27_.png)

Another night passed and John still kept working on the fences, along with different chores around the ranch.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWZNnrGAdGMLXdWxUnassNBVVL8rT6FsphLHFx9G5z1F/screenshot_28_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVBs9X1HTS7FwVz2bvMqEzWqMLCanQkrNDWHSbsY2WcCG/screenshot_29_.png)

Then he was seen milking the cows and maintaining relations with the workers around the ranch to keep up appearances. He moved from one chore to the next without pausing.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU4ArDW753k2wkdKHNRaYB2vw2ns2Yq4cnLkTr2BiEKNG/screenshot_30_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmee7PCCiepxFTsK8Zi1a6m7uDzMzj7NzAdBfPJ4sbp3JN/screenshot_31_.png)

Another night passed by and it seemed like the repetitive nature of the work provided a strange kind of comfort. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSBxgJqkC9bT6Q4o4mEvy6Vv5iRULHiD12ELWwDbiah7G/screenshot_32_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma9CJsWvrSDxevUw3zwxwX3BKgHagL5pMwdMaY1pZy67F/screenshot_33_.png)

It was another morning, and the cycle began again with the first light of dawn hitting the barn. First, he was seen cleaning the stables and then brushing the horses.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvGbDMDbQCBJobTQaoe9tMBuPsustV3K8eeNTc1o7hM5/screenshot_34_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbRzYEf6C5x7z3ectSACGcjEeWadaq7SdFnTqCxe8QrqP/screenshot_35_.png)

And it was probably after some day when he was seen milking the cows in the early morning. It looked like he had at last finished working on the fences.

https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png

Here I'm finishing the post for today, and I'll talk about more special RDR 2 gaming moments in Gaming Photography.

https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gamingphoto/23tRvMuLRERuPePNhyEjtaKt46FiKwDBgwVqqAberwmEFA36fPkh2ad6wvB1RYNKTVezR.png

title.title: Hiking in the Mountains
title.body:
Hello beautiful folks, hope you are living the best of your lives. As few of you might know that I have just finished my exams, so I have this whole week - including Monday - as my vacation. Normally, I just stick my usual routine of morning walk and evening football game; but today, I, along with my friends, decided to go for hiking. It's been almost five or maybe six months since we last enjoy it. Before moving forward, there is one thing I would like to confess: hiking is way harder than it appears. Even with my healthy lifestyle routine, it was hard. And right now, I feel like there are no legs attached. Heheheh! So firstly, we booked bus tickets, and had to wait for like two hours, because of weekend rush. (IDK why but video isn't uploading) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bb09f4df-fd63-4f56-876a-0a55f8e1b2ad.jpg) Picture taken inside the bus. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a7444205-959b-4132-92c5-2bf637a8d291.jpg) Anyways, after few clicks, I just slept during this three hours journey. When we reached there, I was like lemme sleep more and forget about hiking. I don't know, the sleep during that time feels like heaven. Moving forward, as soon as we reached the point, there were tons of jeeps and other rides i.e. horses available. But, we were there for hiking, so of course, we denied all. Although, I felt bad for them, as it is off-season, so they were just waiting for someone. However, this is life in a nutshell. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6cd6221b-7e7f-4705-8f0a-1bd86946c117.jpg) Starting of the route was a simple man-made road. On our way, there were beautiful fields. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d25714b7-6022-4c85-86cb-a99e7616305d.jpg) However, after walking for an hour, we had to hike over natural routes. And things got bit hard, this was my first time on this track, so I was actually scared. But with the support of my friends, I was able to do things easily. Midway through. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d7f583dd-fba3-4c9a-a56e-c6a6e5b8dcd3.jpg) Alas! I was not able to picture the hiking part properly. Primarily, I was scared that I might fall. Secondly, we were left with very little time, because we had to go back down before the sunset. Otherwise, we might had gotten ourselves in some sort of real trouble. In the end, we were not able to reach the top. So, we just decided to descend back. We will surely visit, once again, this time with proper planning and a local person with us. See Ya till then! Peace 🕊 (Pictures were taken by me, using Infinix Note 50 Pro)

title.title: The Impact of Letter Grades and Pass/Fail System on Students
title.body: ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zoe01/6346.png) I have thought many times about the grading system in Bangladesh. Because I was never satisfied with the letter grades system. I always wanted to feel good about my results but I could not because we do not have a pass/fail system. I feel like this is the system that we all needed for a long time. It would be less stressful for the students. But I also know that it can not depict how much good the student is or how well they are actually doing. But still I believe pass/fail system can help students in many morale ways, even though it has some drawbacks. From my personal experience, grades always has been a big deal in my life. Letters such as A, B, C, or even lower has affected my perspective about myself. I still recall that I used to have sleepless nights before the exam day. But I never got the grades as my parents had expected from me. It never felt good, I used to cry out of pressure while writing in the exam hall. It was super discouraging, and at a time I felt like a failure. So, a pass/fail system sounds better because it will be a lot better than the letter system, it will reduce some pressure. It's like if I passed then I would acknowledge that I have met the basic requirements, and I'll not be compared with other students by my teachers or my parents. Pass/fail system would decrease the competitive mindset between the students. Students will stop trying to be “the best in class,” they would start to focus on understanding what they are learning. This is definitely gonna create a relaxed environment where learning doesn't feels like a race anymore. Students like me who has anxiety, this could really help to boost our confidence and mental health. I know students also feel motivated when they study hard and get grade letters of first class and it feels like their effort was recognized. But if it was just pass/fail, that extra motivation might not be there. There might be some students who just wanna pass so they would only need a minimum to do that so they do not give their best. I would not lie, but these grades system did help me to recognize my mistakes and where I stood. With a low grade, I would instantly understand where I needed to improve. With a high grade it would be clear that if I'm on the right track or not. This thing in pass/fail system we will not get to see. Another problem arrives which is that there are different type of students like everyone is passing, and few of them are like who never studies. They only study before the exam night and barely giving any efforts. On the other hand some students who are giving their best. So without letter grades, it may be harder for to see the gap between the students. I feel that, pass/fail is useful but only in few situations, so it should be limited to certain subjects. Like somewhere where ranking doesn’t matter only lessons matter. But if we apply pass/fail system for everything then it might not be the best idea. So, I would like it more if it's more like a mix of both systems. Also, I believe that the education system in Bangladesh is not that good yet, but hopefully it will be near the future. I hope people will start appreciate the efforts of a student instead of just scores. ____ The images are created with [Gemini](gemini.google.com) and edited with [Canva](www.canva.con) ____

title.body:
### Time To Raise The Goal Post

I have long settled at 150k HP and continually sold off the extra Hive in order to diversify my portfolio. That has been a very limited success so far... many projects I invested in went downhill and I am left wondering if I had been better off just stacking Hive. And that is in light of our coin dropping over 90% in just the last year alone... I guess it's fair to say that ALTs in general have all fared quite similarly bad - so at least Hive hasn't really been an exception.

**So why raise my HP goal?** 

[I suppose Hive has had a pretty rough start in 2026](https://peakd.com/hive-133987/@dalz/second-month-in-a-row-with-record-high-inflation-of-10m-more-hive-in-circulation), in which @dalz sees a 20% inflation target for Hive alone... Of course this mainly comes from the conversions of HBD > HIVE and as of now the conversions have actually stopped due to the hair cut rule come into effect. So the 20% projection should already be fairly inaccurate. However, it is clear that more and more Hive is now \

with CMC having us listed with 541M supply. 

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz.shorts/23tv8hGweJu3aLTofrzbc2eYY32jWAK2BjYdxNAGFjMcpWfYducJ26fXMxnDPxghdDn42.png

In other words the 150k HP is going to be worth a lot less in years to come. If I don't want to sell out, the only other option is to stack more to \

with the inflation. 

Since the APR from HP and active curation is at around 10-11% currently, it won't be that hard to achieve that goal post in the years to come. **I am now expecting a peak in late 2028 for the crypto market** and if we do the math, I'd have an extra ~43k HP by that time. So that alone should already be enough. As pointed out previously, being active now and posting on Hive is also much more rewarding. So posting here and there will earn some extra Hive pushing me above 200k in the years to come.

Of course all of this won't matter if Hive's price won't recover. Getting back to the 20-30 cents base line doesn't seem unreasonable, although it also wouldn't be very extraordinary. [With the big pump two days ago, I think we at least have a confirmation that the big CEX whales still have appetite](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@tobetada/hive-macro-trend-change). Once we get back to the previous base line of around 20+ cents, $1 also doesn't seem that far off again - especially since we should have another 2.5 years for some sort of a real ALT coin season to emerge.

I think achieving success will largely depend on whether Hive manages to catapult itself finally into the DeFi space. Just today I realized that @keychain is actually also intending to go cross-chain besides @magi.network. Once we get some decent liquidity there, we truly are unbound from the exchanges and just maybe price will catch up to the one in a kind ecosystem we have built here.

**Do you have a goal post for HP as well and for what time frame?**

title.title: God's Perfect Book (Book Review)
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYQgDC9C5AqErmo2hUPWvw3NKx2VLypEgBSBLPHQdtbw2/bdbd.png 



I have to set the story up on how I even bought this book before we dive into it...

A few weeks ago, I was in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan for work.  While getting ready to leave the city, I came across a church that was renting out the school I was at for my job.

I poked my head into the auditorium to see them setting up for their morning services and beside the entrance was a table with books for sale.  Of course, the one that said '**God's Perfect Book**' captured my attention right away...

I picked it up and then the pastor strolled by....I hit him with the most obvious question there could possibly be...

*\

*

He nodded and we started talking about scripture and the book he was selling.

At first you might be asking, what is the KJV Only movement?  It's a part of Christianity that reads from the King James Version of the bible only.  They argue, it's the pure word of God and all other translations have been corrupted.

And with that in mind, we can look into this book as something you may or may not want to read...

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR9NqLv9hgWQcSBgpV8AFda2M9yjwUyVRQcBnTs8xNWdX/gddg.jpg 

First of all, I'm a HUGE fan of the bible.  Period.  I love the history of it, how it was preserved and how God left it for us throughout history with a clear path to spend eternity with Him.

So the first few chapters of this book are excellent.  The author goes over how the bible has been preserved and the history of the KJV translation.  And I guess the disclaimer is....I'm a KJV only reader, without being....KJV only....

**Huh?**

I read from the *textus receptus* manuscripts.  The received text of Holy Scriptures.  Because yes, I do think there is some suspect things that went with the discovery and translations of the critical text (*which most modern bibles come from*).

However I do not think reading let's say the NIV, leads to damnation.  I do believe God is everywhere in both received text and critical text manuscripts of the greek new testament.

So I do have some biases, because I have a preference. Which is the KJV and NKJV.  But in no way do I think these are the only translations of the bible that are salvational.

But back to the book....

Let me be honest, this could even be called the **KJV Only Manifesto**.  Because it's clear that the author has a staunch opinion about the KJV and every other translation.  And it can be a fascinating look into why *KJV Onlylists* have this frame of thinking.

Because once agin, this is a fantastic look into the history of the bible and how we got what we got.  But the opinion is that leaning on the side of KJV only.

I did enjoy all the references that the author placed as footnotes on the bottom of each page, so it's not just random opinion thrown around.  He did do his research and that should be commended.

But at the end of the day, things like this can end up being very divisive. 

I know a few years ago, I was on the side of 'KJV Only'.  But now the more I have looked into it, including the reading of this book, I do believe, you can read any modern translation and still find God everywhere within it's pages.

A great history lesson on the best selling book of all time but you have to keep in mind, this is leaning on the side of KJV only in it's grand message. 

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@jongolson/gods-perfect-book-book-review-gur)
