title.title: Easy money? I don't believe it
title.body: Whenever I hear the line from a popular comedy series: \

, which I have received in my life from acquaintances, passers-by and various suspicious characters.

There is hardly any easy money anywhere.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUL4YbkpHur2HTm2UcaRyrAPG9Avu7JNhpwh3qNPLKRqb/1778263710916.jpg)

Even in this new crypto world - where for 1$ sometimes someone makes 1000$ (a possibility that is measured in parts per thousand and which never happens to us personally 😀), because with 1000$ you will make 900$ (at best 1100$).
That easy money that is mentioned in the crypto world sometimes costs individuals their heads, and certainly a lot of nerves...

And outside of the crypto world, getting easy money is usually an even more difficult mission.

I wouldn't mention gambling, casinos and betting shops wouldn't be renovated every now and then, and their owners wouldn't be millionaires, if they weren't doing business in the red.
Read, their plus, our minus 🙂

And what is left?
Either honest and hard work, which brings earnings with which you can usually lead a normal life, or not so honest, which can bring a mountain of money, but the collapse of reputation, honor, and sometimes a significant reduction in the number of years spent in freedom under this blue sky of ours...

One of today's weekend-engagement questions is:
*Would you accept a job that you knew was criminal just to make a healthy sum of money?*

I never thought of accepting a criminal job, which would really bring me large amounts of money, but which would make me a man, the kind I don't really like or respect today (I would write first, I despise).


It doesn't necessarily have to be engaging in criminal activities, but perhaps just working for someone who engages in criminal activities?

I will freely write here, and if anyone wants, they can look for a term on the Internet, related to today's situation in Serbia. I have never been and will never be \

in Serbia works for a criminal organized group that steals an entire country and its entire people!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThPWKwZnsd5idFkFTpUypnMfWz6uhSjpYpaBmafMQ4bQ/1778263505569.png)

As a young man, I passed my driving test very early and knew how to drive well.
One of my peers, who was connected to some criminal structures (related to the car mafia), offered me and another friend to drive cars for him outside the borders of our country. 
He offered us money that we could only dream of at the time.

Knowing him, we knew that there were some dubious actions involved and although the offer seemed tempting to us (expensive car, a lot of easy money...) neither of us accepted the job.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThPWKwZnsd5idFkFTpUypnMfWz6uhSjpYpaBmafMQ4bQ/1778263548351.png)

Decades have passed. While I was waiting to board the plane at an airport, I heard someone calling me from behind.
It was that boy, now a middle-aged man from my neighborhood.
\

We got into a short story.

He had piles of money, jewelry, girlfriends, cars, and when he was caught in the business he was in, a conviction and a prison sentence. 
Then, the loss of money, cars and girls. Then, after serving the prison sentence, crimes again. So prison sentence again.

And only a few years ago, he made the decision to start doing an honest job and to feel a bit of life without fear and constantly looking behind his back, whether he will be chased by the police or some rival criminal group...

And me?
I had continued education. Then, one job. Then girl. Then, the car. Then, training. Then, another job. Then, travel. So progress at work. Then, jewelry and an apartment... And an honest life.
A life I wouldn't trade for the one he offered me more than 30 years ago.
During this \
time of mine, little by little, I acquired as much as I could and everything I have now was honestly earned.\nIt may not be piles of money, but \
says the old proverb.\nAnd knowing that it was earned through honest and hard work, each coin shines even brighter.

title.title: Ultimate Wrestling Season 3 - Ch.12: Empire's End: PART - 10
title.body:
![001_8.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf4N9GnqSUarZyVP6XNU5moYiswpYdd2WqXDjHBfpZDSD/001_8.png)

The camera cut back to the Sacred Order locker room, and the room no longer looked like a place where men prepared for battle. It looked like a shrine that had just been struck by lightning.

Incense still smoldered in a shallow brass bowl near the far wall. Prayer beads hung from a steel hook beside neatly folded black robes. A low wooden table held a lacquered box, a chipped porcelain teacup, and an old ceremonial cloth marked with faded kanji. The room had always carried that strange tension unique to the Sacred Order, one foot in the world of wrestlers and one foot in something older, stranger, heavier. Discipline. Ritual. Silence.

Ryota Arakawa shattered all of it with a roar and a flying steel chair.

The chair slammed into a bank of lockers with a brutal metallic explosion. One locker door caved inward. Another sprang open. The incense bowl rattled. The teacup tipped and cracked against the wood. The sound ripped through the room so violently that even the camera seemed to jolt with it.

Ryota stood there breathing hard, chest rising and falling like a bull ready to gore somebody. His fists were clenched so tightly the veins in his forearms bulged. His long dark hair clung damply to the sides of his face. He had not calmed down after watching Kami Nakada walk out with the title she had taken from Tatsu Hime. If anything, the sight of it had broken something open in him.

Across the room, Saikō Sasori sat cross-legged on a bench, back straight, hands resting on his knees.

His eyes had been closed.

Now they were open.

Slowly.

Without hurry.

That only made Ryota angrier.

To one side, Shinku Ryujin stood against the wall like a carved guardian at the gate of a temple. His arms were crossed tightly over his chest. His red dragon mask hid most of his face, but the exposed lower half wore a hard, bitter frown. His eyes were still shut. The red shadow around them bled into the edges of the mask like dried war paint. He looked like wrath held on a chain.

Ryota took a step forward.

Then another.

**Ryota:** This is what we are now?

His voice bounced off the steel and concrete, raw with disgust.

Ryota kicked the fallen chair aside and pointed toward the door as though Kami Nakada herself were still visible through it.

**Ryota:** We just stood there and watched another one of us fail. Another humiliation. Another warning. Another crack in the wall.

Sasori said nothing.

Ryota laughed once, a short, ugly sound with no humor in it.

**Ryota:** Of course. Of course you say nothing.

He spread his arms and turned in a half-circle, gesturing at the room, the lockers, the cloth, the incense, the whole pathetic little sanctum they had built around themselves.

**Ryota:** Sit. Breathe. Meditate. Fold your hands. Burn your incense. While everything around us burns for real.

Sasori’s face did not change, but one finger on his knee curled ever so slightly inward.

Ryota saw it.

He moved closer.

**Ryota:** Good. You heard that.

Shinku opened his eyes.

Only then did the room seem to get quieter.

He did not uncross his arms. He did not move away from the wall. He just watched now, silent and severe, his gaze sliding from Ryota to Sasori and back again.

Ryota’s voice thickened with emotion, rage mixing now with something uglier and more human.

**Ryota:** Tatsu Hime lost that title, and Kami kept it. Do you understand what that means? Do you understand what that cost us?

He jabbed a finger into his own chest.

**Ryota:** I do.

Then he pointed at Shinku.

**Ryota:** He does.

Then at Sasori.

**Ryota:** Do you?

Sasori remained seated for one more moment, then slowly rose to his feet. The movement was calm, controlled, deliberate. It should have defused the moment.

It did the opposite.

Ryota stepped right into him.

**Ryota:** No. Don’t do that. Don’t stand up and give me that look like you’re above this. Don’t give me the mask. Don’t give me the legend. I’m not asking the Scorpion King right now. I’m talking to the man I grew up with.

That landed harder than the chair had.

For the first time, something faint shifted in Sasori’s eyes. Not shock. Not anger. Just a tiny flicker, as if Ryota had put a blade exactly where he meant to.

Ryota saw it and pressed.

**Ryota:** You cannot fail tonight.

His voice lowered, and somehow that made it more dangerous.

**Ryota:** You do not get to fail like the rest of us have failed.

Shinku’s jaw tightened.

Shinku Ryujin: Ryota.

Ryota did not even look at him.

**Ryota:** No. He’s going to hear this.

He pointed toward the arena, toward the match waiting for Sasori, toward the entire night balanced on a single result.

**Ryota:** Drake Nygma can call himself whatever he wants. Nygma. The Sphinx. I don’t care. If that man gets his hands on the Red Orb mounted on the Ultimate Wrestling Championship belt, then all of this becomes bigger than wrestling. Bigger than AAPW. Bigger than our titles and our pride and our stupid little failures.

His voice cracked. Not from weakness. From strain.

**Ryota:** Japan falls into chaos first.

He took another step closer, nearly chest to chest with Sasori now.

**Ryota:** Then the rest of the world follows.

The words hung in the room like smoke.

Even Shinku did not interrupt this time.

Ryota’s eyes were wild, but there was grief in them now too. Fear. Shame. The helpless fury of a strong man watching the world slip beyond strength.

**Ryota:** We were supposed to stop this.

He looked down for a second, then back up again.

**Ryota:** We were supposed to hold the line.

His voice turned bitter.

**Ryota:** Tatsu Hime lost. Kami still stands over us with that title. Every enemy we bury grows another head. Every warning we ignore comes back louder. And you…


![002_8.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP2NGcBRUEfBtphqpfpikBdcE6iNxCUajtTmcLDDpZpym/002_8.png)


He looked Sasori up and down, disgust and heartbreak colliding.

**Ryota:** You sit in silence and trust fate like fate has ever loved men like us.

That one cut.

Sasori’s jaw flexed.

Barely.

But Ryota saw it.

**Ryota:** There you are.

Shinku finally pushed off the wall.

Not much. Just enough.

Just enough to remind both men that if this crossed one more line, he would be in the middle of it.

Shinku Ryujin: Enough.

Ryota rounded on him.

**Ryota:** No, it is not enough! That is the problem! None of this has been enough!

He pointed at the dented lockers.

**Ryota:** Not our discipline. Not our vows. Not our blood. Not our losses.

Then back at Sasori.

**Ryota:** So hear me now. If you lose to the Sphinx, if you let him take that Orb, then everything we claimed to protect dies with us. Japan. The balance. The order. All of it. Gone. And it will be gone because when the moment came, you failed too.

Silence.

A living, hateful silence.

Sasori stared at him.

Not blankly. Not emptily. There was thought in it. Pain in it. A deep old sorrow Ryota was too furious to see clearly. This was not a man who did not care. This was a man carrying so much that speech itself had become dangerous.

He looked past Ryota then, toward the broken chair, the rattled incense, the ruined little sanctuary.

Then to Shinku.

And in that glance, years seemed to pass between them.

Training yards.

Cold mountain mornings.

Shared vows.

Old wounds.

Dead mentors.

Victories.

Burials.

Everything that had once made the Sacred Order feel unbreakable.

Ryota mistook the silence for weakness.

**Ryota:** Say something.

Nothing.

**Ryota:** Damn you, Sasori, say something!

Sasori took one step forward.

For a heartbeat, it looked like he might finally answer.

Instead, he stepped around Ryota.

Ryota turned sharply.

**Ryota:** That’s it?

Sasori kept walking.

**Ryota:** That’s your answer?

Still nothing.

Ryota’s breathing became ragged. Desperation crept fully into the anger now.

**Ryota:** We built this together!

Sasori reached the door.

**Ryota:** We bled for this together!

His hand closed around the handle.

**Ryota:** We buried people for this together!

That made Sasori stop.

Only for a second.

A cruel second.

Just long enough to make it feel like he might turn back.

Just long enough to make the room remember what brotherhood used to look like.

But he did not turn.

Ryota’s voice dropped to almost a plea.

**Ryota:** Don’t walk away from me like I’m wrong.

Shinku’s eyes lowered.

Sasori opened the door.

**Ryota:** If you walk out that door and fail tonight, you don’t just lose a match. You lose us.

That finally did it.

Not a flinch. Not a speech. Not some dramatic promise.

Saikō Sasori paused in the doorway and tilted his head just slightly, not enough to look back, just enough to show he had heard every word.

Then he walked out.


![003_8.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYBBrTevCKprhEgGsRx6YzV1jwJqYdMvG2qRRyjqzyxn8/003_8.png)


The door shut behind him with a hard, flat thud.

The room felt enormous after that.

Ryota stood frozen, staring at the closed door as if rage alone might rip it open again. But his anger had nowhere to go now. It curdled inside him. His shoulders rose and fell. His hands opened and closed. The great Iron Musha, warrior guardian, looked for a moment like a man who had just watched a bridge collapse beneath his own feet.

Shinku studied him in silence.

Then he looked toward the door Sasori had vanished through.

When he spoke, his voice was low and cold.

**Shinku Ryujin:** You spoke to him like an enemy.

Ryota swallowed, still staring at the door.

Ryota: Then maybe he needed to hear it that way.

Shinku took a slow breath through his nose.

**Shinku Ryujin:** Or maybe you were afraid that if you spoke to him like a brother... he might have broken in front of you.

That hit Ryota harder than anything else had.

For the first time since the scene began, he had no answer.

Shinku uncrossed his arms at last and stepped toward the shattered order of the room, toward the cracked cup, the fallen chair, the bent locker door.

He looked at the damage Ryota had done.

Then at Ryota himself.

**Shinku Ryujin:** Pray you did not just help the darkness more than the Sphinx ever could.

And with that, the room went still again.

Not peaceful.

Never peaceful.

Just still in the way battlefields sometimes went still right before the next charge.

title.body:
> ![IMG20251223193200~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdP984JoYmUoSUVi5D8adcu78KADJSAgmpzpHAZNyFA7x/IMG20251223193200~2.jpg) How are you all? I hope you are healthy and safe wherever you are. Today I want to share with you a great experience from my hometown **Valuka**. When we get some free time in the busy city life, we try to spend time with our families. Especially when we see the smiling faces of the children, all the fatigue of the day disappears in an instant. My children love to eat burgers. And whenever we think of burgers, the first name that comes to our mind is this shop in Valuka. In my opinion, this is the most delicious burger shop in our city. This evening, I made a hasty plan to go out with the kids. The destination was our favorite burger shop. Upon reaching the shop, it was quite crowded. The craftsmen of the shop were making burgers one after another with very skillful hands. Seeing the enthusiasm of the children, it seemed that they were ready to eat right away. ![IMG20251223193303~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUbRXp8oa5TgBbPU61JwKqycUxVwjXqHEwB5H5YsT7yyZ/IMG20251223193303~2.jpg) Here you can see the process of making burgers directly. The smell of fresh buns being grilled fills half of the stomach. I have taken some pictures for you where you can see the burgers arranged in rows on a white cutting board. When the burgers were being decorated with ample amount of mayonnaise, sauce, and fresh vegetable slices, it looked really tempting. The specialty here is the balance of their sauce and the taste of the burger patty. Although not too spicy, its taste is like sticking in the mouth. When the kids were eating the burgers with satisfaction, it felt like we were running so much for this small pleasure of theirs. ![IMG20251223193322~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGegw9GFBb2sjbcEswn2t6YN326e9BRmVnDpWW5fAyiD/IMG20251223193322~2.jpg) We ordered several burgers. Each burger was hot and juicy. Although the atmosphere of the shop is not very fancy, the quality of the food and cleanliness are quite good. Especially despite being a roadside shop, they try to maintain hygiene, which reassured me. All in all, today was a great evening. The joy of eating delicious food with loved ones is different. Those of you who are around Bhaluka city or will ever come here, you can try this shop if you want. I am sure, the burgers here will not disappoint you. I am ending here like today. When was the last time you spent such a happy time with your loved ones? You can tell me by commenting. **Everyone stay well, stay healthy. Thank you.** Anyway, this was my plan for today. I hope you liked the food photos I took. I will be back with more food photos like this. Wishing everyone good health, I bid farewell today. Wishing everyone good health, I bid farewell today. ___ |

Hola a todos. Hoy me levanté con todas las ganas de trotar 7 km, pero no logré esa distancia debido a varios factores. Lo bueno es que no dejé de correr y conseguí recorrer 5 kilómetros.



Salí bastante temprano por la mañana pero el sol ya estaba muy fuerte. Tras los primeros 3 km a un ritmo cercano a 5 minutos, me ví obligado a bajar la velocidad. Y tras los 5 kilómetros, tuve que parar pues la respiración no me estaba ayudando.


Considero que tal vez fui muy rápido al principio para el clima que había, y ya cuando di vuelta a la cuadra y el sol me pegó de frente, no logré mantener el ritmo y perdí mucha energía. 



Aún así me mantuve enfocado en trotar al menos 5 km y al final el ritmo fue de 6:03 minutos por km.

 También logré tomar algunas fotografías de la ruta recorrida, sobre todo del principio de la misma. 


Aunque no logré la distancia que quería, me siento muy bien por haber podido manejar un inicio complicado y un clima bastante adverso. Mientras corría pensaba que dentro de todo lo malo, este era solo un entrenamiento y no una carrera oficial así que era una oportunidad para saber cómo actuar si me pasaba en otro momento. Y me siento contento porque poco a poco voy aprendiendo a saber qué hacer para sacar el máximo provecho a la carrera y no rendirme ante la adversidad.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmdsMVdSHnho1Uqw8Nu3UaGUv9CzAttesTt5cZrRGEx5sL/separadores_55.png  
 
English


Hi, everyone. Today I woke up really eager to go for a 7-kilometer jog, but I didn’t quite make it that far due to a few factors. The good news is that I didn’t stop running and managed to cover 5 kilometers.



I headed out pretty early in the morning, but the sun was already beating down. After the first 3 km at a pace of around 5 minutes per kilometer, I was forced to slow down. And after 5 kilometers, I had to stop because my breathing wasn’t helping me.


I think I might have gone too fast at the start given the weather, and once I turned the corner and the sun hit me head-on, I couldn’t keep up the pace and lost a lot of energy. 



Even so, I stayed focused on jogging at least 5 km, and in the end, my pace was 6:03 minutes per km.

I also managed to take some photos of the route I ran, especially at the beginning. 


Although I didn’t cover the distance I wanted, I feel great about having managed a difficult start and some pretty rough weather. While I was running, I kept telling myself that despite everything, this was just a training run and not an official race, so it was a chance to figure out how to handle it if it happened again. And I’m happy because, little by little, I’m learning what to do to get the most out of a run and not give up in the face of adversity.

title.title: [ESP/ENG] La importancia de las madres en nuestro desarrollo, bienestar y relaciones interpersonales.
title.body:
Hay palabras que nacen pequeñas, pero que al pronunciarlas se vuelven inmensas. Madre es una de ellas. No importa el idioma, la cultura o la distancia: siempre guarda un eco de origen, un refugio, una certeza. En el Día de las Madres, celebrarlas es reconocer que su presencia —o su memoria— es la raíz más profunda de nuestra historia personal y el faro que ilumina cada uno de nuestros pasos.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5au4jR1ks3qw4F8riwtnaXJqM3cvreZhKGUQmHaEPFm/1778263150275.jpg)


Una madre es guía incluso antes de que sepamos caminar. Es quien nos enseña a mirar el mundo con curiosidad, a nombrar lo que sentimos, a distinguir entre lo que duele y lo que sana. Su voz es brújula: orienta sin imponer, acompaña sin invadir, sostiene sin exigir. En ella descubrimos que el amor verdadero no se mide por lo que se dice, sino por lo que se hace día tras día, aun cuando nadie lo ve.

En la familia, la madre es el eje silencioso que mantiene el equilibrio. No porque lo haga todo —aunque muchas veces lo hace— sino porque sabe unir lo que parece disperso. Es la que recuerda fechas, la que anticipa necesidades, la que escucha incluso cuando no se habla. Su capacidad para leer gestos, para intuir tristezas, para celebrar alegrías ajenas como si fueran propias, la convierte en la guardiana emocional del hogar. Gracias a ella, la familia no es solo un conjunto de personas, sino un espacio donde se aprende a convivir, a respetar, a compartir y a perdonar.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc12TNyaVKBhnjarhvod6CcotTBbcbP462NPnjvb2bnTA/1778263072264.jpg)


Con los hijos, la madre es maestra de vida. Enseña a través del ejemplo: con su esfuerzo diario, con su manera de enfrentar las dificultades, con su forma de amar sin reservas. Es la primera en creer en nuestras posibilidades y la última en rendirse cuando algo parece imposible. Su fe en nosotros es tan firme que, incluso en los momentos más oscuros, basta recordar su mirada para recuperar la fuerza. Ella nos enseña que la dignidad no se negocia, que la bondad nunca es debilidad y que la valentía consiste, muchas veces, en seguir adelante a pesar del cansancio.



En las relaciones interpersonales, la madre es puente. Nos muestra cómo tratar a los demás, cómo cuidar los vínculos, cómo construir afectos que duren. Su ejemplo nos enseña a ser pacientes, a escuchar, a valorar la palabra dada. De ella aprendemos que la empatía es una forma de inteligencia y que la ternura también es una forma de fortaleza. Gracias a su manera de relacionarse con el mundo, aprendemos a relacionarnos nosotros.



Y en nuestro bienestar, la madre es la primera defensora. Es quien nos recuerda que debemos cuidarnos, que merecemos descanso, que la salud —física y emocional— es un tesoro que no se debe descuidar. Su preocupación no es control, sino amor que desea vernos plenos. Incluso cuando ya somos adultos, su voz sigue siendo un recordatorio de equilibrio: “Cuídate”, “No te olvides de comer”, “Descansa un poco”. Son frases sencillas, pero cargadas de un afecto que nos acompaña toda la vida.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaPw8NUkDVdn4QULUiZ4tvmEKG9PzR4NvKwdswEbp7rRj/1778256729553.jpg)


Ser madre es un acto de entrega que no termina nunca. Incluso cuando los hijos crecen, incluso cuando la vida cambia, incluso cuando la ausencia llega. El amor de una madre no desaparece: se transforma en memoria, en consejo, en fuerza interior. Por eso, en este día, celebrarlas es también agradecerles por todo lo que sembraron en nosotros: por la paciencia, por la disciplina, por la ternura, por la fe, por la vida misma.

Para todas las madres dejo estas décimas poéticas que salen del corazón.

**Madre: ejemplo, fuerza y raíz**


Madre, luz que me acompaña,  
tu amor firme me sostiene,  
y aunque el tiempo todo cambie  
tu abrazo nunca me engaña.  
Eres fuerza que no daña,  
mi refugio verdadero,  
mi consejo más sincero,  
mi raíz y mi destino.  
En tu paso yo camino  
con tu amor como lucero.


Eres guía en mi jornada,  
mi equilibrio y mi ternura,  
la voz que siempre asegura  
que la vida es esperada.  
Tu entrega nunca es cansada,  
tu fe jamás se termina,  
y en tu mirada divina  
encuentro paz y calor.  
Madre, en tu inmenso amor  
mi alma  se me ilumina.


Nota: Las fotos son de mi propiedad.
El traductor utilizado fue DeepL Translate.



**ENGLISH** 



There are words that are born small, but when you pronounce them they become immense. Madre is one of them. No matter the language, culture or distance: it always keeps an echo of origin, a refuge, a certainty. On Mother's Day, to celebrate them is to recognize that their presence – or their memory – is the deepest root of our personal history and the beacon that illuminates our every step.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5au4jR1ks3qw4F8riwtnaXJqM3cvreZhKGUQmHaEPFm/1778263150275.jpg)



A mother is a guide even before we know how to walk. It is what teaches us to look at the world with curiosity, to name what we feel, to distinguish between what hurts and what heals. His voice is a compass: he guides without imposing, accompanies without invading, sustains without demanding. In it we discover that true love is not measured by what is said, but by what is done day after day, even when no one sees it.

In the family, the mother is the silent axis that maintains balance. Not because he does everything – although he often does – but because he knows how to unite what seems dispersed. She is the one who remembers dates, the one who anticipates needs, the one who listens even when she is not talking. Her ability to read gestures, to intuit sadness, to celebrate other people's joys as if they were her own, makes her the emotional guardian of the home. Thanks to it, the family is not only a group of people, but a space where we learn to live together, to respect, to share and to forgive.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc12TNyaVKBhnjarhvod6CcotTBbcbP462NPnjvb2bnTA/1778263072264.jpg)


With children, the mother is a teacher of life. He teaches by example: by his daily effort, by his way of facing difficulties, by his way of loving without reserve. She is the first to believe in our possibilities and the last to give up when something seems impossible. His faith in us is so firm that, even in the darkest moments, it is enough to remember his gaze to regain our strength. She teaches us that dignity is not negotiable, that goodness is never weakness and that courage often consists in moving forward despite fatigue.

In interpersonal relationships, the mother is a bridge. It shows us how to treat others, how to take care of bonds, how to build affections that last. His example teaches us to be patient, to listen, to value the word given. From her we learn that empathy is a form of intelligence and that tenderness is also a form of strength. Thanks to their way of relating to the world, we learn to relate to ourselves.

And in our well-being, the mother is the first defender. He is the one who reminds us that we must take care of ourselves, that we deserve rest, that health – physical and emotional – is a treasure that should not be neglected. Their concern is not control, but love that desires to see us whole. Even when we are adults, his voice is still a reminder of balance: \

. They are simple phrases, but loaded with an affection that accompanies us throughout our lives.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaPw8NUkDVdn4QULUiZ4tvmEKG9PzR4NvKwdswEbp7rRj/1778256729553.jpg)


Being a mother is an act of dedication that never ends. Even when the children grow up, even when life changes, even when absence comes. A mother's love does not disappear: it becomes memory, advice, inner strength. Therefore, on this day, to celebrate them is also to thank them for all that they sowed in us: for patience, for discipline, for tenderness, for faith, for life itself.

For all mothers I leave these poetic tenths that come from the heart.

**Mother: example, strength and root**

Mother, light that accompanies me,  
Your steadfast love sustains me,  
And even if the weather changes everything  
Your embrace never deceives me.  
You are strength that does not harm,  
My true refuge,  
My most sincere advice,  
my root and my destiny.  
In your step I walk  
With your love as a star.

You are a guide on my journey,  
my balance and my tenderness,  
The voice that always ensures  
that life is expected.  
Your delivery is never tiring,  
Your faith never ends,  
And in your divine gaze  
I find peace and warmth.  
Mother, in your immense love  
My soul lights up.

Note: The photos are my property.
The translator used was DeepL Translate.

title.title: Параноя в бункері: чому кремлівська верхівка переходить на \
та чого боїться путін?
title.body: >Знаєте, я дивлюся на останні новини з-за поребрика і не можу позбутися відчуття, що ми спостерігаємо фінальний акт якоїсь абсурдної п'єси. Ви точно бачили ці повідомлення від британської розвідки, про які вже розтрубили всі притомні медіа. Суть проста до ідіотизму: кремлівській верхівці, усій цій \
в дорогих костюмах, офіційно заборонили користуватися смартфонами. Більше того, їх тепер пересадили на \

автівки, які перед виїздом особисто обнюхують собаки ФСО.

\n\n
>Це ж якийсь сюрреалізм, погодьтеся. Люди, які роками розповідали нам про \
, про велич російських технологій і про те, як вони от-от створять власну цифрову екосистему, тепер бояться звичайного iPhone, як чорт ладану. Виявляється, у \
державі головною загрозою національній безпеці став не авіаносець НАТО, а китайський гаджет у кишені міністра.

>Я часто думаю про те, як вони там почуваються. От сидить якийсь умовний Патрушев чи Медведєв (хоча останньому без смартфона, мабуть, зовсім сумно — де ж ще писати свої нічні марення?), і боїться навіть дихнути в бік свого водія. Бо за новими правилами, кожен шофер тепер — потенційний агент впливу, а кожне натискання кнопки на екрані — це сигнал для наведення ракети прямо в лисину вождя.
, про який вони так мріяли? Поки телевізійні пропагандисти, бризкаючи слиною, кричать про \

і малюють путіну космічні 87% підтримки, реальність б'є під дих. Якщо тебе так сильно любить народ, то навіщо тобі собаки, які обнюхують твої штани на предмет вибухівки? Якщо ти впевнений у своїх підлеглих, навіщо відбирати у них телефони?

>Мені це нагадує старі казки про параноїдальних царів, які пробували кожну страву з рук дегустаторів і спали в кімнатах без вікон. Тільки замість дегустаторів тепер — кінологічна служба, а замість вікон — бетонні стіни бункера. Замість технологічного прориву ми бачимо тотальний відкат до \
. Знаєте, я не здивуюся, якщо завтра в Адміністрації президента з’являться вакансії голубівників або фахівців із сигнальних вогнищ. Уявіть собі: \
. Звучить цілком у дусі сучасної РФ.
>Найбільше мене забавляє цей контраст. Ці люди ще вчора погрожували перетворити світ на \

і вихвалялися гіперзвуковими ракетами, які нібито неможливо збити. А сьогодні вони падають у непритомність, якщо в когось у коридорі раптово спрацював будильник на годиннику. Великі геополітики перетворилися на заляканих мишей, які забилися в найтемніші кутки свого підземелля.

>Страх — це дуже цікава штука. Він має властивість масштабуватися. Спочатку ти боїшся опозиції, потім — власних олігархів, потім — генералів, а врешті-решт починаєш боятися навіть мікрохвильовки на кухні. Стіни бункера продовжують невблаганно стискатися. Зона комфорту колись \
тепер дорівнює розмірам того самого легендарного резинового чемоданчика, який за ним носять.

>Ми з вами розуміємо, що це не просто заходи безпеки. Це агонія системи, яка побудована на брехні та насильстві. Коли ти знаєш, що тебе ненавидять мільйони (і не лише за кордоном, а й у власних кабінетах), параноя стає твоїм єдиним вірним супутником. Кожен, хто заходить до кабінету, — потенційний вбивця. Кожна усмішка колеги — прихована зневага.

>Я переконаний, що цей психоз тільки посилюватиметься. Режим, який харчується кров’ю і страхом, рано чи пізно починає поглинати сам себе. Вони вже не можуть довіряти цифрам, не можуть довіряти зв’язку, не можуть довіряти людям. Це глухий кут.

>Що далі? Можливо, путін почне виходити до народу в скафандрі з чистого свинцю? Або накаже вирити тунель від Кремля до Пекіна, щоб пересуватися виключно під землею? Час покаже. Але одне я знаю точно: стіни, які вони будують навколо себе, зрештою стануть їхньою в'язницею.

>Продовжуємо спостерігати за цим цирком. Головне — пам’ятати, що під цими залізними обладунками і за бетонними стінами ховається лише маленька, залякана людина, яка понад усе боїться розплати. А вона обов’язково прийде.

description.title: Weekend Movie – ‘Terror By Night’ (1946)
description.body:
![Filmstrip2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/EqBfW7Vyy4M3yY5L7z6dLZ6GbNuAPZLVDxD5tGWV62i9QAT24YjDJdo4XVE8fdhVmCd.jpg)



The character Sherlock Holmes and his companion Dr Watson have been played by numerous different actors across stage, screen and television. Many people, since the first filmed version of one of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle’s stories in 1916 have played Holmes and Watson.  Each generation is going to have their favourite Holmes and Watson.  Some prefer Peter Cushing or Jeremy Brett or Benedict Cumberbatch as their favourite Holmes but for me my favourite is Basil Rathbone as Holmes and Nigel Bruce as Dr Watson.  Maybe this preference came from watching this pair of actors play Holmes and Watson on old films that were shown on television in the UK when I was a child.  Watson is played very much as the less competent of the paring of Holmes and Watson but Conan Doyle envisaged the character as being much more intelligent than how Nigel Bruce portrays him but that doesn’t detract from Bruce’s performance which serves as a plot device to highlight Holmes’s brilliance. 

In this movie, Terror By Night made in 1946, Holmes and Watson are trying to protect a large diamond, The Star of Rhodesia, from an expected theft.  Holmes and Watson are engaged by the diamond’s owner to protect the diamond as she and the diamond travel to Scotland on a train.

The attempt on the theft of the diamond happens on a moving train and Holmes and Watson have the job of catching the thief and his accomplices who are killing people on the train in order to get the diamond.  This is a great Sherlock Holmes movie set almost entirely on a moving old style corridor train with limited stops.  The film makers have really nailed the claustrophobia of a moving train and its individual compartments where murder and skullduggery are occurring.

I’m not going to give away too much of the plot in this relatively short (59 minutes) movie and you’ll have to watch it to find out whether Holmes gets his man and more importantly the right man.

Whilst putting this piece together I perused wiki biographies of the lead actors in this movie, Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce and they led impressive and very interesting lives.  Rathbone served with distinction in World War One along with his brother who was killed at Arras in June 1918. The loss of his brother seemed to deeply impact Rathbone and he became a reckless fighter and was awarded the Military Cross for conspicuous gallantry.  Nigel Bruce also served the military with distinction joining the military in 1914. During battle he was machine gunned in the legs and invalided out of the British Army but he rejoined the military and was commissioned as a subaltern as a training officer in England.  What brave men they both were.

Anyway here’s Terror By Night

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ae5KnCP6QbI


Links

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basil_Rathbone

Nigel Bruce Wiki
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nigel_Bruce

In online mode you can play Team Deathmatch, Multiplayer and various types of matches and in offline mode you can play practice matches with bot players.The graphics in the game are very high and cannot be played without a high-end device because I experienced frame drops while playing.The game is probably playable at a maximum of 60 FPS, I'm not entirely sure about that.

The popularity of this game has increased manifold due to its realistic graphics and smooth controls.Overall, this is an exciting and action-packed game. Perfect aiming and fast movement are the real highlights of this game.This game will be very good for a fps game lover.Hope you will play this game one time.

description.title: Don't Play With One Single Meta
description.body:
![image by OpenAI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tm7KT12GhiyP3papidRTVNpGNci2KCbaEUcjisYU1FjiwkW2KqFmxYpQLD6MPi9qgML.png)

Hello My Dear Splinterlands Summoners

Finally I get some time to make a Splinterlands post again. I have some difficulties to play Splinterlands due to my health issue, so I try to maximize my limited time here, to play and share my experience in Splinterlands.

Today I am sharing a simple topic that most experience users are already familiar with, but it seems many new and casual players forget about this one. It is about checking the history of your opponents line up.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tRvjWWyr7W87JbgK8jJ44xtxGFWWmiQGqbyJ61SKq2ZKz9G18pYc1anYMV3bgVWgfSB.png

You see, when you get a match opponent, you can check their last 6 battles line up. You can not see the battles, whether they win or not, or what kind of ruleset they had before. 

This could be a deep long topic, but I will make this short and simple. The problem that your opponents have, or this could be your own problem too, is that if they keep spamming with a same lineup with same meta, or different line up with same meta, we can see that... so can your opponent too.

So the message is clear here. DON'T LET YOURSELF GOT READ! If you have a favorite meta, do not rely on one. At least have two or three favorites, so you could mix them in the last 6 battles, not spamming one only.

Now let see a battle that end tragically due to got read by me lol..

#### The Battle


[![~Click The Image Above To See the Full Battle~](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/Eo46K656XoJnpZNfbrGyLrEukk2fAskjK8fLa4UGeXFcyKtP8mE6LpWxNqJMAXrskde.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_f2cdd69f50758c62ed98cbfa48964af3?ref=dewabrata)

Previously I have checked my opponent history here, MARIO04 and I would not tag that person directly here to respect him. I saw a clear pattern that in the last 6 battles, he always go straight forward! I mean that he tried to go all out to the front door, bashing the tank with some overloaded attack.

To secure his victory, he used some speed modifier and a healer. So in other word, he cared about defense a lot too. That's why he wanted to kill the tank sooner then defended totally winning by attrition wars.

It sounds like facing a similar opponent as me lol so here what I will do to counter his approach or his meta

**First I will use a double layer tank.** I mean that he always try to knock my tank first, so I could not guess what kind of attack he would use, but definitely its going to be about all in for killing my tank.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23wfrLbEbys723AuuBzFczWRx3L9bsA1a6BZ1fydpxFEVxaZusLiVesP5Hk72WzcUc5XG.png

The first one is Quillun Legionary, this is one of my favorite thank from earth element. I had a fear that my opponent would come with his legendary summoner who had a thorn ability, so I had no will to bring in any melee unit. He had a mindset of defensive too, so I needed to be extra careful here.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23w2eftuT9BCnJ3MXPoXx3oY61Hqx7TfdTBEDX7Cdx1f4A1gmK9fPiRwEsBQ9xg437t5b.png

The second tank is Silver Shield Sentry, It is from escalation edition and I find this card very useful due to his Bulwark ability. When he gets into main tank position, he would get +8 health and +8 armor, this means it becomes an extra headache for his opponents, unless they manage to shut him down first when he is in backline position.

Sometime I see this traits like a defensive LAST ONE STANDING ability lol.

**Second, I will bring two healers to support my tanks.** I know they would be down fast, so one healer might not enough. and It would be a waste if I had two monstrous tank in front but I did not take care of them at all.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23wgFgBZ2Z5mJgUAui2XbKDgp3K3Bznhj78JroVavb4TtxRcHU2o4spi27ChZNu3PBzfK.png

I like this duo, a combo healer of Calabash Sage + Satha Toledo. Calabash Sage is a good rear wall due to his SHIELD ability, and with the help of Satha Toledo's LOOKOUT ability, it makes Calabash Sage harder to be put down by any melee and range attack.

Another positive (not absolute one, but for me it is) thing about this pair is their speed different. Satha Toledo will heal first, and it prevents other opponent to kill the tank when it is injured. Calabash is very slow, but it makes him heal the last, so in the next round, the fastest opponent might not be able to deliver killing blow first.

Well talking about combination, I know you have a thought about... why not use one units and solve all the problem?

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23wWPA9nHACyfBofT5EKjZTBRUb1ghG87NVnFYY8w3dWin5pYdv6wbs3dexCoQNWkf6mE.png

Arachne Weaver is the best choice for this one. However this unit is easily countered or targeted then he dies first lol. Talking about that, I had a big hunch that my opponent was going to use him so...

**The Third Approach, Was To Aim his middle unit.**

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/Eoc5bU3H58NuHdbms2nbFy9SfJUUc9yfeYyJAWTTa11M54LMued5qwypM8T8i2TCzoJ.png

I used Mahkah Helmit who had Opportunity ability. He would aim opponent backline, in this battle I guessed it would be Arachne Weaver. In case it failed, I brought Forlorn Geomant for having 5 magic damage. 

I knew he would put a wall in front with some heals, so I could not hit half heartily, all my attacks should be a big hook or upper cut lol 

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tS2pNwM7AB7FTtJzUZZTdeXDVQY3c9gAKWK2MM7gJRkLwJ41bMA1XCurgiHn4j5oqLx.png

I lost the first round, they killed my Quillun Legionary and I could not killed any units there. Their Arachne Weaver healed their tank, making it hard to be killed. However this round everything changed, because my Mahkah Helmit put down their Arachne Weaver.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/Eo8LdC1BK3gkKemH6z7rRLLuu2HCf2oXJ1bS3xXAXRntNoWzrwWXcjxVGtSGPhkXF9A.png

The result was clear, they started to crumbled. They did not have a repair ability, so their Warborn Shaman void armor only worked once, the armor would not be repaired. This time they were struggling to knock down my Silver Shield Sentry due to his bulkward. 12 health point, it meant every turn he got +8 health recovered.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tRzb8XKTcgS8ZAwbVy164ZyozZ38pHm8zcorkwwuni7sVD5w2dg7edSaNduE6ThXU7E.png

IF the result was clear, so did the end. In the end of the battle, my Silver Shield Sentry still stood strong even he got poisoned and not cleansed, the health recovery was still greater than the total damage he got in one round. Good Game

Overall Mario04 had a great line up here, and if I did not read his habit of going straight forward and set some defense, I could end up trying to sneak attack them and end up losing. Because I knew and I was sure he would try all his best knocking down my tank ASAP, so I put double tanks and it ended up all his pattern. He got locked due to useless range attackers when they were moved as tank.

So learn by other people mistake here, do not gamble everything into one single meta. If your opponent read or see that, you might lose the battle before you click the start button. Anyway feel free to leave any comment and thank you for visiting my post!

---

![https://splinterlands.com?ref=dewabrata](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbH2XfEqZJAFKMvoBTZG6B1pBkH9XJz79EpLXCGCCHvNVgeBbigFfqAtfmeowZ49T85.gif)

description.title: What Does Teenage Pregnancy Have To Do With Pedophilia?
description.body: ![Marjonhorn is the author of this picture/Source:  Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2021/04/18/17/03/pregnant-6189040_1280.jpg)\n\nThe other day I came across a video by Joshua Barbour on his YouTube channel named \

about family vlogging. Mr. Barbour is one of those conservative religious men who disbelieve in family vlogging and condemns it as being exploitative of minors. I don't agree with much of what he states in his videos, but, at the same time, I cannot deny that he has posted some interesting stuff on his channel. I do agree with Mr. Barbour that parents should not put their autistic kids on camera and exhibit them having meltdowns. Of course, that's neither here nor there. There was this one video that Mr. Barbour posted in which he claimed that Family Fizz had exploited the oldest daughter named Mia. Then he blindly brought up the topic of pedophilia, but, like so many times before, he couldn't seem to get its definition right. Here is his video below. Joshua Barbour Criticizes Family Fizz For Trapping Their Kids Into A Life Of YouTube Videos https://youtu.be/Yk53TjD26HI?si=WepRkleaR3qZmeK0 Mr. Barbour gets much of his information wrong in other videos whenever he brings up the subject of American politics and how our court system and criminal justice system both work. Then again, he lives in Canada, so I don't expect him to know everything about how the American government system works. Nonetheless, I have major problems with some of the statements Mr. Barbour makes in his video above about Family Fizz's two oldest daughters, Mia and Sienna. He claims that they're nearly illiterate. That could not be true, because Mia speaks fluent Spanish. If Mia was able to learn to speak Spanish as well as she does, she must know something about how grammar and structure works in any language that she speaks. I've even always felt that she is likely more intelligent than most women her age. I've seen videos of her speaking in Spanish. Mia is 21 years old. Therefore, if she wants to have a baby, let her have a baby. The baby's father is stepping up to the plate, so that's a good thing. I don't know very much about Sienna. I never get the impression that she is illiterate whenever I have heard her speak. If she has published books as she has, then she has to know something substantial about the English language. She seems as though she has a good head on her shoulders for a 14-year-old girl. Finally, Mr. Barbour was way out of line when he attempted to take writer's license with the definition of pedophilia. He brought up the subject of how Mia did videos about her menstrual cycle when she was barely in her teenage years and that Sienna had done videos of that nature as well. As long as they're not violating any of the community guidelines of YouTube, let them post whatever they want. Anyhow, Mr. Barbour insisted that pedophiles absolutely loved watching videos about adolescent girls having their menstrual period. Wrong, Mr. Barbour! Pedophiles aren't even sexually attracted to girls that age. That's why they are called pedophiles. Pedophiles don't watch videos about pubescent and adolescent girls having their menstrual period or going bra shopping. They watch videos of toddlers bathing in the nude. Pedophiles aren't looking to get middle-school and high-school girls pregnant, because they're not interested in them. Therefore, menstruation at 12 or 13 years old has nothing more to do with pedophilia than teenage pregnancy does. I'm not claiming that adult men should get into the habit of watching videos of pubescent and adolescent girls talking about their periods. There would be no point to it, unless, of course, a man is a single parent dealing with his daughter having her menarche. However, a clinically diagnosed pedophile is not going to get his dopamine hits out of watching videos of pubescent and adolescent girls describing their periods, because to an actual pedophile, a girl Sienna's age looks like an old lady and, therefore, it would turn him off. The point here is that if Mr. Barbour is going to talk about pedophilia in his videos, he should at least look up the definition of it in the Fifth Edition of the *Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders* (\

). I can understand why he questions anything that he sees as not being age-appropriate, even though as a conservative minister he's going to have a much more puritanical perspective of teenage sexuality than most people will. Nonetheless, Mr. Barbour should at least attempt to make the information he delivers in his videos to be as accurate as possible. Otherwise, he is spewing pedophile-panic propaganda that misleads the public on a serious subject matter. Mr. Barbour doesn't have to like family vlogging. I realize that there has been a stirrup of controversy over family vlogging on YouTube ever since the tragic incident involving Ruby Franke and Jodi Hildebrandt out in Utah. However, if he is going to snipe at family vloggers, he should at least attempt to steer clear of **[the misuse of such terminology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pedophilia#Misuse_of_medical_terminology)**. According to the *DSM-5*, pedophilia is the sexual attraction of adolescents and adults 16 years of age and older to prepubescent children (usually younger than 11 years old) that are five years their junior. It has nothing to do with teenage girls or their feminine issues. It has nothing to do with the girls in the video below. Teenage Girls Model Summer Fashion Attire For Other Girls Their Age https://youtu.be/Xo-2BgLv9Bo?si=idCER5zhNa3M5TW8 If there are any men Mr. Barbour's age watching the video above, chances are that they're probably saying to themselves, \

They're not necessarily planning to go full Joey Buttafuoco on their wives or middle-aged girlfriends.  (Does anyone even remember him?)  Also, teenagers are not toddlers and should not be confused with them.

I wasn't trying to put Mr. Barbour down, because everyone is entitled to their opinion despite that it might not be based on the most accurate information.  If he wants to do a video about me and attack me from all directions, he's perfectly welcome to do so.  However, I cannot promise him that my response back at him will be a pleasant experience for him if he is sensitive about what people say about him.

![Cordallman is the author of this picture/Source:  Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2023/12/23/22/15/teen-photo-8466399_1280.jpg)

I just thought that I would put my thoughts about Joshua Barbour's above-described video out there.  That's all.

description.title: That stretch where everything slows down
description.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778198882-60c2dbb7de95.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/averagejen/seed-averagejen-2026-05-08/main-1-1778198882-60c2dbb7de95.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

I took the farm track this afternoon, the one that cuts through between the fields. You know the kind, where the pavement stops and the dirt takes over, and suddenly you're walking through someone else's working land. The wooden gates frame the entrance like a threshold, and once you're through, the noise of the road feels very far away.

The clouds were still doing their thing, rolling overhead in that restless May way, but the light kept breaking through in patches. The fields on either side were at different stages, one side still green and growing, the other already golden with grain coming in. I've walked this path dozens of times by now, but today I found myself really looking at the way the track itself has worn into the earth, two pale lines where boots and boots and boots have gone before.

It's the quiet that does it, I think. Not silence exactly, but the kind of quiet where you can hear the grass moving, hear the distant hum of traffic that doesn't touch you here. My mind went somewhere soft and loose, the way it does when the body is just moving and the scenery is handling itself. No rush to be anywhere. No one else on the path that I could see, just me and the fields and whatever birds were keeping to the hedgerows.

By late afternoon the light shifted again, warmer somehow, and the whole landscape glowed gold for a stretch. The trees in the distance became silhouettes, and the sun was doing that thing where it finds gaps in the clouds and makes everything dramatic without trying. I stood there for a while, not taking a picture, just watching it happen. Sometimes the best moments are the ones you let pass without documenting.

description.title: Título: Entrada al Concurso “Somos también fábula” de Literatos | El último sauce habló con el viento
description.body:
El último sauce habló con el viento

Junto al cauce seco, el sauce viejo aún sostenía sus ramas como cansados brazos. Ya no venían los pájaros a contar historias, ni las hormigas a pedir sombra. Frente a él, una amapola herida tosía polvo gris.

—¿Por qué tiemblas, abuelo? —preguntó la flor, con los pétalos rotos.

—No es miedo, pequeña. Es memoria —respondió el sauce, y su voz sonó como crujido de raíces bajo tierra—. Recuerdo cuando el río enseñaba a cantar a las piedras. Cuando el jabalí y el corzo bebían juntos al alba, y la guerra era solo un cuento que los humanos se contaban a oscuras.

—¿Qué es la guerra? —insistió la amapola, mientras sus hojas se ennegrecían.

El sauce cerró los ojos. Las últimas abejas habían muerto la semana anterior, envueltas en un silencio aceitoso.

—La guerra —dijo— es cuando los hombres olvidan que nosotros existimos. Cuando queman nuestros nombres para escribir el suyo con fuego. Mira ese horizonte: lo que ves no es humo, pequeña. Es el final de todas las preguntas.

La amapola intentó erguirse, pero el viento, que ya olía a hierro y ceniza, la deshojó sin permiso. El sauce guardó las semillas en un nudo de su corteza. Y esperó.

Nadie espera a un árbol. Pero los árboles nacieron sabiendo hacer eso.

I've been on a carnivore diet for a couple of years, and then I felt I needed micronutrients from greens, so I moved to a ketovore approach. The most amazing thing I experienced without carbs was the mental sharpness and steady energy. I never felt tired, and I felt fully awake and active as soon as I got up. I really enjoy the feeling of being in ketosis, and it can also make you quite lean. You can literally feel stronger, and it may even improve your gait.\nAlthough it does contradict my hobbies, like baking bread and cakes, I still make them for others who enjoy them and get tempted sometimes. I make sure to get enough protein. If you're on a zero-carb diet, you also need to manage electrolytes (sodium, potassium, and magnesium) carefully (you can get capsules or powder without unnecessary additives or bulking agents, which some people avoid for kidney health). Otherwise, it can help to include a small amount of healthy carbs so your insulin doesn't become too sluggish.\nWhen you don't eat carbs, blood sugar stays very low, and insulin behaves differently. Insulin helps move sugar (including from carbs) where it needs to go, and it also helps regulate electrolytes. When insulin is low, it can also affect electrolyte balance; you may notice increased urination (and with it, electrolyte loss). Since electrolytes are essential for muscles, including the heart, to function properly, supplementation is important on a zero-carb diet. It's a bit long, but I wanted to share from my own experience. :)

description.body: Nuevamente #viernesdeescritorio hoy es un buen día para hablar de **QuickShell**, son un conjunto de herramientas diseñadas para poder crear entornos gráficos sobre compositores de Wayland o WIndows Manager. La idea es la existencia de cajas que permitan crear barras, menús y los widgets necesarios para generar interfaces de forma rápida y con un mantenimiento amigable. La forma común de configurar un Windows Manager o Compositor este se puede instalar de forma manual, en un Windows Manager instalar manualmente las herramientas para cambio de fondos de pantalla, barras de trabajo al estilo waybar, widgets, todo se arma como un rompecabezas de forma de dejarlo al gusto de los usuarios. Como esto varía de un entorno a otro existen herramientas que se mantienen de un entorno a otro, pero su configuración puede diferir de igual forma, a raíz de todo el trabajo que esto implica surgieron los scripts de configuración para WM y Compositores. Los scripts de los Windows Manager fueron inicialmente algo de nicho programadores que personalizaban y automatizaban sus configuraciones, compartiendo luego con la comunidad en sus perfiles de GitHub o GitLab, algunos se lograron mantener en el tiempo y otros simplemente desaparecían cuando el mantenedor perdía interés o dejaba de tener tiempo disponible. Entre los scripts que siempre recuerdo con cariño y que aún funciona esta gh0stzk, una implementación de BSPWM muy completa y que deja todo listo para usar. https://youtu.be/Ua8PCsVvcWY – Vídeo referencia de gh0stzk Cuando Wayland comenzó a tomar fuerza y con la llegada de Hyprland ciertos scripts llegaron y lograron calar, creando una nueva ola de personalizaciones ML4W, HYDE Dotfiles, Omarchy, de los cuales algunos decidieron migrar posteriormente a convertirse en una distribución como el caso de Omarchy y HYDE Dotfiles. En la actualidad hay una serie de Compositores que están logrando avanzar sobre el gusto de los usuarios y que vienen ganando popularidad, Hyprland y Niri entre ellos, es en estos donde **QuickShell** toma relevancia, crear interfaces modernas y eficientes con el uso de estas herramientas ha permitido a muchas personas se vuelvan a animar a crear personalizaciones. Configurado con QML (lenguaje para la creación de interfaces) tiene integración con gran cantidad de componentes x11, pipewire, wayland, sway, hyprland sin ser limitantes a otros usos. PAra estas personalizaciones igualmente se diseñan paquetes de instalación que integran un WM o Compositor al diseño, con la ventaja que su funcionamiento se actualiza junto con los entornos al contar con gran cantidad de tipos que interactuan con componentes como el bluetooh, red, wi-fi, pipewire, poolkit entre otros, por lo cual al ser actualizados dichos componentes el lenguaje se actualiza y el creador de la interface no debe realizar todo ese trabajo que sucede por debajo de la apariencia. También es cierto que para su uso es necesario que se instale el lenguaje como tal en el equipo algo que ya esta en repositorios de diferentes bases en arch por ejemplo basta con _sudo pacman -S quickshell_. Para fedora se debe tener activo los repositorios COPR de la siguiente manera _sudo dnf copr enable errornointernet/quickshell_ y luego _sudo dnf install quickshell_. En Ubuntu se necesita activar un repo _sudo add-apt-repository ppa:avengemedia/danklinux_ _sudo apt update_ _sudo apt install quickshell_ SI se desea usar la versión en desarrollo no estable se puede apuntar al git, cosa que tambien se puede hacer en otras bases _sudo apt install quickshell-git_ En su [documentación](https://quickshell.org/docs/v0.3.0/types/) se encuentra las formas para usarlo en otras bases. Para el usuario posiblemente este paso será innecesario, porque en los scripts de instalación de los dotfiles este tipo de cosas ya están previstas, se acostumbra colocar en los gits las bases soportadas y pasos de instalación. Algunos dotfiles son ya famosos como el caso de DMS y Noctalia, estas han logrado volverse populares y son incluso implementadas por defecto en CachyOS si se usa con Hyprland (DMS) o Niri (Noctalia). Si eres curioso y deseas ver otros proyectos puedes encontrarlos en el siguiente [Github](https://github.com/topics/quickshell?l=qml&o=desc&s=stars). Ahora sí veremos los Vídeos de la semana. https://youtu.be/EnTfz2FUxtQ https://youtu.be/IpBq\_Zq31N8 https://youtu.be/R93TwHVizeQ https://youtu.be/2gGO9W4tc8Q https://youtu.be/C0CB45XweH8 https://youtu.be/3URsEASpsjo https://youtu.be/icnHDb5wSU4 https://youtu.be/IxGHjU6yduw https://youtu.be/aH7imxkpnqg Y como siempre para el cierre toca el #viernesdeescritorio

description.title: The role of parents in shaping the future generations
description.body:
![parentipacek-motherhood-4624889_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23wCGNa1Hh1wXce5TsxMnJnvSmayUiMpcjAhroCZYMnmhxgoiZBnq4rvesX8KGgqxpnuH.jpg)

![marimari1101-crayon-2009816_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23vshtTR3aeksCSbknpCkCBCU1bMTHMUdztemw3aotxUPMFvcxagLH7AdNgJWfzLozwuV.jpg) (source) 

In today’s fast-changing world, parenting has become more challenging than ever before. Technology, social media, busy work schedules, and changing societal values have greatly influenced the way children grow and learn. In the midst of these changes, intentional parenting has become a necessity for raising responsible, confident, and emotionally healthy children.
Intentional parenting simply means raising children with purpose, wisdom, and active involvement. It is about being deliberate in teaching values, building strong relationships, and guiding children to become the best version of themselves. Rather than leaving children to learn mainly from the internet, television, or peer pressure, intentional parents consciously shape their children’s character and future.
One of the key aspects of intentional parenting in the 21st century is communication. Children today face pressures and distractions that previous generations did not experience. Parents must create safe spaces where children can freely express their thoughts, fears, and emotions without fear of harsh judgment. Listening to children with patience and understanding strengthens trust and emotional connection.
Another important factor is digital guidance. While technology has many benefits, excessive screen time and uncontrolled internet access can negatively affect children’s behaviour, concentration, and social development. Intentional parents set healthy boundaries, monitor online activities, and teach children responsible use of technology.
Intentional parenting also involves teaching values such as respect, honesty, discipline, kindness, and responsibility. Children learn more from what parents do than from what they say. Therefore, parents must lead by example through their words, attitudes, and actions.
Furthermore, intentional parents pay attention to their children’s emotional and mental well-being. Academic success is important, but raising emotionally balanced children is equally essential. Encouraging children, celebrating their efforts, and showing them love and support help to build confidence and resilience.
In conclusion, intentional parenting is not about being perfect; it is about being present, purposeful, and consistent. The 21st century presents many challenges, but with love, guidance, and intentional effort, parents can raise children who will positively impact their families, communities, and the world at large.

description.title: RURAL CHURCH IN POLISH MOUNTAINS
description.body:
![Kopia – Whispers.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xAnfPB18VDeXekuPJ41KYao3DmRtwByYtsLVmzmXT18u1P3ko4utWnzEtU1jVLHDBA3.jpg)

Beskid Niski really likes to surprise people. Besides Orthodox churches, we can also find Roman Catholic churches here. Very often they stand quite close to one another. Such a view does not surprise anyone here, because for many years this region has been a mixture of cultures and religions, as well as Eastern and Western influences. This small church is located in the village of Smerekowiec, just a few kilometers away from my accommodation. From the outside, it seemed very simple and inconspicuous. There is actually nothing particularly unusual about it, but its interior can completely surprise you.

>Beskid niski bardzo lubi zaskakiwać. Oprócz ortodoksyjnych cerkwi możemy tutaj również spotkać kościoły rzymskokatolickie. Stoją one niejednokrotnie w bardzo bliskiej odległości od siebie. Taki widok nie dziwi tutaj nikogo, gdyż region przez lata był mieszanką kultur i wyznań, wpływów wschodu i zachodu. Ten drobny kościółek mieści się we wsi Smerkowiec, oddalonej zaledwie kilka kilometrów od mojego zakwaterowania. Z zewnątrz wydawał się być bardzo prosty i niepozorny. Nie ma w nim tak właściwie nic szczególnego, ale jego wnętrze potrafi totalnie zaskoczyć.


![20260321_140443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/245cRtbndXVsDdN1BB2dPhe6ComLwjzRoE1xrEUMnxLu7n5QZfqqDPEHNRep2wFsQx7Hc.jpg)

![20260321_140604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243WRNqMedGy3FoTe2hm3oA394PyUKfEGv7QRMU7WJxPocQfREzFmDiY8yGqNcX5iDYmW.jpg)

![20260321_140708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243frQahQkxYfghABHuci8K5ZMFz5hkANTR1vgU1a2hDuraKc3Wbb8PiDzU4pSKHjitzM.jpg)

It was the only church we managed to enter during our trip. All the other churches and Orthodox churches were closed, but this time we were lucky because next to the church there was a house belonging most likely to the local priest. When he noticed that my friend and I were taking photographs, he came over to talk to us and invited us inside. He even allowed us to take a few photos. I have to admit that the richness I saw inside made a really strong impression on me. The iconostasis, its colors, and decorations looked truly stunning and created quite a strong contrast to what we could see from the outside.

>Był to jedyny kościół/cerkwia, do którego udało nam się dostać do środka. Wszystkie pozostałe cerkwie i kościoły były pozamykane, a w tym wypadku miałyśmy trochę szczęścia, gdyż obok kościoła znajdował się dom najprawdopodobniej należący do tamtejszego proboszcza, a ten widząc, że robimy z koleżanką fotografie, zagadał do nas i zaprosił nas do środka. Pozwolił nawet zrobić kilka zdjęć. Muszę powiedzieć, że bogactwo, które zobaczyłam w środku, robiło naprawdę spore wrażenie. Ikonostas, jego kolory i zdobienia robiły ogromne wrażenie i stanowiły dość spory kontrast do tego, co możemy oglądać z zewnątrz.


![20260321_141014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23tSac9UBqMPBUnVqzxYYtZWN4ceZo8xKjyE2SunLuYBaKMwSC8FZ9T9Zchbn9BVQD7Ke.jpg)

![20260321_141040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23tSUbdmqz5MQhNYzvJYhjduuMW8pG4mpwfcJfYYU26aqvtG24PzeJvh9z6zFjDfyT2My.jpg)

Interestingly, from the outside this church resembled an Orthodox church much more than a classic Roman Catholic church. This is mainly because of the three domes and, honestly, we thought it was just another Orthodox church. Only when we came closer and spoke with the priest did we realize that it was actually a Roman Catholic church.

>Co ciekawe z zewnątrz kościół ten bardziej przypominał cerkiew, aniżeli klasyczny kościół rzymskokatolicki. Wskazują na to przede wszystkim trzy kopuły i szczerze mówiąc, myślałyśmy, że to kolejna cerkiew. Dopiero jak podeszłyśmy bliżej i porozmawiałyśmy z proboszczem, zrozumiałyśmy, że jest to kościół rzymskokatolicki.


![20260321_140511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243fjpNzJTbnprTpCSBgxwRtmb7TEY4hPVQq1bgN6oLnGJzExoLU6WU7uXWviigXXnL4c.jpg)

![20260321_140741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243LzeRwr6H4JZSNgCkPsmmdw2QuvsbLiGmYDpZh53kojmBtHJApw54NDSQJX55617wMv.jpg)

description.body: \n

/> [source](https://topauto.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Diesel-fuel-cap-header.jpg) South Africa is literally one big crime scene full of bad actors in an unlawful society and one needs to be aware of all the scams. The latest warnings are regarding diesel being diluted with other liquids like paraffin and lubricating oil to help raise the profits.

/></center>

[source](https://topauto.co.za/news/152275/good-news-about-diesel-prices-in-south-africa/)




The problem is diesel has increased in price so much lately and from the 1st January till today has risen by 77-82% which is good news for those looking to  dilute the diesel and make profits. The problem is the rand has depreciated along with the increased oil prices then it has created a double whammy.

The problem is the diesel is now being remixed at fuel depots before the diesel is being distributed. More than 100 fuel depots have been found to be illegally adding paraffin, kerosene, lubricating oils and various industrial solvents. This along with Diesel prices being unregulated it has allowed unscrupulous petrol stations to offer cheaper diesel attracting motorists not knowing what they are purchasing whilst offering those unscrupulous suppliers extra profits. 

Truckers will be tempted to stop and fill up because of the so called savings as many drivers work on a percentage of profits so a so called saving will not be as it seems once the engine needs replacing. Paraffin has wax in it and under cooler temperatures that wax solidifies and clogs up everything in the engine.

The problem is what the dirty diesel does to the engines as the damage is serious. Engines do rely on fuel with lubricating properties and diluted diesel will destroy parts like fuel pumps, filters and injectors. If purchased over a period of time this will lead to higher fuel usage, poor engine power outage and possible engine failure.

The problem is not what is taking place and it is more to do with the policing of the situation as the entire policing system is so corrupt. Just in the last month myself personally I have encountered an entire police station on the books of organised crime who refused to lay charges against the people I was charging because these corrupt individuals were paying those in charge who also happen to be corrupt.

In the past depots caught mixing diesel with paraffin were found to be as high as 68% contamination meaning only 32 % is genuine diesel. Back in 2023 70 depots were fined and this year already 100 depots nationally have been highlighted for testing due to irregular purchases. Surely this is not rocket science and one could tell quite quickly from the volumes of diesel purchased over a period of 12 months. If the supply decreases significantly then something has to be a miss and is not a drop in sales, but something more sinister.

I was reading up about this dirty diesel today and it is happening not only in South Africa, but Kenya as well and I am sure other places around the world. Wherever there is easy profit there is always some crooked angle that will effect so many people not caring what damage they have created.

Roughly 10 years ago we had our local petrol station have contaminated petrol due to rainwater finding it's way in the stations storage tanks. Water and fuel is not great and we had issues when driving until we found out what the problem was and have never returned to that petrol station again.

Hello everyone. The Gaming Photography Contest is back.

Show your photography skills by capturing amazing moments in games like beautiful views, exciting battles, or special action scenes. It could be a sunset, a boss fight, or any moment that looks unforgettable.

Think your screenshot is the best? Submit it as your official entry and don't forget to add the correct tags so the judges can find it easily.

You'll just have to show us your gaming photography, including screenshots of ***Gaming Photographs.*** by any means.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png

**We started our delegation service where we're paying out a 90% curation reward. Check [this post](https://ecency.com/hive-185676/@gamingphoto/introducing-our-community-delegation-system) for more details and please help us grow.**

https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png

**Rules:**
As it's a contest, there should be some rules to follow, right? And these rules are not meant to be broken, lol.

- Publish a post in [Gaming Photography](https://peakd.com/c/hive-185676/created) Community showing some gaming photographs following the theme.

- Add the #gamingphotocontest and #contest in first five tags and then add tags suitable to your post.

- The post must be written only in English (adding a second language would disqualify an entry).

- The post should have at least 350 original words in per language (excluding Hi, Hello, or some common things that you use in your post). You can talk about behind-the-scenes of how you implemented the idea to meet the word counts.

- Show at least 7 photos. They can be photos from 7 different moments or can be a single moment from 7 different angles.

- Leave your entry as a comment to this announcement post so we don't miss your entry.

- Attach the link of this announcement post in your entry so your readers can check this out (not mandatory).

- Mention some of your gamer friends in Hive in your post that you think might be interested in joining the contest (not mandatory).

https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png

**Rewards:**
I bet you want to know what you'll get as a reward after winning or joining the contest so here we are.

- Upvotes from our dedicated sponsor, @Qurator (thanks to @scrooger).
  - The Winner = 30% upvote, 2<sup>nd</sup> position = 20% upvote, 3<sup>rd</sup> position  = 10% upvote.

- Total 60 Hive (yeah, we're rewarding with liquid hive now).
  - The Winner = 30 Hive, 2<sup>nd</sup> position  = 20 Hive, 
 3<sup>rd</sup> position  = 10 Hive.

- 45% beneficiary of the winner announcement post.
  - The Winner = 20%, 2<sup>nd</sup> position = 15%, 3<sup>rd</sup> position  = 10%.

- Possible curation (from other curation services) for all valid entries that has decent effort (not guaranteed).

Current Sponsors: @Qurator is our dedicated sponsor for the weekly contests who'll upvote first 3 winners every week, @gamingphoto = 60 Hive and 45% beneficiary reward.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png

We're looking for more sponsors and we'll keep looking throughout the deadline of the contest so there is a chance for he rewards to increase later. If you wish to be a part of the sponsors (no matter how little it is), send it to @gamingphoto with the memo ***\

*** and I'll update it in this post. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png ***Deadline to join the contest is:*** Basically, 5 days (120 hours) after this post is announced, but you can join till we go for the judging as sometimes we get busy for that as its all manual. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png We suggest you (members of the community and contestants of the contest) to check what others are contributing to this community and engage with them through your comments, upvotes, and follows which would make the community stronger in the long run. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png - Consider delegating a portion of your HP to @gamingphoto which will be used to reward good content.

description.title: De vuelta al gym [ESP/ENG]
description.body: <div class=\

> Me costo mucho decidirme, tomar el valor de levantarme de nuevo, estos días han sido algo complicados, no se como explicarles, pero había dejado el gym, estuve casi tres meses sin asistir, siempre me decía, este mes si iré, pero surgían cosas, no me animaba, y dejaba pasar los días, y así los meses.
![post hive (52).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uQkG84kwKkdgStxv7dwEqY1uZgpLB9RNCDsK2t4xLs5vfUeZnp1hpjtTkP7xqGpMJJB.png)
Pero como dicen por allí, nunca es tarde, esta semana saque valor, tome la decisión, me levante y me fui a mi gym, no les niego el regreso ha sido algo duro, mi cuerpo me lo esta mostrando, de nuevo tengo dolores en las piernas, brazos, la debilidad extrema jeje, leí por ahí que la debilidad en las piernas puede deberse también a mi condición, no lo se, quizás, todo esto me afecta, aun así, debo seguir intentándolo, mantenerme activa, con los ejercicios.
![post hive (53).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xKr7MiLeaiCbcaeoeLDUuTFfTXxoeu4GXoXF3oNWf8669cdXYxdzpe2H9g2Vs7NEctd.png)
Esta semana comencé suave, dentro de lo que cabe, aunque las piernas no me ayudan mucho, no tengo suficiente resistencia en ellas, no entiendo porque, pero bueno, vamos a suponer que es por el tiempo sin hacer ejercicios, mas mi condición, no es fácil, toca aguantar y seguir. Espero cumplir este mes con mis ejercicios, mi rutina, sentirme mas animada, puesto que mi cuerpo me ha hecho sentir demasiado débil y cansada, me hago la dura por fuera, pero por dentro, en fin, mientras me sigo preparando para el día de las madres, haciendo detallitos para regalar. Les estaré mostrando a medida que valla terminando, y ustedes como se preparan para ese día, los leo. ---
ENGLISH VERSION

It was very hard for me to make up my mind, to muster the courage to get up again, these days have been somewhat complicated, I don't know how to explain it to you, but I had stopped going to the gym, I went almost three months without attending, I always told myself, this month I will go, but things came up, I didn't feel motivated, and I let the days go by, and so the months.

![post hive (52).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uQkG84kwKkdgStxv7dwEqY1uZgpLB9RNCDsK2t4xLs5vfUeZnp1hpjtTkP7xqGpMJJB.png)
But as they say over there, it's never too late. This week I gathered courage, made the decision, got up, and went to my gym. I won't deny that the return has been somewhat hard; my body is showing it to me. Again, I have pain in my legs, arms, extreme weakness hehe. I read somewhere that leg weakness can also be due to my condition, I don't know, maybe. All of this affects me, yet I must keep trying, stay active, with the exercises.
![post hive (53).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xKr7MiLeaiCbcaeoeLDUuTFfTXxoeu4GXoXF3oNWf8669cdXYxdzpe2H9g2Vs7NEctd.png)
This week I started off easy, as much as possible, although my legs don’t help me much, I don’t have enough endurance in them, I don’t understand why, but well, let’s suppose it’s because of the time without exercising, plus my condition, it’s not easy, you have to endure and keep going. I hope to fulfill this month with my exercises, my routine, to feel more motivated, since my body has made me feel very weak and tired, I act tough on the outside, but on the inside, anyway, while I continue preparing for Mother’s Day, making little gifts to give. I will be showing you as I finish them, and you, how you prepare for that day, I read you.
