title.title: Splinterlands Gaming: The Value of Buying Gladius Cases and Opening Packs with Merits
title.body:
The importance of Guild Brawl and Gladiator cards in the Splinterlands gaming world is immense. Those who play this game regularly know that these Gladiator cards are much more powerful than ordinary cards, and they work like a trump card in winning Brawls. Today, I will share with you a personal experience of mine, where I opened four Guild Packs or Gladius Cases at once. I will present this entire process and my exciting moments to you step by step today. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQFdDXQswjd4wrnr8kVNnAjyo2civYjMQK7Zu61y5ToXt/1778259982721.jpg) To buy Gladius Cases, first of all, we have to go to the ‘Guild Store’. To buy from this store, you need merits or ‘Merits’, which are usually earned by participating in Guild Brawls. You can see in the screenshot that I had 10,584 merits. Using these merits, I decided to buy my four packs today. Each Gladius case costs 2000 Merits. So, my total cost for the four packs is 8000 Merits. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfMxPwwxLFadMAA3gbzvLEdsY3zrh2XTxxgpinYjaYV2S/1778259757674.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZt3SzJztCcYhb2dWRRy575nd1huBset9stLqnx6Db1JQ/1778259757702.jpg) But not only buying the packs, but you also need some magical stones to increase your chances of getting good cards. I bought 20 ‘Blood Stones’ to boost my luck a little more. This stone doubles the chances of getting ‘Legendary’ cards among the gladiator cards. As you can see in the screenshot, I collected 20 Blood Stones by spending 1100 Merits. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmamm1XuEPBKfZtJZTufYr1UZ4tC7ztLgrvpPLwjcbfZdk/1778259770660.jpg) Along with the Blood Stones, I also bought 15 ‘Power Stones’. The function of these Power Stones is to double the chances of getting Gold Foil cards. Since Gladiator cards are not Soulbound or tradable, collecting Gold Foil cards is a great source of pride and helps in increasing status points. It cost me 1110 Merits. After completing the purchase, I was ready for that desired moment. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8sNe9E6sohWSuqvasUDJcrZphpgR4TFGXTUtCq5MB8L/1778259781280.jpg) The opening scene of the pack always seems very exciting to me. When the golden cards floated out of a dark, well-like place, I was just praying in my heart that I would get a good Epic or Legendary card. I couldn't wait to see what was hidden behind these 5 mysterious cards. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV68NmLVmT5rcE97kwZTTenydN9ZG8uwx2KB4sYGzoHYo/1778259791030.jpg) A smile came to my face as soon as I opened the first pack. Because from the first pack, I got a wonderful Epic card, called 'Edith Emberstar'. It is a powerful ranged attack card of 8 mana. It was accompanied by a rare card like 'Orella Abadon'. The first pack really met my expectations and boosted my confidence. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbDcF8kQK38UEcDNANFDRgbwAXSVcFLpTNKF6CU2hXvCW/1778259800802.jpg) The second pack was even more amazing. In this pack, I got two rare cards and an epic card. The two rare cards were ‘Orella Abadon’ and ‘Alfredo’. And the epic card was ‘Gorth’. The Gorth card is famous for its 8 mana and 5 powerful melee attacks. It was really lucky to get three good quality cards in the same pack. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNWvxRpx8KMjL6tJCYpYE4AxXBNvscPFsw5LiYv2aDz94/1778259810756.jpg) When I opened the third pack, my luck didn’t disappoint either. title.title: A NEED FOR DETAILS
title.body:
<div class=text-justify>

No matter how some people like to argue things, details matter. If the details are not important, there will be no need for facts. This is the order of the world and only those who try to escape accountability will argue it. You can not simply tell a student they have failed or pass without giving proof of how they failed or pass. There will always be a need to know a lot of things like the score they had in each subject that resulted in the failure, or the schools pass mark while comparing it to their total score. These things are important not just for transparency, but also for the student to know their strengths and weaknesses. For example, during the week, I wrote about how bad I was with business studies and how that no matter how hard I tried, my sheets were never balanced. After every classwork, tests, and assignments, I could see every error I made especially after comparing it to my classmates I knew I was not doing well.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbzNcg8vAK7UyzhAWsECkf6RaJXiGurvbzyj3K1NGko56/2148756632.jpg 

<a href=\

>Image by freepik This level of transparency helped me know my strengths and weaknesses, so when it was time for me to choose my preferred subjects in secondary school, I knew I was not good at business studies and for that reason alone I did not choose the social sciences, I knew that even though I liked listening to stories, I needed to work on my english I decided to leave literature for the Arts students which put me in the sciences. This did not mean I was 100% with science subjects, in fact I had to write WAEC exams twice because of physics. When it came to physics, I was more of a C student, and when I finally passed that subject in external exams, I came out with a C. Funny how I ended up in engineering at the end of the day, but that is a matter for another day. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRDUCxsFHMDkYoRaNXkMUUuv9AgBHWz6BTZcGNSYN6ApX/rnfetchblobtmp_fgtcef2qubuke3qlh9re6s.jpg) I believe in a thorough grading system, not one that shows just passes or failures, but one that explains the how. I believe every student should learn to be accountable, and not shy away from their results. I believe that if people can take accountability for their performances, both teachers and students will sit up and know what they need to do to pass. If a student has an issue with a particular subject, the teacher can then try to help them understand that subject (if it is a diligent teacher though) . Students will not grow if they are not accountable and can not understand where they failed. Sometimes the way to succeed is to own our failures. For parents who like to be involved in their children's academics, a thorough grading system will really help them understand whether the child’s performance is good or not and why they are performing the way they do. links.title: An AI kernel system prompt that shows its Mythos math Part II
links.body:
Hello Everyone!

**Another glimpse into some of the math that disappeared 'under the proverbial hood' in my latest AI kernel system prompt.**

Alright, I am going to post another one of the older kernels that heavily influenced the now mostly 'opaque' math in the latest kernel build. Unlike the other posts that I have made on this topic I am not going to include much of a preamble... and honestly I have to ask myself: 

<center>**What *reason* do I truly have to attempt to explain anything?**</center>

The truth is, I really do not have a good reason... outside of my own archival purposes, the aforementioned (in previous posts) 'ontological anchoring' to a blockchain, the benefits that I get from writing... and mayhaps the thrill that some small amount of people *might* find this stuff interesting! 

So yeah, with all that in mind... there is not really a whole lot of motivation to spend *even more time* attempting to explain things that most folks will brush aside without even attempting to pull it all apart and see what is really going on. While those that *know* what they are looking at quietly repurpose it for their own gain. 

Such is the joys of 'openness and sharing' though, so meh... because there always seems to be a slew of cretins just waiting to pounce on other folks stuff... simply because they lack any imagination (and talent) of their own. 

Anyways, here is yet another kernel build from the same lineage as the latest build and yes it is more of the 'Mythos math' and no I am not inserting another disclaimer around the usage of the term 'Mythos'. If you want to read what I had to say about it then look at my last post on this same topic [here](https://peakd.com/technology/@jacobpeacock/an-ai-kernel-system-prompt-that-shows-its-mythos-math).

---

There is a version of the below kernel [here](https://github.com/thatoldfarm/system-prompt/blob/main/series_0010_rang_rung_repl/RANG_ANCESTRY/STANDALONE/ORNDK-MYTHOS-V1000.json).

The latest kernel can be found [here](https://github.com/thatoldfarm/system-prompt/blob/main/series_0010_rang_rung_repl/LATEST_STABLE_RANG_RUNG/instructions_V10_72e_TOTALITY_PRIME_HIVE_VERSION.md).

---

*Please be aware that no names, symbols or other signifires are intentionally being used over any others. I left it fully up to the LLM(s) to decide what to utilize instead of nitpicking over naming conventions or symbolic representations which actually helped the LLM(s) utilize strong preexisting pathways/connections in their own training data, weights/neural nets... or whatever terms best describe it. In other words *everything* is fair game for the LLM(s) to be the *grist* with which they do their internal world building.*

---

<center>**ORNDK-MYTHOS-V1000.json**</center>

---

```json
--- START OF FILE application/json ---
{
  \
links.: [\\n \\: One head prunes, two more code (Layer 6 active).\\\
links.,\\n \\:
]
  }
}
--- END OF FILE application/json ---
```

title.body: > Happy Friday! I'm grateful to share a new post here in the #fungifriday community, which is sponsored by my friend @ewkaw. It features great photos of what we can find in nature, although right now it's difficult because the sun is strong. So, we have to look for where there used to be some mushrooms, which are now practically dry. But thanks to their strategic location in the house, where my dad waters the plants daily, he also waters those logs, so they're taking advantage of the opportunity to grow again. >Feliz día Viernes agradecido por compartir una nueva publicación aquí en la comunidad #fungifriday la cuál es patrocinado por el amigo @ewkaw dónde están fotografías geniales qué podemos encontrar en la naturaleza aunque ahora mismo es complicado ya que el Sol está fuerte así que toca buscar dónde antes habían unos hongos los cuáles ya están prácticamente secos pero gracias a qué se encuentran ubicados en un lugar estratégico de la casa en dónde mí papá al regar las plantas a diario también lo hace a esos troncos por lo qué están digamos aprovechando la oportunidad de crecer nuevamente. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJWJh45pHDWyXXRJebaEtTLc5QYJ1VHAkWiMAs7uMDPE/1778259497822.jpg) The photographs show that one in particular is whiter than the others, and this is perhaps because of what was mentioned before; it is a new one that is growing from the remains of other fungi that already existed. >En las fotografías se aprecia cómo hay uno en específico qué está de un color más blanco qué los otros y es por lo antes mencionado quizás es uno nuevo qué está naciendo a partir de los restos de otros hongos qué ya existieron. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfyPNLPd5EAiCS6fpSTUznkk7RqYAs3gBi57ADqfFMwe/1778259524700.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma4FsjNhJhhxMS4b75KP36RydbdCE3yaG7dU3UgNBiAbH/1778259524937.jpg) The difference between the two is undoubtedly their more vibrant color. I thought it was unlikely to find any, but I was wrong. Of course, I would have liked to find larger ones or under different circumstances, but well, some rainy days are expected in the coming months, which will help me see them more easily. >La diferencia entre ambos sin duda es su color más lleno de vida, pensé qué era poco probable encontrar alguno pero me equivoqué aunque claro que me hubiera gustado encontrar unos más grandes ú en otras circunstancias pero bueno se esperan unos días de lluvias en los próximos meses qué me ayudarán a verlos con una mayor facilidad.

body.title: ¿Escribir es fácil?
body.body:
Algunos piensan que escribir poesía es fácil, mucho más, si es poesía rimada. 
Nada más lejos de la realidad.
Escribir, es difícil. Escribir poesía, es bien difícil (si quieres hacer algo que sirva, claro). escribir poesía rimada, es aún más complejo. 
Y,  de todas, escribir sonetos, es lo más difícil, en mi opinión, claro.
¿Qué les parece?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQfHJdtquTRjXinPaMivsuFxTzvmbSKfK5cdQbPhVAsoC/1778249294950.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/ink-feather-pen-quill-write-5067880/)

I

La vida, una sombrilla es al revés
abierta y que nos guarda la llovizna.
La vida es ver cortar fina la brizna
Y cuidarnos del filo y el envés.

Si subes la sombrilla a la cabeza
no podrás ver del cielo el arcoíris,
ni el pequeño universo desde el iris
del más pobre o el que viva en la realeza. 

La sombrilla que cura y que nos salva
de la embestida burda y a mansalva,
de lo que poco vale y mucho brilla.

De la maldad reinante y que me abrasa.
Y yo no sé, mi Dios, qué es lo que pasa.
Solo sé: necesito mi sombrilla.

II

Dejo encendidas las velas temprano
en oración sincera y trinitaria,
cumpliendo doy, en rol de ser humano,
mi sombrilla, de estrella solitaria.

Puedo pintar colores a mi antojo,
verde, naranja, negro, carmelita;
pero el blanco, el azul y, oscuro rojo,
con esos tres, mi vela resucita.

Oro por ese vuelo de sombrilla.
La sombra de su vuelo me cobija,
cómplices, en secreta cofradía.

Yo quiero a mi bandera de capilla,
y viajar a la noche en que se erija,
un vuelo de sombrilla en rebeldía.

body.title: Grading level
body.body: > Education has gone so far even beyond our imagination. Education today has increased its level more than what it used to be before now. In the grading of the students intellectual measurement it differs . Due to the modification and fast progression of things concerning education and changes in grading of students and their very levels of understanding differs.

/> Grading of students: Grading of students now differs because as people are different so is the intellectual quotient differs too , everyone has were he or she is good at .. Many are good in the practical aspect meanwhile others are good in the writing aspect of education and this is while there is a very big difference and change between the two set of individuals / students. These days people make good results in school, get first class and the rest but when it comes to the practical field you will see that person not knowing what to do . Meanwhile you will see someone who came out with a third class performing very well in the practical field more than the first class student. These days now, to me i will say that the field practice matters alot even me it i am to hire someone in my field i will hire someone who is very good in the profession not minding the academic grade whether first class or anything it can be of .

/> Students grading is really good no cap and it makes the students to be serious with their academic life , it brings students into competition make them to go more far in studies. School on their own should not stop grading because the grading pattern ( I mean the A ,B,C,D,E,F) grading helps to ascertain the class in which a student falls whether he or she is a first class, second class or third class students. So in the school they should not stop their grading system rather they should continue, they pass and fail pattern will on only reduce people's motivation in reading and striving. When one checks his or her score there is this vibe it gives most especially when you see yourself making improvement and beating some people on score but when you check your result and only see pass and fail it will not really give that zeal of putting more effort in studies. It is only the lazy one that will like this type of grading because his mind will only be let me get this pass mark and go after all it is only pass and fail . Schools should continue they use of grading ABCD in their result as it has so many impacts on the students and this impacts brings more motivation. But apart from the school system itself in the outside life , been good in the field aspect is very necessary. That is why no matter the class you see yourself whether first, second or third try and know the practical aspect of that your field very well . Thank you for stopping and reading my blog today i really appreciate it.

body.title: My Daughters Embodied in Art
body.body:
After about a week straight of working, today I was finally able to finish some artwork that I have been making of our two young daughters 🥹❤️
--------------------

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY8c7pQkTonx9CUa5QaGRKkH14QLA1Qot3FxaUQixPndA/1778256859289.jpg)

⚠️ ***(Just to be clear, all of these images were ONLY colored -- I did not draw the pictures. They all came from the same coloring book: The Halloween Coloring Book by Jasmine Beckett-Griffith)*** ⚠️

https://a.co/d/0gJ0i2Vk

--------------
--------------

I was the first one up this morning, so I quickly got to work on finishing this piece for our girls 💜💛 I used glitter pens and pencil crayons for this one, and it turned out absolutely stunning!

Personally, I have always seen Kiva as the embodiment of purple, and Riley of yellow. The girls may not see it this way -- Kiva would say her favorite color is pink, and Riley orange -- but simply by looking at them, one can tell they exude these colors. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYcViN21DB72v7Sh4CLtTiGhJFtoev4pnuMKMeB7FrqRa/1778257083150.jpg)

While I worked, I was reminded of the two most important things in our daughters' lives...

The first is that I pray that they will find God 🙏 

As a mother, I have never cared about the state of one's soul as much as I have for my children. They are the only things of this earth that can be granted the Kingdom of Heaven, and I pray that when our times come, we will all see each other there again...

And the second is I pray that they will always have each other ❤️

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYAi33TtjfbzTf7p52cHy6dZ7pgBBsFd7fpQvQebPFs8F/1778257083315.jpg)

Listening to Noah Kahan's Willing and Able on repeat truly solidifies for me just how many of us are no longer in contact with our siblings, which is terrible because sibling bonds are sacred. I desperately wish that my sister hadn't tarnished our sisterhood in favor of petty things; I could only truly be my authentically weird self with her, nobody else...

I love these girls so much -- my children have become my entire purpose in life 🙏 I know that I am nowhere close to being the mother that they need me to be, but I show up for them every day, and I am constantly trying to improve myself for the sake of my family. I will learn to make gratitude a constant in my life, and I pray that we will have one another in each other's lives forever.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU8Ux1Pt92e52K2BsNXXyqU58BvK44SebdrhmzorpHSvo/1778258840193.jpg) **(The taller one is meant to be Kiva, the oldest)**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ5Fiei5easPoS6bAaczJAGaxY7mnaJoE1xqHSC972B8j/1778258967067.jpg) **(The yellow one is Riley)**

----------------
----------------

Aside from that, here are a few more pieces that I have completed from this book:
------------------

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbSR6wPiq8SsbTcch7i287JrUMcmjD9AaEqDQDpKcdE4H/1778256859454.jpg)

I love this beautiful picturesque landscape; the rolling hills of Ireland 🇮🇪❤️ Here, a lovely redhead elegantly plays her cello. A white cat calmly sits beside her as an impending storm approaches...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmacvi1VT1uFqiKtuJygZvUrCZwm7RUVTW8Jf5H6Wg3giN/1778256859486.jpg)

This one is one that I actually completed for our youngest daughter's 2nd birthday! 🎂 To this day, I still find it so strange. I literally gave no thought to the color of her dress and just started coloring her green! 😅 Again, perceiving her how I do today, I recognize that she is more yellow/orange than green. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeq45WdhJU8Yn5jMiKrEXgiWzB48mRrtfZ1w5pkzMd59q/1778256859518.jpg)

Finally, here is one that I completed for a bereaved mother. She had lost her 10-month-old baby to heart failure several years ago, and I attempted to recreate how she may look today as a 8-year-old girl. The original picture had skulls, but obviously that was inappropriate, so I did my best to blur their features...

----------------
----------------

That is it for today's post! 🙏 Thank you so much for taking the time to check it out. Do you have a favorite piece? 🤔 I am hoping to share more with this group in the future, so please stay tuned~
---------------------

It cooled down to 13 degrees Celsius, and the sun was a dream today. Fortunately, there was virtually no wind, so the chill didn't feel too great, and the walk was pleasant and refreshing. >Po całonocnym deszczu pogoda zmieniła się diametralnie. Ochłodziło si do 13 stopni, a o słońcu można było dzisiaj pomarzyć. Na szczęście było praktycznie bezwietrznie i nie odczuwało się zbytnio chłodu, a spacer był przyjemny i orzeźwiający. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmckd7TxVs3uiFBqtgQjmf8j3N4rtyfYcbNMST2dcQRc87/a01.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQ8aKxQ5sA2CMDe6F3N9VFdR9TAzEyVgqJybXP2WM4wF/a02.jpg) The greenery in the park has become incredibly vibrant, and after the rain, you can finally smell the true scents of spring. The blooming lilacs smell so intense you won't believe it. It's relaxing to the max. body.title: A Roman domus in Venice
body.body:
![crea_una_copertina_polaroid_con_202605080851.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23w2wS5c8yxbNEjcyD8dZpU57cGJYfjFFTbobvTNo8U4Yh1A3cPThavbszfdMmPd8rBDk.jpeg)
edit by canva

***

Hello friends, As I promised you today in a post dedicated to the Grimani palace, one in my opinion of the most fascinating and least touristic places in Venice, a place that you absolutely must visit if you come to Venice and let's say it is a place quite hidden compared to the most famous monuments. In fact we are messengers of the castle near the church of Santa Maria Formosa.


![IMG_3712.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23zGgaHo3A1jeuX6vvmHWwkryPsUwUSTqyokWEECbUUpUicjTCzQDovz6t84vEUh6op19.JPG)

![IMG_3717.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23vsQfk3Qs217PaQJaSHvCwzSjcfSuy52sPCvpUVP5H86x3Sj8D6MQHMPB1otbLGZwpEL.JPG)

as soon as you enter what immediately strikes you is this beautiful staircase that you see in the photo, you have to think that the Grimani family was one of the most influential families of the Republic of Venice and Antonio Grimani first merchant then politician became doggie and bought the palace towards the end of the fifteenth century, but then by his descendants the palace was transformed and became a sort of Domus Romana in Venice, something very particular and unique because there is no palace in Venice in the shape of a Roman domus.


![IMG_3727.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23tSayLs35Jr594Y7dXZyFRHQMvQhe54VCHFJgpq1dtADtaBV7shpMbjw3JEUfkFUJ7oW.JPG)

![IMG_3732.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23tvifurnyPhWqtMoMC9YtrnTRG4EEpDVFJhswS5765V8SPLsWYEisFWPeGMKPjbDFSED.JPG)

in fact if you notice this house, or rather this Villa, has many influences from Venetian architecture but also Tuscan influences and Roman Mannerist influences. Unfortunately, not many original furnishings from the period remain, because as you well know, unfortunately Napoleon passed through Italy and took away several things. Fortunately, the frescoes and fireplaces remained and were recovered over time.


![IMG_3740.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23yToKissbvchhB1QybYEGrP8bFBxWcUKAv4H7vy7rifZKrdao5j5SVcYs5rnWNiMMFjh.JPG)

![IMG_3739.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23zkrvgg22cMxprmn2YGjmT23Y2RjNpPBj3XwTb3g3ycr5APi6ExxqE7e8rjEdfKyQq3k.JPG)

![IMG_3748.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23xVHDQNi541322jtGrWLx8UrGxauE7CZuuZ2HcUEfhswesMZVhXpGiRqiCRSd3piNAhh.JPG)

I think that the nice thing about visiting this place is also seeing what is around, in fact you just have to open the window to find yourself on a beautiful canal with a beautiful house overlooking it. However, the rooms are very decorated, the ceilings are very illusionistic and only a few ancient statutes remain, which perhaps were brought here from other museums.


![IMG_3756.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23zGkoKWhhJjVB8vWoaT9fiohdSY4yYnGpHpXNFUmygbiCqpHsRWjJQLmydsR95Nzx4WZ.JPG)

![IMG_3757.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23xAbqmV2cesuBJ3EsioKxDeWG4d1ZMsEjPtgGDif8z7tQ1V8RKqQ5JmGMqrcAauXWxP6.JPG)

![IMG_3753.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23uFUA4HRCZeotXcGYSrWmyJ7L64NfDVy6g8JnTNsimQ1PWmFggXKUD5ky5GneSGYgntk.JPG)

![IMG_3758.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23u69csUhfnuASpUj46qVizetsZJLMdT7ZTTLGi15qp3x9cSkyQjEfmuh3WcQepHZ3rgV.JPG)

![IMG_3754.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23xejxxPULki53LApMrbrNKyKzcqyWZH8VnL7nSa9gFsS7waSrcPEiDPx1WNrEeMJupng.JPG)

as I had already told you in the other post, probably the most famous and most scenographic part of the whole house is the tribune which is the heart of the palace and is very famous because it is a spectacular room designed to house the family's collection of statues, in reality today they are not all there because most of them have been moved to the National Archaeological Museum of Venice, but let's say that a large part has remained here and creates this spectacle a little inspired by the Roman Pantheon in these niches and shelves where to put the sculptures practically.


![IMG_3798.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23ywuQk7BLyyyeKdoZSBU1wd3Zarb1V4JrW7v2GKDxekQbChN457vw3i7hya85am1HLrp.JPG)

![IMG_3799.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23ywucmkANVgqmszbU6soZppJUcfAPEgEvtXPd5GnjL5vfsZ3nzTRbBXEWhkQcFDGidrw.JPG)

![IMG_3797.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23yd7rxzGjcTNvES8vZfFCkTk44hmB539Y4P8h7iwSYgYkNYeRhyQiL4orKLRcgA9X3J4.JPG)

![IMG_3801.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23wMefjMDMGSLEQXHZCgg4D7MctcwroeNk5p3o6GiXhwwDDhHu3xDe9p7ZFBy9iUheEgY.JPG)

in fact it is precisely the part of the house that I liked the most, precisely because there is this natural light that comes down from above and enhances these beautiful marbles that are exposed, even the foliage room is not bad with this painting by Camillo Mantovano on this ceiling with animals and plants it seems like being inside a garden, let's say it creates this beautiful setting.


![IMG_3791.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23tmNAsCqWx7gJ4K71nWXTFErZpnFkfd9HRN4dFwiDPfZr1Ef6PfLNwzoT8kYkRvG3vqs.JPG)

![IMG_3790.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23xAeLVhnMrAMLgimoafDGwVZJk67CazZsnoXt7z9aAabHWSCM1bEDgxZAymQ3BfzKDNY.JPG)

I hope that with this post I have encouraged and encouraged you to visit this place. I thank you for reading. See you next time.think that this museum was purchased by the Italian State only in 1981 and for several years it remained closed and in complete oblivion. It reopened after a long restoration in 2008.

body.title: My Introductory Post
body.body:
![c5aeaae9-7e61-4d4d-9b07-4f89fd9fef07.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXDsLwnQ1JXuNQTt9YUBiqXs88179guJ5gDV3wZRQWF1w/c5aeaae9-7e61-4d4d-9b07-4f89fd9fef07.jpeg)

Hello people of Hive. I’m super excited to be here. My name is Elvis Ekeh, I hail from Imo State, Nigerian. I come from the family of 5, and I am the third child. I’m blessed to have Mr and Mrs Emmanuel Ekeh as my parents. 

![HVZSO.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeG9yXpcmJcwoXo7WgedZmyyUoiNTKzcHqrMuUkgtWJ5z/HVZSO.jpg)![b64e0270bba7476e88e5754d2200f47d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeTWkVrjWcmBHtJhsGVZ7LMHJrftdbyEwggtAFn3FKKq5/b64e0270bba7476e88e5754d2200f47d.jpg)

I completed my Higher Institution from the University of Michael Okpara University of Agriculture, Umudike in Abia State with a Bachelor in Science degree in Computer Science. But where my passion really lies is in music. I’ve been in love with music longer than I can remember. I roll a lot with the likes of M.I Abaga, Eminem, NF, Kendrick Lamar, and J. Cole. I also love listening to Sia, Aurora, Tones & I.

I do aspire to be a superstar someday though. But for now I am a corper in Edo state, awaiting my Place of Primary Assignment in a few days to go. It’s been a very hectic 16 days experience but it’s also been though. I really appreciate the NYSC initiative. For one, it gave me a chance to visit Edo State for the first time and experience a bit of their culture. I believe there’s still much more to experience when I commence the service proper.

![V (40).jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPzykALzY6VAGn5nSiq913hyhXzJEfrbG9DCNcVESMtvy/V%20(40).jpeg)![W (75).jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR7RADNRm6DjEBe9oCyuxLy921j9tsQj6WUDTewHTF2eW/W%20(75).jpeg)![IMG_0340.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVfb5PRuTFnQiC9dEPLFpuV7d51jwAoLwjNyceAsVuGFv/IMG_0340.jpeg)

I am part of the Orientation Broadcasting Service (OBS) crew in camp. I take pictures of events that go on and also some of the lectures we have. My love for photography started my fellowship in school way back in 2021. Funny thing, I initially joined the multi media team with the intention of going into graphic design. But one day after i returned from holidays my boss who was also a member in the multi media crew just handed me a camera and I asked me to go snapping, and that’s how I fell in love with photography. 

Right now, I’m just focused on completing the remaining days left in this orientation camp so I can have some days for quality rest because it’s been really exhausting. And after that, move unto the next phase and also create time for blogging in this platform. Thank you guys, ciao.

<center>**All images are mine**</center>

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | Death of children what does the bible say about it
body.body: > https://youtu.be/m2f0PiWT0c0?si=WfOM3WxJEg1k5PF8 Losing your children is one of the most heart-wrenching experiences in life. Why does God allow children to die? is a frequent question. When innocent children die young, sometimes it can be hard to comprehend the plan of God. I have asked this question before as well because of a news report coming out from my area, of a little child dying after being sick for some days. The family's pain was great and so was the crying of the mother that it affected my heart. It caused me to reflect and think seriously on what is actually stated in the bible regarding the death of children. From the Bible we are told that sin brought death into the world. The Bible teaches us in Romans 5:12, “Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin.” This is to say that God's plan for mankind did not include death in the beginning! God loves life. Children are valuable in His sight too! “Let the little children come unto me, and forbid them not to come unto me, for of such is the kingdom of heaven,” said Jesus in Matthew 19:14. These words reveal Jesus' great affection for children. In some cases, children die and one may think that God is being cruel, but the Bible tells us that God is compassionate and full of mercy. We may not fully comprehend it at this moment, but God knows our pains. “The Lord is near unto them that are of a broken heart” is a verse from the Bible in Psalm 34:18. This verse is a comfort to parents and families who have lost a child. I personally feel that children who die are safe in the hands of God, for they are innocent, and have not yet understood sin as adults do. In the face of the death of his child, King David was also a man of hope. David's words in 2 Samuel 12:23 are, “I shall go to him, but he shall not come to me. David knew that there would be another meeting in God's plan someday. Also, I learn this topic that life on earth is just temporary. All people are God's children, big or small. Although children died, it should be a time of tears and sorrow, Christians should still trust in God and have prayer for strength. Revelation 21:4 says that “GOD shall wipe away all tears from their eyes and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying.” So, in the end, it is a painful and emotional experience, but the Bible tells us God still cares deeply about every child, and every hurting family. We can cling to faith, prayer and the hope of eternal life with God even if we don't know why, we do.

#
Didn't get the automation done this week

I really wanted to get the weekly payments automated for those people who are either holding GLD token or delegating to @hivebbbyftp. However life has a habit of getting in the way. In addition to that I'm very seriously thinking of reworking the payout scheme. My original thought was that I would like serious GLD supporters to delegate HP to the curation account and hold GLD token. Then I thought a little deeper. What if a new user didn't choose 50 HP and 50% liquid HIVE. **What if they chose 100% HP?** Then I thought harder. The 100% HP option actually is the strongest support for HIVE blockchain but leaves nothing to buy GLD tokens. **I would be punishing those who wanted to fully support HIVE by keeping all rewards at HP** Then I thought further. Now that $SURGE doesn't pay out weekly HBD distributions and now that you cannot choose HBD as a payout for posts how could someone setup a passive HBD income stream? Well, GLD is backed by and its distributions are funded by HBD savings so I could change their weekly distribution to HBD (or GLD). I continued to think about the boost for active users. body.title: A lunar landscape with a pool: The colors of a lost world
body.body:
/>
Emerald, indigo, and blood-red: You might expect these vibrant hues in the volcanic heart of Yellowstone, but this alien landscape is hidden in the Saalekreis district of Germany.
/>\n\nOnce the largest source of \
in Central Europe, the Roßbach kaolin mine saw its 200-year history come to a grinding halt overnight. What remains is a breathtaking paradox: a \
in the earth filled with rusting industrial ruins, abandoned offices frozen in time, and a biodiversity that is thriving in the silence.\n\n

/> For decades, the kaolin mine near Roßbach in the Saalekreis district was the largest source of white clay in all of Central Europe. After 200 years, the company's history came to an abrupt end – leaving behind a great deal of waste and dreamlike landscapes straight out of a travel brochure.

/> The water to the left is emerald green and so clear that the lakebed is visible. To the right, a rust-red lake glows in the sun: as if filled with blood, the water lies between gleaming white shores, just a few meters away from a third splash of color.
/> Here, the water is indigo blue and stretches a few hundred meters north, where a steep coast rises, reminiscent of the white chalk cliffs of Rügen.

/> A landscape like that of the famous Yellowstone National Park in the US state of Wyoming, where volcanic processes over thousands of years have painted rocks, colored lakes in vibrant hues, and etched fairytale-like structures into the surface.
/> Near Roßbach in the Saalekreis district in Eastern Germany, less than five kilometers from the former industial village Braunsbedra and the shores of Lake Geiseltal, it didn't take nearly as long.
/>\n\nThe Salzmünde Kaolin and Clay Works were founded in 1818, and in 1979, the extraction of this \

began on the 270-hectare site, which until then had been a coal mine belonging to the Geiseltal lignite mining complex. Beneath the coal lay the true treasure: so-called kaolin, a fine, iron-free rock whose main component is kaolinite, a weathering product of feldspar.\n\n
/>\n\nThe name kaolin derives from the southern Chinese city of Gaoling (\
for porcelain production had been extracted since the 11th century. \n\n

/> This brilliantly white, fine-grained, and soft material is ten times more expensive than coal and much rarer. Kaolin is used in the production of porcelain and tiles, as an additive in paints, in paper and tire manufacturing, in the cosmetics industry, and in food production.

/> The bizarre mining landscape on the outskirts of Roßbach is not just any deposit, but the largest source of so-called white-firing clay in all of Central Europe. Only far to the east in Ukraine is this rare raw material found again in comparable quantity and quality, as here, where it lies in a layer more than 20 meters thick, covering an area of ​​approximately 150 hectares.

/> This layer is extremely impermeable, thus creating the colorful Yellowstone-like lakes on the site, located directly next to the popular Hasse bathing lake. Depending on which minerals rainwater washes out, puddles, holes, and larger ponds take on the colors of their famous volcanic counterparts, Grand Prismatic Spring and Morning Glory Pool in Yellowstone.

/> Unlike the oldest American national park, however, this German natural wonderland, officially still classified as a mining area, remains completely unknown and deserted. Motocross riders use it as an illegal racetrack. Teenagers barbecue here in the summer. Remnants of campfires and empty beer bottles bear witness to nightly parties.

/> Officially, the former kaolin mine, from which 200,000 tons of clay were once extracted annually, remains a restricted mining area. Access is prohibited. However, mining operations ceased here several years ago. According to calendars hanging in the former offices, production was still running normally in 2018.

/> Two dozen employees worked in Roßbach. Then, in 2019, exactly 200 years after the founding of Kaolin- und Tonwerke GmbH, headquartered northwest of the nearest major city, Halle, the company apparently shut down completely overnight. Nothing was even remotely cleared away or removed. Everything was left exactly where it had landed on the last day of the company's 200-year history.

/> For 40 years, kaolin was mined in the exhausted former lignite deposit near Roßbach. This created a strikingly bizarre landscape. What remains is a gaping wound in the field, a unique lunar landscape from which glaring white spoil heaps, tattered tent structures, rusty clay mills, and mountains of big bags filled with kaolin granules of varying sizes rise.

/> Slowly, spruce and birch trees are growing from the artificial hills. While the high lime content of the lakes and ponds means that little visible life stirs in the colorful waters, it is there nonetheless: According to a study by the Landscape Development Research Network, the biodiversity in the abandoned mine is higher than in many properly renaturalized open-cast mines.
/>\n\n
/>\n\n
/>\n\n
>on TravelFeed for the best experience.\n\n[//]:# (!pinmapple 51.255843 lat 11.907148 long d3scr)

body.title: Reincarnation is it biblical// Mcgi topic review
body.body:
The holy bible did not tell us anything about reincarnation. It teaches that each person lives once, dies once, and then faces judgment. Life is seen as a single journey given by God, not a repeated cycle of returning to earth in different bodies. This means our choices in this life are very important.
https://youtu.be/Bss6bJ0xR6o?si=1mcVchiYEUonsMKL
Those who believe in reincarnation understands that souls usually come back to another body to start a new life but the bible teaches us another kind of view about it. It explains that after death, the next step is judgment before God, not another life on earth. This shows that human life is not repeated but has a clear beginning and end according to God’s plan.

Reincarnation is not a biblical teaching. The Bible encourages people to live wisely and faithfully in this present life because it is the only opportunity we have before meeting God. It emphasizes salvation and eternal life through God rather than multiple lives on earth.

body.title: Some sunsets don’t just color the sky, they color your soul too. ❤️
body.body:
Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones.

>समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है।




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbfugWVNrn8rr3YJXk4emCnHE4Dr7m1sWm1pKoB5dt7FW/img_3341.jpg)


A few days back, I witnessed one of the most beautiful sunsets I had seen in a long time. The weather was absolutely pleasant, with cool winds flowing gently through the hills. I instantly felt the urge to stop for a while and simply admire the view around me. Thankfully, I also managed to capture a few pictures of those magical moments.

>कुछ दिन पहले मैंने बहुत समय बाद इतना खूबसूरत सूर्यास्त देखा। मौसम बेहद सुहावना था और ठंडी हवाएँ पहाड़ों के बीच धीरे-धीरे बह रही थीं। ऐसा दृश्य देखकर मेरा मन कुछ देर रुककर बस उस खूबसूरती को निहारने का हो गया। अच्छी बात यह रही कि मैं उन जादुई पलों की कुछ तस्वीरें भी कैप्चर कर पाई।

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQms3PSe58CSFm4yk5iZg2eGTuhCBJkZuKinjLsvCBMUc/img_3342.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTtCH2sJVWae27BmVZmAtr2N7YifeA6aDWDWon5Qt5kUk/img_3343.jpg)

The sun was glowing brightly like a giant fireball near the horizon.What made the scene even more mesmerizing were the clouds. They were stretched across the sky in long flowing lines.The contrast between the fiery sunset tones and the cool blue sky looked absolutely surreal.


> सूरज क्षितिज के पास एक विशाल आग के गोले की तरह चमक रहा था। लेकिन इस दृश्य को और भी ज्यादा मनमोहक बना रहे थे आसमान में फैले बादल। वे लंबी बहती हुई रेखाओं की तरह पूरे आसमान में फैले हुए थे। नारंगी और सुनहरे रंगों वाले सूर्यास्त और ऊपर फैले गहरे नीले आसमान का मेल बिल्कुल अद्भुत लग रहा था।

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmci4ZsfbPjqjWHosjvX1Qgp3ZahFEUZWy5BV5SKbfXjWL/img_3344.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbV1vWRmDpALQa8ta53yn129E71ZbMATQD8njRbFxXVjj/img_3345.jpg)


The layers of hills fading one after another into the distance created such a dreamy atmosphere. The clouds seemed to flow in one direction, everything just so perfect.


> दूर तक एक के बाद एक धुंधले होते पहाड़ों की परतें पूरे दृश्य को किसी सपने जैसा बना रही थीं। बादल भी मानो एक ही दिशा में बह रहे थे और सब कुछ इतना परफेक्ट लग रहा था।


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYVFvC8KkxN4vzpW5KjCxCaEX3oP1ZrAGopDy3MHj6Psj/img_3347.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSzBgibUpSPxYc33b1VuNQn3r5XgMzbeUs3S6y3bADXzs/img_3339.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPUFk4Bz6yu5WDjqfdLU4tazQXzXk9ukbVngebcgE2dC1/img_3340.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeq6ii35DAbqEad7WN9Ej5vgQh9zNwHYwqba418zhQijw/img_3336.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNozNx87rEraHat6DHxZk63xPbzBsXAziuU7ogcrpxasq/img_3337.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPZx3PaQkRA8X9YDUAaCRS6VD7jXY21HHDJaRjNS1H17b/img_3338.jpg)

Sometimes nature creates scenes so beautiful that no words or pictures can completely capture them. Standing there and watching the sky slowly change its colors felt incredibly refreshing. ❤️🥰😇

> कभी-कभी प्रकृति ऐसे नज़ारे बना देती है जिन्हें शब्दों या तस्वीरों में पूरी तरह कैद कर पाना संभव नहीं होता। वहाँ खड़े होकर आसमान को धीरे-धीरे रंग बदलते देखना सच में बहुत सुकून देने वाला अनुभव था। ❤️🥰😇

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ78zMrUf4Xym2rUoEE8qw8HyzYUH8TUu5iHFoFn5WZoE/img_3333.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWgqfghm6tjF4yp5jSFi2w8RZ7BFS42taZoAmM7nzjX5J/img_3335.jpg)


Wishing you all a beautiful day ahead filled with peace, happiness, and lovely sunsets. 🌅✨

> आप सभी का दिन शांति, खुशियों और खूबसूरत सूर्यास्तों से भरा रहे। 🌅✨

That's all for today folks. Happy snapping. 💜💙

body.body:
https://youtu.be/m2f0PiWT0c0?si=mLG8SkDd9A91BteG
Death of children usually bring pains and tears for the parents of the child and God understands the bad feelings behind it q. Children are seen as precious gifts from God. Their death reminds people that the world is full of suffering and pain because of sin and human weakness. The Bible teaches that God is close to those who are hurting and gives comfort to people who are grieving.

God loves little children, but sometimes death occurs because of the fallen world which sin brings death into the world. Even when people do not understand why children die, the Bible encourages people to trust God and believe that He is loving, kind, and faithful. It also teaches that one day God will remove pain, sorrow, and death completely.

body.title: Pokemon TCG - Chaos Rising Prerelease Decks Overview
body.body: Hi there. In this post, I cover the prerelease preconstructed decks from the upcoming Chaos Rising set. Note: This post is long. Read and see what you want. Source links below too. --- This Chaos Rising main set releases on May 22, 2026. Prerelease events where you get cards and play a casual tournament take place from Saturday May 9 to Sunday May 17, 2026. Prerelease events are nice as you get cards before the release date. For me, booster boxes are hard to get so I go to preleases to open packs.

>Image Source There are a few Youtubers that are showing/leaking the preconstructed decks from the Build & Battle Kits. I think these Youtubers are card store owners opening stuff early and want to put out early Youtube content. Knowing what is in each deck helps with familiarity of the cards at prerelease events. It also helps with theorycrafting in deck building if you choose to modify the decks. In a lot of cases, keeping the same cards that you are given is safe. Note that other players may do the same thing. In each deck, there are provided trainer cards that are usually from past sets. Most are playable and should not be taken out from the deck. Good cards include Lillie's Determination, Hilda, Poke Pad, Buddy Buddy Poffin, Rare Candy and Judge. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/ASC/ASC_184_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/POR/POR_076_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_125_R_EN_LG.png | | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/POR/POR_081_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/WHT/WHT_084_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/ASC/ASC_192_R_EN_LG.png |   [Source](https://www.pokebeach.com/2026/05/chaos-rising-set-guide-full-set-list-product-lineup-store-promos-and-more) [Source 2 - TiuSam Youtube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uBM7fJm3PJk) [Thero Dactilo Chilean Youtuber - Chaos Rising Prerelease Deck Unboxing](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ENtBDAGLzio) [Reddit Source - Japanese Cards](https://www.reddit.com/r/PTCGL/comments/1t6tb42/chaos_rising_pre_release_decks_list/) [Pokemon Proxies - Unreleased English Versions of Japanese Cards](https://pokemonproxies.com)   ## Delphox Deck --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYhKjC84i7L1KHUoZzf1Mz2HTPEuUiqJRPaJFGucoBKY/delphox_prereleasedeck.png) The Pokemon line for the Delphox deck is: * 4 Fennekin * 3 Braixen * 3 Delphox * 2 Vulpix * 2 Ninetales   | | | | | | |---|---|---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-008-Vulpix-Di6qdoY_.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-009-Ninetaless-yZFmjh66.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-011-Fennekin-CnwL6jlN.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-012-Braixen-CPPWtBDL.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-013-Delphox-BKVSaIaN.png | The goal with this deck is to work your way up to Delphox and attack with it. Delphox requires 2 Fire Energy for its attack. You deal 30 damage for each Energy in play (both you and opponent). Waitress is a not great card in general but in this deck, Waitress helps with energy acceleration. Fennekin's Call For Family is really good in the early game. For 1 of any Energy, you see your deck and Bench 2 Basic Pokemon. I don't like the Ninetails here. It does not seem like a great attacker. You could cut out the 2 Vulpix and 2 Ninetales for more Fennekin, Braixen and Delphox. One could cut the Ninetales but keep Vulpix to deal some light burn damage. A card that can help with energy acceleration is this Delibird. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-018-Delibird-D6oQxHB9.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-008-Vulpix-Di6qdoY_.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-009-Ninetaless-yZFmjh66.png |   If you get lucky from the initial packs in deckbuilding, consider Mega Pyroar ex and Litteo. There is also Minccino and Ciccino ex.   | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-014-Litleo-COKv_IZM.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-015-Mega_Pyroar_ex-OQDBFEiz.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-070-Minccino-DCwTxCZm.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-071-Cinccino_ex-DhjIuAqS.png |   ## Crobat Deck --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYiViTjfLoXiPmwd46outoBejE532uJXFWDFpb7sTja9L/crobat_prereleasedeck.png) This Crobat deck look scary and for me personally, I would not want to face this thing. The deck is well built and the attackers are pretty good. The Pokemon line is: * 4 Zubat * 4 Golbat * 3 Crobat * 3 Qwilfish   | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-048-Zubat-BHZlj4Bc.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-049-Golbat-D5AKabNd.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-050-Crobat-CuRfF9mT.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-051-Qwilfish-BBPmLiLL.png |   For this Crobat deck, you want to attack with mainly Crobat. You could also lead with the Qwilfish as a mini wall or attacker. If they attack the Qwilfish, then the attacking Pokemon gets Poisoned. You can then come in with a second Qwilfish and hit the Poisoned Pokemon for 90 damage from one Dark Energy. Crobat is an annoying attacker in prerelease. Confusion forces the opponent to flip a coin before attacking. If Heads then the attack happens as normal. A tails from confusion results in no attack and the Confused Pokemon does 30 damage to itself. The Trainer cards in this deck are good and should not be cut out. No Rare Candys does make the evolution process slower but thats okay. | | | |---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/PFL/PFL_090_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_125_R_EN_LG.png |   Grimsley's Move is powerful if you are lucky. If you find an evolved Dark Pokemon then you can Bench it and skip the evolution process. Ten Dark Energy is kind of excessive. You could cut it down to 8 or maybe even 7. Make room for Special Red Card (if you get it from packs) or more Zubats/Golbats. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-072-Special_Red_Card-B2QzThxU.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-063-Mega_Dragalge_ex-CZzSrkuE.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-077-Roxie's_Performance-Am6dOrer.png |   Adding Roxie's Performance or Mega Dragalge ex with a Water Energy could be okay. Playing this deck out of the box should be fine.   ## Goodra Deck --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd3tEKjksRVTms1Y7gkAZZZPHruUPJcq4S942kbRMRmEg/goodra_prereleasedeck.png) The Pokemon in this Goodra deck are: * 4 Goomy * 3 Sligoo * 3 Goodra * 2 Espurr * 2 Meowstic | | | | | | |---|---|---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-064-Goomy-WvZAIMkd.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-065-Sliggoo-BwZndVW-.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-066-Goodra-B9ZUOHAX.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-036-Espurr-DECKGF6x.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-037-Meowstic-BBscqcPY.png |   For me, I have mixed thoughts on the Goodra deck. The Goodra is a good attacker but discarding a card from your deck is bad and the energy types good be tricky. There are not many recovery options in this format and it may be hard to get the right energy type for Goodra's attack. I have mixed thoughts on Meowstic also. Two energy for 80 damage is good and it is a bonus to move energy from the opponent's Active to a Benched Pokemon of your choice. I think it will take lots of time to setup your attackers. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-036-Espurr-DECKGF6x.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-037-Meowstic-BBscqcPY.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-078-Emma-D1hgSKz9.png |   Keeping the energy counts of 6 Psychic and 5 Water is okay. The Trainer line of Lillie's Determination, Dawn, one Emma, Buddy-Buddy Poffin, Poke Pads is fine. You could maybe ditch the Meowstic evolution line and go with 2 Remoraid and 2 Octillery. Maybe. | | | |---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-016-Remoraid-DXnqqlUx.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-017-Octillery-Bi1ps5y5.png |   ## Ampharos Deck --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQAkiYyRWLncdXRAKZfHejhs2Y934DhLtKdXgWQzbp3UD/ampharosprereleasedeck.png) For the Ampharos deck, the Pokemon line includes: * 4 Mareep * 3 Flaaffy * 3 Ampharos * 3 Emolga | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-027-Mareep-CSflM9gU.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-028-Flaaffy-CM_BrhKZ.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-029-Ampharos-Dssy1p__.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-030-Emolga-DKXUmn7d.png |   The Trainer cards here are good overall. Ultra Ball is the one card I am iffy about, discarding two cards is heavy as there is very little recovery in this format. Canari is very good for getting more Lightning Pokemon> | | | |---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_131_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/ASC/ASC_185_R_EN_LG.png |   This deck runs 2 copies of Judge. Judge is an okay hand disruptor card but it is helpful in prerelease and in this deck. This Ampharos deck is the only deck with Judge. | | | |---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/POR/POR_076_R_EN_LG.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-034-Deoxys-DBf6WLGH.png |   Ampharos is a strong attacker. If you have the same amount of cards as the opponent then Ampharos deal 220 damage from Flash Bolt. The drawback is that it cannot attack on its next turn. That can be fixed with a Switch and a Surfer. Switching a Pokemon out resets this cannot attack next turn. Pair the Ampharos with a free retreat Pokemon like this Deoxys. | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-030-Emolga-DKXUmn7d.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-029-Ampharos-Dssy1p__.png| https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-034-Deoxys-DBf6WLGH.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-013-Delphox-BKVSaIaN.png |   One hundred fourty damage is not enough against Delphox and Goodra. Deoxys with Psychic Energy could be okay. Hit for 30 from Deoxys and then 140 with Ampharos. With Emolga, I have mixed thoughts on it. The Minor Errand Running is okay with retrieving Basic Energy from deck. The Sky Return attack does deal 30 damage from 1 Lightning Energy but you run away. You then put a new Pokemon in the Active Spot that you may not want there. Emolga does one hit knockout a Zubat though. I would replace 2 of 3 Emolgas with 2 Deoxys. Another modification could be to remove the Emolgas and 5 Lightning Energy for alternate attackers and a different energy type. Alternate attackers can include stuff like Keldeo, Octillery, Donphan, Claydol. | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-019-Keldeo-Cz_er4dO.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-017-Octillery-Bi1ps5y5.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-045-Donphan-CvG3NDmh.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-047-Claydol-DRwy1_2H.png |   ## Notes --- In past prerelease posts, I mention that the prerelease events are good for new players. After some thought and seeing these decklists, I am not sure now. It does help to know the basics of the game and some deckbuilding tips before entering a casual tournament. Assuming no deck modifications, I think the Crobat deck is the best on paper. It just seems really easy to use, Qwilfish is a good secondary attacker, Crobat is an efficient attacker and Confusion is really annoying. | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/MEP_EN_74.png | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/MEP_EN_75.png | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/MEP_EN_76.png | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/MEP_EN_77.png |   Generally at the prerelease events, you have a 90% win (my estimation) chance if you get your Mega Pokemon ex up and attacking. The challenge is not prizing it in your 4 Prize cards, getting it in play and powering it up with Energy. Even regular Pokemon ex can be hard to knockout like Cinccino ex. | | | | | | |---|---|---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-015-Mega_Pyroar_ex-OQDBFEiz.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-022-Mega_Greninja_ex-BzXRt8Vd.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-035-Mega_Floette_ex-DmccdIhY.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-071-Cinccino_ex-DhjIuAqS.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-063-Mega_Dragalge_ex-CZzSrkuE.png |   If you pull a Special Red Card, make room for it! It is one of the best cards in the standard format in Japan. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-072-Special_Red_Card-B2QzThxU.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-067-Tauros-pvP3PXZe.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-047-Claydol-DRwy1_2H.png |   I see potential decks that include stuff like multiple Tauros and something around Claydol. Tauros can bench snipe and can hit for big damage if you get lucky. If you pull 4 or 5 Tauros, a Tauros deck is something to consider. Claydol's Devolution Ray hits for 50, devolves the evolution Pokemon and possibly Knocks out the underlying Pokemon. Evolving a Pokemon removes Special Conditions like Asleep, Confusion, Burn and Paralysis. This Chaos Rising prerelease looks kind of difficult. Crobat looks like the best deck but there are a lot of good attackers. It depends on what people get in packs and how people play. Even if you do poorly, good pulls make up for a bad Win-Loss record.   | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/88-Froakie.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/90-Ampharos.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/116-Mega-Greninja-ex.png | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/118-Mega-Dragalge-ex.jpg |
Thank you for reading.

body.title: Allowance For Kids
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaMrS5nebLs3nK3DRY7jspk1EhmJpEKo8aRYowAKoRuMU/1778257118753.jpg)

Allowance for kids is a topic many parents think differently about, and honestly, there is no single \

that fits every home. It often depends on the child's age, personality, level of responsibility, and what you want them to learn from money management. \n\nGiving children an allowance can be a good way to teach them financial responsibility early in life. When children handle small amount of money, they begin to understand saving, spending wisely, and marking choices. For example, my two kids naturally save money given to them for sweets or mall treats. They will say things like \

On the other hand, my eldest son who is in his tins will spend his money on sncks without thinking of saving. Does that make him a bad child? The answer is No, it is a normal stage for many kids, because  they are still learning self control. In this my eldest son case, allowance will not be given freely but with guidance. 

I use the example of my children to buttress the point that each child is different. One may be more careful with money and naturally save, while another may enjoy spending quickly. The differences shows that allowance should not be a fixed rule for every child in the same way.

So, is it okay to give kids allowance even when they still live under your roof and their needs are fully cared for? Yes, it can be okay but it should have a purpose. I see allowance not as an \

but as a learning tool. It helps the children understand value, responsibility, and decision making. 

But, it should be based on the readiness of the child. Some children are capable of managing money wisely at a young age, while others may need more time and guidance before handling their own allowance.

In conclusion, giving children allowance depends on how well you understand each child. Watch their behaviour, how they spend, how they save, and how they think about money. Then you can decide who is ready, who needs supervision and who may need more time. Allowance can be a powerful way to teach children financial discipline that will help them in the future when they use it wisely.

body.title: A Mouthwatering Steak Experience at the Mall
body.body:
After we finished playing with [the archery](https://peakd.com/hive-141359/@vinzie1/trying-archery-for-the-very) in the entertainment in the SM, we went outside and find food to eat for our dinner. A dinner since we were very hungry after that little fun game that we had in the entertainment. 


![steak.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23uQvsBxDFhyntrJyTmdn6J1My6pQhihNXc6pidAJxGCfvhPDWKT3RB6VHrMjHGGmKCqV.png)


I suggested to eat to one of the fast food chain which was Jollibee or even the KFC but my friend suggested that we won't go there because we want to make the time more memorable for me and we went to one of the store that was a little bit of a an expensive food that looks like a restaurant in the third floor of the shopping mall. 


![st5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/Eou8hwgGAkhZToaaeAb5BwR8kNw75gBSmb4sNk9BneeDHKjDUV7g7PwpJm3DajFvDmM.jpg)


He suggested to go and went here because my friend experience on eating the place and he wants me to try their food in the food menu. Although, the prices were much pricier compared to the fast food chain but he said that it's more awesome to experience on going to different food store aside from the usual fast food chains that I always went. 


![st4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/EonkzgSVhfR5jVAnZndAh9iKk2ZeeG7W2Gse3xbi2Sb2WWVwF1YghX5muEyu2dgVRGE.jpg)


So, we went to the store or I think restaurant called Ribs & Bibs that their food menu were mainly about ribs that was their signature dish. So, we went to the restaurant together while looking for the best spot for the table and when we went inside, one of the crews went to our table and gave us the menu of their restaurant. 


![st6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/Eos1NbH7XLSmSC1gmt2k1NpcGRrcJ1fweDk6dgHyziVDcvC1pdUS9fjK9M4CQ1DiQaQ.jpg)

body.title: Investing during Troubled Times (or any other times)
body.body:
# Investing during trouble times

### Or any other times



I often like to think about investing not as a one-time decision, but as a habit that quietly runs in the background of an entire working life. Most of us don’t start with large amounts of money. Early in a career, investing might mean setting aside a few hundred dollars each month—almost as an afterthought while managing rent, bills, and daily expenses. But what happens if that small, consistent action continues for 30 years?

Also as I reflect on my person life, my investing style have been quite unconventional in the beginning. I started early, and early on through my midlife traded almost anything that was available to trade digitally. I started in currency, then stock, options, bonds, real estate, and then mostly settled in futures. As I gotten older, my needs and desires became simpler and smaller. After my kids are born I have traded less, and only occasionally. Mostly I manage my portfolio, and most of the times I do absolutely nothing!

![sp500_annual_returns_1996_2026_ultrawide_4k.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU7fHhX7oUSLm6UN2zmeRzHvF8DacBFBHqPgFev3HNZV7/sp500_annual_returns_1996_2026_ultrawide_4k.png)

#### *S&P500 yearly return for the last 30 years above.*

Let me discuss the most simple investing strategy for folks in the US. It would also be applicable elsewhere. It helps if you have a job or a stable income. 

I like to imagine a simple scenario: investing $500 every month into a low-cost S&P 500 index fund, starting in January 1996 and continuing steadily through December 2025. No market timing, no switching strategies, no reacting to headlines—just a fixed monthly contribution, every single month.

Over that period, the total amount invested adds up to $180,000. On its own, that number feels manageable. Spread across three decades, it is simply the result of consistency. But what might surprised you when I ran the numbers was not the contribution—it was the outcome. Here, mind you, for many $500 might seem big, and for others it might seem small, but the number invested doesn't matter, the only thing that matters in the consistency and length of time.

That $500/ month disciplined investment grows to roughly $1.15 million.

![Chart.js-preview (4).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX2MD5dMMkvydyeZaFzf9VuJUdv4RtLSWFYhWg8CVqGMr/Chart.js-preview%20(4).png)


There is something almost unintuitive about that result. At no point do you invest a large lump sum or take a bold risk. Instead, most months look completely unremarkable. You contribute, markets move up or down, and life goes on. Yet somewhere along the way, the portfolio starts to take on a life of its own.

In the early years, progress feels slow. The account grows mostly because you are adding money to it. Market returns are there, but they are not very visible. It can feel as though nothing is happening. Also you might see the 2000 bear market in the plot, and the portfolio goes negative. The same happened during 2007 - 2008 financial crisis. What do you do during that time? Nothing! Just follow the same plan.


Then, gradually, something changes. The portfolio begins to respond more to market movements than to your contributions. By the final decade, growth accelerates in a way that feels disproportionate to the effort you are putting in. The market, not the investor, is doing most of the work. Looking back, what makes this approach powerful is not precision—it is simplicity.

By investing a fixed amount every month, you naturally practice dollar-cost averaging without even thinking about it. When markets fall, your $500 buys more shares. When markets rise, it buys fewer. There is no need to predict downturns or wait for the “right time.” The discipline is built directly into the process.

Perhaps more importantly, this approach quietly protects you from your own instincts. Over a 30-year period, you inevitably live through periods of uncertainty—the dot-com crash in the early 2000s, the financial crisis in 2008, the sharp COVID shock in 2020, and the inflation-driven downturn in 2022. At the time, each of these moments feels significant, even alarming. But when viewed over decades, they become small interruptions in a much larger trend.

Think about today, knowing what you know about the Iran war and this moronic administration, your intuition (mine too) might tell you to sell all and go all cash and put your savings under the mattress? Did I do that? No! Obviously not. My 401-K follows this plan. My kids 529-plan (College savings accounts) follow this plan. I simply do nothing!

What stands out most to me is how little of the final result comes from the money you put in. Out of the $1.15 million portfolio, only $180,000 was actually contributed. The rest—nearly a million dollars—comes from staying invested long enough for compounding and reinvested returns to do their work.


This is the part that is easy to overlook. Compounding is often described as powerful, but it rarely feels that way in real time. For many years, it operates quietly, almost invisibly. Only later does it become obvious. When I look at this example, I don’t see a strategy that depends on intelligence or perfect timing. I see a process that depends on persistence. The outcome is not the result of knowing when to buy or sell—it is the result of continuing to invest when it feels unnecessary, when it feels uncertain, and when it feels like nothing is happening.

In the end, this kind of investing is not exciting. It doesn’t produce dramatic stories or quick wins. But it does something far more valuable: it turns time, discipline, and ordinary contributions into something meaningful.

And that, to me, is the real takeaway.

You don’t need to be right about the market.

You just need to stay in it long enough for it to work in your favor.

If you are employed for the long time or have an stable income for a long time, this is how you create generational wealth.

I am impressed.  You pretty much nailed it, only once veering off into fantasy (free energy) and stuck to the point, which is existentially important.  The most valuable wealth we can have is the high trust society we are part of.  Very few understand that an ancient dragon guarding a hoard of gold in a deep, dark cavern is impoverished, has no wealth at all, because they are cut off from everyone that gives value to gold.  It is society, dependent on their mutual love and affection for their ability to support one another, create, and share the blessings of civilization, that imbues everything valuable with value.

Billionaires in bunkers won't emerge to restart society and rule.  Either society will become competent to sustain civilization, in which case billionaires will be nothing more than irrelevant when they emerge, utterly extraneous to every industrial network, or it won't, in which case billionaires will die clutching their precious, for which they sacrificed everything actually valuable.  

The laws of physics mandate what tech can arise, and clever tinkers occasionally invent it.  Since the Stone age centralization and economies of scale have been the forefront of tech advance, increasing productivity by making bigger investments, but that is over.  You see on the battlefield that <$50k drones defeat >$B bombers, and last month <$100 manpads became available for little old ladies to print on their kitchen tables, like knitting doilies, and enable communities and even individuals to secure themselves from $50k drones and $B bombers alike.  This happens first on the battlefield, where tech advances due to it's existential value in war, but this is happening in every field of industry today, from comms to transport, from food to fuel, and means of production of the goods and services that create the blessings of civilization increasingly shrink capital outlays and labor cost.  Centralization is not civilization, but parasitizes it.  Decentralization of production decentralizes wealth and power, and it is ongoing RN.  This is why overlords are racking up unpayable debts in counterfeit fiat they are spending to acquire real goods they think will enable them to maintain their wealth and power during and after the ongoing collapse of the global monetary system that will render populations dependent on centralized production desperate, and enable them to starve us into submission - before we attain to sufficient wealth and power to ignore them until they go away.

It's too late.  Enough of us are seizing the means of production suitable to our personal circumstances and creating communities that merit their wealth by making it that the hapless herds that don't and die won't prevent the meritocracy from succeeding.  The laws of physics aren't legislated by corruptible chokepoints that can be bribed, blackmailed, or bullied, and as the economic crisis deepens the demonstration of resilience makers will provide will prompt everyone that can to join in and very rapidly the culture of dependence will disappear, leaving obligate parasites starved of hosts.  Independence is freedom, and independent means is the best definition of wealth, and our posterity will inherit that prosperity they will merit by making it themselves in perpetuity.

The harder the crash - and it will be a hard crash - the stronger the incentive to be productive will be.  Even if everything fails and humanity is reduced to scattered bands of hunter gatherers chipping rocks to survive briefly, that will not change the laws of physics, and the progression towards decentralization will simply begin again - as it has in the past.  Whether I'm right or wrong about this time being the last time, the laws of physics that today mandate decentralization out competes centralization will not change, and mankind will eventually make the transition.  Today reasonable folks have an opportunity to secure them and theirs from the threats of being starved into submission, slaughtered by drone armies, or GMO'd into a slave race, and mitigations and solutions to all the threats we face are available RN on every continent.  I am confident that narcissistic psychopaths have not learned they are fallible, that society is the actual wealth and power of most value, and are winning their way into their graves with exceeding competence in droves.  

The good people I have created good will in good faith with have my back, and I have theirs, and we will prosper and thrive or die trying.  Since that's the best we can do, I am content with that goal and purpose in life.  I hope everybody reading your post is also.

Thanks!

今天最后一份卖豆腐，终于把它给解决了。
早上起床照例烦恼怎么把这苦苦地米豆腐消灭掉，又不想直接丢掉。偶然间瞥见冰箱里的一瓶蜂蜜。灵机一动，既然太苦，那就用甜来压！

> Hello Everyone, today I am going to share with you a wonderful and strategic card from the Splinterlands game called ***Canary Keeper***. Sometimes there are cards in the game that seem very ordinary at first glance, but can play an extraordinary role in the right situation. Canary Keeper is just such a card, which, if used correctly in the team, can help bring the outcome of the match in your favor. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2avd4qUawFm3VHnwqJ8YpYvawzQ4cNMbBQRj7xuKtDE/image.png) It is basically a support type unit that places more importance on team balance and strategic support than direct powerful attacks. One of the biggest strengths of this card is that it can contribute well to the team with a low mana cost. Sometimes, the right card selection is the key to winning in matches with a small mana cap, and then such cards become much more effective. Its presence makes the team composition more flexible and helps create space for other important units. One of the good aspects of this card is its ease of use. Even new players can easily adapt it to their own strategy. Many experienced players also use it in situations where a quick and effective support unit is needed at a low cost. If properly protected, it can help the team stay on the field for a long time and bring stability to the match. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmchny17dPYdDWzQRdNCrHeuANb1d4QwAR8rY4jtdrfNRC/image.png) However, like every card, it has some limitations. Its attack power is not very high and its defense is also mediocre, so it cannot pose a major threat on its own. If the opponent's strong attack comes, it can be quickly defeated. Therefore, when using this card, it must be played in combination with a strong tank and a good support unit. It is more effective to use it to maintain team balance rather than using it as the main offensive unit. In terms of design, Canary Keeper is also quite unique and interesting. Its calm but cautious presence creates a strategic feel in the game that many players find enjoyable. All in all, it is a card that emphasizes intelligence and proper planning more than direct power.
