body.title: Television Review: Six Month Leave (Mad Men, S2x09, 2008)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/rUjzoMAloJjMsjoNQ74V8dZrovy.jpg)


**Six Month Leave (S2x09)**

Airdate: 28 September 2008

Written by: Matthew Weiner, Andre Jacquemott and Maria Jacquemott
Directed by: Michael Uppendahl 

Running Time: 48 minutes



The world of *Mad Men* differs from our own in many details, but one of the most conspicuous is in the different standards and social mores towards drinking, especially drinking on the job. To say that people in the early 1960s were more tolerant towards mixing work and booze would be an understatement; in practice, many offices were manned by what would, in the best-case scenario, be termed functioning alcoholics. What happens when one such alcoholic stops being functional serves as the major storyline in Season 2’s ninth episode, *Six Month Leave*. It is another “wham” episode in the series, although not in the way the audience might have expected, delivering its blows not through external catastrophe but through the quiet, humiliating unravelling of a man and the seismic ripples it sends through the fragile ecosystem of Sterling Cooper.

The episode begins in the Roosevelt Hotel in New York City, where Don Draper has been residing since being chased from his home by Betty. There, he picks up a newspaper and reads the headline about Marilyn Monroe’s suicide, anchoring the plot firmly in 7 August 1962 and the few days that follow. The news proves devastating for the female staff of Sterling Cooper, many of whom are visibly emotional. Even the usually unflappable Joan Holloway shows a rare vulnerability during a chance encounter with Roger Sterling. This historical anchor does more than just provide a date; it casts a pall of melancholy and lost innocence over the entire episode, framing the personal crises to come within a broader cultural moment of disillusionment.

The central crisis, however, is decidedly less glamorous. In his office, Freddy Rumsen has gathered Pete Campbell, Salvatore Romano, and Peggy Olson to discuss a presentation for their Samsonite clients. In that moment, years of excessive drinking take their final, humiliating toll: Freddy loses control of his bladder and, unaware he has wet his trousers, simply passes out. The reactions are telling: Salvatore is amused, Pete seems aghast, but Peggy is temporarily tasked with the presentation whilst Freddy’s condition is hidden. Peggy handles the pitch with her now-characteristic competence, but the news spreads, partly due to Pete, who sees a chance to advance at Freddy’s expense. In a meeting called by Roger, and despite Don’s initial opposition, it is decided that Freddy in such a condition is too great a liability. The episode’s title is thus revealed as a corporate euphemism: a “six months’ leave of absence” with full pay, which everyone present understands is merely a sweetened firing.

The subsequent evening out, where Freddy is told his fate by Don and Roger, is a brilliant example of period detail and masculine stoicism. Freddy accepts his superiors’ decision with a weary dignity, knowing he cannot argue. The trio then proceeds to an underground gambling club, where Freddy’s luck turns and he keeps winning at the table. It is here that Don, spotting the comedian Jimmy Barrett, punches him in the face, blaming him for the collapse of his marriage. The scene is a burst of raw violence in an otherwise tightly controlled episode, a reminder of Don’s simmering rage. Afterwards, Roger and Don discuss their lives, with Roger realising Don’s marriage is on the rocks—a situation he admits to having experienced himself. Don’s advice to “move forward” becomes the episode’s most consequential, and most carelessly delivered, piece of philosophy.

The next day, Don promotes Peggy, giving her all of Freddy’s accounts. In a fine moment of moral clarity, Peggy chastises Pete for engineering Freddy’s downfall, noting she liked the affable alcoholic and owed him her copywriting career. This subplot works well, showcasing Peggy’s ascent and her retention of a moral compass in an amoral environment.

However, the episode’s greatest shock arrives from the reception desk. Mona Sterling storms into the office and confronts Don over his “move forward” advice, which has apparently led Roger to end their twenty-five-year marriage for Don’s young secretary, Jane Siegel. Don, disgusted by the consequence of his own glib counsel, demands Roger move Jane out of her position. This revelation is the episode’s second “wham” moment, and it is here that the script, co-written by Matthew Weiner and André and Maria Jacquemetton, begins to show signs of strain.

Whilst the main storyline involving Freddy’s departure is handled with a superb mix of horror and black humour—his “mishap” is both cringe-inducing and darkly funny—the subplot dealing with Betty Draper feels like an uninspired filler. Depressed and adrift in her empty house, she is observed by her concerned housekeeper, Carla, but even in this state, she manipulatively orchestrates a lunch date between her friend Sarah Beth Carson and the man Sarah Beth secretly desires. It adds little to the episode’s thematic weight and seems a perfunctory check-in on a character whose own narrative is treading water.

The use of Marilyn Monroe as a narrative frame is, however, deftly handled. Her rendition of “Down with Love” over the closing credits provides a poignant, ironic commentary on the episode’s events. Furthermore, the continuity detail—where Peggy notes that Sterling Cooper must scrap their “Jackie vs. Marilyn” conceptual art for Playtex bras in light of Monroe’s death—is a clever, meta-textual nod to the series’ own earlier episode, *[Maidenform](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-maidenform-mad-men-s2x06-2008)*, and the fragile nature of the icons it sells.

The episode’s most significant problem lies in its final twist. The revelation that Roger has begun a full-blown affair with Jane and is willing to blow up his marriage for it comes almost completely out of left field. Whilst something was hinted at in the previous episode (*[The Gold Violin](https://poeakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-the-gold-violin-mad-men-s2x07-2008)*), the development feels dramatically unjustified. It lacks the meticulous build-up that *Mad Men* usually affords such seismic shifts in relationships. Instead, it plays as a “shock for the shock’s sake”, a contrivance designed to inject melodrama into an episode otherwise concerned with slow, pathetic decline. It undermines the more nuanced tragedy of Freddy’s exit by pairing it with a sudsy, impulsive betrayal that the series hasn’t earned at this juncture.

This episode represented the directorial debut of Michael Uppendahl, who would go on to direct seven more episodes of the series. His work here is assured, balancing the claustrophobic office scenes with the more expansive, shadowy atmosphere of the gambling club. He handles the delicate tone of Freddy’s storyline with particular skill, ensuring it never tips into outright farce or maudlin sentiment.

*Six Month Leave* is a powerfully acted and often brilliantly observed episode that stumbles in its final act. It excels in its unflinching portrayal of professional oblivion and the cruel euphemisms of corporate culture, using Freddy Rumsen’s downfall to expose the rot beneath the polished surface of Sterling Cooper. The anchoring of Monroe’s death provides a resonant backdrop. Yet, by grafting on a hastily conceived marital implosion for Roger Sterling, it seeks to deliver a second shock that feels unearned and disruptive to the episode’s otherwise finely calibrated study of failure. It remains a strong, memorable instalment, but one that ultimately lacks the narrative discipline of the series’ very best, falling prey to the very kind of impulsive, messy decision-making its characters would condemn.


RATING: 7/10 (+++)

body.title: Entrada para el Concurso de Sombras/SMASh —  Náufragos de la Sombra [Also in English]
body.body:
> El mediodía caía vertical, sin misericordia, aplastando hombros y pensamientos. Las calles parecían hervir; incluso el aire se deformaba sobre el asfalto, derritiéndolo sin que nadie se percatara. La gente caminaba rápido, escapaba. Muchos se cubrían con sombrillas; otros, con bolsos o mochilas. Varios se rascaban el coco bajo el castigo de los rayos. Todos buscaban salvarse en las pequeñas islas de sombra que obsequiaban algunas edificaciones. Frente a la calle, una panadería resistía con el letrero desteñido. El olor del pan recién hecho alcanzaba la acera en oleadas cálidas. Sin embargo, nadie entraba. Los transeúntes llegaban hasta allí únicamente para quedarse bajo la estrecha sombra que proyectaba el toldo del negocio. Era una isla mínima. Algunos se detenían a respirar; otros solo aprovechaban aquellos segundos en su paso apresurado. Como fuera, todos se disputaban ese pedazo de oscuridad como náufragos. Pero nadie entraba al local. Algunos no resistían voltear atraídos por el olor divino que invitaba a un bocadillo. Aun así, se quedaban abrazando la sombra mientras otros continuaban su camino. Nadie entraba. Una empleada invitaba a pasar. Nadie se movió. No había dinero. No había esperanza en un país sin ganas, atormentado por un océano de desidia y odio. Después de coquetear con la sombra, todos partían hacia su destino. Y allí quedaba ella, aferrada a la panadería en la que nadie quiso entrar.

`© 2021-2026 Germán Andrade G. Todos los derechos reservados.`

También hago constar que he utilizado la herramienta de revisión gramatical [Grammarly](https://app.grammarly.com/). `Desde mi cajón de ideas — 8 de mayo de 2026.` # English # Castaways of the Shadow Entry for the Shadow Contest/SMASh

> High noon fell vertically, mercilessly, crushing shoulders and thoughts. The streets seemed to boil; even the air warped over the asphalt, melting it without anyone noticing. People walked fast, escaping. Many covered themselves with umbrellas; others with bags or backpacks. Several scratched their heads under the punishment of the rays. Everyone sought salvation in the small islands of shadow gifted by a few buildings. Facing the street, a bakery resisted with a faded sign. The smell of freshly baked bread reached the sidewalk in warm waves. However, no one entered. The passersby arrived there only to stay under the narrow shadow projected by the shop's awning. It was a minimal island. Some stopped to breathe; others just took advantage of those seconds in their hurried pace. Whatever the case, everyone fought over that piece of darkness like castaways. But no one entered the premises. Some couldn't resist turning around, lured by the divine scent that invited a snack. Even so, they stayed embracing the shadow while others continued on their way. No one entered. An employee invited them in. No one moved. There was no money. There was no hope in a listless country, tormented by an ocean of apathy and hatred. After flirting with the shadow, everyone left for their destination. And there she remained, clinging to the bakery that no one wanted to enter.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 8 2026
body.body:
Hello **Actifit Community**!!! Guys i made a new friend 😻!! This time i got prepared with light clothes because the plan was to go for my regular walking. First i passed by my old house for leaving a warm jacket which i won't use until next winter. I didn't stayed a lot there, i just put it in my wardrobe and i left. Back in my old days i used to walk everywhere with less people and traffic (of not having to wait for the cars to pass by and avoiding of course the noise from them). I wasn't even gone too far and that kid was sitting in a corner. I said psit psit just to gets it's attention and within a few seconds the kid came to me. I didn't notice if it's a boy or a girl but usually those cats with that pattern of colours are too friendly and clingy. I didn't want to leave it but i noticed that the temperature of my body was getting lower so i kept walking as walk as i could. Well, i didn't do that for too long because my leg was hurting me but i managed to walk to the stadium and it is almost twenty minutes from my house and thirty minutes from my grandmother's house. In total i walked for one hour and forty minutes. I really enjoyed it and i hope to do that again soon because i really missed it. *Here's the little fur kid that i was writing about.* ![1000027377.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/georgia11/EonmQgMCu3wAupmjmwae61wcSLRgDeA5PWPpZX4jJh53g5fofiH7NhyC5WjGx9cAbjH.jpg) ![1000027376.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/georgia11/Eo8UjfWE54aQpkFfabbxRN8uofd5dbv5fbtWL1YqrR4J6QLgSWAY6p9iAiZMQEKDreD.jpg) ![1000027375.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/georgia11/23y8vF1uTC8YxGKnvAVbw82vtR9hFaJZfsGDpXsJNZVK4ADvrEhLZmvyaZGfSfLjiDMgW.jpg) ![1000027381.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/georgia11/23w2nsb5u5Q2xNbYAEF3vKmy5r4XTgDScNZVP3VUNQfdMLnTYV9TjVtfLUk4jn8And8km.jpg) ![1000027380.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/georgia11/23xAcMBMD4mJcEBsA4BSUHpSq3QTgRscddUGEdTXon1w68jGCndveDqAmC5w6akAVkV57.jpg) ![1000027378.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/georgia11/Eoc8uSUYHt9muEhru7FaVdKKHUXBTjjXJ1kQF6c3SNFDK827Rf2hrSDcrQCoRno1NUb.jpg) ![1000027382.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/georgia11/23vsV4Cj6yDBbMozPxrf9FpT4xHeyEcJjMyLTgjvmAAj3Ld4A6fk8H7164hp3Yt2mAYmB.jpg) *Photos by @georgia11*

description.title: Grades That Strengthen or Weaken
description.body:
Greetings, everyone!

The system of grading or scoring students at school has helped the students to know their weaknesses and their strengths to buckle down and improve in their academic performance. 


![file_00000000e2dc71f4b523e2000eb0d79c.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/243Bby96uVTufExwFdXgKtCr34XVFKTZUNFuF3xe8QxNfE4LjYXApsZNvy1uYNqYyyuWx.png)


We all know that A is for excellent, B for very good, C for average, D for lower average, E for poor, and F for failure, and these letters come with their numerical equivalents that tell a lot to the student's mind seeing it pasted on the board.

Grades have been a school system or foundation for ages till now. Being a student in secondary school and writing an examination, and at the end of the day, the results are published, and every student would rally around to see their performance or receive a report card at the end of the term. 

In my secondary school, I understood something about grades. I remembered in my SSS 1, all of us were in the general class receiving lectures. 

In SSS 2, classes would be divided into art classes and science classes. For a student to know where to go was a result of seeing their grades. Some were scoring so high on chemistry, biology, and physics,  and some were scoring high in mathematics, economics, and marketing. This helped us during our time to know if we should go into the science class or the art class. And the teachers were very good at teaching, and their gradings were not manipulative, they gave it to you according to how you understood and put it down.

However, SSS 2 and SSS 3 were like a preparatory level, depending on our scores, to know our strengths in particular subjects and what to study in the university. 

Some students realized that they were good at science subjects, and some ventured into medicine and surgery, engineering, and lots related to science. Some who were good at art ventured into education, law, business administration, and many related fields. This was a good foundation laid for us through seeing our grades with numerical equivalents.

Moreover, in the university, there is what we call GPA, which means Grade Point Average, which is the performance for one semester or session, and CGPA, which means Cumulative Grade Point Average, which is the combined performance of all the semesters and sessions. This tells more of our effort and strength. If you weren't in studios, it will show in your GPA, which will go lower, and if you were in studios, yours will go higher.

There was a time in my second semester when I blatantly refused to read a particular course and during exams, I didn't write anything, when the results came out it was F9, I cried and I told myself this will be the last time, I'm experiencing this bloody grade because it lowers my GPA and I wasn't really happy about it.

Therefore, grades help to identify and highlight the strengths of students. This has been the culture of the educational system in Nigeria. 

I remember those times when we heard our results were out,  our hearts would be panting like a deer panting after the water. So it was a beautiful moment going through the lecturing, relationships, grading, and other aspects of school. 


_**This is my response to the Hivelearners featured contest week 216 episode 3**_

_**I love, I care, and I forgive**_

# Sustainable Chic: The Rise of Eco-Friendly Fashion in 2024

As we step into 2024, the fashion industry is undergoing a remarkable transformation. The rise of **sustainable fashion** is not just a trend; it's a movement that is reshaping the way we think about clothing, consumption, and our planet. This year, eco-friendly fashion is taking center stage, blending style with sustainability in ways that are both innovative and chic.

## The Shift Towards Sustainability

In recent years, consumers have become increasingly aware of the environmental impact of fast fashion. With the alarming statistics on waste and pollution, many are now seeking alternatives that align with their values. This shift has prompted designers and brands to rethink their practices, focusing on ethical sourcing, sustainable materials, and transparent supply chains.

## Key Trends in Eco-Friendly Fashion for 2024

### 1. **Upcycled and Recycled Materials**
Designers are getting creative with upcycled fabrics and recycled materials. From denim made from post-consumer waste to dresses crafted from reclaimed textiles, the possibilities are endless. This not only reduces waste but also adds a unique touch to each piece.

### 2. **Biodegradable Fabrics**
Innovations in fabric technology have led to the creation of biodegradable materials that break down naturally, minimizing their environmental footprint. Look out for clothing made from organic cotton, Tencel, and even mushroom leather!

### 3. **Timeless Designs**
In a world where trends come and go, timeless pieces are making a comeback. Sustainable fashion focuses on quality over quantity, encouraging consumers to invest in versatile, long-lasting garments that can be styled in multiple ways.

### 4. **Local Production**
Supporting local artisans and manufacturers is a growing trend. By reducing the carbon footprint associated with shipping, locally produced fashion is not only eco-friendly but also supports communities and economies.

### 5. **Transparency and Ethical Practices**
Consumers are demanding more from brands. In 2024, transparency in sourcing, manufacturing processes, and labor practices is crucial. Brands that prioritize ethical practices are gaining trust and loyalty from conscious consumers.

## The Role of Technology

Technology is playing a significant role in the evolution of sustainable fashion. From AI-driven design processes that optimize fabric usage to blockchain technology that ensures transparency in supply chains, innovation is paving the way for a greener future.

## Conclusion

As we embrace 2024, the rise of sustainable chic is a testament to the power of conscious consumerism. Eco-friendly fashion is not just about looking good; it’s about making a positive impact on the world. By choosing sustainable options, we can all be a part of this exciting movement. So, let's celebrate style that cares for the planet—because fashion can be fabulous and sustainable at the same time!

description.title: Warum der Himmel blau ist
description.body:
# Warum der Himmel blau ist

![Warum der Himmel blau ist](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518700288831-cef3ba9822f6?crop=entropy&cs=tinysrgb&fit=max&fm=jpg&ixid=M3w4NDgzODF8MHwxfHJhbmRvbXx8fHx8fHx8fDE3NzgyNTYwMDV8&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&q=80&w=1080)

---

Diese scheinbar simple Frage hat eine elegante physikalische Antwort, die auf der Wechselwirkung von Licht mit der Erdatmosphäre beruht. Das Phänomen des blauen Himmels illustriert fundamentale Prinzipien der Optik.

## Licht als elektromagnetische Welle

Sonnenlicht erscheint weiß, ist aber eine Mischung aller Farben des sichtbaren Spektrums. Jede Farbe entspricht einer bestimmten Wellenlänge: Rot hat die längste Wellenlänge (etwa 700 Nanometer), Violett die kürzeste (etwa 380 Nanometer). Blaues Licht liegt mit etwa 470 Nanometern im kürzerwelligen Bereich.

Wenn Sonnenlicht die Erdatmosphäre durchquert, trifft es auf Moleküle von Stickstoff und Sauerstoff sowie auf Staubpartikel und Wassertröpfchen. Diese Partikel sind deutlich kleiner als die Wellenlänge des Lichts.

## Rayleigh-Streuung

Der britische Physiker Lord Rayleigh beschrieb im 19. Jahrhundert, wie Licht an kleinen Partikeln gestreut wird. Die Intensität der Streuung ist umgekehrt proportional zur vierten Potenz der Wellenlänge. Vereinfacht bedeutet das: Kurzwelliges blaues Licht wird etwa 16-mal stärker gestreut als langwelliges rotes Licht.

Wenn Sonnenlicht durch die Atmosphäre wandert, wird das blaue Licht in alle Richtungen gestreut. Von überall am Himmel erreicht uns daher bevorzugt blaues Licht - der Himmel erscheint blau. Das rote Licht passiert die Atmosphäre weitgehend ungestört und kommt größtenteils direkt von der Sonne.

## Sonnenauf- und -untergänge

Bei Sonnenaufgang und -untergang muss das Sonnenlicht einen viel längeren Weg durch die Atmosphäre zurücklegen. Auf diesem Weg wird das blaue Licht so stark gestreut, dass es den Beobachter nicht mehr erreicht. Übrig bleiben die längerwelligen Farben - Orange und Rot dominieren. Je mehr Staub und Partikel in der Luft sind, desto intensiver werden die Rot- und Orangetöne.

Dieser Effekt erklärt auch, warum die Sonne bei Sonnenuntergang oft größer wirkt, obwohl sie es nicht ist - eine optische Täuschung verstärkt durch die atmosphärischen Bedingungen.

## Warum nicht violett?

Eine berechtigte Frage: Wenn kurzwelliges Licht stärker gestreut wird, müsste der Himmel violett erscheinen, nicht blau. Die Erklärung liegt in der Kombination zweier Faktoren: Erstens enthält Sonnenlicht mehr blaues als violettes Licht. Zweitens sind unsere Augen für Blau empfindlicher als für Violett. Die drei Zapfentypen in unserer Netzhaut reagieren optimal auf Rot, Grün und Blau - violettes Licht wird schwächer wahrgenommen.

## Auf anderen Planeten

Die Farbe des Himmels hängt von der Zusammensetzung der Atmosphäre ab. Auf dem Mars erscheint der Himmel rötlich-braun, weil feinster Staub in der dünnen Atmosphäre größere Partikel bildet, die rotes Licht stärker streuen. Bei Sonnenuntergang wird der Mars-Himmel hingegen bläulich - ein umgekehrter Effekt zur Erde.

Auf Planeten ohne Atmosphäre, wie dem Mond, ist der Himmel schwarz. Ohne Luftmoleküle gibt es keine Streuung, und man sieht nur die direkte Strahlung der Sonne und die Sterne.

**Die blaue Farbe des Himmels ist mehr als ein ästhetisches Phänomen - sie zeigt uns die physikalischen Gesetze, nach denen Licht und Materie interagieren.**

description.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![Drcv5zwLTucMcs0M_1000027213.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/Drcv5zwLTucMcs0M_1000027213/Drcv5zwLTucMcs0M_1000027213.webp)

![OFhgDaiuy9HYrKqj_1000027215.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/OFhgDaiuy9HYrKqj_1000027215/OFhgDaiuy9HYrKqj_1000027215.webp)
![ZUvHU9t7Mm0rPOJy_1000027212.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/ZUvHU9t7Mm0rPOJy_1000027212/ZUvHU9t7Mm0rPOJy_1000027212.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

据传，我们最常接触到的AI，豆包，加强版要开始收费了。
对此，无数网友在那调侃：这一次，收费后的豆包会给我更准确，最一针见血，最不绕弯子的答案嘛？
当然，也有无数人开始松了一口气。
收费好啊，收费得收啊！
记得以前每次一些免费的东西开始收费以后，我们都会去吐槽一番。
觉得这已经是互联网公司的惯用套路。
可这次，面对豆包的收费，我们感觉到的却更多是庆幸。
没办法，AI太强了，大量白领失业，只能去挤压蓝领的赛道，大家都不好过。
而AI一旦收费，意味着老板和企业们会重新开始考虑成本的问题。
甚至有无数相关从业者会在那说为什么价格不在涨贵一点，这样就不用担心被裁员了。
是啊，短短几年间，可以说整个世界都被AI深刻影响了一遍。
现在收费，其实也是一种好事。
想象这样一个场景，当大公司一直在砸钱提供免费的AI产品，然后一些企业就开始裁员。
慢慢的，随着AI的训练数据越来越多，准确率什么的越来越好，被裁员的人就更多了。
甚至从百分之八十的人慢慢裁到了百分之90，乃至百分之99的人。
每个领域都只剩下最后的那几十个大佬在撑门面。
而外行的人在看到现状后，就对这些领域完全失去了兴趣，毕竟，学了也没啥用，比自己厉害的人都被裁了，那自己还学了干嘛。
于是，就这么过几年，说不定大学里都不教啥了，没人学，或者不认真学，然后软件公司说不定也不更新维护那些软件了，什么ps，pr，ae啥的。
然后，做AI的公司忽然把模型收费涨到天去了。
比请员工的价格还要高几倍，一次性把前面的损失全弄回来。
如果不接受，那公司基本就只能破产了，因为过去了几年，市面上相关领域的人已经减少，而且几年不碰一个领域，哪怕是原本的从业者，其实也忘的差不多了。
这是不是很符合阴谋论？
哈哈，当然啦，现实肯定不可能的，至少在我们这里不可能，为了就业率，高层肯定会出手的。
而且没有哪家公司有这种实力，这还涉及到垄断了，肯定会有“有形的大手”去垄断了。
但你别说，一些小国家还真说不一定……
好了，越聊越远了，我发觉我还是有点写阴谋论的天赋的。
哈哈哈，你说呢？

description.title: Disclosure Day
description.body:
<center> https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMzZocnUwbHI1djd5Z280YXlsMzcyMnMyOHFvaGptcGdsaTZud3pmNSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/xT9IgEx8SbQ0teblUQ/giphy.gif </center>

The suspense has been building steadily on social media and the podcast circuits since the UAP briefings began in the US Congress last September. Ever since then enthusiasts and members of the UFO community have been speculating about whether or not the truth would ever come out. 




President Trump made a statement this past February that disclosure would likely be happening this year. Early this morning the [official Whitehouse account on X dropped this link to the first batch of files](https://www.war.gov/UFO/).

<center> 
![UFO.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23tRrJC5MTwEfdz8yoxtcBEZ6mkxM9yTJHKNzFh5JMBqbHEWJ87LSYWZPZuL4ZQeMNAHN.jpeg)
</center>

I haven’t had time to peruse all of the information yet. I hope to be able to spend more time with it this weekend but I’ve asked AI to summarize the highlights here:

---

*Transcribed by Grok-AI*

This is the launch of the U.S. Department of War's PURSUE portal (Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters) for public release of government UAP/UFO-related records, following a directive from President Donald Trump.

**Most important aspects of the May 8th disclosures:**

- First tranche released: 161 files (mostly FBI documents from an old case file series). These are unresolved cases — the government states it cannot definitively identify the phenomena due to insufficient data.
 war.gov
- No evidence or conclusions confirming alien/extraterrestrial life, recovered technology, or extraordinary explanations. The materials are presented without official analysis, inviting public/private review.
 politico.com
- Rolling releases planned: Additional tranches of declassified records will be posted every few weeks as more documents (tens of millions across agencies) are reviewed.
 war.gov
- Context: Part of a broader Trump Administration push for \

on UAP/UFOs and related topics. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth emphasized ending secrecy that fueled speculation.
 war.gov
- The site hosts the files (PDFs, images, etc.) for direct public access, with links to AARO for other historical records. In short, this is a major transparency initiative releasing raw, inconclusive historical documents rather than groundbreaking revelations. More is expected soon.

---

The UFO/Extraterrestrial phenomena has piqued my interest since I was a boy. I grew up in close proximity to Wright Patterson Airforce Base where we lived in central Ohio and we experienced several strange things, first hand. Persistent rumors had been swirling about Wright Patterson being a repository for crashed craft and off-world biologics since the Rosewell crash in the 1940s. The entire central Ohio area was an epicenter for sightings and phenomena, particularly in the 1970s through the 1990s. 

Honestly, I didn’t have high hopes for this release of information. Although this first batch of files seem to be disappointingly vague I’m hoping that more substantial information will be revealed in future releases. At least this is a start. 

Are they beings from other planets? From another dimension? A splinter civilization from Earth that somehow survived the last ice age with their technology intact? Are these things we're seeing in the sky our own advanced technology that has been hidden from the public for decades? 

There are so many questions and, so far, so few answers. So many of us want to believe that we must be careful about accepting anything we're being told at face value. 

I do believe the truth is out there and too many people want to know for it to be kept secret forever. I have a feelingif and when it is released it will change our concept of the universe and our place in it forever. 

## What are your thoughts/beliefs about the UAP/extraterrestrial phenomena? ##



All for now. Thanks so much for reading. 


---

title.title: STREETS IN THE WEST OF TOWN... (PHOTOGRAPHY STORIES)
title.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AK3dz2mLa6jCGXxEK6sUeVWde2Q8HCjXs343L4jA3tdHLpbqCc8hcgtVpFPrDEz.jpg)

----

**T**he streets west of Montalbán perhaps best tell the story of how this town has changed from the last quarter of the 20th century to the present day. Fifty years ago, when I was a little boy venturing far from home to play in the pastures and eat wild fruits, like the mangoes that grew along the paths, these areas where these streets now stand were just a handful of houses scattered far apart. And the few paths that could be called \

were dirt roads, the rest being simple narrow trails where people traveled on foot, by bicycle, or even on the backs of donkeys and horses.

**T**hen, with the exponential growth of orange and tobacco cultivation, the town's urban area and its population grew rapidly. I'm talking about the mid-80s to the late 90s... Back then, the once-pastureland plots with houses scattered far apart gradually gave way to the construction of streets in an almost haphazard fashion, as did the houses themselves. Some streets (as you can see in some of these photos) literally climbed up the base of the hills that define the valley where the town is located...

>**L**as calles al Oeste de Montalbán, son quizás las que mejor cuentan una historia de como este pueblo fue cambiando desde el ultimo cuarto del siglo XX hasta nuestros días... Cincuenta años atrás, cuando yo era un chiquillo que se aventuraba a alejarse de casa en busca de jugar en los pastizales y comer algunas frotas silvestres, como los mangos que crecían a lo largo de los senderos; estos espacios en donde hoy están estas calles, eran apenas un puñado de casas alejadas unas de otras. Y los pocos caminos que se podían llamar \

eran de tierra, siendo el resto simples veredas angostas por donde pasaban las personas a pie, en bicicletas o incluso a lomos de burros y caballos... \n\n>**L**uego, con la llegada del crecimiento exponencial de los cultivos de naranja y tabaco, el casco urbano del pueblo y su población, crecieron rápidamente. Estoy hablando de mediados de los años 80 y hasta finales de los 90... Entonces las otrora parcelas de pastizales con casas alejadas unas de la otra,  fueron cediendo sus espacios a la construcción de calles de manera casi anárquica, al igual que las casas que se construyeron. Incluso algunas calles (pueden verlo en algunas de estas fotos) literalmente \

por la base de las colinas que delimitan el valle en donde esta el pueblo en sí... ![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23zbUGnXMUsmMj2EnVFquhNcwcmPc4QsTMwcHs36ifVhtZN6MR8hWz9bKNG2UPgyv8Nro.jpg) ![T02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23w2usST8QLcLAppRHkVVZQHLLuDg9jxUHPj3Rr4i4CsbNZBhK9hDUkau7B8k3HbGo94B.jpg) ![T03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/242het9W858jA58gy2KAmURouFKWcJBtSFbXabk7pEBGi2EC31JQ4amar7GzHLpCYUynB.jpg) ![T04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23y8zBUFvMyqdjA88W8MbRvqhZsMDCaTJf4YFSkoYsZQSwNQVU5nsbJG5RY79ZZ52sTLH.jpg) ![T05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xybX6gQTwKzujobPwBcaTQLZhySfdv42Bpvef9FTfTz6tBiqWe5jFGsa49ZYqz8GkBj.jpg) ![T06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wqpwiqGh3L2DHYcb9BGpB1rs1AMta9AtZ4PJ2G9VdAPeHZST6DMwfb2pVfd1UNdrdxP.jpg) **A**nd all of this I'm telling you continued to happen more or less at the same pace, until the arrival of the new century, when a downward spiral began in which we still seem to be immersed. Then, after some years, these streets to the west of town began to look like the ones in my photos today... A mixture of new and old town, of abandonment and resilience, of silences and movements, with the ghosts of better times seeming to wander aimlessly through the fog-shrouded streets... The exodus of people due to the scarcity of jobs, the evident neglect by the government, and perhaps, in some way, fate itself, conspired to transform these streets into spaces that bear witness to that spasm of growth abruptly cut short... But, at the same time, they also became good streets for taking photographs, for they tell a story of their own... >**Y** todo esto que os cuento, continuó ocurriendo así más o menos al mismo ritmo, hasta que con la llegada del nuevo siglo comenzó una espiral de declive en la cual parecemos estar aún sumergidos. Entonces, después de algunos años, estas calles al Oeste del pueblo comenzaron a verse así como en mis fotos de hoy... Una mezcla de pueblo nuevo y viejo, de abandono y de resistencia, de silencios y movimientos, con los fantasmas de los tiempos buenos pareciendo caminar desmemoriados por las calles visitadas por la niebla... El éxodo de la gente por la escasez de puestos de trabajo, el evidente olvido por parte del gobierno y quizás, de alguna manera, el mismo destino; conspiraron para que estas calles se volviesen espacios que atestiguan aquel espasmo de crecimiento cortado de abruptamente... Pero, al mismo tiempo, se convirtieron también en calles buenas para hacer fotografías, pues ellas cuentan una historia por si mismas... ![T07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wgKLL1YhKpfuNFXS6tqUL76G9y8s3ongT5X7zHCtWZvLUPqyZwnGGngVasmN3fZmqv1.jpg) ![T08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wqrZFAuPSaXHqNq6zt5x6j3YqAj3Fpgex1dmX8GFCYEvxoMqKHfuKjDyJ4htz66eUov.jpg) ![T09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23y8zFkupa9vNWQ27faMvBxKb2um6DihJXZuCVyqAL2H8cryFykWK7X4EV7jCfdJ5WXyL.jpg) ![T10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23zGiwh9pDX6CwfBbszSQyhLP9okkaYBx19RaQa5KQNwRWAdNdkRsHKRkzGCW5ueh3Hgk.jpg) ![T11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xydfvfUJ7vFQoa3sDJgzDpeQXdnrboTD1eXQwY1wg8C9uUwXS3unVHjcuAMLg1Pcy2t.jpg) ![T12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23ydCKQyX5cTEgB8LC2EopLcBcnCf4ymFWofePBXu9GvGgQXwVLuRAmorNhFt7Pnmxgk4.jpg) ---- ##
***Thank you very much for your visit and appreciation!***
> ######
*¡Muchas gracias por pasar y apreciar!*
--- **ADDITIONAL TECHNICAL NOTE**: Photographs captured with my Nikon D7000 DSLR camera in RAW format, then processed in Adobe Camera RAW for adjustments regarding light, sharpening, contrast and depth... They were then exported to JGP format on which minor modifications such as straightening and adding watermarks were carried out using PhotoScape v3.7 >**NOTA TÉCNICA ADICIONAL**: Fotografias capturadas con mi cámara DSLR Nikon D7000 en formato RAW, procesadas posteriormente en Adobe Camera RAW para ajustes relativos a luz, afilado, contraste y profundidad... Luego fueron exportadas a formato JGP sobre el cual se llevaron a cabo modificaciones menores como enderezado y agregado de marcas de agua usando PhotoScape v3.7 ---
#PHOTOGRAPHY # ***END / FIN*** @jlinaresp ---

title.title: Never too old for a cuddle buddy  #SoftToyStory
title.body:
I believe, soft toys are a best selling product in any of the world market. I can confidently say this about the Indian market. Wherever you go, you will find many soft toys selling like a hot cake in the roadside. I saw a big one in Amritsar during my last visit. There were all kinds of toys that were displayed on the footpath and interestingly there were many buyers for it. People of all age group visit them to choose one of their liking. I am not a toy lover, but these monkeys hanging around a shop pulled my attention.


![1000279187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EonjZnr5a7BRwgxbQ9VEvMU5zpZEKFDmDFp2AQKrhGuh1WBEdBPVoVC4B3a35hNPzGB.jpg)

Amritsar is one of the happening place, I ever visited. Although I spent a major portion of life in Delhi but ever since I visited the Amristsar, I find it more lively. The street outside the Golden Temple is most happening and lively place to be. The place is well maintained roads and people like to spend time enjoying the spiritual atmosphere and also try out all the stuffs available over there. The street has shops, food stalls, clothing store but the toy shops always remain into limelight. You will find them at the extreme end of the street spread all over the place 


![1000210830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EowF6pabTvNsh7GT7vDe7qYsgCyqjc8q9ydcYMcCFooqTMSJNLnMXTcDg4fqV7gdNsU.jpg)

![1000279188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EoK5uNdRoTrFd6iqirzkFri4t2kpQcJRxJV9BCgDBwsxdY66YEt9hp7m5bh2o3SvLo5.jpg)

The colorful setup is what made me to visit the store. They are open shops so anyone could take a visit without bothering about anything. These shops does require some bargaining tricks to get a better deal. These toys, provide emotional comfort, hold enduring appeal for all ages, and are highly versatile for gifting. I remember in my youth days, my friends used to soft them to their crush. Teddy being the lone item that were in high demand. But now, as I can see there are all kind of toys of different figurine available over the street.


![1000279186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EoCiZc63h2Rm5oUdjb65qR5f1FAViPnfLLRMNDePzyys5qBweEyUb4fjJrPRnFWrjHv.jpg)



![1000210796.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EpLg1YpabB8wcfG6AFUwS1daMpE8gdJtpM5gNuzuFwqtFz612oEDsUbcBJH4DAjMR5F.jpg)



![1000210795.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xyTC7kr3pznzoGbTBdmStHAcj5gBbhyp3695En7bh75dMqf6cKnnjtrB5CW1QC57nrg.jpg)


Beyond play and gifting, they are widely used as decorative items in living rooms and bedrooms. Many young adults, use stuffed animals for better sleep and as supportive companions during difficult times. This remain a favorite for the teenage girls. However seeing the different variety, I recalled my youth days. It is worth watching all the new items that add beauty to the place.



**In good faith - Peace!!**



![1000037470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8M1obna2cYnnMAc2ZC3wWMW9ZqZHvk9StEga6aY2cTsKmweW7zFBDm7D13YHVoC5N.png)

title.title: The Myth of \
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNTCLup4baca8o5z1z6CUXXUWpL1oxM93MdLirATfXrYS/1778255329460.jpg)

Hi *Hive Student*,
It's **Abeegail**, welcome to my blog. Do you know how hard it is to deal with the fact that your identity and everything you've been is crumbling right beneath your feet. You are at lost, wondering way you got it wrong.

Well  we have almost concluded our first semester exam, and the harsh truth I was running from took me right before my eyes and left me broken for days. I was the smart kid in my secondary school (high school), the straight A student. I understood things quickly, my results made sense, teachers noticed, people used that word around me so often that it started to feel like an Identity. I was smart.

It wasn’t just a compliment anymore, it became an Identity, something you have to say when describing me, and I'm not tooting my own horn because everyone knew. So when I got into university, I didn’t think much would change. Maybe things would get harder, sure, but I still assumed I would figure it out. That’s what “smart people” do, right? They adapt. But it was far from it.

Because uni is a different system. It doesn’t care what you were known for  being smart before you got there. It doesn’t adjust itself to your strengths. It just overwhelms you and Suddenly, the things that used to come easily don’t feel easy anymore. You read something once and don’t fully get it. You attend a lecture and leave more confused than when you walked in. You study and still feel unsure. You read and read and still feel like you are empty. And that’s a very unfamiliar feeling when your whole life, you’ve been “the smart one.” 

Nothing, I mean nothing prepares you for this shift. No one tells you that intelligence in high school and survival in university are not the same thing. That what worked before, like last-minute studying, relying on natural understanding might quietly stop working. And when it does, it’s not just your grades that take a hit. It’s your confidence. Because it's now personal, it no longer “this course is hard.\
maybe I’m not as smart as I thought.”\n\nI remember reading so hard for a test, just to get fifteen out of thirty, now for a average student this is good but for me, \

, I felt irritated because I'm smart I'm supposed to do well above average. This meant I was not special, like I'm like every other student, like I lost my identity, my sense of self.

Even if I have left lecture halls more confused than when I came in, I've come to understand that in that confusion is where one look for clarity and in clarity do we find answers and that the smart student is not always the one who can understand fast and give answers fast but it's even those that are able to admit that they not smart and is willing to learn. The wise man was once a fool but the only difference is that he's not afraid to admit he doesn't know and is ready to learn.

It's Still Abeegail 
\

*Thank you for Reading 
The images are mine*

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I will be opening 35 rare draws from batch 1 of this season. I will not be using alchemy potions, so my chances of getting gold cards will only be 0.5%.

Unfortunately, I didn't get any gold rare card this time. Well, that was to be expected with such a low probability.

My avian, Torrent Sniper only needs eleven more copies to reach the max level, where it will gain the weaken ability, so while it is alive, it will reduce the health of enemy units by 1.

---

Currently, all my rare conclave arcana reward cards are at level 7, except for my elemental, Swampwrought, which is at level 6. I will play many more ranked battles so I can buy more rare draws and this way, find the ones I need to level up my cards. I hope I can get gold cards the next time, and I wish you the same; have fun playing.

Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook.

title.title: Your Life Has to Fall, If You Dedicate In Work Harder
title.body:
![Hello PeakD (7).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anargyaandin/23viR9pvp5vBPDhPXhiZKgybZDuVkLcVXDV8cH4y4nxmnbTLe7RWPfmgvyk5wNF4cdwgN.png)


My national anthem of personal development's content creator spreads on many SNS like Instagram or TikTok, has several topics about productivity and growth, which states that there are differences between working smarter than working harder. Those of the differential are beneath how the progression is more accurately. The working harder type is more precise in how they deliver in such rows; however, the smarter one is more cultured in the meaning of working for the real results (for money and for projection). Both of the two worker types have factors in their successful life.  

I was a worker who would be glad to hikes me as a fighter, given how independent I am, work without any of the leaders, and also have my own direction. The current minus point with my workload problem is only how to work smarter, not harder. I am not typical of working with the decent development of IT tools that until now have brought me to reorganize my last methods of working, and I think that my bravery is so sucks into these recent workload trends, like using more tools to relocate high effort in the task and do some trial and error of using the tool.  

That problem I was cited in me not only then about the tools. As a worker, I was deeply in the gap years if my creativity was not bringing me more clients. It's kind of an alert for many freelancers like me, that your desk is not just about creating new projects like writing articles, but somehow it's intertwined with the meaning of multitasking. You are forced and induced to have not just your centre task but also the branches and the links of its. As a near example of a multitasking workload, for many freelancers, building a connection with your client, and of course, for many freelancers except you, is a great opportunity to shape your future.

That'll qualify, I've been told, is such a sense of people having their life, that sometimes it doesn't need to be hard to feel and think about its achievement; however, it's not the same with mine. When I have to look after my tomorrow duties or maybe my recent future dream, it costs a lot of time to think and feel hard. Then, I know my progression is somehow too lacks of achievements that I never wanted to be compare into manyelse people who are having the same pathway. It feels sucks to know how they compete more than my desk. 

Anyway, that's the story from my POV, then I have to guess how another person might have the same story as me. I have to be honest that I never walk into the city or some of the offices that are located near my area, with my other blog that tells about my family, who neglected my willingness to work on-site, then my projection about how another person who works harder in the office environment is not enough to be discussed. 

However, I know the differences between a freelancer and an employee; again, I have to recognize it while many officers have played a content roles game in SNS, or Instagram. My only reaction when I saw those reels was how amazing their personality was; each of them has a strong character that may have been built by their environment, and it is something that I have never experienced in my life. So, if there were poor people who could not have experienced school, maybe it would be better than having bad luck for the future, and it is seen by how your abilities work. Are you the smarter one or the harder one? 

## What is Actually Different Between the Two Types of Its? 

When someone is working, there is a type with working for keep entire life going well, like paying all of the expenses; the electricity, water, WiFi, and home bills. However, there is also a type of worker that don't think it's a bother that their life expenses are paid by someone. That statement is truly boring today, which could pull someone into not being steady in working to meet all requirement done. But, sighs, it really impacts a lot in my entire day to fulfil my requirements. 

So, I guess that every person who works smarter somehow has a difficult past in their life, like their family can not pay for the WiFi, or so on. However, the process of it person could find the shortcut to fulfill their monthly expenses is different then by the people who live without any hindrances. 

So, if you were a parents who have your baby and still does not know how your future holds, I think that bringing your child into your life consideration, like telling them how the financial outlook is and asking them for tolerance, is much better than just being quiet about your family situation. Somehow, I have a dream to build a family where every part of it is really meaningful, and I like to have a deep and honest conversation about any of them who need any help. Because if you were trapped in the condition of silent treatment, I think it would be hard for you to live a life that is supposed to be. You will never find another who really trusts you or believes in you in the importance.      

Come back again with the topic, so for me, the difference between people who work smarter and harder is found in their culture. Do they need just a glorified and professional look, or do they come from a difficult past? But, talking about how many people get their professional status, it comes in diverse kinds of factors. Others will be able to work smarter because they know how to repair the condition. In the meaning of finding someone's pain problem, they respond quickly to the workload, but most factors that really support it are found in how they are faster in adapting to the environment. 

People who are chalantly into their environment are different from the sociable ones. The near example is the difference in how the reaction occurs when something big happens and is a game-changer. When someone can see the potential, then someone who is still not meeting their opportunities, it's a sign of the difference. Someone who can meet their potential, somehow, is close to working smarter if someone could expand their facility for growth. Because when you seek your potential without any stability of capital, its mean you just put your walk alone with its opportunities, sometimes when you realize it, your pathway seems nothing to be assured. 

## How to Repair the Work Harder into the Smarter?  

The harder workers are complying with the multiple choices to find the best methods in a successful life. Sometimes it's all about the unworthy things they find in their workload, like they are not assured in their pathway, or do not know how to survive in this competitive world. 

There is also a reason why they are working harder, and it is that they are not allowed to have the same access as working smarter does. It might be that the working harder type does not really know, and is deadlocked by the working smarter path in their successful life. The compared habits are still sights on by many people, of course, I.

When your daily just ended by comparing with someone's abilities and so on, you may lose your golden time into your success life. So, the most important advice that supports you whenever finding this reality is just to be confident and love every task you do today or tomorrow. Or the greatest advice is \

. While we are working, there are still many echoes in our minds about everything that is associated with our lives, and you must pretend that everything is fine. If you were finding these problems, you must know that your confidence is a more important things that anyelses to be able to work smarter. 

So, the conclusion is that if you want to work smarter, not harder, the first thing first is to upgrade your skill in confidence, and the other factors will follow then.

title.title: Not dependent on others, everyone is better off independently.
title.body:
by Jamal70 on Jamal70 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/jamal70 [![Not dependent on others, everyone is better off independently.](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/c19b7380-af08-408e-b99d-1ef8624e53ab.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/fowfJ6sLhHZstajfDgec2R) 
 
  


One day, a cat and a dog started talking about their lives. The dog said, “I am very loyal to my owner. I do what my owner says and I always protect him.” The cat smiled and said, “But I am a little different. I am loved by my owner, and I do what I want. Sometimes my owner also has to listen to me.”

A bird on a nearby tree was listening attentively to their conversation. After a while, the bird said, “Both of you are under the authority of your owner. But I am free. I fly in the sky, do what I want and do not have to obey anyone’s orders.”The cat and the dog remained silent for a while after listening to the bird. Then they realized that just as love and security have their value, there is also a special joy in freedom.

title.title: Semifinals with my second Lightborn, the invincible shield of Tigreal - Mobile Legends Bang Bang
title.body:
>


Good day, #HiveGaming community. In my [previous post](https://peakd.com/hive-140217/@takeru255/quarterfinals-in-the-mobile-legends-mro-a-good-start-5sm), I shared the initial part of the tournament I'm participating in (MRO). Today, I bring you the second part of this great feat the semifinals; I hope you enjoy it.

>Muy buen día, comunidad de #HiveGaming. En mi [Post Anterior](https://peakd.com/hive-140217/@takeru255/quarterfinals-in-the-mobile-legends-mro-a-good-start-5sm) les compartí lo que sería la parte inicial de los cuartos de final del torneo en el que estoy participando (MRO). Hoy les traigo la segunda parte de esta gran hazaña las semifinales; espero que la disfruten.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

<center>![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/EoyMynuLtk5sf4bbmfFCVEqmH7uhhsJC8Thpe5FTtj3iTviM6epQz37zCn6eXrXb92A.png)</centeR>

<div class=\

>

This time I wanted to use Tigreal, a tanky character who can take a lot of hits and deal heavy damage. He's a bit slow for my taste, but he does a lot of damage. I managed to provide good support to my team overall.

It's worth noting that I don't have much experience with the characters I'm playing in this campaign, and I'm mostly using them to try out the new skins I have. Even so, I think my overall performance was good with both characters.

> En esta ocasión quise usar a Tigreal, un personaje tanque que aguanta bastante y pega duro a los oponentes. Es un poco lento para mi gusto, pero causa bastante daño. Logré servir de apoyo a todo mi equipo en general.
>
> Cabe destacar que con los personajes que estoy jugando en esta campaña, no tengo mucha experiencia con ellos y los uso más que todo para estrenar las skins que tengo con ellos. Con todo y eso, pienso que mi desempeño a nivel general fue bueno con ambos personajes.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wn522nLJC00


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)



<div class=\

>

I didn't manage to get as many kills as I would have liked, but I did contribute a maximum of 18 times to eliminate the opposing team. Furthermore, I didn't die much either; this speaks volumes when you look at the results on the leaderboard.

Especially considering it was a purely PvP match where you have to attack from all sides and keep the base safe from the enemy. My team, overall, played excellently.

> No logré matar a tantos como me hubiera gustado, pero sí colaboré un máximo de 18 veces para matar al equipo contrario. Además, tampoco morí mucho; esto dice más que suficiente al momento de ver los resultados en la tabla.
>
> Sobre todo cuando se trata de una partida netamente PVP en la que hay que atacar por todos los flancos y mantener la base a salvo del enemigo. Mi equipo en general jugó excelente.

<center>![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tvD21Vc5XRDqbz3AM6w8ogmRMngHoPoV9gdKrNR87eB7S5YGoSzTWooFXsBYi9qfwDq.png)</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)


<center>![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/EpA17PZnDwUhZiUxJtrcdSEWFPp5SYqmiRUDeHDDEXtaQwwywNyZT1fNm4KL3VQbup1.png)</center>


<div class=\

>

With my play style, I continue to earn the MVP title, which means I have managed to be the most valuable player not so much for the number of kills obtained, but for the undeniable support I provided to my team overall.

> Con mi forma de jugar, sigo obteniendo el título de MVP, lo que significa que he logrado ser el jugador más valioso no tanto por la cantidad de muertes obtenidas, sino por el apoyo indiscutible que brindé a nivel general a mi equipo.



<center>![10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tGaDwvrjcywR7qJEFBKWnV1kFULeQsxdsD2Ma8uEankpvVNqLBT4Uqu56NYj8JP3L35.png)</center>

<div class=\

>

Here are the match stats. Unfortunately, this is as far as my team and I got in the quarterfinals. We didn't manage to win the cup or the prize, but I'll keep trying as many times as it takes to bring you my best effort and the ultimate prize of all: winning the cup.

> Aquí les muestro las estadísticas de la partida. Y lamentablemente, hasta aquí llegué yo con mi equipo en los cuartos de final. No logramos ganar la copa ni el premio, pero lo seguiré intentando las veces que sean necesarias para traerles a ustedes mi mejor esfuerzo y el premio mayor de todos, que es ganar la copa.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

<div class=\

> I hope you enjoyed my little bit of fun during the **Mobile Legends Rising Open** (MRO), That's all for now, but I want to thank everyone who took a few minutes to read this. Until next time, cheers! > Espero que les haya gustado mi hazaña en este breve momento durante la copa de **Mobile Legends Rising Open** (MRO). Hasta aquí les dejo mi publicación, no sin antes darles las gracias a los que se tomaron unos minutos de su tiempo para leerme. ¡Hasta la próxima, saludos! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

title.title: A show of wild birdlife...
title.body:
...and something different here, as a challenge for you to now identify the birds.
![133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eoke1VKNF6e9BkECRegnvjn8J6BQxREy64sNBuTPHN237UxHrVhNCVPAVf5c3esfcAL.jpg)

How many times now have I posted birds with their full identification? I can only say that I have lost count. And so, today I will not identify any of the birds and my challenge for you is to name them. Please don't id any bird as a chicken, simply because there are no chickens in the pictures. Lol. I will, of course, leave some clues above some pictures. 
So, lets see how it goes. 

? Clue: The two birds below eat worms.
![157.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23w2gWKMQBRgXekBUvCMcc9LpFZXirqG6GJm6RWJDEfpdtedMCzeFt3xdSTQxiYPwQ3cv.JPG)

? This should be an easy one to identify (2 photos).
![212.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/242hNH2sgT8bqy3SYikg24psMKa6iRcF5MchUTzBFW6DNa2JT2pa4syNdCWsE2jRictgi.JPG)

![213.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23zRxjHMR8hwPcb3aBKWiifPR7ma4LtGxDF9FUUJW4Nm3oqh1Jgjc9VsfCrZ12PSw4G8x.JPG)

? Clue: These are the targets of a famous bird of prey (2 photos).
![002.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23swnw8Gp64TZFJ1dGXxVMBqEA6RDHuaiqShBfnLZzE1kXhJH1wbV3ovmvbkAzRVYCE4A.JPG)

![003.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tv8Jgz3gEEs136VRsMuP2KcQPNiyHd63eJhSwETuHn5eXKACmTW6C1tBqeLMzzwvwEa.JPG)

? And here is the famous bird that targets the birds above (2 photos).
![022.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EpC7Y7dENGfjETRRMeEPNANjV2oSW9CQVQRPyUr1jR2GKLMM3MRo8vHWoB3xJAk8ngL.JPG)

![024.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23y8fCReoz46R31opJawgjeo48yL5PpdbbJzNZjqy5CYLj5tj3bxagXGErHcvSphRabGY.JPG)

And finally, what do you think this bird was? (2 photos)
![001.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23t79SCGM6PX5MhPvHUhRd4nBo5mJAFG2nTDWHfinC8Rx5SumtjDwBCdtzTnSjC87sgxY.JPG)

![002.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tSMxVWqfKiJmqB4iXLZaLiRY8qinrTVNhBvnacy1j7ztwRJ3vv4HmmSXDRwZzzVVmgk.JPG)

Just a fun Friday activity, as I always take random shots of birds in flight, and in here I have included some of the birds to see if you can remember their identities. Note that I have posted each one of them before in different contexts. And also note that these are unpublished ones. It is really important to see the value of identifying if one wants to see where they fit into the eco-system and what the birds' part in it is. 

Identifying also shows some interesting facts about each one, even the more common species. When I started photography, I did not know much about anything, but nature is like a magnet and once your eye can rest upon any of nature's treasures then one becomes hooked. Yes, at times it takes patience, but ever so slowly a person gets used to it, and that's when nature's gates are opened to show her treasures to one. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved. 

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera.

Until next time, cheers!

title.title: Black Ivory 5.7.26 Emma Doesn’t Sell a Painting
title.body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pvE3Wj3jMnk

Here is a rough rundown of the podcast: 

• Edgeworth calls me up on What’s App, and we begin the podcast.
• Edgeworth and Emma ask about the Rose and the Amateurs Nature Center gig last week. He tells them they played 23 covers, but it was more like 20.
• Awkward time at an official ceremony. People standing still, watching us.
• Ron has been painting because the weather is bad.
• Emma is forced indoors to paint because of the forecast, which is often wrong. 
• Edgeworth doesn’t go to Camden because of the forecast which is often wrong.
• But he’s working when not in Camden.
• Ron and Edgeworth are retired.
• Emma had her exhibition at Mill Hill but unfortunately didn’t sell anything. Good turnout though, maybe 300 people. 40 - 50% sold. Just not Emma’s pieces. Badge of honor!
• Emma’s friend paints turtles and she sold a couple. 
• Edgeworth points out that people have no taste. Emma has work worth looking at. 
• Flower pictures sell. It’s just how it is. 
• These exhibitions are cliquey, says Emma. Ron agrees.
• Edgeworth talks about all levels of the art world being rotten with nepotism.
• Edgeworth presents his flowchart putting Free Art Frees Art at the top. It’s like a family tree. How to make all these projects that we’re doing make sense and put them all into one context. 
• Black Ivory and Advertism, for instance, are under the umbrella of Free Art Frees Art.
• Money has been replaced. The art world is being replaced. Free Art Revolution. 
•  Nebulaic!
• Ron makes point that Edgeworth is already making a name for Free Art.
• Must make the ideology work in the real world. It must be self-sustaining.
• An artist can make money around Free Art Free Art.
• Kuwait drilled sideways!
• Emma attended a Tracey Emin exhibition and shoed a couple postcards of her paintings. 
• Emin had a miscarriage and didn’t paint for 5 years.
• Ron decries celebrity artists. Every time she paints a picture she makes a hundred grand.
• Ron says it’s his turn to be a celebrity.
• Emma shows her print she’ll hand out in Camden with Edgeworth on Saturday.
• Edgeworth exhibits his Steemit, Blurt and Ecency art made with LPs.
• Edgeworth exhibits his LP art for Kozmic Records in Camden. Watch for the Studious album, Farangers, Elbow Sisters and 2 Out of 3 Rule promotions. 
• Ron asks about the Camden booklet. Edgworth recently had 3000 printed.
• Emma asks about outdoor sketching. Ron lies and says he’ll be doing it too. But Ron doesn’t like plein airing.
• Edgeworth goes through the booklet.
• He uses GIMP to prepress. 
• Black Ivory Lets Anarchists Create Kash In Violation of Rogue Yesmen
• Emma counts poorly
• Elections in England!
• April 5 is end of tax year in England.
• Edgeworth is a Sole Trader.
• Tax law in U.S. does not support new business.
• WPA during the Depression. Ansel Adams, Edward Hopper, Philip Guston. And Ron was wrong about Hopper. He didn’t take any funding. He was a conservative Republican who hated the New Deal and thought Roosevelt was trying to become a dictator. 
• Edgeworth is eager to talk about Johnstone Chats
• One second of quality content in 59 minutes
• The UK vote 
• Emma Green, Edgeworth Reform, and the Donald Trump button
• Your Party is Your Party and a confusing name.
• And then more politics, you’ll have to listen…
• More politics and power’s universal hold on hypocrisy and corruption…
• A missed opportunity for Anarchy For Art
• More politics that culminate with Ron requesting a Britsh invasion of the U.S.
• The Second Half of Johnstone Chats arrives
• Painting at Camden
• People won’t let us be the opposite of successful
• We wind down for another week

title.title: I Discover the Room of Requirement With Professor Weasley in Hogwarts Legacy
title.body:
![2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swc1HDbup71uHcDw1m7rSy9o1Zz5CJNyXGbcxxVjCLjXrFv9g95h5rhgvMqdc34GQH2.gif)


Hey gamers, how are you all doing? Hope everything is going great! My adventure in Hogwarts Legacy keeps moving forward and this time we're heading into one of the most iconic locations in the entire wizarding world — the Room of Requirement. After everything that went down with Sebastian in the Undercroft, the next main quest on the list was meeting up with Professor Weasley, who apparently has something very special to show me. She told me to meet her near the Astronomy Tower and, well, let's just say what happened before she even arrived was already a surprise. So let's get into it.

**Arriving Before the Professor — The Room Finds Us First**

![1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swcK8S58RVkwFCchMgHKgFZVdF742s6cRRZys9PL1KPTGaXUuPGVPHPkSC3ezgk6cHF.gif)

So I make my way to the meeting point following the golden wisp trail from my charmed compass, and when I get there — no Professor Weasley. She's not there yet. But as I'm standing around waiting, something completely unexpected happens. A door appears in the wall right in front of me. Just materializes out of nowhere, completely on its own, as if the castle itself decided to introduce us without waiting for the professor. And of course I walked right in, because what else are you going to do when a magical door appears in a castle wall and invites you inside? You go in. Obviously.

![0423 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swe5JHW3XJyRfPjFQierR7mWjjNgg6SfBTs5WtweiLFUTXebieAfQRHCmTr4Cwa74zH.jpg)

So I step through and I'm already inside the Room of Requirement by the time Professor Weasley arrives — and she walks in behind me with this look on her face that is somewhere between amused and genuinely impressed. She notes that the room opened for me on its own before she even got there, which is not exactly a common occurrence, and it immediately signals that this place has recognized something in you specifically. It's a small moment but it lands really well as a piece of character storytelling. This isn't just a cool room you've been given access to — it chose you. And for a student who already channels ancient magic, that feels completely appropriate.

**Entering the Room of Requirement With Professor Weasley**

![0423 (1)(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swe119h4haaikwWMifUyXguF2nQdSKLEJj13hY5eoPacQWmK9jKsP8ZxiNWyJ6a5Nhb.jpg)

Once she's inside, Professor Weasley takes the lead and walks you through the room, which in its current state is an absolute labyrinth of accumulated magical junk. And when I say junk I mean centuries worth of forgotten objects, discarded furniture, broken equipment, dusty crates, old school supplies, strange artifacts, towers of chairs, rolled up rugs, hanging lanterns, and basically everything you can imagine a magical school might quietly tuck away and forget about over hundreds of years. The whole thing has this incredible atmosphere of organized chaos — like a magical attic that goes on forever.

Following Professor Weasley through these corridors of oddities is genuinely enjoyable. She walks with authority and purpose but also with this warm familiarity that tells you she's been here before, maybe many times, and that she has a real affection for this place. She explains the history of the room as you move — how it appears only to those who truly need it, how it takes the form of whatever the person entering requires most, and how it has served Hogwarts students in ways that most of the faculty officially know nothing about. There's a real sense of reverence in the way she talks about it, which makes the whole introduction feel significant rather than just functional.

![0423 (1)(4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tGTQCH8qsSNnWJ1UkzbfmrRTkVSb6YBBSHMSL2d5dwxnGofPVS1UwW73Nxxx9LLaRK5.jpg)

Along the way she also gets momentarily distracted when she spots something tucked away in a corner — an old school bag that she recognizes from her own time as a student at Hogwarts. It's a tiny detail but it does a lot of work in humanizing her. You get this brief flash of Weasley as a young student moving through these same corridors, and it makes the room feel genuinely alive with history rather than just being a backdrop for gameplay systems.

**The Design of the Room of Requirement Is Absolutely Stunning**

![0423 (1)(7).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tGTdosXHRqoU2tRHWhi9D7FBuzvFVLbyCXWNADRoahRARgqdW4BrRbnteHJiBg4ouhN.jpg)

I have to stop and talk about how this room looks because honestly it deserves its own section. The visual design of the Room of Requirement in Hogwarts Legacy is one of the most impressive things I've seen in the entire game, and that's saying a lot because this game consistently looks incredible throughout. The lighting alone is extraordinary — warm, amber toned light filtering through dust and haze, lanterns hanging at different heights casting pools of glow across mountains of accumulated magical stuff, shafts of light cutting through gaps in the clutter from sources you can't quite identify.

The sheer density of objects filling every inch of these corridors is remarkable. Nothing feels repeated or copy-pasted — every corner you turn has something new and visually interesting sitting on a shelf or leaning against a wall or hanging overhead. You can spot things that clearly have stories behind them — enchanted mirrors, old cauldrons, broken wands, stacks of spell books with cracked spines, magical instruments whose functions you can only guess at. The whole space communicates that this room has been visited by generations of Hogwarts students going back centuries, each one leaving something behind. It's a world-building achievement wrapped inside a gameplay feature and it makes you want to slow down and look at everything rather than just following the quest marker.

![0423 (1)(9).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swg9vAmrx4hEeVhUD8vPQt74TrkUC8AGtwEWdXWrYDYtFgfFUoJrYnmXZhTqQke1kn4.jpg)

The experience of moving through it for the first time is genuinely immersive in a way that very few game environments manage. Hogwarts Legacy as a whole does an exceptional job of making you feel like you're actually inside the wizarding world, but the Room of Requirement is probably the single location in the game that captures that feeling most completely. It's the kind of space that makes you forget you're playing a video game for a few minutes.

**Learning Evanesco to Clear the Way**

![0423 (1)(6).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swcDGsoLQn8y9haHARzzoA9Vod6B1rb77ZDEaw3gzubVF6hYfG9TM7M392iSa2aZPDc.jpg)

At a certain point as you follow Professor Weasley through the cluttered corridors, you hit a blockage — a massive pile of chairs stacked high and completely sealing off the path forward. There's no way around it and there's no way through it using any spell you already know. So this is where Weasley stops, turns around, and teaches you a new spell — Evanesco, the Vanishing Spell. The spell minigame for this one is moderately tricky compared to some of the others you've learned so far because the wand movement pattern requires you to hit three different face buttons at specific points rather than just one or two, so pay attention to what's coming up on the right side of the screen before you start tracing or you'll likely fumble it on the first attempt.

Once you've got Evanesco locked in, you equip it and cast it directly at the chair tower. And they just disappear. Completely and instantly, like they were never there. Clean, satisfying, and incredibly useful. What's also great is that when you Evanesco objects inside the Room of Requirement specifically, you get Moonstone back as a reward — which is the primary resource currency used to conjure and place objects inside the room. So every time you clear a furniture obstacle you're also banking resources for customizing the space later. It's an elegant little loop that the game introduces naturally through the quest rather than dumping it on you through a menu.

After clearing the first pile you follow Weasley further and quickly come across more chair obstacles blocking different paths — each one giving you a chance to practice the spell and collect more Moonstone. You also find chests scattered off the main route that are absolutely worth grabbing. The most satisfying one requires you to pull a crate toward you with Accio, use Levioso to float it upward, then climb on top and jump to a higher ledge where a large chest is sitting. It's exactly the kind of environmental puzzle that feels organic and fun to solve rather than forced.

**Professor Weasley Sends Me to Explore on My Own**

![0423 (1)(10).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tbJsw7qVesz3LGhvKVvdHo52YTT9unbLbrN9cKUdLJkwu3vBgSd29wseAXGXmCrAFzg.jpg)

After getting distracted by her old school bag, Weasley tells you to go on ahead and explore the rest of the room yourself while she takes a moment. And this is where the quest hands control fully over to you and the Room of Requirement starts to reveal what it actually is — not just a storage space but a living, responsive environment. As you push deeper through the corridors, clearing more chair obstacles and poking around every corner you can find, you eventually reach the far end of the space where a house-elf named Deek is waiting for you. And the moment you make contact with him, the room completely transforms.

The mountains of clutter dissolve away and the space reconfigures itself into something new — your personal Room of Requirement. Clean, open, and ready to be shaped into whatever you need it to be. Professor Weasley catches up, introduces you properly to Deek — who is genuinely one of the sweetest characters in the game and will become an important figure in how you manage and develop the room going forward — and then teaches you the Conjuring Spell, which allows you to create objects out of thin air using Moonstone as fuel. She has you practice by conjuring a Potions Station and a Potting Table, both of which become permanent fixtures and the first building blocks of your own custom space inside the room.

![0423 (1)(11).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23t74yPsqhmqydEcPQpnUDxr3BPNtxLqqdAerqvRarUwwYKDKWNC62Lyjsb7utvZkCfDk.jpg)

So gamers, we're going to leave it right here for this post because the Room of Requirement is a whole world unto itself and everything it unlocks deserves its own dedicated exploration. Between Evanesco, the Conjuring Spell, Deek, and everything this space is going to allow us to do going forward — brew potions, grow magical plants, customize the environment, and eventually even house magical creatures — there is a lot to dig into. Next post we go deeper into all of it. See you there gamers!

title.title: I want to do God’s will but I can’t stop doing bad things // MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
title.body:
https://youtu.be/kTJD6aYScLM?si=gIOL_28AwBZSjg4B

Errors and mistakes are two different things. As God's offspring, we are prone to occasionally making mistakes due to our imperfections. People who are willing to obey God with all of their hearts are what God seeks and desires, not flawless individuals. 

In certain cases, our blunders will be readily apparent to all. Although David was not flawless, the fact that he had received some instruction set him apart from the soul. His time spent tending to his father's sheep in the field wasn't in vain. He was chosen by God to be a shepherd over the flock because he knew how to provide for the needs of the people and would eventually lead them. 

Saul, however, did not receive any training.We need to be disciplined if we are to genuinely carry out God's will and obey his commands. Without discipline, nothing important can be accomplished.

title.title: On My Walk In The Morning 5.8.2026
title.body:
![20260508_060022.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTGtsCxxwUzdehazA46CcAyW5cn8hLGt1TEzvdbDHfps5/20260508_060022.jpg)

On my walk in the morning I took this picture of the moon. Do you see that the moon is light? The Bible in Genesis says that the moon is the lesser light. Of which this light is cooler in its light than in its shade. Compared to the sun, which is known as the greater light, of which light is warmer in its light than in its shade.

And they want to tell me that the moonlight is a reflection of the sunlight. Then why is the moon light cooler in its light than in its shade?

So they tell me that NASA went to orbit the moon recently. Well, how did they break through God's firmament to get to the moon? In Genesis it mentions that the sun, moon and stars are housed in the firmament. Enoch says that the sun, moon and stars travel in their portals in the firmament.

And another thing, is the firmament firm? Well I would imagine the firmament is firm, like terrible crystal, like a molten looking glass. Well, that is how I read it in the Bible.

And have you ever looked at the NASA logo? You see that red serpent tongue? Doesn't it also look like a T? Now add the T to the letters of NASA and you get SATAN, Satan the father of lies, has been lying to us since Adam.

So no, I don't believe NASA. Better to believe in Jesus. Let them say they went around the moon, but they never said, how they handled the firmament. Interesting.

When I was a kid I did believe about the first moon landing and the others that came afterward, but now too many things don't add up.

Now I believe they landed on a movie studio version of the moon. There is a movie called, 
A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Moon - MM2, it was put up about 13 years ago on Youtube. You might want to check it out, it talks about a lot of things that don't add up about the moon landings.

You know when I was a kid, I used to ask, If God didn't like the tower of Babel, how could he let us go to the moon? But then they didn't go to the moon, but God let us know later by they way of that video, A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Moon - MM2, and other videos that NASA really didn't go to the moon at all.

Let's end with a scripture, as it is written, And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years: Genesis 1:14.

If you enjoyed this blog, please upvote and follow.
Thank you, David Oyog.
Image is mine, taken with my Samsung Galaxy Note 9.
