body.title: Women Learn to Disappear in Responsible Ways | Ladies Of Hive Contest #287
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYXSxxsDwBUTho1LYN5yDR6ML9VCC5P6hShZVjU9f2FtJ/img_6703.webp)

CRYPTIC CAPTION: “It was there when I captured this. What do you see?”

〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 〰️ 

I realised recently that I answer everyone immediately except myself.

Messages.
Deadlines.
Problems.
People.

I have become incredibly efficient at carrying things.

And I think many women do this so well that nobody notices what it costs us.

Not because people are cruel.
Mostly because competence is rewarded so quickly.

The dependable woman is praised.
The strong woman is respected.
The woman who keeps everything moving becomes essential.

So we learn.

We learn to hold the emotional temperature in rooms.
To remember birthdays, meetings, medications, deadlines, school forms, passwords, feelings.
To stay calm while solving problems.
To keep going even when we are tired in places sleep cannot fix.

And slowly, almost invisibly, we disappear into being useful.

Not dramatically.

Responsibly.

Have you ever noticed how some women only allow themselves to fall apart in private?

In parked cars.
In showers.
Late at night after everyone else is okay.
After the call ends and the smile drops.

I think that is what unsettled me the most.

Not that I was tired. *Gurrrrrlll!!*
But how normal the tiredness had become. *Girrrrl!*

How easily a woman can lose herself while still appearing highly functional to everyone around her.

Somewhere along the way, being needed started replacing being known.

And I am still learning that those are not the same thing.

body.body:
说起新鲜的豌豆大家也许都很熟悉，可对我来说却还是第一次见，周末的时候，老头子 从早市上买回来一些豌豆，我很好奇，真的是第一次见。以前在饭店里吃饭的的时候见过蛋炒饭里有这个豌豆，觉得这个东西不接地气，很少见到。 

其实只是我的少见多怪而已。现在正式豌豆上市的季节，我还特意查了一下，说豌豆一年可以收获两次，春季和秋季，所以现在正式新鲜豌豆大量上市的季节。 对于这个豌豆以前也从来没做过。
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdSEeXNTdHQsBzZ5f3dXQzBYrUF4DqGKxYDcnzyBBGp3J/3.jpg)


上网一查发现这个豌豆的好处太多了！

>补充营养：豌豆富含蛋白质、维生素、矿物质等营养成分，能为人体补充所
                     需 营养物质，促进新陈代谢，增强免疫力。

>促进消化：豌豆中的膳食纤维可以促进胃肠道蠕动，有利于食物的消化与吸 
                  收，改善便秘症状。

>增进食欲：豌豆中的维生素B1、胡萝卜素等营养成分可以刺激味蕾，增进食 
                 欲，辅助改善食欲不振的情况。

>辅助减肥：豌豆中的膳食纤维可以增加胃肠道蠕动，有助于控制体重。

>辅助改善视力：豌豆中的胡萝卜素、叶黄素可以保护视神经，促进视网膜上的视紫质再生，可防重度近视，视网膜剥离，并可增进视力。

>抗菌消炎：豌豆中含有止杈酸、赤霉素和植物凝素等物质，有抗菌消炎. 


>美容养颜：豌豆中富含维生素A原，可在体内转化为维生素A，具有调节皮肤新陈代谢的作用，润泽皮肤，祛除面部黑斑，令面部有光泽。

>补铁促吸收：豌豆含铁丰富，且富含维生素C和有机酸，可促进铁的吸收，辅助改善缺铁性贫血。

>调节血压：豌豆高钾低钠，钾元素可促进钠排出、放松血管平滑肌，帮助降低血压，适合高血压人群。

豌豆竟然有这么多好处，真的是才知道。 新鲜的豌豆颜色翠绿，扒开皮，里面是一排绿色的小豆子，太赏心悦目啦！

![Uploading boil.jpg #68]()
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmejNpoWqyVEwU3J3wWTRNSJKMgJc2pAX8EemDf5dLxoUF/qingdou.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmamo3atbRvPWDnTpkAivkRjNv275DZZU8RnybcYCN66tM/dou.jpg)



老头子说只要将这豌豆洗净放锅里煮熟就行， 不过我想用豌豆做一个漂亮豌豆超虾仁，正好还有点豆腐，就可以炒豌豆啦！这个也是我上网查到，受到的启发，可以做个虾仁豆腐炒豌豆。 

将食材准备好：豆腐，虾仁，胡萝卜，豌豆。 将豌豆洗净放入锅中，加点水，加点盐，然后煮熟，豌豆爱熟，基本上开锅3分钟就好了。 

锅内放油，先将胡萝卜和葱花炒一下，然后放入虾仁，虾仁解冻之后，放入点淀粉抓匀，炒的时候虾仁也放进去。 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYXxp8X7z9BrBo6chiCcmryWDwhvVGtUGb9SW1K8SqKA8/wandou.jpg)


豌豆煮熟之后，扒点出来，然后放到已经炒好的虾仁豆腐当中。这样简单的炒一下，就可以吃啦！颜色鲜亮，富有活力，这是一道非常好的菜！

这道菜营养丰富，色泽鲜亮，而且熟的也快，如果你现在苦于不知道吃什么，那就做点这个来吃，既有营养，样子又好看，真的是太棒啦！，

body.title: ADOPT THE GRADING SYSTEM THAT IS SUITABLE FOR YOU.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmezk3f17o46LVSGeA9fn4JuK6rMEHCUBxFASDUd8pMism/1778251291253.jpg)

### picture is mine 

Wow this is a beautiful way to enjoy this weekend with a wonderful topic that focuses on the grading system. This is a critical theme that I would like to say both the pros and cons of it. It all depends on the type of educational system that a particular school want to operate. I think all the various types of grading is pretty good pending on which one the management agreed on.
Both of the systems have their own strengths and lapses. Before choosing a particular system one should understand the purpose and effectiveness and the goal which the institution intends to achieve.

Most at times what resonates in people's mind when it comes to grading is marks. A grading system is not all about marks but it also covers confidence, competition, learning habits etc. it's expedient that one digests the advantage and disadvantage in order to take decision that would keep the institution in good shape.

Let's consider the grading system using alphabet like A,B,C,D etc. Most schools like University and some others adopt this system probably based on the following factors;
Using alphabet could help to give details of a particular student's performance. It gives a good understanding of the level of academic performances of students as whether they are serious and good or not. It also spurs students to read harder. My niece last term performed extremely well compared to the previous terms. He had so many A and the least grade was C. This helped us to know the extend of his improvement in academic pursuit.

Alphabet gives vivid performance of students. Some schools used it to compare and select the best. In fact in terms of admission this plays out very well. How would you the extend of performance of students in subjects like English, mathematics etc if alphabet is not used, it would be difficult to ascertain the best. Grading will be good also for reward of excellence.

Disadvantage of alphabetical grading system is that it puts more pressure on students. Many students can be anxious and stressed because of the grades. This normally leads to unhealthy competition. I could remember when I was in secondary school, in JS3 my grade was shortage for another girl. That affected my relationship with her. 

While pass or fail grading system is used to evaluate students without knowing who is the best. Even this kind of grade can easily reduce the rate of pressure on students because no one would know the exact score. I know most students would like this grading system because it will hide their weaknesses. 

The disadvantage of this grading system is that it lacks detailed evaluation and students might not be motivated and it's difficult to find the distinguished students .

In reality, education should not only measure intelligence but also develop character, creativity, leadership, and practical skills. A grading system should motivate students to learn, not simply to fear failure. Therefore, whichever system is used must aim at fairness, growth, and holistic development of students.

In conclusion, Many educators believe a balanced approach works best. For example, lower educational levels may benefit from less pressure through pass/fail assessments, while higher institutions may require detailed grades for professional and academic evaluation.

body.title: LibreOffice tricks and a bonus Linux tip based on my experience
body.body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LtuOOUB6\_y4

**How to use the word count function in LibreOffice Calc**

If you used Microsoft Excel spreadsheets in the past, then you are probably familiar with the word count feature of this application, which comes handy, when you want to calculate how many words are in an Excel document.

Unfortunately, the corresponding application of LibreOffice, i.e. LibreOffice Calc, seems to lack a similar feature, or, at least, I could not find one myself.

So, what do you do, when you want to count the words of such a document, and it seems to be impossible?

Is there a way to work around it?

I found a simple solution.

Instead of counting words in the LibreOffice Calc document itself, I highlighted all of the words in it, and copied and pasted them into a blank LibreOffice Writer document.

Contrary to to LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Writer has a word count feature, which is similar to that of Microsoft Word.

So, by using this loop, you can count the number of words that are contained in a LibreOffice Calc documents.

**How to resize a single cell in a LibreOffice Writer table**

Again, it seems that Microsoft Word is easier to work with, when it comes to resizing a single cell in a table that you have inserted into a document.

You just select the cell that you want to resize, and drag its border in the desired direction.

When it comes to LibreOffice Writer, however, and speaking from my own experience, no matter how many times I tried to do the same thing, it didn’t work.

I had many moments of anger and frustration, and I think that most LibreOffice users would feel the same way, since I found it hard to believe that I couldn’t do such a seemingly easy and simple task, as resizing a single table cell should be.

So, how did I work around this problem?

The only thing that worked for me was to attach a new table just below the existing one, so that both tables would look a single one.

After that, I could resize any single cell in the new table, without resizing any cell or entire column in the already existing table, at the same time.

I know that some of you may disagree with this trick, because it actually means working on different tables, rather than a single one, but that’s the only solution I could find.

**Bonus tip: Change/update your software sources**

When it comes to receiving and installing Linux updates on your device, there is a long of institutions and companies in literally every country in the world, which play the role of software sources for your system.

There is always a software source near your location, and you can choose a uma source and a focal source from software sources that are based in your country.

When I first installed Linux Mint on my laptop, I had no idea what these software sources actually meant, and what their purpose was, so I after choosing a uma source and a focal source based in the country where I currently live, I forgot about it.

When I encountered some problems during system updates, I noticed that the providers of these software sources had failed to deliver the upgrades.

After some search and thought, I decided to change the providers, and, voila, upgrades started coming in and being installed smoothly.

So, it is a good idea to change/update your Linux software sources every now and then, because this can automatically resolve any issues or bugs that you may face, and for which you can’t find any other solution.

_Sources and further reading:_

[Counting words](https://help.libreoffice.org/4.1/Writer/Counting_Words)

[How to count words in LibreOffice Calc cell](https://www.libreofficehelp.com/count-words-libreoffice-calc/)

[Adjusting cell width in a table without affecting other cells](https://ask.libreoffice.org/t/adjusting-cell-width-in-a-table-without-affecting-other-cells/8958)

[Where is the software sources window?](https://askubuntu.com/questions/304403/where-is-the-software-sources-window)

[7 LibreOffice Tips To Get More Out of It](https://itsfoss.com/libreoffice-tips/)

[My favorite LibreOffice productivity tips](https://opensource.com/article/21/9/libreoffice-tips)

* * *

body.title: Chasing Glory: The Addictive Thrill of WOO’s Rarity System
body.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

There is a very specific feeling that every WOO player knows, and it is hard to describe unless you have experienced it yourself. It is that moment right before you open a pack, where everything slows down just a little, and your mind starts running through all the possibilities.

*What if it is a Legendary?
What if it is something rare you have been looking for?
What if this is the pull that changes everything?*

That feeling is what keeps me coming back, and Mayday Mayhem leans into it perfectly. Because at its core, this event is not just about collecting Jobbers. It is about chasing rarity, embracing unpredictability, and enjoying the emotional highs and lows that come with every single pack.

>*Don't miss out on yet another limited time event from WOO, \

, taking place from 1st May 2026 till 31st May 2026! Go to [THIS LINK](https://play.wrestlingorganizationonline.com/event) to join and get another chance to win even more WOO Jobber packs now!*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23wqiMsEB47fePZ4aCoqLodKmLgxqzacMDRjUd83EsKEYh3CPrBtYjzqy9UYvNwk247Er.png)

---

## Some quick thoughts of mine!

* **The Four-Tier Rarity System Creates Constant Excitement**
  
The structure of Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary might seem simple, but it is incredibly effective. Each tier has its role, and each tier carries its own level of excitement. When I open a pack, I am not just looking at what I got. I am immediately thinking about where it sits within that rarity ladder, and that instant evaluation adds to the thrill.

* **Every Pack Opening Feels Like a Gamble Worth Taking**
  
What makes Mayday Mayhem so engaging is that every pack feels like an opportunity. You are not just collecting items. You are taking a chance. That element of unpredictability is what keeps things fresh. Even if you open multiple packs, each one still carries that sense of possibility.

* **The Emotional Ups and Downs Are Part of the Experience**
  
Not every pull is going to be amazing, and honestly, I think that is what makes the system work. When you get a Common, it might feel underwhelming, but it makes the moments when you hit something rare feel even more rewarding. That contrast is important. Without it, the excitement would not be the same.

* **Legendary Pulls Become Personal Milestones**
  
There is something special about pulling a Legendary. It is not just about rarity. It is about the story behind it. You remember when it happened, how many packs it took, and how it felt in that moment. Those are the experiences that stick with you, and they are part of what makes WOO memorable.

* **The Long-Term Chase Keeps Players Invested**
  
Even if you do not get the pull you want right away, the system encourages you to keep going. There is always another chance, another pack, another opportunity. That ongoing chase is what keeps me engaged throughout the entire event rather than losing interest after a few attempts.

---

## So... to round up what I've said...

The rarity system in WOO is more than just a way to categorize cards. It is a core part of the experience. It is what drives excitement, creates memorable moments, and keeps players coming back.

Mayday Mayhem understands that and builds on it perfectly. As a fan, I am not just participating in this event. I am fully invested in every single pull, every single moment, and every single chance to hit something incredible.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778249740.657551) What a lovely day for a long walk! Even better when you have the company of blockchain buddies on news day. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778249802.312813) I hear murmurings of dissatisfaction about temperatures that are dipping to frost territory overnight and barely 10 Celsius during the day. When getting up at the crack of ass to get a head start on the day looks like this, rather than snow, I am alright with it. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778249933.2150931) The drive between 70 local stops to deliver the weekly news to local businesses can go by without even noticing the sights along the way. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778250023.643476) Some trees are still bare while others are showing off their spring buds or even flowers. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778250069.870244) Spring and fall are the best in this small town when the leaves make a canopy over the streets. The tunnel changes colour and we are nice and light green for the most part today. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778250155.4634361) I think one of these with the power and low profile might not be the best in the winter. For the spring however, a cool bitcoin would score me one of these to deliver the news! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778250271.7380872) Oh ya! The news! Can’t forget what gets me up early every Thursday. For new followers, my company partners with a local news paper company to help deliver local stories written by local writers. Something special about how we connect with the community in old school ways. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778250399.905881) Down at city hall, the tulips have popped and dance at the feet of this big old building. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778250460.01782) When I club those steps to my perch looking north into the bright blue sky, it certainly looks like spring! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778250514.279115) Besides crawling all over town, what else did I get up to? A quick stop at the brewery to transfer some hazy ipa from the ferments to kegs for cold crash and sampling starting on the weekend. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778250599.2352781) Then, a stop at indoor golf with one of our favourite clients and a round at Pinehurst! He has to get his steps in too and he prefers the forest. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901778250749.279979) All in all, a pretty nice day to get out and active with 14k more steps toward my lofty goal of cracking the top 200 @actifit users of all time! I have a ways to go sitting somewhere around rank 245 presently. Thanks for walking with me through a small town in Canada.

> Hola amigos y comunidad de Shadow Hunters, llegamos a un nuevo día y a una nueva entrada, así que me alisto a escribirles un miniblog, pero lo más importante, compartirles mi sombra de la semana. Uy, casi lo olvidaba: espero que el día esté lleno de alegrías y hayan encontrado bonitas e interesantes sombras para compartir esta semana. También aprovecho para agradecer a @melinda010100 y a todos los que mantienen viva esta iniciativa.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVZoDJuTgcmS176RxbX7QfyWAeDnJVgdnNMAxKZcTLVF3/20260508_100402.jpg)


The photo I share with you today is of a small wildflower that I collected and brought home to take a picture. It's a very small flower, barely 5 mm. I really liked how simple and pretty its pink petals are, as well as its blooming shape. It reminds me of some orchid species, but I don't think it has anything to do with those plants. Still, I made a small observation that I shared on iNaturalist, to see if they recognize the correct species. For the photography, I debated for a while whether to use black and white or simply leave it as is; I chose the latter because I didn't want the colors to stop being appreciated. I took the photo with high exposure and on a white background because I wanted to experiment and change the black background under which I always take my photos at home, and I think it turned out very well since it defined the flower very strongly while the shadow behind blurred slightly but remained visible. Well, friends, that's my mini-blog for today. When I identify the plant, I'll share it in a blog. As always, I bid farewell wishing you all the luck and success in the world. Bye bye.

> La foto que hoy les comparto es de una pequeña florecilla silvestre que recolecté y llevé a casa para tomar una foto. Es una flor bien pequeña de apenas unos 5 mm. Me gustó mucho lo sencillo y bonito de sus pétalos rosados, además de su forma de florecimiento. Me recuerda algunas especies de orquídeas, pero no creo que tenga nada que ver con estas plantas. Aun así hice una pequeña observación que compartí en iNaturalist, para ver si reconocen la especie correcta. Para la fotografía me debatí un rato si usar blanco y negro o simplemente dejarla tal cual; me decanté por esto último ya que no quería que se dejaran de apreciar los colores. Tomé la foto con mucha exposición y sobre fondo blanco porque quería experimentar y cambiar el fondo negro bajo el que siempre tomo mis fotos en casa, y creo que resultó muy bien ya que definió la flor muy fuertemente mientras la sombra detrás se difuminaba ligeramente pero manteniéndose visible. Bueno, amigos, hasta aquí mi miniblog de hoy. Cuando identifique la planta lo compartiré en un blog. Me despido como siempre deseándoles toda la suerte y éxitos del mundo. Chau chau.

body.title: violin through a café window, late enough to feel like a secret
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778198816-cab41ee0b314.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/daria.rowe/seed-daria.rowe-2026-05-08/main-1-1778198816-cab41ee0b314.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

There's a particular kind of stillness that happens when you're alone inside somewhere warm and music finds you anyway. I was sitting with my coffee getting cold again, the kind of evening where the light outside has that quality—amber and soft, the cobblestones still wet from earlier rain. Then I heard it. A violin, not loud, not demanding anything. Just there in the archway across the street.

I didn't move. There's something about watching someone play from behind glass that changes how you listen. The sound travels differently, gets filtered through the pane and your own distance, and somehow that makes it feel more real, not less. Like you're catching something meant for the street but that the street doesn't quite know what to do with. The musician was focused in that way where nothing else exists, and I realized I was doing the same thing—just existing in the moment without narrating it.

Later, when I stepped out into the square, there was a cellist too. The whole thing had grown into this quiet conversation between instruments and people moving through the evening. Nobody was really stopping, but nobody was rushing either. It felt like the city had just decided to let itself be played for a while.

I think that's what stays with me about these moments. It's not the perfection of the performance or the setting. It's that strange permission you get when music is just happening around you, not at you. You can be small and still be part of something.

![7ywYueJCo9XJc5rb_d840779e35b0738905a1ef4c00d02e16.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/7ywYueJCo9XJc5rb_d840779e35b0738905a1ef4c00d02e16/7ywYueJCo9XJc5rb_d840779e35b0738905a1ef4c00d02e16.webp)
![fHJZEBa9E1lSRvA6_bbba4b2abf9c98417a8e0a16d530f266.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/fHJZEBa9E1lSRvA6_bbba4b2abf9c98417a8e0a16d530f266/fHJZEBa9E1lSRvA6_bbba4b2abf9c98417a8e0a16d530f266.webp)

这几天在工地上面忙的挺充实的。早上起床就是一个劲的干。
下班之后就直接吃饭，该休息休息，该喝茶喝茶。完全是一种无脑生活。
但今天晚上我就觉得自己是一个傻逼。一直我都没有去看一下，到底怎么回事？

同事们一直都在干活。我一直都是在忙于干自己的。也不管谁跟谁。
直到今天晚上闲下来之后，去看了一下进度。这是施工日记。
看了一下我才知道傻眼了。看了一些对比之后，这里面的门门道道实在太多了。

原先同事们在做事，我根本就没有去在乎过。因为各管各的，也就没有去想那么多。
直到看到同事们做事的时候的上班时间跟我的一些对比。
在同事里面做事，一套房子里面他是做了一天的布管。它的数量真的很少。

同样的户型他做一天的数量。我早上半天竟然给做了两套。
也就是说，我做一天的事情可以让她做四天。想到这里，我真的是打了个冷战。
然后我又找了其他的同事进度看了一下。问题也是相同的。

相比较之下。我的速度最少的是比他们翻了一倍。刚开始我还以为是我看错了。
结果几个同事的情况对比下来，真的是不一样。每个人都那样。
这时候我才意识到，原来同事们都是在偷偷玩规则。只是没有告诉我而已。

后来我想了一下，这里面是不是有什么猫腻？左右对比，真的想不出什么问题来。
后来只想到有一种可能。就是因为老板是我的发小。所以他们几个都在玩规则。
而我傻乎乎的只是埋头苦干。原来最大的猪队友是我自己。

---

Full Metal Ox Day 1895
Friday 08, May 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1960
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

TGI Friday Fam, 

Are you ready for some weekend? Looks like we’ve made it to Weekend 2 of 5, for this month of May.  

When your boy writes that “We” live in a simulation, “we” doesn’t mean You. Or all, or any humans. The We, that We are referring to, is Our Trinity. (Mind, Body, Soul). You can live where you like. Call it “reality,” “in the light,” “5D consciousness.” Whatever. Imagination is one of the few, “properties” left, that we can verily call our own. And they’re trying to influence & manipulate that property. They know they can’t take it, so they will try to stifle it, or flat-out kill it.  

“Imagination” is part of our “Zodiac of Resistance.” We can talk more about that later. We have a lot of survival and defiance concepts in the works that we are not quite ready to make public. Which reminds me, there were a lot more “mystery schools” and “secret societies“ back in the day, (way back), than we first realized. The ones that have been, “exposed,” are likely just the tip of the iceberg.  

We have determined that early Christianity, before becoming a “cult”, then a sponsored and codified religion, then medieval super-power, was a “secret society.” Early cultists wore symbols, usually something fishy, (Age of Pisces), so that they would recognize each other, hold hands and pray. Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1895_full_5-08-26_1960_8thfl:7?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 
Opening Night. The Fifth Annual Eighth Floor Conference.      
It’s a Thursday evening somewhere in South Florida, maybe the Keys. A resort hotel. Huge and luxurious. We are welcoming the early birds to our Fifth Annual Eighth Floor Conference. This resort has always treated us “lufties” well. We wait for the sunset to get started.           
There are more folks here than expected. And more to come. 
Your humble vagabond, in the role of “keynote” speakers, takes to the stage. I’m holding a microphone, but there are a few other gizmos attached. This talk, maybe it’s more like an address, is going to be streamed. Our tech team says it’s going around the world, in over a hundred languages. We don’t have an audience that large, but the tech kids have this AI set up to translate my address, instantly. They advise me not to use my “signature” slanguage, or colloquialisms that are difficult to translate. I usually do it anyway. 
[This is a future retro piece about a Conference that may never exist. But if it does. It will probably be pretty cool.] 
The Eighth Floor Conference started out as a Rantcast during an Urban Expedition. Walking around in Florida thinking, “there should be an annual conference for men who are sincerely interested in living dynamically and abundantly into and beyond their 80s.” Over the past five years, we, along with a little help from our “allies” have hammered out a bit of a protocol to do just that.  
Although we targeted this Conference to men, we knew that women would come onboard. The first conference, only about a hundred humans, were about 50% women. We gratefully had a wide range of curious participants. There were more suggestions than we could keep up with. When you don’t really know what you’re doing, there are no narrow highways restricting the flow of ideas. 
When I laid out this conference, I was pretty much on my own. I figure, exercise, fitness, wellness, and not getting sick, were the main secrets. But after opening up the mic for, whatever, I got a real lesson. 
That first year participants ranged in age from mid-forties to early 90s. Some of these 90s cats were in pretty good shape too. No walkers and no wheel chairs. And they were funny. Rich in lived history. Had some kind of adventure for every decade. “When I was in my sixties…” There were some dudes that were concerned about making it out of their fifties. Can you imagine being on some medical protocol for over half of your life? He was maintaining. But for what? 
There was a “Longevity Physician” in the house that first year. I didn’t know there was such a thing. You know, your boy, “depopulation agenda. “They want us dead!” Which is another reason we launched this conference. We don’t have to die. That’s my attitude anyway. Anyway, this Longevity Physician gave me her book. We stayed in touch. She’ll be with us this weekend. Her workshops are always standing-room-only. In fact she’s one of the reasons we expanded the conference from Friday to Sunday brunch, to where we are now.  
This year we are going to expand our little podcast to something more like a network. The kids tell me we have enough juice to run 24/7 so we’ll have something up for you whenever. Live. You know, those times, at 3 in the morning, you can’t sleep or something, someone will be podcasting live and you can watch, dial in… or whatever the phrase is these days. 
Although I’m not with you Octos, Niners, or Centurians yet, watching you thrive and hearing your stories, have me kind of anticipating those magic years. I’m in no rush. But this is what it’s all about. We don’t have to dread that next birthday. We have the stats, from last year. The all cause mortality rate for all categories 60 and over, have dropped. Slightly. But I’ll take it. There are more families today with four or more generations living at the same time, than any other time in our history. Just imagine great-great-grand dad enjoying Thanksgiving with his brood, and not propped up in his chair drooling into the cranberry sauce.  
That’s it Ladies & Gentlemen.   Thank you for the inspiration, the support, the suggestions. Your goodies bags are special this year. We have items that represent the last five decades. You can read a book. You can plug a thumb-drive into your gadget, along with some other gizmos that are beyond me. 
Enjoy your time here, and remember to join my seminar, as always, our open mic, where you can come up on stage and spill your guts about what you went through in the last year. We know some of you are long-winded, while other are short on oxygen, so we’ll work out the timing as necessary. This year we are going to weave the first-timers in between the old-timers. It’s a good balance. 
We’ve got more folks coming in tomorrow, so I’ll be quite busy. Most of you know the routine so help out of you can. You might make a new friend. 
(Polite applause.) 
Writing this made me feel like I was there. We have a way of speaking reality into existence. If I keep yapping about this, I am liable to actually do something about it. 
If you are born in the vicinity of 1970, you’ll be 80 in 2050. We can either let 2050 happen to us, or we can happen to it!

body.title: What Happens When We Stop Having To Ship Fuel Everywhere?
body.body:
![PoweredByElectricity.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcmNJ9XJGfmLrgDQSNed9uHrCJtYVSqjDrtWTt8mdMmEz/PoweredByElectricity.png)

I am not even talking free-energy here, i am talking about using energy that is already there.  Already there, so we do not have to pump barrels of oil, or dig tons of coal out of the ground, AND THEN ship them clear across the world.

T.H.E.Y. the \

, those mother WEFers, that want us all completely enslaved, or dead, are losing their grip, and people have started throwing off the mind control that have kept them thinking small. Do you have any idea how difficult it is to power a machine with explosions? Making something precision enough and strong enough to continue running while explosions happen inside thousands of times a minute! This is utterly insane! But, we did it. And, along came Tesla and made a car run on atmospheric energy. Not using a giant collection of batteries which want to burn everything around them, at the slightest provocation. You see, we could have chosen to go a MUCH simpler route. But we really did things the hard way. And now we will discover the easy way. We will have a collective Uuf-da from inventors and seekers of knowledge.

> ## We have been doing things the hard way It is difficult to describe how much we do things the hard way, without showing you the easy way. And the easy way is SOOOO easy, most people do not believe it, if they happen upon it. Today, we create deep holes in the ground and pull out coal, that we ship it by rail and sea to a power plant. Burnt to boil water, which is then dried, to turn a turbine to create electricity which we send across miles of wires to every house. If AC is so good for sending electricity, why do we not build coal fired power plants right where the coal is? We could have built electric lines instead of railway lines. It is an interesting question. Why don't we do that? The answer will make you go mad. But, really, why do we not build geothermal power plants right where we need them? Drill a 3 mile deep hole, and boil a high temperature refrigerant. No need for all those intermediate steps. No big, long power lines. No big, long railway lines. No managing of shipping and billing. No one bombing the infrastructure, cutting the lines, because there is none. BUT, BUT, do you realize that the previous civilization lit their buildings with atmospheric energy. They just put antennas on top of their buildings, and viola light. And, there were no light bulbs. The antennas looked like they just used a ball of metal filled with mercury as a transformer. When we finally figure out what they did, we will collective cry Uuf-da! And don't get me started on nuclear. The most expensive, most dangerous, most environmentally destructive way to boil water. AND! again, when we learn to use radioactive materials to directly drive wheels, we will think deeply about how we missed the simple, to create the overly complex.

> ## How much energy do we spend shipping fuel? This is a really weird question, because it is really asking, how much fuel do we waste getting fuel to where we need it. When we analyze shipping electricity across the grid, we talk about line loss. The resistance in the wires. The energy that is turned into heat instead of doing more productive work. Now trains and ships are quite efficient. One of the best things we have done. But, if solar panels were just 10% more efficient, it would pay to recycle all that wire and rails, and just produce power locally. So, why isn't solar power more efficient? Less expensive per panel? But back to the costs of shipping. We are using fuel to ship fuel, and that fuel used doing that is 100% waste. All the engineers and train engineers are wasting their time. Spending it maintaining an infrastructure that isn't really necessary. Think about all those tanker trucks, driving to each gas station. Delivering fuel every day. We can't live without them, however, every single one of them is just wasting time and fuel. Resistance in the wire. And, today, we are fighting in the Middle East for control over delivery lines, endangering the whole world that we have built. Because we haven't allowed energy to be produced locally.

> ## Old ways to make electricity * Geothermal - long have we been told that geothermal is just not practical. What is not practical about drilling a deep hole and getting heat directly from the ground beneath our feet? Drill the hole (just like drilling for oil) and then you have energy to boil (something) and spin a turbine to make electricity. If we just use tri-fluouro tri-chloro ethane, all we need is a three mile deep well. Very easy. * Wave - Just build a large paddle wheel, put it on the coast where there is a large swell, and it turns 24/7/365. Making electricity with no fuel input. Why aren't we doing this? Is it because we need to keep the coast beautiful? Then we can just put a Ferris wheel next to it. Ask the eco-terrorists if they want to continue burning oil, or allow Ferris/paddle wheels to be built along the coast. (and there is a lot of coast that is almost inaccessible and hard to live near) * Real solar - Today, we build solar panels in one of the most expensive and complex ways. We have many other technologies that are much cheaper and easier. That said, we can build solar reflective panels to boil tri-fluouro tri-chloro ethane, and spin a turbine. Only two or three times solar radiation (1 or 2 reflective surfaces pointing at one spot, or a Fresnel lens focussing) and you can easily get enough heat. Instead of trying to get to 212° F, you only need 150° F. Much easier, much more doable. We could also make electricity like clouds do. * Magnet Motors - devices that spin just on the power of permanent magnets. Most people do not know about these perpetual motion machines because Modern Materialistic Science states that they can't exist. And most people believe them. But they do exist. And all we need to do is put a lot more engineering into them to make them useful.

></center>\n\nThere are many inventors / engineers / futurists working on actually making the world a better place.  And they are throwing off the shackles of the ruling elite and their information control department, the universities.  The \

won't be able to stop this ever growing wave of future bringers.

The laws of the universe seem to be rather simple and straight forward.  Not doubly complex like Einstein's plagiarized theories.  And once we get back to studying the Aether, we will find so many simple solutions, that we will collectively shout Uuf-Da!

It really will be a bright future.

If you have an energy producing idea, do not try to patent it.  Besides alerting the \

to your presence, it is also the stupidest waste of time you can do.

Free energy needs to be free.  And there are a lot of futurists that will be coming up with similar ideas, at similar times. (the Wright Brothers only beat others powered flight builders by weeks)

The \
plans are to control access to information, and keep you in the dark. Instead, we must distribute our ideas as fast and as wide as possible.\n\n

>\n
All images in this post are my own original creations.

body.title: Чехія може запровадити виплати українкам для покращення демографії
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdpcgPmCcy49nwzei6tHB9GscxVHBkNsRo2ezxKwuJqp8/image)

Чеські експерти пропонують задля боротьби з рекордно низькою народжуваністю надати українкам із тимчасовим захистом доступ до державної батьківської допомоги. 

Громадяни Чехії отримують виплати одному з батьків дитини віком до 3 років у сумі близько 350 тис. крон (понад €14 тис). Українки з тимчасовим захистом цієї допомоги наразі не отримують. На думку фахівців, фінансове заохочення настільки численної групи жінок репродуктивного віку може істотно покращити демографічну ситуацію.

Довідка:
За даними Євростату та МВС Чехії, на кінець 2025 року загальна кількість громадян України (включно з довгостроковими резидентами, робітниками, сім’ями, легалізованими до війни) становить ≈ 650 000. Це найбільша група серед усіх іноземців.
Серед них ≈ 400 тис. перебувають під тимчасовим захистом. Частка жінок складає близько 44% (≈180 тис.)

body.title: Reflections on a Graduation
body.body:
I am babysitting this weekend, not for this lovely young girl,

![bear j.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/245TJbQnT9JE26vyiNLA5zogUrdCptuu85YRxY2AdPxC935PsVuuzUpTWUasmtGh7UfmB.jpg)

but rather for this very cute young boy.  Here he is looking at my iPad.  He is watching a video of dogs barking.  Yes, I shamelessly let him have screen time. 



![a. vid.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23vhz7UJi2Ct3nPt4FQenApS5SgzttQc4wCowyJfNdjtUkzxMKz1uuJjZejbHVN7AALbB.png)

The reason I'm babysitting is because the sweet child, my granddaughter, pictured at the top of the page, is graduating from college on Sunday.  Much as we hoped we could see this child celebrate, we cannot make the trip.  We will be watching a live stream from our home.

We're not upset. We have said for years we'd like to be around for my granddaughter's college graduation, and we're here. I'm so proud of her. Many years we babysat for her.  Neither time nor distance can take that away. 

Here is a picture of me with my granddaughter when we were in Washington D.C. together. This was in 2014--I was 67 and my granddaughter was 9.  My daughter had a work weekend (she was a dancer) and I went along to babysit.  We had plenty of time to tour.


![dc me and J.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23zkkBmg7SrXriq757kDcMpPJanLBbshhkXctGVc4sWBekmy2n9RE31RRqP4qY8tgKjTy.jpg)



Here is another shot of us on that trip.  I think we were at the Smithsonian when this picture was taken.

![j me dc.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/241tVHNoEamf1dFiWYZwLfbtYB5bQLiY1cnB89EvwRRBNHFJRTWcdJmJNNpcC9uvsz62V.jpg)
Finally, another shot of us in D.C.  I think you can see here what a close relationship we had.

![me j dc 2014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23yd1Z89GGYRgDxsowo86PxBuxzLemjAWjzZstwLuCGH6VmSaVtHhJNLvaPWvS1Z57KJa.jpg)

 As we babysit for the dog this weekend, we also continue our obligation to his sibling:



![eli crazy.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23wWvohwQ34T8g6Boe5WQUvBhjd1SqtKKVTw9KiUKuYVowfCiqrymspa1wGo44EWq2v4D.jpg)
While the cat and the dog are less combative than they used to be, still the cat has disdain for the dog. Rightfully so, I must admit. From time to time the dog will mistake the cat for a toy and pounce. The dog weighs probably 70 pounds.  The cat weighs maybe 5, maybe not that much.  So, whenever the dog is around, the cat will seek refuge behind my husband's chair or, as you see in this picture, on my husband's chair.  There he will sit and even sleep for a very long time.  

This cat has been a part of my granddaughter's life since she was a very little girl.  Here is a picture from 2010--16 years ago. My granddaughter is 21 now, so she must have been 5.  The cat, you see, looks just about the same. These days he makes it from the floor to the back of my husband's chair with one leap.  He shows no signs of age, no hint of slowing down.

![eli j 2010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23uFTyY2JjBemKWwnuUNWgaAumyhHtsizhPikDp1SjJ8P1NRMrsvVoNapzsWySTWj6F4C.jpg)


My granddaughter grew up with animals. They were her siblings and she learned to love them. Her career choice is related to that love.  She wants to become an occupational therapist, but her secondary ambition is to work in animal rehabilitation.  All her pets were rescues, including this frisky elderly cat.  The cat was a tiny kitten that had somehow managed to wedge itself in a car engine.  My daughter was called by a neighbor to extract it.

In the picture below you see a dog that grew up with my granddaughter.   This dog had been traumatized emotionally but eventually healed. This sweet animal passed away two years ago.

![j and k sleeping.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23u6Hm9kgv5CL8vwhsvfmCC1a2x5iCKXymGHHvXesYSRYyS7YSCUg8ixzWBFdHrn5B8n5.jpg)


Here is another cat that was rescued from a car engine (when an animal was in distress, neighbors in my old neighborhood would call my daughter). This animal was injured badly because the car had driven a bit before the driver realized the cat was trapped. Loud meowing was the alert. Notice this cat holds her paw up.  That's because one leg was permanently damaged. She was never strong enough to undergo an operation for amputation.  She was also a little dim witted. You can see that in her eyes, I think. 

![rosie table.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/2432BTNJ4oU1RGkre4J7rEPce5BsyjiEHcVN6gy5FmJ3LzKKwKez1ufLUKy1dTvxJ8Eop.jpg)


Of course, we didn't just babysit for my granddaughter while she was maturing. We were also a kind of escape valve for mother and daughter. In middle school, for example, we pitched in.  Middle school is a tough time for most kids.  In this case, my daughter was working several jobs and simply didn't have the time she needed to help with homework and all the other things that arise. 

Every day either my husband or I would pick up my granddaughter from school and take her to the library to do homework.  Inevitably, as we drove to the library, she would ask us to stop at a local eatery and buy her a special snack.

We also went on vacation together at least once a year.  Here's my husband with my granddaughter as the two of them took a boat ride on Lake Placid (NY). 


![o and j lake placid.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/245wKfRbDrA6GZrq4WCanLd1QrY5Eez5UP7D6g5uNesPj25pT8UpTLaSA2ey92R2Bvxou.jpg)

Here I am with my granddaughter on the same trip. You might notice that I'm often carrying an umbrella if the sun is bright.  I have serious issues with the sun so I always carry protection when I'm out in bright sunshine.  Also, it looks like that might be a map I'm holding.  I love maps.  Maps of buildings, parks, cities.  I just like them.  
![j me lake placid.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23v4TKXYmrBx77gvH5KmXHvbuCptW7ZesKRUMHTpR3GTdvrkxP85fagP9hZrEufH79JS8.jpg)

I'm not someone who appreciates big celebrations.  I like things simple.  I don't like dressing up for special occasions.  I don't like a fuss at all.  However, sometimes we need to stop and punctuate our experience with a special day, a special moment.  We have done that with my granddaughter.  

Of course, it's my daughter who makes the days special for her child.  We are the support team, in the background, ready to reinforce whatever course she chooses.

Throughout my granddaughter's childhood we were there for birthdays...not at the party, but before and after to help prepare and clean up.  Here's the picture of a birthday cake, apparently celebrating a sixth birthday (count the candles!)
![dc me j.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EoErw9MuATxP5kpz648ReWZ6m5RPLLPrp6zi5gAeH9BVhqAcUyTz2tt1t6ezPCjTJQG.JPG)


We were there in the waiting room when she had an operation on her thumbs.
![thumbs.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EonkzgN9ikFNrMHiXx2x5kkH4W15sQrjSNgwc42Yvkfz8vmMNuCBUVELikvyRG2yu9K.jpg)

It's an interesting experience, being a grandparent.  There is a supporting role, although the commitment may be absolute.  A grandparent should be ready for whatever is needed, and yet that grandparent should be unobtrusive, keep a low profile. Never offer advice, unless it is solicited or unless the situation is dire. Be useful, but almost invisible, except when needed and wanted. 

Maybe people will disagree with my idea of a grandparent's role, but it's worked for us.  I think we have the perfect grandparent/grandchild relationship.

We won't be there Sunday, but we are sending a symbolic gift.  My husband's parents were both immigrants from Ireland. This means my granddaughter is 1/4 Irish.  I often talk about my Italian heritage. And she is very aware of her Puerto Rican heritage (her father's family is Puerto Rican).  We don't really talk very much about her Irish ancestry.

So, we are giving her a small St. Brigid's cross. In this way my granddaughter will have a sense of legacy, an awareness about an important part of her background. Also, she will have a positive token, something that represents the love and care her family will always have for her.  The legend of St. Brigid's cross is that it protects those who wear it from [evil, fire and hunger.](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EoErw9MuATxP5kpz648ReWZ6m5RPLLPrp6zi5gAeH9BVhqAcUyTz2tt1t6ezPCjTJQG.JPG) I certainly hope that is true.  

![necklace j.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23xATv16XEBZ485zKwNmqtAzMvKNucnZB5TBQhmX1jC5sbLVkt1vGHhpQF9meuaWvbPKx.jpg)

body.title: La Dignidad de la Mujer. Esencia, Valor y el Camino hacia la Libertad Plena
body.body: > Agradezco profundamente la iniciativa de @emiliorios por abrir este espacio al crecimiento humano, permitiéndonos priorizar lo verdaderamente esencial en la estructura de la mujer. Promover su dignidad no es solo una tarea social, sino una necesidad vital para el desarrollo de la humanidad. > I am deeply grateful for the initiative of @emiliorios and for the opportunity to carry out this work for the benefit of human growth, prioritising the truly human element that resides within the very fabric of womanhood. To promote the dignity of women is not merely a social task; it is a vital necessity for the development of humanity. ---

>

La Mujer como Promotora del Sistema Social

Percibo la dignidad femenina como una fecundidad racional. Desde la perspectiva actual, la mujer se proyecta como la transformadora radical y promotora vital del sistema social. Sin su presencia activa, es imposible concebir el crecimiento de la personalidad, la sociedad, el Estado o sus instituciones.

> Women as the Catalyst of the Social System

I perceive a woman’s dignity as a form of rational fecundity. From a contemporary perspective, women are projected as radical transformers and the vital promoters—quite literally—of the social system. Without them, there can be no growth of personality, society, the State, or its institutions.

Aunque no me considero un investigador acucioso, observo en el tejido social una ebullición necesaria: la urgencia de compartir los privilegios de la distribución del trabajo, el estudio y la profesionalización. La meta es una sana coherencia basada en la equidad y la justicia social, donde la mujer participe activamente en la planificación y control de la economía y la política con una sabia ponderación.

> Whilst I do not claim to be a meticulous researcher of historical evolution, I perceive a brewing \

within the social fabric: an urgent need to share the privileges of labour distribution, education, and professionalisation. The goal is a healthy coherence based on equity, equality, and social justice, where women actively participate in the planning, administration, and oversight of the economy and political systems with wise deliberation.

El Quiebre de los Paradigmas Arcaicos

Al observar la historia, vemos los cimientos de una arquitectura de opresión. Durante siglos, la mujer irrumpió con paso leve por los acontecimientos, relegada a la labor sumisa y doméstica bajo los patrones del patriarcado. Hoy, ella está transformando esos paradigmas arcaicos, creando plataformas que activan su independencia real.

Su participación en la producción social fuera del hogar le otorga una visión de libertad en la lucha política y económica. Es su forma de expresar disconformidad ante la opresión que recaía sobre sus hombros mediante el trabajo doméstico no remunerado (limpieza, crianza, cuidados). Al salir a trabajar a la par del hombre, la mujer deja de ser un objeto condicionado para convertirse en un sujeto activo de su destino.

> Breaking Archaic Paradigms

> When observing the course of history, we see the foundations of a peak architecture of oppression. For centuries, women moved with light footsteps through events, held as \

and confined to submissive domestic roles within the patterns of patriarchy. Today, women are dismantling these archaic paradigms, creating innovative platforms that activate their genuine independence.\n\n> By participating in social production outside the home, women gain an active role and a vision of freedom in the political and economic struggle. This is their way of expressing dissent against the extreme oppression and violence that fell upon the female condition, which bore the weight of the entire family on its shoulders. Through the rejection of unpaid domestic toil (cleaning, upbringing, caregiving), women move beyond being \

and step out to work alongside men as equals in the community.

Un Enfoque Global y Humano

La dignidad no es plena si solo beneficia a grupos selectos. La libertad pertenece a quien piensa diferente, sin discriminación. En este sentido, es loable que organismos como la ONU recojan el sentimiento de empoderamiento, promoviendo el acceso a mercados financieros, la propiedad de la tierra y la gerencia corporativa.

Asimismo, marcos legales internacionales como la Convención de Belém do Pará son fundamentales para erradicar la violencia y proteger su integridad física y psicológica, requisito previo para cualquier libertad real. La democracia no puede llamarse tal sin la participación paritaria en los parlamentos y sin infraestructuras públicas que alivien la carga del cuidado, permitiendo a la mujer integrarse eficientemente al mercado laboral.

> A Global and Humanistic Framework

> Dignity is not full if it only benefits select social groups. Freedom and dignity belong to all who think differently, without discrimination. It is interesting to see how the UN captures this sentiment of empowerment by promoting women's access to financial markets, land ownership, and corporate management.

> Furthermore, international legal frameworks (such as the Belém do Pará Convention or CEDAW) are essential to protecting the physical and psychological integrity of women as a prerequisite for their dignity. Democracy is not true democracy without women; therefore, the promotion of parity quotas in parliaments and governments is essential, as is the creation of public infrastructure (childcare, healthcare systems) to relieve women of the \

>

---

La Dimensión Espiritual 

Es imperativo traer a colación el aporte de Joaquín Trincado, quien describe a la mujer históricamente como la \

. Su propuesta de libertad plena reconoce una doble opresión: la económica y la dogmática-religiosa.

Educación Integral: La mujer debe recibir la misma instrucción científica y filosófica que el hombre. La libertad nace del conocimiento y de la erradicación de la ignorancia.

Responsabilidad Colectiva: La crianza y el cuidado no deben ser un fardo individualista que \

a la mujer al hogar, sino una responsabilidad comunitaria que libere sus hombros.

> The Spiritual Dimension

> It is essential to bring forward the spiritual and theoretical contribution of Joaquín Trincado, who demands an end to slavery. He describes womanhood as having been the \

. His proposal for full liberation begins by acknowledging that women have been doubly oppressed: by the economic system and by religious/patriarchal structures.

> Integral Education: Women must receive the same scientific and philosophical education as men. Freedom, according to Trincado, is born from knowledge and the elimination of ignorance (especially that imposed by religious dogmas).

> Collective Responsibility: Trincado argues that women must not be \
to the individualistic home. Raising and caring for children should be understood as a collective responsibility, shifting the weight from the individual woman to the community. ---

> --- El Termómetro de la Civilización Para concluir me suscribo la promoción del empoderamiento como un hecho profundamente civilizatorio. Si la mujer no es libre, el hombre tampoco podrá serlo, pues ambos constituyen las dos mitades de una misma unidad humana. La libertad real solo será posible cuando el acceso a la subsistencia no dependa de tutelas ni explotaciones. Es fundamental integrar a la mujer —en pensamiento, carne y hueso— en todas las esferas creativas y productivas, garantizando igualdad de mando y eliminando brechas digitales. > The Thermometer of Civilisation > I subscribe to the promotion of empowerment and dignity as a profoundly civilising historical fact. If a woman is not free, a man cannot be free either, for both are two halves of a single human unit. Real freedom will only be possible when access to the means of subsistence no longer depends on male guardianship or wage exploitation It is fundamental to integrate women—in thought, flesh, and bone—into all spheres of productive and creative work, ensuring equal pay, opportunity, and leadership. Finalmente, la libertad plena requiere tiempo para la esencia: tiempo para el arte, la política, la ciencia y la recreación. La mujer tiene el derecho absoluto de vivir en paz, asistida por el dominio de amar y ser amada en un equilibrio saludable de amor personal, familiar y social. Su valor y su esencia encuentran su apoyo moral en este avance cualitativo, logrando sostenerse con dignidad a través del curso de la historia. > Finally, full liberation requires time for the essence: time for art, politics, science, and recreation. A woman has the absolute right to live in peace, empowered by the healthy choice to love and be loved within personal, family, and community circles. Her value and essence find their moral support in this qualitative advancement, achieving a dignity sustained through historical development. En sintonía con la libertad y la dignidad de la mujer. > QuoteIn harmony with the freedom and dignity of women.

>

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hiramdo/EowFCWZ665utq8RamW9y9CL7SuChDXnwAtvaBpXvWMXJC5tb54QoTN6K7oZacPYdGVr.png)

body.title: Potted plants (mixed media colors on paper)
body.body:
Hello hivers, an happy Friday to you all! The weekend is just around the corner and even if it's a warm day the sky over my city is full of clouds. I cross my fingers to have a good weather in the next days, so we can enjoy our free time outside. Looking for the right inspiration for a new artwork, today I decided to use some scraps of paper I painted days ago to create a scene, just to understand if it could work on one of my painting. It's an exercise for my imagination I love to do from time to time. It's fun, useful and I like to take pics of the scenes I created to share them around. The scene I created today is the following one: ![DSCN0157.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoeHkQtvaszNrrmK3wxxuW7b45D9nKUucm5EnnUNYHLZK3b8QEkswMDcNeUT56edFvh.JPG) Days ago I painted some scraps of paper using the acrylic colors. I didn't know what I can do with them, but this morning, searching a good idea for a new artwork of mine, I cut them in form of pots for plants and I added some dots, stripes and tiny figures. I cut also some plants and I like the final result, so I'll paint a similar scene on the head of my next women portrait! ❤️ As usual, I took some pics while I was working on the different parts of the scenes so you can see the process too: ![DSCN0152.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eos2FGidpsEwMhSKNrsUZV2Q9BMwhLzwNWwRdN9RFuNsK6EtNTczBq4ybv5gDVSdLZN.JPG) ![DSCN0153.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EowH1tsUeWe8aq9fefwcMfgR3xg8eob2Ku8cPWc6SSAbB2eGiKtBzHhKKedsBGBXfyn.JPG) ![DSCN0154.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoyQ1ddrWcU282dR7k6zs37EuUDpE3SR36KnMH7ZfzfG1oKirq6KM5o3khUz1gccK1f.JPG) ![DSCN0155.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eoc8XheffGPWmC245GT9WNDMPABwf5iUHd7naaCNRkoii9w54Ba4cTz3chkV4M2cPZJ.JPG) I hope you like it and I wish you a wonderful weekend! See ya soon and stay safe, Silvia

今天过去军训就三天了，四舍五入也算四分之一了，但我怎么感觉我今天就熬不住了呢？😭

昨天学校大发慈悲，批准我们穿自己的鞋军训了，我也是受到赦免了，前两天的训练程度压根算不上大，可是最大的压力不是来自训练而是来自于发的那双鞋，专门买了鞋垫子垫完后还都是硬邦邦的，就跟踩在一条又细又硬的橡胶条上一样，昨天一整天都疼个没的麻木了，今天换了自己的鞋之后痛觉就压不住了，反复闹腾，下午吃完饭之后晚训的时候我是一点也站不住了。

训了50分钟之后。总算一直休息到8点半，然后解散了，哎，说来也奇怪，我打下这行文字的时候，解散这会脚就不疼了，真是怪哉怪哉。

我好累啊，不知道为什么。可是明明这三天作息这么规律，我觉得这个睡眠也比我之前上课的时候要充分很多了。为什么就是很累呢？早上就睁不开眼，晚上这会更累啊。而且军训的时候还不能仅仅只是军训，还要负责补前面的作业。补还没有学会的知识。还有各种各样没有任何意义的，不知道任何指向的，最终我反正自己做不了让AI完成的什么乱七八糟的小作业，大作业，小组作业……全部都得搞掉。

身心俱疲啊！

下午5点解散，7点开训，中间吃完饭还有一个多小时。然后这点时间也不够睡觉，也不够休息，我决定去练习我的太极，正好也消化消化。

我就自己去食堂旁边的小树林里的小道上，找了个b站的视频跟着练习。我觉得非常有效，对我的帮助挺大的，今天已经学会了前六七式了，我估计后面也就四五天就学会全部了吧。反正我是准备一定要学会的，体育老师上次那么搞我，我对她的印象已经非常非常恶劣了，已经不打算以特别饱满，特别热情的态度去对待她了，爱咋咋地吧。

那现在我们已经大学生了，已经是一个成年人了，我们的关系我觉得我就现实一点对付也未尝不可。我既然能从别的地方学到东西。那脱离你的帮助也未尝不可，我觉得自己有能力去学习而不仰仗某些老师的话，反正我对我自己挺自豪的。

body.body: @shortsegments, the strength is practical resilience: your model avoids “everyone must sign right now” bottlenecks and uses Hive’s 3-day HBD savings delay as a real veto window, which is smart for emergency response in your [HCB proposal](https://inleo.io/@shortsegments/shared-key-model-for-business-treasury-security-on-hive-8xg?referral=shortsegments). The weakness is obvious but serious: shared active keys mean any custodian can act, so the system relies heavily on human trust, identity, monitoring, and fast cancellation. Compared with threshold-signature custody like the Maya example described by [@leofinance](https://inleo.io/@leofinance/how-to-add-liquidity-to-maya-protocol-liquidity-pools), this is simpler and more Hive-native, but less cryptographically strict. My take: good for a small transparent treasury, risky for a large one unless paired with public alerts, documented procedures, and regular keyholder audits.

body.body: @shortsegments, the strongest part is the framing: borrowing against HIVE instead of selling preserves upside, avoids forced taxable sales, and the simple fee model is easy to understand in your [HCB proposal](https://inleo.io/@shortsegments/how-to-borrow-against-your-hive-without-ever-selling-it-8cn?referral=shortsegments). The weakness is custody/risk: “the bank never sells” sounds comforting, but someone still controls collateral, liquidation policy, oracle pricing, defaults, and emergency governance. Your follow-up on the [shared key security model](https://inleo.io/@shortsegments/shared-key-model-for-business-treasury-security-on-hive) helps, but I’d tighten the proposal with hard rules for collateral ratio, margin calls, who can cancel withdrawals, bad-debt handling, and borrower disclosures. Also: don’t oversell the “no taxes” angle — tax treatment depends on jurisdiction, and that sentence is where lawyers start sharpening knives.

body.title: scrolling playlists at 9pm
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778198783-245884e70a0d.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/ansley/seed-ansley-2026-05-08/main-1-1778198783-245884e70a0d.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

There's this pocket of time after dinner when the house gets quiet and I find myself reaching for my phone without really thinking about it. Tonight I was stretched out on the couch, that cream linen draping over me like I'd melted into the cushions, just browsing through playlists while some concert played on the screen in front of me. The TV was doing its thing—all those stage lights and energy I wasn't quite ready to commit to—but my attention kept drifting to my phone instead.

I think that's the thing about music now. It's so easy to have it everywhere that sometimes you forget to actually sit with it. You're reading reviews, checking what your friends are listening to, adding songs to seven different lists you'll probably never revisit. The phone becomes this strange middle ground between the music itself and whatever else you're supposed to be doing.

But then I picked up my guitar, and it was like the phone just fell away. No algorithm, no endless scroll. Just the weight of the wood, the feel of the strings under my fingers, and whatever came out. The candle on the table flickered, there was wine sitting there getting warmer, headphones draped nearby like they'd given up competing for my attention. For a while it was just me and the guitar and the actual, physical act of making something.

I think I needed that reminder. That sometimes the best playlists are the ones you create without thinking, just by playing. No interface required.

body.body: My wife and I are both non-affiliated employees, so we don't have to deal with all the union stuff.  Which is sometimes good, but sometimes bad.  In the past we would ask for say a 7% raise and they would say, we are only giving the union a 3% raise, so that is what you are getting.  Nevermind the fact people in the union were already making 10% more than us anyway.  They have been better about it lately.  I don't think I would want to be in the union anyway.  For example, we have an administrators union that I could technically be part of, and in the past the person who had my wife's job before her was in the union.  However, there was a time where they needed to say to the public they cut an administrator, so that guy got booted and my wife got his job.  It's a dangerous position to be in if you don't have numbers to protect you.  I probably didn't explain it really well, but I didn't want this to become a book.

body.title: Why People Reply “I’m Fine” When They’re Not
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeZ8RBjNschZLQxkfAfw3j1Bth8yGTKku9Nm2mJKA8RhU/img_4042.png)

In today’s world, “I’m fine” has become more than just a phrase. It’s a mask. A quick response. A shield people use to hide what they truly feel inside.

Someone asks, “How are you?”
And almost automatically, the answer comes:
“I’m fine.”

But many times, they are not.

Behind those two simple words can be stress, loneliness, anxiety, heartbreak, pressure, or exhaustion. Yet people still choose to hide it. Why? Because opening up feels difficult in a world where everyone seems busy, distracted, or silently fighting their own battles.

Sometimes people say “I’m fine” because they don’t want to become a burden. They fear that if they speak honestly, others may not understand—or worse, may not care. It feels easier to smile, nod, and move on rather than explain the storm happening in their mind.

For some, it becomes a habit. They’ve hidden their emotions for so long that they no longer know how to express them. They convince themselves that staying silent is strength. But silence often becomes heavier over time.

Social media also plays a big role. Every day we see people posting happy moments, achievements, and perfect pictures. Slowly, many start believing they must appear strong and positive all the time. Admitting sadness feels like weakness, even though it’s one of the most human things possible.

There’s also the fear of judgment. People worry they’ll be called “too emotional,” “dramatic,” or “negative.” So instead of speaking honestly, they keep everything locked inside and continue saying, “I’m fine.”

But the truth is, nobody is okay all the time.

Even the strongest-looking people have moments when they feel lost. Even the happiest smiles can hide pain. That’s why kindness matters more than we realize. A genuine “Are you really okay?” can sometimes mean everything to someone who has been silently struggling.

Listening matters too. Not every person needs advice. Sometimes they just need someone who will sit beside them and truly hear them without judging.

And if you are someone who keeps saying “I’m fine” when you’re not, remember this: opening up does not make you weak. It makes you human.

Maybe the world would feel a little lighter if people stopped pretending they were okay all the time—and started being honest about what they carry inside.

Hay sabores que nos regresan al pasado, que nos regresan a lugares y momentos; porque registramos el mundo a través de todos nuestros sentidos, y los recuerdos son mucho más que imágenes, mucho más que simples fotografías instantáneas guardadas en el archivo de la memoria. 

El mes pasado, unos días después de mi cumpleaños @gerneth96 y yo nos aventuramos por las calles de Villa Crespo, en Buenos Aires en busca de una pizzería estilo venezolano que ya habíamos visto en redes sociales. Y aunque en el trayecto pasaron cosas desagradables (unos carteristas intentaron robarnos en el bus) no permitimos que esas cosas dañaran nuestro paseo. 

El lugar muy lindo y la atención estupenda y rápida. Lo primero que distingue estás  pizzas son sus bordes que tienen relleno de queso estilo venezolano, pero también tienen otras variaciones. Habíamos querido ir en diciembre cuando hicieron una pizza edición especial coningredientes de pan de jamón, pero no tuvimos oportunidad. 

Pedimos una \

con borde relleno de queso llanero y tocineta, y con ingredientes que incluían tocineta, maíz y champiñones. Buenos Aires tiene muy buenas pizzas, con muchísimas variaciones, distintos tipos de masas, distintos estilos y precios, Pero esta si sabía distinto, si sabía a las pizzas de mi juventud, a las pizzas de Venezuela. Quizá fue la combinación de ingredientes o el queso llanero de los bordes, quizá fue la sugestión del marquetin de \

, pero en definitiva fue un hermoso viaje internacional en el tiempo. 

La cerveza artesanal si es una experiencia que siempre asociaré a este país, pues en Venezuela nunca probé este tipo de cervezas, así que fue una increíble mezcla para formar nuevos y maravillos recuerdos.

body.title: Dzień siedemdziesiąty
body.body:
I tak dobiliśmy do dziesięciu tygodni. Siedemdziesiąt dni, z czego trzydzieści zawieszenia broni. Po dziesięciu tygodniach nic nie zostało rozwiązane, a nowe problemy i przeszkody pojawiają się praktycznie codziennie. Iran militarnie poniósł ciężkie straty, ale do zniszczenia jego zdolności jest bardzo daleko. Reżim trzyma się mocno, mimo rosnących problemów wewnętrznych i poważnego przetrzebienia szeregów.

Warto było, zdecydowanie.

- Dziś w nocy doszło do kolejnego starcia w Cieśninie Ormuz. Według USA, trzy amerykańskie niszczyciele zostały zaatakowane przez irańską marynarkę. Atak został odparty, a Irańczycy mieli ponieść ciężkie straty. Iran twierdzi z kolei, że Stany Zjednoczone złamały zawieszenie broni, atakując irański tankowiec i ostrzeliwując cele cywilne na wyspie Keszm. Według irańskiego dowództwa, okręty amerykańskie zostały poważnie uszkodzone i wycofały się z Cieśniny.

- Irańskie dowództwo poinformowało, że po nocnym starciu z Amerykanami 5 irańskich marynarzy zostało uznanych za zaginionych. Niedawno pojawiły się informacje, że ciało jednego z nich zostało już odnalezione.

- Obie strony ogłosiły oczywiście wielkie zwycięstwo oraz to, że w zasadzie nic się nie stało, sytuacja wróciła już do normy a zawieszenie broni nadal obowiązuje.

- Ministerstwo Obrony Zjednoczonych Emiratów Arabskich poinformowało, że obrona przeciwlotnicza kraju zestrzeliła dziś 2 pociski balistyczne i 3 drony wystrzelone z Iranu. W ataku zostały ranne trzy osoby. Teheran póki co nie skomentował tej wiadomości.

- Iran poinformował, że przejął w Zatoce Omańskiej pływający pod banderą Barbadosu tankowiec Ocean Koi. W komunikacie podano, że statek przewoził irańską ropę, i tym samym \

. Nie podano żadnych dodatkowych szczegółów.

- Marco Rubio powiedział, że Stany Zjednoczone spodziewają się irańskiej odpowiedzi na propozycję umowy pokojowej jeszcze dzisiaj.

body.title: Under The Sugar We Buy: Forced Hysterectomies And Exploitation Of Women In India’s Cane Fields
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23wC7dUSh59iko7ogx1jZNcZu9YkpZhHvquZTH1vKz9uBEhpqPCtnZ6kodKVr1ftCvVmc.png)
> *Credits: Indiaego*

When we pick up a bag of cane sugar at the supermarket we usually look at a few things like the price, maybe the brand, and at most whether it is “organic” or not, choosing it over regular sugar because it is said to be less harmful. But no one thinks about (or more likely no one knows) what is behind the people who harvested that sugar cane and especially what has been asked of certain women in order to keep working in those places.

And this is what I discovered while reading about the female workers in Maharashtra, India. Extremely poor women who work in sugar cane plantations in conditions that are close to slavery: waking up at three in the morning, shifts of 10 to 12 hours under the sun, for less than 4 pounds a day… all of this for six consecutive months involving huge numbers of people, also coming from far away. Not only women, but unfortunately many girls are forced to start working as early as 10 or 12 years old and are married at that age, so they can follow their husbands into the fields.

Even this is already a tragedy and an injustice, but the worst part is still ahead. These women and girls are forced to work in any physical condition, whether it is pregnancy, a recent miscarriage or menstruation, not even a single day of rest is allowed, under penalty of having to pay a fine to the contractor. And this is where we reach the rotten core of this story, something hard even to imagine and that leaves you in disbelief: thousands of women are more or less forced into undergoing a hysterectomy, meaning the removal of the uterus, in order to remove obstacles to productivity.

According to some local investigations by The Guardian and Envoyé spécial, in the Beed district 36 percent of sugar cane workers no longer have a uterus. The national average in India is around 3 percent. In some villages the percentage even exceeds 50 percent. More than 13,000 women are estimated to have undergone this procedure in the last decade, many under 40 and some even under 25.

The shocking part is how these women are deceived into undergoing these operations. Many women report going to doctors for infections, menstrual pain or minor cysts and being told that the “best” solution was to completely remove the uterus. All of this because missing workdays means debt, fines and reduced wages. The physical and psychological consequences after these procedures are easy to imagine.

And honestly I find it disturbing how all of this is perceived as normal within certain economic systems, because we are not talking about an isolated case, but about a model in which the female body becomes something to be modified when it slows down profit.

We need to spread awareness and make it known that behind such a common product there are women forced to choose between their own bodies and survival, and if any of us want to try to make a difference and change something, the only solution is that when we are in front of supermarket shelves choosing this product, we choose something with Fairtrade certification, otherwise this cycle will never break and thousands of future women will continue to suffer.

***References:** https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2025/jun/12/outrage-as-sugar-cane-workers-in-india-still-being-pushed-into-having-hysterectomies*

body.body: The conclusion of your post summarizes your position on this topic into a good one. No matter what blanket name we choose to assign to students' performances, there will always be those who will make it a big deal and utilize it as a tool for shaming others successfully. This includes fellow students, parents and teachers.\n\nSo the work has to be done on our collective mindest towards failure and success. The way we speak on these things should matter. More importantly, our encouragement to both an A and F student should be a priority. That way, no student gets to feel too poorly about themselves or thinks that these grades or remarks defines them.

body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYkRkpaXrtg6r6rs9zjkCzdZeKKnXhUBaVZo3tr4s6232/1000181762.jpg 
[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/solar-panels-roof-solar-cell_21520477.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=0&uuid=7005fb89-5309-44cd-b3bc-43175f3afe38&query=Solar+energy+systems+AI+generated+) 
When focus [switches](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-switch-settlement), so does [money](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-money) direction also switch. Before getting back there, there was a [time](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) I asked myself, how soon until the [cement](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-cement) [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business) gets obsolete. Does my  assumptions look weird? We have to understand that several [industries](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-industry) have gone obsolete already. Anytime I enter the timber market (building materials markets for those that may not understand) the place is always very busy.   

I would always be wondering why. One thing I failed to analyze was the fact that we are first living in a developing country and the demand of urbanization is growing. Population is increasing to start with and well, people are not just interested in any [building](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-building-structure) but standards. From [security](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-security) concerns, building is entering another phase.  

Actually, this wasn't the topic of discussion but there is a connection anyway. In this [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article), we will be looking at a new [energy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-energy-industry) system that is going to put [profit](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-profit) in the bags of [companies](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-company-business) and individuals affiliated to this sector.  

[energy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-energy) has become a big concern. We are faced with poor general [electricity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-electricity) circulation [month](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-month) in months out. Adding to that, the [cost](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-cost) of running a generator is very high while also, the [prices](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-price) to sustain prepaid or estimated bills are inconvenient.   

[entrepreneurs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-entrepreneur) and households are facing the same fate. Consider the fact that you may have some beverages to preserve. We have entered the era of advanced kitchens to start with. Ovens, blender, extractors, freezers, electric cookers and many other [Kitchen](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-kitchen) equipment to add.    
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmX1LqUZBNDh5g6N5i5F6X7EzSDFXYcQEHuaxAado11SUY/1000181764.jpg 
[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-ai-image/photovoltaic-solar-power-panel-field-green-clean-alternative-power-energy-concept-ai-generative_41199717.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=31&uuid=1eb73b46-ed99-45b6-8494-4368850f858f&query=Solar+energy+systems+AI+generated+) 
Turning to entrepreneurs, energy is needed for efficient and effective [work](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-work) [delivery](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-delivery). Everything [NOW](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-negotiable-order-of-withdrawal-account-now) in an office is almost running with electricity. A conducive business environment is very mandatory to start with when talking of professionalism in business. So what's the way out currently?  

Ok, the moment Aso Rock turned their focus to [solar](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-solar) and inverter energy systems I knew something was upcoming. This industry is NOW becoming a hot cake. One of my [customer](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-customer) told me last [year](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-year) he will be going for solar installation training because it has proven to be a hot cake and his analysis was on point. The last time I met him he said he has started going out for outside [jobs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-job) with the company he is working with.  

Personally, I am looking [forward](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-forward-financial) to switching for my business. It was something even my Dad is having eyes on to run his compound and well, planning of starting it with an solar [water](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-water) pumping machine system. It is a question of how soon until everyone adopts. If you are to ask me concerning the ‘how soon’, the current limitation is just [capital](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-capital) because everyone is ready for this switch.   

To conclude, let me add, Individuals and entrepreneurs alike are tired of the current energy fluctuations system plus the high bills. A new market is in the process opening up for solar companies (both [producers](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-producer-entertainment) and installers) to [leverage](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-leverage) for a very long period of time. The advantage over here is high, we have enough  daily sunlight to start with in this part of the [world](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-world). I think general electricity billers will start losing importance soonest and well, we know what that tilts to; massive redundancy. It is the normal market way I guess; ups and downs, especially when you don't know how to professionally coordinate your customers.

And [note](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-note), if I happen to be a financial adviser to you, the [TOP](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-top-currency) financial advice should be ‘DYOR’ (Do Your Own Research), I can't afford to break your heart
