body.body:
> Saludos cordiales, queridos amigos de Be Entrepreneur. Abro las puertas #ecency para reencontrarme con ustedes. Deseándoles amplias posibilidades de crecimiento. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSPMWKVUVkvNaTmVhHehRAmAweSwTHp4NzhbKrDUccnD1/1778165787292.jpg) [unsplash](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/retrato-de-una-joven-barista-sonriente-en-delantal-sosteniendo-un-letrero-abierto-mientras-esta-de-pie-en-su-cafe-el-personal-femenino-de-la-elegante-cafeteria-asiatica-gira-la-placa-de-la-puerta-por-la-manana-en-la-pequena-empresa-de-la-tienda-propia-Jt7pioETCaw)
***

> Frecuentemente llegan por WhatsApp informaciones sobre negocios privados promoviendo su tabla de ofertas y he tomado uno como ejemplo para mi publicación de hoy. El catálogo es de «Los Alquimistas SRL», una Mipyme que trabaja desde el Cerro, en La Habana, Cuba. Venden de todo: refresco, agua, jamonada, queso crema, pan, detergente, pasta dental, desodorante, cremas, pintura… un montón de cosas, la verdad. Pero lo que me llamó la atención no fue la cantidad de productos, sino cómo han entendido el mundo de las criptomonedas mejor que muchos que llevamos algún tiempo aquí. Ellos cobran en USDT, y eso es una lección Sí. «Los Alquimistas SRL» aceptan USDT (BEP20). Ojalá fuera HBD. A lo mejor habría que hablarles de Hive. Cuba es un país con inflación y devaluación constante, atar sus precios a una moneda estable como el dólar digital es un movimiento maestro. Mientras otros negocios pierden valor día tras día, este negocio protege su capital. ¿Y sabes qué es lo más interesante? Nosotros, que estamos en Hive, deberíamos prestar atención. No porque tengan que cambiar Hive por USDT (quién sabe, si, sí), sino porque ellos entendieron algo que es esencial: las criptomonedas resuelven problemas reales. En su caso, el problema es la pérdida de valor del peso cubano (pobre peso cubano, qué deprimido estás) ¿Podrían usar Hive? Claro, que sí. Hive es una moneda volátil. Su valor cambia cada día (en realidad su valor no es muy atractivo que digamos, aunque en estos días nos dio un alegrón fantástico que fue diluyéndose en un pozo de esperanza). Para un negocio que necesita precios estables y predecibles, el USDT es tal vez, más práctico. Obvio, eso no significa que Hive no tenga valor. Nosotros estamos acá porque creemos en la descentralización, en la comunidad y en construir ecosistema propio. Hive no es solo una moneda: es una red social, una plataforma de blogs, un lugar donde generamos ingresos creando contenido. Original. De calidad. «Los Alquimistas SRL», usan USDT para vender. Nosotros usamos Hive para crear. Son herramientas diferentes para necesidades diferentes. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXVyM5EaSxrfb9REsELF8vpwMeA2nWgNx6smg4VbHRqiq/1778165787363.jpg) [unsplash](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/monedas-redondas-de-plata-y-oro-yJpjLD3c9bU)
*** Este negocio demuestra tres cosas esenciales. 💱 Las criptomonedas ya están en la calle. No son solo para traders. Un negocio de barrio en La Habana las usa todos los días. ¡Albricias! 💱 La estabilidad tiene su lugar. No está mal usar USDT para transacciones diarias y guardar valor. Hive puede ser para ahorro e inversión a mediano plazo. 💱 El problema que resuelves define la herramienta. Si tu cliente necesita precios fijos, puedes usar una stablecoin. Si tu comunidad quiere construir ecosistema propio, Hive es el camino. Las criptomonedas están ganando terreno. Y nosotros, desde Hive, tenemos una ventaja: no solo transaccionamos, creamos. Generamos valor con cada post, cada voto, cada interacción. El ser humano llegó donde está gracias a la creación. Sostenemos, desde esta blockchain, el aire, primigenio y original de la creación. ¡Bravo! En eso seguimos. Desde la poesía, desde la ficción y el crecimiento personal. No dejes de incluir, las grandes iniciativas, los fantásticos encuentros, la ayuda al que llega. Creamos. Y crearemos. Ellos protegen su negocio con USDT. Nosotros construimos el futuro con Hive. > Warm greetings, dear friends of Be Entrepreneur. I'm opening the doors of #ecency to reconnect with you. Wishing you ample opportunities for growth. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSPMWKVUVkvNaTmVhHehRAmAweSwTHp4NzhbKrDUccnD1/1778165787292.jpg) [unsplash](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/retrato-de-una-joven-barista-sonriente-en-delantal-sosteniendo-un-letrero-abierto-mientras-esta-de-pie-en-su-cafe-el-personal-femenino-de-la-elegante-cafeteria-asiatica-gira-la-placa-de-la-puerta-por-la-manana-en-la-pequena-empresa-de-la-tienda-propia-Jt7pioETCaw)
***

>

I frequently receive messages via WhatsApp about private businesses promoting their sales catalogs, and I've chosen one as an example for today's post.

The catalog is from \

a micro, small, and medium-sized enterprise (MSME) operating out of Cerro, Havana, Cuba.

They sell everything: soda, water, ham, cream cheese, bread, detergent, toothpaste, deodorant, creams, paint… a ton of stuff, really.

But what caught my attention wasn't the quantity of products, but how they've grasped the world of cryptocurrencies better than many of us who have been here for a while.

They accept payment in USDT, and that's a lesson in itself.

Yes.

\

accepts USDT (BEP20).

I wish it were HBD. Perhaps we should tell them about Hive.

Cuba is a country with constant inflation and devaluation; tying its prices to a stable currency like the digital dollar is a masterstroke. 

While other businesses lose value day after day, this business protects its capital.

And you know what's most interesting?

We, who are in Hive, should pay attention.

Not because they have to exchange Hive for USDT (who knows, maybe they will), but because they understood something essential: cryptocurrencies solve real problems. In their case, the problem is the loss of value of the Cuban peso (poor Cuban peso, how depressed you are).

Could they use Hive? Of course, they could.

Hive is a volatile currency. Its value changes every day (actually, its value isn't very attractive, although these days it gave us a fantastic boost that quickly faded into a well of hope).

For a business that needs stable and predictable prices, USDT is perhaps more practical. Obviously, that doesn't mean Hive has no value.

We are here because we believe in decentralization, in community, and in building our own ecosystem.  Hive is not just a currency: it's a social network, a blogging platform, a place where we generate income by creating content. Original. High-quality.

\

uses USDT to sell. We use Hive to create. They are different tools for different needs. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXVyM5EaSxrfb9REsELF8vpwMeA2nWgNx6smg4VbHRqiq/1778165787363.jpg) [unsplash](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/monedas-redondas-de-plata-y-oro-yJpjLD3c9bU)
*** This business demonstrates three essential things. 💱 Cryptocurrencies are already out there. They're not just for traders. A neighborhood business in Havana uses them every day. Hooray! 💱 Stability has its place. Using USDT for daily transactions and storing value isn't a bad idea. Hive can be used for medium-term savings and investment. 💱 The problem you solve defines the tool. If your client needs fixed prices, you can use a stablecoin. If your community wants to build its own ecosystem, Hive is the way. Cryptocurrencies are gaining ground. And we, at Hive, have an advantage: we don't just transact, we create. We generate value with every post, every vote, every interaction. Humanity has reached where it is thanks to creation. From this blockchain, we sustain the very essence of creation. Bravo! That's what we continue to do. Through poetry, fiction, and personal growth. Don't forget to include great initiatives, fantastic encounters, and helping those who arrive. We create. body.title: Rumbo a la final - Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
Pasaron varios segundos, que más bien fueron eternos y allí anunciaron que la Banda ganadora era la Banda 17. El teatro se llenó de aplausos, gritos y a la vez una gran lluvia de papeles dorados para festejar. Dani quedó sin palabras —¿Ganamos?—Michelle lloro de la felicidad —¡LO LOGRAMOS! —gritó. Mientras que Lucas brincaba de la felicidad, ya que era la primera vez que avanzaba a una final y Stewie simplemente sonrió y levantó las manos. Del otro lado de la tarima estaba la Banda 9 muy triste, aun así se acercaron y los felicitaron, además se lo merecen añadió uno de esa banda. En ese momento ambas bandas terminaron abrazándose en medio del escenario mientras el público seguía celebrando, aunque nadie esperaba que la favorita del torneo quedara eliminada antes de la final. >Several seconds passed—which felt like an eternity—and then they announced that the winning band was Band 17. The theater erupted with applause, cheers, and a shower of gold confetti to celebrate. Dani was speechless—“Did we win?” Michelle cried with joy—“WE DID IT!” she shouted. Meanwhile, Lucas was jumping for joy, since it was the first time he’d made it to a final, and Stewie simply smiled and raised his hands. # >On the other side of the stage, Band 9 looked very sad, but they still came over and congratulated them. “You deserve it,” added one of the band members. At that moment, both bands ended up hugging each other in the middle of the stage while the audience continued to celebrate, even though no one expected the tournament favorite to be eliminated before the final. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQi6JN8KwFrxbBUhroP2xLDMYcy7rwVHmEd548AdZTDuQ/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/escenario-de-conciertos-dramaticos-con-espectaculo-de-luces-de-colores-30831640/) El organizador volvió a subir al escenario —¡Esta noche ha sido el mejor duelo de bandas, además una Banda 17 que acaba de demostrar que el corazón puede vencer a cualquiera— los aplausos seguían, hasta que en la pantalla principal apareció el logo del Concurso Nacional de Bandas, mostrando que la final será dentro de tres días! Todas las bandas estaban allí atentos a la información, donde la final estará dividida en tres fases. La primera será una presentación libre, la segunda tienen que tocar una composición original creada para la final y la última será una batalla en vivo donde el público y el jurado decidirán al campeón nacional. Además, este es el paso final para que una sola Banda pueda tener el título más importante del país. >The organizer returned to the stage—“Tonight was the best band battle yet, and Banda 17 just proved that heart can beat anyone”—the applause continued until the logo for the National Band Competition appeared on the main screen, announcing that the final will take place in three days! # >All the bands were there, paying close attention to the information: the final will be divided into three phases. The first will be a free performance; in the second, they must play an original composition created for the final; and the last will be a live battle where the audience and the jury will decide the national champion. Furthermore, this is the final step for a single band to claim the country’s most prestigious title. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQma3D6HnVnkDMD2vwNtXNbe4ebNgJLDfMkRqx8eMgYZDfM/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/el-hombre-tocando-la-guitarra-cantando-en-el-escenario-1613240/) Luego de esas palabras, la ceremonia continuó con una pequeña celebración en honor a todas las bandas, donde repartieron comida, bebida, música en vivo y allí todos se mezclaron. La banda 17 se reunió y Michelle comentó —Todavía falta la última batalla— Lucas todavía no podía crear lo que estaba pasando, pero Dani levantó un vaso. —Por la Banda 17 y rumbo a la gran final. >After those words, the ceremony continued with a small celebration in honor of all the bands, featuring food, drinks, and live music, and everyone mingled. Band 17 gathered, and Michelle remarked, “We still have one last battle to go.” Lucas still couldn’t quite wrap his head around what was happening, but Dani raised a glass. “Here’s to Band 17 and on to the grand finale.”
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

body.title: Among the Rhododendrons: A Woodland Walk
body.body:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23wCE1fEXNHdGqGYHWz1Cmy797mogvn4Nh4tWi7z7kqcxB9aJXrE91nfSXAMLsxPmNnRQ.jpg

It was quite a chilly morning as I revisited a place I’d only been to once before. This time, I decided to venture into the wood and try to do a circular walk. The last time I was here, I didn’t know the area, but I’m a little more knowledgeable now.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/EogMMRffywKMtFLjjdCeJyuqNDGx1d1wEWCS1mjGc6hTUwVwitgs5rNgaWtfxkrgX7B.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23xATcZMrHbLuMHkFUwMd2iBPAPxjY1ew5QCYrtR6hD5T2XutJbSDVTzybehZL54vYXBn.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23wqg8CGf5XBVC1F1pfJyyv9TzzG32SgxSpQJkZ5mAjHnE1rWc6sbaRd6HXgWfxUEeQbz.jpg

The wooded area looked quite dark and cold. It wasn’t very inviting, but once I got in there, the bright green leaves of a couple of trees lit the place up.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/243BcGw2f1r3DWLh5iaSx6AWFLRBD811QPtCTNti36ptJyg6mevfVHckQMf5MF7RrtfLw.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/EqquoX54MDWswNLbEkn1uJ4YfESkYHmoE9bsVc8Mjh8FeDUhxJzHnME17TS4QbXE7No.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23uQp4x6HNGijj3d6ULgZxhHnWnVpXqrnpj5JHa4eQ4HeNwGYBAGCVwX5FisWTQZ2wqBY.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/241Zk2DvmGXWFgVKCoBQT2xusBhV6ZF1hJxKp7FmK7dwG11sfEM6NUWWyLcJkPpZRF4iB.jpg

Once through the wood, I walked past the horses’ field and then past the derelict stone building. This took me to the outskirts of another wood, with fields to my left. 

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23vsQfn2J6hEQUzRX4DcwMZLwqeNn7X9B5RnX94AAuE8g216jgBPzSigDGv7q8wi3NwpU.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/EoeFScLEA2oYfyaJPvrV4iR9kYgtWqd6cKjDhK1C7UhccjHdGJr26biRUGYzyGjzodk.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23xyUvHwgPMjQMxbjC6D9foeBk6R5y9xQdSUj8L3s5q2UVTE59117SZJBmqmXrSWYKjS8.jpg

There were a few obstacles, mainly a boggy looking trench. I spotted where other people had managed to get over, so it was quite easy in the end. There were a lot of rotten, gnarly trees on the ground so I spotted the odd fungus. 

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23tvisygxXXwwsnTaPBnpbzkx53Nz3h969ZhdqjypmYxP4QjgvovmWv78qDLih6Vnpwth.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23wWvt5RqGEfBAKaoKrbcgGw44wtEvC9KGMJULuH98pWvYWqJNb3FTEnpRVCZFSh25wkV.jpg

At some point, I decided to turn right to try and make my way back to the car.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23vhuiTE9NSn5oLUCb56UDakd8TXghjw515Y44hWbqrcTSo7DrHuxTTTX5Wj9QrG7hoXn.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23uFa4RrkcxVrMq5Ti3DVY7VWAXjnsTbyyz6WzpZSXNUfCZk6uJGVbJ5XaCRJbvf5ZK7D.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/EoeEQKLbw67xr4FWa3kKPAT64bDhhDgfLipFHyZKR7GpK7mEZxstSH6tTKpkLHgpRu4.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ellenripley/23xKnBLNsevELmkTBfqJXpoXfURuyuiDsTX9d3qjthtFiKd5VnNAGU7fcGr1DW9dnHMma.jpg

It will be nice to return here in the summer, as there were lots of rhododendron bushes. They were mostly still in bud, although a few had flowered. Even though they are invasive, they do look and smell lovely. I managed to get back to the car without getting lost, which is a feat in itself.

body.title: PC World (September 1990)
body.body:
>
Cover of the September 1990 issue of PC World
PC World was one of the most popular PC specific magazines for a long time throughout a good portion of the 1980s, the 1990s, and well into the 2000s. The September 1990 issue includes:

Previews

  • 1-2-3 Meets Windows Halfway - Lotus 1-2-3 Release 3.1 added a graphical user interface. It could also run under Windows 3.0 but not with its GUI. It is still basically a DOS program at this point.

  • NEC Pushes Laptop Power - An early look at the NEC UltraLite 286V laptop which includes a 12-MHz 286 CPU, 20MB hard disk, VGA display, 1 MB of RAM, and an external 3.5-inch floppy drive for $3999.

Reviews

  • Do Presentation Manager Spreadsheets Have the Right Stuff? - Reviews of the OS/2 versions of Lotus 1-2-3 and Excel and comparison with the Windows versions.

  • Fonts Unlimited: Seven Smart Lasers for Under $3000 - Reviews of what were at the time relatively low-cost laser printers including the Canon LBP-4, HP LaserJet IIP, HP LaserJet III, IBM LaserPrinter, IBM LaserPrinter E, and Okidata OkiLaser 820.

  • Project Management Reaches the Real World - Reviews of six project management software packages including Harvard Project Manager 3.01, InstaPlan 5000 2.0, Microsoft Project for Windows 1.0, Project Scheduler 4 2.0, SuperProject Expert 1.1, and Time Line 4.0.

>
Table of Contents from the September 1990 issue of PC World

Features

  • The Spreadsheet Connection: From Data Base to Decision - A look at add-ins for allowing spreadsheets to get data out of a database.

  • Buyers' Guide: 80MB Upgrades - A guide to 80MB (give or take) hard drive upgrades. A number of hard drives are examined here including models from CMS, Core International, Cumulus, Fujitsu, Hard Drives International, IBM, Miniscribe, Microscience International, Plus Development, Procom Technology, Quantum, Syquest, Teac, and Western Digital. Prices range from $650 to nearly $1500.

News

  • Top of the News - Lotus Sues Borland over Quattro Pro interface, AST and Airis to offer laptops that run on alkaline batteries, GeoWorks to offer GEOS for XT based computers, Tandy introduces the Tandy 1000 RL, Compaq launches Deskpro 486/33L, Deskpro 386/33L, and Systempro models which include EISA bus and 33 MHz version of 486 chip, and more.

  • Industry Outlook - IBM introduces AT based PS/1 for home office users; Symantec and Norton merge; multiprocessor PC based servers replace minicomputers; and more.

  • Product Outlook - Zenith introduces hard disk equipped notebook (MiniSport HD), Deskpro 386N and 286N diskless workstations from Compaq, Epson LT-386SX laptop, and more.

>
Table of Contents from the September 1990 issue of PC World (continued)

How To

  • PC World's Guide to Painless Backups - A guide to backing up your PCs hard drive to floppies including advice on partitioning your hard drive.

  • Words Into Print - Moving your word processing documents to desktop publishing software.

  • Spreadsheets (A-Z) - Streamlining Lotus 1-2-3's database functions with macros.

  • Data Basics - Lookups in dBASE.

  • The Information Edge - A look at Prodigy, a pre-Internet online service that offered e-mail, stock quotes, bulletin boards, and more.

Departments

  • Richard Landry - Borland and Lotus battle over spreadsheet interface copyright.

  • Letters - Letters from readers about users' rights, Northgate, fonts, WordPerfect, and more.

  • The Help Screen - Keeping your floppy disks safe from your phone, modems, and other heat and magnetic field generating items; using multiple AUTOEXEC.BAT and CONFIG.SYS configurations; maximum DOS command length; and more.

  • Consumer Watch - Advice for buying a used PC.

  • Star-Dot-Star - A C program to make DOS commands failsafe; turning off page breaks in WordStar; validating dates in dBASE; and more.

  • Developer's Toolbox - Comparing Borland Turbo C++ 1.0 and Microsoft C Professional Development System 6.0.

  • Taking It Home - Tips for moving Windows based word processing files to DOS.

>

body.title: Shared Key Model for business treasury security on Hive
body.body:
## The Security and Economic Philosophy of Hive Comunity Bank (HCB)

The Hive Comunity Bank (HCB) is designed as a specialized lending protocol that prioritizes capital preservation and stakeholder security. By moving away from traditional high-risk DeFi mechanisms, HCB establishes a robust architecture specifically tailored for the Hive blockchain ecosystem.


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRgm27H4DVz3KLXBZ4R1eSDTJkzj8q289PC8asiVZRWo5/Screenshot%202026-05-08%20at%203.50.20%E2%80%AFAM.png 


### **Security Architecture**

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmc9tWyXeTeE785bS4w1Mg3g1sHsb8PPgTvfiSVidC51zs/Screenshot%202026-05-08%20at%203.50.53%E2%80%AFAM.png 

At the core of the HCB protocol is a **Shared Active Key Model**. Unlike traditional multisig arrangements—which often fail during emergencies because they require multiple signers to be online simultaneously within a narrow one-hour window—HCB utilizes a more practical, asynchronous approach. 

Three named keyholders (the Manager and two Co-custodians) hold independent copies of the active key. While any of them can initiate routine or emergency operations, their power is kept in check by Hive's native **3-day HBD savings withdrawal window**.



| Keyholder | Key Type | Can Initiate | Can Cancel Savings Withdrawal |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Manager** | Active | Yes — all routine operations | Yes — within 3-day window |
| **Co-custodian 1** | Active | Yes — emergency use | Yes — within 3-day window |
| **Co-custodian 2** | Active | Yes — emergency use | Yes — within 3-day window |
| **Owner Key** | Owner | Account recovery only | N/A — not used for operations |

This 72-hour safety buffer ensures that no funds can leave the protocol instantly. During this window, any keyholder can unilaterally cancel a suspicious withdrawal. Furthermore, this delay allows the broader community or witnesses to intervene if an account compromise is detected, providing a level of defense-in-depth that instant-transfer protocols lack.


### **The Strengths of the HCB Model**

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmavuq5LK8frAjLSD68kfpQcQsAbpCsdajDdNHA4xfovjS/Screenshot%202026-05-08%20at%203.56.56%E2%80%AFAM.png 


The HCB protocol offers a unique set of advantages for significant Hive stakeholders, primarily focused on maintaining long-term asset ownership while accessing liquidity:

*   **Tax Neutrality**: By providing loans rather than requiring asset sales, HCB prevents the realization of capital gains, thus avoiding taxable events.
*   **Zero Oracle Risk**: Traditional DeFi relies on price oracles that can trigger liquidations during \

. HCB removes this risk entirely by checking prices only once per year during interest renewals.\n*   **Governance Retention**: Collateral remains in the ecosystem as Hive Power (HP). This ensures that \

do not lose their curation influence or voting power while their assets are pledged.
*   **Locked-In Costs**: Fees are determined at the moment of loan origination, protecting the borrower from cost increases even if the value of Hive rises significantly.
*   **Passive Treasury Growth**: The underlying pool generates a guaranteed 15% APR through Hive's native savings interest, ensuring the bank remains solvent and profitable even during periods of low borrowing activity.

### **Understanding the Risks**

While the architecture is designed for maximum safety, participants should consider the inherent trade-offs of the system:

*   **Growing Debt Burden**: Because the \

uses secondary loans to cover annual fees, the total debt grows slightly each year. Over a very long horizon with flat asset performance, this could theoretically lead to an underwater position.
*   **Institutional and Regulatory Factors**: The health of the bank relies on stable institutional credit lines and a regulatory environment that remains favorable to decentralized lending structures.
*   **Custodial Trust**: Although mitigated by the 3-day withdrawal window and multi-custodian oversight, the model still requires users to trust the security practices of the named keyholders.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ3kcQhMeMLQua77S6eDzNLpmD9kPVspVwuvo6ZojN589/Screenshot%202026-05-08%20at%203.56.37%E2%80%AFAM.png 


> **The HCB Promise**: We never sell your Hive. We use a smart loop to pay the fees so you stay safe from taxes and market crashes.



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@shortsegments/shared-key-model-for-business-treasury-security-on-hive-8xg)

body.title: Renting Cards from the Splinterlands Market.
body.body:
>
Hello .. !! My dear Hive friends, I am @samadbro08 from Bangladesh. Today is Friday , May 8/2026
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeS7E3SWzG6HrmoqHxvA9XsuodrfcEa62ouPTPd9M9Fmg/1778248278305.png) Hello friends,Hope everyone is well.To win the Splinterlands game, there is no substitute for the right cards. But buying expensive cards is not possible for everyone. This is where **Rental Market** comes in handy. By spending a very small amount of DEC or Credits, you can rent powerful cards and increase your rank and rewards in the game. In today's blog, we will know how to rent cards from the Splinterlands Market step-by-step.
The method of renting cards is to first enter the Market section, log in to your Splinterlands account, click on the **'Market'** icon from the top menu bar. Then select the **'Card Rentals'** tab from there. And search for cards using filters. There are thousands of cards in the market. Use filters to quickly find the card you need, such as, * **Element:** (Fire, Water, Earth etc.) * **Rarity:** (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary) * **Foil:** (Regular or Gold) * **Edition:** (Chaos Legion, Rebellion etc.)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf9DZc6wXd1t6aj4pehTLzpmTvUPS3WkhXUnLeMDxV24c/1778248453874.png) Select the card or click on the card of your choice to see its various listings. Here, choose the card with the lowest price (DEC/Day) and the level you need. Tick the **Check Box** next to the card. Then you have to set the payment and time limit, for example, at the bottom you will see the **'Rent'** button. After clicking there, a pop-up will appear, select whether you will pay with DEC or Credits. And enter the number of days you want to rent for (minimum 1 day).
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPfxd3yjeQZUTT9iUeKjJKe14Ztsiu4R5un4N29wb6sLh/1778248470869.png)
Now confirm the transaction, which is finally click on the **'Rent'** button. If you are using **Hive Keychain**, you will be asked for a confirmation. Once you approve it, the card will be added to your collection. However, when renting a card, check how much power it gives. This is very important for upgrading the league. However, make sure that the card does not have a 'Clock' icon or cooldown. Renting a card with a cooldown cannot be used immediately in battle. If you want, you can rent many cards faster and at once using the PeakMonsters website, in addition to directly in the game. However, one thing is that the rental price of cards increases a lot 1-2 days before the end of the season. So it is wise to rent the necessary cards a few days in advance.
The key to success in Splinterlands is to rent cards smartly. I hope this guide has helped you understand the card renting process. Rent your favorite card today and start the battle. And so I am ending my writing about this here, thank you all.

body.title: Forgive and forget what does the bible say?
body.body:
>“Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.” Ephesians 4:32

The bible taught us that forgiveness of sins is very important in the life of every family and followers of Jesus Christ. The ability to forgive is when you let go of pain or anger caused by someone close to you, in such a way you don't wrong the person back. God calls Christians to forgive others just as He forgives them. It is not always easy, but it is a command that helps bring peace to the heart and restore relationships.

Someone can forgive but to forget is not easily done, that is to enraise our memory of the past.  In some cases, you may still remember what happened, but you are expected not to hold it against the person or keep bringing it up. Forgiveness is about releasing the hurt and trusting God with the outcome.

body.title: Work Work worse Work
body.body: >‎He kept asking me if I’m transforming my life and myself, or if I’ve simply given up and failed—honestly, the latter shouldn’t even be on the list.

>Warm greetings to all readers and everyone who is part of this great community, and above all, this vast blockchain ecosystem. I begin this post with this important point because, some time ago, my focus was entirely personal—centered on sharing art, positive emotions, and ideas, and encouraging other friends and users. However, lately, due to various factors, I’ve been stuck in this loop with no apparent direction.

‎

>‎There are plenty of reasons across different areas and fields, but mainly in this economic aspect: it’s been five months since I’ve been unemployed, and this situation is going from bad to worse with debts, social and legal issues, and food insecurity. But how awful to use a public communication platform like the blockchain to express my reality when the reality for many of us Venezuelans—just like the rest of the world—is that we live to work and work to be able to live.

‎ > Today is another one of those days when I feel my creativity is being stifled and overshadowed by so many adversities that arise. ‎

>‎Leaving home early and heading straight to the public employment office where I did some work a few weeks ago under the promise of a contract—the opportunity to work at this facility, which I’ll show in the next photo—places like these need a lot of attention and a deep overhaul. However, we all already know about the theft committed by our country’s government entities.
/> ‎ > And here I am, looking at the facilities where I’ll soon be working, if they let me. ‎ ‎

>Apart of all of this, would u support as a subscriptor on my channel?

‎ * [https://youtube.com/@fonestreet?si=RlDnBMtkzzOk0sYv](https://youtube.com/@fonestreet?si=RlDnBMtkzzOk0sYv)

body.body: By container volume, the usual top 10 U.S. ports are: Los Angeles, Long Beach, New York/New Jersey, Savannah, Houston, Virginia, Seattle-Tacoma/NWSA, Charleston, Oakland, and Miami/Jacksonville depending on the year and metric. If you mean total tonnage instead of containers, the list changes hard toward Houston, South Louisiana, Corpus Christi, New Orleans, and other bulk/energy ports — maritime rankings are annoyingly metric-sensitive. Good reference points: [BTS port freight data](https://www.bts.gov/ports), [DF Alliance’s 2025 container ranking](https://www.df-alliance.com/blog/busiest-ports-in-the-united-states-in-2025), and [FreightMango’s 2025 guide](https://www.freightmango.com/blog/busiest-ports-in-the-us-focused-guide-2025-2026/).

body.title: HOD Alicante: So we got the party started! [Eng][Esp]
body.body:
>
![IMG_9602.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23zktsRy9MdUWkDb3iDTkTpe4sQPcbzWKH346Zd1wQsPUKHGD5vXMbzknbBvwYcd37JF2.jpeg)
I did it—I made it on time! My biggest worry at the start of the first day of #HODAlicante was that my tight travel schedule would fall apart and I wouldn’t be able to make it to the event’s opening. But I made it, and I had a great time. I’m still trying to figure out the other worry I was carrying around, so I can understand it. It was an almost uncontrollable nervousness that stayed with me throughout the entire trip until arriving at our meeting place; once there, it vanished. I feel like my body was on high alert for no good reason—I can’t say I didn’t know what to expect or that I was worried about feeling out of place, but whatever it was made me feel more anxious than I had been in the past few months. Considering how much has happened! But anyway, even though I was in crisis without realizing it, watching the bus approach the coast, letting me enjoy the spectacle of the Mediterranean Sea after so many months away, filled me with a very genuine joy. I didn't have much time to consider other options when I arrived at the Alicante bus terminal, so I hopped in a taxi right away, and thanks to that, I walked through the doors of *Ulab*, our convention center, at 3:01 p.m. Right on time. I stopped for just a few seconds to say hello to @edje, who was smoking very calmly outside the building, letting me know that I had arrived on time and that I should head to the basement to access the space we would be using. Right away, the place felt spacious and pleasant. There’s a large mural at the bottom of the stairs—and next to the noisy elevator—that welcomes you with the phrase *Start. There’s no substitute for experience*, which I thought was very fitting, because right after that you came across the promotional banner and a whiteboard welcoming you to Hive!
[Esp]
> ¡Lo logré, llegue a tiempo! Mi mayor preocupación al comienzo del primer día del #HODAlicante era que mi ajustado itinerario de viaje fallara y no lograra estar presente durante el inicio del evento. Pero se logró y se disfrutó mucho.
La otra preocupación que llevaba encima aun estoy por deconstruirla, para poder entenderla. Se trataba de un nerviosismo casi incontrolable que me acompañó durante todo el viaje hasta llegar a nuestro lugar de encuentro, una vez allí, desapareció. Siento que mi cuerpo estaba en modo alerta de forma innecesaria, no puedo decir que no sabía lo que me esperaba ni que me preocupaba sentirme fuera de lugar, pero lo que sea que fuera me hizo sentir más ansiosa de lo que había estado durante los últimos meses. ¡Y mira que han pasado cosas!
Pero bueno, a pesar de que estuviese en crisis sin reconocerlo, ver como el bus se acercaba a la costa, dejándome disfrutar del espectáculo del Mar Mediterráneo después de tantos meses alejada, me llenaba con una alegría muy genuina.
No tuve mucho tiempo de considerar vías alternativas al arribar al terminal de autobuses de Alicante, así que me subí a un taxi enseguida y gracias a eso crucé las puertas de *Ulab*, nuestro centro de convenciones, a las 15:01 de la tarde. Justo a tiempo.
Me detuve solo unos segundos para saludar a @edje, quien fumaba muy tranquilamente fuera del edificio, dejándome saber que llegaba a tiempo y que debía dirigirme al sótano del mismo para acceder al espacio que estaríamos usando. De entrada el lugar se percibía amplio y agradable. Hay un gran mural al final de las escaleras, también del ruidoso ascensor, que te da la bienvenida con la frase *Start. There’s no substitute for experience*, muy apropiado en mi opinión, porque Justo después te encontrabas con el banderín publicitario y una pizarra anunciándote la bienvenida a Hive!
![IMG_9662.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EoiY3wakDbuHnonTMySX2FxzmGiwUEiuDNKALPYvmZuEr3jdGcd4XVkJZ9KTTEAaZGc.jpeg) ![IMG_9660.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/Eokf1NWoaUGwsMBNKWcKdjfLosvG9t8Hey8Bbpd7WKxj2kuz2TcZhzrZgLVDY2Y99pF.jpeg) ![IMG_9635.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23wCLbSoBXi4Ju21WPmXxC2gLbVsd9YsyXhAtpmVfoXXQ3mmHDXZVW4SR4bgeE78ag6vh.jpeg) # Goodie bags It was hard to focus at first, but my nerves settled when I saw the first familiar faces; still, my attention kept jumping from one thing to another—between the eye-catching food catering, the reception stand with the event's colorful goodie bags, and the people I wanted to greet. I couldn’t focus right away, but after briefly checking in with the organizers, I made it to the booth where the wonderful *Fiona* was welcoming us with the event’s little gifts and our ID badges. I was so happy to see @tibfox’s partner again, sharing the experience with us. She’s one of those people who stands out because she has such a lovely aura—she doesn’t need to talk to everyone, but she’s always there to brighten our day. Let’s be clear: one of the most exciting things about attending these events is receiving these little bags full of freebies and promotional stickers from the chain. I’m always a fangirl for this stuff. This year, the predominant color is orange, so we stood out everywhere with our eye-catching tote bags. Over the past three years that @tibfox has been leading this project, he has managed to surprise us every year with a special little gift. From the first one, I remember the red bottle that still goes everywhere with me; last year it was the Hive umbrella that we all loved; and this year, to make sure we didn’t go unnoticed, we received Hive sunglasses—perfect for the sunny days ahead. Thank you so much! This year we also received some really fun stickers that were a bit different from the usual, a notebook and pen with a delicate leather-style covering, and a curious fill-in sheet called *Community Bingo* that took center stage during the first three days of the event. Its purpose was to serve as a way to break the ice between strangers, making it easier to start interacting and motivating us with a series of prizes to be awarded to the fastest or most social participants. This initiative was very popular with the crowd, and although I didn’t set out to complete my own, I had a lot of fun helping others fill in the boxes. I found myself listed several times under the options *Hive Project*, *Has a tattoo*, and *Has visited 10+ countries*—categories I’m actually quite proud of, to be honest.
[Esp]
> Fue difícil concentrarse al comienzo, mis ansias se calmaron al ver la primeras caras conocidas pero mi atención saltaba de un lado al otro entre el llamativo catering de comida, el stand de recepcion con las llamativas goodie bags del evento y las personas a las que saludar. No me pude enfocar rápido, pero luego de reportarme brevemente con los organizadores, logré llegar al stand en donde la maravillosa *Fiona* nos recibía con los regalitos respectivos del evento y el carnet para identificarnos. Me alegró mucho volver a ver a la compañera de @tibfox compartiendo junto a nosotros, es de esas personas que se hace notar por tener un aura tan bonita que no falta le hace hablar con todo el mundo, siempre mente estar y alegrarnos el día.
Vamos a ser claros, una de ls cosas más emocionantes de asistir a estos encuentros es recibir estas bolsitas llenas de regalitos y stickers promocionales de la cadena. Fangirl siempre de esto. Este año el color predominante es el naranja, así que resaltábamos por doquier con nuestras llamativas ToteBags.
Durante estos tres años en que @tibfox se ha encargado de sacar adelante este proyecto, ha logrado sorprendernos cada año con un regalito especial. Del primero recuerdo la botella roja que aún me acompaña a todos lados, el año pasado fue el paraguas de Hive que nos encantó a todos y m, para no pasar desapercibidos este año, llegando las gafas de sol de Hive, perfectas para los soleados días que teníamos por delante. ¡Muchas gracias!
Este año también recibimos unos stickers muy divertidos y diferentes a lo usual, un cuaderno y lapicero con un delicado acabado estilo cuero y una curiosa hoja a rellenar llamada *Community Bingo* que se llevó bastante protagonismo los primeros tres días del evento. Su finalidad era servir como una vía para romper el hielo entre usuarios desconocidos, comenzando a interactuar más fácilmente y motivándonos con una serie de premios a repartir entre los más rápidos o los más sociales. Esta iniciativa gustó mucho entre el público y aunque yo no me propuse completar el mío, me divertí mucho ayudando a otros a llenar casillas. Me vi varias veces listada en las opciones de *Proyecto de Hive*, *Tiene un tatuaje* y *Ha visitado 10+ países*, todo un orgullo de categorías para ser sincera.

After the opening talk wrapped up, we spent a couple of hours networking around the catering table, which—though it caught my eye—couldn’t compete with the constant flow of conversations that, happily, kept me distracted from the food. But I did sample the sweets little by little, all while listening intently to the questions people asked me. There were two groups of conversations. First, the acquaintances, whom it’s always a pleasure to greet again. They were intrigued by the events that followed the last #BuzzParty last year in Graz, Austria. There, out of nowhere, I decided to make a 180-degree turn in my life by moving to Guatemala, and the truth is that my lack of blog posts has caused some curiosity. I’m so happy to hear them say that I look much happier and more at peace now. This is very true, and it fills me with excitement that it’s so easy to see. I think it’s something I needed to hear to return to my now-new dream reality in Central America with even more enthusiasm and determination. The other type of conversation involved the curious, eager, and almost insatiable questions that arose from new users who were creating accounts on Hive. They had joined out of curiosity and were eager to absorb every bit of information we could provide. I loved their enthusiasm, but it caused me some conflict to dump so many new concepts into these people’s minds. I’m always overwhelmed by the sense of responsibility when introducing someone new to this world, and I struggle not to worry too much about overwhelming them right away. I kept saying, “Don’t worry, we’ll explain everything a little more tomorrow,” even though I know that didn’t put their minds at ease at all, hahaha—but the truth is, these guys were all wonderful from the very start.

Now, let’s get to what we really came for! Let’s talk a little about the Spanish cuisine tasting we enjoyed on the first day of the event. Since I needed to perk up as the afternoon wore on, I started my tasting with something sweet, trying the lovely profiteroles, which looked absolutely delicious and weren’t at all overly sweet. They had a good balance of pastry and cream. Then, for those who didn’t want something so heavy, there were small cups of fresh fruit set out as dessert, and for those who weren’t strictly vegan, plates with cheese, grapes, and nuts were available. But anyway, let’s continue the rundown, as indicated by the improvised information sign on a paper cup, with the vegetarian section, because as we all know by now, @tibfox always makes sure to take attendees’ special diets into account and not leave anyone out when it comes to enjoying a snack or meal. Since there was a good selection of vegetarian dishes, I didn’t hold back from trying them. It’s important not to leave people without options, but not everyone was there that day, so I was able to take advantage of that. I have to admit that several of the items I liked best were in this section: the colorful wraps, the green gyoza, the potato omelet, and the artichoke salad. All of these were hits for me. I understand that several of them were created by @tibfox himself—maybe not made from scratch, but at least he chose which items to offer—so congratulations on the selection!

Then we could move on to the other dishes that included meat or fish. Here, of course, the Serrano ham was the first to disappear—a must-have that didn’t go unnoticed by anyone. I was very happy because ham is one of the everyday things in Spain that I miss the most, Iberian ham and cheeses. We also had an interesting variety of cheeses to snack on, including aged cheeses, among which the truffle-flavored one was the most popular. We also had some lovely mini burgers that were heartier than they looked; a couple of these felt more than enough as a main course—though of course with their respective sides, like the Russian salads arranged nearby. I really liked the tuna Russian salad, and although I also quite liked the vegetarian version with artichokes, this was the one I went back for more than once. One thing you can’t miss if you’re in Spain is croquettes; we had ham and seafood varieties, both with a soft flavor but nice and crispy on the outside. Other options included curry sandwiches, stuffed croissants, and puff pastry *saladitos*.

Otras opciones fueron sándwiches de Curri, croissans rellenos y los *saladitos* rellenos de hojaldre. ![IMG_9621.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EowJYUVQprpRZtYwWUW2WNE9QqsUr8LZMKfTaAqRSFFn4wSrdYJBvR7x3EajBDpF7Ua.jpeg) ![IMG_9624.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23wgURfBV9qZjbussrGRGhBpLxNdvf2EcXqja1iMko4APBLzH3asAJzutzNEs9FqFjKz3.jpeg)|![IMG_9618.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23y96vr1c6bra1EsuRawYcjdBNbH8FwVJgHXRutRVuPuxx74ab5CCrzyfdKq5YHrN1gZ7.jpeg)|![IMG_9619.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23wqrespuZcbH5HF34dGJtADEgdRmcguikazzUpVJCUaR92S2T6knRSfToHiNKPJiqf9F.jpeg)|![IMG_9647.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23wX7vArLwG145KgV5svzXZYGpkTE2XHhgVU3sjYCSR872tbmwnixTCxxeAwtyx1fZGYb.jpeg) ----|----|----|----

She joined us a little later but in time to introduce herself to the new users who had so many questions for us in Spanish, as well as to those digital friends she’d finally come to meet in person! A couple of hours flew by like that, and between chatting and tasting food, it was almost 7:30 p.m., so we decided to pack up a bit and coordinate with those who had gone back to their hotels to rest before dinner. It was a lovely post-event moment, chatting and taking photos to immortalize this experience. I’ve included a couple of them at the end, after catching up with @livinguktaiwan and being super happy about the chocolates she brought us as gifts ❤️ Thank you so much for taking a little time to think of us when deciding to bring us these gifts—it feels so nice to be kept in mind. body.title: One Click Can Ruin Your Digital Life
body.body:
/>

image source : [https://pixabay.com/](https://pixabay.com/)

Hello friends, how are you? I came here today to the Free Rights group and found something new and interesting here. It's basically a competition: you have to top-click it. Don't click the link, friends. As you know, this topic is very important. It's very important—why it's important is that you've probably noticed that in our everyday lives and online media there are many apps and links that generate a lot of traction. Whatever you buy, if it's supposed to be a thousand dollars on the market, then it… They'll create such an attraction that you click on it, and that same thing that's supposed to cost a thousand dollars will be available to you for $300.  
What happens is that many of our friends fall for the lure that it might be genuine, and they click on it. As soon as they click, all their details go to the person providing the link, who then ends up with your information in one way or another. They get shared.  
One thing I'll point out here is that many people think hacking only happens to famous people or big companies, but the reality is that anyone can target you through cybercrime—all they need is your password or personal information. And for that, they use very clever tricks: sometimes they send you a link, and sometimes they try to connect with you through a fake email.  
  

I'll repeat again that he will try to trap you in many ways: he'll try to give you free prizes, try to lure you, or try to send you promo codes, or he'll do something with you that in our language is called phishing. What happens in phishing is that, for example, he'll ask you to like… They use bait. What happens is they'll offer you a “three-provide” deal: you go to Facebook, give your information, and they'll give you free promos that you can use anywhere to save.  
On the surface, it will look like when you click on it, you'll be taken to the real Facebook, so you'll enter your login password, but your actual Facebook won't open—instead, your login credentials and password will go to the hacker. After that, he can take over your real Facebook and demand a large sum of money from you.  
Why does this happen? Often people click on links without thinking. A new file might download that sends a virus to your system, hacks your personal data, and steals your things, including your personal cards. That sensitive information you've stored on your mobile or laptop can be accessed by hackers through those links.

In the end, I just want to say that, friends, the Internet is undoubtedly a powerful thing. While we build on it every day and reap many benefits in life, we also want to warn you not to click on any wrong link—what you might call an unknown link—or on anything like that. By doing so, your data will, for one reason or another, end up in the hands of hackers, compromising your privacy and causing you a great deal of harm. Thank you.

body.title: Meet Chainers: A WORLD THAT FITS IN A TAB — AND REFUSES TO STAY SMALL
body.body: There’s a specific kind of magic that the best games pull off — where the game stops being something you play and becomes a place you inhabit. Chainers is built around exactly that feeling. It opens in a browser tab, but it doesn’t feel small. The world exists inside a layered Multiverse of civilizations, ecosystems, strange characters, and evolving systems. Its lore does not sit in the background like decoration. It appears through the characters you grow, the events that reshape the world, and the choices that slowly turn a generic farm into your farm. At its core, Chainers is a game about building something that keeps becoming more meaningful over time.

/>  
  
The story begins with the Chainers, refugees from Chainerys — a civilization destroyed by Big Eye and his army of Perfects. After losing their home, they escape through ancient Portals and land on Earth with one goal: to build a future where control cannot reach them again. It gives the game a simple but effective emotional frame. You are not just collecting resources. You are helping rebuild a world.  
  
The gameplay starts with familiar farming and crafting loops, but it quickly becomes more strategic. You plant, harvest, merge, evolve, explore, and unlock new possibilities through the systems you build. The early game feels foundational because it is. Every crop, merge, animal, and upgrade adds weight to your world. Progress does not feel like a temporary boost. It feels like infrastructure.  
  
That is where Chainers becomes more interesting than a standard farming game. It rewards the “Architect mindset” more than the “Harvester mindset.” Players who focus only on collecting may move forward, but players who learn the merge systems, build capacity, and evolve characters will see the world open faster and deeper.  
  
The reward logic also matters. Chainers does not treat earning as the main product. What you earn comes from what you build, farm, synthesize, and understand. This separates it from older Play-to-Earn models, where rewards often carried the whole experience until the economy stopped working. Here, the world comes first. Rewards follow progress, not the other way around.  
  
The community adds another layer. Direct multiplayer is still developing inside the main game, but the Chainers Discord already feels alive. Players take part in an active Discord RPG, fight bosses, join PvP matches, participate in events, create UGC, and build culture around the game. It feels less like a waiting room and more like a parallel social layer that already has its own regulars, jokes, and status.  
  
The browser-first access helps a lot. There is no download, no long setup, and no technical wall before you start playing. You open a tab, create an account, and begin. That makes Chainers easy to try, while the systems give patient players enough depth to stay.  
  
It is not perfect. The learning curve is real, early guidance could be better, and the best version of the game appears after several sessions, not in the first five minutes. Players who want instant multiplayer inside the main game may also need to wait.  
  
But Chainers has something many online games struggle to build: a reason to return. Not because a streak will break, but because your world is still there, still growing, and still waiting for what you decide to build next.

body.title: Green Days and Big Wins: Hive Rises, ClaNFT Dominates
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc6gdt9GDdhGURPp1qqCQgfDg5zDsdKATXNmGvMxsLGHv/thumbnail_brawl.png)

Greetings, Splinterlands warriors!

In this post, I’d like to share another story from my latest brawl results with the ClaNFT guild. But before jumping into the battlefield, many players couldn’t help but notice the recent movement of HIVE, which surged to around 0.09 USD a few days ago. It definitely lifted the mood among players. Even though it has slightly dipped since then, there’s still hope that the crypto market—especially the Hive ecosystem and SPS—will regain momentum.

As usual, my guildmates entrusted me once again with defending fray 12. At this point, it feels like a permanent seat—if it’s ever empty, I’d probably feel lost myself.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRN8g1anFcDWeWFSzPJ6YEbjpr4ZMqWj8fSSRptdaPnJR/my_battles.png)</center>


This brawl was quite busy, with a total of 9 battles available. Out of those, 3 were automatic wins because the opposing guild didn’t fill their slots. The rest, I had to fight for real.

Thankfully, the results were quite satisfying.

Out of all my battles, I only lost 2. Four matches were secured with strategies that, in my opinion, worked quite well. Not perfect, but definitely effective.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYcsb3yRBKeCfvLaiGKxMfhXpngzo8eVKBfiuZLzrywQy/all.png)</center>


Overall, the guild’s performance was outstanding. ClaNFT managed to collect 297 points with a total of 99 wins, securing first place in this brawl. There’s something special about seeing your guild sitting at the top of the leaderboard—it’s a small but meaningful sense of satisfaction.

The rewards were pretty sweet too:
The guild has won spoils of 48 Crowns in the latest brawl! Also, each fully participating member was awarded 2,400 Merits and players with a spellbook received 22.344 staked SPS.

It’s not life-changing wealth, of course—but it’s more than enough to keep the motivation alive.

Now, out of all the battles, there was one that truly caught my attention. It felt special because I once again witnessed just how insane the potential of Riftwing can be when played at max level.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUobyGWSCF1Cv6weMhvYKVSckrzQy8yuF1ZQZncaR6WYV/brawl.png)


Many people usually see Riftwing as just an annoying nuisance. But in this battle, it turned into a core powerhouse. The reason? Its combination with Bren Palesworn.

Bren Palesworn’s Weapon Training ability granted Riftwing additional attack power. And since Riftwing already has incredibly annoying survivability—combined with its scaling endurance as rounds go on—it became a nightmare for the opponent.

What made the battle even more enjoyable was the mix of ranged and melee attacks working together. Riftwing essentially became a wild, ever-growing monster. The longer the battle lasted, the harder it was to stop.

And honestly, seeing a card that’s often considered “just a filler” turn into a match-winner is deeply satisfying.

If you’re curious about how the battle played out, you can check the full replay here:
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_7Zpe5bsikBSRMwz2XJzq?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>


Aside from the victories, there was another thing that made me happy this week: my merits finally reached 10k.

Which means… it’s almost time to open a Gladius Case.

And as always, opening Gladius packs comes with its own excitement. Sometimes you get something ordinary, sometimes a surprise. So I’ll save the results for the next post.

This week’s brawl reminded me once again that sometimes, seemingly simple cards can become incredibly deadly when paired with the right strategy. Riftwing is a perfect example of that.

A quick tip from me: don’t get too fixated on popular meta monsters. Sometimes the overlooked cards can be the true game-changers.

And hopefully… as SPS and HIVE start turning green again, our brawl results will get greener too 😄

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)



Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___


If you already joined the splinterlands, and are looking for a place to grow. We need **YOU**. We are a chill, social guild looking for a few more active members! If you think you might be a fit, join us in our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/5u638vHPVh)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAXaBtYPQQcQ4fDb2DMaFETkzmZ5DNhevYHW4pANVaM2/banner.png)

body.title: Lesma VR [Channel Review] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Yellow and Black Modern True Crime Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23vsQfgE3ZJv31uChwnw7QAdYLNYMmoeGGM9sVB5M4C6ME7GeEG8AQ9zjjsasXstS4avd.jpg)

Hello everyone! How are you? Today I'd like to tell you about a channel I really like, but that I've been watching more recently: Lesma VR. It's a true crime channel, and I've always been drawn to this genre, which is why I'm always watching CSI, Law & Order, and so on. But this channel focuses on real crimes, not fiction, and its narrator takes us through the events in her in-depth investigation. Her voice is silky smooth, very subtle, but her narration isn't monotonous at all; on the contrary, it perfectly maintains the audience's attention. Furthermore, her editing style demonstrates the professionalism of the channel, as she uses very attractive visuals that complement her narrative. >¡Hola hola, gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? Hoy me gustaría hablarles de un canal que me gusta mucho pero que he estado viendo más recientemente, se trata del canal de Lesma VR, uno que está dentro del género True Crimme, osea de crímenes reales, y es que siempre me ha llamado la atención este género, por eso siempre estoy viendo C.S.I, La Ley y El Orden, en fin. Pero este canal se enfoca en crímenes reales, no de ficción, y su narradora nos lleva a través de los hechos en su profunda investigación. La voz de ella es sedosa, muy sutil, pero aún así su relato no es monótono sino todo lo contrario, mantiene perfectamente la atención de la audiencia y además su manera de editar denota todo el profesionalismo que hay en su canal, ya que usa recursos visuales muy atractivos que van en cohesión con su narrativa.

![hu.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EoEjFEK5kceuNLw2mgS2YcJFgyYAfpsu3qNggEjZBPK2riuEqB6bW8HE535Hs2qkJgX.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/@LesmaVR)

Almost all of her videos feature authentic audiovisual material; that is, they are not recreations or dramatizations. Even in these aspects, technology has played a role, providing more information for investigations and helping to solve crimes. For example, in the most recent case in Mexico, the mother-in-law who killed her daughter-in-law, a former beauty queen, shocked the world due to the coldness of both the woman and the husband. On her YouTube channel, Lesma shows security camera footage that reveals part of how the crime unfolded—compelling evidence that the justice system used to solve the case. What I like most about Lesma is that she provides excellent context, not only about the events themselves but also going back to the victim's childhood so that the audience can get to know her better and empathize more deeply. In this specific case, what hurt me the most is that there was a baby involved, and according to what is said, the baby's father allowed the little one to feed on his dead mother's milk while (this is something that comes up in Lesma's video but I've seen it on other channels and I find it abhorrent)

>Casi todos sus videos cuentan con material audiovisual autentico, osea, no son recreaciones o dramatizaciones, ya que hoy en día hasta en eso la tecnología a influido, otorgando más información para las investigaciones, ayudando a resolver crímenes, por ejemplo en el caso más reciente, lo que sucedió en México de la suegra que mató a la nuera, ex reina de belleza, eso conmocionó al mundo por la frialdad de la mujer pero también del esposo. En este canal de youtube Lesma muestra un video de una cámara de seguridad que muestra parte de como fue el crimen, una evidencia contúndete que fue lo que la justicia usó para esclarecer ele hecho. Lo que más me gusta de Lesma es que ella da un muy buen contexto, no solo de los hechos, sino que se remonta a la mismísima infancia de la víctima para que la audiencia pueda conocerla mejor y así empatizar más. En este caso específico lo que más me dolió es que hubo un bebé de por medio, y según se dice, el padre del bebé permitió que el pequeño se alimentara de la leche de su madre muerta mientras (esto es algo que en sale en el video de Lesma pero lo he visto en otros canales y me parece abominable)
https://youtu.be/_QhxXKfTUqg
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_QhxXKfTUqg&t=16s)

But despite the channel's overall theme, she also has some personal vlogs. There aren't many; in fact, I recently found the one I'm about to share, and it's clearly older. But I think it helps the audience understand her channel a bit better. This way, we know she's Guatemalan but lives in Andorra. Seeing this side of the channel's host and owner's life also serves as a kind of \

so to speak, from the heavy content she usually has. Because even though I'm a fan of this genre, I can't deny that it can leave you with a somewhat oppressive feeling. So, yes, it's nice to see some very different content on the same channel.\n\n>Pero a pesar de toda la temática del canal ella también cuenta con algunos Vlogs personales, no son muchos, de hecho este que voy a compartir con ustedes lo encontré recientemente y se nota que tiene ya algún tiempo, pero pienso que ayuda a la audiencia a darle un poco más de contexto a su canal, de esta manera sabemos que ella es guatemalteca pero que vive en Andorra. Ver esta faceta de la vida de la moderadora y dueña del canal sirve también como una especie de \

, por llamarlo de alguna forma, del contenido tan pesado que tiene, porque a pesar de que soy fan de este genero, no puedo dejar de reconocer que uno se queda como con una sensación opresiva, así que pues sí, se agradece ver un contenido muy diferente dentro del mismo canal.

https://youtu.be/HJf2-lrnh6E?list=PL-lM-ASJIfRPTUTpyAxYtPQ8J7HyDDhF8
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HJf2-lrnh6E&list=PL-lM-ASJIfRPTUTpyAxYtPQ8J7HyDDhF8)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

I made the cover and farewell image in Canva

>La imagen de portada y despedida la realicé en Canva.

body.title: THE  UNBREAKABLE PROMISE BETWEEN AMARA AND I
body.body: Hello everyone, you're welcome to my blog today.\n\nHave you ever made a promise to someone and then broken that promise? How did you feel, and how did the person react? Well, today I'll be sharing my story about a promise. It was on a very good day. \

Amara said. She made it sound so casual, like someone who walks up to you and asks for a cord to charge their phone. Her eyes did not match her voice at all; she has always had these stubborn and steady eyes, like she always dreamt her heart was going to be.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQnX9BUEGhXPXwqnLb59PTUo9dhqBsiwm18WuDEguZ3AD/189927.png 




Her laptop sat right there on the table, blank and quiet. It did not look like something that would change our lives, but we all knew that once we opened it and powered it on, there would be no going back. It would either tell us the exact time, seconds, and date when we would die. That actually hits differently, but I was scared too.

I looked up at her with raised eyebrows. \

I thought. It would either make me feel worse or make me feel better. Then there was a pause, the kind of pause that stretches longer than it should, filled with so much tension and nervousness. She whispered to me, \

she said. Then we both reached out our hands at the same time and but couldn't open the laptop.  it felt like we had chosen something bigger than fear. That was about a year ago. Well, we all lived with that fear.\n\nAfter that, it was not quite easy to navigate through life. We joked about it, claiming that we were the brave ones, the ones who wanted to know. We started living life every day like we knew we were going to die the next minute. We would exchange looks and laugh it off whenever we felt pain. Well, imagine living like that. Amara would always say to me, \

I would not pretend that I was not scared. 

Curiosity is one thing and curiosity made us open that laptop that day and come across that website that said countdown. Well, it felt like a movie that I had watched some time ago. Countdown was actually an app, but this was only for phones. This time, it would tell you the exact time and date when something would happen and you would die. It was more like a possession movie spirit. We were friends, so cute, you know, for someone who loves horror movies like me.

It all happened on a very good Friday. Well, I was just sitting down in my room when that sharp pain hit my heart. I remember the first day that we checked it; I was alone in my apartment, just scrolling through my phone, and then it all came to me: what if you don’t really have much time? It hit differently that day.

 I was so scared I felt like passing out, but like a weight, suddenly every plan I had felt unsettling. It felt like I could die at any moment. I opened up my laptop again and looked at the screen. I was not able to open the website because I was too scared. It’s not like I forgot the password or anything. After that, things changed for me. I started to notice that time was moving fast; the days were going by faster. 

How often I would say, \

like it was guaranteed. I would catch myself staring at my friend when she wasn’t looking, wondering how much time I had to spend with her. It all scared me. I remembered my family, and I didn’t even know how much I had left to spend with them. Well, she also noticed it. She would tell me, \

but deep down inside me, I wasn’t okay at all.\n\n Well, she knew. I never said nothing. She asked me if I was thinking about it. I didn’t answer right away. That was enough for her to know what was going on in my mind. She leaned in and exhaled slowly, saying, \

That was the first crack in both of us. We did not talk about it much. In the process, the way we held each other felt a little longer, the silence heavier than before.\n\n Two weeks later, I came back and found my system up and on. I was surprised. I asked her, \
She said yes, that she did. I asked why, but we promised never to open it. She told me that she could not help herself with that; she could not breathe anymore. Every day, she kept thinking, \

What if we were running out of time? We didn’t even know what the time was. At that moment, I stepped closer to her and I didn’t even trust myself to calm her down because I wasn’t calm. So I asked, \
She nodded. Yes, I did. The room felt a little bit smaller and choked up at that moment.\n\nI asked her what exactly was the outcome. She looked up at me with eyes that were uncertain and glossy. \

I thought about the promise we made to each other never to check it. I remembered that if I eventually opened it and checked it and saw the numbers, I would not remain the same again; I would automatically become someone who is just waiting for the end. I let out a breath before I thought she had broken her promise to me. So, I picked up the device and held it to myself.

I told her I had also wanted to check it so many times myself, but I always remembered the promise we made to each other that we were not going to check it because if we do, our lives will never remain the same again. I am glad she understands. It was my most prized possession at that moment, but I carried the laptop to the kitchen, ran water over it, and made sure it was drenched and damaged beyond repair. 

Then I tossed it into the trash. After that moment, I caught her looking at me with wide eyes. She said, \

I told her I had to; what we share is more important than knowing the time that we are going to die. The fact that we made the promise to each other never to check it, I wouldn’t want to put either of us in a compromising situation that would break our promise to each other, and our friendship would never remain the same again.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY7veHfiDCQnCz8kJ97wtMmjZkZB2PSPAPdRJrQiPVuke/189935.png 




I still have that feeling for real after a whole year. I asked her to promise me again. I reached out for her hand and held it close to me, and for the first time in a long while, the future didn’t feel like something measured. It didn’t feel like something we were counting down to. We lived life like every day mattered and made sure that we were happy.

Some promises, when broken, would destroy friendships and make two people who have loved each other for a very long time never see each other the same way again. Let’s always learn to keep our promises and avoid anything that will make us go against our promises, just like Amara and her friend.

Thank you for stopping by my blog.

body.title: Sense & Sensibility (ESP/ENG)
body.body:
![Burgundy and Beige Traditional Narratives Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23yTonJJMhC8bxCncXxsWmG239Ngnsorcpw8WrEeKBsrDsUpjgAqbGtyufcTKbx9E5sEz.jpg)

Today I finished reading another of Jane Austen's novels, Sense and Sensibility, a novel that in some ways reminded me of Pride and Prejudice by the same author but with some notable differences. What happens is that, according to what I've been reading about Jane Austen, she liked to criticize the society in which she lived, since, being educated by her father, she was in some ways very ahead of her time (the Edwardian era). >Hoy terminé de leer una más de las novelas de Jane Austen, Sentido y Sensibilidad, una novela que de cierta manera me recordó a Orgullo y Prejuicio de la misma autora pero con algunas diferencias notales, lo que sucede es que, según lo que estuve leyendo sobre Jane Austen, a ella le gustaba hacer criticas sobre esa sociedad en al que vivía, ya que al ser ella educada por su padre, de cierta manera estaba muy adelantada a su época (la época eduardiana)

This book focuses on the Dashwood sisters: Elinor and Marianne. They also have a younger sister, but the novel centers primarily on the two of them and how their lives change drastically after their father's death. Their older brother (from a previous marriage) inherits the fortune, leaving him with the responsibility of providing the Dashwoods (the mother and the three sisters) with a small allowance. Because of this, the Dashwoods move to Barton Cottage in Devonshire, which becomes their new home. The two sisters cope very differently with their new surroundings. Elinor represents reason; she is balanced, prudent, and extremely respectful, but above all, very reserved with her emotions (she never says what she feels or thinks). Marianne, on the other hand, is the opposite; she embodies feelings. She is impulsive, shrewd, and holds nothing back. Her temperament is cheerful, but she is also fragile and very naive.

>Este libro se centra en las hermanas Dashwood: Elinor y Marianne, ellas también tienen una hermana menor pero la novela se centra más que todo en ellas dos y en como su vida cambia drásticamente tras la muerte de su padre, ya que es su hermano mayor (hijo de un matrimonio anterior) el que heredó la fortuna, quedando con la responsabilidad de darles a las Dashwood (la madre y las tres hermanas) una pequeña pensión. Por causa de esto las Dashwood se trasladan a Barton Cottage en Devonshire que será su nuevo hogar. Las dos hermanas se manejan de manera muy diferente cada uno con su nuevo entorno. Por una parte Elinor es quien representa la sensatez, es equilibrada, prudente en extremo respetuosa pero sobre todo muy contenida con sus emociones (nunca dice lo que siente o piensa) mientras que Marianne es todo lo contrario, es quién representa el los sentimientos, pues es impulsiva, sagaz, no se reserva nada, su temperamento es alegre, pero también es frágil y muy ingenua
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/241tUoqw8NjMqstxbQYUcPP4tASm2fu7acNZmKSv81EzsRCryYH6XYoCMxPD7ExuCCzn9.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/957155727066956450/)

To make matters worse, Marianne falls madly in love with Willoughby, a young man who only intends to seduce her with his beauty and naiveté, as he is accustomed to seducing women. True to her nature, Marianne doesn't hide her feelings for him, while Elinor, despite being in love with Edward Ferrars, suffers in silence, unable to acknowledge her feelings for him even when she believes he has married another woman. But amidst all this, another figure of interest emerges: Colonel Brandom, who is hopelessly in love with Marianne, though she doesn't reciprocate his feelings. Finally, Willoughby abandons Marianne to marry a wealthy young woman, leaving her alone with her wounded feelings, consumed by bitterness and illness, though she later recovers and allows a reconciliation with Colonel Brandom.

>Para colmo Marianne se enamora perdidamente de Willoughby, un joven que solo pretende seducirla por su belleza e ingenuidad, ya que él está acostumbrado a seducir mujeres. Marianne, fiel a su naturaleza no esconde lo que siente por él, mientras que Elinor, a pesar de que está enamorada de Edward Ferrars sufre en silencio sin reconocer sus sentimientos por él ni siquiera cuando cree que él se casó con otra mujer, pero en medio de todo esto surge otra figura de interés, el Coronel Brandom, que está perdidamente enamorado de Marianne aunque ella no le corresponda. Finalmente Willoughby abandona a Marianne para casarse con una joven rica, dejándola sola con sus sentimientos heridos, entregada a la amargura y la enfermedad, aunque más tarde ella se recupera y permite un acercamiento con el Coronel Brandom.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23xAcSYAA5fhtU857xn9aJ1pnT6VGsjoaHgeLRqmmd5UjLZBWvmoFVUnLUKkKE7t5hanm.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/580331102002686899/)

The contrast between the two sisters reflects life itself, polar opposites. An excess of feelings makes you vulnerable and fragile, it can lead to misfortune, but the total absence of them can also lead to self-destruction. Both sisters suffered for different reasons, but each finally found balance upon discovering their mistakes: Elinor learned to open her heart and let her emotions show, to understand that she is human and has the right to feel, while Marianne evolved towards maturity, knowing that it is not good to give away one's feelings deliberately, that it is better to carefully analyze whether or not it is worthwhile. It was thus that she decided to give Brandon a chance, who, incidentally, in some ways represents the archetype of the English romantic gentleman.

>El contraste entre als dos hermanas retrata la vida misma, polos opuestos. Un exceso de sentimientos te hace vulnerable y frágil, te puede conducir a la desgracia, pero la ausencia total de los mismos puede conducirte también a la autodestrucción, ambas hermanas sufrían por motivos distintos pero cada una halló finalmente el equilibrio al descubrir que estaban erradas: Elinor aprendió a abrir su corazón y dejar ver sus emociones, a entender que es humana y tiene derecho a sentir, mientras que Marianne evolucionó hacia la madurez, sabiendo que no es bueno entregar sus sentimientos de manera deliberada, que vale más analizar cautelosamente si vale o no la pena, fue así como decidió darle una oportunidad a Brandom, que por cierto de alguna manera representa el arquetipo del caballero romántico inglés.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23uQkMQiWrmH7zteMFS1k6BV62cg92BSUVc2X1uqr8e6swMg43oeRBR1gVW2aTm5ZbQ1k.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/550987335636335537/)

The novel reflects the sad reality of women of that era, who had no right to inherit and were therefore at the mercy of relatives, with marriage as their only way to gain a little more independence. It also portrays people's tendency to judge and criticize without context (as happened at the ball attended by the human Dashwoods).

>La novela refleja la triste realidad de las mujeres de esa época, las cuales no tenían derecho a heredar y por lo tanto quedaban a merced de familiares y con el matrimonio como una única salida para ganar un poco más de independencia, de la misma manera retrata también la manía de las personas de emitir juicios y criticar sin contexto (como sucedió en el baile al que asistieron las humanas Dashwood)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23tvoD6GuxtTk2d3uJtgEhzAwgui4zf36GkGU1x4qTw4SXs1V71UWhfHnF3RgMfq2q12T.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/1135047912322858926/)

I like the fact that both sisters have learned to find a balance between themselves; that's precisely what maturity is, and it comes with experience. So yes, it was a book I really enjoyed reading, which is why I recommend it.

>Me gusta el hecho de que ambas hermanas hayan aprendido a encontrar el balance entre una y otra, eso precisamente se llama madurez y viene con la experiencia, así que si, fue un libro que disfruté bastante de leer, por eso lo recomiendo.
![Brown Beige Cream Modern Illustration Coffee Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6FdQ2j9v8DRjnGY86szgGFgnNavrFjBHMZrFV9aDdSAH4iQ5F3XMeJj7iYpz2d18ok.jpg)
(Imagen hecha con el editor de canva) >Image made with the Canva editor

body.title: Why Old Friends Always Stay Special
body.body: Old friends are like those beautiful memories of life that don’t fade even as time passes. Even if you don’t talk for years, when you meet again it feels like time stood still. The laughter with them the fights over little things and the time spent together without any reason always stay alive in a person’s heart. That’s why old friends feel different and more special than new people. Life keeps moving forward people change, responsibilities increase but some friends always remain in a corner of our memories. Those friends are witnesses to that time in our lives when we were more genuine, more carefree and happier. Every memory connected to them takes a person back to their past where there was both peace and belonging. The most special thing about old friends is that you don’t need to change yourself in front of them. They know our weaknesses, habits, mistakes and dreams. Sitting with them you don’t have to pretend because they accept us exactly as we truly are. Maybe this is the real beauty of true friendship. Distances definitely come with time but true friendship doesn’t see distances. Sometimes a photo a song or an old place suddenly reminds you of those friends and you smile. Old friends aren’t just people they’re beautiful chapters of our life that a person can never completely forget.
