title.title: Emprender con escasez | Starting up with scarcity
title.body:
En enero retomé mi emprendiendo de polvorones, uno que ha atravesado más rachas malas que buenas, pero que pese a viento y marea, ahí está, saliendo a flote y sobreponiéndose. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXFewjasfD57USejUEVky3Tg2jcumHbSqPUhq2VpqcZfq/img_1263.jpg)
<center>[Fuente ](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/masculino-modelo-3d-aislado-3d-2487481/)</center>


Mientras decidía retomar también cursaba un taller de repostería, en el cual perfeccionaría mis técnicas, me nutriría con otras experiencias y saldría graduada. Allí me di cuenta cuales eran las cosas que hacía mal y que por ellos algunas producciones no salían, era una pequeñez, pero que afectaba toda una jornada. 

De entre las cosas que me llevé del taller está sustituir los aceites por manteca para mejor consistencia de la masa, ahorra materiales, bajar inversión y sobre todo resultados mejores.

Con el nuevo año, mi bello país siempre aprovecha para hacerse de las suyas, seguir inflando los precios o muchas veces desaparecer productos para sacarlos nuevos con otras tarifas. En enero un litro de aceite comenzó costando $1200, en un país donde hay salarios de $2800. La cuestión es que estos precios alteran mi ficha de costo y el valor de mis ofertas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRW6d5KPAZpKC4tQVhfvJZD8asPaXToLWfBj4zdVv3LM7/img_1262.png)
<center>[Fuente ](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/manteca-comida-plato-l%c3%a1mina-8544550/)</center>

La sugerencia del curso me vino como anillo al dedo pues la manteca la última vez que vi vendiendo salía más económica. Pero, dónde hay manteca, me dieron varias direcciones particulares pero en ninguna había disponible. El estado no te oferta nada de estos productos, cuando desistí con la manteca quise retomar el aceite y adivinen. 

Spoiler: también desapreció.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc5HZ4LFxDp2gQ7T1wGRpV5KAgqwW8JdzWh5vmuRs3Tcp/img_1261.jpg)
<center>[Fuente ](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/petr%c3%b3leo-aceitunas-botella-vidrio-8833794/)</center>

Mantener un emprendimiento donde más que constancia y disciplina tienes que ponerle muchas ganas y como si fuera poco en un país donde carecen hasta las ganas de permanecer en él es muy difícil. Mantener un emprendimiento que trata de sobreponerse a estas mismas circunstancias resultando un tanto imposible, no es nada fácil.

Como emprendedora es frustrante porque es algo que no puedo hacer más, estas cosas no dependen de mi. Ahora sin uno de los materiales, la constancia se ve afectada, la disciplina comienza a flaquear y las ganas se ven un tanto vulnerables.

Hace dos días conversaba con mi hermano sobre una pasta que hacía falta para una actividad y le comentaba que no tenía todos los ingredientes a lo que él me respondió que él sí los tenía debido a que en su emprendimiento las pastas son necesarias. Me comenta que él compra los ingredientes en grandes cantidad como reserva ante la escasez porque sino viviera detenido a cada rato. Ahí tuve otra lección. 

<hr>

De esta situación me llevo: debo hacer un stock de materiales, para estos casos donde el país no colabora (again) debo prepararme una reserva así como hacen los militares y como mi hermano. 

Una vez más mi emprendiendo tratando de sobreponerse. Es complicado, pero puede lograrse. 

Abrazo!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMbB7dyG4aZvodEevQiEnScK6HnK1Yt9knsYvSYUF5se/img_1390.png)

In January I resumed my business of polvorones, one that has gone through more bad spells than good, but despite wind and tide, there it is, coming out afloat and overcoming. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXFewjasfD57USejUEVky3Tg2jcumHbSqPUhq2VpqcZfq/img_1263.jpg )
<center>[Source ](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/masculino-modelo-3d-aislado-3d-2487481/)</center>


While I decided to resume I also studied a pastry workshop, in which I would perfect my techniques, nourish myself with other experiences and graduate. There I realized what were the things I was doing wrong and that because of them some productions did not come out, it was a small thing, but it affected an entire day. 

Among the things that I took from the workshop is to replace the oils with butter for better consistency of the dough, saves materials, lower investment and above all better results.

With the new year, my beautiful country always takes the opportunity to make its own, continue inflating prices or many times disappearing products to get new ones with other tariffs. In January, a liter of oil started costing $1200, in a country where there are salaries of $2800. The thing is that these prices alter my cost tab and the value of my offers.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRW6d5KPAZpKC4tQVhfvJZD8asPaXToLWfBj4zdVv3LM7/img_1262.png )
<center>[Source ](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/manteca-comida-plato-l%c3%a1mina-8544550/)</center>

The suggestion of the course came to me as a ring on the finger because the butter the last time I saw selling was cheaper. But, where is there butter, I was given several private addresses but none were available. The state does not offer you any of these products, when I gave up with the butter I wanted to resume the oil and guess what? 

Spoiler: It was also unappreciated.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc5HZ4LFxDp2gQ7T1wGRpV5KAgqwW8JdzWh5vmuRs3Tcp/img_1261.jpg )
<center>[Source ](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/petr%c3%b3leo-aceitunas-botella-vidrio-8833794/)</center>

Maintaining an entrepreneurship where more than perseverance and discipline you have to put a lot of desire into it and as if that were not enough in a country where they lack even the desire to stay in it is very difficult. Maintaining a business that tries to overcome these same circumstances, turning out to be somewhat impossible, is not easy at all.

As an entrepreneur it's frustrating because it's something I can't do anymore, these things don't depend on me. Now without one of the materials, perseverance is affected, discipline begins to falter and the desire looks somewhat vulnerable.

Two days ago I was talking to my brother about a pasta that was needed for an activity and I told him that I didn't have all the ingredients to which he replied that he did have them because in his business pasta is necessary. He tells me that he buys the ingredients in large quantities as a reserve in the face of shortages because otherwise he would live in detention all the time. I had another lesson there. 

<hr>

I take away from this situation: I must make a stock of materials, for these cases where the country does not collaborate (again) I must prepare a reserve just like the military do and like my brother. 

Once again my undertaking trying to overcome. It's complicated, but it can be achieved. 

Hug!

title.title: Hive Wizard Is Live
title.body:
Splinterlands has grown into the kind of game where serious players end up juggling a lot at once: multiple accounts, energy management, reward timing and the constant question of whether your setup is actually running the way you expect it to.

That is exactly why I built Hive Wizard, and today I am happy to say it is live.

Hive Wizard is a battle automation and account workspace built for Splinterlands players. The goal is not to add more noise or more complexity. The goal is to give players a cleaner, more reliable way to manage their accounts, run their sessions, and understand what is happening inside their setup without digging through scattered tabs and guesswork.

At launch, Hive Wizard is focused on practical value:

- a dedicated workspace for each account
- clear control over play behavior, energy thresholds, and reward automation
- visibility into recent sessions, recent teams, and battle logs
- a simpler credit model that charges based on won battles

One thing I cared about from the start was making the product feel transparent. If an account is running, you should be able to open the workspace and quickly see its current status, what happened in the last session, which teams were used recently, and what the bot is waiting on next. Good automation is not just about pressing a button and hoping for the best. It is about having enough visibility to trust the system you are using.

I also wanted the pricing side to stay straightforward. Hive Wizard now uses a credits-based model tied to wins, which keeps the experience easier to understand and closer to actual results. Instead of adding unnecessary friction around access, the product is moving toward a cleaner relationship between usage and value.

This launch is not the finish line. It is the first public step. The current version already gives players a strong control center for managing accounts and automation, but there is still plenty of room to expand from here with better insights, smoother workflows, and tighter quality-of-life improvements across the platform.

Check it out, Hive Wizard is live at https://hive-wizard.com.

I would genuinely like to hear what stands out to you. What feels useful, what feels unclear, and what would make it meaningfully better for your day-to-day Splinterlands routine. That kind of feedback is what will shape the next round of improvements. Join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/KUQxVQ3HrW) community and share your experience.

Thanks to everyone who has been following the build, testing features, and pushing for a better toolset around the game. Launching something is one milestone. Making it truly valuable to the Splinterlands community is the part that matters most.

PS: Survival mode is not supported as it requires explicit Splinterlands team approval to operate, which i didn't get so far.

Currently there is 1600 delegated. I am slowly delegating more HP as I can. There is  about 130 HP I could delegate right now leaving less than 300 HP needed for the goal.

. Curation also varies. But that's the point of the experiment isn't it?

Overall this experiment will be good for this account, regardless of which earns more on average. With the scheduled  buybacks having a little extra liquid HIVE on hand is a good thing for this account as it reduces the need to power down.

title.title: Pro, Alternator, 40.4 Mile Bike Ride Wander, Mowing, Pen Open, Pickup, Prep - Thursday
title.body:
<b>Found that I am doing okay with my Thumbtack profile as I have been given top pro status for a while. I'm just stoked to be getting jobs and clients now.
 
![Screenshot_20260507-070030.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tHbr9yksd5EXyDnXFvPpFyrJoyHDAabBpzahjaTzC1NAwqAxzar2nQGdSSR9GmLifdC.png)

I got the boys to school then headed to Autozone in Deer Park to get the new alternator. The old one was screeching and screaming every time I started the car and the car wouldn't start Wednesday morning.

![IMG_20260507_075240.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tmBGSg68KVCsuXyWDZhS2fdNzZ6YWqxEgjWtpQ65dpJ16aPZvk81zNoyfGNmNFN6hBu.jpg)

It went in in minutes and I let the car run a bit. My damn phone didn't charge overnight so had to try and get something back in it before my ride.

![IMG_20260507_083127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tvc1MaTvw3Gmk69Mtaf6RULbAvhoWLVcNpUN1L4cEnouE8u3d9Hp8U7EZKZ7Pzog25D.jpg)

So I went out with one road in mind to find and ride, it was a very short cut off road and was gravel. I realized if I headed north on north road it would have cut the gravel down in half... Just a prelude of my ride I guess. 

![IMG_20260507_092203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xyRCvGPR9EpCna6SPSYfG3TxiejjYv7EfnFAdjoZiEPZDWA7QUpFCLq5daNsmPhZ7hF.jpg)

Headed up Dalton then decided to try west on Burroughs. That took me to Monroe where I rode up to Bittrich-Antler and rode west.

![IMG_20260507_092209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/244KJTQtkCRfNyDNDPmCexc4rxB5ENbwczpPyRSM6T38m7R83KAbKakTBZs9XXQrCBVxq.jpg)

I had ideas of road that went north but they were all gravel.

![IMG_20260507_092215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/243ffb5YnnyorW3PPBuVEzpZ77ArWULw4K473PZqGx3i8SDCgphq93Zxa9krK5CXZ377s.jpg)

The thing that got me was riding straight at Scoop Mtn, one of the paragliding sites... 

![IMG_20260507_094817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/244oSfqPoxiTVDNrz8QzM2EYVWXRvKxBnahyrVzPDFaQU2YpeUtGTesgpvdMjUxR4o97U.jpg)

I ended up on Williams Valley road and I went north, a way I have never been before. Thankfully I had the maps on my Edge 540 so I could see if side roads went anywhere. I finally chose a gravel road east and then managed to end up almost exactly where I had hoped to, Clayton. From there I ended up on more gravel before finally settling back onto the pavement. I found Montgomery and took that east until it turned to gravel for a while then found Cedar which took me past the Deer Park airport. Down Perry and then had to do a back and forth on the Perry mile to make sure I was going to get past 40 miles.

![IMG_20260507_094821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/243WPSX4pzchbQEXG4vNgq4yX3SWTMgztkDHyfSsPJTRwPiv7hkzZ7nBQRudHSDDtrxf6.jpg)

I stopped my ride at the house at 40.4 miles, my longest ride yet. This was my last long ride before the 50 miler in 9 days. I will likely get a family ride in on Sunday then will do a 50K then a 40K ride tapers during the week, trying to give myself a couple days between to recover.

![bike 5-7 - 40 Mile.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tGY4d336yFeeZNHywTSdS7RCocZ5kdp84hbu1MhjHMuZgFFxwvYjLdGueqNLRiLEF9R.JPG)

I did rather well at staying in zone 2 for much of the ride. The leftover beef stew tasted soooo good after the exertion of the ride. 

![bike 5-7 - 40 Mile zones.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/Eo43n7DujdGYV5g5bKfSZQ8VkT9cym95Nz3e15D7arCcZBkaU5qLRzeWFwBHE9tT2tr.JPG)

I had some time before having to do pickups so I got the mower moving around the farm. Driveway entrance cut on the south side.

![IMG_20260507_140314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xovBoK5mznsMtoXqVYRpSER1w4byAJCjdFU7oBLLHKaoB5pabvDneqYJyuyudgpjzxD.jpg)

Then sections started but had to go around stands of camas to allow them to finish flowering. PLENTY more mowing to still be done.

![IMG_20260507_141720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u5xjoUrnxzjJP9MV2PEpWV3HuoJHsLVmZg3A8ZrTfFPuUBP7d4hinvtx8Wty6PVkFXj.jpg)

Lol, one of my finds on my ride. Mr Meeseeks's catchphrase is a mj company it appears.... MMM OOOWEE!

![IMG_20260507_151604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/2423oBUxXD9snmWAFicGKJkaWfmyLDMzuiLZunZ13YeVrbLAAwiZodW1vFrHvFXsaf8Bv.jpg)

In the short time before leaving I noticed the sheep were out of their hay so I popped open the fence in their pen and allowed them into the other pen where it is lush. I will have to come up with a bale soon.

![IMG_20260507_153552.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wqi8xMufL5uMgf9Xdq35Cg9S8PHKJZqfTFGijhpVCM4Sme9MYAu36Et9bytJt85nvqf.jpg)

The traffic was obnoxious as the boys and I headed to the airport to pickup @stryeyz. The eastbound 90 was backed up from Freya off ramp all the way to the base of Sunset hill.... Like 4 miles.... I chose to go through Airway Heights and the back way home. I managed to pull into a Circle K for gas and timed it perfect to get the .$40 off per gallon! Stoked on that. Then had to drive through the city, but without having to sit in the backup on the \

. Probably took the same time but it felt better moving more than just sitting crawling the miles. Once home I got dinner made and gathered my tools for the gate install job I have this morning. ![IMG_20260507_180814.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tmDgn7ud1SrpjP9UKJCCGJduSW14tmDVQcU1p6MMwuh1o6SDN4BvfT3KYrQnaiVnKLx.jpg) This morning I will get hte boys to school then come back and pack the car before heading to Home Depot to pickup the gates. I then head to client's house and will install the posts and gates. She has a number of other things that she will like in the future... They close on the house today and need the gates to be able to put their dogs in the yard. I then need to be done in time to pickup the Azure order in the early afternoon then will pickup J after his track finishing party. ---

![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gcd726f2c3530cfcb59759f993504f95921eacd23c09e7f49dfc0d9bf93acdfa0ef86f1b60d87bfcee71cadfa4ad0302eacece21db3c7bc56fc879cf2c3536f41_640.jpg)
今天的步行真是让我感到愉快！我沿着城市的公园小道漫步，阳光透过树叶洒在地上，空气中弥漫着花香。 在我路上遇到了一位老爷爷，他正在喂鸽子。他脸上的笑容是那么温暖，和我聊起了他年轻时的故事。他说，年轻时常常在这个公园里跑步，现在则喜欢慢慢地享受每一天。 另外，我在一个小摊上发现了一种新奇的水果，叫做“龙眼”。摊主热情地邀请我尝试，我尝了一口，果肉甜蜜多汁，真是个惊喜！这样的发现总是让我的散步充满乐趣。 今天的步行让我再次感受到人与人之间的温暖和城市生活的小美好。 _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: Lunch at the arcade, then the street just opens up
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778198743-9f5baa1916cf.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/herberthoover/seed-herberthoover-2026-05-08/main-1-1778198743-9f5baa1916cf.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

I came through the covered market around one o'clock, the kind of place where the light hangs warm and everything smells like bread and fresh tomatoes. I wasn't really planning to stop, just cutting through on my way somewhere else, but that's how these days go sometimes.

There's a small spot tucked into the side where an older woman sells pastries and small plates. I grabbed a couple of things, nothing fancy, and found a table facing out toward the street. The light was coming through the arch in a way that made everything feel slower. I sat there with a glass of white wine and just watched people move past, the kind of quiet watching you can only do when you're not actually going anywhere.

After I finished, I stepped back out onto the street and the whole afternoon had already changed. The sky was clearing, there was that specific warmth you get in May when it finally feels like summer might actually come. The vendors were still setting out fruit, the cobblestones were damp from someone washing down the arcade, and I could hear conversations in a dozen different languages just floating around.

I walked for maybe an hour after that, not really tracking where. Just following the kind of rhythm you fall into when a meal sits right and the day is cooperating. Found myself in neighborhoods I don't usually pass through, stopped to look at windows, watched a couple of kids chase a ball across a small plaza.

It's strange how lunch can do that. How one good hour in a warm place can make the rest of the day feel like it belongs to you.

title.title: ဆေးဖက်ဝင်တဲ့ စိန်ပန်းပင်
title.body:
နွေဦးရဲ့ အပူရှိန်အောက်မှာ ရဲရဲနီအောင် ပွင့်လန်းတတ်တဲ့ စိန်ပန်းပင်ဟာ မြင်ရသူတိုင်းကို စိတ်ရွှင်လန်းစေရုံတင်မကဘဲ ရှေးယခင်ကတည်းက ဆေးဖက်ဝင်အပင်တစ်မျိုးအဖြစ်လည်း လူသိများခဲ့ပါတယ်ရှင်။ စိန်ပန်းပွင့်လေးတွေဟာ အပူဒဏ်ကို ခံနိုင်ရည်ရှိပြီး အေးမြတဲ့ အာနိသင်ရှိတာကြောင့် ကိုယ်တွင်းအပူကန်ခြင်း၊ အဖျားတက်ခြင်းနဲ့ ရောင်ရမ်းမှုတွေကို သက်သာစေဖို့အတွက် တိုင်းရင်းဆေးနည်းတချို့မှာ အသုံးပြုလေ့ရှိကြသလို စိန်ပန်းခေါက်နဲ့ အမြစ်တွေဟာလည်း သွေးဝမ်းသွားခြင်းနဲ့ အစာအိမ်ရောဂါတွေအတွက် အကျိုးပြုပါတယ်ရှင်။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdfqWHKdFwgWRhp6YetciZf1P12rMimfRfnh34DGqiFqC/1778244098827.jpg)
Photo by m

​Royal Poinciana trees, blooming brilliantly in the summer heat, are not only a sight to behold but have also been valued for their medicinal properties since ancient times. These flowers possess a cooling nature that helps alleviate internal heat, fever, and inflammation in traditional medicine, while the bark and roots are often utilized to treat ailments like dysentery and various digestive issues.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQwfzo2R1WRabdwgvqtUiS2CZuJmtZ6PkLNj69F8s9hFY/1778244126340.jpg)
Photo by me

​ဆေးဖက်ဝင်ပုံတွေကို ကြည့်မယ်ဆိုရင် စိန်ပန်းရွက်ကို သွေးပြီး လိမ်းပေးခြင်းဖြင့် အဆစ်အမြစ် ကိုက်ခဲတာတွေကို သက်သာစေနိုင်သလို ပန်းပွင့်ကို ပြုတ်ပြီး သောက်ပေးရင်လည်း သွေးတိုးကျစေတဲ့ အာနိသင်ရှိတယ်လို့ ဆိုကြပါတယ်ရှင်။ ဒါပေမဲ့ ဆေးနည်းအဖြစ် အသုံးမပြုခင်မှာ မိမိနဲ့ သင့်တော်မှု ရှိ၊ မရှိကို ကျွမ်းကျင်သူတွေနဲ့ တိုင်ပင်ဖို့တော့ လိုအပ်ပြီး အလှပန်းပင်အဖြစ်ရော ဆေးဖက်ဝင်အပင်အဖြစ်ပါ တန်ဖိုးရှိလှတဲ့ ဒီအပင်လေးကို အိမ်ခြံဝင်းထဲမှာ စိုက်ပျိုးထားသင့်ပါတယ်ရှင်။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSp3bkEN4MXKfSP1QAFnA53dYCKWJAN29DVgPXH2iJMA/img_0.2951814577976987.jpg)

​In terms of specific benefits, crushed leaves can be applied topically to relieve joint pain, and some believe that drinking a decoction of the flowers can help lower blood pressure. However, it is always wise to consult with an expert before using them as a remedy, making this tree a versatile and valuable addition to any garden for both its beauty and its healing potential.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsXBwGDZRwEo7DTMwTP7GYwGb6fqNF7nSHMigpGntxF5/1774362219317.png)

title.title: Public and Private     ...Part 3    ...Repairing a Rift
title.body:
*Love is as strong as death; unyielding as the grave. It burns like a blazing fire; like a mighty flame. Many waters cannot quench love, rivers cannot wash it away. — Solomon*


![Loss.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeccvkX73PqS9tKs2ucRuW9ckjNNvLAr2BSSJGNg3n8fY/Loss.png)


I’m alone in the Alps in Trentino-Alto Adige, the mountainous region on the border between Austria and Italy exhuming an ancient iceman who’s been entombed in the frozen ice layer for several millennia. Why I’m here instead of being back in Toronto working out a family crisis is a question beyond me—suffice it to say, I’m elusive as the abominable snowman I’m tasked with excavating… And truth is, it’s a distraction from a personal dilemna for which I have no immediate solution. My daughter broke contact with Linda and me for 3 years and got married without inviting or even notifying us. Yeah, so maybe I’m bitter and burying myself as well, while I free some ancient herdsman from his unfortunate entrapment.

But being the dispassionate professional I’ve always been, I spend the next few hours inside the tent meticulously picking away at the icy sheet that entombs the corpse. He’s a young huntsman and as I work, I puzzle over what led him to hike in these treacherous mountains. He looks to be no more than twenty—his reddish brown hair, still perfectly preserved. I notice a brown leather satchel in the ice beneath his hand. I chip away for twenty minutes until I finally free it.

The leather flap is frozen shut, so I place it near the propane lantern to let it thaw. While waiting, I notice tattoo marks on the youth’s arm just above the wrist—I’ve seen them before—symbols of betrothal. The tattoo was etched into the boy’s flesh with a flint knife smeared with ashes. Perhaps, by his father. This was not just a young man out hunting—this was a man betrothed—on a journey to fetch his wife.

I sit back and stare at the youth’s face. In the repose of death the features have relaxed back into the face of a child. A great sadness descends upon me. I grieve for this grown boy—for the parents who would never see him again. They’ve lost a son. They’ll never look upon his face, hold him in their arms, or say goodbye. They can’t bury his body or mark his grave. His child bride is also bereft. She’ll grieve his loss the rest of her days. *A newlywed,* just like my daughter, cut off from family.

I pull back the tent flap and go outside and stand looking at the snowy waste. The sky has cleared. Overhead, the great constellations slowly rotate. The vault of heaven is like a celestial star dial—the circling stars marking times and seasons. I can’t comprehend the number of nights he has lain here beneath the stars. Cut off. Abandoned. I begin to cry—for him—for me—and for our own loss.

But the stars are indifferent—unaware of the frisson sweeping over me—they’re also oblivious of the child-man in the tent. The black emptiness is alien—unfeeling—dead. This is no place for me. I go back in and pick up the sodden leather satchel and carefully pull the flap back. Inside are stones—black beads of glass. A wedding gift. *Loss upon loss.*

I think of our lives—our struggle and pain. Gunnar is spending the night with friends—Linda is sitting alone by the fire—Pauline is living estranged from us. And I’m somewhere back in time, grieving another family’s loss. It’s strange. Inner space can be as desolate as outer space.

Tomorrow, Gunnar will come and we’ll extract the boy’s remains. He’ll probably end up on display like the previous iceman—a lifeless shell of what he was. The curious will come—point to his tattoos and wonder. But what he is will be lost to them. They’ll see the desiccated corpse, but the inner mystery won’t be discerned.

Still, perhaps parents like Linda and me will come who will know—who may stand in the gap and grieve for him. Will they understand his last thought was to scrape his way up from the grave and come back to them? Will they perceive that his outstretched hand says it all? Perhaps not… But I’ll do what he cannot—I’ll go home and try to bridge the gap, the rift between our daughter and us. One loss is enough, and one more, far too much. Life is too short for remorse.

title.title: A Visit to the Grounds of Vienna's Schönbrunn Palace [ENG/PL]
title.body:
> We have to drive all the way across Slovakia to reach the Austrian capital, yet it's closer than Warsaw. Only a few kilometers away, but I enjoy geographical curiosities like that—as well as the fact that both Vienna and Warsaw are within 370–380 km of our home. The closest capital city to us, however, is Bratislava, which we've never been to, though we've driven through it so many times that we probably know its ring road by heart. We know Vienna quite well. I first worked there alone for two and a half years, then returned after a few years' break when we were a couple, and we still enjoy returning. We love Vienna's atmosphere, architecture, and the fact that it's easy to explore thanks to its excellent public transportation. Last weekend was just such a return to the old haunts. We set off early on Saturday morning—the journey passed quickly and without any unwanted incidents, although I complicated it a bit by forgoing a vignette. We had to drive a short distance from the Austrian-Slovak border on regular roads, so instead of four hours, the drive turned out to be almost five. A small price to pay for a saving that probably wasn't much of a saving. We arrived at the hotel before 2 p.m.—the perfect start to our check-in time. We unpacked, took a breather, and then began our plan: to revisit our favorite spots in the city.
![line.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/EoJy9ee9vJf2Cwv6D2SAKPm8cDrt2HZEpLT3GqpRvBeYRTZ6TB2xUPkyKZowzgWTXxy.png) *** ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23yJCEozy2UgbBBTYcYaSNzjtds8jCgmeVJSqkSBgbjavcUEo7kqhpm6v37ubtJk5K3dM.jpg) *** Our first stop was Schönbrunn and its surrounding gardens. When we lived in Austria, we often strolled through here after work or on weekends. This isn't a place you just come to for sightseeing. You can sit on the grass on the hill, grab a snack or a book, and simply relax. It was only a 20-minute walk from our accommodation. We entered from the back, up the hill, and it turned out to be a great solution. We could walk through the entire complex from top to bottom and exit through the main gate directly onto the metro. No need to return to the starting point. *** ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23ywsGLW6PRqKAfwYib4W3T2kWrUc42cvmtapTyVVmQP1v9vwqKczymXSEno6Kf2VsVyL.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23w2mLSyops4qYe7gd6rb3q8xZBGkfHr7EpZVZpnAamjo5NN7PtYwwQGsNG1KpQg43xwS.jpg) ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23zRzmV1wHFonACSgA2ftVm79tmeQVopFrw6SvFNoa19HfbaFvy4x34V86mabXvUuBzQF.jpg) *** The first important landmark we encountered was the Gloriette. This structure is the icing on the cake of the entire complex. It crowns the palace hill and also provides an excellent vantage point overlooking the gardens, the palace, and much of Vienna. *** ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/243frC6c9iMQ9GqMLd17R3278r7cjdH8KX9LBgfLMWyXJgzBYNdMC5jnKvz7LpHn8gJWR.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/244xwv34h2Bzf9jsUr936SmWTEBdWEArc4gyscSwKhyNpWUEwSzZnLTFXpQ1dcUF3QKEq.jpg) *** There's a fee to access the roof and the café inside – we opted out this time. A walk around the building and the opportunity to admire it from the outside was enough for us. Although it's small, I consider it one of the most beautiful monuments in Vienna. Sometimes the simplest structures evoke the greatest emotions. And that's exactly what I felt with the Gloriette. Perfect symmetry, open spaces between the arches, and beautiful decorations. A thing of beauty. *** ![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23tvpqA4iunh4zmq6ePk8h3NfXLQwpPeJW21tEkAsLpbW965SNDY3dwnzZEaAthhddpvx.jpg) ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23zbPy8a4WgSdscdi1LhGZeYqfasF8k2Af9YVasUwyuVQFdWN2VRDsyZU8ZKK8hR9VFyj.jpg) *** Below, beneath the hill, the main palace stands proudly, standing out against the city skyline. Simple and as symmetrical as the garden separating it from the hill, it boasts a profusion of windows – 1,441 in total – and just as many rooms. It's hard to imagine this from the outside. Before approaching the palace, we first wanted to see the palm house, which is accessed via a path just below the hill. Halfway there, however, we realized it was only open until 4:00 PM. It was 3:45 PM. We'd never seen this attraction before, and as it turned out, we didn't make it this time either. We wanted to do it the next day, but we ran out of time. *** ![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/2458LRCuKrwBjNZDCu2pMynXA4jbz9h1ksZ1C6amrffexvUR25sPMUTdqa21rQgkMekqZ.jpg) ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23xAR8Voz1pVY16ApxErRE5hiQBYYwkEYjdUxM3LYpcZ2UZUKtNEVn6iCPxxyamKZh4SV.jpg) *** On the way to the palace, we stopped briefly at the Neptune Fountain. We also took a moment to look at the Gloriette from the palace floor, seeing how proudly it perched on the hill. It resembles a royal crown, a testament to the imperial power of the Habsburgs, who were responsible for the construction of Schönbrunn. *** ![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23z7Dubqk6p3Cc68921XoefYHZ6hRrvieEe3ajEKiBHaLocBRf8nNhBGbJf1DvEkG9VR6.jpg) ![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wX5LdWAwV6JZWPFRtYzqUHQkYAS7YwfFV9DfTdT9BFvjkYiXTWzxCXA8YXcVtbv5kvx.jpg) *** The area directly behind the palace consists mainly of a few rectangular sections covered with grass and small clusters of flowers, separated by walking paths. This is clearly visible in the photos from the hill I showed above. There were many people strolling around, and it's no wonder. It was one of the warmest days of the year. The sun shone intensely all day, and the sky was cloudless. *** ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wgWTKPLxGNzHE71XXjTLxWorrQyEzYTy12a4J7KJuLJJSgK4iGecYfiPz8Vgcz5oetg.jpg) ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23x14cYXKNCX7pwTtAMdsGSsq459yrftWqp2YUCR7cgFB6JM1CKQ5XzdUXvtnWJqiJmmQ.jpg) *** We then crossed to the other side of the palace and headed for the exit. The front area is almost entirely under renovation, so we didn't stop there. We wanted to see other places that day, sit down for a while at a pub, and quench our thirst with something other than water. What I've shown here is only a fraction of what the entire complex has to offer. Besides the aforementioned Palm House, there's also the Tiergarten – founded in 1752, the oldest continuously operating zoo in the world. We were there a few years ago and feel no need to return. We have a plan for our next visit: the palace interiors, the museums, and that unfortunate Palm House. This time, the weather was too beautiful to spend any time inside. *** ![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wgRzUAxkn1aawK8rKGtFfgXoZYfoMzyySk71HXMyXoPCznFMNaARTX93RRPBfcQsUN7.jpg) *** After leaving the palace grounds, we headed to the U4 metro station. Our next stop was Karsplatz, but more on that in the next post. That's enough for today. See you soon!
![line.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/EoJy9ee9vJf2Cwv6D2SAKPm8cDrt2HZEpLT3GqpRvBeYRTZ6TB2xUPkyKZowzgWTXxy.png) ***Polska Wersja:***
### Witam społeczność Worldmappin!

> Do stolicy Austrii musimy przejechać całą Słowację, a mimo to mamy do niej bliżej niż do Warszawy. Tylko kilka kilometrów różnicy, ale takie geograficzne ciekawostki lubię — podobnie jak fakt, że zarówno Wiedeń jak i Warszawa mieszczą się w przedziale 370–380 km od naszego domu. Najbliżej nam natomiast do Bratysławy, w której nigdy nie byliśmy, choć przejeżdżaliśmy przez nią tyle razy, że pewnie znamy jej obwodnicę na pamięć. Wiedeń znamy całkiem dobrze. Najpierw pracowałem tam sam przez 2,5 roku, a później wróciłem po kilkuletniej przerwie już kiedy byliśmy parą i do dziś chętnie tam wracamy. Bardzo lubimy klimat Wiednia, architekturę i fakt, że łatwo się go zwiedza dzięki znakomitej komunikacji miejskiej. Poprzedni weekend był właśnie takim powrotem na stare śmieci. Wyruszyliśmy wcześnie rano w sobotę — droga minęła szybko i bez niechcianych przygód, choć trochę ją sobie skomplikowałem rezygnując z winiety. Krótki odcinek od granicy austriacko-słowackiej musieliśmy przejechać zwykłymi drogami, więc zamiast czterech godzin jazdy wyszło prawie pięć. Drobna cena za oszczędność, która pewnie oszczędnością nie była. Do hotelu dotarliśmy przed 14 — idealnie na początek doby hotelowej. Rozpakowanie, chwila oddechu i zaczęliśmy realizować nasz plan, którym było ponowne zobaczenie naszych ulubionych miejsc w mieście.
![line.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/EoJy9ee9vJf2Cwv6D2SAKPm8cDrt2HZEpLT3GqpRvBeYRTZ6TB2xUPkyKZowzgWTXxy.png) *** ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23yJCEozy2UgbBBTYcYaSNzjtds8jCgmeVJSqkSBgbjavcUEo7kqhpm6v37ubtJk5K3dM.jpg) *** Pierwszym przystankiem był Schönbrunn i otaczające go ogrody. Kiedy mieszkaliśmy w Austrii często przechadzaliśmy się tędy po pracy lub w weekendy. To nie jest miejsce, do którego przychodzi się wyłącznie zwiedzać. Można usiąść na trawie na wzgórzu, zabrać coś do jedzenia lub książkę i po prostu się zrelaksować. Wiedeńczycy doskonale o tym wiedzą. Z naszego noclegu mieliśmy tu zaledwie 20 minut spaceru. Weszliśmy od tyłu, od strony wzgórza — i okazało się to świetnym rozwiązaniem. Mogliśmy przejść cały kompleks od góry do dołu i wyjść przez główną bramę prosto do metra. Bez powrotu do punktu startowego. *** ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23ywsGLW6PRqKAfwYib4W3T2kWrUc42cvmtapTyVVmQP1v9vwqKczymXSEno6Kf2VsVyL.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23w2mLSyops4qYe7gd6rb3q8xZBGkfHr7EpZVZpnAamjo5NN7PtYwwQGsNG1KpQg43xwS.jpg) ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23zRzmV1wHFonACSgA2ftVm79tmeQVopFrw6SvFNoa19HfbaFvy4x34V86mabXvUuBzQF.jpg) *** Pierwszym ważnym punktem na jaki natrafiliśmy była Glorieta. Budowla, która jest wisienką na torcie całego kompleksu. Zwieńczeniem wzgórza pałacowego i przy okazji znakomitym punktem widokowym na ogrody, pałac i sporą część Wiednia. *** ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/243frC6c9iMQ9GqMLd17R3278r7cjdH8KX9LBgfLMWyXJgzBYNdMC5jnKvz7LpHn8gJWR.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/244xwv34h2Bzf9jsUr936SmWTEBdWEArc4gyscSwKhyNpWUEwSzZnLTFXpQ1dcUF3QKEq.jpg) *** Wejście na dach i do kawiarni w środku jest płatne — tym razem z tego zrezygnowaliśmy. Wystarczył nam spacer dookoła budowli i możliwość podziwiania jej z zewnątrz. Mimo, że jest niewielka, to dla mnie jest jednym z najpiękniejszych zabytków Wiednia. Czasem najprostsze konstrukcje wywołują największe emocje. I tak właśnie mam z Glorietą. Idealna symetria, otwarta przestrzeń pomiędzy łukami i piękne zdobienia. Coś pięknego. *** ![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23tvpqA4iunh4zmq6ePk8h3NfXLQwpPeJW21tEkAsLpbW965SNDY3dwnzZEaAthhddpvx.jpg) ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23zbPy8a4WgSdscdi1LhGZeYqfasF8k2Af9YVasUwyuVQFdWN2VRDsyZU8ZKK8hR9VFyj.jpg) *** Poniżej, pod wzgórzem dumnie stoi główny pałac wyróżniający się na tle panoramy miasta. Prosty i równie symetryczny co ogród oddzielający go od wzgórza i ze sporą ilością okien, których w całym pałacu jest aż 1441. I tyle samo jest pomieszczeń. Ciężko to sobie wyobrazić oglądając pałac z zewnątrz. Przed podejściem do pałacu najpierw chcieliśmy zobaczyć palmiarnię, do której prowadzi ścieżka tuż pod wzgórzem. W połowie drogi jednak zorientowaliśmy się, że otwarta jest ona jedynie do 16. A była 15:45... Nigdy tej atrakcji nie widzieliśmy i jak się okazało tym razem także się nie udało. Chcieliśmy to zrobić kolejnego dnia, ale zabrakło nam czasu. *** ![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/2458LRCuKrwBjNZDCu2pMynXA4jbz9h1ksZ1C6amrffexvUR25sPMUTdqa21rQgkMekqZ.jpg) ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23xAR8Voz1pVY16ApxErRE5hiQBYYwkEYjdUxM3LYpcZ2UZUKtNEVn6iCPxxyamKZh4SV.jpg) *** W drodze do pałacu zatrzymaliśmy się na krótką chwilę przy fontannie Neptuna. Poświęciliśmy też chwilę, aby przyjrzeć się gloriecie z poziomu pałacu. Zobaczyć jak dumnie wznosi się na wzgórzu. To coś jak królewska korona, która świadczy o imperialnej potędze Habsburgów odpowiedzialnych za powstanie Schönbrunnu. *** ![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23z7Dubqk6p3Cc68921XoefYHZ6hRrvieEe3ajEKiBHaLocBRf8nNhBGbJf1DvEkG9VR6.jpg) ![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wX5LdWAwV6JZWPFRtYzqUHQkYAS7YwfFV9DfTdT9BFvjkYiXTWzxCXA8YXcVtbv5kvx.jpg) *** Teren bezpośrednio za pałacem, to głownie kilka prostokątnych fragmentów porośniętych trawą i niewielkimi skupiskami kwiatów, przedzielone ścieżkami spacerowymi. Widać to dobrze na zdjęciach ze wzgórza, które pokazałem wyżej. Sporo ludzi się tedy przechadzało i nie ma się co dziwić. Był to jeden z najcieplejszych dni w roku. Słońce intensywnie świeciło przez cały dzień, a niebo było bezchmurne. *** ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wgWTKPLxGNzHE71XXjTLxWorrQyEzYTy12a4J7KJuLJJSgK4iGecYfiPz8Vgcz5oetg.jpg) ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23x14cYXKNCX7pwTtAMdsGSsq459yrftWqp2YUCR7cgFB6JM1CKQ5XzdUXvtnWJqiJmmQ.jpg) *** Następnie przeszliśmy na drugą stronę pałacu i kierowaliśmy się już do wyjścia. Teren od frontu niemal cały jest aktualnie w remoncie, dlatego też nie zatrzymywaliśmy się tam. Chcieliśmy jeszcze zobaczyć tego dnia inne miejsca, usiąść na chwilę w jakiejś knajpie i zaspokoić pragnienie czymś innym niż tylko woda. To co tu pokazałem to jedynie część tego, co oferuje cały kompleks. Oprócz wspomnianej palmiarni znajduje się tu także Tiergarten - założony w 1752 roku, najstarsze nieprzerwanie działające zoo na świecie. Byliśmy tam kilka lat temu i nie czujemy potrzeby powrotu. Na kolejną wizytę mamy plan: wnętrza pałacu, muzea i ta nieszczęsna palmiarnia. Tym razem pogoda była zbyt piękna, żeby spędzać czas w środku. *** ![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wgRzUAxkn1aawK8rKGtFfgXoZYfoMzyySk71HXMyXoPCznFMNaARTX93RRPBfcQsUN7.jpg) *** Po opuszczeniu terenów pałacu udaliśmy się do stacji metra lini U4. Kolejnym punktem zwiedzania miał być Karsplatz, ale o tym w kolejnym poście. Na dzisiaj wystarczy. Do zobaczenia wkrótce!

title.title: La propera guerra que sacsejarà els mercats mundials: riscos geopolítics en un món en tensió
title.body: En un context de fragilitat econòmica global, les tensions geopolítiques continuen sent el factor més imprevisible i disruptor per als mercats financers. El 2026 ja ha vist conflictes actius, com l'escalada al Pròxim Orient entre Estats Units, Israel i l'Iran, que ha provocat tancaments temporals de l'Estret d'Ormuz i augments significatius en els preus del petroli. Tanmateix, la \

o escalada que podria moure els mercats de manera profunda probablement girarà al voltant de l'estret de Taiwan, un escenari d'alt risc que combina factors militars, econòmics i tecnològics.

### El context actual: un món en alerta permanent

Des de l'inici del 2026, els mercats han navegat entre conflictes actius i amenaces latents. La guerra al Pròxim Orient ha demostrat com un enfrontament regional pot generar xocs energètics globals: interrupcions en el subministrament de petroli, increments en els preus de les matèries primeres i volatilitat en les borses. L'Estret d'Ormuz, per on passa una gran part del cru mundial, ha esdevingut un punt crític. Qualsevol prolongació o reescalada podria empènyer la inflació i frenar el creixement.

Paral·lelament, la guerra a Ucraïna persisteix en un estancament d'atrrició, amb riscos d'escalada híbrida per part de Rússia contra l'OTAN. Aquests conflictes mantenen elevats els preus de l'energia i els costos d'assegurances marítimes, afectant les cadenes de subministrament.

### Taiwan: el polvorí que podria desencadenar una crisi global

L'escenari més preocupant per als analistes econòmics és una possible crisi o invasió xinesa a Taiwan. Pequín ha intensificat les seves activitats militars al voltant de l'illa, amb vols freqüents d'avions i exercicis navals. Experts parlen d'una \
el 2026, impulsada per factors com la percepció de debilitat nord-americana sota l'administració Trump, la determinació de Xi Jinping per a la \

i les tensions internes a Taiwan.

**Per què mouria els mercats de manera dramàtica?**

- **Semicondutors i tecnologia**: Taiwan produeix més del 60% dels xips avançats mundials (TSMC). Un bloqueig o conflicte interrompria immediatament les cadenes de subministrament, provocant escassedat en electrònica, automòbils, IA i defensa. Això podria causar caigudes borsàries similars o superiors a les de la pandèmia.

- **Comerç marítim i energia**: Un conflicte a l'estret de Taiwan afectaria rutes comercials vitals entre Àsia i la resta del món, augmentant costos de transport i generant inflació importada.

- **Resposta internacional**: Una intervenció nord-americana o sancions massives contra la Xina desencadenarien una fragmentació econòmica global, amb \

accelerat, caiguda del comerç i volatilitat extrema en divises i matèries primeres.

- **Efecte dominó financer**: Els mercats reaccionarien amb fugida cap a actius segurs (dòlar, or, bons del Tresor), caigudes en borses asiàtiques i europees, i possible recessió tècnica en economies dependents de la Xina.

### Altres riscos latents

- **Escalada al Pròxim Orient**: Si l'alto el foc actual amb l'Iran falla, nous tancaments de l'Estret d'Ormuz podrien portar el petroli per sobre dels 150 dòlars per barril.

- **Híbrid rus**: Atacs cibernètics, sabotatges o provocacions contra infraestructures europees podrien augmentar els preus de l'energia i la incertesa.

- **Minerals crítics i multipolaritat**: La competència per terres rares i aliances minerals entre Occident i la Xina ja està reconfigurant cadenes de subministrament.

### Impacte esperat als mercats i recomanacions

Un conflicte major a Taiwan podria reduir el creixement global en diversos punts percentuals, segons models econòmics, amb caigudes borsàries del 20-30% en escenaris greus i increments sostinguts en la inflació. Els sectors beneficiats serien defensa, energia (si no hi ha disrupció total) i certs commodities; els perjudicats, tecnologia, automoció i consum discrecional.

Els inversors haurien de considerar:
- Diversificació geogràfica i sectorial.
- Exposició a actius defensius i or.
- Seguiment estret d'indicadors militars a l'estret de Taiwan i declaracions de Pequín i Washington.

En conclusió, la \

no serà necessàriament una invasió total, sinó qualsevol escalada que alteri el fràgil equilibri actual. Els mercats ja preuen riscos geopolítics, però una sorpresa a Taiwan o al Golf Pèrsic podria canviar el panorama econòmic mundial de manera irreversible. La incertesa és l'única certesa: la preparació i la vigilància seran claus per navegar aquest 2026 turbulent. \n

title.title: The lake was too quiet for football
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778198683-d0f604279fa9.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/siona/seed-siona-2026-05-08/main-1-1778198683-d0f604279fa9.png)
![main-2-1778198693-25888a2bdd92.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/siona/seed-siona-2026-05-08/main-2-1778198693-25888a2bdd92.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

I brought a ball to the valley today, thinking I'd kick it around by the water. The kind of thing that sounds simple until you're actually standing there with the mountains watching and the lake so still it looks like glass.

My friends and I used to play in the park near the city, all noise and movement and someone always shouting. But this place does something different to you. The air is thinner up here, or maybe I'm just more aware of it. The ball felt heavier than usual in my hands.

We started near the grass by the shore, and for a few minutes it was fun, genuinely fun, the kind where you're not thinking about anything else. But then I noticed how the sound of the ball hitting boot echoed off the rock faces. How the ducks scattered when we got too loud. How the mountains seemed to lean in closer, not to watch us play but to ask us to be quieter.

So we stopped. We sat down on the grass with our backpacks and a thermos of tea, and I watched the ball just sit there on the meadow, forgotten. One of my friends laughed and said the lake didn't want to be disturbed. I think she was right.

There's something about moving slowly in a place like this. About letting the sport be just the walking, the breathing, the sitting still and watching how the light moves across the water. I'm learning that not every kind of movement needs to be loud.

title.title: Follow Friday: Spike!
title.body:
# The News I am sure a lot of you saw that the $HIVE price jumped this week. It did not manage to stay above 9c, but it has settle higher than it was before. I hope some people were able to profit from this, but also that others took notice when it was one of the biggest climbing coins. Of course Hive is far more than just an investment with something for everyone. ![Prices from @coingecko](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/23w3CmUU42aiTL2NJwYYwyMwQTFYKYoh9GA4scb52n2mt7pZikvk9RCxTcVTJiyHRUTGU.png) It has been another busy week with updates from @worldmappin, @ecency, @keychain and witness @howo. I recommend following @hivetoday for more in-depth news. The other big news is the announcement from @hivefest about the next big meetup. That will be in Barcelona in September. # Friday Follows * I have been following updates from Hive Open Days in Alicante last weekend. You can find posts about it from @schmidi, @livinguktaiwan, @palomap3 and others. * I just saw a [nice list](/@cryptoreforma/analytical-power-at-hive) of Hive statistics resources from @cryptoreforma. You can track your own account and the chain in general with these. * @acidyo has been posting updates about [Scrobble.life](https://scrobble.life/) that lets you log your music listening on the blockchain via a browser extension. The extensions for Chrome and Firefox should be in the respective stores soon, but it is possible to load them via a download for now. * @an1info may have been on the blockchain before, but this is his new account on Hive. He makes videos about Linux and other technology. He [started well](/hive-174578/@an1info/my-intro-post-startup-with) by powering up direct to Dolphin. # The Dog House This is less about misdemeanors on the blockchain than avoiding trouble. Anyone who understands how Hive works knows that everything we do here is preserved indefinitely as transactions. That is every vote, post, and comment, including previous versions if you edit later. So you should be very conscious that things can come back to haunt you. This is why I am always careful about what I do and say. I was part of an anti-abuse group years ago and so anyone can see all the downvotes I handed out. I avoided following downvote trails as I wanted full control of those so that I could be sure that they were justified. We should each make our own decisions about what we vote on, but if you trust someone enough then you can follow their trails. You could try hiding behind alternative accounts, but you would have to be careful as any interaction between them can also be seen. I have always been open about those I control and have not tried to be anonymous. I can see why some people hide their identity and there can be various reasons for that. I expect that you could use 'AI' agents to investigate people these days and find links on other platforms to identify them, so anonymity may become harder to achieve. My strategy has been to be open and honest. I do not have to agree with everyone here, but I can choose who I engage with. I am not one to seek confrontation, but some people are into that. Hive has to be fun for me and I try to make it better for others. # The End A slight increase in the $Hive price ought to be grounds for optimism and we should ensure that the wider world knows about is. As I said to someone this week, we are all the marketing department. Hive five!

title.title: Everything can be fixed with a file.
title.body:
Everything can be fixed with a file. Everything can be fixed with a file—that's the old saying from a time-worn joke about spies trying to steal a secret piece of special equipment, so they stole the plans, but after assembling it, the result wasn't quite what they wanted, and they had to read the fine print—Fix it with a file! Today was the day I needed a file, because I wanted to find out what gardeners thought about treating common tomato diseases. After watching a bunch of videos, I realized that only a pink panther could find the truth in this chaos of disagreements. And since I didn't have a pink panther's camera... well, I've never seen such a panther in my life... I figured a green balloon on an orange ocean could replace the panther. ![1ag074D2C.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmaY588HESMoqz6vigiHNJUD4wwtz6HZ7PjzRcgzdA9gSq/1ag074D2C.png) After such a brainstorming session, I don't want to think about copper sulfate or whey, which are used to prevent tomato diseases, but rather I want to be distracted by the aroma of pink roses, in whose petals the Pink Panther could be hiding. ![1ag073D2C.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmSPzVDtu4CWQuaBQsvpLcAKMZWTaZeXZsnDQqENnynDfM/1ag073D2C.png) *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. title.title: 🌺Beautiful Red Hibiscus Photography From My Garden 🌺
title.body:
## _Hello Hive friends,_🤝
_Assalamu Alaikum everyone. I hope all of you are doing very well by the grace of Almighty Allah. Today I am very happy to share some beautiful photography of red Hibiscus flowers 🌺 from our area in Najran. I captured these photos on a bright sunny afternoon using my iPhone 12 Pro Max. The natural sunlight made the flowers 🌺 look even more vibrant and attractive._

![image.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPMWKCKAnXcFG1ECb7epUjPdmUW3egLqV6WniHXjpotUA/image.jpeg)

_The Hibiscus flower is one of the most beautiful flowers 🌺 found in tropical regions. Its bright red color easily attracts everyone’s attention. Whenever I see these flowers 🌺 blooming beside the road and around gardens, I feel refreshed and peaceful. Nature always gives us positive energy and inspiration._

![image.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW3jgH1Nm86MPrtvpN2UoC6dwb2wPinwtQ34jTxbvapfq/image.jpeg)

_*The weather was very clear during the photography session, and the blue sky along with the green leaves created a wonderful background for the flowers 🌺 .I especially loved the detailed texture of the petals and the bright yellow pollen in the center of the flower. These small details make the flower look incredibly beautiful.*_

![image.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNfGbSTZsGsS3kyJ9bArdWdCdzbs91kTpRtXTGA3hQJdL/image.jpeg)

_Photography is one of my favorite hobbies. I always enjoy capturing flowers, trees, and natural scenery around my village area. Every flower has its own beauty and uniqueness. Through photography🗻, we can preserve these beautiful 🤩 moments and share them with others._

![image.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQV6JFT5jPH3S3NYmWiJsPb7muL3ymtwUJ7dH9ePWGat/image.jpeg)

_The Hibiscus flower 🌺 is not only beautiful but also very useful. In many countries, people use Hibiscus flowers 🌺 for herbal tea, natural medicine, and decorative purposes. It symbolizes beauty, love, and positivity._

![image.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWdtA7M4BouU12bEx93F1JpZBn5z5tHr3hhNAHr3nzof3/image.jpeg)

_Today I am sharing these photographs 🎥 with all my Hive friends, and I hope you will enjoy them. Your support and valuable comments always inspire me to continue sharing more photography posts from nature and daily life._

![image.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmex79kLthcuGpQXvf3TB2MmvWj6XidWYYMeXwXoQWt5Gt/image.jpeg)

![image.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZPZVMq9W5kwWCubbqTqNLs7Say4yzG9rhLm2ZugxgDFA/image.jpeg)

_**🌺Have a wonderful day everyone🌺**_

## Device Information 📱

    • Device: iPhone 12 Pro Max.
    • Location: Al-Jurba Village, Najran.
    • Photography Type: Flower Photography.
    • Flower Name: Hibiscus rosa-sinensis.


**Thank you so much for visiting my blog and supporting my work.**

title.title: Escape from the Frozen Shadows
title.body:
https://youtu.be/D0d2KCkxmo8?si=_NsCMSTfwPlZITGW
Watch on YouTube 

The intense cold of the night towering walls armed guards stationed at every corner and a secret Russian gulag from which returning alive is considered almost impossible. Infiltrating a Secret Russian Gulag isn’t just an ordinary game but a dangerous mission that tests the player’s nerves at every moment. The game’s dark atmosphere snow covered paths and terrifying silence create the feeling that you’re actually inside a secret military prison.

The most special thing about this game is its stealth and survival gameplay. Every step has to be taken carefully because even a small mistake can alert the enemy. The player has to find secret paths move forward while avoiding enemies and discover secrets that make the whole story even more interesting. This is what keeps the game constantly thrilling.

The graphics and sound effects also take this game to a whole different level. The sounds of snowstorms alarms heard from a distance and dim lights burning in the darkness create a terrifying yet captivating atmosphere. Every scene feels like it’s part of a Hollywood spy film where danger is present at every moment.

If you like action, stealth and thriller games then this game will definitely impress you. This isn’t just a story about fighting enemies but also a test of intelligence patience and bravery. That’s why Infiltrating a Secret Russian Gulag becomes a memorable experience for gamers who love missions full of suspense and danger.

body.title: Pass/Fail Grading: Helpful Simplicity or Loss of Motivation?
body.body:
The study investigates whether pass/fail grading helps students learn better or leads to their academic decline. For many years, schools have used letter grades such as A, B, C, D, and F to measure a student’s academic performance. The grades determine student success or failure because they show the level of academic comprehension and dedication a student demonstrated throughout their studies. However, some people believe that schools should replace the traditional grading system with a simple pass/fail method. The approach decreases student stress while raising student happiness but it also eliminates their motivation and prevents them from achieving outstanding work.

  
The pass/fail system provides students with an advantage because it reduces their academic pressure. Many learners experience anxiety because they constantly worry about achieving high grades. Instead of focusing on learning, they become obsessed with competition and rankings. The pass/fail method enables students to learn about different subjects and participate in activities without worrying about their academic performance. The solution creates a better educational atmosphere which helps students achieve optimal mental health results.

  
Students benefit from pass/fail grading because it creates an equal academic playing field for all learners. The traditional grading system evaluates students by comparing their numerical and letter grades. Students who dedicate themselves to studying face discouragement when they encounter academic challenges. The pass/fail system assesses student performance based on their ability to meet predetermined standards at a specific level of academic achievement. The system enables students to gain confidence which drives them to pursue new educational challenges.

The process of eliminating detailed grades from student assessments creates multiple negative effects. Letter grades provide a clearer picture of a student’s performance. An “A” student and a “C” student both receive a “Pass” grade because they understand material at different levels of comprehension. The absence of particular grades makes it difficult for teachers, parents, colleges, and employers to understand how well students have achieved and what skills they possess.

  
The motivation to work hard will decrease for some students. Students will choose to do the least required work because only passing grades matter to them. Students can achieve their full potential through healthy competition, which teaches them discipline and drives them to improve. When academic performance lacks proper distinctions, students will experience limited academic growth.

  
The pass/fail grading system presents educational institutions with both advantages and disadvantages. The system provides stress reduction and morale enhancement while creating a supportive learning atmosphere. The system decreases student motivation while failing to identify various achievement levels. Schools should use traditional grading systems together with student well-being assessments to develop an educational system that provides both unbiased assessment and effective learning.

body.title: A good pace this season
body.body:
Halfway through the current season, my placement, almost on the verge of Champions League III, is decidedly encouraging. Every season has a different course; sometimes I start with extreme difficulty climbing the rankings, while other times the process is much easier from the very first days. I'm not entirely clear on what all this is about; perhaps sometimes I'm just unlucky in always facing players stronger than me, and other times the opposite.

![1000065043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23tbiSWsLUj93647j1vAX4ed3dVPN8Pqapi9BKp4x2feftfqPKfSjJbQ3BsswRQqGDjNm.jpg)
___

But the important thing is to reach the Champions League III goal and hope to also reach Champions League II. The first part of the season certainly affects GLINT rewards, as they increase the higher you reach the top end of the rankings. My seasonal rewards generally range between 300,000-350,000 GLINT, sometimes reaching as high as 380,000. Not bad, but I always want more!

Alas, my asset upgrades aren't impressive; I limit myself to sporadic targeted purchases of interesting cards, but also at a reasonable price. I hope that by upgrading epic Soulbound cards, my results can further improve. I'm also increasing my SPS staking to increase my GLINT rewards!

<center>
Thank you for taking the time to read this post. If you haven't signed up to Splinterlands yet, I invite you to give it a try. You can use my [referral link](https://steemmonsters.com?ref=claudio83)</center>

# ITA

A metà della stagione in corso, il mio piazzamento quasi a ridosso della Champions III è decisamente incoraggiante. Ogni stagione ha un corso differente, a volte parto con estrema difficoltà nella scalata della classifica, altre volte invece il processo è molto più semplice sin Dai primi giorni. Non ho ben compreso da cosa dipenda tutto ciò, probabilmente alcune volte sono sfortunato ad incontrare sempre giocatori più forti di me, altre volte invece il contrario. 

![1000065043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23tbiSWsLUj93647j1vAX4ed3dVPN8Pqapi9BKp4x2feftfqPKfSjJbQ3BsswRQqGDjNm.jpg)
___

Ma l'importante è raggiungere l'obiettivo della Champions III e sperare di arrivare anche in Champions II. L'andamento della prima parte della stagione influisce di certo sulle rewards GLINT poiché le stesse aumentano quanto più si raggiunge la parte alla della classifica. Generalmente le mie rewards stagionali oscillano tra i 300k-350k GLINT, a volte raggiungo anche i 380k. Non male ma vorrei sempre di più!

Ahimè i potenziamenti del mio asset non sono imponenti, mi limito ad acquisti mirati sporadici ormai di carte interessanti ma anche ad un prezzo economico. Spero che potenziando le carte Soulbound epiche i risultati possano ulteriormente migliorare. Inoltre sto accrescendo il mio staking SPS per aumentare le rewards GLINT! 

<center>
Thank you for taking the time to read this post. If you haven't signed up to Splinterlands yet, I invite you to give it a try. You can use my [referral link](https://steemmonsters.com?ref=claudio83)</center>

Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1895_full_5-08-26_1960_8thfl:7?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 
Opening Night. The Fifth Annual Eighth Floor Conference.      
It’s a Thursday evening somewhere in South Florida, maybe the Keys. A resort hotel. Huge and luxurious. We are welcoming the early birds to our Fifth Annual Eighth Floor Conference. This resort has always treated us “lufties” well. We wait for the sunset to get started.           
There are more folks here than expected. And more to come. 
Your humble vagabond, in the role of “keynote” speakers, takes to the stage. I’m holding a microphone, but there are a few other gizmos attached. This talk, maybe it’s more like an address, is going to be streamed. Our tech team says it’s going around the world, in over a hundred languages. We don’t have an audience that large, but the tech kids have this AI set up to translate my address, instantly. They advise me not to use my “signature” slanguage, or colloquialisms that are difficult to translate. I usually do it anyway. 
[This is a future retro piece about a Conference that may never exist. But if it does. It will probably be pretty cool.] 
The Eighth Floor Conference started out as a Rantcast during an Urban Expedition. Walking around in Florida thinking, “there should be an annual conference for men who are sincerely interested in living dynamically and abundantly into and beyond their 80s.” Over the past five years, we, along with a little help from our “allies” have hammered out a bit of a protocol to do just that.  
Although we targeted this Conference to men, we knew that women would come onboard. The first conference, only about a hundred humans, were about 50% women. We gratefully had a wide range of curious participants. There were more suggestions than we could keep up with. When you don’t really know what you’re doing, there are no narrow highways restricting the flow of ideas. 
When I laid out this conference, I was pretty much on my own. I figure, exercise, fitness, wellness, and not getting sick, were the main secrets. But after opening up the mic for, whatever, I got a real lesson. 
That first year participants ranged in age from mid-forties to early 90s. Some of these 90s cats were in pretty good shape too. No walkers and no wheel chairs. And they were funny. Rich in lived history. Had some kind of adventure for every decade. “When I was in my sixties…” There were some dudes that were concerned about making it out of their fifties. Can you imagine being on some medical protocol for over half of your life? He was maintaining. But for what? 
There was a “Longevity Physician” in the house that first year. I didn’t know there was such a thing. You know, your boy, “depopulation agenda. “They want us dead!” Which is another reason we launched this conference. We don’t have to die. That’s my attitude anyway. Anyway, this Longevity Physician gave me her book. We stayed in touch. She’ll be with us this weekend. Her workshops are always standing-room-only. In fact she’s one of the reasons we expanded the conference from Friday to Sunday brunch, to where we are now.  
This year we are going to expand our little podcast to something more like a network. The kids tell me we have enough juice to run 24/7 so we’ll have something up for you whenever. Live. You know, those times, at 3 in the morning, you can’t sleep or something, someone will be podcasting live and you can watch, dial in… or whatever the phrase is these days. 
Although I’m not with you Octos, Niners, or Centurians yet, watching you thrive and hearing your stories, have me kind of anticipating those magic years. I’m in no rush. But this is what it’s all about. We don’t have to dread that next birthday. We have the stats, from last year. The all cause mortality rate for all categories 60 and over, have dropped. Slightly. But I’ll take it. There are more families today with four or more generations living at the same time, than any other time in our history. Just imagine great-great-grand dad enjoying Thanksgiving with his brood, and not propped up in his chair drooling into the cranberry sauce.  
That’s it Ladies & Gentlemen.   Thank you for the inspiration, the support, the suggestions. Your goodies bags are special this year. We have items that represent the last five decades. You can read a book. You can plug a thumb-drive into your gadget, along with some other gizmos that are beyond me. 
Enjoy your time here, and remember to join my seminar, as always, our open mic, where you can come up on stage and spill your guts about what you went through in the last year. We know some of you are long-winded, while other are short on oxygen, so we’ll work out the timing as necessary. This year we are going to weave the first-timers in between the old-timers. It’s a good balance. 
We’ve got more folks coming in tomorrow, so I’ll be quite busy. Most of you know the routine so help out of you can. You might make a new friend. 
(Polite applause.) 
Writing this made me feel like I was there. We have a way of speaking reality into existence. If I keep yapping about this, I am liable to actually do something about it. 
If you are born in the vicinity of 1970, you’ll be 80 in 2050. We can either let 2050 happen to us, or we can happen to it!

[Projections of when each of 150 countries may eliminate air pollution and carbon emissions from all energy](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2026/su/d5su00912j)

China investiert massiv in erneuerbare Energien und die entsprechenden Technologien. China denkt und handelt strategisch und das bringt ihnen nicht nur aktuell Vorteile. Auch China ist abhängig von Ölimporten die durch die Straße von Hormus müssen. Aber durch gezielte Forschung und Investitionen in Innovation versucht es diese Abhängigkeiten zu reduzieren. Inzwischen ist die halbe Welt von China abhängig bei Rohstoffen wie Lithium, Photovoltaik und und und. Wann wacht der Rest der Welt auf?

>China is investing massively in renewable energies and the corresponding technologies. China thinks and acts strategically—a mindset that yields benefits extending far beyond the present moment. China, too, is dependent on oil imports that must pass through the Strait of Hormuz; however, through targeted research and investments in innovation, it is striving to reduce these dependencies. Meanwhile, half the world has become dependent on China for raw materials such as lithium, photovoltaic components, and much more. When will the rest of the world wake up?

body.title: Conversor de Letras: transforma tus palabras en estilos únicos y llamativos
body.body:
En un entorno digital donde cada detalle cuenta, la manera en que presentas tus textos puede marcar la diferencia entre pasar desapercibido o captar la atención de inmediato. Hoy en día, no basta con escribir bien; también es importante cómo se ve lo que escribes. Aquí es donde un [conversor de letras](https://conversordeletras.art/) se convierte en una herramienta imprescindible para quienes buscan destacar con un toque visual diferente.

Un conversor de letras en línea te permite tomar cualquier texto común y transformarlo en una versión estilizada, utilizando caracteres especiales y tipografías decorativas. Esto significa que puedes convertir una frase simple en algo atractivo, elegante o incluso divertido, dependiendo del estilo que elijas. Ya sea para redes sociales, mensajes personales o perfiles digitales, este tipo de herramienta abre un abanico de posibilidades creativas.

Una de las grandes ventajas de este recurso es su facilidad de uso. No necesitas descargar programas ni tener conocimientos técnicos. Simplemente escribes el texto que deseas transformar, exploras los diferentes estilos disponibles y eliges el que más te guste. En cuestión de segundos, tendrás una versión completamente nueva de tu mensaje lista para copiar y pegar en cualquier plataforma.

Las redes sociales son uno de los espacios donde más se aprovechan estas herramientas. En plataformas como Instagram, por ejemplo, una biografía con letras estilizadas puede hacer que tu perfil destaque entre miles de usuarios. En Twitter, donde el espacio es limitado, utilizar un formato diferente puede ayudarte a transmitir más personalidad en menos caracteres. Incluso en aplicaciones de mensajería como WhatsApp, enviar textos con estilos únicos puede hacer que tus conversaciones sean más dinámicas y expresivas.

Además, los conversores de letras ofrecen una amplia variedad de estilos. Desde tipografías elegantes que aportan un aire sofisticado, hasta diseños más atrevidos con símbolos y caracteres llamativos. Esto te permite adaptar tu mensaje según la ocasión, ya sea algo formal, creativo o simplemente divertido. Cada estilo tiene su propia esencia, lo que te da la libertad de experimentar y encontrar el que mejor represente tu forma de comunicarte.

Otro aspecto interesante es la posibilidad de crear una identidad digital más definida. Un nombre de usuario o un alias con estilo puede ser más fácil de recordar y más atractivo visualmente. Esto es especialmente útil para creadores de contenido, jugadores en línea o cualquier persona que quiera construir una presencia distintiva en internet. En un mundo saturado de información, destacar visualmente puede ser una gran ventaja.

También es importante destacar que estos estilos funcionan gracias a caracteres Unicode, lo que garantiza una buena compatibilidad con la mayoría de plataformas digitales. Esto significa que no tendrás problemas al utilizar tus textos convertidos en diferentes aplicaciones o sitios web. La versatilidad es una de las claves de este tipo de herramientas, ya que te permite usar tus creaciones prácticamente en cualquier lugar.

Más allá de su utilidad práctica, un [conversor de letras](https://conversordeletras.art/) también puede ser una fuente de entretenimiento. Probar diferentes estilos, combinar símbolos y experimentar con nuevas formas de escritura puede ser una actividad creativa en sí misma. Es una manera sencilla de darle un giro interesante a algo tan cotidiano como escribir.

En definitiva, un conversor de letras no solo transforma texto, sino que también transforma la manera en que te expresas en el mundo digital. Te permite destacar, personalizar y añadir un toque especial a cada palabra que compartes. Si buscas una forma sencilla de hacer tus textos más atractivos y originales, esta herramienta es una opción que vale la pena explorar.

body.title: Good Song, Good Lyric...
body.body:
>I love music; but most importantly, I love good music. Now, many will argue that good music is relative, and I completely agree. This is evidenced by the fact that many of my friends consider some of the genres of music I enjoy completely unentertaining. But then, I will not be discussing good music today. I just want to talk about my experience with some songs I have come to love, some of which sometimes stick themselves on my lips so much so that I literally alter them once in every three times I open my mouth to sing.

---


![1000343722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ernesto6402/23tGVvHfFtTViSQk6h1dsWZ5X8BoPTamYiKmyyjcKXTjM1jfu8sdnTmfAoaiRWp4cchu2.jpg)
[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-car-with-a-light-on-top-h7-XQT76cms)

---

Over the years, I have fallen in love with so many songs from different genres. For most of these songs, it was the lyrics that first drew my attention. “Shoe Maker”, for instance; I knew I would love the song from the first time I heard it. I have not yet heard the entire song nor understood the message it conveys, but I was already in love with the few words I had heard. But then, I must have been a little biased. The lyrics would have sounded meaningless if they had been accompanied by poor notes. It was not just the lyrics after all; the music sounded really good. Somehow, a funny and nonchalant lyric made sense simply because of how it was sounded. It was that which made me want to listen more — the fact that such nonchalant lyrics could be used to make musical sounds that are so powerful.

---

https://youtu.be/u7Yqdpzal4g?si=J4AAwPYEhFxCu_bm
<center>**Shoemaker by PD Wallson and Sinmidele**</center>

---


<div class=\

, I wanted to know more. I felt the sound was too serious for the lyrics it had been given, and I felt there would be more to what the composer was trying to say. I eventually realised that the initial words of the lyrics were a prelude to the main message of the song. But for \

, it was entirely different. The message of the song was clear right from the first sentence. It was as if the entire message of the song was summarised in every sentence of the lyric. There was no need to be inquisitive; everything about the song was already known, yet I listened to it over and over again.

---

https://youtu.be/G_NkExMLVwo?si=F3kw4UtA_C85lt7y
<center>**Fame by Adekunle Gold**</center>

---




<div class=\
>Sometimes, it is not just the message it conveys, but also the story it tells. \

is one song that tells an amazing story. You already know how the story will end from the beginning, yet you still want to hear it all. The chorus already summarises the message of the song, but the story keeps you patiently waiting. The composer gives you a hint of what will become of the characters in his story, but it is still so captivating that you want to hear it all.

---

https://youtu.be/asaq3OwVd9g?si=LIkdNxfn07iJSwgw
<center>**Everyday for the their by Cobhams, Sound Sultan and Bez**</center>


<div class=\
>When I spoke of songs that stick themselves on my lips, I was particularly talking about \

. I do not really know why, but I just find myself singing this song all of the time. It is also a song with amazing lyrics, but I do not think it has the most amazing lyrics I have heard. Yet, it somehow stuck itself in my head. For months now, I have been singing the lyrics of this song at least once in every three songs that I sing. I do not really know why, but I just have not been able to help it all this while... https://youtu.be/r1Fx0tqK5Z4?si=uVWKsrDr15q7UMfp
**Older by Sasha Alex Sloan**
--- **I am @ernesto6402, and I thank you for reading through to the end. One Love ✌🏽.** ![IMG_20240328_144926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ernesto6402/23xL59csuhTE6h9z13UvC6oaaPApKgGizvefiMENuMPUM82NHQXN5hbHLAztxRJM1YEN7.jpg) --- ---

body.title: That Spring Chill
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQs99tua38WEZTL6eRwtncUy99sWFpiA8MEiJgAKww3Xo/PXL_20260506_202726296.webp)

-------------------------

I got the chance to go watch my nephew play baseball the other day.  Despite how nice of a day it looks, it was actually quite cold.  By the end of the second game (it was a double header), we were absolutely freezing!  Which is kind of funny because we were even wearing our winter coats, but it was absolutely brutal.  

Even with the weather not being so cooperative, our nephews team was able to pull off a couple of wins to get the sweep.  They won the first game in a shut out, and then the second game was a thrilling come from behind victory.  Our nephew played really well getting a couple of put outs and knocking in a couple of RBI's as well.

Meanwhile, in basketball news, the Pistons were able to finish their first post season series in seven games with a fantastic win over the Magic.  They are currently up two games in the next series over Cleveland.  It's still too early to say if they are going to go the distance, but things are looking pretty good.  I even found myself watching game seven against the Magic and I haven't watched an NBA game in I can't remember how long.

Meanwhile, the conference tournaments continue to chug along in college softball.  Over in the ACC, number 8 Florida State took out Georgia Tech, number 19 Stanford sent number 24 Louisville home, number 13 Duke smashed North Carolina 16 to 8, and number 15 Virginia Tech beat Virginia 3 to 1.

As I said yesterday, the Big Twelve tournament got started yesterday with Kansas upsetting number 21 UCF 6 to 5, number 4 Texas Tech once again blanked Baylor 7 to 0, number 14 Oklahoma State did the same thing against Utah 7 to 0, and number 23 Arizona State slipped past number 20 Arizona 2 to 1.

In the Big South tournament, Radford had a tough lost 1 to 0 against USC Upstate to move the Highlanders down to the secondary bracket.  It was a really tight game and there is a point where our niece was pinch running and the coach had her stop at third base.  I think if he had sent her she could have made it home, but hindsight is 20/20 right?

Gardner-Webb lost to the Winthrop team that took the regular season championship. Then in the late game, Radford had to play an elimination game against Presbyterian.  The Highlanders ended up winning the game 10 to 0 in five innings after a fantastic shut out by Cooper on the mound and a two home run game by their ace pitcher Redmon.  One of the home runs was a grand slam!

They now face Gardner-Webb today in another elimination game.

In the Big Ten Tournament Indiana sent Washington home 9 to 2, number 2 Nebraska bested Michigan 4 to 2, Wisconsin had a huge upset over number 10 Oregon 11 to 9, and number 11 UCLA beat Penn State 6 to 1.

Finally, in the SEC Tournament, number 9 Florida barely beat Auburn 10 to 9, number 3 Alabama beat number 5 Arkansas 7 to 1, Ole Miss was sent home by number 6 Texas in a 6 to 0 shut out, and in an absolute stunner, number 12 Georgia beat number 1 Oklahoma 10 to 5. 

I look forward to following the excitement today as things start to heat up in the later rounds of the tournaments.
