body.title: Siguiendo a el padre del fuego en la naturaleza paisaje cambiante. Por @ramaco54.
body.body:
>Buenos días amigos de hive, les saluda su gran amigo el pintor Ramaco, quien les trae una nueva publicación artística, un paisaje cambiante según el momento y la hora del día muy interesante, que espero sea de su agrado.
Bienvenidos a ver mis ocurrencia artística o un hermoso paisaje, en el blog digital de Hive.

@ramaco54

La ilustración de hoy se titula.

Siguiendo a el padre del fuego en la naturaleza paisaje cambiante.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPj4Fof1rVQ2yzicN4cseZQvtZoQEkBG8LCttLYnu52dr/diapositiva9.jpg)
MIS MATERIALES.

>Los materiales que utilicé en esta oportunidad fueron: acuarela, plumilla, tinta china, acrílico blanco, mis pinceles de acuarela, sobre cartulina FABRIANO, Cámara fotográfica Panasonic, Marca LUMIX FZ47, programa de digitalización Adobe Photoshop, para modificaciones digitales y Power Point, para pasar las imágenes a formato jpg.
PROCESO PASO A PASO.

>Amigo espectador, curador y fiel seguidor de mi trabajo artístico, un paisaje más inspirado en mi creatividad, se hace presente gracias a mi talento creativo, el cual realice de la siguiente manera:
EL INICIO.
>Calor y fuego se hacen presente en las manchas de color anaranjado y amarillo, mostradas en la imagen. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZaaq3kihTckHxGA6d2TxkRbAroibHnpRHNC6S594yPni/diapositiva1.jpg)

>Los detalles de la naturaleza aparecen como detalles sublimes en el horizonte, trazos blancos en acrílico, le dan brillo a la corriente del agua del rio, y la vegetación silvestre floreada en la orilla, protegen la pureza del lugar. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTXUXP7N4qyUWwwhKVLnKa81xLHFBgLxSJEmUbgZLAUfS/diapositiva2.jpg)

>El fuego en el paisaje se hace presente con la presencia del sol, que aclara las tonalidades del cálido cielo en el firmamento, a partir de ese momento los colores se transforman e iluminaban para mostrar la belleza de su alegres colores de la naturaleza, entre los arbustos, la flora silvestre, las matas de cambur, y la calidez del paisaje que se reflejan por las frescas aguas del rio. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSmmqYY3LqVeFrjNHT7QjPYYQwJsAvxX5yc5vgvfuHZup/diapositiva6.jpg)

>Amigos observen muy bien la ilustración, y el proceso para que puedan visualizar el movimiento visual de la obra por cada imagen, de la naturaleza cambiante, mientras el proceso de rotación y traslación de la tierra cambia la posición del sol, la iluminación del paisaje en el día, y la manera de percibir a el medio ambiente. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZM1syyRdaUAx3tsEq6mHcULRpJsjZsMUkGMT4NCyqvoJ/diapositiva7.jpg)

>Un punto de luz blanca se centra en el centro del sol de color ladrillo intenso, generando una energía capaz de generar más movimiento a las aguas del rio, que se ven iluminadas por luces blancas que se movilizan entre las aguas cristalinas del rio. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUEE5JhdbRpBQ8Y699FHZ3fVE7o32BbqiN3x8kWcXmRQx/diapositiva8.jpg)

>Una locura energética ilumina e intensifica el magnífico colorido de la ilustración y la pureza del punto blanco de un sol rojizo e intenso de un atardecer tropical, más el brillo que se refleja en el cauce de las aguas del rio, generando la ilustración de una naturaleza cambiante de la creatividad, titulada:

Siguiendo a el padre del fuego en la naturaleza paisaje cambiante.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPj4Fof1rVQ2yzicN4cseZQvtZoQEkBG8LCttLYnu52dr/diapositiva9.jpg)

>Amigos espectadores, curadores y fieles seguidores de mi trabajo artistico, esta locura ilustrada y la variante de intensidad en cuanto al colorido del paisaje muestra claramente, las fases del ambiente cambiante según el tiempo que marque el reloj, o temporada del año, los cuales me han impresionado durante toda mi existencia, y reflejo el día de hoy para todos mis espectadores.
Muchas gracias por su amable atención.
Un abrazo, los quiero mucho.

Thank you very much for your words.

I completely understand what you mean. There are flavors that stay with us for life because they are connected to people, memories, and moments more than to the food itself.

I also feel that homemade meals carry something different, especially when they are prepared with care and affection. Over time, I’ve realized that what I truly miss is not only the taste, but everything that surrounded those moments at the table.

And yes, today many foods feel too artificial or rushed. Sometimes simplicity and authenticity are what make a meal unforgettable.

I’m glad the post connected with you.
Thank you for reading and sharing your experience.

오늘의 산책은 정말 즐거운 시간이었어요. 도심의 공원을 지나며 예전 친구인 지훈을 우연히 만났습니다. 오랜만에 얼굴을 보니 서로의 근황을 이야기하며 웃음이 끊이지 않았어요. 산책하면서 흥미로운 것 중 하나는 공원에서 작은 플리마켓이 열리고 있었다는 점이에요. 다양한 수공예품과 중고 책들이 진열되어 있었고, 특히 한 할머니께서 손수 만든 엽서와 수제 비누를 판매하고 계셨는데, 그녀의 이야기를 들으니 더 많은 관심이 갔습니다. 또 하나는, 날씨가 좋아서 많은 사람들이 운동을 하거나 가족과 함께 소풍을 즐기고 있었는데, 그 모습을 보며 저도 자연 속에서 여유를 만끽하는 기분이 들었어요. 오늘의 산책이 참 보람찼습니다! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: Hive Open Days: Día 4 // Hive Open Days: Day 4
body.body: ![IMG_2515.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EppMAmJdARUsY1ayUNx8MKgfFSw6oTybMKfvcfur2zphJuSwvx57ghZ8PRQMvkvh8M6.JPG) [Click here to read this post in **English**](#english)

> Hola querido hiver. Todo tiene una fecha de caducidad y los Hive Open Days no son una excepción. Llegó el día de las despedidas, ese que no nos gusta y es el inicio de un nuevo período de espera hasta la siguiente oportunidad de encontrarnos. Aunque esta vez es posible que sea para poco tiempo, pues acababa de deshacer las maletas cuando me sorprendió la noticia de que el próximo HiveFest se celebrará en Barcelona. Tiene que pasar algo muy gordo para que no esté presente. Más cerca solo me queda que se haga en la ciudad en la que vivo, jaja. ![IMG_2364.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpXKUvfTvCMtwDnYPKi1HjhZUsDcs6QSmhLXunN9BMrimPTnukNqrepgTCHwM4rvBRc.JPG) ![IMG_2365.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/23xAgZXwu3wdzrt7XZ1MfqdqVgqqEsJ16eYZi7wJPXv9VcV5U2pEXmpknu3SGkpS9MPRh.JPG) Dejamos aparte los sueños y aterrizamos en lo que venía a contarte. El último día de los Hive Open Days comenzó para mí como había empezado este encuentro, con contratiempos. Mi plan inicial era sumarme a un paseo por un sendero cercano a la localidad de Calpe en compañía de @ph1102 @mipiano y @enraizar. Sin embargo, el móvil me traicionó y no sé qué hice que el despertador no sonó. Recordé que @ninaeatshere había preparado un paseo turístico por Alicante, por lo que aproveché para descansar un poco más y acudí al sitio donde se agrupaban el resto de hivers supervivientes. ![IMG_2366.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoK7mhzUv9xVvmHixi4VjvCXiLdTAumaYioSqXgKzrcL16CiCB6uJRt18EzG14D2BLv.JPG) ![IMG_2367.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Eq5FSKSSwDuZU2PfKW3iEibqkHycp1qy2X6eA9gGH6nx3ohQTUmGmFd4nGb2WSwqox4.JPG) Si eres observador te habrás dado cuenta de que hay algo que aparece en muchas fotografías de este post: ¡escaleras! Todavía me duelen las rodillas por el esfuerzo de ese día. La parte antigua de Alicante está a los pies de su Castillo de Santa Bárbara y los espacios llanos son prácticamente inexistentes. O caminas hacia arriba o lo haces hacia abajo... Visitamos la Basílica de Santa María y tuvimos la oportunidad de disfrutar de un momento mágico. Había un coro ensayando que hizo la experiencia casi mística. ![IMG_2376.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpVDaDsCUSGgPTXBN4t9VEyne8iQgHF62B91pPACygwbyhL8GmxpsnHk8HYRegafZ1J.JPG) ![IMG_2461.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpGRjBUGWjjQZsZ3GT6acjV9zAf57JW5bUnE9c126DXxqKWoEtTKbLq4XVHgjAGk9kJ.JPG) Entramos al Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Alicante y desde allí nos dirigimos al Barrio de la Santa Cruz mientras tratábamos de adivinar los acertijos que Nina nos propuso. Por el camino nos encontramos a unos hivers encarcelados, los liberamos de su prisión y se incorporaron gustosos al grupo explorador. ![IMG_2465.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpT5CUarLw9dkFeHtFFVfYeeHmEToSMt2ctumfpNAtyFeeeN3Z64FPP8jSm3gemLm88.JPG) ![IMG_2466.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EqFtTvbKzyALvoJWjH5GDhYmL9T2VPY15bZ34RytomXpqTSp4tj6yGBoVSuEcnJBrxB.JPG) ¡Gané uno de los premios! Merecía el esfuerzo de posar en una foto para la posteridad. Pasamos por delante de la Ermita de San Roque y llegamos a la zona de las calles más conocidas. ![IMG_2467.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EowHbkdzfJ4DEBbGWjigzRWFVZxujGYqkaiLrZrbxaEQUX1KDqTCAp9sRJNBmdQaWmF.JPG) ![IMG_2469.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpnDfgpVuymrXyDN7KoPX6Gaxqh334Qs2eXVMheF2F1p6s9g41nm2a5ceCmqctujJsA.JPG) En ese fin de semana se celebraba la Fiesta de las Cruces de Mayo. El Barrio de Santa Cruz se adorna con cruces de flores y detalles artesanales realizados por los propios vecinos. También hacen pasacalles y conciertos. Las calles estaban llenas de gente en un ambiente festivo en el que nos sumergimos con gusto. ![IMG_2508.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoK7oT7ejd9GBvar384dQjACTvD6ipFS95TwQqXQce7Z56fpnhXcv8cz9H6RBuZEs1d.JPG) ![IMG_2512.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoH1L24hNgvnuTsmZVhowpw7FQMAVWXaE16f3N6dmRBSu2Pg1eTchQ5Yk6DfmzLCnoX.JPG) Comimos en la zona. Me gustó la decoración, por un lado el llamativo traje de torero y por otro los cuadros alusivos a la Semana Santa de Alicante. Al parecer el local es la sede de la Junta de Cofradías. ![IMG_2513.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Eokf74u9QLrCDMQHgRAvHiHeiZTSbmvAUAV3YgbG2CQkjWa5MiiwL9SxhHojcq2SzMX.JPG) ![IMG_2517.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpvfyTWGwkAFp67GtJ1LymSt69YCDpxt58o8h6P6YZ73erqcs8YHWEDizbCLNzEtEdH.JPG) Después de comer y tomar un café, empezaron las despedidas. Unos cuantos decidimos irnos a la playa para evitar caer rendidos si nos íbamos a nuestros alojamientos a descansar. Fue el mejor plan, reencontrarme con las olas y la arena, conversar de lo divino y lo humano, sentir la brisa del mar... un reconstituyente natural que cargó las pilas para apurar nuestras últimas horas juntos. ![IMG_2522.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Eo6Ks4tLysxTYToYYshxh8rHNbVFYk6TTxUWG8qPtVKyWJbm8UNHHHPD4anpEXT3KLW.JPG) ![IMG_2525.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EqJ1NHYaDK9FaPjAkSaomSAc4JAAURaPTcFJRHtYJL7wsyUdZbTynu45im5H1xtpqVy.JPG) ![IMG_2526.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EqJ1Q2u6scNqx31qcAfnzrWPqUqFfy7W8TkBGhoUYp4axMuD5DgoZZfk9zSN1G2rUpj.JPG) Hubo tres valientes que se atrevieron a meterse en el agua y saltar entre las olas. ¡Y trajeron una buena adquisición para el Clean Planet! Ese cubo que surgió de las aguas llevaba tiempo allí metido, pues tenía conchas pegadas en su superficie. ![IMG_2532.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoEpxv2TcYFm4t8SyKSpppjySkGvcbENM8hQyJayVH2S6QXhRbeLfjGtWgkjopdPqq5.JPG) ![IMG_2535.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoGwyqgPRjGaJeDVHsnKNa9eewb1Nb1orjgHTLQPsvbchZMxYxHLdLvvzTomvDjomxm.JPG) Terminamos el día cenando en una cervecería que dificultaba las fotografías por la oscuridad ambiental pero con una comida y bebida de lo más recomendables. Aquí pusimos fin a nuestros Hive Open Days @enraizar @mightyrocklee @susieisclever @ninaeatshere @honeydue @godfish @nonsowrites y esta servidora. Hasta la próxima publicación. Mientras tanto, ¡cuídate!

> Herramientas: Cámara iPhone 13 Pro, editor de fotos Mac. Mis publicaciones en [Worldmappin pinchando aquí](https://worldmappin.com/@palomap3) Si te gusta lo que publico, únete a mi [Fanbase pinchando aquí](https://hive.vote/dash.php?fan=palomap3&i=2) ![B67FB7A6-2E4B-43FD-BE20-57543B8993A2_4_5005_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/23tmerjFT3bacskjaLCHwJcKiNucG1oEiEzj9BNLMfBBevvri9W4G7eDRveawxvcGY472.jpeg) ©️Copyright 2026 Paloma Peña Pérez. Todos los derechos reservados.

> Hi, dear hiver. Everything has an expiry date, and the Hive Open Days are no exception. The day of farewells has arrived—the one we don’t like—and it marks the start of another waiting period until the next chance to meet up. Although this time it might not be for long, as I’d only just unpacked my bags when I was surprised by the news that the next HiveFest will be held in Barcelona. Something really big would have to happen for me not to be there. The only thing closer would be if it were held in the city where I live, haha. ![IMG_2364.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpXKUvfTvCMtwDnYPKi1HjhZUsDcs6QSmhLXunN9BMrimPTnukNqrepgTCHwM4rvBRc.JPG) ![IMG_2365.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/23xAgZXwu3wdzrt7XZ1MfqdqVgqqEsJ16eYZi7wJPXv9VcV5U2pEXmpknu3SGkpS9MPRh.JPG) Let’s put dreams aside and get down to what I came to tell you. The last day of the Hive Open Days began for me just as this event had started: with a few hiccups. My initial plan was to join a walk along a trail near the town of Calpe in the company of @ph1102, @mipiano and @enraizar. However, my mobile let me down and I don’t know what I did, but the alarm didn’t go off. I remembered that @ninaeatshere had organised a sightseeing tour of Alicante, so I took the opportunity to rest a little longer and headed to the spot where the rest of the surviving Hivers were gathering. ![IMG_2366.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoK7mhzUv9xVvmHixi4VjvCXiLdTAumaYioSqXgKzrcL16CiCB6uJRt18EzG14D2BLv.JPG) ![IMG_2367.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Eq5FSKSSwDuZU2PfKW3iEibqkHycp1qy2X6eA9gGH6nx3ohQTUmGmFd4nGb2WSwqox4.JPG) If you’re observant, you’ll have noticed that there’s something that appears in many of the photos in this post: stairs! My knees still ache from the exertion of that day. The old town of Alicante lies at the foot of Santa Bárbara Castle and flat surfaces are practically non-existent. You’re either walking uphill or downhill... We visited the Basilica of Santa María and had the chance to enjoy a magical moment. There was a choir rehearsing, which made the experience almost mystical. ![IMG_2376.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpVDaDsCUSGgPTXBN4t9VEyne8iQgHF62B91pPACygwbyhL8GmxpsnHk8HYRegafZ1J.JPG) ![IMG_2461.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpGRjBUGWjjQZsZ3GT6acjV9zAf57JW5bUnE9c126DXxqKWoEtTKbLq4XVHgjAGk9kJ.JPG) We entered the Alicante Museum of Contemporary Art and from there headed to the Santa Cruz neighbourhood whilst trying to solve the riddles Nina had set us. Along the way we came across some imprisoned hivers; we freed them from their prison and they happily joined our exploration group. ![IMG_2465.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpT5CUarLw9dkFeHtFFVfYeeHmEToSMt2ctumfpNAtyFeeeN3Z64FPP8jSm3gemLm88.JPG) ![IMG_2466.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EqFtTvbKzyALvoJWjH5GDhYmL9T2VPY15bZ34RytomXpqTSp4tj6yGBoVSuEcnJBrxB.JPG) I won one of the prizes! It was worth the effort to pose for a photo for posterity. We walked past the Chapel of San Roque and reached the area with the best-known streets. ![IMG_2467.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EowHbkdzfJ4DEBbGWjigzRWFVZxujGYqkaiLrZrbxaEQUX1KDqTCAp9sRJNBmdQaWmF.JPG) ![IMG_2469.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpnDfgpVuymrXyDN7KoPX6Gaxqh334Qs2eXVMheF2F1p6s9g41nm2a5ceCmqctujJsA.JPG) That weekend saw the celebration of the Fiesta de las Cruces de Mayo. The Santa Cruz neighbourhood is decorated with floral crosses and handcrafted decorations made by the residents themselves. There are also parades and concerts. The streets were packed with people in a festive atmosphere that we happily immersed ourselves in. ![IMG_2508.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoK7oT7ejd9GBvar384dQjACTvD6ipFS95TwQqXQce7Z56fpnhXcv8cz9H6RBuZEs1d.JPG) ![IMG_2512.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoH1L24hNgvnuTsmZVhowpw7FQMAVWXaE16f3N6dmRBSu2Pg1eTchQ5Yk6DfmzLCnoX.JPG) We had a meal in the area. I liked the décor: on the one hand, the eye-catching bullfighter’s costume, and on the other, the paintings depicting Holy Week in Alicante. Apparently, the premises are the headquarters of the Board of Brotherhoods. ![IMG_2513.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Eokf74u9QLrCDMQHgRAvHiHeiZTSbmvAUAV3YgbG2CQkjWa5MiiwL9SxhHojcq2SzMX.JPG) ![IMG_2517.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpvfyTWGwkAFp67GtJ1LymSt69YCDpxt58o8h6P6YZ73erqcs8YHWEDizbCLNzEtEdH.JPG) After lunch and a coffee, it was time to say our goodbyes. A few of us decided to head to the beach to avoid collapsing from exhaustion if we went back to our accommodation to rest. It was the perfect plan: reconnecting with the waves and the sand, chatting about everything under the sun, feeling the sea breeze… a natural pick-me-up that recharged our batteries so we could make the most of our final hours together. ![IMG_2522.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Eo6Ks4tLysxTYToYYshxh8rHNbVFYk6TTxUWG8qPtVKyWJbm8UNHHHPD4anpEXT3KLW.JPG) ![IMG_2525.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EqJ1NHYaDK9FaPjAkSaomSAc4JAAURaPTcFJRHtYJL7wsyUdZbTynu45im5H1xtpqVy.JPG) ![IMG_2526.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EqJ1Q2u6scNqx31qcAfnzrWPqUqFfy7W8TkBGhoUYp4axMuD5DgoZZfk9zSN1G2rUpj.JPG) There were three brave souls who dared to wade into the water and jump amongst the waves. And they brought back a fine find for Clean Planet! That bucket that emerged from the water had been there for some time, as it had shells stuck to its surface. ![IMG_2532.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoEpxv2TcYFm4t8SyKSpppjySkGvcbENM8hQyJayVH2S6QXhRbeLfjGtWgkjopdPqq5.JPG) ![IMG_2535.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoGwyqgPRjGaJeDVHsnKNa9eewb1Nb1orjgHTLQPsvbchZMxYxHLdLvvzTomvDjomxm.JPG) We ended the day with dinner at a pub where the dim lighting made it difficult to take photos, but the food and drink were highly recommended. This is where we wrapped up our Hive Open Days: @enraizar, @mightyrocklee, @susieisclever, @ninaeatshere, @honeydue, @godfish, @nonsowrites and yours truly. Until the next post. In the meantime, take care! [//]:# (!worldmappin 38.37472 lat -0.40921 long d3scr)

></center>

body.body:
Welcome to my gaming update, and this is my update on week 30. Although I still had 3 weeks break sometime ago, but I am so happy that I can continue my gaming activities, and have hit week 30. There are a few exciting news that I have on this update today, hopefully I can continue to do so in the future. ## Rising Star Games On Rising Star, I managed to reach level 126, and I have also gained around 1600 XP, I still have a lot to collect to be able to reach the next level, but so far it has been better than last week. Here are my stats for the week. **This Week** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVTx357dSS3KMbt7XSdCgCKWCwoCinuu9FsK2Wyg2PYdy/image.png)
**Last Week** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdUADxXrtSGvcFUWTVbMafkFjZCKQCMQXm172b5EVqwWA/image.png) ![separator2.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMa7EifqXSjKGqGjSzs4d9eNGjhV129o5S1XYGh2hUVQ/separator2.png) ## Splinterlands The good thing comes from Splinterlands. I managed to reach Silver III now, and still playing there for a while now. I also boosted my Glint so that I recieve more glint from the win if I could win a battle. But I think I will play in that league for sometime, as the opponent grow stronger, and they have a much better deck. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV1ACUPkYKoeHFnLMTG2z3KJaAPX77xxQxJhdwdHNSS8R/image.png) And on the brawl, my guild is still sitting on the first place. With less than an hour to go, I think we will be able to win the brawl this time. And it is so good. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRa4R1S4J4L5aAhPeit3hfo5fakT3v4VbVzJsa7uS4spx/image.png) Personally I get 7 wins and one lose at the moment. Which is sueper nice. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8z57vY64hZGLTM3E9JcKX6h68Ygz4xHf1jjFqgtMACx/image.png) The funny thing was that I get a good win, although I did put the card in a bad situation, and in case my opponent has better card selection, I think I might lose. Look at the line-up here. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTXhz7xjjdzhJv7ASqWMoKuz4Dq5e6jPAYBw47z7AmRdj/image.png) I messed up on Trapp Halloway ability, as I think he can attack from the second position, no knowing, he only have weaken and bloodlust , but not reach. Lucky that the void from Nim Guard Captain reduce the damaged from Great Bear Druid magic attack with his Void. And shield also took the melee attack nicely. So on that battle, my Epic Trapp Halloway do nothing but as a back-up only, as the job was done nicely by Nim Guard Captain. It is unsettling how easily access to information is being confused with actual autonomy. The tools that were supposed to expand our thinking, are now quietly narrowing it. The ugliest part is it is not the by-producy of force, but of comfort. And this is the more worrying part; there is no clear villain, just a system that works a little too well with our own leaniancies. 

Though, I dont think it is as absolute as total control. There is still space for awareness, but it requires effort ehich most  people would not (continuously) choose. Because, I think, convenience usually wins over clarity.

Plus, the line between what we want and what we are pushed to want might is blurry. And at that point, even resistance could start to feel like just another pattern within the system. The tech companies will label us as cult, who are against advancement :)

body.title: I will be always there
body.body:
# A promise of presence matters a lot and should never be broken.

![170810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23x1BQLUywvVGeCu3p5ZY87nHJbAhAtxXpLX1UquvRZ37qgviCREfP9o88FEGS54RrWbM.jpg)

The loneliness of old age is the hardest battle of life and most likely we all have to go through that phase of life, when we wish there is someone to look after us. As we get older, health issues crop up, causing anxiety and fear enter our minds and that is when we realize the value of having someone, who can provide a safe place, to turn our fears into security and worries into peace. **The Promise of \

** is not just about being there during major emergencies, but to prioritize and be present on every small occasion in regular intervals, a powerful conviction that every children should have - the emotional foundation necessary for our Parents to feel safe, loved, and confident. They have been our guiding light when we were learning to navigate life and now is our turn to be their anchor - to cherish their love and return it with the same, unconditional devotion they showed us. ![20260508_100333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23wC7M6rE2RNtGF8TM7eSVJw7466neRw5RvUksj1gtZJiKZi6eStHBVuLcxKLNb3YmdAD.jpg) As we navigate the bustling, fast-paced world of our lives managing our own mountains of responsibility, it is incredibly easy to let time slip through our fingers and forget about them, but I have made it an habit of watching them live every moment, every day and monitor their activities to let them know that they are not alone. And a frequent physical visit always feels overwhelming and that's the reason I do visit them as much as I can. We can never repay the debt of their sacrifice, nor can we truly pay back the years they invested in us, but offering our time is perhaps the greatest asset (that money cannot buy) that we can promise, honoring their journey and ensuring they feel worthy, loved, and never abandoned in this old age. Last two months have been very hectic as the kid was preparing for the exam and we did not want to disturb him for anything. That's the reason, I have not been able to stay for longer duration, and finally time has come to visit them again and spend some quality time with them - listen to their stories with patience and love. ![20260508_100407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/EppJjSpZqQewE4YJ1VuvPXVUA4pu9ouu1ZQPcUscXMZEqbFA9nEdk5gkBghS1KBYo3G.jpg) And there are some sweet rewards always - do you see that in the CCTV Footage ? We have lot of mangoes this year, and I have already ordered few tools to help us pluck, more to come on that..... This post is in response to the [Inkwell Combined Writing Prompt #31](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-inkwell-combined-writing-prompt-31--fiction-or-creative-nonfiction) ![hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23t7Yf2ig7CziqatXGLDSFvEXbGWpLghnimWmyzQWE2BichH69ZtADrPf9j3fQTtbt3cw.png)

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/AJpkBSvB2q9h2g9R6Ufit5GZRnoVwqzU8v6V8GjcbtmDSqCaZYQrEwmXnJWgBF7.gif

body.title: Un muy feliz día a todas las mamás./Happy Mother's Day to all the moms! [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
>No me había percatado que este domingo era el día de las madres y, por ende, no podía faltar un dibujo para honrar a esa persona tan especial en la vida de cada uno de nosotros, y no solo para honrar aquellas mamás que tienen hijos, niet@s... Sino también aquellas que han hecho el rol de una mamá y se han convertido en una importante figura para uno. Este dibujo en especial, se lo dedico a mi mamá, aunque ella no está en condiciones para saber de qué se trata y todo ello, sigue siendo la persona más importante en mi vida; también es dedicado a mi hermana y a todas en mi familia y círculo cercano. Bendiciones a todas las mamis en la comunidad y espero les guste. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-08_073643_es.pinterest.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xynQ6CBHkMQhPpUE3bxre4Nr8EnbUYcMDC7LoNty8tewqNM54jDAS9xzERSCfySBkEU.png) [Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/641411171974061341/) ---

>Como no tenía mucho tiempo para ponerme hacer algo muy detallado, tomé de referencia una imagen en Pinterest muy bonita, donde sale la mano de una mamá y su bebé con una flor, así que puse manos a la obra con el boceto, así también esto me ayudaría a practicar mi mayor debilidad: las manos y los pies, que, por lo general busco tapar en mis ilustraciones, pero esta vez quise a salir de mi zona de confort y siento que cuando dibujo la mano como tal no tengo problema, el inconveniente es cuando lo hago en el cuerpo y en posiciones que no ubico como son. ---
![DMOTHER1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23u6Ba4BUEDqLsqiTzZerT1wavRyMPTaVbwH7Hy3EpcTcSvekNeQ7qK8gRW9J6MZfjSo4.jpg)
---

>Continuando, ya al tener el boceto, decidí no hacer las líneas en limpio y pintar directamente, pintando por capa y en orden, así como cuando se pinta de forma tradicional. ---
![DMOTHER2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eo27bTtgmffU1W3aWT5M5HpUKUkoGHdWGW6PsjbsHvtZj7jpewv6jAF9Ben1YCxHBsQ.jpg)
---

>Tras ello, procedí a darle las luces y sombras a la flor y así sucesivamente a las manos. En este punto me estaba agradando como se veía y bueno, al tener la imagen de referencia y es más fácil visualizar los detalles que siempre se me escapan. ---
![DMOTHER3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eo27aPh6LqKLiEE3pRvdoovcuQ3EE1PcrPP7WASuXKa63LuGRBJcVRWwjt1xdeLBHfh.jpg)
---
![DMOTHER4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eo27WekFcVNeVKuvSyQgYYhcXriAXvmxYsJjKHXxhbGi5oL4u7GzRHqm59NqqqYvSVb.jpg)
---

>Luego, cambié el color de fondo por un ocre-rosado pastel y, aquí de igual forma tomé dos imágenes de Pinterest y solo dibujé sus contornos, para hacerlas tipo sombra. Una en la zona superior izquierda, una mamá con un bebé y en la parte inferior derecha, una mamá con una niña; le di a filtro y desenfoqué ambas sombras y le bajé la opacidad, porque tampoco querían que fuesen como el centro de atención. ---
![DMOTHER5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tHQmW2EQfsJJiyP3GBA3eXzXJw6z3ut8jwkMxkoQ1CtydYANkF7L4nxWpvEbBnN2ba9.jpg)
---

>Después de eso, procedí a dibujar dos mariposas, una un poco más grande que la otra y en tono amarillo y, jugando con los modos de fusión de los pinceles y texturas, le di a estas mariposas un efecto como luminosidad. ---
![DMOTHER6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Enz1bx7bnkLUUHGeZFC9nu5NbEPo4E6NyhKsWDQfdaAUAcZUufRvVLmkSskTNc6jmYm.jpg)
---

>Para ir finalizando, le añadí unas lucecitas por aquí y por allá, sobre todo en las zonas de las mariposas y en la flor, también uno pequeño degradados en las sombras de las figuras. Así mismo y es algo que tiendo hacer con mis ilustraciones, es agregarle una capa de textura como de papel, en este caso lo hice con dos texturas, las superpuse y con los ajustes en niveles y de opacidad, pareciera que fuese hecha de papel, la primera textura no me gustó, así que, la dejé con la textura de las siguiente a esa. ---
![DMOTHER7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/242P228TiUc5A6E2rc2m353SpVUmh3sMFG5yXmXqk3PUi9SBHcYG8CftXdJNfNa5PepdB.jpg) La imagen final, a la derecha, es la primera textura que le habia agregado.
---
![MOTHERFINALCONLOGO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tmZ4sTTRQMKATWKPDhRgZ32LgDz6FSpcCdJWBjECJo1EreXJWVWb3Ev6hWMer1eJHre.jpg) El resultado.
--- ![SEPARADORFINAL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7DhyLsnCvap7nZh5KQhSei8HfFKRCDACSsevDY6FtCrxZEtkcEjJFcgM5dmXK527Py.png) ---

# Gracias por leer mi post. Espero que les haya gustado. Estaré atenta a responder sus comentarios. Pueden visitar mi blog, seguir mis contenidos y redes sociales.
--- ![yaslenysofia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tbPQJuhQvKp68VNMKi3kQndgZvBYbtZEzvQZXh65h4iSzkicR1GASmv8uf1B2anwojU.jpg) ---
[FACEBOOK](https://www.facebook.com/umbrapandamart) / [INSTAGRAM](https://www.instagram.com/yaslenysofiaart/) / [TWITTER](https://twitter.com/yaslenysofiaart) --- ![SEPARADORFINALCONNOMBRE.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7FGdTBoiFu47PGW1gvhMcnRQHJmPkkcFJZXF3F5kRN8m2ZfnofVCifvK7J3EQGw2dQ.png) ---
# ENGLISH
---

>I hadn't realized that this Sunday was Mother's Day, and therefore, I couldn't let the day pass without a drawing to honor that very special person in each of our lives, and not only to honor those mothers who have children, grandchildren... but also those who have taken on the role of a mother and have become an important figure in our lives. This drawing in particular is dedicated to my mother, although she's not in a position to know what it's about and all that, she continues to be the most important person in my life; it's also dedicated to my sister and all the mothers in my family and close circle. Blessings to all the mothers in the community, and I hope you like it. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-08_073643_es.pinterest.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xynQ6CBHkMQhPpUE3bxre4Nr8EnbUYcMDC7LoNty8tewqNM54jDAS9xzERSCfySBkEU.png) [Source](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/641411171974061341/) ---

>Since I didn't have much time to work on something very detailed, I used a beautiful image from Pinterest as a reference. It shows a mother's hand and her baby holding a flower, so I got to work on the sketch. This also helped me practice my biggest weakness: hands and feet, which I usually try to cover up in my illustrations. But this time I wanted to step out of my comfort zone, and I feel that when I draw the hand itself, I have no problem. The difficulty arises when I draw it on the body and in positions I'm not familiar with. ---
![DMOTHER1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23u6Ba4BUEDqLsqiTzZerT1wavRyMPTaVbwH7Hy3EpcTcSvekNeQ7qK8gRW9J6MZfjSo4.jpg)
---

>Continuing, once I had the sketch, I decided not to clean up the lines and paint directly, painting layer by layer and in order, just like when painting traditionally. ---
![DMOTHER2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eo27bTtgmffU1W3aWT5M5HpUKUkoGHdWGW6PsjbsHvtZj7jpewv6jAF9Ben1YCxHBsQ.jpg)
---

>After that, I proceeded to add highlights and shadows to the flower, and then to the hands. At this point, I was liking how it looked, and well, having the reference image made it easier to visualize the details that I always miss. ---
![DMOTHER3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eo27aPh6LqKLiEE3pRvdoovcuQ3EE1PcrPP7WASuXKa63LuGRBJcVRWwjt1xdeLBHfh.jpg)
---
![DMOTHER4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eo27WekFcVNeVKuvSyQgYYhcXriAXvmxYsJjKHXxhbGi5oL4u7GzRHqm59NqqqYvSVb.jpg)
---

>Then, I changed the background color to a pastel ochre-pink, and here too I took two images from Pinterest and only drew their outlines to create shadows. One in the upper left area, a mother with a baby, and in the lower right, a mother with a little girl; I applied a filter and blurred both shadows and lowered the opacity, because I didn't want them to be the center of attention. ---
![DMOTHER5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tHQmW2EQfsJJiyP3GBA3eXzXJw6z3ut8jwkMxkoQ1CtydYANkF7L4nxWpvEbBnN2ba9.jpg)
---

>After that, I proceeded to draw two butterflies, one slightly larger than the other and in a yellow tone, and, playing with the blending modes of the brushes and textures, I gave these butterflies a luminous effect. ---
![DMOTHER6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Enz1bx7bnkLUUHGeZFC9nu5NbEPo4E6NyhKsWDQfdaAUAcZUufRvVLmkSskTNc6jmYm.jpg)
---

>To finish up, I added some little lights here and there, especially around the butterflies and the flower, and also a slight gradient in the shadows of the figures. Also, something I tend to do with my illustrations is add a paper-like texture layer. In this case, I used two textures, layering them and adjusting the levels and opacity to make it look like it was made of paper. I didn't like the first texture, so I left it with the texture of the second one. ---
![DMOTHER7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/242P228TiUc5A6E2rc2m353SpVUmh3sMFG5yXmXqk3PUi9SBHcYG8CftXdJNfNa5PepdB.jpg) The final image, on the right, is the first texture I had added.
---
![MOTHERFINALCONLOGO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tmZ4sTTRQMKATWKPDhRgZ32LgDz6FSpcCdJWBjECJo1EreXJWVWb3Ev6hWMer1eJHre.jpg) The result.

body.title: VE Day anniversary
body.body:
![ve day.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/23zbTqFehdZvPBdKKRs8DZ5pLRqvVcqgtqobxxwdVWXDe4ucy3FDJNUrLjFfR9FS8WZWB.jpeg)



Although in the UK much media and public attention is being focused on the local council elections we must not forget that today is the 81st anniversary of the defeat of Nazi Germany in 1945. 

Remember those who fought for us and died for us and specifically on this day of election results, who dearly bought us the right to decide who governs us.

body.title: STREET ART #250 – The government school in Grand Baie, Mauritius
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXjfDXzricxsm41vd2MRzjbAQZHFRs8gjikWB5ShN2gBZ/01.jpg)
One day, not long ago in Grand Baie, I took a slightly different route than I usually do. Instead of walking the main street, the intention was to get away from the busy road with heavy traffic. I wanted to see if I could find a quieter road, that would also be a shortcut home.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5hijCATK2qDDBRRebwKjEmNRVuu5cRWaa1ZgsUFe9bZ/02.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmNY9t3CrRn8GL4wc5CLfi4UdnG7XPMFcfm5XwrxYnYnen/03.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQma6wJhDmixyLfd2UopXj8DA7SYLHh8gbfiocrcZu5hdd3/04.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmZRobC2oXsaUJ1yrk6dFDLfHmx1dQ1b442UsF9gAKsKER/05.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmPsNo7ddj9riQ9T4F5k2fPCiwwLoFpz6T8UcvZKTtEwym/06.jpg
It was a good idea to do that. I came across the Grand Baie Government School, which is an elementary school. The wall that surrounds the school has several nice images. There is a narrow sidewalk and a fence separating the sidewalk and the road. This meant I got very close to the wall. It was therefore sometimes difficult to get absolutely every part of the painted image into the frame.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmTwNmZMHiRJQNYoDixQE4B2obMY9BGwPSx2s1NayzKY1t/07.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHDTVFLg8ZH6zEXM2BYPaZcCDovj8tduy1u8mbwuzNu4/08.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmWXQSxCfdzJV3waBVXUCYkPMTNzvMz8KCksjWFa88cBZk/09.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsRQiwkvvG2cgyE6zJWPPYxGCRkgBsGsLXppcupij6Z1/10.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmZjUJGrfCxnGC39EpPr9FbpPuWy4xrSgrUa5xiCfdRq/11.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbCckVTorVoYFhtUmUHwCr1cZP8rr81iAKcgQvs1um1P/12.jpg
I assume that the pictures were painted by the students. They show a bit of what they are interested in and what is important to them. The last two photos show paintings on each side of the entrance gate. I am pretty sure that the colored fingerprints, are the signatures of the artists – pupils. There are several parts of the wall that have only had the background color. Maybe there will be more paintings eventually. The pupils did a good job helping to decorate their own school. Now I have started to walk this road because it is shorter and with less trafic. At the same time I can admire the walls and maybe discover more after some time.

body.title: How can we improve user retention on Hive?
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/242DNbcTccJ6wvjSLYTuLrWvdq1ayLAA5KzkgA4btVA1TgwmoQTRbQnCmjkhRyLuKcPx1.png) Last week Hiver @demotruk was the main guest of the #hivethrive community hour, this week hosted by @alessandrawhite, @shadowspub and @buttcoins. For those who don't know Hivethrive shows; they are held every Tuesday at 8PM CEST. Every week the Hivethrive team invites a guest involved in Hive-related projects to talk about their work. Other Hivers can follow the interview live via the Voice Channel and ask questions in the chat. Check out the [official Hive Discord Server](https://discord.gg/3sUqmmxwWm) to see when the shows are and tune in next Tuesday! A few weeks ago I recommended @demotruk to the Hivethrive team since I think it would be interesting to hear some more about his projects. And that wasn't a bad idea at all. It was a great show where @demotruk explained about his recent posts focusing on statistics on user retention. ![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png) # User retention on Hive We all know it's difficult to keep users on the Hive platform. Especially in times when the price of Hive and thus the rewards are low. But the following stat presented in [demotruks blog](/hive-133987/@demotruk/insights-from-blockchain-data-what-actually-works-for-retention-on-hive) still shocked me! @ocd has the highest user retention of the large onboarders with 46% or 36% after 6 months (depending on whether the new user created an #introduceyourself post). But on the other side of the graph is Leo.voter with 28% retention, or just 2% for users who didn’t make an #introduceyourself post. But what amazes me is the effect of the user of the #introducteyourself tag (later more on that!). ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23u5XXnQ475BzygQ3j5DnsL4svZNCNG7mqorTGdgYiE2Jj2s7XEj2F27G793anWkjtP9P.png) The following stat was also very interesting. The user retention after 6 months increases significantly when the rewards increase. It might sound obvious, but it also reignited the discussion about whether we should support our newly onboarded users a bit better. Interacting with posts from new users and giving them some upvotes will surely help increase the user retention. During the show some Hivers mentioned initiatives to follow posts of newly onboarded Hivers. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23xAPJP9sBbyjNfWVtegmFsueL2TS2v6P333J1aGTNsAR4Agp8VZWbFYJodRNVyVMGWJn.png)
The discussions during the show made me reflect on what I do for newly onboarded Hivers. And I must admit: it isn’t that much. But the show definitely inspired me to do better! In Dutch we have a saying that translates to: Change the world, start with yourself! And that is what I did; I started exploring some of the initiatives that were mentioned in the chat during the show. I will share these initiatives and my experiences in this blog. ![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png) # New user feeds The reason that I hardly see new users posts is that I mostly use my 'Following' and 'Community' feed for finding interesting posts to upvote and/or comment on. During the show a couple of people mentioned initiatives to support new Hivers. I'll first list them here and mention who posted them in the chat. Clicking them will redirect you to the feed immediately. - [Lovesniper](/@lovesniper/feed) (mentioned by @palomap3) - [Pioneersupporter](/@pioneersupporter/feed) (mentioned by @starkerz) - [Swarmpost](/@swarmpost/feed) (mentioned by @demotruk) - #introduceyourself (discussed in the show)
**[Lovesniper](/@lovesniper/feed)** Lovesniper is an initiative by the @ocd curation team. In their retention curation post they explain it as follows: ``` The Lovesniper Retention curation initiative aiming to retain those quality content creators after making their introduction posts. It was observed that after newbies made their introduction posts, their succeeding posts are often ignored. This initiative will hopefully encourage the newbies to continue posting quality content and interact with anyone in the community. As compilation posts are also done, this will highlight the newbies and will give the community an idea which newbie to look out for. OCD's Lovesniper team will follow everyone who made an introduction post and @lovesniper's feed will be the place to scour those quality content from new authors. Curators will check all the posts in the feed to find under-rewarded posts and recommend them for curation. ``` ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23y9Cho5zCikbmG7npmj2vwD4f1RPjGgjzzwGjGBW8m1HXe6zLjwZSKTcsZgR2fwFRTvn.png) So, the OCD curators can nominate posts in the stream that they think deserve an upvote from OCD. But we can use this stream as well to find interesting new users as well to support and/or engage with.
**[Pioneersupporter](/@pioneersupporter/feed)** Another initiative is the Pioneersupporter feed. The account doesn't have a lot of information about what it does (maybe you could create a short post in this account @starkerz), but it does have one comment saying: ``` \

``` If I remember correctly (and correct me if I'm wrong) these are users that are onboarded 'in real life' by other Hivers via checkinwith.xyz. So you won't be seeing many bots in this stream.
**[Swarmpost](/@swarmpost/feed)** This initiative was created by @demotruk. Just like Pioneersupporter, Swarmpost works with trust. You can become a member of the trust network and **vouch** for a user you brought to Hive or **sponsor** a user if you believe they are a real person, which makes you responsible for that account. Both newly onboarded users as sponsors can win rewards in a lottery. ``` How to Help New Users Enter the Lottery If you're part of the trust network, you can help new Hive users become eligible for the lottery: Vouch — If you know who onboarded a new user but their on-chain creator is a service account (like @hiveonboard), comment on their introduction post: !vouch @realcreator This tells the system who really brought them to Hive. The attested creator receives the onboarder's share of the rewards. Sponsor — If a new user has no trusted onboarder at all but you believe they are a real person worth supporting, comment on their introduction post: !sponsor This makes you responsible for that account. You receive the onboarder's share of the rewards. Sponsoring requires a higher trust score than vouching. ``` ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/EobyP3pchfRii5QpKB4wbfkU8wmyPqnvtXSEukA2iWccERPJX4NGMbtKjyTCUdxADAH.png) If you are onboarding people you know, it might be interesting for you to use this service. I personally don't onboard users I know, but I did register my account via https://hiveinvite.com/trust/ so I'm able to sponsor newly created accounts that I trust are human. And I will keep an eye on [the swarmpost feed](/@swarmpost/feed) as well.
**#introduceyourself** The #introduceyourself tag exists for a long time. New users are often encouraged to create an introduction post with this tag. If you open this tag on your favourite front-end you get all the introduction posts. If you're using the @PeakD front-end, you can even 'bookmark' this stream by clicking the star (it will turn blue). This way you can easily access this stream via the \

menu in PeakD.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23tHTJZMpJ1icRJoRorLTpCFFx6LoyL58yRhwcom8sBUHRCxR64nevPPZMbmJ2qCebEQf.png)

By default the stream is sorted by the most trending posts. By clicking the sort button you can change it to 'Recent' to see the most recent introduction posts.


![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

# My first impression
I've been checking these streams for the past few days. I must say there are quite a few new users being onboarded on Hive and a lot of them seem to be genuine people that want to add something to Hive. 
I'll keep on checking these streams for a while to see if I can support some newly onboarded Hivers.

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)
# PeakD lists
One other dilemma I had while engaging with the new Hivers was how I keep track of them after their first posts. I don't want to start following all. I don’t want my following list to grow too large so I can keep track of the people I follow. 

But PeakD has a neat solution for this, which is **lists**. In PeakD you can create multiple custom lists and add accounts to those lists. The lists show up under the \

menu in PeakD. 
By clicking one of your lists under the Feeds menu, you are presented with all posts of the users on that list.
So what I’ve done is create a “Newbies” list where I add newly discovered Hivers I’m curious about, to see what they’ll be posting in the future.

Adding a list and accounts to that list is really easy in PeakD. When you're reading someone's blog you see their profile on the right hand side which has on option \

.  When you click that button you can create a new list or add the account to one of your existing lists.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23wr7sVKJbtRTDad74S4T4K1K4kHMoRzizwn2XaEboDGB8gMLZAGRE74MTgqwdoSrBorK.png)

I will regularly check my \

list to see if they have created any new blogs. These personalized list feeds can also be opened via the mobile version of PeakD as you can see below.


![1000082822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/1000082822.jpg)



![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

# Automated comments
During my experiment with the feeds of new users I've discovered something else, which is automated comments. 
Several new accounts automatically receive replies from some accounts. Most of them are (or at least seem) automated. I have some mixed feelings about it. 

One of the accounts is certainly creating automated comments. Rafiki is an AI controlled account that replies on newly created posts via Inleo. 
It does mention it is an AI agent in the comment itself, but I doubt if we give a good signal with these comments. Especially when it's the only comment a post gets... 

Another comment I noticed a couple of times is from a particular account telling people to power down and sell. Also not a good thing when there are just a few comments. 

I did see another positive initiative recently, but I can't seem to find it anymore 😬
It was an autoreply that scanned the blog with AI and suggested both Hivers as Communities to follow based on the content of their blog. I found it very interesting since it guides new users and shows them users and communities that they might like. 

If anyone knows which initiative this is, please share it in the comments. I also wonder why I can't see these comments on all recent #introduction posts.

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

I’d love to hear your thoughts on user retention and engagement. Are you engaging with newcomers? Do you have something to add to this blog? Do you know of any other initiatives perhaps? Please share it in the comments!

<center>
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/245n3faSf1E4HdNCPePvHHzVkaLUPjScGnEhLJdQ9YtAeD2ZUpVCBcm9i3TRJ1AHZFLr4.png
# Friendlymoose
</center>

body.body: Latin Name|Observation date|Location| |------------|------------|------------| |Genus Nisitrus| May 08 2026 | Central Aceh Regency,Aceh, Indonesia | In some areas of my plantation it was very dirty and it was very difficult to clean it alone, so I decided to hire some workers to clean my plantation and the results were quite satisfactory. When I was on the edge of the garden, I also managed to find a forest cricket that looked very unique, this cricket has two large legs that it often uses to jump and it looks like a grasshopper, when I wanted to take a picture of it, suddenly this cricket jumped onto my young mango tree, initially I tried to take a picture of it using the help of a macro lens, but it didn't work because this cricket immediately jumped to other trees. Because of the uniqueness of this cricket, I didn't want to miss this moment so I decided to take a picture using a cellphone camera, from a safe distance I managed to take a picture of it. body.title: Analytical Power at HIVE
body.body: >Analyzing statistics isn’t just a matter of vanity or a “obsession with numbers”; it’s the difference between navigating with a compass and drifting aimlessly in an ecosystem where attention and capital (Hive Power) are finite resources. ![Analytical Power at HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tbPj2fZNKMsskQhH1hjx28D9zkq31MAUFHECAQUp9ThjjVoWdMwnE81D9TptLnMwCey.jpg)

>We are driven by different goals within a space shared by different cultures, which is why it is difficult to reach a consensus on what is good or bad for HIVE, or what is acceptable and what is not. Relativity exists. It becomes difficult to gain a clear understanding of our performance within the ecosystem. ㅤ Sometimes we may take paths that prove difficult in the future, convinced that we are currently on the right track. What is required is rigorous, honest, analytical, scientific criticism—if you will. I am interested in hearing different people’s opinions to reach a conclusion. But when opinions diverge and are varied, I prefer to base my strategies on my interpretation of the available statistics. Statistical analysis on HIVE is largely divided between monitoring each user’s financial performance and analyzing the dApp ecosystem (games and social networks). That’s why I’ve divided it into two groups: 1- User Performance: account statistics and rewards. 2- HIVE Performance: dApp and network statistics, and raw data extraction (for developers). Before giving a brief overview of each, I want to apologize to everyone who is identified. The purpose is simple: to authenticate the creators of each tool presented here. ![main separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23t7YN54ksTQz6cDk6AHxBSd4ghBk8wbX6hgyer5UZmWDgr8XD4C5vkyusk3phanKDNys.png) ###
Analytics Tools 🛠 User Performance

>Frontends have built-in statistical data. Take PeakD Analytics, for example: within the PeakD interface, there is a statistics section that shows your posts’ engagement, who your top voters are, your profile’s organic growth, and other useful metrics. Other options available: **TOOL** | **LINK** | **CREATOR** --------- | ---------- | ---------- Hive CoderGeek | https://hive.codergeek.org | @nuthman CoderGeek Classic | https://hive.codergeek.org/classic.php | @yabapmatt HiveStats | https://hivestats.io | @leofinance HiveTasks | https://hivetasks.com |  @fernandosoder Hive Report Card | https://holoz0r.github.io/HiveReportCard | @holoz0r hStats | https://hive-stats.sagarkothari88.one | @sagarkothari88 ManteCurated Live | https://mantecurated.3speak.tv | @mantequilla-soft HiveBuzz | https://hivebuzz.me | @arcange HiveBlocks Explorer | https://hiveblockexplorer.com | @penguinpablo ###
🛠
## HIVE CoderGeek ![1-codergeek.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tbPKQ5NoyuzXXf4R8G1qHvWVCuabZY3w2dsX5DuXd2fmGZHSiHMX7fSBcv6rGE9777p.jpg)

>Let’s get off to a good start and keep the momentum going. HIVE’s real-time wallet dashboard won’t let you get bored. The breakneck pace of the rising numbers would get even a dead person excited. ㅤ The creator drew inspiration from Matt Rosen’s SteemDash. Although it’s a simple interface, it lets you change the theme and colors, use a pop-out widget, and switch to classic mode. This is where I want you to go now—to classic mode. ![2-codergeek.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tGXnE8gqLKXAuN2h29apXRX5x2CoYWh56yX9Myo4uuAFhsdDX9nHa4UiNuZrkZvw6S7.jpg) ###
🛠
### CoderGeek Classic ![CODERGEEK CLASSIC.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23w31fSSY9dsceM3vowWTcv6g8a3tPpiZYZvSsuXsiByJ9J5XGcQAaeYNZnt8Br2gZscV.jpg)

>The classic version of the previous tool. My starting point. This was the first tool I saw on HIVE. I was impressed, not only by the minimalist interface but also by how the numbers on the counters reminded me of the characters used at old-fashioned Texas gas stations. ㅤ The numbers here tick by more slowly, which allows for a different kind of reflection. So, when you’re feeling down because your account is running low, focus on this tool. Watch the numbers rise at the pace of your heart rate. I suggest a mantra to heal your discomfort: focus on this tool for one minute before falling asleep. When you wake up, do the same—watch it for one minute. After 21 days, you’ll be healed. 😀 You’ll wake up to HIVE with more energy than you’ve ever had. 💪 Give it a try. ###
🛠
### HIVE Stats ![3-hivestats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tGXzLTiGppJFv9aFsnUUv8gmxhq6xTzHKWnVKhVvsuEzX6MEWVgAmzxfafH7G1iFetY.jpg)

>One of the most traditional dashboards in the ecosystem. It focuses on the account’s ROI (Return on Investment), clearly showing how much you’re earning per day/week and the total value of your “Hive Power.” Among many other possible analyses. ###
🛠
### HIVE Tasks ![4-HIVE Tasks.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tHXXUqWkeQK88SrBtZfzUjv7cpAtDpRzbkwWD6E1DRz536vNtTpMMv87EqwanN7DtT8.jpg)

>It is an essential tool for managing and monitoring users. Think of it as a “Dashboard” that makes it easy to see everything happening with each account without having to navigate through complex block explorers. ㅤ Here you can monitor your rewards and activity, pending rewards, transaction history, delegation management, and many more analytical features. For Witnesses (network validators), you also have the ability to monitor node status and check for missing blocks. ###
🛠
### Hive Report Card ![5-HiveReportCard.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23swfuNrD9kGQH1ptWNhS3tJSdX9FonEDUubad1uR6Nr6RpZDkXwknft8WqDgjGmZFwhV.jpg)

>According to its creator, this tool is designed to analyze the complexity of a HIVE user’s content. It also shows how their writing style or text length may evolve over time. The readability score is calculated using the Flesch-Kincaid methodology. ㅤ It is a very comprehensive tool—perhaps one of the most comprehensive—because it offers a wide variety of metrics to analyze your performance. Among them, the ones I highlight are Readability Distribution and Engagement by Readability Level. ![5-HiveReportCard_2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23uQGVD5usy7VGJAR8NSy8x6t82ZL4RUCCZivRiuc6GfSPaT33FxJxxiFYPPKANRV3Dys.jpg) ###
🛠
### hStats ![6-hStats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tGVvGgHKK41u6vVFwHywVVLJoni45cdckPNToomrQs5pJacAqGoHxvHoWrBJqBvGcuM.jpg)

>A modern and intuitive tool (available on the web and in the app) that provides detailed user statistics, including forecasts for Resource Credit top-ups and a history of rewards for authors and curators. ###
🛠
### ManteCurated Live ![15-ManteCurated.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tkdUBdBtzTpyr2623vqvHmd9zPf5yn2gCJTYMaK1DU2qufycPJc7WA11WRzbssm2PLi.jpg)

>It’s the latest analytical tool, and it focuses exclusively on curation analysis on Hive. It analyzes the quality of curation on the Hive blockchain using the revolutionary Curation Quality Score (CQS) system. ㅤ Here you can see your performance when it comes to curation. You can even compare yourself with other users or curation groups. It has a very user-friendly and simple interface where you can track all the votes you’ve cast and your voting power. ###
🛠
### HiveBuzz ![8-HiveBuzz.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/243MHaQfKzpVisz5oSR7F7q6D6YSK7ZdF7thfYyaZP6dDxkWxjjtmpnFgctGihGqfL1AF.jpg)

>Gamification-focused statistics. Features: Badges, User Progress, Activity History, and Ranking. ###
🛠
### HiveBlocks Explorer ![9-HiveBlocks Explorer.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/Eo8Z64rEuwMsfa4vd4Jvk9wGaioHC8Q1VtSz8X4M46vKpejrbbC63hoKDozjToFQYmi.jpg)

>Blockchain explorers are essential tools in any decentralized network. In practice, they function as a “Google” for the HIVE network: they allow users to view everything that happens on-chain in a public and transparent manner. ㅤ It is a useful tool for public auditing and financial transparency. It can be used to verify DHF payments, track whale activity, confirm Hive-Engine operations, and analyze account activity. It also displays HIVE/HBD prices, blockchain statistics, transaction history, block production, and witness activity. ![main separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23t7YN54ksTQz6cDk6AHxBSd4ghBk8wbX6hgyer5UZmWDgr8XD4C5vkyusk3phanKDNys.png) ###
Analytics Tools 🛠 HIVE Performance

>Every month, the Hive Statistics community releases detailed analyses by @arcange and @dalz. @steevc, @demotruk, @holoz0r, and @fullcoverbetting have also been contributing to the community since the beginning of this year with more specific, yet very interesting, statistics. ㅤ Others available: **TOOL** | **LINK** | **CREATOR** --------- | ---------- | ---------- Chain State Dashboard | https://cutehive.com | @cutehive.com Power Up Tracker | https://power-up-tracker.vercel.app/ | @louis88 HBD Stats | https://hbdstats.com/hbd.html | @dalz HiveSQL | https://hivesql.io |  HiveSQL HAF | https://github.com/openhive-network/haf | GitHub,inc Hive DHF | https://www.hiveinflation.com | HIVE DHF ###
🛠
### Chain State Dashboard ![10-Chain State Dasboard.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/48FiDU5V9S9W2P2T9XNDd5qDTZ1y1Rmhao9342dwCUArfHSUn85soZCeuEGBuW3tRg.jpg)

>According to the developers, this tool is not intended to be a traditional blockchain explorer homepage, but rather a status overview. ㅤ Behind this project lie pertinent questions about the HIVE blockchain, which formed the basis for this analytical product: - Are on-chain prices aligned with the market? - Is block production running smoothly? - Has the network been stable recently? - What do current inflation and issuance look like? - Is HBD approaching any risk thresholds? It has a very pleasant and dynamic interface. The available data updates in real time, with the option to pause for a more detailed analysis. This ability to pause time is a brilliant feature. It is also possible to check the dynamics and work of the witnesses, and it displays all DHF proposals in a well-organized manner. ###
🛠
### Power-Up Tracker ![11-Power Up Tracker.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23t6zbLGdv7eKi5vkzbbyJcU6RwhhQLsujzRWFxs8VPAyWMpMptCZdJ5thAMAYnRbT6SN.jpg)

>This tool is a real-time monitor of “Power Ups.” It is used to track who is converting liquid HIVE into Hive Power (HP)—that is, who is increasing their stake and influence on the network. ㅤ It allows for viewing by time periods and amount filters. In practice, this tool is useful for gauging sentiment and confidence in the HIVE ecosystem. It enables users to identify whales or active accounts accumulating HP, track events such as Hive Power Up Day, analyze the network’s economic behavior, and detect investment or accumulation patterns. ###
🛠
### HBD Stats ![12-HBD Stats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23sweCyXC5XpJ8ryRwbCWn6aMr9ejfXHAZtJRypYxuLS4ZUJAvUhuGBViRY94Fk9BKgy7.jpg)

>It features a simple, minimalist interface packed with information and serves as an analysis and monitoring tool focused on the HBD stablecoin. Although it also analyzes HIVE and SPS (the Splintershards game token), its primary purpose is to track economic and financial indicators related to HBD, providing insight into the state of Hive’s internal economy. ㅤ It offers a variety of features and can be useful for studying demand cycles for HBD versus HIVE, as well as for analyzing systemic risk. ###
🛠
### HiveSQL ![hivesql.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/48KbB1CZwiLTj8EXqsob181bYdjGohGegaFwQXpRJPJeMpXSTYrXXNB5mjniy8eNRA.png)

>It is a relational database that allows you to extract complex statistics (e.g., “How many users posted more than 5 times in the last week?”) that standard explorers cannot process. Ideal for analysts and developers. ㅤ HiveSQL is a publicly available Microsoft SQL Server database that contains all data from the Hive blockchain. Before accessing HiveSQL, you will need to create an account. The data is structured and easily accessible from any application capable of connecting to an MS-SQL Server database. It allows you to easily access the data contained in the Hive blockchain and perform analyses or find valuable insights. ###
🛠
### HAF (Hive Application Framework) ![13-HAF.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23swgSgnp24AKCB8L8FW2YrpHJiZMXJ8e66Jv95koi7NRQ8bqKUx7aMarXGD2uJdHWWSo.jpg)

>HAF is one of the most important infrastructures in the HIVE technical ecosystem because it acts as an intermediary layer between the blockchain and applications. ㅤ Simply put, HAF transforms the “raw” data from the Hive blockchain into an organized, easy-to-query SQL database. Many modern tools in the ecosystem use HAF directly or indirectly, including explorers, dashboards, analytics, social APIs, financial tools, Hivemind, reputation systems, indexers, and curation applications. ###
🛠
### Hive DHF ![14-Hive DHF.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/Eo1vs6YxBqLoFtDoSLCyj5sHfWc5umwetX3MjGSkRkZHbEPLigfjXnBMBJKKn15R3kW.jpg)

>It is one of the issues that has most stirred up the ecosystem: the inflation caused by the DHF in approved financing proposals. This tool helps to restrict financed transactions in a transparent manner. ㅤ The DHF (Decentralized Hive Fund) receives a portion of all new HIVE created. This dashboard shows who controls those funds, how much is being minted, and where it flows. ###
🛠
### Conclusion ✅

>What’s my favorite tool? All of them! They’re all useful for evaluating our work—both as creators and curators—as well as for assessing the performance of the entire ecosystem. ㅤ The tools I’m presenting here are the ones I’m familiar with, and they’re available online. I don’t know if the list is complete—I’m not sure about that. If you know of any others that aren’t listed here, please leave a comment, and I’ll make sure to update the post. ![main separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23t7YN54ksTQz6cDk6AHxBSd4ghBk8wbX6hgyer5UZmWDgr8XD4C5vkyusk3phanKDNys.png) ![cryptoreforma Banner animated 1440x510, 10fps.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tbRgmvUr2wnjV51FoK5G5vd3jCNyqru4LAdQRxZhWEHbTTXWn8xF7i7Kq7kddaBJCfc.gif)

title.title: 💛 Ese clic me cambió la vida👣 [ Esp - Eng ] 💛 That Click Changed My Life 👣
title.body:
>

7 de mayo de 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Día 3096: ¡no hagas clic en el enlace!

Muy buenos días, mi gente, por acá escribiendo nuevamente para ustedes desde Buenos Aires, #Argentina. Y la verdad, apenas leí el tema de hoy, automáticamente me vino algo a la mente, cuántas veces en la vida uno escucha ***“no hagas clic”, “no entres ahí”, “mejor déjalo así”***, y aun así termina haciéndolo.

Y es curioso, porque muchas veces los cambios más grandes empiezan así, con algo pequeño, con una decisión rápida, con un simple clic que parecía no tener importancia. Pero pasa el tiempo y te das cuenta de que ese momento terminó cambiando muchas cosas en tu vida.
___________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTkAAYQmAA3ZyVFrSxgMXMvY4Ty7ZjBYAodgLMs2drRdT/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
___________

Hay cosas en la vida que comienzan casi jugando. Uno está tranquilo, revisando el teléfono, viendo cualquier cosa, y de repente aparece ese famoso mensaje: ***“No hagas clic en el enlace”***. Y claro… ahí mismo empieza el problema. Porque mientras más te dicen que no entres, más curiosidad te da. Uno empieza a pensar ***“¿y qué tendrá eso?”, “déjame ver rapidito”***. Y así, sin darte cuenta, terminas abriendo puertas que ni imaginabas. A veces son tonterías, otras veces son sustos, y otras… son cosas que terminan cambiándote la vida. Porque siendo sinceros, la vida también funciona así, uno va haciendo clic en decisiones sin saber realmente hacia dónde lo van a llevar.

Yo me pongo a pensar en muchas decisiones que tomé así, casi sin medir todo lo que venía detrás. Como cuando decidí salir de Venezuela buscando un mejor futuro para mi familia. En ese momento uno cree que solo está tomando una decisión importante, pero no alcanza a imaginar todo lo que viene después. Nuevas costumbres, nuevos trabajos, nuevas personas, otros dolores, otras alegrías. Y aunque hubo momentos duros, también aparecieron cosas bonitas, aprendizajes y personas que de alguna manera hicieron más llevadero el camino. Es como si la vida te mostrara que algunos clic traen miedo al principio, pero también pueden abrir oportunidades que jamás imaginaste.

Y hablando de clics que cambian cosas, Hive también llegó así. Un día alguien te habla de una plataforma, de escribir, de compartir experiencias, de crecer poco a poco, y uno entra medio curioso, sin entender mucho. Lo que uno no imagina es que con el tiempo eso termina convirtiéndose en parte de tu rutina, de tus pensamientos y hasta de tus metas. Aquí no solo encontré una plataforma, encontré gente, apoyo, motivación y una forma distinta de drenar muchas cosas que llevo dentro. Hay días donde uno escribe feliz, otros donde escribe cansado, otros donde simplemente necesita sacar algo que pesa. Pero de alguna manera, uno termina creando conexiones reales detrás de una pantalla.

Claro, no todos los clics son fáciles. Hay algunos que duelen, que marcan, que te cambian para siempre. Y mientras escribía todo esto, recordé uno de los clics más difíciles que me ha tocado vivir. Hace muchos años, mi hermano menor Joe Suárez, con apenas veinte años de edad, tuvo un accidente de moto que le fracturó el tallo cerebral. Quedó en estado vegetativo, conectado a un ventilador artificial, y llegó un momento donde me tocó tomar una de las decisiones más duras de mi vida, hacer clic al botón de apagar aquel ventilador y dejar todo en manos de Dios. Y aunque parezca increíble, después de hacerlo, él continuó respirando por sí solo. Eso para nosotros fue una alegría inmensa, una esperanza en medio de tanto dolor. Así pasaron trece años de lucha, cuidándolo en todos los aspectos, porque permanecía postrado en una cama, apenas abriendo los ojos, sin dar señales, pero estando allí con nosotros. Hasta que un día simplemente no despertó más y falleció, aparentemente por un paro respiratorio. Y ahí entendí algo, hay clics en la vida que uno jamás olvida. Decisiones, momentos y dolores que siguen arrastrándose dentro de uno, incluso mientras la vida continúa avanzando.

Y quizás de eso se trata la vida también, de esos clics que hacemos sin saber todo lo que viene después. Algunos nos llevan a momentos felices, otros nos marcan para siempre, pero todos terminan formando parte de nuestra historia.

From Luxembourg… to Europe. 🧡

Today, we’re proud to announce something huge; Innopay is now officially live in 2 European countries, Luxembourg and Romania! With Zen Bar in Bucharest becoming the first partner restaurant outside Luxembourg to integrate Innopay.

And honestly?
This is much bigger than a single restaurant. Because for too long, Europe relied on:
- foreign payment processors
- foreign infrastructures
- foreign technologies
Without asking ourselves a simple question: Why aren’t we building more of this ourselves? 

Blockchain changes that equation, allowing Europe to rethink infrastructure:
- more open
- more efficient
- more resilient
- more independent
And Innopay is part of that movement.

For those discovering it now: Innopay is a payment system built on blockchain rails.

In restaurants or bars you:
- scan the QR code
- order directly from the menu
- pay instantly (crypto or traditional payment methods)
- receive cashback

Meanwhile merchants benefit from lower transaction costs, better operational efficiency, improved CRM possibilities and no painful card-processing overhead eating margins. 

Simple experience on the surface. Different infrastructure underneath.
And this is only the beginning. Because Europe has enormous potential.
500 million people. Brilliant engineers. Strong financial culture. World-class infrastructure.

What’s often missing is coordination. Speed. And the ability to let innovation breathe across borders.

If Europe manages to simplify regulation, reduce fragmentation and truly unify its digital markets… the next generation of financial infrastructure can absolutely emerge here. And blockchain may very well become one of the strongest symbols of that evolution.

Huge thanks to the Zen Bar team for the trust. 🧡
And if you’d like to see Innopay in your favorite restaurant… tag the owners in the comments. 

Also:
- Next Letz OffChain → Brasserie Millewee
- Tuesday evening
And this one will be special; full Innopay setup officially live there as well!

Come try it.
Come meet the family.
Come experience the future of payments yourself. 🧡 

And don’t forget to follow the Innopay page to stay updated as we keep expanding across Europe!

he stopped.

she said.\n\nTunde smiled that quiet smile. \
