# Learn Creative Coding (#58) - Swarm Intelligence: Ants, Bees, and Slime Molds

![cc-banner](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTUxQoFArrnLxQrqV2tPhMY6XhpoNn85wxFacvHV279kq/cc-banner-cyan.png)

Twelve episodes into the emergent systems arc. Grid automata (ep047-049), free-moving flocks (ep050-051), continuous chemistry (ep052-053), formal grammars (ep054-055), autonomous crawlers and slime molds (ep056), erosion and growth (ep057). Every system so far starts with simple agents or cells and produces complex structure from nothing. But most of those agents are... kind of dumb? They follow gradients, they react to neighbors, they deposit chemical. They don't solve problems.

Today's agents solve problems. Ant colonies find the shortest path to food without any ant knowing the full map. Bee swarms allocate foragers to the best flowers without a central scheduler. Slime molds build transport networks that rival human-engineered rail systems. This is swarm intelligence -- collective problem-solving where the group is smarter than any individual member. No leader, no blueprint, no global plan. Just simple agents following simple rules, and somehow the colony as a whole does something clever.

We already touched on some of this in episode 56 with the Physarum simulation and stigmergy. But that was focused on the visual patterns -- the glowing filament networks. Today we go deeper into the intelligence side. How do ants actually find shortest paths? How does pheromone evaporation prevent the colony from getting stuck? How do you build a working ant colony optimization in Canvas? And then we'll push the Physarum model further -- not just as art but as a network designer that connects food sources with efficient paths.

The creative coding angle: these simulations produce genuinely beautiful output. Pheromone trails glow and fade. Ant highways form and dissolve. Slime mold networks branch and merge like living circuitry. And the fact that they're SOLVING something -- not just making pretty noise -- gives the visuals a kind of purposeful energy that random systems don't have.

## Ant colony optimization: the pheromone trick

The basic setup. You have a grid (our Canvas). Somewhere on it is a nest (where ants live) and one or more food sources. Ants leave the nest, wander around looking for food, and when they find it they grab some and walk back home. Simple enough so far. The magic is pheromone.

Every ant deposits a chemical trail as it walks. Other ants can sense this pheromone and prefer to follow paths that have more of it. When an ant finds food and returns home, it deposits a stronger pheromone trail on the return path. Other ants smell that strong trail and follow it toward the food. More ants on a path means more pheromone, which attracts even more ants. Positive feedback loop.

But here's the crucial part that makes it actually work: pheromone evaporates. Every frame, every cell's pheromone decays a little bit. Long paths lose pheromone faster than short paths (because the pheromone is spread over more cells and each cell decays independently). Short paths between nest and food get traversed more frequently per unit time, so they accumulate more pheromone relative to evaporation. The colony converges on the shortest route without any ant knowing geometry.

Let's build it.

```javascript
const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width = 600;
const H = canvas.height = 600;

// pheromone grids -- two types
const toFoodPhero = new Float32Array(W * H);  // \
-- ants searching for food follow the \
pheromone, and ants returning home follow the \
pheromone (so other ants can find their way back). When carrying food, it follows \
signal) while searching ants deposit only 0.5 (weaker \
signal). This is deliberate. The strong \

pheromone is more of a general trail. This asymmetry makes food trails dominate, which is what you want -- the colony prioritizes the important paths.\n\nThe `dir += Math.PI` when picking up food or arriving home is the simplest possible \

pheromone on the way home. Other ants near that trail smell it and follow. More ants reach the food, more return with strong pheromone, the trail brightens, more ants join.

Within a few hundred frames you see clear green highways connecting the nest to each food source. The highways aren't straight lines -- they meander a bit because the first few ants that found the path weren't walking in a straight line. But over time, as more ants travel the route, the pheromone concentrates along the shorter path segments and the highway straightens. It's optimization by accumulation.

The color coding helps you read it: green channels are \
pheromone (the valuble information), blue channels are \

about food sources instantly when a scout returns, but has no spatial trail to follow.

**Physarum**: Continuous field model. No discrete agents making decisions -- instead, a chemical field that diffuses, decays, and gets reinforced by moving particles. Finds near-optimal network topologies. The most visually dramatic of the three because the entire field is the artwork.

All three produce efficient solutions to routing and allocation problems. All three use positive feedback (reinforcement of good solutions) balanced by negative feedback (decay/evaporation of bad ones). All three scale gracefully -- add more agents and the solutions get better, not worse. None of them need any global knowledge or central control.

## The visual connection

Purely as art pieces, these simulations have a quality that random generative systems don't. Because the agents are SOLVING something, the patterns have directionality and purpose. Ant trails converge on food sources. Bee flight paths form focused beams between hive and flowers. Physarum networks are efficient and branching, not random. The viewer can sense that these shapes mean something even if they don't know the simulation rules. Compare that to plain noise or random walker art -- beautiful in its own way, but without the sense of intentional structure.

That tension between bottom-up emergence and apparent top-down design is one of the most interesting things in creative coding. The agents have no intention. The patterns look designed. The gap between those two facts is where the art lives.

Twelve episodes of emergent systems now. We've covered a LOT of ground -- grid automata, flocking, reaction-diffusion, L-systems, crawlers, erosion, and now swarm intelligence. Still a few more to go in this arc before we wrap up and move on to something completley different.

Looking ahead -- we've been building systems that create structure and systems that destroy it (erosion). We've seen agents that wander (random crawlers), agents that follow rules (boids, ants), and agents that communicate through shared fields (Physarum). What happens when we model physical processes like wave propagation? When you drop a stone in water, the ripples aren't agents and they aren't cells -- they're a continuous phenomenon governed by differential equations. Simulating that connects back to the reaction-diffusion work from episode 52 but with very different visual results. And what about building a full ecosystem where multiple species of agents interact -- predators, prey, plants, decomposers -- all in one simulation? That's where all these techniques come together.

## Allez, wa weten we nu allemaal?

- Ant colony optimization uses two pheromone types: \

(deposited by searching ants). Ants follow the pheromone type that matches their current goal. The two-pheromone system creates directional highways between nest and food sources
- Pheromone evaporation is what makes shortest paths win. Short paths get traversed more frequently per unit time, so their pheromone accumulates faster than it evaporates. Long paths lose the evaporation race. No ant measures distance -- the colony optimizes through chemistry alone
- Multi-colony competition with separate pheromone fields produces emergent territory boundaries. The colony with the shorter path to a shared resource dominates because its round-trip pheromone reinforcement rate is higher
- Bee foraging uses direct information sharing (shared memory / waggle dance) instead of environmental pheromone. Foragers are recruited proportionally to food source quality. Faster response to new information than ants, but less spatial robustness
- Physarum with 150,000 agents and fixed food emitters builds efficient transport networks between food sources. The network topology converges on solutions close to the minimum spanning tree -- the same result as the famous Tokyo rail experiment where real slime mold matched human-engineered infrastructure
- All three swarm systems use positive feedback (reinforcement of good solutions) balanced by negative feedback (evaporation/decay). This feedback balance is the universal mechanism that makes swarm intelligence work across ants, bees, slime molds, and many other collective systems
- The visual quality of these simulations differs from random generative art because the agents are solving problems. The patterns have directionality and purpose that viewers can sense even without knowing the rules

Sallukes! Thanks for reading.

# The Great Illusion: How @guiltyparties Built an Empire on Empty Promises



---

## **Prologue: The Mask of Benevolence**

There is a particular kind of tragedy in watching a wolf dress itself in shepherd's clothing, not to protect the flock, but to shear it bare while convincing the sheep they are being cared for.

Today, we pull back the curtain on **@guiltyparties**.

To the casual observer, this account appears to be a hub of charity, a distributor of aid, a beacon of hope in the Hive ecosystem. The transaction history is a cascade of outgoing transfers: thousands of HIVE and HBD flowing to `gpwallet` accounts, to individuals in need, to \

*\n\nBut look closer. Follow the money. And you will find not a charity, but a **centralized banking cartel** disguised as a community fund. You will find a system where power is concentrated, transparency is an illusion, and the \

provided is merely the interest paid on a loan of trust that can never be repaid.

**We expose the truth:** @guiltyparties runs a massive farm, a shadow bank, and a political machine, all while pretending to be a simple benefactor.

---

## **I. The Architecture of the Shadow Bank**

### **Figure 1: The Wallet Network (The Shell Game)**

```
THE GUILTYPARTIES ECOSYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Central Hub: @guiltyparties
│
├── The Distribution Arms (Dozens of \

accounts)
│   ├── @gpwallet, @gpwallet2, @gpwallet3... @gpwallet30
│   ├── Function: Receive large lump sums from HQ
│   └── Function: Disburse funds to end-users or exchanges
│
├── The Laundering Layer (@bdhivesteem)
│   ├── Pattern: gpwallets send HIVE → @bdhivesteem
│   ├── Action: @bdhivesteem swaps HIVE for HBD via internal orders
│   └── Result: Clean stablecoins ready for reuse or export
│
└── The Power Base (@spaminator, @logic, @hivewatchers)
    ├── @spaminator: Receives delegation (20k HP) & funds logic
    ├── @logic: Receives steady weekly stipend (~50-100 HIVE)
    └── @hivewatchers: Receives operational funding
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Analyst Note: This is not charity; this is corporate structure. The use of dozens of numbered wallets obscures the total volume of flow and makes auditing nearly impossible for the average user.
```

**The Implication:**
Why does a charity need 30+ numbered wallets? Why does it need to route funds through `@bdhivesteem` to convert currency before distribution? The answer is **control**. By fragmenting the treasury, @guiltyparties creates a labyrinth that protects the central hoard from scrutiny while maintaining absolute authority over who eats and who starves.

---

## **II. The Mechanical Symphony of Control**

*Based on on-chain transaction logs*

While the public sees \

the blockchain records **transactions**. And the patterns reveal a cold, calculated machine.

### **Figure 2: The Stipend System (@logic)**

```
THE LOGIC STIPEND
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Recipient: @logic
Frequency: Weekly (every 7 days ±1 day)
Amount: ~50.00 to ~100.00 HIVE (precise decimals)
Duration: Continuous for years
Recent Examples:
• 50.066 HIVE (5 days ago)
• 100.051 HIVE (11 days ago)
• 49.985 HIVE (23 days ago)
• 75.249 HIVE (Mar 18, 2026)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Verdict: This is not a donation; it is a salary. @logic is an employee of the @guiltyparties empire, paid to maintain the infrastructure (Spaminator, etc.) that enforces the cartel's will.
```

### **Figure 3: The Currency Mill (@bdhivesteem)**

```
THE CONVERSION LOOP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Step 1: @gpwallet30 receives 830.000 HIVE from @guiltyparties.
Step 2: @gpwallet30 sends 830.000 HIVE to @bdhivesteem.
Step 3: @bdhivesteem executes internal limit orders to swap HIVE for HBD.
Step 4: Repeat with @gpwallet10, @gpwallet2, etc.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Observation:  HIVE were funneled through this mill. The sheer volume suggests @guiltyparties is acting as an unregulated central bank, minting stablecoin liquidity for its own network while bypassing open market price discovery.
```

---

## **III. The Narrative vs. The Ledger**

The most dangerous lie is the one wrapped in truth. Yes, @guiltyparties *does* send money to people in need. The transactions are real. The memos are heart-wrenching. *\

*

But consider the source.

When a warlord builds a school in the village he occupies, is he a philanthropist? Or is he buying silence?

The ledger shows that for every dollar given to the poor, ten dollars are moved between shell companies (`gpwallets`). For every memo about \

there is a silent transfer of thousands of HIVE to `@logic` to fund the bots that downvote dissenters.

**The Truth:**
The \

is the marketing budget. It is the cost of doing business for a cartel that seeks to dominate Hive's governance and culture. They give you crumbs to keep you from noticing they are eating the whole loaf.

---

## **IV. The Connection to the Downvote Machine**

We cannot talk about @guiltyparties without talking about **@spaminator** and **@hivewatchers**.

*   **@guiltyparties** delegates **20,614 HP** to **@spaminator**.
*   **@spaminator** receives this power and uses it (along with delegated power from others) to fund **@logic**.
*   **@logic** and **@spaminator** are historically linked to the coordination of downvotes against critics, whistleblowers, and competitors.

The cycle is complete:
1.  **Accumulate** power and wealth (often via opaque means or early adoption advantages).
2.  **Distribute** small amounts to the public to build a reputation as a \

3.  **Fund** the enforcement arm (@logic/@spaminator) to silence anyone who questions the source of the wealth.
4.  **Repeat.**

This is not community building. This is **protection racketeering** on the blockchain.

---

## **V. The Verdict: A Scam of Proportions**

To call this a \
in the traditional sense might be too simple. It is more insidious. It is a **governance scam**.\n\n*   **The Promise:** \

The use of dozens of `gpwallet` accounts serves no purpose other than obfuscation. A true charity publishes its ledgers. It does not hide behind `gpwallet24` and `gpwallet25`. It does not route funds through internal swaps to avoid detection.

**@guiltyparties** has built a shadow state within Hive. They hold the purse strings, they hold the voting power (via delegates), and they hold the whip (via downvote bots). And they expect us to thank them for the privilege of being ruled.

---

## **Epilogue: The Reckoning**

There is a particular courage in speaking truth to power, especially when that power holds the keys to your survival.

But the blockchain does not care about fear. It only records truth.

And the truth is this: **You cannot build a free community on a foundation of centralized control.** You cannot claim to be a benefactor while funding the silencing of your critics. You cannot pretend to be a saint when your ledger reads like a mob boss's ledger.

To the users of Hive: Do not be fooled by the breadcrumbs. Look at the bakery. See who owns the oven. See who controls the flour. And ask yourself: *If I speak out against the baker, will I still be fed tomorrow?*

The time for gratitude is over. The time for scrutiny is now.

**Expose the farm.**
**Demand transparency.**
**Break the cartel.**

*— #Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can confront it.*

#HiveBlockchain #CryptoForensics #GuiltyParties #ShadowBank #DownvoteCartel #Transparency #BilpcoinTruth #StopTheAbuse

First day since my wife broke her toe. We have a once a month lunch with her old work colleagues at Sydney Rowing Club in Abbotsford. The plan had been to use train and ferry to get there. No chance my wife could walk the steps needed - took the car - driver - me. One beer me ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6c8409fe-4e43-44d2-a4bd-c74802ee6052.jpg) Was a cold windy day - snowing in the mountains a bit early. Too cold to do photos outside - borrowing one taken two years ago. We had a good lunch. Stories. Recollections. An old photo album. Was invited to drinks with a collection of uranium people - nicknamed uTwits - including CEO of a uranium company I have shares in. body.title: Reflexión sobre un Pez (es/en)
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcfGBRjoMEFCGU7YJvSAByipEDgi19CeTRRCwEkL8z1Eq/1778237789204.jpg)


✍️✍️VERSION EN ESPAÑOL✍️✍️

Un día llegué a una casa en la que estaban haciendo una liquidación apresurada de casi todos los artículos y bienes, ya que estaban en oro de una mudanza de largo viaje. Para alimentar la parte del comedor, sobre la mesa había un objeto que rápidamente llamó mi atención. Inmediatamente traté de abrir una negociación con la dueña, pero ella me dijo que no, porque era un recuerdo familiar o un regalo en un aniversario del que no recuerdo. Bueno, tiempo después, solicitó que entrara a la casa y propuso negociar por una cifra que yo estimé que era una baratija.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPrjycN2MSsNCeZ7uhCiYjgtMUfMmoM3kijPH99XpveNR/1778237844354.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAtsSd7HL58GupSTdnT2aWHpwbeWSeFWEzc47CNAosRs/1778237844619.jpg)

El objeto en cuestión era (hoy es) una cerámica en terracota patinada con bronce, que reproduce un pez, estimo yo, de muy buena factura técnica, a la vez que con soluciones decorativas propias de un buen ceramista o de un buen taller de cerámica.

Desde ese día, la pieza está en el centro de la mesa del comedor de mi casa (como centro de mesa que es). Allí está con su lomo abierto, que se ha convertido en el depositario de cuanto objeto pequeño se pone sobre la mesa.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXq5Yq26AAnCJbS367tQAV6teKcEbF9frzJGt6pWynx13/1778237884375.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbsESfc1o7doKbPBkceke3XDbLuhKbAP8hM4Pppnjo6Ff/1778237909234.jpg)

Cada vez que me siento a almorzar o a comer (cenar), siempre queda frente a mi vista. Y como por tradición, casi siempre hago esas dos actividades solo, entre el pez de barro y yo se establece una rara y muda conversación, solo interrumpida por el tintineo de la cuchara en el plato de loza.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc4AG3miMvek19xn2KJ1DGQ9DvpPF6kiVwsghs4APGCS8/1778237961033.jpg)

Cuando el pez está en el agua es \

que navega de forma decorativa sobre la mesa del comedor.

Y... ¿por qué compré aquel objeto artístico?

Más allá de que encontré que es una buena cerámica con su pátina de color oro viejo, en este animal acuático siempre he visto algo muy enigmático, y a veces siento una especie de asfixia en su mudez. Eso siempre me sucede cuando lo observo dentro de una pecera o cuando voy a su medio natural, cualquiera que sea.
Pero creo que la causa principal de la Sra. es su amplio simbolismo y su importancia en posiblemente todas las culturas, desde la antigüedad hasta el presente. Aunque no creo haber visto a un cromañón pinchando un pez en la pared de una caverna.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVEEz8qoXGH2Faxa49X4rqyj2njfEuwCLiG5s9acJJD9c/1778238006087.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWoKH2T9Um1vT6YZ5rcA2a8ArpP3UVtQHxMt5jXZE5nxH/1778238006954.jpg)

El mito que más conocemos en Occidente habita en el cristianismo, tanto en el Antiguo como en el Nuevo Testamento. Primero, con el asunto de Jonás, que salvó la vida contra días en el vientre de un gran pez, y en el otro, con el milagro del río, pan y los peces.

Allá por Asia veneran a un gran pez con largos bigotes, quizás una gran claria como las que han invadido nuestros ríos y espejos de agua en la actualidad, eliminando otras especies acuáticas con su actitud depredadora.

Otro de los mitos en los que el pez tiene gran importancia es en la secta Abakuá en algunas regiones de África, donde se reveló que el tambor sagrado de la iniciación está hecho 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSGeVHkfCxarnX3RRDnLUu4asZj4HJhfoC9QT2NQDELMJ/1778238052135.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbP9jpDpeoTJFbcTUzFJC2dB3YuJu8ktxnu2Bu9fFyLaV/1778238052408.jpg)
con la fina piel de un raro animal acuático.

En otras culturas, simplemente es el centro de sus hábitos culinarios o la dieta principal.

La navegación marítima se desarrolló teniendo en cuenta la forma dinámica de los peces. Los nórdicos, grandes navegantes, muchas veces dieron a sus barcos formas de peces.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaRAByWprrhrHGcujrryXrCJMvQv5Xy2PFjQKy3NAtoj/1778240249188.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZQFMuPZL6yUg4JiBUAuiiiWmcAddzkVBzGBHGKzQj9he/1778240249457.jpg)

En la charada, el referente acuático aparece con varios números y es favorito de muchos jugadores porque está asociado a la abundancia y la prosperidad.

También en el dicho popular está el animal presente cuando se hace alusión a la superioridad.

En la música, por ejemplo, Pedro Luis Guerra cantó entusiasmado su deseo de ser un pez para meter la nariz en su pecera. Una metáfora con un alto grado de erotismo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxrnnLHd25uWMya9BTREZE3uKCVDxZQQTY8HRB3gkAE9/1778238110704.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNa9nYRTLDYnVAAo89cBDso6bpqu3c6nevYfEwCbzkMBS/1778238110964.jpg)

Pero en el fondo, adquirí esa pieza de cerámica porque, más allá de que haya sido concebida por el creador como un \

, me atraen la forma y el estilo en el mundo de la ado y la sobriedad del patinado que le dio un acabado que lo aleja de la estridencia comercial, y lo asumo como arte.

Gracias por acompañarme en este nuevo post.

Texto totalmente original de mi autoría.  
Todos los derechos reservados © @davidsantafe

 ✍️✍️ ENGLISH VERSIÓN ✍️✍️

>One day I arrived at a house where they were doing a hasty liquidation of almost all the items and goods, since they were in gold from a long-travel move. To feed the dining room part, on the table there was an object that quickly caught my attention. I immediately tried to open a negotiation with the owner, but she told me no, because it was a family souvenir or a gift for an anniversary that I don't remember. Well, some time later, he asked me to enter the house and proposed to negotiate for a figure that I considered to be a trinket.

>The object in question was (today it is) a terracotta ceramic patinated with bronze, which reproduces a fish, in my opinion, of very good technical workmanship, as well as with decorative solutions typical of a good ceramist or a good ceramic workshop.

>Since that day, the piece has been in the center of the dining room table in my house. (as a centerpiece that it is). There it is with its back open, which has become the depository for every small object that is placed on the table.

>Every time I sit down to have lunch or dinner, it is always in front of my view. And as by tradition, I almost always do these two activities alone, a strange and silent conversation is established between the clay fish and me, only interrupted by the clink of the spoon on the china plate.

>When the fish is in the water it is \

that sails decoratively on the dining table.

>And... why did I buy that artistic object?

>Beyond the fact that I found it to be a good ceramic with its old gold-colored patina, I have always seen something very enigmatic in this aquatic animal, and sometimes I feel a kind of suffocation in its muteness. That always happens to me when I observe it in a fish tank or when I go to its natural environment, whatever it may be.
But I think the main cause of Ms. is its extensive symbolism and its importance in possibly all cultures, from ancient times to the present. Although I don't think I've ever seen a Cro-Magnon poking a fish on a cave wall.

>The myth that we know best in the West lives in Christianity, both in the Old and New Testaments. First, with the matter of Jonah, who saved his life against days in the belly of a large fish, and in the other, with the miracle of the river, bread and fish.

>There in Asia they worship a large fish with long mustaches, perhaps a large claria like those that have invaded our rivers and water bodies today, eliminating other aquatic species with their predatory attitude.

>Another of the myths in which the fish has great importance is in the sect Abakuá in some regions of Africa, where it was revealed that the sacred drum of initiation is made from the thin skin of a rare aquatic animal.

>In other cultures, it is simply the center of their culinary habits or main diet.

>Maritime navigation was developed taking into account the dynamic form of fish. The Nordics, great sailors, often gave their boats the shape of fish.

>In the charade, the aquatic reference appears with various numbers and is a favorite of many players because it is associated with abundance and prosperity.

>Also in the popular saying the animal is present when allusion is made to superiority.

>In music, for example, Pedro Luis Guerra sang enthusiastically of his desire to be a fish to stick his nose into his tank. A metaphor with a high degree of eroticism.

>But deep down, I acquired that ceramic piece because, beyond the fact that it was conceived by the creator as a \

, I am attracted to the shape and style in the world of ado and the sobriety of the patina that gave it a finish that distances it from commercial stridency, and I assume it as art.

>Thank you for joining me in this new post.

body.title: Book Review Daring Greatly
body.body:
![118.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Eoc5B1L7WLmjYBAJyRhdEUVM4m1yfadDfE5ywhrvtC9bfoKcsymWS4wUvg88QzGxidE.jpg)
Hello everyone, Welcome to another book review from me based on a quote from a book. Today's writing will be from the book ***Daring Greatly*** by Brené BrownRobert Kiyosaki, and the quote says: ***“Vulnerability is the birthplace of innovation, creativity, and change.”*** This is another quote from a book where the reader needs to go through the book to understand better what the book is talking about. It is not one of those quotes that is easy to understand just by reading the quote. You will be left wondering, like I was, when I came across the statement: ***“Vulnerability is the birthplace of innovation, creativity, and change.”*** Is the writer trying to tell us to be vulnerable to experience true innovation or change? This is really challenging if you ask me. Being vulnerable can be tricky in the sense that what if the weakness from your vulnerability is later used against you in a way you were not expecting, and in a way you definitely will not like. Brene Brown talks about the concept that, from a young age, we are taught to appear strong in order to mask our weakness. Thereby, taking it to adulthood, it becomes more difficult to show weakness. For one, I can relate to this. There is a society that has been created to showcase asking for help as a form of weakness. This says a lot about certain things that have been said, like take it like a man, do not cry, you are a man, and more statements like you are not the only one. This, in turn, pushes the need to ask for help far away from the problem as the situation gets worse. Thereby leading to suffering in silence and not speaking up when the need arises. Well, this is where the author comes in. Brene Brown flips the script by stating it is not about being weak but about growth. It is the passage to the change one seeks. There is no success with failure or trial and error in different forms. The vulnerability is about the change and not just the weakness. It is the prerequisite for the innovation one needs. How can you get help when you do not ask for it? Many do not have the liberty to pay close attention, especially when one steps back. If it is not spoken about, how will they come to a solution? She says when one stops trying to protect themselves from their vulnerability, they start to speak about what truly affects them. When we are less worried about what others think, we can now focus on what we truly think and spot the areas where we might be vulnerable. The author opens my mind to the idea that I should be more open to the vulnerability I try my best to cover, for within it is why I will find change and innovation. Now, when I think about it deeply, I begin to remember instances where I was only able to find change after I had dealt with the uncomfortable. It is more like sitting down within the discomfort to accept your flaws so you can get to where the change will come. It still does not change the fact that it is uncomfortable to ask for help, especially when it makes you vulnerable, yet how will the change you seek come?
___ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)
![Samostically Banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Eo6Cie7XPvRCoFSbPcHCY2WLfe8w5upAP4o2FvnNPV8d52md62bx9Gg7vhkcHNi1hnr.png)
I am @samostically, a chess player and writer. I love to share the experience I have gained from different battles over the 64 squares and the knowledgeable insights from books I have read. But most importantly, [I am a Midnight Owl and I founded the community Midnight Letters.](https://peakd.com/c/hive-186424/about) ♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)

body.title: Mowing and Seedlings - May 6 & 7, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![Lawn mowed crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eq9UNUby8agtmG9kfc9Yiuw1nSDPSUGBU7Srs4GHw1Z8MDVXTSxZchshUiB9F7Re2oV.jpg)

On Wednesday morning I was up around 6AM, got the cat fed and checked e-mail. Then at 7AM I headed out to start mowing. Fortunately there was very little dew as it had been quite windy.

The little mower pulled its antic of not starting after the first dumping of the bagger. So I just mowed on the rider for a while until the push mower cooled down and was able to finish the trim work. Then back on the rider and the yard was done by 9:30AM.

So I headed to the barn to mow that area for the first time this year. I finished around 10:30AM.

![MacIntosh, crabapple, magnolia collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/242s3TmZ9dCgLHai27TxN5H5naBsS8EQjMWsLZp3Xpuh98rjpcJBPirfqCR4EoBCKJbhs.jpg)

As I came back from the barn mowing, the trees looked so nice. So I got my camera and got some photos of them. The rain had been forecast to start at 11AM so that’s why the early start.

![Flowers collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/245TDz1jxSFobV56jhwgX5G83T63WiCJoqt5XW32K1YUr9VDju9SKqvDDT54F7GFKpFwC.jpg)

I got a couple more photos and went inside. I was so exhausted I didn’t even shower, just had some lunch and went to bed and slept 4 hours.

![Bridges of Madison County1 crop.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23yJLU11WUaoAU9stG759czsuz3JUWzvvbfJkZhUBfdDbGW6jpvUM81FL3d1gir4RLcAi.jpg)

When I got up I decided the watch ‘Bridges of Madison County’, a favorite of mine. I was in bed by 8:45PM.

On Thursday I wasn’t moving too fast. I had a kitchen disaster to clean up, laundry to do, and several small projects to finish. I also needed to take a thorough shower! At 10:30AM a person was coming to evaluate the house and appliances for fuel assistance. I was looking to learn about heat pumps for the house, particularly for cooling.

I managed to finish the kitchen with help from my #4 helper, get the laundry started, and spent 2½ hours with the FA person. It looks like I will get 2 new AC units as the heat pump assessment and installation won’t happen before autumn. I can get 2 new freezers now, but they are smaller than the ones I have now. 

If I can get the 3 freezers at the barn started and filled, then she will come back and test them and maybe replace them. The ancient dehumidifier for the cellar will be replaced. The only thing they aren’t going to do, because the job is too small, is replace the weatherstripping on the 2 back doors. That was the only thing she found for the house proper.

She left just before 1PM and my #4 helper was late due to road construction and didn’t get here until 1:45PM. We got started on the seedlings after cleaning up the kitchen.

![Seedlings on the move collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoH1L7WDNPUe2ZGHd559ZG2VUk7Hhur7heHZz9H7y96RYimwHg5XKjvN2wYDwe14RbE.jpg)

I hadn’t had time or energy to check on what had come up from Saturday’s starting. It turns out a lot of stuff had, and some had gotten leggy. I also had ones that were too tall for the lights and needed to go to the cold frame. Those trays had to be leveled as they went out so they could be properly watered.

We hadn’t gotten much rain during the night and the seedlings in the cold frame were much too dry. So once we got the ones moved out of the house, we fed them all until they were soaked.

Then we went inside and fed or watered all the rest of the seedlings. By the time that was done, I was wiped out and had to sit down. She vacuumed the first floor before she left at 5:45PM.

![Alice in Wonderland crop.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23uQkGBKRYgN1ZUwv4duv5PhEy447Dmv492hvS5NQLpXiUHq9zJjY59aXM33JCxHjuBWx.jpg)

I made some supper and sat down to watch ‘Alice in Wonderland’ but only made it through half of it. I got the shades pulled, asked my son to light the fire in the office as it was to drop to 40F during the night, and went to bed at 8:15PM.

On Friday, I need to finish the laundry, get the house plants watered, and I’m hoping my #3 helper who comes at 12:30PM can help put up pea fences.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

body.title: The Gravity of the Unseen Tide
body.body:
There is a quiet tension in holding a seedling that hasn't yet met the sun. We keep it hidden in the dark, afraid that the open air might be too harsh, or that the ground we’ve chosen isn't ready to hold its roots. To speak of love is to plant that seed in the open; it is an act of total exposure, where we risk the frost of a silent response for the hope of a summer we haven't yet earned. ***

The Gravity of the Unseen Tide

I am a shore that waits for a moon,
Humming a low and ancient tune.
I feel the pull of a hidden tide,
With nowhere left for the waves to hide.

I am a book with a silver seal,
Hiding the truths that I’ve come to feel.
Afraid if I open the spine to the light,
The ink will dissolve and vanish from sight.

You are the sky, vast and unknown,
While I am a bird who has never quite flown.
I want to trust the wind of your breath,
But I fear the silence—the gravity’s death.

If I offer the bloom, will you catch the scent?
Or will it be crushed, its beauty all spent?
I’d rather be winter, frozen and deep,
Than wake a forest I’m not allowed to keep.

So I keep the fire in a lantern of glass,
And watch the ghosts of the \

pass.
A storm in a bottle, a star in a cage,
Afraid to turn to the final page. *** In the end, I find a strange peace in the shadows. I would rather my words remain unwritten than risk upsetting the rhythm of your world. Watching you smile, seeing the light dance in your eyes—that is enough to keep me warm. I have learned to love the sun without needing to touch it, finding my own joy simply by standing in the glow of your happiness, even if I am the only one who knows why I am smiling back.

Just like currently, now that Hive price is low, for that reason I bought some tokens and I am just waiting for the right time to sell. Well, I can't say that I am perfect at strategizing, but I'm looking into building a sustainable future for myself and not just focusing on earnings alone. I am focusing on remaining active here and posting consistently. I believe it is better for me to maintain value in every one of my posts than posting randomly without any meaningful impact. And yes, I must confess that I have also been learning from successful creators here on Hive, and to be sincere, I don't think it is a bad thing to learn from those who have been there before me. To be honest, my experience so far has been quite amazing 👌😎🥰. On my content plan, I like sharing my thoughts on things that have to do with motivation, my personal experiences, and lifestyle. Then sometimes, I can just observe things and use what I realize and what I think is right to create my content. I also engage in communities that I find interesting. India United community is one of the best communities that I have ever come across here on Hive. I also like to engage with meaningful content that I come across, and it's always a thing of joy to interact with my fellow Hivers, and I believe that also supports the growth of the blockchain. Hive is like a new home to me, and my mission here is very clear. I am focusing on remaining active and consistent, growing gradually as a creator, supporting my fellow users here on the blockchain, and continuing to contribute to the communities that fit my type of content. Most importantly, I understand that Hive is not a fast way of making money, and for that reason, I'm putting my focus on long-term growth. body.body:
>
Hola a todos en la comunidad de Hive. Es un verdadero placer estar de vuelta con ustedes para compartir mi participación en la semana 41 del Festival de Música Tradicional VDC, un espacio que siempre nos permite mostrar nuestra Arte y el talento de grandes compositores. En esta ocasión, he preparado con mucho cariño una interpretación de \

, una obra bellísima del reconocido Alexander Tiapa que destaca por su sentimiento y lírica profunda. Para esta ejecución, me sumerjo en la brillante tonalidad de La mayor, buscando transmitir cada matiz de esta pieza que tanto resuena en nuestra cultura llanera. Tengo el inmenso honor de contar con el acompañamiento en el arpa del Maestro Ramón Páez, cuya destreza y maestría en las cuerdas brindan el marco perfecto para que la melodía cobre vida con esa autenticidad que nos caracteriza. Participar en este festival no es solo un reto personal, sino una oportunidad de conectar con todos ustedes a través de la música que nos une y nos define como comunidad. Espero que disfruten de esta entrega tanto como yo disfruté grabándola, pues cada nota lleva un pedacito de mi corazón y el respeto que siento por nuestra tradición. Como siempre, les agradezco por el apoyo constante, por sus comentarios que me motivan a seguir mejorando y por mantener viva la llama de nuestra identidad musical en esta plataforma. Sin más que agregar, les envío un fuerte abrazo y el mayor de los éxitos en sus proyectos. Como siempre un gran abrazo para todos con cariño para todos, su amiga @Yoxibeth🎵🔥

body.title: Blue skies smiling at me
body.body:
<center>![PXL_20260502_134522302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/243q4PYqngsRJU9EhtjJQ58pvc4rsQA1cT5wBXzC152DJSR1bWq5fG6vHeJrUTh1LMDQo.jpg)</center>

-----------------------------

Things are looking up a bit am I right?  I mean BTC went back over $80,000 and HIVE even hit close to $.09 this past week.  It's about time something started happening again.  Something positive anyway.  Meanwhile, in the real world, things are starting to green up and signs of winter are slowly starting to fade away.  Where last weekend was a whirlwind of travel for @mrsbozz and I, this coming weekend is going to be a bit different.  

We still plan on being quite busy, but we are going to be staying a little closer to home and focusing on getting the travel trailer ready for our first trip of the season over the Memorial Day weekend.  We need to get the interior and exterior all cleaned up, all of our gear moved back in, and I need to pull apart the wheel bearings, inspect them, and then repack them with grease and put them back together.


<center>![PXL_20260502_015643425.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23t74ZCdAHjPbkxatqV1YwpSB4Z1Z31189PKo9YxyZQNxiokC9rvYa8MZApdAvf5xmitH.jpg)</center>

-------------------------

I forgot to share this photo I took the other day while we were at the zoo lights lantern festival exhibit.  That bright light in the center is the moon, but right below it is what I thought at first was a building.  Turns out it was actually the cloud deck.  It gave things a quite creepy feel as we were finishing up our walk.  It was still pretty cool though.

### Coin Gecko

I was having some issues with Coin Gecko for the past couple of weeks.  For some reason the app was not working for me on my phone.  Every time I would try to open it I was getting an error and nothing would load.  I reached out to their technical support and after a bit of back and forth we were able to determine it was something specific with the app and my public IP address.  After a little bit more conversation they were finally able to fix it.  

I have to say, for such an insignificant issue that potentially only a single person was having, they handled it really well.  I feel like they went the extra mile to make sure I was taken care of even though I am paying them nothing and the information they supply can be easily acquired somewhere else.  My hats off to the team at Coin Gecko.  Well done!

### Splinterlands

I've been continuing to play Splinterlands a bit more than I have in the past.  Brawls still continue to be my favorite part of the game. I noticed a while ago that the clan I am part of wasn't filling the gold foil frays very consistently, so I decided to focus solely on building up my GF cards to fulfill that need.  

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23u5ZgGBSnSFMkzEw8b98ZTZenX9eaYRHVDkMXWpw3qrBTKD96NyfjAZdW2rVKjx6LxBE.png)</center>

--------------------------

We are far from a top tier guild, but it has been working out well for me.  Sometimes I wonder what it might be like to be in a bigger guild that can offer more rewards, but I have been in this guild so long and there is a bit of loyalty there.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tkomsfgDHpvVGVt655WNtq2dkhojvdsZ4n6JjAFM7e725VoeCJJTVm96m2nRc6xPAmy.png)</center>

------------------------------------

Meanwhile, I actually made it to Gold III in Frontier league or whatever it is called, but I am afraid to play anymore the rest of the season because I don't want to get knocked back down to Silver I and not be able to break back into the Gold tier.  I seem to have streaks where I lose more than I win, so it's dangerous to keep playing.  Which is too bad because there is still a lot of season left!

### Contract Negotiations

On the traditional finance side of things, I recently drafted the letters for my wife and myself asking for a raise.  They have been turned over to the appropriate supervisor and now we just wait to see if they fulfill it or decline.  I say negotiation, but it's not really the case.  We can ask for whatever, but they basically say what they are going to give us.  There isn't usually much back and forth if they decline.  I ended up asking for more than I had planned this year, and if we both get our request, I think I am going to bump up @mrsbozz's retirement contributions a little bit.

### Travala

The crypto travel platform [Travala](https://www.travala.com/ref/EALCVN) recently finished their latest quarterly rewards.  Basically, you get tokens in return for doing specific tasks.  Most of them take place on X and they are fairly easy to accomplish.  I earned about 100 tokens this cycle which amounts to maybe $20 at current prices. It isn't great, but it's better than nothing.  Perhaps one day it will be worth something again.

Sadly, I feel like Travala is starting to lose their edge in the crypto travel market.  It seems a lot of other companies are starting to integrate travel options into their wallet or platform. This could be bad for Travala depending on how they play it.

### SMR

Not much news about NuScale this week.  Just the fact that they had their earnings call yesterday and it came in at -$.14 per share which is only a penny off from what was predicted.  I'll choose to see that as some good news.

### GoMining 

Finally, with the price of BTC recovering, the crypto mining platform [GoMining](https://gomining.com/?ref=AWSRZIN) is likely going to be pulling back some of it's discounts that they have had over the past few months.  I took advantage of the current discounts and picked up another 8TH of mining power for about $100.  That puts my main mining rig at about 108TH/15W.  Similar rigs on the secondary market have an asking price of well into the four figure range.  I don't plan on selling though.  GoMining is a long term investment for me that I see appreciating as the price of BTC continues to go up.

body.title: Legacy of Discovery.
body.body:
in the manor, young Lara discovered a hand-drawn note with hidden coordinates. By adjusting a globe to 30 North and 90 East, I revealed a secret ladder leading to more artifacts. Then I solved a mechanical puzzle involving a great bat and shielded knights to free the White Queen.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUWAcr4f1QTw7WnuCs4G26EhUYLJrNhxWf8hJt6iN8SEn/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeKcKfWpmjZ3LixN7FnYr2VmmdEmg79vQLs3Sxi7EgPA6/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWWLQp5poQL1BBR1RCzvxAmLL5nynN7aHJKbxm76teXRA/screenshot_3_.png)

So the kid survived with no injury after her fall, and then I had to move inside the building and enter the hallroom that Lara mentioned as the forbidden tomb. And it looked like this place was not a regular building, but a museum of her father's greatest discoveries. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc6TsxqmxdGyRJAMevCFc8Lgxa42Wqts4LWqC9VwyNiWt/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQzeFz5dGd9sLgnmCNPoMYxChe5EKsoGedYoj81t1mWWB/screenshot_5_.png)

When I started checking around the room, I noticed valuable artifacts from all over the world, each one telling a story of a distant land. And then Lara locked the door with a playful sense of determination. She moved with a confidence that mirrored the great explorer she was destined to become one day.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNorZzxYLfCxSbesCWy5x8dUiqWvhDYQSsZHgSZ81J4A/screenshot_6_.png)

She found a valuable intel on a hand-drawn note where she mentioned the great bat stole the queen at 30 North and 90 East by night. It was a riddle, designed to test her mind and her observational skills. I studied the drawings, and tried to visualize how these numbers would help me navigate the room's complex mechanisms.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWcPL2W3dT1P3ftrw14cdiJsXTUxQGbAuEcVcQ42atboR/screenshot_7_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaMhUzRLd2vkru22Kuwb9U7vG4UQavzqNL3EpkcSAPdje/screenshot_8_.png)

At first, I didn't understand what the intel was for, but then I understood I had to interact with this mechanical globe where I had to look for the exact altitude on the massive globe.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYFEccYabJprA6bNoh5EJhAKjF4SUP9tBd5TknkCua9L2/screenshot_9_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdKWh7Kywyf2qC1yPvtYZKjyACxiNJRv6KNiGTvkDgum/screenshot_10_.png)

After finding 30 North and 90 East on the globe, the open roof got closed, plunging the room into a dramatic darkness. And a ladder got released from the floor above with a thin light appearing on the globe.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2BNvYQcHgPJ7ivK2HitZSP4q73ZHHnFBEWUhEUYQH5w/screenshot_12_.png)

I had to climb up that ladder, and it looked like the floor above was full of artifacts that Lara has been seen before, as she mentioned while identifying the various statues and relics. Each piece was a memory of her father's travels, preserved here in the heart of their home.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeBMk1WxF72tJ4Wv6cmX4aTPuFC2Mo9tacBerbqFfzbj9/screenshot_13_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWrjktjtZifbD4yXnaxjSB9xN1yb7w4ZeWYZoYxfRrh8c/screenshot_14_.png)

I had to use this mechanical wheel to make that mechanical bat spread her wings. The wings were massive, and it was a beautiful piece of craftsmanship that dominated the ceiling.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmawEmtJrctQ2fAkMy8n1noGPeDCdRwgNynP1EsA7trYL1/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQLhgWWR3K4guyeDQBB5MkJjNwtLrJT9toRgxDsTrGg6M/screenshot_16_.png)

After the great bat's wings were unfurled, there came two red lights below, so I had to work on some puzzles next. Upon Lara mentioning the clues, I had to move the knights with shields into position to reflect the light correctly across the floor. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqvJiXQ2HH8RJsg8AYsNGAc781poDSTwiX4syasSTvDb/screenshot_17_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNXgEhifaMjfzE6k5Vi2MCv8sv2tpKoLbDA8sfRLHzHQ8/screenshot_18_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeTuo5kDYjQSu75anDLvv6y75XokFjPc1NgLe4g1srTTP/screenshot_19_.png)

The clue Lara was giving me allowed me to solve the puzzle easily, aligning the shields until the path was clear. And at last, the White Queen got revealed, who was stuck behind the ladder.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdATJjAYZjosUCj2EceZT8LVdPkyTHoYNSZ7wV3os6VnU/screenshot_20_.png)

Then I had to interact with the globe again, turning the wheels one final time so the ladder gets back upwards. Once the obstruction was moved, the White Queen got free and could be moved to the center of the display. It was a satisfying conclusion to the riddle, proving that even as a child, Lara was a master of puzzles, and yeah, thanks to me for helping her.

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/6ec6c273)

body.title: Tomar un tiempo y apreciarme ¿Es malo?/  Is it wrong to take some time to appreciate myself? [ESP/ENG]
body.body: > Hola queridos amigos de @holos.lotus, saludos y bendiciones, en esta ocasión vengo con una reflexión que mantuve con mi prima, tras ella contarme todo lo que ha estado haciendo, algo atareada y sintiendo que el tiempo no le alcanza, es por eso que me pregunto que si era malo pensar un momento en ella y darse un cariño. --- ![REVIEW (8).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23zbkp26SyCzc4PPo9ra6WHiHweHkDPCskC55BdSyQxZzo9W9CHjgFSdcftneC3DYjcUi.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

>Tras escuchar su pregunta y dudas me puse a analizar al respecto, ciertamente hay momentos en lo que las responsabilidades del hogar, el cuidar los hijos, atender al marido si hay jeje, o a los padres sobre todo cuando están muy mayores, el trabajo, en fin, muchas cosas a lo que uno debe atender, y a veces por más que uno quiera darle un tiempo para después el esperar o dejar que se acumulen no siempre resulta ya que a la final lo que genera más estrés o acumular más trabajo de lo que uno espera, por eso uno trata de poner prioridad a todo ese trabajo o responsabilidades para evitar ello, pero cuan necesario es hacer una pausa y pensar un momento en lo que uno quiere hacer, en lo que uno desea cambiar y poder darse la oportunidad de tomar un tiempo para uno mismo. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>Pero, ¿tomar un tiempo para uno? Ps estoy de acuerdo que si se merece ello, no dijo que dejar a un lado las cosas que caen en la mano de uno no se haga, sino que es necesario e importante tomarse un momento para hacer lo que uno quiere, por ejemplo, una mujer casada y con hijos, una vida llena de responsabilidad y atenciones, a veces ni arreglarse las uñas o el cabello que parece algo simple pero como hace sentir mejor a uno como mujer, es importante hacerlo, no quita mucho tiempo pero como hace que las cosas se vean mejor en uno mismo y más cómodo, se siente definitivamente cosas distintas, es una felicidad poder lograr ello y tan importante para poder continuar con el resto. --- ![sunriseforever-woman-5536361_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23vsWh9C2SfQF4RnWszgp6DBvsSXAfK4N5sS9gad24eaqRjLddYad8Lnb3EisTcBhe9Sf.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-5536361_1920.jpg) ---

>Oh una mujer con hijos y encargada de sus padres, un momento para salir sola, distraerse, que alguien le apoye con el cuidado, que pueda tener un rato para ver otras cosas que no sea del hogar, que pueda disfrutar de un helado sin preocupaciones de llegar atendiendo, también tiene ese derecho, que para algunos pueda verse como alejarse de ello sabiendo que el tiempo pasa, pero cuando necesario es para que el cuerpo tome algo diferente, para que la mente descanse y pueda activarse de otra manera, las cosas cotidianas de alguna u otra manera agotan por ello tomarse un tiempo para uno mismo no está mal, sea arreglándose, saliendo o haciendo cualquier cosa diferente a lo que habitualmente se hace, es una manera en la que las cosas se pueden sentir mejor y diferente. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png) **ENGLISH**

> Hello, dear friends at @holos.lotus. Greetings and blessings. Today I’d like to share a conversation I had with my cousin after she told me about everything she’s been up to—she’s been quite busy and feels like she doesn’t have enough time. That’s why I wonder if it’s wrong to take a moment to think of her and show her some kindness. --- ![REVIEW (9).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23zbkozzm3tVeUwFKmCLeDu3pnE9SYasrz973bt9t5L5gTiXp9hfhiCPNULjPHRD2b16t.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

>After hearing your question and concerns, I started thinking about it. There are certainly times when household responsibilities, taking care of the kids, looking after your husband if you have one, hehe, or parents—especially when they’re very old—work, and so on—there are just so many things one has to attend to. And sometimes, no matter how much you want to set aside time for them later, waiting or letting them pile up doesn’t always work out, since in the end, it just creates more stress or piles up more work than you expected. That’s why you try to prioritize all that work and those responsibilities to avoid that, but how necessary it is to pause and think for a moment about what you want to do, what you wish to change, and to give yourself the opportunity to take some time for yourself. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>But taking some time for yourself? P.S. I agree that if you deserve it, I didn’t say you shouldn’t set aside the things that fall into your lap, but rather that it’s necessary and important to take a moment to do what you want. For example, a married woman with children, a life full of responsibilities and demands—sometimes even getting a manicure or a haircut, which seems like a simple thing, but since it makes you feel better as a woman, it’s important to do it. It doesn’t take much time, but since it makes you look better and feel more comfortable, you definitely feel different. It’s a joy to be able to do that, and it’s so important for being able to keep going with everything else. --- ![sunriseforever-woman-5536361_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23vsWh9C2SfQF4RnWszgp6DBvsSXAfK4N5sS9gad24eaqRjLddYad8Lnb3EisTcBhe9Sf.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-5536361_1920.jpg) ---

>Oh, a woman with children who also takes care of her parents—she deserves a moment to go out alone, to take her mind off things, to have someone help with the caregiving, to have a little time to see things beyond the home, to enjoy an ice cream without worrying about rushing back to tend to others. She has that right, too. To some, it might seem like she’s turning her back on it, knowing that time is passing, but when necessary, it’s so the body can recharge, so the mind can rest and recharge in a different way. Everyday life is exhausting in one way or another, so taking some time for yourself isn’t a bad thing—whether it’s getting dressed up, going out, or doing something different from what you usually do—it’s a way to make things feel better and different. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

> **Thank you very much for reading. I hope you enjoy it. I’d be happy to answer any questions you may have, and if you’d like to know more about me, here are my:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
**Translated Using Deepl** ![separadoryasma2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23t7FGdvDtjjEnDiEmhiBDnp6mbsh7xtMBUvkUFiwLtYYSHA9MCnR3VGBuvWJeHNVDBGh.png)

body.title: Store of Value
body.body:
This is a topic that is always in my mind and should be in yours too, if you want a good future for yourself. Storing value is important and not as easy as some think, if you want the best result.

![ahmet-kahveci-quXcDasTHpM-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tbMBUQdvZCdNfg3v81nNWxtQpauYedo1haV6fWHqfz1rt3eFVyNipoy34UVGfnnbV9w.jpg)
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash Ever since the current, or should I say the newest war started, I've been keeping an eye on things you can store value in or with, to see how their value reacts to Geo-political changes. It gives you an indication if your strategy is good or bad and also presents some opportunities to fine tune, or change your plans in the future. ![nico-knaack-oo4c_knwCuI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23zbcJ32MV72NCB1Z6Yjm5F6PCpoWS9mTQdj3ei896B6HgYKStkVt6NkYJmu7k3gF1dJx.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash Today I'm going to try to show you how they reacted during the current war, which is far from over. ![sebastien-lavalaye-67Ws06I8yv4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23uQmt8toJdf3pwfjHgfNEXNc4tEeaKTReauMDMs3ZFFwve1vuqdq11G5kSHPyA4H3ntG.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash Let's start with Gold as precious metals and gold in general has been knows, or thought to be the safest and best store of value for so long. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tSzChUMEnenN6C4YHT7F5QACaSZpZcgpj3955EcqAxy9ZweunvxgunwXiPCj5w9XkZg.png) This is the daily tokenized Gold chart. I marked the day the current war started. You can see gold hit $5470 and then literally sold off, we got a 24% decline after that. If it would be the best store of value, it would have swept all time high and continue to blow the roof, literally, but it didn't. So those who bet on gold just lost a quarter of their investment's value, in case they bought gold that day. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tcP5TryRHifWYhiineY53whHGngrkgvVECQhpiHBzKKEqNFbvbrq8J36pRYqvCiGSp2.png) Silver pretty much had the same faith, with a bit more bitter results as the drop was of almost 37%. You can argue that both precious metals mentioned above had a nice run previously and set new all time highs both, which is true, but in times of crises, they preformed exactly the opposite of what some people expect. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23twAKV13E6AdrHpZUtiRLbYLUa92ec3UdVDqkUgL9U6wd5GC8zrmxTdgaeLeHdELkqBk.png) NASDAQ had a similar evolution, maybe the drop was not as sharp as in case of precious metals, but we've seen a 12% drop, before a reversal. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tcNRVeXyqRjMML8RC6FyLz7ukcetxjrMSALDLRDth46AGbwaPUDmKBftZrsyy5D3UzW.png) S&P 500, the stock market index had a 8.42% drop. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tcP5TrvzWWm3rLXXTb5ozN1vbPwYfY4zet66RcGvuKH82rdJLnWz9vVRHTKB9VKcjwj.png) Dow Jones, the stock market index of 30 prominent companies listed on stock exchanges in the United States, down 8.2%. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23viTJhBnL6UMFFGNC8HHv8CcspKwaHqsKAXfVhvtLUmJD2QBLkE2K51oVBCuwGxf77YM.png) $USD on the other hand wrote a swing low that very day and went up 5% since then. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23u6Ymojh4evAhSg1zohH5FiDnitv8MAVDSRRjYH1wca9YrkdxPobFeQZB9Rm1ZQ9fZ5j.png) The obvious winner was crude oil. Everyone with a bit of knowledge knew what's on stake here and those who were trading crude made the move and as a result, made the money too as crude went up 67% and even though there has been corrections, going back to $70's level, which was the norm before the war started is slim right now. Each party is announcing victory every week twice, but you can't take these announcements seriously as the war is far from over and the real effects of it are yet to come. Fuel prices have been fluctuating in every country. Some countries are not dependent on oil coming from that region, but those that are need to manage the situation the best way they can. Flight prices have surged significantly not only due to fuel prices but also because of airspace rerouting. In case of such crises, usually money flows out of risk assets, into less risky areas. Crypto is considered risk and we've seen how it reacts in times of crises, but that doesn't mean each asset is performing the same way. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23u6YmoQXHjZsBPqFLzbDpwDDPf7Guqh7pz54eizYoP6SXejXdqLV7g7DRq8A75Yxhmcx.png) $BTC is up 31% since the war started. It has been continuing its journey like nothing happened and from technical point of view, it's a healthy evolution. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tmmXSxYTR2ZHJor1cXmypiKfZ6znjAY6MSabk1EHUjGAQDRYaNVr9pZtdHD4jB8HTwV.png) $ETH had a similar evolution, with a slightly better result, but the difference is insignificant, what matters is that in this case it's been a trustworthy asset. This new crisis, just like the previous ones has shown what a decentralized asset means when it comes to free payment. Money has been weaponized for so long, it's time to have a decentralized currency that is not controlled by any entity. Please note, this is not financial advice, I'm not going to tell you what to invest in, that's your responsibility. So what do you think the best store of value is? Let me know in a comment. Let's see what you have in mind.

></center>

If you're a newbie, you may want to check out these guides:
- [Communities Explained - Newbie Guide](https://peakd.com/hive-174578/@erikah/communities-explained-newbie-guide)

body.title: Syndicate Protocol Now Has a Full Onboarding Experience — Here's How It Works
body.body:
![openart-sample_1778239135101_ed14c89a.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23u5bfMCS6C86qVgfQCx57GxjKdSsaHzQMLU1f4EdeYzScJnuMkPrhTuZnd6jt1YoxLvj.png)

One of the biggest barriers to entry in any strategy game is the cold start. 
You log in, you see a map, some numbers, and a button — and you have no idea 
where to begin. We've heard your feedback, and today we're 
shipping something that changes it completely.

**Syndicate Protocol now has a guided onboarding flow** — a step-by-step 
cinematic introduction that walks every new player through their first 
operation from scratch. No guesswork. No wiki required.

Here's exactly what it looks like.
## The Cinematic Intro


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23tGRh1D8TsGVxzbeVxmhzZeKoVkDCQhuwaGrEyhuaTrtKrNXRa6w16LJqnvGL5TCz4R2.png)


The moment you log in for the first time, the game fades in with a 
full-screen cinematic sequence. No tutorial popups. No checkbox lists. 
Just the city talking to you:

> *\

*

Each line types out one character at a time. When the sequence finishes, 
a single button appears: **Begin**. That's your moment to step into the city.

---

## Step 1 — Build Your Crew


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23t6zDcRtRLAKz9ypLSpBnDjHLueLpwGtGzxtxZHccUKU2ATDsvnq7atS8fKgJgAnMPUj.png)


The first thing every syndicate needs is bodies. A spotlight appears on 
the **Crew** link in the navigation bar, drawing your attention to the 
recruitment office. A coach mark card tells you what you're doing and why:

> *\

*

The rest of the screen is dimmed. There's only one place to go.

---

## Step 2 — Sign Your First Operative



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23tRr48HaUD3Ps3R9Ko1oK9eB6H6WjF1MbgzZ1ursncsmccCJGtkhBA7qvKgskCfPu9aT.png)


Inside the Crew page, the recruit button pulses with an amber glow. 
The coach mark explains the weight of the moment:

> *\

*

The moment your first crew member is signed, the flow automatically 
advances to the next step — no button press needed.

---

## Step 3 — You Need Backup


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23tRrLVD6ikwBMhnJpfp9QkjUjy3L45G6W5Y3QWw7fs5cuhRfPBK26UVuFBBnLPTY8Bj2.png)


One operative isn't enough for Iron Row operations. The game knows this, 
and it tells you directly:

> *\

*

Same recruit button, same amber spotlight. Sign your second operative 
and the flow moves on automatically.

---

## Step 4 — Head to the Zones


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23t72fJaZ9iE62XhbpybJyWYaUB4CbWWWnyqwgh7HUzF95EM8vJqvEScvoL8tdg1qDr4p.png)


With two crew members on the roster, the game shifts focus to the map. 
The **Zones** navigation link lights up:

> *\

*

---

## Step 5 — Choose Your Ground


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23t72jmDe665GgLv7dU6BJEQjCeVP6voWSE55YDyqo3UxhvpbgUXYf9jT2NhJ7g38YyEY.png)


On the Zones page, **Iron Row** is highlighted. It's the starting zone — 
free to access, no HIVE required. The coach mark sets the scene:

> *\

*

---

## Step 6 — Claim Your Territory


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23t72XDSE7nGU83aTpSyq8EaKDwQYBHT1Gnk9S7L1YDKnTkUSxxxSaZf13kqeNXDKdDFW.png)


Inside Iron Row, the **Anchor Yard** territory is spotlighted. This is 
your foothold — the ground you'll run your first operation from:

> *\

*

The game auto-selects the territory for you so you can see exactly 
what a selected territory looks like before you move on.

---

## Step 7 — Deploy Your Crew


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23t72XDSCRZC9wMcbHwZG2tmtf2qT6TS5GU5Acqrj7HH6CtqrimjqHz5SpT6FdCaoSDnf.png)


With a territory selected, the deployment bay opens. The crew assignment 
section is spotlighted:

> *\

*

Your first two crew members are automatically slotted in so you can 
see the deployment bay in action.

---

## Step 8 — Sweep the Block


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23tGPdV57a9guu1eMYnrp18drbXuUWX9uzcDLiLpKRmraPaCA2f4oPzT2nzkzAi2HDy5i.png)


The **Deploy & Scan** button lights up. This is the moment your crew 
goes out to find available operations in the territory:

> *\

*

---

## Step 9 — Pick Your Play


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23t6zDcRuu9QteWLUQM8gSE1apWJifbGmUrZTNJ9ykZWcdtCCYXvTLwLmzazJY6M8M1Fy.png)


The scan returns with jobs on the table. The first operation card is 
spotlighted:

> *\

*

The game selects your first operation automatically and launches it 
so you land directly in the live operation view.

---

## Step 10 — You're In


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syndicate.game/23t72XD6zo6oPBCinJNyJAoA9VCaaQuWiVDJ9Uv2gjYmXwwjKUGBYd9AsKZCy5JWYBZbZ.png)


The operation is live. The **Advance Operation** button pulses. 
This is the last step of onboarding:

> *\

* From here, you're on your own. The city is watching. --- ## How It's Built A few things worth noting for the technically curious: - Progress is saved to your account after every step — if you close the browser mid-onboarding, you resume exactly where you left off - The flow never blocks you. If anything goes wrong on the backend, the game defaults to onboarding complete and lets you play freely - On mobile, coach marks anchor above the bottom navigation. On desktop, they position intelligently around the highlighted element --- ## Try It If you're a new player, the flow starts automatically the moment you log in. If you've been around since before this update, you've already seen most of this the hard way — respect. New to Syndicate Protocol? Log in at [syndicate-protocol.com](https://syndicate-protocol.com) and let the city introduce itself. * * *

/>

**Syndicate Protocol** — Build your crew. Run ops. Control territory.  
A browser-based crime syndicate strategy game on the Hive blockchain.

body.title: 😝World Password Day! / ¡Día Mundial de la Contraseña! 😎
body.body:
>

World Password Day is celebrated annually on the first Thursday of May, a date that reminds us of the importance of protecting our passwords and developing better password security habits. We live in an increasingly interconnected and digital world, making our passwords more important than ever. It's recommended that you not only review your passwords today, but also do so regularly to ensure your digital life is as secure as possible.

> El Día Mundial de la Contraseña, se celebra anualmente el primer jueves de mayo, una fecha que nos recuerda la importancia de proteger nuestras contraseñas y desarrollar mejores hábitos en este sentido. Vivimos en un mundo cada vez más interconectado y digital, por lo que nuestras contraseñas son más importantes que nunca.
Es recomendable que no solo revises tus contraseñas hoy, sino que también lo hagas periódicamente para garantizar que tu vida digital sea lo más segura posible.

World Password Day is a celebration that was first recommended by security expert **Mark Burnett** in his book \

Eight years later, in May **2013**, Intel Security officially recommended that the first Thursday in May be designated as World Password Day. Since then, it has been celebrated regularly.\n\n> El Día Mundial de la Contraseña es una celebración que fue recomendada por primera vez por el experto en seguridad Mark Burnett en su libro \

. Ocho años después, en mayo de 2013, Intel Security recomendó oficialmente que el primer jueves de mayo se designara como el Día Mundial de la Contraseña. Desde entonces, se celebra con regularidad. Using 1991 decryption technology, it would take over 6,000 years to crack a random eight-character password with random symbols and letters. That same eight-character password could be cracked in approximately nine years in 2021. - Roughly one-third of all phishing emails are opened by the recipient. - In 2017, 90% of all phishing emails contained some form of ransomware. - The list of the ten most commonly used passwords over the past five years has barely changed. - On this day, it's also advisable to enable ***two-factor*** authentication on your important accounts. Additionally, be sure to log out of your bank accounts when you're finished using them, don't save your passwords on your phone or computer, and password-protect your router. > Utilizando la tecnología de descifrado de 1991, se necesitarían más de 6.000 años para descifrar una contraseña aleatoria de ocho caracteres con símbolos y letras aleatorios. Esa misma contraseña de ocho caracteres podría descifrarse en 2021 en aproximadamente 9 años. -Aproximadamente un tercio de todos los correos electrónicos de phishing son abiertos por el destinatario. -En 2017, el 90% de todos los correos electrónicos de phishing contenían algún tipo de ransomware. -La lista de las diez contraseñas más utilizadas en los últimos cinco años apenas ha cambiado. En este día, también es recomendable activar la autenticación de dos factores en tus cuentas importantes. Además, asegúrate de cerrar sesión en tus cuentas bancarias cuando termines de usarlas, no guardes tus contraseñas en el teléfono ni en el ordenador y protege tu router con contraseña. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thealliance/SszMQ6lq-thealliance20new20pagebreak.png ## Family Time!

> ![theallianceaddamsamily.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thealliance/Eo1xNsyU9Q6SticGggzUC7xpkcWk5kDPPA4jxXtRSJGrwXNYeTqbZEsruByRn4MkSey.gif) Well hey there, did ya miss us? We missed you! So much, in fact, that we have rescheduled our 'Family Time' to Fridays and we hope to see you there! Join our lovely band of outcasts, normies, goofballs, pimps, degenerates, professionals and all things within and without and betwixt and between starting **6 pm CST/ 7 pm EST**. We always try to have a little fun and and if you're paying attention, a few smiles might just be shared. We like to smile. We like to laugh. We realize that life isn't all about the important things like #politics, #religion and #sex, no, it's about the time spent, the experiences had and memories made. Únase a nuestra encantadora banda de marginados, normativos, tontos, proxenetas, degenerados, profesionales y todo lo relacionado con dentro y fuera y entre y a partir de **6 p.m. CST/ 7 p.m. EST**. Siempre tratamos de divertirnos un poco y, si estás prestando atención, es posible que compartamos algunas sonrisas. Nos gusta sonreír. Nos gusta reír.
