body.title: A Day in My Life Blog: A Simple but Very Memorable Birthday Celebration of My Mother held here at Home! 🎊😇🎂
body.body: **Have a Blessed Day to all ASEAN Hivers and all my Fellow Hivers all over the World!** In my past blog post which we can read it [Here](https://hive.blog/hive-141359/@godlovermel25/an-update-of-my-life), I have shared an update about my life which I have tell the reasons of my inactivity for more than two weeks. I just hope that everyone will understand. I have shared also that I can now write a blog but not always as I needed to rest more, but if I can do it, I will make sure to share my blog post, most especially those events that I didn't shared yet. For today will be very special blog post, as it is all about the recent simple Birthday Celebration of my Mother here in our house. But before I continue sharing, my greetings and thanksgiving first to all my supporters. I do appreciate you all for the nnending supp. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVn3Z7XK4A3W3igsaRjFfegSLPGhKGYAeEFXLQ76Dj5zK/1778234934400.png) My Mother's Birthday was on last April 30, but due to what happened to me as I shared in my last blog post. I didn't able to share the simple celebration here in the community. At this moment, I am still not feeling well that is why I didn't helped anything in the preparations, I just thank God for the help of my Aunts and cousins in this important moment of my Mother. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5H7kvQBTUcuhJqfg8Em7jTNhkv9eNqY3AyxtjMfxy4F/1778236164105.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYcUjNEnADXAeuZdeZNsgweEXAMsjWA5PkKAJV8t3ARrQ/1778236164173.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMr67SRWCVqGtxMCezVsJTDw6SCoRbR9vcAsHfA8NfUi/1778236164220.jpg) That was around 4:30 in the afternoon when they finished cooking the foods that they prepared for my Mother. I don't know what they're cooking as I stayed in my room all the time. I have now then called to go in our Sala in order to start the short fellowship for the celebration. I didn't have part in the program, and am just a listener at the moment. We have now then sang a song of praises and worship to God and even though I stand well at this time, I make sure that I have sing a song of praises and worship to God. It is my Aunt's time to share God's Word as I am not able to share at this time. What she shared to us is very timely especially to me, as she said that we should be happy in all circumstances. This is what 1 Thessalonians 5:16-18 said, and I am very thankful to the Word of God being shared to us in this celebration. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZT4AbXtsbXsmhamL4rLspeLUobjNJsJWbSVoBXUB4UBn/1778236706076.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQS6KwedaDz3YSspGTYB6Y4X6YGeAXCKMdBrZy8nVcZHX/1778236706135.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQeGRytManU9a5hgnSQqsWt25NMbXj37daHyHq8hpwHYS/1778236706177.jpg) After the short Fellowship, we have now then given each one of us to share our praywr and declaration to my Mother. At this time everyone have shared more birthdays and blessings to come to her and that all her plans may come true. I am now the last who shared and I can't stop myself to cry as I am very thankful to God for I am here celebrating her birthday. I thank and praise God for the extension of life and I also thank my Mother for always loving me. Before I ended, I have also given to her my simple gift together with my Girlfriend. We gave her a Sandal and a Bag which she can used. I know she is very happy with my simple gift to her. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRwSJACtvNcAMYbJFSM5Xe9BZ1wCHFmHQtBv7VE4YtSe1/1778237061442.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbErPCzfuuvnVGoUboNAXokaK2s3mYoMJyyuhYxAh53cz/1778237061494.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVMihf5Sm8dTVxdu3BUqRYm4U6WjAteLgn6oQHT5HNZtC/1778237061532.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmebV1839t4TSRnNigYCLv7TgjxyLKz2eXo21fJL8hjH87/1778237061570.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVs6QMn6jFi1zzQKxhuEGY6vuyi5HQVSkmviRspjRgisM/1778237061601.jpg) After a while, I have then back to my room to rest but the Birthday Celebration continues and I thank my cousin who were able to capture pictures during the celebration. At this time, the foods were already prepared and before they started eating, a Birthday Cake bought by my Girlfriend was now light up to be blown away by my Morher. After she blown the candle, they have then sing a Birthday song. My nephew Baby King2x is very happy while singing a Birthday song for his Grandmother which he called as Nanay. He is very excited too with the Birthday Cake as it is his favorite flavor. They have then started taking their dinner at this moment. Even though it is a simple Birthday Celebration of my Mother. The most important thing is that she is very happy and that we are complete with good health and strength from God. As for me, I have eaten a few only and continued my rest as my body this time is very weak. I just thank God for the success of my Mother's simple Birthday Celebration. This would be all for today's post, and until next time again, I just want to thank everyone in advance who will drop by on my blog post. **To God be all the Glory!** 😇🙌☝️ **Your Friend** **_@godlovermel25_**

body.title: beach gym fit hits different when the sunset's golden
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778202527-98a007d03c58.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/rabbitfish/seed-rabbitfish-2026-05-08/main-1-1778202527-98a007d03c58.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

So I've been going to the outdoor gym down by the beach most mornings lately, and honestly it's become my favorite part of the day. There's something about working out right there by the water, feeling that salt air on your skin, watching the light change as you move through your routine. Today I threw on this green leaf print bikini top with my black bottoms, kept it simple, and just soaked in the vibe.

I grew up in the water basically, so being near it while I'm training just makes sense to me. The gym itself is this casual blue setup right on the sand, nothing fancy, just enough equipment to get a solid session in. I love that it's real and unpretentious, you know? No one's there for the gram, people are actually just moving their bodies and enjoying being outside. The energy is different than any indoor gym I've ever tried.

What really got me today was how the light was hitting everything as the afternoon stretched out. That golden hour thing started early, and I could feel the day shifting. I grabbed my water, threw a towel over my shoulder, and just felt so present in that moment. The beach is where I belong, and being able to train right there, surrounded by palms and that endless horizon, it's like the perfect reminder of why I love this lifestyle so much.

Fashion-wise, I'm all about mixing prints and solid colors when I'm at the gym. The tropical print top keeps things fun and true to who I am, while the simple black bottoms balance it out. It's practical and it feels good, which is really all that matters when you're actually working. That's the real fit check, right? When your clothes feel like an extension of what you're doing, not something you're thinking about.

body.title: MY SEEDLING REPLANTING  - and why I didn't want to do it
body.body:
My seedling grow more and more, and it was high time to replace it to new homes.
I was doubting if I should make it because of one serious reason I faced.

The seedling doesn't like replanting! I was very surprised to discover it. 
Of course, I knew replanting is stress for any plants, but I was sure it's a short and not serious stress, and it leads just to positive changes and more active growth - bigger pots - more place for growing.
But in fact, when I made replanting for other big seedlings for the first time (about 2 weeks ago) I noticed, it stopped growing for more than a week! Sopme of them even died after replanting.
Wtf! I was very upset.. I tried my best to follow all rules but somehow it didn't work.

But thanks God, in some time they felt better and started growing again - they understood those new bigger pots were not so bad;)
But I made a conclusion that the next year I will choose big pots at once and will plant seeds there from the very beginning not to bother seedling during its growth any more.

But it will be in future.
This year I planted 2-3-4 seeds into 1 small pot to see which of them would sprout.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTnNRKDzF71EPC7Yy3dfjeivhpXZpk4HqgQTWiU8NqvaP/image.png)

Sometimes all of them sprouted so I have to replant and separate them.


![photo_2026-05-08_13-52-08.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd5MBNBLCpntXgiKBZGgcK27BKZEQEWg2RwReUqBtAMGZ/photo_2026-05-08_13-52-08.jpg)

the roots were huge already! and they needed more space


![photo_2026-05-08_13-52-09.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTtUvHesVnV7Zk47j6Jc5imsTKvDjutMdoQASBJRS51xe/photo_2026-05-08_13-52-09.jpg)


So my seedling was moved to new bigger pots yesterday.
I bought natural pots and special soil for it.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTBEQovzqtpFuNx5tQac5L3fepUbRu7mRCJcoCPLQJ9AB/image.png)


that's how they look now in new pots

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR8tupZ3cJiP8W8a4CWZmq3uxg13KLKGZ8ep78c9ihrfk/image.png)


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcpJMvxc91w5pmvcxGfCMYfxFMgBjgpzVyggcWWdbp78E/image.png)


What can you say, guys?
Do you make replanting for your seedling?

body.title: Cheesy Chicken Rice Paper Roll
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVMcFfUjCUmahJSopppdPLSw3qjLNCQPHZgeXDsrjLs6L/1778236559945.png)

Hello bloggers and food lovers, good morning, and I hope you’re having a great day. Today I’m going to make a dish that’s been trending online lately. Rice paper is filled with ground meat and then rolled up like a cinnamon roll. This time, I’ve substituted the filling with chicken that’s pan-fried until cooked through, then shredded and mixed with cheese and sauce. This dish is my entry for this week’s [Hive Top Chef!](https://ecency.com/qurator/@qurator/qurators-hive-top-chef-or-cheesy) hosted by @qurator. Alright, let’s get started

**Ingredients:**

- 2 sheets of rice paper 
- 200 grams of chicken thigh fillet
- 1/4 onion
- 1 clove garlic
- chopped scallions 
- pepper
- salt
- black pepper 
- cream cheese
- mozzarella cheese
- chili sauce
- mayonnaise
- 1 egg
- cooking oil
- margarine
- sesame seeds

**Instructions:**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZrS6EU8aYYPrc2bQZge3KfnVB8qtPXNeK9u5bCgLuYVW/1778236605439.jpg)

- Rinse the chicken thigh fillets thoroughly 

- Prick the chicken thighs with a fork 

- Marinate the chicken thigh fillets with pepper and salt for 30 minutes 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZrS6EU8aYYPrc2bQZge3KfnVB8qtPXNeK9u5bCgLuYVW/1778237043616.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekxkZJXAzA5xh51h9ju1uAMox5PpkG2THew4vKd1b8EF/1778237044000.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYewKhKM1mRN8PGRomqhrZ6uypyaioHJV37egMHqR1CZW/1778237097374.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNr21dG236mCDAFeg3UmDnCYWRg3FctHNPq55c3gcXBGB/1778237097587.jpg)

- Pan-fry the chicken thighs in oil and a little margarine until cooked through and browned
 
- Remove and drain 

- Sauté the onion in the remaining chicken oil until softened and browned, then set aside

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdcvKYR6FdnknRiHi4fecd7ZMPaXhU4t5YM8f91btmtoV/1778237244893.jpg)

- Once cooled, shred the chicken thighs and place them in a bowl

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLSgNfAVN6KNWMHrHiS4BXAyChFD8FNQxhBXjfKU6s6m/1778237274690.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYEwrPn6LkTh5XdzpUoHWSbRYtwKqhsSr6kF9P691uvZ9/1778237274959.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeXNvGpNs6DxpnTGN6kjjLt6fNfgR3zNxZzvUe22TJPKs/1778237275199.jpg)

- Add cream cheese, chili sauce, black pepper, and chopped scall

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmakhsSJGKvjhJpa15TKhppvyMyJVGoWDgM598i373MShZ/1778237925140.jpg)

- Stir until well combined

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeau6eXFS5nKAUFNF4W5CmqaRNS4peK9zni87yzbFqnf5/1778237965822.jpg)

- Crack the eggs and beat them

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRfXZJ8uv9DZaBMqpdJNcDAg1Qyf9u8QyUkx62Vk3Ke6B/1778238006932.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQ6XZbHe35MmVAXKXPHpK1EJcybFNdsDGujmFHYKtBJ4/1778238007104.jpg)

- Dip the rice paper into the beaten eggs

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZX1w6uaRvvwKAAz8bZVnhCBdwfN9zZ2CfWLFSa8ubBwC/1778238103824.jpg)

- Place on a plate or cutting board

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXqwkwPRtrBDR1HLmA4gZeNUkCNUs3T8VambJ4cqM5jeA/1778238138754.jpg)

- Place the chicken and cheese mixture in the center of the rice paper

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbPCy84cFa59NnVxZcrLy2w7VAEH6qgVGkUh1NRKZKVNo/1778238164847.jpg)

- Add the sautéed onions

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRuP99GsNsKtbfWKr8kbDEGUWy91XBxAKQMiwxLUZ2UuU/1778238183095.jpg)

- Top with grated mozzarella cheese

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSyBAZiUHcdsCQNnEXKmnYsNaNq4ZMzVuwnxT8c7i9wjf/1778238225078.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZN9D4uXJ9hNXV8hTuGHBuu2duXwn4Vxq8nz2GVUH6wjg/1778238225344.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQe9tq2LEkSfrBnCFiZwAmhSbABUjvUBoA64un4Be9br/1778238225550.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXQ8Sv98JAaUmroH33NsLmqoaH4FhYa52NYtPexEFhTQW/1778238244769.jpg)

- Fold the rice paper over and roll into a spiral

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRYzpy6hewcuFvjbxRhZnjuWBQC4AMfgELGjo4SPpYJhi/1778238267083.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfDhqDb5E9Tmis6K4UgYNYrhwa3CfRjir6Fs3mdvnVSpt/1778238267233.jpg)

- Sprinkle with sesame seeds

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU9PDFDGmsBKyoBQzJKumdoW6UGXMsbxwpVQ8SCnYZzVR/1778238300461.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP5ECpkkcTQh4kbAaPybimG9DUiuJR4raxXUXCfxr94oy/1778238300591.jpg)

- Spray a little water and bake in the oven at 150°C or 302°F for 25 minutes, or use an air fryer

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8sYfbZnFRccJ4m6MDKfKdNco6H8AzU9Jwi2akygH1oh/1778238408359.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcSYs6PVPGcoBVkGC2ixGzFem8WgK5eFpgmz698xTvMtZ/1778238408559.jpg)

- Remove and serve on a plate

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGzkuxtFdULcVc46f3D2X7ZX9K3fGtJj3A6ehcSY8twk/1778238439928.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXDr67RM3Ksmo3fPiBzqwP9EryASc4FszZqkLuLSAvX5g/1778238440245.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmecEBYfchRd8gKGkRHTXT676wNPh1cuhMizhBoREKzWEX/1778238440590.jpg)

- Cheesy Chicken Rice Paper Roll is ready to eat

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 08 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g1e00720837cdd410c807adb10118a3a7d8adb42279bdef95dbd821b7e8380e8c9dcb5d07eb5748ff6a301fb4bec13101eb5d1319dceb0c75139559b03309bfd7_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata fue realmente revitalizante. Empecé mi día temprano, disfrutando del aire fresco de la mañana. Caminé por un parque local donde me encontré con un grupo de personas haciendo yoga al aire libre. Era genial ver esa energía positiva y cómo todos se concentraban en su bienestar. En el camino, conocí a un artista callejero que pintaba un mural colorido. Me detuve a hablar con él y me contó que estaba inspirado por la cultura local y la diversidad de la ciudad. Sus obras tienen un mensaje sobre la unión y la paz, lo que me hizo reflexionar sobre la importancia de la comunidad. En otra esquina, un anciano vendía flores frescas. Me detuve a comprar un ramo y tuve una conversación breve pero significativa con él sobre cómo las flores pueden alegrar el día de cualquiera. La sonrisa en su rostro al hablar sobre su pasión por las flores fue contagiosa. Cada paso que di me recordó lo vibrante que puede ser la vida cotidiana. Disfrutar de estos pequeños momentos y las interacciones con las personas que conoces es lo que hace que cada caminata sea especial. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: [ENG/ESP] A sunny Thursday spent working and traveling to Isla de Coche
body.body: > **I wish you all a wonderful Friday; you’re almost ready to start your well-deserved break. For many, the weekend is synonymous with taking a breather, taking a deep breath, and letting go of the week’s weight. For me, however, this will be a short break, because I have to work through Saturday. Even so, I’m facing it with a positive attitude, grateful for every day I’ve completed and for every experience that comes with the job. This week has been particularly hectic. We’ve had a lot of work, and on top of everything, this past Thursday felt like an incredibly long day—one of those that seem to have more hours than they actually do. We had to travel to Isla de Coche, and although we’re feeling the fatigue, it’s also true that these trips always leave us with stories, landscapes, and moments that are well worth it. We got up very early, almost at the first crow of the roosters, so we could reach Playa El Yaque before the boat that would take us to our destination left. The weather was excellent; a radiant sun that promised heat from early on, that typical Margarita warmth that you already know and that, although sometimes exhausting, also brightens the day.**

> *Les deseo un viernes maravilloso a todos, ya están muy cerca de comenzar su merecido descanso. Para muchos, el fin de semana es sinónimo de pausa, de respirar hondo y soltar el peso de la semana. Para mí, en cambio, este será un descanso cortito, porque me toca trabajar hasta el sábado. Aun así, lo afronto con la mejor disposición, agradecida por cada jornada cumplida y por cada experiencia que trae el trabajo. Esta semana ha sido particularmente movida. Hemos tenido bastante trabajo y, entre todo, este jueves que recién culminó se sintió como una jornada larguísima, de esas que parecen tener más horas de las que realmente tienen. Nos tocó trasladarnos a la Isla de Coche, y aunque el cansancio se siente, también es cierto que estos viajes siempre dejan anécdotas, paisajes y momentos que valen la pena. Nos levantamos muy temprano, casi con el primer canto de los gallos, para poder llegar a Playa El Yaque antes de que saliera la lancha que nos llevaría a nuestro destino. El clima estaba excelente; un sol radiante que anunciaba calor desde temprano, ese calorcito típico de Margarita que uno ya conoce y que, aunque a veces agota, también alegra el día.*
![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23wWyQ3BXrzhUjXQGBnsP5YqeyU8hXxzwpZmxHdQLAaAt96CM1o1FwRRxUL4pqtEXNRm2.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-34.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq7NsFhf7TemGCKW1BTV9w1zUc954K2dGWoFmKitYhf63jB2cL3bcPce6FWr9rMYand.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpxrGAfNPC6PVPSxyz3tXX7idnxawhdSRpped31Vnno6zxeFwmhhEMnNyV9D2q7BMvv.jpg)

> **We picked up our friend Luis, and the three of us set off together. He always adds a touch of humor to our trips, so the morning started with laughter. When we arrived at the pier, we were warmly welcomed and waited in the waiting area.**

> *Pasamos por nuestro amigo Luis y nos fuimos los tres juntos. Él siempre le pone un toque de humor a los viajes, así que la mañana comenzó con risas. Al llegar al embarcadero fuimos bien recibidos y nos quedamos en el área de espera.*
![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23uQvSjDxrug9rNgDLSKu6cCHkMsxNkiGBTkDS4t3aCMMa6BiybWnB35Y63bZfRurnLTJ.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23yJQzfUvRasr4SZ1hM6YZT22oKeKxpTuNjtBgTZRmJqUAMogEEhm1NFCgxPqCAAqwbDN.jpg)

> **When the boat arrived, we put on our life jackets and got ready for the trip. Luis got the front seat—the one everyone calls “the brave one’s seat”—because that’s where you get splashed with seawater. He eagerly asked for it because he wanted a better view of the scenery, and everyone gave it to him, knowing full well what was in store for him. It was a comical scene: he was happy with the seat, and we were laughing because we knew he’d end up a little wet. And that’s exactly what happened. Every wave that hit the bow gave him an unexpected splash, but he enjoyed it like a kid.**

> *Cuando llegó la lancha, nos colocamos los chalecos salvavidas y nos preparamos para la travesía. A Luis le tocó el primer puesto, ese que todos conocen como “el de los valientes”, porque es el que recibe los salpicones de agua de mar. Él lo pidió con entusiasmo porque quería ver mejor el paisaje, y todos se lo cedieron sabiendo perfectamente lo que le esperaba. Fue una escena cómica, él feliz por el asiento, y nosotros riéndonos porque sabíamos que terminaría un poco mojado. Y así fue. Cada ola que golpeaba la proa le regalaba un chapuzón inesperado, pero él lo disfrutó como un niño.*
![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xVW3eY1zMhapiCKpY17ukQ1v2zc55ZEt899T8yMMszP7BXkmtbFqncjViJXxymUcjhN.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnAKpkUCHBarpwWgmbwia5SZu3zkveyYfYaUNr6wDq5Gwdbp3JTgoouFcZHrJvDcvz.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/241thrdDYpauBHgWDKoVq34PTigA92x3JCs2XuqHSZjyKfhsYSF8LTYCRnQXHqN6UcBAz.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoK5qsYDv6GYGThaJy6k1Q522RQocV57xWinExujJvm2ZvZ8gerYhma23eZJYwTVzFt.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqYtkB6SzJtyrCXSjbasA6EtqBaUYd7ksZ8PhqQQfafAjPdpab826YqUPc5gP1P4ucU.jpg)

> **The trip was peaceful and, above all, beautiful. The sea was calm, with that deep blue color that captivates you, and a gentle breeze accompanied us. When we arrived at the Sunsol Punta Blanca hotel, we were greeted by the concierge, who gave us a tour of the facilities.**

> *El trayecto fue tranquilo y, sobre todo, hermoso. El mar estaba sereno, con ese azul profundo que enamora, y el viento nos acompañó suavemente. Al llegar al hotel Sunsol Punta Blanca, fuimos recibidos por la muchacha de calidad, quien nos acompañó en el recorrido por las instalaciones.*
![y (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EogPkgfyC4ELYFtpZKa9PTe96X7txcEur1C87xM63zjwxggZUaMJvZJ1k2CDA5n74Uk.jpg) ![y (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpQwmYeqzvKejQJLvd5gNTxLrqcdwi4JtvTvY7wKTWuW86mqH2PRnu3FVqEZTWkaXC6.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23wMhCAWPifVeUTLafuNZ8y2Pk535Fd78rrmSE7XusLiBPUw3P6Vqwu69dHXAnanLtJyU.jpg)

> **Since our last visit six months ago, they had addressed many of our suggestions, which is always encouraging. We measured the residual chlorine levels and reviewed the desalination plant’s parameters. Everything was within the acceptable ranges, allowing us to proceed with confidence.**

> *Desde nuestra última visita, hace seis meses, habían trabajado en muchas de nuestras sugerencias, lo cual siempre es satisfactorio. Realizamos la medición del cloro residual y revisamos los parámetros de la desalinizadora. Todo dio dentro de los rangos, lo que nos permitió avanzar con tranquilidad.*
![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoChi9JHEJcsFP2F6KwqeFUjRnZwYCr6HrxgZn4pTAc6ECBoFed52oeNc27AW4LejMm.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7vUCQfhCaZutwTYMghNbticYyaYk55S2xPbemBoweNzrkLfnzywki9xAWpgirmYEN.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqHzRNKQw2QPCYmCaSKmEDg6vCWqDy7y3Rt49WCoSTTNxkArYcwd9ugEE51P7S3CSWk.jpg)

> **As we were inspecting the fiberglass tanks, a curious iguana appeared from under the eaves, peeking out as if it wanted to supervise our work. It stood perfectly still, posing for the photo, as if it knew it was the star of the moment.**

> *Mientras revisábamos los tanques de fibra de vidrio, una iguana curiosa apareció por el alero, asomándose como si quisiera supervisar nuestro trabajo. Se quedó quietecita, posando para la foto, como si supiera que era la protagonista del momento.*
![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EogPLCtwfKBx1rcQn2C8ivqVbAbxgiKZZQ6PkXJYAFiW5yniEpoqbVzeMo62r49Npnn.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT3j4wAzhhWVcz5nhK94Ru3kqPCazss447mg7Wq2cUxaA71ccVwHNgU1vK62EChmwi.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7u8Km5BT87jEmHuQygAKEjd47TeLFHRAEqQMKgzEDR2c9MFCFMf6aopjeRq1HaJat.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-07_23-11-06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpLfZ8YNTx1GVkdRBdns6vYfn6YK4kARuxf4S8ACah64wtLf1ua5b8p6thoe5DECu6w.jpg)

> **We kept working at a brisk pace, because time flies in Coche and you have to keep an eye on the last boat’s departure, which is at 4:30 p.m. After that, you have no choice but to stay until the next day, when the first boat sets sail at 8:30 a.m. Luckily, we finished on time and were able to board the return trip with the satisfaction of a job well done. The sea, once again, treated us to a calm journey, as if bidding us a fond farewell.**

> *Seguimos trabajando con buen ritmo, porque en Coche el tiempo pasa volando y hay que estar atentos a la salida de la última lancha, que es a las cuatro y treinta de la tarde. Después de esa hora, no queda más remedio que quedarse hasta el día siguiente, cuando zarpa la primera a las ocho y treinta de la mañana. Por suerte, terminamos a tiempo y pudimos embarcar de regreso con la satisfacción del deber cumplido. El mar, nuevamente, nos regaló un viaje sereno, como si nos despidiera con cariño.*

body.title: (EN-IT) Discover Mt. Pelion in Greece: A wonderful year-round tourist destination-Scopri il Monte Pelio in Grecia: una meravigliosa meta turistica in ogni stagione.
body.body: /> Photo by [Vasilis Caravitis](https://unsplash.com/@epicuros?utm_medium=referral&utm_source=vocal.media) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/?utm_medium=referral&utm_source=vocal.media) (English version) Mt. Pelion in Greece could be the next holiday destination for you to discover and enjoy Greece is a favorite destination for millions of tourists. Despite the fact that the biggest percentage of them prefer to visit the islands, mainland Greece has many attractive options to offer to holidaymakers. One of these options is to visit the evergreen mountain of Pelion in Thessaly, Central Greece. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q2ci1myGhpM&pp=ygUTZXZlcmdyZWVuIG10IHBlbGlvbg%3D%3D According to Greek mythology, the mountain itself was named after King Peleus. It was believed to be the homeland of the mythic Centaurs who were half human and half horse creatures. It is no coincidence that Mt. Pelion served as a holiday resort for the Olympian gods. The fact that Zeus and the rest of his company had chosen Pelion to spend their holiday there is some form of top recommendation for those wishing to visit it; better than any holiday review! For any traveler who wants to visit a destination, there are a number of things that he or she should know about the actual place before his or her arrival. For example, a traveler would like to know the most popular and attractions that are worth visiting, and what the place is generally famous for. A good source of information can be and other people who have been there before and can express their genuine opinion. Locals also usually give invaluable pieces of information, since they know the ins and outs of the place, where not to go and sites to avoid, how to save money while enjoying the place, at the same time, etc. First of all, we need to find out some reasons why Mt. Pelion is so popular with locals. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TUOyBlz3dGQ&pp=ygUTZXZlcmdyZWVuIG10IHBlbGlvbg%3D%3D The countless fish taverns, located at the seafront of the capital city of Volos, at the roots of Mt. Pelion, offer a gastronomic variety and experience at very reasonable prices, which you will remember for a long time. Octopus on the grill and the marvelous “kakavia” fish soup (a variation of the French bouillabaisse) while you enjoy drinking the world famous ouzo, which the region is famous for, will take you back to the time of mythology, in the company of wine god Dionysus. When you visit Pelion, it is essential to pay a visit to the “ouzo temples” of Volos, where you can “worship” the mythological drinking god. Another thing that you should know is that Mt. Pelion is equally marvelous and magical all-year round, whatever season you may choose to visit it. Perhaps, when visiting Greece on holiday, you don’t naturally expect to go snow skiing, so you will be amazed to know that there is a skiing center on the mountain, where you can practice your skiing skills during the winter months. The experience is outstanding, since you can ski while having a breathtaking view of the Pagasetic Gulf at your feet, at the same time. Without doubt, you would feel like mythical King Peleus used to feel on his throne! When it comes to the most well-kept secret of Pelion, it is none other than its small, picturesque villages. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8cfslAtUgX4&pp=ygUTZXZlcmdyZWVuIG10IHBlbGlvbg%3D%3D The hospitality of local people, combined with the natural beauty of unspoilt forests and fruit tree orchards was the reason behind many visitors’ decision to buy holiday homes in the area. However, the area is not densely populated and built yet, and there are many opportunities for those wishing to make a life dream come true by buying a holiday home there. On the other hand, those no-so-lucky ones who cannot afford to buy and own a piece of paradise themselves, there are many small family pensions available to rent, where a guest will literally feel at home. (Versione italiana) Il monte Pelio in Grecia potrebbe essere la tua prossima meta di vacanza da scoprire e apprezzare

/>

Foto di [Vasilis Caravitis](https://unsplash.com/@epicuros?utm_medium=referral&utm_source=vocal.media) su Unsplash

La Grecia è una meta prediletta da milioni di turisti.

Nonostante la maggior parte preferisca visitare le isole, la Grecia continentale offre numerose e interessanti opzioni per le vacanze.

Una di queste è la visita al sempreverde monte Pelio in Tessaglia, nella Grecia centrale.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q2ci1myGhpM&pp=ygUTZXZlcmdyZWVuIG10IHBlbGlvbg%3D%3D

Secondo la mitologia greca, la montagna prende il nome dal re Peleo.

Si credeva fosse la patria dei mitici Centauri, creature metà umane e metà equine.

Non è un caso che il Monte Pelio fosse una meta di vacanza per gli dei dell'Olimpo. Il fatto che Zeus e il resto della sua compagnia avessero scelto il Pelio per trascorrere le loro vacanze è una garanzia di qualità per chiunque desideri visitarlo, meglio di qualsiasi recensione di viaggio!

Per qualsiasi viaggiatore che desideri visitare una destinazione, ci sono diverse cose che dovrebbe sapere sul luogo prima dell'arrivo.

Ad esempio, un viaggiatore vorrebbe conoscere le attrazioni più popolari e imperdibili, e per cosa il luogo è generalmente famoso.

Una buona fonte di informazioni può essere rappresentata da altre persone che ci sono già state e possono esprimere la loro opinione sincera.

Anche gli abitanti del luogo di solito forniscono informazioni preziose, poiché conoscono a fondo il posto, sanno dove non andare e quali luoghi evitare, come risparmiare denaro godendosi il posto allo stesso tempo, ecc.

Prima di tutto, dobbiamo scoprire alcuni motivi per cui il Monte Pelio è così popolare tra gli abitanti del posto.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TUOyBlz3dGQ&pp=ygUTZXZlcmdyZWVuIG10IHBlbGlvbg%3D%3D

Le innumerevoli taverne di pesce, situate sul lungomare della capitale Volos, alle pendici del Monte Pelio, offrono una varietà gastronomica e un'esperienza indimenticabile a prezzi molto ragionevoli.

Polpo alla griglia e la squisita zuppa di pesce \

(una variante della bouillabaisse francese), accompagnati dal famoso ouzo, prodotto tipico della regione, vi riporteranno indietro nel tempo, in compagnia del dio del vino Dioniso.\n\nDurante una visita al Pelio, è d'obbligo una tappa ai \

il mitologico dio del bere.

Un'altra cosa da sapere è che il Monte Pelio è altrettanto meraviglioso e magico in ogni stagione dell'anno, qualunque sia il periodo in cui decidiate di visitarlo.

Forse, quando si visita la Grecia in vacanza, non ci si aspetta di sciare, quindi rimarrete sorpresi di sapere che in montagna c'è un centro sciistico dove potrete praticare lo sci durante i mesi invernali.

L'esperienza è straordinaria, poiché potrete sciare godendovi allo stesso tempo una vista mozzafiato sul Golfo Pagasitico.

Senza dubbio, vi sentirete come il mitico re Peleo sul suo trono!

Il segreto meglio custodito del Pelio è senza dubbio rappresentato dai suoi piccoli e pittoreschi villaggi.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8cfslAtUgX4&pp=ygUTZXZlcmdyZWVuIG10IHBlbGlvbg%3D%3D

L'ospitalità della gente del posto, unita alla bellezza naturale di foreste incontaminate e frutteti, è stata la ragione per cui molti visitatori hanno deciso di acquistare case vacanza nella zona.

Tuttavia, la zona non è ancora densamente popolata e edificata, e offre molte opportunità a coloro che desiderano realizzare il sogno di una vita acquistando una casa vacanze.

D'altra parte, per coloro che non sono così fortunati da potersi permettere di acquistare e possedere un angolo di paradiso, sono disponibili numerose piccole pensioni a conduzione familiare da affittare, dove gli ospiti si sentiranno letteralmente come a casa.

(Questo post è stato tradotto dall'inglese all'italiano con Google Translate)

_Sources and further reading:_

[Explore Pelion All Year Round: A Guide to Visiting This Unique Destination in Every Season](https://followmetogreece.com/article/explore-pelion-all-year-round-a-guide-to-visiting-this-unique-destination-in-every-season/3)

body.title: 和家人逛北陵（皇太极广场篇）
body.body:
话说参观了令人失望😔的郁金香花海之后，我们决定去皇太极广场看看热闹，一般来讲，唱歌跳舞的都集中在这里。

![20260505_103313.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbCBA2EyuXDLwSLDyp7sQy43LCv6og3bHbQCWub1U8wxk/20260505_103313.jpg)

![20260505_103737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPPkFj4mszF2T6kXHXXcRKvkRcZNqhud1RdhXfiyMQ2de/20260505_103737.jpg)

没想到到了皇太极广场这，唱歌跳舞的没看到多少，但是去发现成片的郁金香，比湖心岛花海漂亮百倍。

早知如此，我们就不走很多冤枉路去湖心岛看花海啦，哎，出发之前去网上（小红书、抖音啥的）看看攻略和大家的评价就好啦。

原本准备从众多照片中选择一张作为封面图，但其中有几张我都非常喜欢，尤其是其中的两张，我觉得不分上下，索性都放到封面中。亲爱的朋友，你更喜欢哪张呢？

从湖心岛离开，我原本计划绕着湖逆时针转半圈回到皇太极广场，可是大家都不听我的，非要原路返回，哎，只好随他们啦。

虽然十一级的大风吹得脑瓜子嗡嗡的，但拍照还挺出片的。
![20260505_095652.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRuvGub8FhvHF1UaMYmdpCDXY41TYRzMAeMH2Yr6K21QZ/20260505_095652.jpg)

儿子小时候经常带他在这条路玩卡丁车
![20260505_095916.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQZ25gXgFwsTtf5zAXSM5UAxupVCgrkWC2kKTLwdYa8EQ/20260505_095916.jpg)

这个角度拍照好美
![20260505_100337.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW9H9uTo2zZbQFnAnDzuAn3QiyPb2dUuVZDvcdUrYMZcK/20260505_100337.jpg)

本来我们可以抄近路的，可是他们都不走寻常路
![20260505_100657.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXycre2FTVaKv8eyRmjcZqseC6EZ6atc88kew5GSyF1Ai/20260505_100657.jpg)

游乐场
![20260505_102341.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVvvfsgVoTHPKqWASPLga1KfUkbcvVJPgH6EphX4fbkRU/20260505_102341.jpg)

好喜欢这片郁金香，像是夜晚的彩灯一样美丽
![20260505_103313.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbCBA2EyuXDLwSLDyp7sQy43LCv6og3bHbQCWub1U8wxk/20260505_103313.jpg)

怎么没人给皇太极跳舞了？大概是公园管理部门出手整治了
![20260505_103341.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUQZ4SUq2fS42iTuHHzkvP7e1imDeYAdNFb2HP7yDKhrt/20260505_103341.jpg)

这片黄色的郁金香我也好喜欢
![20260505_103703.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR4NR4gxWonrkBnmsZVshFNt15XxRV31U5zoSwMBUmUM8/20260505_103703.jpg)

这片也不错哦
![20260505_103737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPPkFj4mszF2T6kXHXXcRKvkRcZNqhud1RdhXfiyMQ2de/20260505_103737.jpg)

这边郁金香也超级好看
![20260505_103822.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUPtPMijMLJxRu1AJmdwJFFTszsphrTqsFGS74LuhaKqi/20260505_103822.jpg)

去往秀芳园
![20260505_104552.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfR3XqF71uYM1dA3pPMSkXNq6gYtQzeDrGd39X8omQvTC/20260505_104552.jpg)

郁金香很好看，但是有点稀疏，哈哈
![20260505_104656.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQqsueFUxkHyMmRijo8A3nTxNazWbZsCWzpHyEGPNDubP/20260505_104656.jpg)

body.body:
>

‎Studentship is a wild journey. For me, I was always on the run, I'm not sure if I was being chased by something but I knew what I was chasing after. I have always admired financial independence, it was almost everything to me. I just enjoy the idea of having my own money, my own business and having to do with it as I please, kind of following the principle of my life; my rules.
‎
‎While I was in school, I was skillful. When it comes to getting things done, I learn things a lot faster than most people and the moment I get hold of it, I look for ways to monetize it. I have always had the ability but school made it a lot easier for to know how far I can go with it.
‎
‎Being a student is not a black and White journey, it is the survival of he fittest. One of the things that threatens students survival the most is finance. School is built in a way that sucks every penny out of a student, without having enough resources to keep things under control, life becomes unbearable for a student, especially those without strong support system.
‎
‎The best solution is side hustle; learn and earn. It is a simple strategy. For me, it started with getting assignments done, I mean printable assignment, anything written is not my thing, my handwriting is terrible. I always have a cybercafe as a friend, where I am easily run to print my documents without staying on the queue.
‎
‎But after my national diploma, I discovered hive.io, then the concept of side hustle took a different turn. At first, I didn't take it seriously. It was a lot complex than I imagined, especially the crypto aspect, so I bailed. It took me about a year to return back to hive, I call it the long break. By the time I applied for my higher national diploma, I had returned back to hive. So hive also served as a side hustle.
‎
‎While hustling in hive, I was also in writing of research project and proposals, it was a profitable business in school. Well, with the advent of AI, I have no idea what the business will look like now.
‎

body.body:
# My Diary For Weeks 18-19 | Mein Tagebuch für die Wochen 18-19

Hallo zusammen, hier wie gewohnt meine Wochenzusammenfassung, die ich zwar mit KI Unterstützung, aber trotzdem selbst geschrieben, bzw überarbeitet habe. Es ist eine Mischung aus Tagebuch, Gesundheitsbericht und Wochenrückblick.


Hello everyone! As usual, here is my weekly summary—written (or rather, revised) by me personally, albeit with the assistance of AI. It is a blend of diary entries, a health report, and a weekly review.

## Bilder
![Rursee](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/EqHx4BwP9hTrQSZcgBUcdCXcB933r7FgaJVxZTRxbbHYxszuMcBZwM1PeGcyVaH5bnm.jpg)

![Dive Out in der Rockfabrik](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/Eou6j4BzCCwfk8qC8pL2EDBknTqp6BfaMHo62Hqd2dLHCSr3sAVuYcuZzE6HF1kaCa8.png)

![Echtz bei 26°C](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/2449uwFusQw3EBFBo19HBribr2YBLe3P6wxqHbuXaZoHtYeUVi91BCxvHQsY1jM2Wfust.jpg)

---

**ENGLISH**
The last two weeks had it all—from a night spent dancing at the Rockfabrik to some good old-fashioned manual labor outdoors.

On April 30th, we went to the Rockfabrik to see \
a Depeche Mode cover band that was really excellent. The lead singer even let me sing \

into his microphone! We danced until 1:30 a.m. The very next day—May 1st—Annette and I went for a bike ride of about 40 km to Lucherberg and Echtz. It was 26°C, with blue skies and a dry easterly breeze; we lay out in the meadow, and it was every bit as lovely as it sounds. In the evening, we enjoyed paella cooked over a campfire with friends.

Then, the weather turned cold and rainy. I stayed home and worked on various things—including my OpenClaw agent project—and tidied up some of my journaling structures. Lesson learned: ask for backups more frequently, and for complex tasks, dive into the technical details myself.

On Thursday, May 7th, we went on strike at Telekom. The rain had finally let up, so I was able to get back outside: I changed tires, sawed and stacked wood, and then cycled to Aachen (a two-hour round trip) to pick up some wild boar meat from a buddy and bring it home. That evening, I played some *Civilization*.

**Health:** Felt generally good overall. Experienced a bit of cabin fever during the rainy days. Slept well most nights.
**Physical Activity:** 40 km of cycling, dancing at the club, changing tires, and doing yard work (+ a brisk two-hour bike ride).

---

**DEUTSCH**

Die letzten zwei Wochen hatten alles – von einer durchtanzten Nacht in der Rockfabrik bis zu handfester Arbeit draußen.

Am 30. April waren wir in der Rockfabrik bei \
, einer Depeche Mode-Coverband, die richtig gut war. Der Sänger ließ mich sogar \

in sein Mikro singen! Wir tanzten bis 1:30 Uhr. Am nächsten Tag, dem 1. Mai, fuhren Annette und ich ca. 40 km Fahrrad nach Lucherberg und Echtz. 26°C, blauer Himmel, trockener Ostwind – wir lagen auf der Wiese und es war so schön, wie es sich anhört. Abends gab es Lagerfeuer-Paella mit Freunden.

Dann wurde das Wetter kalt und verregnet. Ich blieb zu Hause und arbeitete u.a. an meinem OpenClaw-Agenten-Projekt, räumte Tagebuchstrukturen auf. Lesson Learned: öfter Backups einfordern und bei komplexen Sachen selbst technisch einsteigen.

Am Donnerstag, 7. Mai haben wir bei der Telekom gestreikt.Der Regen hat aufgehört, also ging ich endlich wieder raus: Reifen gewechselt, Holz gesägt und gestapelt, dann mit dem Fahrrad nach Aachen (2 Stunden hin und zurück) um Wildschweinfleisch von einem Kumpel abzuholen und nach Hause zu bringen. Abends noch Civilization gespielt.

**Gesundheit:** Insgesamt gut gefühlt. Etwas Budenkoller an den Regentagen. Meist gut geschlafen.
**Bewegung:** 40 km Fahrrad, Tanzen im Club, Reifenwechsel und Holzarbeiten (+ 2 Stunden schnelle Radtour).

---

body.title: Mustard Flower: Fields of Gold and Quiet Hope
body.body:
The mustard flower transforms ordinary land into waves of living gold. When it blooms, entire fields seem to breathe together, glowing under open skies with small yellow blossoms that carry the warmth of the sun. Simple in form yet powerful in presence, the mustard flower connects deeply with rural life, seasons of harvest, and the quiet poetry of the countryside.

Each mustard flower is modest, made of tiny petals that do not seek individual attention. Yet together, they create a breathtaking vision of unity. Their gentle sway in the breeze feels almost rhythmic, as if the land itself is humming a familiar tune. This collective beauty reminds us that strength often comes not from standing alone, but from growing together.

Beyond its visual charm, the mustard flower carries deep cultural meaning in many regions. It signals renewal, prosperity, and the promise of nourishment. For farmers, its bloom is both a relief and a hope—an assurance that care and patience will soon be rewarded. For visitors, it becomes a moment of stillness, an invitation to slow down and simply look.

The mustard flower also teaches resilience. It grows in open fields, facing wind, sun, and changing weather without complaint. Its ability to thrive in simple soil reflects a quiet endurance, mirroring the lives of those who work the land with dedication and faith in the seasons.

body.title: “Amenaza de tormenta” – Nora Roberts  ///  “Storm Warning” – Nora Roberts
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUs7xSqexXKWNACjgkJbVTmYNqj59N5UPRSF7jHNe1Sy8/1778237670474.jpg)</center>
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUu68NUW4c7pt8BYs5pjdsvzs3WYomovydGCdGtraegVG/img_0.6108203491677975.jpg)</center>

Hola a todos, espero que estén bien y que hayan tenido un lindo día. Para continuar con mis lecturas de principio de este mes, me sumergí en “Amenaza de tormenta”, una obra que reafirma por qué Nora Roberts es una de mis autoras favoritas. Su estilo de narración tiene esa capacidad única de envolverte por completo, mezclando de forma magistral la intriga con una sensibilidad emocional que muy pocos logran alcanzar. En este relato, Roberts nos transporta a un entorno cargado de tensión atmosférica y emocional, donde los secretos del pasado parecen acechar en cada rincón. Lo que más me fascina de su pluma es cómo logra que los escenarios cobren vida propia, convirtiendo el entorno en un personaje más que influye directamente en el estado de ánimo y las decisiones de los protagonistas, creando una atmósfera tan absorbente que es imposible soltar el libro hasta llegar a la última página.
#
La trama de esta historia nos presenta a Autumn, una mujer cuya vida fue destruida en el pasado por Lucas McLean. Tras años de distancia, Lucas vuelve a entrar en su mundo, reabriendo heridas que ella creía haber dejado atrás, pero también reencendiendo un amor que nunca llegó a apagarse del todo. Sin embargo, su reencuentro está marcado por la sospecha y el peligro, ya que existen pruebas contundentes que señalan a Lucas como el principal culpable de un asesinato. La narrativa fluye con una naturalidad asombrosa, permitiéndonos sentir la urgencia de desentrañar la red de secretos que rodea a la posada y a las personas envueltas en este misterio, mientras la amenaza de una tormenta real y metafórica se cierne sobre ellos.
#
Finalmente, esta historia nos deja reflexiones profundas sobre la confianza y la redención frente a la adversidad. El libro nos enseña que, aunque el pasado pueda haber sido devastador, siempre existe la posibilidad de encontrar la verdad si tenemos la valentía de mirar más allá de las apariencias y las pruebas superficiales. A través de Autumn, aprendemos que el perdón no es un signo de debilidad, sino un acto de fortaleza que nos permite liberar el corazón de viejos rencores para poder ver con claridad el presente. La obra nos invita a reflexionar sobre la importancia de la lealtad y el peso de las segundas oportunidades, recordándonos que, incluso cuando todo parece estar en contra de quienes amamos, nuestra esencia y nuestra intuición son las brújulas más fiables para navegar a través de la tormenta y encontrar finalmente la paz.

*<center>Espero les haya gustado 
Que Dios los Bendiga 🙏
 Feliz Noche</center>*

# ***<center>Créditos </center>***

-	Imágenes tomadas como captures de pantalla con celular Infinix Hot 40i
-	Contenido de mi autoría 
-	Traductor usado: DeepL app
-	Editor utilizado: Editor de fotos Canva.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdU2jaVDoyaen8XU5v7aDi6p7UqyGet29whZXQwDQX9gW/img_0.8432625036666158.jpg)</center>


Hello everyone, I hope you’re all doing well and had a nice day. Continuing with my reading from earlier this month, I dove into *Storm Warning*, a novel that reaffirms why Nora Roberts is one of my favorite authors. Her storytelling style has that unique ability to completely draw you in, masterfully blending suspense with an emotional sensitivity that very few writers can achieve. In this story, Roberts transports us to a setting charged with atmospheric and emotional tension, where the secrets of the past seem to lurk in every corner. What fascinates me most about her writing is how she brings settings to life, turning the environment into another character that directly influences the protagonists’ moods and decisions, creating an atmosphere so absorbing that it’s impossible to put the book down until you reach the last page.
#
The plot of this story introduces us to Autumn, a woman whose life was destroyed in the past by Lucas McLean. After years apart, Lucas reenters her world, reopening wounds she thought she had left behind, but also rekindling a love that never quite died out. However, their reunion is marked by suspicion and danger, as there is compelling evidence pointing to Lucas as the prime suspect in a murder. The narrative flows with astonishing naturalness, allowing us to feel the urgency of unraveling the web of secrets surrounding the inn and the people entangled in this mystery, while the threat of a real and metaphorical storm looms over them.
#
Finally, this story leaves us with profound reflections on trust and redemption in the face of adversity. The book teaches us that, even if the past may have been devastating, there is always the possibility of finding the truth if we have the courage to look beyond appearances and superficial evidence. Through Autumn, we learn that forgiveness is not a sign of weakness, but an act of strength that allows us to free our hearts from old grudges so we can see the present clearly. The work invites us to reflect on the importance of loyalty and the weight of second chances, reminding us that, even when everything seems to be against those we love, our essence and our intuition are the most reliable compasses for navigating through the storm and finally finding peace.

好家伙，从昨晚21:00左右开始，这天气就没忍住从小雨，到中雨，最后到大暴雨，那动静可真大啊，只觉得呆在屋内是满满的安全感，原本早就需要上朴朴购买物资了，担心外送人员在暴雨中操作难度加大，因此，就把购买事宜推到了今天晚上。。

今天依旧还是阴天为主，早上还下着中，小雨，没得法子，还是要出门干活，只能说尽快把手中的活做完，早点回去，天气预报今日还会有大雨，暴雨来临。。

我这样不喜带任何雨具的，就不要在外面瞎掺和啦，于是乎，提前完成当天的工作，大概在17:30左右就到家啦，立马上朴朴超市下订单，工作人员在半小时之内把我购买的物资顺利送达，这会天空还是有点中雨。。

这样的雨天，外送人员也是辛苦了，关键是还能准点送达，我给他打了3元的小费表示感谢。

哈哈哈，买了一堆的东西哈，总共是27件物品，包括泰国香米，纸巾，生抽，面条，西红柿，盐水鸭，饺子，茶叶，黑猪肉包，猪肉，柠檬，基围虾，富硒蛋,土豆片等等。。原本还有牛肉，羊排，猪心不知道为啥结算的时候 ，突然就消失不见了，可能是刚好没货了。。这七七八八算下才208元，哈哈哈，主要是我购买了朴朴的年卡，每周都会给我发放优惠卷，这一单算下来是优惠了16元左右。。比平时去永辉购物要实惠一些。

晚餐，就简单一些吧，肉包两个，盐水鸭若干，基围虾几只，鸡蛋一个，餐后水果就来个西红柿吧，差不多就这些吧。。。外面的雨还在下着，而我却在屋内享受美食，看着电影--星河入梦，那感觉挺好。。Give thanks.

OK，今天先分享到这儿哈，祝福大家周五愉快，喜乐平安。

body.title: Behind the Curtain
body.body:
>

While I write a lot and tend to explore several topics from various angles, the overall thread is pretty clear in that I am someone who would like the world to move in a better direction than it is. I always find it interesting what can inspire an article for me and this one was triggered by four words from @acidyo.

> # Attention is being centralised. 


---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23x9o1chXoQXXuNTm11zhyw2uf98ZmvQn6jU6GA7jYWmSakkPXeLzMGXYF9TxCTqEW2fX.png)


---

Before we get into that though, some might remember the original purpose of the internet was a democratisation of information, where elite control over information would be broken as both access to it was vastly increased and, anyone could add to it as a creator. Before this, to be part of the public discourse, information first went through many, many filters - now everyone and anyone has a platform, whether what they say is valuable, correct, or harmful. 

This has meant that while information is available to pretty much everyone and \

are able to connect, misinformation and polarization is also an increasing problem. Misinformation was a problem earlier also, but the difference was that once corrected, it was corrected at the base level (for the most part) so that everyone was able to get the latest knowledge. 

For a *strangely polarizing* example, once it was discovered that the earth is in fact round, years of persecution of those who had scientifically supported this stopped, and the books were updated to reflect the change. Now though, this same problem still plagues us, where like minds are able to collect together and start new beliefs that they claim and act on as truths. In a similar vein, once it become clear that there are indeed little animals living on our skin that can make us sick (bacteria), the information in the medical books was updated. 

Yet, while the digital age driven by the internet was meant to democratise information and wrest it away from the elites, the very same mechanism has actually centralised it further, putting it even more firmly in the control of those same elites. You might not believe this to be the case, but the internet has changed markedly since its modern public release and ubiquitous take-up back in the 90s. Information might still be free in some respect, but the fact is that human nature takes the path of least resistance and this has led to the majority of people getting their information from a declining pool of sources. And those sources have increasingly granular insight and control to feed specific information to specific people, based on various algorithms. 


>Top Websites Globally (Feb/March 2026):
- Google.com: ~28% share
- YouTube.com: ~6-7% share
- Facebook.com: ~2-3% share
- Instagram.com: ~1-2% share
- ChatGPT.com: ~0.8-1.3% share
- Reddit.com: ~0.8% share
- Wikipedia.org: ~0.9% share
- X.com: ~1% share
- Pornhub.com: ~0.5-0.6% share (based on industry reports)
- WhatsApp.com: ~1% share

As you can see, currently Google controls over a third of all the information people access *directly,* and probably a lot more once other gateways are included. Meta through their apps come in at another 6-7%. This means that almost 50% of all internet traffic is going through those top ten websites, and I would expect due to the various APIs, that number would go up significantly with embeds. 

> Half our digital attention on 10 sites? 

Now, that doesn't tell the full picture, because that is based on visits, and of course since Google is the dominant search engine by far, it gets a lot of visits. Move it to minutes spent, and the picture changes slightly, *but only slightly.*

> Top Sites by Average Time Per Visit (Early 2026)
- WhatsApp.com: ~30 minutes 17 seconds
- YouTube.com: ~25 minutes 7 seconds
- Facebook.com: ~14 minutes 55 seconds
- Netflix.com: ~13 minutes 43 seconds
- Instagram.com: ~13 minutes 28 seconds
- Google.com: ~12 minutes 53 seconds
- Reddit.com: ~12 minutes 27 seconds
- X.com (Twitter): ~12 minutes
- Yandex.ru: ~8 minutes 51 seconds
- Wikipedia.org: ~3 minutes 19 seconds

And I would say that these numbers are skewed by the way the applications work, since I don't think the average visit for WhatsApp would be 30 minutes, nor the average for Netflix only 13 minutes. But, what is clear is that the majority of our *attention* is being spent on entertaining ourselves. Even google where people \

(probably what to be entertained by) slips down the list. Several years ago I wrote some articles about the real battle we are fighting in the world is between centralisation and decentralisation and unfortunately, I see that centralisation is currently winning again. The average person is becoming more reliant on fewer sources because it is more convenient to do so. Even people in crypto who *talk about* decentralisation, spend the majority of their time shilling on centralised platforms in the hope to pump prices so they can sell into centralised currencies. > We become what we pay attention to. It is the, *we are what we eat* situation, because our attention is *the only thing* we really have control over. Where we direct it becomes our source of experience and we use it to shape our thoughts and hence, our behaviours. We are centralising because our attention is being funnelled with increasing efficiency into fewer sources that are influencing us to think and believe in ways that enrich the supplier, not the audience. Just like how Nike doesn't care how your health is, none of these platforms care what condition you are in mentally, emotionally, physically, or socially. Their only metric of success is their bottom line. As a result, through incentivised business practices, the centralisation of our attention into increasingly large, but narrow sourced buckets, is detrimental to our health across the board, no matter *who we are.* Because while you might think you are immune to what is happening in the world, the unfortunate reality is that we are all impacted by the environment in which we live, and that is heavily influenced by the masses. And those masses are being influenced by the *very elites* that the internet was meant to help us get out from under. > Our attention has been hijacked. Rather than spending our time on the things that matter, whether it be active, healthy participation in the community, or building a strong family and creating for improvement, we are spending our time being conditioned by where we spend our time. We surround ourselves with information and influences that run counter to what we want in life experience. We information smokers, giving ourselves informational cancer, because it is easier to do so, we are addicted, and everyone else is doing it. > Look behind the curtain. It doesn't really matter what you believe your behaviours to be, because it is *incredibly likely* that beneath the surface of what you consider being discerning usage, you are being just as conditioned as others, even if the top-layer content looks different. The conditioning for profit is going to feed algorithms that will push people into more centralised groups, but also more polarised groups. This means that people will become increasingly attached through identity, and incensed by the opposing side. > For profit. But of course, you think you are different, you are immune - while an algorithm pushes you another piece of content that you think you chose. body.title: found this qipao at the night market and couldn't resist 😍
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![main-1-1778210309-e63c06e91d6b.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/engagement-bootstrap/generated/mara.ellis/seed-mara.ellis-2026-05-08/main-1-1778210309-e63c06e91d6b.png)
</center>
</liketuimages>

okay so i went to the night market tonight just to browse, right? wasn't even planning to buy anything. but then i walked past this vintage stall tucked between the food vendors, and there it was—this gorgeous light blue qipao with the most delicate embroidery work. the moment i saw it hanging there under those warm lights, i knew i had to try it on.

the fit is absolutely insane. like, whoever made this understood the assignment. the dress hugs in all the right places, and the length is perfect, sitting just above the knee. there's this subtle slit on the side that gives it a modern edge while keeping that classic elegance. the fabric has this soft sheen to it, and the embroidered details catch the light in the most beautiful way. it's definitely not brand new, but that's what makes it even better—it has character, you know?

the owner of the stall told me it's from the 90s, handcrafted by someone local. honestly, i love finding pieces with history like this. it feels so much more special than anything you'd grab off a rack. plus, the price was reasonable enough that i didn't feel guilty about the impulse buy.

i paired it with this delicate hair clip i already owned, and the whole look just came together perfectly. there's something about wearing a qipao that makes me feel more put together, more confident. maybe it's the structure, or maybe it's just knowing that i'm wearing something with actual craftsmanship behind it.

night market finds hit different. i'm already planning to go back next week to see what else is hiding in those stalls.

body.title: Is Survival about How We Create Meaning? Review: 'The Bone Temple'
body.body:
If you ever loved the cult classic with Cillian Murphy, '28 Days Later', I'd be interested to know what you think of the latest installment to the series with '28 Years Later' and it's follow up, 'The Bone Temple'. I don't think it's a plot spoiler at this point to say that Cillian Murphy is enough of a reason to watch it, because yes, confirmed, he does appear, and is even more gorgeous than he was in 2003. 


![2724.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/242Nd7gYVx9otBM1HgV6sk7oHbXrouoiGV3BYG8ZPVywfdWPyFqpfSTSWqFYNmtCsgjio.png)




The initial film shows the emergence of the Rage Virus - not the undead, per se - a highly infectious disease that drives those it infects into uncontrollable, violent fury. Unlike previous zombie flicks, these are fast and furious. After the virus is unintentionally released from a research facility test on monkeys in England, it rapidly spreads, triggering a devastating epidemic that leads to the breakdown of society.

The new films begin in an England 28 years later, isolated from the rest of the world lest the virus spread to Europe and beyond. It's an England that has regressed - small enclaves figure out ways to live through subsistance farming and others, like the 'Jimmys', turn to small bands of violent criminals who steal from, and torture, others. 

Spike, the young lad from 28 Years Later, falls in with this band by bad luck - the leader is a lad who, having been subjected to the violent death of his priest father by the infected years before - creates his own mythology to keep his 'fingers' or seven followers under control. They're dressed in matching tracksuit pants, a nod to Jimmy Saville who had his own fall from grace in English society after it was discovered he was an abuser and even, macabrely, into necrophilia. It's a tonal decision that nods to the hidden horrors in polite and civilised British society - here, they are out in the open, killing people for a giggle. 

The Bone Temple examines what happens when we adhere to belief systems that are based on fear and illusion - the stories we follow are important. The Jimmy's fear in their leader is because they are afraid of him and his power, and the fear he raises in them, therefore controlling them abjectly. Uneducated in this new horror landscape, they are lead because they believe in his stories of Father/Satan. The encroachment of Telly Tubbies as mythology into this dynamic serves to remind the audience that the regression of language and education, of misremembering history, and the deterioration of information - furthers power through illusion and distortion. 

By contrast, Kelson, the doctor who creates the bone temple as a memento mori to the dead, is relatively sane, even though he appears mad, covered in what appears to be blood but is iodine, serving to repel the infected. This is established in 28 Days Later - he's a deeply compassionate man that shows Spike that compassionate must be extended to every living creature. Threatened by Jimmy to play the role of Satan, or die, he takes it seriously - one of the most delightful scenes I've seen in a while. Ralph Fiennes draws on his previous roles as Voldemort to act out Satan to Iron Maiden, mesmerising the Fingers who believe the story they've been told. Theatrics are important deception, after all. I loved this scene and had to watch it again immediately and it's absolutely what many reviewers described as a mic drop or at least a needle drop. Apparently in some showings they got up and clapped. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_WCCVqkTI9Q

Without giving to much else away, the last belief system nodded to at the end of the film is education. Spike and Kelly look like they will be saved from this violent, degenerative myth making  as they encounter Cillian Murphy who is teaching his daughter history, lest we forget, as Dr Kelson would argue. As Spike carries Kelson's lessons on empathy, one would hope he will learn other lessons to, and carry the torch for humanity better than Jimmy. 

Score by me? Eight zombies.

body.title: Reunión familiar (cuento)
body.body: Como te decía, mi amiga, eso de mudarse para acá de a poco es un buen negocio. Ahora bien, lo de cobrar un ojo por cada envío es un cuento; los muy descarados no piden lo mismo por el ojo que por la pierna. Espera, déjame acomodar este teléfono que no se te oye bien. Sí, niña. Ya ha transcurrido un año desde que empezamos a traer a la tía Ofelia. Pues sí, un año entre el papeleo y su llegada, pero bueno, valora tú a ver, porque no es mucho tiempo si consideras lo que se demora ese trámite allá en la isla. Lo único malo, y eso sí tienes que tenerlo presente, fíjate… lo único malo es que el servicio medio, que es el que pudimos pagar, imagínate, no viene con la opción de arribarlo todo a un mismo sitio. ¡Que emoción la de Susanita al saber que tía ya venía en camino! Los saltos que daba de lo contenta. Pobrecita, anda muy triste porque no pudimos llevarnos al perro y tía con ella no tenía reparos. Es que Ofelia la malcriaba con muchas chucherías, ya tú sabes cómo es ella con los niños. Esperamos como dos semanas hasta que llegó lo primero de tía; con retraso de un día y obvio que nos descontaron por ello. Tuvimos que recoger el brazo derecho de tía por allá por Toronto; lejísimos. Nos echamos tres días para llegar. Ya el gerente del aeropuerto nos estaba advirtiendo que había que llevarse ese paquete o lo remitía a Medicina Legal. Nosotros le dijimos que no era nada de lo que pensaba, que la tía estaba viva, que por razones de tarifa y agencias había mandado primero el brazo y el resto de ella ya venía en camino. ¿Qué cómo supimos que era su brazo? Ay mija, ¡tienes cada preguntas! ¡Por supuesto que por el recibo del paquete! Además, ellos aclararon que lo primero que se envía siempre es un brazo como “un gesto de confianza” hacia el cliente, así le dicen. ¿Tú piensas que nos vamos a dejar estafar así por así? También envían en la caja las indicaciones de la siguiente entrega. Como te decía, luego de recoger el brazo nos estaba esperando una pierna en Chicago. Oye niña, menos mal que aquí se anda en carro y avión, porque las piernas nuestras eran las que se iban a quedar en el camino si nos hubiera tocado montar una guagua o un tren de esos de los que se rompen de la nada. Claro que me refiero a los de allá, donde si no, aquí nada se rompe. A eso del miércoles llegó el otro brazo y el jueves recibimos en Miami el dorso de la tía. Llevaba puesto el vestido rosado que le compramos hace cinco años antes de venir para acá. Estaba como nuevo. La niña le puso los dos brazos al cuerpo mientras sonreía y nos preguntaba si lo estaba haciendo bien. Muchacha, qué bonito aquello. Era como la Navidad esa en que matamos un puerco en tu casa y armamos el arbolito ¿te acuerdas? Mi marido, Susanita y yo contemplamos maravillados el cuerpo que pronto sería la propia tía, similar a los bustos de maniquíes en las tiendas de lujo, aunque con sus senos bien caídos con los años. Ellos nos dijeron que eso no tenía solución, porque su tarea era el de transportar, no la cirugía estética. Yo, la verdad, es que no sé cómo lo hacen… oye ¿tú me oyes bien? Que no se te ve bien en la pantalla. Esa debe ser la conexión tuya; claro está que no es la mía… Te decía que no sé cómo ellos lo hacen. Cuando firmas el contrato y mandas la mitad del dinero, hablan primero con el familiar o la persona y le indican una dieta especial Ni me preguntes por ello; ya tía te lo dirá. Esa dieta hay que mezclarla con un cocimiento raro para anestesiar el cuerpo y desfragmentar las células o algo de eso, dicen que así se pueden separar los órganos y preservar la vida. ¡Ay niña pero que voy a saber yo como es que la gente se queda viva! Ustedes allá todavía están vivos y nadie se extraña. Así fue que trajeron a Raymundo el marido de Tania ¿te acuerdas de Raymundo? y ya tú ves qué bien está en las fotos. Bueno, sí, tiene un ojo azul y otro carmelita, pero eso fue porque la estúpida de su mujer recogió el que no era. Ajá, pero lo del brazo más corto que el otro fue por el cambio de equipajes en el aeropuerto. Al menos se lo indemnizaron dándole el de un hombre cuya familia decidió no continuar pagando el servicio. Ese del pago incompleto sí está embarcado, fíjate: anda con un pie aquí y el otro allá. Claro que yo estoy clara. Claro. Yo hablé con el mismo dueño de la mypime. Ellos te llevan al hospital más cercano. Tienen contratos con casi todos los hospitales del país. Allí te practican la cirugía y acto seguido envalijan el órgano. Lo demás es historia. Pero no todo es así de fácil. Lo malo que es ser pobre aquí, mi hermana. Fíjate que cuando fuimos a recoger la cabeza de tía en… ¿dónde es que era, Armando?... Ajá, en California, el señor ese de la aduana no quería dárnosla. Para colmo él con todo su inglés…tú sabes que yo no entiendo ese idioma… él con su inglés explicándonos lo inaudito que era hallar una cabeza humana dentro del equipaje. Que quién nos dijo que eso era normal. Imagínate, y nosotros explicándole. Esa gente no sabe nada de eso. Al final terminó por informar a las autoridades. Lo peor no fue eso, sino que tía venía sin la boca. Si no hubiera sido así, ella misma hubiera explicado el asunto y san se acabó. La pobre nos miraba con ojos asustados mientras nosotros le hacíamos señas de que se calmara en lo que el FBI hacia la pesquisa. Menos mal que Armando llamó a un amigo que es abogado y que sabe inglés. Ese sí estaba actualizado de las circunstancias y negocios de la isla y pudo aclararlo todo. Así que nos la llevamos y ya ella está aquí ¡de las mil maravillas! Si, sí. Ya la armamos completa y nos cercioramos de que respira bien y todo. Nada más le falta la boca. Ya tío Ramón nos contó que se la quitó para que no se le ocurriera atormentarnos aquí con los problemas de allá, que sin falta la envía más adelante, pero nosotros estamos valorando si realmente la necesitamos. Qué va, ha sido mucho el gasto y ya tenemos a la tía Ofelia aquí con nosotros, que es lo más importante. Sí, nosotros pagamos la tarifa media ¿Qué cuánto cuesta el servicio básico? Niña, por tu madre, no te atrevas a pagar el básico y deja la tacañería esa, a no ser que quieras recorrer medio mundo armando a tu familiar. Recuerda lo que le pasó a Raymundo. Mira que si te falta un pulmón o la vesícula, ellos no responden. Te dejo mi amiga que ahora voy a cocinar. ¡Qué alegría hablar contigo! Voy a hacer lasaña, el plato favorito de tía. Ella no puede comer aún pero qué se va a hacer. Bueno, tú cualquier cosa me dices. Dale, besitos. Sí, descuida, yo mañana te mando una foto en cuanto nos llegue la primera pata del perro.

body.title: Lost in the Snow
body.body:
In today's busy life and fast moving world, some pauses are also necessary for us. Everyone is busy in their lifes, constantly chasing their targets, responsibilities and endless routines. Sometimes people forget to take some pause, give some relaxation to their selfs and also ignore the beauty of nature. They should plan trips to release street.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbiKxS33DojYK6BHamz3X82cWKMmtShZQgcxFx6RfTaZQ/1778237213740.jpg)

I was free from examination last week which exhausted my mind so much. In my city the weather is too hot which leads me to disturbance. Again classes are going to be start but before classes I want to enjoy and cool my mind, so I planned a trip with my brother to northern areas. 
We pack bags and started our journey towards snowy areas. There we reached, when I saw snow fall everywhere I forget everything in the world. I lost myself in the snowy areas. The view in my front was truly breathtaking. The weather was cold , huge mountains was covered  with snow. Forest surrounded the valleys creating a very beautiful contrast with snow. There was completely face. My brother was also lost in calmness. Cold air touching my face was so fantastic. I can never forget that moment. Nature is so creative.
I think that we cannot buy happiness. Happiness never comes from expensive things, even a minor thing can make us happy. These simple moments are very peaceful which motivates us. Nothing can replace nature. These moments remains always in our hearts for a long time.
Traveling with siblings and friends are so amazing. We always learn,  observe and understand different things. These calm feelings make me to do my work more perfectly in my life. I always get motivation from nature.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb1WjFauukVS8yCuB9SeY9ApsifGm6Dugu6qF2UPHLbhk/1778236521794.jpg)</center>

Yesterday, when I got home, they told me it was my turn to make dinner. I’ve never really liked cooking—I know the basics. There are some things I’ve never made but know in theory, and others I enjoy making only once in a while. Hamburgers fall into the latter category, and since we had buns and other ingredients, I decided that would be our dinner. It was pretty quick but delicious. Would you have been okay with that for dinner? Do you like to cook?

>El día de ayer al llegar a mi casa me dijeron que me tocaba jacer la cena, jamás me ha gustado cocinar, sé lo básico, hay cosas que no he hecho pero conozco en teoría y hay otras que disfruto hacer solo si es de vez en cuando, las hamburguesas son de esas últimas y como había pan y otros ingredientes decidí que esa sería nuestra cena, fue algo bastante rápido pero delicioso ¿ustedes hubieran aceptado esa cena? ¿A ustedes les gusta cocinar?

body.title: Backyard Blessings: Fresh Buko and Beautiful View
body.body: > Happy Friday Hivers! ## One of the people I’m truly grateful to, aside from God and my parents, is the person who planted these coconut trees. According to my mother, it was planted by the husband of her auntie. Because of him, we get to enjoy harvesting fresh coconuts and, most of all, enjoying them almost every month. ## ![IMG_4114.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23xyQmFdkkq4Lh2Nn4fv8jPfQ7RFKXB69cYjqyDocJCxMBbPmRQiCb3om5d8HvbWGPQa4.jpeg) ## Although he has already passed away, the coconut tree he planted continues to remind us of him. My mother would often say that he was the one who planted it, yet we are the ones enjoying and eating its fruits now that he is gone. ## ![89C64A5C-0604-4E7D-96FA-EDD783563928.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23wgHdVaMVCUPZfDDfJPLW7KyBig8EL1kzvSxz8Awstdn8czmfg7gPAqSVa7JPc9cUawp.jpeg) ## This time, we decided to harvest the coconuts while they are still young. We do not usually use coconut milk, and we also have no plans of selling the fruits, so whenever fresh buko is available, we harvest it for our own consumption. Buko is quite expensive in the market, which is why we are very grateful that we no longer need to buy it because we already have it right in our backyard. ## ![IMG_4109.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/243WMSt4Dj3hZkTjtnMyd6VhmqsCGCwdWWTvdSWu6ysPfiWjygAJvdMeAa3kkVbRoscvK.jpeg) ## We only have two coconut trees in our backyard, and these two trees are actually different varieties. One of them is a dwarf coconut tree, and its fruits are orange in color. My mother and I did not expect that the dwarf coconut would also produce fruits with plenty of coconut meat inside. ## ![B16DC75C-4C34-4991-8C95-BFB2E96B1D10.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23wgMdHgEs4LAtPc4ui5pPhTouwppgPum1pAsdDFz3wvrCmAS2JNovohZuTYJByhf91xa.jpeg) ## This morning, the person we entrusted to harvest the coconuts came very early to do the job. When my mother and I arrived home from the mini farm, we were surprised to see so many fresh coconuts already placed on the table. We did not expect that such a large number of buko would be harvested. ## ![IMG_4108.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/EpNoSWVPNKTJdfHFd4xEWnZ6jukU1wNjERZtwxoJASjTkFJQoPUknuTAsKNLsprSXfD.jpeg) ## I was excited to try the dwarf variety because it was my first time tasting it. It is sweeter compared to the other variety. Although both of them are delicious, this one is noticeably sweeter, especially its juice. Because of its sweetness, it may not be ideal for people with high blood sugar levels. Actually, this morning, I skipped breakfast because I had already eaten so much coconut meat and drank a lot of buko juice. I was truly satisfied with my craving for buko since I had been wanting to eat fresh coconut for the past few days. ## ![357B0717-4186-4914-96A9-379FFBAF7362.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/EoiXbDQY5pDzJqNWLKbxdT6mxHRajngoJKFV73qsonHmE5df33brXEati98Lsb7jp82.jpeg) ## Moments like this make me truly appreciate the simple blessings in our backyard; fresh buko to enjoy, a peaceful view to admire, and the kind of province life that brings genuine happiness and contentment. ##

>

Thank you for reading and see you on my next blog. Cheers!

body.body:
# A few more shots from my Visit to Kennedy Park Fall River Good Morning today I will share a few shots from a visit to John F. Kennedy Park in Fall River. That morning I had a doctor's appointment that I had to be there at 7:30, and since it was a nice morning i headed out early and caught the sunrise at Heritage State park, but when I was done there I still had time to fill, so decided to check out this park I had never been to before. A little about the park John F. Kennedy Park, which is the full name for the park, is a 57-acre historic recreational area in southern Fall River, Massachusetts, designed by the famed Frederick Law Olmsted and Calvert Vaux, they are notable for designing many parks, including Central Park in NYC, and locally here also Buttonwood Park in New Bedford Originally called South Park when it opened in 1868, it was renamed in 1963 to honor the late president. The park is known for its rolling landscapes that offer panoramic views of Mount Hope Bay and the Braga Bridge I will probably head there again sometime, perhaps even check it out at sunrise when the views may be cool, but these shots give a little feel of some of the features in the park Starting with this cool old structure, which I have shared a shot of in a Monochrome Monday post but from inside it , I would imagine it would be a cool spot to host events, I wonder if they do that

body.title: This morning, I’m not really feeling great
body.body:
This morning, I’m not really feeling great. I’m exhausted. To be fair, I stayed up until 3 a.m., getting pulled back into an old online game. It actually made me smile to see that there were still a few players hanging around—like regulars refusing to let a piece of their past die.

But of course, waking up is harder. Even though I’m not working today, I can clearly feel that I’m no longer in my twenties. All-nighters just aren’t made for my body anymore, and I pay the price the next day. That said, I don’t really regret it. Having fun once in a while, slipping back into childhood a bit—it doesn’t hurt.

Then reality caught up with me pretty quickly.

Today, my family called me urgently. My grandmother’s husband is in the hospital, at the end of his life. This time, it’s no longer a matter of months, but of hours. A difficult sentence to hear, almost unreal. As if, all of a sudden, time were collapsing in on itself, and the end of the game of life was becoming imminent for him.

It’s not good news, of course. But in moments like this, there’s not really any room for denial. You just have to face it, in your own way.

Unfortunately, some stages of life can’t be avoided. As hard as they are, they’re part of the journey. So I try to keep some distance, to tell myself that respecting someone’s final wishes is also a form of love—perhaps the hardest one , but also the most sincere .

Have a good day everyone despite everything, and let’s keep living our lives for as long as we still can .


I’m going to get back to my activities now, even though the day hasn’t started on a positive note .
