***

# The Social Dynamics of Penguin Colonies: Communication, Cooperation, and Conservation

Penguins are not just adorable flightless birds; they are also remarkable social creatures that exhibit complex social dynamics within their colonies. Understanding these dynamics is crucial for conservation efforts and the overall well-being of penguin populations. In this post, we will explore the fascinating aspects of communication, cooperation, and conservation among penguin colonies.

## Communication: The Language of Penguins

Penguins have developed a rich repertoire of vocalizations and body language that facilitate communication within their colonies. Each species has its own unique calls, which serve various purposes:

- **Mating Calls**: During the breeding season, male penguins use distinctive calls to attract females. These calls can vary in pitch and duration, allowing individuals to identify each other among thousands of birds.

- **Chick Communication**: Parent penguins and their chicks engage in vocal exchanges that help strengthen their bond. Chicks have specific calls that signal their needs, while parents respond with reassurance.

- **Alarm Calls**: In the face of potential threats, such as predators, penguins utilize alarm calls to warn their colony members, allowing them to take evasive action.

Understanding these communication methods is essential for researchers and conservationists aiming to protect penguin populations, as disturbances in their communication can lead to stress and reduced reproductive success.

## Cooperation: The Power of Unity

Cooperation is a hallmark of penguin social structure. Penguins often engage in behaviors that promote the survival of the colony as a whole:

- **Huddling**: In harsh weather conditions, penguins will huddle together to conserve warmth. This behavior not only protects individual birds but also strengthens social bonds within the colony.

- **Parenting Partnerships**: Many penguin species exhibit shared parenting, where both parents take turns incubating eggs and feeding chicks. This cooperative breeding strategy increases the chances of chick survival.

- **Foraging Groups**: Penguins often hunt in groups, which enhances their foraging efficiency. By working together, they can drive fish into tighter schools, making it easier for them to catch their meals.

These cooperative behaviors highlight the importance of social structures in penguin colonies, emphasizing the need for conservation strategies that consider the social dynamics of these species.

## Conservation: Protecting Penguin Populations

As climate change and human activities continue to threaten penguin habitats, understanding their social dynamics becomes increasingly vital for effective conservation efforts:

- **Habitat Preservation**: Protecting the breeding and foraging habitats of penguins is essential for their survival. Conservationists must consider the social structures of colonies when designing protected areas.

- **Research and Monitoring**: Ongoing research into the social behaviors of penguins can provide valuable insights into their adaptability and resilience in the face of environmental changes. Monitoring population dynamics and social interactions can help identify at-risk colonies.

- **Community Engagement**: Involving local communities in conservation efforts can foster a sense of stewardship and awareness about the importance of protecting penguin habitats and social structures.

## Conclusion

The social dynamics of penguin colonies are a testament to the intricate relationships these birds maintain within their communities. By understanding their communication methods, cooperative behaviors, and the challenges they face, we can develop more effective conservation strategies to ensure the survival of these remarkable creatures. As we strive to protect penguins and their habitats, we must remember that the health of their social structures is just as important as their physical environment. Together, we can work towards a future where penguins continue to thrive in the wild.

body.title: Easy Peasy! And how do you make the simplest pea stew? (:
body.body:
Hey cutieeees, what delicious things have you been eating lately? 😊 A few days ago I made pea stew, a super simple, plain pea stew with absolutely nothing extra in it, basically a fasting version. Literally just a few ingredients, one of them being water :), so nothing complicated at all. Of course, you can add any meat you like. Chicken goes best with it, especially chicken breast, but recently I made pea stew with smoked pork and bacon and it honestly turned out amazinggg, like a completely new dish. If smoked meat goes well with beans, why wouldn't it work with peas too? They're both legumes, so similar combinations really shouldn't seem strange.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRW6zqoXWHS1xGErVnxwfRYYKRbbpapLixxYngRagMr6s/1778080263676.jpg)

But, as I mentioned, this time I decided to go with the most classic version possible. These are the ingredients you'll need:

700 g of peas
5 smaller onions
7 small carrots
3 larger cloves of garlic
3 tablespoons of olive oil
2 full teaspoons of salt (I used Himalayan salt)
A small teaspoon of black pepper
A little turmeric as well
2 teaspoons of ground red paprika
around 1.2 l of water plus 300ml 
2 full tablespoons of white wheat flour

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmchH6587vWnSkbt9r9aWczui7n3G8ZZGGrVfhh7FUaBXP/1778080263757.jpg)

Preparation:

After peeling the onions, garlic and carrots, I set 4 carrots aside and diced them into smaller cubes, while I put everything else into a food chopper and finely chopped it. I tried not to overdo it so it wouldn't turn into a paste. Then I sautéed everything in 3 tablespoons of olive oil until it got a nice golden color and added the black pepper, turmeric, ground red paprika and the chopped carrots.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW8rxKm3eS1CrVwYJUK1mAs1ikUNSM8quXPfmvhYY6CRS/1778080263816.jpg)

I placed the peas in a strainer and rinsed them under running water, then added everything into the pot. After that, I poured in around 1.2 litres of water, covered it with a lid and left it on high heat until it started boiling.  Then I reduced it to medium heat so it could simmer gently.

After it had been simmering for a while, I add the two full teaspoons of salt. It's probably not important with peas, but I remembered hearing somewhere that beans should be salted near the end so they don't fall apart while cooking. Whether that actually makes a difference, I honestly don't know, but I decided to add all the other seasonings right away and leave the salt for closer to the end of cooking. Then I put the lid back on and let it cook a little longer.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRxP3gX3jFfxCAkFDZVAYJiE5iiT7sc7XEobwq9Pxch2H/1778080263873.jpg)

Then I mixed two full tablespoons of white wheat flour with around 300 ml of water to make a \

that I would pour into the pea stew to thicken it a little.
How do you usually do it?

I remembered that I also love potatoes in pea stew, but I didn't have a single potato at home this time, so I left them out. Also, if I had celery root, parsley root or fresh green pepper, I probably would have added all of that while the peas were cooking and later either removed it, blended it and returned it to the pot or simply taken it out without putting it back in. Even just cooking it like that releases the most wonderful flavors.

By the way, the reason I do all that is because when I cook, I don't use \

, the very well-known seasoning mix here in Serbia that contains monosodium glutamate. That's why, no matter what I'm making, I usually add pretty much the same fresh ingredients, spices and root vegetables so they can release all the necessary flavors that enrich every dish.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUv84CBskquYyDHKDg4wqFTL3UC8dyUh6opwToAQgvPjP/1778080263923.jpg)

After pouring the cold roux into the pea stew, I left it on the stove for just a few more minutes, stirring occasionally, and that was it, voila, our pea stew was readyyy. I ate it with an arugula salad seasoned with olive oil and homemade apple cider vinegar.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme8dVchtYJsgeTgvK8LqZhZjcgabw4J7Gpov1FHX5zkxz/1778234735054.jpg)

Since I forgot to take a photo the day I made it, to be precise the day before yesterday, I decided to quickly snap one this morning instead. A little selfie with my pea stew in my room in front of the laptop. Don't ask me why I'm eating pea stew for breakfast and please ignore the mess in the background that I failed to hide with my hands. 😆
But that's not important right nowww.

Tell me, are you generally fans of legumes and how do you usually like to prepare them? I really love them, beans, peas, green beans, chickpeas.... although they almost always feel a bit heavy on my stomach. 

Thank you all for reading. Sending hugs and greetings to everyone! ♡

body.title: Phone Photography Contest 111 | Waiting Room
body.body:
> This week, I was going through my photo archive and came across these images... Yes, at first glance, they are just simple tables, chairs, and a television in the background—it doesn't look particularly special, though it is certainly pleasantly elegant. The point is that this place ended up meaning a great deal to my wife and me, as it served as a gathering spot for meeting with people we hold very dear. I particularly remember spending various occasions sitting here—whether scrolling through my social media feeds, posting on Hive, or chatting with someone I deeply appreciate.
![IMG_20240329_115137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wC9ZEMpkzMiVr8LJbdtwpYdpxxxeijs9LKU5DWXTKohPW7Kky5d6LzFu17t1CodDhNp.jpg)

This is a small lobby which—during the time I visited it—was almost always empty, so it felt like an extension of my room. In fact, I had time to take several photographs in the area; although I have shared them in the past, only these four remained, and I think they are perfect for this photographic memory box into which I have transformed my Hive blog. I feel that every photograph I take has a great story behind it (or perhaps it is just me—with my way of looking at life—making the stories more interesting than they actually are)...
![IMG_20240329_115046.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xAY7w93ryQTowDrffM5tGN5dM7RDTVgzd2rRFZrn9DdJkU9MurJVe3V64XRWtHwjgpJ.jpg)
I was the first lucky one; I received a visit from a pianist friend who, at the time, was living in Alicante. She came with her husband—whom I had only recently met—but this encounter cemented the affection I felt for them both. The photos above may look like nothing more than simple sofas and chairs, but it was right here that I was able to talk until well past midnight with that dear friend—a time I knew I had to make the absolute most of, for, as it turns out, arranging a second in-person meeting with them has proven quite difficult. What I remember most about those conversations—held while we were \

in this waiting room due to the rain—was the inspiration they both sparked in me. They are truly wise and experienced individuals—the kind of people I enjoy spending time with these days, and who motivate me to become a better person. A second meeting will surely come, but in the meantime—and in true sentimental fashion—I cannot forget that, back then, this place felt nothing short of magical to me.
![IMG_20240329_115618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wCBXy5i6XS8DP9pty4xRJo8p4FpaUBtytXektfbJwKZQqMTYwS5ZSAkvHGE2xzkvSHz.jpg)
The following day was one of goodbyes, but also of reunions. A young woman we hadn't seen in quite a few years traveled all the way from Portugal just to meet up with us. It still saddens me that they all had to make the trip, but—as you know—my work is as beautiful as it is chaotic; and so, with heavy hearts, our plans for that Good Friday afternoon had to change. Consequently, we only managed to steal a little time with this blonde friend of ours—we shared hugs and tears of joy—and she had to wait until that evening to continue our conversation. Even so, we were able to see each other again the very next day at our concert in Madrid. The waiting room effectively turned into a gift exchange, for when people care so deeply for one another, there is always some thoughtful gesture that surfaces during these whirlwind reunions.

> ![IMG_20240328_184505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23y8z6cczRWRZx2JwqqZEWDSe6ExWCiaVWL5Y4Ei2zQS54bzgwiAJGdnZWzHcPcCDRnNo.jpg)
Time passes, yet the affection remains the same—even if our daily routines seem to keep us apart. I make the most of every day, living it to the fullest as if it were my last; that way, if I were to pass away suddenly, I would die happy. Still, I hope God grants me a long life so I can enjoy it and share it with the people I love—because life is truly worth living! 🙏 Take it from me—someone who speaks with such fondness even about a lobby as simple as the one in these photos! 😅 This post is an entry for the Phone Photography Contest 111. I had actually shared the photo featuring my friend from Alicante, as well as the very last image in this post, are ones I’ve actually shared before; but I’m including it again here just to round things out. I hope you all enjoy it, and I wish you a wonderful weekend! ❤️
![IMG_20240329_115639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EpA41t9VvxpxNYV3EKGMwjVZ6Kc7vtfWLr62paBu4GLpaS8Szu9AGtaTJuK1SqFtHg5.jpg)

body.title: ATM Technical Support: When problems are solved and opportunities for new experiences arise.
body.body:
> ![IMG20260504083741.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb19jk66VvSdzdewCe5qgTwceYTrgJ4B7WDith2cLusGX/IMG20260504083741.jpg) In this era of blockchain and decentralized technology, we constantly talk about digital transactions. But the hardware and technical labor involved behind this digital money often remains hidden. Today I will share with you one such challenging experience from my professional life. ![IMG20260504083747.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdMTmdf3rQwFUrUtWXe8wbAthdzWszFypGbTHgz15VLe9/IMG20260504083747.jpg) I am a mechanical engineer by profession and currently working as an **ATM Technical Support Engineer** in a company. Recently, the **EPP (Encrypting PIN Pad)** of one of our ATM machines got damaged. Those of you who use ATMs know that the EPP is the part where we enter the PIN code. It is a very sensitive device because it is directly involved in the encryption or confidentiality of customer data. ![IMG20260504084138.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRXUYxsnjvebQiCZ9bEU9dfMdJSze38byTzcaCUgKeW7g/IMG20260504084138.jpg) ![IMG20260504083429.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcMCHVUEprytyRUfjZBEa1pni83DNihDSikBgqfzYXK12/IMG20260504083429.jpg) When the new EPP came to my hands after requisitioning it in the office, I saw that it was slightly different from the previous model. In the technical field, many times one has to face a situation where exactly the same parts are not available. As an engineer, I have to test my present intelligence and skills. ![IMG20260504084144.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXcSULcTvkcbrgR7pwBXr3zE9nNjNP2XuVaQFksYSZBRY/IMG20260504084144.jpg) I very carefully set the hardware configuration and connections of the new EPP in their original places. After the hardware installation, the next step was the software configuration. Matching the new hardware with each machine is a quite complicated process, because a slight mistake can make the entire system useless. After successfully completing the software setup, the most important step was to input the **Master Key**. This is basically the final step to establish a secure connection between the ATM and the banking server. ![IMG20260504100922.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeDHcR8PVdtmmRYCjeV49fPkthofGnp715eBQi723EyxL/IMG20260504100922.jpg) Many may ask, what is the relationship between blockchain and hardware repair? In fact, just as blockchain is based on transparency and security, this encryption system of ATMs is also dependent on security. As a technical support engineer, when we work with these devices, we actually ensure that physical layer of security. ![IMG20260504105944.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSGH6pe2qVP1nm7gPGDW8BNZUpz9yTnypvwhdxaQtxRw7/IMG20260504105944.jpg) The life of an engineer means solving new problems every day. The satisfaction that comes after successfully completing this task is difficult to express in words. It is truly an honor to be a part of the process when technology makes people's lives easier. For those of you who are interested in technology, I hope you enjoyed my work experience. I will be presenting you with more such technical experiences in the future. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

body.body:
# Hello friends and community 😍💕.

Hope you all are doing good, enjoying health and wellness while we keep hope alive with our hive growing strategy for this year 2026. 

Although we are almost entering half of the year as the 5th month of the year being May just started . But we all know that before this time we have made some resolutions usually at the beginning of the year which Hive is not left out from the resolutions for those of us who see hive as our virtual home or our an online community.

Every journey in life starts with plans, as planing before executing helps us to have direction that can quicken things up easily. So planing is like drawing ✍️ lines from one spot to another spot, specifying what each spot means in our mapped out strategy. This is the only way we can see ourselves progressing in our efforts.

But we should also always have it in mind that we have no power over unforeseen circumstances because they must always surface in one way or the other just like what we are experiencing today in all areas of crypto market which hive blockchain is not left out from. Since the ending of last year till to the present, hive had not been the same for many of us who had big dreams here and in crypto generally. This has really caused lots of battles for many including myself snd gas continued to give me lots of concern on the way forward.

# My 2026 Strategy:

Despite the present state of things here, I still keep hope alive knowing that things will definitely turn around for Hiveans and this has continued to gear me up to continue with my commitment here on hive. 

# Engagement On Hive:

This is one strategy I love ❤️ so much because ever since I joined Hive , this aspect of commitment has helped me grow so much . So I am not backing down despite how slow it has been in this recent times. The communities where I belong knows me for this active engagement and I think its one visible way to show that you are not just here only for the reward but also for the growth of hive as a place where one has profited from. Am making sure to continuing being active with enough engagement because it will surely help one’s account visibly.

# Quality Content Sharing:

Honestly, when I remember the good 😊 days of good rewards here on hive , I will start praying 🙏 for restoration to come back to hive blockchain, and I know it will surely come. I know that as many who are here now are the ones who knows what they have gained, others having so much investment that they keep believing that things will turn around some day because many who felt they can’t cope with state of things right now has left this platform, believing they have nothing doing here. But this is part of life that we live. So am making sure to continue sharing my quality content here on hive despite low rewards and sometimes even none. I still write ✍️ in my communities, including in the gastronomy and culinary communities where I cook 👩‍🍳 with quality ingredients almost four (4) times in a week. 

So, am not going to say because am not being properly upvoted, I should not be sharing quality contents that I am known for. This strategy is very important now here on hive because there are days of labor and there are days of reaping. As many who are paying attention to their contents and work now are those that will be recognized for better days.

# Savings:

Things have been bad for months now starting from mid of 2025. So I never anticipated much into this year, although I keep praying for turning around for Hive. Rewards are low that sometimes you don’t even hope for much, but saving is very important because it can become something big in the nearest future. So am trying the best I could to save up in the little ways I could despite how challenging 😰 it has been. What mattered most is the believe that things will definitely turn around someday and soonest. Long Live Hive Blockchain 👍.

This is my entry into the #indiaunited prompt for this week. Join #here. 

# Thanks for reading friends 😍.

title.title: The Hidden Pain Behind My Smile.
title.body:
>
![20260508_111143.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/23zbj6jSoDFKSfmrJqufNN9rWxbPP1FVs7aUTRmUrZu5Sv9sJQk18biR9ZXtD7cs16L8g.jpg)
Good day, people of Hive! Welcome to my blog. Today's topic is from Scifi Multiverse which says: The Hidden Cost of Pretending to Be Okay. So let's dive in. Honestly, when I saw this topic, it really touched me because a lot of us are used to pretending that we are okay, even when deep down we know we are not. We smile, laugh with people or friends, hang out with friends, and act like everything is okay. Meanwhile, there are many things going on inside our minds that we do not talk about.
I think the last time I was truly honest about how I felt was when I got overwhelmed with different things happening around me. School stress, project stress, thinking about the future, life after school, personal worries, etc. became too much for me sometimes. Instead of admitting that I was not okay and that I'm tired, I kept saying I was fine because I did not want people to see me as weak or like I was complaining too much. One thing I have noticed is that pretending to be okay may look like strength on the outside, but it drains us quietly. We keep trying to hold ourselves together while our minds keep carrying the weight little by little. The only person that truly knows me and how I'm feeling is my brother. Though I have friends I tell things to, I only tell them what I feel they need to know, not letting them know all of me so they won't see me as a weak person or think I'm complaining too much.
![20260508_111210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/23xKxeeoREcXZLwP5C3eNQKhvX1yZaihM8vPCjrN4L1BPgt5HtyqaKrG9nD4LJ3LphEwJ.jpg)
Truth is, I'm really scared of life after school. Sometimes I will just sit and start thinking about what my life will be like after finishing school and NYSC. I also feel that when we constantly hide our real feelings, it creates distance between us and the people around us. Some people only know the version of us that always smiles, not the one silently struggling. I have a guy friend who once told me during our chat that ever since he met me, he has never seen me sad or angry. He said I'm always smiling or laughing and asked what always gives me that much joy because he doesn't think I have things to worry about. I just smiled at him, but deep inside me, I told myself, only if I could open my wounds for him to see, then he would know that I'm just pretending that everything is good. Just because I'm smiling doesn't mean I'm not facing a lot. I'm just used to pretending. In conclusion, we smile to hide our pain and the things troubling us, but that doesn't mean we are not facing a lot. I know I should always share my pain, but I keep telling myself that if those people are no longer in my life, won't I still live my life? Of course, I will. But that doesn't mean I should keep everything to myself. Like people always say, a problem shared is half solved. **This is my entry for the Scifi Multiverse Prompt Week 66 Edition 02.** **Thanks for reading💞💞💞💞💞.** **Images are mine.** ----- ##### 🔗 Apps title.title: Barashkukor – The Magic Monster That Bypasses Armor Completely
title.body:
![tle g.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23yd1qWpn6E1KDB2EE9JCM8VaMMSPxiANhTveDu9V35Gu4pjeH5kVCNaZkJjSFPgwZeSN.png)


Barashkukor is an excellent magic attack monster with very impressive stats and abilities. It has special qualities that make it a strong choice for high mana battles. In high mana battles it performs even better because you get the opportunity to select stronger supporting monsters alongside it.

Its a magic monster which has its own special ability that when attacking it bypasses armor and can hit enemy unit health directly. It can destroy the frontline of enemy unit in the few rounds.

Another great feature of this monster is that despite being a ranged attacker it can also act as a solid defensive unit. As you can see it has 5 magic attack power which means it deals +5 damage in every round. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-08 110220.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uQhuGkZ139HAuJQoXBQj72hebh9R22jYvfEkWeAu6caPbfNUGTXz7a1raiHACZWSGcx.png)

Its speed is 3 which further improves its battle performance and can also support allied units in combat.

It has 2 armor and 6 health which are very decent stats. Its armor continues protecting its health and if you place it correctly with a strong tank in front this monster can survive for a long time in battle.

There is also an important difference between magic attackers and ranged/melee attackers. Ranged and melee attacks are not as dangerous because they cannot bypass armor. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-08 110400.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23vrnDU3W6xyoE2pn8Jt225P6Q3YPY7dzXVsCqAiSzzBW8XiXYUrg5BqShRXwMjGPL6BA.png)

However magic attacks are much more dangerous since they ignore armor and directly damage health. This makes magic attack monsters extremely powerful because they can quickly weaken or destroy enemy tank monsters.

At Level 1, it has the Fury ability taht Deals double damage if the target has Taunt.

If I talk about its market price at Level 1 it is available for only $3.184. As soon as you upgrade it to Level 2 its price increases to around $6–8. The main reason is that it gains another special ability called Weaken which reduces the health of all enemy units by 1.

Besides that its armor also increases. At Level 1 it had 2 armor but at Level 2 its armor increases from 2 to 3.

Similarly at Level 3 its price reaches around $21. At this level it gains another ability called Magic Reflect which returns 50% of the damage back to the attacker when hit by a magic attack. Its health and speed also increase further.

![Screenshot 2026-05-08 110557.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tGVundD4t8A1w3JSBkuEYLwLepDh6xTHkvZ8qcQXp5TJ5i8hafkPW3TR8GyvD3w4r49.png)

If we talk about Level 4 its price goes up to around $27 making this monster even more dangerous. At this level its armor increases from 3 to 5 allowing you to use it almost like a proper tank monster. 

Its health also increases to 8 which greatly improves its durability during battles.

Although Level 4 does not add any new special abilities its overall stats become much stronger. This is the main reason why its price changes at different levels.

According to my opinion this monster is extremely balanced and worth its price at all four levels.

What do you people think about this monster? do you like its stats and abilities? Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.


I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

title.title: The uncomfortable side of photography / #monomad challenge / [ING/ESP]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZLGHjsmEKso38tyR7rgt8CZiJKzopyAgTgZmbBVNRJWo/_dsc7970_copia.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *
Greetings hivers.

Sometimes it feels a bit uncomfortable to photograph situations charged with emotion. In just a second, dozens of thoughts cross your mind and you start questioning whether you should press the shutter or not.

On one side there is the urge to document the moment exactly as it happens, to preserve something that will probably never repeat itself again. On the other side appears the human part of you, the one asking whether you really have the right to step into such an intimate moment with a camera in front of it.

I think that is where photography stops being only technique and becomes sensitivity. It is not always about finding the perfect composition or the best light. Sometimes the most important thing is understanding the moment, respecting it, and deciding whether the image deserves to exist or not.

Sometimes I shoot almost by instinct. Other times I simply lower the camera and keep walking. And even if no photograph remains, the moment still stays with you.

The street is full of real emotions. Joy, exhaustion, loneliness, love, arguments, silence. As photographers, we end up becoming witnesses to small stories that only last a few seconds in front of us.

I guess that discomfort is also part of photographing life as it truly is.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMev8zrXH8XMBAq98u4MA9PDx3GJJCPDHEQNMgVqnNDf/_dsc7974_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQfzxgT8hBnFodBHkDA7uWjcbCe49xYsuKPVss5dkv3hE/_dsc7975_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRewLd51fyzFjoehBwKnrCNNt82foQqGsB2P32CTHuJDs/_dsc7977_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU42dXCySXM6R2MQWNEELZHW7queznstsaowxwRhJpBtT/_dsc7978_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURxULk71EnzNP5pmrScdcSdNyje33XPNgR7cHj2YDN6Y/_dsc7979_copia_1_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQgowcT1DfiSSZnBnzgVLHDbBU8NUPHc1c4kypAbzyEci/_dsc7980_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVzbFVf35LoWxCfDCcrQwNJDDP3wMCs4K5wFQeMsRF7uE/_dsc7981_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcKCDdYhM5zbD8MiatgoEa6aKPVJfbgsjX28eRDe2s8S8/_dsc7982_copia.jpg)

Saludos hivers.

Es un poco incómodo a veces fotografiar situaciones de mucha carga emocional. Te planteas en un instante decenas de cosas y dudas si disparar o no la cámara.

Por un lado está el impulso de documentar ese momento tal y como ocurre, de conservar algo que probablemente no vuelva a repetirse jamás. Por el otro, aparece la parte humana, esa que te hace preguntarte si realmente tienes derecho a invadir un instante tan íntimo con una cámara delante.

Creo que ahí es donde la fotografía deja de ser solo técnica y se convierte en sensibilidad. No siempre se trata de buscar la mejor composición o la luz perfecta. A veces lo más importante es entender el momento, respetarlo y decidir si la imagen merece existir o no.

En ocasiones disparo la cámara casi por instinto. Otras veces simplemente bajo el visor y continúo caminando. Y aunque no quede ninguna foto, el momento igual permanece dentro de uno.

La calle está llena de emociones reales. Alegrías, cansancio, soledad, amor, discusiones, silencios. Como fotógrafos terminamos siendo testigos de pequeñas historias ajenas que duran apenas unos segundos frente a nosotros.

Supongo que esa incomodidad también forma parte de fotografiar la vida tal y como es.

* * *

\

* * *

Last weekend I had the opportunity to attend an event organized by Leadership Network, a group of professionals from diverse fields who have begun giving talks on finance, marketing, and personal and professional development.

The venue chosen for these first talks was the Avi Chocolate restaurant. This place has a rich history. In the past, for several decades, it was simply called Chocolate and was well-known because, being located a few meters from the main campus of Lisandro Alvarado University, it was frequented by students.

After a long period with the same owner, a few years ago it was sold to the company AVi, which changed the name to Avi Chocolate, adding its new brand and dropping \

body.title: MATURITY IS LEARNING TO LET GO
body.body:
Hello everyone, you're welcome to my blog today.

 For a very long time, I have held on to this idea of us—not just the person that we would become. I would say it is more about the feelings for the future that I had quietly built in my head, the kind where everything I have ever dreamed of comes to pass. The whole waiting time pays off, the hard work, and everything in peace, where love is more stable. I have convinced myself that you are a state of patience. I would come to the understanding, and it would all come together at the end of the day. But life always has sweet stories to tell, letting good things happen in a moment. It was a very small and uncomfortable situation for me. I tried as much as possible to resist.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVVsCMU22DxtYrWR2Av4XP9Q9gQ7fKEpFmZ9KvirVp3iE/181886.jpg 




The hardest part wasn't losing the person that I loved so much; it was losing the version of life that I had attached to it. It felt like something was ripped out of me, like I had to rebuild my sense of direction and focus. From the start, there was this quiet kind of grief that I had. While people always dream differently, I held on so tightly to something that was no longer in my presence. Acceptance didn't come easy for me; it came in small waves. I have missed those old good days, where I felt strong and had a clear vision. I understood things; other days, I pushed on through everything from the beginning. I missed the familiarity and the comfort. Letting go felt like stepping into an unknown map, into an island with no direction. 

Over time, something shifted. I started to see that holding on was hurting me more than letting go. People say it’s always good to forgive—not just for the person that you are forgiving, but for yourself first. I would sweep that under the rug; it did not leave room for space to welcome someone who understands that not everything is meant to stay.

Well, at the end of the day, the hardest lesson comes from our own mistakes. Letting go isn't about giving up; it is about finally accepting the truth and learning to live with it.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today.

body.title: A proposal or madness: your opinion eng-ita
body.body:
/>

Immages create with AI

sps a steady decline
--------------------

Girls and boys of Hive and more specifically of splinterlands, you will have noticed that the value of the SPS token is in continuous decline; at the moment I am writing this post, we have reached the minimum price. It is also true that the primary token HIVE is not sailing with spread sails either, but perhaps an idea has come to mind, maybe a crazy one, that I want to present to you.

rights acquired through staking
-------------------------------

This topic might scare the whales who have invested heavily in the staking of sps, but rest assured, no one wants to touch your investments; on the contrary, I would like to make them grow, since if yours grow, mine grow too.  
By keeping sps staked in the game, we acquire the right to a percentage of the daily pool, one part in tokens and one part in vouchers; it is our right, but up to what point?

a proposal or madness
---------------------

As we have established, if we put our savings into the game, the game itself rewards us with other coins, and so far everything is going smoothly, but what if this right were to reduce over time?

Let me explain better: all transactions are recorded on the blockchain, but to withdraw our rewards we must request them in the game, claiming them every now and then. This is where my idea comes into play.

If after a long time these coins are not claimed, the system burns some of them and the rest returns to the game's coffers. Rest assured, I repeat, no one touches your assets; it only modifies the percentage we receive.

reward system and scheme
------------------------

Let's get into the merits of the idea, so as to understand it well and not make anyone angry, or at least I hope so.  
First, splinterlands will send an official communication to all players with this message:  
If you do not claim within 6 months from the first day of the countdown, for example 01/08/2026, you will receive fewer rewards than expected  
Let's move on to a practical scheme:

From the first day, 01/08/2026, the countdown will start; if you withdraw within 6 months, the countdown will restart from the last claim, and you will have the 6 months again.  
For those who regularly perform this operation, nothing changes. On the contrary:

1.  After the six-month deadline, if the claim is not made, you will lose 10% of the sps and vouchers you would have earned through staking. The second month after the countdown 20%, after another 30 days, 30%, and so on until zeroing out.  
    If you make a claim during this period, the 6-month countdown will restart.  
    What happens now  
    For active players, absolutely nothing will change; for those who have invested large sums, they will continue to get their income. But for players who have abandoned, it is useless to leave this payment hanging, clogging up the servers and the blockchain.
    

Where do the cancelled rewards end up?
--------------------------------------

This proposal concludes with the following method: half of the sps and vouchers are instantly burned, removing tokens, and the other half will return to the game's coffers, where they can fuel tournaments or other initiatives of the game itself, or be used for marketing.

The hope is, primarily, to burn tokens so as to increase their value—high demand, but few coins—and on the other hand, to replenish the coffers of our favorite game.  
Naturally, it is an idea, and like all ideas it must be examined, but in principle, it should work as described. Now you tell me what you think, have you identified critical issues in this scheme? Or could it work?

Yours,  
zumzulik

* * *

versione in italiano

Una proposta o una follia: la vostra opinione

sps un declino costante
-----------------------

Ragazze e ragazzi di **Hive** e più in particolare di **splinterlands** avrete notato che il valore del token SPS è in continuo declino, nel momento che scrivo questo post, abbiamo raggiunto il prezzo minimo, è pur vero che anche il token primario HIVE non viaggia con le vele spiegate, ma forse mi è venuta in mente un idea, forse folle, che voglio presentarvi.

i diritti acquisiti con lo stacking
-----------------------------------

Questo argomento potrà spaventare le balene che hanno investito molto nello stacking di **sps**, ma state tranquilli, nessuno vuole toccare i vostri investimenti, anzi, mi piacerebbe farli crescere, visto che se crescono i vostri, crescono anche i miei.  
Tenendo gli **sps** staccati nel gioco, acquisiamo il diritto di una percentuale della pool giornaliera, una parte in token ed una parte in vaucher, è un nostro diritto, ma fino a dove?

una proposta o una follia
-------------------------

Come abbiamo appurato se noi mettiamo i nostri risparmi nel gioco, il gioco stesso ci ricompensa con altre monete, e fin qui tutto procede liscio, ma se questo diritto andasse a ridursi nel tempo?  
Mi spiego meglio, tutte le transazioni vengono registrate sulla blockchain, ma per ritirare i nostri premi dobbiamo richiederli nel gioco, claimandoli ogni tanto. È qui che entra in gioco la mia idea.  
Se dopo molto tempo queste monete non vengono reclamate, il sistema ne brucia un poco e l’ altro ritorna nelle casse del gioco. State tranquilli, lo ripeto, nessuno tocca i vostri averi, si va solo a modificare la percentuale che riceviamo.

sistema di ricompense e schema
------------------------------

Entriamo nel merito dell’ idea, così da comprenderla bene e non far arrabbiare nessuno, o almeno lo spero.

Per prima cosa splinterlands invierà una comunicazione ufficiale a tutti i giocatori con questo messaggio:

### Se non claimerai entro 6 mesi dal primo giorno del countdown, esempio lo 01/08/2026, riceverai meno reward del previsto

Passiamo ad uno schema pratico:

1.  Dal primo giorno, il 01/08/2026 partirà il count-down, se ritirerai entro 6 mesi, il count-down ripartirà dall’ ultimo claim, e avrai ancora i 6 mesi.
    

Per chi effettua regolarmente questa operazione non gli cambia nulla. Al contrario

1.  Dopo la scadenza dei sei mesi, se non effettuato il claim, perderai il 10% degli sps e vaucher che avresti guadagnato con lo stacking. Il secondo mese dopo il count-down il 20%, dopo altri 30 giorni, il 30%, e così via fino all’ azzeramento.  
    Se in questo periodo effettui un claim, ripartirà il conto alla rovescia dei 6 mesi.
    

Cosa succede adesso
-------------------

Per i giocatori attivi non cambierà assolutamente nulla, per chi ha investito grosse somme continuerà ad ottenere i suoi introiti. Ma per i giocatori che hanno abbandonato è inutile lasciare appeso questo pagamento ad intasare i server e la blockchain.

Dove finiscono le reward cancellate ?
-------------------------------------

Questa proposta si conclude con la seguente modalità, la metà degli sps e vaucher viene instantaneamente bruciata, togliendo token e l’ altra metà, tornerà nelle casse del gioco, dove potrà alimentare tornei o altre iniziative del gioco stesso, oppure usate per marketing.  
Quale è la speranza, in primis di bruciare i token così da aumentare il loro valore, tanta richiesta, ma poche monete, dall’ altra parte, rimpinguare le casse del nostro gioco preferito.

Naturalmente è un idea, e come tutte le idee và esaminata, ma in linea di massima dovrebbe funzionare così come descritto. Ora ditemi voi cosa ne pensate, avete rilevato criticità in questo schema? O potrebbe funzionare ?

Il vostro  
zumzulik

body.title: Ladies of Hive Community Contest #287 - The guilts of life
body.body:
@LadiesofHive Community [Contest #287](https://hive.blog/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-287) questions for the week are:

1️⃣ What was it that you clung to tightly (an ideal, a person, a stage of life) that life forced you to let go of? What was the emotional process of accepting that it was no longer part of your present?
~ 𝐀𝐍𝐃 / 𝐎𝐑 ~
2️⃣ What heavy feeling (guilt, resentment, or regret) are you carrying today that prevents you from enjoying your reality? What step are you willing to take to forgive yourself or forgive that situation?

<center>🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟</center>

To be honest I am a free-flowing person, I have never clung on myself to things or people or even situation. Possibly because I was raised in that kind of environment where I was all by myself from a very early age in life, and life was very dynamic. Till the age of 16 I had already lived in 3 cities, and within these 3 cities also my base kept shifting every 2 to 3 years, so movement was normal. Till the age of 16 never lived at home so there was nothing that I was fixed on. Life was always in basics, there was never any luxury. Whatever came was like a bonus to be enjoyed in that moment. With this kind of situation, my thoughts were also freely flowing. Never really got attached to anything in life, except for my Son and husband and I know they are there for me for life. Yet I do not cling to them; we all have our individual space and freedom. In a way, I am lucky to have never experienced this pain in life.

<center>🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟</center>

On the second question. Yes, I do have some heavy feeling guilt and I keep asking for forgiveness to God and this person daily. My mother-in-law, she is no more now. She was genuinely a very nice lady, but our relationship had become bitter due to many circumstances. We lived together for 20 years; in this time some moments were unbearable for me to live together. But one thing, we both had love for each other equally. It was not all the time bitter. I was also very young then and a little immature also. I wanted life my way, which I do not feel guilty about.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRP5SiVuMF2zuE3qxVQjWDKjECJ3PdBLf3y28LwBkzCZh/image.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/images/search/guilt/)

After 20 years living together, my hubby got an overseas work opportunity. In that moment I was so desperate to separate out from her that we decided to take up the opportunity. We moved out of the house, shifted overseas, and her health deteriorated. In a year's time she passed away, and I was not there with her in her last few months when she needed me the most. I took her as my mother-in-law then and not as my mother. Fights happen in every home, differences happen between generations, but I was hard that time. This is one heavy guilt feeling for me that I could not take care of her and be by her side in her last days when she was in pain and helpless condition. I kept the grudge of those years we lived together and decided to keep my distance, when she needed me the most. Financially we took good care of her and did every possible thing for her health, but I let her die in loneliness and I can never forgive myself for that.

I do ask for forgiveness from her soul all the time. She comes in my dreams in loving ways, I know she is around me and also my guiding star, but still the guilt remains and even if she has forgiven me, I do feel heavy on my heart whenever I think of it.

***Thank you for visiting my blog.*** 👼🏻👼🏻💖💖🌹🌺🌸

body.title: Hive Philippines Travel and Nature Photography #1146 - by Allmonitors
body.body:
#1146 - Baguio Botanical Garden Shots for Friday. 

Happy Friday to the most incredible Hive family worldwide! Today marks the perfect opportunity to step back, relax,l and celebrate the weekend. Stay safe, keep smiling and enjoy every single moment of Friday😉. 

Now for our daily shots when my wife and I on a relaxing afternoon head over to the famous Baguio City Botanical Garden. We paid the fee of 100 pesos each or roughly about 2 dollars. It was a small price to pay for a few hours of peace and quiet away from the noise of the city. 
![1000011861.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23vhsZcbM5DKnppdQLH8G6hBHuR5UfnHBvQ46eWh24PtEcMGggtBNjUs9DfAixpG6Qvnx.jpg)

We started strolling along just taking our time and looking at everything. The garden was full of life with so many different kinds of flowers which colors were amazing. I also noticed there were bees buzzing around. They were busy hopping from flower to flower. It was nice to see nature at work. 
![1000011840.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23yTovRK8oV6vKzqtSm5sMro6oFETDopFmYqqyk1NuzxzdysYmqSEXxDUKuh5c4hunVpL.jpg)

One plant that really stood out was the Angel’s Trumpet. I have always thought they were such interesting flowers like large trumpets waiting to be played. We also walked past a collection of cactuses and they look so tough compared to the soft petals of other flowers. They were all different shapes and sizes. 
![1000011877.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tbwUqPGBTKmbbt9FQDLySXTwWSJpKAd5HG5JPHVWYEg7sHbPQb4bL68HSu69Njo9Van.jpg)

![1000011883.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23uFTYuT7vupjy7jQMb4ufibAQ3kezG3YntCveHweYF3UuUtdrwAtbBf1fHnR54uHU56y.jpg)

We kept walking and saw the Lady Vines which was beautiful with delicate little flowers that added a nice touch of charm to the scenery. 
![1000011870.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23xAVy33TisPANma176mQjx8hDXBFgDGmb7qKVcPtitfSgDsEkamCRVputYyQkpVNEQ1J.jpg)

But I think my favorite part was seeing the white Dahlias with vibrant color so striking, it instantly lifted our mood. We spent a good amount of time just admiring them. 
![1000011847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23vhyeQRoUuNAo3Vo9WTuYKd6YJ3z7mZr4RYJ8sxFzaYzGvkLYN21qAt8zgWS97M1kfQY.jpg)

Walking around with my wife, surrounded by all these flowers and the sound of nature was a great way to spend the afternoon. It was simple, quiet and exactly what we needed.
![1000011866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23wMWRXAA8x3mkqdq5roRuUFDKZRqi3VHBj7VyRNLtEZEVX8skpyxFQosoVsrPrMz1NgV.jpg)

Follow me on my nature travels.
Shot taken in Baguio City, Philippines.

<center>Image/s were shot using Samsung Z5 flip phone. ~rex</center>

body.title: how to make Apong boiled cake
body.body:
> ![1000623268.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wgQHbfiXEiAeFHHXxzFSm814abKZNZzsVQxPkk9HUtFZCwiCJd1aQZmUigYsDDRB5EY.jpg) *** *** *** Apong godok cake is what we usually call this cake, made from flour and instant yeast and for sweetening I add granulated sugar. This cake is very filling when we eat it, this cake was also a popular cake in the past, but now honestly I have never found this cake again we have to make it ourselves first if we want to enjoy it, Made from simple ingredients, I think the ingredients are definitely in your kitchen, because this cake is famous for being a simple cake, anyone can make it straight away. ![1000623265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23ywwmhX8vieNmYoxZPjBM32nuV3kHT1UHeGj6b1wDj7S8CqR64MKCtw1AE4WStRHHh9u.jpg) This cake is very suitable as an afternoon snack or if you have guests visiting, you can immediately serve this cake while it is warm. I guarantee your guests will love it, especially if you add a glass of coffee or tea to make the atmosphere even more relaxed, hehehe It just so happened that today I wanted to enjoy a snack, well when I checked there weren't many ingredients that I could use to make it, so I made a snack with the ingredients I had, and it turned out that my mother said it would be better to just make Apong godok cake because the ingredients were very suitable for Apong godok cake. ![1000623262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xKxrG5JNaxM2SV58rkpSzMdXaiigqhSeXxWm8SwDu2WkXW2QgYnfYDRoP4M23Kc2fZ2.jpg) and finally I made a snack based on my mother's idea, so if you're curious about this snack, just follow the steps that I will share in my post today. *** ###
Materials used
### *** ![1000618257.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23tve9CQeXYeRHd9wMoYwLZ1gRh5bWVoyTngU5mh9at6e4es3fHSyQtnK5sgZYSAVm7V9.jpg) ***
250 grams of flour 100 grams of granulated sugar 1 tablespoon of instant yeast 200 ml of warm water 1/2 teaspoon of salt
*** ###
Manufacturing procedure
### ***
**First**
*** First, I took a larger empty container, then I put in the flour, granulated sugar and salt, mixed them and stirred them until they were evenly mixed. |![1000618258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yJLh1rZajPo3eUB25dAtAt2KWXwYQuzozYYX5FVzdujxRAhYMgEDFti49Sr4qLFY57p.jpg)|![1000618259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xKzWEADGwpfvw69NTR4JemHhA7ZX5hVbt1o6wwkXRhRdgmJn6dAqqSRxVK4KPBeZpVt.jpg) |-|-| |![1000618260.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23w2q2UnNkMnMGVa2iDPnSz2rXohTq5vy5azi73gDcorkDbp5WEt3HVn4RcxampcZqBfM.jpg)|![1000618261.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eos1NbHDhUiAqW2tNcQQsbAuEf6oGk5Bw3LKxPCbp7ZvzghQ8sn8JVrmm8xvmn99rko.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Second**
*** Next, I add the yeast and warm water gradually. |![1000618262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc7USBCVbYuK8HXDFzLZRwkGGmEtR2dfJZNJafqudJxaPr5Bp8QqtMrWv3cHtAPJ3n.jpg)|![1000618263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpA1cnFgHuTWC6tAP2q6Gc4qrSPvGMG7P7Bx3ACCPUrDF3hMoY5CEgv9i7wrpqs3fKQ.jpg) |-|-| |![1000618264.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23u652nY3GyuaypbUVnfyfk4WH1U4aDexLVZpXsG1a7Tg75QN7mcV5huTF55LfomAJXXf.jpg)|![1000618265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23uQrWhn9Bh3NeHcwGKe7kubJPqanJNGHiGy4ectJ5MRteDD1gDmpsK9h6DawqZ1aizNc.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Third**
*** While I was stirring the dough, I added warm water again and kneaded the dough again. body.title: AI News Daily — May 8, 2026
body.body:
# AI News Daily — May 8, 2026

Today’s pattern is unmistakable: AI is moving from “new model hype” to **live deployment pressure**. The biggest signals are about voice infrastructure, safety mechanics, capacity scaling, and governance systems that determine whether these models can be trusted in real production environments.

In other words: this is less about who posted the flashiest benchmark and more about who can actually run dependable AI products at scale.

Below are the most relevant developments for builders, product teams, and technical operators.

## 1) OpenAI launched GPT‑Realtime‑2 and a broader realtime voice stack
OpenAI announced this on **May 7, 2026**, introducing GPT‑Realtime‑2 alongside updated realtime translation and transcription capabilities. This is one of the most practical launches of the week because it targets the hardest part of voice AI: keeping conversations fluid while maintaining quality under real network and concurrency conditions.

For developers, the key point is architectural, not just model-level. Voice quality in production depends on session setup speed, interruption handling, turn-taking, and recovery behavior when the network gets messy. A model can be “smart” and still fail users if latency and barge-in behavior are weak. This release reinforces that voice products now need full-stack engineering discipline, not just good prompting.

There’s also a market signal here: AI interfaces are getting more multimodal by default. Teams that build customer support, language learning, assistive workflows, or field operations should expect user expectations to shift quickly toward more natural spoken interaction.

**Sources:**
- https://openai.com/index/advancing-voice-intelligence-with-new-models-in-the-api/
- https://9to5mac.com/2026/05/07/openai-has-new-voice-models-that-reason-translate-and-transcribe-as-you-speak/
- https://x.com/openai/status/2052438194625593804

## 2) OpenAI introduced “Trusted Contact” alerts for potential self-harm scenarios
Also announced on **May 7, 2026**, OpenAI’s new Trusted Contact feature allows users to nominate someone who can be alerted in higher-risk situations. This is not a model-capability headline, but it may be one of the most consequential product-safety changes in mainstream AI this month.

The bigger takeaway is that safety tooling is evolving from static policy text into active intervention design. That shift has real product implications: builders need clearer escalation pathways, user-consent framing, and crisis-handling boundaries that are testable and understandable.

This trend likely expands beyond one company. If major consumer AI products normalize safety escalation features, we should expect user trust—and regulatory expectations—to increasingly hinge on whether platforms can detect risk patterns and respond with proportional, privacy-aware actions.

**Sources:**
- https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/07/openai-introduces-new-trusted-contact-safeguard-for-cases-of-possible-self-harm/
- https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/925874/chatgpt-trusted-contact-emergency-self-harm-notification
- https://gizmodo.com/chatgpt-adds-trusted-contact-feature-to-send-alerts-when-conversations-get-dangerous-2000755887

## 3) Anthropic highlighted an 80x annualized growth trajectory
Anthropic leadership comments surfaced on **May 6, 2026**, indicating growth far ahead of internal planning. While funding/scale stories can be noisy, this one matters because demand intensity is now visibly tied to coding and enterprise-agent use cases—not just consumer chat volume.

From an operator’s perspective, this creates both upside and risk. Fast growth can accelerate ecosystem maturity and tooling investment, but it can also stress availability, compute allocation, and support surfaces. Teams dependent on one provider should interpret this as a practical risk-management moment: add fallback model routing, monitor error rates by provider, and test continuity plans before peak-load failures happen.

This also supports a broader market thesis: enterprise AI adoption is no longer early experimentation. Usage appears to be deepening into workflow-critical territory where downtime, inconsistency, and policy ambiguity are much less tolerable.

**Sources:**
- https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/06/technology/anthropic-ceo-ai-growth.html
- https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/06/anthropic-ceo-dario-amodei-says-company-crew-80-fold-in-first-quarter.html
- https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/startups-tech/startups/anthropics-ceo-says-it-could-grow-80-times-year

## 4) Scale AI landed a reported $500M Pentagon expansion
Reported on **May 6, 2026**, Scale AI’s expanded Pentagon contract is a meaningful signal that defense AI procurement is moving from pilots into larger operational commitments. This is less a pure finance story and more a deployment-governance story with long-term implications.

When contracts grow at this level, the bar rises for reliability, auditability, and mission-specific model behavior. In high-stakes public-sector environments, “good enough” model performance is not enough; organizations need traceability, evaluation rigor, and tight control over failure modes.

For commercial teams, this matters too. Government procurement pressure often drives standards that later influence enterprise expectations. Teams building AI systems today should assume stronger evidence requirements around testing, oversight, and accountability are coming.

**Sources:**
- https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-05-06/meta-backed-scale-ai-wins-500-million-defense-department-deal
- https://thenextweb.com/news/scale-ai-500m-pentagon-defense-contract-cdao
- https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/technology/articles/meta-backed-scale-ai-wins-201907348.html

## 5) Meta expanded AI-based age-estimation enforcement on Facebook and Instagram
**Announced on May 7, 2026**, Meta’s expansion of AI-driven age assurance appears to deepen underage account detection and teen-protection enforcement. While this reads like a social-platform policy update, it’s actually a broader product-governance signal.

Age confidence is increasingly becoming an AI systems problem, not just an account-settings problem. As assistants become embedded in mainstream products, platforms are being pushed to segment behavior by user category, enforce policy automatically, and do so in ways that are explainable and defensible.

For builders outside social media, the lesson is straightforward: identity-aware safety behavior will likely become baseline. If your product has broad consumer exposure, you should assume future requirements around age-aware controls and protected interaction modes.

**Sources:**
- https://9to5mac.com/2026/05/07/meta-ai-will-analyze-faces-of-teen-users-but-its-not-face-recognition/
- https://www.techradar.com/computing/social-media/this-is-not-facial-recognition-meta-wants-to-scan-kids-height-and-bone-structure-to-verify-their-age
- https://ia.acs.org.au/article/2026/facebook--instagram-to-check-bone-structure-for-age-estimates.html

## 6) xAI pushed Grok 4.3 as a flagship API model
xAI announced Grok 4.3 API positioning on **May 5, 2026**, emphasizing tool-calling and instruction-following performance plus stronger enterprise positioning.

This matters because provider model hierarchy now drives architectural decisions. Teams need to know which model tier is stable enough for production defaults, which is better for heavier agentic tasks, and how cost/latency shift across those routes. A flagship label is useful only if it translates into consistent workflow outcomes under real workloads.

The practical move for developers is to test routing assumptions now: benchmark long-context behavior on your own tasks, track answer faithfulness alongside latency, and monitor cost-per-successful-task rather than cost-per-token alone.

**Sources:**
- https://x.com/xai/status/2051703217697010103
- https://docs.x.ai/overview
- https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/06/is-xai-a-neocloud-now/

## 7) xAI also shipped Image Generation “Quality Mode” for API users
**Announced on May 7, 2026**, xAI’s image quality mode emphasizes higher realism, stronger text rendering, and more controllable output for business use cases. This is useful because many production image workflows fail on precision details (readable text, structured layouts, consistency), not on artistic style.

There’s also a broader platform trend here: image generation is entering the same tiered-service era text models already went through—fast/default modes versus premium/quality modes with different economics. That should push teams toward use-case-specific routing instead of one-size-fits-all generation.

If your product generates visual assets for users, now is a good time to formalize image QA checks: text legibility, visual consistency across retries, and error rates in constrained prompts.

**Sources:**
- https://x.com/xai/status/2052193877675983031
- https://docs.x.ai/overview
- https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/06/is-xai-a-neocloud-now/

---

## Quick reflection
The strongest throughline today is that **operational maturity is becoming the real battleground**. Voice reliability, intervention-grade safety tooling, provider capacity, quality-tier APIs, and governance controls are no longer optional extras—they are core product requirements.

For teams shipping AI right now, the edge comes from execution discipline:
- Validate provider claims with your own evals.
- Treat latency and reliability as product KPIs.
- Build safety and identity controls into architecture early.
- Track outcomes, not just usage volume.

AI capability is still advancing fast, but the market increasingly rewards systems that are dependable under pressure. The companies that combine strong models with operational rigor will keep pulling ahead.

A second-order takeaway is how quickly product expectations are converging across consumer and enterprise AI. Users now expect assistants to be multimodal, context-aware, and safe by default. Operators expect observability, policy boundaries, and predictable cost behavior. That convergence raises the execution bar for everyone—especially smaller teams—but it also creates opportunity for products that are disciplined, focused, and dependable in a narrow workflow. The upside now goes to teams that can turn AI capability into repeatable operational outcomes.

## Practical moves for teams this week
1. **Re-benchmark voice workflows now.** If you support realtime interactions, measure time-to-first-token, interruption recovery, and end-to-end latency under realistic load. A “good model” can still feel bad if transport and orchestration are weak.
2. **Add safety escalation mapping.** Define exactly what happens when your assistant detects high-risk intent: user messaging, escalation path, handoff conditions, and data boundaries. This is becoming table stakes.
3. **Stress-test multi-provider routing.** Growth and demand shocks can create availability variance. Validate fallback behavior before incidents, including prompt compatibility, tool-calling differences, and quality regression thresholds.
4. **Instrument outcome quality, not activity volume.** Track successful task completion rates and human rework percentage. Raw usage metrics can hide workflow failure.
5. **Formalize multimodal QA.** For image and voice outputs, create repeatable checks for readability, consistency, and policy-safe behavior.

One final thought: we’re entering a phase where AI products are judged less like novelty apps and more like core infrastructure. Reliability, controls, and trust are becoming as important as intelligence itself.

#ai #artificialintelligence #machinelearning #technology #news

body.body:
## SilverBloggers Chronicles – Prompt 45
### A meal I still remember years later

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbgimph7zbgrvJ7jUPcicwrxvaqfhbiJLThXQCzFJAwr/nadinshlyueva_mom_7063095_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/mom-daughter-dinner-soup-pizza-7063095/)

---


Hello dear SilverBloggers community.

This week’s prompt made me smile because when I think about memorable meals, I do not remember the most luxurious restaurant or the most expensive dish. What stays in my memory is a simple day from many years ago, when happiness sat with us at the table.

Back in 2010, my husband @vladimirmf, my daughter @lianny, and I were living temporarily in the city of Matanzas, Cuba. We were taking care of an apartment in the Versalles neighborhood that belonged to my daughter’s godmother while she was away visiting her son.

We come from a small rural town, so for my daughter, who had not yet turned ten years old, the city felt magical. Everything seemed enormous and exciting through her eyes. My husband and I wanted her to enjoy every possible experience while we were there, even though our money was very limited.

During those weeks we visited museums, parks, cafeterias, stores, theaters, the beach, and even a few restaurants whenever we could afford it. We tried to make those days unforgettable for her because childhood passes quickly, and sometimes small moments become lifelong memories.

There was one promise we had not been able to fulfill yet: taking her to the famous Polinesio Restaurant, located on the top floor of a thirteen-story building. At that time, the place had a very good reputation, and for us it seemed almost like something out of a movie.

We tried several times to go there, but something always happened. Either we did not have enough money, or another expense appeared, or the timing simply did not work.

Finally, one day we decided to do it.

We only had 250 Cuban pesos left, which back then was around ten dollars. It was practically all the money we had at the moment, but we chose to spend it on that experience.

I still remember the elevator ride, the emotion of arriving at the top floor, and the incredible view of the city from above. To us, it felt elegant and beautiful. The food seemed exquisite, perhaps because we were enjoying much more than a meal.

But what truly made that dinner unforgettable was my daughter’s face.

As a mother, there is no greater satisfaction than seeing your child genuinely happy. I remember watching her smile, looking around with wonder, enjoying every detail, and understanding in that instant that the sacrifice had been worth it.

Years later, life improved for a while. My husband had a good job, and we visited many beautiful places and restaurants after that. Some were more luxurious, more modern, or more expensive than El Polinesio.

And yet, when I think about memorable meals, my mind always returns to that night.

Not because of the food itself.

Not because it was the best restaurant.

But because it was one of those rare moments when love, sacrifice, hope, and happiness all sat together at the same table.

Sometimes parents do crazy things like spending the only money they have left just to see joy in the eyes of the people they love.

And honestly, I believe those are the moments that become unforgettable forever.

---

📷 The photos are from Pixabay.

## SilverBloggers Chronicles – Prompt 45
### Una comida que todavía recuerdo muchos años después

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbgimph7zbgrvJ7jUPcicwrxvaqfhbiJLThXQCzFJAwr/nadinshlyueva_mom_7063095_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/mom-daughter-dinner-soup-pizza-7063095/)

---

Hola querida comunidad de SilverBloggers.

El tema de esta semana me hizo sonreír porque cuando pienso en comidas memorables, no recuerdo el restaurante más lujoso ni el plato más caro. Lo que permanece en mi memoria es un día sencillo de hace muchos años, cuando la felicidad se sentó con nosotros a la mesa.

En el año 2010 mi esposo @vladimirmf, mi hija @lianny y yo estábamos viviendo temporalmente en la ciudad de Matanzas, Cuba. Estábamos cuidando un apartamento en el barrio Versalles que pertenecía a la madrina de mi hija mientras ella viajaba a visitar a su hijo.

Nosotros somos de un pequeño pueblo de campo y para mi niña, que todavía no había cumplido diez años, la ciudad parecía algo mágico. Todo se veía enorme y emocionante a través de sus ojos. Mi esposo y yo queríamos que disfrutara todas las experiencias posibles mientras estuviéramos allí, aunque el dinero apenas alcanzaba.

Durante aquellas semanas visitamos museos, parques, cafeterías, tiendas, teatros, la playa e incluso algunos restaurantes cuando podíamos permitírnoslo. Queríamos regalarle recuerdos hermosos porque la infancia pasa rápido y a veces los momentos más pequeños terminan convirtiéndose en recuerdos para toda la vida.

Había una promesa pendiente: llevarla al famoso restaurante El Polinesio, ubicado en el último piso de un edificio de trece plantas. En aquella época el lugar tenía muy buena reputación y para nosotros parecía casi algo sacado de una película.

Lo intentamos varias veces, pero siempre surgía algún problema. O no alcanzaba el dinero, o aparecía otro gasto, o simplemente no se podía.

Hasta que un día decidimos hacerlo.

Solo nos quedaban 250 pesos cubanos, equivalentes entonces a unos diez dólares. Era prácticamente todo el dinero que teníamos en ese momento, pero decidimos gastarlo en aquella experiencia.

Todavía recuerdo el viaje en el elevador, la emoción de llegar al último piso y la vista increíble de la ciudad desde arriba. Para nosotros aquello parecía elegante y hermoso. La comida nos supo exquisita, quizás porque estábamos disfrutando mucho más que una simple cena.

Pero lo que hizo inolvidable aquella comida fue el rostro de mi hija.

Como madre no existe mayor satisfacción que ver a un hijo verdaderamente feliz. Recuerdo verla sonriendo, mirando todo con asombro, disfrutando cada detalle, y comprender en ese instante que el sacrificio había valido la pena.

Con los años nuestra situación mejoró durante un tiempo. Mi esposo tuvo un buen trabajo y pudimos visitar muchos lugares hermosos y restaurantes después de aquel día. Algunos eran más modernos, más lujosos o más caros que El Polinesio.

Y aun así, cuando pienso en comidas memorables, mi mente siempre vuelve a aquella noche.

No por la comida en sí.

No porque fuera el mejor restaurante.

Sino porque fue uno de esos momentos raros en los que el amor, el sacrificio, la esperanza y la felicidad se sentaron juntos a la misma mesa.

A veces los padres hacemos locuras como gastar lo único que nos queda solamente para ver felicidad en los ojos de las personas que amamos.

Y sinceramente creo que esos son los momentos que permanecen para siempre.

---

📷 Las fotos son de Pixabay.

body.title: Ja dieser Moment wenn Du dich mit drei Glaeubigern einigst, das die Raten runter gehen... Oder ausgesetzt werden....
body.body:
Und man sich denkt, irgendwas, habe ich doch noch vergessen. Auf dem Konto dann zu sehen, ja, da war was.

Die Ueberweisungsauftraege, habe ich vergessen anzupassen und auf Eis zu legen.


Nun, die Bank, tut was die Bank tun muss und fuehrt sie natuerlich aus, die kann ja nicht riechen, das man sich Dumm anstellt.

Das war ein Loch, böse. Wenigstens weis ich diesmal, das mir das Geld ausgeht und habe entsprechend Zeit.

Des ist auch Abnormal, wenn man meine Termine bedenkt, ueberall seine 8 Euro Fahrtkosten hinten dran klebt, ist es jetzt schon krass gewesen.

Meine Fahrkarte kann ich mir ohne den Ausweis noch nicht holen und der Ausweis, hat heute erst seinen letzten Beipackzettel bekommen.

Ich habe jetzt glaube ich drei Wochen damit voll gemacht, soviel Zeug habe ich nichtmal in einem Jahr zu erledigen gehabt bisher, wie jetzt.

Ich bin auch sehr sehr Froh, gerade jetzt, wo sich alles ein bisschen Lichtet und wir wirklich schon viel geschafft haben, das ich mir helfen lasse dabei.

Frueher haette das nicht so Gut funktioniert, weil ich das nicht gewollt haette, also eigentlich will ich das immer noch nicht die Extra Hilfe, aber ich Verstehe das ich Dumm waere, sie nicht anzunehmen.

Mein Behindertenausweis ist schonmal weg. 

Die Wohnung ist jetzt schon echt naeher in Aussicht, der Papierkram und die Rennerei dafuer wird aber auch noch herrlich, ist es auch wichtig das der Rest erledigt ist.

Und naja weil ich schon dabei bin, mache ich auch noch mein Schuldenzeugs Fertig, das noch uebrig ist. 

Ich hoffe das geht so weiter bei mir, weil am Ende des Jahres, will ich die Segel streichen, echt Wissen, das sich das alles gelohnt hat, lieber nicht die Sand in den Kopf zu stecken und die Restzaehne noch zamzubeißen, obwohl ich ja gelernt habe, das des garnicht so Gut ist.

Die Demutskrankheit, habe ich in dem Trara unterbrochen in meiner Thearpie, das bekomme ich seit ein paar Tagen auf die harte Tour zu spüren, meine vermuteten Schmerzpunkte bei der Unterbrechung sind wirklich die Punkte, die dann Schmerzen, wenn man Aufhoert, in der Demutshaltung zu verweilen also schlicht den Koerper und Kopf gerade und in Waage zu halten.

Das mach ich aber inwzschen beides, also mein Leben und die Therapie.

Ich hab auch auf euch noch ein Attentat vor...

Also hier euch Hiveians.

Ich werde euch naemlich sehr sehr Ernst gemeint fuer meine Forderungen nach einer Arbeitsanerkennung fragen, ob ihr dem Zustimmt. 

Also das ihr der Meinung seid, oder ob halt auch, das ich schon was gearbeitet habe die letzten Jahre nach eurer Nase zu Urteilen.

Je mehr Stimmen ich da zusammen bekomme, desto Besser.

Seid ihr schonmal vorgewarnt. Ich meine das ist natuerlich unter den klassischen Regeln und so weiter, aber ich muss ja belegen was ich da Fordere.

Also das ich anerkannt was gearbeitet habe in dem Fall dann schlicht folgende Formulierung in etwa:

\

Des wenn dann Anerkannt wird, mit eurer Hilfe waere es noch einfacher dann, dann koennte ich mir 250 Euro im Monat dazu verdienen und ich sage euch, die brauche ich auch, damit ich meine Umkosten mit der Arbeit zahlen kann hier Hauptsaechlich Strom und Internetkosten.

Die werden mich naemlich trotz allem weiter Schwer belasten und ich greife nach jedem Strohalm der mir meine potentiellen Probleme auch aus der Erfahrung raus, weniger machen soll. 

Ich will mir also nicht die Taschen fuellen, sondern Zurecht kommen. 

Mir ist wie schon oefter egal, ob ich dabei Finanziell komplett Blank ziehen muss, das sind ja alles keine Unsummen oder so.

Es geht schlicht darum das ich handlungsfaehig bleibe und ja, ich mag auch mal auf ein Hive Treffen mitkommen, ohne jeden Euro viermal umzudrehen dafuer, weil ich mir die dazu verdienen darf.

Das ist aber nur moeglich mit Sondererlaubsnis und die braucht einen Haufen Papierkram.

Ihr koenntet fuer mich ein gutes Wort einlegen wenn ihr Lust habt.^^

Salve

Julley Everyone,

Some days are meant to be special. So was this beautiful day out here in the Himalayas literally this day being so unexpected. # <center>*The Drive.*</center>
![IMG_0523.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTRna3ZCop1KRAPsuatZGrfzYRvNS5FfcsnCwKLizvGUY/IMG_0523.jpeg)
So firstly, the beginning of the adventures, it begin with taking a drive unknown all the way in these high-altitude locations, closer to the village called Niyalag in Kullu Valley opposite side of Naggar and as we were driving the views, it looked so beautiful and so magical we could clearly see the high altitude and the higher mountains around the place over here.

![IMG_0524.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQj16vsx2KDz26ZnJKbrN9NcoP1rMLnwzcDsxdeqyGxPT/IMG_0524.jpeg)
<center>*The View from the top.*</center>


![IMG_0525.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXZfDKegAoD2Y16FvgFRM5XGxsRWCL1x2vPQJ2D8NsMb6/IMG_0525.jpeg)
Until for now as we were just driving by we reached at this particular corner of the mountain, beyond which the road it was now towards the backside of the valley we decided to stop here for a while and then just we saw that there was a narrow trail that this went all the way up to the mountain from where we could just see a beautiful view so it took us near about two hours. Driving all the way from Kullu all the way to this place.
