body.title: Crypto Sarcasm #65 - Prediction Markets, Football & Compulsive Liars
body.body:
Here’s your weekly reminder that yes, you are doing amazing, sweetie… even if your last post got three likes and one of them was your burner account. Keep up the good work! 

Welcome to Sarcasm Saturday! Today we gonna talk about sports and prediction markets! We gonna have a dive into [Xmarkets](https://xmarket.app/referrals/x7QBs6EwqHJeJV6) & [Duck Duel](https://duelduck.com/?referral_token=BSCmw4iB) but will also have a lot of fun! 

Prediction markets were supposed to make us smarter. We joined the rational data-driven arenas where truth rises to the top and sentiment gets priced in with brutal efficiency.

[Xmarket](https://xmarket.app/referrals/x7QBs6EwqHJeJV6) on BNB chain blends crowd forecasting, decentralized finance, and creator economics into one seamless system! You’re building markets around it and earning as others trade.

My race to find the next big thing took me to Solana, where I explored [Duck Duels](https://duelduck.com/?referral_token=BSCmw4iB) as predictions with a twist! I found a prediction game where you set up head-to-head “duels”.

In theory they cut through bias. In reality? They just give us a more sophisticated way to be confidently wrong. It's still gambling and ignore everyone who says it's not! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTeAcpYHS1guSmnN39Rncs64JMKCNdjd1FHT3t69BsCFF/image.png)


We lie ourself when we say we are not gambling! We are losing money! But it's ok because even top football players are lying! We’ve all seen it! Compulsive liars!

The player signs a big transfer and within minutes they say _“This has always been my dream club”!_ Today the dream just happens to match the wage packet.

Who remembers when Jhon Duran said he grew up watching Al-Nassr? What a dream club! I've seen people lying but they have never lied like  at this magnitude before! 

Take football as the best example and the perfect ecosystem for prediction markets! There are massive data sets, global attention, and outcomes that seem measurable.

And yet it’s  pure chaos. Transfers happen, narratives flip overnight, and suddenly a player who grew up idolizing one club is kissing the badge of another like it’s been stitched to their soul since birth.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPoxdommraeZ2gYUAGixWFpKrp4gkm3bRZEGdaRwoNw67/image.png)


If you built a prediction market on “Is this player telling the truth?” you’d need more liquidity than the entire crypto space combined. Because deep down everyone knows the game.

Fans pretend to believe it, players pretend to mean it, and the market pretends it can price sincerity. Prediction markets don’t eliminate human nature... they just tokenize it.

That’s where crypto sarcasm kicks in with bias, tribalism, and wishful thinking. Sometimes the lies go beyond charts and odds! This is the best I've seen on ages! 

It’s basically a sarcastic joke built around a real football controversy. The Confederation of African Football looked into the identity of Guelor Kanga after a complaint from the Congolese association.

The allegation claimed that his official documents said he was born in 1990, but there were records suggesting his mother had died in 1986. That’s where the comedy comes in!

It’s important to note that CAF reviewed the case and ultimately cleared Kanga due to a lack of solid evidence. So while the situation became a meme online... nothing was officially proven! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXkdRLFFohZiP6W6bbcZhVtdVh5G3x2od4oj7DZ824fAz/image.png)


All this sarcasm brings us neatly to broadcasting economics, another place where logic takes a back seat to something far more primal. On paper it makes no sense! 

Why did BBC reportedly pay around £200 million to retain rights to Match of the Day for roughly 4 million viewers... mostly men? Who complained about this deal?

The \

was they wouldn’t stretch to £25 million to keep The Great British Bake Off for 15 million audience! Triple the audience for a fraction of the cost?

Any prediction market worth its salt should scream buy Bake Off and sell football rights. But markets, whether crypto or media, aren’t driven purely by numbers. 

Real life is driven by intensity. Football is lived and you can't argue over that. It’s the kind of engagement that advertisers and institutions quietly value far beyond raw viewership.

Football fuels tribal loyalty, weekly rituals, generational identity. No one’s flipping tables over a slightly underbaked Victoria sponge. There are no last-minute screamers and no collective eruptions

Bake Off doesn’t quite spark the same emotional volatility. No bakers make pubs losing their minds in unison. Let’s be honest... have you ever seen a Victoria sponge bend a banger top bins from 30 yards in the last minute?


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXPgAhvLedTLb2m3G3Gg11w157We27uGGkdHjggP92z2g/image.png)


The flaw in both prediction markets and surface-level analysis is the same! Both underestimate chaos and emotions. The things you can’t easily quantify are often the things that matter most.

So whether it’s a footballer rewriting their childhood allegiances, a trader mispricing sentiment, or a broadcaster doubling down on tradition over logic... the pattern is the same.

We’re not as rational as we like to think and we never were. Crypto didn’t fix that and will never do it! Prediction markets just gave us better graphs to watch while we argue about it.

I had this saved in my draft and never had an article where I could add it... until now! This is a collage of Italian football teams kits and mascots. Football is beautiful! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZKK4k5P2r7pfZ8nRsrZW8QvD9wAsfB3N7Q48LmELnENw/image.png)

body.title: In the next decade consumer apps will move to conversational interaction
body.body:
We are living through a third paradigm shift in human-computer interaction. The first was the command line. The second was the graphical user interface (GUI). The third — now underway — is the conversational interface. 

This movement is a shift from navigation to conversation.

ChatGPT reached 100 million active users just two months after launch — the fastest adoption of any consumer application in history at the time.

This event effectively \

where conversational interactions are not just acceptable but often preferred.

Over the next decade, the dominant modality for consumer software will be conversation — not menus, not taps, not navigation trees, although these will remain to ease complex interactions between humans and computers.

### Intelligent machines

Intelligent machines is the reason this shift will be taking place.

Rather than spending hours tapping buttons and connecting dots, users will prefer to outsource to intelligent machines.

On the deeper level, not just users will be doing this. Builders, businesses and even other machines will rely on intelligent software systems to handle a wide array of tasks.

Moving machine interaction to conversation across multiple domains and system layers.

How do we know this to be true?

Trends, this is how.

People are moving away from a lot of manual executions or simply processes that don't involve intelligent machines.

Programmers for instance, are increasingly using AI systems to fast-pace their development of software across the board.

AI for consumer services was already valued $12.06 billion in 2024 and is projected to grow to $47.82 billion by 20230.

Agentic AI, which I consider the most crucial layer for future applications is projected by Statista to reach $47.1 billion by 2030, up from $5.1 billion in 2025.

I guess the question people might be asking is why should people even want to move to conversational interfaces?

### Lower cognitive load

I think it's also important to note that in the long run, the primary conversation mode will be voice.

This is crucial for maximum efficiency and user experience.

Typing can be a hell of a job and even though in several tasks today, texting an AI beats manual navigation of the Internet and/or apps, the majority shift to voice will be the top indicator of a proper migration to conversational interactions between humans and machines.

With that said, the reason any of this makes sense and will become fundamental is because it lowers cognitive load.

In other words, it feeds our declining attention span and our general laziness.

The solution of the century right?

This is the inevitable path.

body.title: New Album Pre-Save: If I Wasn’t Me
body.body:
![IIWM Final.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmetfefeyGWNKQnCRrkdNvAe4dBc9stMeQyjxK4hpDieng/IIWM%20Final.png)

My new album **If I Wasn’t Me** is now available to pre-save on Spotify 🎶

This one means a lot to me. It's releasing **May 15th, 2026**, just a short way away.

**If I Wasn’t Me** is a 20-track journey through reflection, resilience, love, loss, growth, faith, late nights, ambition, and trying to turn pain into something with purpose. It runs 1 hour, 12 minutes, and 58 seconds, and every track carries a different piece of the story.

This album is about becoming yourself through everything that tried to change you.

It’s about the heavy nights.
The thoughts you don’t always say out loud.
The love you still carry.
The mistakes you learn from.
The pressure of trying to keep going.
The dreams that keep calling you back.
The moments where you feel lost, but still decide to move forward.

From Where Do We Go to Let The Light In, this project moves through a lot of different feelings. There are reflective tracks like These Thoughts, Space, and Remember Me. Late-night songs like Sleepless Nights and Line For Line. Motivational moments like Work For Your Dreams, Midas Touch, Giving Grace, and Low Lights, High Hopes. There’s love in Ocean View, healing in Back Again, faith and perception in See Three, and that constant search for peace throughout the whole album.

I wanted this project to feel honest.

Not perfect.
Not polished to the point where the emotion disappears.
Just real.

A lot of these songs came from late nights, overthinking, stress, hope, love, regret, and the need to keep creating even when life felt heavy. I think that’s what this album is really built on: the idea that every setback, scar, mistake, dream, and lesson can still become part of the story.

**If I Wasn’t Me** is for anyone who’s been trying to heal while still showing up.
For anyone chasing a dream while carrying doubt.
For anyone trying to choose love instead of bitterness.
For anyone who’s had to lose themselves a little just to understand who they really are.

Thank you to everyone who has listened, supported, shared, commented, and been part of this journey in any way. It genuinely means more than I can say.

🎶 Pre-save **If I Wasn’t Me** here 👇
https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/scottychams/if-i-wasnt-me

Low lights, high hopes.
Still, I find a way.

PS. I'm coming out with a newsletter and will be offering early access on Soundcloud!

body.title: A day in the daily life with my wife, Go to get the car AC fixed, our lunch and walk and shop at the wet market.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfLkVB9xYarBYHCQMdWDdAQ9eX81AaAgG14akrsnFwCeY/1778223644762.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. After yesterday's I drove 300 kilometers round trip with my wife to the hospital in the city. But we ran into some car issues along the way. My car's air conditioning only blows cold air when I'm moving, but it gets warm when I'm idling or in traffic or driving slowly. This morning, after my wife and I took our autistic son to school, We are go to a car AC shop in a nearby district. This car AC shop is called AJ shop. It's a local car AC shop located in Chai Prakan district. Even though it's in a different district, it's close to our house. And several people recommended this car AC shop. So we went to this car AC shop this morning. When we arrived at this car AC shop, it was a small shop located on the main road. And In addition to car AC services, this shop is also a car audio specialist. The car AC technician is coming to check the unit of my car, Weak compressor, quite blocked condenser and condenser fan not working properly. Fixing my car A/C will take around 3 hours. And it was finished around 11:10 AM.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYrckmTVcxVvGGyvn4upuUucFnTXyUoA96vbC7exkH26r/1778223644822.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZqM2yPm8B81GAqfmmSHH1R8DAQcS6FvXLFkCV1FCCyPw/1778223644993.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfF7af9AVbQWU7o5QVdo6LB9zn6EovhodNQSro5o2SYPc/1778223645113.jpg)

My wife and I have about four hours of free time before picking up our autistic son from school. So we returned to our district. And we went to a simple restaurant in our district. This restaurant is located in an alley. I was very hungry, so I ordered two dishes. The first dish was thin noodles with seafood and fish balls in pink tofu soup. And for my second dish, I ordered northern Thai curry noodles with pork meatballs. And my wife ordered thin noodles with seafood and fish balls in pink tofu soup too.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNvDbX6GFb7ED6TY8KyZSpn9kb9tCEfACQTPQu8njYmUd/1778224496435.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRoWsKBcU5dGzJZNQK7LJse8EY1kEnqsJsnwMPpWT5s6k/1778224496548.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRU2ftBRabNd9ikk8L7JcXzvc9BM7dA8WW1LkwEbRkbMB/1778224496729.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZA2gj11Gsqp7n5Eq4BMyK56d5j7kyoF4nsSxsVvGtSJQ/1778224496657.jpg)

Finally we went to the wet market near the restaurant. Tomorrow is the weekend, so we're buying ingredients for this weekend. And I walked around this wet market to kill time before picking up my son from school.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdHcJM1LdLTbZYXswFDXPMLfmsTanZYAaQnXDxLCuyyEE/1778224789567.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbFkSwNhUhkQnex8CYgpUXNWd4s5WNo7ibpXQMp5yLmP/1778224789449.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY6W3cV8jmPgMou3aekQhkEh78gAojiKg1i3hAmBRebkY/1778224789696.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVx8vhiSL1ZvK7TV5NkmJveWbjWbLwKZqvakrvfHrK7LN/1778224789808.jpg)

Then we pick up our autistic son from school and go home. And we have to take close care of our autistic son at home. There are no activities at home. These are the stories and photos I want to share for this post. Invite everyone to see and enjoy my stories and photos. Please forgive any errors/mistakes. Have a great day. See you next time. Thank you for your support and visiting my post. Bye 🤗

📷 Take photo By Smartphone Vivo V30.

body.title: 用不完的AI额度以后会出现转让或出售吗？
body.body:
今天看到一个短视频《当世界被AI接管》，内容讲的是未来的城市都被AI接管后，人类所能做的事情很有限，无非就是吃喝玩乐而已。虽然这个视频看起来有点夸张，但长远看，概率很大啊。

现在有个词token，中文翻译为词元。日常办公用AI，可能头疼的一个问题，就是每天AI的使用有额度限制，如Open AI，


![001.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeNtGwUyQmLaTPR6z4PX8nx5wZa6H8g3EaLtS2bVnubKg/001.png)


通常是5个小时重置一次，如果5个小时内提前用完了额度，就必须等到5小时后额度重置后才可以继续使用。

之后就是每周有个额度限制，这个额度提前用完了，就必须得等到下周才能继续使用。

看，现在是不是有种被AI“裹挟”的感觉？

如果你额度用完了，想继续用，办法倒是有，一种就是升级更高的套餐，价格自然也更贵些。

还有个办法，虽然目前没有提供，但我觉得未来很可能会有人提供类似的服务，我们暂且就把它叫做“额度转让”。

所谓“额度转让”，就是每个人每天有一定的额度，但每个人使用的情况自然不同。有些人用的少，有些人用的多。好比吃饭，饭量大的人往往不够用，饭量小的人却有点浪费。

那么机会来了，用量小的人，可以把自己多出的额度转让给有需要的人啊，这些多出的额度再适度收些费用也未尝不可，这算不算一种商业机会呢？

我觉得这个机会还是有很大可能的。


![002.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVqoy1BMgknuXbbEn6oHY33LV8aLszTDkgAaA6FKqs5Wy/002.png)

以后工作都普及用了AI，干活的时候基本交给AI，每个人每天使用了多少AI工作量，这个是很容易统计出来，比如如上图。

但问题来了，既然工作量能被轻易统计出来，那么像现在很普及的KPI考核等，是不是也会跟着类似如此？如果真那样的话就有点麻烦，打工族们上班想趁老板或领导不在时，趁机摸会鱼，偷会懒，有了AI工作量考评，会不会就很难办了。囧😳😳😳

回到开始的主题：用不完的AI额度以后会转让或出售吗？

我觉得大概率还是会的。只要有利益的地方，自然就会衍生出相关交易了。

body.title: 20 Years of Experience: The Cobra Exercise for Herniated Discs – Benefits and Hidden Dangers
body.body:
20 Years of Experience: The Cobra Exercise for Herniated Discs – Benefits and Hidden Dangers

Based on my personal experiences that I have had over the course of two decades, I have discovered that dealing with the spine is like dealing with building columns in terms of the distribution of loads on the vertebrae, and suffering from a herniated disc is not an inevitable fate that befalls a person and ends his life. Rather, it is like any passing disease that has its symptoms. By treating the cause, the symptom ends. Based on these long experiences that I went through after my injury, and based on many of the exercises spread to treat the herniated disc randomly, I will present to you a summary of these exercises in turn, in the hope that they will be a helpful factor. For those who have lost their way in treatment, with a detailed explanation of each exercise accurately, I hope to God that we will be a reason to restore life to those who feel better in despair after their injury. We will begin this post with the first exercise with a detailed explanation, and it will be followed later by a detailed post for each movement that is beneficial or harmful for each exercise, God willing. The first exercise:
Cobra exercise or what some call Mackenzie
The goal is to return the slipped cartilage to its center as much as possible
 




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmda4Ty8SCs5p6PdR8kdZf6geW9YpXShWHX2rAxz7srtGD/1778105213748.png)



[Source](https://pixabay.com)








![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcvo566rbEmL749vcFxN74CN8odaPX1MP2t72TQBPkcUd/1778104702500.png)


[Source](https://pixabay.com)


 

 
I put this exercise in the beginning because it is a double-edged sword. Just as it was the reason for the comfort of some injured people, it was also the reason for the development of the condition and the further deterioration of the slip. Note that many therapists prescribe it randomly, apart from their personal experiences, and to know its positive or negative role in each individual case, the injured person must be his own doctor first of all. Every movement he makes must monitor himself and the extent of his body’s response to it. The beginning of this exercise is by leaning and raising the body on the elbows using the arms only, without using the back muscles for lifting at all, and the pelvis is completely touching the ground. Hold still for 10 seconds, then lie down on the stomach for another 10 seconds. Repeat the exercise as much as possible, increasing the duration of holding this position to 5 minutes, with rest and lying down for one minute so that the injured person does not reach the stage of extreme fatigue from performing the movement.

When feeling tired, stop exercising to leave room for the muscles that were affected by the exercise to rest. After the body gets used to this position, we move the position to the more difficult option (as in the picture), which is to rest on the palms and raise the upper part of the body up using the arms. Here, extreme caution begins with the injured person. He must watch himself, as the numbness extends to the legs and is repeated after several sessions of exercise without the numbness decreasing. After getting used to the movement, he must stop exercising because it is not appropriate for the physical condition of his injury or the type and extent of his muscles. He becomes flexible and resorts to other exercises instead (we will talk about them later). Here the big mistake of some sufferers or therapists occurs. Every sufferer must listen to the sound of pain in his body and study his condition himself, as there are two types of pain: the type that starts and descends gradually until it disappears, and this type is appropriate for the injured person just like muscle pain after iron exercises. This pain is evidence of the benefit of the muscle and the beginning of its enlargement and not an injury or deterioration of the condition, that is, as we call it in common language (the muscle that does not go away after Two or three days at most) and a type that increases without decreasing. This is evidence that the exercise is not appropriate for the injured person, and he must stop before the point that it will lead to his condition deteriorating instead of improving.

Of course, I was one of the people for whom this exercise was not suitable, and it caused me more harm because I did not adhere to its conditions and monitor its direct results, but this does not negate the fact that it is one of the most important exercises that helps to reposition the slipped cartilage somewhat in its place for many injuries. Indeed, thanks to this exercise, many of the injured people returned to their semi-normal lives. As for myself, I did not have anyone to advise and warn me, so I fell into the trap of this exercise, and I do not want others to fall into this same trap...and your safety. God willing
God willing, we will complete the rest of the exercises later...
We hope that it will be of benefit to everyone, and for any inquiries, we are ready to answer in the comments. Thank you...

I offer my apologies for any errors in translation into English, as it is through a translation program to present the topic to everyone in the simplest possible way.

body.body:
> #
Retractable Reel Light
**GAMGE CHANGING FEATURE**

https://youtu.be/cHRw4Rpieio

*.  At least that's what the brand called it in their original communication.  It's basically a retractible string with led lights on it. It's about 10m long and has many lighting modes including lamp and SOS.

I can imagine this could be quite fun to use in other scenarios, including at Christmas for seasonal decorations, even though it was designed for *indoor* camping use.  I was actually considering using this as background lighting for my YouTube videos, but I've seen found another, more appropriate, light that I had but had misplaced for years.  I moved some wardrobes around today and, lo and behold, there it was wedged between the wardrobe and the wall, covered months of dust and cobwebs. 

The \

feature is its ability to retract, hereby keeping the whole setup very tidy.  One of the reasons why I don't like string lights much is the chaos that ensues when one tries to put it back in its box.  They can somehow never return to anything near their initial state.  This changes that.\n\nIt's not weather resistant enough to make it a true outdoor light. It can withstand some drizzling or occasional splash but heavy rain would ruin it.  It also cannot be submerged.  However it is marketed as an \
light, so I guess that's ok. Peace & Love, *Adé*

之前过完年换了个手机，因为是鸿蒙系统，很多app不匹配，以至于我到现在都没有登陆过币安，昨天想着把最近的hive都存进去，于是把旧手机翻出来 还好还能使用，但是vpn连不上了。

时间太久了，现在的记忆力不足以支撑我这么久不使用这个东西还能想起密码之类的，于是又去问了朋友，她马上就回复了我，匆匆忙忙重新下载翻墙软件，终于是登陆上了，操作了一番转换。

然后币安也在就手机安装上，打开以后一看，比过年那段时间价格好一丢丢，于是我把手里的hive全部存进去，后面的步骤又忘记了，换了手机之前的视频和讲解全都没了，但始终是操作过的，凭借记忆还是把步骤一点一点拾回来了。

我发现我现在的记忆力真的是衰退的厉害，先不说年龄的问题，我觉得还是受那个新冠疫苗三针科兴针的影响的，我现在的生活和状态，跟之前差的太远了，尽管我还是保持一颗少女心，一颗活跃的心态，但是身体还是有明显变化的。

我有的同事就没有打针，当时家门也不让出，她就只待在自己家，什么活动都不参加，那时候不打针不让上班不让上学，索性她就辞职，她娃因为是幼儿园基本也都请假的。我非常欣赏她的执行力，决定的事情不容易去动摇。

而我们这些听话的人却吃了大亏，我娃让我多玩玩游戏或者得找人打打牌，哈哈哈，预防老年痴呆，我说我看上去没那么糟糕吧，只是有时候思想上懒了点，不过也只是一时的，我始终还是在调整自己状态的，尽量保持积极向上，不然早废了。

---

Which comments are eligible for upvotes and which are not? Not all nominated comments will receive an upvote from Topcomment. While the concept of \

#### No upvotes for **1. Comments with hate speech, racism, conspiracy theories or other negative reactions** I strive to keep the community positive. The same applies to comments that are part of the commentrewarder initiative. **5. Giveaways or contest entries** There are some initiatives asking you to submit your entry in the comments. These are excluded from Topcomment upvotes. **6. Commenting on own blogs** Comments from bloggers on their own blog will not be upvoted. body.title: ‎The Quiet Power of Balance: My Journey to a Peaceful Life ‎
body.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎For sometimes now, I actually used to think that peace in life would come when everything was finally “in place”, when the money was enough, the work was stable, the family was settled, and all worries disappeared. 
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTECN2pWEth5NRTjtW1nKzsXJtRQd9WRo9xDJS6Qash9K/denfran-stone-tower-4519290_1920.jpg 

‎[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/stone-tower-balance-meditation-4519290/)
‎
‎But reality has a way of teaching deeper lessons. I have come to realized that a peaceful life is not about having everything perfect, but it is about finding the right balance in the midst of everything life throws at you.
‎
‎Balance is not something you can achieve once and keep forever. But it's something you keep adjusting, like a farmer carefully tending his land, knowing that too much or too little of anything can actually affect the harvest. 
‎
‎I have seen how easy it is to lean too far in one direction in my own life. There are times when work takes over everything, like chasing income, trying to meet responsibilities, and pushing myself beyond my limits. At other times, I have focused so much on rest or comfort that I began to lose productivity and direction. Neither extreme brought me peace.
‎
‎And what really changed my perspective was realizing that every important area of life deserves attention. Yes, Work is important, but so is family. Ambition matters, but so also does rest as well. Providing for loved ones is necessary, but being present with them is just as important. When one side dominates the other for too long, then something begins to break, either around you or within you.
‎
‎I have also learned that balance helps to protect the mind. When life becomes too focused on responsibilities and pressure, stress silently builds up. But when I  create time intentionally to rest, reflect, and even enjoy simple moments, I realize a difference. Because peace does not come from doing less, but it comes from knowing when to pause, when to reflect and when to push forward.
‎
‎Emotional control is another aspect about balance. Life will always bring challenges, unexpected expenses, disappointments, and tough days. But how I tackle those situations matters. Finding balance means not allowing temporary problems to steal away your long-term peace. It also means learning to stay calm in the middle of storms and not overreact to every situation.
‎
‎Balance also to  shapes relationships. Because when I give time to listen, understand, and connect with the people around me, it strengthens connections. But when I become too busy or distracted, those relationships start to weaken. Peaceful living is not  about what happens within me only, but it's also about the harmony I maintain with others.
‎
‎What I now clearly understand is that balance is not about sharing everything equally but it's about giving each part of life what it actually needs at the right time. Some days require more effort, while others require more rest. The wisdom lies in knowing the difference.
‎
‎At the end, a peaceful life is not something we find outside but it's something we build day to day through balance. When I manage my time, emotions, relationships, and responsibilities with care, I start to experience a kind of silent peace that no amount of success alone can give. And to me, that is what actually makes life enjoyable.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy/the-quiet-power-of-balance-my-journey-to-a-peaceful-life--bsg)

body.title: The Ever-Changing Face of Relevance
body.body: I often think about what it takes to succeed at something.\n\nI know we have a world full of experts who would no doubt be able to come up with all sorts of different formulaic answers for *\

*. While they may be correct, I think they often overlook what is perhaps the most significant thing, and that is *relevance.*

![CC0152-Portrait.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat.pal/23zS3AKQPfZtgvAwJm89fAYEQgrbqhZ3NKDAg8h8a9yyF87teeDsM1uywghR7PWjPLZzZ.JPG)

The thing is, it doesn't matter how great and groundbreaking a new idea might be, if it's not actually *relevant* to people in their lives and what they *need* in their lives... it's likely not going to get very far. While we might declare things *cool* and initially get involved in them for their novelty value, that won't last long if they aren't *relevant* to our world.

This is often true in the world of technology, blockchain, and crypto.

Somebody comes up with something that they claim to be a *\

* or a new way of doing things... but it quickly turns out that while the aforesaid statements might be *true*, nobody actually cares.\n\nI've personally experienced this quite a lot in the field of de-fi, where it so often seems like the *groundbreaking new ideas* smell more like *\

* than something people would actually *use*.

![CCP-000-Considers.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat.pal/Eqb2xeGPuYwLtYHPt7KZVmmX6zyqQ5QpdcpLfpj6ovRUYW14YKtMRvprbujwCMBvinK.JPG)

I've seen quite a few proposals along the way that were announced with great fanfare and I ended up thinking to myself *\

*, and the great success your promising is predicated on hundreds of thousands of users.

I'm not sure if this is some sort of weird myopia, or a total cluelessness with respect to understanding what the marketplace actually wants.

In a very distant past when I worked in the it industry, one of the things we often encountered was the fact that so many developers were completely removed from reality.

Working with usability and human factors, I often spend time as a kind of go between and liaison between developers, the marketing department, and management. And I have to say that the perceptions of each different vastly even though people purportedly were working towards the same end.

![CCP-181-AtWindow.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat.pal/243ftdmVn9j6kLPKsgcpLxTcWTTfTj6hycZkcYjpSyfvpqr7F9M7pXNayMGpoeMbiMKQ4.JPG)

I sometimes even see a variation of this unfold here on Hive. It comes up both in DHF proposals, as well as in things that have already been developed.

It is as if the new ideas exist completely independently of any kind of feasibility study or even minimal research to determine whether people actually want what's being offered.

Having spent a fair amount of time in the marketing field, as well, I can assure you that it is much easier to build something to a demand that already exists then it is to bring something completely new to market that people don't even know what's about nor how it will benefit them.

And being too myopic about what you're doing is almost a guaranteed path to failure.

*Feel free to leave a comment — this IS \

media, after all!*

body.title: El resto,  una silueta | Poesía [ES/EN]
body.body: >A Raúl, el Yuca (y a alguien más, que tiene otro nombre).* La muchacha que una vez estuvo vestida de negro, me sirve otra taza de café. Le pido un doble de aguardiente, no para tomármelo sino para darle a los santos, por aquello que dijo Raúl: comprar un trago, tirar una foto, guardarla. Él pensaba en un niño; yo, en tantas madres, padres, discursos inconsecuentes, historias en las que es mejor no pensar... Pido otro café. Me lo sirven en una taza esmaltada con plato de cerámica. Ambos elementos provienen del mismo lodo y nadie repara en su contraste. La chica se balancea frente a la barra, discute con su novio sobre algo que tiene que ver con un Chacal o un Yakarta, me da igual. Le pido otro trago, este sí es para beber, y sonrío por aquellos que no conocen a Raúl por su nombre. Al final, un nombre es ilusión. El resto, una silueta.

>¡Muchas gracias por tu visita!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6J5VsJhDbqGxF9Mu3F28qKa8xTsrJSejZ43aAKShFMB/smart_watch_2_hecho_con_postermywall_1_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUH2qcdpFJnsHFp9RpwVAzV4AsGQZLZQjYsMQdjbQcG7R/whatsapp_image_2026_04_29_at_18.21.45.jpeg)
***

>To Raúl, the Yuca (and to someone else, who has another name).* The girl who once wore black, serves me another cup of coffee. I order a double shot of aguardiente, not to drink it but to offer to the saints, for what Raúl said: buy a drink, take a picture, keep it. He was thinking of a child; I, of so many mothers, fathers, inconsequential speeches, stories that are better left unthought... I order another coffee. They serve it to me in an enameled cup with a ceramic saucer. Both elements come from the same mud and no one notices their contrast. The girl sways in front of the bar, arguing with her boyfriend about something that has to do with a Chacal or a Yakarta, it's all the same to me. I order another drink, this one is for drinking, and I smile for those who don't know Raúl by name. In the end, a name is an illusion. The rest, a silhouette.

>

body.title: Lo que montones rehuyen es que la paz es la canción y la meta subestimada  (Poesía) [ESP/ENG] What multitudes shun is that peace is the song and the underestimated goal
body.body:
Muchedumbres que confunden belleza  con tierna sabiduría y dulzura
En el alma de desesperados que no entieden la pasión que enaltece
La vida parece ensordecerles y apabullarles los sentidos con locura
La lujuria les enmudece y les pone en un solo patrón devaluado.

La conducta de miles de insensatos que nunca varía y siempre contamina
Los estresantes desvelos de mentes que se ocultan enteramente y olvidan
En razones ignoradas hay que buscar justificación y no es encontrada
Lo que montones rehuyen es que la paz es la canción y la meta subestimada.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNRSUTYNrVnrXv8wRpZ6Hmtgj5u7PSqGLhVrYdTi9GbyH/image.png)
[Origen de la imagen](https://pixabay.com/photos/people-abstract-blurry-motion-10153153/)

Modas de momentos que parecen estúpidos y absurdos relucen
Cerebros desconcertados al ver la insensatez en su salsa más espesa
Dos momentos se concentran y se pierde la razón sin conexión
Personas que no encuentran su norte y no tienen comprensión.

Todo empieza en un camino de verdes praderas que solo es artificial
En el escenario rimbombante de árboles que no prosperan por no ser de verdad
Los frutos no se hacen esperar, pero no son apetecibles y son desesperantes
Quince días de tormentas han pasado desde los momentos más debilitantes.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXMff2SHPuUK2gPbBDBGdqgAWm31deWDja8c9MuPbi5fZ/image.png)
[Origen de la imagen](https://pixabay.com/photos/flowers-pink-flowers-cosmos-meadow-8368561/)

Solo las mentes suavizadas en la razón y la emoción son contundentes
Solo los que saben que la sensatez es la primera y la final emoción emergen
Solo los que esperan sin esperar en medio de la confusión hablan y crece la solución
Son los que deben prevalecen llegada la conmoción y el momento de presión.

En caminos trillados por mi mente sé las verdadera respuestas al tema
Las preguntas no tendrían razón de ser en mi cabeza si estuviera completamente serena
Pero las pautas y los esquemas olvido a veces y me abrumo sin más
No sé cómo ni porqué esto me ha de pasar y comienzo a lamentarme. 

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZnGQgyJrZyFZQniE1P4bFrpWmXgaSYXUMdmZZRsRVJWD/image.png)
[Origen de la imagen](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-asia-portrait-lotus-vase-10164177/)

No entiendo el olvido de lo que antes veía tan claro y lúcido
Es un momento de turbación el que parece estar atando mi mente
Es oscura la notoriedad que mi atención presta al infeliz evento
Sé que he de superarlo, pero la ansiedad ya ha tomado partido. 

No hay atajos visibles, pero sabes que el camino es retomar la consciencia
No hay regalos que la situación te dé, solo debe haber evaluación y adaptación
Tomar las cosas como se dan y asumir la posición sin considerar la relación
Solo descubrir lo que no parece tener razón aparente pero es cierto sin duda ni negación.

Finalizan los momentos en tesoros y remembranzas 
Los recuerdos que aparecen en similares torbellinos
Sensaciones que prevalecen a pesar de la molestia
Cuando nuestra mente adolece de paz la esperanza parece esfumarse.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQfHHfJSfeLMC14VCCNtdG5kUhQnniwwqQdvQeHzHAXmb/image.png)
[Origen de la imagen](https://pixabay.com/photos/beauty-retouching-portrait-retouching-9943435/)

Lo que olvidé sé que lo recordaré si me tengo paciencia
Los que saben caminar en caminos de sabiduría no se estresan
Los que ven con fascinación el momento de conflicto y de complicación
Sabrán convertirse siempre en su mejor y más pura versión.

Tanto que escribir y tan poco conveniente parecen las circunstancias
La adaptación deberá prevalecer una vez más porque es la sabiduría necesaria
En el momento de sinceridad es que salen las mejores palabras inspiradas
Y los que viven intentando lograr sus buenos propósitos con sinceridad sabrán aprovechar cada ocasión.

**Poema escrito por el puño y letra de @poetisotizo.**
**Espero les haya gustado.**

_________
### English version
_________

Crowds who mistake beauty for tender wisdom and sweetness
In the souls of the desperate, who don't understand the passion that ennobles
Life seems to deafen them and overwhelm their senses with madness
Lust silences them and confines them to a single, devalued pattern.

The behavior of thousands of fools, which never varies and always contaminates
The stressful sleepless nights of minds that hide entirely and forget
Justification must be sought in ignored reasons, and it is not found
What multitudes shun is that peace is the song and the underestimated goal.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNRSUTYNrVnrXv8wRpZ6Hmtgj5u7PSqGLhVrYdTi9GbyH/image.png)
[Image source](https://pixabay.com/photos/people-abstract-blurry-motion-10153153/)

Fashions of moments that seem stupid and absurd shine
Bewildered minds seeing folly in its thickest sauce
Two moments converge, and reason is lost without connection
People who cannot find their way and have no understanding.

It all begins on a path of green meadows that are only artificial
In the bombastic setting of trees that don't thrive because they aren't real
The fruits don't take long to appear, but they aren't appetizing and are disheartening
Fifteen stormy days have passed since the most debilitating moments.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXMff2SHPuUK2gPbBDBGdqgAWm31deWDja8c9MuPbi5fZ/image.png)
[Image source](https://pixabay.com/photos/flowers-pink-flowers-cosmos-meadow-8368561/)

Only minds tempered by reason and emotion are decisive
Only those who know that reason is the first and last emotion emerge
Only those who wait without expecting, amidst the confusion, speak and the solution grows
They are the ones who must prevail when the commotion and the moment of pressure arrive.

On paths well-trodden by my mind, I know the true answers to the matter
The questions would have no reason to exist in my head if I were completely serene
But I sometimes forget the guidelines and the frameworks and I am simply overwhelmed
I don't know how or why this has to happen to me and I begin to lament.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZnGQgyJrZyFZQniE1P4bFrpWmXgaSYXUMdmZZRsRVJWD/image.png)
[Image source](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-asia-portrait-lotus-vase-10164177/)

I don't understand forgetting what I once saw so clearly and lucidly
It's a moment of turmoil that seems to be binding my mind
The attention my eye lends to this unfortunate event is obscure
I know I must overcome it, but anxiety has already taken hold.

There are no visible shortcuts, but you know the path is to regain awareness
There are no gifts the situation offers, only evaluation and adaptation
Taking things as they are and assuming the position without considering the relationship
Only discovering what seems to have no apparent reason but is true without doubt or denial.

Moments end in treasures and remembrances
Memories that appear in similar whirlwinds
Sensations that prevail despite the discomfort
When our mind lacks peace, hope seems to vanish.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQfHHfJSfeLMC14VCCNtdG5kUhQnniwwqQdvQeHzHAXmb/image.png)
[Image source](https://pixabay.com/photos/beauty-retouching-portrait-retouching-9943435/)

What I've forgotten, I know I'll remember if I'm patient with myself
Those who know how to walk the paths of wisdom don't get stressed
Those who view moments of conflict and complication with fascination 
They will always know how to become their best and purest version.

So much to write, and yet the circumstances seem so inconvenient
Adaptation must prevail once again because it is the necessary wisdom
It is in moments of sincerity that the best, most inspired words emerge
And those who live striving to achieve their good intentions with sincerity will know how to seize every opportunity.

**Poem written by the hand of @poetisotizo.**
**I hope you liked it.**

body.body:
I have a genuinely lousy short-term memory.

This is not something that has shown up in my life because I'm getting older it is something that has been with me since I was a kid.

![0805-Beach.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/EoXsDX93F5BZktgbsSsmQndWqQpcgM6BGqBNVugyznmSzdQZkLNZKWzQKynDHDZAY5B.jpg)

As I have written before, I managed to get by in life in a reasonably functional manner because I keep endless lists of everything.

It would be easy to say *\

* and just leave it at that. I have a bad memory, I keep lists, I get by. Case closed.

But it's actually not that simple, even though I wish it were.

Lists or not, having a lousy short-term memory is *exhausting!*

It is exhausting because you spend an awful lot of your life worrying about whether or not you forgotten something, and whether or not everything you needed to remember actually got written down on your list, and sometimes even worrying about whether or not you remembered your list!

![1046-Purple.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/EogPoCEfEuVnNqjCx2pU3Lo1xg9VgktJRmJirJzBXpVRwgMGEuRT19EVBjxCEC7CCzC.jpg)

What becomes exhausting is the constant *second guessing* yourself.

In my peculiar little world, this predicament is married to an almost obsessive re-checking to make sure that I actually *did* the things that I checked off my list as having done. I suppose you could claim that it's a variation of OCD-ish tendencies.

Then again, it may just be that it follows naturally from the fact that I have nearly always tested very high in terms of *\
*\n\nI often pause to think about whether this is a case of *nature* or *nurture.* While it's a popular sport for people to *\

* for everything that's not working right in their lives, I tend to shy away from that. Granted, they *were* very perfectionistic and had very high expectations of me but I don't think that's their fault exactly.

![0939-Strawflower.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23zGnpPDYmtWALSgVtjczswnjMKpJm7KjWJqDuYWGKDPj2ff83W84CXAaZoMeGCq6Ubp2.JPG)

Family lore — as told to me by other members of the family who were around at the time — suggest that I was always an anxious baby, even when I was in the crib. And that was long before expectations of others were imprinted on me.

Why do I even *care* about all this stuff?

I guess it's my own version of coming up with *\

* that somehow make my existence a little bit easier. And because it bothers me that I spend so much time feeling emotionally exhausted... which means I am less productive, which leads to my beating myself up for being *\

* because I don't get things done.

Thanks for stopping by, and have a great Friday!

真的很忙，从昨天都开始返回郑州了，早晨起的早早的就去了医院，拿很多常用的药和胰岛素之类的，准备了冰块，胰岛素需要冷藏携带，准备了一个月的用量，没有做复查，复查比拿药还花钱多，我的钱不够用，就只拿了药，没有做复查，穷人，就是维持，维持基本的生命特征。

body.body:
First, I'm not endorsing violent uprising.  I'm certain it's going to happen, because that's what happens when corruption becomes intolerable.  In the 17th Century the Dutch killed, cooked, and ate the liver of their despised Prime Minister.  Saying that isn't endorsing cannibalism.  Rather I lament that the execrable corrupt rulers we get when we accept rulers indoctrinate and blow smoke up our skirts until we can't agree water is wet.  The only time things change is when we are so outraged we cannot tolerate that corruption anymore, and mobs slaughter anyone they think did them dirty.

Something you don't acknowledge is that you are permanently sovereign, and only you can rule you.  Only you can will your heavy hand to rise to your weary brow and wipe away the dripping sweat of your hard labor.  You, and you alone, will rule you while you live.  If the history you know has taught you anything, it will include that institutions created to govern all become corrupted, and all end the same way, collapsing and being replaced by the next mob boss.

I am not propounding my preferred vision of society when I talk about decentralization.  I'm talking about physics.  The laws of physics determine what technology can be invented, and we clever monkeys tinker and occasionally invent it.  You can observe that the laws of physics are today decentralizing production on the battlefields of the world at war today.  <$50k drones are defeating >$B weapons platforms, and last month <$100 manpads grannies can print on their kitchen tables, like knitting doilies, advented that enable communities and even individuals to be secure from $50k drones and $B bombers alike.  We see this first on the battlefield, but the same thing's happening in every field of industry today.  

That's not my preference.  It's not my vision.  It's what the laws of physics mandate.  The last oil we're going to get from the ME has been delivered.  A lot of the infrastructure to produce oil has been destroyed, and will take years (years without war) before it can be rebuilt, and the war is still ongoing, the Strait of Hormuz is still closed.  The costs of that shortfall haven't begun yet, but they are guaranteed because that shortfall has occurred.  70% of American farmers haven't planted crops because they can't get the fertilizer to grow them.  Farmers in OZ have left crops to rot in the field because they can't get diesel to harvest them.  The goods and services that are necessary to us to enjoy the blessings of civilization are going to be short this fall.  

It doesn't matter that we're lazy.  It matters that we eat.  Them that will eat are growing food today.  We'll either make what we need or we won't get what we need, and we'll die.  It doesn't matter what I prefer.  It matters that I do what I need to do to live.  That's what's coming.  If someone comes to harm you, and you haven't prepared to secure yourself from harm, it will be your fault you governed yourself so poorly as to fail to defend you.  If they come for your granddaughter and you can't defend her, it will be your fault if she's harmed.  It doesn't matter what you like, or don't like, to do with your tools and time.  It matters whether or not you secure you, yours, and have people you protect that protect you.  

You govern you, whether you want to or not.  Anyone that says they govern you is a liar.  Because you have the authority to rule you, you are responsible for your rule.  As your ruler you are responsible for your security, and nothing anyone says otherwise is true.  

The folks that accept their responsibility and rule themselves wisely will secure them and theirs from armed thugs.  Folks always do, or they die.  Them that do will be those that build society after all the brigands, robbers, and psychopaths have been dealth with, and they will have produced themselves the goods and services that enabled them to live, and secure themselves.  Those are just predictable from the coming consequences of shutting down the Strait of Hormuz.

Live and die as you please. I am no prophet, not your master, and neither dependent on what you do.  You are.  Your grand daughter is.  You depend on your sight, your laziness or industry, and so does your granddaughter. I hope you see clearly and act wisely to create your security so that your granddaughter doesn't come to grief, because I think you're a kind person, and I want my sons to have kind people to work with after this.

Please do.

body.title: In preparation for the workshop, the Indonesian Environmental Forum in Aceh held an audience with this figure
body.body:
![Walhi_02.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvpEaEsMrMVSgyKWB6ks1mYFdCugHjLWXQAJDp9yt8KK/Walhi_02.jpg)
***

Banda Aceh — The Indonesian Forum for the Environment (WALHI Aceh) held an audience with the Wali Nanggroe Aceh, His Excellency Tgk. Malik Mahmud Al Haythar, to finalize preparations for the seminar and workshop to be held in Sabang City at the end of April 2026.

The Head of Cooperation and Public Relations for Wali Nanggroe, Zulfikar Idris, stated that the meeting took place in Meuligoe Wali Nanggroe on Friday afternoon, April 17, 2026.

The audience was led by WALHI Aceh's Executive Director, Ahmad Shalihin, along with several administrators and members, namely Munawir Abdullah, Afiffuddin, Nisrina Nur Afifaf, and M. Dahlan.

The Wali Nanggroe was accompanied by Special Staff Dr. Muhammad Raviq.

Ahmad Shalihin explained that the meeting aimed to discuss plans for a workshop and invited the Wali Nanggroe (National Guardian) as the keynote speaker. The event will highlight strategic environmental issues in Aceh, including an evaluation of the Sabang Area Business Agency (BPKS), which has been in operation for approximately 26 years since its inauguration.

\

said Ahmad Shalihin.

He added that the discussion was crucial for assessing the impact of policies and management of the Sabang area on environmental aspects and sustainable development.

In response, the Wali Nanggroe welcomed the planned event initiated by WALHI Aceh. He even expressed his commitment to supporting the discussion forum as a space for exchanging ideas on the future direction of environmental policy in Aceh.

In April and May 2026, a legal conflict escalated between crypto entrepreneur **Justin Sun** and **World Liberty Financial (WLFI)**, a digital currency venture co-founded by **Donald Trump** and his sons. The dispute involves two separate lawsuits—one filed by Sun and a countersuit filed by World Liberty.

### **Sun's Lawsuit (April 2026)**
On April 21, 2025, Justin Sun filed a federal lawsuit in **California** against World Liberty Financial, alleging the following:
*   **Illegal Account Freezing:** Sun claimed the company illegally froze his holdings of approximately **4 billion WLFI tokens**, which were worth roughly **$320 million** at the time.
*   **Secret Control Tools:** The suit alleged that World Liberty secretly installed tools to block the sale of Sun's tokens and even threatened to **\

** (permanently delete) them, even while they were in his private digital wallet.
*   **Extortion Allegations:** Sun alleged the company froze his assets after he refused their repeated demands to invest an additional **$200 million** into a secondary stablecoin called **USD1**.
*   **Governance Stripping:** Sun claimed he was stripped of his voting and governance rights without a vote from token holders.

### **World Liberty Financial's Countersuit (May 2026)**
On May 4, 2026, World Liberty Financial filed a **defamation lawsuit** against Sun in **Florida** state court. Their primary claims include:
*   **Public Smear Campaign:** The venture accused Sun of launching a coordinated campaign to **\

the market price of the WLFI token through false statements on social media.
*   **Token Misconduct:** World Liberty alleged that Sun improperly transferred tokens to the **Binance** exchange and engaged in **short-selling** (betting against the token's value) to push prices down.
*   **Contractual Rights:** The company maintained that its ability to freeze tokens was clearly disclosed in the original **Terms of Sale** and was used to protect the ecosystem from Sun's alleged misconduct.

### **Current Status**
Sun has publicly dismissed World Liberty's defamation lawsuit as a **\
** and stated he looks forward to defeating the case in court. As of early May 2026, both cases are ongoing in their respective jurisdictions in California and Florida.

![quick one.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaY7mhb7cgCptWS3ninbLZDcypqEdHwxxzvhTBQPmoU3d/quick%20one.jpg)
Hey everyone,
I'm here to share some of the challenges we digital artists face. While I was quickly redrawing an old imaginary painting, I was in such a hurry that I forgot to save the project file and only saved the image. I was so distraught that I immediately got chills. All that work, all that time, all those layers... Gone!
We don't only lose files by this method. Sometimes files crash if they become too large or detailed. Or you start a project without starting the time-lapse recording. There are so many ways to easily lose files digitally.  
>Hola a todos,
Estoy aquí para compartir algunos de los retos a los que nos enfrentamos los artistas digitales. Mientras redibujaba rápidamente un viejo cuadro imaginario, tenía tanta prisa que me olvidé de guardar el archivo del proyecto y solo guardé la imagen. Me sentí tan angustiado que enseguida se me puso la piel de gallina. Todo ese trabajo, todo ese tiempo, todas esas capas... ¡Perdido!
No solo perdemos archivos de esta manera. A veces los archivos se bloquean si se vuelven demasiado grandes o detallados. O empiezas un proyecto sin iniciar la grabación del lapso de tiempo. Hay muchas formas de perder archivos digitalmente con facilidad.

While most people are busy buying the top, I look for the exhaustion point.\n​My recent performance—hitting +1,420% in 30 days—isn't about luck. It’s about a disciplined \

strategy. Here is how I do it:
​My Strategic Blueprint: The Short-Squeeze Hunt
​I don't just gamble; I follow a specific mechanical process:
​Scanning the Heat: I identify coins that are currently trending and have already pumped hundreds of percent. These are high-volatility targets.
​Identifying \

body.body:
![david-clode-r71alYDBEbU-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/Eo8RLkwaUdJ3YFVowaZ6wow9bh1fGxLxo3o1jZFTZ9JG9up7v4BoQuXRNzLDBZLTAnn.jpg)

> Not long ago, this planet of havenworlders saved a human who had, had a cheese-grater landing. If not for these beings, the human, fortunately the only occupant of that freighter, would not have survived. Then raiders came to harm these people. And the humans showed what gratitude for kindness earns. -- Anon Guest

[AN: May be in relation to: [https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04839-m090-waif-and-stray](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04839-m090-waif-and-stray) ]

Hal was learning a lot of things. Starting with the fact that aliens were real _and_ that a lot of them were more harmless than the average Human. The surprising part was that there were other Human worlds, stations, and settlements all over the known universe. Lots of them had banded together to form some kind of fellowship, but they were also friends with a whole bunch of aliens.

He also figured out that he couldn't go back to his world and tell the people there that. Hal's home was isolated and would panic if actual real live aliens showed up. He might even be considered 'polluted' or 'infected' by the alien forces.

They might even think he had been copied or... taken over by the aliens.

It might be better if his world thought he'd died with the rest of them. His world was not ready to know about the Galactic Alliance. They might be ready in a century or two of various revelations, sightings, and benevolent close encounters.

Hal spent a week worrying why he wasn't so disturbed by that thought. Maybe it was because he'd already expected to die on the planet. Maybe it was because he expected the nice lizards to eat him, still. _Maybe_ it was because all the people he'd known were on board the ship with him when it crashed. Or it might be because the vegetarian lizards were nicer to him than anyone in his life before that day.

A couple more weeks into the trip to a better place, Hal realised that his health was improving beyond what he was used to at home. He was stronger, faster, more agile. Heck, he was quicker on the uptake when he was learning things.

These lizards were good to him, _and_ for him.

Which was why, when the raiders attacked the vessel, Hal picked up the nearest heavy object and brought it smashing into the first invader's helmet. He didn't stop swinging until the raiders disconnected and fled.

Panting, trembling, twitching, Hal put the item down. \

He barely made it to the hygiene facilities in time. He'd later learn that his weapon _had_ been bolted to the bulkhead before Hal ripped it off.

Which explained why his muscles were all knots when he was done getting over his adrenaline rush. And why all the nice lizard people were afraid of him.

Hal defaulted to hiding in the most sheltered corner of his sleep nook, wrapped over with a blanket so that most of him was hidden. Being as still and quiet as possible so that nobody would be mad at him.

Crillut crept softly towards Hal's bunk. \
\n\nThe last batch of Humans that Hal knew hadn't been as nice. \
\n\nHal let himself shake, but they were aftershocks from everything else. \

body.body: />Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing great and welcome to another #Splinterlands post. Today I played one of the weirdest and most intense battles I had in a long time in Splinterlands. Honestly when the match started, I already thought I was going to lose because my opponent had 6 units while I only had 3 units on the battlefield. Usually when you are outnumbered like that, the chances of winning becomes very low. But somehow my fire team survived and turned the battle around. This battle lasted for 6 rounds, and from round 4 till the end, one of my monsters basically did a crazy 1 vs 4 comeback against the enemy team. I was actually shocked while watching it happen lol. The battle reminded me why I still enjoy #Splinterlands so much. Sometimes strategy matters more than numbers. When the battle loaded in, I looked at the enemy lineup and instantly got worried. My opponent had a full team with lots of damage dealers while my lineup looked very small and risky. I decided to go with a Fire element team because I felt speed and damage would help me survive longer. My idea was simple: * Try to remove enemy damage dealers quickly * Depend on one strong carry monster * Hope for lucky dodges and positioning Not gonna lie, it felt like gambling.

> I used only 3 monsters, but each one had an important role. One monster was there mainly to absorb early damage while the other two were my real win condition. The MVP of the battle was absolutely the last surviving monster that carried the fight from round 4 onward. At first the battle was looking pretty normal. Enemy attacks were landing hard and I was losing health quickly. My opponent also had more control of the battlefield because of having double the monsters. But then things slowly started changing. One enemy monster got eliminated earlier than expected, and suddenly the pressure became lower. That gave me a tiny bit of hope. The battle completely changed around round 3 and 4. At this point, one of my monsters went down and it became a much harder fight. But the remaining monster started carrying insanely hard. My opponent still had 4 monsters alive. FOUR. And somehow my unit kept winning exchanges one after another. Dodges, attacks, timing, everything started going perfectly for me. This is honestly one of those battles where you just sit and stare at the screen because you cannot believe what is happening.

> By round 5, I was fully locked in watching every attack animation 😂 At this stage my last surviving monster was basically fighting alone against multiple enemies. Every attack mattered. One miss could have lost me the game. But somehow the attacks kept connecting perfectly and enemy monsters slowly disappeared one after another. When the final enemy monster died, I actually laughed because I still could not believe I won that fight. It felt like an anime comeback honestly lol.

></center>

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

Today’s session was actually very fun because of this battle alone. Even if I played only one match like this the whole day, I would still be satisfied.

Winning with only 3 monsters against 6 feels amazing, especially when the battle goes multiple rounds and becomes super close near the end.

I am definitely going to remember this match for some time.

Now I just hope I can continue climbing without getting destroyed in the next few games lol.

Anyway, that was my grind today. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.title: Growth Might Not Always Feel Good But It Always Worth It
body.body:
You know that feeling when life just seems to push you into the deep end, and you’re left flailing, wondering if you’ll ever come out the other side? Yeah… that’s growth. One of the most important lessons I’ve learned is that growth, is as they say it, it might notalways feel good, but it’s always worth it and it is true.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNUV761mEmme4H3TwH4cLzEmQgd4y4MRtbmRGn4ChDRZj/1000212983.jpg 

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/agriculture-rice-plantation-thailand-1807581/)

I won’t lie,  it can be messy. Sometimes it feels uncomfortable,  Sometimes it stretches you beyond what you thought you could handle. There have been moments when I wanted to give up, when the challenge felt way bigger than me, when I thought, “Why is this so hard?” And in the middle of it, growth can feel almost invisible, like you’re trudging through mud without moving forward at all.

But here is the thing that I learnt, that discomfort, that awkward, tiring, confusing stretch, that is exactly where change is happening. Every challenge, every misstep, every moment that pushes you outside your comfort zone is shaping you into someone stronger, wiser, and more aligned with who you’re meant to be. Growth isn’t neat or linear, It doesn’t follow a perfect plan. It doesn’t come with a guarantee that you will see immediate results. And yet, when you look back, you start to notice the subtle ways you have been transformed.

I’ve also learned that growth can’t be rushed. Life has its own timeline, and sometimes you just have to let it unfold, even if it’s uncomfortable. Trusting the process is hard, especially when all you want is certainty, but that’s where the magic happens. Even pain has lessons to teach. Even failure becomes a stepping stone. Even uncertainty can guide you toward clarity.

Every time I’ve faced the unknown and leaned into it, I’ve discovered strength I didn’t know I had. I’ve learned resilience. I’ve become more patient with myself. I’ve realized that the most uncomfortable moments often lead to the most profound transformation.

So if life is stretching you right now, if you’re in the middle of a messy, confusing, uncomfortable season, remember this, that is exactly where growth lives. Lean into it, trust yourself, and trust the process. It might not feel good today, but down the road, it will be worth it, and you will be so glad you didn’t give up.





**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

body.title: A Note Left on the Chair's Desk
body.body:
# A Note Left on the Chair's Desk

*The institution that invented forward guidance is about to lose its voice. Here's what the building is thinking.*

---

**May 8, 2026 · Monetary Policy**

---

Fifty-two years. That's roughly how long it has been since the Federal Reserve last faced four dissents in a single meeting. October 1992. The Greenspan era, early days. The economy coming out of a shallow recession, the committee fractious about the pace of recovery. It was a different institution in a different country facing a different set of problems. The comparison is instructive not because history rhymes — it doesn't, not cleanly — but because four dissents is a number that means something. It means the center is not holding.

Last Wednesday's April 29th meeting was Jerome Powell's last as chair. He held the fed funds rate at 3.50–3.75%, which everyone expected, which the CME FedWatch priced at 100% probability the morning of. The unanimous part ended there. Three officials voted to strip the statement of any \

— the coded language signaling that cuts remain on the table. One official, Stephen Miran, dissented the other direction, pushing for an immediate reduction. Four dissents. The most since 1992. Powell stood at the podium and congratulated his successor on clearing the Senate Banking Committee the same afternoon. The central bank of the United States, in the span of a single press conference, buried one era and nervously inaugurated another.

Kevin Warsh takes the chair in June. He is, by training and temperament, a market man. He served on the Board from 2006 to 2011 — he was there for the crisis, which should count for something — and has since spent the intervening years as a fellow at the Hoover Institution, writing op-eds, advising private equity, and nursing views about monetary policy that put him, broadly, in the easier-money camp. In November he published a piece in the Wall Street Journal calling Trump's deregulatory agenda the most significant since Reagan. That was not an accident of phrasing.

The uncomfortable truth about Warsh's situation, which the Natixis economist Christopher Hodge put plainly, is that he may be the least influential Fed chair in decades. The chair controls the agenda. The chair has one vote. And right now the committee has three officials who don't want to signal cuts, one who wants them immediately, and a former chair who has publicly said he's staying on the board until Trump's legal threats against the institution are \

This is not a well-oiled consensus machine. This is a governing committee that is also quietly a constitutional standoff.

---

| | |
|---|---|
| **Fed funds rate** | 3.50–3.75% — held at April 29 meeting |
| **April 29 dissents** | 4 — most since October 1992 |
| **10-year Treasury (post-meeting)** | 4.42% — one-month high |
| **CME hike odds by year-end** | ~17% hike / 12.6% cut |
| **Warsh confirmation** | Senate Banking Committee cleared, party-line |

---

Into this walks the April jobs report, released this morning at 8:30.

Consensus was somewhere between 55,000 and 120,000 depending on who you asked, which is an unusually wide spread and reflects something honest: nobody actually knows what April looks like. The ADP number came in at 109,000 — better than feared, buoyed by education and healthcare, with professional and business services down 8,000. March's headline was 178,000, but that was inflated by strike-return effects in healthcare. The underlying monthly average since January is 68,000. Real average hourly earnings fell 0.6% in March when you adjust for the CPI surge driven by energy. Wage growth of 3.5% annually sounds fine until oil-driven inflation is running above it. Real purchasing power for the average American worker has effectively flatlined.

The Fed knows all of this. The three dissents on the easing bias were not from people who think the economy is strong. They were from people who think inflation is the more urgent variable, that the Iran war has structurally changed the energy price environment in ways that a cut — or even the signal of a cut — would make worse. Alberto Musalem, St. Louis Fed president, said this week that risks have \
that rates may need to stay on hold \

That is not a man preparing to ease.\n\nMeanwhile Warsh, who will chair his first meeting on June 17th, has spent years arguing for a more aggressive posture on inflation and a more market-sensitive Fed. The specific shape of his views — does he cut because Trump wants him to, or does he tighten because inflation demands it, or does he simply inherit a committee that won't move regardless of what he wants — is genuinely unclear. Senator Elizabeth Warren called him a \

during confirmation hearings. His supporters say he'll be independent. Both things might be true at different moments. The mortgage rate swings alone tell the story of how little clarity the market has: the 30-year fixed fell to 6.23% last week after touching 6.46% earlier in the month. Bond traders are not pricing a coherent view. They're pricing confusion.

Here is what the Fed is actually confronting. A labor market that is cooling but not breaking. Inflation that is structurally elevated by a war that has not ended, mediated by an oil price that fell 7% on Wednesday on peace hopes and then rose again Thursday when U.S. destroyers took fire in the Strait of Hormuz. A new chair who inherits four dissenters, a former chair with a board seat and a lawyer, and a White House that has made clear it views the institution as a policy lever. A preliminary benchmark revision that wiped 911,000 jobs from the March 2025 count. Data that is noisier than usual because of a 43-day government shutdown, strike distortions, and war-related sectoral dislocations.

The Fed's credibility rests on one thing: that when it says something about the future, markets believe it. Forward guidance works when the institution is coherent. Four dissents, a leadership transition, a geopolitical price shock, and a White House openly hostile to the institution's independence are not a recipe for coherence. They are a recipe for the kind of muddled, reactive policy-making that defined the 1970s — not because inflation will necessarily spiral, but because the signal-to-noise ratio at the world's most important central bank is the worst it has been in a generation.

The April payrolls number drops this morning. If it's weak enough to revive cut pricing, Musalem and his fellow dissenters will say the inflation picture hasn't changed. If it's strong enough to revive hike bets, Miran will say policy is already too tight. Either way, Powell walks out of the building for the last time as chair having presided over the most operationally fragmented FOMC since the early Greenspan years.

Warsh walks in on June 17th.

The chair controls the agenda. One vote.

---
 Not investment advice*

body.title: How to Borrow Against Your Hive Without Ever Selling It
body.body:
## Hive Comunity Bank (HCB)

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfPixydvUJSnJ2Dzw48wcuKJRZ7RcU5kVTEHMoKRWazHv/Screenshot%202026-05-07%20at%209.12.13%E2%80%AFPM.png 


Most people think that if you need cash, you have to sell your Hive. But when you sell, you have to pay taxes, and you lose out if the price goes up later. We created a new way to get money called **Hive Community Bank (HCB)**. 

With this plan, the bank **never** sells your Hive. We keep it safe while you get the cash you need.
#
 

---

### 1. How the Money Works
This isn't like a normal bank loan where the price changes all the time.
*   **Get Cash Fast:** You can borrow up to half the value of your Hive right away.
*   **SAFE KEEPING:** Your Hive stays in the bank's wallet, locked up as Hive Power. We don't sell any of it to pay for the loan.
*   **Fair Prices:** At the start, you pay a one-time fee of 7.5% of what you borrowed. After that, you only pay 1% of what you borrowed each year. This price stays the same even if Hive’s price zooms to the moon!
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTJ9fdmJSrmwcMP4PBBrFMcd26cQnQUFe7SDTdsbMhkGz/Screenshot%202026-05-07%20at%208.59.38%E2%80%AFPM.png 


### 2. The \

(No Taxes!)
Usually, if a bank sells your Hive to pay for interest, the government takes a cut in taxes. We fixed that.
*   **The Second Loan:** Every year, the bank gives you a tiny second loan to cover the 1% interest.
*   **Paying It Back:** You use that tiny loan to pay the interest immediately.
*   **No Tax Man:** Because you didn't \

anything, you don't owe taxes. Your total debt grows a little bit, but your Hive stays exactly where it is.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXNwHxjA4vt2gpWaCtZj2PUpprUGuoFTDsqCUMWsDGYzP/Screenshot%202026-05-07%20at%209.02.33%E2%80%AFPM.png 

### 3. No Scary \

(computers that watch the price every second). If the price drops for even a minute, they sell your Hive. **We don't do that.**
*   **Yearly Check-in:** Since your interest is already paid for a year in advance, we only check the price once a year.
*   **Relaxed Rules:** If the price drops suddenly, we don't panic and sell your coins. We give the market time to grow back.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQhg8wsQbRpx7WsRm3cP6jL4fRrLD8JZyHvLRJcRPPKZw/Screenshot%202026-05-07%20at%209.05.41%E2%80%AFPM.png 

### 4. Getting Your Hive Back
Our goal is to make sure you keep your Hive for a long, long time.
*   **Paying the Loan:** When you are ready, you can pay back the money using cash from your job or business. Once you pay, you get **100%** of your Hive back.
*   **Keep the Gains:** If Hive goes up in value over 5 or 10 years, you keep all that extra money. You only owe us the original amount you borrowed plus the small interest fees.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaRm89LnXCmc4vGJj2JxjVzVJqABMS3Q2iyEQLh61ufS6/Screenshot%202026-05-07%20at%209.06.59%E2%80%AFPM.png 

---

> **The HCB Promise:** We never sell your Hive. We use a smart loop to pay the fees so you stay safe from taxes and market crashes.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ96SKBR12YfMTtfdK9Fr4AxQsGGp57F4xs2p8x9HbF6r/Gemini_Generated_Image_md438gmd438gmd43.png 
---

### Appendix: Strengths and Weaknesses

**Top 5 Strengths**
1.  **No Taxes:** You don't have to pay the government because you never sold your coins.
2.  **No Panic Selling:** We don't watch the price every second, so \

won't lose you your coins.
3.  **Keep Your Coins:** 100% of your Hive stays in the bank's wallet as Hive Power.
4.  **Locked-In Prices:** Your yearly fee is based on what you first borrowed, not the higher future price of Hive.
5.  **Easy to Manage:** You don't have to send us monthly checks; the system handles the interest for you.

**Top 5 Weaknesses**
1.  **Growing Debt:** Your total bill grows a little bit every year. If Hive's price stays flat for a long time, you might eventually owe more than the coins are worth.
2.  **Bank Health:** The bank needs to be able to get cheap loans from bigger banks to make this work.
3.  **Rules Might Change:** Governments might make new laws about these types of loans in the future.
4.  **Limited Spots:** The bank needs a lot of extra cash to pay the interest for everyone, so not everyone can join at once.
5.  **Trust:** You have to trust the bank to keep your Hive safe in their wallet (\
