body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777872737999-24b6314327a2791e.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sagarkothari88/0ce2c1a4)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sagarkothari88/0ce2c1a4)


---

## Distriator Backend (distrion-backend)

### Review Questionnaire Update

- Updated review questionnaire for detailed reviews.
- Improved structure to capture more meaningful user feedback.

---

### User Management: Auto-Approve and Flag Propagation

- feat(manage-users): add auto-approve toggle and flag propagation across collections.
- Added flag/unflag APIs:
  - Toggle `requiresManualApproval` for:
    - Users  
    - Business Owners  
    - Guides  


- Introduced shared helper:
  - Propagates flag state across all related collections:
    - User  
    - Guide  
    - BusinessOwner  


- Fixed reward auto-approval logic:
  - Now checks flag status across all collections instead of a single role.


- API enhancements:
  - Included `requiresManualApproval` field in list APIs.  
  - Trigger Discord alerts when flag status changes.  


Admin Flag Toggle Backend Flow

![Flag user Api docs](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/241trBgsLb37vpLrpJgyjjsU7e9FaLHFReCosiQiGinARJrNtjXcmGRacW6LbxjdKuVoT.png)

![Unflag user Api docs](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/EppQXbmNbwgypKRkb7yLpkXfHaeSMsTXy2gDtE9sjYQG8aT7SQJhfwVd6wZ4iqE1avo.png)


---

## Distriator Frontend

### Review System Improvements

- fix(reviews): increase validation thresholds and add image fallback.
- Updated validation rules:
  - Minimum 30 characters for answers  
  - Minimum 40 characters for main review  


- Ensured:
  - Validation messages  
  - Character counters  
  - Submit button states  
  remain fully synchronized with new thresholds.



- Media handling improvements:
  - Added image proxy fallback using `stripHiveImageProxy` in review preview modal.  
  - Prevented infinite retry loops.  
  - Ensured proper reset when navigating images.  


Review Validation UI with Counters
![Review Validation UI with Counters](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23tGTQBcXhs1Zm3jg4JXj7G1qeEg5SMSfYxvSDCtBaPpyd1cK75yxC1eiFQmHoNQ7SfgV.png)


Image Fallback in Review Preview
![Image Fallback in Review Preview](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23swg56njrX7BBJ5gtxS8HWsyLdWA9gzmwUidGb3Za4Ft9HdpxxYAxD4Jcj8p7j936AWg.png)


---

### User Management UI Enhancements

- feat(manage-users): add Auto Approve toggle with full UI integration.
- Replaced flag button with Auto Approve toggle (ON/OFF).
- Extended role types and UI state to support `requiresManualApproval`.


- Integrated APIs:
  - Connected flag/unflag endpoints with optimistic UI updates.  
  - Added confirmation dialog for better control.  


- UI improvements:
  - Stacked action layout for better readability.  
  - Mobile dropdown support for improved responsiveness.  


Auto Approve Toggle in User Management UI

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/Eo8K7cuFCPQUzicEMXwFopBdeZfUAiT1stX9atgC5VhS9hU6gELDkYedhiX7dYamNgR.png)


---


## Powering the Hive Ecosystem

- Continuously improving Hive applications with a focus on stability, performance, and scalability  
- Contributing to open-source development and building reusable solutions for the community  
- Working towards a stronger, more accessible, and feature-rich Hive ecosystem

## Hello everyone!!! 
### I hope so you all are fine and happy 😀 

I don't know why but this generation kids want to copy each other that if she has a doll then I want the same doll too and if she has a pink Barbie bag then i want to take this too. And now parents have to fulfill these small wishes too but really I can't understand the behavior of kids. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXJ1XEQkEHYZfHP3T97QyinQgkpA9QzWbvWq8micvxfeR/1778219767524.jpg)


Two weeks ago, we attended a birthday party of my cousin's daughter and she's from a rich family that she can afford a big party at home and more decorations and she put the theme of [K-pop demon hunter Netflix series. ](https://peakd.com/hive-190931/@les90/phone-photography-contest-round-110)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdGkcb6pdRy8deNonQfpekfu8gc3SWHLv6SizT8fnQkC2/1778219566911.jpg)

Now a week ago my two other kids in my family who have birthday, now they want to celebrate it too and they copy the pink purple theme but keep it at simple. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbfDoEfW8VX4twsVC3HFVRQ7PfSDxRjY1Ggpy8Y5Lgosa/1778219575813.jpg)

body.title: You Cannot Skip The Process And Expect The Result
body.body:
>

A few years back, there was a time I went to visit one of my Aunties who was a professional cake baker. So in one of the times, I joined her to bake, and I observed how she follows the processes. She would first turn the margarine and the sugar until a certain consistency, then she would sift in the flour, and then cream it until a certain level. Then she would add egg, and other ingredients. I then asked her why she did not put everything at once and turn, since they would still be put inside. She smiled and said that in order for her to get the right result, they she has to follow the required process. That statement made so much meaning to me even beyond the cake baking. In life, if you must arrive at a result, then you have to be willing and ready to follow the required process.

<center>![pexels-maltelu-5310563.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbMTLmF3xyFaMgCZHqbVjRAbTg1AUvv8CFMQJ33MSgfj7/pexels-maltelu-5310563.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/crop-man-drawing-on-whiteboard-during-financial-training-5310563)</sub></center>

In life, every meaningful result that you want to get has a process behind it. Things like success, growth, improvement, mastery, etc, are not gotten by accident but by following the process. That is, by consistent efforts, which includes sacrifices, learning, patience, and discipline. It is ironic that a lot of people want the result without following the process. They want quick success without working for it, and they want progress without consistency. How will someone want to harvest what they have not even planted? Imagine dreaming of rewards or the prize, yet you have not paid the price? The level of results you need will be determined by your commitment to follow after the process.

The process is actually what prepares you for the result. It has a way of developing your skills, strengthening your mindset, and building your character. Without following the process, no matter how big your dream may be, it may just end up as mere wishes. A lot of the many struggles and difficulties that people experience in life are not necessarily about the largeness of the tasks at hand, but simply because they did not follow the right process. Imagine if you are climbing the staircase and you are stretching your legs to take it 3 steps at a time. You will become tired easily, and it will even be so difficult to climb, and will ultimately slow you down. But if you climb one step at a time, it will be easier, and you will even be faster, and you will achieve the required result.

One of the reasons why people skip the process is because of impatience. In the world we live in, almost everything is becoming fast and instant, so much that has made people to look for quick result. They even tend to compare themselves with others, and feel sad and frustrated if progress seems slow. But what they fail to understand is that building success can take time. Even what may look like an \

could be months or years of intense work and sacrifices. That is, what you can see on the outside could be what took years to prepare for.
![pexels-silverkblack-23496678.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfHAQ1feszsmnp2CJacpW1k8f3eoeJwVcsP2nTnNwepsM/pexels-silverkblack-23496678.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-group-of-people-at-a-table-with-a-laptop-23496678)
While following the process, it may require you to give up your comfort at some points. This is because it will require discipline, persistence, sacrifices, and repetition. There might even be moments of failed attempts, frustration, and boredom. Some people tend to avoid these and opt for shortcuts, but at the end, they would discover that they have also missed the result. Shortcuts may bring temporary results, but if you want long-term success, then you have to follow the process. It is by following the due process that you will lay a solid foundation on which the success will be built on. Following the process also teaches resilience and patience. When you work through challenges, it will teach you how to adapt, how to improve, and how to keep going even in the midst of difficulties. These lessons are very valuable, even as valuable as the final results itself. You have to understand that who you become during the process holds more importance than even the reward you eventually receive. This is why you have to trust the process even if it takes a while or it seems gradual. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

body.title: Splinterlands: Winning because I had the higher level card
body.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I saw a battle where I saw a new ruleset.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>
![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23w2HBpN1zZoBoXQNu1ndz9gpir74jnsP5K47FMbz78pTjF46y5w8iAGxrhiS6DQDmRGY.png)</center>

The rulesets this time are Up Close & Personal and Born Again. This means that only melee monsters can be used, and all monsters gain the rebirth ability. There is also 27 mana available, and I can use only fire [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter).

It's an interesting fight since we are limited to a single splinter type and melee monsters.

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Barthalamas|6|Summoner|+1 speed|
|Frankarsgard|7|1st||
|Chaos Furybringer|6|2nd|Reach|
|Echelon|4|3rd|Opportunity|
|Ember Roast Sow|4|4th|Sneak|
|Total Mana:|27|||

My summoner is Barthalamas for the +1 speed. I have Frankarsgard as my tank. After that is Chaos Furybringer with reach. Following that, I have Echelon and Ember Roast Sow.

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. Frank and Chaos were my definite picks, but I only had 8 mana after picking those 2. So I ended up choosing the two 4 mana monsters because they could potentially keep Chaos longer if my opponent has sneak or opportunity.

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tvkseeSU179ShuyxLbkNa3DQwpvigbh5HMkSSPTCag5hAhvPPnGu8GHw2Q46SaEDDo7.png)
At first glance, I think that I have the advantage. My Chaos Furybringer is higher level, and that taunt monster will just attract my last two monsters. In a showdown between our first two monsters, my monsters should win due to the level advantage.

### Round 4

![round 4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tmNDJQPy7i7sGhatBLTf1fUehs4kWEEPAYiUbbHC6kHKtnf6wBkBr8EZmCjAQHau1k6.png)
A few rounds later, my opponent has lost his tank, and I still have a healthy lineup. This is my win because my opponent can't dodge my Chaos Furybringer.

![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tvkxQ78y1AUQyJ9MgVYcM33DRgRodtcphhV1Q2pwvMtXCVymECuuSj3wimWFYkp5g7r.png)
I won a round later.

## Conclusion
The battle did not go exactly as planned. I had Chaos Furybringer at max level, and my opponent had one level less. This gave my lineup one mroe extra damage, and it made my Chaos Furybringer faster than my opponent's. It gave me an easy win due to this.

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_a695082c4fb0186a1db785cc698b7a8a?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@jfang003/splinterlands-winning-because-i-had-the-higher-level-card-aqg)

body.title: #82 Maryja Płaszczem Okryta
body.body:
# Jedna tajemnica
Wschód i Zachód. Dwa płuca, które pompują to samo powietrze, każde na swój sposób. Co jednak jest w tych płucach? Germanie wołają: Schutzmantelmadonna — Madonna w płaszczu ochronnym, Madonna w sztormiaku. Na wschodzie: Pokrow - pokryvat', osłaniać, okrywać. Różne słowa, ale jedna tajemnica: Maryja, okryta płaszczem, okrywająca nim też człowieka. Skąd ten obraz? Zobaczmy, co o mówi o nim Pismo Święte.
## 
W starożytnej kulturze semickiej płaszcz był przedłużeniem osoby. Oddać płaszcz — oddać siebie. Okryć kogoś płaszczem — poręczyć za niego swoim imieniem, wziąć za niego lub za nią pełną odpowiedzialność. Obraz ten wraca w Piśmie wielokrotnie: w godności, mocy, intymności, chwale i prośbie.
## Godność
Jonatan, syn Saula i prawowity następca tronu, zdejmuje swój płaszcz i oddaje go Dawidowi, oddając zarazem godność królewską i władzę namaszczonemu przez Boga królowi  [(1 Sm 18,4)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=1171). Ten sam gest powtórzył Eliasz wobec Elizeusza: przechodził obok orzącego pola chłopa i „zarzucił na niego swój płaszcz”[(1 Krl 19,19)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=1227). Ani słowa. Sam płaszcz wystarczy, by Elizeusz zrozumiał: jego życie należy odtąd do innego porządku. 
## Moc
Płaszcz jest testamentem. Gdy Eliasz zostaje zabrany do nieba, Elizeusz „wziął płaszcz Eliasza, który spadł z góry od niego” [(2 Krl 2,13)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=1250), a następnie stanął nad Jordanem by dokonać cudu. [(2 Krl 2,13–14)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=1250) Pierwsze uderzenie nie rozdziela jednak wód. Dopiero gdy woła: „Gdzie jest Pan, Bóg Eliasza?” — Jordan się rozstępuje [(2 Krl 2,14)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=1250). Płaszcz nie jest talizmanem — jest narzędziem działającym mocą imienia Bożego. Tą samą logiką rządzi się uzdrowienie kobiety cierpiącej dwanaście lat na krwotok: dotyka frędzli szaty Jezusa, mówiąc do siebie: „Żebym się choć Jego płaszcza dotknęła, a będę zdrowa” [(Mt 9,21)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=252). Frędzle, których dotknęła, były w Prawie znakiem przymierza. [(Lb 15,39)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=135). Dotykając ich, kobieta wyznawała wiarę w Mesjasza Prawa. Szkaplerz, różaniec, sakramentalia maryjne — działają tą samą logiką: nie jako magia, lecz jako dotyk płaszcza dla tych, którzy wołają z wiarą.
## intymność
Płaszcz tworzy intymność — oddziela to, co pod nim, od tego, co poza. W Namiocie Spotkania zasłona [(Wj 26,31–33)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=76), oddzielała Święte od Najświętszego — przestrzeni nasyconej obecnością Bożą, intymnej sfery Jahwe. Za tą zasłoną Bóg był nagi wobec Izraela: obecny bez pośrednictwa, bez dystansu. 
Gest rozciągnięcia płaszcza nad kobietą był formułą zaślubin. Bóg mówi do Izraela: „Rozciągnąłem połę płaszcza mego nad tobą i zakryłem twoją nagość. Związałem się z tobą przysięgą i wszedłem z tobą w przymierze - wyrocznia Pana Boga - stałaś się moją. \

[(Rt 3,9)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=1160). Booz jest go'el — odkupicielem, powinowatym, zobowiązanym by spłodzić dziecko bezdzietnej żonie swojego zmarłego krewnego. Prośba o okrycie płaszczem jest zarazem prośbą o małżeństwo. 
## Chwała
Okrycie płaszczem jest także okryciem chwałą. Zwiastując, Gabriel mówi: „Duch Święty zstąpi na Ciebie i moc Najwyższego osłoni Cię” [(Łk 1,35)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=316). Osłonić, to znaczy okrywać cieniem — to dokładnie to samo słowo, opisujące obłok chwały przy Namiocie Spotkania [(Wj 40,34)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=108) i obłok na Górze Przemienienia. Bóg jest tu obecny. W Apokalipsie też widzimy tę chwałę: „Niewiasta obleczona w słońce i księżyc pod jej stopami” [(Ap 12,1)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=1100). Niewiasta zwycięska, obleczona w znak tryumfu Boga.
## Prośba
Okrycie jest też narzędziem prośby. Psalmista woła: „w cieniu Twych skrzydeł mnie ukryj.” [(Ps 17,8)]( https://biblia.deon.pl/rozdzial.php?id=850). Rut nie wstydzi się prosić powinowatego o to, co się jej należy. 

# Maryjo
Maryjo, w Tobie te wszystkie aspekty wypełniają się jednocześnie. 
Moc Najwyższego osłania Cię,  
Bóg jest obecny w Tobie. 
Znalazłaś się brzemienną za sprawą Ducha Świętego.  
Otacza Cię godność Boga, gdyż nosisz Go w sobie.
Pod Twój płaszcz, uciekamy się, Święta Boża Rodzicielko. 
Maryjo, rozciągnij brzeg swego płaszcza nade mną. 


*[Kazanie wygłoszone w czasie majówki 6 maja 2026 w Bazylice Trójcy Świętej u oo. dominikanów w Krakowie]*

body.title: Walking through the world of Napoleon and Joséphine 🇫🇷
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYvJiN1gMz8R99a5SrwJd9EPQei5LasEGEBd8bN3xffPx/IMG_4877.jpeg 


One of the most impressive parts of visiting Château de Malmaison was seeing how art was used almost like propaganda. Portraits of Napoleon are everywhere, but each one tells a slightly different story. In this painting, he looks calm and perfectly controlled, even with chaos happening behind him. It feels less like a simple portrait and more like a message about leadership and power.

> Una de las partes más impresionantes de visitar el Château de Malmaison fue ver cómo el arte era utilizado casi como propaganda. Los retratos de Napoleón están por todas partes, pero cada uno cuenta una historia ligeramente distinta. En esta pintura se ve tranquilo y completamente controlado, incluso con el caos ocurriendo detrás de él. Se siente menos como un simple retrato y más como un mensaje sobre liderazgo y poder.

---

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd6DJgycbsCt8kMKEnDqC1dfhJxyYmZyyPKtcmRAa4jyQ/IMG_4879.jpeg 


This huge painting immediately caught my attention because of the contrast between the white horse and Napoleon’s red uniform. The amount of detail in the clothing, the horse, and even the soldiers in the background is incredible. Standing in front of paintings this large feels very different from seeing them online or in books.

> Esta enorme pintura llamó mi atención inmediatamente por el contraste entre el caballo blanco y el uniforme rojo de Napoleón. La cantidad de detalle en la ropa, el caballo e incluso los soldados del fondo es impresionante. Estar frente a pinturas de este tamaño se siente muy diferente a verlas en internet o en libros.

---

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdaSLz7z3Y3FZ1inDjcnM79nQWFe4ADSY1hrXvwxjjtYL/IMG_4880.jpeg 


I got closer to appreciate the texture of the painting and honestly it made me think about how much patience and technical skill artists needed centuries ago. Every fold in the clothes and every reflection on the horse was painted by hand with incredible precision.

> Me acerqué para apreciar la textura de la pintura y honestamente me hizo pensar en la enorme paciencia y habilidad técnica que necesitaban los artistas hace siglos. Cada pliegue de la ropa y cada reflejo en el caballo fueron pintados a mano con una precisión increíble.

---

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf7tUSUnx73p4ef5o3JzkQXM2WQigX1NdeDeDXtmaEJxh/IMG_4875.jpeg 


This painting felt mysterious to me. The dark atmosphere, the dramatic gestures, and the contrast with the white figure create a scene that almost looks theatrical. I spent a while just trying to understand the emotions and symbolism behind it.

> Esta pintura me transmitió algo misterioso. La atmósfera oscura, los gestos dramáticos y el contraste con la figura blanca crean una escena que parece casi teatral. Pasé un buen rato intentando entender las emociones y el simbolismo detrás de ella.

---

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQTHZowHzm3pomPouctKK21gHmxSbrJGoaQqmKy8DoW29/IMG_4876.jpeg 


Some of the paintings inside the palace feel closer to mythology than history. This one was full of symbolism, dramatic poses, and movement. It reminded me how art from that era often tried to connect rulers and political figures with ideas of destiny, glory, or divinity.

> Algunas de las pinturas dentro del palacio se sienten más cercanas a la mitología que a la historia. Esta estaba llena de simbolismo, poses dramáticas y movimiento. Me recordó cómo el arte de esa época intentaba conectar a los gobernantes y figuras políticas con ideas de destino, gloria o incluso divinidad.

---

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUNbC49gKsfGapvr3N7kDokGJM2kQVmyS7T3f9KGAsvdq/IMG_4882.jpeg 


One thing I loved about Malmaison was how elegant even the smallest decorative objects were. This porcelain piece with the flower painting looked simple at first, but the closer you look, the more details you notice in the gold borders and design.

> Algo que me encantó de Malmaison fue lo elegantes que eran incluso los objetos decorativos más pequeños. Esta pieza de porcelana con la flor parecía sencilla al principio, pero mientras más la observas, más detalles encuentras en los bordes dorados y el diseño.

---

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPyUm7ByAR1CqF9HBmiHWtrkG2k6WGmvpRpMLhApRoMS4/IMG_4881.jpeg 


This room felt surprisingly intimate compared to the grand halls in other parts of the palace. The colors, the curtains, and the furniture create an atmosphere that feels more personal and human. It is strange to think that people who shaped European history also lived ordinary moments inside places like this.

> Esta habitación se sintió sorprendentemente íntima en comparación con los grandes salones del palacio. Los colores, las cortinas y los muebles crean una atmósfera más personal y humana. Es extraño pensar que personas que marcaron la historia europea también vivieron momentos cotidianos dentro de lugares así.

---

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZR8msRZT9mpjwU7H6yzsxZSxU9cmv9599A9Eu2uQJDgU/IMG_4883.jpeg 


The mirror reflections in this room created an almost endless visual effect. I also liked how the photo accidentally captured us in the reflection because it made the image feel more alive instead of looking like a perfect museum catalog photo.

> Los reflejos de los espejos en esta habitación creaban un efecto visual casi infinito. También me gustó que la foto captara accidentalmente nuestro reflejo porque hizo que la imagen se sintiera más viva y no como una foto perfecta de catálogo de museo.

---

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcKtRXPd629TcWkRWEfS5ubAspe1NPD4B855zF4R2QCeE/IMG_4887.jpeg 


The bedroom was honestly one of the most extravagant spaces in the entire palace. The red and gold combination gives it a very imperial feeling. It is impossible not to imagine how carefully designed every detail was to communicate luxury and authority.

> Honestamente, la habitación fue uno de los espacios más extravagantes de todo el palacio. La combinación de rojo y dorado le da una sensación completamente imperial. Es imposible no imaginar cómo cada detalle fue diseñado cuidadosamente para transmitir lujo y autoridad.

---

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNzvDQEwozmdyZUzQrx52b67FHRuyv7LfqAgESbWv5m5E/IMG_4894.jpeg 


After spending time inside the palace, walking through the gardens felt peaceful. The contrast between the luxurious interiors and the calm outdoor spaces made the experience feel complete. Even with the cloudy sky, the gardens looked beautiful.

> Después de pasar tiempo dentro del palacio, caminar por los jardines se sintió muy tranquilo. El contraste entre los interiores lujosos y los espacios exteriores calmados hizo que la experiencia se sintiera completa. Incluso con el cielo nublado, los jardines se veían hermosos.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@walterprofe/walking-through-the-world-of-napoleon-and-josphine--l5i)

body.title: Бумбокс - нова пісня \
body.body: 7 травня український гурт Бумбокс випустив кліп на нову пісню \
.\nЦікаво те, як створювались всі пісні до альбому. Вони виникали спонтанно і за 2-3 години матеріал був повністю готовий для запуску в роботу. Так само простою була і історія створення \

. Барабанщик Олександр Люлякін розповідає, що почалося все з телефонного дзвінка Андрія Хливнюка, де він попередив, що завтра гурт пише пісню. Яку саме — ніхто не знав і не обговорював заздалегідь. А вже наступного дня музиканти приїхали на студію — і за пару годин \
була готова.\nНе дивлячись на різне сприйняття пісні учасниками гурту, в одному всі сходяться: вона особлива. Так, наприклад, Дмитро Кувалін назвав \
. Інна Невойт своїм жіночим сприйняттям бачить у ній історію про людську близькість: \
Валентин Матіюк відзначає, що пісня нова за стилем навіть для самого гурту — і зізнається, що грає в ній менше, ніж зазвичай. Але це не мінус, а свідомий вибір. А фронтмен \
Андрій Хливнюк відмовляється аналізувати цю пісню, характеризуючи її як \
виходить 14 травня. А хто давно чекав виступу вживу улюбленого \

, - для вас відбудуться два концерти в Blockbuster Mall — 16 і 17 травня.

body.title: A Refreshing Habit I Learned in Germany / ドイツで始めた鼻うがい
body.body:
![IMG_5610.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoyQuHetQ9vffZiuJGQS6yU4YB96JfE8k5BvPj3Dmt5APW2gTnK6zYvsftcmqRFcPHd.jpg)


Have you ever tried nasal rinsing?

For a long time, I watched my partner enthusiastically doing it while thinking, “Is it really *that* good?” I think I was still remembering that strange painful, uncomfortable feeling from getting pool water up my nose as a child.

But one day, I suddenly decided to try it myself ... and it felt surprisingly refreshing! Since then, I’ve been doing it from time to time. Earlier this year, I took an online breathing class, which made the idea that “breathing is meant to happen through the nose (mouth is more for eating)” really click for me. Since then, I’ve become much more conscious about nasal breathing in daily life.

To avoid the pain, the salt concentration is really important. A few times I made it too casually and immediately regretted it, but once I started measuring the salt properly with my accurate scale, I haven't have pain. Still it's not super comfortable though. 

It’s also interesting how nasal rinse tools differ depending on the country. In Japan, minimal and smaller squeeze-type bottles seem more common, while in Germany a gravity-fed type where the water flows naturally with water pressure is common and the capacity is larger than Japanese ones. 

This is also the season when I’m covered in pollen and grass from gardening, and wood dust from woodworking — in other words, the season for nasal rinsing.

I’ll probably do a refreshing wash again soon ☺️

Have a nice weekend, everyone!

---

title.title: Нераціональне використання площі
title.body:
Як отримати баланс, щоб всім було достатньо? А то одні туляться на кількох квадратних метрах цілими родинами в однокімнатних квартирах, а хтось набудував собі палаців, щоб там ганяти повітря і можна було в прямому сенсі бігати по кімнатах )

Так, на днях я опинилася в будинку, в якому не менше 500 м² площі. Будували його на початку 1990-х, але мабуть, потім з фінансами у родини стало не густо, тому всередині всі ці площі виглядають пусткою і відверто кажучи, перебувати в такому будинку навіть трохи некомфортно.

Я вже боялась спитати, як ці люди зимою опалюють такі площі і чи може варто подумати, щоб продати це житло і придбати щось менше та затишніше? 
Але, можливо, люди вже звикли і їм нормально.

title.title: Falooda ice cream to beat the heat ## A refreshing and fulfilling summer drink
title.body:
## Hello friends ! 
The peak summer season is here and this hot season required lots of drinks and icecreams to beat the heat. When we get varieties it become wonderful to enjoy the summer and summer become refreshing. So I try yumm kesar pista flavoured falooda at home . 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeV5yJKN2G7LsTWEgHyujXxzhfxCT45NgtVgxeiQSgyMt/img_7998.png)

<hr>
<hr>


Yesterday was Sunday and I had lots of work to do which was pending for days. I thought to make something nice , fulfilling and quick for lunch . Even While making breakfast I prepared for this , so I get whole noon to done my work and also get some rest . 

I orderd instant falooda packet from blinkit. The flavour was kesar pista one of my favourite . 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS78AqBnn4gYYWdFH5AvKdwbFfMD7opkJZ6QiDcRKsJLE/img_7971.jpg)

On The packet there was full instructions and I just follow the instructions and prepared the falooda . 

## INGREDIENTS : 
* Water 200 ml
* Milk 1 liter 
* instant falooda mix 1 packet 
* ice cream and Rabri ( for serving ) 
* Nuts (optional ) 


<hr>
<hr>

## PROCESS : 
So in a kadai I start to make the falooda , I add water and milk together and wait for boiling . One side I prepared my breakfast and another side I prepared this for lunch . 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWYNaChCaJ2VjDjXkeWSAK2f8Lrjc86cxFL5V4BRxXvnb/img_7969.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTW19MWa8KjyhzyJ2QL2JbjzzkjPuybzZkqU9xGrNkPE6/img_7970.jpg)

After boiling the milk I add instant falooda packet in the kadai . Now I stir it continuously for almost 15 minutes on the high flame . 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSP1fH42dRkp8Zhvo7Lq5bpjT9UkaPQoDd9VZmDwjRWEh/img_7972.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWyv3DGy56wsiaCCbxLo82eMeLKGrQV9xZbEQVb8UNgN/img_7974.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW9EooTVKPUWNoUTVrz16xBDHPvqGJgK2M4jPV83aSYFY/img_7977.jpg)

After 15 minutes it become thick , creamy and Amazing . 


<hr>
<hr>

Now I transfer it in another vessel , cover it and left it for 45 minutes to maintain the room temperature. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZm3aCVLDrPVnQYKhMHKaTGba8hn3xRZ4JWVm2hPhPs5y/img_7978.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgQE7cJvxRtkcYqTBcfQnLkwTKmeh5TXWWCog4ukovu1/img_7979.jpg)

After 45 minutes I put this in the refrigerator for 5-6 hours , so it could get completely chilled . 


Another side I bought ice cream and Rabri from a local ice cream shop . You can add vanilla ice cream too . 

In the afternoon I start to prepare the glass for all . It is a pack of 6 and I serve exactly 6 glass . First I pour 2 tbsp Rabri than half glass faluda and than fill the glass with ice cream . 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAiZ611A7aQqfzCKHzyenMKaCFX2kQw4enyvHKW32rST/img_7999.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc1XpUSi72mwmTG9hNwFqrhzDAYk1HFSgjFCzX6jMyUr4/img_7989.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7pcsAuNPhJEy4e4iz5ccSk3FSmbugwiUDp9SN3CJ6Wx/img_7991.jpg)


One glass gives lots of energy and also fulfill for whole noon and during summer when we don’t want to eat much we can enjoy it . 

My whole family like this and it is also a good way to keep family together, let’s make for the family and enjoy it together and make your summer amazing . 

<hr>
<hr>

I hope you enjoy this falooda recipe and my experience . Wishing you all a wonderful summer and unforgettable experiences. 

### Thank you so much everyone for your valuable time , support and love 🤍🌸

## @mysteriousroad 🙏🇮🇳

title.title: Welcome To Gonzoville
title.body: /> For several years now, I've been on a mission from our lord and savior Dr. Raoul Duke to put the gonzo into photojournalism. This mission didn't happen to come with instructions, or even the vaguest notion of an outline of how to accomplish it, so there's been a good bit of fumbling along and not a great deal of success.

/> Was working my way through all the photos from the Kentucky Derby this past weekend when the lightbulb lit up and it hit me: _people are gonzo!_ Just need to get out of my own way and stop trying too hard and let the gonzo come to me.
/> Didn't get a chance to get in my own way Saturday, the gonzo came calling first, begging me to take its photo.
/> _Yeehaw y'all!_ Nothing for it but to lean into it.
/> Who knew god hated horse racing? _This guy._
/>\n\nThe ponies have done pranced off and the hangovers are starting to wear off, but the gonzo isn't going anywhere. _Stay weird y'all._

title.title: Speed Plays an Important Role in Battles || 4 Monsters Awarded After Completing Chapter 5
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 8, 2026, 10_41_07 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23w2eTH63v1hJp9udV3qfgFaea9i3Ume4NXaECeHeBX1BY8GQHLqtwbvDeEA4fiTwii6B.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


In Splinterlands the Campaign mode plays a very important role especially for players who are new to the game and want to understand it properly. My suggestion would be to first complete the campaign chapters because they not only help you understand the gameplay but also provide detailed knowledge about card types, abilities and stats.

Today I am exploring another chapter from the Campaign mode. Last week we discussed ranged attack monsters including what ranged attacks are, how to identify them and how and where they should be used in battles. 

Today we are going to talk about another important power which is Speed. You can find this power in the right bottom corner with the visual of the boot with blue background or just by taking cursor on it you can read the name.

Speed plays a very important role in battles. I often see players ignoring this power because most of their focus remains on armor, health and attack. However that approach is not completely correct. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-08 101502.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tv48GiR8LTj72t5jBiTPnJWEvx4Dfap7gmr8Lt2DuU3SgVyz1TkSRwF5mSdyxUqmmeZ.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

We should always look for balanced abilities and select monsters that have well balanced stats so they can give the best performance in battle. A battle with balance monster cards and proper selection and positioning is always a win.

Speed is one of the most important mechanics in battles because it affects both attack order and hit chance. Units with higher speed attack faster and also dodge more attacks while slower monsters have a higher chance of missing their attacks.

Speed does not only decide which unit takes its turn first but it also decreases the accuracy of melee and ranged attacks. Every one point difference in speed reduces attack accuracy by 10%.

![Screenshot 2026-05-08 101525.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EoeCZ5bPVGSgCUQFj2B1UdwnJQvCKgHfMJjh1fdktoMbzE3GtKb4tvM8a8hnYoEM6aR.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

For example imagine a melee attacker with a speed of 2 attacking a target with a speed of 5. 5-2=3

This means the attack has a 30% chance to miss.

No matter how powerful a card may be if it gets defeated or misses its attack it cannot deal any damage. That is why speed based monsters play a very important role in battles and should always be considered carefully.

![Screenshot 2026-05-08 101726.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tSWJ1Dscp8hwjDt4UrUEVUGKGHQpw9fzUKZapucT95uHmgbpcvjFTKrAv1KNyPyUEVG.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

In todays campaign I once again clicked on the campaign mode and then selected Chapter Five 5 with the name Speed. I used to play a practice battle. As you can see the game also provides detailed explanations about speed abilities and what speed monsters can do in battle.

The campaign highlights speed based monsters in a short battle and demonstrates how they can effectively use their speed power. After completing the battle or you can say after completing the campaign chapter I also received rewards.

I received four monster cards as rewards including Marlai Singariel, Port Guardian, Waterlogged Wizard and Spitting Camel.

These are four monster cards that all contain speed related abilities. One of them even includes an Archon which gives you more options for Archon selection.

![Screenshot 2026-05-08 101752.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vrtpMpT1aZEQcKwnodtA47Jbj4fS3BED6fyZsRQuWzg2D9K6TC7JwQf3u4suDb5Fg9u.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

In my opinion campaigns like these not only improve your learning experience but also provide excellent rewards. As you can see I received four good monster cards simply for completing the campaign chapter.

You should definitely try these campaigns and complete their chapters so you can continue earning more rewards while also improving your understanding of the game.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

title.title: MOVIE REVIEW : MADE IN KOREA
title.body:
![1001116881.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/EogLNjP2xWZuY76sjgG24z1Y1xWGq84LZrpgdDWBtvXp5Jeb6xqQUQnQ3ukWQeJHYTA.jpg)


Recently, I watched the movie titled made in Korea about a young Indian girl whose dream all along has been to travel to Korea when she's old enough. Apparently she fell in love with their culture and had it in mind to travel to the Country so as to experience it in reality. She had to do everything in our power to learn the language, the culture, eating etiquette and everything.


![1001116883.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/EoEo9wZjNRjtDULonu5FZhXKrQsEgXx4cvzeWtfykJ8eZLAhGAYauGVtHeopdWyGrDc.jpg)

Along the line after she finished from High School and graduated from school her boyfriend assured her that she would travel to Korea and it would make sure you happen but unfortunately they were supposed to travel together but the boy scammed her father of his hard earned savings.


![1001116886.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/Eoc5XXtV4G6bQSjtC2o24e2f4hoLe1Ph6o8fy7AsruJV43MRoc6QXAYBpxMEXvtAHdM.jpg)


Out of this savings the boy made sure she traveled to the country of her dreams but he also traveled to another country which is Mumbai to start up his life. The girl was devastated to the extent that she cried a lot because of the hurt and disappointment she felt.


![1001116887.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/EoGvXQ91kgory6ih3hRrGkXEuLnxtmRjtzFEWDXa18WNm6G7DNgofW7k8RTu6qxcCGV.jpg)


In the end however she traveled to the country and started life afresh she got a job of taking care of an elderly woman who was supposed to be sick and cannot move our body but reverse was the case as the woman was only pretending to gain her son's attention.


![1001116882.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/EoiUENyVBHLK9XG8SefEweftK4PDXLmtYX4avkRMTvt2BUcuLV4V1Rsy4LY5fQmGmzb.jpg)


So far so good the movie is interesting with great cinematic view and I can recommend it to people to watch as it blends two cultures of Indian and Korea together.

Note: images used here were obtained as screenshots from the downloaded movie... 

Thanks for stopping by my blog...

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e6ae4e69-d412-451c-b235-dff49885d702.jpg) 🇵🇱 ### Start nie był idealny Ten trening nie zaczął się dobrze. Pierwsze odcinki bardziej przypominały walkę z bieżnią niż kontrolowany bieg. Za szybkie wejście, chaos prędkości, pochylenie sylwetki. Zamiast rytmu — próba „utrzymania się przy taśmie”. Trochę jak pilot, który po starcie za mocno ciągnie maszynę do góry. Prędkość jest, ale wszystko wokół zaczyna się rozpadać. --- 🇬🇧 ### The start wasn’t perfect This session didn’t start well. The first intervals felt more like fighting the treadmill than controlled running. Too aggressive, chaotic pacing, body leaning forward. Instead of rhythm — just trying to stay with the belt. Like a pilot pulling too hard right after takeoff. The speed is there, but everything starts falling apart.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6cd019ed-1199-406d-965e-fd7f28cd2e7f.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9a1b11a9-a1a9-45ca-a11e-77045ce54b11.jpg)
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/528030b4-2094-468c-ad04-03891950d75a.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### Synchronizacja Od trzeciego–czwartego odcinka coś się zmieniło. Organizm zaczął rozumieć rytm bieżni. Sylwetka się wyprostowała. Krok zrobił się bardziej naturalny. Nogi zaczęły pracować szybciej i lżej. Wysiłek dalej był bardzo ciężki — ale przestał być chaotyczny. --- 🇬🇧 ### Synchronization From the third or fourth interval, something changed. The body finally synced with the treadmill rhythm. Posture became more upright. Stride felt more natural. Legs started moving faster and lighter. The effort was still extremely hard — but it stopped being chaotic.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/af3ce7b3-0bd5-47e9-a798-ca78487ba2a0.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/93792c42-9b3c-4b2f-bfab-82f9a994e4b2.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### VO₂max to inny świat Próg boli spokojnie. VO₂max boli gwałtownie. Tutaj nie ma komfortu ani miejsca na długie myślenie. Oddech bardzo szybko przejmuje kontrolę nad całym organizmem. Ale pierwszy raz ten trening nie zamienił się w „walkę o przeżycie”. Pojawiła się kontrola. Ciężko. Bardzo ciężko. Ale świadomie. --- 🇬🇧 ### VO₂max is a different world Threshold hurts in a controlled way. VO₂max hurts violently. There’s no comfort here and no time to think too much. Breathing quickly takes over the entire body. But for the first time, this session didn’t turn into survival mode. There was control. Hard. Very hard. But intentional.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cd7a074f-7a76-4b90-99dd-74a64fbbf94d.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b2f2d047-7845-46c5-8d63-475d2fce6e8e.jpg)
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ea1bd116-99f8-4599-9f2e-a7e48f348930.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### Największy progres Największym sukcesem tego treningu nie było tempo. Było nim utrzymanie rytmu pod zmęczeniem. W poprzednich jednostkach narastający problem oddechowy rozwalał mechanikę biegu. Krok robił się cięższy, dłuższy i mniej ekonomiczny. Tym razem nogi dalej pracowały szybko. Rytm został utrzymany. I właśnie tam wydarzył się prawdziwy progres. --- 🇬🇧 ### The biggest progress The biggest success of this session wasn’t the pace. It was maintaining rhythm under fatigue. In previous workouts, breathing problems destroyed running mechanics. Stride became heavier, longer and less efficient. This time, the legs kept moving fast. The rhythm stayed alive. That’s where the real progress happened.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a7bb239d-1cf3-4be5-bd68-bed34ceaca69.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/83eaa006-78bc-44fc-a5a3-fa5a2e462673.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f1afa76b-1a49-4489-bf8e-3d3da5e1c244.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### Odcinki, które zmieniły trening Najbardziej wartościowe były ostatnie interwały. Zmęczenie rosło, ale technika się nie rozsypała. Pojawiła się szybka praca nóg, krótszy kontakt z podłożem i bardziej sprężysty ruch. Mniej siłowego „pchnięcia”, więcej kontroli. To był pierwszy trening VO₂max w projekcie SUB40, który zaczął przypominać lot na wysokiej prędkości… a nie awaryjne lądowanie. ✈️ --- 🇬🇧 ### The intervals that changed the session The most valuable part came in the final intervals. Fatigue increased, but the mechanics stayed together. Fast leg turnover, shorter ground contact and a more reactive stride appeared. Less brute force, more control. For the first time in the SUB40 project, a VO₂max session started to feel like high-speed flight… instead of an emergency landing. ✈️
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e810c922-6bb2-4c88-bd87-a9976e420cd0.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/11b99fe2-172c-4637-a997-e43f829a68fd.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### Krok naprzód Tempo 3:30–3:35/km nadal wymaga ogromnego wysiłku. Ale organizm zaczyna je akceptować. Nie tylko wydolnościowo. Również mechanicznie i neuromotorycznie. To jeszcze nie jest pełna swoboda na tej intensywności. Ale pierwszy raz pojawiło się coś bardzo ważnego: kontrola przy dużej prędkości. I właśnie od takich treningów zaczyna się prawdziwe budowanie SUB40. --- 🇬🇧 ### A step forward 3:30–3:35/km still demands a huge effort. But the body is starting to accept it. Not only physiologically. Mechanically and neuromotorically as well. This still isn’t full comfort at that intensity. But for the first time, something very important appeared: control at high speed. And sessions like this are where SUB40 truly begins.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/dbf8a4f8-0a9e-452d-8223-6a1352a60a4b.jpg)

title.title: My Splinter Choice on Shades of Gray Ruleset
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tS32PNcFR5jp4yodT74hk8ALXHtMK2mqJChBJRNxQyP4HKPmK2SFz5rLADwMStRTCgf.png)
Hi there again Splinter-friends and HIVEees. Hope everything is still well to you where ever you are. This blog is intended to share some of my battles in Frontier Rank format in Splinterlands. With how the game developed right now, battles and features are not just limited to simply make a deck, battle and repeat. Splinterlands also have features that can be tested by new guys and can start their asset accumulation with minimal financing or if they want. Go big time in an instant. Frontier battle format of Splinterlands have the minimum or can be considered almost zero start up capacity as long you have your splinterbook then start the campaign mode to get your free cards. What you really have to do is start playing it. Anyways, I am going to share one of battles in gold league of Frontier Battle Format. # Shades of Gray #
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/AJmnmzGYPmiyQHs2xbvKksVvtLvP7YvrwFtgEfMuuzfo8bQyzE57NK8EGTXgqNy.png
> Only Neutral Units maybe used. Shades of Gray is one of the ruleset that will limit archons potential domination in the battle. It is basically that this ruleset only allowed Neutral Monster units can be used. That is a bit hard to form a team specially if you have limited to no card collection or rented with Neutral splinters. So how are you playing this in Frontier Rank Battle? This clearly limit your potential team construction with this ruleset present in the battle. Your favorite meta will be ousted. But for sure you need to send your team in the battle right. This is where I will share my experience for this type of rule in the Frontier. # Battle Sample on Shades of Gray on Frontier Rank #
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tviP2a44a4afgks1NJpwFiaz2Lh832mcmY1orAL97jCDBR9Vm6xBMfcEUcRRShCS8LL.png)
In this battle, I am currently in the Gold League of Frontier Rank. Maintaining here in this rank should possess a good set of cards probably rank 3 and above for the archons and followed by the units. Since I maxed my cards that I think are suited to be good enough to battle in frontier, I am maintaining gold league in the ranked battle for the time being. While still waiting for the book2 or whatever frontier updates, I am still minting those free resources and trying my luck to those rare foils every week. You should really not gonna missed this for rare foils still got their nice market prices. Continuing with the battle. I am playing the Shades of Gray Ruleset with 42 Mana Capacity. I am playing this in the Earth splinters boost additional HP archons. Why I chose this one to be my Archon? Aurelia of Earth splinters summoner ability is better to other available archons right now, in my opinion of course, where in its true opponent, the Death splinter is not available for use. Yes, If ever Shades of Gray is here and Earth and Death splinters are both present for use, I am having trouble in making desition to which one i should play. Unless they put additional rule aside from shades of gray. And I am placing first the card that got the taunt ability New Beluroc Aegis in front followed by Lunaki Howler. Although this card does not possess a great damage, I still see it as an important card for it got a balance stats. Vengeful Monk, Kanaaq Miner and A'lan the Musketeer will be my main offense for this battle.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23uFTcmnTKG1dnUM6Sz2pJ4vJqct4MSt29WdHmdr5VN3WHbhJCGiV4WTZSoRQZ4gpGXt4.png)
Facing the Water Splinter boost of my opponents team, Right in this round 1, My tank already suffered a good amount of damages on its mages that were boosted. Take note that magic damages are hard to counter in normal situation because magic damages passess thru the armor of the monster units.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23uFVvJwPQeWaTZr8Ft2JyDakqCbjruut9yU15yX1QSyGLX26Q89HH7A15Ut979Argqg6.png)
Round 5 is where I already see the possible victory because the offense of my opponent is not enough to cut all my monster units HP. Here is the good thing about playing the Frontier battle rank, since it got a limited amount of card at the moment, not that many as the same from modern and wild rank, battles cannot always been dominated and won with a little margin which it make more exciting. - Well, Shades of Gray is one of the ruleset that I used to form team with balance as much as possible. I believed that Attacks and Survivability should both exist in this type ruleset to gain the upper hand. ###### You can watch the full battle [HERE](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_3ebd86b06adbdfd8f26876e3f8799548?ref=buratus). ###### --- You want to join the game? click it [HERE](https://next.splinterlands.com/register?ref=buratus) for my referral and start your journey! This is it for this blog. Thank you for your time! Disclaimer: Images that were used, if not specified, are from [SPLINTERLANDS](https://splinterlands.com).

title.title: Love was in your eyes, The Night Before
title.body:
What a difference a day makes.

Last night you said you loved me! Now today I find that you have changed your mind. Oh how I wish things were like they were the night before.

When we said goodbye last night, I saw the love you had for me in your eyes. I loved you too.  I still do!

I'll always remember how you were last night. When I think of things we did, it makes me wanna cry!

Were you telling lies the night before? Was I so unwise, the night before? Now today I find that you have changed your mind.

Treat me like you did the night before!

<hr>

## The Beatles

The year is 1965. The most popular band on the planet were also movie stars. Their second movie called Help! was super popular and it was in Color, whereas the first, Hard Day's Night was Black n White.

Years later I was in the bedroom of a girl I knew.  We were talking and laughing and having teenage fun. She had some old albums and she put this record on. It was the Help! soundtrack, which was new to me. 

The one song that really stood out to me was a simple song, with a hooky 4 chord progression. The story line was as described up at the top of this post. Paul on vocals with John and George backing. John played a pianet, electric piano, which has a really pleasant tone.  Ringo was banging away on that cymbal most of the song, as he tended to do on early Beatles records. Then that break and the way too short guitar solo, but still catchy. 

I loved it then and I love it now.

## The Night Before, from HELP!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d2FIKMwhf4w

Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d2FIKMwhf4w

This video of this song is only a month old on YouTube. It already has 806K views!

The version on The Beatles YouTube channel from 7 years ago has 19 Million views!
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7tD40D7jk-Q

## Let's Deconstruct This, Track by Track

Last month, a YouTube channel called <a href=\

>https://www.youtube.com/@itzeds put up a 15 minute video which somehow isolates all the instrumental and vocal tracks for this song, The Night Before. Normally I might be interested in such detail, but I really do love this song! So it was a treat to study it as it was broke down into its parts. You can hear every little detail. Nothing in the same frequency band to cover over anything else. **Things I noticed:** - Paul's bass has a little play in the notes. They mostly are 1 2 3, but sometimes its more like 1 23. If you hear what I mean. :D - Backing vocals, after \

are ahh ahh ahh ahh. I always noticed the second ahh was a lower tone than the first one.  I was surprised that this was repeated in the 3rd and 4th ahhs. I always though ahh 4 was a higher tone, because the lead vocal over it went up in tone.

- John on pianet is rather sloppy. I hear mistakes! not just one or two but several. This instrumentation is rather back in the track volume and you don't get a clear hearing of it in the original full song.

- The rhythm guitar by George is mostly subdued too. Some notes ring out hard, but mostly it's rather mellow. I think this was typical for those days. I am a Ramones fan and all they have is rhythm guitar (no lead) and it is very loud and prominent. I guess with the other instruments on a song like this, you don't need any one instrument to be super powerful.

- Ringo on drums drives the track. It's fairly basic.  You don't hear him hitting that cymbal - it just seems like it is always vibrating. Maybe loud soft loud soft, but there isn't a part where I do Not hear it!

Well here it is. I don't know if this is your thing, but for me, I found it very cool to hear!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ocXsRt7EArE

Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ocXsRt7EArE

## Fast Forward SIXTY Years

I found a cover of The Night Before on YouTube a few days ago when it first dropped.

This is a very very accurate cover!

The band is The Young Analogues. I think they are from Ireland. The YouTube channel is The Analogues and I think that is a different band. Maybe The Young Analogues are their kids?

Well folks are freaking out (or crashing out as the kids now say) in the comments.

- They're so amazing.

- I'm 74 and have been a Beatles fan all my life. You guys are the best in recreating their music. Thank you, I love it.

- So beautifully nostalgic, It Makes Me Wanna Cry.

- It's so great that young people today still play the music of the Beatles!

title.title: Будуємо омріяну альтанку
title.body:
У дворі батьківської хати ніколи не було місця, де можна сховатися від дощу чи сонця теплої пори року та просто посидіти в тиші, перепочити від роботи на городі чи у дворі. Думаю, що не до цього було людям, в яких є живність та великі городи, і які ще й умудряються хоити щодня на роботу.Бо поки ти після 8-годинного робочого дня нагодуєш домашніх тварин, прополеш якусь одну-дві грядки, приготуєш поїсти собі і повечеряєш, то аби пошвидше дойти до ліжка і впасти поспати. Бо завтра - знову на роботу. А тут дощів нема, а сохне розсада на грядках. А пройшла буря і виложила пшеницю на полі, треба піти подивитися. А на тижні пора вже бараболю копати, треба погріб вичистити і підготувати під її зберігання. А козам сіна накосив, треба перевернути, щоб швидше висохло, і сховати на гору у хлів. А дощі.... А суша... А колорадські жуки... А хопта...
Хто не ріс у селі, той не зрозуміє.
Тим не менш, ми надумали таки побудувати на цей сезон альтанку. І самим за щастя буде посидіти в ній, і мамі старенькій буде куди вийти.
Собачці сподобалась наша ідея. Думаю, вона вирішила, що це для неї, і буде тут жити.😁

title.title: Ecency Operational Transparency & Infrastructure Insights (2025-2026)
title.body: This report provides a transparent overview of Ecency's operational scale, infrastructure demands, onboarding systems, and cost structure over the past 12 months.\n\n

/>

* * *

System Scale & Traffic
----------------------

Over the past year:

*   3.84 billion requests served
    
*   473 million page views
    
*   237 TB bandwidth delivered
    
*   ~10.56 million requests per day
    

### Observations

*   Bandwidth per request has increased over time
    
*   Cache efficiency fluctuates (10%-60%)
    
*   Increased scraper and AI crawler activity impacts performance
    

* * *

Peak Load Events
----------------

*   March 2026:
    
    *   424 million requests
        
    *   40 TB bandwidth
        
*   Peak day:
    
    *   27.3 million requests
        
*   Peak bandwidth:
    
    *   2.66 TB in a single day
        

Infrastructure must handle spikes, not averages.

* * *

Abuse Prevention & Security
---------------------------

Using IPQS and internal filtering:

*   53,802 verification checks
    
*   25,251 fraudulent attempts detected
    
*   ~46.93% fraud rate
    

Additional internal protections:

*   behavioral heuristics
    
*   rate limiting
    
*   validation systems
    

Actual fraud pressure is likely higher than measured.

* * *

Onboarding System
-----------------

Monthly onboarding range:

*   Low: ~217 users
    
*   High: ~1056 users
    
*   Stable range: ~400-600 users
    

### Key insight

Onboarding is constrained by quality filtering, not demand.

* * *

User Support
------------

Ecency provides ongoing user support through:

*   Email
    
*   Discord
    
*   Telegram
    

Helping users:

*   understand Hive
    
*   resolve issues
    
*   stay engaged
    

* * *

Retention & Engagement
----------------------

Retention is improved through:

### Support layer

*   onboarding guidance
    
*   troubleshooting
    
*   user assistance
    

### Product mechanisms

*   points system
    
*   gamification
    
*   engagement incentives
    

Retention is an active focus area.

* * *

Cost Structure Evolution
------------------------

### 2025:

*   Dev: 51.9%
    
*   Infra: 22.1%
    
*   Other: ~26%
    

### 2026:

*   Dev: ~36%
    
*   Infra: ~30%
    
*   Other: ~34%
    

### Total cost:

*   Reduced from ~$11,550 - ~$9,064
    

* * *

Efficiency Gains
----------------

*   Dev team reduced ~50%
    
*   Feature delivery maintained
    
*   Infrastructure load increased
    

Efficiency improved while demand increased.

* * *

Core Services Operated
----------------------

Ecency maintains:

*   [Ecency.com](http://Ecency.com)
    
*   Ecency mobile app (Android, iOS)
    
*   HiveSigner (authentication)
    
*   HiveExplorer (blockchain explorer)
    
*   HiveSearcher (search & indexing)
    
*   HiveKeeper (browser extension)
    
*   Image hosting infrastructure
    
*   Full Hive node
    

These support authentication, data access, content discovery, and media delivery.

* * *

Infrastructure Role
-------------------

Infrastructure supports:

*   frontend delivery
    
*   APIs and backend systems
    
*   indexing and caching
    
*   abuse detection
    

It also absorbs spikes and mitigates attacks.

* * *

Key Challenges
--------------

*   increasing bandwidth demand
    
*   AI crawler pressure
    
*   cache inefficiency
    
*   balancing onboarding vs abuse
    

* * *

Strategic Direction
-------------------

*   improve caching efficiency
    
*   reduce cost per request
    
*   maintain onboarding quality
    
*   explore partial revenue offsets
    

* * *

Transparency
------------

Full financial breakdown:

[https://trust.ecency.com](https://trust.ecency.com)

* * *

Final Insight
-------------

Ecency has transitioned from a development-heavy model to an infrastructure-driven system operating at real-world scale.

The majority of cost is now tied to sustaining usage, not expanding teams.

title.title: Weaver ant
title.body: > At the tip of a pointed blade of grass, a weaver ant stood majestically. The ant's charm was like that of a traveler gazing out at the vastness of the world. The ant's body was tiny and seemingly light, yet it held an incredibly powerful vitality. It stood there quietly, not moving, let alone screaming for attention. But that was precisely where my fascination lay. I slowly approached it, taking slow, careful steps.

> Its slender legs gripped the blade of grass tightly, balancing its body as it danced in the cool morning breeze. It seemed to be enjoying every movement the wind made. Whatever it was, it was reveling in its calm. It seemed as if it had fully understood that life doesn't always go as planned. Its long antennae continued to move, perhaps trying to gauge the direction of the wind. I noticed that when the wind died down, its antennae also ceased moving.

> Its shiny black eyes continued to stare at the camera. From the look in their eyes, it seemed to be inviting me to talk. Another interesting aspect of this ant was its body. Look at that little body, it's all muscular, like someone who works out really hard at the gym. This is the first time I've encountered an insect with such an interesting body shape.

title.title: Cuando Nadie Aplaude #12 — Hay silencios que también son inteligencia [Esp/Eng]
title.body:
* * *

Hola comunidad @holos-lotus hoy continuo con la serie, **Cuando Nadie Aplaude** en ella pretendo mostrar aquellas situaciones poco reconocidas, pero muy humanas y que forman parte de nuestra vida

* * *

## Hay silencios que también son inteligencia  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTLEDnps1EqkNJ7a9B68iAyVke5TXvea59ssSXzGgcguJ/sick_street_photography_man_4327174_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-window-think-inside-portrait-4327174/)

---

No sé quién dijo aquella frase de que somos dueños de lo que callamos y esclavos de lo que decimos.  

Tal vez por eso, hace tiempo empecé a pensar dos veces antes de hablar.  

También existe otra idea que siempre me hizo sentido: tenemos dos oídos y una sola boca para escuchar más de lo que hablamos.  

Y mientras más crezco, más entiendo por qué.  

---

Cuando era más pequeña pensaba que decir todo lo que uno sentía era sinónimo de sinceridad.  

Que explicar demasiado ayudaba.  
Que hablar resolvía.  
Que mientras más uno intentara hacerse entender, mejor saldrían las cosas.  

Pero la vida, incluso en poco tiempo, te va enseñando matices.  

---

Tengo 25 años y aunque todavía siento que me falta muchísimo por aprender, ya he vivido suficientes momentos para entender que hablar de más también puede romper cosas.  

A veces rompe relaciones.  
A veces rompe oportunidades.  
A veces rompe la tranquilidad de un momento que habría sobrevivido mejor con un poco de silencio.  

---

Y no hablo de callar por miedo.  

Hablo de esa pausa necesaria antes de responder.  
De ese instante donde uno se pregunta:  

“¿Vale la pena decir esto?”  

---

Porque no todo pensamiento necesita convertirse en palabras.  

No toda emoción necesita explotar en el momento exacto en que aparece.  

Hay cosas que, vistas desde la calma, cambian completamente de forma.  

---

Con el tiempo he aprendido que muchas discusiones nacen más de la necesidad de reaccionar rápido que de la necesidad real de comunicarse.  

Y reaccionar rápido casi nunca deja espacio para pensar bien.  

---

A veces el silencio evita heridas innecesarias.  

A veces evita arrepentimientos.  

Y otras veces simplemente permite entender mejor lo que realmente sentimos antes de ponerlo sobre otra persona.  

---

Si lo pensara como una fotografía, no sería una escena dramática.  

Sería algo mucho más simple:  

Alguien observando por una ventana.  
Una taza de café ya fría.  
Un mensaje escrito… que nunca fue enviado.  

---

Nada extraordinario.  

Pero lleno de contención.  

---

La persona que aprende a callar ciertas cosas no siempre lo hace porque no tenga nada que decir.  

Muchas veces lo hace porque entiende el peso que tienen las palabras.  

Porque sabe que una frase dicha en el momento incorrecto puede quedarse viviendo demasiado tiempo en la memoria de alguien.  

---

Vivimos en una época donde todo parece impulsivo.  

Se responde rápido.  
Se opina rápido.  
Se juzga rápido.  

Y quizás por eso el silencio se ha vuelto tan incómodo.  

---

Parece que quien calla pierde.  

Pero no siempre es así.  

A veces callar es inteligencia emocional.  
A veces es madurez.  
A veces es simplemente darse tiempo para no empeorar algo que todavía puede salvarse.  

---

No significa reprimirlo todo.  

Tampoco significa vivir guardándose las emociones.  

Significa aprender que no todo merece una reacción inmediata.  

---

Hay conversaciones que salen mejor después de respirar.  
Hay decisiones que mejoran después de esperar.  
Y hay palabras que nunca debieron decirse.  

---

Quizás crecer también sea aprender a diferenciar entre lo que necesita ser dicho…  
y lo que solo necesitaba ser sentido por un momento y dejarlo pasar.  

---

Porque nadie aplaude esos silencios.  

Nadie ve el esfuerzo que implica detener una reacción impulsiva.  
Nadie nota las veces que alguien eligió calma en lugar de conflicto.  

---

Y aunque nadie lo aplauda…  

pensar antes de hablar  
también es una forma de cuidar.  

---

Con esto termina este capítulo y me despido. Díganme en los comentarios que les pareció y si quieren apoyar será bien recibido.

Las imágenes utilizadas son de Pixabay y utilizo Google Translate para la versión en inglés.

* * *

🇬🇧 *English Version*

* * *

Hello @holos-lotus community, today I continue with the series, **When No One Applauds**. In it, I intend to show those little-recognized yet deeply human situations that are part of our lives.

* * *

### There Are Silences That Are Also Intelligence  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTLEDnps1EqkNJ7a9B68iAyVke5TXvea59ssSXzGgcguJ/sick_street_photography_man_4327174_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-window-think-inside-portrait-4327174/)

---

I do not know who once said that we are masters of what we keep silent and slaves of what we say.  

Maybe that is why, some time ago, I started thinking twice before speaking.  

There is also another idea that has always made sense to me: we have two ears and only one mouth so that we can listen more than we speak.  

And the older I get, the more I understand why.  

---

When I was younger, I used to think that saying everything you felt was the same as being honest.  

That overexplaining helped.  
That talking solved things.  
That the more you tried to make yourself understood, the better things would turn out.  

But life, even in a short time, teaches you nuances.  

---

I am 25 years old, and although I still feel like I have so much to learn, I have already lived enough moments to understand that saying too much can also break things.  

Sometimes it breaks relationships.  
Sometimes it breaks opportunities.  
Sometimes it breaks the peace of a moment that would have survived better with a little silence.  

---

And I am not talking about staying silent out of fear.  

I mean that necessary pause before responding.  
That moment when you ask yourself:  

“Is this really worth saying?”  

---

Because not every thought needs to become words.  

Not every emotion needs to explode the exact moment it appears.  

Some things, when seen from calmness, completely change shape.  

---

Over time, I have learned that many arguments are born more from the need to react quickly than from the real need to communicate.  

And reacting quickly rarely leaves space for thinking clearly.  

---

Sometimes silence prevents unnecessary wounds.  

Sometimes it prevents regret.  

And other times it simply allows us to better understand what we truly feel before placing it onto someone else.  

---

If I thought of it as a photograph, it would not be a dramatic scene.  

It would be something much simpler:  

Someone looking through a window.  
A cup of coffee gone cold.  
A written message… that was never sent.  

---

Nothing extraordinary.  

But full of restraint.  

---

The person who learns to remain silent about certain things does not always do it because they have nothing to say.  

Many times, they do it because they understand the weight words carry.  

Because they know that a sentence said at the wrong moment can live in someone’s memory for far too long.  

---

We live in a time where everything feels impulsive.  

People reply quickly.  
Judge quickly.  
React quickly.  

And maybe that is why silence has become so uncomfortable.  

---

It seems that the person who stays quiet loses.  

But that is not always true.  

Sometimes silence is emotional intelligence.  
Sometimes it is maturity.  
Sometimes it is simply giving yourself time not to make worse something that can still be saved.  

---

It does not mean repressing everything.  

Nor does it mean living while hiding emotions.  

It means understanding that not everything deserves an immediate reaction.  

---

There are conversations that go better after breathing.  
There are decisions that improve after waiting.  
And there are words that should never have been spoken.  

---

Maybe growing up is also learning to distinguish between what truly needs to be said…  
and what only needed to be felt for a moment and then let go.  

---

Because no one applauds those silences.  

No one sees the effort it takes to stop an impulsive reaction.  
No one notices the times someone chose calm instead of conflict.  

---

And even if no one applauds it…  

thinking before speaking  
is also a way of caring.  

---

With this, this chapter comes to an end, and I say goodbye. Let me know in the comments what you think, and if you want to support it, it will be greatly appreciated.

The images used are from Pixabay, and I use Google Translate for the English version.

title.title: 「生活」无缘大学校庆
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![k5giewN0YyMJPHM3_IMG_6973.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/k5giewN0YyMJPHM3_IMG_6973/k5giewN0YyMJPHM3_IMG_6973.webp)
![lhZBZ4q23aG98COA_IMG_6968.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/lhZBZ4q23aG98COA_IMG_6968/lhZBZ4q23aG98COA_IMG_6968.webp)
![HNgQ9DvjX7HdgBgd_IMG_6971.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/HNgQ9DvjX7HdgBgd_IMG_6971/HNgQ9DvjX7HdgBgd_IMG_6971.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

上个月，我们大学08级校友群里发了返校给母校庆生的通知。这次学校办的是80周年校庆，感觉时间过得太快了，转眼我都工作十多年了。当时看到通知我就特别心动，特别想回学校看一看。

毕业之后我回过学校好几次，有一次是因为工作回去的，2023年还专门和朋友约着回去了一趟。当时就觉得物是人非，学校变化真的挺大的。而且每次都来去匆匆，根本没好好玩，就待一天，第二天就走了。

这次不一样，大家都从五湖四海赶回来给母校庆生。可惜我这周六、周日晚上都有课，实在没办法回去。

我还记得读大三的时候，正好赶上学校65周年校庆。那时候学校给每个在校生都发了校庆衣服，有好几种颜色，我们分到的是黄色。衣服尺码都偏大，穿起来松松垮垮的，大家平时都直接当睡衣穿。

那时候我们还互相开玩笑，说毕业多年以后，会不会回学校参加校庆。感觉那些日子就像在昨天一样，一晃十多年就过去了，真有点恍如隔世的感觉。也想起了好多大学的点点滴滴，在师院那四年我过得特别开心。虽然大家都在忙着备考专四、专八，但轻松快乐的时光也特别多。直到现在，我还经常梦回大学那段日子。

也不知道为什么，我对大学就是有种特别的眷恋。不知道这么形容合不合适，这种感觉和高中完全不一样。高中的时候我特别自卑，做什么都谨小慎微。从镇上到城里读书，总觉得自己格格不入。到了大学就不一样了，氛围很包容，身边同学也都很淳朴，让我待着特别自在。

很怀念学校里师兄师姐、师弟师妹之间的感情，大家的情感纽带很深，互相之间也都很敬重。在大学里，我还遇到了一群志同道合的朋友。

虽然现在大家联系得少了，但一起走过的青葱岁月真的很难忘。至少在我心里，和这些朋友的情谊一点都没变。只是大家现在都结婚生子，各自有了生活，慢慢联系也就少了。

这次没能回去给母校庆生，心里真的挺遗憾的。也许下个十年，我也会如约回去吧。只能在心里遥祝母校生日快乐！

---
