title.body: > https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/23yneyYzqoDgiBjE9AZeh48tt2ktiWduLjb2jLzQRqAkN1aVD6bx5eZZucjf7pmfdpN7E.png Hello fellow crafters and the @hivediy community! It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed day with your loved ones. I'm excited to share a new sewing project: a set of pot holders with a vegetable and chef design. I loved these fabrics from the moment I saw them in the store because their prints are perfect for kitchen decorations and accessories. The pot holders are reversible, and I used red and green bias tape along the edges to match the fabric's designs and patterns, coordinating with the green vegetables and the chef-themed background. It's a simple project that allows you to combine different fabric colors. I invite you to join me in the process!

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/23yTr7DVouLxVD12JG2QmRdLpwmfKbgrJ4uE3Kt8azagY1UjPDSWQbm4tbQDDFGC4YDq2.png Hola, hola amigos artesanos y comunidad @hivediy, es un placer saludarles deseando que tengan un feliz y bendecido día en unión de sus seres queridos, me siento feliz de compartir un nuevo proyecto de costura, se trata de un set de agarradores de olla con diseño de vegetales y chef, estas telas me gustaron mucho desde que las vi en la tienda, porque son ideales para los adornos y accesorios de la cocina por el estampado. Los agarrradores son reversibles,y en los bordes utilicé sesgo rojo y verde aordes con los diseños y figuras de las telas, para combinar con los vegetales verdes y el fondo de la tela con diseño de chef; es un proyecto sencillo de hacer y en el cual se pueden combinar diferentes colores de tela, les invito a acompañarme en el proceso de elaboración. ![AGARRADORES DE OLLAS (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpEKDkxn7HbBcLTwLSm7ULehoY4PVw7hAjRdR2rhNWwBEgBesFxFUiw7EtqSV1bMShH.jpeg) ![AGARRADORES DE OLLAS (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpJZdyThmUoWPVYBYHGWUbQsMaYu4bUngpC8bvPQp1ED48d1Hsioeifh7WzYBibdSFg.jpeg) ![CINTILLO B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ydV5FZaqNcDMKtbipQ1N5NLm3e5QMkn955u9dcp41hg2uR4SL2MQnzytKVN11aTGikQ.jpg)

> **Elaboration** The first step in making the potholders was to cut the pieces; four rectangles of 23 * 18 centimeters in main fabric and two rectangles in lining fabric, also two rectangles of wadding to pad and insulate the heat, for a better finish I rounded the corners of the pieces.

> **Elaboración** El primer paso para elaborar los agarradores fue cortar las piezas; cuatro rectángulos de 23 * 18 centímetros en tela principal y dos rectángulos en tela forro, también dos rectángulos de guata para acolchar y aislar el calor, para un mejor acabado redondeé las esquinas de las piezas. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eonmw9tWERT4Btjq6LLFikzQtGymf33scFhv4HaAWCjSvsf3y9L8sMYpDrUfhBDM8Pa.png)

> Once the pieces were cut, the next step was to assemble the handles. I placed the lining fabric at the bottom, with the wrong side facing out, then the wadding in the center, and on top of that the main fabric. I secured it with pins to prevent it from moving while sewing.

> Cortadas las piezas, el siguiente paso fue ensamblar los agarradores, coloqué la tela de forro abajo, con el revés hacia afuera, luego la guata en el centro y encima la tela principal, sujeté con alfileres para evitar que se muevan al momento de coser. ![AGARRADERAS (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoiXEYwY4UpS8W4Kjs8tqUSj1ehnWgbtHpRWeGZwUT34Tyug1md4Kt2rCjtXxspiKZS.jpeg) ![CINTILLO B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ydV5FZaqNcDMKtbipQ1N5NLm3e5QMkn955u9dcp41hg2uR4SL2MQnzytKVN11aTGikQ.jpg)

> The next step was quilting. For this, it's advisable to leave a margin of fabric and batting. This makes sewing easier, as the fabric sometimes shrinks due to the various seams. Use the main fabric as a guide, since it's the one that has the shape of the pot holder. Sew around the edge with a zigzag stitch and remove the excess fabric.

> El siguiente paso fue acolchar, para ello es recomendable dejar un margen de tela y guata, esto permite coser más cómodo, ya que las telas a veces reducen su tamaño por las diferentes costuras que se pasan, se toma como guía la tela principal, ya que esta es la que tiene la forma del agarrador de ollas; cosí por el contorno con puntada de zigzag y retiré el exceso de tela. ![AGARRADERAS (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EokeW6jBNpL8kNLa44JL41Cr7xLssPXWf7BVkCk5aQVMotUP6g4xxKPsrjGFRu5Jrbr.jpeg) ![CINTILLO B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ydV5FZaqNcDMKtbipQ1N5NLm3e5QMkn955u9dcp41hg2uR4SL2MQnzytKVN11aTGikQ.jpg)

> The next step was quilting. For this, it's advisable to leave a margin of fabric and batting. This makes sewing easier, as the fabric sometimes shrinks due to the various seams. Use the main fabric as a guide, since it's the one that has the shape of the pot holder. Sew around the edge with a zigzag stitch and remove the excess fabric.

> el siguiente paso fue acolchar, para ello es recomendable dejar un margen de tela y guata, esto permite coser más cómodo, ya que las telas a veces reducen su tamaño por las diferentes costuras que se pasan, se toma como guía la tela principal, ya que esta es la que tiene la forma del agarrador de ollas; cosí por el contorno con puntada de zigzag y retiré el exceso de tela. ![AGARRADORES DE OLLAS (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eos2JKYuRjooju9xVicEb8w8tEo4gfc2KpqhLm4riib1Qo1TsU7HsMEFm8yEwaSRtch.jpeg) ![CINTILLO B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ydV5FZaqNcDMKtbipQ1N5NLm3e5QMkn955u9dcp41hg2uR4SL2MQnzytKVN11aTGikQ.jpg)
> Then I sewed a straight stitch from the top to the bottom, forming an X. Then I sewed another stitch through the center of this X, and that's how the pieces are joined.

> Luego pasé una puntada recta desde el extremo superior hasta el inferior, formé una X, luego pasé otra costura por el centro de esta y así las piezas quedan unidas. ![AGARRADORES DE OLLAS (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EonkXUnLfYK8bYhDYNZDTHj1uyzuDg5HwhWnCPAxShcpCHTxYsz2zAMA8pVwGTT4rQp.jpeg) ![CINTILLO B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ydV5FZaqNcDMKtbipQ1N5NLm3e5QMkn955u9dcp41hg2uR4SL2MQnzytKVN11aTGikQ.jpg)

title.title: LIVE IN ALICANTE
title.body: > --- I attended the last Hive Live Event in Graz by chance (it so happened to be in the city were I reside) thanks to a YouTube notification. It was one of my major milestone as a Hivean, and for the next Hive Live Event in Alicante, I did make a conscious effort to attend and it turned out to be a pleasant experience. My trip to Alicante was tedious. I had to travel from Graz to Vienna to catch my first flight to Milan. The connecting flight to Alicante was about three hours after my arrival. I got to Alicante around 0:00 and still had to roam around for another 15 hours before I could check in to my hostel (always make your reservations yourself people!). So the entire hassle did ruin my plans with the hive community on that said day, and I had already missed out on the presentations the previous day.

> Things were not looking great on the first day of my trip, and I thought it might end up being a disaster, concerning I had just a few days to spend in Alicante. Fortunately, I was able to meet up for dinner later that evening, and it turned out great. Saw new and old faces. Had a couple chats whilst drinking beer. A perfect way to end a hectic day. I had plans to visit Ibiza the following day but after weighing my options I decided to forgo my trip to hangout with the Hive community, and in hindsight, it was the better choice.

>

The follow day we went on a city tour courtesy our wonderful tour guide @ninaeatshere. Our first stop was at Basilica De Santa Maria, one of the oldest active churches in Alicante built between the 14th-16th century. We were greeted by a warm-melodious song thanks to the choir and the immaculate view of the cathedral. It is always refreshing paying a visit to a church, and I enjoyed our brief visit.

---


<div class=\

> --- Our next stop was the Maca Art Museum. The museum is said to house one of Spain's most important 20th century art collection and I will agree. We got to view so many beautiful art works (and some funny ones as well).
> --- We continued our tour alongst the Santa Cruz district and we were able to experience the Cruces de Mayo festival, an important spring festival in Spain.

> After a busy day touring the city, the few of us left standing decided to make one last stop at the beach. Can't swim but I do enjoy going to the beach and this wasn't an exception. The view was perfect and I got to enjoy the sun for the first time in a long while. ---

title.title: Using Allowance as a Tool to Teach Financial Responsibility and Accountability to Children
title.body: The first place of learning for every child is their home. Kids learn financial discipline, accountabilty, budgeting, savings and contentment from home and that's why I believe kids shouldn't just be given an allowance but also be taught the value of finance, how to manage the finances given to them, accountability and budgeting from the allowance given to them. I will give my kids allowance, and also use that as a tool to teach them financial discipline and accountability. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUgJWZnZvPErmbQtD7SxaxWaFhmCPfdbXdb6ad9zeViku/1778214751419.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/black-boy-collecting-money-to-piggy-bank-0wsnmmbefiE) As a child I was only privileged to allowance when I needed it, because my parents provided all I needed at home and any money given to me was for a purpose. Having everything I needed, I used the money to satisfy some wants and in most cases saved for a particular desire. I believe children deserve allowance, but they also need supervision on how to spend and also, while making allowance available for kids, it's also necessary to teach them financial discipline, budgeting, and also make them understand that money does not always come at a free cost and the value of money. If my children have everything they need at home , I don't expect the child to use their daily or monthly allowance for irrelevant purposes, because I will always demand for accountability and budgeting. I believe the failure to inculcate these values and make them understand that nobody gets money for free, will makes kids to minimize entitlement. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXAQZxR2h6jjfcBpcsSQNQ2F3hGU61TLDEdC8jsqYCakY/1778214762466.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-holding-1-us-dollar-bill-GQ5uX_BlfmY) I want my children to have a better life than I had, but I won't do that at the expense of making them grow to be entitled adults that don't understand the value of money. Allowance will be given to my kids, but for a purpose and also as a part of financial management classes. I expect savings, because even as a child, the little money my parents gave me, taught me to save. I might have saved for less relevant occasions, but I cultivated a habit. Teach them to spend wisely and I understand budgeting better. Kids should definitely give account of how their allowance was spent, so, as parents, you should be aware of what they spend on. That's to prevent them from purchasing harmful things too. Also, there would be no fixed allowance for a child, especially a teenage child. The allowance that will be given to my child will be based on my choice and financial capacity, not the child's. It is from demanding habits that kids grow up with the mindset that the world or people around them owes them. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVoidbUxS19kw2LB9655qzvU8TQfYYAZiVUGKq3gqRSm7/1778214775807.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/mom-and-son-saving-money-to-piggy-bank-these-documents-are-our-own-generic-designs-they-do-not-infringe-on-any-copyrighted-designs-HcjbcZUqHdI) Allowance doesn't spoil or make a child bad, but rather it's a way of inculcating good values on kids. I know an aunt that never gives her kids allowance, but instead keeps her money where her kids are fully aware of and instructs the kids to give an account of every penny taken from the wallet. Allowance shouldn't just be given to kids for giving sake, but for a purpose. I will teach my child that allowance should not be spent without a plan and purpose. They should understand that money was earned through hardwork, not pick on street. They should understand that allowances aren't just free money, but money that should be spent with a purpose and accounted for. Give kids allowance to teach them financial discipline. The allowance should be a tool for teaching children to be financially responsible and accountable towards money. Parents should give allowance with the intention of teaching their kids to spend responsibility and grow up to be responsible adults. ### Thanks for reading ♥️ ### Vanilla 💗

title.title: Macramé keychains: a unique and beautiful project🩷
title.body: > Greetings and blessings, my dear creative friends. I hope you’re all doing well and staying healthy. It always happens to me that when I walk into Dollar City, I go in looking for one thing and end up finding a creative project that excites me. This time, I came across a kit for making macramé keychains, and honestly, I couldn’t resist. It came with everything I needed, and as soon as I got home, I wanted to get started. I love having these little projects on the side, in addition to my usual knitting and embroidery, because I feel like they help me unwind and try new techniques. So without further ado, here are the materials and step-by-step instructions for this beautiful macramé keychain project.

> Saludos y bendiciones, mis queridos amigos creativos. Espero que estén todos bien con salud y bienestar. Siempre me pasa que cuando entro a Dollarcity voy por una cosa y termino encontrando algún proyecto creativo que me emociona. Esta vez me encontré un kit para hacer llaveros en macramé y, sinceramente, no pude resistirme. Traía todo lo necesario y apenas llegué a casa quise comenzar. Me encanta tener estos pequeños proyectos aparte de mis tejidos y bordados habituales porque siento que me ayudan a desconectarme y probar técnicas nuevas. Así que sin más, les comparto los materiales y el paso a paso de este hermoso proyecto de llaveros en macramé. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23uEykz3jJ5LazDozuAWewqy1LNNKkjRHW8qggFLQ4JVqzRMDiaRXpQWGWBtvw2QWQSCp.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wqu7iJB8enPjYDZiLKHMTL7U4qYkvigXSApnujD2FT1SK5weXvNv8wWt3u13wmfvm2c.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wMckkwoWFV7DTtnSaPEXdQnbrFkp7GNbSjrVaBiirDFjCRnrfSbNig2MWfYrrmjPDYt.jpg |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23uEykz3jJ5LazDozuAWewqy1LNNKkjRHW8qggFLQ4JVqzRMDiaRXpQWGWBtvw2QWQSCp.png

> #### Materials The kit came with everything you need, and that’s what I liked best. It included: • Purple and fuchsia cord • Wooden beads • The metal keyring • Extra cord for the final knot Honestly, when a project comes with all the materials, you’re much more motivated to do it because there are no excuses not to get started.

> #### Materiales El kit venía súper completo y eso fue lo que más me gustó. Traía: • Cordón en color morado y fucsia • Cuentas de madera • El llavero metálico • Cordón adicional para el cierre final La verdad es que cuando un proyecto ya trae todos los materiales, uno se anima muchísimo más a hacerlo porque no hay excusas para empezar. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23uEykz3jJ5LazDozuAWewqy1LNNKkjRHW8qggFLQ4JVqzRMDiaRXpQWGWBtvw2QWQSCp.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/Eo8Ujh4xCAqfREUtSG16F4Jy4i9jzqEcRfduiKLkbwPs2zACFBkq1tVYX2qBdZL19uZ.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/EoK7MGYigQpEG9ga9rkLitvoiVawDUYoeMGKURQ2ULxQ4Qkig1WhEzLwAXTggXRsmpJ.jpg| |--|--| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgTtoDhtezxGBgrtjh4S4DtS1gY6XWr9i8muoJfc5xrk3766ErhC4MyWoJsbKWvwp7E.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xek6GLBqzmUFeoVPeg4evNfYVtuccLFxUrkijTFJ5smHjzTDAavn2xZWnozmm4BqG2F.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23uEykz3jJ5LazDozuAWewqy1LNNKkjRHW8qggFLQ4JVqzRMDiaRXpQWGWBtvw2QWQSCp.png

> #### Step by Step The first thing I did was thread the 85-cm cords through the metal keyring to secure them tightly. Then I tied lark’s head knots on each of the cords to secure them properly. That’s when the real concentration began. I then continued working with half double knots. I must admit that during that part I tried to do my best because it had been a while since I’d worked with this technique, and I’m still learning some macramé moves. Some knots require patience and practice. Even so, I really enjoyed the process. When I finished the first part, I threaded the wooden bead onto the middle cords. That detail completely changed the design because it gave it a much more delicate and handcrafted finish. Then I continued making double-loop knots all around the bead to secure it firmly and shape the keychain. To finish, I tied everything together using a joining knot with a 30 cm cord. Then I frayed the ends to create a small tassel, which was my favorite part because the keychain took on a style that I really like. In the end, I was delighted with the result. Beyond how it turned out, I really enjoyed the moment of sitting quietly to create something with my hands.

> #### Paso a paso Lo primero que hice fue colocar los cordones de 85 cm en el llavero metálico para sujetarlos bien. Después hice los nudos alondra en cada uno de los cordones para fijarlos correctamente. Ahí empezó la verdadera concentración. Luego seguí trabajando con nudos de medio enganche doble. Debo admitir que en esa parte traté de hacerlo lo mejor posible porque tenía tiempo que no tejía en esta técnica y todavía estoy aprendiendo algunos movimientos del macramé. Hay nudos que requieren paciencia y práctica. Aun así, disfruté muchísimo el proceso. Cuando terminé la primera parte, introduje la cuenta de madera en los cordones del medio. Ese detalle cambió completamente el diseño porque le dio un acabado mucho más delicado y artesanal. Después continué haciendo nudos de enganche doble alrededor de toda la cuenta para sujetarla bien y darle forma al llavero. Para finalizar, até todo usando un nudo de unión con un cordón de 30 cm. Luego despeiné las puntas para crear una pequeña borla, que fue mi parte favorita porque el llavero tomó un estilo que me gusta mucho. Al final quedé encantada con el resultado. Más allá de cómo quedó, disfruté muchísimo el momento de sentarme tranquila a crear algo con mis manos. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23uEykz3jJ5LazDozuAWewqy1LNNKkjRHW8qggFLQ4JVqzRMDiaRXpQWGWBtvw2QWQSCp.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xpCyxfpN51tzrtDitHdjLSGqMFXLnPXsEge4zWimvHo9epBN2fFFrMnPELGVZjcqvyb.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xyfpKJgdJHeLZiFA7nb1DbzbLLvum1JcqrZmrPbJhsLy6Sy5yvEop93F4cdmncyvhHH.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23uEykz3jJ5LazDozuAWewqy1LNNKkjRHW8qggFLQ4JVqzRMDiaRXpQWGWBtvw2QWQSCp.png

title.body: # Deliciosas galletas caseras de mantequilla [ESP/ENG]\n<div class=\

>

Hola amigos que me leen en la comunidad de @hivefood, Gusto en saludarlos. Espero que todos se encuentren bien de salud y que hayan pasado un hermoso día. Los invito a que visiten mi blog para que observen la deliciosa receta que hoy les traigo.

![30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zGoExrPLYjbcs6eru3pveDfGMrXLq8YSyfHKSL4savYqQ2WzY2P7YFf4BZDAmujYEmY.jpg)

Hoy una vez mas me encuentro con ustedes, con la finalidad de hacerles llegar una receta que es muy fácil, sencilla y rápida de preparar, además es una receta que lleva pocos ingredientes y es super deliciosa: Una ricas crocantes galletas de mantequilla.

![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpLhyLmawU79ruvSgxqvUpSXrWNrkQuNi894fD5oKMUbWTc9aejzyoqQW9MMsgwuiEW.jpg)
 
Estas galletas las hice en dos tandas, unas que las deje un poco mas crocante que son las que están mas doraditas y otras menos doradas, es decir quedan mas suaves. Les comento que de las dos versiones me encantan, pero prefiero las crocantes y doradas, en fin son super deliciosas, los invito a que la preparen, no se  a repetirán. Son super ricas con una taza de café, para las merienda delos mas pequeños para un pequeño presente , que es mi caso.

![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoGzSFm2AVfCYGUb1i17m17G77QNwetM6kTrpuGxVktVjsarXHBmojdMgKvEGteV92D.jpg)

Quise hacer estas galleticas para colocarla en bolsa pequeñas con una etiqueta y darle un pequeño presenta a las madres que asistan a misa, claro no voy hacer tantas, solo 100 paquetes de 4 galleticas cada una. Con los ingredientes que a continuación voy a mostrarle.

![29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23y8ux7Q37mYcXXnYciM5C24Svg1QapbSCVVPHphHkzMLnyDJ69KY3tKhNupsUqgAqzsU.jpg)

![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoyQ1cYkiAP8bHLyHBb5KFHrbyMG1RzWYKBhyZ4EV8yHP6TSnKHbrjmTkNtGA7cKora.jpg)

A continuación les indico los ingredientes y el paso a paso:

Ingredientes.
* 140 gramos de margarina
* 150 gramos de azúcar blanca o morena
* 320 gramos de harina leudante
*1 huevo
* 1/2 cucharadita de sal, 1 cucharadita de bicarbonato
* 1 cucharada de extracto de vainilla
* 1 o 2 cucharadas de ralladura de naranja
* Azúcar para espolvorear

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eou9G4pPm7E7ixEcrLQh2pLQAKYXnmc4PYeNrdRxpU1u2BppjbATFJzN1jrd3jHdSsj.jpg)

# Preparacion
 lo primero que hice fue preparar todo los ingredientes, es decir tenerlos listo, pesado para proceder a la preparación. 
Coloque en un bol de vidrio la mantequilla y el azúcar, con ayuda de las manos, le agrego el extracto de vainilla y voy amasando estos dos ingredientes.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uFTcnrJaoFHPnHi7LmjrX5KAmYHXGccMHWoDdsy6kauivbSa9VVSQ4YXqJirJmK6C3F.jpg)|![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMVxzW8HscHCR9pYxTuc5CrpNr2QBqYfNjxw6QGswpbcUYn74gYdijSWr2xPb54pYZJ.jpg)
-|-

Luego agrego el huevo entero y bato con la ayuda de una espátula, agrego la ralladura de naranja, le agrego la harina cernida debe tener el bicarbonato y la pizca de sal.

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQrM4w4u2qVXD8bZQu5Z7QG5mHiqyCvVBq78kT5fHjxYsh7zH7sEHckKvgpNcX4txsj.jpg)|![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoeFwuHLkSeoxgJ9LJ2mFwHYjRH7uEcWrHewZUNHAyHf3RSfyvCSPjmwzUPNqkM22Uk.jpg)
-|-

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EopuKGKhkkGvmN1AAHeFn4KQGQ3LkrT3efNRU68ASHrr5umsejrs3qxrRC8vVLmyHck.jpg)|![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wCBXW2KLfvFukH6x5E7fK1RCfQ8EiHwBxJYyWq5rpTipu4UB7frsnM1Lv2t9F33JoFx.jpg)
-|-

Amaso muy bien, introduzco en el frise por 20 minutos, la saco y empiezo a estirar y con un cortador a marcar y cortar las galletas a nuestro gusto

.
![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wWvrzRvRRZHQ6mwDKgwZ6mrNU3WQkgrKsznnV7gPHsxFfgmsbzTYTDYhMb7DfSfTFMh.jpg)|![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgQHAEZwsJTu5eJUDg5dsBtmUepVr9EsZE5RWCqBYCJeqhGknm26vdf8z2GWXRpsD9e.jpg)|![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eou8hxkHX4EB8QFD2red6a71stscgnLcfT21gTej16sULUYz8MFGJixezVoPZD2NuFF.jpg)
-|-|-

![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ywsYnkq51NPin3PAyokjA6zYRNgmN5ahFT8hryKXG3PQx61V9U6vdSZqPQKBNwuUBs6.jpg)|![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgMy5pUuawMhbQzNKxSPZ2t4r8ZG4ia5KCUaGgsYTnXxok7ncNZfRWpjLmERnr4qThT.jpg)|![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EonkbWQaVsSLxrmRboSStnowdS86cgGvWyY39U6wqrAvG3cFMa2WeDkHG2kKadVApy3.jpg)|![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wWwQu5hwpB3y4m3E8KExMDvCvSKa7BrKaMRVLWYKkozF9SNBgafHR5ivJ2pq7RuhcUf.jpg)
-|-|-|-

Introduzco al horno y las dejo de 10 a 15 minutos dependiendo lo doradas que las queramos, apago, bajo y listas para la merienda.

![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgKmus1ShtAdzXkU2HgsV5WSuBYUG4XwiVM2t38HzZ4Zf15iUDzamDg6VzwkwNL5RSx.jpg)|![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep5nAFfc9GrPjV4PN2Zr7kw89rUoCZFdwEDqoCYnprDMg6jX4Zamju7CK31Dkx4PjMv.jpg)
-|-

![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpLhyLmawU79ruvSgxqvUpSXrWNrkQuNi894fD5oKMUbWTc9aejzyoqQW9MMsgwuiEW.jpg)

Hasta aquí mi post, espero sea de su agrado y nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\
> # English Version # Delicious Homemade Butter Cookies

> Hello, friends who read my posts in the @hivefood community! It’s a pleasure to greet you. I hope you’re all in good health and had a wonderful day. I invite you to visit my blog to check out the delicious recipe I’m sharing with you today. ![30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zGoExrPLYjbcs6eru3pveDfGMrXLq8YSyfHKSL4savYqQ2WzY2P7YFf4BZDAmujYEmY.jpg) Today I’m back with you once again to share a recipe that’s very easy, simple, and quick to prepare. It also requires just a few ingredients and is super delicious: some tasty, crunchy butter cookies. ![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpLhyLmawU79ruvSgxqvUpSXrWNrkQuNi894fD5oKMUbWTc9aejzyoqQW9MMsgwuiEW.jpg) I made these cookies in two batches: some I left a little crispier—those are the more golden ones—and others less golden, meaning they’re softer. I have to say that I love both versions, but I prefer the crispy, golden ones. Anyway, they’re super delicious—I invite you to make them; I’m sure you’ll want to make them again. They’re delicious with a cup of coffee, for the little ones’ snack time, or as a small gift—which is my case. ![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoGzSFm2AVfCYGUb1i17m17G77QNwetM6kTrpuGxVktVjsarXHBmojdMgKvEGteV92D.jpg) I wanted to make these little cookies to put in small bags with a label and give them as a little gift to the mothers attending Mass. Of course, I’m not going to make that many—just 100 bags, each containing 4 cookies. Here are the ingredients I’ll be using. ![29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23y8ux7Q37mYcXXnYciM5C24Svg1QapbSCVVPHphHkzMLnyDJ69KY3tKhNupsUqgAqzsU.jpg) ![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoyQ1cYkiAP8bHLyHBb5KFHrbyMG1RzWYKBhyZ4EV8yHP6TSnKHbrjmTkNtGA7cKora.jpg) Here are the ingredients and step-by-step instructions: Ingredients. * 140 grams of margarine * 150 grams of white or brown sugar * 320 grams of self-rising flour * 1 egg * 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1 teaspoon of baking soda * 1 tablespoon of vanilla extract * 1 or 2 tablespoons of orange zest * Sugar for dusting ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eou9G4pPm7E7ixEcrLQh2pLQAKYXnmc4PYeNrdRxpU1u2BppjbATFJzN1jrd3jHdSsj.jpg) # Preparation The first thing I did was prepare all the ingredients—that is, have them ready and weighed out—so I could begin the preparation. I placed the butter and sugar in a glass bowl. Using my hands, I added the vanilla extract and began mixing these two ingredients together. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uFTcnrJaoFHPnHi7LmjrX5KAmYHXGccMHWoDdsy6kauivbSa9VVSQ4YXqJirJmK6C3F.jpg) |![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMVxzW8HscHCR9pYxTuc5CrpNr2QBqYfNjxw6QGswpbcUYn74gYdijSWr2xPb54pYZJ.jpg) -|- Then I add the whole egg and beat it with a spatula, add the orange zest, and add the sifted flour, which should include the baking soda and a pinch of salt. ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQrM4w4u2qVXD8bZQu5Z7QG5mHiqyCvVBq78kT5fHjxYsh7zH7sEHckKvgpNcX4txsj.jpg) |![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoeFwuHLkSeoxgJ9LJ2mFwHYjRH7uEcWrHewZUNHAyHf3RSfyvCSPjmwzUPNqkM22Uk.jpg) -|- ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EopuKGKhkkGvmN1AAHeFn4KQGQ3LkrT3efNRU68ASHrr5umsejrs3qxrRC8vVLmyHck.jpg) |![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wCBXW2KLfvFukH6x5E7fK1RCfQ8EiHwBxJYyWq5rpTipu4UB7frsnM1Lv2t9F33JoFx.jpg) -|- Knead very well, place in the fridge for 20 minutes, remove it, and begin rolling out the dough. Use a cookie cutter to shape and cut the cookies to your liking. ![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wWvrzRvRRZHQ6mwDKgwZ6mrNU3WQkgrKsznnV7gPHsxFfgmsbzTYTDYhMb7DfSfTFMh.jpg) |![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgQHAEZwsJTu5eJUDg5dsBtmUepVr9EsZE5RWCqBYCJeqhGknm26vdf8z2GWXRpsD9e.jpg) |![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eou8hxkHX4EB8QFD2red6a71stscgnLcfT21gTej16sULUYz8MFGJixezVoPZD2NuFF.jpg) -|-|- ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ywsYnkq51NPin3PAyokjA6zYRNgmN5ahFT8hryKXG3PQx61V9U6vdSZqPQKBNwuUBs6.jpg) |![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgMy5pUuawMhbQzNKxSPZ2t4r8ZG4ia5KCUaGgsYTnXxok7ncNZfRWpjLmERnr4qThT.jpg) |![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EonkbWQaVsSLxrmRboSStnowdS86cgGvWyY39U6wqrAvG3cFMa2WeDkHG2kKadVApy3.jpg) |![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wWwQu5hwpB3y4m3E8KExMDvCvSKa7BrKaMRVLWYKkozF9SNBgafHR5ivJ2pq7RuhcUf.jpg) -|-|-|- I put them in the oven and bake them for 10 to 15 minutes, depending on how golden we want them; then I turn off the oven, let them cool, and they’re ready for snack time. ![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgKmus1ShtAdzXkU2HgsV5WSuBYUG4XwiVM2t38HzZ4Zf15iUDzamDg6VzwkwNL5RSx.jpg)|![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep5nAFfc9GrPjV4PN2Zr7kw89rUoCZFdwEDqoCYnprDMg6jX4Zamju7CK31Dkx4PjMv.jpg) -|- ![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpLhyLmawU79ruvSgxqvUpSXrWNrkQuNi894fD5oKMUbWTc9aejzyoqQW9MMsgwuiEW.jpg) That's all for this post. I hope you enjoyed it, and I'll see you next time. * Photos taken with an iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with DeepL Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/deliciosas-galletas-caseras-de-mantequilla-espeng-3wb)

If you like the video, then of course you should give your important opinion and this is a living example of how a beautiful shop can be created in our country like in foreign countries. I only see such shops in the outside world through mobile or television. But it was beyond my imagination, which I saw with my own eyes today, especially in big influential countries such as America, various European countries, England and other countries. Such shops can be seen in various countries.

title.title: Buying School Supplies for Children While Supporting Community Outreach and Flores de Mayo Activities Together
title.body:
![Cokelat dan Krem Modern Kolase Foto Polaroid Liburan Buku Kliping.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48TofHAg7d7Km8NCUgM9wxhe6m1Yo68vD4CijEaDnMidkmq7g2tFuPSWBzicMk5B4B.png)

Hello everyone! Today was one of those meaningful and productive days that reminded me how important community involvement and volunteerism truly are. Despite having a busy schedule in life, I always believe that making time for activities that bring people together is something valuable and fulfilling.

As the Vice President of our chapel and one of the committee members for the Flores de Mayo celebration, I became part of the preparations for this yearly activity that many children and families look forward to. Flores de Mayo is widely celebrated in many communities in the Philippines during the month of May. Aside from the colorful flowers and activities, it also becomes a way to encourage unity, participation, and involvement among young people and parents in the community.

![IMG_20260426_083639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/2423ymZL6MzKiDtr6LJiujmFjm36eTyuh3qCy9sLvVSzSbPCiH3MAsGrexi23CFXDo45r.jpg)

Today, our priest and some mothers from the church visited us for a meeting and sharing of ideas regarding the preparation. During our discussion, I suggested asking for support from a friend of mine who is now a successful business owner and also my former classmate back in college. I was very happy and thankful because they welcomed the idea positively.

![received_1596010714828905.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/EpnCk3a5Q5afJHyHooMBEoEEDvpgfhdw4kEEQiMAruR3zwpoxYNYNu2mcCPkdHghub1.jpeg)

![received_1764975401542904.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/EpJYfCbnR5VT3UvBbvbWzQwYgm6VnQkEtVBoNPkpkgxcGD2c8BWVz3TJPKViHoEiicF.jpeg)

One of the most special parts of the day was receiving boxes of school supplies for the children. Seeing people willing to help and support community activities is truly inspiring. It reminded me that small acts of generosity can create a big impact, especially for young kids who will benefit from these simple gifts. All are happy and their parents chatting and saying thank you so much. 

![IMG_20260423_134525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wgHTqSKBsras7s6kUXdnKygL1gNQ4SwSHi3an1JEgUbS6ubLGwh4s4wEtVa2f8czg2v.jpg)

![IMG_20260423_134419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tbtuVrM1UXbC8q2zfVfhKGsYpUWLpFse7EoinaAyZwvhdJVaFZcS3h4SkcMmCqC3NGV.jpg)

After the meeting, I also went to town to buy additional school supplies and snacks for the children. To maintain transparency and proper accountability, all receipts were submitted to our treasurer and to the person who extended financial support. For me, transparency is important in every outreach activity because it builds trust and shows respect to those who are helping.

![IMG_20260423_134555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zS9TgmEinET6KWJBbeKtyn6DrauyuoydWGsAUL7q4Cgp1S7XwySSPjkRCDY7GdCjLAo.jpg)

It also makes me happy seeing more people actively attending the Flores de Mayo activities. The church becomes lively, children become more active, and the sense of community becomes stronger. Moments like this show that even simple gatherings can create meaningful connections among people.

![received_979802967766109.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/245wRnDdbchhJ3DwkvEHmFxJuqj8rq9UAfVsiuxLPoH8ip8dWZKCdW2rbrMSSq9ZC7pEy.jpeg)

Thank you for reading my story, this is my owned picture. Edited in Canva. Through experiences like this, I realized that serving the community is not only about giving material things, but also about giving time, effort, ideas, and presence. Even with the pressures and responsibilities of daily life, participating in activities like this gives a different kind of fulfillment.

Someday, I also hope to organize more outreach activities in our place in the mountains. It has always been one of my dreams to give back and help children and families in our community in the future. title.title: Kilometers pass, scenes remain//MONOMAD CHALLENGE
title.body: >Good morning dear Friends in the Black And White Community 🙌📸\n\n

>Sometimes we don't see some landscapes with our eyes but with our feelings, and those of us who love photography record these feelings with our lenses. Just like us, nature bears its scars, but it still looks magnificent and divine, and its beauty is often in its imperfections. And so, sometimes the view out the window is enough of a reminder of how big the world is, how small we are and how we need to protect it, and the mountains preserve stories that people have long forgotten. Nature always knows how to silence what is making too much noise inside us, and that was exactly true for me that day. Returning home, new obligations, new insecurities and new, ordinary life problems. Nothing spectacular, but enough to start the noise inside me. And then, just that view out the bus window, a camera in my hand and total peace.
>So, let's go see together that peace in my mind trough the Shots, but first
>I took the photos with a Olympus E-M10 Mark III, 40-150mm, f/4, auto mode. Processing in Photoshop Action-Black&White3.\n\n
>This is all for Today, see you Tomorrow!\n\n

Investing in dependable cleaning and hygiene solutions is not only about keeping spaces neat; it is about protecting people and preserving professional standards. title.title: My entry to the Phone Photography Contest, #111 [En-Es] Gymnetis pantherina
title.body:
**Blessings, friends.**

>**Bendiciones amigos.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFLwFpeVgBG37gPspj6PXYKGi3GhcPjJj7zUfZmYENsn/1778198805402.jpg)
<center>

***I found two beetles on the lawn that seemed to be learning to fly.***

>**Encontré dos escarabajos en el césped que parecían estar aprendiendo a volar.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8XQ2jrURd25QkthESnU5d4ufpcbgA1XjhANay7ivLhU/1777991886251.jpg)
<center>

**They measured about 18 millimeters, had an orange back with dark spots, and their ventral side, legs, eyes and antennae were completely black.**

>**Medían unos 18 milímetros,  tenían el dorso anaranjado con manchas oscuras, el lado ventral, patas, ojos y antenas completamente negros.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQRbAeRS6LJ2EKQEovv8Mot6FCamGsN15dX3ban9rQaNV/1777849512587.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZm8QPeWoBuWuJxEgG83CSbpkYMYUwbUq8eqjyNSnSu75/1777991886174.jpg)
<center>

**They seemed less fearsome than another beetle I found a few days ago, a tiger beetle. This one, while also beautiful and beneficial, is a skilled predator of other insects.**

>**Parecían menos temibles que otro escarabajo que encontré días atras, un escarabajo tigre.  Este,  siendo tambien bonito y beneficioso, es un  hábil depredador de otros insectos.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS4n7NQDQHbdVeM3iKqyHmbJix9KDmxTypjivRbRARRaQ/1778031984288.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcyF6e8nB9B7P66AxUeHGPa5TCycLTmpsJi5TTvopg2En/1777659168927.jpg)
<center>

**[Gymnetis pantherina](https://pictureinsect.com/es/wiki/Gymnetis_pantherina.html) pollinates while feeding on flowers. Thanks to this, some plants develop fruit.**

>**[Gymnetis pantherina](https://pictureinsect.com/es/wiki/Gymnetis_pantherina.html) poliniza mientras se alimenta en las flores. Gracias a ello, algunas plantas desarrollan  frutos.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdQaQTXFViXRN48zghUiHGNWU7DKLaB2dL1kE3zdLX6Cf/1777659169012.jpg)
<center>

**I had described them in another post using the common name of flower beetles. This time I was able to see them in a more natural environment and identify exactly which species they belong to.**

>**Yo los había descrito en otro post con el nombre común  de escarabajos de las flores. Esta vez pude verlos en un ambiente más natural e identificar exactamente a qué especie pertenecen.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbag4yu7zEr5JavcwxeBRU8hhZ5d3ybPirSfCSfQmtRBr/1777991827674.jpg)
<center>

**To photograph the first one, I made it climb onto a dry leaf, from there I transported it to a tree trunk and then it flew away.**

>*Para fotografiar al primero de ellos hice que subiera a una hoja seca, de allí lo transporté al tronco de un árbol  y después voló.*

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpKsgyWa4yVBootSH5YqnWK6gr8jvzBVdx6uSLjdeuCM/1777659081076.jpg)
<center>

**Another one appeared later, with the same colors but duller.
I picked it up too, this time with my hand, and it flew quickly toward the trees.**

>**Otro ejemplar apareció después, con los mismos colores pero más opacos .
Tambien lo alcé,  esta vez con mi mano,  y voló rápidamente hacia los árboles.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczehAdSY1jPNfv8zii7FKiUmGU6kJWZDfTTu5JewBS3q/1777723935392.jpg)
<center>

**I thought maybe they had just emerged from the ground in a youth stadium and were showing off their wings for the first time.**

>**Pensé que tal vez acababan de salir de la tierra en un estadio juvenil y estaban  estrenando sus alas.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmST1PPc7cZ4RjZf7U4rHTX3RM3UQYGQnhGMH9qPLgu7go/1777849512771.jpg)
<centrr>

**I also considered the possibility that it was a pair trying to mate.**

>**Tambien creí en la posibilidad de que se tratara de una pareja intentado aparearse.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqDMrrYzS4NCrbHqTeu9WL1x9KfrbYabG2nuJRf7XeRQ/1777991740843.jpg)
<center>

**The next day I heard a buzzing sound and discovered one fluttering near some loquats that were on the ground.**

>**Al dia siguiente escuché un zumbido y descubrí a uno revoloteando cerca de unos  nísperos que estaban en el suelo.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVajRQ6JZBGn5UdJAPbK7GLWHjHcmoYYwSLrBkMeoFF7q/1777760913244.jpg)
<center>

**[Six Pattes](https://www.six-pattes.com/es/cetonia/283-gymnetis-pantherina.html) has catalogs where they offer them for sale. They also offer everything necessary for their breeding, and valuable information about their biology.**

>**[Six pattes](https://www.six-pattes.com/es/cetonia/283-gymnetis-pantherina.html) tiene catalogos donde los ofrece en venta. También ofrece lo necesario para su cría, e información valiosa sobre su biología.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTEG9GYwx8aqVQjEZpa99uPjbKChvHf684jMG2tg5yv3q/1777991827541.jpg)
<center>

**If this beetle is turned upside down on a smooth surface, it cannot right itself.**

>**Si este escarabajo es volteado patas arriba en una superficie lisa no puede  incorporarse solo.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmak7cURaCduariG8Wm5etXAtesiUTnPa8B47vtiHm3xWF/1777723935441.jpg)
<ceter>

**The male has a dull gray ventral face, and the female has a shiny black one.**

>**El macho tiene la cara ventral gris opaco y la hembra lo tiene negro brillante.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFRyQ1CW8Wi7UL5981CVpaRVcUY3S4KE98drPD9B6AuY/1777991860302.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmet29fM3ALwkcGBPaYTR1RT1p3yiLa4URB7f9P11kytjk/1777849512513.jpg)
<center>

**Gymnetis pantherina belongs to the subfamily [Cetoniinae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cetoniinae?wprov=sfla1) or flower beetles, it lives in Venezuela but has also been reported in Colombia. 
 It feeds on, in addition to pollen, nectar, fruits and flowers.**

>**Gymnetis pantherina pertenece a la subfamilia [Cetoniinae](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cetoniinae?wprov=sfla1) o escarabajos de las flores, habita Venezuela pero tambien se ha reportado en Colombia. 
Se alimenta de, ademas de polen,  de néctar, frutos y flores.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmest13BhmebjRzUkQrdhwgrQBvdYRQhHKiRMtaUJdpxXN/1777991860569.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYu5EKDj9JLVuQepYkRbuSMZLwPGJM7Q6DrRE7HjUcsMu/1777991741016.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcPsEBFzSvtAP2N6yMrpxfindMPMnoRfo1ZpPuNz36y62/1777849512642.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVciJmom4NyLbf9aqPSGxYu8MJu4y2kpeC6VBmjrcAvHb/1777991827301.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPVYPx9WzPHc5fps8jtQisosH8QGvQ8sutphdjSJPDz2/1777991740922.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWd4Ff87JBHpWFkxat2XFgdQ3QThf5VFVd1WyGka5xAh8/1777991827356.jpg)
<center>

**All photos were taken with my Samsung Galaxy A15 smartphone.**

>**Todas las fotos fueron tomadas con mi teléfono inteligente Samsung Galaxy A15.**

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYioawRaiULgbxn6aRhz1k3THovypFspg5aRxSJMBKfou/1777849512701.jpg)
<center>

**Thank you so much for stopping by and reading my post.**

title.title: Deliciosa galletas caseras de mantequilla [ESP/ENG]
title.body: # Deliciosa galletas caseras de mantequilla [ESP/ENG]\n<div class=\

>

Hola amigos que me leen en la comunidad de @hivefood, Gusto en saludarlos. Espero que todos se encuentren bien de salud y que hayan pasado un hermoso día. Los invito a que visiten mi blog para que observen la deliciosa receta que hoy les traigo.

![30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zGoExrPLYjbcs6eru3pveDfGMrXLq8YSyfHKSL4savYqQ2WzY2P7YFf4BZDAmujYEmY.jpg)

Hoy una vez mas me encuentro con ustedes, con la finalidad de hacerles llegar una receta que es muy fácil, sencilla y rápida de preparar, además es una receta que lleva pocos ingredientes y es super deliciosa: Una ricas crocantes galletas de mantequilla.

![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpLhyLmawU79ruvSgxqvUpSXrWNrkQuNi894fD5oKMUbWTc9aejzyoqQW9MMsgwuiEW.jpg)
 
Estas galletas las hice en dos tandas, unas que las deje un poco mas crocante que son las que están mas doraditas y otras menos doradas, es decir quedan mas suaves. Les comento que de las dos versiones me encantan, pero prefiero las crocantes y doradas, en fin son super deliciosas, los invito a que la preparen, no se  a repetirán. Son super ricas con una taza de café, para las merienda delos mas pequeños para un pequeño presente , que es mi caso.

![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoGzSFm2AVfCYGUb1i17m17G77QNwetM6kTrpuGxVktVjsarXHBmojdMgKvEGteV92D.jpg)

Quise hacer estas galleticas para colocarla en bolsa pequeñas con una etiqueta y darle un pequeño presenta a las madres que asistan a misa, claro no voy hacer tantas, solo 100 paquetes de 4 galleticas cada una. Con los ingredientes que a continuación voy a mostrarle.

![29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23y8ux7Q37mYcXXnYciM5C24Svg1QapbSCVVPHphHkzMLnyDJ69KY3tKhNupsUqgAqzsU.jpg)

![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoyQ1cYkiAP8bHLyHBb5KFHrbyMG1RzWYKBhyZ4EV8yHP6TSnKHbrjmTkNtGA7cKora.jpg)

A continuación les indico los ingredientes y el paso a paso:

Ingredientes.
* 140 gramos de margarina
* 150 gramos de azúcar blanca o morena
* 320 gramos de harina leudante
*1 huevo
* 1/2 cucharadita de sal, 1 cucharadita de bicarbonato
* 1 cucharada de extracto de vainilla
* 1 o 2 cucharadas de ralladura de naranja
* Azúcar para espolvorear

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eou9G4pPm7E7ixEcrLQh2pLQAKYXnmc4PYeNrdRxpU1u2BppjbATFJzN1jrd3jHdSsj.jpg)

# Preparacion
 lo primero que hice fue preparar todo los ingredientes, es decir tenerlos listo, pesado para proceder a la preparación. 
Coloque en un bol de vidrio la mantequilla y el azúcar, con ayuda de las manos, le agrego el extracto de vainilla y voy amasando estos dos ingredientes.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uFTcnrJaoFHPnHi7LmjrX5KAmYHXGccMHWoDdsy6kauivbSa9VVSQ4YXqJirJmK6C3F.jpg)|![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMVxzW8HscHCR9pYxTuc5CrpNr2QBqYfNjxw6QGswpbcUYn74gYdijSWr2xPb54pYZJ.jpg)
-|-

Luego agrego el huevo entero y bato con la ayuda de una espátula, agrego la ralladura de naranja, le agrego la harina cernida debe tener el bicarbonato y la pizca de sal.

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQrM4w4u2qVXD8bZQu5Z7QG5mHiqyCvVBq78kT5fHjxYsh7zH7sEHckKvgpNcX4txsj.jpg)|![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoeFwuHLkSeoxgJ9LJ2mFwHYjRH7uEcWrHewZUNHAyHf3RSfyvCSPjmwzUPNqkM22Uk.jpg)

<div class=\
> # English Version # Delicious Homemade Butter Cookies

> Hello, friends who read my posts in the @hivefood community! It’s a pleasure to greet you. I hope you’re all in good health and had a wonderful day. I invite you to visit my blog to check out the delicious recipe I’m sharing with you today. ![30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zGoExrPLYjbcs6eru3pveDfGMrXLq8YSyfHKSL4savYqQ2WzY2P7YFf4BZDAmujYEmY.jpg) Today I’m back with you once again to share a recipe that’s very easy, simple, and quick to prepare. It also requires just a few ingredients and is super delicious: some tasty, crunchy butter cookies. ![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpLhyLmawU79ruvSgxqvUpSXrWNrkQuNi894fD5oKMUbWTc9aejzyoqQW9MMsgwuiEW.jpg) I made these cookies in two batches: some I left a little crispier—those are the more golden ones—and others less golden, meaning they’re softer. I have to say that I love both versions, but I prefer the crispy, golden ones. Anyway, they’re super delicious—I invite you to make them; I’m sure you’ll want to make them again. They’re delicious with a cup of coffee, for the little ones’ snack time, or as a small gift—which is my case. ![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoGzSFm2AVfCYGUb1i17m17G77QNwetM6kTrpuGxVktVjsarXHBmojdMgKvEGteV92D.jpg) I wanted to make these little cookies to put in small bags with a label and give them as a little gift to the mothers attending Mass. Of course, I’m not going to make that many—just 100 bags, each containing 4 cookies. Here are the ingredients I’ll be using. ![29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23y8ux7Q37mYcXXnYciM5C24Svg1QapbSCVVPHphHkzMLnyDJ69KY3tKhNupsUqgAqzsU.jpg) ![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoyQ1cYkiAP8bHLyHBb5KFHrbyMG1RzWYKBhyZ4EV8yHP6TSnKHbrjmTkNtGA7cKora.jpg) Here are the ingredients and step-by-step instructions: Ingredients. * 140 grams of margarine * 150 grams of white or brown sugar * 320 grams of self-rising flour * 1 egg * 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1 teaspoon of baking soda * 1 tablespoon of vanilla extract * 1 or 2 tablespoons of orange zest * Sugar for dusting ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eou9G4pPm7E7ixEcrLQh2pLQAKYXnmc4PYeNrdRxpU1u2BppjbATFJzN1jrd3jHdSsj.jpg) # Preparation The first thing I did was prepare all the ingredients—that is, have them ready and weighed out—so I could begin the preparation. I placed the butter and sugar in a glass bowl. Using my hands, I added the vanilla extract and began mixing these two ingredients together. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uFTcnrJaoFHPnHi7LmjrX5KAmYHXGccMHWoDdsy6kauivbSa9VVSQ4YXqJirJmK6C3F.jpg) |![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMVxzW8HscHCR9pYxTuc5CrpNr2QBqYfNjxw6QGswpbcUYn74gYdijSWr2xPb54pYZJ.jpg) -|- Then I add the whole egg and beat it with a spatula, add the orange zest, and add the sifted flour, which should include the baking soda and a pinch of salt. ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQrM4w4u2qVXD8bZQu5Z7QG5mHiqyCvVBq78kT5fHjxYsh7zH7sEHckKvgpNcX4txsj.jpg) |![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoeFwuHLkSeoxgJ9LJ2mFwHYjRH7uEcWrHewZUNHAyHf3RSfyvCSPjmwzUPNqkM22Uk.jpg) -|- ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EopuKGKhkkGvmN1AAHeFn4KQGQ3LkrT3efNRU68ASHrr5umsejrs3qxrRC8vVLmyHck.jpg) |![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wCBXW2KLfvFukH6x5E7fK1RCfQ8EiHwBxJYyWq5rpTipu4UB7frsnM1Lv2t9F33JoFx.jpg) -|- Knead very well, place in the fridge for 20 minutes, remove it, and begin rolling out the dough. Use a cookie cutter to shape and cut the cookies to your liking. ![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wWvrzRvRRZHQ6mwDKgwZ6mrNU3WQkgrKsznnV7gPHsxFfgmsbzTYTDYhMb7DfSfTFMh.jpg) |![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgQHAEZwsJTu5eJUDg5dsBtmUepVr9EsZE5RWCqBYCJeqhGknm26vdf8z2GWXRpsD9e.jpg) |![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eou8hxkHX4EB8QFD2red6a71stscgnLcfT21gTej16sULUYz8MFGJixezVoPZD2NuFF.jpg) -|-|- ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ywsYnkq51NPin3PAyokjA6zYRNgmN5ahFT8hryKXG3PQx61V9U6vdSZqPQKBNwuUBs6.jpg) |![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgMy5pUuawMhbQzNKxSPZ2t4r8ZG4ia5KCUaGgsYTnXxok7ncNZfRWpjLmERnr4qThT.jpg) |![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EonkbWQaVsSLxrmRboSStnowdS86cgGvWyY39U6wqrAvG3cFMa2WeDkHG2kKadVApy3.jpg) |![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wWwQu5hwpB3y4m3E8KExMDvCvSKa7BrKaMRVLWYKkozF9SNBgafHR5ivJ2pq7RuhcUf.jpg) -|-|-|- I put them in the oven and bake them for 10 to 15 minutes, depending on how golden we want them; then I turn off the oven, let them cool, and they’re ready for snack time. ![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgKmus1ShtAdzXkU2HgsV5WSuBYUG4XwiVM2t38HzZ4Zf15iUDzamDg6VzwkwNL5RSx.jpg)|![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep5nAFfc9GrPjV4PN2Zr7kw89rUoCZFdwEDqoCYnprDMg6jX4Zamju7CK31Dkx4PjMv.jpg) -|- ![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpLhyLmawU79ruvSgxqvUpSXrWNrkQuNi894fD5oKMUbWTc9aejzyoqQW9MMsgwuiEW.jpg) That's all for this post. <center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g81aa54643069a0528301073f4695baa0737371d54a22e8558ff298ea8245194ad758c12cce9f91552ecfaf58c890de7bafc52ef593999f3facfa3f20ed170f6c_640.jpg)</center>

***

当然可以！以下是关于自然的博客主题建议，采用Markdown格式：

```markdown
# 探索四季的魅力

四季更替，带来了自然界的无限变化与美丽。这篇博客将带你走进四季的世界，感受每个季节独特的魅力。

## 春天：复苏的季节

春天是万物复苏的季节，树木发芽，花儿竞相开放。这个季节象征着新的开始和希望。

- **花卉**：樱花、郁金香、迎春花等，绽放出五彩斑斓的色彩。
- **气候**：温暖的阳光和适宜的气温，适合户外活动。
- **活动建议**：春游、野餐、园艺等。

## 夏天：热情的季节

夏天是阳光明媚、充满活力的季节。人们在这个季节享受阳光、海滩和各种户外活动。

- **自然景观**：碧海蓝天、绿树成荫，是度假的理想之地。
- **气候**：炎热的天气，适合游泳、烧烤等。
- **活动建议**：海滩派对、露营、徒步旅行等。

## 秋天：丰收的季节

秋天是丰收的季节，树叶变色，果实成熟，给人带来宁静与思考的时刻。

- **自然景观**：金黄的稻田、红色的枫叶，构成了一幅美丽的画卷。
- **气候**：凉爽的气温，适合户外探险。
- **活动建议**：采摘果实、徒步旅行、赏枫等。

## 冬天：静谧的季节

冬天是一个宁静而神秘的季节，雪花飘落，万物沉寂，给人一种宁静的美感。

- **自然景观**：白雪皑皑的山脉、冰封的湖泊，展现出独特的冬季风情。
- **气候**：寒冷的气温，适合滑雪、冰上活动等。
- **活动建议**：滑雪、堆雪人、温泉旅行等。

## 结语

四季的变化不仅带来了自然风光的不同，也影响着我们的生活与心情。让我们在每个季节中找到属于自己的乐趣，去探索、去体验大自然的魅力吧！
```

title.title: Making it a three day weekend
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d0cca1de-897d-4bf9-8fb5-f1bc15fbfb07.jpg) We had the most unusual summer in April / May this year. The weather is worm and almost feels like a real summer. I almost miss the rain. We probably would need rain soon to water the grass. I have an irrigation system, but this is way too early to turn it on. Usually I run it first time in June or July. Tomorrow I am taking off from work and we are going for the early Mother's day St. Edward Afternoon Tea. Should be a fun little event, though I am still on the hook to drive our daughter to school and back which should only consume a couple hours tomorrow. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d9e268ae-24e8-4721-a430-cbad544e2dea.jpg) And we are going to pick up my mother in law on the way there. In between I am planning to do a couple things around the house, like vacuuming the first and second floors. While we have a nice and early start to our weekend, this weekend promises to be an eventful one, on Saturday we are going to work on AI agents for my wife's business and I will also have to do some tax reporting. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e9e3d423-eb6a-4891-95d5-85014db50d84.jpg) On Sunday our son is coming over for a workout and a movie hopefully. He was actually here this week due to an internet outage at his place and he needed a reliable internet connection to work remotely. So he was here in the morning and until six in the evening when he had to go to his evening MBA class. It was nice to have dinner together, we has meatballs and pasta that my wife made and he really enjoyed that dish. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9fb18d70-1f99-44c8-ab3d-df26230c55c4.jpg) But we didn't have time for a workout and we have not worked out together for a while since we were sick, then went to Hawaii for slightly more than a week and then his MBA classes started. Sounds like his classes are hard, especially financial analysis class that he kept talking about. He is also cramming four graduate school classes in each quarter, because University of Washington is encouraging it. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4ad6395f-428a-4ea8-9106-75281c7a028f.jpg) Basically if you take one class you have to pay five thousand dollars for it, but if you take four classes you only pay ten thousand dollars. So basically you get two classes for free. If he gets good grades his employer also reimburses up to five thousand dollars per year. So that is a good deal. What is not a good deal is that we found out this year that lifetime learning credit is not available for him even though he is making a normal or actually below normal salary for his age. Those numbers really need to get updated for the cost of living increases. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8791c721-1b13-4565-b2c2-21eaba9cf331.jpg) At work it is all about AI, what we found out is that any time humans are involved in the process it really slows down the roll out of the AI developed software. We quickly roll out new functioning systems, but it takes forever for functional analysts to validate that everything is there and sign off on it and the same goes for the users of the system and security office. We should automate more of these processes as I believe AI will do those tasks quicker and more thoroughly. At this point humans are the bottleneck, no wonder companies are laying off people... ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3ff37650-6bd0-4f29-8f0d-e632d7614664.jpg) Those layoffs are probably speeding up delivery of the systems, but at some point there will be no humans working and if there are no humans working then there will be no consumers buying products that companies are producing using AI and the whole economy is going to come crashing down as we have a consumption based economy. Something will have to change, but I don't think governments and people are ready for it...
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@seattlea/actifit-seattlea-20260508t041541175z)_

# <center> Namaste 🇮🇳🙏🏻</center>
____________________________________


Hello Friends, How are you all ?? Wishing you all happy and prosperous life Ahead.

Today i would like to share the recipe of **Fried Noodles Rice** it is made up of noodles & Rice sauted with Veggies of your choice and Spices & Herbs. It can be served during Lunch or Dinner. It is easiest & Quickest to prepare your meal with minimal Ingredients even you can try this recipe with leftover rice, just simply boiled the noodles, actually I always want to eat junk food but with Indian spices and Flavours, I have try this recipe for the first time, kids gonna like it as it contains Noodles, you can add veggies of your Choice. Try this recipe & let me know in the comment section, how was it.


![1000665967.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/EouC4tQMhTu7gv4wrZtftqZ3wsBroDnbie6vinPeGTAW17jw8dfzo7pTRVHpWNDE1Mv.png)


____________________________________
# <center> Timming 🕡</center>
____________________________________

|Preparation Time|10 Minutes|
|-|-|
|Soaked Time| 10 Minutes|
|Cooking Time|20 Minutes|
|Cuisine|Indian|
|Course|Main Course|
|Serving|2 Person|




____________________________________
# <center> Ingredients 📃</center>
____________________________________

• 1 cup of Rice.
• 200 grms of Noodles.
• 1 Chopped Onion.
• 1/2 Chopped capsicum.
• 2 Slit Green Chilli.
• 4-5 chopped cloves of Garlic.
• 1/2 tbsp of cumin.
• Pinch of Asafoetida.
• 1 Sachet of Maggi Masala.
• 1/2 tbsp of Red Chilli powder.
• 1/2 tbsp of Garam Masala.
• Green Coriander leaves for Garnish.
• salt to taste.
• water as required.



____________________________________
# <center> Process 👨🏻‍🍳</center>
____________________________________


![1000664800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23tveHxMqogPkJKEsTQm7z9BxH2QNyqYCnuL2wizrW9C33t1y22zVfijhCwuRyQxtFYLy.jpg)

Measure out the desired amount of rice, then wash it 3 to 4 times thoroughly until the water runs clear and all impurities are removed.

![1000664817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23vsQkWoQPFgQYo8ReCHLfHhHFm9rjRnng1EbS73kAhBkFZfk9GfXwmDRkFVWyKsP9c4x.jpg)

Now, let it soak for about 10 to 15 minutes. Soaking rice makes it cook faster and makes it softer


![1000664809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242NoKz7yNrne4LphBfdZ7nHNWDkrsLDUKXXNsYsWZ6fbWvHVgTspoNzrqaQ6ey6pve6C.jpg)

Discard that water, add fresh water, and set it to cook.


![1000664812.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242YBrhYvMrGoK1BMPTDq4tT1ZtfGHN9zsALqb7DDgJ4iRfGpqozGuEaZxGRN66g7xCsy.jpg)

Add the noodles when your rice is half-cooked and stir occasionally to prevent them from sticking to the bottom.Cook the rice & noodles until soft.

Tip: Don't overcook the rice; try to keep it at 90% cooked because the rice shouldn't be too soft when making fried rice.

![1000664797.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xAZpd3xKWhyKTZZHbX25eWuHzs1DeXbA35uz28rZYwRFnLxNdy9w4oqmaga3YGZqdpD.jpg)

Drain the rice and noodles using a strainer and immediately pour cold water over them to remove excess starch and prevent stickiness. Keep it aside.

____________________________________


![1000665514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23tmN1hLTDQpmxJjuAy6H5b9fSoNQ7jXDx7zgfXGK2RqW218h7KAd5fNgyh9AHrXLPdVn.jpg)

Heat the oil in the kadai, add cumin, asafoetida and Garlic, cook until  its get aromatic.

![1000665513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23ywyLr963hEoQMqLNbpoy8fCni8Ha2MXRJgqsHtuHXGrb3BV2riG5z6hQ6jVhrF9v1Bm.jpg)

add the chopped onion & capsicum, cooked untill it get translucent.

![1000664802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242YCCQsPmKpfc3dGj9QNaEANA2JfyrkAsaXge2BLXERGbBTmiEkxXXUbTyQhrCKTs3uq.jpg)

Lower the flame, add maggi masala, red Chilli powder and Salt, add few drops of water to avoid burning of Spices.

![1000664803.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242DQbktX7niBZuxb5zZE96Lwt8km4LSGX1fJZbUBD8PKwBT4d7pf6yDYtgv8dYpwmEgg.jpg)

Now add boiled rice Nd noodles, mix well so that spices get well coated with rice & Noodles. Mix it with soft hand to avoid the breaking of Rice Grains. cook it for another 2-3 minutes so that spices well absorb by noodles & Rice.

![1000664810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23tvnuKSHcq2R5uFAM1N7d83XwdLj4pr8MyCM8a479Z8WnYB7B8DL5Lq3HukQE75cLz8Z.jpg)


Serve the Hot Fried Noodles Rice with Flavoured Curd or sauce of your Choice.


It's Delicious and easy to cook recipe, try it. 'm sure you are gonna love it. Try this recipe and let me know how it is. For more indian cuisine stay connected to my blogs.

My Afternoon Walk: Golden Sunset and Colorful Flaglets
title.body:
/>

Yesterday was a beautiful day for a walk. I stepped outside at 5:00 PM to enjoy the fresh air. The sun was starting to go down, giving everything a soft and warm glow.

I walked to the Provincial Capitol. As I got closer, I saw the sunlight hitting the building. The white walls started to turn golden yellow 😁. The sky above was a pretty shade of ash blue with thin, wispy clouds floating by.

Then I saw the iconic \
sign. It has a new look. The letters now have different bright colors, adding more festive vibe to the place. The big and yellow mango is still there next to it.\n\n

/> * * * * * * The capitol grounds were full of life and color. I saw some bright festive banderitas. There were long strings of flaglets in red, blue, yellow, and green stretched across the paths. There were also small colored flags. Those tiny flags danced in the breeze on tall white poles at the side of the road.
/>\n\nI also saw a large poster that said \
It is happening from May 15 to May 24, 2026. This festival celebrates the famous sweet mangoes that grow here on the island. I am looking forward to the \
Mangoes. 😋 All these decorations are for the Manggahan Festival. You can feel the excitement in the air as everyone gets ready for the big celebration.

/> Even the trees seemed to be part of the show. Some had orange leaves that looked like fire against the blue sky. I walked along the new brick paths and watched the sunset. The ground turned bright orange as the sun slowly dipped down. I walked around the square for a while and enjoyed the peaceful moment.
/> It was a very peaceful walk. Seeing the colorful flags and the golden capitol made me feel happy and proud of my hometown. I can't wait for the festival to start. 🥰

>Texts and Images by @vvodjiu

All photos were edited on Lightroom for minimal enhancements

Hello everyone have a nice day to you all where ever part of the world you are right now.. yesterday afternoon, as the sun was slowly sitting behind the clouds and the sky was still blue.. the clouds were so beautiful to look at. With the golden edge from the rays of the sun hidden behind them.. as if they were telling me that the days to come will be beautiful...

title.title: 🌱 From Flowers to Fresh Pods – My Green Beans Are Thriving! 🌿
title.body:
Hello dear Ecency & Hive family! 👋
Yesterday I went out to my small farm here in Lusaka, Zambia to check on my green beans, and what a pleasant surprise I got! The plants have moved from just growing leaves to full flowering stage, and the young tender beans have already started developing. Seeing those delicate white and pale yellow flowers turning into slim, vibrant green pods is such a rewarding sight for any farmer.
I captured these moments yesterday 






![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUhByrtWKuGctJUu22xCec8BtEvC1qoq2aRporVraU9D/1778213233455.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdQ9UDeBvpjJiegsGd1KwYEDe37RZx1GZmQBrwnnyTJVk/1778213233981.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUmrMj2tiGvnnZNwswKJ7giWPGxg1cnzL1pranY5WdSLK/1778213234318.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUhByrtWKuGctJUu22xCec8BtEvC1qoq2aRporVraU9D/1778213265767.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdQ9UDeBvpjJiegsGd1KwYEDe37RZx1GZmQBrwnnyTJVk/1778213266084.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUmrMj2tiGvnnZNwswKJ7giWPGxg1cnzL1pranY5WdSLK/1778213266346.jpg)
during the golden hour. The plants are looking healthy with their broad trifoliate leaves, though I noticed a few yellow spots here and there (probably minor nutrient stress or early pest pressure – I’ll keep monitoring). The flowers are blooming beautifully in small clusters, and you can clearly see the tiny bean pods forming right behind the faded blossoms.
Green beans (also known as French beans or Phaseolus vulgaris) are one of my favorite crops to grow because they are relatively fast-growing and give multiple harvests if well managed. In Zambia’s climate, they do very well during the warm season, especially with consistent watering. I’m using drip irrigation in my field to make sure the moisture is even, which seems to be helping a lot.
Looking at the wider field shots, the rows are coming along nicely. Some plants are bushier than others, which is normal depending on variety and spacing. I planted improved varieties that are known for good pod setting and disease resistance. My goal is to have a good yield so I can supply my family with fresh vegetables and possibly sell the surplus at the local market.
Farming in Zambia comes with its challenges – unpredictable weather, pests like aphids and bean flies, and occasional soil fertility issues. But moments like today, when you see your hard work literally bearing fruit (or pods in this case), make everything worth it. There’s something deeply satisfying about growing your own food from seed to plate.
I would love to hear from fellow farmers and gardeners in the community:
What varieties of green beans do you grow in your area?
Any tips for dealing with flower drop or improving pod set?
How do you manage pests organically?
I’m planning to do a follow-up post once the pods are fully mature and ready for harvest. Maybe even share some simple Zambian recipes using fresh green beans!
If you’re into gardening, permaculture, sustainable farming, or just love seeing real-life agricultural progress, drop a comment, upvote, and reblog so more people can see the beauty of small-scale farming in Zambia.
Let’s keep supporting each other in this journey of growing food and building food security

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* We fry the bacon slices... When they are golden brown, we remove them and cut them into small pieces.

title.title: Climb the Mountain of Spirit: Manaslu Expedition
title.body:
The Manaslu Expedition is one of the most exciting climbing adventures in Nepal. Mount Manaslu is the eighth highest mountain in the world, standing tall at 8,163 meters (26,781 feet). It is known for its snowy beauty, remote trails, and peaceful mountain views.

Many climbers choose [Mt.Manaslu](https://nepalsocialtreks.com/trip/manaslu-expedition/) because it is less crowded than Everest but still offers a big challenge. The mountain is perfect for experienced climbers who want adventure, nature, and culture all in one journey.

<h2 style=\

>The Meaning of Manaslu The word “Manaslu” comes from the Sanskrit word Manasa, which means “soul” or “intellect.” Because of this, the mountain is often called the “Mountain of Spirit.” The mountain lies in the Gorkha district of Nepal, east of the Annapurna region. The area is filled with glaciers, rivers, forests, and hidden valleys. Many local people believe the mountain is sacred.

>Manaslu Expedition Statistics Here are some useful facts about the expedition: * **Duration:** Around 40 days * **Maximum Elevation:** 8,163 meters (26,781 feet) * **Destination:** Manaslu Region, Nepal * **Activity:** Mountain Expedition The Manaslu Expedition is one of Nepal’s most technical 8000-meter climbs.

>History of Mount Manaslu The first successful climb of Mount Manaslu happened in 1956. Toshio Imanishi and Gyalzen Norbu reached the summit for the first time. After that, many Japanese teams explored the mountain. However, the local people believed the peak was sacred, so climbing was limited for many years. Later, Manaslu officially opened for mountaineering expeditions in 1991. Today, the mountain remains quieter than Everest and offers a peaceful climbing experience.

>Why Climbers Love the Manaslu Expedition The Manaslu Expedition is full of adventure and natural beauty. It takes climbers through remote Himalayan landscapes and traditional mountain villages. Highlights of the Expedition: * Experience remote Himalayan wilderness * Enjoy fewer crowds compared to Everest * Explore Tibetan Buddhist culture * See stunning glaciers and snow-covered peaks * Witness beautiful mountains like Annapurna and Ganesh Himal * Climb the world’s 8th highest mountain Many climbers also use Manaslu as training before attempting Everest or K2.

>Journey to Manaslu Base Camp The journey begins from Kathmandu and continues toward the Manaslu region. Climbers travel through rivers, hills, forests, and traditional villages before reaching base camp. The trek itself is beautiful and peaceful. Along the trail, climbers see monasteries, prayer flags, and local homes built in Tibetan style. The Manaslu Base Camp sits at around 4,700 meters above sea level. This becomes the main center for rest, training, and preparation.

>Camps During the Manaslu Expedition There are four main camps above base camp before the summit push. **Camp I** – **5,700m** \-Located above the glacier \-First major climbing camp, Takes around 2–3 hours from base camp **Camp II – 6,400m** \-Most technical climbing section \-Snowy and steep terrain \-Takes around 3–6 hours from Camp I **Camp III – 6,800m** \-Built below the mountain col \-Windy and cold conditions \-Short climbing section between camps **Camp IV – 7,400m** \-Final camp before summit day \-Very cold with strong winds \-Last preparation point for the final climb **From Camp IV**, climbers begin the difficult journey toward the summit.

>Challenges of Climbing Manaslu Climbing Mount Manaslu is not easy. The mountain is known for technical climbing and changing weather conditions. * Main Challenges * Ice and snow climbing * Low oxygen levels * Strong winds * Heavy snowfall * Risk of avalanches * Extreme cold temperatures Because of these risks, climbers need proper mountaineering experience and good physical fitness.

>Importance of Acclimatization At high altitude, the body receives less oxygen. Climbers must move slowly and rest often so the body can adjust. This process is called acclimatization. Without proper acclimatization, climbers may suffer from altitude sickness. Guides and Sherpas carefully watch climbers during the expedition to keep everyone safe.

>Life in the Manaslu Region The Manaslu region is rich in culture and tradition. The local people follow Tibetan Buddhism and live simple mountain lives. * Along the route, climbers can see: * Ancient monasteries * Prayer wheels and flags * Mani walls * Traditional Tibetan villages The peaceful environment makes the journey feel spiritual and meaningful.

>Is the Manaslu Expedition Right for You? The Manaslu Expedition is best for experienced climbers looking for a remote and less crowded adventure. It is ideal for people who enjoy technical climbing and peaceful mountain landscapes. * You should have: * Strong physical fitness * Previous climbing experience * Mental toughness * Patience and teamwork skills If you love mountains and adventure, Manaslu can become one of the greatest journeys of your life.

>Conclusion The Manaslu Expedition is a true Himalayan adventure filled with challenge, beauty, and culture. From hidden valleys and snowy glaciers to high camps and summit dreams, every moment feels unforgettable. Climbing the “Mountain of Spirit” is not only about reaching the top. It is also about discovering strength, courage, and the beauty of Nepal’s remote Himalayas.

title.title: My Day So Far: Laundry, Breakfast, and Kalamansi
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjgb1QaS8VnBUDjcfwQdxzFtZJTdujXyL2MQbLmHbrrq/1778212746224.png)

‎Hello everyone! 
‎
‎Welcome to my day as a wife and mom, juggling the house chores. 😜
‎
‎And today...
‎
‎Is laundry day! 🧺
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmn3tEb1rFynG2Keze8ZsYKGcaKcSkUQWNLzWuJnpeY4/1778212492935.jpg)

‎Our clothes had really piled up, so now that the sun is extremely hot... hanging them out will dry super fast.
‎
‎That instantly motivated me! 
‎
‎So, I quickly put water in the washing machine and started washing our clothes. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVCLr7J66om11sMT8Vu2VoLheE7SqTKLUK8gM6o5MFrWe/1778212510747.jpg)

‎The sun gives you that urgency to get things done. Haha
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVbC5D5a8VJhPngjmx9ncYhsu8wCKk8DAg5CzTF6Jdzmb/1778212532916.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZJzn11UubNqPHmzw9amMTdWzyFkMmHy9X6h8nWcvu6Ey/1778212533114.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSkexB1DYASfZRqQRr7e6MTuy73iJVgMAngbCCDY7BnNV/1778212533315.jpg)
‎
‎It definitely motivated me to wash them right away. 😅
‎
‎And while the washing machine was doing its work, I took a little break. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRMmtcgvoHHj3oK5Ld5SqnFDahZvUknjrffsyNReo3Fg1/1778212555861.jpg)
‎
‎First, I enjoyed my breakfast! It was just a simple bowl of noodles with egg. 
‎
‎Even with the hot weather, it felt so comforting. You know, that’s just how we Pinoys enjoy our food, no matter the heat! Haha.
‎
‎Then, after taking the clothes out of the machine, I went upstairs to hang them all out. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSf8tL8WN6fmofTpVw5VmDU9DsgHNGuZ3oCzWefNWrQKh/1778212573020.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQT82Ud25R3kZCavaSvZQLtxTKaqWNWb9PfkJfxkV59YW/1778212573176.jpg)
‎
‎Then, I noticed our kalamansi tree. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX7Nq9Rf2uLjADJrARzTnRbKXQdaAPfQjodeWCYdQkQWJ/1778212592782.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXJtE6adqbdtwdKZmbg8htq9rN89zGPX1CCtVp3sSh4UR/1778212593005.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfRDD3cQzF7WnLvQEEN6BUDwM1xshJeW1CdVzmqzMyQKC/1778212593171.jpg)
‎
‎It's overflowing with fruits and flowers! 😍
‎
‎It looks so healthy and green. I guess it really loves all this sunshine, because it’s growing so well. 
‎
‎I always felt happy to see nature thriving right in our own yard.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfVSt7J634XD5R1agfTcumoNQzQqaoiUSBYgpqd6ocKkB/1778212617811.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWf5ZsKe8LnVhebmh6c1Hc631fi3GfBi54QLRHAGzb2oa/1778212618050.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP3QCcWZBSik8ziPDCLQFRYc9fkY8bUzT4bPK2ZLRLZEZ/1778212618229.jpg)
‎
‎So yeah...
‎
‎That’s the glimpse into my busy day so far.
‎
‎How about your day? How's everything going for you? 
‎
‎Until my next daily blog...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwGy1PepFwdzckxAm8fJT2BtNG3DHPuCTBsrcmCAb78j/1778212646621.png)

title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778212241102-d264a291c65b658f.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dominic1/cbbaf8ec)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dominic1/cbbaf8ec)


---

Hey Hive friends! I'm learning to draw hands. It's one of the most difficult drawing techniques, and today my mom @cositav and I started drawing.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23xep7TNR6YUEPu6UUuy5qTrLdX3GfkhwvfwDRBMo2yzYJwNZBNdkpMbASkUzRpFvHAoy.png)

At first, I wasn't very good at it. It was a bit difficult, but I kept trying, and I think I'll learn as I practice more and more. It's difficult, but the video I was using as a guide says that we have to practice very often to get it right.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23wqtjzCkksZQcatbVbGGgr52VRDCqayJnMB3xqn21N1rECj4ctHbgJNGbtiuLVJMoS2L.png)

I'm following a tutorial I saw on YouTube that explains step-by-step how to draw hands and gives me some good tips.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zlC1Gy4-XP0&t=17s

Drawing hands is a technique that requires a lot of patience, and I practice whenever I can. In this video, I'm showing you a clip of me practicing today.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23x1Fkt5JXGT8LfqNma7yrrqcTUVWzWcWJ1HyJvyXwGUC9U8fCjbVmFaxJLVxf5cYTRmj.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23wMm3Ud6FLfGSuf93fgdThUBJ8K5wpv3ZEWXBU5mhcYyq1x4CfHd7cDnePvgQde3JMm2.png)

I made several attempts until I got it right. I hope you like my video.

____

*Photos taken with a Redmi 13 phone
Video recorded with a Redmi 13 phone and edited with Capcut
Free music from Capcut
Google Translate used*

____

### ESPAÑOL

Hola amiguitos de Hive, estoy aprendiendo a dibujar manos, es uno de las técnicas de dibujos más difíciles y hoy mi mamá @cositav y yo nos pusimos a dibujar.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23xep7TNR6YUEPu6UUuy5qTrLdX3GfkhwvfwDRBMo2yzYJwNZBNdkpMbASkUzRpFvHAoy.png)


Al principio no me salía bien, me costó un poco pero seguía intentándolo y creo que iré aprendiendo a medida que practique más y más, se me hace difícil pero en el video que tenía como guía nos dice que debemos practicar muy seguido para que nos salga bien.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23wqtjzCkksZQcatbVbGGgr52VRDCqayJnMB3xqn21N1rECj4ctHbgJNGbtiuLVJMoS2L.png)

Me estoy guiando por un tutorial que vi en YouTube donde me explican paso a paso como dibujar manos y me dan buenos consejos.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zlC1Gy4-XP0&t=17s

Dibujar manos es una técnica que requiere mucha paciencia y cada vez que puedo practico un poco, en el video les muestro un video practicando el día de hoy.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23x1Fkt5JXGT8LfqNma7yrrqcTUVWzWcWJ1HyJvyXwGUC9U8fCjbVmFaxJLVxf5cYTRmj.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23wMm3Ud6FLfGSuf93fgdThUBJ8K5wpv3ZEWXBU5mhcYyq1x4CfHd7cDnePvgQde3JMm2.png)

Hice varios intentos hasta que me salió mejor, espero les guste mi video.


____
