title.title: Grilled chicken breast fillets with barbecue sauce and oregano [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
<center> 

### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Mi fuente de proteínas favorita es el pollo, así que siempre estoy buscando nuevas formas de prepararlo. La receta de hoy es filete de pechuga de pollo a la parrilla con salsa barbacoa y orégano. Es una receta muy sencilla una opción estupenda, saludable y deliciosa para el almuerzo, por lo que a mi familia le encanta y a mí me gusta preparársela. A continuación te dejo el paso a paso; ten en cuenta que esta receta es para tres personas.

> ``` My favorite source of protein is chicken, so I’m always looking for new ways to prepare it. Today’s recipe is grilled chicken with barbecue sauce and oregano. This recipe is very simple—a great, healthy, and delicious option for lunch—so my family loves it, and I enjoy treating them to it. Below is a step-by-step guide, keeping in mind that this recipe serves three people. ```
![Añadir un subtítulo (5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23yx1Yz7uK3G9W5B4pkNN4K27KapHEghMTMWufMmBXDjdbF8UUS2YXcw2KwqMVnez764Y.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48a5mJrfDHAmwWoz38hgptfiWQnXDZdBjC7FvrycEqcnHCJdmNi4EnNSReLZSLbmQr.png)

> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGxxQuiToRNe7CtYbepgPkvRvGqw6JwRtJ8e2VxVJrr7JDhd9qZg1bTGsxtyQ5SKxq.png) 700 gr de filete de pechuga, 01 cucharada de ajo en polvo, 02 cucharadas de salsa barbacoa, 01 cucharada de orégano, 01 cucharada de paprika, 01 cucharada de salsa inglesa de vino, 01 cucharada de aceite de oliva, sal y pimienta al gusto. ``` 700 g chicken breast fillets, 1 tablespoon garlic powder, 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce, 1 tablespoon oregano, 1 tablespoon paprika, 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce, 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt and pepper to taste. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48YA3dVucGUQ3j5STqMX3enFGLhvzgymiszf9aqeZzxzyW8oooVgCVPH9wwS7LPMkv.png)

>
Empiezo cortando la pechuga de pollo en filetes, lavándola y escurriéndola, poniéndola en un bol y sazonándola con sal, pimienta, ajo en polvo, paprika, salsa barbacoa, salsa inglesa de vino, aceite de oliva y orégano. Mezclar bien y lo dejar marinar durante media hora.

> ``` I start by cutting the chicken breast into strips, washing and draining it, placing it in a bowl, and seasoning it with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, olive oil, and oregano. Mix well and let it marinate for half an hour. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoCjxQbQUXPaiDE46Jrsa5YN43SdNhp5qnrL7BbHz1DLzuox6xtPgRmYwfs2fsydJ2x.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EogMoQEmPu1daur8RnJx1so7LT5sHpAjWAF5Rqs5r5dADibQ6z6H3pmvhQ7xxGcAuMf.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoK3yLVhL5QZfEsjJKrwP2KBJZCoWS4L1oF28S3H8Uaa34eJm1u2GCpRpjTBxgoxLzt.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoniaK5jo94UY8KujHXQwyQBJsAZLyMyudXzDq3TQAL6JpvEshCxK85hRuf55NSaqMR.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EowEkR2e1nYuosXq7piEhTD8zpowy2yCUmgYaTJcSea9UxkPdXcKeqvka6gZzxzXZSm.png) -|-|-|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EopsuSrSUd5zNqACXnZv6g9QtoDEm74tMWcSjAEG7Q33WZHUAk5h1kHYyyKajneWBya.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoCbp6hKgLBH8QtdBDA89z7Rfui4iiRnw54MwvqX3GBLpQV7hA2DtmqojXAFqfroo4J.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eokc5MCM4uUvuMYgxi6bWjZjGvknVX1vcDGVmpU3exGtnz1czzdK5zvFpbXnPqKMJMw.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep3bqaUTk3qU3LkPbeRQp5sZtGQEQMGiejyAJrW5wfwPZoRQ8W3raq74nA2vRv75hrA.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoEuQ6fLmKw9TvwLrzpTz9THqcuPMTPF8btNqPF2hbKNc8fiAC6Z8ugQ2SFuWKLXd4L.png)

>
Una vez transcurrido el tiempo de marinado, coloca los filetes de pechuga de pollo en una parrilla eléctrica precalentada y engrasada, dándoles la vuelta hasta que estén bien cocidos y dorados por ambos lados.

> ``` Once the marinating time is up, place the chicken breast fillets on a preheated and greased electric grill, turning them until they are cooked through and golden brown on both sides. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGztSo9DM9xdZJ5UZBaq8nZhhHxLJJTaWmUzzbQByA6UkXArsqoPbPKoaTBCwrZyHg.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoK8BxzoQ1YFCemzf3qZwYzjV6CiE3fbHJGR5fADCGDM2PpDvPLGiDeZvUCxHf69JYg.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoc8yAcHBwjHu2ebUvSVG5c4etbmAm4hwkdmUK477UYNG5EtR25pj8R3itqRm8TpaUU.png) -|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eou9ccSSiK3yAvuzmt5PiBroWEcnW6WijQLby8hkfr1uqnmsui41Db6Lf9rVXF3vAoF.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoiWCHuCae4tJm6fKde51GkCesxJwe4kwuk8smyP8sUYyD4Xf1tSyTTUHxSTFF1kMZr.png)

>
El resultado: unos filetes jugosos; hoy los he servido con ocumo y plátanos cocidos, pero puedes acompañarlos con tu guarnición favorita. Espero que te haya gustado.

> ``` The result: juicy steaks; today I served them with blanched taro and boiled plantains, but you can serve them with your favorite side dish. I hope you enjoyed it. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eou9c9DuLGfEEnE1rEKxUkG4njowMEkGXBqrYhfhFbUX75fmDTunbjHRAU3qyFe3RR8.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EonmyEf3ExmBTGxZD2C46kJpRdZaq1CCzs13p3yES226vFK9TxmQKw2y6sjTiDJkaQ1.png) --- ![ggifupdate.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/SD9NuiQZ-g-gif-update.gif)

title.title: [Esp/Eng]  Concurso TBT una foto una historia un día de esos. La despedida   | TBT Contest: One Photo, One Story, One of Those Days. The Farewell
title.body: > ¡Hola hermosa comunidad TopFiveFamily! Es grato volver a compartir con ustedes en esta nueva semana del [Concurso TBT una foto una historia un día de esos.](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-tbt-una-foto-una-historia-un-dia-de-esos-tendeg) al que nos invita nuestro estimado amigo @lanzjoseg. Las despedidas a los seres queridos, en especial a todos aquellos que han compartido muchas vivencias, experiencias, enseñanzas de vida, en los trecho de nuestro camino en este mundo, que son bastante emocionales. En esta foto nos estamos despidiendo de una de las mujeres más bellas que hemos conocido sobre esta tierra, nos unimos todos los compañeros de trabajo en la funeraria, para tomarnos una foto en conmemoración de nuestra unión, en un último adiós para nuestra querida Marieta. Parece Mentira, que un gesto tan sencillo como ese, nos haya llenado de emoción profunda, que aún ahorita, que ya han pasado 6 años de la muerte de ella, todavía nos recordamos de ese momento tan bonito en su despedida, que inclusive quedamos reuniéndonos de vez en cuando, para celebrar que todavía estamos juntos y recordar a los que se han ido de nuestro lado. Precisamente hoy se fue a los brazos del creador otro de nuestros compañeros, expresamos condolencias y le damos fortaleza a su familia, para que acepte su partida y a nosotros nos queda el recuerdo de todas las enseñanzas y de todas las veces que tuvimos la dicha de compartir con él; fue un hombre reilón, que tocaba cuatro y guitarra, que cantaba buenísimo los boleros, que tenía muchos dichos, muchos saberes, fue nuestro compañero, fue amigo, fue confidente en muchos casos, también te vamos a recordar Nelson, con mucho amor, con mucho respeto. Hay que valorar a los amigos, porque ellos son la familia que nosotros escogemos aquí en la tierra y cuando se van, a veces sentimos que es una luz que se apaga, pues ellos por un momento nos iluminaron el camino y nos acompañaron; por eso es que tenemos que apreciar el presente y decirles cuánto los apreciamos y cuánto los queremos, en el momento justo, no después que se fueron. ![1002322713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damelysh/23xKsyFU6h12yVQDBh4XKEHXN3xCm2HydzTrJRn2CDEHYpFu9oYw3jcBKwhtJkGPA6s5T.jpg) ![1001967396.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damelysh/23vhS9cKGQ8deK9KieU1djgdFfajC5pLY7SnGFuiMTdT2P7GHxGhdjyCS9cbgYgv5ETuW.jpg)

> Hello, wonderful TopFiveFamily community! It’s a pleasure to share with you again this new week of the [TBT Contest: A Photo, A Story, One of Those Days.](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-tbt-una-foto-una-historia-un-dia-de-esos-tendeg) hosted by our dear friend @lanzjoseg. Saying goodbye to loved ones—especially those who have shared so many experiences, lessons, and life stories along our journey in this world—is always deeply emotional. In this photo, we are saying goodbye to one of the most beautiful women we have ever known on this earth. All of us coworkers at the funeral home gathered to take a photo in commemoration of our bond, as a final farewell to our dear Marieta. It seems unbelievable that such a simple gesture could have filled us with such deep emotion. Even now, six years after her passing, we still remember that beautiful moment at her farewell. We even continue to meet from time to time to celebrate that we are still together and to remember those who have left us. Just today, another of our colleagues has passed away; we offer our condolences and send strength to his family, so that they may come to terms with his passing. We are left with the memory of all he taught us and all the times we had the joy of spending with him; He was a cheerful man who played the cuatro and the guitar, sang boleros beautifully, and had many sayings and much wisdom. He was our colleague, our friend, and our confidant on many occasions. We will also remember you, Nelson, with much love and respect. We must value our friends, because they are the family we choose here on earth, and when they leave, we sometimes feel as though a light has gone out, for they illuminated our path and walked with us for a time; that is why we must cherish the present and tell them how much we appreciate them and how much we love them, at the right moment—not after they are gone. Les estoy súper agradecida por su visita y me gustaria leer sus comentarios sus comentarios ¡muchas gracias! > I am very grateful for your visit and I would love to read your comments, thank you very much! 📓 traducción por/ translation by Traductor de DeepL 🏜 Imágenes cortesía de / Images courtesy of: álbum familiar 🛑 Letrero generado por / Sign generated by https://es.cooltext.com/Logo-Design-Spaced-Out?Font=11291

title.title: Challenging game using one finger
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778211894433-875460cf8bbc1e69.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/3f177913)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/3f177913)


---

Good morning and welcome to all gaming lovers.Today Friday morning I played an interesting game.The name of the game is Rollanc Adventure Balls.Although it is much easier for modern gaming, this game was once popular with us.But I think it is still a popular game.I've seen a lot of ratings and downloads for this game.

The game is available on the Google Play Store and is very easy to play on mobile.It was very easy for me to play it offline.It has 100+ million downloads and 77k reviews.

In this modern era, there are many popular games and there are difficult games so I think that my adventure ball game today is very normal compared to these modern games.However this game is the best in terms of popularity and once it was much popular.There is another reason why this game is so popular to me, and that is.

So when we had a computer at home, we used to play some games and this Adventure Ball game was one of those games.When I played this game on the computer, my cousins and sisters around would watch me play and they would also enjoy watching.This was a long time ago when I used to play such games on the computer.We didn't have mobile back then.

I mean, we didn't have such advanced Android phones back then.There were phones that couldn't play any games on them, but the most interesting thing is that nowadays we don't just have to rely on computers to play a game, now we can play games on our smartphones too.So today I found my game on Google Play Store called Adventure Ball.

The game is played entirely with the fingers.This game is very easy at the beginning but as you progress through the levels it gets harder as you have to play with your fingers.It gets quite challenging as the levels get higher but that's where the fun lies.You will try and think to yourself I can do this.This is how you have to take on the challenge.

In the end, it becomes quite interesting and the desire to pass the level is created in the mind.The more levels I go through here, the more obstacles I will face and the more obstacles I will have to overcome to get the ball around the road.I played this game on mobile for the first time today.I got through levels one to eight but couldn't get past level nine.I tried so hard to get past level nine but failed every time, so I took a leave.

I failed a few times to get past point 9, so I quit the game but I will definitely try next time and I hope to succeed.However I invite you to watch this interesting game, including my successes from level 1 to 8 and my failures at level 9.This is a gaming site designed in full 3D and with beautiful graphics that also look great.

Thumbnail source: Original screenshot from my gameplay.

Thank you.

@Angelmitu

---

In the end, it becomes quite interesting and the desire to pass the level is created in the mind.The more levels I go through here, the more obstacles I will face and the more obstacles I will have to overcome to get the ball around the road.I played this game on mobile for the first time today.I got through levels one to eight but couldn't get past level nine.I tried so hard to get past level nine but failed every time, so I took a leave.

I failed a few times to get past point 9, so I quit the game but I will definitely try next time and I hope to succeed.However I invite you to watch this interesting game, including my successes from level 1 to 8 and my failures at level 9.This is a gaming site designed in full 3D and with beautiful graphics that also look great.

Thumbnail source: Original screenshot from my gameplay.

Thank you.

title.title: Día de campo: Disfrutando de la naturaleza [Esp-Eng-Pt]
title.body:
>

**<center>ESPAÑOL</center>**

Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta comunidad de @worldmappin. Es un placer saludarlos y desearles un día feliz y lleno de bendiciones. Que las bendiciones de Dios inunden sus vidas.

Hoy les comparto un breve recorrido por el campo, o \

como se le conoce en el municipio de Benítez. Estas son áreas dedicadas al cultivo y la cría de animales. Mis tíos, como he mencionado en otras publicaciones, siempre se han dedicado a la agricultura, así que aproveché la oportunidad para visitarlos después de varios años. Estos lugares me traen muchos recuerdos de la infancia. Aunque no es la temporada de lluvias, el clima ha sido favorable para esta zona. La mayor parte de la vegetación permanece verde, y actualmente están criando patos y cabras. Los patos eran más amigables que las cabras; pude observarlos durante varios minutos mientras se ataban y luego mientras se dirigían a los campos en busca de sombra y un lugar para descansar.

>

**<center>ENGLISH</center>**

Abundant and eternal blessings to all members of this @amazingnature  community. It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed day. May God's blessings flood your lives.

Today I'm sharing a short tour of the countryside, or \

as it's known in the Benítez municipality. These are areas dedicated to crops and raising animals. My uncles, as I've mentioned in other posts, have always worked in agriculture, so I took the opportunity to visit after several years. These places bring back many childhood memories. Although it's not the rainy season, the weather has been kind to this area. Most of the vegetation remains green, and they're currently raising ducks and goats. The ducks were friendlier than the goats; I was able to watch them for several minutes while they ate and then as they headed off into the fields in search of shade and a place to rest. ![día campo (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoK5sQFCPtgaaCcsL7GZM2jcbG5tAGsiqnffm6j6R4z6BQ5YGFFkMMNii96tvshRop8.jpeg) ![día campo (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23tSamN5AfWL4zUXnMmNgJ8z5MYaP5KNFJnAkJYBXv26VK2LiSDQz1rNqJokWRYq1Nbnv.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Di un breve paseo por los campos, observando la vegetación. Me sorprendió que, aunque la temporada de lluvias aún no ha comenzado oficialmente, la mayor parte del terreno está cubierta de vegetación, lo cual beneficia enormemente a los animales, incluidas las cabras que se alimentan de pasto. Por seguridad, decidí no acercarme demasiado a estas amigables criaturas, ya que mi tío me explicó que no se las debe molestar cuando comen o descansan. Añadió que pueden ser agresivas con los extraños. Mantuve la distancia y solo tomé dos fotos. Había dos cabras donde me encontraba; una era blanca y negra, y la otra marrón y blanca. En ese momento, estaban comiendo y la marrón descansaba. Estos animales son comunes en esta zona, ya que el clima y la vegetación son adecuados para proporcionarles alimento durante todo el año.

> I took a short walk through the fields, observing the vegetation. I was struck by the fact that, although the rainy season hasn't officially started, most of the land is covered in vegetation, which is a great benefit to the animals, including the goats that feed on grasses. For safety, I decided not to get too close to these friendly creatures, because my uncle explained that they shouldn't be disturbed when they're eating or resting. He added that they can be aggressive towards strangers. I kept my distance and only took two photos. There were two goats where I stood; one was black and white, and the other was brown and white. At that time, they were eating, and the brown one was resting. These animals are common in this area, as the climate and vegetation are suitable for providing them with food year-round. ![día campo (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoK6JyJeZ2ksPu9bEUZpKCWcagN1StksN51u41kmzdnBJQ689cLGaSQf3RgUvEtzpCX.jpeg) ![dia campo.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpA24rGLRru9XEPCQEYeYAdVoHNSw8m2enbSRKpxUtDKJpHdD5DrDQ8BWXz73BG581Q.jpeg)

> Continuando mi paseo por esta hermosa zona, vi algunas aves, pero fue imposible fotografiarlas porque eran muy rápidas. También vi algunos insectos. Al subir la pequeña colina, encontramos varios cultivos, incluyendo *Patilla* [Citrullus lanatus](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Citrullus_lanatus) y calabazas. No pudimos avanzar más para no pisar algunas plántulas que estaban creciendo. La sandía es una fruta que se cultiva en esta zona, especialmente en las partes más altas de la montaña. Había varias sandías en el suelo, incluyendo una muy grande que me llamó la atención, así que le tomé una foto. Después de cruzar un puente, el camino lleva a la cima de la montaña. Allí se pueden ver varias parcelas de tierra donde se cultivan productos como taro, berenjena y tomate, entre otros. Además de la sandía, también se cultivan otras frutas como el aguacate y la guama. Esta última es una especie de maraca verde con varias almendras en su interior, cubierta de una deliciosa pulpa blanca. Después de explorar y observar la tierra de mi tío, rodeamos el puente y allí vi una planta de *Cariaquito Morado* [Lantana horrida](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lantana_horrida) Se cree que esta planta se usa para alejar la mala suerte. Sus flores son de varios colores, estas eran de un amarillo brillante, y las hojas son de un verde brillante. Según mi tío, las hojas se pueden usar en una cataplasma para tratar heridas e infecciones. Tras un breve descanso, descendimos la montaña para regresar a casa. Gracias por acompañarme en esta aventura.

> Continuing my walk through this beautiful area, I saw some birds, but it was impossible to photograph them because they were so fast. I also saw some insects. Climbing up the small hill, we found several crops, including *Watermelon* [Citrullus lanatus](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Citrullus_lanatus) and pumpkin. We couldn't go any further to avoid stepping on some seedlings that were growing. Watermelon is a fruit grown in this area, especially on the higher parts of the mountain. There were several watermelons on the ground, including a very large one that caught my eye, so I took a picture. After crossing a bridge, the road leads to the top of the mountain. There, you can see several plots of land where crops such as taro, eggplant, and tomatoes are grown, among others. In addition to watermelon, other fruits that are also cultivated are avocado and guama. The latter is a type of green maraca with several almonds inside, covered in a delicious white pulp. After exploring and observing my uncle's land, we went around behind the bridge and there I saw a *Purple Cariaquito* [Lantana horrida](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lantana_horrida) plant. It is believed that this plant is used to ward off bad luck. Its flowers are various colors, these being bright yellow, and the leaves are bright green. According to my uncle, the leaves can be used in a poultice to treat wounds and infections. After a rest, we descended the mountain to return home. Thank you for joining me on this adventure. ![dia campo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23tvnpuDSjR5WXSYvH8Q3QCRnE4eHJna2UDgpnFPKgYi8Pozpvhz5iEzxy9e9dMuiVi5P.png) ![día campo (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EogNqvruYK7XX88W4hbfJNXYK2E5SZ5DMihykvuisJpccDRyMnZoBSCzjcfaKTtSL1q.jpeg)

>

**Portugués**

 
Muitas bênçãos para todos os membros desta comunidade @amazingnature. É um prazer cumprimentá-los e desejar-lhes um dia feliz e abençoado. Que as bênçãos de Deus inundem as vossas vidas.

Hoje, partilho um pequeno passeio pelo campo, ou \

, como é conhecido no concelho de Benítez. São áreas dedicadas à agricultura e à criação de animais. Os meus tios, como já referi noutras publicações, sempre foram agricultores, pelo que aproveitei a oportunidade para os visitar passados vários anos. Estes lugares trazem-me muitas lembranças da infância. Embora não seja época de chuvas, o clima tem sido favorável para esta região. A maior parte da vegetação permanece verde e estão a criar patos e cabras. Os patos eram mais amigáveis do que as cabras; pude observá-los durante alguns minutos enquanto se amarravam e depois enquanto se dirigiam para os campos em busca de sombra e de um lugar para descansar. Dei um pequeno passeio pelos campos, observando a vegetação. Fiquei surpreendido ao ver que, embora a estação das chuvas ainda não tivesse começado oficialmente, a maior parte do terreno estava coberto de vegetação, o que beneficia muito os animais, incluindo as cabras que ali pastavam. Por segurança, decidi não me aproximar muito destas criaturas amigáveis, pois o meu tio explicou que não devem ser perturbadas quando estão a comer ou a descansar. Acrescentou que podem ser agressivas com estranhos. Mantive a distância e tirei apenas duas fotografias. Havia duas cabras onde eu estava; uma era preta e branca, e a outra castanha e branca. Naquele momento, elas estavam a comer, e a castanha estava a descansar. Estes animais são comuns nesta região, pois o clima e a vegetação são adequados para lhes fornecer alimento durante todo o ano. Continuando a minha caminhada por esta bela região, avistei algumas aves, mas foi impossível fotografá-las porque eram muito rápidas. Também vi alguns insetos. Ao subirmos a pequena colina, encontramos diversas plantações, incluindo *Melancias* [Citrullus lanatus](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Citrullus_lanatus) e abóboras. Não pudemos ir mais longe com medo de pisar algumas mudas que estavam a crescer. A melancia é um fruto cultivado nesta região, principalmente nas partes mais altas da montanha. Havia várias melancias no chão, incluindo uma bem grande que me chamou a atenção, por isso tirei uma fotografia. Depois de atravessar uma ponte, o trilho leva ao topo da montanha. Ali, é possível ver vários terrenos onde são cultivados produtos como o inhame, a beringela e o tomate, entre outros. Além da melancia, também são cultivadas outras frutas como o abacate e o guama. Esta última é uma espécie de maraca verde com várias amêndoas no seu interior, coberta por uma deliciosa polpa branca. Depois de explorar e observar a propriedade do meu tio, contornámos a ponte e aí vi um pé de *cariaquito roxo* [Lantana horrida](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lantana_horrida). Acredita-se que esta planta afasta o azar. As suas flores vêm em várias cores; estas eram de um amarelo vivo, e as folhas são de um verde vibrante. Segundo o meu tio, as folhas podem ser utilizadas em cataplasmas para tratar feridas e infeções. Após uma breve pausa, descemos a montanha para regressar a casa. Obrigada por me acompanharem nesta aventura. ![campo.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpGQBdUqNyz9GcyusuWmfh8UXaRgTNYeuzzcKw8WLM57ZMhBvNHChBRmnwWiSPJXcPz.jpeg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

title.title: Beans with Onions and Paprika (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> For lunch, I made some delicious stewed beans, served with white rice and a couple of fried corocoros. I love beans; their unique sweet flavor reminds me of my childhood—my mom used to make them with pumpkin and chaco. Although I’ve tried to replicate the recipe, I haven’t been able to get it just right—one of the mysteries of old-school home cooking. Now, let’s get down to business.
![1000113954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zGaDdJWXNXXtHKs5bL4NwUEHmN2JLdELTDQ1WiqYBmckAkt1YBXZocXGHXMd96xchGh.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 150 grams of white beans - 2 onions - 1 bell pepper - 3 liters of water - 2 tablespoons of sugar - Salt to taste - Oil
![1000113943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wMRrwovxAYxiGjQb3KVpM56d1hJcpB4xM3VGBJHvoy8B9KGT94h7kevq28AvWmerNrV.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the beans and soaked them in a liter of water, then left them in the oven for about six hours—in other words, I did this before starting breakfast. After that time had passed, I rinsed them thoroughly and drained them. Next, I filled a pot with water on the stove, added the beans along with a pinch of salt, and brought them to a boil.
![1000113946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yd3v2p5JWjyo5T7VvzydxQhtLfkowNE8cHc9Utiw4XAFsxh8d3yLeDfAHEJKB6GqVAj.jpg)
Next, I washed the vegetables, removed the seeds from the bell pepper, and diced it. I peeled the outer layer of the onions and chopped them in the same way. By then, the beans were tender, and the water level indicated that it was the right time to start cooking.
![1000113952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zknd5vo2ir2YdsdKauJGCZcYGTDuwVJM6DuizfdpEsnfGWcNUGhUx1Wc9BzBMt1aX5G.jpg)
I heated a skillet with two tablespoons of oil and sautéed the seasonings in it. Once the onion turned translucent, I added this mixture to the beans. Finally, I added a pinch of sugar—I like these beans slightly sweet, so this part is up to personal preference.
![1000113949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vhwemiYKZxHt9P4fNXewQhyPFawqRMQQoSEaEkNk9u44RbPRxw5M4riGR9gNMH1aD9C.jpg)
While I was doing this, I started cooking the white rice on another burner using a ratio of three cups of water to one cup of rice. Next to it, the cococoros were sizzling in the oil. In less than 20 minutes, everything was ready: a fish lunch with two different types of beans. Although I’m more of a bean person, this stew is spectacular. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Para mi almuerzo preparé unos deliciosos frijoles guisados, acompañados con arroz blanco y un par de corocoros fritos. Me encantan los frijoles, su particular sabor dulzón me recuerda a mi infancia, mi mamá preparaba estos granos con auyama y chaco. Aunque he intentado replicar la receta no he podido hacerlo a la perfección, misterios de la cocina hogareña de la vieja escuela. A lo que vinimos.
![1000113954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zGaDdJWXNXXtHKs5bL4NwUEHmN2JLdELTDQ1WiqYBmckAkt1YBXZocXGHXMd96xchGh.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 150 gramos de frijoles blanco - 2 cebollas - 1 pimentón - 3 litros de agua - 2 cucharadas de azúcar - Sal al gusto - Aceite
![1000113943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wMRrwovxAYxiGjQb3KVpM56d1hJcpB4xM3VGBJHvoy8B9KGT94h7kevq28AvWmerNrV.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé los frijoles y los puse a remojar con un litro de agua, los guardé en el horno durante unas seis horas, es decir antes de iniciar el desayuno realicé esta tarea. Transcurrido ese tiempo, los limpié muy bien y los saqué del agua. Luego, monté una olla en la cocina con agua, agregué los frijoles más una pizca de sal y los puse a sancochar.
![1000113946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yd3v2p5JWjyo5T7VvzydxQhtLfkowNE8cHc9Utiw4XAFsxh8d3yLeDfAHEJKB6GqVAj.jpg)
Después lavé los aliños, retiré las semillas del pimentón y corté en cuadritos. Quité la primera capa de las cebollas y piqué de la misma forma. Para entonces los frijoles estaban blandos y el nivel de agua me indicaba que era el momento propicio para guisar.
![1000113952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zknd5vo2ir2YdsdKauJGCZcYGTDuwVJM6DuizfdpEsnfGWcNUGhUx1Wc9BzBMt1aX5G.jpg)
Monté un sartén con dos cucharadas de aceite y allí coloqué los aliños a sofreír. Al transparentarse la cebolla, agregué esta preparación a los frijoles. Finalmente puse un punto de azúcar, me gustan estos granos ligeramente dulces, así que esta parte es a gusto de cada persona.
![1000113949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vhwemiYKZxHt9P4fNXewQhyPFawqRMQQoSEaEkNk9u44RbPRxw5M4riGR9gNMH1aD9C.jpg)
Mientras avanzaba este paso, en otra hornilla puse a cocinar el arroz blanco con la proporción de tres tazas de agua por una de arroz. Al lado, los cococoros crepitaban junto al aceite. En menos de 20 minutos tenía todo listo, un almuerzo de pescado con dos distintos tipos de granos, aunque mi inclinación es con el frijol, es espectacular guisado. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

<i>
Lamps are lit in the courtyard in time-worn vessels,
made of clay, a little crooked, a little tired
The scent of oil lingers in the air,
warmth spreading across the cheeks,
and in the smoke
slowly faces begin to take shape
in which the past still breathes

The first lamp in the name of my father.
The flame trembles,
but it doesn't go out
as if the shadow of an invisible hand
still lingers on it
His voice still comes—
\

And I think, My hands don't burn anymore, but my heart melts a little more each time The second lamp dedicated to my mother! It smells of turmeric, basil, and the faint melody of an old chant which still plays like music to silence in the corners of the room The third lamp in the names of friends who walked together on the trails of memories, whose words now fall like leaves every autumn, and yet give the earth a new greenness The fourth lamp for those dreams that remained unfulfilled, that never found time to be expressed, but which are still etched in the heart like the sky seen through a closed window Thank you so much for reading. title.title: [ESP-ING] A Tour of the Las Américas Shopping Center
title.body: > Pasear un rato por los centros comerciales se han convertido en una salida para el calor y la distracción de la mente luego de que se va la luz, lamentablemente los centros comerciales están sufriendo las mismas consecuencias que nosotros en nuestros hogares ya que al visitar este centro comercial tampoco tenía luz sin embargo tienen plantas eléctricas que tienen la capacidad de encender las luces pero los aires lamentablemente no pueden funcionar, pero igual ha IA muchas personas allí. Este centro comercial se llama Las Américas, fue fundado por Filipo Sindoni, el dueño de las empresas Sindoni, se fundó en el año 2000, ubicado en una de las mejores zonas de la ciudad de Maracay, Las Delicias, in centro comercial de tres niveles y de una capacidad de 403 locales, lo que lo hace un centro comercial muy grande, además cuenta con salas de cine, llamados cines unidos.

> Para mí este centro comercial fue el segundo centro comercial más grande del estado aragua, en este centro comercial siempre hacen eventos de todo tipo para celebrar días de las madres, Día del Padre, Día del Niño, navidades, Carnaval, semana santa y cualquier otro evento que pueda haber en la semana o en el mes, en este caso este día que fui habían varias pantallas donde se podía ver el fútbol todas las personas estaban atentos al mismo. Había una pantalla hasta en la feria de comida, donde habían bastantes personas a pesar de que se sentía bastante vapor, aunque no haya luz estos centros comerciales se la pasan full y mucha gente consumiendo, Todos los locales de la feria de comida estaban abiertas hasta los helados, es decir que con la planta ayudan a mantener todos esos puestos y locales comerciales.

> Los pasillos del centro comercial son bastante amplios y está muy bien cuidado al centro comercial ya tiene 26 años desde su inauguración me gusta mucho los pisos sobre todo el central donde hay hasta asientos como plazas redondas y dentro de ellas en el medio como unas palmeras donde la gente se sienta a descansar y hay varios locales tanto de ropa como unos a un lado de comida uno siempre tiene que buscar donde sentarse y estos que están allí son uno de los mejores asientos del centro comercial pues es en este lugar donde se han dado los mejorws espectáculo, hace mucho tiempo aquí se celebró una feria de emprendedores En el 2015, y tuve el placer de estar allí en primera fila y vivir uno de los mejores momentos.

>


Este centro comercial es céntrico y se reúnen alli muchas personas conocidas y lo mejor alunos locales tiene muy buenos, que se pueden conseguir viendo las tiendas, me ha pasado que pienso que una tienda es costosa pero al preguntar resulta que los precios son accesibles, ahora les pregunto ¿ya tu visitaste el C.C las Américas?


















<a href=\

width=472 height=49 border=0>
--- >! [ENGLISH] > >Spending some time wandering through shopping malls has become a way to escape the heat and take one’s mind off things after the power goes out. Unfortunately, shopping malls are suffering the same consequences as we are in our homes; when I visited this mall, there was no power either. However, they have generators capable of turning on the lights, but the air conditioning, unfortunately, cannot operate—yet there are still many people there. > >This shopping mall is called Las Américas; it was founded by Filipo Sindoni, the owner of the Sindoni companies, in the year 2000. It is located in one of the best areas of the city of Maracay, Las Delicias. It is a three-story shopping mall with a capacity of 403 stores, making it a very large shopping mall. It also features movie theaters, known as Cines Unidos. > >

> > >For me, this mall was the second-largest in Aragua state. They always hold all kinds of events here to celebrate Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Children’s Day, Christmas, Carnival, Holy Week, and any other occasion that might come up during the week or month. On the day I visited, there were several screens showing soccer games, and everyone was glued to them. > >There was even a screen in the food court, where there were quite a few people despite the fact that it felt quite stuffy. Even without electricity, these malls are always packed, and many people are shopping. All the food court stalls were open, including the ice cream stands—in other words, the power supply helps keep all those stalls and shops running. > >

> > >The aisles in the mall are quite wide, and the mall is very well maintained—it’s been 26 years since it opened. I really like the floors, especially the central one, where there are even round seating areas with palm trees in the middle where people sit to rest. There are several stores, both clothing shops and food stalls on one side, so you always have to look for a place to sit, and these spots are some of the best seats in the mall, because this is where the best shows have taken place. A long time ago, an entrepreneurs’ fair was held here in 2015, and I had the pleasure of being there in the front row and experiencing one of the best moments. > >

> > >This shopping center is centrally located and attracts a lot of people I know. Best of all, the local shops are great—you can find some real gems just by browsing. I’ve had times when I thought a store was expensive, but when I asked, it turned out the prices were actually reasonable. So, have you visited Las Américas Shopping Center yet? > ---

This is what I found:
Ruta Loans 💱
Sin embargo todas las opciones anteriormente expuestas solo funcionan con dinero de $HIVE en liquidez y el $HP (Hive Power) como les comenté está congelado y hacer un retiro se tarda 13 semanas en hacerse efectivo por completo.

Semanalmente se va recibiendo una parte de lo que se retira hasta haberse realizado totalmente.

En Ruta Loans vas a poder solicitar un préstamo en $HBD y pagarlo con tu $HP.

Debes poner a @rutablockchain como tu cuenta de recuperación y mandar tu clave máster ya que tu cuenta se usa como garantía y ellos inician el Power Down es decir el retiro de tus $HP que deberás usar para comprar $HBD y pagar semanalmente las cuotas de tu préstamo.

However, all the above options only work with $HIVE money in liquidity and the $HP (Hive Power) as I mentioned before is frozen and it takes 13 weeks for a withdrawal to be fully effective.
Weekly you will receive a portion of what is withdrawn until it has been fully realized.
In Ruta Loans you will be able to request a loan in $HBD and pay it with your $HP.
You must put @rutablockchain as your recovery account and send your master key as your account is used as collateral and they initiate the Power Down the withdrawal of your $HP that you must use to buy $HBD and pay weekly installments of your loan.

Esto es una dinámica interesante ya que puedes darle un valor extra al dinero que tienes congelado que ya de por sí, tiene una utilidad.

Es importante tener en cuenta que el préstamo mínimo debe ser de 20 $HBD.

Para calcular saber cuánto puedes pedir de préstamo tienes que dividir el total de tu HP disponible para luego multiplicarlo por 4 o 8 ya te explico el motivo.

13 semanas es lo que se tarda un Power Down en hacerse efectivo y los préstamos son o de 4 semanas o máximo 8 semanas de Power Down (retiro)

Ya sea de 4 semanas o 8 semanas debes pagar un % de interés extra por el préstamo.

En mi caso yo probé con un préstamo de 60 $HBD y pagué el 20% de interés más el préstamo, dando un total de 72 $HBD.

This is an interesting dynamic since you can give an extra value to the money you have frozen that already has a utility.
It is important to keep in mind that the minimum loan must be 20 $HBD.
To calculate how much you can borrow you have to divide the total of your available HP and then multiply it by 4 or 8 and I will explain why.
13 weeks is how long it takes for a Power Down to become effective and the loans are either 4 weeks or maximum 8 weeks of Power Down (withdrawal).
Whether it is 4 weeks or 8 weeks you must pay an extra % of interest for the loan.
In my case I tried a loan of 60 $HBD and paid 20% interest plus the loan, for a total of 72 $HBD.

Le doy las gracias a @danielvehe por hablarme de este proyecto y por la buena labor que hacen, lo recomiendo por completo todo fue muy seguro y transparente y sin inconveniente alguno y muy seguramente lo volveré a usar de ser necesario.

links.title: How do Splinterlands’ “SPS NODES” and “LICENSES” work?
links.body:
>

<center> **Best regards Splinterlovers** 💚</center>

Something I’ve noticed isn’t discussed much out there is “SPS Nodes,” which form the backbone of the SPS network—where transactions take place, and, in short, the economy operates. This is where rewards are distributed, but many people aren’t aware of this and don’t realize that these nodes can generate daily income. but it’s a process that requires following a step-by-step procedure and making an investment. Don’t worry, though—in this post, I’ll cover every possible aspect so you can have all this information if you weren’t familiar with SPS nodes.

That’s why, if you’ve been living under a rock and don’t have the faintest idea what “SPS Nodes” are, this is the post you need to learn everything you need to get started—or at least to grasp the basics—so you can fill in the gaps through your own research. Although, if you ask me and I see enough comments on this post, I’ll write a more advanced post on this topic.

**So, if you want to learn about “SPS Nodes” and licenses, stick around until the end of this post. Without further ado, let’s get right to it.**

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png)

## <center>What are SPS NODES and Splinterlands LICENSES?</center>
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

As I mentioned in the introduction—and I’ll reiterate here—SPS NODES are the software required to process transactions and distribute in-game rewards. Essentially, they’re like the workers responsible for carrying out all these tasks, except in this case, it’s software that handles the execution. but it doesn’t do it on its own—at least not within the “Splinterlands” ecosystem.

**This is where “Licenses” come into play, because the two work together as a team and depend on each other:**

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>What are Splinterlands Licenses?</center>

Licenses are an asset in Splinterlands, a type of NFT “item” whose role is to enable the “software”—in short, the “nodes” I mentioned earlier—to carry out all the functions I described. This pertains to the blockchain itself; however, there are other functions as well, namely that anyone with at least one active license can receive automatic rewards from the fund allocated for the nodes.

Now, I imagine you’re wondering how many “Licenses” there are in total. When they were first released, the agreed-upon supply was a total of 60,000 Licenses, which were sold in phases. However, if I’m not mistaken, only the first phase was sold out; the rest have been being traded on “Hive-Engine” and that is where I recommend purchasing the “Licenses” if you wish to venture into this way of earning passive income in $SPS by becoming a “Validator Node” on the SPS network.

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png)

## <center>What is the “Earnings Mechanism”?</center>

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

This is where things get interesting, because this is where I’ll explain how earnings work and show you what the “Top Performers” are earning and how they’re doing it, what the requirements are, and how it all works, so keep reading because we’re going to look at some numbers and calculations—though they’re really very basic; there’s nothing complicated about it. We’ll just use the data we already have by default, which we can see for every “Node” that’s active in the system, thanks to @peakmonster displaying it on its interface.

**But let's get right to the calculations, although first we need to go over a few details below:**

>* ***For “Validator Node” rewards on the SPS network, the team has a monthly fund of 3,750,000 SPS. This is what incentivizes users to maintain the network. Furthermore, it is only natural that they be rewarded—or rather, that this activity be rewarded—since they are helping to decentralize the network and, in addition, keeping it running.***

Great, now let's move on to calculating these profits, which is done as follows:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Calculation of Profits</center>

The first thing we need to know is how the group is divided, because even though the nodes operate using the licenses collectively, the reality is that we also receive a reward for having them. However, for this to be worthwhile, it’s best to combine it with one or more licenses, and you’ll see why:

* **Validator Pool:** This pool’s reward is 10% of the total, which means that anyone with a validator can earn a share of that 10% total, which amounts to approximately 375,000 SPS per month. This works practically the same way as a “Validator Node” on the “Hive” blockchain: you must obtain votes from people who hold SPS to receive a greater or lesser percentage from both pools.

* **License Pool:** This is where the majority of the rewards are concentrated, which is why “Licenses” are expensive: the more you have, the greater your earnings will be, so those rewards are directly proportional to the number of licenses you hold. That is why this pool accounts for the remaining 90% of SPS, which amounts to 3,375,000.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Analysis of Real Data (Based on the Top Current Validators)</center>

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/Eo8K7d8M2ehgXu7NioypoG1EBu7hfeueQLgrSFfzeBXkqSAkjsr2UbaTS8pNfgeszfK.png

<div class=\

>

As you can see in the image, the data is quite clear: the reward per license is approximately 1,060 SPS per hour. This means that each “License” could generate approximately 25.44 SPS per day for every active license. But there is another factor I mentioned earlier: SPS validators work the same way as Hive validators, and those who verify more blocks or earn a higher reward are the ones with the most votes—and the same applies here.

**<u>Now that we've cleared that up, let's see how much the top 5 earn:</u>**

1.	peakmonsters.sps: ~852.49 SPS/day (Mainly because it is the most-voted validator).
2.	vugtis: ~5,030.66 SPS/day (Has 165 active licenses + voting rewards).
3.	aggroed: ~4,495.13 SPS/day (Has 147 active licenses + voting rewards).
4.	bamloix: ~2,443.27 SPS/day (Has 69 active licenses + voting rewards).
5.	azircon: ~1,040.18 SPS/day (Has 15 active licenses + voting rewards).

---
**<u>The factors that influence your earnings are as follows:</u>**

* **Number of active licenses:** As I mentioned earlier, the more licenses you have, the more you can earn.

* **Votes received:** If you receive large votes from users with a lot of SPS, you’ll be able to stake and validate more transactions on the SPS network, which will earn you higher rewards.

* **Vouchers:** Something I hadn't mentioned is that each active license you hold can earn a proportional share of a daily \

pool of 20,000, which is distributed among license holders. --- https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png ##
Conclusion
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif With that in mind, I think one of the best ways to make money on Splinterlands is by becoming a validator node. You do have to invest, especially in “Licenses,” which are the main source of earnings and are currently valued at around $231.85 on Hive Engine—which is no small amount of money. But there are several factors at play, so let me know what you think is missing and whether you’d like me to write a follow-up to this post. I’ll check the comments.
https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhowii/23t74jP9PwnQVm1xvGFRSWNw9CX8dtyaB4fPKB2YqhBL6VuzewvG9Sd3Ft2qNL4scwN2L.gif
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/AJhYgvAA2jMdAtev45LxeeeYzzVqonoQgjHfk865cC9GnBW1MVqFA5B5cJ6BKaa.gif ### **I invite everyone to join Splinterlands, the best game based on chains of blocks, full of adventures, battles, and strategies where you will have fun and get rewards according to your league**

Or will they toss it in a dresser drawer, similar to the man that buried his one Talent?🙄😇 Our baby Granddaughter Olivia, will be growing up in a generation where I believe it will come second nature to Stack Bitcoin Sat’s, and I’m sure she will be able to explain it all to her daddy “IF” he doesn’t get it by then Lol!🥰 Remember to step away from the computer, get some exercise, and enjoy life, it goes by way too fast!🤗 Silvertop is closings the door, and going for a hike in beautiful 68°F weather!😎🤗 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike 😊

links.title: A Stroll Through Francisco de Miranda Square (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> Today’s tour takes us to Francisco de Miranda Square, a landmark in Cumana because it is located in the city center, across from the Luis Mariano Rivera Theater. Here you can see the statue of this illustrious Venezuelan in this public space, which has been renovated several times.
![1000113712.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/243M2iURxrJk9mkCnVpkZmgRFXT7jAEFz8GGuKoPMymh6SpUPtsesCBUNaqEDKZnQvM3N.jpg)
![1000113710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23yThHMdy2wdDGWoC5xm3KSN5TogyXY4tzVKoifNqqzBYLFasFo2hSWuL72LjYNSJsTFY.jpg)
The plaza was originally built in 1912 and now features well-maintained gardens, with various ornamental plants beautifying these corners. Perhaps the most striking feature of this place is its large fountain, which in the past was kept active with water and featured very attractive nighttime lighting.
![1000113709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpA2aFL5AvwHsgS9nZQ4xMNGkiLvy9j7osBUYGD7bW7KX9QkPxTXtnMst6aNMQ5MsvV.jpg)
![1000113726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoyQ1bnPuVbPmMEtsMVwqPMGZhLfpg8aAwNvR2mhyDNi7P1ZbEpYUZG4kQwkibkpQ9Z.jpg)
Miranda Square is an island, so you need to be careful when crossing the streets to enter and exit it. Here you’ll find lush trees that provide plenty of shade, as well as several benches. It’s very common to see people chatting and taking a break from the daily hustle and bustle. In front of the plaza is the bus stop for buses heading to Clodosbaldo Russian Polytechnic University, so it’s common to see many students waiting for transportation in and around the plaza.
![1000113705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xejtZ4rxo5gQNRH8zScwH1fLE8abEdLAkM5zsE1QTVKzNszgB8fnqK8CD67sRixCggX.jpg)
![1000113722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eou8mnxjjVw4BrisGLViNqu8XCYVx4bSEuNFcUQbxtoPykz8KEeVKEiSvfK9cVpstn6.jpg)
This location serves as a key landmark due to its central position and proximity to Bermudez and Mariño avenues. It also connects to Humboldt Avenue, which leads to the passenger terminal, and to the roads heading toward Cantarrana, Cumanacoa, and Maturín. As you can see, it’s not a place for quiet conversation or to go unnoticed, since nearly all of Cumana’s traffic passes through this area.
![1000113728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/242Y1nUUFDn8o4bwz9zkNGZ65JFYYK9Mtrt9kVZA9MRJDfxhcmKvY6bFQ8CiBvMoYq9aT.jpg)
Además del Teatro Luis Mariano Rivera, frente a la plaza se ubican varios negocios comerciales que han permanecido abiertos al público durante décadas, entre ellos una ferretería, dos ópticas y un bar. Un negocio de comida muy popular que desapareció fue una pollera, era muy famosa porque se podían observar los pollos dando vueltas desde la plaza, por supuesto el aroma alegraba el ambiente, pero ya no está y solo quedan los recuerdos. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> El recorrido de hoy nos presenta a la Plaza Francisco de Miranda, un punto de referencia en Cumaná porque se encuentra ubicada en el centro de la ciudad, frente al teatro Luis Mariano Rivera. Acá se puede observar la estatua de este ilustre venezolano en este espacio público que ha sido remodelado en varias ocasiones.
![1000113712.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/243M2iURxrJk9mkCnVpkZmgRFXT7jAEFz8GGuKoPMymh6SpUPtsesCBUNaqEDKZnQvM3N.jpg)
![1000113710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23yThHMdy2wdDGWoC5xm3KSN5TogyXY4tzVKoifNqqzBYLFasFo2hSWuL72LjYNSJsTFY.jpg)
La plaza originalmente se construyó en 1912 y actualmente exhibe unos jardines bien cuidados, varias plantas ornamentales embellecen estos rincones. Quizás lo más llamativo de este lugar sea su gran fuente, que en épocas anteriores se mantenía activa con agua y una iluminación nocturna muy atractiva.
![1000113709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpA2aFL5AvwHsgS9nZQ4xMNGkiLvy9j7osBUYGD7bW7KX9QkPxTXtnMst6aNMQ5MsvV.jpg)
![1000113726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoyQ1bnPuVbPmMEtsMVwqPMGZhLfpg8aAwNvR2mhyDNi7P1ZbEpYUZG4kQwkibkpQ9Z.jpg)
La plaza Miranda es una isla, por tal razón se debe estar pendiente a la hora de cruzar las calles para acceder y salir de ella. Acá se aprecian frondosos árboles que ofrecen bastante sombra, además hay diversos bancos. Es muy común observar a personas conversando y tomando un descanso del ajetreo diario. En frente de la plaza está la parada de autobuses que se dirigen a la Universidad Politécnica Clodosbaldo Russian, por lo que es normal que muchos estudiantes esperen transporte en la plaza y sus alrededores.
![1000113705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xejtZ4rxo5gQNRH8zScwH1fLE8abEdLAkM5zsE1QTVKzNszgB8fnqK8CD67sRixCggX.jpg)
![1000113722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eou8mnxjjVw4BrisGLViNqu8XCYVx4bSEuNFcUQbxtoPykz8KEeVKEiSvfK9cVpstn6.jpg)
Este lugar suele ser un punto referencial por su ubicación, su proximidad a las avenidas Bermúdez y Mariño, también comunica con la Humboldt, que es la vía hacia el terminal de pasajeros y con la vía hacia Cantarrana, Cumanacoa y Maturín. Como se advierte, no es un sitio para conversar tranquilamente ni pasar desapercibidos porque casi todo el tránsito de Cumaná suele pasar por este punto.
![1000113728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/242Y1nUUFDn8o4bwz9zkNGZ65JFYYK9Mtrt9kVZA9MRJDfxhcmKvY6bFQ8CiBvMoYq9aT.jpg)
Además del Teatro Luis Mariano Rivera, frente a la plaza se ubican varios negocios comerciales que han permanecido abiertos al público durante décadas, entre ellos una ferretería, dos ópticas y un bar. Un negocio de comida muy popular que desapareció fue una pollera, era muy famosa porque se podían observar los pollos dando vueltas desde la plaza, por supuesto el aroma alegraba el ambiente, pero ya no está y solo quedan los recuerdos.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

> Hello, friends! Have a blessed weekend, everyone. Today I want to share the results of a mother-daughter photo shoot I did for a client in honor of Mother’s Day, which is coming up soon. They traveled all the way from Cumana to Maturín to take these photos, and I was really happy to hear that. She told me she used to work there and saw a video of my work on TikTok, which is why she wanted to do this with me. It’s wonderful to know that—the fact that my videos reach people and that they enjoy working with me afterward is just great. So, here are the results of these beautiful photos. >Hola amigos, bendecido fin de semana para todos, el día de hoy quiero compartibles el resultado de una sesion fotográfica madre e hija que realice para una clienta para el día de las madres que esta cerca, ellas viajaron desde Cumana hasta Maturín para hacer estas fotografías y me gusto mucho saber eso, me comento que a trabajado alla y que vio un video mío de mis trabajos por Tiktok y quiso hacerlo conmigo, es estupendo saber eso porque el hecho de que mis videos lleguen a personas y les plazca luego trabajar conmigo es genial, asi que bueno amigos por acá les dejo el resultado de estas lindas fotografías.

links.body:
There are so many meaning to the life of human we live on earth.

https://youtu.be/XxgAGPXlJTs?si=fUSdLKZODEOJQF1m

Each life starts with a purpose. Life is just a simple work, money, fun and everything to some individuals is all about working making money and enjoying life but if more than that the Bible also realized that God made man to serve another and more important purpose our life is not just an accident.

 *Genesis 1 to 7*, say that God made man in his own image and his likeness. This evaluation of our life is what living on earth must be created by some character and how we live our life for God. Knowing that God and
being in relationship forming a close relationship with God is what is very important here.

In *Ecclesiastes 12:13* which says that fear God keep his commandment that it is all due to man.

This is to inform us that our responsibility is the word of God and to obey his will. I consider it so we have to understand that when we live according to the commandments of God we are living according to the wishes for life and it becomes more clear.

Helping and doing the good will of God is what helps us to progress God did not make us. God did not create us only for ourselves but to serve a specific purpose. This message remember that we need to keep acting the way that God wants us to act living according to purpose having compassion patience and everything being conclusive we should know that God will obey his commandment do good to others and prepare to live for the purpose of human life.

When we consider this fact then we believe that there's no empty world so meaningless whether it's valuable gifts that God provides for us with faith love and reason.

links.title: Dusk at the Park [ENG|ESP]
links.body: > Hello everyone. Today I want to share some photos of the sky during sunset. I was talking with my friends at the park where we usually meet when one of the oldest members of the group mentioned how impressive the afternoon looked. I took my phone and captured several images of the moment. # At first, the sun was about to hide on the horizon. It looked like a small red sphere while its rays pierced through the clouds. It was a clear sight, and the intensity of the light changed quickly as the minutes passed. I stayed focused on the horizon to capture the exact point before the sun disappeared completely. # After it was no longer visible, the sky remained lit for a long time. The colors shifted toward yellow and orange tones, creating a different atmosphere in the park. Even though I didn't have a professional camera, the phone managed to record the colors well enough. I think these types of shots represent exactly what we were seeing at that time. # I decided to share these photos because it was a moment that caught the attention of everyone in the group. I hope you find these captures of the local sky interesting. # Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! Until next time!

> Hola a Todos. Hoy quiero compartir unas fotos del cielo durante el atardecer. Me encontraba hablando con mis amigos en el parque en el que nos solemos reunir cuando uno de los integrantes más viejos del grupo mencionó lo impresionante que se veía la tarde. Tomé mi celular y capturé varias imágenes del momento. # Al principio, el sol estaba a punto de esconderse en el horizonte. Se veía como una pequeña esfera roja mientras sus rayos atravesaban las nubes. Era una vista clara y la intensidad de la luz cambiaba rápido con el paso de los minutos. Me mantuve atento al horizonte para captar el punto exacto antes de que el sol desapareciera por completo. # Luego de que ya no era visible, el cielo siguió iluminado por un largo rato. Los colores pasaron a tonos amarillos y anaranjados, creando una atmósfera distinta en el parque. Aunque no tenía una cámara profesional, el celular logró registrar los colores lo suficientemente bien. Creo que este tipo de tomas representan exactamente lo que estábamos viendo en ese momento. # Decidí compartir estas fotos porque fue un momento que llamó la atención de todos en el grupo. Espero que estas capturas del cielo local les resulten interesantes. # Sin más que agregar me despido, estén atentos a los próximos post. ¡Hasta la Próxima! ------ ---- |

links.title: 😝National Nurses Day! / ¡Día Nacional de la Enfermería! 😎
links.body: >\n\nIn the late 19th century, **Florence Nightingale**, known as \

founded modern nursing. Through her strict adherence to handwashing and hygiene practices while caring for wounded soldiers in the Crimean War, Nightingale and her colleagues reduced the mortality rate from **42%** to **2%,** paving the way for nursing as we know it today. On May 6, we celebrate National Nurses Day, recognizing the vital role nurses play in our lives. > A finales del siglo XIX, Florence Nightingale, conocida como «La Dama de la Lámpara», fundó la enfermería moderna. Gracias a su estricto uso del lavado de manos y las prácticas de higiene durante la atención a los soldados heridos en la Guerra de Crimea, Nightingale y sus colaboradores redujeron la tasa de mortalidad del 42 % al 2 %, dando paso a la enfermería tal como la conocemos hoy. El 6 de mayo, celebramos el Día Nacional de la Enfermería, reconociendo el importante papel que desempeñan las enfermeras en nuestras vidas. This week was first celebrated in the United States in ***October 1954*** to commemorate the centennial of Nightingale's pioneering work in Crimea. With more than 3 million nurses currently working in the United States, they make up the largest percentage of the country's healthcare workforce. Nurses often work long and unrewarding shifts, standing for 12 hours or more a day. For a nurse who is constantly on the go. > Esta semana se celebró por primera vez en Estados Unidos en octubre de 1954 para conmemorar el centenario del trabajo pionero de Nightingale en Crimea. Con más de 3 millones de enfermeros en activo en Estados Unidos, constituyen el mayor porcentaje de la fuerza laboral sanitaria del país. Las enfermeras suelen trabajar turnos largos y poco gratificantes, de pie durante 12 horas o más al día. Para una enfermera que siempre está de un lado para otro. **300** AD: the earliest date for recorded mentions of nurses. **4–5** – the number of miles nurses walk per shift. **50%** – the percentage of nursing students among the total number of health science students. 19 million: the number of nurses worldwide. **41%** – the percentage of registered nurses working in hospitals. **10%** – the percentage of registered male nurses in the total workforce. **$35.24**: the average hourly wage for a nurse. Doctors diagnose us, prescribe medications, and operate on us, but without nurses, their work would be impossible. Nurses are on the front lines every day: ***administering injections, performing physical exams, treating wounds, and, in many cases, caring for terminally ill patients when a doctor is not present.*** > Año 300 d. C .: fecha más temprana en la que se registran las primeras menciones de enfermeras. 4–5 – la cantidad de millas que caminan las enfermeras en cada turno. 50% – el porcentaje de estudiantes de enfermería entre el número total de estudiantes de ciencias de la salud. 19 millones : el número de enfermeras en el mundo. 41% – el porcentaje de enfermeras tituladas que trabajan en hospitales. 10% – el porcentaje de enfermeros titulados varones en la plantilla total. 35,24 dólares : el salario medio por hora de una enfermera. Los médicos nos diagnostican, nos recetan medicamentos y nos operan, pero sin las enfermeras, su trabajo sería imposible. Las enfermeras están en primera línea todos los días: ***administran inyecciones, realizan exámenes físicos, curan heridas y, en muchos casos, cuidan a pacientes terminales cuando el médico no está presente.*** https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thealliance/SszMQ6lq-thealliance20new20pagebreak.png ## Family Time!

links.title: A 36 días para el Mundial | Las cinco leyendas que no jugaron un Mundial FIFA (Esp/Eng)
links.body: A pesar de su inmenso talento, estas cinco figuras nunca disputaron un minuto en la fase final de una Copa del Mundo. Alfredo Di Stéfano, considerado por muchos como el jugador más completo de la historia, es el caso más emblemático; aunque representó a tres selecciones (Argentina, Colombia y España), una mezcla de boicots, burocracia y una lesión inoportuna en 1962 le impidió debutar. \n\nGeorge Best, el \

, sufrió el peso de pertenecer a una selección modesta como Irlanda del Norte, que no logró clasificar durante sus años de plenitud física y artística.  

En África, George Weah se mantiene como el único Balón de Oro del continente, pero su dominio en el AC Milan y el PSG no fue suficiente para llevar a la humilde Liberia a la gran cita. Por otro lado, Ryan Giggs acumuló más de 30 títulos con el Manchester United, pero su carrera internacional con Gales terminó años antes de que el equipo lograra su histórica clasificación reciente. 

Finalmente, el carismático Eric Cantona se quedó fuera de EE. UU. 1994 por la eliminación de Francia y no fue convocado para 1998 tras el ascenso de la generación de Zidane.  Estas ausencias demuestran que, a veces, la grandeza individual no puede doblegar las circunstancias de su contexto nacional. Ver a Di Stéfano o Best en un Mundial es uno de los mayores \

para los historiadores del fútbol. 

Sus nombres, sin embargo, brillan con la misma intensidad que los de aquellos que sí levantaron el trofeo, probando que el legado de un ídolo trasciende las estadísticas de la FIFA.

¿Te gustó este artículo? Déjanos tu like, y comenta si crees que hay otra leyenda que no pudo participar en un Mundial de Fútbol.

## English Version
## ***36 Days to the World Cup | Five legends who never played in a FIFA World Cup***

Despite their immense talent, these five figures never played a single minute in the final stage of a FIFA World Cup. Alfredo Di Stéfano, considered by many to be the most complete player in history, is the most emblematic case; although he represented three national teams (Argentina, Colombia, and Spain), a mix of boycotts, bureaucracy, and an untimely injury in 1962 prevented him from debuting. 

George Best, the \

suffered the burden of belonging to a modest national team like Northern Ireland, which failed to qualify during his years of physical and artistic peak.

In Africa, George Weah remains the only Ballon d'Or winner from the continent, but his dominance at AC Milan and PSG was not enough to lead humble Liberia to the big stage. On the other hand, Ryan Giggs accumulated more than 30 titles with Manchester United, yet his international career with Wales ended years before the team achieved its recent historic qualification. Finally, the charismatic Eric Cantona missed out on USA 1994 due to France's elimination and was not called up for 1998 following the rise of Zidane's generation.

These absences demonstrate that, at times, individual greatness cannot overcome the circumstances of its national context. Seeing Di Stéfano or Best in a World Cup is one of the greatest \

for football historians. Their names, however, shine with the same intensity as those who did lift the trophy, proving that an idol's legacy transcends FIFA statistics.

links.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 08 2026
links.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gc30ac3005c331a3a336fd6796c604a10a2f958313793f2c379494e3e7873e3795f464e572a0a90a6021deb071715711f34aff146c62dc04ab940ce3723d87a1a_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente revitalizante. Empecé en el parque central, donde el aire fresco y el canto de los pájaros me hicieron sentir energizado. Mientras caminaba, me crucé con una mujer que estaba pintando un mural vibrante en una pared. Me contó que estaba trabajando en un proyecto comunitario para embellecer el barrio y fomentar la creatividad entre los jóvenes. Fue inspirador escuchar su pasión por el arte y su deseo de hacer una diferencia. Más adelante, pasé por un pequeño mercado de agricultores donde conocí a un anciano vendedor que ofrecía frutas y verduras orgánicas. Tenía un gran sentido del humor y me compartió historias sobre cómo cultivaba su propio huerto. Me sorprendió la variedad de productos que ofrecía, y decidí comprar algunas fresas, que estaban simplemente deliciosas. Su entusiasmo por la agricultura local realmente me hizo apreciar más los alimentos frescos. La caminata terminó siendo una mezcla perfecta de ejercicio, descubrimiento y conexión con la comunidad. Al final del día, me sentí agradecido por las pequeñas interacciones que hacen que la vida en la ciudad sea tan rica y dinámica. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). links.title: Look Outside, Lovecraftian Terror and Survival in an RPG Maker Masterpiece.
links.body:
https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3373660/7d2b829f5383f992b1bd533ca4296811ae0d909e/ss_7d2b829f5383f992b1bd533ca4296811ae0d909e.1920x1080.jpg?t=1773940368 [_Source_](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373660/Look_Outside/)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Buenos días, buenas tardes o buenas noches, damas y caballeros. ¿Cómo están? ¿Cómo se encuentran el día de hoy? Espero que muy bien. Yo particularmente tengo un problemita y es que simplemente ya no aguanto más los apagones que hay en mi estado y más específicamente por mi zona, porque pareciera que la tienen agarrada con nosotros, apagones de cinco horas, todos por la noche pero bueno, qué se le va a hacer. No les vengo a hablar de eso, aunque sí quería desahogarme un poquito. Como muchos saben por acá, yo soy bastante fanático de los juegos hechos con RPG Maker y hasta tengo un post donde hablo de su magia, porque es un arte usar algo tan limitado para hacer cosas tan impresionantes. Ahora imagina uno de estos juegos totalmente influenciado por Lovecraft, ese terror cósmico inenarrable para cualquiera y que no se puede transmitir a lo visual, solo a lo literario. ¿Un juego de RPG Maker de verdad puede dar esas sensaciones de terror lovecraftiano? Al parecer hubo un creador que lo logró recientemente y eso es lo que les vengo a traer por acá. Por cierto, no esperes una novela visual de mi parte por esta vez, esta vez sí usaron RPG Maker para hacer un RPG, algo que no se ve últimamente por estos días, en los cuales lo usan más que todo para narrativas o aventuras gráficas. Así que sin más dilación, hablemos de Look Outside.

Good morning, good afternoon or good evening, ladies and gentlemen. How are you? How are you doing today? I hope very well. I personally have a little problem, and it’s that I simply can’t stand the power cuts in my state any longer – and more specifically in my area, because it seems they’ve got it in for us. Power cuts lasting five hours, all at night, but well, what can you do? I’m not here to talk about that, although I did want to vent a little. As many of you around here know, I’m quite a fan of games made with RPG Maker, and I even have a post where I talk about their magic, because it’s an art to use something so limited to make such impressive things. Now imagine one of those games totally influenced by Lovecraft – that cosmic terror that is indescribable for anyone and cannot be conveyed visually, only in literature. Can a game made with RPG Maker truly give those feelings of Lovecraftian horror? Apparently there was a creator who recently achieved it, and that’s what I’ve come to bring to you here. By the way, don’t expect a visual novel from me this time – this time they actually used RPG Maker to make an RPG, something that hasn’t been seen much lately, these days when it’s mostly used for narratives or graphic adventures. So without further ado, let’s talk about Look Outside.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3373660/cc4185ab5e8efaf2545d3103443c376b7170c673/ss_cc4185ab5e8efaf2545d3103443c376b7170c673.1920x1080.jpg?t=1773940368 [_Source_](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373660/Look_Outside/)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Look Outside transcurre en un mundo donde de repente un ser se acerca al planeta tierra, todos aquellos que lo ven sufren deformaciones e inclusive algunos de ellos se convierten en monstruos, de los cuales tendrás que defenderte. Tu objetivo dentro del conjunto de apartamentos en el que te encuentras será el de sobrevivir cueste lo que cueste, para ello tendrás que fabricar armas, encontrar objetos y conseguir aliados que te acompañen en tu ardua lucha. Tendrás que descubrir qué es el extraño ser que tanto daño está causando, por qué lo hace, cuál es su propósito, ¿es maligno? ¿Podrás derrotarlo? Son algunas de las dudas que te surgirán en tu aventura. El sistema de combate es bastante especial en este caso, es el típico RPG con bastantes añadidos, porque evidentemente somos unos simples humanos, nuestro daño se basará en el equipamiento que llevemos encima y de los objetos que también podamos usar para atacar, a menos que tengamos aliados que estén \

pero aún conscientes de sí, ellos sí podrán tener habilidades especiales según la condición que padezcan, otro punto a destacar es que el daño varía según el distanciamiento de los enemigos y de cómo los ataquemos, ya que se pueden seleccionar varias partes de sus cuerpos.

Look Outside takes place in a world where suddenly a being approaches planet Earth. Everyone who sees it suffers deformities, and some of them even turn into monsters, which you’ll have to defend yourself from. Your goal, within the apartment complex where you find yourself, will be to survive no matter the cost. To do that, you’ll have to craft weapons, find objects and get allies to accompany you in your arduous struggle. You’ll have to discover what this strange being causing so much harm is, why it does it, what its purpose is – is it evil? Can you defeat it? These are some of the questions that will arise during your adventure. The combat system is quite special in this case – it’s the typical RPG with quite a few additions, because obviously we’re just ordinary humans. Our damage will be based on the equipment we carry and the items we can also use to attack, unless we have allies who are \

but still self-aware. They will be able to have special abilities depending on their condition. Another point to note is that damage varies depending on the distance from the enemies and how we attack them, as you can select different parts of their bodies.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3373660/48c330033d5b109990492ddc86e5b0e2f43cbd4e/ss_48c330033d5b109990492ddc86e5b0e2f43cbd4e.1920x1080.jpg?t=1773940368 [_Source_](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373660/Look_Outside/)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Tampoco te pienses que podrás investigar todo el rato sin parar, acá debes gestionar a tus personajes, darles de comer, bañarlos, dormir, para que mantengan su cordura y no pienses que puedes guardar la partida cuando quieras, tendrás que avanzar lo suficiente para que el juego te deje hacerlo. En conjunto esto que mencioné hace un producto bastante experimental e interesante. El juego cuenta con varios finales y además puedes conseguir diferentes aliados según lo que hagas en tus partidas, por lo que hay cierta libertad de elección que inclusive puede tener consecuencias como por ejemplo perder un brazo para salvar a algo o alguien y que luego no puedas equiparte ningún objeto en ese brazo que perdiste durante toda la partida. Además algo que destaca muchísimo de Look Outside son el diseño de los monstruos, de verdad se ven bizarros pero de una buena manera, te dan esa sensación de asco o mal augurio, habiendo una gran diversidad de ellos y no olvidemos mencionar la impresionante banda sonora, de esas que no te esperas por nada del mundo, jamás de los jamases encontrarte en un videojuego como este debido a ser un humilde indie. Si eres fan de Lovecraft sin dudas este será un juego para ti, siendo mucho más fiel este producto a las adaptaciones del género que simplemente no supieron expresar el terror que quería transmitir el autor. Así que sin más nada que añadir, me despido por el día de hoy, espero que le eches un ojo si te llamó la atención el concepto.

Don’t think you’ll be able to investigate non-stop either. Here you have to manage your characters, feed them, bathe them, let them sleep, so they keep their sanity, and don’t think you can save the game whenever you want – you’ll have to progress far enough for the game to let you do it. All together, what I’ve mentioned makes for a quite experimental and interesting product. The game features multiple endings, and you can also get different allies depending on what you do in your playthroughs, so there is a certain freedom of choice that can even have consequences, such as losing an arm to save something or someone, and then being unable to equip any item on that arm that you lost for the rest of the game. Also, something that really stands out about Look Outside is the design of the monsters – they truly look bizarre, but in a good way. They give you that feeling of disgust or bad omen, with a great diversity of them, and let’s not forget to mention the impressive soundtrack – the kind you would never, ever expect to find in a video game like this, given it’s a humble indie. If you’re a fan of Lovecraft, this will undoubtedly be a game for you, being much more faithful than adaptations of the genre that simply didn’t know how to express the terror the author wanted to convey. So with nothing more to add, I bid you farewell for today, and I hope you’ll give it a look if the concept caught your attention.
