title.title: 🌸 Ladies of Hive Contest #287: Let go to make room for the new [ES/EN]
title.body:
>

<center>![1000028072.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/48b2ctw9yEP8fQyCjof1yfbQNkq1Eyen3dG4hpgh9nMqqx1Sqmv6VrKGyHyNkxa1Vf.jpg)
<sub>Portada hecha en Canva</sub>
</center>

¡Hola queridas Damas de Hive! Espero que se encuentren todos muy bien. Hoy me paso por acá para participar de las preguntas de la semana de la mano de @monachta, con temas muy reflexivos. También agradezco a mi amiga @naath por la invitación. 

##### ***¿Qué es aquello a lo que te aferrabas con fuerzas (un ideal, una persona, una etapa) y que la vida te obligó a soltar? ¿Cómo fue el proceso emocional de aceptar que eso ya no formaba parte de tu presente?***

Solía definirme como una persona a la que le cuesta soltar. Todavía lo hago, porque de verdad creo que hay cosas que valen la pena, pero a veces solo es una sosteniendo la vela y nadie más. Eso te abre los ojos y por más que te cueste empiezas a entender que es momento de soltar. Me paso con amistades, con las que ni siquiera tuve una pelea o algo, simplemente comenzaron a alejarse, y yo intentaba estar ahí, seguir manteniendo la comunicación. Hasta que me di cuenta que era unilateral y si dejaba de retener se iba a cortar. Siento que cuesta hacer esto y nos aferramos porque no comprendemos cómo a la otra persona, con la que compartiste un montón de experiencias y momentos lindos, le termina resultando tan fácil irse. Eso siempre me descoloca, tal vez sea una nostálgica del pasado. 

Ahora, luego de tener un par de experiencias de estas, es que me di cuenta que hay personas y situaciones que llegan a tu vida para enseñarte algo o vivir un momento, una lección que tenías que aprender, o solo tienes que conocerla y pasar un tiempo juntos, y que cuando el tiempo termina lo más sano es soltar. Claro que decirlo es más fácil que hacerlo, todavía me aferro a las personas y por más que tenga una visión más espiritual acerca de esto, sigue costando. Hoy en día soy fiel creyente de que lo que es para uno siempre te encuentra y lo que no es, no hay forma de conservarlo en tu vida hagas lo que hagas. 

El proceso emocional siempre es complejo y depende de cada persona, por supuesto que en una primera instancia es triste, pero mientras más rápido sueltes es mejor porque hay que dejar ir lo viejo, lo que ya no te suma, para dejarle espacio a lo nuevo. Así que por más que me cueste, trato de aceptarlo y seguir mi camino. Siempre agradeciendo el tiempo compartido porque no fue en vano, pasó porque así tenía que ser y algo bueno nos habrá dejado.

##### ***¿Qué sentimiento \

(culpa, rencor, o arrepentimiento) estás cargando hoy que te impide disfrutar de tu realidad? ¿Qué paso estás dispuesta a dar para perdonarte o perdonar esa situación?*** No creo cargar con culpas, ni rencores, pero sí tengo algún que otro arrepentimiento. Este suele venir del lado de no haberme valorado lo suficiente, de no haberme elegido a mí cuando era lo único importante en aquel entonces. Arrepentimientos de no confiar lo suficiente en mis capacidades como para arriesgarme y dar todos aquellos saltos que hoy me cuestan y sé que debo hacerlo para disfrutar de mi presente. Voy en camino, pero es empinado y lento, más que nada porque yo lo hago que sea así. Aunque sí me perdono, esa versión del pasado que permitió todo esto o que siente que no hizo lo suficiente, ya no existe. Ahora soy esta otra persona, más consciente y abierta a los cambios, aunque me cuesten todavía. Sé que llegará el día en que pueda dejar todo atrás y empezar una nueva versión de mí.
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
Bueno amigos, hasta acá mi reflexión acerca de estos temas. Espero que les haya gustado e invito a todos a sumarse y participar con sus respuestas. Gracias por llegar hasta acá y apoyar mi contenido. ¡Hasta la próxima!
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
![1000028073.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/48bWaSw3ForHKYwZjyX56mVvQE6U8oPeZJsnWsPF8mzynza9CCK2fu7AzzLYytQm9m.jpg) Cover made in Canva
Hello, dear Ladies of Hive! I hope you’re all doing well. I’m stopping by today to take part in this week’s questions from @monachta, which cover some really thought-provoking topics. I’d also like to thank my friend @naath for the invitation. ##### ***What was it that you clung to tightly (an ideal, a person, a stage of life) that life forced you to let go of? What was the emotional process of accepting that it was no longer part of your present?*** I used to describe myself as someone who has a hard time letting go. I still do, because I truly believe there are things worth holding on to, but sometimes I’m the only one keeping the flame alive. That’s an eye-opener, and no matter how hard it is, you start to realize it’s time to let go. It happens with friendships—with people I didn’t even have a fight with or anything; they just started drifting away, and I tried to be there, to keep the lines of communication open. Until I realized it was one-sided, and if I stopped holding on, it would end. I feel like it’s hard to do this, and we cling on because we don’t understand how the other person—with whom you shared so many experiences and beautiful moments—ends up finding it so easy to walk away. That always throws me off; maybe I’m just nostalgic for the past. Now, after going through a couple of experiences like this, I’ve realized that there are people and situations that come into your life to teach you something or to share a moment with you—a lesson you needed to learn—or simply because you were meant to meet them and spend some time together. And when that time is up, the healthiest thing to do is let go. Of course, saying it is easier than doing it; I still cling to people, and even though I have a more spiritual perspective on this, it’s still hard. Today, I’m a firm believer that what’s meant for you will always find you, and what isn’t, there’s no way to keep it in your life no matter what you do. The emotional process is always complex and varies from person to person. Of course, at first it’s sad, but the sooner you let go, the better—because you have to let go of the old, of what no longer serves you, to make room for the new. So, as hard as it is for me, I try to accept it and move on. I’m always grateful for the time we shared because it wasn’t in vain; it happened because that’s how it was meant to be, and it must have left us with something good. ##### ***What heavy feeling (guilt, resentment, or regret) are you carrying today that prevents you from enjoying your reality? What step are you willing to take to forgive yourself or forgive that situation?*** I don’t think I carry any guilt or resentment, but I do have the occasional regret. These usually stem from not valuing myself enough, from not choosing myself when I was the only thing that mattered back then. Regrets about not trusting my abilities enough to take risks and make all those leaps that are hard for me now—even though I know I have to do them to enjoy my present. I’m on my way, but it’s a steep and slow climb, mostly because I’m the one making it that way. Although I do forgive myself, that version of my past that allowed all this to happen—or that feels like she didn’t do enough—no longer exists. Now I’m this other person, more aware and open to change, even if it’s still hard for me. I know the day will come when I can leave it all behind and start a new version of myself.
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
Well, friends, that wraps up my thoughts on these topics. I hope you enjoyed it, and I invite everyone to join in and share your thoughts. Thank you for reading this far and supporting my content. See you next time!
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)

title.title: Evergreen Life is going through a tough time, battling a tumor, my cousin is very sick
title.body: >Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu The last few days have been quite worrying for my uncle's family. My cousin's tumor being diagnosed under his armpit was an unexpected shock. But, without delay, we took him to Jamalpur Ever Green Life Hospital. As soon as we stepped inside the hospital, a kind of mixed feeling was at work—on the one hand, anxiety, on the other hand, hope for good treatment. The doctor's appointment was over, and then the real hustle and bustle began. The doctor gave a total of eight tests to diagnose the disease. After receiving the list of these eight tests, it felt like a long way to go. ​The hustle and bustle of the tests |!\[Raju20250918\_192512\_Vivid Human Portrait By Light Editz.jpg\](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUPoZrQK75PVbdaaVtyRftojfzgterXpDQNG2yTyceZor/Raju20250918\_192512\_Vivid%20Human%20Portrait%20By%20Light%20Editz.jpg)|ECG| |-|-| |!\[Raju20250918\_192454\_Vivid Human Portrait By Light Editz.jpg\](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmaSfgQLh8MaAAUAFoG11adBruUGvXm2rzQbWaNTKqqHeU/Raju20250918\_192454\_Vivid%20Human%20Portrait%20By%20Light%20Editz.jpg)|ECG| |-|-| The first of the tests was to understand the condition of the chest and the activity of the heart. In a room in the hospital, my brother is lying on a bed. Electrodes for ECG or perhaps other monitoring are attached to his chest and body. He is lying calmly, a nurse or health worker is taking care of him next to him. He might seem calm on the outside, but the inner anxiety was evident just by looking at his eyes and face. We were encouraging him, but the silence at that moment was very heavy. |!\[Raju20250918\_190720\_Vivid Human Portrait By Light Editz.jpg\](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdDgnLRkHy2bonFaUcD9crNcJiMQ39JXbxkdw5KAQzWvd/Raju20250918\_190720\_Vivid%20Human%20Portrait%20By%20Light%20Editz.jpg)|X-ray| |-|-| ​Then came the turn of the X-ray or radiology room. He took off his shirt, tilted his body slightly, and stood in front of the X-ray machine. Standing in front of such a large machine was like a silent challenge. We waited anxiously outside the door waiting for each test to be completed. We prayed in our hearts that all the reports would come in order. Although the rest of the tests were not captured on camera, standing in line for them, waiting—all of this seemed to pass very slowly. ​Waiting for medicine and the first step of treatment |!\[Raju20250918\_190217\_Vivid Human Portrait By Light Editz.jpg\](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZZqtyCHTgkgXMFFLo4xYyNsQ6VBqD6W2P9yz4rftL1KY/Raju20250918\_190217\_Vivid%20Human%20Portrait%20By%20Light%20Editz.jpg)|Pharmacy| |-|-| ​Finally, one phase of the tests was over. After looking at all the reports, the doctor prescribed medicine for a week as the first step of treatment. With the prescription, we went to the pharmacy on the ground floor of the hospital. There was a crowd of people in front of the glass-walled pharmacy. All of us, including my uncle's family members, were waiting behind. All the reports and the doctor's advice require the purchase of medicines, and that waiting period is also an essential part of the treatment. The doctor's clear instructions are that these medicines will last for a week. If the tumor does not shrink within this time, we will have to meet again next week and in that case, an operation may be necessary. This thought brought a new cloud of worry to our minds—operation! We are now just waiting for these seven days, wishing in our hearts that the medicine will work. Please all pray for my cousin so that he gets better with the medicine and doesn't have to undergo surgery.

>Thank you all for reading my post.

title.title: 🌅🥥Coconut fiber for plants🌻🌿
title.body: >https://images.hive.blog/DQmf3oWDNdyPfAAjqt9yNTLvr4xnWntVUQtWAhtcrraE9YQ/imagen.png\n\nDuring my recent visit to Colombia, I had the opportunity to buy some processed coconut fiber for my plants; a product that really worked for them. After doing some research, I discovered a way to process it at home that seemed the most logical and brilliant of all. Since we recently had Holy Week in Latin America, we can find a lot of the familiar coconut husk or \

discarded on the streets, due to the sweets made during that week. Rather than seeing it as pollution, I see it as an opportunity to do something good for my garden. In short, this coconut fiber is used to control humidity and improve aeration for plants, so under these conditions, it seems to be very useful for our little plants in the yard.\n\n>***En mi reciente visita a Colombia tuve una oportunidad de comprar allá una fibra de coco procesada para las plantas; un producto que de verdad funcionó para mis plantas, e investigando un poco, descubrí una manera de procesarlo en casa que me pareció la más lógica y genial de todas. Como recientemente tuvimos en temporada de \
en Latinoamérica, podemos conseguir botadas en la calle mucha de la conocida Concha o \

de Coco, debido a los dulces realizados en dicha semana, y yo más que contaminación, veo una oportunidad de hacer algo bueno para mi jardín. En pocas palabras, esta fibra de coco es utilizada para el control de la humedad y la aireación de las plantas, así que bajo estas condiciones, parece ser que esta es muy útil en nuestras pequeñas del patio.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmTuvcSFtyMnRyZiTfNGDSWFsJW6AdMRAjqbBfsTBVLq66/imagen.png I started by placing small pieces of the fiber on a plate with enough space. You should try to break them up as finely as possible, as you can see in the photo. Then I microwaved them for one minute to ensure they were sterilized and any mold that might grow on them was eliminated. This was the exact procedure I used because it was the most logical one I found online, and it's the one I trust the most. >***Comencé por dejar trozos pequeños de la fibra en un plato con suficiente espacio. Acá debes hacer lo posible por dejarla lo más finas posibles, tal como puedes detallar en la foto, para luego llevarlo al microondas por 1 minuto, y así verificar que se esterilice y se eliminen aquellos hongos que suelen crecer en ellos. Este fue el procedimiento exacto que utilicé, porque fue el más lógico que leí en internet, y realmente es el que me da más confianza de todas.***
![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

from my mother's yard, since it's filled with this soil. In fact, my mother has some very healthy and delicious fruit trees on this land, such as mango, avocado, passion fruit, lemon, etc. That's why I felt confident using it. I used a little more than twice the amount of sand and mixed it very well before using it.\n\n>***Proseguí recogiendo \

del patio de mi mamá, ya que aquí está relleno de esta tierra, de hecho en este terreno mi mamá tiene algunas plantas frutales que son altamente sanas y deliciosas, como: Mango, Aguacate, Parchita, limón, etc. Por eso confié bastante en utilizarla, utilicé un poco más del doble de la arena y lo mezclé muy bien para utilizarlo.***

If you look closely, in one of the pictures you can see that I also used charcoal. Since my mom cooks with firewood every weekend, there's charcoal scattered in her backyard at her business, and when I went to eat there, I took advantage of the situation and used some of the charcoal from the fires. Charcoal can help control humidity and act as a filter for plants, as well as a fungicide. In the picture, you can see that I added it directly to the planter, placing it about two centimeters deep to act as a filter, and I also added some to the soil to provide some charcoal.

>***Si notan, en una de las imágenes pueden notar que también utilicé carbón vegetal, y como mi mamá cocina con leña todos los fines de semana, en su negocio hay carbón esparcido en su patio trasero, y ahora que fui a comer allá aproveché y agarré algunos de los fogones y los utilicé. El carbón puede servir para el control de la húmeda y como filtro para las plantas, al igual que un controlador de hongos. En la imagen pueden ver que los agregué directamente al matero, colocándolo al fondo unos dos centímetros, para su función como filtro y agregué un poco a la tierra para que también porte un poco de carbón.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\

because of its small spines, which serve as a defense mechanism against insects that try to feed on it. This is one of my oldest cacti; I actually had a larger one, but unfortunately, I haven't been able to control a white fungus that always appears on it. I hope the charcoal I used helps it.\n\n>***Esta planta es conocida como el cactus \

por sus pequeñas púas que sirven como método de defensa contra algunos insectos que tratan de buscar comidas en ella. Este es uno de mis cactus más antiguos, realmente tenía uno más grande, pero lamentablemente no he podido controlar un hongo blanco que siempre le aparece, espero que el carbón utilizado le sirva de mucho.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcjtR6k7q4j9e6KFX7N3EM69nwwnhMWqPjPjtEC5f9v7d/imagen.png)

<div class\

> I was surprised at how big my cacti have grown since I returned. I already had several plants that I lost for various reasons, but I'm still very happy with the ones that are still here. I invite you to see all these plants I have; I added some of this soil to each one, and I hope to return soon to show you some other homemade ideas I'll be implementing. I'm getting back into the swing of things on the page, and I hope to continue sharing with you. Thanks for reading. >***Me pareció sorprendente lo grande que conseguí a mis cactus desde mi regreso, anteriormente ya tenía varias plantas que por diferentes motivos he perdido por distintos motivos, pero aun así estoy muy feliz de los que aquí siguen. Acá los invito a presenciar todas estas plantas que tengo, a cada una les agregué de esta tierra y espero muy pronto volver para mostrarles algunas otras de las ideas caceras que iré implementando. Ya estoy integrándome de nuevo por la página, espero poder seguir compartiendo con ustedes, gracias por leer.***
![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

y vaya que si desde que estoy aprendiendo y siento me falta por conocer más de este mundo de la costura,pero alli vamos paso a paso y a mí ritmo ☺️. # > _Hello! My dear and cherished sewing family of this beautiful community 🤗 I hope you enjoyed your day. We're almost at the weekend, and it seems like the days are flying by, and I'm not getting better 🤭 I've been a little under the weather these past few days, but that hasn't stopped me from picking up my machine and sewing in my spare time. I feel like sewing is a form of therapy for me, a way to forget a little about all the bad things I'm going through mentally, especially when negative thoughts invade my mind. Something that helps me minimize them a bit is sewing. Ever since I discovered I was good at it—well, almost good, because I'm still learning—I feel like you never stop learning something because there's always something new to learn about what you love. That's why I feel like I'm almost good, because I'm surprised when I learn something new and try to put it into practice. But I always remember the words of a teacher who said, \

and boy, is that ever since I started learning. I feel like I still have so much to learn about this world of sewing, but we're getting there, step by step. And at my own pace ☺️._

#

<div class=\

>Me sorprendo casi siempre cuando hay clientas que dejan en mi su proceso sus ideas y sus sueños,y a que me refiero? Se preguntarán...Pues si me refiero a la hora de escoger el diseño soñado para una clienta de su prenda,me animan mucho este tipo de comentarios porque difícil a mi se me haría complicado confiarle eso a alguien que por primera vez quiero que me haga una prenda pero aún von todo ellas mis bellas clientas lo hacen y es algo que aprecio mucho porque han confiado en mi desde el primer momento sin saber como va a quedar sus prendas y con poco conocimiento cuando se trata de prendas que no he hecho pero bueno de los errores se aprende en el camino y eso es algo que me ha enseñado un poco la costura al principio no creia en eso pero tuve que vivirlo para saber que es así,desde que mis clientas me han entregado ese poder para confiar en que sus prendas siempre se las haré como sueñan no hay quien me pare jajajaja 🤣la verdad es chiste pero si hay momentos donde pues simplemente les queda un poco grande y hay que hacer ajustes,pero nada que una maquina y aguja e hilo no pueda solucionar,me pasó con este traje de baño todavía no se si a mi clienta le quede bien pero aqui les muestro el proceso creativo ,en otro tutorial les estaré recordando si a ella le gustó o no 🤭😅pero a mi sin duda me encantó. # > _I'm almost always surprised when clients entrust their process, their ideas, and their dreams to me. What do I mean by that? You might be wondering... Well, if I'm referring to choosing the dream design for a client's garment, these kinds of comments really encourage me because it would be difficult for me to entrust that to someone I want to make a garment for the first time. But even so, my beautiful clients do it, and it's something I really appreciate because they've trusted me from the very beginning, without knowing how their garments will turn out and with little experience when it comes to garments I haven't made before. But hey, you learn from your mistakes along the way, and that's something sewing has taught me a little. At first, I didn't believe in it, but I had to experience it to know that it's true. Since my clients have given me that power to trust that I'll always make their garments exactly as they dream, nothing can stop me! Hahaha 🤣 It's a joke, really, but there are times when it's simply a little too big and adjustments are needed. But nothing a machine, needle, and thread can't fix. It happened to me with this swimsuit. I still don't know if it will fit my client well, but here it is. I'm showing the creative process, in another tutorial I'll remind you if she liked it or not 🤭😅 but I definitely loved it._ # ---

### _Paso 01_

>El primer paso es cortar las piezas correspondientes en este caso las piezas del frente del top las piezas del short en este caso lo haremos con la parte de adelante doble así que cortaremos de la pieza delantera dos,cortamos los tirantes en este caso 5 , cuatro para el shorts y una para el top,cortamos los tirantes del top y por último la pieza doble del top de la espalda y nuestra pretina del short ,esas son las piezas correspondientes a usar para la confección del traje de baño. # > ### _Step 01_ > _The first step is to cut the corresponding pieces; in this case, the front pieces of the top and the shorts pieces. In this case, we will use a double front piece, so we will cut two pieces from the front piece. We cut the straps; in this case, 5, four for the shorts and one for the top. We cut the straps from the top and finally the double back piece of the top and our waistband for the shorts. These are the corresponding pieces to use for making the swimsuit._ ---

### _Paso 02_

>Primero vamos a estar cosiendo las piezas de los tiros del short cada una en su lugar cosemos la entrepierna y la pieza de atrás que es una sola nos debe quedar en el medio de las dos piezas de la parte del frente,cosemos por el borde de los costados del short en este caso lo hice con costura overclock y cosemos también la parte de las piernas osea el borde para el dobladillo. # > ### _Step 02_ > _First we're going to sew the pieces of the shorts' crotch seams, each one in its place. We sew the crotch seam and the back piece, which is a single piece, should be in the middle of the two front pieces. We sew along the edge of the sides of the shorts; in this case, I did it with an overlock stitch. We also sew the leg part, that is, the edge for the hem._ ---

Now we sew the drawstrings for the top and shorts together._ ---

>Cosemos los tirantes del top también y vamos a ubicar la costura de los costados por dentro del short,insertamos en vada lado los cordones y cosemos la pretina al short doblada a la mitad,luego cosemos el top las piezas de adelante asi como cosimos el short que quede entre la pieza de adelante la de atrás y no se vea costura,luego cosemos el borde del top cosemos al frente lo mismo como el short por los costados para insertar el cordón y por último cosemos los tirantes por el frente y a la espalda del top. # > ### _Step 04_ > _We sew the top straps as well and we're going to place the side seams inside the shorts, we insert the drawstrings on each side and sew the waistband to the shorts folded in half, then we sew the front pieces of the top as well as we sewed the shorts so that there is no visible seam between the front and back pieces, then we sew the edge of the top, we sew the front in the same way as the shorts on the sides to insert the drawstring and finally we sew the straps to the front and back of the top._ ---

title.title: What can the Summoner do in “Escalation Conflicts”? / Escalation Conflicts のサモナーはどんな能力？
title.body:
![Top Image](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZEvYGUgFMSE3ogHF5vG2oBqPJjBNZaK5xfwxBK6cbLp/image.png)

### [ENGLISH]

The Conflicts for Splinterlands: Conclave Arcana are almost over. The ninth card is DRAGONLORD MANCER. I want a Gold Foil version, but it’s probably going to be insanely expensive.

I’ve said it many times already, but DRAGONLORD MANCER is ridiculously strong. Bloodlust and Corrupted Healing? Giving two top-tier abilities like that is absolutely crazy for a summoner. I want it!

Anyway, putting that aside.

This time I want to talk about Escalation. As you probably know, Escalation will also have Conflicts. I assume, just like before, that nine cards will be distributed one by one. So let’s try predicting what the latter six summoners will be like.

---

First, here’s the announcement posted on Discord on May 5.

![official-annauncements](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfCZKLU3oCiqhQhERu5FSYrnNVen5m91Atg4DNv4NuhDJ/image.png)

To summarize it very simply:

One guaranteed card with 325 Chance.
The number of Gold Foils in Gold Foil Draw Events will be reduced from 155 copies to 50 copies.

Apparently that’s what it means, though I’m not entirely sure what Gold Foil Draw Events actually are. Still, it’s disappointing that the number is decreasing.

However, 325 Chance is surprisingly low. The current DRAGONLORD MANCER requires 1450 Chance. That’s less than a quarter of it! 👍

If you properly buy Escalation cards and load them into your wagon, it seems like it’ll be much easier to obtain Conflict cards too. Everyone, please keep getting them and keep selling them off! I’ll buy them on the market!

---

Anyway, I got sidetracked again. We were supposed to be talking about predicting card performance.

I think it’ll still be the same structure: three units plus one summoner for each element, making a total of nine cards. However, I personally suspect the summoners might not be Legendary rarity this time.

In the Chaos Legion block, there were Rare cards in Chaos Legion and Legendary cards in Conflicts. Riftwatchers had Epic cards. Then Rewards had Rare cards, and Promo had Legendary cards.

Altogether, there were 11 Rare summoners, 6 Epic summoners, and 9 Legendary summoners — a total of 26 summoners.

But in the current Conclave Arcana block, there’s only one Rare and one Legendary summoner for each element. That’s only 12 in total.

Right now, because of the Rebellion multi-element summoners, it might not feel inconvenient. But once the next main set releases and Rebellion rotates out, I think it’ll become incredibly inconvenient.

And yet, for some reason…

Yes, for some reason…

Escalation strangely doesn’t include summoners in the initial set! I kept wondering what the intention behind that was, but I think maybe they intentionally left them out because they planned to increase the number of summoners through Escalation Conflicts.

Since there are so few summoners, players are practically forced to participate in Conflicts. Because of that, I predict the Escalation summoners will all have extremely powerful and desirable abilities. Otherwise, nobody would want them!

https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/conclave/Dragonlord%20Mancer_lv2_gold.png

In Conclave Arcana’s case, the format is basically: buff two races + choose and grant two abilities. If Escalation follows the same pattern with two race buffs and abilities, it feels like we’d end up with nothing but Legendary summoners, which would not be very wallet-friendly.

That’s why I’d be happy if they were Rare or maybe Epic summoners instead. Once Rebellion leaves Modern, we’ll need to collect summoners again, so I hope they keep them reasonably affordable.

![sample](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfCZXDWPvGqNPcqznvyTEddsctLyKguRZkEJNcLP8wwTi/image.png)

For example, something like this.

Compared to Rare summoners, it would have one additional ability in exchange for higher rarity. Maybe it would even be better to make the cost 5. That way it couldn’t be used in Little League, but it could still be used in Junior Varsity, which would help differentiate it.

Ah, but maybe that wouldn’t work. If the top six presale buyers are given design rights, then people might complain if Conclave cards are Legendary while Escalation cards are only Epic.

In that case, maybe they really will end up being Legendary cards after all...

Still, if they simply use the same race buff + ability structure as Conclave Arcana, there wouldn’t be enough differentiation, so I think they’ll probably introduce some kind of unique twist.

Hmm… I honestly don’t know.

I guess we’ll find out once the first summoner card gets revealed.

Wait a minute… if it’s one card per month, does that mean it’ll take nine months to finish all nine cards? So that would be around next February?

And if a new set releases at the end of the year, would that mean the new pack launches before Conflicts even finish?

Surely not… unless the new set release gets delayed so the timing works out perfectly? No way… 😱

---

The images below include the BATTLE URL with a referral link.
If you are thinking of getting started, take a look at the BATTLE before you sign up.

[![BATTLE URL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFyv4Ep3buivhRL15L1YbU3DUKEKHTDSbKxQcwQUsuyC/image.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0f9afb5257750511d55dee2d9383fb52?ref=sakurakko)


![Separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sakurakko/23zSQpURqMgpo5FuaQVKT1UG8Dxmivcj6ZFG4XD7GLXtN5UkPKZi5j2byDtJpSdMjqZaU.png)



### [日本語]

コンクラーベ・アルカナ の Conflicts が終わりですね。9つ目のカードは DRAGONLORD MANCER です。GFで欲しいけどめっちゃ高いんだろうなー

何度も言いますが、DRAGONLORD MANCER はめちゃくちゃ強いです。 Bloodlust と Corrupted Healing ですよ？超優秀アビリティを2つも付与するなんてとんでもないサモナーです。欲しい！

さて、それはともかく。

今回の話は エスカレーションです。ご存じの通り、エスカレーション にも Conflicts があります。おそらく今まで通りに9枚のカードが順に配布されると思うのですが、後半6枚のサモナーがどんなカードになるか予想してみましょう。

---

まず、5月5日に Discord でアナウンスされた内容は以下の通り。

![official-annauncements](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfCZKLU3oCiqhQhERu5FSYrnNVen5m91Atg4DNv4NuhDJ/image.png)

超簡単にまとめると 

* 325 Chance で1枚確定だよ。 
* Gold Foil Draw Events の Gold Foils の枚数を 155 枚から 50 枚 に減らすよ。

って事らしいのですが、Gold Foil Draw Events がよくわかんない。まぁ、枚数が減るのは残念ですが。

しかし、325 Chance って少なくていいね。いまの DRAGONLORD MANCER は 1450 Chance だからね。4分の1以下じゃん！👍

ちゃんと エスカレーション のカードを買ってワゴンに詰めたら、Conflicts のカードも手に入りやすそう。みんあ、どんどん手に入れてどんどん売り飛ばしてください！私はマーケットで買います！

---

また話がずれていました。カード性能を予想してみようって話でしたね。

ユニットが3枚、サモナーが各エレメントに1枚、計9枚なのは同じだと思います。しかし、私が思うにサモナーのレアリティがレジェンドじゃないんじゃないかと思うんですよね。

カオスレギオン のブロックでは カオスレギオンで レアカード、Conflicts でレジェンドカード。リフトウォッチャー ではエピックカード。さらに リワード でレアカード。 プロモ でレジェンド。

合計でレアが11枚、エピックが6枚、レジェンドが9枚の26枚もサモナーがありました。

それなのに、今回の コンクラーベ・アルカナ ブロックだと レア と レジェンドが各エレメントにそれぞれ1枚づつ。合計12枚しかありません。

今は リベリオン の マルチエレメントサモナー があるので不便に感じてないかもしれませんが、次のメインセットが出てリベリオンが落ちたらめちゃくちゃ不便になると思うんですよね。

それなのに、なぜか！

そう、なぜか！エスカレーション では初期セットにサモナーが含まれないという謎な状況！これってどういう意図なのかと悩んだんですが、もともと エスカレーション の Conflicts でサモナーを増やす計算で入れなかったんじゃないかと思うのです。

サモナーの数が少ないから Conflicts に参加せざるを得ない状況。なので、 エスカレーション のサモナーは非常に優秀な能力で欲しくなるカードばっかりになるんじゃないかと予想します。じゃないとみんな欲しがらないからね！

https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/conclave/Dragonlord%20Mancer_lv2_gold.png

コンクラーベアルカナ の場合、種族2つにバフ＋アビリティ2つを選択して付与という形です。同じように種族バフ2つとアビリティだった場合、レジェンダリーサモナーばかりになってお財布に優しくないセットになっちゃう気がする。

なので、 レア 、もしくは エピック のサモナーだと嬉しいんだよね。リベリオン が モダン から落ちた後、サモナーを揃えないといけないのでなるべくお安くしてほしいです。

![sample](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfCZXDWPvGqNPcqznvyTEddsctLyKguRZkEJNcLP8wwTi/image.png)

たとえばこんな感じでね。

レアのサモナーと比べるとアビリティが1つ多い代わりにレアリティが上がってる感じ。コストも5にしたほうが良いかもね。5にすることで Little League では使えないけど Junior Varsity では使えるという感じで差別化するといいかもしれない。

あ、でも駄目かも。プレセール上位の6人にデザイン権を与えているなら、コンクラーベ は レジェンド なのに、エスカレーション はエピックとか不満出るね。

そうなるとやっぱり レジェンドカード か...

コンクラーベ・アルカナ と同じように 種族バフ＋アビリティ だった場合は差別化できないから何らかの差をつけるとは思うんだけど。

んー...わからん。

最初のサモナーカードが発表されればわかると思うんだけどね。

あれ？そういえば1ヶ月で1枚だとすると、9種類終わるまで9ヶ月かかる？ってことは来年2月？年末に新セットが発売されるとすると新パックが発売されてもまだコンフリクトが終わらないってことになる？

まさか、新セットの発売が伸びるからちょうど良くなるとか？まさかね...😱

title.title: My Sister's Shared Memories, and the Joy When She travelled together with her friends
title.body: > I wanna tell you today how my gay sister enjoyed her travel in Bohol.. We leaved her together with her friends for she wanted to explore some places and beautiful sceneries aside from beaches..

> She told me that they've discovered a beautiful resort in Bohol yet a not so expensive one,she tried to emphasized to me that the entrance fee is just for free and what you only need to do is just to purchased some food and then you'll get to enjoy the place-- thats so relaxing and comforting for free..

> The place is named Terra Verde Resort,she told me that if I didn't went home right away I would have visited the beautiful resort. She and her friends were enjoying the place,doing chitchats and the best of all ordering their favourite foods..
> Together with her sophomore college friends,they're enjoying the foods even if they're ordering pastas and fruit juices and smoothies
> And then there's a little carbonara too,enough to fill their one's tummy..

> As for my sister she find it best tasting the one sliced of tomato based pizza.What she liked about it was that its made from a thin crust with herbs and a lot of tomato toppings.. I'm just enjoying while listening to her narrating her story having an enjoyable stay at Terra Verde Resort..

> Her other friend chose banana smoothie with a banana slice on a glass and as per her friend it really tasted delicious and nutritious. A lot of people will get motivated to stay at the place because aside from its beautiful ambiance,local tourist got the chance to enjoy the place at a very affordable price.

>\nStill they're adventures continue talking and chatting with her friends still went on and then they took the opportunity to wander and roam around the area of the restaurant,and experienced the beauty of the cozy place.\n

>
The cozy atmosphere of the place was very warm because of its surroundings so relaxing during at night.

They've stayed in the place until evening to see how beautiful  it is at nighttime too and then they went home after wandering and having picture takings..She said to me that whenever I'll be back in Bohol,I won't have missed to visit the place soon..

Upon hearing all her stories,I enjoyed so much how she used to convince me to include the place in my travel list soon because the place is really worth to be visited for..


This would be all for now and I hope you're enjoying hearing my stories for today..See you next time😊

title.title: My Sketchquest Entry: Replaced and Lost
title.body:
![07ec7aa2-5b91-4146-9c8c-512201fbdd8c~3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cjsean/23wC5YzAd6Cmst2VuPhy8VbBMNKZWkZHXgbbF47vGFZPrDH5BvkJKA2Zgb1mWJBwJZbtF.png)
I saw one artist online who got replaced and is now feeling unsure about her career. If I remember it right her work had been used to train AI and now they don't need her anymore. She felt doubts in her skills and abilities but her followers were quick to mention that she must put a clause in her contract about not using her work for AI training some people even commented that in their country that practice is not allowed.

My drawing today is inspired by this situation, I thought if I create art using my own style and own hands that is my way of supporting fellow creatives regarding the matter I raised. Here is my entry to sketchquest drawing contest 100 percent me and no AI

# Here's how I made it

![e5443324-2f46-4126-8721-f3636d9d599f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cjsean/23uFTmWJTcy6VYEq4FbcCwDN62HqhyE3Jk9fQFBMm73UB9fB6MGMTFyp3W2DDXxvAWv4R.jpg)
I am using my original characters the ones wearing this bubble like headpiece with horns. Those creatures who love fireworks and partying if you had been following me you are already familiar with these folks. On a colored canvas I started scratching this image I don't have rough draft nor any line drawing to follow I just went with it spontaneously and this is how it looked. My only plan at this point is draw a pair of startled eyes 
![sketch1778206205152.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cjsean/23u6333HdUwiJm6osAVsoDtGiAwwkNeXNyzMxMsvFUQWChjbRRuvSGoBQJwukKxyp2FiQ.jpg)
To achieve that lost vibe I drew a gadget used for navigation and mapped out some small details to keep me going as to how far I would take this. The small mushrooms are new characters I thought I would give them personalities instead of just being mushrooms. Of course the flying rockets would be there and some vegetations two of the things I love drawing for this kind of art 
![sketch1778207021175.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cjsean/23u5y2BbnJ3vZqZskCTwpH5ezTgMZX8mB9uyK7A2gTfPCvmJKkLrv6wGhyQGpt8Ygh8Ec.jpg)
Finally to fill the space I added the house to the left with a circular window at the top left of the canvas. I added a butterfly and a few more mushrooms and vegetations. This is pretty much done I just have to scratch off the remaining areas with no details 


![07ec7aa2-5b91-4146-9c8c-512201fbdd8c.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cjsean/23u5vaXwEAeYhebER8wG6PwLiUZVmzgwC6wiYLs4hQ7USNj5Qj69yXDexffspkz9rSw4w.jpg)
I could have scratched off that big circular space around the butterfly but I kept it and made it into a big moon to frame the butterfly. I think that worked for me and I am glad I did not hesitate.

title.title: BLACK, WHITE, AND MANY SHADES OF GRAY
title.body: Yep, it's just like the title says. You'll see some black, some white, and quite a few shades of gray here, but ...\n\n<a href=\

> (Enlargeable) ... but that isn't all. I have to warn you that the post contains some unexpected, colorful moments, as well. Ok, you have been warned - let's go. MUSHROOMS AND STUFF ON A WET AUTUMN DAY
> (Enlargeable) It happened in autumn last year, if I remember correctly.
> (Enlargeable) It has been raining a lot, so I used to spend most of my time at home, in those days.
> (Enlargeable) These photographs were probably taken in one of the short periods between the rains.
> (Enlargeable) Judging by the number of photographs, I must have spent an hour or two in the woods not far from the town of Svetvinchenat.

> (Enlargeable) I visited the town as well, obviously. I mean, you can see the town in some of these pictures, so ... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXK4Z8CZLCkxesQctUtoWfzRgfbD7BmAmrLqHg2ychZbF/img_6302_malo.jpg) The woods are amazing. The trees aren't anything special, but ...

> (Enlargeable) ... but you can sometimes find surprisingly lovely footwear there. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQByHg8bjhpLdfUJ7zheb3x2MDF95d5ktQpdJkAePehyu/img_6290_malo.jpg) A sneaker like this can look like a mushroom from a distance. Do you like mushrooms? Becouse, you know ...
> (Enlargeable) ... I photographed some mushrooms that day. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQWTeCnadzo6fSw2Hdvkq4NSjVLzbzEXEmvJ6BUKynFdR/img_6309_malocb.jpg) Small mushrooms, mostly.

> (Enlargeable) Some were even smaller than small, more like tiny. Tiny and gracile. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTAbsSmbkipRVQBptzK6G8RRyigpnsGmGn5pH7W96PqN/img_6318_malo.jpg) Here you can see a mushroom peeking from the leaf litter. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTYrDYbSWPB6D7kqbCzHQALD4uR887No6DMxQuRDwAfsi/img_6321_malo.jpg) The same mushroom, only from a different angle. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb6Zw7yyhrm9U1wmre1qJ3PqxDzQZUhyukgAA9QKNZGXb/img_6316_malo.jpg) Here you can see some fluffy stuff atached to a fallen leaf. A gall of sorts, probably. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWmiX3F6hgetME7stUhQ6XJFmD9hAP4bVZ9GXgnMdr95D/img_6306malocb.jpg) Dead leaves usually decay in a visually appealing way.

> (Enlargeable) First, they display lovely autumnal colors... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmexz4LkiLQGqyWE5aArMihq2G5zbyQpp9qe4KTpjNY2t5/img_6307malo.jpg) ... and then you can admire the intricate lace of their exposed veins.

> (Enlargeable) This is a scene from Svetvinchenat, the town I mentioned earlier in the post. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUEXKdCHfmRGkD4bS51doa5e4kHmvWSmJt8b483c2sW4u/img_6325_cbmalo.jpg) It's a cool litlle town ...
> (Enlargeable) ... with a cool historic fortress in its center.
> (Enlargeable) Here I caught the shadow of one of the lanterns in Svetvinchenat.
> (Enlargeable) This is the facade of an old building, one of the historic buildings that surround the main square.
> (Enlargeable) Here I zoomed in on one of its windows. In the following photograph ...
> (Enlargeable) ... I zoomed in even more.
> (Enlargeable) Here you can take a peek through the rusted bars of that broken window. Just like the window, the interior has surely seen better days.

> (Enlargeable) This inscrutable window belongs to the same house. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRp5x6erRMqeaCLjxBQGGEdemk72yAgQxqWzy2STNp7o8/img_6293_malo.jpg) This detail belongs to the woods. The photograph shows the leaves of a wild rose.
> (Enlargeable) This is yet another small mushroom. The mushroom in the following photograph ...

> (Enlargeable) ... is partially covered with dry leaves fallen from an oak tree. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRXbsAFy2gBASPiZ5hNCJSCN6MJDc13RbCn9UxHvBF8jL/img_6314_malo.jpg) This mushroom is barely visible among the dead foliage.

> (Enlargeable) I decided to end this first segment of today's post with a bit of color. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1F1SJ352HTCz2zbAN3KSzcxg6TTo6FzgbbU4tUrwhE2/razmakmalo.jpg) ON A CLOUDY SUMMER DAY At first glance, it looks very much like today ... ![IMG_3562 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/uQQ2BxN9-IMG_356220malo.jpg) ... but it was a much warmer, summer day ... ![IMG_3653 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/r4JW2YDo-IMG_365320malo.jpg) ... in the small port, a few kilometers from my house ... ![IMG_3660 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/NJ9GFe6d-IMG_366020malo.jpg) ... a photogenic place ... ![IMG_3563 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/SeXfWIGh-IMG_356320malo.jpg) ... with many interesting details. ![IMG_3564 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/A0N9Cy22-IMG_356420malo.jpg) I inverted this clam in Photoshop to see how it looks ... and I liked what I saw ... so this picture is part of the post now. ![IMG_6784 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/VCkAvVsU-IMG_678420malo.jpg) There is a beach near the fishing port ... and this Baywatch tower looks pretty cool ... in my opinion ... ![IMG_6783 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/DlW9aBXe-IMG_678320malo.jpg) ... especially on a day like this ... I like this white and blue coloration in combination with the sky & sea on a cloudy day ...

> (Enlargeable) ... all this area is designed in white and blue ... I like that ... ![IMG_3703 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/wirlSftb-IMG_370320malo.jpg) ... some boats are also nicely blue ... in the same kind of blue ... I apologize for this colored section of the black & white post ... but I felt the urge to include these photographs as well. ![IMG_1591 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/su417048-IMG_159120malo.jpg) Some crabs were rotting on the rocks ... they were accidentally caught in the nets, I suppose.

> (Enlargeable) A man was working on his boat ... or someone else's boat, I don't know for sure ... ![IMG_1586 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/8wZ9WNz9-IMG_158620malo.jpg) ... it was a nice opportunity ...

> (Enlargeable) ... to take a few paparazzi shots. ![IMG_3656 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/y6ZCBe4D-IMG_365620malo.jpg) The sun appeared for a moment, but ended up in a pool of water, before my feet. ![IMG_3489 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/6v7NFzC4-IMG_348920malo.jpg) The car was parked near the water ... ![IMG_3492 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/SIrHrHZF-IMG_349220malo.jpg) ... and a cat was enjoying the day from that shiny, elevated place. ![IMG_3657 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/QilvxdVt-IMG_365720malo.jpg) The car tire from another machine ended up in the shallows ... ![IMG_3659 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/DrwKmZuu-IMG_365920malo.jpg) ... not far from some stranded boats. ![IMG_3662 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/gmWNYJ7n-IMG_366220malo.jpg) These are the last shots ...

> (Enlargeable) ... soon I was home. ![IMG_3565 malo INVERT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/x4tHDeXr-IMG_356520malo20INVERT.jpg) As always in these monochromatic (well, mostly) excursions on HIVE ... ![IMG_3655 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/qu1XH7Kt-IMG_365520malo.jpg) ... the photographs are my work. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1F1SJ352HTCz2zbAN3KSzcxg6TTo6FzgbbU4tUrwhE2/razmakmalo.jpg) THE ASTROCAT She landed in suburbia ... a couple of years ago ... ![dsc01304_malo.jpg](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPiaChtooT9JbmgFy914Xiivzn3YwdgWZTh18KPbX8JYY/dsc01304_malo.jpg) ... and now she's sharing the house with a friend of mine. ![dsc01297_malo.jpg](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTzLP43LtZHDkmDVPNiMJT4eSwDHiE8WfFPr1XyzuSXfm/dsc01297_malo.jpg) Although this extraterrestrial cat can breathe quite good here on earth ... she likes to wear her old space helmet ... ![dsc01303_malo.jpg](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrkkW7pgSDny4NXxcVkobySU7HP9cG2RrCdBiy5QgcH9/dsc01303_malo.jpg) ... especially in front of the guests. ![dsc01307_malo.jpg](https://images.ecency.com/DQmduyPRc252jpc6XEc6pVkyNkTwCZi3qVSgQFgfzqpkvra/dsc01307_malo.jpg) Here you can see Pepitza, that's her earthly name, without the helmet ... ![dsc01305_malo.jpg](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSTkPNE8UKpC9rfySo68E2oLfgphXzRAiSRGa9wE77Skh/dsc01305_malo.jpg) ... posing on some fine shoes and elegant boots. ![dsc01298_malo.jpg](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbgX4XVTDPpRtAYWNWzp8JHKxXGyzAwaT3RqzC8s6Phav/dsc01298_malo.jpg) Some people from that suburban neighborhood don't believe in Pepitza's extraterrestrial origin. They have another theory. Something about a secret North Korean space program ... that never reached the orbit ... but somehow ended up here ... on the earth again. ![dsc01302_malo.jpg](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQAH34nfS3FATv2UponYGg6gkf5DvUZ4FaRiTuYQLQWMq/dsc01302_malo.jpg) As always in these local Science Fiction reports, the photographs are my work ... MEOW MEOW (which means THE END in Pepitza's native language) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1F1SJ352HTCz2zbAN3KSzcxg6TTo6FzgbbU4tUrwhE2/razmakmalo.jpg) A MONOCHROME JOURNEY THROUGH THE WOODS When I walk around the woods, a thing that I do quite often, the seasonal colors, the greens in spring and summer, the warm palette of the autumn and the winter's dark, washed out browns are always present as the main ingredient of that quiet but intense experience. ![DSC03661 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/j6CcQePA-DSC0366120malo.jpg) It's hard ... or better, practically impossible for me even to imagine the monochrome version of the colored world around me while observing it.

> (Enlargeable) I mean, yes I can vaguely see from experience what subject and composition could look good in black & white, depending on the interplay between colors and lighting, I notice this stuff while photographing, it's not that I just go randomly shooting around hoping that something will turn into acceptable monochromatic post material :D ... but ... ![DSC03610 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/xgWWuwey-DSC0361020malo.jpg) ... only when the pictures are brought from the camera into the PC, my favorite magic machine in the world ... ![DSC07734 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/P0tLLn2U-DSC0773420malo.jpg) ... only then, after a short editing work in Photoshop trying to find the right balance (I mean, right for me and my imagination, I'm not talking about some universal perfectionist value) of shades and contrast ... I can finally enter the strange and beautiful world of Black, White & some stuff in between ... ![DSC04473 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/CU5MRIKp-DSC0447320malo.jpg) ... that sometimes looks even more real ... ![DSC04476 samo MALO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/1UHNqHt0-DSC0447620samo20MALO.jpg) ... or other times - just surreal ... ![DSC03615 samoMALO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/mepgxpdI-DSC0361520samoMALO.jpg) ... but always, to me at least ... I don't know ... kind of more lucid ... more \

than the colored version, seen unedited, directly through my own eyes. 

![DSC03829 MALO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/OBQiIkbb-DSC0382920MALO.jpg)

And now :D after these slightly convoluted and vaguely artsy - philosophic lines ...

![DSC03669 samoMALO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/viguRmcz-DSC0366920samoMALO.jpg)

... is time to present Bepina, my companion on this walk.

![DSC03637 samo MALO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/Mt4BZJwT-DSC0363720samo20MALO.jpg)

As you can see, Bepina is a small dog ...

![DSC03662 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/OBXXo535-DSC0366220malo.jpg)

... that feels very comfortable in big woods ... always busy thoroughly, and quite competently, sniffing around.

![DSC03636 samo malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/TgNtRfiT-DSC0363620samo20malo.jpg)

There is one more thing I would like to tell you about my old friend Bepina, and I'll let the following picture do all the talking, there will be no usual text under the picture.

![DSC03635 krop i tekst.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/z9QcIU4h-DSC0363520krop20i20tekst.jpg)

(....... the most complete silence ......)

![DSC03635 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/xojVjs5P-DSC0363520malo.jpg)

Do you see now how the pictures can talk in a quite articulate manner ?

![IMG_7027 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/UjT6hYRG-IMG_702720malo.jpg)

And with this I said all I was prepared to say in the post ... the rest will be pure improvisation ...

![DSC03903 MALO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/pbimmgAF-DSC0390320MALO.jpg)

... a collection of monochromatic memories from deep within the forest of my perception, accompanied by stuff that I can remember about these shots ... or very simple and banal information about what is on the photograph.

![IMG_3245 CB malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/CUvXKUVo-IMG_324520CB20malo.jpg)

Fairly funny stuff, like these small flowers that look exactly like a toothbrush ... some kind of misplaced bathroom mimicry aimed at human pollinators ...

![DSC03640 malo samoMALO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/vLaaReH6-DSC0364020malo20samoMALO.jpg)

... slightly creepy stuff, like this Carrion beetle (Phosphuga atrata) feeding on a dead cricket ...

 <a href=\

> (Enlargeable) ... or seriously elegant stuff, like this small, translucent mushroom beauty. ![DSC03629 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/JZFtagzH-DSC0362920malo.jpg) You'll see also quite a few more generic shots ... like this one ... ![DSC03634 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/avFTHLHM-DSC0363420malo.jpg) ... just wide views on trees and stuff ... yes, more trees than anything else, I admit. I'll try to regularly break the boring flow of this kind of pictures ... ![IMG_2525 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/WL2wVWM3-IMG_252520malo.jpg) ... with the occasional flower ... ![DSC03673 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/zrNkxc8r-DSC0367320malo.jpg) ... or ... ![IMG_6564 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/CMgWYSdB-IMG_656420malo.jpg) ... some others interesting natural architectures. ![DSC03617 samoMALO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/Ji6zCRlm-DSC0361720samoMALO.jpg) A look at the woods ...

> (Enlargeable) ... a look at some detail ... ![DSC03644 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/U0jl7Zg8-DSC0364420malo.jpg) ... a look at the woods ... ![P1810502 samoMALO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/HKlVYJtN-P181050220samoMALO.jpg) ... a look at some detail ... ![DSC03650 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/rdz3q4jl-DSC0365020malo.jpg) ... a look at the woods ...

> (Enlargeable) ... a look at some detail ... ![DSC03631 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/3bQMmNAV-DSC0363120malo.jpg) ... a look at the woods ... ![IMG_4897 CB malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/AvAGB1se-IMG_489720CB20malo.jpg) ... a look at some detail ... ![DSC03657 CB malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/5N4lsCQl-DSC0365720CB20malo.jpg) ... until this becomes a pattern ...

> (Enlargeable) ... a rhythm of this scroll. ![DSC03897 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/ne8Srwcc-DSC0389720malo.jpg) As always in these posts on HIVE ... ![DSC07737 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/FbcMl4sc-DSC0773720malo.jpg) ... all the photographs are my work - THE END. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1F1SJ352HTCz2zbAN3KSzcxg6TTo6FzgbbU4tUrwhE2/razmakmalo.jpg) MONOCHROMATIC TRIP ON A WINDY DAY I took these photographs about two weeks ago.

> (Enlargeable) I was in the small port of the small village called Liznjan, and as sometimes happens in summer, a strong wind started to blow, pretty suddenly. ![IMG_2545 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/sLC4GwBm-IMG_254520malo.jpg) This port is situated in a large, shallow and very well sheltered lagoon, so although the wind was strong and very refreshing ... ![IMG_2544 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/SGtQ1Aij-IMG_254420malo.jpg) ... the waves weren't particularly big.

> (Enlargeable) The sky was at first mostly clear and blue ... but there were some small sporadic clouds too ... and dark clouds faraway on the horizon so from time to time the intensity of light was shifting, creating some cool photogenic atmosphere. He, he ... hope you don't mind this short colored interlude in between black & white shots. It's here only to accentuate the elegance and artsy qualities of the monochrome stuff. There is this little park, with playground for children, near the fishing and fishermen stuff, and it has some kind of surreal and cinematic feel when no one is there. ![IMG_2550 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/H2sUuMJv-IMG_255020malo.jpg) Here is a monochrome look at the playground ... and on the following photograph ... ![IMG_2548 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/1JbhtKju-IMG_254820malo.jpg) ... a similar look at the quiet, resting angle of the park ... with the typical bench. ![IMG_2635 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/WMzpDTDE-IMG_263520malo.jpg) While sniffing around the port I found some dried out corals near the fishing nets. ![IMG_2647 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/48STF0My-IMG_264720malo.jpg) A lovely structure that looks very good in black & white.
> (Enlargeable) This angle with a large table among the storage shacks for various fishing and boat repairing equipment, was also pretty photogenic ... so I took a few shots there.

> (Enlargeable) As the dark clouds were approaching from the horizon, the atmosphere got much darker and dramatic ... but then I had to go home, so I have only this one cloudy shot to show you here ... and with the following, closing shot ...

> ... with some color in it ... the post is ready to end - THE END. As always in these posts on HIVE, the photographs are my work. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1F1SJ352HTCz2zbAN3KSzcxg6TTo6FzgbbU4tUrwhE2/razmakmalo.jpg) SUMMER MEADOWS IN BLACK & WHITE The grass is tall and dry on the meadows near the sea ... ![DSC00119 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/hVaTJ7p4-DSC0011920malo.jpg) ... and that dense intricate vegetation, besides providing food & shelter for many small arthropods ... ![IMG_0736 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/iDcgauY9-IMG_073620malo.jpg) ... is also able to provide some pretty cool shapes and textures for black & white photography. ![0057 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/TCl57O1J-005720malo.jpg) I spend a lot of my free time in this habitat lately, taking photographs. Usually I publish them in colors, in the form of short documentary blogs ... ![0075 CB malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/s8XRWPlO-007520CB20malo.jpg) ... but sometimes, some desaturation :) is what it takes to show the elegance of life on this planet. ![DSC00270 CB malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/CjnVDzZS-DSC0027020CB20malo.jpg) And so, I put together this short, monochrome look at the coastal meadows. ![4626 CB malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/rcLKavCM-462620CB20malo.jpg) As always in these posts on HIVE, the photographs are my work. ![IMG_0735 malo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/borjan/B1ml3DLu-IMG_073520malo.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1F1SJ352HTCz2zbAN3KSzcxg6TTo6FzgbbU4tUrwhE2/razmakmalo.jpg) A FOUR NOTES PHOTOGRAPHIC NOCTURNE FOR A SMALL COMPACT CAMERA IN THE COLD WINTER NIGHT DO YOU SEE ME ? ... I mean right now ... Hm ... let's see ... ![noccetvero4 CB MALO.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbhysodjh4jv7Ypcq2a6mKBE7PNFcqiLqAKV8GnDmBh8W/noccetvero4%20CB%20MALO.jpg) ... if the title will end up to be longer than the actual post :D He,he ... it had good chances, but I ended up slightly more talky than I thought I would be after a long day under the strong sun. These obscure winter images gave me a nice counterbalance and a healthy dose of darkness, so I'm kind of renewed now ... and ready to prepare some longer, more elaborate, flora & fauna oriented post for tomorrow. If I knew the English language better, maybe I will throw even some poetry attempt in this mix, because the grainy photographs look like an attempt at some kind of visual poetry and a bunch of elegant words could nicely complement the whole thing. Interesting how the winter now looks like a distant memory, something that happened a few decades ago ... and maybe to someone else. As always in these ramblings on HIVE, the photographs are my work. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1F1SJ352HTCz2zbAN3KSzcxg6TTo6FzgbbU4tUrwhE2/razmakmalo.jpg) A MONOCHROME DAY ON THE BEACH It was a warm and exuberant day at the end of summer, filled with many wonders ... ![IMG_8572 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPfg8aLYhpYj77mWidEuhj8mJ2k1CyM5DNfyfh4XFdjES/IMG_8572%20malo.jpg) ... but lacking the colors. ![P1860929 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRpuiwr7pxgf9Q2kuCeG9uNaLwC1kqWz3kTxb2C8KNq1b/P1860929%20malo.jpg) I was rambling along the coastline ... ![DSC00181 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmerK7zEGzibECwrmHEZ8zfo6o9muFzPqizTqigok39NSg/DSC00181%20malo.jpg) ... from my hometown's port ... calm and sheltered in the large shallow bay ... ![P1860090 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmawDzDx3xpijshu139vbMcXcZj8pwDeMaYKyr8YCQE2VF/P1860090%20malo.jpg) ... to the rocky shore and great, open views near one of the neighboring smaller villages. ![DSC09962 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZvNvW4Qj71Hi8JsAncHdGBhuEuxw73nq144oSXDyQqaf/DSC09962%20malo.jpg) I stopped for an hour or so, to snorkel a bit ... ![P1840608 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQFbNTpyBa8jRARYgkfT2JsnTd5iTJY8mmYRD6RkRJj7S/P1840608%20malo.jpg) ... in one of those inlets. Some trees were in bloom ...

>(Enlargeable) ... and the sea has deposited a tick layer of underwater vegetation ... ![P1840600 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTmMtwLjsSBc1dDPkuVV2ji61vQvJRCnWtJCE684NY7Zk/P1840600%20malo.jpg) ... complete with some elegant shells. ![P1860908 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQYEoZ5sbwFyV87jmtfFzk2sjkCDt2FzP3H1LvSYNpGU6/P1860908%20malo.jpg) Later in the day ... ![P1860110 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZsanQoUpsCkcM195c6goibbduJdHdm5Hq4ewp3njBXiv/P1860110%20malo.jpg) ... I visited another little bay ... ![DSC04340 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSHQ1zaGpQfg62Sx6cdEUqcSTctC7b7tsMuG3PQy9akG/DSC04340%20malo.jpg) ... with few boats anchored there ... ![DSC04501 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXPJiRQmjbeczZJHSkZS3TrHznUMnJVMWiyN2epLktD8W/DSC04501%20malo.jpg) ... and the Black-headed gull swimming around. It's a pretty rare seagull species in this area, dominated by other type of seagulls. ![DSC06452 malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTFawsdhjTSRYv3py8pZSMH9XpzVmnAxJ3FNwo4oDR1BC/DSC06452%20malo.jpg) After a bit of swimming I continued my barefoot walk, following the dusty narrow path near the sea ... and at one point ... ![DSC01007 CB malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZnC76MFpasayFNRYcAgAmU8LaL5PC99rZjMdmsEnERFU/DSC01007%20CB%20malo.jpg) ... I came across some house built with stones ... it looked like some small mythical or fairy tell humanoids will come out of there. This is actually a pretty precise replica of a traditional stone building used in this area since Neolithic, first as homes ... and in later periods, including pretty recent times up to the end of WW 2, were built as shelters from bad weather and for tool storage at the edge of the cultivated fields surrounded by stones picked from those fields to make place for relatively fertile and workable area. Someone did a pretty good job with this construction. When I was ready to go to my car and return home ... ![DSC01007 colorCROP malo.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeieNK6yUWjW5y36NmnmesLYPcGVAPR98rbeyhmiq1Qoc/DSC01007%20colorCROP%20malo.jpg) ... the colors somehow reappeared ... and I think, this is a good moment to end this monochromatic post. As always in these posts on HIVE, all the photographs are my work. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1F1SJ352HTCz2zbAN3KSzcxg6TTo6FzgbbU4tUrwhE2/razmakmalo.jpg) THE AGRICULTURAL FASHION ART There is a pretty big cabbage production, present in the coastal fields around the village called Liznjan, on the Istra peninsula at the northern end of the Adriatic Sea in Croatia, not far from the town that goes by the name of Medulin and in which I live. Besides the large cabbage fields there are vast areas covered with meadows and Mediterranean bush. I spend a lot of time there, photographing plants, insects, other small arthropods and the landscape in general ... generally concentrated on exploring the wilder parts of this place, avoiding the cultivated fields. But sometimes ... ![DSC07954 malo.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdLJ5hryAC7ah87xashsHJJLo4NVyDh3NUuAesyFGBB58/DSC07954%20malo.jpg) ... when I'm in good company willing to be photographed, I like to use those large fields, especially when they are just plowed and empty, to create a few shots in that slightly surreal atmosphere. ![DSC07985 malo.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmNsNNwF2G6aEe1m4jTpCjLvKz5oxfkyYQ87RsecNZZ2L1/DSC07985%20malo.jpg) The emptiness of the setting ... ![DSC07959 CB malo.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmT1pPUVqMXfarvY4Tz7VyRTgWUeyZRsTAqzSgPryLXV4k/DSC07959%20CB%20malo.jpg) ... the vagueness ... ![DSC07965 malo CB.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdAz4ZttZVeQ5URQwKdhNhr6iqAbMpedHeE8QfWxJRt5V/DSC07965%20malo%20CB.jpg) ... and scarcity ... ![DSC08000 CB malo.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmQST8sMaJGKCnmMrKpqHq8GDdZW6WtyFytmmvauYqSGhp/DSC08000%20CB%20malo.jpg) ... of clear connotations ... ![DSC07978 CB malo.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmVJ97MnDBzaXm17TqYdJKK5ZQK7ytmGeZTVKv6dMCRuJe/DSC07978%20CB%20malo.jpg) ... makes it easier to turn the landscape into a dreamscape ... or some sort of metaphysical place. ![DSC07827 malo.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmb45wzRPo87rMjtZAUUVJorNJrGS8PigkrP8JCWoDNv6A/DSC07827%20malo.jpg) And also ... without other distractions in the frame ... in that place that looks like something that you get if you give Salvador Dali a tractor and say :\

title.title: The humanoid robot that feels.
title.body:
> As companies compete to build the fastest, strongest robot, one Chinese company decided to attack a much more difficult problem: making a machine feel. The Senzen-based Kinetic AI company announced the humanoid Kai, a life-sized robot with a level of sensitivity and control that is beginning to approach the human body and the numbers are impressive.


There are 115 degrees of freedom of which 72 are in the hands alone, well above the average for most current humanoid robos, but what really changes the game is on the surface. Kai is covered in a synthetic skin equipped with 18,000 touch sensors capable of detecting extremely light forces in the range of 0.1 N., translated, it can perceive contact with sufficient precision to manipulate fragile objects and safely interact with people.


The hands, for example, combine active joints for precise control with passive joints that function as natural shock absorbers. This allows robots to physically adapt to the object even before the computational processing takes effect. It is as if part of the intelligence were in the body itself and that is strategic because it reduces response time and increases safety in unpredictable environments.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nr4-8ADt2e0
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> Kai can also carry up to 20 kg, operate for about 4 hours and reach a speed of up to 5 km/h, figures that already place robots in a functional zone for real tasks, but the most important detail is in the brain, Kinetic AI developed a system based on a world model where the robot not only reacts, but also predicts.


Before executing an action, simulate possible results, evaluate scenarios and Only then does it decide the movement, to train this behavior, the company created the Kai Halo, a wearable device that collects real human data, first-person vision, movements, interaction with objects, that is, the robot learns by watching humans live and that explains the ambition of the project.


Kai was not created for heavy industry, it was designed for services, retail and home environments, tasks like organizing products, folding clothes, carrying objects and even performing extremely delicate movements like threading a needle. Production of more is planned for the end of 2026 with an estimated price below $40,000.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png


Sorry for my Ingles, it's not my main language. The images were taken from the sources used or were created with artificial intelligence

title.title: Fish recipe made with beans and potatoes/Receta de pescado con judías y patatas[ENG/SPA]
title.body:
![4b4056ee-19ec-4543-8740-ca425fe376fe.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQx9z5TVDG9SghnsgJMwy5td3w6dj2ayipvsZr7R6jaVR/4b4056ee-19ec-4543-8740-ca425fe376fe.jpg)


Friends, how are you? I hope you are all well, and I am also well. Alhamdulillah, Today I have come to you with a great recipe. I am going to tell you about a healthier, much more fun recipe. Let's start by explaining in detail how to make this a fun and delicious recipe.

Horn fish
 onion
 green pepper
 bay leaf
potato
 beans
salt
 turmeric powder
dry chili powder
cumin powder
 Whiteoil

To prepare today's dish, first I boiled the potatoes well, peeled them, and chopped them up a bit, and along with that, I peeled the beans well.

![1a3a08f8-8d51-4fd2-89e5-e11b63035087.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT2aQMVG9JV6nFqTV26WwnzC5AvigXiMokmon6ErY7msu/1a3a08f8-8d51-4fd2-89e5-e11b63035087.jpg)

Then I will put a clean pot on the stove and add finely chopped onion and bay leaf.

![b6a9a1b7-34df-45c0-a8ea-67e3bfa0847f.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZrurF9U3bokwGBTMbKnbmbLu8ehywUft7W1n2niqP9EG/b6a9a1b7-34df-45c0-a8ea-67e3bfa0847f.jpg)

Then, when the onions are slightly hot, I add a little oil and fry the onions until they turn brown.

![1b605ea0-d53a-44e0-af54-ce399dff55af.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS5jKFJsyA95N6FLuwDwEejDZxDjNA9K2aH2kKkFheiGb/1b605ea0-d53a-44e0-af54-ce399dff55af.jpg)

Then, here I will add a little water when the onions are browned, and here I will add all the spices, ginger, and garlic paste.

<div class=\

> ![c6677f8c-ea3b-48dc-b58e-f0cc80c0c414.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma6aR8beDvEfT5sNsYvi6HNnRRvXtAk5rCjcd6sVchJLL/c6677f8c-ea3b-48dc-b58e-f0cc80c0c414.jpg) Then I'll put a few pieces of a whole garlic clove here. ![acfddcbe-a781-4d5e-b0c2-07b031bad10e.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmebKGeFyP7AYiucTyb82NWnyF3cSYySWipWbQv8XKWbYM/acfddcbe-a781-4d5e-b0c2-07b031bad10e.jpg) Then take some time to grind all the spices well and wait until the oil comes out on top. ![f8622498-3688-427a-8ea2-6be6d4dade6d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYrGuExijPeUuzPbmGrPLMqkt6vFWj3qVUerAGNGd8ykX/f8622498-3688-427a-8ea2-6be6d4dade6d.jpg) Once the spices are ground, I will add the cut and washed horn fish here. ![7e8c676e-5e3f-4340-bddf-cb65cef24d12.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT4FA43Btox5uXSCxTvLj5a95W4TJvNCavjtjYTkcz9iZ/7e8c676e-5e3f-4340-bddf-cb65cef24d12.jpg) I will boil it with a little water for about five minutes and then take it out in a bowl. ![d343cb61-5171-470c-be65-e69d94ca561e.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQmjxFnF4jteeGpFhZSKUYQkWXTGymBG7oAe2pfTV6BWt/d343cb61-5171-470c-be65-e69d94ca561e.jpg) Then, in the same pan, add a little oil again. I will give potato and mix it well with the spices. ![b2ebc6a1-8622-4739-805f-45a48fcdf84a.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZV8NHZGXKmDrEKBr2fGMuL3arEvqcvgwHQaGC6xK2NuU/b2ebc6a1-8622-4739-805f-45a48fcdf84a.jpg) Then add a little water and cover it with a lid for 5 minutes.

> ![44eb9b01-fb56-462f-9b39-e2f8dd1f9dc6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYSqG5aFpApDpuAXU2T8v7gNtageJreBfVuxgibrMCnt2/44eb9b01-fb56-462f-9b39-e2f8dd1f9dc6.jpg) After five minutes, I will lift the lid and add the fish that I prepared earlier. ![cd78524a-e6ff-4905-940d-68190111b617.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR5Esx4iVFUf7YwnipeFou37V8GxuJRgLHWJJ7FP93sN4/cd78524a-e6ff-4905-940d-68190111b617.jpg) Then let the fish and potatoes cook well for a few more minutes. Then my cooking is almost finished, and here I will give water and sprinkle the fried dhuna cumin seeds on top. ![fe8b9530-0b44-4cc1-809d-70fdcbf9671b.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeqrkMu2dbWBEpbgn51LFYJfQs5DF5ybmnAYb5TAX9a4f/fe8b9530-0b44-4cc1-809d-70fdcbf9671b.jpg) Then wait a while, and my cooking will be complete, and I will take the pan off the stove. ![c35a6102-8722-4e64-b144-e6d2bedb013d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQrR3ouEgsCzPvpy3iYW1iX7qjT8Sk2fcbp8YLTuFN2xD/c35a6102-8722-4e64-b144-e6d2bedb013d.jpg) Now the question is again about fish recipes and for serving it, it can be served in a bowl with a generous amount of curry potatoes and a few pieces of fish.

> ![3981353c-5a96-4e0b-bf32-2c007eec7262.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXJimKmkHHpjZ1mYBtt7UL7UirWVz2B57vbuWzbiRVcus/3981353c-5a96-4e0b-bf32-2c007eec7262.jpg) ![a2c5e6ca-ebd4-4a25-ae46-d7a60a1f9185.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZqBrViHUgQhze8C2zCPayXYdLoEAMws58NDmwbaXLLdq/a2c5e6ca-ebd4-4a25-ae46-d7a60a1f9185.jpg) ![b1029df8-13d3-4bd5-bfb2-aa2fb957f4d7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNQUTkF89UPcjM6tvqTRXoVafDF2jos9f436gcqdJBdAm/b1029df8-13d3-4bd5-bfb2-aa2fb957f4d7.jpg) Friends, this recipe is very delicious and fun to make, but it doesn't require many ingredients and can be prepared in a short time. I hope you like it. I will definitely see you again for new posts. May Allah protect you. Stay well and healthy. May Allah protect you. Translation Spanish ![4b4056ee-19ec-4543-8740-ca425fe376fe.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQx9z5TVDG9SghnsgJMwy5td3w6dj2ayipvsZr7R6jaVR/4b4056ee-19ec-4543-8740-ca425fe376fe.jpg) Amigos, ¿cómo están? Espero que estén todos bien, yo también. Alhamdulillah, hoy les traigo una receta estupenda. Les voy a contar una receta más saludable y mucho más divertida. Empecemos explicando en detalle cómo preparar esta receta divertida y deliciosa. Pescado cuerno Cebolla Pimiento verde Hoja de laurel Patata Judías verdes Sal Cúrcuma en polvo Chile en polvo Comino en polvo Aceite blanco Para preparar el plato de hoy, primero cocí bien las patatas, las pelé y las troceé un poco. Además, pelé bien las judías verdes. ![1a3a08f8-8d51-4fd2-89e5-e11b63035087.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT2aQMVG9JV6nFqTV26WwnzC5AvigXiMokmon6ErY7msu/1a3a08f8-8d51-4fd2-89e5-e11b63035087.jpg) Luego pondré una olla limpia al fuego y añadiré la cebolla y la hoja de laurel finamente picadas. ![b6a9a1b7-34df-45c0-a8ea-67e3bfa0847f.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZrurF9U3bokwGBTMbKnbmbLu8ehywUft7W1n2niqP9EG/b6a9a1b7-34df-45c0-a8ea-67e3bfa0847f.jpg) Luego, cuando las cebollas estén ligeramente calientes, añado un poco de aceite y las frío hasta que se doren. ![1b605ea0-d53a-44e0-af54-ce399dff55af.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS5jKFJsyA95N6FLuwDwEejDZxDjNA9K2aH2kKkFheiGb/1b605ea0-d53a-44e0-af54-ce399dff55af.jpg) Luego, cuando las cebollas estén doradas, añadiré un poco de agua y, a continuación, todas las especias, el jengibre y la pasta de ajo.

> ![c6677f8c-ea3b-48dc-b58e-f0cc80c0c414.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma6aR8beDvEfT5sNsYvi6HNnRRvXtAk5rCjcd6sVchJLL/c6677f8c-ea3b-48dc-b58e-f0cc80c0c414.jpg) Luego pondré aquí unos trocitos de un diente de ajo entero. ![acfddcbe-a781-4d5e-b0c2-07b031bad10e.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmebKGeFyP7AYiucTyb82NWnyF3cSYySWipWbQv8XKWbYM/acfddcbe-a781-4d5e-b0c2-07b031bad10e.jpg) Luego, muele bien todas las especias y espera a que el aceite suba a la superficie. ![f8622498-3688-427a-8ea2-6be6d4dade6d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYrGuExijPeUuzPbmGrPLMqkt6vFWj3qVUerAGNGd8ykX/f8622498-3688-427a-8ea2-6be6d4dade6d.jpg) Una vez molidas las especias, añadiré aquí el pez cuerno cortado y lavado. ![7e8c676e-5e3f-4340-bddf-cb65cef24d12.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT4FA43Btox5uXSCxTvLj5a95W4TJvNCavjtjYTkcz9iZ/7e8c676e-5e3f-4340-bddf-cb65cef24d12.jpg) Lo herviré con un poco de agua durante unos cinco minutos y luego lo sacaré a un tazón. ![d343cb61-5171-470c-be65-e69d94ca561e.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQmjxFnF4jteeGpFhZSKUYQkWXTGymBG7oAe2pfTV6BWt/d343cb61-5171-470c-be65-e69d94ca561e.jpg) Luego, en la misma sartén, añade un poco más de aceite. Agrega la papa y mézclala bien con las especias. ![b2ebc6a1-8622-4739-805f-45a48fcdf84a.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZV8NHZGXKmDrEKBr2fGMuL3arEvqcvgwHQaGC6xK2NuU/b2ebc6a1-8622-4739-805f-45a48fcdf84a.jpg) Luego, añade un poco de agua y cúbrelo con una tapa durante 5 minutos.

> ![44eb9b01-fb56-462f-9b39-e2f8dd1f9dc6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYSqG5aFpApDpuAXU2T8v7gNtageJreBfVuxgibrMCnt2/44eb9b01-fb56-462f-9b39-e2f8dd1f9dc6.jpg) Después de cinco minutos, levantaré la tapa y añadiré el pescado que preparé anteriormente. ![cd78524a-e6ff-4905-940d-68190111b617.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR5Esx4iVFUf7YwnipeFou37V8GxuJRgLHWJJ7FP93sN4/cd78524a-e6ff-4905-940d-68190111b617.jpg) Luego, deja que el pescado y las patatas se cocinen bien durante unos minutos más. Ya casi he terminado de cocinar, así que añadiré agua y espolvorearé las semillas de comino dhuna fritas por encima. ![fe8b9530-0b44-4cc1-809d-70fdcbf9671b.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeqrkMu2dbWBEpbgn51LFYJfQs5DF5ybmnAYb5TAX9a4f/fe8b9530-0b44-4cc1-809d-70fdcbf9671b.jpg) Luego, espera un rato y terminaré de cocinar; retiraré la sartén del fuego. ![c35a6102-8722-4e64-b144-e6d2bedb013d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQrR3ouEgsCzPvpy3iYW1iX7qjT8Sk2fcbp8YLTuFN2xD/c35a6102-8722-4e64-b144-e6d2bedb013d.jpg) Ahora bien, la pregunta vuelve a ser sobre recetas de pescado y cómo servirlo. Se puede servir en un bol con una generosa cantidad de patatas al curry y unos trozos de pescado.
