title.title: Maestra de Música, Aprendiz del Escenario|Music Teacher, Stage Apprentice.
title.body:
> Estos días me he ido preparando paso a paso para un recital que tengo el día de mañana. Aún no me siento totalmente segura, pero tengo que hacerlo. He estudiado mucho; la verdad, me duelen los dedos de ambas manos y, aunque esto no es limitante, es bastante tedioso tratar de estudiar así. Pero, de igual forma, se hizo.
Lately, I’ve been preparing step by step for a recital I have tomorrow. I still don’t feel completely confident, but I have to do it. I’ve practiced a lot; to be honest, my fingers on both hands hurt, and even though that doesn’t stop me, it’s pretty tedious trying to practice like this. But I got it done anyway.
​Mañana voy a presentar dos merengues: uno llamado \

. Si les soy sincera, estos dos temas me encantan. Son piezas que escuchaba desde pequeña pero que, por alguna razón, en aquel momento no pude cantar. Actualmente tampoco puedo debido a mi disfonía, aunque una que otra vez, en medio del estudio, las tarareo; eso me ayuda a encontrarle un poco más de sentido, o a colocarle un poco más de sabor e intención a lo que estoy tocando.
Tomorrow I’m going to perform two merengue songs: one called “La negra ATilia” and another called “Presagio.” To be honest, I absolutely love these two songs. They’re songs I’ve been listening to since I was a little girl, but for some reason, I couldn’t sing them back then. I still can’t sing them now because of my dysphonia, although every once in a while, while I’m in the studio, I hum them to myself; that helps me find a little more meaning in them, or add a little more flavor and intention to what I’m playing.
​Lo cierto es que los recitales me dan mucha pena y nervios, a pesar de que soy profesora de música. Esos nervios nunca se van, y pienso que el día que un artista no los sienta, hasta ese día debe trabajar en este mundo, porque ese impulso es lo que te hace ser mejor y te demuestra de lo que eres capaz. Sin embargo, esto no quita el hecho de que a veces los nervios me traicionan.
The truth is, recitals make me feel really anxious and nervous, even though I’m a music teacher. That nervousness never goes away, and I think that as long as an artist still feels it, they should keep working in this field—because that drive is what makes you better and shows you what you’re capable of. However, that doesn’t change the fact that sometimes my nerves get the better of me.
​El día de hoy aproveché un rato libre en el trabajo para estudiar. Parece mentira, pero cuando llego a casa luego de la jornada me ocupo en millones de cosas y ya no puedo dedicarle tanto tiempo al instrumento. ¡Deséenme suerte para mañana y, sobre todo, mucha serenidad!
Today I took advantage of some free time at work to practice. It seems unbelievable, but when I get home after work, I find myself caught up in a million things and can’t devote as much time to my instrument anymore. Wish me luck for tomorrow—and, above all, lots of calm!

title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![stXRj9q3bI8FLu93_IMG_9453.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/stXRj9q3bI8FLu93_IMG_9453/stXRj9q3bI8FLu93_IMG_9453.webp)
![Z00EOiCy4SJXmYsB_IMG_9468.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/Z00EOiCy4SJXmYsB_IMG_9468/Z00EOiCy4SJXmYsB_IMG_9468.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近自己的中奖体质又上线了。

一开始我压根不知道京东还有发票抽奖的活动，还是哥哥提醒我才了解到，不光是京东平台的发票可以参与抽奖，其他平台的电子发票、就连线下的实体发票，只要拍照上传，发票抬头和本人姓名一致，就能参与抽奖，门槛特别低。

我第一次试着抽，就直接中了120元，运气开门红。哥哥还跟我说，他同事第一次参与就抽中了800元，听得我好羡慕。后来我也把这个福利分享给了身边的同事，大家参与之后，也陆陆续续抽到了奖，少的中10，多的也有中100元的。

本来我还以为自己过往的订单发票快用完了，没什么抽奖机会了，意外发现京东还能一键换开发票，可以把前后的订单合并，重新开具新发票，靠着这个方法，就能反复参与抽奖。

就这样断断续续抽了一段时间，累计下来居然中了四百多块奖金，最让我惊喜的是今天早上，等红绿灯的时候随手点开抽了一下，直接中了迄今为止最大的200元大奖，哈哈哈！

这个活动的奖金，有的可以立刻到账，有的需要等待十个工作日核验完成。只要奖金进到京东钱包，一键提现就能秒到银行卡，妥妥白捡福利。

同事都忍不住感慨，说我运气太好，前段时间我在直播间留言刷屏，也总是很容易中奖。反观带我的哥哥，一次都没中过，有点惨🤭

不得不说，频频中奖的感觉真好，我都开始琢磨，是不是可以去试试买彩票，说不定也能收获意外惊喜呢！

title.title: Planchas Dinámicas [Esp/Eng]
title.body:
>

Planchas Dinámicas. Las planchas son conocidas por fortalecer y desarrollar todo el cuerpo de manera integral. Ahora; al proponer variantes, donde el cuerpo debe estar en constante acción; hace que mejore un mundo la estabilidad, la cordinación y que se queme más calorías que de la forma tradicional. Por otra parte; al mantenerse activo de forma dinámica, se trabajan los miembros del tren superior, abdomen y tren inferior. La idea es que todo el cuerpo se fortalezca y así estemos en condiciones óptimas para realizar cualquier actividad física. Que nadie se quede atrás, vente conmigo y dale movimiento a tu vida. >Dynamic Planks. Planks are known for strengthening and developing the entire body in a comprehensive way. Now, by introducing variations that keep the body in constant motion, stability and coordination improve significantly, and more calories are burned than with the traditional form. On the other hand, by staying dynamically active, you work your upper body, core, and lower body. The idea is to strengthen the entire body so that we’re in optimal condition to perform any physical activity. Don’t let anyone fall behind come with me and get your life moving.

![1000458384.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKAqSZgFYZkrftiv9prY9X4w7KQ1uN4TYYgqFtWi39G3sfZtY5BsqcfHQqfwMpq.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **PIES AL FRENTE EN SALTO CON CRUCE DE BRAZOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados, con brazos al frente formando una X. >[**Warm-up 1**, **FEET TOGETHER WITH CROSSED ARMS**]() >[Posture]() >Legs hip-width apart; elbows bent, arms out in front forming an X.
![1000458248.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKU3vVwXBcFNPofCynMEEGxffyS9DXeQRcuKw2J1JeawEKNuDp8RmgdbA5h6VdR.gif)
[Ejecución]() A través de pequeños saltos; vamos llevando los pies al frente de forma alterna. Al mismo tiempo, los codos van hacia atrás y luego al frente cruzando los brazos en X. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >Take small jumps, bringing your feet forward one at a time. At the same time, bring your elbows back and then forward, crossing your arms in an X shape. Do this for 3 minutes.
![1000458256.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKU3uJmAG2bQ42BUoYFPvrL7p865ZPzGoaF8E2CqedymPyaDfgZbiKCRBsdihmy.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **ELEVACIÓN DE RODILLAS CON CRUCE DE BRAZOS VERTICAL Y HORIZONTAL**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; brazos a los lados, codos flexionados a nivel de hombros con un brazo en posición vertical y el otro en posición horizontal. >[**Warm-up 2**, **KNEELIFTS WITH VERTICAL AND HORIZONTAL ARM CROSSES**]() >[Posture]() >Legs hip-width apart; arms at your sides, elbows bent at shoulder height, with one arm in a vertical position and the other in a horizontal position.
![1000458258.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKScffcEcB3Sa3tQZojFZmirRn6MmVsJqLwbyJPxvK7yqySy8F8dcV3mvYmztJL.gif)
[Ejecución]() Activación continua en 3 minutos. Vamos elevando las rodillas de forma alterna. Al mismo tiempo pasamos el brazo horizontal, debajo del que está en posición vertical, luego se intercambia la posición de brazos y se realiza la misma acción. >[Execution]() >Continuous exercise for 3 minutes. Alternately lift your knees. At the same time, bring your horizontal arm under the one that is vertical, then switch the position of your arms and repeat the same movement.
![1000458276.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKScffZcqwcg7FkzE98pTVGSWEvazT8Pt3kcEdiNgaKC47cUJJZevTFd3g5auaa.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **RODILLA ADENTRO EN PLANCHA MÁS SALTOS DIRECCIONALES**]() [Postura]() Nos ubicamos en posición de plancha o flexiones, con piernas al ancho de la cadera y brazos al ancho de hombros. >[**Station 1**, **KNEE-TO-CHEST IN PLANK POSITION PLUS DIRECTIONAL JUMPS**]() >[Position]() >Start in a plank or push-up position, with your legs hip-width apart and your arms shoulder-width apart.
![1000458280.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKDha6DPjXQu8gghR95NEg4NsZwoyAj9B9UMERM3uj2B6VgydWwRTHw95wdpkSf.gif)
[Ejecución]() Mientras el tren superior se mantiene en tensión; se fortalecen núcleo y piernas. Para ejecutar el movimiento; en primer lugar, llevamos las rodillas adentro de forma alterna. Luego; salto hacia atrás, salto diagonal, salto atrás y salto diagonal. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >While keeping your upper body engaged, strengthen your core and legs. To perform the movement, first bring your knees in alternately. Then, jump backward, jump diagonally, jump backward, and jump diagonally. 20 repetitions total in 4 sets.
![1000458291.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKDhDkjkmppNA8CFVKfh7nTKhLdj8tPvELqxYeaGg1HaRYJLB6aLfbEVA4PhenK.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **PLANCHA MÁS SENTADILLA EN SALTO Y GOLPE ALTERNO CON MANCUERNA**]() [Postura]() Material; una mancuerna, si no la tienen pueden lanzar los golpes sin ella. Adoptamos posición de flexiones; piernas al ancho de la cadera, una mano en el piso y otra apoyada en la mancuerna. >[**Station 2**, **PLANK WITH SQUAT-TO-JUMP AND ALTERNATING DUMBBELL PUNCHES**]() >[Position]() >Equipment: one dumbbell; if you don't have one, you can perform the punches without it. Assume a push-up position: legs hip-width apart, one hand on the floor and the other resting on the dumbbell.
![1000458295.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK9PZVrzz1CdhNzjH35ATJ7zR69MguEejV5djdGvStR465XoWLdEDHPsR4GUswP.gif)
[Ejecución]() Todo el cuerpo trabajando de forma integral; acción doble en brazos y tren inferior. Ahora; una vez ubicados en la posición indicada, ejecutamos un salto al frente, quedando el cuerpo en posición de sentadilla profunda con apoyo en punta de pies. Rápidamente; elevamos la mancuerna y lanzamos un golpe frontal. Mancuerna al suelo, salto atrás y regresamos a la posición inicial. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >The entire body works in unison; a dual movement involving the arms and lower body. Now, once you’re in the starting position, perform a forward jump, landing in a deep squat with your weight on the balls of your feet. Quickly, lift the dumbbell and throw a front punch. Lower the dumbbell to the floor, jump backward, and return to the starting position. 20 repetitions total, in 4 sets.
![1000458311.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK9PY6Vwr6YSXEDQa8jgwDMCKEtA9aRPLEPrnQwZPty4qHX4gND3fP9omfW1n3D.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **SALTO A LA PARED IDA Y VUELTA MÁS FLEXIONES EN POSTURA DEL OSO**]() [Postura]() Nos ubicamos a espaldas de la pared; manos en el piso y rodillas flexionadas, elevamos un poco la cadera. >[**Station 3**, **WALL JUMP (ROUND TRIP) PLUS PUSH-UPS IN THE BEAR POSITION**]() >[Position]() >Stand with your back to the wall; place your hands on the floor and bend your knees, lifting your hips slightly.
![1000458318.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKGZh78Et5qE5dVMeZuWjqqY4zBBc6uwho2fgNtThYhPrGaQTzk9yTmV2rcrma3.gif)
[Ejecución]() Continuamos con una activación total e integral; ejercicio muy completo. Ubicados en la postura indicada, ejecutamos un salto llevando los pies a pared, tren superior soporta el peso. Regresamos al piso con otro salto y realizamos una flexión. Serían 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >We continue with a full-body, comprehensive workout; a very complete exercise. From the starting position, we jump with our feet against the wall, keeping our upper body stable. We return to the floor with another jump and perform a push-up. The goal is 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000458369.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKF8TTyUDo2mJQwwiVg4W1smba8Vz391ht8feFzzAfYzrdciQRCvTPPGZSaGMPF.gif)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZBBKyy8xPj9Eg1xaRdy6LF8Nh9LYGbgYhtPH4TwqueNU/1778173792630.gif)

title.title: Arepas with double the amount of beets and oats (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> I went back to making beet arepas, but this time I enhanced the flavor by using a higher proportion of the ingredients and adding rolled oats. I wanted to create a new version to bring out more flavor, making the most of the beets’ natural sweetness and color.
![1000114003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xAe44BJoaYncLTUHGy7dXx1AJsjsGByK7XaUTLVcARaFu6sSKnbUFtgF5FAfU65w3dr.png)
## Ingredients: - 3 beets - 100 grams of oat flour - 150 grams of corn flour - 50 grams of rolled oats - 2 tablespoons of wheat flour - 2 cups of water - Salt to taste - Hard white cheese for grating - Oil
![1000113985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wX7QowrHigUzZDJyq8aS1udK8sS9YShFmEHasgYrJ97D8rRcMFSvdToNjeKut3KanjM.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the beets, peeled them, chopped them into pieces, put them in a blender with two cups of water, and blended them thoroughly until I had a deep purple juice.
![1000113988.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xVRXRiCGeYFNum4UB1pYnhwJpYcPZnjsEiKZ4emCZS9FauyzbYU845Rtp2sxJPfxJs4.jpg)
I poured it into a deep bowl, then added the cornmeal and rolled oats, and kneaded it thoroughly. Next, I added the oat flour and wheat flour, which produced a somewhat sticky mixture—very different from the previous batter—indicating that these arepas were enriched with more oats, a very healthy ingredient I really enjoy for breakfast.
![1000113991.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xyXWDnbAZ6pXGTrVW9ACU3icML5cikdT5p325jHAgQbx35g9SK3DzDFA4uYBqPUAqGt.jpg)
This time I didn’t use sugar so as not to mask the natural flavor of the beets, which is very tasty. Next, I shaped the two arepas and placed them on the griddle; the color was quite striking. I even had trouble telling when the arepas were done—I had to check by touch; if they sound like a drum, they’re ready.
![1000113994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMm1uxKhavT93bfGFxk3nogVKYUiPVZ6nPYPTPxFQWgRt6UxZhxFVMyXnJEhqKwECzL.jpg)
Twenty minutes was enough to cook the arepas; I enjoyed them with butter and grated white cheese. This dough turned out great—firm, fluffy, and colorful—plus it’s very healthy thanks to the combination of oats and beets. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Volví a las arepas de remolacha, pero esta vez intensifiqué el sabor utilizando una mayor proporción en los ingredientes y además adicioné avena en hojuelas. Quería realizar una nueva versión para así obtener más sabor, aprovechando el dulzor y el color natural de la remolacha.
![1000114003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xAe44BJoaYncLTUHGy7dXx1AJsjsGByK7XaUTLVcARaFu6sSKnbUFtgF5FAfU65w3dr.png)
## Ingredientes: - 3 remolachas - 100 gramos de harina de avena - 150 gramos de harina de maíz - 50 gramos de avena en hojuelas - 2 cucharadas de harina de trigo - 2 tazas de agua - Sal al gusto - Queso blanco duro para rallar - Aceite
![1000113985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wX7QowrHigUzZDJyq8aS1udK8sS9YShFmEHasgYrJ97D8rRcMFSvdToNjeKut3KanjM.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé las remolachas, retiré las conchas, piqué en pedazos, llevé a la licuadora junto a dos tazas de agua y batí muy bien hasta obtener un jugo de color morado intenso.
![1000113988.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xVRXRiCGeYFNum4UB1pYnhwJpYcPZnjsEiKZ4emCZS9FauyzbYU845Rtp2sxJPfxJs4.jpg)
Lo vacíe en un envase hondo y luego agregué la harina de maíz y las hojuelas de avena, amasé muy bien. Después adicioné la harina de avena y la de trigo, lo que produjo una mezcla un tanto pegostosa, muy distinta a la preparación anterior, lo que era indicio de que estas arepas estaban repotenciadas con más avena, un ingrediente muy saludable que me gusta mucho para desayunar.
![1000113991.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xyXWDnbAZ6pXGTrVW9ACU3icML5cikdT5p325jHAgQbx35g9SK3DzDFA4uYBqPUAqGt.jpg)
Esta vez no usé azúcar para no ocultar el sabor natural de la remolacha, el cual es muy sabroso. Lo siguiente fue armar las dos arepas y colocarlas en el budare, el color era bastante llamativo, incluso me costó darme cuenta cuando las arepas estaban cocidas, lo tuve que confirmar al tacto, si suenan como un tambor es porque están listas.
![1000113994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMm1uxKhavT93bfGFxk3nogVKYUiPVZ6nPYPTPxFQWgRt6UxZhxFVMyXnJEhqKwECzL.jpg)
Veinte minutos fueron suficientes para cocinar las arepas, las disfruté con mantequilla y queso blanco rallado. Esta masa quedó muy buena, compacta, esponjosa y colorida, además de muy saludable por la combinación de avena con remolacha. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title.title: A fascinating morning of educational and cultural encounters, an exhibition, dances, and gastronomy from my Venezuela.
title.body:
>
![GridArt_20260507_213803488.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKDhteuTznPQMBx1RaajH6TgVCWP5xM4vuF26FRFcHE2Upn3MeRhgtc1kHjYXJR.jpg)
Feliz y bendecido jueves para todos mis queridísimos amigos lectores, reciban un cordial saludo lleno de mucha buena vibra especialmente para todos los que hacen vida en esta fascinante comunidad, en esta oportunidad, aprovecho para regalarles otro contenido como parte de las actividades que se desarrollan diariamente en mi sitio de trabajo, fascinante mañana de encuentros pedagógicos y culturales, exposición, bailes y gastronomía de mi Venezuela. Hace algunos días, como parte de las actividades escolares regidas por el calendario escolar y por nuestro ente rector el Ministerio del Poder Popular para la Educación al culminar cada momento educativo específicamente al dar por terminado cada proyecto de aprendizaje corresponde realizar la socialización o encuentro de saberes para realizar el respectivo intercambio de conocimientos por cada grado, donde los niños se realizan en conjunto con su maestra y apoyo de sus padres representantes cumplen con las diferentes actividades como exposiciones referente a las costumbres y tradiciones de nuestro país Venezuela también nos deleitaron y alegraron la mañana con un baile de joropo y estribillo representativo del Oriente de nuestro país. Esa mañana fue muy alegre y significativa, en vista de que los niños estuvieron muy receptivos, resaltando sus participaciones proporcionando el conocimiento adquirido durante el tiempo de ejecución del proyecto de aprendizaje. Durante esa mañana también tuvimos la presencia de los efectivos policiales de la guardia del pueblo, ellos también tuvieron su participación.
![GridArt_20260507_213847759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKF8rUCWgfhuZENWDRbcdWrpioNwUSwE1KokSLHhiKkX3CfwrvYH3D9p9dzetHF.jpg)

title.title: If we believe in ourselves, everything is possible.
title.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/17732711/pexels-photo-17732711.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-person-taking-a-picture-of-themselves-in-a-field-17732711/ ) Many times we cannot believe in ourselves that we can do a certain job or not, many times we think that we can do the job well and then we think that we may not be able to do the job well. In fact, these two kinds of thoughts come to us due to the complete lack of self-confidence. If we can believe in ourselves and have the right knowledge about our abilities, then we will be able to understand in an instant what work will be possible for us and what work will not be possible. If we always have the mentality of doing the right thing and we can stay away from doing bad things, then we will be able to say no to any bad thing and do the right and good thing beautifully. And along with that, if we have a lot of good work skills and we can possess many qualities, can acquire knowledge from different aspects and can acquire skills in different tasks beautifully, then we will be able to take a few moments to decide whether we can do those things or not. If we remove laziness and always engage in different tasks and acquire skills in different tasks, then a different confidence will be born in us and we can do those tasks beautifully. A courage is created in ourselves that is why if someone lets us do those tasks about which we have a lot of ideas, we can do the task beautifully with confidence and can express our skills in front of different people beautifully. To do any task beautifully, we first need to have confidence in ourselves and that confidence comes by acquiring skills in different tasks. On the other hand, there are many who cannot gain confidence in acquiring skills in different tasks, that is, many think that doing or learning this task is not possible for me in any way, this is very wrong and bad thinking is present in some people. If we think that we can learn a task beautifully and can achieve a good look in that task, then we can definitely do it, but if we think that we cannot do any work or we cannot learn a specific task, then we will not be able to acquire skills in that task in any way. In fact, having confidence in ourselves is very necessary for everything. Just as confidence is needed to do a job well, confidence is also needed to learn a job. Even speaking in a meeting or in a large crowd requires confidence. We also need confidence to participate in a discussion within the family or society and to express our decisions or thoughts. Confidence is something that is very important in our lives and is needed in every step of our lives. If we keep thinking right and can do the right thing and are efficient, then speaking with confidence gives us much more importance. Just as confidence can decorate our lives beautifully, our lives can become very messy due to the lack of this confidence, because if we believe in ourselves, we can do many things, we can achieve many skills and even achieve success in life, but if this lack of confidence is seen in us, we will not be able to do any work and will lag behind in life. This confidence within us helps us to improve in life constantly, so we always need to do a lot of good things to increase this confidence and we need to make ourselves more skilled so that we can do various things well without any fear and establish ourselves in a good way. The better we do and the better we acquire skills, the more our confidence will increase and if this confidence increases, our ability to do a lot of good things in life will increase, which will result in a lot of improvement in our life. So if we want to improve in life and achieve success, we must first have confidence in ourselves. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/one-should-never-be-friends-with-an-enemy-kw)

title.title: Officiating Basketball Games in Bang-Bang, Cordova , Cebu .
title.body:
Good day hivers ! Hope you are all doing fine . 
I am just sharing my journey as a basketball referee in a beautiful place of Bang-Bang, Cordova, Cebu . The views in going to the gym are very nice in which beside it are stunning views of the sea and mangroves . 

![1000090087.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/48JdvEEJx5yoLApDksibkQXfeJWDnEppfiEfTswe7jcjdUoipm6zoQuePPYnqfbzz5.jpg)
I was assigned to officiate the basketball league of grab riders there in Bang-Bang Cordova . I was amazed the beauty of the area which is along the seashore with a dense of mangrove forest. Ahead of the gym we can see the  whole view of CCLEX Bridge ( Cebu-Cordova Link Expressway) connecting to Cebu City which is 8.9 km, the longest bridge for the record in the Philippines surpassing the length  of  San Juanico bridge that connects Tacloban and Samar . 

![1000089932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/242DGJpSafbZm3JTKUptFm1kV4hKu5dZJEz9KYcidc8P1CwVP7jLrRDxNL7HoNA3v5Z4U.jpg)

![1000089933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Epxqpj7hemSiSgvsoue35Kykgn6XBvcQLrSnAM4cbttXyBPtcruycrd3uGmGceZT3Bw.jpg)

![1000089934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EpvjtFaWYJwevY8DhGeL9wNdoakXjPRhekG3y39NTZXFesz3iB3JysBhnnZU8kmY3Ao.jpg)

![1000089935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EqNF9FtyQ9uW4p25JEjTuyAzWKHhddNwsq7T4cBMqnB8TemgYhkC2Xoq7e1vbYuhFRU.jpg)

![1000089936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Eq9WAKpjLNyfWLJczVX1RoN2f1SoY3NAqnfYJ95MbdbrEW8Pvm8xVh4vifN7xG8W5j7.jpg)

![1000089937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EpJYdDYdrTDJkNyjtmeVr1ptHecAKd7zDsk7qWsq3K1bCwRmHnD3WToWGzg4FUbh4Ge.jpg)

 I was asking the old resident in that place how they got the name of the place\

. According to the story of the place during ancient time , there was a strong typhoon affected the area . It so happened that the Spanish couple were passed by the area but there were trees bothered in the passage after the typhoon . The Spanish couple were asked  for help to clear the big jackfruit trees . There was this strong man in that place named, Mariano Sumagang. Mariano cleared the area alone and lifting the big jackfruit tree that bothered the pathway . The residents were amazed by his strength including the Spanish Couple . The residents said this in native language, \

meaning ,incredible strength. The Spanish couple were so thankful of that strong man Mariano and name the place , Bangbang in honor of the native resident ,Mariano . 

![1000089940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/23wMMrXhFrzo4sxfzJPM3M7pxpp4haBdVaCqjYRd9XrhtvVZbBEeepxk98GRS3eoRNW2V.jpg)

![1000089946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Eou7GJJttieJbaahjpzPpBF6pwdYhGwiJjhvYxk2MuYnJGb9MmSM8TnE2wDvhWPB9SA.jpg)

The Gym is very airy in which you can feel the cool breeze of the air on both sides . It is very peaceful quiet-place and beside it is their Barangay Hall . 
The grab riders chose this place for their league for it is chief to rent per hour and very refreshing place .
We the referees felt sleepy due to cool breeze upon waiting the players for the next game .   

![1000089963.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EonjXvLyM9VyWhouHM6C6euUwUQfwy3kHRnhW2nG7xe8vQ9WsxzEKjAmnj59QivcbFS.jpg)

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 7 2026
title.body:
​It is officially Thursday, May 7, 2026, and my American journey continues to surprise me in the best ways possible. While I didn't quite reach the 10k mark today, finishing with 8,475 steps feels like a win, especially because today was more about the quality of the journey and the connections I’m making within the Hive community.

​A Small World Moment

​One of the highlights of my day wasn't just the walk itself, but a fascinating interaction I had on my last post. I met a fellow user, @terganftp, who pointed out a hilarious coincidence I just moved from London to North America, and in just a few days, they are heading from North America to London!
​It truly is a small world. We’re basically swapping continents! As someone who just made that trip, I was happy to share some \

(like always carrying a jacket and wearing the most comfortable shoes possible). This is exactly what Actifit and Hive are all about beyond the numbers and the rewards, it’s the friendships and the global stories that make every step more interesting. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4af808dd-1fc0-47ee-815a-99e80c49927c.jpg) ​Today’s Scenic Route ​The weather in Old Bridge remains spectacular. Today’s walk took me past some beautiful local homes. I had to stop and take a photo of one particularly charming house (as seen in my post). With the perfectly cut green grass, the blooming bushes, and the American flag waving proudly in the yard, it felt like a classic scene from a movie. ​There is a sense of pride and order in these neighborhoods that makes walking very therapeutic. I spent most of my active time today between 4:00 PM and 6:00 PM, soaking up the afternoon sun. Even though I was a bit more relaxed today, those 8k steps still represent a good few miles of movement and fresh air. ​Dashboard & Stats Update ​Looking at my Actifit dashboard, I’m seeing steady progress ​Total Steps 8,475 ​AFIT Balance 20,625.101 ​User Rank 38.38 ​Voting Power 99.56% ​I’ve been keeping my boosters active, including the sports gear and water bottles, which continue to provide that extra edge for my AFIT earnings. ​Reflection ​Today taught me that consistency doesn't always have to mean hitting your maximum target every single day. Sometimes, it’s okay to take a slightly shorter route if it means you have more time to engage with your new friends and appreciate the scenery of a new country. ​Tomorrow is Friday, and I’m aiming to get back into the 10k club to finish the work week strong! ​How is your week going? Have you had any small world moments lately? Let me know in the comments!
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@lovlygirl/actifit-lovlygirl-20260508t023703179z)_
